    exact (weightedCappedRoundRobin w cap hw).pos_slotOf j r hvalid
  show ((weightedCappedRoundRobin w cap hw).slotOf i).isSome = true
  rw [hslot]
  rfl

name: Azurite.WeightedCappedRoundRobin.owned_of_exists_lt_roundStart
proof:
:= by
  have hspec := Nat.find_spec h
  have hne : Nat.find h ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0] at hspec
    simp [roundStart] at hspec
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, Nat.find h = t + 1 := ⟨Nat.find h - 1, by omega⟩
  have h1 : ¬i < roundStart w cap t := Nat.find_min h (by omega)
  rw [ht] at hspec
  exact owned_of_round hw (Nat.le_of_not_lt h1) hspec

name: Azurite.weightedCappedRoundRobin_owned_of_none
proof:
:= by
  apply WeightedCappedRoundRobin.owned_of_exists_lt_roundStart hw
  refine ⟨i + 1, ?_⟩
  have hsize : ∀ t, 1 ≤ WeightedCappedRoundRobin.roundSize w cap t := by
    intro t
    calc 1 ≤ w j₀ := hw j₀
      _ = WeightedCappedRoundRobin.contrib w cap t j₀ :=
          (WeightedCappedRoundRobin.contrib_none h).symm
      _ ≤ WeightedCappedRoundRobin.roundSize w cap t :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (fun j' _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j₀)
  calc i < i + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self i
    _ = ∑ _t ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), 1 := by simp
    _ ≤ WeightedCappedRoundRobin.roundStart w cap (i + 1) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun t _ => hsize t

name: Azurite.weightedCappedRoundRobin_valid_of_none
proof:
:=
  fun i _ => weightedCappedRoundRobin_owned_of_none hw h i

name: Azurite.weightedCappedRoundRobin_owned_iff
statement:
theorem weightedCappedRoundRobin_owned_iff {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℕ) (b : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (i : ℕ) :
    (weightedCappedRoundRobin w (fun j => some (b j)) hw).Owned i ↔ i < ∑ j, b j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp h
    obtain ⟨hpos, hvalid⟩ :=
      (weightedCappedRoundRobin w (fun j' => some (b j')) hw).pos_rank i j hj
    have hlt : (weightedCappedRoundRobin w (fun j' => some (b j')) hw).pos j
          ((weightedCappedRoundRobin w (fun j' => some (b j')) hw).rank i)
        < WeightedCappedRoundRobin.roundStart w (fun j' => some (b j'))
          ((weightedCappedRoundRobin w (fun j' => some (b j')) hw).rank i / w j + 1) :=
      WeightedCappedRoundRobin.posFun_lt_roundStart_succ (hw j) hvalid
    rw [hpos] at hlt
    refine Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hlt ?_
    rw [WeightedCappedRoundRobin.roundStart_eq_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j' _ => ?_
    simp only [Option.elim_some]
    exact Nat.min_le_right _ _
  · intro h
    apply WeightedCappedRoundRobin.owned_of_exists_lt_roundStart hw
    refine ⟨∑ j, b j, ?_⟩
    rw [WeightedCappedRoundRobin.roundStart_eq_sum]
    refine Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)
    simp only [Option.elim_some]
    exact Nat.le_min.mpr ⟨Nat.le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum
        (fun j' _ => Nat.zero_le (b j')) (Finset.mem_univ j))
      (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (hw j)), Nat.le_refl _⟩

name: Azurite.weightedCappedRoundRobin_valid_iff
statement:
theorem weightedCappedRoundRobin_valid_iff {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℕ) (b : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (k : ℕ) :
    (weightedCappedRoundRobin w (fun j => some (b j)) hw).Valid k ↔ k < 2 ^ ∑ j, b j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply lt_two_pow_of_testBit_eq_false
    intro i hi
    by_contra hbit
    simp only [Bool.not_eq_false] at hbit
    have := (weightedCappedRoundRobin_owned_iff w b hw i).mp (h i hbit)
    omega
  · intro h i hbit
    rw [weightedCappedRoundRobin_owned_iff]
    have h2 : 2 ^ i ≤ k := Nat.ge_two_pow_of_testBit hbit
    by_contra hge
    have : (2 : ℕ) ^ ∑ j, b j ≤ 2 ^ i := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    omega

name: Azurite.WeightedCappedRoundRobin.contrib_one
statement:
theorem contrib_one (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ) (t : ℕ) (j : Fin m) :
    contrib (fun _ => 1) cap t j
      = if CappedRoundRobin.ActiveIn cap t j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hc : cap j with _ | b
  · rw [contrib_none hc,
      ite_eq_left (show CappedRoundRobin.ActiveIn cap t j from fun b hb => nomatch hc.symm.trans hb)]
  · rw [contrib_some hc]
    show min 1 (b - t * 1) = _
    split_ifs with h
    · have := h b hc; omega
    · have hnb : ¬ t < b := fun hlt => h fun b' hb' => Option.some.inj (hc.symm.trans hb') ▸ hlt
      omega

name: Azurite.WeightedCappedRoundRobin.roundSize_one
statement:
theorem roundSize_one (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ) (t : ℕ) :
    roundSize (fun _ => 1) cap t = CappedRoundRobin.roundSize cap t
proof:
:= by
  unfold roundSize CappedRoundRobin.roundSize
  rw [Finset.card_filter]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => contrib_one cap t j

name: Azurite.WeightedCappedRoundRobin.roundStart_one
statement:
theorem roundStart_one (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ) (t : ℕ) :
    roundStart (fun _ => 1) cap t = CappedRoundRobin.roundStart cap t
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t' _ => roundSize_one cap t'

name: Azurite.WeightedCappedRoundRobin.offsetIn_one
statement:
theorem offsetIn_one (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ) (t : ℕ) (j : Fin m) :
    offsetIn (fun _ => 1) cap t j = CappedRoundRobin.offsetIn cap t j
proof:
:= by
  rw [offsetIn_eq_sum_Ioi, CappedRoundRobin.offsetIn]
  have hset : Finset.univ.filter (fun j' => CappedRoundRobin.ActiveIn cap t j' ∧ j < j')
      = (Finset.Ioi j).filter (CappedRoundRobin.ActiveIn cap t) := by
    ext j'
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_Ioi]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨b, a⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨b, a⟩⟩
  rw [hset, Finset.card_filter]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j' _ => contrib_one cap t j'

name: Azurite.WeightedCappedRoundRobin.posFun_one
statement:
theorem posFun_one (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ) (j : Fin m) (r : ℕ) :
    posFun (fun _ => 1) cap j r = CappedRoundRobin.posFun cap j r
proof:
:= by
  show roundStart (fun _ => 1) cap (r / 1) + offsetIn (fun _ => 1) cap (r / 1) j + r % 1
      = CappedRoundRobin.roundStart cap r + CappedRoundRobin.offsetIn cap r j
  rw [Nat.div_one, Nat.mod_one, Nat.add_zero, roundStart_one, offsetIn_one]

name: Azurite.weightedCappedRoundRobin_one_pos
statement:
theorem weightedCappedRoundRobin_one_pos {m : ℕ} (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ) (j : Fin m)
    (r : ℕ) :
    (weightedCappedRoundRobin (fun _ => 1) cap fun _ => Nat.one_pos).pos j r
      = (cappedRoundRobin cap).pos j r
proof:
:=
  WeightedCappedRoundRobin.posFun_one cap j r

name: Azurite.weightedCappedRoundRobin_one_slotOf
statement:
theorem weightedCappedRoundRobin_one_slotOf {m : ℕ} (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
    (weightedCappedRoundRobin (fun _ => 1) cap fun _ => Nat.one_pos).slotOf i
      = (cappedRoundRobin cap).slotOf i
proof:
:= by
  cases h : (cappedRoundRobin cap).slotOf i with
  | some j =>
    obtain ⟨hpos, hvalid⟩ := (cappedRoundRobin cap).pos_rank i j h
    have hpos' : WeightedCappedRoundRobin.posFun (fun _ => 1) cap j
        ((cappedRoundRobin cap).rank i) = i := by
      rw [WeightedCappedRoundRobin.posFun_one]
      exact hpos
    rw [← hpos']
    exact (weightedCappedRoundRobin (fun _ => 1) cap fun _ => Nat.one_pos).pos_slotOf j
      ((cappedRoundRobin cap).rank i) hvalid
  | none =>
    cases hwc : (weightedCappedRoundRobin (fun _ => 1) cap fun _ => Nat.one_pos).slotOf i with
    | none => rfl
    | some j =>
      obtain ⟨hpos, hvalid⟩ :=
        (weightedCappedRoundRobin (fun _ => 1) cap fun _ => Nat.one_pos).pos_rank i j hwc
      have hpos' : (cappedRoundRobin cap).pos j
          ((weightedCappedRoundRobin (fun _ => 1) cap fun _ => Nat.one_pos).rank i) = i := by
        rw [← weightedCappedRoundRobin_one_pos]
        exact hpos
      have hslot := (cappedRoundRobin cap).pos_slotOf j
        ((weightedCappedRoundRobin (fun _ => 1) cap fun _ => Nat.one_pos).rank i) hvalid
      rw [hpos', h] at hslot
      exact absurd hslot (by simp)

name: Azurite.WeightedCappedRoundRobin.contrib_noneCap
statement:
theorem contrib_noneCap (w : Fin m → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (j : Fin m) :
    contrib w (fun _ => none) t j = w j
proof:
:=
  contrib_none rfl

name: Azurite.WeightedCappedRoundRobin.roundStart_noneCap
statement:
theorem roundStart_noneCap (w : Fin m → ℕ) (t : ℕ) :
    roundStart w (fun _ => none) t = t * ∑ j, w j
proof:
:= by
  unfold roundStart roundSize
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t' _ =>
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => contrib_noneCap w t' j]
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, smul_eq_mul]

name: Azurite.WeightedCappedRoundRobin.offsetIn_noneCap
statement:
theorem offsetIn_noneCap (w : Fin m → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (j : Fin m) :
    offsetIn w (fun _ => none) t j = weightBlockStart w j
proof:
:= by
  rw [offsetIn]
  congr 1
  funext j'
  exact contrib_noneCap w t j'

name: Azurite.WeightedCappedRoundRobin.posFun_noneCap
statement:
theorem posFun_noneCap (w : Fin m → ℕ) (j : Fin m) (r : ℕ) :
    posFun w (fun _ => none) j r = weightedPos w j r
proof:
:= by
  unfold posFun weightedPos
  rw [roundStart_noneCap, offsetIn_noneCap]

name: Azurite.weightedCappedRoundRobin_none_pos
statement:
theorem weightedCappedRoundRobin_none_pos {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (j : Fin m) (r : ℕ) :
    (weightedCappedRoundRobin w (fun _ => none) hw).pos j r
      = (weightedRoundRobin w hm hw).pos j r
proof:
:=
  WeightedCappedRoundRobin.posFun_noneCap w j r

name: Azurite.weightedCappedRoundRobin_none_slotOf
statement:
theorem weightedCappedRoundRobin_none_slotOf {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (i : ℕ) :
    (weightedCappedRoundRobin w (fun _ => none) hw).slotOf i
      = some ((weightedRoundRobin w hm hw).slotOf i)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : (weightedCappedRoundRobin w (fun _ => none) hw).pos
      ((weightedRoundRobin w hm hw).slotOf i) ((weightedRoundRobin w hm hw).rank i) = i := by
    rw [weightedCappedRoundRobin_none_pos w hm hw]
    exact (weightedRoundRobin w hm hw).pos_rank i
  have hslot := (weightedCappedRoundRobin w (fun _ => none) hw).pos_slotOf
    ((weightedRoundRobin w hm hw).slotOf i) ((weightedRoundRobin w hm hw).rank i)
    fun b hb => nomatch hb
  rw [hpos] at hslot
  exact hslot

name: Azurite.boolsGen_card
statement: theorem boolsGen_card : Fintype.card Bool = 2
proof: := fintypeCard_eq_finiteCard

name: Azurite.orderingsIncreasingGen_card
statement: theorem orderingsIncreasingGen_card : Fintype.card Ordering = 3
proof: := fintypeCard_eq_finiteCard

name: Azurite.orderingsGen_card
statement: theorem orderingsGen_card : Fintype.card Ordering = 3

name: Azurite.roundingModesGen_card
statement: theorem roundingModesGen_card : Fintype.card RoundingMode = 5
proof: := fintypeCard_eq_finiteCard

name: Azurite.ofNat_succ_pos
statement: theorem ofNat_succ_pos (k : ℕ) : 0 < AzNat.ofNat (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzNat.lt_iff_toNat_lt, AzNat.toNat_zero, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
  exact Nat.succ_pos k

name: Azurite.positiveNaturalsFun_bijective
statement: theorem positiveNaturalsFun_bijective : Function.Bijective positiveNaturalsFun
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    intro k j h
    have hval : AzNat.ofNat (k + 1) = AzNat.ofNat (j + 1) := congrArg Subtype.val h
    have := congrArg AzNat.toNat hval
    rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at this
    omega
  · 
    rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨a.toNat - 1, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    show AzNat.ofNat (a.toNat - 1 + 1) = a
    rw [AzNat.lt_iff_toNat_lt, AzNat.toNat_zero] at ha
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel ha, AzNat.ofNat_toNat]

name: Azurite.fusc_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem fusc_zero : fusc 0 = 0
proof: := by simp only [fusc]

name: Azurite.fusc_one
statement: @[simp] theorem fusc_one : fusc 1 = 1
proof: := by simp only [fusc]

name: Azurite.fusc_two_mul
statement: theorem fusc_two_mul (n : ℕ) : fusc (2 * n) = fusc n
proof:
:= by
  match n with
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 =>
    have he : 2 * (k + 1) = (2 * k) + 2 := by ring
    rw [he, fusc]
    rw [dite_eq_left (by omega)]
    congr 1
    omega

name: Azurite.fusc_two_mul_add_one
statement: theorem fusc_two_mul_add_one (n : ℕ) : fusc (2 * n + 1) = fusc n + fusc (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  match n with
  | 0 => simp
  | k + 1 =>
    have he : 2 * (k + 1) + 1 = (2 * k + 1) + 2 := by ring
    rw [he, fusc]
    rw [dite_eq_right (by omega)]
    have h1 : (2 * k + 1 + 2) / 2 = k + 1 := by omega
    rw [h1]

name: Azurite.fusc_two
statement: @[simp] theorem fusc_two : fusc 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 2 * 1 by rfl, fusc_two_mul, fusc_one]

name: Azurite.fusc_three
statement: @[simp] theorem fusc_three : fusc 3 = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (3 : ℕ) = 2 * 1 + 1 by rfl, fusc_two_mul_add_one, fusc_one,
      show (1 : ℕ) + 1 = 2 by rfl, fusc_two]

name: Azurite.fusc_pos
statement: theorem fusc_pos : ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → 0 < fusc n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro hn
    match n, hn with
    | 1, _ => simp
    | (m + 2), _ =>
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd (m + 2) with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
      · 
        have hk2 : m + 2 = 2 * k := by omega
        rw [hk2, fusc_two_mul]
        exact ih k (by omega) (by omega)
      · 
        have hk2 : m + 2 = 2 * k + 1 := by omega
        rw [hk2, fusc_two_mul_add_one]
        have : 0 < fusc (k + 1) := ih (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        omega

name: Azurite.fusc_coprime
statement: theorem fusc_coprime : ∀ n, Nat.Coprime (fusc n) (fusc (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    match n with
    | 0 => simp [Nat.Coprime]
    | 1 => simp [Nat.Coprime]
    | (m + 2) =>
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd (m + 2) with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
      · 
        have hk2 : m + 2 = 2 * k := by omega
        rw [hk2, fusc_two_mul, fusc_two_mul_add_one]
        rw [Nat.coprime_self_add_right]
        exact ih k (by omega)
      · 
        have hk2 : m + 2 = 2 * k + 1 := by omega
        rw [hk2, show 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) by ring, fusc_two_mul_add_one, fusc_two_mul]
        rw [Nat.coprime_add_self_left]
        exact ih k (by omega)

name: Azurite.fusc_newman
statement:
theorem fusc_newman : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m →
    fusc (m + 2) = (2 * (fusc m / fusc (m + 1)) + 1) * fusc (m + 1) - fusc m
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    intro hm
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd m with ⟨j, hj⟩ | ⟨j, hj⟩
    · 
      have hj1 : 1 ≤ j := by omega
      have hm2 : m = 2 * j := by omega
      rw [hm2]
      simp only [show 2 * j + 2 = 2 * (j + 1) by ring, fusc_two_mul, fusc_two_mul_add_one]
      
      have hpos : 0 < fusc (j + 1) := fusc_pos (j + 1) (by omega)
      have hfloor : fusc j / (fusc j + fusc (j + 1)) = 0 :=
        Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)
      rw [hfloor]
      omega
    · 
      have hm2 : m = 2 * j + 1 := by omega
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with hj0 | hjpos
      · 
        subst hj0
        have hm1 : m = 1 := by omega
        subst hm1
        
        show fusc 3 = (2 * (fusc 1 / fusc 2) + 1) * fusc 2 - fusc 1
        rw [fusc_one, fusc_two, fusc_three]
      · 
        rw [hm2]
        simp only [show 2 * j + 1 + 2 = 2 * (j + 1) + 1 by ring,
          show 2 * j + 1 + 1 = 2 * (j + 1) by ring, fusc_two_mul_add_one, fusc_two_mul]
        rw [show j + 1 + 1 = j + 2 by rfl]
        
        
        have hpos : 0 < fusc (j + 1) := fusc_pos (j + 1) (by omega)
        have hdiv : (fusc j + fusc (j + 1)) / fusc (j + 1) = fusc j / fusc (j + 1) + 1 := by
          rw [Nat.add_div_right _ hpos]
        rw [hdiv]
        have hIH : fusc (j + 2) = (2 * (fusc j / fusc (j + 1)) + 1) * fusc (j + 1) - fusc j :=
          ih j (by omega) hjpos
        have hle : fusc j ≤ (2 * (fusc j / fusc (j + 1)) + 1) * fusc (j + 1) := by
          have h1 := Nat.div_add_mod (fusc j) (fusc (j + 1))
          have h2 := Nat.mod_lt (fusc j) hpos
          have hexp : (2 * (fusc j / fusc (j + 1)) + 1) * fusc (j + 1)
              = fusc (j + 1) * (fusc j / fusc (j + 1))
                + (fusc (j + 1) * (fusc j / fusc (j + 1)) + fusc (j + 1)) := by ring
          omega
        
        set k := fusc j / fusc (j + 1) with hk
        set a := fusc j with ha
        set b := fusc (j + 1) with hb
        set c := fusc (j + 2) with hc
        
        have hexp : (2 * (k + 1) + 1) * b = (2 * k + 1) * b + 2 * b := by ring
        omega

name: Azurite.sternBrocotStep_fst_toNat
statement:
theorem sternBrocotStep_fst_toNat (s : AzNat × AzNat) :
    (sternBrocotStep s).1.toNat = s.2.toNat
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.sternBrocotStep_snd_toNat
statement:
theorem sternBrocotStep_snd_toNat (s : AzNat × AzNat) :
    (sternBrocotStep s).2.toNat =
      (2 * (s.1.toNat / s.2.toNat) + 1) * s.2.toNat - s.1.toNat
proof:
:= by
  show ((s.1 / s.2 + s.1 / s.2 + 1) * s.2 - s.1).toNat = _
  rw [AzNat.toNat_sub, AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_add, AzNat.toNat_add,
      AzNat.toNat_div, AzNat.toNat_one]
  ring_nf

name: Azurite.positiveRationalPair_toNat
statement:
theorem positiveRationalPair_toNat (n : ℕ) :
    (positiveRationalPair n).1.toNat = fusc (n + 1) ∧
    (positiveRationalPair n).2.toNat = fusc (n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have h0 : positiveRationalPair 0 = sternBrocotStep (0, 1) := by
      show sternBrocotStep^[0 + 1] (0, 1) = sternBrocotStep (0, 1)
      rw [Function.iterate_one]
    rw [h0]
    constructor
    · rw [sternBrocotStep_fst_toNat, fusc_one]; rfl
    · rw [sternBrocotStep_snd_toNat, fusc_two]
      simp [AzNat.toNat_zero, AzNat.toNat_one]
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih
    have hstep : positiveRationalPair (n + 1)
        = sternBrocotStep (positiveRationalPair n) := by
      show sternBrocotStep^[n + 1 + 1] (0, 1) = sternBrocotStep (sternBrocotStep^[n + 1] (0, 1))
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    rw [hstep]
    constructor
    · rw [sternBrocotStep_fst_toNat, ih2]
    · rw [sternBrocotStep_snd_toNat, ih1, ih2]
      have hN := fusc_newman (n + 1) (by omega)
      rw [show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 from rfl] at hN
      exact hN.symm

name: Azurite.fusc_lt_of_even
statement: theorem fusc_lt_of_even {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : fusc (2 * k) < fusc (2 * k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fusc_two_mul, fusc_two_mul_add_one]
  have : 0 < fusc (k + 1) := fusc_pos (k + 1) (by omega)
  omega

name: Azurite.fusc_gt_of_odd
statement: theorem fusc_gt_of_odd {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : fusc (2 * k + 1 + 1) < fusc (2 * k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) by ring, fusc_two_mul, fusc_two_mul_add_one]
  have : 0 < fusc k := fusc_pos k hk
  omega

name: Azurite.fusc_odd_le
statement: theorem fusc_odd_le (k : ℕ) : fusc (2 * k + 1 + 1) ≤ fusc (2 * k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) by ring, fusc_two_mul, fusc_two_mul_add_one]
  omega

name: Azurite.fusc_inj
statement:
theorem fusc_inj : ∀ m n, 1 ≤ m → 1 ≤ n →
    fusc m = fusc n → fusc (m + 1) = fusc (n + 1) → m = n
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    intro n hm hn hnum hden
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd m with ⟨mk, hmk⟩ | ⟨mk, hmk⟩ <;>
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with ⟨nk, hnk⟩ | ⟨nk, hnk⟩
    · 
      have hmk2 : m = 2 * mk := by omega
      have hnk2 : n = 2 * nk := by omega
      rw [hmk2, hnk2] at hnum hden
      simp only [fusc_two_mul] at hnum
      simp only [fusc_two_mul_add_one] at hden
      have e2 : fusc (mk + 1) = fusc (nk + 1) := by omega
      have : mk = nk := ih mk (by omega) nk (by omega) (by omega) hnum e2
      omega
    · 
      exfalso
      have hmk2 : m = 2 * mk := by omega
      have hn2 : n = 2 * nk + 1 := by omega
      have hlt := fusc_lt_of_even (k := mk) (by omega)
      rw [← hmk2] at hlt
      have hle := fusc_odd_le nk
      rw [← hn2] at hle
      omega
    · 
      exfalso
      have hnk2 : n = 2 * nk := by omega
      have hm2 : m = 2 * mk + 1 := by omega
      have hlt := fusc_lt_of_even (k := nk) (by omega)
      rw [← hnk2] at hlt
      have hle := fusc_odd_le mk
      rw [← hm2] at hle
      omega
    · 
      have hm2 : m = 2 * mk + 1 := by omega
      have hn2 : n = 2 * nk + 1 := by omega
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos mk with hmk0 | hmkp <;>
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos nk with hnk0 | hnkp
      · omega  
      · 
        exfalso
        have hgt := fusc_gt_of_odd hnkp
        rw [← hn2] at hgt
        have hm1 : m = 1 := by omega
        subst hm1
        rw [fusc_one] at hnum
        rw [show (1 : ℕ) + 1 = 2 by rfl, fusc_two] at hden
        omega
      · 
        exfalso
        have hgt := fusc_gt_of_odd hmkp
        rw [← hm2] at hgt
        have hn1 : n = 1 := by omega
        subst hn1
        rw [fusc_one] at hnum
        rw [show (1 : ℕ) + 1 = 2 by rfl, fusc_two] at hden
        omega
      · 
        rw [hm2, hn2] at hnum hden
        simp only [fusc_two_mul_add_one] at hnum
        simp only [show 2 * mk + 1 + 1 = 2 * (mk + 1) by ring,
          show 2 * nk + 1 + 1 = 2 * (nk + 1) by ring, fusc_two_mul] at hden
        have e2 : fusc mk = fusc nk := by omega
        have : mk = nk := ih mk (by omega) nk (by omega) (by omega) e2 hden
        omega

name: Azurite.fusc_surj_aux
statement:
theorem fusc_surj_aux : ∀ s a b, a + b = s → 0 < a → 0 < b → Nat.Coprime a b →
    ∃ m, 1 ≤ m ∧ fusc m = a ∧ fusc (m + 1) = b
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  induction s using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ s ih =>
    intro a b hs ha hb hcop
    rcases lt_trichotomy a b with hab | hab | hab
    · 
      have hba : 0 < b - a := by omega
      have hcop' : Nat.Coprime a (b - a) := by
        have : Nat.Coprime a (a + (b - a)) := by rw [show a + (b - a) = b from by omega]; exact hcop
        rwa [Nat.coprime_self_add_right] at this
      obtain ⟨k, hk1, hka, hkb⟩ := ih b (by omega) a (b - a) (by omega) ha hba hcop'
      refine ⟨2 * k, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [fusc_two_mul]; exact hka
      · rw [fusc_two_mul_add_one, hka, hkb]; omega
    · 
      subst hab
      have ha1 : a = 1 := by
        have h := hcop; unfold Nat.Coprime at h; rw [Nat.gcd_self] at h; exact h
      subst ha1
      exact ⟨1, by omega, by simp, by simp⟩
    · 
      have hab' : 0 < a - b := by omega
      have hcop' : Nat.Coprime (a - b) b := by
        have : Nat.Coprime ((a - b) + b) b := by rw [show (a - b) + b = a from by omega]; exact hcop
        rwa [Nat.coprime_add_self_left] at this
      obtain ⟨k, hk1, hka, hkb⟩ := ih a (by omega) (a - b) b (by omega) hab' hb hcop'
      refine ⟨2 * k + 1, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [fusc_two_mul_add_one, hka, hkb]; omega
      · rw [show 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) from by ring, fusc_two_mul]; exact hkb

name: Azurite.fusc_surj
statement:
theorem fusc_surj (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hcop : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    ∃ m, 1 ≤ m ∧ fusc m = a ∧ fusc (m + 1) = b
proof:
:=
  fusc_surj_aux (a + b) a b rfl ha hb hcop

name: Azurite.toRat_positiveRationals
statement:
theorem toRat_positiveRationals (n : ℕ) :
    AzRat.toRat (positiveRationals n) = (fusc (n + 1) : ℚ) / (fusc (n + 2) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := positiveRationalPair_toNat n
  rw [positiveRationals, AzRat.toRat_ofAzNats, h1, h2]

name: Azurite.positiveRationals_pos
statement: theorem positiveRationals_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < positiveRationals n
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzRat.lt_iff_toRat_lt, AzRat.toRat_zero, toRat_positiveRationals]
  have h1 : 0 < fusc (n + 1) := fusc_pos (n + 1) (by omega)
  have h2 : 0 < fusc (n + 2) := fusc_pos (n + 2) (by omega)
  positivity

name: Azurite.ofAzNats_num_den
statement:
theorem ofAzNats_num_den {a b : AzNat} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hcop : AzNat.coprime a b = true) :
    (AzRat.ofAzNats a b).num = a ∧ (AzRat.ofAzNats a b).den = b
proof:
:= by
  have hg1 : AzNat.gcd a b = 1 := by
    apply AzNat.toNat_injective
    rw [AzNat.toNat_gcd, AzNat.toNat_one]
    exact (AzNat.coprime_iff a b).mp hcop
  have hdiv : ∀ x : AzNat, x / AzNat.gcd a b = x := by
    intro x
    apply AzNat.toNat_injective
    rw [AzNat.toNat_div, hg1, AzNat.toNat_one, Nat.div_one]
  constructor
  · show (AzRat.ofSignAzNats true a b).num = a
    rw [AzRat.ofSignAzNats, dite_eq_right hb, dite_eq_right ha]
    exact hdiv a
  · show (AzRat.ofSignAzNats true a b).den = b
    rw [AzRat.ofSignAzNats, dite_eq_right hb, dite_eq_right ha]
    exact hdiv b

name: Azurite.positiveRationalsFun_bijective
statement: theorem positiveRationalsFun_bijective : Function.Bijective positiveRationalsFun
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    intro m n h
    have hv : positiveRationals m = positiveRationals n := congrArg Subtype.val h
    
    obtain ⟨hm1, hm2⟩ := positiveRationalPair_toNat m
    obtain ⟨hn1, hn2⟩ := positiveRationalPair_toNat n
    
    have hmna : (positiveRationalPair m).1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; rw [h0, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hm1
      exact absurd hm1.symm (Nat.ne_of_gt (fusc_pos (m + 1) (by omega)))
    have hmnb : (positiveRationalPair m).2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; rw [h0, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hm2
      exact absurd hm2.symm (Nat.ne_of_gt (fusc_pos (m + 2) (by omega)))
    have hnna : (positiveRationalPair n).1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; rw [h0, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hn1
      exact absurd hn1.symm (Nat.ne_of_gt (fusc_pos (n + 1) (by omega)))
    have hnnb : (positiveRationalPair n).2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; rw [h0, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hn2
      exact absurd hn2.symm (Nat.ne_of_gt (fusc_pos (n + 2) (by omega)))
    have hmcop : AzNat.coprime (positiveRationalPair m).1 (positiveRationalPair m).2 = true := by
      rw [AzNat.coprime_iff, hm1, hm2]; exact fusc_coprime (m + 1)
    have hncop : AzNat.coprime (positiveRationalPair n).1 (positiveRationalPair n).2 = true := by
      rw [AzNat.coprime_iff, hn1, hn2]; exact fusc_coprime (n + 1)
    obtain ⟨hmnum, hmden⟩ := ofAzNats_num_den hmna hmnb hmcop
    obtain ⟨hnnum, hnden⟩ := ofAzNats_num_den hnna hnnb hncop
    
    have hnum : (positiveRationalPair m).1 = (positiveRationalPair n).1 := by
      rw [← hmnum, ← hnnum]; exact congrArg AzRat.num hv
    have hden : (positiveRationalPair m).2 = (positiveRationalPair n).2 := by
      rw [← hmden, ← hnden]; exact congrArg AzRat.den hv
    
    have enum : fusc (m + 1) = fusc (n + 1) := by
      rw [← hm1, ← hn1, hnum]
    have eden : fusc (m + 2) = fusc (n + 2) := by
      rw [← hm2, ← hn2, hden]
    have : m + 1 = n + 1 :=
      fusc_inj (m + 1) (n + 1) (by omega) (by omega) enum
        (by rw [show m + 1 + 1 = m + 2 from rfl, show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 from rfl]; exact eden)
    omega
  · 
    rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    
    have hpos : 0 < AzRat.toRat q := by
      rw [AzRat.lt_iff_toRat_lt, AzRat.toRat_zero] at hq; exact hq
    have hnum_pos : 0 < (AzRat.toRat q).num := Rat.num_pos.mpr hpos
    have hqsign : q.sign = true := by
      rw [← AzRat.ofRat_toRat q]
      show decide (0 ≤ (AzRat.toRat q).num) = true
      rw [decide_eq_true_eq]; omega
    have hqnum : q.num ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hnum_eq : (AzRat.toRat q).num
          = if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℤ) := rfl
      rw [h0, AzNat.toNat_zero, Nat.cast_zero] at hnum_eq
      have hz : (AzRat.toRat q).num = 0 := by rw [hnum_eq]; split <;> simp
      omega
    have hqden : q.den ≠ 0 := q.den_nz
    have hnumpos : 0 < q.num.toNat := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q.num.toNat with h | h
      · exact absurd (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm)) hqnum
      · exact h
    have hdenpos : 0 < q.den.toNat := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q.den.toNat with h | h
      · exact absurd (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm)) hqden
      · exact h
    have hqcop : Nat.Coprime q.num.toNat q.den.toNat := (AzNat.coprime_iff _ _).mp q.reduced
    obtain ⟨msucc, hmge, hma, hmb⟩ := fusc_surj q.num.toNat q.den.toNat hnumpos hdenpos hqcop
    
    refine ⟨msucc - 1, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    show positiveRationals (msucc - 1) = q
    have hmn : msucc - 1 + 1 = msucc := by omega
    obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := positiveRationalPair_toNat (msucc - 1)
    rw [hmn] at hp1
    have hp2' : (positiveRationalPair (msucc - 1)).2.toNat = q.den.toNat := by
      rw [hp2, show msucc - 1 + 2 = msucc + 1 from by omega, hmb]
    have hp1' : (positiveRationalPair (msucc - 1)).1.toNat = q.num.toNat := by
      rw [hp1, hma]
    
    have ea : (positiveRationalPair (msucc - 1)).1 = q.num := AzNat.toNat_injective hp1'
    have eb : (positiveRationalPair (msucc - 1)).2 = q.den := AzNat.toNat_injective hp2'
    rw [positiveRationals, ea, eb]
    
    have := AzRat.ofSignAzNats_self q
    rw [hqsign] at this
    exact this

name: Azurite.negativeRationals_neg
statement: theorem negativeRationals_neg (n : ℕ) : negativeRationals n < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [negativeRationals, AzRat.lt_iff_toRat_lt, AzRat.toRat_zero, AzRat.toRat_neg]
  have := positiveRationals_pos n
  rw [AzRat.lt_iff_toRat_lt, AzRat.toRat_zero] at this
  linarith

name: Azurite.negativeRationalsFun_bijective
statement: theorem negativeRationalsFun_bijective : Function.Bijective negativeRationalsFun
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro m n h
    have hv : negativeRationals m = negativeRationals n := congrArg Subtype.val h
    have : positiveRationals m = positiveRationals n := by
      have := congrArg AzRat.toRat hv
      rw [negativeRationals, negativeRationals, AzRat.toRat_neg, AzRat.toRat_neg] at this
      exact AzRat.toRat_injective (by linarith)
    exact positiveRationalsFun_bijective.injective (Subtype.ext this)
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := positiveRationalsFun_bijective.surjective ⟨-q, by
      rw [AzRat.lt_iff_toRat_lt, AzRat.toRat_zero, AzRat.toRat_neg]
      rw [AzRat.lt_iff_toRat_lt, AzRat.toRat_zero] at hq; linarith⟩
    refine ⟨n, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    show negativeRationals n = q
    have : positiveRationals n = -q := congrArg Subtype.val hn
    rw [negativeRationals, this]
    exact AzRat.toRat_injective (by simp)

name: Azurite.nonnegativeRationals_nonneg
statement: theorem nonnegativeRationals_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ nonnegativeRationals n
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonnegativeRationals]
  split
  · exact le_refl 0
  · exact le_of_lt (positiveRationals_pos _)

name: Azurite.nonnegativeRationalsFun_bijective
statement: theorem nonnegativeRationalsFun_bijective : Function.Bijective nonnegativeRationalsFun
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro m n h
    have hv : nonnegativeRationals m = nonnegativeRationals n := congrArg Subtype.val h
    rw [nonnegativeRationals, nonnegativeRationals] at hv
    
    by_cases hm0 : m = 0 <;> by_cases hn0 : n = 0
    · omega
    · exfalso; rw [ite_eq_left hm0, ite_eq_right hn0] at hv
      exact absurd (positiveRationals_pos (n - 1)) (by rw [← hv]; exact lt_irrefl 0)
    · exfalso; rw [ite_eq_right hm0, ite_eq_left hn0] at hv
      exact absurd (positiveRationals_pos (m - 1)) (by rw [hv]; exact lt_irrefl 0)
    · rw [ite_eq_right hm0, ite_eq_right hn0] at hv
      have : m - 1 = n - 1 :=
        positiveRationalsFun_bijective.injective (Subtype.ext hv)
      omega
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hq with h0 | h0
    · exact ⟨0, Subtype.ext (by show nonnegativeRationals 0 = q; rw [nonnegativeRationals, ite_eq_left rfl]; exact h0)⟩
    · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := positiveRationalsFun_bijective.surjective ⟨q, h0⟩
      refine ⟨n + 1, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
      show nonnegativeRationals (n + 1) = q
      rw [nonnegativeRationals, ite_eq_right (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hn

name: Azurite.nonzeroRationals_ne_zero
statement: theorem nonzeroRationals_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : nonzeroRationals n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonzeroRationals]
  split
  · exact ne_of_gt (positiveRationals_pos _)
  · intro h
    have hp := positiveRationals_pos (n / 2)
    rw [AzRat.lt_iff_toRat_lt, AzRat.toRat_zero] at hp
    have h2 := congrArg AzRat.toRat h
    rw [AzRat.toRat_neg, AzRat.toRat_zero] at h2
    linarith

name: Azurite.nonzeroRationalsFun_bijective
statement: theorem nonzeroRationalsFun_bijective : Function.Bijective nonzeroRationalsFun
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro m n h
    have hv : nonzeroRationals m = nonzeroRationals n := congrArg Subtype.val h
    rw [nonzeroRationals, nonzeroRationals] at hv
    by_cases hm : m % 2 = 0 <;> by_cases hn : n % 2 = 0
    · rw [ite_eq_left hm, ite_eq_left hn] at hv
      have : m / 2 = n / 2 := positiveRationalsFun_bijective.injective (Subtype.ext hv)
      omega
    · exfalso; rw [ite_eq_left hm, ite_eq_right hn] at hv
      
      have hp := positiveRationals_pos (m / 2)
      have hp2 := positiveRationals_pos (n / 2)
      rw [AzRat.lt_iff_toRat_lt, AzRat.toRat_zero] at hp hp2
      have := congrArg AzRat.toRat hv
      rw [AzRat.toRat_neg] at this
      linarith
    · exfalso; rw [ite_eq_right hm, ite_eq_left hn] at hv
      have hp := positiveRationals_pos (m / 2)
      have hp2 := positiveRationals_pos (n / 2)
      rw [AzRat.lt_iff_toRat_lt, AzRat.toRat_zero] at hp hp2
      have := congrArg AzRat.toRat hv
      rw [AzRat.toRat_neg] at this
      linarith
    · rw [ite_eq_right hm, ite_eq_right hn] at hv
      have hneg : positiveRationals (m / 2) = positiveRationals (n / 2) := by
        have := congrArg AzRat.toRat hv
        rw [AzRat.toRat_neg, AzRat.toRat_neg] at this
        exact AzRat.toRat_injective (by linarith)
      have : m / 2 = n / 2 := positiveRationalsFun_bijective.injective (Subtype.ext hneg)
      omega
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    rcases lt_trichotomy q 0 with hlt | heq | hgt
    · 
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := positiveRationalsFun_bijective.surjective ⟨-q, by
        rw [AzRat.lt_iff_toRat_lt, AzRat.toRat_zero, AzRat.toRat_neg]
        rw [AzRat.lt_iff_toRat_lt, AzRat.toRat_zero] at hlt; linarith⟩
      refine ⟨2 * n + 1, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
      show nonzeroRationals (2 * n + 1) = q
      rw [nonzeroRationals, ite_eq_right (by omega),
          show (2 * n + 1) / 2 = n from by omega]
      have : positiveRationals n = -q := congrArg Subtype.val hn
      rw [this]
      exact AzRat.toRat_injective (by simp)
    · exact absurd heq hq
    · 
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := positiveRationalsFun_bijective.surjective ⟨q, hgt⟩
      refine ⟨2 * n, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
      show nonzeroRationals (2 * n) = q
      rw [nonzeroRationals, ite_eq_left (by omega), show (2 * n) / 2 = n from by omega]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hn

name: Azurite.rationals_bijective
statement: theorem rationals_bijective : Function.Bijective rationals
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro m n h
    rw [rationals, rationals] at h
    by_cases hm0 : m = 0 <;> by_cases hn0 : n = 0
    · omega
    · exfalso; rw [ite_eq_left hm0, ite_eq_right hn0] at h
      exact nonzeroRationals_ne_zero (n - 1) h.symm
    · exfalso; rw [ite_eq_right hm0, ite_eq_left hn0] at h
      exact nonzeroRationals_ne_zero (m - 1) h
    · rw [ite_eq_right hm0, ite_eq_right hn0] at h
      have : m - 1 = n - 1 := nonzeroRationalsFun_bijective.injective (Subtype.ext h)
      omega
  · intro q
    by_cases hq0 : q = 0
    · exact ⟨0, by rw [rationals, ite_eq_left rfl]; exact hq0.symm⟩
    · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := nonzeroRationalsFun_bijective.surjective ⟨q, hq0⟩
      refine ⟨n + 1, ?_⟩
      rw [rationals, ite_eq_right (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hn

name: Azurite.positiveRationalsGen_infinite
statement: theorem positiveRationalsGen_infinite : Infinite {q : AzRat // 0 < q}
proof:
:=
  Infinite.of_injective positiveRationalsFun positiveRationalsFun_bijective.injective

name: Azurite.negativeRationalsGen_infinite
statement: theorem negativeRationalsGen_infinite : Infinite {q : AzRat // q < 0}
proof:
:=
  Infinite.of_injective negativeRationalsFun negativeRationalsFun_bijective.injective

name: Azurite.nonnegativeRationalsGen_infinite
statement: theorem nonnegativeRationalsGen_infinite : Infinite {q : AzRat // 0 ≤ q}
proof:
:=
  Infinite.of_injective nonnegativeRationalsFun nonnegativeRationalsFun_bijective.injective

name: Azurite.nonzeroRationalsGen_infinite
statement: theorem nonzeroRationalsGen_infinite : Infinite {q : AzRat // q ≠ 0}
proof:
:=
  Infinite.of_injective nonzeroRationalsFun nonzeroRationalsFun_bijective.injective

name: Azurite.rationalsGen_infinite
statement: theorem rationalsGen_infinite : Infinite AzRat
proof:
:=
  Infinite.of_injective rationals rationals_bijective.injective

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.contiguous_of_gen_some
statement:
theorem contiguous_of_gen_some {T : Type*} (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) {f : ℕ → T}
    (hg : g.gen = fun n => some (f n)) : @Contiguous T g
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun n h => by rw [hg] at h; exact absurd h (Option.some_ne_none _)⟩

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.contiguous_of_boundedBij
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun n h => ?_⟩
  rw [hg] at h ⊢
  simp only at h ⊢
  by_cases hn : n < card
  · rw [ite_eq_left hn] at h; exact absurd h (Option.some_ne_none _)
  · rw [ite_eq_right (by omega)]

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.contiguous_of_boundedBijOn
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun n h => ?_⟩
  rw [hg] at h ⊢
  simp only at h ⊢
  by_cases hn : n < card
  · rw [dite_eq_left hn] at h; exact absurd h (Option.some_ne_none _)
  · rw [dite_eq_right (by omega)]

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.contiguous_of_getElem?
statement:
theorem contiguous_of_getElem? {T : Type*} (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) {l : List T}
    (hg : g.gen = fun n => l[n]?) : @Contiguous T g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun n h => ?_⟩
  rw [hg] at h ⊢
  simp only at h ⊢
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff] at h ⊢
  omega

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.mapGen_contig_step
statement:
theorem mapGen_contig_step {S T : Type*} (f : S → T) (hf : Function.Bijective f)
    (g : ExhaustiveGenerator S) (hstep : ∀ n, g.gen n = none → g.gen (n + 1) = none) :
    ∀ n, (mapGen f hf g).gen n = none → (mapGen f hf g).gen (n + 1) = none
proof:
:= by
  intro n h
  have h : (g.gen n).map f = none := h
  show (g.gen (n + 1)).map f = none
  rw [Option.map_eq_none_iff] at h ⊢
  exact hstep n h

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.mapGen_contiguous
statement:
theorem mapGen_contiguous {S T : Type*} (f : S → T) (hf : Function.Bijective f)
    (g : ExhaustiveGenerator S) (hg : @Contiguous S g) : @Contiguous T (mapGen f hf g)
proof:
:=
  @Contiguous.mk T (mapGen f hf g) (mapGen_contig_step f hf g (fun n => hg.contig n))

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.gen_none_of_le
statement:
theorem gen_none_of_le [Contiguous T] {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (h : gen (T := T) m = none) : gen (T := T) n = none
proof:
:= by
  induction hmn with
  | refl => exact h
  | step _ ih => exact Contiguous.contig _ ih

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.gen_none_of_le_step
statement:
theorem gen_none_of_le_step {S : Type*} (g : ExhaustiveGenerator S)
    (hstep : ∀ n, g.gen n = none → g.gen (n + 1) = none) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (h : g.gen m = none) : g.gen n = none
proof:
:= by
  induction hmn with
  | refl => exact h
  | step _ ih => exact hstep _ ih

name: Azurite.FiniteGenerator.card_pos
statement:
theorem card_pos {T : Type*} [inst : ExhaustiveGenerator T] [FiniteGenerator T]
    [Nonempty T] : 0 < card (T := T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t⟩ := ‹Nonempty T›
  obtain ⟨n, hn, -⟩ := inst.occurs_exactly_once t
  by_contra h
  rw [gen_none n (by omega)] at hn
  exact Option.some_ne_none t hn.symm

name: Azurite.naturals_bijective
statement: theorem naturals_bijective : Function.Bijective AzNat.ofNat
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    intro n m h
    have := congrArg AzNat.toNat h
    rwa [AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at this
  · 
    intro a
    exact ⟨a.toNat, AzNat.ofNat_toNat a⟩

name: Azurite.FairSlot.lt_two_pow_of_gen_some
statement:
theorem lt_two_pow_of_gen_some {T : Type*} {g : ExhaustiveGenerator T} (s : @FairSlot T g)
    {n : ℕ} {t : T} (h : g.gen n = some t) : ∀ b, s.bits = some b → n < 2 ^ b
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨hcard, -, hnone⟩ := s.spec_some b hb
  by_contra hge
  rw [Nat.not_lt] at hge
  exact Option.some_ne_none _ (h.symm.trans (hnone n (by omega)))

name: Azurite.FairSlot.hasCount
statement:
theorem hasCount {T : Type*} {g : ExhaustiveGenerator T} (s : @FairSlot T g) :
    HasCount T s.count
proof:
:= by
  rcases hb : s.bits with _ | b
  · 
    simp only [FairSlot.count, hb, Option.map_none]
    have hne := s.spec_none hb
    refine ⟨fun n => (g.gen n).get (Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mpr (hne n)), ?_⟩
    intro n m hnm
    have hnm' : (g.gen n).get (Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mpr (hne n))
        = (g.gen m).get (Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mpr (hne m)) := hnm
    obtain ⟨j, -, hu⟩ := g.occurs_exactly_once
      ((g.gen n).get (Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mpr (hne n)))
    have h1 : g.gen n = some ((g.gen n).get (Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mpr (hne n))) :=
      (Option.some_get _).symm
    have h2 : g.gen m = some ((g.gen n).get (Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mpr (hne n))) := by
      rw [hnm']
      exact (Option.some_get _).symm
    rw [hu n h1, hu m h2]
  · 
    simp only [FairSlot.count, hb, Option.map_some]
    obtain ⟨-, hsome, hnone⟩ := s.spec_some b hb
    exact ⟨@equivFin T g s.card hnone hsome⟩

name: Azurite.HasCount.vector
statement:
theorem HasCount.vector {T : Type*} {c : ℕ} (hc : HasCount T (some c)) (n : ℕ) :
    HasCount (List.Vector T n) (some (c ^ n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := hc
  exact ⟨(Equiv.vectorEquivFin T n).trans
    ((Equiv.arrowCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin n)) e).trans finFunctionFinEquiv)⟩

name: Azurite.FairSlot.gen_isSome_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs b hb
    obtain ⟨-, -, hnone⟩ := s.spec_some b hb
    by_contra hge
    rw [hnone x (Nat.le_of_not_lt hge)] at hs
    exact absurd hs (by simp)
  · intro h
    rcases hb : s.bits with _ | b
    · exact Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mpr (s.spec_none hb x)
    · obtain ⟨-, hsome, -⟩ := s.spec_some b hb
      exact Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mpr (hsome x (h b hb))

name: Azurite.CompressFast.fairPairGenCapped_gen_isSome_iff
statement:
theorem fairPairGenCapped_gen_isSome_iff {A B : Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (gB : ExhaustiveGenerator B) (sA : @FairSlot A gA) (sB : @FairSlot B gB) (k : ℕ) :
    ((fairPairGenCapped gA gB sA sB).gen k).isSome
      ↔ Live ![sA.bits, sB.bits] ![sA.card, sB.card] k
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : (fairPairGenCapped gA gB sA sB).gen k
      = if (fairPairCappedAssignment sA.bits sB.bits).Valid k then
          (gA.gen ((fairPairCappedAssignment sA.bits sB.bits).deinterleave 0 k)).bind fun a =>
            (gB.gen ((fairPairCappedAssignment sA.bits sB.bits).deinterleave 1 k)).map fun b =>
              (a, b)
        else none := rfl
  rw [hgen]
  by_cases hv : (fairPairCappedAssignment sA.bits sB.bits).Valid k
  · rw [ite_eq_left hv]
    constructor
    · intro hs
      refine ⟨hv, ?_⟩
      rcases hga : gA.gen ((fairPairCappedAssignment sA.bits sB.bits).deinterleave 0 k)
        with _ | a
      · rw [hga] at hs
        exact absurd hs (by simp)
      rcases hgb : gB.gen ((fairPairCappedAssignment sA.bits sB.bits).deinterleave 1 k)
        with _ | b
      · rw [hga, hgb] at hs
        exact absurd hs (by simp)
      intro j bb hj
      match j with
      | ⟨0, _⟩ =>
        exact (sA.gen_isSome_iff _).mp (Option.isSome_iff_exists.mpr ⟨a, hga⟩) bb hj
      | ⟨1, _⟩ =>
        exact (sB.gen_isSome_iff _).mp (Option.isSome_iff_exists.mpr ⟨b, hgb⟩) bb hj
    · rintro ⟨-, hlt⟩
      have ha : (gA.gen ((fairPairCappedAssignment sA.bits sB.bits).deinterleave 0 k)).isSome :=
        (sA.gen_isSome_iff _).mpr fun bb hb => hlt 0 bb hb
      have hb : (gB.gen ((fairPairCappedAssignment sA.bits sB.bits).deinterleave 1 k)).isSome :=
        (sB.gen_isSome_iff _).mpr fun bb hb => hlt 1 bb hb
      obtain ⟨a, hga⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp ha
      obtain ⟨b, hgb⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hb
      rw [hga, hgb]
      rfl
  · rw [ite_eq_right hv]
    exact iff_of_false (by simp) fun hlive => hv hlive.1

name: Azurite.CompressFast.fairTripleGenCapped_gen_isSome_iff
statement:
theorem fairTripleGenCapped_gen_isSome_iff {A B C : Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (gB : ExhaustiveGenerator B) (gC : ExhaustiveGenerator C) (sA : @FairSlot A gA)
    (sB : @FairSlot B gB) (sC : @FairSlot C gC) (k : ℕ) :
    ((fairTripleGenCapped gA gB gC sA sB sC).gen k).isSome
      ↔ Live ![sA.bits, sB.bits, sC.bits] ![sA.card, sB.card, sC.card] k
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : (fairTripleGenCapped gA gB gC sA sB sC).gen k
      = if (fairTripleCappedAssignment sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits).Valid k then
          (gA.gen ((fairTripleCappedAssignment sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits).deinterleave 0 k)).bind
            fun a =>
              (gB.gen ((fairTripleCappedAssignment
                sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits).deinterleave 1 k)).bind fun b =>
                  (gC.gen ((fairTripleCappedAssignment
                    sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits).deinterleave 2 k)).map fun c => (a, b, c)
        else none := rfl
  rw [hgen]
  by_cases hv : (fairTripleCappedAssignment sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits).Valid k
  · rw [ite_eq_left hv]
    constructor
    · intro hs
      refine ⟨hv, ?_⟩
      rcases hga : gA.gen ((fairTripleCappedAssignment
          sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits).deinterleave 0 k) with _ | a
      · rw [hga] at hs
        exact absurd hs (by simp)
      rcases hgb : gB.gen ((fairTripleCappedAssignment
          sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits).deinterleave 1 k) with _ | b
      · rw [hga, hgb] at hs
        exact absurd hs (by simp)
      rcases hgc : gC.gen ((fairTripleCappedAssignment
          sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits).deinterleave 2 k) with _ | c
      · rw [hga, hgb, hgc] at hs
        exact absurd hs (by simp)
      intro j bb hj
      match j with
      | ⟨0, _⟩ =>
        exact (sA.gen_isSome_iff _).mp (Option.isSome_iff_exists.mpr ⟨a, hga⟩) bb hj
      | ⟨1, _⟩ =>
        exact (sB.gen_isSome_iff _).mp (Option.isSome_iff_exists.mpr ⟨b, hgb⟩) bb hj
      | ⟨2, _⟩ =>
        exact (sC.gen_isSome_iff _).mp (Option.isSome_iff_exists.mpr ⟨c, hgc⟩) bb hj
    · rintro ⟨-, hlt⟩
      have ha : (gA.gen ((fairTripleCappedAssignment
          sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits).deinterleave 0 k)).isSome :=
        (sA.gen_isSome_iff _).mpr fun bb hb => hlt 0 bb hb
      have hb : (gB.gen ((fairTripleCappedAssignment
          sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits).deinterleave 1 k)).isSome :=
        (sB.gen_isSome_iff _).mpr fun bb hb => hlt 1 bb hb
      have hc : (gC.gen ((fairTripleCappedAssignment
          sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits).deinterleave 2 k)).isSome :=
        (sC.gen_isSome_iff _).mpr fun bb hb => hlt 2 bb hb
      obtain ⟨a, hga⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp ha
      obtain ⟨b, hgb⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hb
      obtain ⟨c, hgc⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hc
      rw [hga, hgb, hgc]
      rfl
  · rw [ite_eq_right hv]
    exact iff_of_false (by simp) fun hlive => hv hlive.1

name: Azurite.CompressFast.fairQuadrupleGenCapped_gen_isSome_iff
statement:
theorem fairQuadrupleGenCapped_gen_isSome_iff {A B C D : Type*}
    (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A) (gB : ExhaustiveGenerator B) (gC : ExhaustiveGenerator C)
    (gD : ExhaustiveGenerator D) (sA : @FairSlot A gA) (sB : @FairSlot B gB)
    (sC : @FairSlot C gC) (sD : @FairSlot D gD) (k : ℕ) :
    ((fairQuadrupleGenCapped gA gB gC gD sA sB sC sD).gen k).isSome
      ↔ Live ![sA.bits, sB.bits, sC.bits, sD.bits] ![sA.card, sB.card, sC.card, sD.card] k
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : (fairQuadrupleGenCapped gA gB gC gD sA sB sC sD).gen k
      = if (fairQuadrupleCappedAssignment sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits sD.bits).Valid k then
          (gA.gen ((fairQuadrupleCappedAssignment
            sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits sD.bits).deinterleave 0 k)).bind fun a =>
              (gB.gen ((fairQuadrupleCappedAssignment
                sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits sD.bits).deinterleave 1 k)).bind fun b =>
                  (gC.gen ((fairQuadrupleCappedAssignment
                    sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits sD.bits).deinterleave 2 k)).bind fun c =>
                      (gD.gen ((fairQuadrupleCappedAssignment
                        sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits sD.bits).deinterleave 3 k)).map fun d =>
                          (a, b, c, d)
        else none := rfl
  rw [hgen]
  by_cases hv : (fairQuadrupleCappedAssignment sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits sD.bits).Valid k
  · rw [ite_eq_left hv]
    constructor
    · intro hs
      refine ⟨hv, ?_⟩
      rcases hga : gA.gen ((fairQuadrupleCappedAssignment
          sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits sD.bits).deinterleave 0 k) with _ | a
      · rw [hga] at hs
        exact absurd hs (by simp)
      rcases hgb : gB.gen ((fairQuadrupleCappedAssignment
          sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits sD.bits).deinterleave 1 k) with _ | b
      · rw [hga, hgb] at hs
        exact absurd hs (by simp)
      rcases hgc : gC.gen ((fairQuadrupleCappedAssignment
          sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits sD.bits).deinterleave 2 k) with _ | c
      · rw [hga, hgb, hgc] at hs
        exact absurd hs (by simp)
      rcases hgd : gD.gen ((fairQuadrupleCappedAssignment
          sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits sD.bits).deinterleave 3 k) with _ | d
      · rw [hga, hgb, hgc, hgd] at hs
        exact absurd hs (by simp)
      intro j bb hj
      match j with
      | ⟨0, _⟩ =>
        exact (sA.gen_isSome_iff _).mp (Option.isSome_iff_exists.mpr ⟨a, hga⟩) bb hj
      | ⟨1, _⟩ =>
        exact (sB.gen_isSome_iff _).mp (Option.isSome_iff_exists.mpr ⟨b, hgb⟩) bb hj
      | ⟨2, _⟩ =>
        exact (sC.gen_isSome_iff _).mp (Option.isSome_iff_exists.mpr ⟨c, hgc⟩) bb hj
      | ⟨3, _⟩ =>
        exact (sD.gen_isSome_iff _).mp (Option.isSome_iff_exists.mpr ⟨d, hgd⟩) bb hj
    · rintro ⟨-, hlt⟩
      have ha : (gA.gen ((fairQuadrupleCappedAssignment
          sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits sD.bits).deinterleave 0 k)).isSome :=
        (sA.gen_isSome_iff _).mpr fun bb hb => hlt 0 bb hb
      have hb : (gB.gen ((fairQuadrupleCappedAssignment
          sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits sD.bits).deinterleave 1 k)).isSome :=
        (sB.gen_isSome_iff _).mpr fun bb hb => hlt 1 bb hb
      have hc : (gC.gen ((fairQuadrupleCappedAssignment
          sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits sD.bits).deinterleave 2 k)).isSome :=
        (sC.gen_isSome_iff _).mpr fun bb hb => hlt 2 bb hb
      have hd : (gD.gen ((fairQuadrupleCappedAssignment
          sA.bits sB.bits sC.bits sD.bits).deinterleave 3 k)).isSome :=
        (sD.gen_isSome_iff _).mpr fun bb hb => hlt 3 bb hb
      obtain ⟨a, hga⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp ha
      obtain ⟨b, hgb⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hb
      obtain ⟨c, hgc⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hc
      obtain ⟨d, hgd⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hd
      rw [hga, hgb, hgc, hgd]
      rfl
  · rw [ite_eq_right hv]
    exact iff_of_false (by simp) fun hlive => hv hlive.1

name: Azurite.CompressFast.fairVecGenCapped_gen_isSome_iff
statement:
theorem fairVecGenCapped_gen_isSome_iff {T : Type*} (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T)
    (s : @FairSlot T g) (m k : ℕ) :
    ((fairVecGenCapped g s m).gen k).isSome
      ↔ Live (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => s.bits) (fun _ => s.card) k
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : (fairVecGenCapped g s m).gen k
      = if h : (fairVecCappedAssignment m s.bits).Valid k ∧
          ∀ j, (g.gen ((fairVecCappedAssignment m s.bits).deinterleave j k)).isSome then
        some (List.Vector.ofFn fun j =>
          (g.gen ((fairVecCappedAssignment m s.bits).deinterleave j k)).get (h.2 j))
      else none := rfl
  rw [hgen]
  by_cases hc : (fairVecCappedAssignment m s.bits).Valid k ∧
      ∀ j, (g.gen ((fairVecCappedAssignment m s.bits).deinterleave j k)).isSome
  · rw [dite_eq_left hc]
    exact iff_of_true rfl ⟨hc.1, fun j b hj => (s.gen_isSome_iff _).mp (hc.2 j) b hj⟩
  · rw [dite_eq_right hc]
    refine iff_of_false (by simp) fun hlive => hc ⟨hlive.1, fun j => ?_⟩
    exact (s.gen_isSome_iff _).mpr fun b hb => hlive.2 j b hb

name: Azurite.CompressFast.fastUnrankPair_eq_specUnrankPair
statement:
theorem fastUnrankPair_eq_specUnrankPair {A B : Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (gB : ExhaustiveGenerator B) (sA : @FairSlot A gA) (sB : @FairSlot B gB) (i : ℕ) :
    fastUnrankPair gA gB sA sB i = specUnrankPair gA gB sA sB i
proof:
:=
  fastUnrank_eq_unrank (fairPairGenCapped_gen_isSome_iff gA gB sA sB) i

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.lengthsGen_contigStep
statement:
theorem lengthsGen_contigStep :
    ∀ n, lengthsGen.gen n = none → lengthsGen.gen (n + 1) = none
proof:
:=
  fun _ h => absurd h (Option.some_ne_none _)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.flattenShortlex_bijective
statement:
theorem flattenShortlex_bijective {T : Type*} :
    Function.Bijective (flattenShortlex (T := T))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    rintro ⟨n, ⟨v⟩⟩ ⟨m, ⟨w⟩⟩ h
    have hl : v.toList = w.toList := congrArg ShortlexVec.val h
    have hnm : n = m := by
      have := congrArg List.length hl
      rwa [v.toList_length, w.toList_length] at this
    subst hnm
    rw [List.Vector.eq v w hl]
  · 
    rintro ⟨l⟩
    exact ⟨⟨l.length, ⟨⟨l, rfl⟩⟩⟩, rfl⟩

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.gen_ne_none_of_infinite
statement:
theorem gen_ne_none_of_infinite [ExhaustiveGenerator T] [Contiguous T] [Infinite T] :
    ∀ n, gen (T := T) n ≠ none
proof:
:= by
  intro n h
  
  have hnone_ge : ∀ m, n ≤ m → gen (T := T) m = none := fun m hm => gen_none_of_le hm h
  
  let G : T → Fin n := fun t => ⟨idx t, by
    by_contra hge
    rw [Nat.not_lt] at hge
    exact Option.some_ne_none _ ((gen_idx t).symm.trans (hnone_ge (idx t) hge))⟩
  have hG : Function.Injective G := by
    intro a b hab
    have hidx : idx a = idx b := congrArg Fin.val hab
    have h1 := gen_idx a
    rw [hidx, gen_idx b] at h1
    exact (Option.some.inj h1).symm
  have : Finite T := Finite.of_injective G hG
  exact not_finite T

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.gen_isSome_of_infinite
statement:
theorem gen_isSome_of_infinite [ExhaustiveGenerator T] [Contiguous T] [Infinite T] (n : ℕ) :
    (gen (T := T) n).isSome
proof:
:=
  Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mpr (gen_ne_none_of_infinite n)

name: Azurite.BitAssignment.infinite_setOf_deinterleave_eq
statement:
theorem infinite_setOf_deinterleave_eq {m : ℕ} (A : BitAssignment m) {i j : Fin m}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (k : ℕ) : {n | A.deinterleave j n = k}.Infinite
proof:
:=
  Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem
    (f := fun a : ℕ => A.interleave fun l => if l = i then a else if l = j then k else 0)
    (fun a b hab => by
      have hab' : A.interleave (fun l => if l = i then a else if l = j then k else 0)
          = A.interleave (fun l => if l = i then b else if l = j then k else 0) := hab
      have ha := A.deinterleave_interleave
        (fun l => if l = i then a else if l = j then k else 0) i
      have hb := A.deinterleave_interleave
        (fun l => if l = i then b else if l = j then k else 0) i
      rw [show (if i = i then a else if i = j then k else 0) = a from ite_eq_left rfl] at ha
      rw [show (if i = i then b else if i = j then k else 0) = b from ite_eq_left rfl] at hb
      rw [← ha, ← hb, hab'])
    (fun a => by
      show A.deinterleave j (A.interleave _) = k
      rw [A.deinterleave_interleave]
      show (if j = i then a else if j = j then k else 0) = k
      rw [ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hij), ite_eq_left rfl])

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.infinite_setOf_bitDistributorSequence_eq
statement:
theorem infinite_setOf_bitDistributorSequence_eq (P : BitAssignment 2) (k : ℕ) :
    {n | bitDistributorSequence P n = k}.Infinite
proof:
:=
  P.infinite_setOf_deinterleave_eq (i := 0) (j := 1) (by decide) k

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.exists_le_and_bitDistributorSequence_eq
statement:
theorem exists_le_and_bitDistributorSequence_eq (P : BitAssignment 2) (k N : ℕ) :
    ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ bitDistributorSequence P n = k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hmem, hlt⟩ := (infinite_setOf_bitDistributorSequence_eq P k).exists_gt N
  exact ⟨n, le_of_lt hlt, hmem⟩

name: Azurite.twoAdicVal_of_odd
statement: theorem twoAdicVal_of_odd {n : ℕ} (h : n % 2 = 1) : twoAdicVal n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [twoAdicVal]
  exact dite_eq_left (Or.inr h)

name: Azurite.twoAdicVal_two_mul
statement:
theorem twoAdicVal_two_mul {n : ℕ} (h : 0 < n) :
    twoAdicVal (2 * n) = twoAdicVal n + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [twoAdicVal]
  rw [dite_eq_right (by omega), Nat.mul_div_cancel_left n (by norm_num)]

name: Azurite.two_pow_twoAdicVal_dvd
statement: theorem two_pow_twoAdicVal_dvd (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ twoAdicVal n ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [twoAdicVal]
    split_ifs with h
    · simp
    · 
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ih (n / 2) (Nat.div_lt_self (by omega) Nat.one_lt_two)
      refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
      rw [pow_succ]
      calc n = 2 * (n / 2) := by omega
        _ = 2 * (2 ^ twoAdicVal (n / 2) * c) := by rw [← hc]
        _ = 2 ^ twoAdicVal (n / 2) * 2 * c := by ring

name: Azurite.not_two_pow_twoAdicVal_succ_dvd
statement:
theorem not_two_pow_twoAdicVal_succ_dvd {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ¬2 ^ (twoAdicVal n + 1) ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro hdvd
    rw [twoAdicVal] at hdvd
    by_cases h : n = 0 ∨ n % 2 = 1
    · 
      rw [dite_eq_left h, zero_add, pow_one] at hdvd
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hdvd
      omega
    · 
      rw [dite_eq_right h] at hdvd
      refine ih (n / 2) (Nat.div_lt_self (by omega) Nat.one_lt_two) (by omega) ?_
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hdvd
      refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
      have hkey : n = 2 ^ (twoAdicVal (n / 2) + 1) * c * 2 := by
        conv_lhs => rw [hc]
        ring
      omega

name: Azurite.twoAdicVal_two_pow_mul_odd
statement:
theorem twoAdicVal_two_pow_mul_odd (k m : ℕ) :
    twoAdicVal (2 ^ k * (2 * m + 1)) = k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, one_mul]; exact twoAdicVal_of_odd (by omega)
  | succ k ih =>
    have h : 2 ^ (k + 1) * (2 * m + 1) = 2 * (2 ^ k * (2 * m + 1)) := by ring
    rw [h, twoAdicVal_two_mul (by positivity), ih]

name: Azurite.twoAdicVal_eq_padicValNat
statement:
theorem twoAdicVal_eq_padicValNat {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    twoAdicVal n = padicValNat 2 n
proof:
:= by
  have hle : twoAdicVal n ≤ padicValNat 2 n :=
    ((padicValNat_dvd_iff_of_ne_one (by norm_num) _ _).mp
      (two_pow_twoAdicVal_dvd n)).resolve_left hn
  have hge : padicValNat 2 n ≤ twoAdicVal n := by
    by_contra hlt
    exact not_two_pow_twoAdicVal_succ_dvd hn
      ((pow_dvd_pow 2 (by omega)).trans pow_padicValNat_dvd)
  omega

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.rulerSequence_eq_padicValNat
statement:
theorem rulerSequence_eq_padicValNat (n : ℕ) :
    rulerSequence n = padicValNat 2 (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  twoAdicVal_eq_padicValNat (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.two_pow_rulerSequence_le
statement: theorem two_pow_rulerSequence_le (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ rulerSequence n ≤ n + 1
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.succ_pos n) (two_pow_twoAdicVal_dvd (n + 1))

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.rulerSequence_le_log
statement: theorem rulerSequence_le_log (n : ℕ) : rulerSequence n ≤ Nat.log 2 (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_log_of_pow_le Nat.one_lt_two (two_pow_rulerSequence_le n)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.rulerSequence_two_pow_sub_one
statement: theorem rulerSequence_two_pow_sub_one (k : ℕ) : rulerSequence (2 ^ k - 1) = k
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 1 ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  have h : 2 ^ k - 1 + 1 = 2 ^ k * (2 * 0 + 1) := by omega
  rw [rulerSequence, h, twoAdicVal_two_pow_mul_odd]

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.rulerSequence_lt_of_lt_two_pow
statement:
theorem rulerSequence_lt_of_lt_two_pow {k n : ℕ} (h : n + 1 < 2 ^ k) :
    rulerSequence n < k
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hge
  have h1 : 2 ^ k ≤ 2 ^ rulerSequence n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
  have h2 := two_pow_rulerSequence_le n
  omega

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.rulerSequence_two_pow_sub_one_add_mul
statement:
theorem rulerSequence_two_pow_sub_one_add_mul (k m : ℕ) :
    rulerSequence (2 ^ k - 1 + m * 2 ^ (k + 1)) = k
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 1 ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  have h : 2 ^ k - 1 + m * 2 ^ (k + 1) + 1 = 2 ^ k * (2 * m + 1) := by
    calc 2 ^ k - 1 + m * 2 ^ (k + 1) + 1 = m * (2 ^ k * 2) + 2 ^ k := by
          rw [← pow_succ]; omega
      _ = 2 ^ k * (2 * m + 1) := by ring
  rw [rulerSequence, h, twoAdicVal_two_pow_mul_odd]

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.infinite_setOf_rulerSequence_eq
statement:
theorem infinite_setOf_rulerSequence_eq (k : ℕ) :
    {n | rulerSequence n = k}.Infinite
proof:
:=
  Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem
    (f := fun m : ℕ => 2 ^ k - 1 + m * 2 ^ (k + 1))
    (fun a b hab => by
      have h : 2 ^ k - 1 + a * 2 ^ (k + 1) = 2 ^ k - 1 + b * 2 ^ (k + 1) := hab
      have h2 : a * 2 ^ (k + 1) = b * 2 ^ (k + 1) := by omega
      have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ (k + 1) := by positivity
      exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hpos h2)
    (fun m => rulerSequence_two_pow_sub_one_add_mul k m)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.exists_le_and_rulerSequence_eq
statement:
theorem exists_le_and_rulerSequence_eq (k N : ℕ) :
    ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ rulerSequence n = k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨2 ^ k - 1 + N * 2 ^ (k + 1), ?_, rulerSequence_two_pow_sub_one_add_mul k N⟩
  have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ (k + 1) := by positivity
  have h : N ≤ N * 2 ^ (k + 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right N hpos
  omega

name: Azurite.natRangeGen_contigStep
statement:
theorem natRangeGen_contigStep (a b : ℕ) :
    ∀ n, (natRangeGen a b).gen n = none → (natRangeGen a b).gen (n + 1) = none
proof:
:= by
  intro n h
  by_cases hn : n < b - a
  · rw [show (natRangeGen a b).gen n
        = some ⟨a + n, Nat.le_add_right a n, by omega⟩ from dite_eq_left hn] at h
    exact absurd h (Option.some_ne_none _)
  · exact dite_eq_right (by omega)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.flattenShortlexRange_bijective
statement:
theorem flattenShortlexRange_bijective {T : Type*} {a b : ℕ} :
    Function.Bijective (flattenShortlexRange (T := T) (a := a) (b := b))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, ⟨v⟩⟩ ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, ⟨w⟩⟩ h
    have hl : v.toList = w.toList := congrArg Subtype.val h
    have hnm : n = m := by
      have := congrArg List.length hl
      rwa [v.toList_length, w.toList_length] at this
    subst hnm
    rw [List.Vector.eq v w hl]
  · rintro ⟨l, hl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨⟨l.length, hl⟩, ⟨⟨l, rfl⟩⟩⟩, rfl⟩

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.flattenVecRange_bijective
statement:
theorem flattenVecRange_bijective {T : Type*} {a b : ℕ} :
    Function.Bijective (flattenVecRange (T := T) (a := a) (b := b))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, v⟩ ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, w⟩ h
    have hl : v.toList = w.toList := congrArg Subtype.val h
    have hnm : n = m := by
      have := congrArg List.length hl
      rwa [v.toList_length, w.toList_length] at this
    subst hnm
    rw [List.Vector.eq v w hl]
  · rintro ⟨l, hl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨⟨l.length, hl⟩, ⟨l, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩

name: Azurite.LexVec.card
statement:
theorem card {T : Type*} [Fintype T] {n : ℕ} :
    Fintype.card (LexVec T n) = (Fintype.card T) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_congr equivVector, card_vector]

name: Azurite.LexVec.eq_zero
statement: theorem eq_zero {T : Type*} (t : LexVec T 0) : t = ⟨List.Vector.nil⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v⟩ := t; rw [v.eq_nil]

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.consVec_bijective
statement:
theorem consVec_bijective {T : Type*} {n : ℕ} :
    Function.Bijective (consVec : LexPair T (LexVec T n) → LexVec T (n + 1))
proof:
:=
  Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr
    ⟨fun p => ⟨p.val.head, ⟨p.val.tail⟩⟩,
     fun p => by
       obtain ⟨a, ⟨v⟩⟩ := p
       show (⟨(a ::ᵥ v).head, ⟨(a ::ᵥ v).tail⟩⟩ : LexPair T (LexVec T n)) = ⟨a, ⟨v⟩⟩
       rw [List.Vector.head_cons, List.Vector.tail_cons],
     fun p => by
       obtain ⟨v⟩ := p
       exact congrArg LexVec.mk (List.Vector.cons_head_tail v)⟩

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.LexVecData.contiguous
statement:
theorem LexVecData.contiguous {T : Type*} {cT n : ℕ} (d : LexVecData T cT n) :
    @Contiguous _ d.gen
proof:
:= by
  refine @Contiguous.mk (LexVec T n) d.gen (fun k h => d.hnone (k + 1) ?_)
  by_contra hlt
  exact d.hsome k (by omega) h

name: Azurite.lt_iff_exists_diff_bit
statement:
theorem lt_iff_exists_diff_bit {k n : ℕ} :
    k < n ↔ ∃ i, n.testBit i = true ∧ k.testBit i = false ∧
      ∀ i', i < i' → k.testBit i' = n.testBit i'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hkn
    have hne : k ^^^ n ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hkeq : k = n := Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq fun i => by
        have h := congrArg (fun x => x.testBit i) h0
        simp only [Nat.testBit_xor, Nat.zero_testBit] at h
        revert h
        cases k.testBit i <;> cases n.testBit i <;> simp
      omega
    obtain ⟨i, hbit, hhigh⟩ := Nat.exists_most_significant_bit hne
    have hagree : ∀ i', i < i' → k.testBit i' = n.testBit i' := by
      intro i' hi'
      have h := hhigh i' hi'
      rw [Nat.testBit_xor] at h
      revert h
      cases k.testBit i' <;> cases n.testBit i' <;> simp
    rw [Nat.testBit_xor] at hbit
    rcases hk : k.testBit i with _ | _ <;> rcases hn : n.testBit i with _ | _
    · rw [hk, hn] at hbit; exact absurd hbit (by simp)
    · exact ⟨i, hn, hk, hagree⟩
    · 
      exact absurd (Nat.lt_of_testBit i hn hk fun j hj => (hagree j hj).symm) (by omega)
    · rw [hk, hn] at hbit; exact absurd hbit (by simp)
  · rintro ⟨i, hn, hk, hagree⟩
    exact Nat.lt_of_testBit i hk hn hagree

name: Azurite.diff_bit_unique
statement:
theorem diff_bit_unique {k n i i' : ℕ}
    (h : k.testBit i = false ∧ ∀ p, i < p → k.testBit p = n.testBit p)
    (h' : k.testBit i' = false ∧ ∀ p, i' < p → k.testBit p = n.testBit p)
    (hn : n.testBit i = true) (hn' : n.testBit i' = true) : i = i'
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy i i' with hlt | heq | hgt
  · have := h.2 i' hlt
    rw [h'.1, hn'] at this
    exact absurd this (by simp)
  · exact heq
  · have := h'.2 i hgt
    rw [h.1, hn] at this
    exact absurd this (by simp)

name: Azurite.testBit_add_of_mod_eq_zero
statement:
theorem testBit_add_of_mod_eq_zero {a b f : ℕ} (ha : a % 2 ^ f = 0) (hb : b < 2 ^ f)
    (p : ℕ) : (a + b).testBit p = if p < f then b.testBit p else a.testBit p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : 2 ^ f ∣ a := Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero ha
  subst hq
  rw [Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul_add q hb p]
  by_cases hp : p < f
  · rw [ite_eq_left hp, ite_eq_left hp]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hp, ite_eq_right hp,
      show 2 ^ f * q = q <<< f by rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.mul_comm],
      Nat.testBit_shiftLeft]
    simp [Nat.le_of_not_lt hp]

name: Azurite.card_filter_range_add_lt
statement:
theorem card_filter_range_add_lt (F D c : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.range F).filter fun x => D + x < c).card = min F (c - D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (Finset.range F).filter (fun x => D + x < c) = Finset.range (min F (c - D)) by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_min]
    omega]
  exact Finset.card_range _

name: Azurite.CappedRoundRobin.roundStart_eq_sum
statement:
theorem roundStart_eq_sum (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ) (t : ℕ) :
    roundStart cap t = ∑ j, (cap j).elim t (min t)
proof:
:= by
  calc roundStart cap t
      = ∑ t' ∈ Finset.range t, ∑ j : Fin m, if ActiveIn cap t' j then 1 else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t' _ => ?_
        rw [roundSize, Finset.card_filter]
    _ = ∑ j : Fin m, ∑ t' ∈ Finset.range t, if ActiveIn cap t' j then 1 else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ j : Fin m, (cap j).elim t (min t) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        rcases hc : cap j with _ | b
        · 
          have hone : ∀ t' ∈ Finset.range t, (if ActiveIn cap t' j then 1 else 0) = 1 :=
            fun t' _ => ite_eq_left fun b hb => nomatch hc.symm.trans hb
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hone]
          simp
        · 
          have hiff : ∀ t' ∈ Finset.range t, (if ActiveIn cap t' j then 1 else 0)
              = if t' < b then 1 else 0 := by
            intro t' _
            by_cases h : t' < b
            · have ha : ActiveIn cap t' j := fun b' hb' =>
                Option.some.inj (hc.symm.trans hb') ▸ h
              rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left ha]
            · have hna : ¬ActiveIn cap t' j := fun ha => h (ha b hc)
              rw [ite_eq_right hna, ite_eq_right h]
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hiff, ← Finset.card_filter,
            show (Finset.range t).filter (fun t' => t' < b) = Finset.range (min t b) by
              ext x; simp]
          simp [Finset.card_range]

name: Azurite.CappedRoundRobin.posFast_eq
statement:
theorem posFast_eq (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ) (j : Fin m) (r : ℕ) :
    posFast cap j r = posFun cap j r
proof:
:= by
  rw [posFast, posFun, roundStart_eq_sum]

name: Azurite.CompressFast.deiFast_eq
statement:
theorem deiFast_eq (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ) (j : Fin m) (k : ℕ) :
    deiFast cap j k = (cappedRoundRobin cap).deinterleave j k
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => by rw [posFast_eq]; rfl

name: Azurite.CompressFast.owned_iff_totalBits
statement:
theorem owned_iff_totalBits (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ) (p : ℕ) :
    (cappedRoundRobin cap).Owned p ↔ Under (totalBits cap) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [totalBits]
  split
  · next h =>
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : Fin m → ℕ, ∀ j, cap j = some (b j) :=
      ⟨fun j => (cap j).get (h j), fun j => (Option.some_get (h j)).symm⟩
    have hcap : cap = fun j => some (b j) := funext hb
    subst hcap
    rw [cappedRoundRobin_owned_iff b p, under_some_iff]
    simp
  · next h =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := not_forall.mp h
    have hjn : cap j = none := Option.not_isSome_iff_eq_none.mp hj
    exact ⟨fun _ => under_none p, fun _ => cappedRoundRobin_owned_of_none hjn p⟩

name: Azurite.CompressFast.valid_lt_two_pow_of_totalBits
statement:
theorem valid_lt_two_pow_of_totalBits {cap : Fin m → Option ℕ} {B k : ℕ}
    (htb : totalBits cap = some B) (hv : (cappedRoundRobin cap).Valid k) : k < 2 ^ B
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_two_pow_of_testBit_eq_false
  intro p hp
  by_contra hbit
  simp only [Bool.not_eq_false] at hbit
  have hown := (owned_iff_totalBits cap p).mp (hv p hbit)
  rw [htb] at hown
  exact absurd (under_some_iff.mp hown) (by omega)

name: Azurite.CompressFast.exists_freeCount
statement:
theorem exists_freeCount (A : CappedBitAssignment m) (j : Fin m) (i : ℕ) :
    ∃ f, A.deinterleave j (2 ^ i - 1) + 1 = 2 ^ f
      ∧ (∀ r, ((∀ b, A.cap j = some b → r < b) ∧ A.pos j r < i) ↔ r < f)
      ∧ (∀ b, A.cap j = some b → f ≤ b)
proof:
:= by
  set S := (Finset.range i).filter
    (fun r => (∀ b, A.cap j = some b → r < b) ∧ A.pos j r < i) with hS
  have hmem : ∀ r, r ∈ S ↔ ((∀ b, A.cap j = some b → r < b) ∧ A.pos j r < i) := by
    intro r
    rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
    exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (A.le_pos j r h.1) h.2, h⟩⟩
  have hchar : ∀ r, ((∀ b, A.cap j = some b → r < b) ∧ A.pos j r < i) ↔ r < S.card := by
    intro r
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hsub : Finset.range (r + 1) ⊆ S := by
        intro r' hr'
        have hr'r : r' ≤ r := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hr')
        refine (hmem r').mpr ⟨A.valid_of_le hr'r h.1, ?_⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hr'r with hlt | heq
        · exact Nat.lt_trans (A.pos_lt_pos j r' r h.1 hlt) h.2
        · exact heq ▸ h.2
      have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      rw [Finset.card_range] at this
      omega
    · intro hr
      by_contra hno
      have hsub : S ⊆ Finset.range r := by
        intro s hs
        rw [Finset.mem_range]
        by_contra hge
        have hs' := (hmem s).mp hs
        have hrs : r ≤ s := Nat.le_of_not_lt hge
        refine hno ⟨A.valid_of_le hrs hs'.1, ?_⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hrs with hlt | heq
        · exact Nat.lt_trans (A.pos_lt_pos j r s hs'.1 hlt) hs'.2
        · exact heq ▸ hs'.2
      have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      rw [Finset.card_range] at this
      omega
  refine ⟨S.card, ?_, hchar, ?_⟩
  · have hdei : A.deinterleave j (2 ^ i - 1) = 2 ^ S.card - 1 := by
      apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
      intro r
      rw [A.testBit_deinterleave, Nat.testBit_two_pow_sub_one, Nat.testBit_two_pow_sub_one]
      by_cases hv : ∀ b, A.cap j = some b → r < b
      · rw [decide_eq_true hv, Bool.true_and]
        by_cases hp : A.pos j r < i
        · rw [decide_eq_true hp, decide_eq_true ((hchar r).mp ⟨hv, hp⟩)]
        · rw [decide_eq_false hp, eq_comm, decide_eq_false
            fun hrf => hp ((hchar r).mpr hrf).2]
      · rw [decide_eq_false hv, Bool.false_and, eq_comm, decide_eq_false
          fun hrf => hv ((hchar r).mpr hrf).1]
    rw [hdei]
    have : 1 ≤ 2 ^ S.card := Nat.one_le_two_pow
    omega
  · intro b hb
    by_contra hgt
    have := ((hchar b).mpr (Nat.lt_of_not_le hgt)).1 b hb
    omega

name: Azurite.CompressFast.deinterleave_lt_of_lt_two_pow
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_two_pow_of_testBit_eq_false
  intro r hr
  rw [A.testBit_deinterleave]
  by_cases hv : ∀ b, A.cap j = some b → r < b
  · rw [decide_eq_true hv, Bool.true_and]
    have hpos : ¬A.pos j r < i := fun hp => absurd ((hf r).mp ⟨hv, hp⟩) (by omega)
    exact Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow (lt_of_lt_of_le hlo
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Nat.le_of_not_lt hpos)))
  · simp [hv]

name: Azurite.CompressFast.deinterleave_add_of_prefix
proof:
:= by
  have hhimod : hi % 2 ^ (i + 1) = 0 := Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq fun p => by
    rw [Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow, Nat.zero_testBit]
    by_cases hp : p < i + 1
    · rw [hhi p (by omega)]
      simp
    · simp [hp]
  have hlo' : lo < 2 ^ (i + 1) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hlo (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega))
  have hsum := testBit_add_of_mod_eq_zero hhimod hlo'
  have hdlo : A.deinterleave j lo < 2 ^ f := deinterleave_lt_of_lt_two_pow A hlo hf
  have hdhimod : A.deinterleave j hi % 2 ^ f = 0 := Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq fun r => by
    rw [Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow, Nat.zero_testBit]
    by_cases hrf : r < f
    · obtain ⟨hv, hp⟩ := (hf r).mpr hrf
      rw [A.testBit_deinterleave, hhi (A.pos j r) (by omega)]
      simp
    · simp [hrf]
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
  intro r
  rw [A.testBit_deinterleave, testBit_add_of_mod_eq_zero hdhimod hdlo r]
  by_cases hrf : r < f
  · obtain ⟨hv, hp⟩ := (hf r).mpr hrf
    rw [ite_eq_left hrf, A.testBit_deinterleave, hsum (A.pos j r), ite_eq_left (by omega)]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hrf, A.testBit_deinterleave]
    by_cases hv : ∀ b, A.cap j = some b → r < b
    · have hpos : ¬A.pos j r < i := fun hp => hrf ((hf r).mp ⟨hv, hp⟩)
      rw [hsum (A.pos j r)]
      by_cases hpi : A.pos j r < i + 1
      · have hpe : A.pos j r = i := by omega
        rw [ite_eq_left hpi, hpe, hhi i (le_refl i), Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow (hpe ▸ hlo)]
      · rw [ite_eq_right hpi]
    · simp [hv]

name: Azurite.CompressFast.shiftRight_eq_iff_agree
statement:
theorem shiftRight_eq_iff_agree {k n i : ℕ} :
    k >>> (i + 1) = n >>> (i + 1) ↔ ∀ p, i < p → k.testBit p = n.testBit p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h p hp
    have := congrArg (fun x => x.testBit (p - (i + 1))) h
    simp only [Nat.testBit_shiftRight] at this
    rwa [show i + 1 + (p - (i + 1)) = p by omega] at this
  · intro h
    apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
    intro p
    rw [Nat.testBit_shiftRight, Nat.testBit_shiftRight]
    exact h (i + 1 + p) (by omega)

name: Azurite.CompressFast.card_class
statement:
theorem card_class (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ) (cards : Fin m → ℕ) {n' i : ℕ}
    (hbit : n'.testBit i = true)
    (hval : (cappedRoundRobin cap).Valid ((n' >>> (i + 1)) <<< (i + 1))) :
    ((Finset.range n').filter fun k => Live cap cards k ∧ k.testBit i = false ∧
        k >>> (i + 1) = n' >>> (i + 1)).card
      = ∏ j, slotCount cap cards j i ((n' >>> (i + 1)) <<< (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  set A := cappedRoundRobin cap with hA
  set hi' := (n' >>> (i + 1)) <<< (i + 1) with hhi'def
  
  have hhibit : ∀ p, p ≤ i → hi'.testBit p = false := by
    intro p hp
    rw [hhi'def, Nat.testBit_shiftLeft]
    simp [Nat.not_le_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hp)]
  have hhibit' : ∀ p, i < p → hi'.testBit p = n'.testBit p := by
    intro p hp
    rw [hhi'def, Nat.testBit_shiftLeft, Nat.testBit_shiftRight,
      show i + 1 + (p - (i + 1)) = p by omega]
    simp [Nat.succ_le_of_lt hp]
  have hhimul : hi' = 2 ^ (i + 1) * (n' >>> (i + 1)) := by
    rw [hhi'def, Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.mul_comm]
  have hhimod : hi' % 2 ^ (i + 1) = 0 := by
    rw [hhimul]
    exact Nat.mul_mod_right _ _
  
  choose f hF hfr hfb using fun j => exists_freeCount A j i
  
  have hslot : ∀ j, slotCount cap cards j i hi' = match cap j with
      | none => 2 ^ f j
      | some _ => min (2 ^ f j) (cards j - A.deinterleave j hi') := by
    intro j
    rcases hc : cap j with _ | b <;>
      simp only [slotCount, hc, deiFast_eq, ← hA, hF j]
  have hx2f : ∀ (x : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ j, x j < slotCount cap cards j i hi') →
      ∀ j, x j < 2 ^ f j := by
    intro x hx j
    have := hx j
    rw [hslot j] at this
    rcases hc : cap j with _ | b
    · rwa [hc] at this
    · rw [hc] at this
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le this (min_le_left _ _)
  
  rw [show (∏ j, slotCount cap cards j i hi')
      = (Fintype.piFinset fun j => Finset.range (slotCount cap cards j i hi')).card by
    rw [Fintype.card_piFinset]
    exact (Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => (Finset.card_range _).symm)]
  
  refine Finset.card_bij' (fun k _ j => A.deinterleave j (k % 2 ^ (i + 1)))
    (fun x _ => hi' + A.interleave x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · 
    intro k hk
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hk
    obtain ⟨hkn, hlive, hkbit, hkagree⟩ := hk
    
    have hlo_lt : k % 2 ^ (i + 1) < 2 ^ i := by
      apply lt_two_pow_of_testBit_eq_false
      intro p hp
      rw [Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow]
      by_cases hpi : p < i + 1
      · rw [show p = i by omega, hkbit]
        simp
      · simp [hpi]
    have hksplit : k = hi' + k % 2 ^ (i + 1) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.div_add_mod k (2 ^ (i + 1))]
      rw [hhimul, ← Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow, hkagree]
    rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
    intro j
    rw [Finset.mem_range, hslot j]
    have hdlo : A.deinterleave j (k % 2 ^ (i + 1)) < 2 ^ f j :=
      deinterleave_lt_of_lt_two_pow A hlo_lt (hfr j)
    rcases hc : cap j with _ | b
    · exact hdlo
    · refine Nat.lt_min.mpr ⟨hdlo, ?_⟩
      have hsplit := deinterleave_add_of_prefix A hhibit hlo_lt (hfr j)
      rw [← hksplit] at hsplit
      have hcapped := hlive.2 j b hc
      rw [← hA] at hcapped
      omega
  · 
    intro x hx
    rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset] at hx
    have hx' : ∀ j, x j < slotCount cap cards j i hi' := fun j =>
      Finset.mem_range.mp (hx j)
    have hxf := hx2f x hx'
    
    have hlox : A.interleave x < 2 ^ i := by
      apply lt_two_pow_of_testBit_eq_false
      intro p hp
      cases hsl : A.slotOf p with
      | none => exact A.testBit_interleave_unowned x hsl
      | some j =>
        rw [A.testBit_interleave_owned x hsl]
        obtain ⟨hpos, hvalid⟩ := A.pos_rank p j hsl
        by_contra hbitp
        simp only [Bool.not_eq_false] at hbitp
        have hrank : A.rank p < f j := by
          have h2 : 2 ^ A.rank p ≤ x j := Nat.ge_two_pow_of_testBit hbitp
          have := hxf j
          by_contra hge
          exact absurd (lt_of_le_of_lt h2 this)
            (Nat.not_lt.mpr (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Nat.le_of_not_lt hge)))
        have hlt := ((hfr j) (A.rank p)).mpr hrank
        rw [hpos] at hlt
        omega
    have hlox' : A.interleave x < 2 ^ (i + 1) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hlox (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega))
    have hsum := testBit_add_of_mod_eq_zero hhimod hlox'
    
    have hcapb : ∀ j b, A.cap j = some b → x j < 2 ^ b := by
      intro j b hb
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (hxf j)
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (hfb j b hb))
    have hdix : ∀ j, A.deinterleave j (A.interleave x) = x j :=
      A.deinterleave_interleave x hcapb
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
    refine ⟨?_, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      refine Nat.lt_of_testBit i ?_ hbit ?_
      · rw [hsum i, ite_eq_left (by omega)]
        exact Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow hlox
      · intro p hp
        rw [hsum p, ite_eq_right (by omega), hhibit' p hp]
    · 
      intro p hbitp
      rw [hsum p] at hbitp
      by_cases hpi : p < i + 1
      · rw [ite_eq_left hpi] at hbitp
        exact A.interleave_valid x p hbitp
      · rw [ite_eq_right hpi] at hbitp
        exact hval p hbitp
    · 
      intro j b hc
      rw [← hA, deinterleave_add_of_prefix A hhibit hlox (hfr j), hdix j]
      have := hx' j
      rw [hslot j, hc] at this
      have hDx := Nat.lt_min.mp this
      omega
    · 
      rw [hsum i, ite_eq_left (by omega)]
      exact Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow hlox
    · 
      rw [shiftRight_eq_iff_agree]
      intro p hp
      rw [hsum p, ite_eq_right (by omega), hhibit' p hp]
  · 
    intro k hk
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hk
    obtain ⟨hkn, hlive, hkbit, hkagree⟩ := hk
    have hlo_lt : k % 2 ^ (i + 1) < 2 ^ i := by
      apply lt_two_pow_of_testBit_eq_false
      intro p hp
      rw [Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow]
      by_cases hpi : p < i + 1
      · rw [show p = i by omega, hkbit]
        simp
      · simp [hpi]
