    have hksplit : k = hi' + k % 2 ^ (i + 1) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.div_add_mod k (2 ^ (i + 1))]
      rw [hhimul, ← Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow, hkagree]
    have hlov : A.Valid (k % 2 ^ (i + 1)) := by
      intro p hbitp
      rw [Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbitp
      exact hlive.1 p hbitp.2
    have hid := A.interleave_deinterleave (k % 2 ^ (i + 1)) hlov
    calc hi' + A.interleave (fun j => A.deinterleave j (k % 2 ^ (i + 1)))
        = hi' + A.interleave (A.deinterleaveTuple (k % 2 ^ (i + 1))) := rfl
      _ = hi' + k % 2 ^ (i + 1) := by rw [hid]
      _ = k := hksplit.symm
  · 
    intro x hx
    rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset] at hx
    have hxf := hx2f x fun j => Finset.mem_range.mp (hx j)
    have hlox : A.interleave x < 2 ^ i := by
      apply lt_two_pow_of_testBit_eq_false
      intro p hp
      cases hsl : A.slotOf p with
      | none => exact A.testBit_interleave_unowned x hsl
      | some j =>
        rw [A.testBit_interleave_owned x hsl]
        obtain ⟨hpos, hvalid⟩ := A.pos_rank p j hsl
        by_contra hbitp
        simp only [Bool.not_eq_false] at hbitp
        have hrank : A.rank p < f j := by
          have h2 : 2 ^ A.rank p ≤ x j := Nat.ge_two_pow_of_testBit hbitp
          have := hxf j
          by_contra hge
          exact absurd (lt_of_le_of_lt h2 this)
            (Nat.not_lt.mpr (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Nat.le_of_not_lt hge)))
        have hlt := ((hfr j) (A.rank p)).mpr hrank
        rw [hpos] at hlt
        omega
    have hmod : (hi' + A.interleave x) % 2 ^ (i + 1) = A.interleave x := by
      rw [hhimul, Nat.mul_add_mod_self_left]
      exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hlox
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)))
    have hcapb : ∀ j b, A.cap j = some b → x j < 2 ^ b := fun j b hb =>
      lt_of_lt_of_le (hxf j) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (hfb j b hb))
    funext j
    rw [hmod]
    exact A.deinterleave_interleave x hcapb j

name: Azurite.CompressFast.sum_classes_eq_card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  have hpart : (Finset.range n').filter (fun k => Live cap cards k)
      = ((Finset.range n'.size).filter fun i => n'.testBit i).biUnion
          fun i => (Finset.range n').filter fun k => Live cap cards k ∧
            k.testBit i = false ∧ k >>> (i + 1) = n' >>> (i + 1) := by
    ext k
    simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hkn, hlive⟩
      obtain ⟨i, hni, hki, hagree⟩ := lt_iff_exists_diff_bit.mp hkn
      exact ⟨i, ⟨Nat.lt_size.mpr (Nat.ge_two_pow_of_testBit hni), hni⟩,
        hkn, hlive, hki, shiftRight_eq_iff_agree.mpr hagree⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, -, hkn, hlive, -, -⟩
      exact ⟨hkn, hlive⟩
  have hdisj : (↑((Finset.range n'.size).filter fun i => n'.testBit i) :
      Set ℕ).PairwiseDisjoint
      (fun i => (Finset.range n').filter fun k => Live cap cards k ∧
        k.testBit i = false ∧ k >>> (i + 1) = n' >>> (i + 1)) := by
    intro i hi i' hi' hne
    simp only [Function.onFun]
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro k hk hk'
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hk hk'
    have hi_bit := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hi)).2
    have hi'_bit := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hi')).2
    exact hne (diff_bit_unique ⟨hk.2.2.1, shiftRight_eq_iff_agree.mp hk.2.2.2⟩
      ⟨hk'.2.2.1, shiftRight_eq_iff_agree.mp hk'.2.2.2⟩ hi_bit hi'_bit)
  rw [hpart, Finset.card_biUnion hdisj]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  have hbit := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
  exact (card_class cap cards hbit (hval i hbit)).symm

name: Azurite.CompressFast.countBelow_eq_card
statement:
theorem countBelow_eq_card (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ) (cards : Fin m → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    countBelow cap cards n = ((Finset.range n).filter fun k => Live cap cards k).card
proof:
:= by
  rcases htb : totalBits cap with _ | B
  · 
    rw [countBelow]
    simp only [htb]
    refine sum_classes_eq_card cap cards fun i _ => ?_
    intro p _
    rw [owned_iff_totalBits cap p, htb]
    exact under_none p
  · 
    have hclip : (Finset.range n).filter (fun k => Live cap cards k)
        = (Finset.range (min n (2 ^ B))).filter (fun k => Live cap cards k) := by
      ext k
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_min]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hkn, hlive⟩
        exact ⟨⟨hkn, valid_lt_two_pow_of_totalBits htb hlive.1⟩, hlive⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨hkn, -⟩, hlive⟩
        exact ⟨hkn, hlive⟩
    rw [countBelow]
    simp only [htb]
    rw [hclip]
    refine sum_classes_eq_card cap cards fun i hbit => ?_
    intro p hbitp
    rw [Nat.testBit_shiftLeft, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
      Nat.testBit_shiftRight, show i + 1 + (p - (i + 1)) = p from by omega] at hbitp
    obtain ⟨hip, hNp⟩ := hbitp
    have h2p : 2 ^ p ≤ min n (2 ^ B) := Nat.ge_two_pow_of_testBit hNp
    rw [owned_iff_totalBits cap p, htb]
    rw [under_some_iff]
    have hpB : p ≤ B := by
      by_contra hgt
      have h1 : 2 ^ (B + 1) ≤ 2 ^ p := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
      have h2 : 2 ^ p ≤ 2 ^ B := le_trans h2p (min_le_right _ _)
      have h3 : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ B := Nat.one_le_two_pow
      have h4 : 2 ^ (B + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ B := by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]
      omega
    rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hpB with h | h
    · exact h
    · 
      
      subst h
      have hNe : min n (2 ^ p) = 2 ^ p := le_antisymm (min_le_right _ _) h2p
      rw [hNe, Nat.testBit_two_pow_of_ne (show p ≠ i by omega)] at hbit
      exact absurd hbit (by simp)

name: Azurite.CompressFast.countBelow_eq_rankSpec
statement:
theorem countBelow_eq_rankSpec {T : Type*} (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T)
    {cap : Fin m → Option ℕ} {cards : Fin m → ℕ}
    (hbr : ∀ k, (g.gen k).isSome ↔ Live cap cards k) (n : ℕ) :
    countBelow cap cards n = rankSpec g n
proof:
:= by
  rw [countBelow_eq_card, rankSpec]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.filter_congr
  intro k _
  simp [hbr k]

name: Azurite.CompressFast.binSearch_spec
statement:
theorem binSearch_spec {P : ℕ → Bool} (hmono : ∀ x y, x ≤ y → P x = true → P y = true)
    {lo hi : ℕ} (hlh : lo ≤ hi) (hhi : P hi = true) :
    P (binSearch P lo hi) = true
      ∧ (∀ x, lo ≤ x → x < binSearch P lo hi → P x = false)
      ∧ lo ≤ binSearch P lo hi ∧ binSearch P lo hi ≤ hi
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ d lo hi, hi - lo ≤ d → lo ≤ hi → P hi = true →
      P (binSearch P lo hi) = true
        ∧ (∀ x, lo ≤ x → x < binSearch P lo hi → P x = false)
        ∧ lo ≤ binSearch P lo hi ∧ binSearch P lo hi ≤ hi from
    h (hi - lo) lo hi (le_refl _) hlh hhi
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro lo hi hd hlh hhi
    have heq : hi = lo := by omega
    subst heq
    rw [binSearch, dite_eq_left (le_refl _)]
    exact ⟨hhi, fun x hx hx' => absurd hx' (by omega), le_refl _, le_refl _⟩
  | succ d ih =>
    intro lo hi hd hlh hhi
    rw [binSearch]
    split
    · next h =>
      have heq : lo = hi := by omega
      subst heq
      exact ⟨hhi, fun x hx hx' => absurd hx' (by omega), le_refl _, le_refl _⟩
    · next h =>
      have hlt : lo < hi := by omega
      split
      · next hm =>
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := ih lo ((lo + hi) / 2) (by omega) (by omega) hm
        exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, by omega⟩
      · next hm =>
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := ih ((lo + hi) / 2 + 1) hi (by omega) (by omega) hhi
        refine ⟨h1, ?_, by omega, h4⟩
        intro x hx hx'
        by_cases hxm : (lo + hi) / 2 + 1 ≤ x
        · exact h2 x hxm hx'
        · 
          rcases hPx : P x with _ | _
          · rfl
          · exact absurd (hmono x ((lo + hi) / 2) (by omega) hPx) hm

name: Azurite.CompressFast.fastUnrank_eq_unrank_of_under
proof:
:= by
  rw [fastUnrank, dite_eq_left hi]
  have hlive : (g.gen (unrank g N h i)).isSome := gen_unrank_isSome hi
  have hrank : rankSpec g (unrank g N h i) = i := rankSpec_unrank hi
  have hcb : ∀ x, countBelow cap cards x = rankSpec g x :=
    countBelow_eq_rankSpec g hbr
  set P := fun k => decide (i < countBelow cap cards (k + 1)) with hP
  have hmono : ∀ x y, x ≤ y → P x = true → P y = true := by
    intro x y hxy hx
    rw [hP, decide_eq_true_eq] at hx ⊢
    have := rankSpec_le_rankSpec g (show x + 1 ≤ y + 1 by omega)
    rw [hcb] at hx ⊢
    omega
  have hPu : P (unrank g N h i) = true := by
    rw [hP, decide_eq_true_eq, hcb, rankSpec_succ_of_isSome hlive, hrank]
    omega
  have hPbelow : ∀ x, x < unrank g N h i → P x = false := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hP, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Nat.not_lt, hcb]
    have := rankSpec_le_rankSpec g (show x + 1 ≤ unrank g N h i by omega)
    omega
  
  have hex : ∃ t, i < countBelow cap cards (2 ^ t) := by
    refine ⟨(unrank g N h i + 1).size, ?_⟩
    rw [countBelow_eq_rankSpec g hbr]
    have h1 : rankSpec g (unrank g N h i + 1) = i + 1 := by
      rw [rankSpec_succ_of_isSome hlive, hrank]
    have h2 : rankSpec g (unrank g N h i + 1)
        ≤ rankSpec g (2 ^ (unrank g N h i + 1).size) :=
      rankSpec_le_rankSpec g (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_size_self _))
    omega
  have hPhi : P (2 ^ Nat.find hex) = true := by
    have hspec := Nat.find_spec hex
    rw [hP, decide_eq_true_eq]
    have := rankSpec_le_rankSpec g (show 2 ^ Nat.find hex ≤ 2 ^ Nat.find hex + 1 by omega)
    rw [hcb] at hspec ⊢
    omega
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, -, -⟩ := binSearch_spec hmono (Nat.zero_le _) hPhi
  
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy (binSearch P 0 (2 ^ Nat.find hex)) (unrank g N h i)
    with hlt | heq | hgt
  · rw [hPbelow _ hlt] at h1
    exact absurd h1 (by simp)
  · exact heq
  · rw [h2 (unrank g N h i) (Nat.zero_le _) hgt] at hPu
    exact absurd hPu (by simp)

name: Azurite.CompressFast.fastUnrank_eq_unrank
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : Under N i
  · exact fastUnrank_eq_unrank_of_under hbr hi
  · rw [fastUnrank, dite_eq_right hi, unrank, dite_eq_right hi]

name: Azurite.CompressFast.compressFast_gen_eq_compress
statement:
theorem compressFast_gen_eq_compress {T : Type*} (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ)
    (cards : Fin m → ℕ) (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) (N : Option ℕ)
    (h : ∀ n, Under N (rankSpec g n) → ∃ k, n ≤ k ∧ (g.gen k).isSome)
    (h' : ∀ k, (g.gen k).isSome → Under N (rankSpec g k))
    (hbr : ∀ k, (g.gen k).isSome ↔ Live cap cards k) (i : ℕ) :
    (compressFast cap cards g N h h' hbr).gen i = (compress g N h h').gen i
proof:
:= by
  show (if Under N i then g.gen (fastUnrank cap cards g N h hbr i) else none)
    = (if Under N i then g.gen (unrank g N h i) else none)
  rw [fastUnrank_eq_unrank hbr i]

name: Azurite.CompressFast.compressFast_contiguous
statement:
theorem compressFast_contiguous {T : Type*} (cap : Fin m → Option ℕ)
    (cards : Fin m → ℕ) (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) (N : Option ℕ)
    (h : ∀ n, Under N (rankSpec g n) → ∃ k, n ≤ k ∧ (g.gen k).isSome)
    (h' : ∀ k, (g.gen k).isSome → Under N (rankSpec g k))
    (hbr : ∀ k, (g.gen k).isSome ↔ Live cap cards k) :
    @Contiguous T (compressFast cap cards g N h h' hbr)
proof:
:=
  @Contiguous.mk T (compressFast cap cards g N h h' hbr) fun n hnone => by
    rw [compressFast_gen_eq_compress] at hnone ⊢
    exact @Contiguous.contig T (compress g N h h') (compress_contiguous g N h h') n hnone

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.flattenVec_bijective
statement:
theorem flattenVec_bijective {T : Type*} :
    Function.Bijective (flattenVec (T := T))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    rintro ⟨n, v⟩ ⟨m, w⟩ h
    have hl : v.toList = w.toList := h
    have hnm : n = m := by
      have := congrArg List.length hl
      rwa [v.toList_length, w.toList_length] at this
    subst hnm
    rw [List.Vector.eq v w hl]
  · 
    intro l
    exact ⟨⟨l.length, ⟨l, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.snocNZ_bijective
statement:
theorem snocNZ_bijective {T : Type*} [Zero T] {n : ℕ} :
    Function.Bijective (snocNZ (T := T) (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, t, ht⟩ ⟨w, u, hu⟩ h
    have hl : v.toList ++ [t] = w.toList ++ [u] :=
      congrArg (fun x : {v : List.Vector T (n + 1) //
        v.toList.getLast? ≠ some 0} => x.val.toList) h
    obtain ⟨hvw, htu⟩ := List.append_inj hl
      (by rw [v.toList_length, w.toList_length])
    have h1 : v = w := List.Vector.eq v w hvw
    have h2 : t = u := by
      have := congrArg (fun l : List T => l.getLast?) htu
      simpa using this
    subst h1 h2
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨⟨l, hlen⟩, hlast⟩
    rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat l with rfl | ⟨l', x, rfl⟩
    · simp at hlen
    · have hlen' : l'.length = n := by
        have h2 : (l'.concat x).length = n + 1 := hlen
        rw [List.concat_eq_append, List.length_append] at h2
        simpa using h2
      have hlast' : (l'.concat x).getLast? ≠ some 0 := hlast
      rw [List.concat_eq_append, List.getLast?_concat] at hlast'
      have hx : x ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hlast' (by rw [h0])
      refine ⟨(⟨l', hlen'⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩), ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply List.Vector.eq
      show l' ++ [x] = List.Vector.toList ⟨l'.concat x, hlen⟩
      have hred : List.Vector.toList (⟨l'.concat x, hlen⟩ : List.Vector T (n + 1))
          = l'.concat x := rfl
      rw [hred, List.concat_eq_append]

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.flattenPoly_length
statement:
theorem flattenPoly_length {T : Type*} [Zero T] :
    ∀ p : (n : ℕ) × polyCoeffFiber T n, (flattenPoly p).val.length = p.1
  | ⟨0, v⟩ => v.toList_length
  | ⟨_ + 1, v⟩ => v.val.toList_length

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.flattenPoly_bijective
statement:
theorem flattenPoly_bijective {T : Type*} [Zero T] :
    Function.Bijective (flattenPoly (T := T))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, v⟩ ⟨m, w⟩ h
    have hl : (flattenPoly ⟨n, v⟩).val = (flattenPoly ⟨m, w⟩).val := congrArg Subtype.val h
    
    have hnm : n = m := by
      have h1 : (flattenPoly ⟨n, v⟩).val.length = n := flattenPoly_length ⟨n, v⟩
      have h2 : (flattenPoly ⟨m, w⟩).val.length = m := flattenPoly_length ⟨m, w⟩
      rw [← h1, ← h2, hl]
    subst hnm
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      have hv : v = List.Vector.nil := List.Vector.eq v List.Vector.nil
        (by rw [List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero v.toList_length]; rfl)
      have hw : w = List.Vector.nil := List.Vector.eq w List.Vector.nil
        (by rw [List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero w.toList_length]; rfl)
      rw [hv, hw]
    | succ n =>
      have hl' : v.val.toList = w.val.toList := hl
      have hvw : v = w := Subtype.ext (List.Vector.eq v.val w.val hl')
      rw [hvw]
  · rintro ⟨l, hl⟩
    cases hlen : l.length with
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨⟨0, List.Vector.nil⟩, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      show ([] : List T) = l
      exact (List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hlen).symm
    | succ n =>
      exact ⟨⟨n + 1, ⟨⟨l, hlen⟩, hl⟩⟩, rfl⟩

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.listToPoly_bijective
statement:
theorem listToPoly_bijective {R : Type*} [Semiring R] :
    Function.Bijective (listToPoly (R := R))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨l, hl⟩ ⟨l', hl'⟩ h
    have h2 : l.toArray.toList = l'.toArray.toList :=
      congrArg (fun p : AzPolynomial R => p.coeffs.toList) h
    exact Subtype.ext (show l = l' from h2)
  · intro p
    refine ⟨⟨p.coeffs.toList, by rw [Array.getLast?_toList]; exact p.last_ne_zero⟩, ?_⟩
    apply AzPolynomial.ext
    show p.coeffs.toList.toArray = p.coeffs
    exact Array.toArray_toList

name: Azurite.degree_lt_iff_size_le
statement:
theorem degree_lt_iff_size_le {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (p : AzPolynomial R) (b : ℕ) :
    p.degree < (b : WithBot ℕ) ↔ p.coeffs.size ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzPolynomial.degree
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [h]
  · rw [show ((p.natDegree : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) < (b : WithBot ℕ)
        ↔ p.natDegree < b from WithBot.coe_lt_coe]
    unfold AzPolynomial.natDegree
    have hpos : 0 < p.coeffs.size := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p.coeffs.size with h0 | h0
      · exact absurd (Array.eq_empty_of_size_eq_zero h0) h
      · exact h0
    omega

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.flattenPolyDegLt_bijective
statement:
theorem flattenPolyDegLt_bijective {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {b : ℕ} :
    Function.Bijective (flattenPolyDegLt (R := R) (b := b))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, v⟩ ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, w⟩ h
    have h1 : listToPoly (flattenPoly ⟨n, v⟩) = listToPoly (flattenPoly ⟨m, w⟩) :=
      congrArg Subtype.val h
    have h2 : flattenPoly (T := R) ⟨n, v⟩ = flattenPoly ⟨m, w⟩ :=
      listToPoly_bijective.injective h1
    have h3 : (⟨n, v⟩ : (k : ℕ) × polyCoeffFiber R k) = ⟨m, w⟩ :=
      flattenPoly_bijective.injective h2
    obtain ⟨hnm, hvw⟩ := Sigma.mk.injEq .. ▸ h3
    subst hnm
    have hvw' : v = w := eq_of_heq hvw
    subst hvw'
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, hlp⟩ := listToPoly_bijective.surjective p
    obtain ⟨⟨n, v⟩, hnv⟩ := flattenPoly_bijective.surjective ⟨l, hl⟩
    have hlen : n ≤ b := by
      have hsize : p.coeffs.size ≤ b := (degree_lt_iff_size_le p b).mp hp
      have h1 : (flattenPoly ⟨n, v⟩).val.length = n := flattenPoly_length ⟨n, v⟩
      rw [hnv] at h1
      have h2 : l.toArray.size = p.coeffs.size := by
        rw [show l.toArray = p.coeffs from congrArg AzPolynomial.coeffs hlp]
      rw [List.size_toArray] at h2
      have : l.length = n := h1
      omega
    refine ⟨⟨⟨n, Nat.zero_le n, by omega⟩, v⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    show listToPoly (flattenPoly ⟨n, v⟩) = p
    rw [hnv, hlp]

name: Azurite.revWeightSum_zero
statement: theorem revWeightSum_zero (w : Fin m → ℕ) : revWeightSum w 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_range_zero _

name: Azurite.revWeightSum_succ
statement:
theorem revWeightSum_succ (w : Fin m → ℕ) (r : ℕ) :
    revWeightSum w (r + 1)
      = revWeightSum w r + if h : r < m then w ⟨m - 1 - r, by omega⟩ else 0
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_range_succ _ r

name: Azurite.revWeightSum_succ_of_lt
statement:
theorem revWeightSum_succ_of_lt (w : Fin m → ℕ) {b : ℕ} (hb : b < m) :
    revWeightSum w (b + 1) = revWeightSum w b + w ⟨m - 1 - b, by omega⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [revWeightSum_succ, dite_eq_left hb]

name: Azurite.revWeightSum_mono
statement: theorem revWeightSum_mono (w : Fin m → ℕ) : Monotone (revWeightSum w)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hab => Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr hab)

name: Azurite.revWeightSum_eq_sum_filter
statement:
theorem revWeightSum_eq_sum_filter (w : Fin m → ℕ) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ m) :
    revWeightSum w r = ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin m => m - r ≤ j.val), w j
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_bij'
    (fun a ha => ⟨m - 1 - a, by have := Finset.mem_range.mp ha; omega⟩)
    (fun b _ => m - 1 - b.val) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro a ha
    have ha' := Finset.mem_range.mp ha
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    show m - r ≤ m - 1 - a
    omega
  · intro b hb
    have hbv := b.isLt
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hb
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
  · intro a ha
    have ha' := Finset.mem_range.mp ha
    show m - 1 - (m - 1 - a) = a
    omega
  · intro b hb
    have hbv := b.isLt
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hb
    exact Fin.ext (show m - 1 - (m - 1 - b.val) = b.val by omega)
  · intro a ha
    have ha' := Finset.mem_range.mp ha
    rw [dite_eq_left (show a < m by omega)]

name: Azurite.revWeightSum_total
statement: theorem revWeightSum_total (w : Fin m → ℕ) : revWeightSum w m = ∑ j, w j
proof:
:= by
  rw [revWeightSum_eq_sum_filter w le_rfl]
  refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
  refine Finset.filter_true_of_mem fun j _ => ?_
  omega

name: Azurite.weightSum_pos
statement:
theorem weightSum_pos (hm : 0 < m) {w : Fin m → ℕ} (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) :
    0 < ∑ j, w j
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_pos (fun j _ => hw j) ⟨⟨0, hm⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩

name: Azurite.weight_le_sum
statement: theorem weight_le_sum (w : Fin m → ℕ) (j : Fin m) : w j ≤ ∑ j', w j'
proof:
:=
  Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le (w i)) (Finset.mem_univ j)

name: Azurite.weightBlockStart_eq_sum_Ioi
statement:
theorem weightBlockStart_eq_sum_Ioi (w : Fin m → ℕ) (j : Fin m) :
    weightBlockStart w j = ∑ j' ∈ Finset.Ioi j, w j'
proof:
:= by
  have hj := j.isLt
  rw [weightBlockStart, revWeightSum_eq_sum_filter w (by omega)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
  ext j'
  have hj' := j'.isLt
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_Ioi, Fin.lt_def]
  omega

name: Azurite.revWeightSum_reflect_succ
statement:
theorem revWeightSum_reflect_succ (w : Fin m → ℕ) (j : Fin m) :
    revWeightSum w (m - 1 - j.val + 1) = weightBlockStart w j + w j
proof:
:= by
  have hj := j.isLt
  rw [revWeightSum_succ, dite_eq_left (show m - 1 - j.val < m by omega)]
  congr 1
  exact congrArg w (Fin.ext (show m - 1 - (m - 1 - j.val) = j.val by omega))

name: Azurite.weightBlockStart_add_weight_le
statement:
theorem weightBlockStart_add_weight_le (w : Fin m → ℕ) (j : Fin m) :
    weightBlockStart w j + w j ≤ ∑ j', w j'
proof:
:= by
  have hj := j.isLt
  rw [← revWeightSum_reflect_succ, ← revWeightSum_total]
  exact revWeightSum_mono w (by omega)

name: Azurite.weightBlockIdx_eq
statement:
theorem weightBlockIdx_eq (w : Fin m → ℕ) {t r : ℕ} (hr : r < m)
    (h1 : revWeightSum w r ≤ t) (h2 : t < revWeightSum w (r + 1)) :
    weightBlockIdx w t = r
proof:
:= by
  have hfil : (Finset.range m).filter (fun r' => revWeightSum w (r' + 1) ≤ t)
      = Finset.range r := by
    ext r'
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨-, hle⟩
      by_contra hnot
      have := revWeightSum_mono w (show r + 1 ≤ r' + 1 by omega)
      omega
    · intro hlt
      have h3 : revWeightSum w (r' + 1) ≤ revWeightSum w r := revWeightSum_mono w (by omega)
      exact ⟨by omega, le_trans h3 h1⟩
  rw [weightBlockIdx, hfil, Finset.card_range]

name: Azurite.exists_weightBlock_decomp
statement:
theorem exists_weightBlock_decomp (w : Fin m → ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : t < ∑ j, w j) :
    ∃ (j : Fin m) (s : ℕ), s < w j ∧ t = weightBlockStart w j + s
      ∧ weightBlockIdx w t = m - 1 - j.val
proof:
:= by
  have ht' : t < revWeightSum w m := by rwa [revWeightSum_total]
  have hex : ∃ r, t < revWeightSum w (r + 1) :=
    ⟨m - 1, by rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel hm]⟩
  
  obtain ⟨b, hbm, hlow, hspec⟩ :
      ∃ b, b < m ∧ revWeightSum w b ≤ t ∧ t < revWeightSum w (b + 1) := by
    refine ⟨Nat.find hex, ?_, ?_, Nat.find_spec hex⟩
    · have : Nat.find hex ≤ m - 1 :=
        Nat.find_min' hex (by rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel hm])
      omega
    · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Nat.find hex) with h0 | h0
      · rw [h0, revWeightSum_zero]; exact Nat.zero_le t
      · have hmin := Nat.find_min hex (show Nat.find hex - 1 < Nat.find hex by omega)
        rw [show Nat.find hex - 1 + 1 = Nat.find hex by omega] at hmin
        omega
  have hltb : m - 1 - b < m := by omega
  have hsucc : revWeightSum w (b + 1) = revWeightSum w b + w ⟨m - 1 - b, hltb⟩ :=
    revWeightSum_succ_of_lt w hbm
  have hbs : weightBlockStart w ⟨m - 1 - b, hltb⟩ = revWeightSum w b :=
    congrArg (revWeightSum w) (show m - 1 - (m - 1 - b) = b by omega)
  refine ⟨⟨m - 1 - b, hltb⟩, t - revWeightSum w b, by omega, by rw [hbs]; omega, ?_⟩
  show weightBlockIdx w t = m - 1 - (m - 1 - b)
  rw [weightBlockIdx_eq w hbm hlow hspec]
  omega

name: Azurite.weightBlockIdx_blockStart_add
statement:
theorem weightBlockIdx_blockStart_add (w : Fin m → ℕ) (j : Fin m) {s : ℕ}
    (hs : s < w j) : weightBlockIdx w (weightBlockStart w j + s) = m - 1 - j.val
proof:
:= by
  have hj := j.isLt
  refine weightBlockIdx_eq w (show m - 1 - j.val < m by omega)
    (Nat.le_add_right _ _) ?_
  rw [revWeightSum_reflect_succ]
  omega

name: Azurite.weightedPos_mod
statement:
theorem weightedPos_mod (w : Fin m → ℕ) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (j : Fin m) (r : ℕ) :
    weightedPos w j r % (∑ j', w j') = weightBlockStart w j + r % w j
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : weightBlockStart w j + r % w j < ∑ j', w j' :=
    Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.mod_lt r (hw j)) _)
      (weightBlockStart_add_weight_le w j)
  rw [weightedPos, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.mul_add_mod', Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt]

name: Azurite.weightedPos_div
statement:
theorem weightedPos_div (w : Fin m → ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j)
    (j : Fin m) (r : ℕ) : weightedPos w j r / (∑ j', w j') = r / w j
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : weightBlockStart w j + r % w j < ∑ j', w j' :=
    Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.mod_lt r (hw j)) _)
      (weightBlockStart_add_weight_le w j)
  rw [weightedPos, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.mul_comm,
    Nat.mul_add_div (weightSum_pos hm hw), Nat.div_eq_of_lt hlt, Nat.add_zero]

name: Azurite.weightedPos_slotOf
statement:
theorem weightedPos_slotOf (w : Fin m → ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j)
    (j : Fin m) (r : ℕ) : weightedSlotOf w hm (weightedPos w j r) = j
proof:
:= by
  have hj := j.isLt
  apply Fin.ext
  show m - 1 - weightBlockIdx w (weightedPos w j r % ∑ j', w j') = j.val
  rw [weightedPos_mod w hw, weightBlockIdx_blockStart_add w j (Nat.mod_lt r (hw j))]
  omega

name: Azurite.weightedRank_pos
statement:
theorem weightedRank_pos (w : Fin m → ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j)
    (j : Fin m) (r : ℕ) : weightedRank w hm (weightedPos w j r) = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedRank, weightedPos_slotOf w hm hw, weightedPos_mod w hw,
    weightBlockIdx_blockStart_add w j (Nat.mod_lt r (hw j)),
    weightedPos_div w hm hw]
  have hbs : revWeightSum w (m - 1 - j.val) = weightBlockStart w j := rfl
  rw [hbs, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, Nat.mul_comm]
  exact Nat.div_add_mod r (w j)

name: Azurite.weightedPos_rank
statement:
theorem weightedPos_rank (w : Fin m → ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (i : ℕ) :
    weightedPos w (weightedSlotOf w hm i) (weightedRank w hm i) = i
proof:
:= by
  have hW : 0 < ∑ j', w j' := weightSum_pos hm hw
  obtain ⟨j, s, hs, ht, -⟩ :=
    exists_weightBlock_decomp w hm (Nat.mod_lt i hW)
  have hdiv : (i / (∑ j', w j') * w j + s) / w j = i / (∑ j', w j') := by
    rw [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_add_div (hw j), Nat.div_eq_of_lt hs, Nat.add_zero]
  have hmod : (i / (∑ j', w j') * w j + s) % w j = s := by
    rw [Nat.mul_add_mod', Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hs]
  have hkey : weightedPos w j (i / (∑ j', w j') * w j + s) = i := by
    rw [weightedPos, hdiv, hmod, Nat.add_assoc, ← ht, Nat.mul_comm]
    exact Nat.div_add_mod i _
  rw [← hkey, weightedPos_slotOf w hm hw, weightedRank_pos w hm hw]

name: Azurite.weightedPos_strictMono_aux
statement:
theorem weightedPos_strictMono_aux {d W c : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hdW : d ≤ W) :
    StrictMono fun r => r / d * W + c + r % d
proof:
:= by
  intro r r' h
  simp only
  have hle : r / d ≤ r' / d := Nat.div_le_div_right h.le
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (r / d) (r' / d) with hq | hq
  · calc r / d * W + c + r % d < r / d * W + c + d :=
          Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.mod_lt r hd) _
      _ ≤ r / d * W + c + W := Nat.add_le_add_left hdW _
      _ = (r / d + 1) * W + c := by ring
      _ ≤ r' / d * W + c :=
          Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_right W (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hq)) c
      _ ≤ r' / d * W + c + r' % d := Nat.le_add_right _ _
  · have heq : r / d = r' / d := le_antisymm hle hq
    have e1 := Nat.div_add_mod r d
    have e2 := Nat.div_add_mod r' d
    rw [← heq] at e2
    have hs : r % d < r' % d := by
      have hlt : d * (r / d) + r % d < d * (r / d) + r' % d := by
        rw [e1, e2]; exact h
      exact Nat.lt_of_add_lt_add_left hlt
    rw [heq]
    exact Nat.add_lt_add_left hs _

name: Azurite.weightedRoundRobin_slotOf
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightedRoundRobin_slotOf (w : Fin m → ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) : (weightedRoundRobin w hm hw).slotOf = weightedSlotOf w hm
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.weightedRoundRobin_rank
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightedRoundRobin_rank (w : Fin m → ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) : (weightedRoundRobin w hm hw).rank = weightedRank w hm
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.weightedRoundRobin_pos
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightedRoundRobin_pos (w : Fin m → ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) : (weightedRoundRobin w hm hw).pos = weightedPos w
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.sum_const_one
statement: theorem sum_const_one (m : ℕ) : (∑ _j : Fin m, (1 : ℕ)) = m
proof: := by simp

name: Azurite.revWeightSum_one
statement:
theorem revWeightSum_one {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ m) :
    revWeightSum (fun _ : Fin m => 1) r = r
proof:
:= by
  calc revWeightSum (fun _ : Fin m => 1) r
      = ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range r, 1 :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi =>
          dite_eq_left (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hi) hr)
    _ = r := by simp

name: Azurite.weightBlockIdx_one
statement:
theorem weightBlockIdx_one {t : ℕ} (ht : t < m) :
    weightBlockIdx (fun _ : Fin m => 1) t = t
proof:
:=
  weightBlockIdx_eq _ ht (by rw [revWeightSum_one ht.le])
    (by rw [revWeightSum_one (by omega)]; omega)

name: Azurite.weightedRoundRobin_one_slotOf
statement:
theorem weightedRoundRobin_one_slotOf (hm : 0 < m) (i : ℕ) :
    (weightedRoundRobin (fun _ => 1) hm (fun _ => Nat.one_pos)).slotOf i
      = (roundRobin m hm).slotOf i
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  show m - 1 - weightBlockIdx (fun _ : Fin m => 1) (i % ∑ _j : Fin m, (1 : ℕ))
    = m - 1 - i % m
  rw [sum_const_one, weightBlockIdx_one (Nat.mod_lt i hm)]

name: Azurite.weightedRoundRobin_one_rank
statement:
theorem weightedRoundRobin_one_rank (hm : 0 < m) (i : ℕ) :
    (weightedRoundRobin (fun _ => 1) hm (fun _ => Nat.one_pos)).rank i
      = (roundRobin m hm).rank i
proof:
:= by
  show weightedRank (fun _ : Fin m => 1) hm i = i / m
  rw [weightedRank, sum_const_one, weightBlockIdx_one (Nat.mod_lt i hm),
    revWeightSum_one (Nat.mod_lt i hm).le]
  omega

name: Azurite.weightedRoundRobin_one_pos
statement:
theorem weightedRoundRobin_one_pos (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin m) (r : ℕ) :
    (weightedRoundRobin (fun _ => 1) hm (fun _ => Nat.one_pos)).pos j r
      = (roundRobin m hm).pos j r
proof:
:= by
  have hj := j.isLt
  show weightedPos (fun _ : Fin m => 1) j r = r * m + (m - 1 - j.val)
  rw [weightedPos, weightBlockStart, sum_const_one, revWeightSum_one (by omega),
    Nat.div_one, Nat.mod_one, Nat.add_zero]

name: Azurite.DepFinGen.card_eq
statement:
theorem DepFinGen.card_eq {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} {a : A} [Fintype (B a)]
    (d : DepFinGen B a) : d.card = Fintype.card (B a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.card_of_bijective d.bij, Fintype.card_fin]

name: Azurite.DepFinGen.boundedEnum_bijective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j h
    have hi : g.gen i = some (boundedEnum g hsome i) := (Option.some_get _).symm
    have hj : g.gen j = some (boundedEnum g hsome j) := (Option.some_get _).symm
    obtain ⟨n, _, hun⟩ := g.occurs_exactly_once (boundedEnum g hsome i)
    have h1 : (i : ℕ) = n := hun i hi
    have h2 : (j : ℕ) = n := hun j (hj.trans (congrArg some h.symm))
    exact Fin.ext (h1.trans h2.symm)
  · intro b
    obtain ⟨n, hn, -⟩ := g.occurs_exactly_once b
    have hlt : n < c := by
      by_contra hge
      rw [hnone n (by omega)] at hn
      exact Option.some_ne_none b hn.symm
    refine ⟨⟨n, hlt⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [boundedEnum]
    apply Option.some_injective
    rw [Option.some_get]
    exact hn

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.blockSum_succ
statement:
theorem blockSum_succ {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a) (i : ℕ) :
    blockSum gA dB (i + 1) =
      blockSum gA dB i + (match gA.gen i with | some a => (dB a).card | none => 0)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.blockSum_mono
statement:
theorem blockSum_mono {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a) : Monotone (blockSum gA dB)
proof:
:= by
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro i
  rw [blockSum_succ]
  exact Nat.le_add_right _ _

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.blockSum_lt_succ
statement:
theorem blockSum_lt_succ {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a) {i : ℕ} {a : A} (ha : gA.gen i = some a) :
    blockSum gA dB i < blockSum gA dB (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockSum_succ, ha]
  exact Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (dB a).pos

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.le_blockSum_of_some
statement:
theorem le_blockSum_of_some {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a) :
    ∀ i, (∀ j, j < i → gA.gen j ≠ none) → i ≤ blockSum gA dB i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => intro _; exact Nat.zero_le _
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hsome
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp (hsome i (Nat.lt_succ_self i))
    have hlt : blockSum gA dB i < blockSum gA dB (i + 1) := blockSum_lt_succ gA dB ha
    have := ih (fun j hj => hsome j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj))
    omega

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.exists_block
statement:
theorem exists_block {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a) :
    ∀ (c k : ℕ), k < blockSum gA dB c →
      ∃ i, i < c ∧ blockSum gA dB i ≤ k ∧ k < blockSum gA dB (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  induction c with
  | zero => intro k hk; simp [blockSum] at hk
  | succ c ih =>
    intro k hk
    by_cases h : k < blockSum gA dB c
    · obtain ⟨i, h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih k h
      exact ⟨i, by omega, h2, h3⟩
    · exact ⟨c, by omega, by omega, hk⟩

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.depFind_hit_gen
statement:
theorem depFind_hit_gen {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a) :
    ∀ (d fuel i₀ jB : ℕ) (a : A) (hjB : jB < (dB a).card),
      gA.gen (i₀ + d) = some a →
      (∀ j, j < d → gA.gen (i₀ + j) ≠ none) →
      d < fuel →
      depFind gA dB fuel i₀ (blockSum gA dB (i₀ + d) - blockSum gA dB i₀ + jB) =
        some ⟨a, (dB a).enum ⟨jB, hjB⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro fuel i₀ jB a hjB hga _ hfuel
    
    obtain ⟨fuel', rfl⟩ : ∃ f, fuel = f + 1 := ⟨fuel - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [Nat.add_zero] at hga
    have hidx : blockSum gA dB (i₀ + 0) - blockSum gA dB i₀ + jB = jB := by
      rw [Nat.add_zero, Nat.sub_self, Nat.zero_add]
    rw [hidx]
    show depFind gA dB (fuel' + 1) i₀ jB = _
    unfold depFind
    rw [hga]
    simp only
    rw [dite_eq_left hjB]
  | succ d ih =>
    intro fuel i₀ jB a hjB hga hmid hfuel
    
    obtain ⟨fuel', rfl⟩ : ∃ f, fuel = f + 1 := ⟨fuel - 1, by omega⟩
    have hmid0 : gA.gen (i₀ + 0) ≠ none := hmid 0 (by omega)
    rw [Nat.add_zero] at hmid0
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hmid0
    
    have hstep : gA.gen (i₀ + (d + 1)) = some a := hga
    have hmono : blockSum gA dB (i₀ + 1) ≤ blockSum gA dB (i₀ + (d + 1)) :=
      blockSum_mono gA dB (by omega)
    have hc0 : blockSum gA dB (i₀ + 1) = blockSum gA dB i₀ + (dB a₀).card := by
      rw [blockSum_succ, ha₀]
    have hge : (dB a₀).card ≤ blockSum gA dB (i₀ + (d + 1)) - blockSum gA dB i₀ + jB := by
      omega
    show depFind gA dB (fuel' + 1) i₀ _ = _
    unfold depFind
    rw [ha₀]
    simp only
    rw [dite_eq_right (by omega)]
    
    have hkey : blockSum gA dB (i₀ + (d + 1)) - blockSum gA dB i₀ + jB - (dB a₀).card =
        blockSum gA dB ((i₀ + 1) + d) - blockSum gA dB (i₀ + 1) + jB := by
      rw [show (i₀ + 1) + d = i₀ + (d + 1) by omega]
      omega
    rw [hkey]
    exact ih fuel' (i₀ + 1) jB a hjB (by rw [show (i₀ + 1) + d = i₀ + (d + 1) by omega]; exact hga)
      (fun j hj => by rw [show (i₀ + 1) + j = i₀ + (j + 1) by omega]; exact hmid (j + 1) (by omega))
      (by omega)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.depFind_decode
statement:
theorem depFind_decode {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a) :
    ∀ (fuel i₀ r : ℕ) (a' : A) (b' : B a'),
      depFind gA dB fuel i₀ r = some ⟨a', b'⟩ →
      ∃ (i : ℕ) (jB' : ℕ) (hj : jB' < (dB a').card),
        i₀ ≤ i ∧ gA.gen i = some a' ∧ b' = (dB a').enum ⟨jB', hj⟩ ∧
        r + blockSum gA dB i₀ = blockSum gA dB i + jB'
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro i₀ r a' b' h; simp [depFind] at h
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro i₀ r a' b' h
    rw [depFind] at h
    rcases hga : gA.gen i₀ with _ | a₀
    · rw [hga] at h; simp at h
    · rw [hga] at h
      simp only at h
      by_cases hr : r < (dB a₀).card
      · 
        rw [dite_eq_left hr] at h
        have heq : (⟨a₀, (dB a₀).enum ⟨r, hr⟩⟩ : LexDepPair A B) = ⟨a', b'⟩ := Option.some.inj h
        obtain ⟨rfl, hb⟩ := LexDepPair.mk.injEq .. ▸ heq
        
        refine ⟨i₀, r, hr, le_refl _, hga, (eq_of_heq hb).symm, ?_⟩
        omega
      · 
        rw [dite_eq_right hr] at h
        obtain ⟨i, jB', hj, hle, hgi, hbi, hsum⟩ := ih (i₀ + 1) (r - (dB a₀).card) a' b' h
        refine ⟨i, jB', hj, by omega, hgi, hbi, ?_⟩
        have hc0 : blockSum gA dB (i₀ + 1) = blockSum gA dB i₀ + (dB a₀).card := by
          rw [blockSum_succ, hga]
        omega

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.depFind_fuel_irrel
statement:
theorem depFind_fuel_irrel {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a) :
    ∀ (r fuel fuel' i : ℕ), r < fuel → r < fuel' →
      depFind gA dB fuel i r = depFind gA dB fuel' i r
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  induction r using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ r ih =>
    intro fuel fuel' i hf hf'
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ : ∃ f, fuel = f + 1 := ⟨fuel - 1, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨f', rfl⟩ : ∃ f2, fuel' = f2 + 1 := ⟨fuel' - 1, by omega⟩
    unfold depFind
    rcases hga : gA.gen i with _ | a
    · rfl
    · simp only
      by_cases hr : r < (dB a).card
      · rw [dite_eq_left hr, dite_eq_left hr]
      · rw [dite_eq_right hr, dite_eq_right hr]
        have hpos := (dB a).pos
        exact ih (r - (dB a).card) (by omega) f f' (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.depFind_none_step
statement:
theorem depFind_none_step {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a) :
    ∀ (r i : ℕ), depFind gA dB (r + 1) i r = none →
      depFind gA dB (r + 2) i (r + 1) = none
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  induction r using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ r ih =>
    intro i h
    rw [depFind] at h
    show depFind gA dB ((r + 1) + 1) i (r + 1) = none
    unfold depFind
    rcases hga : gA.gen i with _ | a
    · rfl
    · rw [hga] at h
      simp only at h ⊢
      have hpos := (dB a).pos
      by_cases hr : r < (dB a).card
      · rw [dite_eq_left hr] at h
        exact absurd h (Option.some_ne_none _)
      · rw [dite_eq_right hr] at h
        rw [dite_eq_right (by omega)]
        
        
        have h' : depFind gA dB (r - (dB a).card + 1) (i + 1) (r - (dB a).card) = none :=
          (depFind_fuel_irrel gA dB (r - (dB a).card) _ r (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega)).trans h
        have hstep := ih (r - (dB a).card) (by omega) (i + 1) h'
        rw [show r + 1 - (dB a).card = (r - (dB a).card) + 1 from by omega]
        exact (depFind_fuel_irrel gA dB (r - (dB a).card + 1) _ _ (i + 1)
          (by omega) (by omega)).trans hstep

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.depFind_miss_gen
statement:
theorem depFind_miss_gen {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a) :
    ∀ (d fuel i₀ r : ℕ),
      gA.gen (i₀ + d) = none →
      (∀ j, j < d → gA.gen (i₀ + j) ≠ none) →
      blockSum gA dB (i₀ + d) - blockSum gA dB i₀ ≤ r →
      d < fuel →
      depFind gA dB fuel i₀ r = none
proof:
:= by
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro fuel i₀ r hga _ _ hfuel
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ : ∃ f, fuel = f + 1 := ⟨fuel - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [Nat.add_zero] at hga
    unfold depFind
    rw [hga]
  | succ d ih =>
    intro fuel i₀ r hga hmid hsum hfuel
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ : ∃ f, fuel = f + 1 := ⟨fuel - 1, by omega⟩
    have hmid0 : gA.gen (i₀ + 0) ≠ none := hmid 0 (by omega)
    rw [Nat.add_zero] at hmid0
    obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hmid0
    have hc0 : blockSum gA dB (i₀ + 1) = blockSum gA dB i₀ + (dB a₀).card := by
      rw [blockSum_succ, ha₀]
    have hmono : blockSum gA dB (i₀ + 1) ≤ blockSum gA dB (i₀ + (d + 1)) :=
      blockSum_mono gA dB (by omega)
    unfold depFind
    rw [ha₀]
    simp only
    rw [dite_eq_right (by omega)]
    refine ih f (i₀ + 1) (r - (dB a₀).card) ?_ ?_ ?_ (by omega)
    · rw [show (i₀ + 1) + d = i₀ + (d + 1) by omega]; exact hga
    · intro j hj
      rw [show (i₀ + 1) + j = i₀ + (j + 1) by omega]
      exact hmid (j + 1) (by omega)
    · rw [show (i₀ + 1) + d = i₀ + (d + 1) by omega]
      omega

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.depFind_unique
statement:
theorem depFind_unique {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a)
    (m : ℕ) (a : A) (b : B a) (iA : ℕ) (hiA : gA.gen iA = some a)
    (huA : ∀ y, gA.gen y = some a → y = iA) (jB : ℕ) (hjB : jB < (dB a).card)
    (hjFin : (dB a).enum ⟨jB, hjB⟩ = b)
    (hm : depFind gA dB (m + 1) 0 m = some ⟨a, b⟩) :
    m = blockSum gA dB iA + jB
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, jB', hj, _, hgi, hbi, hsum⟩ := depFind_decode gA dB (m + 1) 0 m a b hm
  
  have hi : i = iA := huA i hgi
  subst hi
  
  have hjeq : (⟨jB', hj⟩ : Fin (dB a).card) = ⟨jB, hjB⟩ :=
    (dB a).bij.injective (by rw [← hbi, hjFin])
  have : jB' = jB := congrArg Fin.val hjeq
  subst this
  
  simpa [blockSum] using hsum

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.lexDepPairGen_contig_step
statement:
theorem lexDepPairGen_contig_step {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a)
    (hA : ∀ n, gA.gen n = none → gA.gen (n + 1) = none) :
    ∀ k, (lexDepPairGen gA dB hA).gen k = none →
      (lexDepPairGen gA dB hA).gen (k + 1) = none
proof:
:=
  fun k h => depFind_none_step gA dB k 0 h

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.lexDepPairGen_contiguous
statement:
theorem lexDepPairGen_contiguous {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a)
    (hA : ∀ n, gA.gen n = none → gA.gen (n + 1) = none) :
    @Contiguous (LexDepPair A B) (lexDepPairGen gA dB hA)
proof:
:=
  @Contiguous.mk (LexDepPair A B) (lexDepPairGen gA dB hA) (lexDepPairGen_contig_step gA dB hA)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.lexDepPairGen_gen_none
statement:
theorem lexDepPairGen_gen_none {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a)
    (hA : ∀ n, gA.gen n = none → gA.gen (n + 1) = none) {cA : ℕ}
    (hnoneA : ∀ n, cA ≤ n → gA.gen n = none) (hsomeA : ∀ n, n < cA → gA.gen n ≠ none) :
    ∀ k, blockSum gA dB cA ≤ k → (lexDepPairGen gA dB hA).gen k = none
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  have hle : cA ≤ blockSum gA dB cA :=
    le_blockSum_of_some gA dB cA (fun j hj => hsomeA j hj)
  show depFind gA dB (k + 1) 0 k = none
  refine depFind_miss_gen gA dB cA (k + 1) 0 k ?_ ?_ ?_ (by omega)
  · rw [Nat.zero_add]; exact hnoneA cA (le_refl _)
  · intro j hj; rw [Nat.zero_add]; exact hsomeA j hj
  · rw [Nat.zero_add]
    simp only [blockSum]
    omega

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.lexDepPairGen_gen_some
statement:
theorem lexDepPairGen_gen_some {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} (gA : ExhaustiveGenerator A)
    (dB : (a : A) → DepFinGen B a)
    (hA : ∀ n, gA.gen n = none → gA.gen (n + 1) = none) {cA : ℕ}
    (hsomeA : ∀ n, n < cA → gA.gen n ≠ none) :
    ∀ k, k < blockSum gA dB cA → (lexDepPairGen gA dB hA).gen k ≠ none
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨i, hic, h1, h2⟩ := exists_block gA dB cA k hk
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp (hsomeA i hic)
  have hcard : blockSum gA dB (i + 1) = blockSum gA dB i + (dB a).card := by
    rw [blockSum_succ, ha]
  have hjB : k - blockSum gA dB i < (dB a).card := by omega
  have hile : i ≤ blockSum gA dB i :=
    le_blockSum_of_some gA dB i (fun j hj => hsomeA j (by omega))
  have hhit := depFind_hit_gen gA dB i (k + 1) 0 (k - blockSum gA dB i) a hjB
    (by rw [Nat.zero_add]; exact ha)
    (fun j hj => by rw [Nat.zero_add]; exact hsomeA j (by omega))
    (by omega)
  have hSeq : blockSum gA dB (0 + i) - blockSum gA dB 0 + (k - blockSum gA dB i) = k := by
    rw [Nat.zero_add]
    simp only [blockSum]
    omega
  rw [hSeq] at hhit
  show depFind gA dB (k + 1) 0 k ≠ none
  rw [hhit]
  exact Option.some_ne_none _

name: Azurite.LexDepPair.card
statement:
theorem card {A : Type*} {B : A → Type*} [Fintype A] [∀ a, Fintype (B a)] :
    Fintype.card (LexDepPair A B) = ∑ a, Fintype.card (B a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_congr equivSigma, Fintype.card_sigma]

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.boolsGen_contigStep
statement: private theorem boolsGen_contigStep : ∀ n, boolsGen.gen n = none → boolsGen.gen (n + 1) = none
proof:
:=
  fun n => Contiguous.contig n

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.naturalsGen_contigStep
statement:
private theorem naturalsGen_contigStep :
    ∀ n, naturalsGen.gen n = none → naturalsGen.gen (n + 1) = none
proof:
:=
  fun n => Contiguous.contig n

name: Azurite.under_none
statement: theorem under_none (c : ℕ) : Under none c
proof: := fun _ h => nomatch h

name: Azurite.under_some_iff
statement: theorem under_some_iff {n c : ℕ} : Under (some n) c ↔ c < n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h n rfl, fun h _ hb => Option.some.inj hb ▸ h⟩

name: Azurite.Under.of_le
statement: theorem Under.of_le {N : Option ℕ} {c c' : ℕ} (hcc : c ≤ c') (h : Under N c') : Under N c
proof:
:=
  fun b hb => Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hcc (h b hb)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.rankSpec_zero
statement: theorem rankSpec_zero (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) : rankSpec g 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [rankSpec]

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.rankSpec_succ_of_isSome
statement:
theorem rankSpec_succ_of_isSome {g : ExhaustiveGenerator T} {k : ℕ}
    (hk : (g.gen k).isSome) : rankSpec g (k + 1) = rankSpec g k + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankSpec, Finset.range_add_one, Finset.filter_insert, ite_eq_left hk,
    Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp)]
  rfl

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.rankSpec_succ_of_not_isSome
statement:
theorem rankSpec_succ_of_not_isSome {g : ExhaustiveGenerator T} {k : ℕ}
    (hk : ¬(g.gen k).isSome) : rankSpec g (k + 1) = rankSpec g k
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankSpec, Finset.range_add_one, Finset.filter_insert, ite_eq_right hk]
  rfl

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.rankSpec_le_rankSpec
statement:
theorem rankSpec_le_rankSpec (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) {k k' : ℕ} (h : k ≤ k') :
    rankSpec g k ≤ rankSpec g k'
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset_filter _ (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr h))

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.rankSpec_le
statement: theorem rankSpec_le (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) (k : ℕ) : rankSpec g k ≤ k
proof:
:=
  le_of_le_of_eq (Finset.card_filter_le _ _) (Finset.card_range k)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.rankSpec_eq_of_not_isSome
statement:
theorem rankSpec_eq_of_not_isSome (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (h : ∀ j, a ≤ j → j < b → ¬(g.gen j).isSome) : rankSpec g b = rankSpec g a
proof:
:= by
  induction b, hab using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rfl
  | succ n hn ih =>
    rw [rankSpec_succ_of_not_isSome (h n hn (Nat.lt_succ_self n))]
    exact ih fun j hj hjn => h j hj (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hjn)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.rankSpec_eq_self_of_isSome
statement:
theorem rankSpec_eq_self_of_isSome (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) {b : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ j, j < b → (g.gen j).isSome) : rankSpec g b = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankSpec, Finset.filter_true_of_mem fun j hj => h j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj),
    Finset.card_range]

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.rankSpec_lt_rankSpec
statement:
theorem rankSpec_lt_rankSpec {g : ExhaustiveGenerator T} {k k' : ℕ}
    (hk : (g.gen k).isSome) (hkk' : k < k') : rankSpec g k < rankSpec g k'
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := rankSpec_succ_of_isSome hk
  have h2 := rankSpec_le_rankSpec g (show k + 1 ≤ k' from hkk')
  omega

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.eq_of_rankSpec_eq
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy k k' with hlt | heq | hgt
  · have := rankSpec_lt_rankSpec hk hlt; omega
  · exact heq
  · have := rankSpec_lt_rankSpec hk' hgt; omega

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.gen_unrank_isSome
statement: theorem gen_unrank_isSome {i : ℕ} (hi : Under N i) : (g.gen (unrank g N h i)).isSome
proof:
:= by
  rw [unrank, dite_eq_left hi]
  exact (unrankAux g N h i hi).2.1

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.rankSpec_unrank
statement: theorem rankSpec_unrank {i : ℕ} (hi : Under N i) : rankSpec g (unrank g N h i) = i
proof:
:= by
  rw [unrank, dite_eq_left hi]
  exact (unrankAux g N h i hi).2.2

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.unrank_lt_unrank
statement:
theorem unrank_lt_unrank {i j : ℕ} (hij : i < j) (hj : Under N j) :
    unrank g N h i < unrank g N h j
proof:
:= by
  have hi : Under N i := Under.of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hij) hj
  by_contra hge
  have hmono := rankSpec_le_rankSpec g (Nat.le_of_not_lt hge)
  rw [rankSpec_unrank hi, rankSpec_unrank hj] at hmono
  omega

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.unrank_rankSpec
statement:
theorem unrank_rankSpec {k : ℕ} (hk : (g.gen k).isSome) (hr : Under N (rankSpec g k)) :
    unrank g N h (rankSpec g k) = k
proof:
:=
  eq_of_rankSpec_eq (gen_unrank_isSome hr) hk (rankSpec_unrank hr)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.compress_gen_isSome
statement:
theorem compress_gen_isSome (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) (N : Option ℕ)
    (h : ∀ n, Under N (rankSpec g n) → ∃ k, n ≤ k ∧ (g.gen k).isSome)
    (h' : ∀ k, (g.gen k).isSome → Under N (rankSpec g k)) {i : ℕ} (hi : Under N i) :
    ((compress g N h h').gen i).isSome
proof:
:= by
  show (if Under N i then g.gen (unrank g N h i) else none).isSome
  rw [ite_eq_left hi]
  exact gen_unrank_isSome hi

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.compress_gen_none
statement:
theorem compress_gen_none (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) (N : Option ℕ)
    (h : ∀ n, Under N (rankSpec g n) → ∃ k, n ≤ k ∧ (g.gen k).isSome)
    (h' : ∀ k, (g.gen k).isSome → Under N (rankSpec g k)) {i : ℕ} (hi : ¬Under N i) :
    (compress g N h h').gen i = none
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_right hi

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.compress_contiguous
statement:
theorem compress_contiguous (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) (N : Option ℕ)
    (h : ∀ n, Under N (rankSpec g n) → ∃ k, n ≤ k ∧ (g.gen k).isSome)
    (h' : ∀ k, (g.gen k).isSome → Under N (rankSpec g k)) :
    @Contiguous T (compress g N h h')
proof:
:=
  @Contiguous.mk T (compress g N h h') fun n hnone => by
    cases N with
    | none =>
      exact absurd hnone
        (Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mp (compress_gen_isSome g none h h' (under_none n)))
    | some m =>
      by_cases hn : n < m
      · exact absurd hnone (Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mp
          (compress_gen_isSome g (some m) h h' (under_some_iff.mpr hn)))
      · exact compress_gen_none g (some m) h h'
          fun hu => hn (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt (under_some_iff.mp hu))

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.unrank_eq_self
statement:
theorem unrank_eq_self (hnh : ∀ k, Under N k → (g.gen k).isSome) {i : ℕ} (hi : Under N i) :
    unrank g N h i = i
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : rankSpec g (unrank g N h i) = i := rankSpec_unrank hi
  have h2 := rankSpec_le g (unrank g N h i)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i (unrank g N h i) with hlt | hge
  · have hpre : rankSpec g (i + 1) = i + 1 := rankSpec_eq_self_of_isSome g fun j hj =>
      hnh j (Under.of_le (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hj) hi)
    have := rankSpec_le_rankSpec g (show i + 1 ≤ unrank g N h i from hlt)
    omega
  · omega

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.compress_gen_eq_of_no_holes
statement:
theorem compress_gen_eq_of_no_holes (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) (N : Option ℕ)
    (h : ∀ n, Under N (rankSpec g n) → ∃ k, n ≤ k ∧ (g.gen k).isSome)
    (h' : ∀ k, (g.gen k).isSome → Under N (rankSpec g k))
    (hnh : ∀ k, Under N k → (g.gen k).isSome) (i : ℕ) :
    (compress g N h h').gen i = g.gen i
proof:
:= by
  show (if Under N i then g.gen (unrank g N h i) else none) = g.gen i
  by_cases hi : Under N i
  · rw [ite_eq_left hi, unrank_eq_self hnh hi]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hi]
    cases N with
    | none => exact absurd (under_none i) hi
    | some m =>
      have hm : m ≤ i := Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hlt => hi (under_some_iff.mpr hlt)
      by_contra hne
      have hlive : (g.gen i).isSome :=
        Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mpr fun h0 => hne (h0 ▸ rfl)
      have hcnt : rankSpec g i < m := under_some_iff.mp (h' i hlive)
      have hpre : rankSpec g m = m :=
        rankSpec_eq_self_of_isSome g fun j hj => hnh j (under_some_iff.mpr hj)
      have := rankSpec_le_rankSpec g hm
      omega

name: Azurite.HasCount.prod
statement:
theorem HasCount.prod {A B : Type*} {a b : Option ℕ} (ha : HasCount A a)
    (hb : HasCount B b) : HasCount (A × B) (mulCount a b)
proof:
:= by
  match a, b with
  | some m, some n =>
    obtain ⟨eA⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨eB⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨(eA.prodCongr eB).trans finProdFinEquiv⟩
  | some 0, none =>
    obtain ⟨eA⟩ := ha
    have : IsEmpty A := ⟨fun x => (eA x).elim0⟩
    exact ⟨Equiv.equivOfIsEmpty (A × B) (Fin 0)⟩
  | some (m + 1), none =>
    obtain ⟨eA⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨fun k => (eA.symm 0, f k), fun k k' hkk' => hf (congrArg Prod.snd hkk')⟩
  | none, some 0 =>
    obtain ⟨eB⟩ := hb
    have : IsEmpty B := ⟨fun x => (eB x).elim0⟩
    exact ⟨Equiv.equivOfIsEmpty (A × B) (Fin 0)⟩
  | none, some (n + 1) =>
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨eB⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨fun k => (f k, eB.symm 0), fun k k' hkk' => hf (congrArg Prod.fst hkk')⟩
  | none, none =>
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨fB, -⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨fun k => (f k, fB 0), fun k k' hkk' => hf (congrArg Prod.fst hkk')⟩

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.hasCount_h
statement:
theorem hasCount_h (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) {N : Option ℕ} (hc : HasCount T N) :
    ∀ n, Under N (rankSpec g n) → ∃ k, n ≤ k ∧ (g.gen k).isSome
proof:
:= by
  intro n hUn
  by_contra hno
  have hdead : ∀ k, n ≤ k → ¬(g.gen k).isSome := fun k hk hs => hno ⟨k, hk, hs⟩
  
  have hmem : ∀ t : T, @idx T g t ∈ (Finset.range n).filter fun k => (g.gen k).isSome := by
    intro t
    have hlive : (g.gen (@idx T g t)).isSome := by rw [@gen_idx T g t]; rfl
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr ?_, hlive⟩
    by_contra hge
    exact hdead _ (Nat.le_of_not_lt hge) hlive
  have hidx_inj : ∀ t t' : T, @idx T g t = @idx T g t' → t = t' := by
    intro t t' htt
    have h1 := @gen_idx T g t
    rw [htt, @gen_idx T g t'] at h1
    exact (Option.some.inj h1).symm
  cases N with
  | none =>
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hc
    
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun i => @idx T g (f i))
      (fun i _ => Finset.mem_coe.mpr (hmem (f i)))
      (fun i _ j _ hij => hf (hidx_inj _ _ hij))
      (s := Finset.range (n + 1))
    have hle : ((Finset.range n).filter fun k => (g.gen k).isSome).card ≤ n :=
      le_of_le_of_eq (Finset.card_filter_le _ _) (Finset.card_range n)
    rw [Finset.card_range] at hcard
    omega
  | some m =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := hc
    
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun i => @idx T g (e.symm i))
      (fun i _ => Finset.mem_coe.mpr (hmem (e.symm i)))
      (fun i _ j _ hij => e.symm.injective (hidx_inj _ _ hij))
      (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)))
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
    have hUm : rankSpec g n < m := under_some_iff.mp hUn
    exact absurd hcard (by rw [rankSpec] at hUm; omega)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.hasCount_h'
statement:
theorem hasCount_h' (g : ExhaustiveGenerator T) {N : Option ℕ} (hc : HasCount T N) :
    ∀ k, (g.gen k).isSome → Under N (rankSpec g k)
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  cases N with
  | none => exact under_none _
  | some m =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := hc
    rw [under_some_iff]
    by_contra hge
    rw [Nat.not_lt] at hge
    
    
    have hSlive : ∀ j ∈ insert k ((Finset.range k).filter fun k' => (g.gen k').isSome),
        (g.gen j).isSome := by
      intro j hj
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl | hj'
      · exact hk
      · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj').2
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun j => e ((g.gen j).getD ((g.gen k).get hk)))
        ↑(insert k ((Finset.range k).filter fun k' => (g.gen k').isSome)) := by
      intro i hi j hj hij
      obtain ⟨vi, hvi⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp (hSlive i (Finset.mem_coe.mp hi))
      obtain ⟨vj, hvj⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp (hSlive j (Finset.mem_coe.mp hj))
      simp only [hvi, hvj, Option.getD_some] at hij
      have hvij : vi = vj := e.injective hij
      obtain ⟨n₀, -, hu⟩ := g.occurs_exactly_once vi
      rw [hu i hvi, hu j (show g.gen j = some vi by rw [hvj, hvij])]
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn _
      (fun j _ => Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_univ _)) hinj
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (fun hmem =>
        absurd (Finset.mem_range.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hmem).1) (lt_irrefl k)),
      Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
    rw [rankSpec] at hge
    omega

name: Azurite.azNatRangeToInfinityFun_bijective
statement:
theorem azNatRangeToInfinityFun_bijective (a : AzNat) :
    Function.Bijective (azNatRangeToInfinityFun a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j h
    have h2 := congrArg AzNat.toNat (congrArg Subtype.val h)
    rw [azNatRangeToInfinityFun, azNatRangeToInfinityFun] at h2
    simp only [AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at h2; omega
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hla : a.toNat ≤ x.toNat := (AzNat.le_iff_toNat_le a x).mp hx
    refine ⟨x.toNat - a.toNat, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    show AzNat.ofNat (a.toNat + (x.toNat - a.toNat)) = x
    rw [show a.toNat + (x.toNat - a.toNat) = x.toNat from by omega, AzNat.ofNat_toNat]

name: Azurite.toInfF_surj
statement: theorem toInfF_surj (a : AzInt) (x : ℤ) (hx : a.toInt ≤ x) : ∃ n, toInfF a n = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hsign : 0 ≤ a.toInt
  · exact ⟨(x - a.toInt).toNat, by unfold toInfF; rw [ite_eq_left hsign]; omega⟩
  · rcases lt_trichotomy x 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
    · exact ⟨(2 * (-x)).toNat, by unfold toInfF; rw [ite_eq_right hsign]; split_ifs <;> omega⟩
    · exact ⟨0, by unfold toInfF; rw [ite_eq_right hsign]; simp [hzero]⟩
    · by_cases hle : x ≤ -a.toInt
      · exact ⟨(2 * x - 1).toNat, by unfold toInfF; rw [ite_eq_right hsign]; split_ifs <;> omega⟩
      · exact ⟨(x - a.toInt).toNat, by unfold toInfF; rw [ite_eq_right hsign]; split_ifs <;> omega⟩

  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩

proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.collectStream_succ
statement:
theorem collectStream_succ {T σ : Type*} (next : σ → Option T × σ) (st : σ) (n : ℕ) :
    collectStream next st (n + 1)
      = (next st).1.toList ++ collectStream next (next st).2 n
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.StreamFor.collectStream_advanceN
statement:
theorem collectStream_advanceN (s : StreamFor g) (k n : ℕ) :
    collectStream s.next (advanceN s.next s.init k) n
      = (List.range' k n).filterMap g.gen
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [collectStream_succ]
    have h1 : (s.next (advanceN s.next s.init k)).1 = g.gen k := s.emits k
    have h2 : (s.next (advanceN s.next s.init k)).2 = advanceN s.next s.init (k + 1) := rfl
    rw [h1, h2, ih (k + 1)]
    show _ = (k :: List.range' (k + 1) m).filterMap g.gen
    cases hgk : g.gen k with
    | none => simp [hgk]
    | some t => simp [hgk]

name: Azurite.StreamFor.firstNStream_eq_filterMap
statement:
theorem firstNStream_eq_filterMap (s : StreamFor g) (n : ℕ) :
    s.firstNStream n = (List.range n).filterMap g.gen
proof:
:= by
  have h := collectStream_advanceN s 0 n
  rw [List.range_eq_range']
  exact h

proof:
:=

statement:
theorem positiveRationalPair_succ (n : ℕ) :
    positiveRationalPair (n + 1) = sternBrocotStep (positiveRationalPair n)
proof:
:= by
  show sternBrocotStep^[n + 1 + 1] (0, 1) = _
  rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
  rfl

name: Azurite.CWState.eq_of_pair_eq
statement: theorem eq_of_pair_eq {s t : CWState} (h : s.pair = t.pair) : s = t
proof:
:= by
  cases s; cases t; cases h; rfl

name: Azurite.CWState.q_pos
statement: theorem q_pos (s : CWState) : 0 < s.q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := s.reachable
  show 0 < AzRat.ofAzNats s.pair.1 s.pair.2
  rw [hn]
  exact positiveRationals_pos n

name: Azurite.CWState.neg_q_neg
statement: theorem neg_q_neg (s : CWState) : -s.q < 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := s.q_pos
  rw [AzRat.lt_iff_toRat_lt, AzRat.toRat_zero] at h ⊢
  rw [AzRat.toRat_neg]
  linarith

name: Azurite.positiveRationals_state
statement:
theorem positiveRationals_state (n : ℕ) :
    advanceN positiveRationalsNext CWState.init n = ⟨positiveRationalPair n, n, rfl⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [advanceN, ih]
    exact CWState.eq_of_pair_eq (positiveRationalPair_succ k).symm

name: Azurite.negativeRationals_state
statement:
theorem negativeRationals_state (n : ℕ) :

proof:

name: Azurite.nonnegativeRationals_state
statement:
theorem nonnegativeRationals_state (n : ℕ) :
    advanceN nonnegativeRationalsNext (none : Option CWState) (n + 1)
      = some ⟨positiveRationalPair n, n, rfl⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [advanceN, ih]
    exact congrArg some (CWState.eq_of_pair_eq (positiveRationalPair_succ k).symm)

name: Azurite.nonzeroRationals_state
statement:
theorem nonzeroRationals_state (n : ℕ) :
    advanceN nonzeroRationalsNext (true, CWState.init) n
      = (decide (n % 2 = 0), ⟨positiveRationalPair (n / 2), n / 2, rfl⟩)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [advanceN, ih]
    rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one k with hk | hk
    · rw [decide_eq_true hk, decide_eq_false (show ¬(k + 1) % 2 = 0 by omega),
        show (k + 1) / 2 = k / 2 by omega]
      rfl
    · rw [decide_eq_false (show ¬k % 2 = 0 by omega),
        decide_eq_true (show (k + 1) % 2 = 0 by omega),
        show (k + 1) / 2 = k / 2 + 1 by omega]
      exact congrArg (Prod.mk true)
        (CWState.eq_of_pair_eq (positiveRationalPair_succ (k / 2)).symm)

name: Azurite.rationals_state
statement:
theorem rationals_state (n : ℕ) :
    advanceN rationalsNext (none : Option (Bool × CWState)) (n + 1)
      = some (decide (n % 2 = 0), ⟨positiveRationalPair (n / 2), n / 2, rfl⟩)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [advanceN, ih]
    rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one k with hk | hk
    · rw [decide_eq_true hk, decide_eq_false (show ¬(k + 1) % 2 = 0 by omega),
        show (k + 1) / 2 = k / 2 by omega]
      rfl
    · rw [decide_eq_false (show ¬k % 2 = 0 by omega),
        decide_eq_true (show (k + 1) % 2 = 0 by omega),
        show (k + 1) / 2 = k / 2 + 1 by omega]
      exact congrArg (fun t => some (true, t))
        (CWState.eq_of_pair_eq (positiveRationalPair_succ (k / 2)).symm)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.unrank_eq_find
statement:
theorem unrank_eq_find {p i : ℕ} (hp : rankSpec g p = i) (hu : Under N i)
    (hex : ∃ k, p ≤ k ∧ (g.gen k).isSome) :
    unrank g N h i = Nat.find hex
proof:
:= by
  have hlive : (g.gen (Nat.find hex)).isSome := (Nat.find_spec hex).2
  have hrank : rankSpec g (Nat.find hex) = i := by
    rw [rankSpec_eq_of_not_isSome g (Nat.find_spec hex).1
      fun j hj hjf hs => Nat.find_min hex hjf ⟨hj, hs⟩, hp]
  rw [← hrank]
  exact unrank_rankSpec hlive (by rw [hrank]; exact hu)

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.compressNext_idx_of_under
statement:
theorem compressNext_idx_of_under {s : CompressState g} (hu : Under N s.idx) :
    ((compressNext g N h s).2).idx = s.idx + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compressNext]
  rw [dite_eq_left hu]

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.compressNext_fst_of_under
statement:
theorem compressNext_fst_of_under {s : CompressState g} (hu : Under N s.idx)
    (hex : ∃ k, s.pos ≤ k ∧ (g.gen k).isSome) :
    (compressNext g N h s).1 = g.gen (Nat.find hex)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compressNext]
  rw [dite_eq_left hu]

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.compressNext_of_not_under
statement:
theorem compressNext_of_not_under {s : CompressState g} (hu : ¬Under N s.idx) :
    compressNext g N h s = (none, s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compressNext]
  rw [dite_eq_right hu]

name: Azurite.ExhaustiveGenerator.compress_state
statement:
theorem compress_state (n : ℕ) :
    (advanceN (compressNext g N h) (compressInit g) n).idx = n ∨
      (¬Under N (advanceN (compressNext g N h) (compressInit g) n).idx ∧
        (advanceN (compressNext g N h) (compressInit g) n).idx ≤ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Or.inl rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [advanceN]
    by_cases hu : Under N (advanceN (compressNext g N h) (compressInit g) k).idx
    · rw [compressNext_idx_of_under hu]
      rcases ih with hik | ⟨hnu, _⟩
      · exact Or.inl (by omega)
      · exact absurd hu hnu
    · rw [compressNext_of_not_under hu]
      show (advanceN (compressNext g N h) (compressInit g) k).idx = k + 1 ∨
        (¬Under N (advanceN (compressNext g N h) (compressInit g) k).idx ∧
          (advanceN (compressNext g N h) (compressInit g) k).idx ≤ k + 1)
      rcases ih with hik | ⟨hnu, hle⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hu, by omega⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hnu, by omega⟩

name: Azurite.naturals_state
statement:
theorem naturals_state (n : ℕ) :
    advanceN naturalsNext (0 : AzNat) n = AzNat.ofNat n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact AzNat.ofNat_zero.symm
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [advanceN, ih]
    show AzNat.ofNat k + 1 = AzNat.ofNat (k + 1)
    apply AzNat.toNat_injective
    rw [AzNat.toNat_add, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_one, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]

name: Azurite.zigZag_succ_of_even
statement: theorem zigZag_succ_of_even {k : ℕ} (hk : k % 2 = 0) : zigZag (k + 1) = -zigZag k + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold zigZag
  rw [ite_eq_left hk, ite_eq_right (show ¬(k + 1) % 2 = 0 by omega)]
  omega

name: Azurite.zigZag_succ_of_odd
statement: theorem zigZag_succ_of_odd {k : ℕ} (hk : k % 2 = 1) : zigZag (k + 1) = -zigZag k
proof:
:= by
  unfold zigZag
  rw [ite_eq_right (show ¬k % 2 = 0 by omega), ite_eq_left (show (k + 1) % 2 = 0 by omega)]
  omega

name: Azurite.integers_state
statement:
theorem integers_state (n : ℕ) :
    advanceN integersNext ((0 : AzInt), true) n
      = (AzInt.ofInt (zigZag n), decide (n % 2 = 0))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
    show (0 : AzInt) = AzInt.ofInt (zigZag 0)
    rw [show zigZag 0 = 0 from rfl, AzInt.ofInt_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [advanceN, ih]
    rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one k with hk | hk
    · rw [decide_eq_true hk]
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · show -AzInt.ofInt (zigZag k) + 1 = AzInt.ofInt (zigZag (k + 1))
        rw [zigZag_succ_of_even hk, AzInt.ofInt_add, AzInt.ofInt_neg, AzInt.ofInt_one]
      · show false = decide ((k + 1) % 2 = 0)
        exact (decide_eq_false (show ¬(k + 1) % 2 = 0 by omega)).symm
    · rw [decide_eq_false (show ¬k % 2 = 0 by omega)]
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · show -AzInt.ofInt (zigZag k) = AzInt.ofInt (zigZag (k + 1))
        rw [zigZag_succ_of_odd hk, AzInt.ofInt_neg]
      · show true = decide ((k + 1) % 2 = 0)
        exact (decide_eq_true (show (k + 1) % 2 = 0 by omega)).symm

name: Azurite.azNatRangeNext_of_zero

theorem azNatRangeNext_of_zero {a b : AzNat} {s : AzNatRangeState a b} (h : s.rem = 0) :

proof:
:= by

  rw [dite_eq_left h]

name: Azurite.azNatRangeNext_rem_of_ne
statement:
theorem azNatRangeNext_rem_of_ne {a b : AzNat} {s : AzNatRangeState a b} (h : s.rem ≠ 0) :
    ((azNatRangeNext a b s).2).rem = s.rem - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [azNatRangeNext]
  rw [dite_eq_right h]

name: Azurite.azNatRange_state
statement:
theorem azNatRange_state (a b : AzNat) (n : ℕ) :
    (advanceN (azNatRangeNext a b) (azNatRangeInit a b) n).rem
      = b.toNat - a.toNat - n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [advanceN]
    by_cases h0 : (advanceN (azNatRangeNext a b) (azNatRangeInit a b) k).rem = 0
    · rw [azNatRangeNext_of_zero h0]
      show (advanceN (azNatRangeNext a b) (azNatRangeInit a b) k).rem
        = b.toNat - a.toNat - (k + 1)
      omega
    · rw [azNatRangeNext_rem_of_ne h0]
      omega

name: Azurite.increasingRangeSignedGen_gen_none
statement:
theorem increasingRangeSignedGen_gen_none {T : Type*} [LE T] [LT T]
    (toInt : T → ℤ) (ofInt : ℤ → T) (bound : ℕ)
    (canon ofInt_toInt toInt_lt le_toInt lt_iff le_iff) (a b : T) (n : ℕ)
    (h : (toInt b - toInt a).toNat ≤ n) :
    @gen _ (increasingRangeSignedGen toInt ofInt bound canon ofInt_toInt toInt_lt le_toInt lt_iff le_iff a b) n = none
proof:

name: Azurite.increasingRangeSignedGen_gen_some

    (h : n < (toInt b - toInt a).toNat) :
    @gen _ (increasingRangeSignedGen toInt ofInt bound canon ofInt_toInt toInt_lt le_toInt lt_iff le_iff a b) n ≠ none
proof:

  rw [show @gen _ (increasingRangeSignedGen toInt ofInt bound canon ofInt_toInt toInt_lt le_toInt lt_iff le_iff a b) n = some _ from dite_eq_left (by omega)]
  exact Option.some_ne_none _

name: Azurite.int8RangeGen_card
statement:
theorem int8RangeGen_card (a b : Int8) :
    Fintype.card ({x : Int8 // a ≤ x ∧ x < b}) = (b.toInt - a.toInt).toNat

    (fun n hn => increasingRangeSignedGen_gen_none _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ a b n hn)
    (fun n hn => increasingRangeSignedGen_gen_some _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ a b n hn)

theorem uint32RangeInclusiveGen_card (a b : UInt32) :
    Fintype.card ({x : UInt32 // a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b}) = b.toNat + 1 - a.toNat
proof:
:=
  @fintypeCard_eq _ (uint32RangeInclusiveGen a b) _ (b.toNat + 1 - a.toNat)
    (fun n hn => increasingInclusiveRangeUnsignedGen_gen_none _ _ _ _ _ _ _ a b n hn)
    (fun n hn => increasingInclusiveRangeUnsignedGen_gen_some _ _ _ _ _ _ _ a b n hn)

theorem uint64RangeInclusiveGen_card (a b : UInt64) :

name: Azurite.magF_mem
statement:
theorem magF_mem {a b : ℤ} {n : ℕ} (h : (n : ℤ) < b - a) :
    a ≤ magF a b n ∧ magF a b n < b
proof:
:= by
  unfold magF; split_ifs <;> omega

name: Azurite.magF_inj
statement: theorem magF_inj {a b : ℤ} {i j : ℕ} (h : magF a b i = magF a b j) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  unfold magF at h; split_ifs at h <;> omega

name: Azurite.magF_surj
statement:
theorem magF_surj {a b : ℤ} {x : ℤ} (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x < b) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (n : ℤ) < b - a ∧ magF a b n = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : 0 ≤ a
  · exact ⟨(x - a).toNat, by omega, by unfold magF; rw [ite_eq_left ha]; omega⟩
  · by_cases hb : b ≤ 0
    · exact ⟨(b - 1 - x).toNat, by omega, by unfold magF; rw [ite_eq_right ha, ite_eq_left hb]; omega⟩
    · rcases lt_trichotomy x 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
      · by_cases hle : -x ≤ min (b - 1) (-a)
        · exact ⟨(-2 * x).toNat, by omega, by
            unfold magF; rw [ite_eq_right ha, ite_eq_right hb]; split_ifs <;> omega⟩
        · exact ⟨(-x + min (b - 1) (-a)).toNat, by omega, by
            unfold magF; rw [ite_eq_right ha, ite_eq_right hb]; split_ifs <;> omega⟩
      · exact ⟨0, by omega, by unfold magF; rw [ite_eq_right ha, ite_eq_right hb]; simp [hzero]⟩
      · by_cases hle : x ≤ min (b - 1) (-a)
        · exact ⟨(2 * x - 1).toNat, by omega, by
            unfold magF; rw [ite_eq_right ha, ite_eq_right hb]; split_ifs <;> omega⟩
        · exact ⟨(x + min (b - 1) (-a)).toNat, by omega, by
            unfold magF; rw [ite_eq_right ha, ite_eq_right hb]; split_ifs <;> omega⟩

name: Azurite.exhaustiveSignedRangeGen_gen_none
statement:
theorem exhaustiveSignedRangeGen_gen_none {T : Type*} [LE T] [LT T]
    (toInt : T → ℤ) (ofInt : ℤ → T) (bound : ℕ)
    (canon ofInt_toInt toInt_lt le_toInt lt_iff le_iff) (a b : T) (n : ℕ)
    (h : (toInt b - toInt a).toNat ≤ n) :
    @gen _ (exhaustiveSignedRangeGen toInt ofInt bound canon ofInt_toInt toInt_lt le_toInt lt_iff le_iff a b) n = none
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_right (by omega)

name: Azurite.exhaustiveSignedRangeGen_gen_some
statement:
theorem exhaustiveSignedRangeGen_gen_some {T : Type*} [LE T] [LT T]
    (toInt : T → ℤ) (ofInt : ℤ → T) (bound : ℕ)
    (canon ofInt_toInt toInt_lt le_toInt lt_iff le_iff) (a b : T) (n : ℕ)
    (h : n < (toInt b - toInt a).toNat) :
    @gen _ (exhaustiveSignedRangeGen toInt ofInt bound canon ofInt_toInt toInt_lt le_toInt lt_iff le_iff a b) n ≠ none
proof:
:= by
  rw [show @gen _ (exhaustiveSignedRangeGen toInt ofInt bound canon ofInt_toInt toInt_lt le_toInt lt_iff le_iff a b) n = some _ from dite_eq_left (by omega)]
  exact Option.some_ne_none _

name: Azurite.exhaustiveSignedRangeInclusiveGen_gen_none
statement:
theorem exhaustiveSignedRangeInclusiveGen_gen_none {T : Type*} [LE T]
    (toInt : T → ℤ) (ofInt : ℤ → T) (bound : ℕ)
    (canon ofInt_toInt toInt_lt le_toInt le_iff) (a b : T) (n : ℕ)
    (h : (toInt b - toInt a + 1).toNat ≤ n) :
    @gen _ (exhaustiveSignedRangeInclusiveGen toInt ofInt bound canon ofInt_toInt toInt_lt le_toInt le_iff a b) n = none
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_right (by omega)

name: Azurite.exhaustiveSignedRangeInclusiveGen_gen_some
statement:
theorem exhaustiveSignedRangeInclusiveGen_gen_some {T : Type*} [LE T]
    (toInt : T → ℤ) (ofInt : ℤ → T) (bound : ℕ)
    (canon ofInt_toInt toInt_lt le_toInt le_iff) (a b : T) (n : ℕ)
    (h : n < (toInt b - toInt a + 1).toNat) :
    @gen _ (exhaustiveSignedRangeInclusiveGen toInt ofInt bound canon ofInt_toInt toInt_lt le_toInt le_iff a b) n ≠ none
proof:
:= by
  rw [show @gen _ (exhaustiveSignedRangeInclusiveGen toInt ofInt bound canon ofInt_toInt toInt_lt le_toInt le_iff a b) n = some _ from dite_eq_left (by omega)]
  exact Option.some_ne_none _

name: Azurite.Airy.fDen_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem fDen_zero : fDen 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.Airy.gDen_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem gDen_zero : gDen 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.Airy.fDen_succ
statement: theorem fDen_succ (k : ℕ) : fDen (k + 1) = fDen k * ((3 * k + 2) * (3 * k + 3))
proof:
:=
  prod_range_succ _ _

name: Azurite.Airy.gDen_succ
statement: theorem gDen_succ (k : ℕ) : gDen (k + 1) = gDen k * ((3 * k + 3) * (3 * k + 4))
proof:
:=
  prod_range_succ _ _

name: Azurite.Airy.fDen_pos
statement: theorem fDen_pos (k : ℕ) : 0 < fDen k
proof: := prod_pos fun j _ => by positivity

name: Azurite.Airy.gDen_pos
statement: theorem gDen_pos (k : ℕ) : 0 < gDen k
proof: := prod_pos fun j _ => by positivity

name: Azurite.Airy.factorial_two_mul_le_fDen
statement: theorem factorial_two_mul_le_fDen (k : ℕ) : (2 * k).factorial ≤ fDen k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [fDen_succ, show 2 * (k + 1) = 2 * k + 1 + 1 by ring, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.factorial_succ]
    calc (2 * k + 1 + 1) * ((2 * k + 1) * (2 * k).factorial)
        = (2 * k).factorial * ((2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 2)) := by ring
      _ ≤ fDen k * ((3 * k + 2) * (3 * k + 3)) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul ih (Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega))

name: Azurite.Airy.factorial_two_mul_add_one_le_gDen
statement: theorem factorial_two_mul_add_one_le_gDen (k : ℕ) : (2 * k + 1).factorial ≤ gDen k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [gDen_succ, show 2 * (k + 1) + 1 = 2 * k + 1 + 1 + 1 by ring, Nat.factorial_succ,
      Nat.factorial_succ]
    calc (2 * k + 1 + 1 + 1) * ((2 * k + 1 + 1) * (2 * k + 1).factorial)
        = (2 * k + 1).factorial * ((2 * k + 2) * (2 * k + 3)) := by ring
      _ ≤ gDen k * ((3 * k + 3) * (3 * k + 4)) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul ih (Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega))

name: Azurite.Airy.fDen_dvd
statement: theorem fDen_dvd {k K : ℕ} (h : k ≤ K) : fDen k ∣ fDen K
proof:
:=
  prod_dvd_prod_of_subset _ _ _ (range_subset_range.mpr h)

name: Azurite.Airy.gDen_dvd
statement: theorem gDen_dvd {k K : ℕ} (h : k ≤ K) : gDen k ∣ gDen K
proof:
:=
  prod_dvd_prod_of_subset _ _ _ (range_subset_range.mpr h)

name: Azurite.Airy.fTerm_zero
statement: theorem fTerm_zero (x : ℝ) : fTerm x 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [fTerm]

name: Azurite.Airy.gTerm_zero
statement: theorem gTerm_zero (x : ℝ) : gTerm x 0 = x
proof: := by simp [gTerm]

name: Azurite.Airy.fTerm_succ
statement:
theorem fTerm_succ (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    fTerm x (k + 1) = fTerm x k * (x ^ 3 / ((3 * k + 2) * (3 * k + 3)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold fTerm
  rw [fDen_succ, show 3 * (k + 1) = 3 * k + 3 by ring, pow_add]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Azurite.Airy.gTerm_succ
statement:
theorem gTerm_succ (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    gTerm x (k + 1) = gTerm x k * (x ^ 3 / ((3 * k + 3) * (3 * k + 4)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold gTerm
  rw [gDen_succ, show 3 * (k + 1) + 1 = 3 * k + 1 + 3 by ring, pow_add]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Azurite.Airy.abs_pow_three_mul
statement: theorem abs_pow_three_mul (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : |x| ^ (3 * k) = (Real.sqrt |x| ^ 3) ^ (2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_mul, show 3 * (2 * k) = 2 * (3 * k) by ring, pow_mul (Real.sqrt |x|) 2,
    Real.sq_sqrt (abs_nonneg x)]

name: Azurite.Airy.abs_fTerm_le
statement:
theorem abs_fTerm_le (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    |fTerm x k| ≤ (Real.sqrt |x| ^ 3) ^ (2 * k) / (2 * k).factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [fTerm, abs_div, abs_pow, Nat.abs_cast, abs_pow_three_mul]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity)
    (by exact_mod_cast factorial_two_mul_le_fDen k)

name: Azurite.Airy.abs_gTerm_le
statement:
theorem abs_gTerm_le (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    |gTerm x k| ≤ |x| * ((Real.sqrt |x| ^ 3) ^ (2 * k) / (2 * k).factorial)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gTerm, abs_div, abs_pow, Nat.abs_cast, pow_succ, mul_comm (|x| ^ (3 * k)), mul_div_assoc,
    abs_pow_three_mul]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (abs_nonneg x)
  refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity) ?_
  calc ((2 * k).factorial : ℝ) ≤ (2 * k + 1).factorial := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le (by omega)
    _ ≤ gDen k := by exact_mod_cast factorial_two_mul_add_one_le_gDen k

name: Azurite.Airy.summable_cosh_term
statement: theorem summable_cosh_term (y : ℝ) : Summable fun k : ℕ => y ^ (2 * k) / ((2 * k).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  (Real.hasSum_cosh y).summable

name: Azurite.Airy.summable_fTerm
statement: theorem summable_fTerm (x : ℝ) : Summable (fTerm x)
proof:
:=
  (summable_cosh_term _).of_norm_bounded fun k => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact abs_fTerm_le x k

name: Azurite.Airy.summable_gTerm
statement: theorem summable_gTerm (x : ℝ) : Summable (gTerm x)
proof:
:=
  ((summable_cosh_term _).mul_left |x|).of_norm_bounded fun k => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact abs_gTerm_le x k

name: Azurite.Airy.abs_f_le
statement: theorem abs_f_le (x : ℝ) : |f x| ≤ Real.cosh (Real.sqrt |x| ^ 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (Real.hasSum_cosh _).tsum_eq]
  exact (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm ((summable_fTerm x).norm)).trans
    ((summable_fTerm x).norm.tsum_le_tsum (fun k => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact abs_fTerm_le x k) (summable_cosh_term _))

name: Azurite.Airy.abs_g_le
statement: theorem abs_g_le (x : ℝ) : |g x| ≤ |x| * Real.cosh (Real.sqrt |x| ^ 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (Real.hasSum_cosh _).tsum_eq, ← tsum_mul_left]
  exact (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm ((summable_gTerm x).norm)).trans
    ((summable_gTerm x).norm.tsum_le_tsum (fun k => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact abs_gTerm_le x k) ((summable_cosh_term _).mul_left _))

name: Azurite.Airy.fTerm_nonneg
statement: theorem fTerm_nonneg (hx : 0 ≤ x) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ fTerm x k
proof: := by unfold fTerm; positivity

name: Azurite.Airy.gTerm_nonneg
statement: theorem gTerm_nonneg (hx : 0 ≤ x) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ gTerm x k
proof: := by unfold gTerm; positivity

name: Azurite.Airy.one_le_f
statement: theorem one_le_f (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 1 ≤ f x
proof:
:=
  calc (1 : ℝ) = fTerm x 0 := (fTerm_zero x).symm
    _ ≤ f x := (summable_fTerm x).le_tsum 0 fun k _ => fTerm_nonneg hx k

name: Azurite.Airy.le_g
statement: theorem le_g (hx : 0 ≤ x) : x ≤ g x
proof:
:=
  calc x = gTerm x 0 := (gTerm_zero x).symm
    _ ≤ g x := (summable_gTerm x).le_tsum 0 fun k _ => gTerm_nonneg hx k

name: Azurite.Airy.f_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem f_zero : f 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [f, tsum_eq_single 0 fun k hk => ?_, fTerm_zero]
  simp [fTerm, hk]

name: Azurite.Airy.g_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem g_zero : g 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [g, tsum_eq_single 0 fun k hk => ?_, gTerm_zero]
  simp [gTerm]

name: Azurite.Airy.abs_fTerm_add_le
statement:
theorem abs_fTerm_add_le {K : ℕ} (hK : |x| ^ 3 ≤ (3 * K + 2) * (3 * K + 3) / 2) (i : ℕ) :
    |fTerm x (K + i)| ≤ |fTerm x K| / 2 ^ i
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [← add_assoc, fTerm_succ, abs_mul, abs_div, abs_pow,
      show |fTerm x K| / 2 ^ (i + 1) = |fTerm x K| / 2 ^ i * (1 / 2) by rw [pow_succ]; ring]
    refine mul_le_mul ih ?_ (by positivity) (by positivity)
    rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (3 * (K + i : ℕ) + 2) * (3 * (K + i : ℕ) + 3)),
      div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
    have hKi : (K : ℝ) ≤ ((K + i : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right K i
    have h1 : (3 * (K : ℝ) + 2) * (3 * (K : ℝ) + 3)
        ≤ (3 * ((K + i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) * (3 * ((K + i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 3) := by
      nlinarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg K : (0 : ℝ) ≤ K)]
    linarith

name: Azurite.Airy.abs_gTerm_add_le
statement:
