theorem abs_gTerm_add_le {K : ℕ} (hK : |x| ^ 3 ≤ (3 * K + 3) * (3 * K + 4) / 2) (i : ℕ) :
    |gTerm x (K + i)| ≤ |gTerm x K| / 2 ^ i
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [← add_assoc, gTerm_succ, abs_mul, abs_div, abs_pow,
      show |gTerm x K| / 2 ^ (i + 1) = |gTerm x K| / 2 ^ i * (1 / 2) by rw [pow_succ]; ring]
    refine mul_le_mul ih ?_ (by positivity) (by positivity)
    rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (3 * (K + i : ℕ) + 3) * (3 * (K + i : ℕ) + 4)),
      div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
    have hKi : (K : ℝ) ≤ ((K + i : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right K i
    have h1 : (3 * (K : ℝ) + 3) * (3 * (K : ℝ) + 4)
        ≤ (3 * ((K + i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 3) * (3 * ((K + i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) := by
      nlinarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg K : (0 : ℝ) ≤ K)]
    linarith

name: Azurite.Airy.abs_tsum_add_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem abs_tsum_add_le_two_mul {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Summable a) (K : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i, |a (K + i)| ≤ |a K| / 2 ^ i) : |∑' i : ℕ, a (i + K)| ≤ 2 * |a K|
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Summable fun i => a (i + K) := (summable_nat_add_iff K).mpr ha
  have hg : Summable fun i : ℕ => |a K| / 2 ^ i := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow] using
      (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num)).mul_left |a K|
  calc |∑' i : ℕ, a (i + K)| ≤ ∑' i : ℕ, |a (i + K)| := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hs.norm
    _ ≤ ∑' i : ℕ, |a K| / 2 ^ i :=
        hs.norm.tsum_le_tsum (fun i => by rw [add_comm]; exact h i) hg
    _ = |a K| * ∑' i : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ i := by
        rw [← tsum_mul_left]; exact tsum_congr fun i => by rw [one_div_pow, div_eq_mul_one_div]
    _ = 2 * |a K| := by
        rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]; norm_num; ring

name: Azurite.Airy.abs_f_sub_sum_le
statement:
theorem abs_f_sub_sum_le {K : ℕ} (hK : |x| ^ 3 ≤ (3 * K + 2) * (3 * K + 3) / 2) :
    |f x - ∑ k ∈ range K, fTerm x k| ≤ 2 * |fTerm x K|
proof:
:= by
  rw [f, ← (summable_fTerm x).sum_add_tsum_nat_add K, add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact abs_tsum_add_le_two_mul (summable_fTerm x) K (abs_fTerm_add_le hK)

name: Azurite.Airy.abs_g_sub_sum_le
statement:
theorem abs_g_sub_sum_le {K : ℕ} (hK : |x| ^ 3 ≤ (3 * K + 3) * (3 * K + 4) / 2) :
    |g x - ∑ k ∈ range K, gTerm x k| ≤ 2 * |gTerm x K|
proof:
:= by
  rw [g, ← (summable_gTerm x).sum_add_tsum_nat_add K, add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact abs_tsum_add_le_two_mul (summable_gTerm x) K (abs_gTerm_add_le hK)

name: Azurite.Airy.halving_of_le
statement:
theorem halving_of_le {K : ℕ} (hK : Real.sqrt |x| ^ 3 ≤ K) :
    |x| ^ 3 ≤ (3 * K + 2) * (3 * K + 3) / 2 ∧ |x| ^ 3 ≤ (3 * K + 3) * (3 * K + 4) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt |x| ^ 3 := by positivity
  have hsq : (Real.sqrt |x| ^ 3) ^ 2 = |x| ^ 3 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, show 3 * 2 = 2 * 3 by ring, pow_mul, Real.sq_sqrt (abs_nonneg x)]
  have hK2 : |x| ^ 3 ≤ (K : ℝ) ^ 2 := by rw [← hsq]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ h0 hK 2
  have hK0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ K := Nat.cast_nonneg K
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: Azurite.Airy.fPartialDen_pos
statement: theorem fPartialDen_pos {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (K : ℕ) : 0 < fPartialDen q K
proof:
:= by
  unfold fPartialDen; have := fDen_pos K; positivity

name: Azurite.Airy.gPartialDen_pos
statement: theorem gPartialDen_pos {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (K : ℕ) : 0 < gPartialDen q K
proof:
:= by
  unfold gPartialDen; have := gDen_pos K; positivity

name: Azurite.Airy.sum_fTerm_div_eq
statement:
theorem sum_fTerm_div_eq {m : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (K : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range K, fTerm ((m : ℝ) / q) k = (fPartialNum m q K : ℝ) / fPartialDen q K
proof:
:= by
  unfold fPartialNum fPartialDen
  have hqr : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq.ne'
  have hD : (fDen K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (fDen_pos K).ne'
  simp only [Int.cast_sum, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_natCast, Nat.cast_mul,
    Nat.cast_pow]
  rw [sum_div]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  rw [mem_range] at hk
  have hdk : (fDen k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (fDen_pos k).ne'
  rw [Nat.cast_div (fDen_dvd hk.le) hdk, fTerm, div_pow,
    show 3 * K = 3 * k + 3 * (K - k) by omega, pow_add]
  field_simp

name: Azurite.Airy.sum_gTerm_div_eq
statement:
theorem sum_gTerm_div_eq {m : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (K : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range K, gTerm ((m : ℝ) / q) k = (gPartialNum m q K : ℝ) / gPartialDen q K
proof:
:= by
  unfold gPartialNum gPartialDen
  have hqr : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq.ne'
  have hD : (gDen K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (gDen_pos K).ne'
  simp only [Int.cast_sum, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_natCast, Nat.cast_mul,
    Nat.cast_pow]
  rw [sum_div]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  rw [mem_range] at hk
  have hdk : (gDen k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (gDen_pos k).ne'
  rw [Nat.cast_div (gDen_dvd hk.le) hdk, gTerm, div_pow,
    show 3 * K + 1 = (3 * k + 1) + 3 * (K - k) by omega, pow_add]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.Airy.fDTerm_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem fDTerm_zero (x : ℝ) : fDTerm x 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [fDTerm]

name: Azurite.Airy.gDTerm_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem gDTerm_zero (x : ℝ) : gDTerm x 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [gDTerm]

name: Azurite.Airy.fDDTerm_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem fDDTerm_zero (x : ℝ) : fDDTerm x 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [fDDTerm]

name: Azurite.Airy.gDDTerm_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem gDDTerm_zero (x : ℝ) : gDDTerm x 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [gDDTerm]

name: Azurite.Airy.fDTerm_succ
statement:
theorem fDTerm_succ (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    fDTerm x (k + 1) = x ^ (3 * k + 2) / (fDen k * (3 * k + 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fDTerm, fDen_succ, show 3 * (k + 1) - 1 = 3 * k + 2 by omega]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Azurite.Airy.gDTerm_succ
statement:
theorem gDTerm_succ (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    gDTerm x (k + 1) = x ^ (3 * k + 3) / (gDen k * (3 * k + 3))
proof:
:= by
  rw [gDTerm, gDen_succ, show 3 * (k + 1) = 3 * k + 3 by omega]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.Airy.fDDTerm_succ
statement: theorem fDDTerm_succ (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : fDDTerm x (k + 1) = x * fTerm x k
proof:
:= by
  rw [fDDTerm, fTerm, fDen_succ, show 3 * (k + 1) - 2 = 3 * k + 1 by omega]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.Airy.gDDTerm_succ
statement: theorem gDDTerm_succ (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : gDDTerm x (k + 1) = x * gTerm x k
proof:
:= by
  rw [gDDTerm, gTerm, gDen_succ, show 3 * (k + 1) - 1 = 3 * k + 2 by omega]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.Airy.hasDerivAt_fTerm
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_fTerm (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : HasDerivAt (fun y => fTerm y k) (fDTerm x k) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_pow (3 * k) x).div_const (fDen k : ℝ)
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  rw [fDTerm]; push_cast; ring

name: Azurite.Airy.hasDerivAt_gTerm
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_gTerm (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : HasDerivAt (fun y => gTerm y k) (gDTerm x k) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_pow (3 * k + 1) x).div_const (gDen k : ℝ)
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  rw [gDTerm]; push_cast; ring

name: Azurite.Airy.hasDerivAt_fDTerm
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_fDTerm (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => fDTerm y k) (fDDTerm x k) x
proof:
:= by
  rcases k with _ | k
  · have e : (fun y : ℝ => fDTerm y 0) = fun _ => 0 := by funext y; simp
    rw [e, fDDTerm_zero]
    exact hasDerivAt_const x 0
  · have e : (fun y : ℝ => fDTerm y (k + 1))
        = fun y : ℝ => y ^ (3 * k + 2) / ((fDen k : ℝ) * (3 * k + 2)) := by
      funext y; exact fDTerm_succ y k
    rw [e, fDDTerm_succ]
    have h := (hasDerivAt_pow (3 * k + 2) x).div_const ((fDen k : ℝ) * (3 * k + 2))
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    have hD : (fDen k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (fDen_pos k).ne'
    rw [fTerm]; push_cast; field_simp; ring

name: Azurite.Airy.hasDerivAt_gDTerm
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_gDTerm (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => gDTerm y k) (gDDTerm x k) x
proof:
:= by
  rcases k with _ | k
  · have e : (fun y : ℝ => gDTerm y 0) = fun _ => 1 := by funext y; simp
    rw [e, gDDTerm_zero]
    exact hasDerivAt_const x 1
  · have e : (fun y : ℝ => gDTerm y (k + 1))
        = fun y : ℝ => y ^ (3 * k + 3) / ((gDen k : ℝ) * (3 * k + 3)) := by
      funext y; exact gDTerm_succ y k
    rw [e, gDDTerm_succ]
    have h := (hasDerivAt_pow (3 * k + 3) x).div_const ((gDen k : ℝ) * (3 * k + 3))
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    have hD : (gDen k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (gDen_pos k).ne'
    rw [gTerm]; push_cast; field_simp; ring

name: Azurite.Airy.abs_fTerm_le_fTerm
statement: theorem abs_fTerm_le_fTerm {y R : ℝ} (h : |y| ≤ R) (k : ℕ) : |fTerm y k| ≤ fTerm R k
proof:
:= by
  rw [fTerm, fTerm, abs_div, abs_pow, Nat.abs_cast]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg y) h _) (by positivity)

name: Azurite.Airy.abs_gTerm_le_gTerm
statement: theorem abs_gTerm_le_gTerm {y R : ℝ} (h : |y| ≤ R) (k : ℕ) : |gTerm y k| ≤ gTerm R k
proof:
:= by
  rw [gTerm, gTerm, abs_div, abs_pow, Nat.abs_cast]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg y) h _) (by positivity)

name: Azurite.Airy.abs_fDTerm_succ_le
statement:
theorem abs_fDTerm_succ_le {y R : ℝ} (h : |y| ≤ R) (k : ℕ) :
    |fDTerm y (k + 1)| ≤ R ^ 2 * fTerm R k
proof:
:= by
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := (abs_nonneg y).trans h
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < fDen k := by exact_mod_cast fDen_pos k
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < fDen k * (3 * k + 2) := mul_pos hD (by positivity)
  rw [fDTerm_succ, abs_div, abs_pow, fTerm, ← mul_div_assoc, ← pow_add, abs_of_pos hpos,
    show 2 + 3 * k = 3 * k + 2 by ring]
  refine div_le_div₀ (by positivity) (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg y) h _) hD ?_
  have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 * k + 2 := by linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k)]
  nlinarith

name: Azurite.Airy.abs_gDTerm_succ_le
statement:
theorem abs_gDTerm_succ_le {y R : ℝ} (h : |y| ≤ R) (k : ℕ) :
    |gDTerm y (k + 1)| ≤ R ^ 2 * gTerm R k
proof:
:= by
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := (abs_nonneg y).trans h
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < gDen k := by exact_mod_cast gDen_pos k
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < gDen k * (3 * k + 3) := mul_pos hD (by positivity)
  rw [gDTerm_succ, abs_div, abs_pow, gTerm, ← mul_div_assoc, ← pow_add, abs_of_pos hpos,
    show 2 + (3 * k + 1) = 3 * k + 3 by ring]
  refine div_le_div₀ (by positivity) (pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg y) h _) hD ?_
  have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 * k + 3 := by linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k)]
  nlinarith

name: Azurite.Airy.summable_shiftBound
statement:
theorem summable_shiftBound {c₀ C : ℝ} {v : ℕ → ℝ} (hv : Summable v) :
    Summable (shiftBound c₀ C v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← summable_nat_add_iff 1]
  refine (hv.mul_left C).congr fun k => ?_
  simp [shiftBound]

name: Azurite.Airy.summable_fDTerm
statement: theorem summable_fDTerm (x : ℝ) : Summable (fDTerm x)
proof:
:=
  (summable_shiftBound (c₀ := 0) (C := |x| ^ 2) (summable_fTerm |x|)).of_norm_bounded fun k => by
    rcases k with _ | k
    · simp [shiftBound]
    · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      simpa [shiftBound] using abs_fDTerm_succ_le (le_refl |x|) k

name: Azurite.Airy.summable_gDTerm
statement: theorem summable_gDTerm (x : ℝ) : Summable (gDTerm x)
proof:
:=
  (summable_shiftBound (c₀ := 1) (C := |x| ^ 2) (summable_gTerm |x|)).of_norm_bounded fun k => by
    rcases k with _ | k
    · simp [shiftBound]
    · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      simpa [shiftBound] using abs_gDTerm_succ_le (le_refl |x|) k

name: Azurite.Airy.hasDerivAt_f
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_f (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt f (fD x) x
proof:
:= by
  set R : ℝ := |x| + 1 with hR
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := by positivity
  have hu : Summable (shiftBound 0 (R ^ 2) (fTerm R)) :=
    summable_shiftBound (summable_fTerm R)
  have hg' : ∀ k (y : ℝ), y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) R →
      ‖fDTerm y k‖ ≤ shiftBound 0 (R ^ 2) (fTerm R) k := by
    intro k y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hy
    rcases k with _ | k
    · simp [shiftBound]
    · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      simpa [shiftBound] using abs_fDTerm_succ_le hy.le k
  have hx : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) R := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs]; linarith
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) R := Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
  exact hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected hu Metric.isOpen_ball
    (convex_ball (0 : ℝ) R).isPreconnected (fun k y _ => hasDerivAt_fTerm y k) hg' h0
    (summable_fTerm 0) hx

name: Azurite.Airy.hasDerivAt_g
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_g (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt g (gD x) x
proof:
:= by
  set R : ℝ := |x| + 1 with hR
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := by positivity
  have hu : Summable (shiftBound 1 (R ^ 2) (gTerm R)) :=
    summable_shiftBound (summable_gTerm R)
  have hg' : ∀ k (y : ℝ), y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) R →
      ‖gDTerm y k‖ ≤ shiftBound 1 (R ^ 2) (gTerm R) k := by
    intro k y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hy
    rcases k with _ | k
    · simp [shiftBound]
    · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      simpa [shiftBound] using abs_gDTerm_succ_le hy.le k
  have hx : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) R := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs]; linarith
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) R := Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
  exact hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected hu Metric.isOpen_ball
    (convex_ball (0 : ℝ) R).isPreconnected (fun k y _ => hasDerivAt_gTerm y k) hg' h0
    (summable_gTerm 0) hx

name: Azurite.Airy.tsum_fDDTerm
statement: theorem tsum_fDDTerm (x : ℝ) : ∑' k : ℕ, fDDTerm x k = x * f x
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Summable (fDDTerm x) := by
    rw [← summable_nat_add_iff 1]
    refine ((summable_fTerm x).mul_left x).congr fun k => ?_
    simp [fDDTerm_succ]
  rw [hs.tsum_eq_zero_add, fDDTerm_zero, zero_add, f, ← tsum_mul_left]
  exact tsum_congr fun k => fDDTerm_succ x k

name: Azurite.Airy.tsum_gDDTerm
statement: theorem tsum_gDDTerm (x : ℝ) : ∑' k : ℕ, gDDTerm x k = x * g x
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Summable (gDDTerm x) := by
    rw [← summable_nat_add_iff 1]
    refine ((summable_gTerm x).mul_left x).congr fun k => ?_
    simp [gDDTerm_succ]
  rw [hs.tsum_eq_zero_add, gDDTerm_zero, zero_add, g, ← tsum_mul_left]
  exact tsum_congr fun k => gDDTerm_succ x k

name: Azurite.Airy.hasDerivAt_fD
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_fD (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt fD (x * f x) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tsum_fDDTerm]
  set R : ℝ := |x| + 1 with hR
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := by positivity
  have hu : Summable (shiftBound 0 R (fTerm R)) := summable_shiftBound (summable_fTerm R)
  have hg' : ∀ k (y : ℝ), y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) R →
      ‖fDDTerm y k‖ ≤ shiftBound 0 R (fTerm R) k := by
    intro k y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hy
    rcases k with _ | k
    · simp [shiftBound]
    · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, fDDTerm_succ, abs_mul]
      simp only [shiftBound, Nat.succ_ne_zero, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      exact mul_le_mul hy.le (abs_fTerm_le_fTerm hy.le k) (abs_nonneg _) hR0
  have hx : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) R := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs]; linarith
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) R := Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
  exact hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected hu Metric.isOpen_ball
    (convex_ball (0 : ℝ) R).isPreconnected (fun k y _ => hasDerivAt_fDTerm y k) hg' h0
    (summable_fDTerm 0) hx

name: Azurite.Airy.hasDerivAt_gD
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_gD (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt gD (x * g x) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tsum_gDDTerm]
  set R : ℝ := |x| + 1 with hR
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := by positivity
  have hu : Summable (shiftBound 0 R (gTerm R)) := summable_shiftBound (summable_gTerm R)
  have hg' : ∀ k (y : ℝ), y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) R →
      ‖gDDTerm y k‖ ≤ shiftBound 0 R (gTerm R) k := by
    intro k y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hy
    rcases k with _ | k
    · simp [shiftBound]
    · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, gDDTerm_succ, abs_mul]
      simp only [shiftBound, Nat.succ_ne_zero, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      exact mul_le_mul hy.le (abs_gTerm_le_gTerm hy.le k) (abs_nonneg _) hR0
  have hx : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) R := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs]; linarith
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) R := Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
  exact hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected hu Metric.isOpen_ball
    (convex_ball (0 : ℝ) R).isPreconnected (fun k y _ => hasDerivAt_gDTerm y k) hg' h0
    (summable_gDTerm 0) hx

name: Azurite.Airy.deriv_f
statement: theorem deriv_f : deriv f = fD
proof: := funext fun x => (hasDerivAt_f x).deriv

name: Azurite.Airy.deriv_g
statement: theorem deriv_g : deriv g = gD
proof: := funext fun x => (hasDerivAt_g x).deriv

name: Azurite.Airy.f_ode
statement: theorem f_ode (x : ℝ) : deriv (deriv f) x = x * f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_f]; exact (hasDerivAt_fD x).deriv

name: Azurite.Airy.g_ode
statement: theorem g_ode (x : ℝ) : deriv (deriv g) x = x * g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_g]; exact (hasDerivAt_gD x).deriv

name: Azurite.Airy.fD_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem fD_zero : fD 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e : fDTerm 0 = fun _ => 0 := by
    funext k
    rcases k with _ | k
    · simp
    · simp [fDTerm_succ]
  rw [fD, e, tsum_zero]

name: Azurite.Airy.gD_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem gD_zero : gD 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [gD, tsum_eq_single 0 fun k hk => ?_, gDTerm_zero]
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = j + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
  simp [gDTerm_succ]

name: Azurite.Airy.hasDerivAt_wronskianFG
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_wronskianFG (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt wronskianFG 0 x
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_f x).mul (hasDerivAt_gD x)).sub ((hasDerivAt_fD x).mul (hasDerivAt_g x))
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  ring

name: Azurite.Airy.wronskianFG_eq_one
statement: theorem wronskianFG_eq_one (x : ℝ) : wronskianFG x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hconst := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun y => (hasDerivAt_wronskianFG y).differentiableAt)
    (fun y => (hasDerivAt_wronskianFG y).deriv) x 0
  rw [hconst, wronskianFG, f_zero, g_zero, fD_zero, gD_zero]
  ring

name: Azurite.Airy.c₁_pos
statement: theorem c₁_pos : 0 < c₁
proof:
:= div_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _)
  (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by norm_num))

name: Azurite.Airy.c₂_pos
statement: theorem c₂_pos : 0 < c₂
proof:
:= div_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _)
  (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by norm_num))

name: Azurite.Airy.c₁_mul_c₂
statement: theorem c₁_mul_c₂ : c₁ * c₂ = 1 / (2 * Real.sqrt 3 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  have hΓ := Real.Gamma_mul_Gamma_one_sub (1 / 3)
  rw [show (1 : ℝ) - 1 / 3 = 2 / 3 by norm_num, show Real.pi * (1 / 3) = Real.pi / 3 by ring,
    Real.sin_pi_div_three] at hΓ
  have h3 : (3 : ℝ) ^ (-(2 / 3 : ℝ)) * (3 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 3 : ℝ)) = 1 / 3 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3), show -(2 / 3 : ℝ) + -(1 / 3) = -1 by norm_num,
      Real.rpow_neg_one, one_div]
  have hG1 : 0 < Real.Gamma (1 / 3) := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by norm_num)
  have hG2 : 0 < Real.Gamma (2 / 3) := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by norm_num)
  have hs3 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt 3 := by positivity
  have hs3sq : Real.sqrt 3 ^ 2 = 3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  rw [c₁, c₂, div_mul_div_comm, h3, mul_comm (Real.Gamma (2 / 3)), hΓ]
  field_simp
  nlinarith [hs3sq, Real.pi_pos]

name: Azurite.Airy.Ai_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem Ai_zero : Ai 0 = c₁
proof: := by simp [Ai]

name: Azurite.Airy.Bi_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem Bi_zero : Bi 0 = Real.sqrt 3 * c₁
proof: := by simp [Bi]

name: Azurite.Airy.AiD_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem AiD_zero : AiD 0 = -c₂
proof: := by simp [AiD]

name: Azurite.Airy.BiD_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem BiD_zero : BiD 0 = Real.sqrt 3 * c₂
proof: := by simp [BiD]

name: Azurite.Airy.hasDerivAt_Ai
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_Ai (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt Ai (AiD x) x
proof:
:=
  ((hasDerivAt_f x).const_mul c₁).sub ((hasDerivAt_g x).const_mul c₂)

name: Azurite.Airy.hasDerivAt_Bi
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_Bi (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt Bi (BiD x) x
proof:
:=
  (((hasDerivAt_f x).const_mul c₁).add ((hasDerivAt_g x).const_mul c₂)).const_mul (Real.sqrt 3)

name: Azurite.Airy.hasDerivAt_AiD
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_AiD (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt AiD (x * Ai x) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_fD x).const_mul c₁).sub ((hasDerivAt_gD x).const_mul c₂)
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  rw [Ai]; ring

name: Azurite.Airy.hasDerivAt_BiD
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_BiD (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt BiD (x * Bi x) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (((hasDerivAt_fD x).const_mul c₁).add ((hasDerivAt_gD x).const_mul c₂)).const_mul
    (Real.sqrt 3)
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  rw [Bi]; ring

name: Azurite.Airy.deriv_Ai
statement: theorem deriv_Ai : deriv Ai = AiD
proof: := funext fun x => (hasDerivAt_Ai x).deriv

name: Azurite.Airy.deriv_Bi
statement: theorem deriv_Bi : deriv Bi = BiD
proof: := funext fun x => (hasDerivAt_Bi x).deriv

name: Azurite.Airy.Ai_ode
statement: theorem Ai_ode (x : ℝ) : deriv (deriv Ai) x = x * Ai x
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_Ai]; exact (hasDerivAt_AiD x).deriv

name: Azurite.Airy.Bi_ode
statement: theorem Bi_ode (x : ℝ) : deriv (deriv Bi) x = x * Bi x
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_Bi]; exact (hasDerivAt_BiD x).deriv

name: Azurite.Airy.wronskian_Ai_Bi
statement: theorem wronskian_Ai_Bi (x : ℝ) : Ai x * BiD x - AiD x * Bi x = 1 / Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  have hW := wronskianFG_eq_one x
  rw [wronskianFG] at hW
  have hc := c₁_mul_c₂
  have hs3 : Real.sqrt 3 ^ 2 = 3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hπ : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_pos.ne'
  have hs : Real.sqrt 3 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have e : Ai x * BiD x - AiD x * Bi x
      = 2 * Real.sqrt 3 * (c₁ * c₂) * (f x * gD x - fD x * g x) := by
    unfold Ai Bi AiD BiD; ring
  rw [e, hW, hc]
  field_simp

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.prime_of_rail_checks
statement:
theorem prime_of_rail_checks
    {n : AzNat} {I F : ℕ} [Fact (1 < n.toNat)]
    (hI : Squarefree I) (hF : Squarefree F)
    (hqI : ∀ q ∈ F.primeFactors, (q - 1) ∣ I)
    (hgcd : Nat.Coprime (I * F) n.toNat) (hnF : n.toNat < F ^ 2)
    {w u : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hw : ∀ p ∈ I.primeFactors, 0 < w p)
    (hu : ∀ p ∈ I.primeFactors, ¬p ∣ u p)
    {lTab : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} {lq : ℕ → ℕ} {l : ℕ} {q₀ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hq₀ : ∀ p ∈ I.primeFactors, q₀ p ∈ F.primeFactors ∧ p ∣ q₀ p - 1)
    {g : ℕ → ℕ} {gu : (q : ℕ) → (ZMod q)ˣ}
    (hgu : ∀ q ∈ F.primeFactors, ((g q : ℕ) : ZMod q) = (gu q : ZMod q))
    (hgen : ∀ q, q ∈ F.primeFactors → ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (gu q))
    {e e' : ℕ → AzNat}
    (he : ∀ p ∈ I.primeFactors, (e p).toNat = p ^ w p * u p)
    (he' : ∀ p ∈ I.primeFactors, (e' p).toNat = p ^ (w p - 1) * u p)
    (hstep : ∀ q (_ : q ∈ F.primeFactors) [Fact q.Prime],
      ∀ p (_ : p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors) [Fact p.Prime],
      (gaussSumT n p q (g q)).powAzNat (e p) = zetaPPowT n p q (lTab p q))
    (h5 : ∀ p (_ : p ∈ I.primeFactors) [Fact p.Prime]
      [Fact (q₀ p).Prime],
      step5Check n p (q₀ p)
        ((gaussSumT n p (q₀ p) (g (q₀ p))).powAzNat (e' p)) = true)
    (hlq : ∀ q ∈ F.primeFactors, ∀ p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors,
      lq q ≡ lTab p q [MOD p])
    (hl : ∀ q ∈ F.primeFactors,
      ((l : ℕ) : ZMod q) = ((gu q ^ lq q : (ZMod q)ˣ) : ZMod q))
    (hscan : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < I → l ^ j % F ∣ n.toNat →
      l ^ j % F = 1 ∨ l ^ j % F = n.toNat) :
    n.toNat.Prime
proof:
:= by
  have hn1 : 1 < n.toNat := Fact.out
  by_contra hncomp
  
  
  have hreduce : ∀ (q : ℕ) (hq : q ∈ F.primeFactors),
      ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors),
      ∀ (_ : Fact q.Prime) (_ : Fact p.Prime) (E L : ℕ),
      reduceT n p q (gaussSum
          (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (CP.zetaPQUnit_mem hp) (hgen q hq))
          (AddChar.zmodChar q (CP.isPrimitiveRoot_zetaQPQ hp).pow_eq_one)
          ^ E
        - ((CP.zetaPQUnit p q : (CP.CycPQ p q)ˣ) : CP.CycPQ p q) ^ L)
      = (gaussSumT n p q (g q)) ^ E - zetaPPowT n p q L := by
    intro q hq p hp _ _ E L
    rw [map_sub, map_pow, map_pow,
      reduceT_gaussSum n hp (hgen q hq) (hgu q hq),
      CP.val_zetaPQUnit hp, reduceT_zetaP, constT_pow, zetaPPowT]
  have hfound : ∃ j, 0 < j ∧ j < I ∧ l ^ j % F ∣ n.toNat
      ∧ 1 < l ^ j % F ∧ l ^ j % F < n.toNat := by
    refine CP.theorem_4_4_6_composite_tower hn1 hncomp hI hF hqI hgcd hnF
      hw hu (lTab := lTab) (lq := lq) (l := l) (q₀ := q₀) hq₀
      (g := gu) hgen ?_ ?_ hlq hl
    · 
      intro q hq _ p hp
      have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp⟩
      have hpI : p ∈ I.primeFactors :=
        Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp,
          (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp).trans (hqI q hq), hI.ne_zero⟩
      have hrail := hstep q hq p hp
      rw [powAzNat_eq_pow, he p hpI] at hrail
      rw [natCast_dvd_iff_reduceT, hreduce q hq p hp ‹_› ‹_›, hrail,
        sub_self]
    · 
      
      intro q hq _ p hp hq₀p d hd hd1 j
      have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp⟩
      have hpI : p ∈ I.primeFactors :=
        Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp,
          (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp).trans (hqI q hq), hI.ne_zero⟩
      subst hq₀p
      have hrail := h5 p hpI
      rw [step5Check, List.all_eq_true] at hrail
      
      have hζp : ((CP.zetaPQUnit p (q₀ p) : (CP.CycPQ p (q₀ p))ˣ)
          : CP.CycPQ p (q₀ p)) ^ p = 1 := by
        rw [← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val,
          (CP.isPrimitiveRoot_zetaPQUnit hp).pow_eq_one, Units.val_one]
      have hper : ((CP.zetaPQUnit p (q₀ p) : (CP.CycPQ p (q₀ p))ˣ)
          : CP.CycPQ p (q₀ p)) ^ j
          = ((CP.zetaPQUnit p (q₀ p) : (CP.CycPQ p (q₀ p))ˣ)
            : CP.CycPQ p (q₀ p)) ^ (j % p) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.div_add_mod j p, pow_add, pow_mul, hζp,
          one_pow, one_mul]
      rw [hper]
      
      have hjp : j % p ∈ List.range p :=
        List.mem_range.mpr (Nat.mod_lt j
          (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).pos)
      have hcheck := hrail (j % p) hjp
      rw [decide_eq_true_eq] at hcheck
      have hgcd1 : (towerContentGcd n p (q₀ p)
          ((gaussSumT n p (q₀ p) (g (q₀ p))).powAzNat (e' p)
            - zetaPPowT n p (q₀ p) (j % p))).toNat = 1 := by
        rw [hcheck]
        exact AzNat.toNat_ofNat 1
      have hred := hreduce (q₀ p) hq p hp ‹_› ‹_›
        (p ^ (w p - 1) * u p) (j % p)
      rw [powAzNat_eq_pow, he' p hpI] at hgcd1
      rw [← hred] at hgcd1
      exact not_dvd_of_towerContentGcd_eq_one n p (q₀ p) _ hgcd1 d hd hd1

  obtain ⟨j, hj0, hjI, hjdvd, hj1, hjn⟩ := hfound
  rcases hscan j hj0 hjI hjdvd with h | h <;> omega

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.prime_dvd_list_prod
statement:
private theorem prime_dvd_list_prod {r : ℕ} (hr : r.Prime) :
    ∀ {l : List ℕ}, r ∣ l.prod → ∃ q ∈ l, r ∣ q
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro h
    rw [List.prod_nil, Nat.dvd_one] at h
    exact absurd h hr.one_lt.ne'
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro h
    rw [List.prod_cons] at h
    rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hr).mp h with h | h
    · exact ⟨a, List.mem_cons_self, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨q, hq, hdvd⟩ := ih h
      exact ⟨q, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq, hdvd⟩

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.squarefree_prod_of_nodup_primes
statement:
theorem squarefree_prod_of_nodup_primes :
    ∀ {l : List ℕ}, l.Nodup → (∀ p ∈ l, p.Prime) → Squarefree l.prod
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro _ _
    rw [List.prod_nil]
    exact squarefree_one
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro hnd hpr
    rw [List.prod_cons]
    have ha : a.Prime := hpr a List.mem_cons_self
    have hco : Nat.Coprime a l.prod := by
      rw [Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd ha]
      intro hdvd
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hdvd'⟩ := prime_dvd_list_prod ha hdvd
      rw [(Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq ha
        (hpr q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq))).mp hdvd'] at hnd
      exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1 hq
    exact (Nat.squarefree_mul hco).mpr
      ⟨ha.squarefree, ih (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).2
        (fun p hp => hpr p (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hp))⟩

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.mem_primeFactors_prod_iff
statement:
theorem mem_primeFactors_prod_iff {l : List ℕ} (_ : l.Nodup)
    (hpr : ∀ p ∈ l, p.Prime) {r : ℕ} :
    r ∈ l.prod.primeFactors ↔ r ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hm
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hdvd⟩ := prime_dvd_list_prod
      (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hm)
      (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hm)
    rwa [(Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hm)
      (hpr q hq)).mp hdvd]
  · intro hm
    refine Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hpr r hm, List.dvd_prod hm, ?_⟩
    exact Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp
      (List.prod_pos fun p hp => (hpr p hp).pos)

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.gaussSumsTest_eq_true
statement:
theorem gaussSumsTest_eq_true (h : gaussSumsTest n c = true) :
    n.toNat.Prime
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussSumsTest] at h
  by_cases h1 : AzNat.ofNat 1 < n
  case neg => rw [dite_eq_right h1] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  rw [dite_eq_left h1] at h
  have : Fact (1 < n.toNat) := ⟨by
    have h' := (AzNat.lt_iff_toNat_lt _ _).mp h1
    rwa [AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at h'⟩
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    beq_iff_eq] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hIndup, hIpr⟩, hFndup⟩, hFpr⟩, hgcd'⟩, hlt⟩, hP⟩, hQ⟩,
    hscan'⟩ := h
  set I := c.Ips.prod with hIdef
  set F := c.Fps.prod with hFdef
  have memI : ∀ {r : ℕ}, r ∈ I.primeFactors ↔ r ∈ c.Ips :=
    mem_primeFactors_prod_iff hIndup hIpr
  have memF : ∀ {r : ℕ}, r ∈ F.primeFactors ↔ r ∈ c.Fps :=
    mem_primeFactors_prod_iff hFndup hFpr
  
  have hQ' : ∀ q ∈ c.Fps, (q - 1) ∣ I ∧ Nat.Coprime (c.g q) q
      ∧ (∀ r ∈ c.Ips, r ∣ q - 1 →
          ((c.g q : ℕ) : ZMod q) ^ ((q - 1) / r) ≠ 1)
      ∧ (∀ p ∈ c.Ips, p ∣ q - 1 →
          pairCheck n c q p = true ∧ c.lq q ≡ c.lTab p q [MOD p])
      ∧ ((c.l : ℕ) : ZMod q) = ((c.g q : ℕ) : ZMod q) ^ c.lq q := by
    intro q hq
    have hcheck := hQ q hq
    rw [qCheck, dite_eq_left (hFpr q hq)] at hcheck
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_filter,
      decide_eq_true_eq, and_imp] at hcheck
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨hdvd, hco⟩, hgen'⟩, hpair⟩, hl'⟩ := hcheck
    exact ⟨hdvd, hco, fun r hr hrd => hgen' r hr hrd,
      fun p hp hpd => hpair p hp hpd, hl'⟩
  
  have hP' : ∀ p ∈ c.Ips, (c.q₀ p).Prime ∧ 0 < c.w p ∧ ¬p ∣ c.u p
      ∧ c.q₀ p ∈ c.Fps ∧ p ∣ c.q₀ p - 1
      ∧ ∀ (_ : Fact p.Prime) (_ : Fact (c.q₀ p).Prime),
        step5Check n p (c.q₀ p)
          ((gaussSumT n p (c.q₀ p) (c.g (c.q₀ p))).powAzNat (certE' c p))
          = true := by
    intro p hp
    have hcheck := hP p hp
    rw [pCheck, dite_eq_left (hIpr p hp)] at hcheck
    by_cases hq : (c.q₀ p).Prime
    · rw [dite_eq_left hq] at hcheck
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hcheck
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨hw, hu⟩, hq₀F⟩, hq₀d⟩, h5⟩ := hcheck
      exact ⟨hq, hw, hu, hq₀F, hq₀d, fun _ _ => h5⟩
    · rw [dite_eq_right hq] at hcheck
      exact absurd hcheck (by simp)
  
  let gu : (q : ℕ) → (ZMod q)ˣ := fun q =>
    if h : Nat.Coprime (c.g q) q then ZMod.unitOfCoprime _ h else 1
  refine prime_of_rail_checks (n := n) (I := I) (F := F)
    (squarefree_prod_of_nodup_primes hIndup hIpr)
    (squarefree_prod_of_nodup_primes hFndup hFpr)
    (fun q hq => (hQ' q (memF.mp hq)).1)
    ?_ ?_
    (w := c.w) (u := c.u)
    (fun p hp => (hP' p (memI.mp hp)).2.1)
    (fun p hp => (hP' p (memI.mp hp)).2.2.1)
    (lTab := c.lTab) (lq := c.lq) (l := c.l) (q₀ := c.q₀)
    (fun p hp => ⟨memF.mpr (hP' p (memI.mp hp)).2.2.2.1,
      (hP' p (memI.mp hp)).2.2.2.2.1⟩)
    (g := c.g) (gu := gu) ?_ ?_
    (e := certE c) (e' := certE' c)
    (fun p _ => by rw [certE, AzNat.toNat_ofNat])
    (fun p _ => by rw [certE', AzNat.toNat_ofNat])
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · 
    have h := congrArg AzNat.toNat hgcd'
    rwa [AzNat.toNat_gcd, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at h
  · 
    have h := (AzNat.lt_iff_toNat_lt _ _).mp hlt
    rwa [AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at h
  · 
    intro q hq
    have hco := (hQ' q (memF.mp hq)).2.1
    show _ = ((gu q : (ZMod q)ˣ) : ZMod q)
    rw [show gu q = ZMod.unitOfCoprime _ hco from dite_eq_left hco,
      ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime]
  · 
    intro q hq
    have : Fact q.Prime := ⟨hFpr q (memF.mp hq)⟩
    have hco := (hQ' q (memF.mp hq)).2.1
    refine CP.forall_mem_zpowers_of_pow_div_prime (g := gu q) ?_
    intro r hr
    have hrI : r ∈ c.Ips := by
      have hrIF : r ∈ I.primeFactors :=
        Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hr,
          (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hr).trans
            (hQ' q (memF.mp hq)).1,
          (squarefree_prod_of_nodup_primes hIndup hIpr).ne_zero⟩
      exact memI.mp hrIF
    have hval := (hQ' q (memF.mp hq)).2.2.1 r hrI
      (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hr)
    intro heq
    refine hval ?_
    have h := congrArg (fun u : (ZMod q)ˣ => (u : ZMod q)) heq
    rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_one] at h
    rwa [show ((gu q : (ZMod q)ˣ) : ZMod q) = ((c.g q : ℕ) : ZMod q) from by
      rw [show gu q = ZMod.unitOfCoprime _ hco from dite_eq_left hco,
        ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime]] at h
  · 
    intro q hq _ p hp _
    have hpI : p ∈ c.Ips := by
      have : p ∈ I.primeFactors :=
        Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp,
          (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp).trans
            (hQ' q (memF.mp hq)).1,
          (squarefree_prod_of_nodup_primes hIndup hIpr).ne_zero⟩
      exact memI.mp this
    have hpair := ((hQ' q (memF.mp hq)).2.2.2.1 p hpI
      (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp)).1
    rw [pairCheck, dite_eq_left (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp),
      decide_eq_true_eq] at hpair
    exact hpair
  · 
    intro p hp _ _
    exact (hP' p (memI.mp hp)).2.2.2.2.2 ‹_› ‹_›
  · 
    intro q hq p hp
    have hpI : p ∈ c.Ips := by
      have : p ∈ I.primeFactors :=
        Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp,
          (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp).trans
            (hQ' q (memF.mp hq)).1,
          (squarefree_prod_of_nodup_primes hIndup hIpr).ne_zero⟩
      exact memI.mp this
    exact ((hQ' q (memF.mp hq)).2.2.2.1 p hpI
      (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp)).2
  · 
    intro q hq
    have hco := (hQ' q (memF.mp hq)).2.1
    rw [(hQ' q (memF.mp hq)).2.2.2.2, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val,
      show ((gu q : (ZMod q)ˣ) : ZMod q) = ((c.g q : ℕ) : ZMod q) from by
        rw [show gu q = ZMod.unitOfCoprime _ hco from dite_eq_left hco,
          ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime]]
  · 
    intro j hj0 hjI hjdvd
    have hcheck := hscan' 
    rw [scanCheck, List.all_eq_true] at hcheck
    have hj := hcheck j (List.mem_range.mpr hjI)
    simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, Bool.not_eq_eq_eq_not,
      Bool.not_true] at hj
    rcases hj with hj | hj
    · omega
    rcases hj with hj | hj
    case inr =>
      exact Or.inr (by
        have h := congrArg AzNat.toNat hj
        rwa [AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at h)
    rcases hj with hj | hj
    · exact Or.inl hj
    · 
      exfalso
      rw [beq_eq_false_iff_ne] at hj
      refine hj ?_
      apply AzNat.toNat_injective
      rw [AzNat.toNat_mod, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hjdvd
      rw [hk]
      exact Nat.mul_mod_right _ _

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.foldl_gcd_dvd
statement:
private theorem foldl_gcd_dvd {α : Type _} (f : α → AzNat) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (acc : AzNat),
    ((l.foldl (fun a x => AzNat.gcd a (f x)) acc).toNat ∣ acc.toNat)
      ∧ ∀ x ∈ l,
        (l.foldl (fun a x => AzNat.gcd a (f x)) acc).toNat ∣ (f x).toNat
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro acc
    exact ⟨dvd_rfl, by simp⟩
  | cons v l ih =>
    intro acc
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih (AzNat.gcd acc (f v))
    refine ⟨h1.trans ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [AzNat.toNat_gcd]
      exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _
    · intro x hx
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx
      · exact h1.trans (by
          rw [AzNat.toNat_gcd]
          exact Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
      · exact h2 x hx

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.towerContentGcd_dvd
statement:
theorem towerContentGcd_dvd (T : GaussTowerPQ n p q) :
    (towerContentGcd n p q T).toNat ∣ n.toNat
      ∧ ∀ c2 ∈ T.val.coeffs, ∀ c1 ∈ c2.val.coeffs,
        (towerContentGcd n p q T).toNat ∣ c1.val.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [towerContentGcd]
  have houter : ∀ (l : List (GaussTowerP n p)) (acc : AzNat),
      ((l.foldl (fun acc' c2 =>
          c2.val.coeffs.foldl (fun acc'' c1 => AzNat.gcd acc'' c1.val)
            acc') acc).toNat ∣ acc.toNat)
        ∧ ∀ c2 ∈ l, ∀ c1 ∈ c2.val.coeffs,
          (l.foldl (fun acc' c2 =>
            c2.val.coeffs.foldl (fun acc'' c1 => AzNat.gcd acc'' c1.val)
              acc') acc).toNat ∣ c1.val.toNat := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
      intro acc
      exact ⟨dvd_rfl, by simp⟩
    | cons c2 l ih =>
      intro acc
      rw [List.foldl_cons]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih
        (c2.val.coeffs.foldl (fun acc'' c1 => AzNat.gcd acc'' c1.val) acc)
      have hinner := foldl_gcd_dvd (fun c1 : AzZMod n => c1.val)
        c2.val.coeffs.toList acc
      rw [← Array.foldl_toList] at h1 h2 ⊢
      refine ⟨h1.trans ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Array.foldl_toList]
        rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
        exact hinner.1
      · intro c2' hc2' c1 hc1
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hc2' with rfl | hc2'
        · refine h1.trans ?_
          rw [Array.foldl_toList, ← Array.foldl_toList]
          exact hinner.2 c1 (by simpa using hc1)
        · exact h2 c2' hc2' c1 hc1
  have h := houter T.val.coeffs.toList n
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList]
  exact ⟨h.1, fun c2 hc2 => h.2 c2 (by simpa using hc2)⟩

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.azPolynomial_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem azPolynomial_eq_zero {R : Type _} [Semiring R]
    (P : AzPolynomial R) (h : ∀ x ∈ P.coeffs, x = 0) : P = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : P.coeffs.size = 0
  · apply AzPolynomial.ext
    rw [Array.eq_empty_of_size_eq_zero hs]
    rfl
  · exfalso
    have hlast : P.coeffs.back? = some (P.coeffs[P.coeffs.size - 1]) := by
      rw [Array.back?_eq_getElem?, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem
        (by omega)]
    refine P.last_ne_zero ?_
    rw [hlast, h _ (P.coeffs.getElem_mem (by omega))]

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.azZMod_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem azZMod_eq_zero {m : AzNat} [NeZero m.toNat]
    (x : AzZMod m) (h : x.val.toNat = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hv : x.val = 0 :=
    AzNat.toNat_injective (by rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero])
  cases x with
  | mk v hlt => cases hv; rfl

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.gaussTower_eq_zero_of_grid
statement:
theorem gaussTower_eq_zero_of_grid (T : GaussTowerPQ n p q)
    (h : ∀ c2 ∈ T.val.coeffs, ∀ c1 ∈ c2.val.coeffs, c1.val.toNat = 0) :
    T = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n.toNat :=
    ⟨by have := Fact.out (p := 1 < n.toNat); omega⟩
  have hc2 : ∀ c2 ∈ T.val.coeffs, c2 = 0 := by
    intro c2 hc2
    have hval : c2.val = 0 :=
      azPolynomial_eq_zero _ fun c1 hc1 =>
        azZMod_eq_zero c1 (h c2 hc2 c1 hc1)
    exact AzPolyMod.ext (by rw [hval]; rfl)
  have hval : T.val = 0 := azPolynomial_eq_zero _ hc2
  exact AzPolyMod.ext (by rw [hval]; rfl)

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.towerContentGcd_eq_one_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem towerContentGcd_eq_one_of_ne_zero (hprime : n.toNat.Prime)
    (T : GaussTowerPQ n p q) (hT : T ≠ 0) :
    (towerContentGcd n p q T).toNat = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hseed, hentries⟩ := towerContentGcd_dvd n p q T
  rcases hprime.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd _ hseed with h1 | hN
  · exact h1
  · exfalso
    refine hT (gaussTower_eq_zero_of_grid n p q T ?_)
    intro c2 hc2 c1 hc1
    have hd := hentries c2 hc2 c1 hc1
    rw [hN] at hd
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt hd c1.isLt

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.reduceT_sub_pow
statement:
theorem reduceT_sub_pow {n : AzNat} [Fact (1 < n.toNat)]
    {q p : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] [Fact p.Prime]
    (hp : p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors) {gu : (ZMod q)ˣ}
    (hgen : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers gu) {g : ℕ}
    (hg : ((g : ℕ) : ZMod q) = (gu : ZMod q)) (E L : ℕ) :
    reduceT n p q (gaussSum
        (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (CP.zetaPQUnit_mem hp) hgen)
        (AddChar.zmodChar q (CP.isPrimitiveRoot_zetaQPQ hp).pow_eq_one)
        ^ E
      - ((CP.zetaPQUnit p q : (CP.CycPQ p q)ˣ) : CP.CycPQ p q) ^ L)
      = (gaussSumT n p q g) ^ E - zetaPPowT n p q L
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sub, map_pow, map_pow, reduceT_gaussSum n hp hgen hg,
    CP.val_zetaPQUnit hp, reduceT_zetaP, constT_pow, zetaPPowT]

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.gaussSumsTest_complete
statement:
theorem gaussSumsTest_complete
    {n : AzNat} {c : GaussSumsCert} [Fact (1 < n.toNat)]
    (hprime : n.toNat.Prime)
    (hIndup : c.Ips.Nodup) (hIpr : ∀ p ∈ c.Ips, p.Prime)
    (hFndup : c.Fps.Nodup) (hFpr : ∀ q ∈ c.Fps, q.Prime)
    (hgcd : Nat.Coprime (c.Ips.prod * c.Fps.prod) n.toNat)
    (hnF : n.toNat < c.Fps.prod ^ 2)
    (hqI : ∀ q ∈ c.Fps, (q - 1) ∣ c.Ips.prod)
    (hw : ∀ p ∈ c.Ips, 0 < c.w p)
    (hu : ∀ p ∈ c.Ips, ¬p ∣ c.u p)
    (hq₀F : ∀ p ∈ c.Ips, c.q₀ p ∈ c.Fps)
    (hq₀d : ∀ p ∈ c.Ips, p ∣ c.q₀ p - 1)
    {gu : (q : ℕ) → (ZMod q)ˣ}
    (hgu : ∀ q ∈ c.Fps, ((c.g q : ℕ) : ZMod q) = (gu q : ZMod q))
    (hgen : ∀ q, q ∈ c.Fps → ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (gu q))
    (hpair : ∀ q (hq : q ∈ c.Fps) [Fact q.Prime],
      ∀ p (hp : p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors) [Fact p.Prime],
      ((n.toNat : ℕ) : CP.CycPQ p q) ∣
        gaussSum
            (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (CP.zetaPQUnit_mem hp) (hgen q hq))
            (AddChar.zmodChar q
              (CP.isPrimitiveRoot_zetaQPQ hp).pow_eq_one)
            ^ (p ^ c.w p * c.u p)
          - ((CP.zetaPQUnit p q : (CP.CycPQ p q)ˣ) : CP.CycPQ p q)
            ^ c.lTab p q)
    (hmin : ∀ p (hpI : p ∈ c.Ips) [Fact p.Prime]
      [Fact (c.q₀ p).Prime] (hp : p ∈ (c.q₀ p - 1).primeFactors),
      ∀ j < p,
      ¬((n.toNat : ℕ) : CP.CycPQ p (c.q₀ p)) ∣
        (gaussSum
            (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (CP.zetaPQUnit_mem hp)
              (hgen (c.q₀ p) (hq₀F p hpI)))
            (AddChar.zmodChar (c.q₀ p)
              (CP.isPrimitiveRoot_zetaQPQ hp).pow_eq_one)
            ^ (p ^ (c.w p - 1) * c.u p)
          - ((CP.zetaPQUnit p (c.q₀ p) : (CP.CycPQ p (c.q₀ p))ˣ)
              : CP.CycPQ p (c.q₀ p)) ^ j))
    (hlqh : ∀ q ∈ c.Fps, ∀ p ∈ c.Ips, p ∣ q - 1 →
      c.lq q ≡ c.lTab p q [MOD p])
    (hlh : ∀ q ∈ c.Fps,
      ((c.l : ℕ) : ZMod q) = ((c.g q : ℕ) : ZMod q) ^ c.lq q) :
    gaussSumsTest n c = true
proof:
:= by
  have hn1 : 1 < n.toNat := Fact.out
  have h1 : AzNat.ofNat 1 < n := by
    rw [AzNat.lt_iff_toNat_lt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
    exact hn1
  rw [gaussSumsTest, dite_eq_left h1]
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    beq_iff_eq]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hIndup, hIpr⟩, hFndup⟩, hFpr⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · 
    exact AzNat.toNat_injective (by
      rw [AzNat.toNat_gcd, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
      exact hgcd)
  · 
    rw [AzNat.lt_iff_toNat_lt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
    exact hnF
  · 
    intro p hp
    have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hIpr p hp⟩
    have : Fact (c.q₀ p).Prime := ⟨hFpr _ (hq₀F p hp)⟩
    rw [pCheck, dite_eq_left (hIpr p hp), dite_eq_left (hFpr _ (hq₀F p hp))]
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨hw p hp, hu p hp⟩, hq₀F p hp⟩, hq₀d p hp⟩, ?_⟩
    have hpmem : p ∈ (c.q₀ p - 1).primeFactors :=
      Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hIpr p hp, hq₀d p hp, by
        have := (hFpr _ (hq₀F p hp)).two_le
        omega⟩
    rw [step5Check, List.all_eq_true]
    intro j hj
    rw [List.mem_range] at hj
    rw [decide_eq_true_eq]
    refine AzNat.toNat_injective ?_
    rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
    refine towerContentGcd_eq_one_of_ne_zero n p (c.q₀ p) hprime _ ?_
    intro h0
    rw [powAzNat_eq_pow] at h0
    simp only [certE', AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at h0
    refine hmin p hp hpmem j hj
      ((natCast_dvd_iff_reduceT n p (c.q₀ p) _).mpr ?_)
    rw [reduceT_sub_pow hpmem (hgen _ (hq₀F p hp)) (hgu _ (hq₀F p hp))]
    exact h0
  · 
    intro q hq
    have : Fact q.Prime := ⟨hFpr q hq⟩
    have hq1 : q - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      have := (hFpr q hq).two_le
      omega
    rw [qCheck, dite_eq_left (hFpr q hq)]
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨hqI q hq, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, hlh q hq⟩
    · 
      have : NeZero q := ⟨(hFpr q hq).pos.ne'⟩
      rw [← ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime, hgu q hq]
      exact (gu q).isUnit
    · 
      intro r hr
      rw [List.mem_filter] at hr
      obtain ⟨hrI, hrdvd⟩ := hr
      rw [decide_eq_true_eq] at hrdvd
      have hrp : r.Prime := hIpr r hrI
      have : NeZero q := ⟨(hFpr q hq).pos.ne'⟩
      have hord : orderOf (gu q) = q - 1 := by
        rw [orderOf_eq_card_of_forall_mem_zpowers (hgen q hq),
          Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card_units_eq_totient,
          Nat.totient_prime (hFpr q hq)]
      rw [hgu q hq]
      intro heq
      rw [← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_eq_one] at heq
      have hdvd := orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one heq
      rw [hord] at hdvd
      have hq2 : 0 < q - 1 := by omega
      have hrle : r ≤ q - 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd hq2 hrdvd
      have hpos : 0 < (q - 1) / r := Nat.div_pos hrle hrp.pos
      have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd hpos hdvd
      have hlt : (q - 1) / r < q - 1 :=
        Nat.div_lt_self hq2 hrp.one_lt
      omega
    · 
      intro p hp
      rw [List.mem_filter] at hp
      obtain ⟨hpI, hpdvd⟩ := hp
      rw [decide_eq_true_eq] at hpdvd
      have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hIpr p hpI⟩
      have hpmem : p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors :=
        Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hIpr p hpI, hpdvd, hq1⟩
      refine ⟨?_, hlqh q hq p hpI hpdvd⟩
      rw [pairCheck, dite_eq_left (hIpr p hpI), decide_eq_true_eq]
      have hd := hpair q hq p hpmem
      rw [natCast_dvd_iff_reduceT,
        reduceT_sub_pow hpmem (hgen q hq) (hgu q hq)] at hd
      rw [powAzNat_eq_pow]
      simp only [certE, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hd
  · 
    rw [scanCheck, List.all_eq_true]
    intro j _
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · rw [Bool.or_eq_true]
      left
      rw [hj0]
      rfl
    · rw [Bool.or_eq_true]
      right
      show ((c.l ^ j % c.Fps.prod == 1)
        || !(n % AzNat.ofNat (c.l ^ j % c.Fps.prod) == AzNat.ofNat 0)
        || (AzNat.ofNat (c.l ^ j % c.Fps.prod) == n)) = true
      set d := c.l ^ j % c.Fps.prod with hd
      by_cases hdvd : d ∣ n.toNat
      · rcases hprime.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd d hdvd with hd1 | hdn
        · rw [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_true]
          left; left
          rw [beq_iff_eq]
          exact hd1
        · rw [Bool.or_eq_true]
          right
          rw [beq_iff_eq, hdn]
          exact AzNat.toNat_injective (by rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat])
      · rw [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_true]
        left; right
        rw [Bool.not_eq_eq_eq_not, Bool.not_true, beq_eq_false_iff_ne]
        intro heq
        refine hdvd (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero ?_)
        have h' := congrArg AzNat.toNat heq
        rwa [AzNat.toNat_mod, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at h'

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.not_prime_of_factor
statement:
private theorem not_prime_of_factor {N d : ℕ} (hd : d ∣ N) (h1 : 1 < d)
    (hN : d < N) : ¬N.Prime
proof:
:= by
  intro hp
  rcases hp.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd d hd with h | h <;> omega

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.gaussSumsTestO_eq_some_true
statement:
theorem gaussSumsTestO_eq_some_true
    (h : gaussSumsTestO n c = some true) : n.toNat.Prime
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussSumsTestO] at h
  by_cases h1 : AzNat.ofNat 1 < n
  case neg => rw [dite_eq_right h1] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  rw [dite_eq_left h1] at h
  have : Fact (1 < n.toNat) := ⟨by
    have h' := (AzNat.lt_iff_toNat_lt _ _).mp h1
    rwa [AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at h'⟩
  by_cases hlists : listChecks c = true
  case neg => rw [ite_eq_right hlists] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  rw [ite_eq_left hlists] at h
  rw [listChecks] at hlists
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    at hlists
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨-, hIpr⟩, -⟩, hFpr⟩ := hlists
  by_cases hmem : (memListAz n c.Ips || memListAz n c.Fps) = true
  · 
    simp only [memListAz, Bool.or_eq_true, List.any_eq_true,
      beq_iff_eq] at hmem
    rcases hmem with ⟨p, hp, hpn⟩ | ⟨p, hp, hpn⟩
    · have := congrArg AzNat.toNat hpn
      rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at this
      rw [← this]
      exact hIpr p hp
    · have := congrArg AzNat.toNat hpn
      rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at this
      rw [← this]
      exact hFpr p hp
  · rw [ite_eq_right hmem] at h
    by_cases hgcd : (!(AzNat.gcd
        (AzNat.ofNat (c.Ips.prod * c.Fps.prod)) n
        == AzNat.ofNat 1)) = true
    case pos => rw [ite_eq_left hgcd] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
    rw [ite_eq_right hgcd] at h
    by_cases hfac : (c.Ips.any (step5FactorFound n c)
        || scanFactorFound n c) = true
    case pos => rw [ite_eq_left hfac] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
    rw [ite_eq_right hfac] at h
    by_cases htest : gaussSumsTest n c = true
    case neg => rw [ite_eq_right htest] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
    exact gaussSumsTest_eq_true n c htest

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.not_prime_of_factor_found
statement:
private theorem not_prime_of_factor_found [Fact (1 < n.toNat)]
    (hIpr : ∀ p ∈ c.Ips, p.Prime)
    (hfac : (c.Ips.any (step5FactorFound n c)
      || scanFactorFound n c) = true) : ¬n.toNat.Prime
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bool.or_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at hfac
  rcases hfac with ⟨p, hp, hfound⟩ | hfound
  · 
    rw [step5FactorFound, dite_eq_left (hIpr p hp)] at hfound
    by_cases hq : (c.q₀ p).Prime
    case neg => rw [dite_eq_right hq] at hfound; exact absurd hfound (by simp)
    rw [dite_eq_left hq] at hfound
    rw [List.any_eq_true] at hfound
    obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := hfound
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hj
    obtain ⟨hj1, hjn⟩ := hj
    have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hIpr p hp⟩
    have : Fact (c.q₀ p).Prime := ⟨hq⟩
    set T := (gaussSumT n p (c.q₀ p) (c.g (c.q₀ p))).powAzNat (certE' c p)
      - zetaPPowT n p (c.q₀ p) j with hT
    have hdvd := (towerContentGcd_dvd n p (c.q₀ p) T).1
    refine not_prime_of_factor hdvd ?_ ?_
    · have h' := (AzNat.lt_iff_toNat_lt _ _).mp hj1
      rwa [AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at h'
    · exact (AzNat.lt_iff_toNat_lt _ _).mp hjn
  · 
    rw [scanFactorFound, List.any_eq_true] at hfound
    obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := hfound
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_eq_eq_not, Bool.not_true,
      beq_iff_eq, decide_eq_true_eq] at hj
    obtain ⟨-, hj2⟩ := hj
    obtain ⟨⟨hmod, hd1⟩, hdn⟩ := hj2
    set d := c.l ^ j % c.Fps.prod with hd
    have hdvd : d ∣ n.toNat := by
      refine Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero ?_
      have h' := congrArg AzNat.toNat hmod
      rwa [AzNat.toNat_mod, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at h'
    have hlt : d < n.toNat := by
      have h' := (AzNat.lt_iff_toNat_lt _ _).mp hdn
      rwa [AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at h'
    exact not_prime_of_factor hdvd hd1 hlt

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.gaussSumsTestO_eq_some_false
statement:
theorem gaussSumsTestO_eq_some_false
    (h : gaussSumsTestO n c = some false) : ¬n.toNat.Prime
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussSumsTestO] at h
  by_cases h1 : AzNat.ofNat 1 < n
  case neg => rw [dite_eq_right h1] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  rw [dite_eq_left h1] at h
  have hfact : Fact (1 < n.toNat) := ⟨by
    have h' := (AzNat.lt_iff_toNat_lt _ _).mp h1
    rwa [AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at h'⟩
  by_cases hlists : listChecks c = true
  case neg => rw [ite_eq_right hlists] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  rw [ite_eq_left hlists] at h
  rw [listChecks] at hlists
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    at hlists
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨hIndup, hIpr⟩, hFndup⟩, hFpr⟩ := hlists
  have hIpos : 0 < c.Ips.prod :=
    List.prod_pos fun p hp => (hIpr p hp).pos
  have hFpos : 0 < c.Fps.prod :=
    List.prod_pos fun q hq => (hFpr q hq).pos
  by_cases hmem : (memListAz n c.Ips || memListAz n c.Fps) = true
  case pos => rw [ite_eq_left hmem] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  rw [ite_eq_right hmem] at h
  by_cases hgcd : (!(AzNat.gcd
      (AzNat.ofNat (c.Ips.prod * c.Fps.prod)) n
      == AzNat.ofNat 1)) = true
  · 
    rw [Bool.not_eq_eq_eq_not, Bool.not_true, beq_eq_false_iff_ne]
      at hgcd
    have hne : Nat.gcd (c.Ips.prod * c.Fps.prod) n.toNat ≠ 1 := by
      intro heq
      refine hgcd (AzNat.toNat_injective ?_)
      rw [AzNat.toNat_gcd, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, heq]
    have hg1 : 1 < Nat.gcd n.toNat (c.Ips.prod * c.Fps.prod) := by
      rw [Nat.gcd_comm]
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos
        (Nat.gcd (c.Ips.prod * c.Fps.prod) n.toNat) with h0 | hpos
      · have := (Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff.mp h0).2
        have := hfact.out
        omega
      · omega
    refine CP.step2_composite_of_gcd (by positivity) hg1 ?_
    intro hmem'
    have hIF : c.Ips.prod ≠ 0 := hIpos.ne'
    have hFF : c.Fps.prod ≠ 0 := hFpos.ne'
    rw [Nat.primeFactors_mul hIF hFF, Finset.mem_union] at hmem'
    have hself : AzNat.ofNat n.toNat = n :=
      AzNat.toNat_injective (by rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat])
    rcases hmem' with hmem' | hmem'
    · refine absurd ?_ hmem
      have hm : memListAz n c.Ips = true := by
        rw [memListAz, List.any_eq_true]
        exact ⟨n.toNat,
          (mem_primeFactors_prod_iff hIndup hIpr).mp hmem',
          by rw [beq_iff_eq]; exact hself⟩
      simp [hm]
    · refine absurd ?_ hmem
      have hm : memListAz n c.Fps = true := by
        rw [memListAz, List.any_eq_true]
        exact ⟨n.toNat,
          (mem_primeFactors_prod_iff hFndup hFpr).mp hmem',
          by rw [beq_iff_eq]; exact hself⟩
      simp [hm]
  rw [ite_eq_right hgcd] at h
  by_cases hfac : (c.Ips.any (step5FactorFound n c)
      || scanFactorFound n c) = true
  case neg =>
    rw [ite_eq_right hfac] at h
    by_cases htest : gaussSumsTest n c = true
    · rw [ite_eq_left htest] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
    · rw [ite_eq_right htest] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  rw [ite_eq_left hfac] at h
  exact not_prime_of_factor_found n c hIpr hfac

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.gaussSumsTestO_complete
statement:
theorem gaussSumsTestO_complete [Fact (1 < n.toNat)]
    (hprime : n.toNat.Prime)
    (hIndup : c.Ips.Nodup) (hIpr : ∀ p ∈ c.Ips, p.Prime)
    (hFndup : c.Fps.Nodup) (hFpr : ∀ q ∈ c.Fps, q.Prime)
    (hgcd : Nat.Coprime (c.Ips.prod * c.Fps.prod) n.toNat)
    (hnF : n.toNat < c.Fps.prod ^ 2)
    (hqI : ∀ q ∈ c.Fps, (q - 1) ∣ c.Ips.prod)
    (hw : ∀ p ∈ c.Ips, 0 < c.w p)
    (hu : ∀ p ∈ c.Ips, ¬p ∣ c.u p)
    (hq₀F : ∀ p ∈ c.Ips, c.q₀ p ∈ c.Fps)
    (hq₀d : ∀ p ∈ c.Ips, p ∣ c.q₀ p - 1)
    {gu : (q : ℕ) → (ZMod q)ˣ}
    (hgu : ∀ q ∈ c.Fps, ((c.g q : ℕ) : ZMod q) = (gu q : ZMod q))
    (hgen : ∀ q, q ∈ c.Fps → ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (gu q))
    (hpair : ∀ q (hq : q ∈ c.Fps) [Fact q.Prime],
      ∀ p (hp : p ∈ (q - 1).primeFactors) [Fact p.Prime],
      ((n.toNat : ℕ) : CP.CycPQ p q) ∣
        gaussSum
            (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (CP.zetaPQUnit_mem hp) (hgen q hq))
            (AddChar.zmodChar q
              (CP.isPrimitiveRoot_zetaQPQ hp).pow_eq_one)
            ^ (p ^ c.w p * c.u p)
          - ((CP.zetaPQUnit p q : (CP.CycPQ p q)ˣ) : CP.CycPQ p q)
            ^ c.lTab p q)
    (hmin : ∀ p (hpI : p ∈ c.Ips) [Fact p.Prime]
      [Fact (c.q₀ p).Prime] (hp : p ∈ (c.q₀ p - 1).primeFactors),
      ∀ j < p,
      ¬((n.toNat : ℕ) : CP.CycPQ p (c.q₀ p)) ∣
        (gaussSum
            (MulChar.ofRootOfUnity (CP.zetaPQUnit_mem hp)
              (hgen (c.q₀ p) (hq₀F p hpI)))
            (AddChar.zmodChar (c.q₀ p)
              (CP.isPrimitiveRoot_zetaQPQ hp).pow_eq_one)
            ^ (p ^ (c.w p - 1) * c.u p)
          - ((CP.zetaPQUnit p (c.q₀ p) : (CP.CycPQ p (c.q₀ p))ˣ)
              : CP.CycPQ p (c.q₀ p)) ^ j))
    (hlqh : ∀ q ∈ c.Fps, ∀ p ∈ c.Ips, p ∣ q - 1 →
      c.lq q ≡ c.lTab p q [MOD p])
    (hlh : ∀ q ∈ c.Fps,
      ((c.l : ℕ) : ZMod q) = ((c.g q : ℕ) : ZMod q) ^ c.lq q) :
    gaussSumsTestO n c = some true
proof:
:= by
  have htest : gaussSumsTest n c = true :=
    gaussSumsTest_complete hprime hIndup hIpr hFndup hFpr hgcd hnF
      hqI hw hu hq₀F hq₀d hgu hgen hpair hmin hlqh hlh
  have hn1 : 1 < n.toNat := Fact.out
  have h1 : AzNat.ofNat 1 < n := by
    rw [AzNat.lt_iff_toNat_lt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
    exact hn1
  rw [gaussSumsTestO, dite_eq_left h1]
  have hlc : listChecks c = true := by
    rw [listChecks]
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact ⟨⟨⟨hIndup, hIpr⟩, hFndup⟩, hFpr⟩
  rw [ite_eq_left hlc]
  by_cases hmem : (memListAz n c.Ips || memListAz n c.Fps) = true
  · rw [ite_eq_left hmem]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hmem]
    have hbeq : (AzNat.gcd (AzNat.ofNat (c.Ips.prod * c.Fps.prod)) n
        == AzNat.ofNat 1) = true := by
      rw [beq_iff_eq]
      exact AzNat.toNat_injective (by
        rw [AzNat.toNat_gcd, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
        exact hgcd)
    rw [ite_eq_right (by rw [hbeq]; simp)]
    rw [ite_eq_right fun hfac =>
      not_prime_of_factor_found n c hIpr hfac hprime]
    rw [ite_eq_left htest]

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.sum_antidiagonal_symm
statement:
theorem sum_antidiagonal_symm {M : Type _} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M)
    (hf : ∀ i j, f i j = f j i) (d : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ antidiagonal d, f x.1 x.2
      = (∑ x ∈ (antidiagonal d).filter (fun x => x.1 < x.2), f x.1 x.2)
        + (∑ x ∈ (antidiagonal d).filter (fun x => x.1 < x.2), f x.1 x.2)
        + (if d % 2 = 0 then f (d / 2) (d / 2) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hB : ∑ x ∈ (antidiagonal d).filter (fun x => ¬ x.1 < x.2), f x.1 x.2
      = (∑ x ∈ (antidiagonal d).filter (fun x => x.1 < x.2), f x.1 x.2)
        + (if d % 2 = 0 then f (d / 2) (d / 2) else 0) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not ((antidiagonal d).filter (fun x => ¬ x.1 < x.2))
      (fun x => x.2 < x.1), Finset.filter_filter, Finset.filter_filter]
    congr 1
    · 
      refine Finset.sum_nbij' Prod.swap Prod.swap ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro x hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_antidiagonal, Prod.fst_swap, Prod.snd_swap] at hx ⊢
        omega
      · intro x hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_antidiagonal, Prod.fst_swap, Prod.snd_swap] at hx ⊢
        omega
      · intro x _; rfl
      · intro x _; rfl
      · intro x _
        exact hf _ _
    · 
      by_cases hd : d % 2 = 0
      · rw [ite_eq_left hd]
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (d / 2, d / 2)]
        · intro x hx hne
          exfalso
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hx
          apply hne
          ext <;> simp only <;> omega
        · intro h
          exfalso
          apply h
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_antidiagonal]
          omega
      · rw [ite_eq_right hd]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro x hx
        exfalso
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hx
        omega
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (antidiagonal d) (fun x => x.1 < x.2), hB, add_assoc]

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.squareNat_eq_mul
statement: theorem squareNat_eq_mul (P : AzPolynomial AzNat) : squareNat P = P * P
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toPoly_inj, toPoly_mul, squareNat, toPoly_normalize_ofFn _ (coeffSq P.coeff)]
  apply Polynomial.ext
  intro d
  rw [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_mul]
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_toPoly_eq]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  have hvan : ∀ x ∈ Finset.antidiagonal d, 2 * P.coeffs.size - 1 ≤ d → P.coeff x.1 * P.coeff x.2 = 0 := by
    intro x hx hd
    rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hx
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge x.1 P.coeffs.size with h1 | h1
    · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_size_le P (by omega : P.coeffs.size ≤ x.2), mul_zero]
    · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_size_le P h1, zero_mul]
  split_ifs with hd
  · rw [coeffSq, sum_antidiagonal_symm (fun i j => P.coeff i * P.coeff j) (fun i j => mul_comm _ _)]
    simp only [Azurite.Square.square_eq]
  · rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hd
    exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => hvan x hx hd).symm

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {a b : AzPolyMod f} (h : a.val = b.val) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  cases a; cases b; cases h; rfl

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.modByMonic_isReduced
statement:
theorem modByMonic_isReduced (p : AzPolynomial R) :
    (AzPolynomial.modByMonic p f).coeffs.size < f.coeffs.size ∨ f.coeffs.size = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f.coeffs.size = 0
  · exact Or.inr hf
  · exact Or.inl (AzPolynomial.modByMonic_coeffs_size_lt p f (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hf))

name: Azurite.AzPolyMod.zero_isReduced
statement:
theorem zero_isReduced :
    (0 : AzPolynomial R).coeffs.size < f.coeffs.size ∨ f.coeffs.size = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f.coeffs.size = 0
  · exact Or.inr hf
  · exact Or.inl (by rw [AzPolynomial.coeffs_zero, Array.size_empty]; exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hf)

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.cyclotomicPrimePow_coeffs_size
statement:
@[simp] theorem cyclotomicPrimePow_coeffs_size (p k : ℕ) :
    (cyclotomicPrimePow R p k).coeffs.size = (p - 1) * p ^ (k - 1) + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [cyclotomicPrimePow]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.coeff_cyclotomicPrimePow
statement:
theorem coeff_cyclotomicPrimePow (p k i : ℕ) :
    (cyclotomicPrimePow R p k).coeff i
      = if i ≤ (p - 1) * p ^ (k - 1) ∧ i % p ^ (k - 1) = 0 then (1 : R) else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold coeff cyclotomicPrimePow
  simp only [Array.getElem?_ofFn]
  by_cases hi : i < (p - 1) * p ^ (k - 1) + 1
  · rw [dite_eq_left hi]
    simp only [Option.getD_some]
    by_cases hm : i % p ^ (k - 1) = 0
    · rw [ite_eq_left hm, ite_eq_left ⟨by omega, hm⟩]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hm, ite_eq_right (fun h => hm h.2)]
  · rw [dite_eq_right hi]
    simp only [Option.getD_none]
    rw [ite_eq_right (fun h => hi (by omega))]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.leadingCoeff_cyclotomicPrimePow
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_cyclotomicPrimePow (p k : ℕ) :
    (cyclotomicPrimePow R p k).leadingCoeff = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [leadingCoeff, natDegree, cyclotomicPrimePow_coeffs_size, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
    coeff_cyclotomicPrimePow]
  rw [ite_eq_left ⟨le_refl _, Nat.mul_mod_left _ _⟩]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.monic_toPoly_cyclotomicPrimePow
statement:
theorem monic_toPoly_cyclotomicPrimePow (p k : ℕ) :
    (AzPolynomial.toPoly (cyclotomicPrimePow R p k)).Monic
proof:
:= by
  have h := leadingCoeff_toPoly (cyclotomicPrimePow R p k)
  rw [Polynomial.Monic, h]
  exact leadingCoeff_cyclotomicPrimePow R p k

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.cyclotomicPrime_coeffs_size
statement:
@[simp] theorem cyclotomicPrime_coeffs_size (p : ℕ) :
    (cyclotomicPrime R p).coeffs.size = p
proof:
:= by
  simp [cyclotomicPrime]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.leadingCoeff_cyclotomicPrime
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_cyclotomicPrime {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    (cyclotomicPrime R p).leadingCoeff = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k =>
    rw [AzPolynomial.leadingCoeff, AzPolynomial.coeff,
      AzPolynomial.natDegree]
    simp [cyclotomicPrime]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.monic_toPoly_cyclotomicPrime
statement:
theorem monic_toPoly_cyclotomicPrime {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    (AzPolynomial.toPoly (cyclotomicPrime R p)).Monic
proof:
:= by
  have h := leadingCoeff_toPoly (cyclotomicPrime R p)
  rw [Polynomial.Monic, h]
  exact leadingCoeff_cyclotomicPrime R hp

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toInt_spec
statement: lemma toInt_spec (a : ↥intSet) : ((toInt a : ℝ) : EReal) = a.val
proof:
:= by
  unfold toInt
  exact Classical.choose_spec a.property

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toInt_eq_of_val
statement:
lemma toInt_eq_of_val {a : ↥intSet} {z : ℤ} (h : ((z : ℝ) : EReal) = a.val) :
    toInt a = z
proof:
:= by
  have hsp := toInt_spec a
  have heq : ((toInt a : ℝ) : EReal) = ((z : ℝ) : EReal) := hsp.trans h.symm
  exact_mod_cast heq

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundFloor_intSet
statement:
lemma val_roundFloor_intSet (x : ℝ) :
    (roundFloor intSet x).val = ((⌊x⌋ : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isGreatest_roundFloor intSet x).unique
  refine ⟨⟨⟨⌊x⌋, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact_mod_cast Int.floor_le x
  · rintro s ⟨⟨z, rfl⟩, hz⟩
    have : (z : ℝ) ≤ x := by exact_mod_cast hz
    exact_mod_cast Int.le_floor.mpr this

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundCeiling_intSet
statement:
lemma val_roundCeiling_intSet (x : ℝ) :
    (roundCeiling intSet x).val = ((⌈x⌉ : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isLeast_roundCeiling intSet x).unique
  refine ⟨⟨⟨⌈x⌉, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact_mod_cast Int.le_ceil x
  · rintro s ⟨⟨z, rfl⟩, hz⟩
    have : x ≤ (z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hz
    exact_mod_cast Int.ceil_le.mpr this

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toInt_roundFloor
statement: private lemma toInt_roundFloor (x : ℝ) : toInt (roundFloor intSet x) = ⌊x⌋
proof:
:=
  toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundFloor_intSet x).symm

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toInt_roundCeiling
statement: private lemma toInt_roundCeiling (x : ℝ) : toInt (roundCeiling intSet x) = ⌈x⌉
proof:
:=
  toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundCeiling_intSet x).symm

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.intSet_neg_mem
statement: private lemma intSet_neg_mem {s : EReal} (h : s ∈ intSet) : -s ∈ intSet
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h
  exact ⟨-z, by rw [Int.cast_neg, EReal.coe_neg, hz]⟩

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toInt_neg
statement:
private lemma toInt_neg (a : ↥intSet) :
    toInt ⟨-a.val, intSet_neg_mem a.property⟩ = -toInt a
proof:
:= by
  apply toInt_eq_of_val
  rw [Int.cast_neg, EReal.coe_neg, toInt_spec a]

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_eq_coe_toInt
statement: private lemma val_eq_coe_toInt (a : ↥intSet) : a.val = ((toInt a : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:=
  (toInt_spec a).symm

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.compare_coe_coe
statement: theorem compare_coe_coe (a b : ℝ) : compare (a : EReal) (b : EReal) = compare a b
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a b with h | h | h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr h)]
  · rw [h, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl]
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr h)]

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.coe_sub_coe
statement:
private theorem coe_sub_coe (a b : ℝ) :
    ((a : ℝ) : EReal) - (b : EReal) = ((a - b : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:=
  (EReal.coe_sub a b).symm

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toInt_round_nearest_eq_of_abs_lt
statement:
theorem toInt_round_nearest_eq_of_abs_lt {x : ℝ} {n : ℤ} (h : |x - n| < 1 / 2) :
    toInt (round intSet .Nearest x) = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp h
  have hF := val_roundFloor_intSet x
  have hC := val_roundCeiling_intSet x
  rcases lt_trichotomy (n : ℝ) x with hlt | heq | hgt
  · have hfl : ⌊x⌋ = n := by rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]; constructor <;> linarith
    have hceil : ⌈x⌉ = n + 1 := by rw [Int.ceil_eq_iff]; push_cast; constructor <;> linarith
    have hcmp : (x : EReal) - (roundFloor intSet x).val
        < (roundCeiling intSet x).val - (x : EReal) := by
      rw [hF, hC, hfl, hceil, coe_sub_coe, coe_sub_coe, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]
      push_cast; linarith
    unfold round
    simp only []
    rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr hcmp]
    exact toInt_eq_of_val (by rw [hF, hfl])
  · have hmem : ((x : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ intSet := ⟨n, by rw [heq]⟩
    exact toInt_eq_of_val (by rw [val_round_of_mem _ _ hmem, heq])
  · have hceil : ⌈x⌉ = n := by rw [Int.ceil_eq_iff]; constructor <;> linarith
    have hfl : ⌊x⌋ = n - 1 := by rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]; push_cast; constructor <;> linarith
    have hcmp : (roundCeiling intSet x).val - (x : EReal)
        < (x : EReal) - (roundFloor intSet x).val := by
      rw [hF, hC, hfl, hceil, coe_sub_coe, coe_sub_coe, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]
      push_cast; linarith
    unfold round
    simp only []
    rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr hcmp]
    exact toInt_eq_of_val (by rw [hC, hceil])

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toInt_round_nearest_half
statement:
theorem toInt_round_nearest_half (n : ℤ) :
    toInt (round intSet .Nearest ((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) = if Even n then n else n + 1
proof:
:= by
  set x : ℝ := (n : ℝ) + 1 / 2 with hx
  have hF := val_roundFloor_intSet x
  have hC := val_roundCeiling_intSet x
  have hfl : ⌊x⌋ = n := by rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hceil : ⌈x⌉ = n + 1 := by rw [Int.ceil_eq_iff]; push_cast; constructor <;> linarith
  have hcmp : (x : EReal) - (roundFloor intSet x).val
      = (roundCeiling intSet x).val - (x : EReal) := by
    rw [hF, hC, hfl, hceil, coe_sub_coe, coe_sub_coe, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff]
    push_cast; linarith
  have hFn : toInt (roundFloor intSet x) = n := toInt_eq_of_val (by rw [hF, hfl])
  have hCn : toInt (roundCeiling intSet x) = n + 1 := toInt_eq_of_val (by rw [hC, hceil])
  unfold round
  simp only []
  rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr hcmp]
  show toInt (intTiebreak (roundFloor intSet x) (roundCeiling intSet x)) = _
  unfold intTiebreak
  rw [hFn, hCn]
  by_cases he : Even n
  · have hno : ¬ Even (n + 1) := fun h => (Int.even_add_one.mp h) he
    split_ifs with h1 h2 <;>
      first | exact hFn | exact absurd h2.2 he | exact absurd ⟨he, hno⟩ h1
  · have hyes : Even (n + 1) := Int.even_add_one.mpr he
    split_ifs with h1 h2 <;>
      first | exact absurd h1.1 he | exact hCn | exact absurd ⟨hyes, he⟩ h2

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.abs_sub_toInt_round_nearest_le
statement:
theorem abs_sub_toInt_round_nearest_le (x : ℝ) :
    |x - toInt (round intSet .Nearest x)| ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  set n := ⌊x + 1 / 2⌋ with hn
  have h1 : (n : ℝ) ≤ x + 1 / 2 := Int.floor_le _
  have h2 : x + 1 / 2 < n + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with heq | hlt
  · 
    have hx : x = ((n - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2 := by push_cast; linarith
    rw [hx, toInt_round_nearest_half]
    split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> rw [abs_le] <;> constructor <;> linarith
  · rw [toInt_round_nearest_eq_of_abs_lt (n := n) (by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith)]
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.abs_toInt_round_nearest_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_toInt_round_nearest_sub_le (x : ℝ) (m : ℤ) :
    |x - toInt (round intSet .Nearest x)| ≤ |x - m|
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_ge |x - m| (1 / 2) with hlt | hge
  · rw [toInt_round_nearest_eq_of_abs_lt hlt]
  · exact (abs_sub_toInt_round_nearest_le x).trans hge

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.nearestTernary_neg
statement:
theorem nearestTernary_neg {y : ℝ} {R : ℤ} {o : Ordering} (h : NearestTernary y R o.swap) :
    NearestTernary (-y) (-R) o
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
  have e : |-y - ((-R : ℤ) : ℝ)| = |y - R| := by
    push_cast; rw [show -y - -(R : ℝ) = -(y - R) by ring, abs_neg]
  refine ⟨by rw [e]; exact h1, fun hh => ?_⟩
  rw [e] at hh
  obtain ⟨hlt, hgt, heq⟩ := h2 hh
  refine ⟨fun ho => ?_, fun ho => ?_, fun ho => ?_⟩
  · have := hgt (by rw [ho]; rfl)
    push_cast; linarith
  · have := hlt (by rw [ho]; rfl)
    push_cast; linarith
  · have := heq (by rw [ho]; rfl)
    exact even_neg.mpr this

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toInt_round_nearest_of_ternary
statement:
theorem toInt_round_nearest_of_ternary {w X : ℝ} {R : ℤ} {B : ℤ} (hB : |w| < B)
    (hclose : ∀ m : ℤ, |m| ≤ B → |X - w| ≤ |(m : ℝ) - w|)
    (hclose' : ∀ m : ℤ, -B ≤ m → m ≤ B - 1 → |X - w| ≤ |(m : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - w|)
    (hR : NearestTernary X R (compare X w)) :
    toInt (round intSet .Nearest w) = R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hR1, hR2⟩ := hR
  set n := ⌊w⌋ with hn
  have hn1 : (n : ℝ) ≤ w := Int.floor_le w
  have hn2 : w < n + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one w
  obtain ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hB
  have hnB : -B ≤ n := Int.le_floor.mpr (by rw [Int.cast_neg]; linarith)
  have hnB' : n ≤ B - 1 := by
    have : (n : ℝ) < B := by linarith
    have : n < B := by exact_mod_cast this
    omega
  have hc1 := hclose n (by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> omega)
  have hc3 := hclose (n + 1) (by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> omega)
  have hc2 := hclose' n hnB hnB'
  have hRa := abs_le.mp hR1
  rcases lt_trichotomy w ((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) with hw | hw | hw
  · 
    rw [toInt_round_nearest_eq_of_abs_lt (n := n) (by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith)]
    have hXlo : (n : ℝ) ≤ X := by
      rw [abs_of_nonpos (a := (n : ℝ) - w) (by linarith)] at hc1
      have := abs_le.mp hc1; linarith
    have hXhi : X ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 / 2 := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (a := (n : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - w) (by linarith)] at hc2
      have := abs_le.mp hc2; linarith
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hXhi with hXlt | hXeq
    · have h1 : (R : ℝ) < n + 1 := by linarith
      have h2 : (n : ℝ) - 1 < R := by linarith
      have h1' : R < n + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
      have h2' : n - 1 < R := by exact_mod_cast h2
      omega
    · have hcmp : compare X w = .gt := compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (by linarith)
      have hhalf : |X - R| = 1 / 2 := by
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hR1 with h | h
        · exact h
        · exfalso
          obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp h
          have h1' : n < R := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (n : ℝ) < R)
          have h2' : R < n + 1 := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (R : ℝ) < n + 1)
          omega
      have hlt := (hR2 hhalf).2.1 hcmp
      have h1' : n ≤ R := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (n : ℝ) ≤ R)
      have h2' : R < n + 1 := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (R : ℝ) < n + 1)
      omega
  · 
    have hX : X = w := by
      have h0 : |(n : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - w| = 0 := by rw [hw]; simp
      rw [h0] at hc2
      have := abs_nonneg (X - w)
      have : |X - w| = 0 := le_antisymm hc2 this
      linarith [abs_eq_zero.mp this]
    have hcmp : compare X w = .eq := compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr hX
    rw [hw, toInt_round_nearest_half]
    have hhalf : |X - R| = 1 / 2 := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hR1 with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp h
        rw [hX, hw] at h1 h2
        have h1' : n < R := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (n : ℝ) < R)
        have h2' : R < n + 1 := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (R : ℝ) < n + 1)
        omega
    have hev := (hR2 hhalf).2.2 hcmp
    rw [hX, hw] at hRa
    have h1' : n ≤ R := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (n : ℝ) ≤ R)
    have h2' : R ≤ n + 1 := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (R : ℝ) ≤ n + 1)
    rcases (by omega : R = n ∨ R = n + 1) with hRn | hRn
    · subst hRn
      simp only [hev, ↓reduceIte]
    · subst hRn
      have : ¬ Even n := Int.even_add_one.mp hev
      simp only [this, ↓reduceIte]
  · 
    rw [toInt_round_nearest_eq_of_abs_lt (n := n + 1)
      (by rw [abs_lt]; push_cast; constructor <;> linarith)]
    have hXhi : X ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (a := ((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) - w) (by push_cast; linarith)] at hc3
      have := abs_le.mp hc3; push_cast at this
      linarith
    have hXlo : (n : ℝ) + 1 / 2 ≤ X := by
      rw [abs_of_nonpos (a := (n : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - w) (by linarith)] at hc2
      have := abs_le.mp hc2; linarith
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hXlo with hXlt | hXeq
    · have h1 : (R : ℝ) < n + 2 := by linarith
      have h2 : (n : ℝ) < R := by linarith
      have h1' : R < n + 2 := by exact_mod_cast h1
      have h2' : n < R := by exact_mod_cast h2
      omega
    · have hcmp : compare X w = .lt := compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (by linarith)
      have hhalf : |X - R| = 1 / 2 := by
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hR1 with h | h
        · exact h
        · exfalso
          obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp h
          have h1' : n < R := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (n : ℝ) < R)
          have h2' : R < n + 1 := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (R : ℝ) < n + 1)
          omega
      have hlt := (hR2 hhalf).1 hcmp
      have h1' : n < R := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (n : ℝ) < R)
      have h2' : R ≤ n + 1 := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (R : ℝ) ≤ n + 1)
      omega

name: Azurite.roundFloor_val_of_isGreatest
statement:
lemma roundFloor_val_of_isGreatest {S : Set EReal} [RoundingTarget S]
    {x : ℝ} {e : EReal} (h : IsGreatest {s | s ∈ S ∧ s ≤ (x : EReal)} e) :
    (roundFloor S x).val = e
proof:
:= by
  unfold roundFloor
  exact (existsGreatestLE (S := S) x).choose_spec.unique h

name: Azurite.roundCeiling_val_of_isLeast
statement:
lemma roundCeiling_val_of_isLeast {S : Set EReal} [RoundingTarget S]
    {x : ℝ} {e : EReal} (h : IsLeast {s | s ∈ S ∧ (x : EReal) ≤ s} e) :
    (roundCeiling S x).val = e
proof:
:= by
  unfold roundCeiling
  exact (existsLeastGE (S := S) x).choose_spec.unique h

name: Azurite.roundCeiling_natBotSet
statement:
lemma roundCeiling_natBotSet (x : ℝ) :
    (roundCeiling natBotSet x).val = ((⌈x⌉₊ : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  apply roundCeiling_val_of_isLeast
  refine ⟨⟨Or.inr ⟨⌈x⌉₊, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact_mod_cast Nat.le_ceil x
  · rintro s ⟨hmem, hge⟩
    rcases hmem with rfl | ⟨n, rfl⟩
    · exact absurd hge (not_le_of_gt (EReal.bot_lt_coe x))
    · have : x ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hge
      exact_mod_cast Nat.ceil_le.mpr this

name: Azurite.roundFloor_natBotSet_nonneg
statement:
lemma roundFloor_natBotSet_nonneg (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (roundFloor natBotSet x).val = ((⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  apply roundFloor_val_of_isGreatest
  refine ⟨⟨Or.inr ⟨⌊x⌋₊, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact_mod_cast Nat.floor_le hx
  · rintro s ⟨hmem, hle⟩
    rcases hmem with rfl | ⟨n, rfl⟩
    · exact bot_le
    · have : (n : ℝ) ≤ x := by exact_mod_cast hle
      exact_mod_cast Nat.le_floor this

name: Azurite.natBotToNat_eq_of_nat_val
statement:
lemma natBotToNat_eq_of_nat_val (q : ℕ) (s : ↥natBotSet)
    (hs : s.val = ((q : ℝ) : EReal)) : natBotToNat s = q
proof:
:= by
  unfold natBotToNat
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, ((n : ℝ) : EReal) = s.val := ⟨q, hs.symm⟩
  rw [dite_eq_left hex]
  have h1 := hex.choose_spec
  have h2 : ((hex.choose : ℝ) : EReal) = ((q : ℝ) : EReal) := h1.trans hs
  exact_mod_cast h2

name: Azurite.nat_div_pow_nonneg
statement:
lemma nat_div_pow_nonneg (v : ℕ) (sh : Nat) :
    0 ≤ (v : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ sh)
proof:
:= by
  apply div_nonneg
  · exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le _
  · exact pow_nonneg (by norm_num) _

name: Azurite.floor_nat_div_pow
statement:
lemma floor_nat_div_pow (v : ℕ) (sh : Nat) :
    ⌊(v : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ sh)⌋₊ = v / 2 ^ sh
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ sh) = (((2 ^ sh : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by push_cast; rfl
  rw [h1, Nat.floor_div_natCast, Nat.floor_natCast]

name: Azurite.ceil_nat_div_pow_of_dvd
statement:
lemma ceil_nat_div_pow_of_dvd (v : ℕ) (sh : Nat) (h : 2 ^ sh ∣ v) :
    ⌈(v : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ sh)⌉₊ = v / 2 ^ sh
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  have heq : (v : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ sh) = (q : ℝ) := by
    rw [hq]; push_cast; field_simp
  rw [heq, Nat.ceil_natCast, hq, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (Nat.two_pow_pos sh)]

name: Azurite.ceil_nat_div_pow_of_not_dvd
statement:
lemma ceil_nat_div_pow_of_not_dvd (v : ℕ) (sh : Nat) (h : ¬ 2 ^ sh ∣ v) :
    ⌈(v : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ sh)⌉₊ = v / 2 ^ sh + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h2pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ sh := pow_pos (by norm_num) _
  set q := v / 2 ^ sh with hq_def
  set r := v % 2 ^ sh with hr_def
  have hr_pos : 0 < r := by
    rw [hr_def, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    intro heq
    exact h (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero heq)
  have hr_lt : r < 2 ^ sh := Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
  have hn : v = q * 2 ^ sh + r := by
    rw [hq_def, hr_def, Nat.mul_comm]
    exact (Nat.div_add_mod v (2 ^ sh)).symm
  have hfloor_lt : ((q : ℝ)) < (v : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ sh) := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ h2pos, hn]
    push_cast
    have : (0 : ℝ) < (r : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hr_pos
    linarith
  have hlt_ceil : (v : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ sh) < (q + 1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ h2pos, hn]
    push_cast
    have : ((r : ℝ)) < ((2 : ℝ) ^ sh) := by
      have := hr_lt
      have h2 : ((2 ^ sh : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((2 : ℝ) ^ sh) := by push_cast; rfl
      rw [← h2]; exact_mod_cast this
    linarith
  have h2 : (v : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ sh) ≤ ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    push_cast; linarith
  have h3 : ((q : ℕ) : ℝ) < (v : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ sh) := hfloor_lt
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact Nat.ceil_le.mpr h2
  · have := Nat.add_one_le_ceil_iff (n := q)
      (a := (v : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ sh))
    exact this.mpr h3

name: Azurite.nat_eq_mul_pow_add_mod
statement:
lemma nat_eq_mul_pow_add_mod (v : ℕ) (sh : Nat) :
    v = (v / 2 ^ sh) * 2 ^ sh + v % 2 ^ sh
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.div_add_mod v (2 ^ sh)]
  ring

name: Azurite.testBit_top_false_iff_lt_half
statement:
lemma testBit_top_false_iff_lt_half (v sh : ℕ) (hsh : 0 < sh) (hv : v < 2 ^ sh) :
    v.testBit (sh - 1) = false ↔ v < 2 ^ (sh - 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, Nat.testBit_eq_false_of_lt⟩
  intro h
  by_contra hge
  push Not at hge
  have h_rem_lt : v - 2 ^ (sh - 1) < 2 ^ (sh - 1) := by
    have h_two_pow : 2 ^ sh = 2 ^ (sh - 1) * 2 := by
      conv_lhs => rw [show sh = (sh - 1) + 1 from by omega]
      rw [Nat.pow_succ]
    omega
  have h_v_eq : v = 2 ^ (sh - 1) * 1 + (v - 2 ^ (sh - 1)) := by omega
  rw [h_v_eq, Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul_add _ h_rem_lt (sh - 1)] at h
  simp at h

name: Azurite.testBit_top_true_iff_half_le
statement:
lemma testBit_top_true_iff_half_le (v sh : ℕ) (hsh : 0 < sh) (hv : v < 2 ^ sh) :
    v.testBit (sh - 1) = true ↔ 2 ^ (sh - 1) ≤ v
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (v.testBit (sh - 1) = true) ↔ ¬ v.testBit (sh - 1) = false from by
    cases v.testBit (sh - 1) <;> simp]
  rw [testBit_top_false_iff_lt_half v sh hsh hv]
  omega
