name: Azurite.eq_half_of_testBit_and_dvd
statement:
lemma eq_half_of_testBit_and_dvd (v sh : ℕ) (hsh : 0 < sh) (hv : v < 2 ^ sh)
    (hbit : v.testBit (sh - 1) = true) (hdvd : 2 ^ (sh - 1) ∣ v) :
    v = 2 ^ (sh - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hge : 2 ^ (sh - 1) ≤ v := (testBit_top_true_iff_half_le v sh hsh hv).mp hbit
  have h_two_pow : 2 ^ sh = 2 ^ (sh - 1) * 2 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [show sh = (sh - 1) + 1 from by omega]
    rw [Nat.pow_succ]
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hdvd
  have hq_lt : q < 2 := by
    have h1 : 2 ^ (sh - 1) * q < 2 ^ (sh - 1) * 2 := by rw [← h_two_pow]; exact hv
    exact Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h1
  have hq_pos : 0 < q := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q with hq0 | hq0
    · exfalso; rw [hq0, Nat.mul_zero] at hge
      exact absurd hge (by simp)
    · exact hq0
  have : q = 1 := by omega
  rw [this, Nat.mul_one]

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toScaled_spec
statement:
lemma toScaled_spec (a : ↥(scaleSet b s)) :
    (((toScaled a : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : EReal) = a.val
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec a.property

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toInt_ofIntSet
statement: @[simp] lemma toInt_ofIntSet (z : ℤ) : toInt (ofIntSet z) = z
proof:
:=
  toInt_eq_of_val rfl

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toScaled_eq_of_val
statement:
lemma toScaled_eq_of_val [NeZero b] {a : ↥(scaleSet b s)} {m : ℤ}
    (h : (((m : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : EReal) = a.val) : toScaled a = m
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ s := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne b)
    positivity
  have heq : (((toScaled a : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : EReal)
      = (((m : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : EReal) := (toScaled_spec a).trans h.symm
  have heq' : (toScaled a : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s = (m : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s := EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp heq
  have := (div_left_inj' hb.ne').mp heq'
  exact_mod_cast this

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toScaled_ofScaled
statement: @[simp] lemma toScaled_ofScaled [NeZero b] (m : ℤ) : toScaled (ofScaled b s m) = m
proof:
:=
  toScaled_eq_of_val rfl

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.b_pow_pos
statement: private lemma b_pow_pos (b s : ℕ) [NeZero b] : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ s
proof:
:= by
  have : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne b)
  positivity

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.div_le_iff_le_floor
statement:
private lemma div_le_iff_le_floor (m : ℤ) (x : ℝ) :
    (m : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s ≤ x ↔ m ≤ ⌊x * (b : ℝ) ^ s⌋
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (b_pow_pos b s), Int.le_floor]

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.le_div_iff_ceil_le
statement:
private lemma le_div_iff_ceil_le (m : ℤ) (x : ℝ) :
    x ≤ (m : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s ↔ ⌈x * (b : ℝ) ^ s⌉ ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (b_pow_pos b s), Int.ceil_le]

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundFloor_scaleSet
statement:
lemma val_roundFloor_scaleSet (x : ℝ) :
    (roundFloor (scaleSet b s) x).val = (((⌊x * (b : ℝ) ^ s⌋ : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isGreatest_roundFloor (scaleSet b s) x).unique
  refine ⟨⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr ((div_le_iff_le_floor _ x).mpr (le_refl _))
  · rintro e ⟨⟨m, rfl⟩, hm⟩
    have hm' : (m : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s ≤ x := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp hm
    have hle : m ≤ ⌊x * (b : ℝ) ^ s⌋ := (div_le_iff_le_floor m x).mp hm'
    have hleR : (m : ℝ) ≤ ((⌊x * (b : ℝ) ^ s⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hleR (b_pow_pos b s).le)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundCeiling_scaleSet
statement:
lemma val_roundCeiling_scaleSet (x : ℝ) :
    (roundCeiling (scaleSet b s) x).val
      = (((⌈x * (b : ℝ) ^ s⌉ : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isLeast_roundCeiling (scaleSet b s) x).unique
  refine ⟨⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr ((le_div_iff_ceil_le _ x).mpr (le_refl _))
  · rintro e ⟨⟨m, rfl⟩, hm⟩
    have hm' : x ≤ (m : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp hm
    have hle : ⌈x * (b : ℝ) ^ s⌉ ≤ m := (le_div_iff_ceil_le m x).mp hm'
    have hleR : ((⌈x * (b : ℝ) ^ s⌉ : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hleR (b_pow_pos b s).le)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.compare_mul_right
statement:
private lemma compare_mul_right (u v c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    compare (u * c) (v * c) = compare u v
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy u v with h | h | h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h hc)]
  · rw [h, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl]
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h hc)]

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_round_scaleSet
statement:
theorem val_round_scaleSet (mode : RoundingMode) (x : ℝ) :
    (round (scaleSet b s) mode x).val
      = (((toInt (round intSet mode (x * (b : ℝ) ^ s)) : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  set y := x * (b : ℝ) ^ s with hy
  have hF := val_roundFloor_scaleSet (b := b) (s := s) x
  have hC := val_roundCeiling_scaleSet (b := b) (s := s) x
  have hFi : toInt (roundFloor intSet y) = ⌊y⌋ := toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundFloor_intSet y).symm
  have hCi : toInt (roundCeiling intSet y) = ⌈y⌉ :=
    toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundCeiling_intSet y).symm
  have h0 : (0 ≤ x) ↔ (0 ≤ y) := by
    rw [hy]; constructor
    · intro h; exact mul_nonneg h (b_pow_pos b s).le
    · intro h; exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_left h (b_pow_pos b s)
  cases mode with
  | Floor => rw [show round (scaleSet b s) .Floor x = roundFloor (scaleSet b s) x from rfl,
      show round intSet .Floor y = roundFloor intSet y from rfl, hF, hFi]
  | Ceiling => rw [show round (scaleSet b s) .Ceiling x = roundCeiling (scaleSet b s) x from rfl,
      show round intSet .Ceiling y = roundCeiling intSet y from rfl, hC, hCi]
  | Down =>
    show (if 0 ≤ x then roundFloor (scaleSet b s) x else roundCeiling (scaleSet b s) x).val
      = (((toInt (if 0 ≤ y then roundFloor intSet y else roundCeiling intSet y) : ℝ)
        / (b : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : EReal)
    by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
    · rw [ite_eq_left hx, ite_eq_left (h0.mp hx), hF, hFi]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hx, ite_eq_right (fun h => hx (h0.mpr h)), hC, hCi]
  | Up =>
    show (if 0 ≤ x then roundCeiling (scaleSet b s) x else roundFloor (scaleSet b s) x).val
      = (((toInt (if 0 ≤ y then roundCeiling intSet y else roundFloor intSet y) : ℝ)
        / (b : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : EReal)
    by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
    · rw [ite_eq_left hx, ite_eq_left (h0.mp hx), hC, hCi]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hx, ite_eq_right (fun h => hx (h0.mpr h)), hF, hFi]
  | Nearest =>
    show (let F := roundFloor (scaleSet b s) x
          let C := roundCeiling (scaleSet b s) x
          let dF : EReal := ((x : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val
          let dC : EReal := C.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
          match compare dF dC with
          | .lt => F
          | .gt => C
          | .eq => tiebreak F C).val
      = (((toInt (let F := roundFloor intSet y
          let C := roundCeiling intSet y
          let dF : EReal := ((y : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val
          let dC : EReal := C.val - ((y : ℝ) : EReal)
          match compare dF dC with
          | .lt => F
          | .gt => C
          | .eq => tiebreak F C) : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : EReal)
    simp only []
    rw [hF, hC, val_roundFloor_intSet, val_roundCeiling_intSet]
    
    have hcmp : compare (((x : ℝ) : EReal) - (((⌊y⌋ : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : EReal))
        ((((⌈y⌉ : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : EReal) - ((x : ℝ) : EReal))
        = compare (((y : ℝ) : EReal) - ((⌊y⌋ : ℝ) : EReal)) (((⌈y⌉ : ℝ) : EReal) - ((y : ℝ) : EReal)) := by
      rw [← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_sub]
      rw [compare_coe_coe, compare_coe_coe]
      rw [← compare_mul_right _ _ _ (b_pow_pos b s), sub_mul, sub_mul,
        div_mul_cancel₀ _ (b_pow_pos b s).ne', div_mul_cancel₀ _ (b_pow_pos b s).ne', ← hy]
    rw [hcmp]
    rcases h : compare (((y : ℝ) : EReal) - ((⌊y⌋ : ℝ) : EReal))
        (((⌈y⌉ : ℝ) : EReal) - ((y : ℝ) : EReal)) with _ | _ | _
    · simp only []; rw [hF, hFi]
    · 
      simp only []
      show (scaleTiebreak (roundFloor (scaleSet b s) x) (roundCeiling (scaleSet b s) x)).val
        = (((toInt (intTiebreak (roundFloor intSet y) (roundCeiling intSet y)) : ℝ)
          / (b : ℝ) ^ s : ℝ) : EReal)
      unfold scaleTiebreak
      have hFs : toScaled (roundFloor (scaleSet b s) x) = ⌊y⌋ := toScaled_eq_of_val hF.symm
      have hCs : toScaled (roundCeiling (scaleSet b s) x) = ⌈y⌉ := toScaled_eq_of_val hC.symm
      rw [hFs, hCs]
      have hFe : ofIntSet ⌊y⌋ = roundFloor intSet y :=
        Subtype.ext (val_roundFloor_intSet y).symm
      have hCe : ofIntSet ⌈y⌉ = roundCeiling intSet y :=
        Subtype.ext (val_roundCeiling_intSet y).symm
      rw [hFe, hCe]
      rfl
    · simp only []; rw [hC, hCi]

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.not_existsGreatestLE_ratSet
statement:
theorem not_existsGreatestLE_ratSet :
    ¬ ∃ M, IsGreatest {s | s ∈ ratSet ∧ s ≤ ((Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : EReal)} M
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨M, ⟨⟨q, rfl⟩, hq_le⟩, hM⟩
  have hq_le_r : (q : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := by exact_mod_cast hq_le
  have hq_ne : (q : ℝ) ≠ Real.sqrt 2 := (irrational_sqrt_two.ne_rat q).symm
  have hq_lt : (q : ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne hq_le_r hq_ne
  obtain ⟨q', hqq', hq'lt⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hq_lt
  have hmem : ((q' : ℝ) : EReal) ∈
      {s | s ∈ ratSet ∧ s ≤ ((Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : EReal)} := by
    refine ⟨⟨q', rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    exact_mod_cast hq'lt.le
  have hle_EReal : ((q' : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ ((q : ℝ) : EReal) := hM hmem
  have hle_R : (q' : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle_EReal
  linarith

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.not_nonempty_roundingTarget_ratSet
statement:
theorem not_nonempty_roundingTarget_ratSet :
    ¬ Nonempty (RoundingTarget ratSet)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨inst⟩
  exact not_existsGreatestLE_ratSet (inst.existsGreatestLE (Real.sqrt 2))

name: Azurite.val_roundFloor_natBotSet_eq_intSet
statement:
lemma val_roundFloor_natBotSet_eq_intSet (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (roundFloor natBotSet x).val = (roundFloor intSet x).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [roundFloor_natBotSet_nonneg x hx, val_roundFloor_intSet]
  have h : ((⌊x⌋₊ : ℤ) : ℝ) = ((⌊x⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Int.natCast_floor_eq_floor hx
  push_cast at h
  rw [h]

name: Azurite.val_roundCeiling_natBotSet_eq_intSet
statement:
lemma val_roundCeiling_natBotSet_eq_intSet (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (roundCeiling natBotSet x).val = (roundCeiling intSet x).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [roundCeiling_natBotSet, val_roundCeiling_intSet]
  have h : ((⌈x⌉₊ : ℤ) : ℝ) = ((⌈x⌉ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Int.natCast_ceil_eq_ceil hx
  push_cast at h
  rw [h]

name: Azurite.natBot_int_tiebreak_value_agree
statement:
private lemma natBot_int_tiebreak_value_agree {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (Fn : ↥natBotSet) (Cn : ↥natBotSet) (Fi : ↥intSet) (Ci : ↥intSet)
    (hFn_val : Fn.val = ((⌊x⌋ : ℝ) : EReal))
    (hCn_val : Cn.val = ((⌈x⌉ : ℝ) : EReal))
    (hFi_val : Fi.val = ((⌊x⌋ : ℝ) : EReal))
    (hCi_val : Ci.val = ((⌈x⌉ : ℝ) : EReal)) :
    (RoundingTarget.tiebreak Fn Cn).val = (RoundingTarget.tiebreak Fi Ci).val
proof:
:= by
  
  have hFi_int : toInt Fi = ⌊x⌋ := toInt_eq_of_val hFi_val.symm
  have hCi_int : toInt Ci = ⌈x⌉ := toInt_eq_of_val hCi_val.symm
  have hxc : 0 ≤ ⌈x⌉ := Int.ceil_nonneg hx
  have hxf : 0 ≤ ⌊x⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr hx
  have hF_nat_val : Fn.val = ((⌊x⌋.toNat : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [hFn_val]
    have : ((⌊x⌋.toNat : ℤ) : ℝ) = ((⌊x⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg hxf
    push_cast at this; rw [this]
  have hC_nat_val : Cn.val = ((⌈x⌉.toNat : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [hCn_val]
    have : ((⌈x⌉.toNat : ℤ) : ℝ) = ((⌈x⌉ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg hxc
    push_cast at this; rw [this]
  have hFn_natBot : natBotToNat Fn = ⌊x⌋.toNat :=
    natBotToNat_eq_of_nat_val ⌊x⌋.toNat Fn hF_nat_val
  have hCn_natBot : natBotToNat Cn = ⌈x⌉.toNat :=
    natBotToNat_eq_of_nat_val ⌈x⌉.toNat Cn hC_nat_val
  
  have hF_parity : Even (natBotToNat Fn) ↔ Even (toInt Fi) := by
    rw [hFn_natBot, hFi_int]
    rw [← Int.even_coe_nat ⌊x⌋.toNat, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hxf]
  have hC_parity : Even (natBotToNat Cn) ↔ Even (toInt Ci) := by
    rw [hCn_natBot, hCi_int]
    rw [← Int.even_coe_nat ⌈x⌉.toNat, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hxc]
  show (natBotTiebreak Fn Cn).val = (intTiebreak Fi Ci).val
  unfold natBotTiebreak intTiebreak
  by_cases hFE : Even (toInt Fi)
  · by_cases hCE : Even (toInt Ci)
    · 
      have hFC_eq : ⌊x⌋ = ⌈x⌉ := by
        have hf_le_c : ⌊x⌋ ≤ ⌈x⌉ := Int.floor_le_ceil x
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hf_le_c with hlt | heq
        · have hle1 : ⌈x⌉ ≤ ⌊x⌋ + 1 := Int.ceil_le_floor_add_one x
          have hsucc : ⌈x⌉ = ⌊x⌋ + 1 := by omega
          have hCnotE : ¬ Even (toInt Ci) := by
            rw [hCi_int, hsucc, Int.even_add_one]; exact not_not.mpr (hFi_int ▸ hFE)
          exact absurd hCE hCnotE
        · exact heq
      rw [ite_eq_left (hF_parity.mpr hFE)]
      have h1 : ¬ (Even (toInt Fi) ∧ ¬ Even (toInt Ci)) := fun ⟨_, h⟩ => h hCE
      have h2 : ¬ (Even (toInt Ci) ∧ ¬ Even (toInt Fi)) := fun ⟨_, h⟩ => h hFE
      rw [ite_eq_right h1, ite_eq_right h2]
      have h_int_eq : toInt Fi = toInt Ci := by rw [hFi_int, hCi_int, hFC_eq]
      have h3 : ¬ (toInt Fi).natAbs < (toInt Ci).natAbs := by
        rw [h_int_eq]; exact lt_irrefl _
      have h4 : ¬ (toInt Ci).natAbs < (toInt Fi).natAbs := by
        rw [h_int_eq]; exact lt_irrefl _
      rw [ite_eq_right h3, ite_eq_right h4]
      rw [hFn_val, hFi_val]
    · 
      rw [ite_eq_left (hF_parity.mpr hFE)]
      rw [ite_eq_left ⟨hFE, hCE⟩]
      rw [hFn_val, hFi_val]
  · by_cases hCE : Even (toInt Ci)
    · 
      have hFn_not : ¬ Even (natBotToNat Fn) := fun h => hFE (hF_parity.mp h)
      rw [ite_eq_right hFn_not, ite_eq_left (hC_parity.mpr hCE)]
      have h1 : ¬ (Even (toInt Fi) ∧ ¬ Even (toInt Ci)) := fun ⟨h, _⟩ => hFE h
      rw [ite_eq_right h1, ite_eq_left ⟨hCE, hFE⟩]
      rw [hCn_val, hCi_val]
    · 
      have hFC_eq : ⌊x⌋ = ⌈x⌉ := by
        have hf_le_c : ⌊x⌋ ≤ ⌈x⌉ := Int.floor_le_ceil x
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hf_le_c with hlt | heq
        · have hle1 : ⌈x⌉ ≤ ⌊x⌋ + 1 := Int.ceil_le_floor_add_one x
          have hsucc : ⌈x⌉ = ⌊x⌋ + 1 := by omega
          have hCE' : Even (toInt Ci) := by
            rw [hCi_int, hsucc, Int.even_add_one]; exact hFi_int ▸ hFE
          exact absurd hCE' hCE
        · exact heq
      have hFn_not : ¬ Even (natBotToNat Fn) := fun h => hFE (hF_parity.mp h)
      have hCn_not : ¬ Even (natBotToNat Cn) := fun h => hCE (hC_parity.mp h)
      rw [ite_eq_right hFn_not, ite_eq_right hCn_not]
      have h1 : ¬ (Even (toInt Fi) ∧ ¬ Even (toInt Ci)) := fun ⟨h, _⟩ => hFE h
      have h2 : ¬ (Even (toInt Ci) ∧ ¬ Even (toInt Fi)) := fun ⟨h, _⟩ => hCE h
      rw [ite_eq_right h1, ite_eq_right h2]
      have h_int_eq : toInt Fi = toInt Ci := by rw [hFi_int, hCi_int, hFC_eq]
      have h3 : ¬ (toInt Fi).natAbs < (toInt Ci).natAbs := by
        rw [h_int_eq]; exact lt_irrefl _
      have h4 : ¬ (toInt Ci).natAbs < (toInt Fi).natAbs := by
        rw [h_int_eq]; exact lt_irrefl _
      rw [ite_eq_right h3, ite_eq_right h4]
      rw [hFn_val, hFi_val]

name: Azurite.val_round_natBotSet_eq_intSet
statement:
theorem val_round_natBotSet_eq_intSet (mode : RoundingMode) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (round natBotSet mode x).val = (round intSet mode x).val
proof:
:= by
  have hF := val_roundFloor_natBotSet_eq_intSet x hx
  have hC := val_roundCeiling_natBotSet_eq_intSet x hx
  cases mode with
  | Floor => exact hF
  | Ceiling => exact hC
  | Down =>
    show (if 0 ≤ x then roundFloor natBotSet x else roundCeiling natBotSet x).val =
         (if 0 ≤ x then roundFloor intSet x else roundCeiling intSet x).val
    rw [ite_eq_left hx, ite_eq_left hx]; exact hF
  | Up =>
    show (if 0 ≤ x then roundCeiling natBotSet x else roundFloor natBotSet x).val =
         (if 0 ≤ x then roundCeiling intSet x else roundFloor intSet x).val
    rw [ite_eq_left hx, ite_eq_left hx]; exact hC
  | Nearest =>
    show (let F := roundFloor natBotSet x
          let C := roundCeiling natBotSet x
          let dF : EReal := ((x : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val
          let dC : EReal := C.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
          match compare dF dC with
          | .lt => F
          | .gt => C
          | .eq => tiebreak F C).val =
         (let F := roundFloor intSet x
          let C := roundCeiling intSet x
          let dF : EReal := ((x : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val
          let dC : EReal := C.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
          match compare dF dC with
          | .lt => F
          | .gt => C
          | .eq => tiebreak F C).val
    simp only
    set Fn : ↥natBotSet := roundFloor natBotSet x
    set Cn : ↥natBotSet := roundCeiling natBotSet x
    set Fi : ↥intSet := roundFloor intSet x
    set Ci : ↥intSet := roundCeiling intSet x
    have hFn_val : Fn.val = ((⌊x⌋ : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      change (roundFloor natBotSet x).val = _
      rw [hF, val_roundFloor_intSet]
    have hCn_val : Cn.val = ((⌈x⌉ : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      change (roundCeiling natBotSet x).val = _
      rw [hC, val_roundCeiling_intSet]
    have hFi_val : Fi.val = ((⌊x⌋ : ℝ) : EReal) := val_roundFloor_intSet x
    have hCi_val : Ci.val = ((⌈x⌉ : ℝ) : EReal) := val_roundCeiling_intSet x
    have hFn_eq_Fi : Fn.val = Fi.val := hFn_val.trans hFi_val.symm
    have hCn_eq_Ci : Cn.val = Ci.val := hCn_val.trans hCi_val.symm
    rw [hFn_eq_Fi, hCn_eq_Ci]
    rcases lt_trichotomy (((x : ℝ) : EReal) - Fi.val) (Ci.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal))
      with h1 | h1 | h1
    · rw [show compare (((x : ℝ) : EReal) - Fi.val) (Ci.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)) = .lt
            from compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h1]
      exact hFn_eq_Fi
    · rw [show compare (((x : ℝ) : EReal) - Fi.val) (Ci.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)) = .eq
            from compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h1]
      exact natBot_int_tiebreak_value_agree hx Fn Cn Fi Ci hFn_val hCn_val hFi_val hCi_val
    · rw [show compare (((x : ℝ) : EReal) - Fi.val) (Ci.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)) = .gt
            from compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h1]
      exact hCn_eq_Ci

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.int_mem_precisionSet
statement:
theorem int_mem_precisionSet (n : ℤ) (hn : |n| < 2 ^ p) :
    ((n : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ precisionSet 2 p
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | h0
  · exact Or.inl (by simp)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨n, 0, h0, by exact_mod_cast hn, by simp⟩

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.int_mem_intPrecisionSet
statement:
theorem int_mem_intPrecisionSet (n : ℤ) (hn : |n| < 2 ^ p) :
    ((n : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ intPrecisionSet p
proof:
:=
  ⟨int_mem_precisionSet n hn, n, rfl⟩

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.two_zpow_pred_eq
statement:
theorem two_zpow_pred_eq (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) = ((2 ^ (p - 1) : ℤ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (p : ℤ) - 1 = ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega, zpow_natCast]
  norm_cast

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.two_pow_pred_lt
statement: theorem two_pow_pred_lt (hp : 1 ≤ p) : (2 : ℤ) ^ (p - 1) < 2 ^ p
proof:
:=
  pow_lt_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.isGreatest_intPrecision_small
statement:
theorem isGreatest_intPrecision_small (x : ℝ) (hx : |x| < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1)) :
    IsGreatest {s | s ∈ intPrecisionSet p ∧ s ≤ (x : EReal)} ((⌊x⌋ : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 1 ≤ p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  rw [two_zpow_pred_eq hp] at hx
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hx
  have hbound : |⌊x⌋| < 2 ^ p := by
    have hlo : -(2 ^ (p - 1) : ℤ) ≤ ⌊x⌋ :=
      Int.le_floor.mpr (by push_cast at h1 ⊢; linarith)
    have hhi : ⌊x⌋ < 2 ^ (p - 1) := Int.floor_lt.mpr h2
    have := two_pow_pred_lt (p := p) hp
    rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
  refine ⟨⟨int_mem_intPrecisionSet ⌊x⌋ hbound, by exact_mod_cast Int.floor_le x⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro s ⟨⟨-, z, rfl⟩, hz⟩
  have : (z : ℝ) ≤ x := by exact_mod_cast hz
  exact_mod_cast Int.le_floor.mpr this

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.isLeast_intPrecision_small
statement:
theorem isLeast_intPrecision_small (x : ℝ) (hx : |x| < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1)) :
    IsLeast {s | s ∈ intPrecisionSet p ∧ (x : EReal) ≤ s} ((⌈x⌉ : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 1 ≤ p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  rw [two_zpow_pred_eq hp] at hx
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hx
  have hbound : |⌈x⌉| < 2 ^ p := by
    have hlo : -(2 ^ (p - 1) : ℤ) < ⌈x⌉ := Int.lt_ceil.mpr (by push_cast at h1 ⊢; linarith)
    have hhi : ⌈x⌉ ≤ 2 ^ (p - 1) := Int.ceil_le.mpr h2.le
    have := two_pow_pred_lt (p := p) hp
    rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
  refine ⟨⟨int_mem_intPrecisionSet ⌈x⌉ hbound, by exact_mod_cast Int.le_ceil x⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro s ⟨⟨-, z, rfl⟩, hz⟩
  have : x ≤ (z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hz
  exact_mod_cast Int.ceil_le.mpr this

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.precScale_eq_pow
statement:
theorem precScale_eq_pow (x : ℝ) (hx : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ |x|) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, precScale 2 p x = (2 : ℝ) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : 0 < |x| := lt_of_lt_of_le (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _) hx
  have hlog : (p : ℤ) - 1 ≤ Int.log 2 |x| :=
    (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log (by norm_num) hx0).mp (by simpa using hx)
  refine ⟨(Int.log 2 |x| - p + 1).toNat, ?_⟩
  unfold precScale
  rw [← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)]
  norm_num

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.ne_zero_of_two_zpow_le
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_two_zpow_le {x : ℝ} (hx : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ |x|) : x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [h, abs_zero] at hx
  exact absurd hx (not_le.mpr (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _))

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.isGreatest_intPrecision_large
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hmem, hge⟩ := isGreatest_precision (b := 2) (p := p) x (ne_zero_of_two_zpow_le hx)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := precScale_eq_pow x hx
  refine ⟨⟨⟨hmem.1, ⌊x / precScale 2 p x⌋ * 2 ^ k, ?_⟩, hmem.2⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hk]; push_cast; rfl
  · rintro s ⟨⟨hs, -⟩, hsx⟩
    exact hge ⟨hs, hsx⟩

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.isLeast_intPrecision_large
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hmem, hle⟩ := isLeast_precision (b := 2) (p := p) x (ne_zero_of_two_zpow_le hx)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := precScale_eq_pow x hx
  refine ⟨⟨⟨hmem.1, ⌈x / precScale 2 p x⌉ * 2 ^ k, ?_⟩, hmem.2⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hk]; push_cast; rfl
  · rintro s ⟨⟨hs, -⟩, hsx⟩
    exact hle ⟨hs, hsx⟩

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.ipToReal_spec
statement: theorem ipToReal_spec (a : ↥(intPrecisionSet p)) : ((ipToReal a : ℝ) : EReal) = a.val

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundFloor_intPrecision_small
statement:
