name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.ipScale_eq_one
statement:
theorem ipScale_eq_one (a c : ↥(intPrecisionSet p))
    (h : min |ipToReal a| |ipToReal c| < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1)) : ipScale a c = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold ipScale
  apply max_eq_right
  have hp : 1 ≤ p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  have hlog : Int.log 2 (min |ipToReal a| |ipToReal c|) ≤ (p : ℤ) - 1 := by
    rcases eq_or_ne (min |ipToReal a| |ipToReal c|) 0 with h0 | h0
    · rw [h0, Int.log_zero_right]; omega
    · have hpos : 0 < min |ipToReal a| |ipToReal c| :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (le_min (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) h0.symm
      exact ((Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt (by norm_num) hpos).mp (by simpa using h)).le
  unfold precScale
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (le_min (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _))]
  calc ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (Int.log 2 (min |ipToReal a| |ipToReal c|) - p + 1)
      ≤ ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (0 : ℤ) := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
    _ = 1 := zpow_zero _

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.ipTiebreak_consecutive
statement:
theorem ipTiebreak_consecutive (a c : ↥(intPrecisionSet p)) (n : ℤ)
    (ha : a.val = ((n : ℝ) : EReal)) (hc : c.val = (((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) : EReal))
    (hn : (n : ℝ) + 1 / 2 ∈
      Set.Ioo (-(2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1)) ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1))) :
    (ipTiebreak a c).val
      = if Even n then ((n : ℝ) : EReal) else (((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  have har : ipToReal a = n := ipToReal_eq_of_val ha.symm
  have hcr : ipToReal c = ((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := ipToReal_eq_of_val hc.symm
  have hscale : ipScale a c = 1 := by
    apply ipScale_eq_one
    rw [har, hcr]
    rcases le_or_gt 0 n with hn0 | hn0
    · calc min |(n : ℝ)| |((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ |(n : ℝ)| := min_le_left _ _
        _ = n := abs_of_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hn0)
        _ < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) := by linarith [hn.2]
    · calc min |(n : ℝ)| |((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ |((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ)| := min_le_right _ _
        _ = -((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
          rw [abs_of_nonpos (by push_cast; exact_mod_cast (show n + 1 ≤ 0 by omega))]; push_cast
          ring
        _ < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) := by linarith [hn.1]
  have hfa : ⌊|ipToReal a| / ipScale a c⌋ = |n| := by
    rw [hscale, div_one, har, ← Int.cast_abs, Int.floor_intCast]
  have hfc : ⌊|ipToReal c| / ipScale a c⌋ = |n + 1| := by
    rw [hscale, div_one, hcr, ← Int.cast_abs, Int.floor_intCast]
  have hev : Even |n| ↔ Even n := by
    rw [Int.abs_eq_natAbs]; exact_mod_cast Int.natAbs_even
  have hev' : Even |n + 1| ↔ Even (n + 1) := by
    rw [Int.abs_eq_natAbs]; exact_mod_cast Int.natAbs_even
  unfold ipTiebreak
  rw [hfa, hfc]
  by_cases he : Even n
  · rw [ite_eq_left ⟨hev.mpr he, fun h => (Int.even_add_one.mp (hev'.mp h)) he⟩, ha,
      ite_eq_left he]
  · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h => he (hev.mp h.1)),
      ite_eq_left ⟨hev'.mpr (Int.even_add_one.mpr he), fun h => he (hev.mp h)⟩, hc,
      ite_eq_right he]

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.intTiebreak_consecutive
statement:
theorem intTiebreak_consecutive (a c : ↥intSet) (n : ℤ)
    (ha : a.val = ((n : ℝ) : EReal)) (hc : c.val = (((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) : EReal)) :
    (intTiebreak a c).val
      = if Even n then ((n : ℝ) : EReal) else (((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  have hia : toInt a = n := toInt_eq_of_val ha.symm
  have hic : toInt c = n + 1 := toInt_eq_of_val hc.symm
  unfold intTiebreak
  rw [hia, hic]
  by_cases he : Even n
  · rw [ite_eq_left ⟨he, fun h => (Int.even_add_one.mp h) he⟩, ha, ite_eq_left he]
  · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h => he h.1), ite_eq_left ⟨Int.even_add_one.mpr he, he⟩, hc,
      ite_eq_right he]

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_round_intPrecision_small
statement:
theorem val_round_intPrecision_small (mode : RoundingMode) (x : ℝ)
    (hx : |x| < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1)) :
    (round (intPrecisionSet p) mode x).val = (round intSet mode x).val
proof:
:= by
  have hF := val_roundFloor_intPrecision_small x hx
  have hC := val_roundCeiling_intPrecision_small x hx
  have hFi := val_roundFloor_intSet x
  have hCi := val_roundCeiling_intSet x
  cases mode with
  | Floor => exact hF.trans hFi.symm
  | Ceiling => exact hC.trans hCi.symm
  | Down =>
    show (if 0 ≤ x then roundFloor _ x else roundCeiling _ x).val
      = (if 0 ≤ x then roundFloor intSet x else roundCeiling intSet x).val
    split_ifs
    · exact hF.trans hFi.symm
    · exact hC.trans hCi.symm
  | Up =>
    show (if 0 ≤ x then roundCeiling _ x else roundFloor _ x).val
      = (if 0 ≤ x then roundCeiling intSet x else roundFloor intSet x).val
    split_ifs
    · exact hC.trans hCi.symm
    · exact hF.trans hFi.symm
  | Nearest =>
    show (let F := roundFloor (intPrecisionSet p) x
          let C := roundCeiling (intPrecisionSet p) x
          let dF : EReal := ((x : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val
          let dC : EReal := C.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
          match compare dF dC with
          | .lt => F
          | .gt => C
          | .eq => tiebreak F C).val
      = (let F := roundFloor intSet x
          let C := roundCeiling intSet x
          let dF : EReal := ((x : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val
          let dC : EReal := C.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
          match compare dF dC with
          | .lt => F
          | .gt => C
          | .eq => tiebreak F C).val
    simp only []
    rw [hF, hC, hFi, hCi]
    rcases h : compare (((x : ℝ) : EReal) - ((⌊x⌋ : ℝ) : EReal))
        (((⌈x⌉ : ℝ) : EReal) - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)) with _ | _ | _
    · exact hF.trans hFi.symm
    · 
      rw [← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_sub, compare_coe_coe, compare_eq_iff_eq] at h
      show (tiebreak (roundFloor (intPrecisionSet p) x) (roundCeiling (intPrecisionSet p) x)).val
        = (tiebreak (roundFloor intSet x) (roundCeiling intSet x)).val
      rcases eq_or_ne ⌊x⌋ ⌈x⌉ with heq | hne
      · have h1 : ∀ a : ↥(intPrecisionSet p), a = roundFloor (intPrecisionSet p) x ∨
            a = roundCeiling (intPrecisionSet p) x → a.val = ((⌊x⌋ : ℝ) : EReal) := by
          rintro a (rfl | rfl)
          · exact hF
          · rw [hC, heq]
        have h2 : ∀ a : ↥intSet, a = roundFloor intSet x ∨ a = roundCeiling intSet x →
            a.val = ((⌊x⌋ : ℝ) : EReal) := by
          rintro a (rfl | rfl)
          · exact hFi
          · rw [hCi, heq]
        rw [h1 _ (tiebreak_mem _ _), h2 _ (tiebreak_mem _ _)]
      · have hc1 : ⌈x⌉ = ⌊x⌋ + 1 :=
          le_antisymm (Int.ceil_le_floor_add_one x)
            (Int.add_one_le_iff.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne (Int.floor_le_ceil x) hne))
        have hhalf : x = ⌊x⌋ + 1 / 2 := by
          rw [hc1] at h; push_cast at h; linarith
        have hmem : (⌊x⌋ : ℝ) + 1 / 2 ∈
            Set.Ioo (-(2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1)) ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1)) := by
          rw [← hhalf]; exact abs_lt.mp hx
        rw [hc1] at hC hCi
        show (ipTiebreak (roundFloor (intPrecisionSet p) x)
            (roundCeiling (intPrecisionSet p) x)).val
          = (intTiebreak (roundFloor intSet x) (roundCeiling intSet x)).val
        rw [ipTiebreak_consecutive _ _ ⌊x⌋ hF hC hmem,
          intTiebreak_consecutive _ _ ⌊x⌋ hFi hCi]
    · exact hC.trans hCi.symm

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundFloor_intPrecision_large
statement:
theorem val_roundFloor_intPrecision_large (x : ℝ) (hx : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ |x|) :
    (roundFloor (intPrecisionSet p) x).val = (roundFloor (precisionSet 2 p) x).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [val_roundFloor_precision x (ne_zero_of_two_zpow_le hx)]
  exact (isGreatest_roundFloor _ x).unique (isGreatest_intPrecision_large x hx)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundCeiling_intPrecision_large
statement:
theorem val_roundCeiling_intPrecision_large (x : ℝ) (hx : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ |x|) :
    (roundCeiling (intPrecisionSet p) x).val = (roundCeiling (precisionSet 2 p) x).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [val_roundCeiling_precision x (ne_zero_of_two_zpow_le hx)]
  exact (isLeast_roundCeiling _ x).unique (isLeast_intPrecision_large x hx)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.ipScale_eq_precScale
statement:
theorem ipScale_eq_precScale (a c : ↥(intPrecisionSet p))
    (h : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ min |ipToReal a| |ipToReal c|) :
    ipScale a c = precScale 2 p (min |ipToReal a| |ipToReal c|)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ipScale
  apply max_eq_left
  have hpos : 0 < min |ipToReal a| |ipToReal c| := lt_of_lt_of_le (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _) h
  have hlog : (p : ℤ) - 1 ≤ Int.log 2 (min |ipToReal a| |ipToReal c|) :=
    (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log (by norm_num) hpos).mp (by simpa using h)
  unfold precScale
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (le_min (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _))]
  calc (1 : ℝ) = ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (0 : ℤ) := (zpow_zero _).symm
    _ ≤ ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (Int.log 2 (min |ipToReal a| |ipToReal c|) - p + 1) :=
      zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.two_zpow_le_floor_ceil
statement:
theorem two_zpow_le_floor_ceil (x : ℝ) (hx : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ |x|) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ |ipToReal (roundFloor (intPrecisionSet p) x)| ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ |ipToReal (roundCeiling (intPrecisionSet p) x)|
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 1 ≤ p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  have hF := isGreatest_roundFloor (intPrecisionSet p) x
  have hC := isLeast_roundCeiling (intPrecisionSet p) x
  have hFx : ipToReal (roundFloor (intPrecisionSet p) x) ≤ x := by
    have := hF.1.2; rw [← ipToReal_spec] at this; exact_mod_cast this
  have hxC : x ≤ ipToReal (roundCeiling (intPrecisionSet p) x) := by
    have := hC.1.2; rw [← ipToReal_spec] at this; exact_mod_cast this
  have hmemP : (((2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ intPrecisionSet p := by
    have := int_mem_intPrecisionSet (p := p) (2 ^ (p - 1))
      (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; exact two_pow_pred_lt hp)
    rwa [two_zpow_pred_eq hp]
  have hmemN : (((-(2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1)) : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ intPrecisionSet p := by
    have := int_mem_intPrecisionSet (p := p) (-(2 ^ (p - 1)))
      (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; exact two_pow_pred_lt hp)
    rw [two_zpow_pred_eq hp]
    push_cast at this ⊢
    exact this
  rcases le_or_gt 0 x with hx0 | hx0
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg hx0] at hx
    have hFlo : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ ipToReal (roundFloor (intPrecisionSet p) x) := by
      have := hF.2 ⟨hmemP, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hx⟩
      rw [← ipToReal_spec] at this
      exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp this
    constructor
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (le_trans (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _).le hFlo)]; exact hFlo
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]; linarith
  · rw [abs_of_neg hx0] at hx
    have hChi : ipToReal (roundCeiling (intPrecisionSet p) x) ≤ -(2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) := by
      have := hC.2 ⟨hmemN,
        EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (show x ≤ -(2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) by linarith)⟩
      rw [← ipToReal_spec] at this
      exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp this
    constructor
    · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith [zpow_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num) ((p : ℤ) - 1)])]
      linarith

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_round_intPrecision_large
statement:
theorem val_round_intPrecision_large (mode : RoundingMode) (x : ℝ)
    (hx : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ |x|) :
    (round (intPrecisionSet p) mode x).val = (round (precisionSet 2 p) mode x).val
proof:
:= by
  have hF := val_roundFloor_intPrecision_large x hx
  have hC := val_roundCeiling_intPrecision_large x hx
  cases mode with
  | Floor => exact hF
  | Ceiling => exact hC
  | Down =>
    show (if 0 ≤ x then roundFloor _ x else roundCeiling _ x).val
      = (if 0 ≤ x then roundFloor (precisionSet 2 p) x else roundCeiling (precisionSet 2 p) x).val
    split_ifs
    · exact hF
    · exact hC
  | Up =>
    show (if 0 ≤ x then roundCeiling _ x else roundFloor _ x).val
      = (if 0 ≤ x then roundCeiling (precisionSet 2 p) x else roundFloor (precisionSet 2 p) x).val
    split_ifs
    · exact hC
    · exact hF
  | Nearest =>
    show (let F := roundFloor (intPrecisionSet p) x
          let C := roundCeiling (intPrecisionSet p) x
          let dF : EReal := ((x : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val
          let dC : EReal := C.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
          match compare dF dC with
          | .lt => F
          | .gt => C
          | .eq => tiebreak F C).val
      = (let F := roundFloor (precisionSet 2 p) x
          let C := roundCeiling (precisionSet 2 p) x
          let dF : EReal := ((x : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val
          let dC : EReal := C.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
          match compare dF dC with
          | .lt => F
          | .gt => C
          | .eq => tiebreak F C).val
    simp only []
    rw [hF, hC]
    rcases h : compare (((x : ℝ) : EReal) - (roundFloor (precisionSet 2 p) x).val)
        ((roundCeiling (precisionSet 2 p) x).val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)) with _ | _ | _
    · exact hF
    · 
      show (ipTiebreak (roundFloor (intPrecisionSet p) x) (roundCeiling (intPrecisionSet p) x)).val
        = (precTiebreak (roundFloor (precisionSet 2 p) x)
            (roundCeiling (precisionSet 2 p) x)).val
      set F := roundFloor (intPrecisionSet p) x with hF_def
      set C := roundCeiling (intPrecisionSet p) x with hC_def
      set F' := roundFloor (precisionSet 2 p) x with hF'_def
      set C' := roundCeiling (precisionSet 2 p) x with hC'_def
      have hFr : ipToReal F = precToReal F' :=
        ipToReal_eq_of_val ((precToReal_spec F').trans hF.symm)
      have hCr : ipToReal C = precToReal C' :=
        ipToReal_eq_of_val ((precToReal_spec C').trans hC.symm)
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := two_zpow_le_floor_ceil x hx
      have hscale := ipScale_eq_precScale F C (le_min h1 h2)
      unfold ipTiebreak precTiebreak
      rw [hscale, hFr, hCr]
      split_ifs <;> first | exact hF | exact hC
    · exact hC

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.not_existsGreatestLE_natSet
statement:
theorem not_existsGreatestLE_natSet :
    ¬ ∃ M, IsGreatest {s | s ∈ natSet ∧ s ≤ ((-1 : ℝ) : EReal)} M
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨M, ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, hM_le⟩, _⟩
  have h1 : ((n : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ ((-1 : ℝ) : EReal) := hn ▸ hM_le
  have h2 : (n : ℝ) ≤ -1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
  linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.not_nonempty_roundingTarget_natSet
statement:
theorem not_nonempty_roundingTarget_natSet :
    ¬ Nonempty (RoundingTarget natSet)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨inst⟩
  exact not_existsGreatestLE_natSet (inst.existsGreatestLE (-1))

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.isGreatest_roundFloor
statement:
lemma isGreatest_roundFloor (x : ℝ) :
    IsGreatest {s | s ∈ S ∧ s ≤ (x : EReal)} (roundFloor S x).val
proof:
:=
  (existsGreatestLE (S := S) x).choose_spec

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.isLeast_roundCeiling
statement:
lemma isLeast_roundCeiling (x : ℝ) :
    IsLeast {s | s ∈ S ∧ (x : EReal) ≤ s} (roundCeiling S x).val
proof:
:=
  (existsLeastGE (S := S) x).choose_spec

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundFloor_of_mem
statement:
lemma val_roundFloor_of_mem {x : ℝ} (hx : ((x : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ S) :
    (roundFloor S x).val = ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isGreatest_roundFloor S x).unique
  exact ⟨⟨hx, le_refl _⟩, fun _ ⟨_, hsle⟩ => hsle⟩

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundCeiling_of_mem
statement:
lemma val_roundCeiling_of_mem {x : ℝ} (hx : ((x : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ S) :
    (roundCeiling S x).val = ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isLeast_roundCeiling S x).unique
  exact ⟨⟨hx, le_refl _⟩, fun _ ⟨_, hxle⟩ => hxle⟩

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_round_of_mem
statement:
theorem val_round_of_mem (mode : RoundingMode) {x : ℝ} (hx : ((x : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ S) :
    (round S mode x).val = ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  have hF : (roundFloor S x).val = ((x : ℝ) : EReal) := val_roundFloor_of_mem S hx
  have hC : (roundCeiling S x).val = ((x : ℝ) : EReal) := val_roundCeiling_of_mem S hx
  cases mode with
  | Floor => exact hF
  | Ceiling => exact hC
  | Down =>
    show (if 0 ≤ x then roundFloor S x else roundCeiling S x).val = ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
    split_ifs <;> [exact hF; exact hC]
  | Up =>
    show (if 0 ≤ x then roundCeiling S x else roundFloor S x).val = ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
    split_ifs <;> [exact hC; exact hF]
  | Nearest =>
    show (let F := roundFloor S x
          let C := roundCeiling S x
          let dF : EReal := ((x : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val
          let dC : EReal := C.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
          match compare dF dC with
          | .lt => F
          | .gt => C
          | .eq => tiebreak F C).val = ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
    simp only
    have hd_eq : ((x : ℝ) : EReal) - (roundFloor S x).val =
                 (roundCeiling S x).val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal) := by rw [hF, hC]
    rw [show compare (((x : ℝ) : EReal) - (roundFloor S x).val)
              ((roundCeiling S x).val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)) = .eq from
            compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr hd_eq]
    rcases tiebreak_mem (roundFloor S x) (roundCeiling S x) with hT | hT
    · rw [hT]; exact hF
    · rw [hT]; exact hC

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.mem_of_coord
statement:
private lemma mem_of_coord (m k : ℤ) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hlt : |m| < (b : ℤ) ^ p) :
    (((m : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ k : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ precisionSet b p
proof:
:=
  Or.inr ⟨m, k, hm, hlt, rfl⟩

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.precisionSet_exists_real
statement: lemma precisionSet_exists_real (a : ↥(precisionSet b p)) : ∃ r : ℝ, ((r : ℝ) : EReal) = a.val
proof:
:= by
  rcases a.property with h | ⟨m, k, _, _, h⟩
  · exact ⟨0, by rw [h]; rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨_, h⟩

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.precToReal_spec
statement: lemma precToReal_spec (a : ↥(precisionSet b p)) : ((precToReal a : ℝ) : EReal) = a.val
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (precisionSet_exists_real a)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.precToReal_eq_of_val
statement:
lemma precToReal_eq_of_val {a : ↥(precisionSet b p)} {r : ℝ} (h : ((r : ℝ) : EReal) = a.val) :
    precToReal a = r
proof:
:=
  EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp ((precToReal_spec a).trans h.symm)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.hb1
statement: private lemma hb1 (b : ℕ) [Fact (1 < b)] : 1 < b
proof: := Fact.out

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.hbR
statement: private lemma hbR (b : ℕ) [Fact (1 < b)] : (1 : ℝ) < b
proof: := by exact_mod_cast hb1 b

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.hb0R
statement: private lemma hb0R (b : ℕ) [Fact (1 < b)] : (0 : ℝ) < b
proof: := lt_trans one_pos (hbR b)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.hp0
statement: private lemma hp0 (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] : 0 < p
proof: := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.precScale_pos
statement: private lemma precScale_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < precScale b p x
proof: := zpow_pos (hb0R b) _

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.y_bounds
statement:
private lemma y_bounds (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ x / precScale b p x ∧ x / precScale b p x < (b : ℝ) ^ (p : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (Int.log b x - p + 1) := zpow_pos (hb0R b) _
  have hlog_le : (b : ℝ) ^ Int.log b x ≤ x := Int.zpow_log_le_self (hb1 b) hx
  have hlog_lt : x < (b : ℝ) ^ (Int.log b x + 1) := Int.lt_zpow_succ_log_self (hb1 b) x
  unfold precScale
  rw [abs_of_pos hx]
  constructor
  · rw [le_div_iff₀ hu, ← zpow_add₀ (hb0R b).ne']
    rw [show (p : ℤ) - 1 + (Int.log b x - p + 1) = Int.log b x from by ring]
    exact hlog_le
  · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hu, ← zpow_add₀ (hb0R b).ne']
    rw [show (p : ℤ) + (Int.log b x - p + 1) = Int.log b x + 1 from by ring]
    exact hlog_lt

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.one_le_b_pow_pm1
statement: private lemma one_le_b_pow_pm1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1)
proof:
:=
  one_le_zpow₀ (hbR b).le (by have := hp0 p; omega)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.abs_div_precScale_bounds
statement:
lemma abs_div_precScale_bounds (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ |x / precScale b p x| ∧
      |x / precScale b p x| < (b : ℝ) ^ (p : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hu := precScale_pos (b := b) (p := p) x
  have h := y_bounds (b := b) (p := p) |x| (abs_pos.mpr hx)
  rw [show precScale b p |x| = precScale b p x from by unfold precScale; rw [abs_abs]] at h
  rwa [abs_div, abs_of_pos hu]

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.isGreatest_precision_pos
proof:
:= by
  set u := precScale b p x with hu_def
  have hu := precScale_pos (b := b) (p := p) x
  set y := x / u with hy_def
  obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := y_bounds (b := b) (p := p) x hx
  rw [← hy_def] at hy1 hy2
  have hfloor_pos : (0 : ℤ) < ⌊y⌋ := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ y := le_trans one_le_b_pow_pm1 hy1
    exact Int.floor_pos.mpr this
  have hfloor_lt : ⌊y⌋ < (b : ℤ) ^ p := by
    have h1 : (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) ≤ y := Int.floor_le y
    have h2 : (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) < ((b : ℤ) ^ p : ℤ) := by
      push_cast; rw [← zpow_natCast]; exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1 hy2
    exact_mod_cast h2
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · 
    have := mem_of_coord (b := b) (p := p) ⌊y⌋ (Int.log b |x| - p + 1) hfloor_pos.ne'
      (by rw [abs_of_pos hfloor_pos]; exact hfloor_lt)
    exact this
  · 
    apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
    rw [← le_div_iff₀ hu, ← hy_def]
    exact Int.floor_le y
  · 
    rintro s ⟨hs, hsx⟩
    rcases hs with h0 | ⟨m, k, hm, hmlt, rfl⟩
    · rw [h0]
      exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (by positivity)
    · apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
      have hsx' : (m : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ k ≤ x := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp hsx
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hm with hmneg | hmpos
      · 
        have : (m : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ k < 0 :=
          mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hmneg) (zpow_pos (hb0R b) _)
        have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) * u := by positivity
        linarith
      · by_cases hk : Int.log b |x| - p + 1 ≤ k
        · 
          obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℕ, k = (Int.log b |x| - p + 1) + d :=
            ⟨(k - (Int.log b |x| - p + 1)).toNat, by omega⟩
          have hs_eq : (m : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ k = ((m * (b : ℤ) ^ d : ℤ) : ℝ) * u := by
            rw [hd, zpow_add₀ (hb0R b).ne', hu_def]; unfold precScale; push_cast
            rw [zpow_natCast]; ring
          rw [hs_eq] at hsx' ⊢
          rw [← le_div_iff₀ hu, ← hy_def] at hsx'
          have : (m * (b : ℤ) ^ d : ℤ) ≤ ⌊y⌋ := Int.le_floor.mpr hsx'
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast this) hu.le
        · 
          push Not at hk
          have hmR : (m : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (p : ℤ) := by
            have : m < (b : ℤ) ^ p := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self m) hmlt
            have h' : (m : ℝ) < ((b : ℤ) ^ p : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast this
            push_cast at h'; rw [← zpow_natCast] at h'; exact h'
          have h1 : (m : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ k < (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) + k) := by
            rw [zpow_add₀ (hb0R b).ne']
            exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hmR (zpow_pos (hb0R b) _)
          have h2 : (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) + k) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ Int.log b |x| :=
            zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (hbR b).le (by omega)
          have h3 : (b : ℝ) ^ Int.log b |x| = (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) * u := by
            rw [hu_def]; unfold precScale; rw [← zpow_add₀ (hb0R b).ne']; congr 1; ring
          have h4 : (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) * u ≤ (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) * u := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hu.le
            have : (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ y := hy1
            
            have hint : ((b : ℤ) ^ (p - 1) : ℤ) ≤ ⌊y⌋ := by
              apply Int.le_floor.mpr
              have hcast : (((b : ℤ) ^ (p - 1) : ℤ) : ℝ) = (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) := by
                push_cast
                rw [← zpow_natCast]
                congr 1
                have := hp0 p; omega
              rw [hcast]; exact this
            have hcast : (((b : ℤ) ^ (p - 1) : ℤ) : ℝ) = (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) := by
              push_cast
              rw [← zpow_natCast]
              congr 1
              have := hp0 p; omega
            rw [← hcast]; exact_mod_cast hint
          linarith

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.isLeast_precision_pos
proof:
:= by
  set u := precScale b p x with hu_def
  have hu := precScale_pos (b := b) (p := p) x
  set y := x / u with hy_def
  obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := y_bounds (b := b) (p := p) x hx
  rw [← hy_def] at hy1 hy2
  have hy_pos : 0 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos one_le_b_pow_pm1) hy1
  have hceil_pos : (0 : ℤ) < ⌈y⌉ := Int.ceil_pos.mpr hy_pos
  have hceil_le : ⌈y⌉ ≤ (b : ℤ) ^ p := by
    apply Int.ceil_le.mpr
    push_cast; rw [← zpow_natCast]; exact hy2.le
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · 
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hceil_le with hlt | heq
    · exact mem_of_coord (b := b) (p := p) ⌈y⌉ (Int.log b |x| - p + 1) hceil_pos.ne'
        (by rw [abs_of_pos hceil_pos]; exact hlt)
    · have hval : ((⌈y⌉ : ℝ) * u : ℝ) = ((1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ (Int.log b |x| + 1) := by
        rw [heq, hu_def]; unfold precScale; push_cast
        rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (hb0R b).ne', one_mul]; congr 1; ring
      rw [hval]
      exact mem_of_coord (b := b) (p := p) 1 _ one_ne_zero (by
        rw [abs_one]; exact_mod_cast Nat.one_lt_pow (hp0 p).ne' (hb1 b))
  · apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
    rw [← div_le_iff₀ hu, ← hy_def]
    exact Int.le_ceil y
  · rintro s ⟨hs, hxs⟩
    rcases hs with h0 | ⟨m, k, hm, hmlt, rfl⟩
    · rw [h0] at hxs
      have : x ≤ 0 := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp (by simpa using hxs)
      linarith
    · apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
      have hxs' : x ≤ (m : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ k := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp hxs
      have hmpos : 0 < m := by
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hm with hmneg | hmpos
        · have : (m : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ k < 0 :=
            mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hmneg) (zpow_pos (hb0R b) _)
          linarith
        · exact hmpos
      by_cases hk : Int.log b |x| - p + 1 ≤ k
      · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℕ, k = (Int.log b |x| - p + 1) + d :=
          ⟨(k - (Int.log b |x| - p + 1)).toNat, by omega⟩
        have hs_eq : (m : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ k = ((m * (b : ℤ) ^ d : ℤ) : ℝ) * u := by
          rw [hd, zpow_add₀ (hb0R b).ne', hu_def]; unfold precScale; push_cast
          rw [zpow_natCast]; ring
        rw [hs_eq] at hxs' ⊢
        rw [← div_le_iff₀ hu, ← hy_def] at hxs'
        have : ⌈y⌉ ≤ (m * (b : ℤ) ^ d : ℤ) := Int.ceil_le.mpr hxs'
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast this) hu.le
      · push Not at hk
        have hmR : (m : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) ^ (p : ℤ) := by
          have : m < (b : ℤ) ^ p := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self m) hmlt
          have h' : (m : ℝ) < ((b : ℤ) ^ p : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast this
          push_cast at h'; rw [← zpow_natCast] at h'; exact h'
        have h1 : (m : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) ^ k < (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) + k) := by
          rw [zpow_add₀ (hb0R b).ne']
          exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hmR (zpow_pos (hb0R b) _)
        have h2 : (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) + k) ≤ (b : ℝ) ^ Int.log b |x| :=
          zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (hbR b).le (by omega)
        have h3 : (b : ℝ) ^ Int.log b |x| ≤ x := by
          rw [abs_of_pos hx]; exact Int.zpow_log_le_self (hb1 b) hx
        linarith

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.precisionSet_neg_mem
statement: lemma precisionSet_neg_mem {e : EReal} (h : e ∈ precisionSet b p) : -e ∈ precisionSet b p
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h0 | ⟨m, k, hm, hlt, rfl⟩
  · left; rw [h0]; simp
  · right
    refine ⟨-m, k, neg_ne_zero.mpr hm, by rwa [abs_neg], ?_⟩
    rw [← EReal.coe_neg]; congr 1; push_cast; ring

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.precScale_neg
statement: lemma precScale_neg (x : ℝ) : precScale b p (-x) = precScale b p x
proof:
:= by
  unfold precScale; rw [abs_neg]

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.isGreatest_of_isLeast_neg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨hmem, hle⟩, hleast⟩ := h
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [EReal.coe_neg]; exact precisionSet_neg_mem hmem
  · rw [EReal.coe_neg]
    have := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp hle
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (by linarith)
  · rintro s ⟨hs, hsx⟩
    have hs' : -s ∈ precisionSet b p := precisionSet_neg_mem hs
    have hsx' : ((-x : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ -s := by
      rw [EReal.coe_neg]; exact EReal.neg_le_neg_iff.mpr hsx
    have := hleast ⟨hs', hsx'⟩
    rw [EReal.coe_neg]
    have h2 : -(-s) ≤ -((L : ℝ) : EReal) := EReal.neg_le_neg_iff.mpr this
    rwa [neg_neg] at h2

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.isLeast_of_isGreatest_neg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨hmem, hle⟩, hgreatest⟩ := h
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [EReal.coe_neg]; exact precisionSet_neg_mem hmem
  · rw [EReal.coe_neg]
    have := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp hle
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (by linarith)
  · rintro s ⟨hs, hxs⟩
    have hs' : -s ∈ precisionSet b p := precisionSet_neg_mem hs
    have hxs' : -s ≤ ((-x : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      rw [EReal.coe_neg]; exact EReal.neg_le_neg_iff.mpr hxs
    have := hgreatest ⟨hs', hxs'⟩
    rw [EReal.coe_neg]
    have h2 : -((G : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ -(-s) := EReal.neg_le_neg_iff.mpr this
    rwa [neg_neg] at h2

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.isGreatest_precision
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hx with hneg | hpos
  · have h := isLeast_precision_pos (b := b) (p := p) (-x) (neg_pos.mpr hneg)
    rw [precScale_neg] at h
    have h' := isGreatest_of_isLeast_neg (b := b) (p := p) x _ h
    rw [show (-((⌈-x / precScale b p x⌉ : ℝ) * precScale b p x) : ℝ)
        = (⌊x / precScale b p x⌋ : ℝ) * precScale b p x from by
      rw [neg_div, Int.ceil_neg]; push_cast; ring] at h'
    exact h'
  · exact isGreatest_precision_pos x hpos

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.isLeast_precision
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hx with hneg | hpos
  · have h := isGreatest_precision_pos (b := b) (p := p) (-x) (neg_pos.mpr hneg)
    rw [precScale_neg] at h
    have h' := isLeast_of_isGreatest_neg (b := b) (p := p) x _ h
    rw [show (-((⌊-x / precScale b p x⌋ : ℝ) * precScale b p x) : ℝ)
        = (⌈x / precScale b p x⌉ : ℝ) * precScale b p x from by
      rw [neg_div, Int.floor_neg]; push_cast; ring] at h'
    exact h'
  · exact isLeast_precision_pos x hpos

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.precToReal_neg
statement:
lemma precToReal_neg (a : ↥(precisionSet b p)) :
    precToReal (⟨-a.val, precisionSet_neg_mem a.property⟩ : ↥(precisionSet b p))
      = -precToReal a
proof:
:=
  precToReal_eq_of_val (by rw [EReal.coe_neg, precToReal_spec])

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundFloor_precision
statement:
lemma val_roundFloor_precision (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    (roundFloor (precisionSet b p) x).val
      = (((⌊x / precScale b p x⌋ : ℝ) * precScale b p x : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:=
  (isGreatest_roundFloor (precisionSet b p) x).unique (isGreatest_precision x hx)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundCeiling_precision
statement:
lemma val_roundCeiling_precision (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    (roundCeiling (precisionSet b p) x).val
      = (((⌈x / precScale b p x⌉ : ℝ) * precScale b p x : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:=
  (isLeast_roundCeiling (precisionSet b p) x).unique (isLeast_precision x hx)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.precScale_min_floor_ceil
proof:
:= by
  set u := precScale b p x with hu_def
  have hu := precScale_pos (b := b) (p := p) x
  set e := Int.log b |x| with he
  
  suffices h : (b : ℝ) ^ e ≤ min |(⌊x / u⌋ : ℝ) * u| |(⌈x / u⌉ : ℝ) * u| ∧
      min |(⌊x / u⌋ : ℝ) * u| |(⌈x / u⌉ : ℝ) * u| < (b : ℝ) ^ (e + 1) by
    have hmin_pos : 0 < min |(⌊x / u⌋ : ℝ) * u| |(⌈x / u⌉ : ℝ) * u| :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (zpow_pos (hb0R b) _) h.1
    have hlog : Int.log b (min |(⌊x / u⌋ : ℝ) * u| |(⌈x / u⌉ : ℝ) * u|) = e := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · exact Int.lt_add_one_iff.mp ((Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt (hb1 b) hmin_pos).mp h.2)
      · exact (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log (hb1 b) hmin_pos).mp h.1
    unfold precScale
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (le_min (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)), hlog, hu_def]
    unfold precScale
    rw [← he]
  have hbe : (b : ℝ) ^ e = (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) * u := by
    rw [hu_def]; unfold precScale; rw [← zpow_add₀ (hb0R b).ne', ← he]; congr 1; ring
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hx with hneg | hpos
  · 
    set z := -x with hz
    have hz_pos : 0 < z := by rw [hz]; exact neg_pos.mpr hneg
    obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := y_bounds (b := b) (p := p) z hz_pos
    rw [show precScale b p z = u from by rw [hz, precScale_neg]] at hy1 hy2
    have hfloor_ge : (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ (⌊z / u⌋ : ℝ) := by
      have hcast : (((b : ℤ) ^ (p - 1) : ℤ) : ℝ) = (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) := by
        push_cast; rw [← zpow_natCast]; congr 1; have := hp0 p; omega
      have hint : ((b : ℤ) ^ (p - 1) : ℤ) ≤ ⌊z / u⌋ :=
        Int.le_floor.mpr (by rw [hcast]; exact hy1)
      have hR : (((b : ℤ) ^ (p - 1) : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ ((⌊z / u⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hint
      rwa [hcast] at hR
    have hC : (⌈x / u⌉ : ℝ) * u = -((⌊z / u⌋ : ℝ) * u) := by
      rw [hz, neg_div, Int.floor_neg]; push_cast; ring
    have hF : (⌊x / u⌋ : ℝ) * u = -((⌈z / u⌉ : ℝ) * u) := by
      rw [hz, neg_div, Int.ceil_neg]; push_cast; ring
    have hfl_pos : 0 ≤ (⌊z / u⌋ : ℝ) * u :=
      mul_nonneg (le_trans (le_trans zero_le_one one_le_b_pow_pm1) hfloor_ge) hu.le
    have hfc : (⌊z / u⌋ : ℝ) * u ≤ (⌈z / u⌉ : ℝ) * u :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast Int.floor_le_ceil _) hu.le
    rw [hC, hF, abs_neg, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hfl_pos, abs_of_nonneg (le_trans hfl_pos hfc),
      min_eq_right hfc, hbe]
    constructor
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfloor_ge hu.le
    · have : (⌊z / u⌋ : ℝ) * u ≤ z := by
        rw [← le_div_iff₀ hu]; exact Int.floor_le _
      have hz_lt : z < (b : ℝ) ^ (e + 1) := by
        have h := Int.lt_zpow_succ_log_self (hb1 b) z
        rwa [he, show |x| = z from by rw [hz, abs_of_neg hneg]]
      linarith
  · obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := y_bounds (b := b) (p := p) x hpos
    rw [← hu_def] at hy1 hy2
    have hfloor_ge : (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ (⌊x / u⌋ : ℝ) := by
      have hcast : (((b : ℤ) ^ (p - 1) : ℤ) : ℝ) = (b : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) := by
        push_cast; rw [← zpow_natCast]; congr 1; have := hp0 p; omega
      have hint : ((b : ℤ) ^ (p - 1) : ℤ) ≤ ⌊x / u⌋ :=
        Int.le_floor.mpr (by rw [hcast]; exact hy1)
      have hR : (((b : ℤ) ^ (p - 1) : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ ((⌊x / u⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hint
      rwa [hcast] at hR
    have hfl_pos : 0 ≤ (⌊x / u⌋ : ℝ) * u :=
      mul_nonneg (le_trans (le_trans zero_le_one one_le_b_pow_pm1) hfloor_ge) hu.le
    have hfc : (⌊x / u⌋ : ℝ) * u ≤ (⌈x / u⌉ : ℝ) * u :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast Int.floor_le_ceil _) hu.le
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hfl_pos, abs_of_nonneg (le_trans hfl_pos hfc), min_eq_left hfc, hbe]
    constructor
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfloor_ge hu.le
    · have : (⌊x / u⌋ : ℝ) * u ≤ x := by
        rw [← le_div_iff₀ hu]; exact Int.floor_le _
      have hx_lt : x < (b : ℝ) ^ (e + 1) := by
        have := Int.lt_zpow_succ_log_self (hb1 b) x
        rwa [he, abs_of_pos hpos]
      linarith

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toInt_intTiebreak_consecutive
statement:
private lemma toInt_intTiebreak_consecutive (n m : ℤ) (h : m = n ∨ m = n + 1) :
    toInt (intTiebreak (ofIntSet n) (ofIntSet m)) = if Even n then n else m
proof:
:= by
  unfold intTiebreak
  simp only [toInt_ofIntSet]
  rcases h with rfl | rfl
  · split_ifs <;> simp_all
  · by_cases hn : Even n
    · have h1 : Even n ∧ ¬ Even (n + 1) := ⟨hn, by rw [Int.even_add_one]; exact not_not.mpr hn⟩
      rw [ite_eq_left h1, ite_eq_left hn, toInt_ofIntSet]
    · have h1 : ¬ (Even n ∧ ¬ Even (n + 1)) := fun h => hn h.1
      have h2 : Even (n + 1) ∧ ¬ Even n := ⟨Int.even_add_one.mpr hn, hn⟩
      rw [ite_eq_right h1, ite_eq_left h2, ite_eq_right hn, toInt_ofIntSet]

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_round_precisionSet
statement:
theorem val_round_precisionSet (mode : RoundingMode) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    (round (precisionSet b p) mode x).val
      = (((toInt (round intSet mode (x / precScale b p x)) : ℝ) * precScale b p x : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  set u := precScale b p x with hu_def
  have hu : 0 < u := precScale_pos (b := b) (p := p) x
  set y := x / u with hy
  have hF := val_roundFloor_precision (b := b) (p := p) x hx
  have hC := val_roundCeiling_precision (b := b) (p := p) x hx
  rw [← hu_def, ← hy] at hF hC
  have hFi : toInt (roundFloor intSet y) = ⌊y⌋ := toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundFloor_intSet y).symm
  have hCi : toInt (roundCeiling intSet y) = ⌈y⌉ :=
    toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundCeiling_intSet y).symm
  have h0 : (0 ≤ x) ↔ (0 ≤ y) := by
    rw [hy]; constructor
    · intro h; exact div_nonneg h hu.le
    · intro h; exact (div_nonneg_iff.mp h).elim (fun h => h.1) (fun h => by
        have := h.2; linarith)
  cases mode with
  | Floor => rw [show round (precisionSet b p) .Floor x = roundFloor (precisionSet b p) x from rfl,
      show round intSet .Floor y = roundFloor intSet y from rfl, hF, hFi]
  | Ceiling => rw [show round (precisionSet b p) .Ceiling x
        = roundCeiling (precisionSet b p) x from rfl,
      show round intSet .Ceiling y = roundCeiling intSet y from rfl, hC, hCi]
  | Down =>
    show (if 0 ≤ x then roundFloor (precisionSet b p) x else roundCeiling (precisionSet b p) x).val
      = (((toInt (if 0 ≤ y then roundFloor intSet y else roundCeiling intSet y) : ℝ) * u : ℝ)
        : EReal)
    by_cases hx0 : 0 ≤ x
    · rw [ite_eq_left hx0, ite_eq_left (h0.mp hx0), hF, hFi]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hx0, ite_eq_right (fun h => hx0 (h0.mpr h)), hC, hCi]
  | Up =>
    show (if 0 ≤ x then roundCeiling (precisionSet b p) x else roundFloor (precisionSet b p) x).val
      = (((toInt (if 0 ≤ y then roundCeiling intSet y else roundFloor intSet y) : ℝ) * u : ℝ)
        : EReal)
    by_cases hx0 : 0 ≤ x
    · rw [ite_eq_left hx0, ite_eq_left (h0.mp hx0), hC, hCi]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hx0, ite_eq_right (fun h => hx0 (h0.mpr h)), hF, hFi]
  | Nearest =>
    show (let F := roundFloor (precisionSet b p) x
          let C := roundCeiling (precisionSet b p) x
          let dF : EReal := ((x : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val
          let dC : EReal := C.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
          match compare dF dC with
          | .lt => F
          | .gt => C
          | .eq => tiebreak F C).val
      = (((toInt (let F := roundFloor intSet y
          let C := roundCeiling intSet y
          let dF : EReal := ((y : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val
          let dC : EReal := C.val - ((y : ℝ) : EReal)
          match compare dF dC with
          | .lt => F
          | .gt => C
          | .eq => tiebreak F C) : ℝ) * u : ℝ) : EReal)
    simp only []
    rw [hF, hC, val_roundFloor_intSet, val_roundCeiling_intSet]
    have hcmp : compare (((x : ℝ) : EReal) - (((⌊y⌋ : ℝ) * u : ℝ) : EReal))
        ((((⌈y⌉ : ℝ) * u : ℝ) : EReal) - ((x : ℝ) : EReal))
        = compare (((y : ℝ) : EReal) - ((⌊y⌋ : ℝ) : EReal))
          (((⌈y⌉ : ℝ) : EReal) - ((y : ℝ) : EReal)) := by
      rw [← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_sub,
        compare_coe_coe, compare_coe_coe]
      conv_rhs => rw [← compare_mul_right _ _ _ hu]
      rw [sub_mul, sub_mul, hy, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hu.ne']
    rw [hcmp]
    rcases h : compare (((y : ℝ) : EReal) - ((⌊y⌋ : ℝ) : EReal))
        (((⌈y⌉ : ℝ) : EReal) - ((y : ℝ) : EReal)) with _ | _ | _
    · simp only []; rw [hF, hFi]
    · simp only []
      show (precTiebreak (roundFloor (precisionSet b p) x) (roundCeiling (precisionSet b p) x)).val
        = (((toInt (intTiebreak (roundFloor intSet y) (roundCeiling intSet y)) : ℝ) * u : ℝ) : EReal)
      have hFr : precToReal (roundFloor (precisionSet b p) x) = (⌊y⌋ : ℝ) * u :=
        precToReal_eq_of_val hF.symm
      have hCr : precToReal (roundCeiling (precisionSet b p) x) = (⌈y⌉ : ℝ) * u :=
        precToReal_eq_of_val hC.symm
      have hFe : ofIntSet ⌊y⌋ = roundFloor intSet y :=
        Subtype.ext (val_roundFloor_intSet y).symm
      have hCe : ofIntSet ⌈y⌉ = roundCeiling intSet y :=
        Subtype.ext (val_roundCeiling_intSet y).symm
      rw [← hFe, ← hCe, toInt_intTiebreak_consecutive ⌊y⌋ ⌈y⌉ (by
        have h1 := Int.floor_le_ceil y
        have h2 := Int.ceil_le_floor_add_one y
        omega)]
      unfold precTiebreak
      simp only [hFr, hCr]
      have hscale := precScale_min_floor_ceil (b := b) (p := p) x hx
      rw [← hu_def, ← hy] at hscale
      have habs : ∀ n : ℤ, Even |n| ↔ Even n := fun n => by
        rw [Int.abs_eq_natAbs, Int.even_coe_nat, Int.natAbs_even]
      rw [hscale, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hu, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hu.ne',
        mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hu.ne', ← Int.cast_abs, ← Int.cast_abs, Int.floor_intCast,
        Int.floor_intCast]
      simp only [habs]
      have h1 := Int.floor_le_ceil y
      have h2 := Int.ceil_le_floor_add_one y
      rcases (show ⌈y⌉ = ⌊y⌋ ∨ ⌈y⌉ = ⌊y⌋ + 1 by omega) with heq | heq
      · rw [heq]
        simp only [and_not_self, ↓reduceIte, lt_self_iff_false]
        rw [heq] at hC
        rw [hF]
        split_ifs <;> rfl
      · rw [heq]
        by_cases hn : Even ⌊y⌋
        · have hn1 : ¬ Even (⌊y⌋ + 1) := Int.not_even_iff_odd.mpr (hn.add_one)
          simp only [hn, hn1, not_false_eq_true, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
          exact hF
        · have hn1 : Even (⌊y⌋ + 1) := Int.even_add_one.mpr hn
          simp only [hn, hn1, not_true_eq_false, ↓reduceIte, not_false_eq_true, and_self]
          rw [← heq]
          exact hC
    · simp only []; rw [hC, hCi]

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.coe_neg
statement: private lemma coe_neg (x : ℝ) : ((-x : ℝ) : EReal) = -((x : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  push_cast; rfl

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundFloor_neg
statement:
lemma val_roundFloor_neg (x : ℝ) :
    (roundFloor S (-x)).val = -(roundCeiling S x).val
proof:
:= by
  apply (isGreatest_roundFloor S (-x)).unique
  refine ⟨⟨SymmetricRoundingTarget.neg_mem (roundCeiling S x).property, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [coe_neg]
    exact (EReal.neg_le_neg_iff).mpr (isLeast_roundCeiling S x).1.2
  · rintro s ⟨hs, hsle⟩
    have h_ms : -s ∈ S := SymmetricRoundingTarget.neg_mem hs
    have h_x_le_ms : (x : EReal) ≤ -s := by
      rw [coe_neg] at hsle
      exact (EReal.le_neg).mpr hsle
    have h_le := (isLeast_roundCeiling S x).2 ⟨h_ms, h_x_le_ms⟩
    exact (EReal.le_neg).mp h_le

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundCeiling_neg
statement:
lemma val_roundCeiling_neg (x : ℝ) :
    (roundCeiling S (-x)).val = -(roundFloor S x).val
proof:
:= by
  apply (isLeast_roundCeiling S (-x)).unique
  refine ⟨⟨SymmetricRoundingTarget.neg_mem (roundFloor S x).property, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [coe_neg]
    exact (EReal.neg_le_neg_iff).mpr (isGreatest_roundFloor S x).1.2
  · rintro s ⟨hs, hxle⟩
    have h_ms : -s ∈ S := SymmetricRoundingTarget.neg_mem hs
    have h_ms_le_x : -s ≤ (x : EReal) := by
      rw [coe_neg] at hxle
      exact (EReal.neg_le).mp hxle
    have h_le := (isGreatest_roundFloor S x).2 ⟨h_ms, h_ms_le_x⟩
    exact (EReal.neg_le).mpr h_le

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundFloor_zero
statement: lemma val_roundFloor_zero : (roundFloor S 0).val = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (isGreatest_roundFloor S 0).unique
  refine ⟨⟨SymmetricRoundingTarget.zero_mem, le_refl _⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro s ⟨_, hsle⟩
  exact_mod_cast hsle

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.val_roundCeiling_zero
statement: lemma val_roundCeiling_zero : (roundCeiling S 0).val = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (isLeast_roundCeiling S 0).unique
  refine ⟨⟨SymmetricRoundingTarget.zero_mem, le_refl _⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro s ⟨_, hxle⟩
  exact_mod_cast hxle

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.roundFloor_neg
statement:
lemma roundFloor_neg (x : ℝ) :
    roundFloor S (-x) =
      ⟨-(roundCeiling S x).val,
        SymmetricRoundingTarget.neg_mem (roundCeiling S x).property⟩
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (val_roundFloor_neg S x)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.roundCeiling_neg
statement:
lemma roundCeiling_neg (x : ℝ) :
    roundCeiling S (-x) =
      ⟨-(roundFloor S x).val,
        SymmetricRoundingTarget.neg_mem (roundFloor S x).property⟩
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (val_roundCeiling_neg S x)

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.round_neg
statement:
theorem round_neg (mode : RoundingMode) (x : ℝ) :
    (round S mode (-x)).val = -(round S (-mode) x).val
proof:
:= by
  cases mode with
  | Floor =>
    show (roundFloor S (-x)).val = -(roundCeiling S x).val
    exact val_roundFloor_neg S x
  | Ceiling =>
    show (roundCeiling S (-x)).val = -(roundFloor S x).val
    exact val_roundCeiling_neg S x
  | Down =>
    show (if 0 ≤ -x then roundFloor S (-x) else roundCeiling S (-x)).val =
        -(if 0 ≤ x then roundFloor S x else roundCeiling S x).val
    by_cases hx0 : 0 ≤ x
    · by_cases hnx0 : 0 ≤ -x
      · have hx_eq : x = 0 := by linarith
        rw [hx_eq, neg_zero]
        simp only [le_refl, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [val_roundFloor_zero, neg_zero]
      · simp only [hnx0, ↓reduceIte, hx0]
        exact val_roundCeiling_neg S x
    · have hnx0 : 0 ≤ -x := by linarith
      simp only [hnx0, ↓reduceIte, hx0]
      exact val_roundFloor_neg S x
  | Up =>
    show (if 0 ≤ -x then roundCeiling S (-x) else roundFloor S (-x)).val =
        -(if 0 ≤ x then roundCeiling S x else roundFloor S x).val
    by_cases hx0 : 0 ≤ x
    · by_cases hnx0 : 0 ≤ -x
      · have hx_eq : x = 0 := by linarith
        rw [hx_eq, neg_zero]
        simp only [le_refl, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [val_roundCeiling_zero, neg_zero]
      · simp only [hnx0, ↓reduceIte, hx0]
        exact val_roundFloor_neg S x
    · have hnx0 : 0 ≤ -x := by linarith
      simp only [hnx0, ↓reduceIte, hx0]
      exact val_roundCeiling_neg S x
  | Nearest =>
    show (let F := roundFloor S (-x)
          let C := roundCeiling S (-x)
          let dF : EReal := ((-x : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val
          let dC : EReal := C.val - ((-x : ℝ) : EReal)
          match compare dF dC with
          | .lt => F
          | .gt => C
          | .eq => tiebreak F C).val =
        -(let F := roundFloor S x
          let C := roundCeiling S x
          let dF : EReal := ((x : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val
          let dC : EReal := C.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
          match compare dF dC with
          | .lt => F
          | .gt => C
          | .eq => tiebreak F C).val
    simp only
    set F : ↥S := roundFloor S x with hF_def
    set C : ↥S := roundCeiling S x with hC_def
    set Fn : ↥S := roundFloor S (-x) with hFn_def
    set Cn : ↥S := roundCeiling S (-x) with hCn_def
    have hFn_val : Fn.val = -C.val := val_roundFloor_neg S x
    have hCn_val : Cn.val = -F.val := val_roundCeiling_neg S x
    
    have h_dFn : ((-x : ℝ) : EReal) - Fn.val = C.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      rw [hFn_val, coe_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_neg, add_comm, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    have h_dCn : Cn.val - ((-x : ℝ) : EReal) = ((x : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val := by
      rw [hCn_val, coe_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_neg, add_comm, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [h_dFn, h_dCn]
    set dF : EReal := ((x : ℝ) : EReal) - F.val
    set dC : EReal := C.val - ((x : ℝ) : EReal)
    rcases lt_trichotomy dF dC with h1 | h1 | h1
    · 
      rw [show compare dC dF = .gt from compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h1,
          show compare dF dC = .lt from compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h1]
      exact hCn_val
    · 
      rw [show compare dC dF = .eq from compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h1.symm,
          show compare dF dC = .eq from compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h1]
      show (tiebreak Fn Cn).val = -(tiebreak F C).val
      by_cases hFC : F = C
      · 
        have h_val_eq : F.val = C.val := congrArg Subtype.val hFC
        rcases tiebreak_mem Fn Cn with hT | hT <;>
          rcases tiebreak_mem F C with hT' | hT' <;>
          simp [hT, hT', hFn_val, hCn_val, h_val_eq]
      · 
        
        have hC_ne : C.val ≠ -F.val := by
          intro hC_eq
          apply hFC
          apply Subtype.ext
          
          have hF_le_x : F.val ≤ (x : EReal) := (isGreatest_roundFloor S x).1.2
          have hx_le_C : (x : EReal) ≤ C.val := (isLeast_roundCeiling S x).1.2
          have h0memS : (0 : EReal) ∈ S := SymmetricRoundingTarget.zero_mem
          by_cases hx0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ x
          · 
            
            have h0le_x : (0 : EReal) ≤ (x : EReal) := by exact_mod_cast hx0
            have hF_ge_0 : (0 : EReal) ≤ F.val :=
              (isGreatest_roundFloor S x).2 ⟨h0memS, h0le_x⟩
            have hF_le_neg : F.val ≤ -F.val := by
              rw [← hC_eq]; exact hF_le_x.trans hx_le_C
            have h_neg_F_le_0 : -F.val ≤ 0 := by
              have := (EReal.neg_le_neg_iff).mpr hF_ge_0
              rwa [neg_zero] at this
            have hF_le_0 : F.val ≤ 0 := hF_le_neg.trans h_neg_F_le_0
            have hF_eq_0 : F.val = 0 := le_antisymm hF_le_0 hF_ge_0
            rw [hF_eq_0, hC_eq, hF_eq_0, neg_zero]
          · 
            
            push Not at hx0
            have hx_lt_0 : (x : EReal) < 0 := by exact_mod_cast hx0
            have hx_le_0 : (x : EReal) ≤ 0 := hx_lt_0.le
            have hC_le_0 : C.val ≤ 0 :=
              (isLeast_roundCeiling S x).2 ⟨h0memS, hx_le_0⟩
            have h_neg_F_le_0 : -F.val ≤ 0 := by rw [← hC_eq]; exact hC_le_0
            have hF_ge_0 : (0 : EReal) ≤ F.val := by
              have := (EReal.neg_le_neg_iff).mpr h_neg_F_le_0
              rwa [neg_zero, neg_neg] at this
            have hF_lt_0 : F.val < 0 := lt_of_le_of_lt hF_le_x hx_lt_0
            exact absurd hF_ge_0 (not_le.mpr hF_lt_0)
        have hFn_eq : Fn = ⟨-C.val, SymmetricRoundingTarget.neg_mem C.property⟩ :=
          Subtype.ext hFn_val
        have hCn_eq : Cn = ⟨-F.val, SymmetricRoundingTarget.neg_mem F.property⟩ :=
          Subtype.ext hCn_val
        rw [hFn_eq, hCn_eq]
        exact SymmetricRoundingTarget.tiebreak_neg C F hC_ne
    · 
      rw [show compare dC dF = .lt from compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h1,
          show compare dF dC = .gt from compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h1]
      exact hFn_val

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toReal_spec
statement: lemma toReal_spec (a : ↥realSet) : ((toReal a : ℝ) : EReal) = a.val
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec a.property

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toReal_eq_of_val
statement:
lemma toReal_eq_of_val {a : ↥realSet} {x : ℝ} (h : ((x : ℝ) : EReal) = a.val) :
    toReal a = x
proof:
:= by
  have hsp := toReal_spec a
  have heq : ((toReal a : ℝ) : EReal) = ((x : ℝ) : EReal) := hsp.trans h.symm
  exact_mod_cast heq

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.realSet_neg_mem
statement: private lemma realSet_neg_mem {s : EReal} (h : s ∈ realSet) : -s ∈ realSet
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨-x, by push_cast; rfl⟩

name: Azurite.RoundingTarget.toReal_neg
statement:
private lemma toReal_neg (a : ↥realSet) :
    toReal ⟨-a.val, realSet_neg_mem a.property⟩ = -toReal a
proof:
:= by
  apply toReal_eq_of_val
  rw [EReal.coe_neg, toReal_spec a]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomialQ.listIntGcd_map_neg
statement:
lemma listIntGcd_map_neg (l : List ℤ) :
    listIntGcd (l.map (fun x => -x)) = listIntGcd l
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [listIntGcd]
  suffices h : ∀ acc : ℕ,
      (l.map (fun x => -x)).foldl (fun acc n => Nat.gcd acc n.natAbs) acc =
      l.foldl (fun acc n => Nat.gcd acc n.natAbs) acc by
    exact h 0
  intro acc
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp [ih]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomialQ.coeff_neg
statement:
@[simp] lemma coeff_neg (p : AzPolynomialQ) (i : ℕ) :
    (-p).coeff i = - p.coeff i
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [coeff, Neg.neg, instNegAzPolynomialQ]
  rcases hp : p.numerators[i]? with _ | c
  · have hw : (p.numerators.map (fun x => -x))[i]? = none := by
      rw [Array.getElem?_map, hp]; rfl
    change ((((p.numerators.map (fun x => -x))[i]?).getD 0 : ℤ) : ℚ) / p.denom = _
    rw [hw]
    simp
    exact neg_zero.symm
  · have hw : (p.numerators.map (fun x => -x))[i]? = some (-c) := by
      rw [Array.getElem?_map, hp]; rfl
    change ((((p.numerators.map (fun x => -x))[i]?).getD 0 : ℤ) : ℚ) / p.denom = _
    rw [hw]
    simp
    exact neg_div _ _

name: Azurite.foldl_gcd_dvd_acc
statement:
private lemma foldl_gcd_dvd_acc (l : List ℤ) (acc : ℕ) :
    l.foldl (fun acc m => Nat.gcd acc m.natAbs) acc ∣ acc
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    exact dvd_trans (ih _) (Nat.gcd_dvd_left acc a.natAbs)

name: Azurite.foldl_gcd_dvd_mem
statement:
private lemma foldl_gcd_dvd_mem (l : List ℤ) (n : ℤ) (hn : n ∈ l) :
    ∀ acc : ℕ, l.foldl (fun acc m => Nat.gcd acc m.natAbs) acc ∣ n.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing n with
  | nil => simp_all
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro acc
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.mem_cons] at *
    cases hn with
    | inl h => subst h; exact dvd_trans (foldl_gcd_dvd_acc as _) (Nat.gcd_dvd_right acc n.natAbs)
    | inr h => exact ih n h (Nat.gcd acc a.natAbs)

name: Azurite.listIntGcd_dvd_of_mem
statement:
lemma listIntGcd_dvd_of_mem (l : List ℤ) (n : ℤ) (hn : n ∈ l) :
    listIntGcd l ∣ n.natAbs
proof: := foldl_gcd_dvd_mem l n hn 0

name: Azurite.listIntGcd_map_ediv
proof:
:= by
  simp only [listIntGcd]
  suffices h : ∀ acc : ℕ, g ∣ acc →
      (l.map (· / (g : ℤ))).foldl (fun acc n => Nat.gcd acc n.natAbs) (acc / g) =
      l.foldl (fun acc n => Nat.gcd acc n.natAbs) acc / g by
    simpa using h 0 (Nat.dvd_zero g)
  intro acc hacc
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.foldl_cons]
    have ha : (g : ℤ) ∣ a := hdvd a (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl))
    have has : ∀ n ∈ as, (g : ℤ) ∣ n :=
      fun n hn => hdvd n (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hn))
    have hgne : (g : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hg.ne'
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ha
    rw [show a / (g : ℤ) = k from by rw [hk]; exact Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left k hgne]
    have hna : a.natAbs = g * k.natAbs := by rw [hk, Int.natAbs_mul]; simp
    have hna_dvd : g ∣ a.natAbs := hna ▸ dvd_mul_right g k.natAbs
    rw [show k.natAbs = a.natAbs / g from by rw [hna, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg]]
    conv_lhs => rw [Nat.gcd_div hacc hna_dvd]
    exact ih has _ (Nat.dvd_gcd hacc hna_dvd)

name: Azurite.AzPolynomialQ.ext
proof:
:= by
  cases p; cases q
  simp only at hnum hdenom
  subst hnum hdenom
  congr

name: Azurite.AzPolynomialQ.zero_numerators
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_numerators : (0 : AzPolynomialQ).numerators = #[]
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzPolynomialQ.zero_denom
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_denom : (0 : AzPolynomialQ).denom = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzPolynomialQ.Monic.def
statement: theorem Monic.def {p : AzPolynomialQ} : p.Monic ↔ p.leadingCoeff = 1
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Azurite.AzPolynomialQ.Monic_iff
statement:
theorem Monic_iff (p : AzPolynomialQ) :
    p.Monic ↔ (p.numerators[p.natDegree]?.getD 0 : ℤ) = p.denom
proof:
:= by
  unfold Monic leadingCoeff coeff
  have hd : (p.denom : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast p.denom_pos.ne'
  rw [div_eq_one_iff_eq hd]
  norm_cast

name: Azurite.AzPolynomialQ.Monic.leadingCoeff_eq_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Monic.leadingCoeff_eq_one {p : AzPolynomialQ} (hp : p.Monic) : p.leadingCoeff = 1
proof:
:=
  hp

name: Azurite.AzPolynomialQ.Monic.coeff_natDegree
statement: theorem Monic.coeff_natDegree {p : AzPolynomialQ} (hp : p.Monic) : p.coeff p.natDegree = 1
proof:
:=
  hp

name: Azurite.AzPolynomialQ.coeff_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma coeff_zero (i : ℕ) : (0 : AzPolynomialQ).coeff i = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeff]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomialQ.one_numerators
statement: @[simp] lemma one_numerators : (1 : AzPolynomialQ).numerators = #[1]
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzPolynomialQ.one_denom
statement: @[simp] lemma one_denom : (1 : AzPolynomialQ).denom = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzPolynomialQ.normalize_coeff
statement:
lemma normalize_coeff (nums : Array ℤ) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (i : ℕ) :
    (normalize nums d hd).coeff i =
    ((nums.popWhile (fun x => decide (x = 0)))[i]?.getD 0 : ℤ) / d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [AzPolynomialQ.normalize, AzPolynomialQ.coeff, Array.getElem?_map]
  set nums' := nums.popWhile (fun x => decide (x = 0))
  set G := listIntGcd nums'.toList
  set g := Nat.gcd G d
  have hg_pos : 0 < g := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right G hd
  have hg_dvd_d : g ∣ d := Nat.gcd_dvd_right G d
  have hgZ : (g : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hg_pos.ne'
  have hgQ : (g : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hg_pos.ne'
  rcases h : nums'[i]? with _ | c
  · simp
  · 
    simp only [Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]
    
    have hg_c : (g : ℤ) ∣ c := by
      rw [← Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs]
      simpa using dvd_trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_left G d)
        (listIntGcd_dvd_of_mem _ c (by rw [Array.mem_toList_iff]; exact Array.mem_of_getElem? h))
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hg_c
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hg_dvd_d
    rw [hk, hm, Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ hgZ, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg_pos]
    push_cast
    rw [mul_div_mul_left _ _ hgQ]

name: Azurite.mulAdjacentPairs_prod
statement:
theorem mulAdjacentPairs_prod : ∀ l : List α, (mulAdjacentPairs l).prod = l.prod
  | [] => rfl
  | [_] => rfl
  | x :: y :: rest => by
    rw [mulAdjacentPairs, List.prod_cons, mulAdjacentPairs_prod rest, List.prod_cons,
      List.prod_cons, mul_assoc]

name: Azurite.foldl_mul_eq_mul_prod
statement: theorem foldl_mul_eq_mul_prod (l : List α) (acc : α) : l.foldl (· * ·) acc = acc * l.prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih => rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, List.prod_cons, mul_assoc]

name: Azurite.prodTree_eq_prod
statement:
theorem prodTree_eq_prod : ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (l : List α), prodTree fuel l = l.prod
  | 0, l => by rw [prodTree, foldl_mul_eq_mul_prod, one_mul]
  | _ + 1, [] => by simp [prodTree]
  | _ + 1, [x] => by simp [prodTree]
  | fuel + 1, x :: y :: rest => by
    show prodTree fuel (mulAdjacentPairs (x :: y :: rest)) = _
    rw [prodTree_eq_prod fuel, mulAdjacentPairs_prod]

name: Azurite.balancedProduct_eq_prod
statement: theorem balancedProduct_eq_prod (l : List α) : balancedProduct l = l.prod
proof:
:=
  prodTree_eq_prod _ _

name: Azurite.addAdjacentPairs_sum
statement:
theorem addAdjacentPairs_sum : ∀ l : List β, (addAdjacentPairs l).sum = l.sum
  | [] => rfl
  | [_] => rfl
  | x :: y :: rest => by
    rw [addAdjacentPairs, List.sum_cons, addAdjacentPairs_sum rest, List.sum_cons, List.sum_cons,
      add_assoc]

name: Azurite.foldl_add_eq_add_sum
statement: theorem foldl_add_eq_add_sum (l : List β) (acc : β) : l.foldl (· + ·) acc = acc + l.sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih => rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, List.sum_cons, add_assoc]

name: Azurite.sumTree_eq_sum
statement:
theorem sumTree_eq_sum : ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (l : List β), sumTree fuel l = l.sum
  | 0, l => by rw [sumTree, foldl_add_eq_add_sum, zero_add]
  | _ + 1, [] => by simp [sumTree]
  | _ + 1, [x] => by simp [sumTree]
  | fuel + 1, x :: y :: rest => by
    show sumTree fuel (addAdjacentPairs (x :: y :: rest)) = _
    rw [sumTree_eq_sum fuel, addAdjacentPairs_sum]

name: Azurite.balancedSum_eq_sum
statement: theorem balancedSum_eq_sum (l : List β) : balancedSum l = l.sum
proof:
:=
  sumTree_eq_sum _ _

name: Azurite.map_fastPowAux
statement:
theorem map_fastPowAux {M N : Type*} [Mul M] [Square M] [Monoid N]
    (f : M → N) (hmul : ∀ a b : M, f (a * b) = f a * f b) (acc base : M) (n : ℕ) :
    f (fastPowAux acc base n) = f acc * (f base) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn generalizing acc base with
  | _ n ih =>
    unfold fastPowAux
    split
    · 
      rename_i h; subst h; simp
    · rename_i h
      split
      · 
        rename_i hd
        have hn1 : n = 1 := by omega
        subst hn1
        rw [ite_eq_right (show ¬ ((1 : ℕ) % 2 = 0) from by decide), hmul, pow_one]
      · rename_i hd
        split
        · 
          rename_i heven
          rw [ih (n / 2) (Nat.div_lt_self (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h) (by omega))]
          congr 1
          rw [Square.square_eq, hmul, show f base * f base = (f base) ^ 2 from (sq _).symm, ← pow_mul]
          congr 1; omega
        · 
          rename_i hodd
          rw [ih (n / 2) (Nat.div_lt_self (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h) (by omega))]
          rw [hmul, mul_assoc]
          congr 1
          rw [Square.square_eq, hmul, show f base * f base = (f base) ^ 2 from (sq _).symm,
              ← pow_mul, ← pow_succ']
          congr 1; omega

name: Azurite.fastPowAux_eq
statement:
theorem fastPowAux_eq [Monoid M] [Square M] (acc base : M) (n : ℕ) :
    fastPowAux acc base n = acc * base ^ n
proof:
:=
  map_fastPowAux id (fun _ _ => rfl) acc base n

name: Azurite.fastPow_eq_pow
statement: theorem fastPow_eq_pow [Monoid M] [Square M] (a : M) (n : ℕ) : fastPow a n = a ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [fastPow, fastPowAux_eq, one_mul]

name: Azurite.map_fastPow
statement:
theorem map_fastPow {M N : Type*} [Mul M] [One M] [Square M] [Monoid N]
    (f : M → N) (hone : f 1 = 1) (hmul : ∀ a b : M, f (a * b) = f a * f b) (a : M) (n : ℕ) :
    f (fastPow a n) = (f a) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [fastPow, map_fastPowAux f hmul, hone, one_mul]

name: Azurite.foldl_range_add
statement:
private theorem foldl_range_add {n : ℕ} (f : ℕ → S) :
    (List.range n).foldl (fun acc j => acc + f j) 0 = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, f j
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, ih,
      Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: Azurite.detFn_eq_det
statement:
theorem detFn_eq_det : ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : ℕ → ℕ → S) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) S),
    (∀ (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n), M i j = A ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩) →
    detFn n M = A.det
  | 0, _, A, _ => by rw [Matrix.det_fin_zero]; rfl
  | n + 1, M, A, h => by
    rw [Matrix.det_succ_row_zero, detFn, foldl_range_add
      (f := fun j => (-1) ^ j * M 0 j
        * detFn n (fun r c => M (r + 1) (if c < j then c else c + 1))),
      ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [h 0 j (by omega) j.isLt]
    have h0 : (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) = 0
proof:
:= rfl
    rw [h0]
    congr 1
    
    refine detFn_eq_det n _ (A.submatrix Fin.succ j.succAbove) ?_
    intro r c hr hc
    simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge c (j : ℕ) with hcj | hcj
    · rw [ite_eq_left hcj, h (r + 1) c (by omega) (by omega)]
      congr 1
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.succAbove]
      rw [ite_eq_left (by
        simp only [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_castSucc]
        omega)]
      rfl
    · rw [ite_eq_right (by omega), h (r + 1) (c + 1) (by omega) (by omega)]
      congr 1
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.succAbove]
      rw [ite_eq_right (by
        simp only [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_castSucc]
        omega)]
      rfl

name: Azurite.map_detFn
statement:
theorem map_detFn {T : Type _} [CommRing T] (f : S →+* T) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : ℕ → ℕ → S), f (detFn n M) = detFn n (fun i j => f (M i j))
  | 0, _ => by rw [detFn, detFn, map_one]
  | n + 1, M => by
    rw [detFn, detFn]
    
    have hfold : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (acc : S),
        f (l.foldl (fun a j => a + (-1) ^ j * M 0 j
            * detFn n (fun r c => M (r + 1) (if c < j then c else c + 1))) acc)
          = l.foldl (fun a j => a + (-1) ^ j * f (M 0 j)
            * detFn n (fun r c => f (M (r + 1) (if c < j then c else c + 1)))) (f acc)
proof:
:= by
      intro l
      induction l with
      | nil => intro acc; rfl
      | cons x xs ih =>
        intro acc
        rw [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_cons, ih, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow,
          map_neg, map_one, map_detFn f n]
    rw [hfold, map_zero]

name: Azurite.squareN_eq
statement: theorem squareN_eq [Monoid M] [Square M] (x : M) (k : ℕ) : squareN x k = x ^ (2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [squareN]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [squareN, ih, Square.square_eq, ← pow_two, ← pow_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [pow_succ']

name: Azurite.oddShift_spec
statement:
theorem oddShift_spec :
    ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m = (oddShift m).2 * 2 ^ (oddShift m).1 ∧ (oddShift m).2 % 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind m ih =>
    intro hm
    rw [oddShift]
    by_cases h2 : m % 2 = 1
    · rw [ite_eq_left h2]
      exact ⟨by simp, h2⟩
    · rw [ite_eq_right h2, ite_eq_right (show m ≠ 0 by omega)]
      have hhalf : 1 ≤ m / 2 := by omega
      obtain ⟨heq, hodd⟩ := ih (m / 2) (by omega) hhalf
      refine ⟨?_, hodd⟩
      simp only [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, ← heq]
      omega

name: Azurite.oddPowersGo_getD
statement:
theorem oddPowersGo_getD [Monoid M] (asq : M) :
    ∀ (k i : ℕ) (cur : M) (acc : Array M) (v : M), i < acc.size + k →
      (oddPowersGo asq cur acc k).getD i v =
        if h : i < acc.size then acc[i] else cur * asq ^ (i - acc.size + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro i cur acc v hi
    rw [oddPowersGo, dite_eq_left (show i < acc.size by omega)]
    exact (Array.getElem_eq_getD v).symm
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i cur acc v hi
    rw [oddPowersGo]
    have hpush : (acc.push (cur * asq)).size = acc.size + 1 := by simp
    have hi' : i < (acc.push (cur * asq)).size + k := by rw [hpush]; omega
    rw [ih i (cur * asq) (acc.push (cur * asq)) v hi']
    simp only [hpush]
    by_cases hlt : i < acc.size
    · rw [dite_eq_left hlt, dite_eq_left (show i < acc.size + 1 by omega), Array.getElem_push_lt]
    · by_cases heq : i = acc.size
      · subst heq
        rw [dite_eq_right hlt, dite_eq_left (show acc.size < acc.size + 1 by omega), Array.getElem_push_eq]
        simp
      · rw [dite_eq_right hlt, dite_eq_right (show ¬ i < acc.size + 1 by omega), mul_assoc, ← pow_succ']
        congr 2
        omega

name: Azurite.mkOddPowerTable_getD
statement:
theorem mkOddPowerTable_getD [Monoid M] [Square M] (a : M) (w : ℕ) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j < 2 ^ (w - 1)) (v : M) :
    (mkOddPowerTable a w).getD j v = a ^ (2 * j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mkOddPowerTable]
  by_cases hk : 2 ^ (w - 1) ≤ 1
  · rw [ite_eq_left hk]
    have hj0 : j = 0 := by omega
    subst hj0
    simp [Array.getD]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hk, Square.square_eq, ← pow_two]
    have hsize : (#[a] : Array M).size = 1 := rfl
    have hi : j < (#[a] : Array M).size + (2 ^ (w - 1) - 1) := by rw [hsize]; omega
    rw [oddPowersGo_getD (a ^ 2) (2 ^ (w - 1) - 1) j a #[a] v hi]
    by_cases hj0 : j < 1
    · have : j = 0 := by omega
      subst this
      rw [dite_eq_left (by rw [hsize]; omega)]
      simp
    · rw [dite_eq_right (by rw [hsize]; omega), hsize, show j - 1 + 1 = j from by omega, ← pow_mul,
        ← pow_succ']

name: Azurite.swPowAux_eq
statement:
theorem swPowAux_eq [Monoid M] [Square M] (a : M) (w : ℕ) (hw : 1 ≤ w) (table : Array M)
    (htable : ∀ d : ℕ, d % 2 = 1 → d < 2 ^ w → ∀ fb : M, table.getD ((d - 1) / 2) fb = a ^ d) :
    ∀ (len h n : ℕ), n < 2 ^ len → swPowAux table w (a ^ h) n len = a ^ (h * 2 ^ len + n)
proof:
:= by
  intro len
  induction len using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind len ih =>
    intro h n hn
    obtain _ | len := len
    · rw [swPowAux]
      have : n = 0 := by simpa using hn
      subst this; simp
    · rw [swPowAux]
      by_cases htop : n < 2 ^ len
      · rw [ite_eq_left htop,
          show Square.square (a ^ h) = a ^ (h * 2) by rw [Square.square_eq, ← pow_two, ← pow_mul],
          ih len (by omega) (h * 2) n htop]
        congr 1
        rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc, mul_comm 2 (2 ^ len)]
      · rw [ite_eq_right htop]
        extract_lets L0 winRaw p L d
        have hL0 : L0 = min w (len + 1) := rfl
        have hwinRaw : winRaw = n / 2 ^ (len + 1 - L0) := rfl
        have hL : L = max 1 (L0 - p.1) := rfl
        have hd : d = p.2 := rfl
        have hL0_pos : 1 ≤ L0 := by rw [hL0]; omega
        have hL0_le : L0 ≤ len + 1 := by rw [hL0]; exact min_le_right _ _
        have hL0_le_w : L0 ≤ w := by rw [hL0]; exact min_le_left _ _
        have hge : 2 ^ (L0 - 1) ≤ winRaw := by
          rw [hwinRaw, Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (Nat.two_pow_pos _), ← pow_add,
            show L0 - 1 + (len + 1 - L0) = len by omega]
          omega
        have hpos : 1 ≤ winRaw := le_trans (Nat.one_le_two_pow) hge
        have hlt : winRaw < 2 ^ L0 := by
          rw [hwinRaw, Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (Nat.two_pow_pos _), ← pow_add,
            show L0 + (len + 1 - L0) = len + 1 by omega]
          exact hn
        obtain ⟨heqw, hdodd⟩ := oddShift_spec winRaw hpos
        rw [← hd] at heqw hdodd
        have hd_ge1 : 1 ≤ d := by omega
        have hpow_le : 2 ^ p.1 ≤ winRaw := by
          rw [heqw]; exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
        have ht_lt : p.1 < L0 :=
          (Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right (by omega)).mp (lt_of_le_of_lt hpow_le hlt)
        have hL_eq : L = L0 - p.1 := by rw [hL, max_eq_right (by omega)]
        have hd_le : d ≤ winRaw := by
          rw [heqw]; exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right d (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
        have hd_lt : d < 2 ^ w :=
          lt_of_le_of_lt hd_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hL0_le_w))
        have hexp : len + 1 - L = (len + 1 - L0) + p.1 := by rw [hL_eq]; omega
        have key : d = n / 2 ^ (len + 1 - L) := by
          have hd_eq : d = winRaw / 2 ^ p.1 := by
            rw [heqw, Nat.mul_div_cancel _ (Nat.two_pow_pos _)]
          rw [hd_eq, hwinRaw, Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, ← pow_add, hexp]
        have decomp : d * 2 ^ (len + 1 - L) + n % 2 ^ (len + 1 - L) = n := by
          rw [key]; exact Nat.div_add_mod' n (2 ^ (len + 1 - L))
        have hL_le : L ≤ len + 1 := by rw [hL_eq]; omega
        have hlen'_lt : len + 1 - L < len + 1 := by omega
        have hrem_lt : n % 2 ^ (len + 1 - L) < 2 ^ (len + 1 - L) := Nat.mod_lt n (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
        rw [squareN_eq, ← pow_mul, htable d hdodd hd_lt (a ^ h), ← pow_add,
          ih (len + 1 - L) hlen'_lt (h * 2 ^ L + d) (n % 2 ^ (len + 1 - L)) hrem_lt]
        congr 1
        rw [add_mul, mul_assoc, ← pow_add, show L + (len + 1 - L) = len + 1 by omega,
          add_assoc, decomp]

name: Azurite.one_le_slidingWindowSize
statement: theorem one_le_slidingWindowSize (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ slidingWindowSize n
proof:
:= by
  rw [slidingWindowSize]
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: Azurite.slidingWindowPow_eq_pow
statement:
theorem slidingWindowPow_eq_pow [Monoid M] [Square M] (a : M) (n : ℕ) :
    slidingWindowPow a n = a ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [slidingWindowPow]
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · subst hn0; simp
  · rw [ite_eq_right hn0]
    extract_lets w table s L0 winRaw p L d
    have hw : 1 ≤ w := one_le_slidingWindowSize n
    have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by omega
    have hs_def : s = Nat.log 2 n + 1 := rfl
    have hs_pos : 1 ≤ s := by omega
    have hs_lo : 2 ^ (s - 1) ≤ n := by
      rw [show s - 1 = Nat.log 2 n by omega]; exact Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hn0
    have hs_hi : n < 2 ^ s := by rw [hs_def]; exact Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by omega) n
    
    have hL0 : L0 = min w s := rfl
    have hwinRaw : winRaw = n / 2 ^ (s - L0) := rfl
    have hL : L = max 1 (L0 - p.1) := rfl
    have hd : d = p.2 := rfl
    have hL0_pos : 1 ≤ L0 := by rw [hL0]; omega
    have hL0_le : L0 ≤ s := by rw [hL0]; exact min_le_right _ _
    have hL0_le_w : L0 ≤ w := by rw [hL0]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hge : 2 ^ (L0 - 1) ≤ winRaw := by
      rw [hwinRaw, Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (Nat.two_pow_pos _), ← pow_add,
        show L0 - 1 + (s - L0) = s - 1 by omega]
      exact hs_lo
    have hpos : 1 ≤ winRaw := le_trans (Nat.one_le_two_pow) hge
    have hlt : winRaw < 2 ^ L0 := by
      rw [hwinRaw, Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (Nat.two_pow_pos _), ← pow_add,
        show L0 + (s - L0) = s by omega]
      exact hs_hi
    obtain ⟨heqw, hdodd⟩ := oddShift_spec winRaw hpos
    rw [← hd] at heqw hdodd
    have hpow_le : 2 ^ p.1 ≤ winRaw := by rw [heqw]; exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
    have ht_lt : p.1 < L0 := (Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right (by omega)).mp (lt_of_le_of_lt hpow_le hlt)
    have hL_eq : L = L0 - p.1 := by rw [hL, max_eq_right (by omega)]
    have hd_le : d ≤ winRaw := by rw [heqw]; exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right d (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
    have hd_lt : d < 2 ^ w :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt hd_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hL0_le_w))
    have hexp : s - L = (s - L0) + p.1 := by rw [hL_eq]; omega
    have key : d = n / 2 ^ (s - L) := by
      have hd_eq : d = winRaw / 2 ^ p.1 := by rw [heqw, Nat.mul_div_cancel _ (Nat.two_pow_pos _)]
      rw [hd_eq, hwinRaw, Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, ← pow_add, hexp]
    have decomp : d * 2 ^ (s - L) + n % 2 ^ (s - L) = n := by
      rw [key]; exact Nat.div_add_mod' n (2 ^ (s - L))
    have hrem_lt : n % 2 ^ (s - L) < 2 ^ (s - L) := Nat.mod_lt n (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
    
    have htable : ∀ d' : ℕ, d' % 2 = 1 → d' < 2 ^ w → ∀ fb : M,
        table.getD ((d' - 1) / 2) fb = a ^ d' := by
      intro d' hodd' hlt' fb
      have h2w : 2 ^ w = 2 * 2 ^ (w - 1) := by rw [← pow_succ']; congr 1; omega
      have hbound : (d' - 1) / 2 < 2 ^ (w - 1) := by omega
      have hget := mkOddPowerTable_getD a w ((d' - 1) / 2) hbound fb
      rw [show 2 * ((d' - 1) / 2) + 1 = d' by omega] at hget
      exact hget
    rw [htable d hdodd hd_lt a, swPowAux_eq a w hw table htable (s - L) d (n % 2 ^ (s - L)) hrem_lt,
      decomp]

name: Azurite.map_getD
statement:
theorem map_getD (f : M → N) (t : Array M) (i : ℕ) (v : M) :
    f (t.getD i v) = (t.map f).getD i (f v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?, Array.getElem?_map]
  cases t[i]? <;> simp

name: Azurite.map_squareN
statement:
theorem map_squareN [Mul M] [Square M] [Mul N] [Square N] (f : M → N)
    (hsq : ∀ x, f (Square.square x) = Square.square (f x)) (x : M) (k : ℕ) :
    f (squareN x k) = squareN (f x) k
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => show f (squareN (Square.square x) k) = squareN (Square.square (f x)) k
                 rw [ih, hsq]

name: Azurite.map_oddPowersGo
statement:
theorem map_oddPowersGo [Mul M] [Mul N] (f : M → N) (hmul : ∀ a b : M, f (a * b) = f a * f b)
    (asq : M) : ∀ (k : ℕ) (cur : M) (acc : Array M),
      (oddPowersGo asq cur acc k).map f = oddPowersGo (f asq) (f cur) (acc.map f) k
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro cur acc; rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    intro cur acc
    show (oddPowersGo asq (cur * asq) (acc.push (cur * asq)) k).map f
        = oddPowersGo (f asq) (f cur * f asq) ((acc.map f).push (f cur * f asq)) k
    rw [ih, hmul, Array.map_push, hmul]

name: Azurite.map_mkOddPowerTable
statement:
theorem map_mkOddPowerTable [Mul M] [Square M] [Mul N] [Square N] (f : M → N)
    (hmul : ∀ a b : M, f (a * b) = f a * f b) (hsq : ∀ x, f (Square.square x) = Square.square (f x))
    (a : M) (w : ℕ) : (mkOddPowerTable a w).map f = mkOddPowerTable (f a) w
proof:
:= by
  rw [mkOddPowerTable, mkOddPowerTable]
  have hsing : (#[a] : Array M).map f = #[f a] := by simp
  by_cases hk : 2 ^ (w - 1) ≤ 1
  · rw [ite_eq_left hk, ite_eq_left hk, hsing]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hk, ite_eq_right hk, map_oddPowersGo f hmul, hsq, hsing]

name: Azurite.map_swPowAux
statement:
theorem map_swPowAux [Mul M] [Square M] [Mul N] [Square N] (f : M → N)
    (hmul : ∀ a b : M, f (a * b) = f a * f b) (hsq : ∀ x, f (Square.square x) = Square.square (f x))
    (w : ℕ) (t : Array M) :
    ∀ (result : M) (n len : ℕ),
      f (swPowAux t w result n len) = swPowAux (t.map f) w (f result) n len
proof:
:= by
  intro result n len
  induction len using Nat.strongRecOn generalizing result n with
  | ind len ih =>
    obtain _ | len := len
    · simp [swPowAux]
    · rw [swPowAux, swPowAux]
      by_cases htop : n < 2 ^ len
      · rw [ite_eq_left htop, ite_eq_left htop, ih len (by omega) (Square.square result) n, hsq]
      · rw [ite_eq_right htop, ite_eq_right htop]
        simp only []
        have hL : 1 ≤ max 1 (min w (len + 1) - (oddShift (n / 2 ^ (len + 1 - min w (len + 1)))).fst) :=
          le_max_left _ _
        generalize hLdef :
          max 1 (min w (len + 1) - (oddShift (n / 2 ^ (len + 1 - min w (len + 1)))).fst) = L at *
        generalize (oddShift (n / 2 ^ (len + 1 - min w (len + 1)))).snd = d
        rw [ih (len + 1 - L) (by omega) (squareN result L * t.getD ((d - 1) / 2) result)
              (n % 2 ^ (len + 1 - L)), hmul, map_squareN f hsq, map_getD f]

name: Azurite.map_slidingWindowPow
statement:
theorem map_slidingWindowPow [Mul M] [One M] [Square M] [Monoid N] [Square N]
    (f : M → N) (hone : f 1 = 1) (hmul : ∀ a b : M, f (a * b) = f a * f b) (a : M) (n : ℕ) :
    f (slidingWindowPow a n) = (f a) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ∀ x : M, f (Square.square x) = Square.square (f x) := fun x => by
    rw [Square.square_eq, hmul, Square.square_eq]
  rw [← slidingWindowPow_eq_pow (f a) n]
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst hn; simp [slidingWindowPow, hone]
  · rw [slidingWindowPow, slidingWindowPow, ite_eq_right hn, ite_eq_right hn]
    simp only []
    rw [map_swPowAux f hmul hsq, map_getD f]
    simp only [map_mkOddPowerTable f hmul hsq]
