name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.sRemU_succ_succ
statement:
theorem sRemU_succ_succ (P Q : AzPolynomial K) (n : ℕ) :
    sRemU P Q (n + 2) =
      (if sRemS P Q (n + 1) = 0 then 0
       else -(sRemU P Q n) + quo (sRemS P Q n) (sRemS P Q (n + 1)) * sRemU P Q (n + 1))

  rfl

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.sRemStep_triple
statement:
private theorem sRemStep_triple (P Q : AzPolynomial K) (i : ℕ) :
    sRemStep (sRemTriple P Q i) (sRemTriple P Q (i + 1)) = sRemTriple P Q (i + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sRemTriple, sRemTriple, sRemTriple, sRemS_succ_succ, sRemU_succ_succ, sRemV_succ_succ,
    sRemStep]
  by_cases h : sRemS P Q (i + 1) = 0
  · simp [h]
  · simp only [ite_eq_right h]
    rfl

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.sRemBuild_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro i; rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    intro i
    rw [sRemBuild, sRemStep_triple, show i + 2 = (i + 1) + 1 from rfl, ih (i + 1),
      List.range'_succ, List.map_cons]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.extendedSRemS_eq_spec
statement:
theorem extendedSRemS_eq_spec (P Q : AzPolynomial K) (n : ℕ) :
    extendedSRemS P Q n = (sRemSList P Q n, sRemUList P Q n, sRemVList P Q n)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : sRemBuild n (P, 1, 0) (Q, 0, 1) = (List.range' 0 n).map (sRemTriple P Q) :=
    sRemBuild_eq P Q n 0
  simp only [extendedSRemS, hb, sRemSList_eq, sRemUList, sRemVList, List.map_map,
    List.range_eq_range']
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.truncate_zero_poly
statement:
@[simp] lemma truncate_zero_poly (i : ℕ) :
    truncate i (0 : AzPolynomial R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply AzPolynomial.ext
  unfold truncate normalize
  simp

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.natDegree_truncate_le
statement:
theorem natDegree_truncate_le (i : ℕ) (p : AzPolynomial R) :
    (truncate i p).natDegree ≤ i
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncate natDegree
  set a := p.coeffs.extract 0 (i + 1)
  
  
  have h_norm : (normalize a).coeffs.size ≤ a.size := by
    change (a.popWhile (· = 0)).size ≤ a.size
    rw [← Array.length_toList, ← Array.length_toList,
        toList_popWhile_eq_dropTrailingZeros]
    exact (dropTrailingZeros_prefix _).length_le
  have h_ext : a.size ≤ i + 1 := by
    simp [a, Array.size_extract]
  omega

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.char_ofNat_ne_dash
statement: lemma char_ofNat_ne_dash (n : ℕ) : Char.ofNat ('0'.toNat + n % 10) ≠ '-'
proof:
:= by
  have h_mod : n % 10 < 10 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
  generalize h : n % 10 = k
  rw [h] at h_mod
  rcases k with _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _
  all_goals { first | decide | contradiction}

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.not_mem_natToCharsAux
statement:
lemma not_mem_natToCharsAux (f n : ℕ) (acc : List Char) (h : '-' ∉ acc) :
  '-' ∉ natToCharsAux f n acc
proof:
:= by
  induction f generalizing n acc with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ f ih =>
    dsimp [natToCharsAux]
    split
    · exact h
    · apply ih
      intro hc
      rw [List.mem_cons] at hc
      rcases hc with h_head | h_tail
      · exact char_ofNat_ne_dash n h_head.symm
      · exact h h_tail

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.not_mem_natToChars
statement: lemma not_mem_natToChars (n : ℕ) : '-' ∉ natToChars n
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [natToChars]
  split
  · intro hc; nomatch hc
  · apply not_mem_natToCharsAux
    intro hc; nomatch hc

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.not_mem_tail_intToChars
statement: lemma not_mem_tail_intToChars (z : ℤ) : '-' ∉ (intToChars z).drop 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [intToChars]
  split
  · split
    · decide
    · dsimp [List.drop]
      apply not_mem_natToCharsAux
      intro hc; nomatch hc
  · split
    · decide
    · intro hc
      exact not_mem_natToCharsAux _ _ _ (by intro hc2; nomatch hc2) (List.mem_of_mem_drop hc)

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.natToCharsAux_ne_nil_of_acc_ne_nil
statement:
lemma natToCharsAux_ne_nil_of_acc_ne_nil (f n : ℕ) (acc : List Char) (h : acc ≠ []) :
    natToCharsAux f n acc ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  induction f generalizing n acc with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ f ih =>
    dsimp [natToCharsAux]
    split
    · exact h
    · apply ih
      intro hc
      contradiction

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.natToCharsAux_ne_nil_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma natToCharsAux_ne_nil_of_ne_zero (f n : ℕ) (h : n ≠ 0) :
    natToCharsAux (f + 1) n [] ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [natToCharsAux]
  split
  · contradiction
  · apply natToCharsAux_ne_nil_of_acc_ne_nil
    intro hc; contradiction

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.natToChars_ne_nil
statement: lemma natToChars_ne_nil (n : ℕ) : natToChars n ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [natToChars]
  split_ifs with hn
  · intro hc; contradiction
  · cases n
    · contradiction
    · rename_i k
      exact natToCharsAux_ne_nil_of_ne_zero k (k+1) (by simp)

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.zmodToChars_ne_nil
statement: lemma zmodToChars_ne_nil {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (c : ZMod n) : zmodToChars c ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [zmodToChars]
  exact natToChars_ne_nil c.val

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.intToChars_ne_nil
statement: lemma intToChars_ne_nil (z : ℤ) : intToChars z ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [intToChars]
  split
  · split
    · intro hc; contradiction
    · intro hc; contradiction
  · split
    · intro hc; contradiction
    · cases hz : z.natAbs
      · contradiction
      · rename_i k
        apply natToCharsAux_ne_nil_of_ne_zero k (k+1)
        intro hc; contradiction

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.ratToChars_ne_nil
statement: lemma ratToChars_ne_nil (q : ℚ) : ratToChars q ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [ratToChars]
  split
  · exact intToChars_ne_nil _
  · have h_int := intToChars_ne_nil q.num
    cases h : intToChars q.num
    · contradiction
    · intro hc
      contradiction

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.not_mem_tail_ratToChars
statement: lemma not_mem_tail_ratToChars (q : ℚ) : '-' ∉ (ratToChars q).drop 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [ratToChars]
  split
  · exact not_mem_tail_intToChars _
  · have h_int := intToChars_ne_nil q.num
    cases h : intToChars q.num
    · contradiction
    · rename_i head tail
      dsimp [List.drop]
      intro hc
      rw [List.mem_append] at hc
      cases hc with
      | inl h_tail =>
        have h_int_tail : '-' ∉ tail := by
          have ht := not_mem_tail_intToChars q.num
          rw [h] at ht
          exact ht
        rw [List.mem_append] at h_tail
        cases h_tail with
        | inl ht' => exact h_int_tail ht'
        | inr hdiv => nomatch hdiv
      | inr h_rest =>
        exact not_mem_natToChars _ h_rest

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.natToChars_not_dash
statement: lemma natToChars_not_dash (n : ℕ) (cs : List Char) : natToChars n = '-' :: cs → False
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h_parse := parseNatChars_natToChars n
  rw [h] at h_parse
  have h_none : parseNatChars ('-' :: cs) = none := rfl
  rw [h_none] at h_parse
  contradiction

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.intToChars_natAbs
statement:
lemma intToChars_natAbs (z : ℤ) :
    intToChars z = if z < 0 then '-' :: natToChars z.natAbs else natToChars z.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  unfold intToChars natToChars
  dsimp only
  split_ifs
  any_goals rfl
  any_goals omega

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.parseIntChars_intToChars
statement: lemma parseIntChars_intToChars (z : ℤ) : parseIntChars (intToChars z) = some z
proof:
:= by
  rw [intToChars_natAbs]
  split_ifs with hz
  · change (parseNatChars (natToChars z.natAbs)).map (fun n => - (n : ℤ)) = some z
    have h_parse := parseNatChars_natToChars z.natAbs
    rw [h_parse]
    dsimp
    congr 1
    omega
  · have hz_nonneg : 0 ≤ z := by omega
    cases h_chars : natToChars z.natAbs with
    | nil =>
      have h_parse := parseNatChars_natToChars z.natAbs
      rw [h_chars] at h_parse
      contradiction
    | cons c cs =>
      by_cases h_c : c = '-'
      · subst h_c
        exfalso
        exact natToChars_not_dash z.natAbs cs h_chars
      · have h_parse_int : parseIntChars (c :: cs) =
            (parseNatChars (c :: cs)).map (fun n => (n : ℤ)) := by
          unfold parseIntChars
          split
          · contradiction
          · rename_i rest h_eq
            injection h_eq with h_c_eq
            contradiction
          · rfl
        rw [h_parse_int]
        have h_parse := parseNatChars_natToChars z.natAbs
        rw [h_chars] at h_parse
        rw [h_parse]
        dsimp
        congr 1
        omega

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.not_mem_natToCharsAux_of_not_digit
statement:
lemma not_mem_natToCharsAux_of_not_digit (c : Char) (hc : c.toNat < 48 ∨ 57 < c.toNat)
    (fuel n : ℕ) (acc : List Char) (h : c ∉ acc) :
    c ∉ natToCharsAux fuel n acc
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing n acc with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ f ih =>
    dsimp [natToCharsAux]
    split_ifs with hn
    · exact h
    · apply ih
      simp only [List.mem_cons, not_or]
      constructor
      · intro hc_eq
        have hd : (Char.ofNat (48 + n % 10)).toNat - 48 = n % 10 := toNat_digit n
        rw [← hc_eq] at hd
        have h_lt : n % 10 < 10 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
        rw [← hd] at h_lt
        cases hc with
        | inl h1 =>
          have h_sub : c.toNat - 48 = 0 := by omega
          have h_mod : n % 10 = 0 := by omega
          have h_c_0 : c = '0' := by
            rw [h_mod] at hc_eq
            exact hc_eq
          have ht : '0'.toNat = 48 := rfl
          rw [h_c_0, ht] at h1
          omega
        | inr h2 =>
          omega
      · exact h

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.not_mem_natToChars_of_not_digit
statement:
lemma not_mem_natToChars_of_not_digit (c : Char) (hc : c.toNat < 48 ∨ 57 < c.toNat) (n : ℕ) :
    c ∉ natToChars n
proof:
:= by
  unfold natToChars
  split_ifs with hn
  · intro hc_eq; simp at hc_eq
    have ht : '0'.toNat = 48 := rfl
    have hc_toNat : c.toNat = 48 := by
      rw [hc_eq, ht]
    rw [hc_toNat] at hc
    omega
  · exact not_mem_natToCharsAux_of_not_digit c hc _ _ _ (by simp)

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.mem_natToChars_only_digits
statement:
lemma mem_natToChars_only_digits (n : ℕ) (c : Char) (h : c ∈ natToChars n) :
    '0'.toNat ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ '9'.toNat
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  rw [not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hc
  have h_not_mem := not_mem_natToChars_of_not_digit c hc n
  contradiction

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.mem_intToChars_only_digits_or_dash
statement:
lemma mem_intToChars_only_digits_or_dash (z : ℤ) (c : Char) (h : c ∈ intToChars z) :
    c = '-' ∨ ('0'.toNat ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ '9'.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  rw [intToChars_natAbs] at h
  split_ifs at h with hz
  · rcases (List.mem_cons.mp h) with rfl | h_nat
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (mem_natToChars_only_digits _ _ h_nat)
  · exact Or.inr (mem_natToChars_only_digits _ _ h)

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.mem_ratToChars_only_digits_or_dash_or_slash
statement:
lemma mem_ratToChars_only_digits_or_dash_or_slash (q : ℚ) (c : Char) (h : c ∈ ratToChars q) :
    c = '/' ∨ c = '-' ∨ ('0'.toNat ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ '9'.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [ratToChars] at h
  split_ifs at h with hd
  · rcases (mem_intToChars_only_digits_or_dash _ _ h) with rfl | h_dig
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h_dig)
  · have h_assoc : intToChars q.num ++ ['/'] ++ natToChars q.den
        = (intToChars q.num ++ ['/']) ++ natToChars q.den := rfl
    rw [h_assoc] at h
    rcases (List.mem_append.mp h) with h_int_slash | h_nat
    · rcases (List.mem_append.mp h_int_slash) with h_int | h_slash
      · rcases (mem_intToChars_only_digits_or_dash _ _ h_int) with rfl | h_dig
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h_dig)
      · rcases (List.mem_cons.mp h_slash) with rfl | hk
        · exact Or.inl rfl
        · contradiction
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (mem_natToChars_only_digits _ _ h_nat))

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.not_mem_natToCharsAux_div
statement:
lemma not_mem_natToCharsAux_div (fuel n : ℕ) (acc : List Char) (h : '/' ∉ acc) :
    '/' ∉ natToCharsAux fuel n acc
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing n acc with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ f ih =>
    dsimp [natToCharsAux]
    split_ifs with hn
    · exact h
    · apply ih
      simp only [List.mem_cons, not_or]
      constructor
      · intro hc
        have hd : (Char.ofNat (48 + n % 10)).toNat - 48 = n % 10 := toNat_digit n
        rw [← hc] at hd
        have h47 : '/'.toNat = 47 := rfl
        rw [h47] at hd
        have h_sub : 47 - 48 = 0 := rfl
        rw [h_sub] at hd
        have h_mod_0 : n % 10 = 0 := hd.symm
        rw [h_mod_0] at hc
        revert hc
        decide
      · exact h

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.not_mem_natToChars_div
statement: lemma not_mem_natToChars_div (n : ℕ) : '/' ∉ natToChars n
proof:
:= by
  unfold natToChars
  split_ifs with hn
  · intro hc; simp at hc
  · exact not_mem_natToCharsAux_div _ _ _ (by simp)

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.not_mem_intToChars
statement: lemma not_mem_intToChars (z : ℤ) : '/' ∉ intToChars z
proof:
:= by
  rw [intToChars_natAbs]
  split_ifs with hz
  · intro hc
    simp only [List.mem_cons] at hc
    cases hc with
    | inl hl =>
       have h_val := congrArg Char.toNat hl
       have h47 : '/'.toNat = 47 := rfl
       have h45 : '-'.toNat = 45 := rfl
       rw [h47, h45] at h_val
       contradiction
    | inr hr => exact not_mem_natToChars_div _ hr
  · exact not_mem_natToChars_div _

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.splitOnP_go_cons_false
statement:
private lemma splitOnP_go_cons_false (sep x : Char) (xs acc : List Char)
    (h : (x == sep) = false) :
    List.splitOnPPrepend (· == sep) (x :: xs) acc =
    List.splitOnPPrepend (· == sep) xs (x :: acc)
proof:
:= by
  exact List.splitOnPPrepend_cons_neg h

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.splitOnP_go_cons_true
proof:
:= by
  exact List.splitOnPPrepend_cons_pos (beq_self_eq_true sep)

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.splitOnP_go_not_mem
statement:
private lemma splitOnP_go_not_mem (sep : Char) (l acc : List Char) (h : sep ∉ l) :
    List.splitOnPPrepend (· == sep) l acc = [acc.reverse ++ l]
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp [List.splitOnPPrepend]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hxq : (x == sep) = false := by
      simp only [beq_eq_false_iff_ne]; intro hx; subst hx; exact h (List.Mem.head _)
    simp only [splitOnP_go_cons_false sep x xs acc hxq]
    rw [ih (x :: acc) (fun hc => h (List.Mem.tail _ hc))]
    simp [List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.splitOnP_go_append_not_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction l1 generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hxq : (x == sep) = false := by
      simp only [beq_eq_false_iff_ne]; intro hx; subst hx; exact h (List.Mem.head _)
    rw [List.cons_append, splitOnP_go_cons_false sep x (xs ++ l2) acc hxq]
    rw [ih (x :: acc) (fun hc => h (List.Mem.tail _ hc))]
    simp [List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.splitOn_not_mem
statement: lemma splitOn_not_mem (sep : Char) (l : List Char) (h : sep ∉ l) : l.splitOn sep = [l]
proof:
:= by
  simp [List.splitOn, List.splitOnP, splitOnP_go_not_mem sep l [] h]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.splitOn_append_singleton_append_not_mem
statement:
lemma splitOn_append_singleton_append_not_mem (sep : Char) (l1 l2 : List Char)
    (h1 : sep ∉ l1) (h2 : sep ∉ l2) :
    (l1 ++ [sep] ++ l2).splitOn sep = [l1, l2]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.splitOn, List.splitOnP, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
  rw [splitOnP_go_append_not_mem sep l1 (sep :: l2) [] h1]
  simp only [List.append_nil]
  rw [splitOnP_go_cons_true sep l2 l1.reverse]
  rw [show List.splitOnPPrepend (· == sep) l2 [] = [l2] by
    simpa using splitOnP_go_not_mem sep l2 [] h2]
  simp

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.splitOn_not_mem_slash
statement: lemma splitOn_not_mem_slash (l : List Char) (h : '/' ∉ l) : l.splitOn '/' = [l]
proof:
:=
  splitOn_not_mem '/' l h

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.splitOn_append_singleton_append_not_mem_slash
statement:
lemma splitOn_append_singleton_append_not_mem_slash (l1 l2 : List Char)
    (h1 : '/' ∉ l1) (h2 : '/' ∉ l2) :
    (l1 ++ ['/'] ++ l2).splitOn '/' = [l1, l2]
proof:
:=
  splitOn_append_singleton_append_not_mem '/' l1 l2 h1 h2

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.rat_ext_eq
statement: lemma rat_ext_eq (q : ℚ) : q = (q.num : ℚ) / (q.den : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Rat.num_div_den q).symm

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.parseRatChars_ratToChars
statement: lemma parseRatChars_ratToChars (q : ℚ) : parseRatChars (ratToChars q) = some q
proof:
:= by
  unfold ratToChars
  split_ifs with hd
  · unfold parseRatChars
    rw [splitOn_not_mem_slash (intToChars q.num) (not_mem_intToChars q.num)]
    change (parseIntChars (intToChars q.num)).map (fun n => (n : ℚ)) = some q
    have hz_parse := parseIntChars_intToChars q.num
    rw [hz_parse]
    dsimp
    have h_eq_q : some ((q.num : ℚ)) = some q := by
      congr 1
      have h_q := rat_ext_eq q
      rw [h_q, hd]
      simp
    rw [h_eq_q]
  · unfold parseRatChars
    have h1 := not_mem_intToChars q.num
    have h2 := not_mem_natToChars_div q.den
    rw [splitOn_append_singleton_append_not_mem_slash
      (intToChars q.num) (natToChars q.den) h1 h2]
    change (match parseIntChars (intToChars q.num), parseNatChars (natToChars q.den) with
            | some num, some den => if den = 0 then none else some ((num : ℚ) / (den : ℚ))
            | _, _ => none) = some q
    rw [parseIntChars_intToChars q.num, parseNatChars_natToChars q.den]
    dsimp
    have hn0 : q.den ≠ 0 := by
      have hpos := q.den_pos
      omega
    rw [ite_eq_right hn0]
    have h_eq_q : some ((q.num : ℚ) / (q.den : ℚ)) = some q := by
      congr 1
      exact (rat_ext_eq q).symm
    rw [h_eq_q]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.scaleRootsAux_length
statement:
theorem scaleRootsAux_length (c : R) : ∀ (k : R) (l : List R),
    (scaleRootsAux c k l).length = l.length
  | _, [] => rfl
  | k, a :: t => by simp [scaleRootsAux, scaleRootsAux_length c (k * c) t]

omit [DecidableEq R] in

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.scaleRootsAux_getD
statement:
theorem scaleRootsAux_getD (c : R) : ∀ (l : List R) (k : R) (i : ℕ),
    (scaleRootsAux c k l).getD i 0 = l.getD i 0 * (k * c ^ i)
  | [], k, i => by simp [scaleRootsAux]
  | a :: t, k, 0 => by simp [scaleRootsAux]
  | a :: t, k, (i + 1) => by
    simp only [scaleRootsAux, List.getD_cons_succ]
    rw [scaleRootsAux_getD c t (k * c) i, pow_succ', mul_assoc]

                                                                               
                                                                                
                                                            
def scaleRoots (p : AzPolynomial R) (b c : R) : AzPolynomial R
proof:
:=
  normalize (((scaleRootsAux b 1 ((scaleRootsAux c 1 p.coeffs.toList).reverse)).reverse).toArray)

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.coeff_scaleRoots
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_scaleRoots (p : AzPolynomial R) (b c : R) (i : ℕ) :
    (p.scaleRoots b c).coeff i = p.coeff i * c ^ i * b ^ (p.natDegree - i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaleRoots, coeff_normalize]
  set L := p.coeffs.toList with hL
  set M := (scaleRootsAux c 1 L).reverse with hM
  have hlenM : M.length = L.length := by rw [hM, List.length_reverse, scaleRootsAux_length]
  rw [List.getElem?_toArray, ← List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
  by_cases hi : i < L.length
  · have h1 : ((scaleRootsAux b 1 M).reverse).getD i 0
        = (scaleRootsAux b 1 M).getD (L.length - 1 - i) 0 := by
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
        List.getElem?_reverse (by rw [scaleRootsAux_length, hlenM]; exact hi),
        scaleRootsAux_length, hlenM, ← List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
    rw [h1, scaleRootsAux_getD, one_mul]
    have h2 : M.getD (L.length - 1 - i) 0 = (scaleRootsAux c 1 L).getD i 0 := by
      rw [hM, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
        List.getElem?_reverse (by rw [scaleRootsAux_length]; omega),
        scaleRootsAux_length, show L.length - 1 - (L.length - 1 - i) = i by omega,
        ← List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
    rw [h2, scaleRootsAux_getD, one_mul]
    have h3 : L.getD i 0 = p.coeff i := by
      rw [hL, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, Array.getElem?_toList]; rfl
    have h4 : L.length - 1 - i = p.natDegree - i := by
      rw [hL, Array.length_toList]; rfl
    rw [h3, h4]
  · have h1 : ((scaleRootsAux b 1 M).reverse).getD i 0 = 0 := by
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_none
        (by rw [List.length_reverse, scaleRootsAux_length, hlenM]; omega)]
      rfl
    have h2 : p.coeff i = 0 := by
      show (p.coeffs[i]?).getD 0 = 0
      rw [Array.getElem?_eq_none (by rw [← Array.length_toList, ← hL]; omega)]; rfl
    rw [h1, h2, zero_mul, zero_mul]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.scaleRoots_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem scaleRoots_zero (b c : R) : (0 : AzPolynomial R).scaleRoots b c = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply AzPolynomial.ext
  show (normalize _).coeffs = #[]
  simp [scaleRootsAux, coeffs_zero, normalize]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.sub_coeff_eq_zero_of_size_le
statement:
private lemma sub_coeff_eq_zero_of_size_le (p : AzPolynomial R) (n : ℕ) (h : p.coeffs.size ≤ n) :
    p.coeff n = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeff, Array.getElem?_eq_none h]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.sub_back_ofFn
statement:
private lemma sub_back_ofFn {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (f : Fin n → R) :
    (Array.ofFn f).back? = some (f ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Array.back?; simp [show n - 1 < n from by omega]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.sub_coeff_at_leading
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeff, hm, show p.coeffs.size - 1 < p.coeffs.size from by omega]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.sub_back_eq_some_zero_of_leading
statement:
private lemma sub_back_eq_some_zero_of_leading (p : AzPolynomial R) (hp : 0 < p.coeffs.size)
    (h : p.coeffs[p.coeffs.size - 1]'(by omega) = 0) : p.coeffs.back? = some 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold Array.back?; simp [show p.coeffs.size - 1 < p.coeffs.size from by omega, h]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.sub_back_ne_zero_of_ne_size
statement:
private lemma sub_back_ne_zero_of_ne_size (p q : AzPolynomial R)
    (hps : 0 < p.coeffs.size) (hqs : 0 < q.coeffs.size)
    (hne : p.coeffs.size ≠ q.coeffs.size) :
    (subArray p q).back? ≠ some 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_back_ofFn (by omega : 0 < max p.coeffs.size q.coeffs.size)]
  intro h; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
  by_cases hpq : p.coeffs.size > q.coeffs.size
  · rw [sub_coeff_eq_zero_of_size_le q _ (by omega), sub_zero,
        sub_coeff_at_leading p _ (by omega) hps] at h
    exact p.last_ne_zero (sub_back_eq_some_zero_of_leading p hps h)
  · rw [sub_coeff_eq_zero_of_size_le p _ (by omega), zero_sub] at h
    have : q.coeff (max p.coeffs.size q.coeffs.size - 1) = q.coeffs[q.coeffs.size - 1]'(by omega) :=
      sub_coeff_at_leading q _ (by omega) hqs
    rw [this] at h
    have hq0 : q.coeffs[q.coeffs.size - 1]'(by omega) = 0 := neg_eq_zero.mp h
    exact q.last_ne_zero (sub_back_eq_some_zero_of_leading q hqs hq0)

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.natDegree_neg
statement:
private theorem natDegree_neg (p : AzPolynomial (AzMvPolynomial k D ord)) :
    (-p).natDegree = p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  simp only [natDegree]
  congr 1
  show (-p).coeffs.size = p.coeffs.size
  change (mapZeroInjective _ _ p).coeffs.size = p.coeffs.size
  simp [mapZeroInjective]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.natDegree_pRem_lt
statement:
private theorem natDegree_pRem_lt
    (P Q : AzPolynomial (AzMvPolynomial k D ord))
    (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (hR : pRem P Q ≠ 0) :
    (pRem P Q).natDegree < Q.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hQP : AzPolynomial.toPoly Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; exact hQ (toPoly_inj.mp (by rw [h, toPoly_zero]))
  have hRP : AzPolynomial.toPoly (pRem P Q) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; exact hR (toPoly_inj.mp (by rw [h, toPoly_zero]))
  have hdeg := degree_toPoly_pRem_lt P Q hQP
  have := Polynomial.natDegree_lt_natDegree hRP hdeg
  rwa [AzPolynomial.natDegree_toPoly, AzPolynomial.natDegree_toPoly] at this

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.natDegree_mem_tru_le
statement:
private theorem natDegree_mem_tru_le
    (p : AzPolynomial (AzMvPolynomial k D ord))
    (child : AzPolynomial (AzMvPolynomial k D ord))
    (hmem : child ∈ tru p) : child.natDegree ≤ p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  unfold tru at hmem
  split_ifs at hmem with h0 hbase
  · simp at hmem
  · rw [List.mem_singleton.mp hmem]
  · rw [List.mem_cons] at hmem
    rcases hmem with rfl | hmem
    · exact le_refl _
    · have ih := natDegree_mem_tru_le _ child hmem
      have := natDegree_truncate_le (p.natDegree - 1) p
      omega

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.natDegree_child_lt_of_mem_tru_neg_pRem
statement:
theorem natDegree_child_lt_of_mem_tru_neg_pRem
    {parentPol curPol child : AzPolynomial (AzMvPolynomial k D ord)}
    (h_ne : curPol ≠ 0)
    (hmem : child ∈ tru (-(pRem parentPol curPol))) :
    child.natDegree < curPol.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h4 : pRem parentPol curPol = 0
  · 
    rw [h4, neg_zero] at hmem; unfold tru at hmem; simp at hmem
  · have h1 := natDegree_mem_tru_le _ child hmem
    have h5 := natDegree_pRem_lt parentPol curPol h_ne h4
    have h6 : (-(pRem parentPol curPol)).natDegree =
        (pRem parentPol curPol).natDegree := natDegree_neg _
    omega

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux_cons
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux_cons
    (c : Char) (cs : List Char) (d : ℕ) (curRev : List Char)
    (accRev : List (List Char)) :
    AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux (c :: cs) d curRev accRev =
      (if c = '+' ∧ d = 0 then
        AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux cs 0 [] (curRev.reverse :: accRev)
      else if c = '(' then
        AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux cs (d + 1) (c :: curRev) accRev
      else if c = ')' then
        AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux cs (d - 1) (c :: curRev) accRev
      else
        AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux cs d (c :: curRev) accRev)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux_cons_neutral
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux_cons_neutral
    (c : Char) (cs curRev : List Char) (accRev : List (List Char)) (d : ℕ)
    (hlp : c ≠ '(') (hrp : c ≠ ')') (htop : c = '+' → d ≠ 0) :
    AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux (c :: cs) d curRev accRev =
    AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux cs d (c :: curRev) accRev
proof:
:= by
  rw [splitTermsAux_cons]
  by_cases h_plus : c = '+'
  · have hd : d ≠ 0 := htop h_plus
    rw [ite_eq_right (fun ⟨_, hd0⟩ => hd hd0), ite_eq_right (h_plus ▸ hlp), ite_eq_right (h_plus ▸ hrp)]
  · rw [ite_eq_right (fun ⟨hp, _⟩ => h_plus hp), ite_eq_right hlp, ite_eq_right hrp]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux_consume_neutral
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux_consume_neutral
    (t : List Char) (cs : List Char) (d : ℕ) (accRev : List (List Char))
    (h1 : '(' ∉ t) (h2 : ')' ∉ t) (htop : d = 0 → '+' ∉ t) :
    ∀ curRev : List Char,
    AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux (t ++ cs) d curRev accRev =
    AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux cs d (t.reverse ++ curRev) accRev
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | nil => intro curRev; simp
  | cons c t' ih =>
    intro curRev
    have hc1 : c ≠ '(' := fun h => h1 (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have hc2 : c ≠ ')' := fun h => h2 (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have hctop : c = '+' → d ≠ 0 := fun h hd =>
      htop hd (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have ht1 : '(' ∉ t' := fun hc => h1 (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc)
    have ht2 : ')' ∉ t' := fun hc => h2 (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc)
    have httop : d = 0 → '+' ∉ t' :=
      fun hd hc => htop hd (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc)
    rw [List.cons_append, splitTermsAux_cons_neutral c _ _ _ _ hc1 hc2 hctop,
        ih ht1 ht2 httop]
    simp

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux_consume_paren_wrapped
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux_consume_paren_wrapped
    (inner cs : List Char) (d : ℕ) (accRev : List (List Char))
    (h1 : '(' ∉ inner) (h2 : ')' ∉ inner) :
    ∀ curRev : List Char,
    AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux ('(' :: inner ++ ')' :: cs) d curRev accRev =
    AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux cs d (')' :: (inner.reverse ++ '(' :: curRev)) accRev
proof:
:= by
  intro curRev
  
  have hrewrite : ('(' :: inner ++ ')' :: cs) = '(' :: (inner ++ ')' :: cs) := by simp
  rw [hrewrite]
  
  rw [splitTermsAux_cons]
  rw [ite_eq_right (fun ⟨hp, _⟩ => absurd hp (by decide : ('(' : Char) ≠ '+'))]
  rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
  
  rw [splitTermsAux_consume_neutral inner (')' :: cs) (d + 1) accRev h1 h2
      (fun hd => by omega) ('(' :: curRev)]
  
  rw [splitTermsAux_cons]
  rw [ite_eq_right (fun ⟨hp, _⟩ => absurd hp (by decide : (')' : Char) ≠ '+'))]
  rw [ite_eq_right (by decide : ¬(')' : Char) = '(')]
  rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
  show AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux cs (d + 1 - 1) _ _ = _
  rw [show d + 1 - 1 = d from by omega]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.IsTerm.ofNoParensNoPlus
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.IsTerm.ofNoParensNoPlus
    {t : List Char} (h1 : '(' ∉ t) (h2 : ')' ∉ t) (h3 : '+' ∉ t) :
    AzPolynomial.IsTerm t
proof:
:= fun cs curRev accRev =>
  AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux_consume_neutral t cs 0 accRev h1 h2 (fun _ => h3) curRev

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.IsTerm.ofWrapped
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.IsTerm.ofWrapped
    {inner tail : List Char}
    (h_in_lp : '(' ∉ inner) (h_in_rp : ')' ∉ inner)
    (h_tail_lp : '(' ∉ tail) (h_tail_rp : ')' ∉ tail) (h_tail_pl : '+' ∉ tail) :
    AzPolynomial.IsTerm ('(' :: inner ++ ')' :: tail)
proof:
:= by
  intro cs curRev accRev
  have hreassoc : ('(' :: inner ++ ')' :: tail) ++ cs = ('(' :: inner ++ ')' :: (tail ++ cs)) := by
    simp
  rw [hreassoc]
  rw [AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux_consume_paren_wrapped inner (tail ++ cs) 0 accRev h_in_lp h_in_rp curRev]
  rw [AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux_consume_neutral tail cs 0 accRev h_tail_lp h_tail_rp
        (fun _ => h_tail_pl) _]
  congr 1
  simp

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.xPowerChars_isTerm
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.xPowerChars_isTerm (i : ℕ) :
    AzPolynomial.IsTerm (AzPolynomial.xPowerChars i)
proof:
:=
  AzPolynomial.IsTerm.ofNoParensNoPlus
    (AzPolynomial.xPowerChars_no_lparen i)
    (AzPolynomial.xPowerChars_no_rparen i)
    (AzPolynomial.xPowerChars_no_plus i)

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith_isTerm
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith_isTerm
    (c : AzMvPolynomial n R ord) (i : ℕ) :
    AzPolynomial.IsTerm (AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith F c i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith
  by_cases h1 : c = 1 ∧ i ≠ 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left h1]; exact AzPolynomial.xPowerChars_isTerm i
  · rw [ite_eq_right h1]
    by_cases h2 : i = 0
    · 
      rw [show (if i = 0 then ('(' :: c.toCharsWith F ++ [')'] : List Char)
            else '(' :: c.toCharsWith F ++ [')'] ++ '*' :: AzPolynomial.xPowerChars i)
          = '(' :: c.toCharsWith F ++ ')' :: [] from by simp [h2]]
      exact AzPolynomial.IsTerm.ofWrapped
        (AzMvPolynomial.toCharsWith_no_lparen F c)
        (AzMvPolynomial.toCharsWith_no_rparen F c)
        (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)
    · 
      rw [show (if i = 0 then ('(' :: c.toCharsWith F ++ [')'] : List Char)
            else '(' :: c.toCharsWith F ++ [')'] ++ '*' :: AzPolynomial.xPowerChars i)
          = '(' :: c.toCharsWith F ++ ')' :: ('*' :: AzPolynomial.xPowerChars i) from by
            rw [ite_eq_right h2]; simp]
      refine AzPolynomial.IsTerm.ofWrapped
        (AzMvPolynomial.toCharsWith_no_lparen F c)
        (AzMvPolynomial.toCharsWith_no_rparen F c)
        ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro hc
        simp only [List.mem_cons] at hc
        rcases hc with heq | hc
        · exact absurd heq (by decide)
        · exact AzPolynomial.xPowerChars_no_lparen i hc
      · intro hc
        simp only [List.mem_cons] at hc
        rcases hc with heq | hc
        · exact absurd heq (by decide)
        · exact AzPolynomial.xPowerChars_no_rparen i hc
      · intro hc
        simp only [List.mem_cons] at hc
        rcases hc with heq | hc
        · exact absurd heq (by decide)
        · exact AzPolynomial.xPowerChars_no_plus i hc

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.parseBareX_xPowerChars
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.parseBareX_xPowerChars (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    AzPolynomial.parseBareX (AzPolynomial.xPowerChars i) = some i
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzPolynomial.xPowerChars
  rw [ite_eq_right hi]
  by_cases h1 : i = 1
  · rw [ite_eq_left h1, h1]; rfl
  · rw [ite_eq_right h1]
    show AzPolynomial.parseBareX ('x' :: '^' :: natToChars i) = some i
    simp [AzPolynomial.parseBareX, parseNatChars_natToChars]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.parseCoeffSuffix_mul_xPowerChars
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.parseCoeffSuffix_mul_xPowerChars (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    AzPolynomial.parseCoeffSuffix ('*' :: AzPolynomial.xPowerChars i) = some i
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzPolynomial.xPowerChars
  rw [ite_eq_right hi]
  by_cases h1 : i = 1
  · rw [ite_eq_left h1, h1]; rfl
  · rw [ite_eq_right h1]
    show AzPolynomial.parseCoeffSuffix ('*' :: 'x' :: '^' :: natToChars i) = some i
    simp [AzPolynomial.parseCoeffSuffix, parseNatChars_natToChars]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.parseOneTermMvCoeff_wrapped
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.parseOneTermMvCoeff_wrapped
    (c : AzMvPolynomial n R ord) (suffix : List Char) (i : ℕ)
    (hsuf : AzPolynomial.parseCoeffSuffix suffix = some i) :
    AzPolynomial.parseOneTermMvCoeff F ('(' :: (c.toCharsWith F ++ ')' :: suffix)) =
      some (c, i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzPolynomial.parseOneTermMvCoeff
  have h_norp : ')' ∉ c.toCharsWith F := AzMvPolynomial.toCharsWith_no_rparen F c
  have h_all : ∀ x ∈ c.toCharsWith F, (x != ')') = true :=
    fun x hx => by simp; intro h; exact h_norp (h ▸ hx)
  have htw : List.takeWhile (· != ')') (c.toCharsWith F ++ ')' :: suffix) = c.toCharsWith F := by
    rw [List.takeWhile_append, (List.takeWhile_eq_self_iff).mpr h_all]
    simp
  have hdw : List.dropWhile (· != ')') (c.toCharsWith F ++ ')' :: suffix) = ')' :: suffix := by
    rw [List.dropWhile_append, (List.dropWhile_eq_nil_iff).mpr h_all]
    simp
  simp only [List.span_eq_takeWhile_dropWhile, htw, hdw]
  simp only [hsuf, Option.bind_some, AzMvPolynomial.parseWith_toCharsWith, Option.map_some]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.parseOneTermMvCoeff_termCharsMvCoeffWith
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.parseOneTermMvCoeff_termCharsMvCoeffWith
    (c : AzMvPolynomial n R ord) (i : ℕ) :
    AzPolynomial.parseOneTermMvCoeff F (AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith F c i) =
      some (c, i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith
  by_cases h1 : c = 1 ∧ i ≠ 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left h1]
    obtain ⟨hc, hi⟩ := h1
    subst hc
    
    have hx : ∃ rest, AzPolynomial.xPowerChars i = 'x' :: rest := by
      unfold AzPolynomial.xPowerChars
      rw [ite_eq_right hi]
      by_cases h1' : i = 1
      · rw [ite_eq_left h1']; exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
      · rw [ite_eq_right h1']; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨rest, hrest⟩ := hx
    rw [hrest]
    show ((AzPolynomial.parseBareX ('x' :: rest)).map (fun i => (1, i))) = some (1, i)
    rw [← hrest, parseBareX_xPowerChars i hi]
    rfl
  · rw [ite_eq_right h1]
    by_cases h2 : i = 0
    · subst h2
      simp only
      
      have : ('(' :: c.toCharsWith F ++ [')'] : List Char) =
          '(' :: (c.toCharsWith F ++ ')' :: []) := by simp
      rw [this]
      exact parseOneTermMvCoeff_wrapped F c [] 0 rfl
    · rw [ite_eq_right h2]
      
      have : ('(' :: c.toCharsWith F ++ [')'] ++ '*' :: AzPolynomial.xPowerChars i) =
          '(' :: (c.toCharsWith F ++ ')' :: ('*' :: AzPolynomial.xPowerChars i)) := by simp
      rw [this]
      exact parseOneTermMvCoeff_wrapped F c _ i
        (parseCoeffSuffix_mul_xPowerChars i h2)

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux_joinWithPlus
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux_joinWithPlus
    {ts : List (List Char)} (hts : ∀ t ∈ ts, AzPolynomial.IsTerm t) (hne : ts ≠ []) :
    ∀ accRev : List (List Char),
    AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux (AzPolynomial.joinWithPlus ts) 0 [] accRev =
    accRev.reverse ++ ts
proof:
:= by
  induction ts with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
  | cons t rest ih =>
    intro accRev
    match hrest : rest with
    | [] =>
      
      simp only [AzPolynomial.joinWithPlus]
      have ht : AzPolynomial.IsTerm t := hts t (List.mem_cons_self ..)
      
      have : AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux t 0 [] accRev =
          AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux [] 0 (t.reverse ++ []) accRev := by
        have := ht [] [] accRev
        simpa using this
      rw [this]
      simp [AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux]
    | t' :: rest' =>
      
      have hjoin : AzPolynomial.joinWithPlus (t :: t' :: rest') =
          t ++ '+' :: AzPolynomial.joinWithPlus (t' :: rest') := rfl
      rw [hjoin]
      have ht : AzPolynomial.IsTerm t := hts t (List.mem_cons_self ..)
      
      have h1 : AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux (t ++ '+' :: AzPolynomial.joinWithPlus (t' :: rest'))
                  0 [] accRev =
          AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux ('+' :: AzPolynomial.joinWithPlus (t' :: rest')) 0
              (t.reverse ++ []) accRev := ht _ _ _
      rw [h1]
      
      rw [splitTermsAux_cons]
      rw [ite_eq_left ⟨rfl, rfl⟩]
      simp only [List.append_nil, List.reverse_reverse]
      
      have hts' : ∀ s ∈ (t' :: rest'), AzPolynomial.IsTerm s :=
        fun s hs => hts s (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hs)
      have hne' : (t' :: rest') ≠ [] := by simp
      rw [ih hts' hne' (t :: accRev)]
      simp

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.splitTerms_joinWithPlus
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.splitTerms_joinWithPlus
    {ts : List (List Char)} (hts : ∀ t ∈ ts, AzPolynomial.IsTerm t) (hne : ts ≠ []) :
    AzPolynomial.splitTerms (AzPolynomial.joinWithPlus ts) = ts
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzPolynomial.splitTerms
  have := AzPolynomial.splitTermsAux_joinWithPlus hts hne []
  simpa using this

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.foldl_add_monomial_toPoly
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.foldl_add_monomial_toPoly
    {S : Type _} [DecidableEq S] [CommSemiring S]
    (L : List (S × ℕ)) (init : AzPolynomial S) :
    AzPolynomial.toPoly
      (L.foldl (fun acc x => acc + AzPolynomial.monomial x.2 x.1) init) =
    AzPolynomial.toPoly init +
      (L.map (fun x => (Polynomial.monomial x.2) x.1)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction L generalizing init with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x L' ih =>
    show AzPolynomial.toPoly
      (L'.foldl _ (init + AzPolynomial.monomial x.2 x.1)) = _
    rw [ih (init + AzPolynomial.monomial x.2 x.1)]
    rw [toPoly_add, toPoly_monomial]
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    rw [add_assoc]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.listRange_map_sum
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.listRange_map_sum
    {M : Type _} [AddCommMonoid M] (N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → M) :
    ((List.range N).map f).sum = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, f i
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih => simp [List.range_succ, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.sum_filterMap_eq_sum_range
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.sum_filterMap_eq_sum_range
    {S : Type _} [CommSemiring S] [DecidableEq S] (p : AzPolynomial S) (N : ℕ) :
    (((List.range N).reverse.filterMap
        (fun i => if p.coeff i = 0 then none else some (p.coeff i, i))).map
          (fun x => (Polynomial.monomial x.2) x.1)).sum =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (Polynomial.monomial i) (p.coeff i)
proof:
:= by
  
  have step1 :
      (((List.range N).reverse.filterMap
          (fun i => if p.coeff i = 0 then none else some (p.coeff i, i))).map
            (fun x => (Polynomial.monomial x.2) x.1)) =
      ((List.range N).reverse.filterMap
        (fun i => if p.coeff i = 0 then none
                  else some ((Polynomial.monomial i) (p.coeff i)))) := by
    rw [List.map_filterMap]
    congr 1
    funext i
    by_cases h : p.coeff i = 0 <;> simp [h]
  rw [step1]
  
  have step2 :
      (((List.range N).reverse.filterMap
          (fun i => if p.coeff i = 0 then none
                    else some ((Polynomial.monomial i) (p.coeff i)))).sum) =
      (((List.range N).reverse.map
          (fun i => (Polynomial.monomial i) (p.coeff i))).sum) := by
    induction (List.range N).reverse with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons i L' ih =>
      by_cases h : p.coeff i = 0
      · rw [List.filterMap_cons]
        simp only [h, ite_true]
        rw [ih]
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
        rw [h, Polynomial.monomial_zero_right, zero_add]
      · rw [List.filterMap_cons]
        simp only [h, ite_false]
        rw [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.sum_cons, ih]
  rw [step2]
  
  rw [show ((List.range N).reverse.map (fun i => (Polynomial.monomial i) (p.coeff i)))
        = ((List.range N).map (fun i => (Polynomial.monomial i) (p.coeff i))).reverse from by
      rw [List.map_reverse]]
  rw [List.sum_reverse]
  rw [listRange_map_sum]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.foldl_monomial_recovers_poly
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.foldl_monomial_recovers_poly
    {S : Type _} [CommSemiring S] [DecidableEq S]
    (p : AzPolynomial S) (N : ℕ) (hN : p.coeffs.size ≤ N) :
    (((List.range N).reverse.filterMap
        (fun i => if p.coeff i = 0 then none else some (p.coeff i, i))).foldl
      (fun acc x => acc + AzPolynomial.monomial x.2 x.1) 0) = p
proof:
:= by
  
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · subst hp0
    
    have hempty : (List.range N).reverse.filterMap
        (fun i => if (0 : AzPolynomial S).coeff i = 0 then none else some ((0 : AzPolynomial S).coeff i, i))
        = [] := by
      apply List.filterMap_eq_nil_iff.mpr
      intro i _
      simp [AzPolynomial.coeff]
    rw [hempty, List.foldl_nil]
  apply toPoly_inj.mp
  rw [foldl_add_monomial_toPoly, sum_filterMap_eq_sum_range]
  rw [toPoly_zero, zero_add]
  
  have hbound : (AzPolynomial.toPoly p).natDegree < N := by
    have hs : p.coeffs.size ≠ 0 := fun h => hp0 (AzPolynomial.ext (Array.eq_empty_of_size_eq_zero h))
    have hpos : 0 < p.coeffs.size := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hs
    apply Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.sub_lt hpos Nat.one_pos) hN)
    apply Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
    intro m hm
    rw [coeff_toPoly_eq]
    have hm' : p.coeffs.size ≤ m := by omega
    simp [AzPolynomial.coeff, Array.getElem?_eq_none hm']
  rw [Polynomial.as_sum_range' (AzPolynomial.toPoly p) N hbound]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [coeff_toPoly_eq]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith_head_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith_head_ne_zero
    (c : AzMvPolynomial n R ord) (i : ℕ) :
    ∃ ch t, AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith F c i = ch :: t ∧ ch ≠ '0'
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith
  by_cases h1 : c = 1 ∧ i ≠ 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left h1]
    unfold AzPolynomial.xPowerChars
    rw [ite_eq_right h1.2]
    by_cases h2 : i = 1
    · rw [ite_eq_left h2]; exact ⟨'x', [], rfl, by decide⟩
    · rw [ite_eq_right h2]; exact ⟨'x', _, rfl, by decide⟩
  · rw [ite_eq_right h1]
    by_cases h2 : i = 0
    · rw [ite_eq_left h2]
      exact ⟨'(', c.toCharsWith F ++ [')'], by simp, by decide⟩
    · rw [ite_eq_right h2]
      refine ⟨'(', c.toCharsWith F ++ [')'] ++ '*' :: AzPolynomial.xPowerChars i, ?_, by decide⟩
      simp

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.coeff_size_sub_one_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.coeff_size_sub_one_ne_zero
    {S : Type _} [Semiring S] [DecidableEq S]
    (p : AzPolynomial S) (hp : p.coeffs.size ≠ 0) :
    p.coeff (p.coeffs.size - 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply p.last_ne_zero
  have hpos : 0 < p.coeffs.size := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hp
  have hlt : p.coeffs.size - 1 < p.coeffs.size := Nat.sub_lt hpos Nat.one_pos
  have hback : p.coeffs.back? = some (p.coeffs[p.coeffs.size - 1]'hlt) := by
    simp [Array.back?, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt]
  rw [hback]
  congr 1
  have : p.coeffs[p.coeffs.size - 1]'hlt = p.coeff (p.coeffs.size - 1) := by
    simp [AzPolynomial.coeff, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt]
  rw [this, h]

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.reverse_range_cons
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.reverse_range_cons
    {sz : ℕ} (hsz : 0 < sz) :
    (List.range sz).reverse =
      (sz - 1) :: (List.range (sz - 1)).reverse
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [show sz = (sz - 1) + 1 from (Nat.sub_add_cancel hsz).symm]
  rw [List.range_succ, List.reverse_append]
  simp

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.terms_ne_nil
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.terms_ne_nil
    (p : AzPolynomial (AzMvPolynomial n R ord)) (hp : p.coeffs.size ≠ 0) :
    ((List.range p.coeffs.size).reverse.filterMap (fun i =>
        let c := p.coeff i
        if c = 0 then none else
          some (AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith F c i))) ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < p.coeffs.size := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hp
  have hlast := AzPolynomial.coeff_size_sub_one_ne_zero p hp
  rw [AzPolynomial.reverse_range_cons hpos]
  simp only [List.filterMap_cons]
  rw [ite_eq_right hlast]
  simp

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.toCharsMvCoeffWith_ne_zeroChar
statement:
private theorem AzPolynomial.toCharsMvCoeffWith_ne_zeroChar
    (p : AzPolynomial (AzMvPolynomial n R ord)) (hp : p.coeffs.size ≠ 0) :
    AzPolynomial.toCharsMvCoeffWith F p ≠ ['0']
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzPolynomial.toCharsMvCoeffWith
  rw [ite_eq_right hp]
  have hpos : 0 < p.coeffs.size := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hp
  have hlast := AzPolynomial.coeff_size_sub_one_ne_zero p hp
  rw [AzPolynomial.reverse_range_cons hpos]
  simp only [List.filterMap_cons]
  rw [ite_eq_right hlast]
  
  obtain ⟨ch, tl, heq, hch⟩ :=
    AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith_head_ne_zero F
      (p.coeff (p.coeffs.size - 1)) (p.coeffs.size - 1)
  rw [heq]
  
  generalize ((List.range (p.coeffs.size - 1)).reverse.filterMap (fun i =>
      let c := p.coeff i
      if c = 0 then none else
        some (AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith F c i))) = L
  intro hc
  match L with
  | [] =>
    
    have : AzPolynomial.joinWithPlus ([ch :: tl]) = ch :: tl := rfl
    rw [this] at hc
    rw [List.cons.injEq] at hc
    exact hch hc.1
  | t :: rest =>
    
    have : AzPolynomial.joinWithPlus ((ch :: tl) :: t :: rest) =
        ch :: (tl ++ '+' :: AzPolynomial.joinWithPlus (t :: rest)) := by
      show (ch :: tl) ++ '+' :: AzPolynomial.joinWithPlus (t :: rest) = _
      simp
    rw [this] at hc
    rw [List.cons.injEq] at hc
    exact hch hc.1

name: Azurite.AzPolynomial.parseMvCoeffWith_toCharsMvCoeffWith
statement:
theorem AzPolynomial.parseMvCoeffWith_toCharsMvCoeffWith
    (p : AzPolynomial (AzMvPolynomial n R ord)) :
    AzPolynomial.parseMvCoeffWith F (AzPolynomial.toCharsMvCoeffWith F p) = some p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp0 : p.coeffs.size = 0
  · 
    have hp : p = 0 := AzPolynomial.ext (Array.eq_empty_of_size_eq_zero hp0)
    subst hp
    unfold AzPolynomial.parseMvCoeffWith AzPolynomial.toCharsMvCoeffWith
    simp
  · 
    have hne : AzPolynomial.toCharsMvCoeffWith F p ≠ ['0'] :=
      AzPolynomial.toCharsMvCoeffWith_ne_zeroChar F p hp0
    unfold AzPolynomial.parseMvCoeffWith
    rw [ite_eq_right hne]
    
    let indices := (List.range p.coeffs.size).reverse
    let terms : List (List Char) := indices.filterMap (fun i =>
      let c := p.coeff i
      if c = 0 then none else some (AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith F c i))
    let pairs : List (AzMvPolynomial n R ord × ℕ) := indices.filterMap (fun i =>
      if p.coeff i = 0 then none else some (p.coeff i, i))
    
    have htoCs : AzPolynomial.toCharsMvCoeffWith F p = AzPolynomial.joinWithPlus terms := by
      unfold AzPolynomial.toCharsMvCoeffWith
      rw [ite_eq_right hp0]
    rw [htoCs]
    
    have hterms_isTerm : ∀ t ∈ terms, AzPolynomial.IsTerm t := by
      intro t ht
      simp only [terms, List.mem_filterMap] at ht
      obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := ht
      by_cases hc : p.coeff i = 0
      · rw [ite_eq_left hc] at hi; exact absurd hi (by simp)
      · rw [ite_eq_right hc] at hi
        rw [Option.some.injEq] at hi
        rw [← hi]
        exact AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith_isTerm F (p.coeff i) i
    have hterms_ne : terms ≠ [] := AzPolynomial.terms_ne_nil F p hp0
    rw [AzPolynomial.splitTerms_joinWithPlus hterms_isTerm hterms_ne]
    
    have hmapM : terms.mapM (AzPolynomial.parseOneTermMvCoeff F) = some pairs := by
      show (indices.filterMap
            (fun i =>
              let c := p.coeff i
              if c = 0 then none else
                some (AzPolynomial.termCharsMvCoeffWith F c i))).mapM
            (AzPolynomial.parseOneTermMvCoeff F) =
          some (indices.filterMap
            (fun i => if p.coeff i = 0 then none else some (p.coeff i, i)))
      induction indices with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons i rest ih =>
        simp only [List.filterMap_cons]
        by_cases hc : p.coeff i = 0
        · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte]
          exact ih
        · simp only [hc, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [List.mapM_cons,
              AzPolynomial.parseOneTermMvCoeff_termCharsMvCoeffWith F]
          simp [ih]
    rw [hmapM]
    
    show some (pairs.foldl (fun acc x => acc + AzPolynomial.monomial x.2 x.1) 0) = some p
    rw [AzPolynomial.foldl_monomial_recovers_poly p p.coeffs.size (le_refl _)]

name: Azurite.rootsPoly_eval_zero_ne
statement: theorem rootsPoly_eval_zero_ne (n : ℕ) : (rootsPoly n).eval 0 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootsPoly, eval_prod]
  exact prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun _k _ => by simp; omega

name: Azurite.mem_aroots_rootsPoly
statement:
theorem mem_aroots_rootsPoly {n k : ℕ} (hk : k < n) :
    ((k : ℂ) + 1) ∈ (rootsPoly n).aroots ℂ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_aroots]
  refine ⟨rootsPoly_ne_zero n, ?_⟩
  rw [rootsPoly, map_prod]
  exact prod_eq_zero (mem_range.mpr hk) (by simp)

name: Azurite.aeval_exp_one_ne_zero
statement: theorem aeval_exp_one_ne_zero {Q : ℤ[X]} (hQ0 : Q.eval 0 ≠ 0) : aeval (Real.exp 1) Q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hQe
  set n := Q.natDegree with hn
  have ha0 : Q.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := by rwa [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]
  
  have hsum : ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), (Q.coeff k : ℂ) * Complex.exp k = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ)) hQe
    rw [aeval_eq_sum_range] at h
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_zero] at h
    rw [← h]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    simp only [zsmul_eq_mul, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_intCast, Complex.ofReal_pow,
      Complex.ofReal_exp, Complex.ofReal_one, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul, mul_one]
  have hsum' : (Q.coeff 0 : ℂ)
      + ∑ k ∈ range n, (Q.coeff (k + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((k : ℂ) + 1) = 0 := by
    rw [sum_range_succ', Nat.cast_zero, Complex.exp_zero, mul_one, add_comm] at hsum
    rw [← hsum]
    congr 1
    exact sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by push_cast; ring_nf
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := LindemannWeierstrass.exp_polynomial_approx (rootsPoly n)
    (rootsPoly_eval_zero_ne n)
  set A : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ range n, ‖((Q.coeff (k + 1) : ℤ) : ℂ)‖ with hA
  
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun p : ℕ => A * (c ^ p / ((p - 1)! : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h2 : Tendsto (fun p : ℕ => c ^ (p - 1) / ((p - 1)! : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
      (FloorSemiring.tendsto_pow_div_factorial_atTop c).comp (tendsto_sub_atTop_nat 1)
    have h3 : Tendsto (fun p : ℕ => A * c * (c ^ (p - 1) / ((p - 1)! : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using h2.const_mul (A * c)
    refine h3.congr' (eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨1, fun p hp => ?_⟩)
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, p = m + 1 := ⟨p - 1, by omega⟩
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ]
    ring
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (hlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds one_pos))
  
  obtain ⟨p, hpN, hp⟩ := Nat.exists_infinite_primes
    (max N (max ((rootsPoly n).eval 0).natAbs (Q.eval 0).natAbs) + 1)
  obtain ⟨nₚ, hnp, gₚ, -, hbound⟩ := hc p (by omega) hp
  
  have hg : ∀ k : ℕ, aeval ((k : ℂ) + 1) gₚ = ((gₚ.eval ((k : ℤ) + 1) : ℤ) : ℂ) := fun k => by
    have e : ((k : ℂ) + 1) = algebraMap ℤ ℂ ((k : ℤ) + 1) := by simp
    rw [e, aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval]
    simp
  
  set E : ℤ := Q.coeff 0 * nₚ + p * ∑ k ∈ range n, Q.coeff (k + 1) * gₚ.eval ((k : ℤ) + 1)
    with hEdef
  have hE : (E : ℂ) = ∑ k ∈ range n, (Q.coeff (k + 1) : ℂ)
      * ((p : ℂ) * aeval ((k : ℂ) + 1) gₚ - (nₚ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((k : ℂ) + 1)) := by
    have e1 : ∑ k ∈ range n, (Q.coeff (k + 1) : ℂ)
        * ((p : ℂ) * aeval ((k : ℂ) + 1) gₚ - (nₚ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((k : ℂ) + 1))
        = (p : ℂ) * ∑ k ∈ range n, (Q.coeff (k + 1) : ℂ) * aeval ((k : ℂ) + 1) gₚ
          - (nₚ : ℂ) * ∑ k ∈ range n, (Q.coeff (k + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((k : ℂ) + 1) := by
      rw [mul_sum, mul_sum, ← sum_sub_distrib]
      exact sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by ring
    rw [e1]
    simp only [hEdef, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_sum, hg]
    linear_combination (nₚ : ℂ) * hsum'
  
  have hEle : ‖(E : ℂ)‖ ≤ A * (c ^ p / ((p - 1)! : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hE, hA, sum_mul]
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (sum_le_sum fun k hk => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (norm_nonneg _)
    have hb := hbound (mem_aroots_rootsPoly (mem_range.mp hk))
    rwa [zsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, ← norm_neg, neg_sub] at hb
  have hlt : ‖(E : ℂ)‖ < 1 := hEle.trans_lt (hN p (by omega))
  have hE0 : E = 0 := by
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_intCast, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, ← Int.cast_abs] at hlt
    exact Int.abs_lt_one_iff.mp (by exact_mod_cast hlt)
  
  have hdvd : (p : ℤ) ∣ Q.coeff 0 * nₚ := by
    rw [hEdef] at hE0
    exact ⟨-(∑ k ∈ range n, Q.coeff (k + 1) * gₚ.eval ((k : ℤ) + 1)), by linear_combination hE0⟩
  rcases (Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.mp hp).dvd_or_dvd hdvd with h | h
  · have h1 : p ∣ (Q.coeff 0).natAbs := by
      have := Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr h
      simpa using this
    have h2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr ha0) h1
    rw [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero] at h2
    omega
  · exact hnp h

name: Azurite.transcendental_exp_one_int
statement: theorem transcendental_exp_one_int : Transcendental ℤ (Real.exp 1)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨P, hP0, hPe⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hPQ, hQ⟩ := exists_eq_pow_rootMultiplicity_mul_and_not_dvd P hP0 0
  rw [map_zero, sub_zero] at hPQ hQ
  have hQ0 : Q.eval 0 ≠ 0 := by rwa [← coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, Ne, ← X_dvd_iff]
  have hQe : aeval (Real.exp 1) Q = 0 := by
    rw [hPQ, map_mul, map_pow, aeval_X] at hPe
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hPe).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ (Real.exp_pos 1).ne')
  exact aeval_exp_one_ne_zero hQ0 hQe

name: Azurite.transcendental_exp_one
statement: theorem transcendental_exp_one : Transcendental ℚ (Real.exp 1)
proof:
:= fun h =>
  transcendental_exp_one_int ((IsFractionRing.isAlgebraic_iff ℤ ℚ ℝ).mpr h)

name: Azurite.transcendental_exp_nat
statement: theorem transcendental_exp_nat {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : Transcendental ℚ (Real.exp m)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply transcendental_exp_one
  refine IsAlgebraic.of_pow hm ?_
  rwa [← Real.exp_nat_mul, mul_one]

name: Azurite.transcendental_exp_rat
statement: theorem transcendental_exp_rat {q : ℚ} (hq : q ≠ 0) : Transcendental ℚ (Real.exp q)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hnum : q.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hq
  have h1 : IsAlgebraic ℚ (Real.exp q.num) := by
    have := h.pow q.den
    rwa [← Real.exp_nat_mul, show (q.den : ℝ) * q = (q.num : ℝ) by
      rw [mul_comm]; exact_mod_cast Rat.mul_den_eq_num q] at this
  have hm : 0 < q.num.natAbs := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hnum
  apply transcendental_exp_nat hm
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hnum with hneg | hpos
  · have e : (q.num : ℝ) = -(q.num.natAbs : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Int.cast_natCast, Int.natCast_natAbs, Int.cast_abs, abs_of_neg (by exact_mod_cast hneg)]
      ring
    rw [e, Real.exp_neg] at h1
    exact IsAlgebraic.inv_iff.mp h1
  · have e : (q.num : ℝ) = (q.num.natAbs : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Int.cast_natCast, Int.natCast_natAbs, Int.cast_abs, abs_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hpos)]
    rwa [e] at h1

name: Azurite.irrational_exp_one
statement: theorem irrational_exp_one : Irrational (Real.exp 1)
proof: := transcendental_exp_one.irrational

name: Azurite.irrational_exp_rat
statement: theorem irrational_exp_rat {q : ℚ} (hq : q ≠ 0) : Irrational (Real.exp q)
proof:
:=
  (transcendental_exp_rat hq).irrational

name: Azurite.irrational_log_rat
statement: theorem irrational_log_rat {r : ℚ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≠ 1) : Irrational (Real.log r)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    have : Real.log (r : ℝ) = 0 := by rw [← hq]; simp
    rw [Real.log_eq_zero] at this
    rcases this with h | h | h
    · exact absurd h (by exact_mod_cast hr.ne')
    · exact hr1 (by exact_mod_cast h)
    · have : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
      linarith
  apply transcendental_exp_rat hq0
  rw [hq, Real.exp_log (by exact_mod_cast hr)]
  exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap r

name: Azurite.irrational_log_two
statement: theorem irrational_log_two : Irrational (Real.log 2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using irrational_log_rat (r := 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

name: Azurite.AzInt.toInt_injective
statement: private theorem toInt_injective {a b : AzInt} (h : a.toInt = b.toInt) : a = b
proof:
:= by

name: Azurite.AzInt.toInt_natCast
statement: @[simp] theorem toInt_natCast (n : ℕ) : (n : AzInt).toInt = n
proof:

name: Azurite.AzInt.toInt_intCast
statement: @[simp] theorem toInt_intCast (i : ℤ) : (i : AzInt).toInt = i
proof: := toInt_ofInt i

name: Azurite.AzInt.ofNat_ne_zero
statement:
theorem ofNat_ne_zero (k : ℕ) [inst : k.AtLeastTwo] :
    (OfNat.ofNat k : AzInt) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h2 := congrArg AzInt.toInt h
  rw [show (OfNat.ofNat k : AzInt) = ((k : ℕ) : AzInt) from rfl,
    toInt_natCast] at h2
  simp at h2
  have hk : 2 ≤ k := inst.prop
  omega

name: Azurite.AzInt.neg_ofNat_ne_zero
statement:
theorem neg_ofNat_ne_zero (k : ℕ) [inst : k.AtLeastTwo] :
    (-(OfNat.ofNat k) : AzInt) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h2 := congrArg AzInt.toInt h
  rw [show (-(OfNat.ofNat k) : AzInt) = -((k : ℕ) : AzInt) from rfl,
    toInt_neg, toInt_natCast] at h2
  simp at h2
  have hk : 2 ≤ k := inst.prop
  omega

name: Azurite.Random.nonzero_int_random_gen_nonzero
statement:
theorem nonzero_int_random_gen_nonzero (ig : NonzeroIntRandomGen) :
    let (v, _)
proof:
:= NonzeroIntRandomGen.next ig
    v ≠ 0 := by
  simp only [NonzeroIntRandomGen.next, PairRandomGen.next]
  rw [show RandomGen.next ig.pairGen.gen2 = PositiveNatRandomGen.next ig.pairGen.gen2 from rfl]
  
  have hpos : 1 ≤ (PositiveNatRandomGen.next ig.pairGen.gen2).1 :=
    positive_nat_random_gen_positive ig.pairGen.gen2
  have hX : (PositiveNatRandomGen.next ig.pairGen.gen2).1 ≠ 0 := by omega
  
  by_cases hsign : (RandomGen.next ig.pairGen.gen1).1 = true <;>
    simp only [hsign, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_true, ite_false] <;>
    simpa using hX

name: Azurite.Random.nonzero_rat_random_gen_nonzero
statement:
theorem nonzero_rat_random_gen_nonzero (rg : NonzeroRatRandomGen) :
    let (v, _)
proof:
:= NonzeroRatRandomGen.next rg
    v ≠ 0 := by
  simp only [NonzeroRatRandomGen.next, PairRandomGen.next]
  have h_num := nonzero_int_random_gen_nonzero rg.pairGen.gen1
  set num := (NonzeroIntRandomGen.next rg.pairGen.gen1).1
  set den := (PositiveNatRandomGen.next rg.pairGen.gen2).1
  have h_den : 1 ≤ den := positive_nat_random_gen_positive rg.pairGen.gen2
  have h_den_ne : (den : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by omega
  intro h
  exact h_num ((Rat.mkRat_eq_zero h_den_ne).mp h)

name: Azurite.Random.NatWithBitsRandomGen.next_bounds
statement:
theorem NatWithBitsRandomGen.next_bounds {G : Type} [RandomGen G UInt64] (bg : NatWithBitsRandomGen G) (hb : bg.b ≠ 0) :
  let (v, _)
proof:
:= NatWithBitsRandomGen.next bg
  2^(bg.b - 1) ≤ v ∧ v < 2^bg.b := by
  change 2^(bg.b - 1) ≤ (NatWithBitsRandomGen.next bg).1 ∧ (NatWithBitsRandomGen.next bg).1 < 2^bg.b
  simp only [NatWithBitsRandomGen.next]
  split
  · 
    rename_i h_eq_zero
    have h_b_zero : bg.b = 0 := of_decide_eq_true h_eq_zero
    contradiction
  · 
    rename_i h_not_zero
    let chunks := (bg.b + 63) / 64
    set raw := (genNatChunks chunks bg.gen).1
    set mask := (1 : Nat) <<< (bg.b - 1) with h_mask_def
    set lower_mask := mask - 1

    have h_mask_eq : mask = 2^(bg.b - 1) := by
      rw [h_mask_def]
      rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
      omega

    constructor
    · 
      have h1 : 2^(bg.b - 1) = mask := h_mask_eq.symm
      rw [h1]
      exact Nat.right_le_or
    · 
      have h_raw_lower_lt : raw &&& lower_mask < 2^(bg.b - 1) := by
        have h_upper : lower_mask < 2^(bg.b - 1) := by
          change mask - 1 < 2^(bg.b - 1)
          rw [h_mask_eq]
          have : 1 ≤ 2^(bg.b - 1) := Nat.one_le_two_pow
          omega
        exact Nat.and_lt_two_pow raw h_upper

      have h_mask_lt : mask < 2^bg.b := by
        rw [h_mask_eq]
        apply Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by decide)
        omega

      have h_mask_lt2 : 2^(bg.b - 1) < 2^bg.b := by
        apply Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by decide)
        omega

      have h_raw_lower_lt2 : raw &&& lower_mask < 2^bg.b := Nat.lt_trans h_raw_lower_lt h_mask_lt2

      rw [h_mask_eq]
      exact Nat.or_lt_two_pow h_raw_lower_lt2 h_mask_lt2

name: Azurite.Random.NatUpToBitsRandomGen.next_bounds
statement:
theorem NatUpToBitsRandomGen.next_bounds {G : Type} [RandomGen G UInt64] (bg : NatUpToBitsRandomGen G) (hb : bg.b ≠ 0) :
  let (v, _)
proof:
:= NatUpToBitsRandomGen.next bg
  v < 2^bg.b := by
  change (NatUpToBitsRandomGen.next bg).1 < 2^bg.b
  simp only [NatUpToBitsRandomGen.next]
  split
  · 
    rename_i h_eq_zero
    have h_b_zero : bg.b = 0 := of_decide_eq_true h_eq_zero
    contradiction
  · 
    rename_i h_not_zero
    let chunks := (bg.b + 63) / 64
    set raw := (genNatChunks chunks bg.gen).1
    set mask := ((1 : Nat) <<< bg.b) - 1 with h_mask_def

    have h_upper : mask < 2^bg.b := by
      rw [h_mask_def]
      rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
      have : 1 ≤ 2^bg.b := Nat.one_le_two_pow
      omega

    exact Nat.and_lt_two_pow raw h_upper

name: Azurite.Random.NatLessThanRandomGen.nextLoop_bounds
statement:
theorem NatLessThanRandomGen.nextLoop_bounds {G : Type} [RandomGen G UInt64] (fuel k b : Nat) (g : G) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
  let (v, _)
proof:
:= NatLessThanRandomGen.nextLoop fuel k b g
  v < k := by
  induction fuel generalizing g with
  | zero =>
    change 0 < k
    omega
  | succ f ih =>
    change (NatLessThanRandomGen.nextLoop (f + 1) k b g).1 < k
    simp only [NatLessThanRandomGen.nextLoop]
    split
    · rename_i h_lt
      exact h_lt
    · rename_i h_not_lt
      exact ih _

name: Azurite.Random.NatLessThanRandomGen.next_bounds
statement:
theorem NatLessThanRandomGen.next_bounds {G : Type} [RandomGen G UInt64] (bg : NatLessThanRandomGen G) (hk : bg.k ≠ 0) :
  let (v, _)
proof:
:= NatLessThanRandomGen.next bg
  v < bg.k := by
  change (NatLessThanRandomGen.next bg).1 < bg.k
  simp only [NatLessThanRandomGen.next]
  split
  · 
    rename_i h_le_one
    have h_k_one : bg.k = 1 := by omega
    omega
  · 
    exact NatLessThanRandomGen.nextLoop_bounds 1024 bg.k bg.b bg.gen hk

name: Azurite.Random.SplitMix64.gamma_odd
statement: lemma SplitMix64.gamma_odd : Odd SplitMix64.gamma
proof: := by decide

name: Azurite.Random.SplitMix64.gamma_coprime_2_64
statement: lemma SplitMix64.gamma_coprime_2_64 : Nat.Coprime SplitMix64.gamma (2^64)
proof:
:= by
  have h_pow : Nat.Coprime SplitMix64.gamma (2^64) ↔ Nat.Coprime SplitMix64.gamma 2 :=
    Nat.coprime_pow_right_iff (by decide) SplitMix64.gamma 2
  rw [h_pow]
  rw [Nat.coprime_two_right]
  exact SplitMix64.gamma_odd

name: Azurite.Random.mix_not_constant

name: Azurite.Random.getNatGen_b_eq
statement:
private lemma getNatGen_b_eq (b : Nat) (seed : UInt64) (cache : Std.HashMap Nat SplitMix64) :

proof:
:= by
