name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.σequiv_symm_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem σequiv_symm_inl (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (j : Fin (k 0 + 1)) :
    (σequiv k).symm (Sum.inl j) = ⟨0, j⟩
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.σequiv_symm_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem σequiv_symm_inr (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (j : Fin (k 1 + 1)) :
    (σequiv k).symm (Sum.inr j) = ⟨1, j⟩
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.σequiv_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem σequiv_apply_zero (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (j : Fin (k 0 + 1)) :
    σequiv k ⟨0, j⟩ = Sum.inl j
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.σequiv_apply_one
statement:
theorem σequiv_apply_one (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (j : Fin (k 1 + 1)) :
    σequiv k ⟨1, j⟩ = Sum.inr j
proof:
:= by
  apply (σequiv k).symm.injective
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, σequiv_symm_inr]

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.sumElim_σequiv
statement:
theorem sumElim_σequiv (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (a : Fin (k 0 + 1) → Ri R) (b : Fin (k 1 + 1) → Ri R)
    (v : (i : Fin 2) → (Fin (k i + 1) → Ri R)) (ha : v 0 = a) (hb : v 1 = b) :
    (fun s : (i : Fin 2) × Fin (k i + 1) => (Sum.elim a b) (σequiv k s)) = fun s => v s.1 s.2
proof:
:= by
  funext s
  obtain ⟨i, j⟩ := s
  revert j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i' j => ?_) i
  · intro j
    rw [σequiv_apply_zero, Sum.elim_inl, ha]
  · obtain rfl : i' = 0 := Fin.eq_zero i'
    show Sum.elim a b (σequiv k ⟨1, j⟩) = v 1 j
    rw [σequiv_apply_one, Sum.elim_inr, hb]

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.eval_sumToIter
statement:
theorem eval_sumToIter {S₁ S₂ : Type*} (a : S₁ → C) (b : S₂ → C)
    (P : MvPolynomial (S₁ ⊕ S₂) C) :
    eval a (map (eval b) (sumRingEquiv C S₁ S₂ P)) = eval (Sum.elim a b) P
proof:
:= by
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r => rw [sumRingEquiv_C, map_C, eval_C, eval_C, eval_C]
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, map_add, eval_add, hp, hq, eval_add]
  | mul_X p i hp =>
    cases i with
    | inl b₁ =>
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, eval_mul, hp, sumRingEquiv_X_inl, map_X, eval_X, eval_mul, eval_X,
        Sum.elim_inl]
    | inr c =>
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, eval_mul, hp, sumRingEquiv_X_inr, map_C, eval_C, eval_mul]
      simp only [eval_X, Sum.elim_inr]

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.coeff_sumToIter
statement:
theorem coeff_sumToIter {S₁ S₂ : Type*} (P : MvPolynomial (S₁ ⊕ S₂) C) (γ₀ : S₁ →₀ ℕ)
    (γ₁ : S₂ →₀ ℕ) :
    ((sumRingEquiv C S₁ S₂ P).coeff γ₀).coeff γ₁ = P.coeff (γ₀.sumElim γ₁)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on generalizing γ₀ γ₁ with
  | C r =>
    have key : (0 : S₁ ⊕ S₂ →₀ ℕ) = γ₀.sumElim γ₁ ↔ (0 : S₁ →₀ ℕ) = γ₀ ∧ (0 : S₂ →₀ ℕ) = γ₁ := by
      rw [eq_comm, eq_comm (a := (0 : S₁ →₀ ℕ)), eq_comm (a := (0 : S₂ →₀ ℕ))]
      constructor
      · intro h
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · ext a; have := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp h (Sum.inl a); simpa [Finsupp.sumElim_inl] using this
        · ext b; have := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp h (Sum.inr b); simpa [Finsupp.sumElim_inr] using this
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; subst h1; subst h2; ext x; cases x <;> simp
    simp only [sumRingEquiv_C, coeff_C, apply_ite (fun q => AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff q γ₁), AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
    split_ifs with h0 h1 h2 <;> simp_all
  | add p q hp hq => simp only [map_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hp, hq]
  | mul_X p i hp =>
    cases i with
    | inl b =>
      have hmem : b ∈ γ₀.support ↔ (Sum.inl b : S₁ ⊕ S₂) ∈ (γ₀.sumElim γ₁).support := by
        simp [Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
      have hsub : (γ₀ - Finsupp.single b 1).sumElim γ₁
          = γ₀.sumElim γ₁ - Finsupp.single (Sum.inl b) 1 := by
        ext x
        cases x with
        | inl a => simp [Finsupp.sumElim_inl, Finsupp.single_apply, Sum.inl.injEq]
        | inr a => simp [Finsupp.sumElim_inr]
      rw [map_mul, sumRingEquiv_X_inl, coeff_mul_X', coeff_mul_X', apply_ite (fun q => AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff q γ₁), AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
      split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
      · rw [hp, hsub]
      · exact absurd (hmem.1 h1) h2
      · exact absurd (hmem.2 h2) h1
      · rfl
    | inr c =>
      rw [map_mul, sumRingEquiv_X_inr]
      have e : ((sumRingEquiv C S₁ S₂) p * MvPolynomial.C (X c)).coeff γ₀
          = ((sumRingEquiv C S₁ S₂) p).coeff γ₀ * X c := by rw [mul_comm, coeff_C_mul, mul_comm]
      have hmem : c ∈ γ₁.support ↔ (Sum.inr c : S₁ ⊕ S₂) ∈ (γ₀.sumElim γ₁).support := by
        simp [Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
      have hsub : γ₀.sumElim (γ₁ - Finsupp.single c 1)
          = γ₀.sumElim γ₁ - Finsupp.single (Sum.inr c) 1 := by
        ext x
        cases x with
        | inl a => simp [Finsupp.sumElim_inl]
        | inr a => simp [Finsupp.sumElim_inr, Finsupp.single_apply, Sum.inr.injEq]
      rw [e, coeff_mul_X', coeff_mul_X']
      split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
      · rw [hp, hsub]
      · exact absurd (hmem.1 h1) h2
      · exact absurd (hmem.2 h2) h1
      · rfl

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.eval_split
statement:
theorem eval_split (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial ((i : Fin 2) × Fin (k i + 1)) (Ri R))
    (v : (i : Fin 2) → (Fin (k i + 1) → Ri R)) :
    eval (v 0) (map (eval (v 1)) (split k P)) = evalCoords P v
proof:
:= by
  rw [split, eval_sumToIter, eval_rename, evalCoords]
  congr 1
  rw [Function.comp_def]
  exact congrArg _ (sumElim_σequiv k (v 0) (v 1) v rfl rfl)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.coeff_coeff_split
statement:
theorem coeff_coeff_split (k : Fin 2 → ℕ)
    (P : MvPolynomial ((i : Fin 2) × Fin (k i + 1)) (Ri R))
    (γ₀ : Fin (k 0 + 1) →₀ ℕ) (γ₁ : Fin (k 1 + 1) →₀ ℕ) :
    ((split k P).coeff γ₀).coeff γ₁
      = P.coeff (Finsupp.mapDomain (σequiv k).symm (γ₀.sumElim γ₁))
proof:
:= by
  rw [split, coeff_sumToIter]
  have hmap : Finsupp.mapDomain (σequiv k) (Finsupp.mapDomain (σequiv k).symm (γ₀.sumElim γ₁))
      = γ₀.sumElim γ₁ := by
    rw [← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
    simp only [Equiv.self_comp_symm, Finsupp.mapDomain_id]
  conv_lhs => rw [← hmap]
  exact coeff_rename_mapDomain (σequiv k) (σequiv k).injective P _

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.mapDomain_symm_inl
statement:
theorem mapDomain_symm_inl (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (γ₀ : Fin (k 0 + 1) →₀ ℕ) (γ₁ : Fin (k 1 + 1) →₀ ℕ)
    (j : Fin (k 0 + 1)) :
    Finsupp.mapDomain (σequiv k).symm (γ₀.sumElim γ₁) ⟨0, j⟩ = γ₀ j
proof:
:= by
  have h : (σequiv k).symm (Sum.inl j) = ⟨0, j⟩ := σequiv_symm_inl k j
  rw [← h, Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective (σequiv k).symm.injective, Finsupp.sumElim_inl]

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.mapDomain_symm_inr
statement:
theorem mapDomain_symm_inr (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (γ₀ : Fin (k 0 + 1) →₀ ℕ) (γ₁ : Fin (k 1 + 1) →₀ ℕ)
    (j : Fin (k 1 + 1)) :
    Finsupp.mapDomain (σequiv k).symm (γ₀.sumElim γ₁) ⟨1, j⟩ = γ₁ j
proof:
:= by
  have h : (σequiv k).symm (Sum.inr j) = ⟨1, j⟩ := σequiv_symm_inr k j
  rw [← h, Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective (σequiv k).symm.injective, Finsupp.sumElim_inr]

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.split_isHomogeneous
proof:
:= by
  intro γ₀ hγ₀
  
  obtain ⟨γ₁, hγ₁⟩ : ∃ γ₁, ((split k P).coeff γ₀).coeff γ₁ ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hγ₀ (MvPolynomial.ext _ _ (fun γ₁ => by rw [h γ₁, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]))
  rw [coeff_coeff_split] at hγ₁
  set c := Finsupp.mapDomain (σequiv k).symm (γ₀.sumElim γ₁) with hc
  have hcmem : c ∈ P.support := MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hγ₁
  rw [Finsupp.weight_apply]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Pi.one_apply]
  rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (fun _ => rfl),
    show (∑ j : Fin (k 0 + 1), γ₀ j) = ∑ j, c ⟨0, j⟩ from
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (mapDomain_symm_inl k γ₀ γ₁ j).symm]
  exact hP 0 c hcmem

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.coeff_split_isHomogeneous
proof:
:= by
  intro γ₁ hγ₁
  rw [coeff_coeff_split] at hγ₁
  set c := Finsupp.mapDomain (σequiv k).symm (γ₀.sumElim γ₁) with hc
  have hcmem : c ∈ P.support := MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hγ₁
  rw [Finsupp.weight_apply]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Pi.one_apply]
  rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (fun _ => rfl),
    show (∑ j : Fin (k 1 + 1), γ₁ j) = ∑ j, c ⟨1, j⟩ from
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (mapDomain_symm_inr k γ₀ γ₁ j).symm]
  exact hP 1 c hcmem

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.e1_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem e1_apply (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) : e1 n j = ⟨0, j⟩
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.rename_e1_isMultihomogeneous
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro i γ hγ
  obtain rfl : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [MvPolynomial.support_rename_of_injective (e1 n).injective] at hγ
  obtain ⟨γ', hγ'mem, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hγ
  have hdeg : (Finsupp.weight 1) γ' = m := hQ (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hγ'mem)
  rw [Finsupp.weight_apply] at hdeg
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Pi.one_apply] at hdeg
  rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (fun _ => rfl)] at hdeg
  rw [show (∑ j : Fin (n + 1), Finsupp.mapDomain (e1 n) γ' ⟨0, j⟩) = ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), γ' j from
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by
      rw [show (⟨0, j⟩ : (i : Fin 1) × Fin (n + 1)) = e1 n j from rfl,
        Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective (e1 n).injective]]
  exact hdeg

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.projVanishes_rename_e1
statement:
theorem projVanishes_rename_e1 {n : ℕ} (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) (Ri R))
    (y : (i : Fin 1) → complexProjectiveSpace R n) :
    ProjVanishes (k := fun _ : Fin 1 => n) (rename (e1 n) Q) y ↔ eval (y 0).rep Q = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProjVanishes, evalCoords, eval_rename]
  refine Iff.of_eq (congrArg (· = 0) ?_)
  refine congrArg (eval · Q) ?_
  funext j
  rfl

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.blockVec_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockVec_zero (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (a : Fin (k 0 + 1) → Ri R)
    (b : Fin (k 1 + 1) → Ri R) : blockVec k a b 0 = a
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.blockVec_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockVec_one (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (a : Fin (k 0 + 1) → Ri R)
    (b : Fin (k 1 + 1) → Ri R) : blockVec k a b 1 = b
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.blockVec_ne_zero
statement:
theorem blockVec_ne_zero (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (a : Fin (k 0 + 1) → Ri R) (b : Fin (k 1 + 1) → Ri R)
    (i : Fin 2) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : blockVec k a b i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i' => ?_) i
  · exact ha
  · obtain rfl : i' = 0 := Fin.eq_zero i'
    exact hb

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.eval_split_blockVec
statement:
theorem eval_split_blockVec {k : Fin 2 → ℕ}
    (P : MvPolynomial ((i : Fin 2) × Fin (k i + 1)) (Ri R)) (a : Fin (k 0 + 1) → Ri R)
    (b : Fin (k 1 + 1) → Ri R) :
    eval a (map (eval b) (split k P)) = evalCoords P (blockVec k a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eval_split k P (blockVec k a b), blockVec_zero, blockVec_one]

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.projVanishes_iff_eval_split
statement:
theorem projVanishes_iff_eval_split {k : Fin 2 → ℕ}
    (P : MvPolynomial ((i : Fin 2) × Fin (k i + 1)) (Ri R))
    (x : (i : Fin 2) → complexProjectiveSpace R (k i)) :
    ProjVanishes P x ↔
      eval (x 0).rep (map (eval (x 1).rep) (split k P)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProjVanishes, ← eval_split k P (fun i => (x i).rep)]

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.exists_line_iff_exists_nonzero
statement:
theorem exists_line_iff_exists_nonzero {k : Fin 2 → ℕ}
    (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial ((i : Fin 2) × Fin (k i + 1)) (Ri R)))
    (hPs : ∀ P ∈ Ps, ∃ dd : Fin 2 → ℕ, IsMultihomogeneous P dd)
    (y₁ : complexProjectiveSpace R (k 1)) :
    (∃ x₀ : complexProjectiveSpace R (k 0),
        ∀ P ∈ Ps, eval (x₀).rep (map (eval y₁.rep) (split k P)) = 0)
      ↔ (∃ z : Fin (k 0 + 1) → Ri R, z ≠ 0 ∧
          ∀ P ∈ Ps, eval z (map (eval y₁.rep) (split k P)) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩
    exact ⟨x₀.rep, x₀.rep_nonzero, hx₀⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, hzvan⟩
    refine ⟨mkLine z hz, fun P hP => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨dd, hdd⟩ := hPs P hP
    have hzP : eval z (map (eval y₁.rep) (split k P)) = 0 := hzvan P hP
    
    rw [eval_split_blockVec]
    rw [eval_split_blockVec] at hzP
    
    have hmk : ∀ i : Fin 2,
        mkLine (blockVec k (mkLine z hz).rep y₁.rep i)
          (blockVec_ne_zero k _ y₁.rep i (mkLine z hz).rep_nonzero y₁.rep_nonzero)
        = mkLine (blockVec k z y₁.rep i)
          (blockVec_ne_zero k z y₁.rep i hz y₁.rep_nonzero) := by
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i' => ?_)
      · exact Projectivization.mk_rep (mkLine z hz)
      · obtain rfl : i' = 0 := Fin.eq_zero i'
        rfl
    rw [evalCoords_eq_zero_iff_of_mkLine_eq hdd _ _ hmk]
    exact hzP

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.blockVecPt_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockVecPt_zero (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (x₀ : complexProjectiveSpace R (k 0))
    (y₁ : complexProjectiveSpace R (k 1)) : blockVecPt k x₀ y₁ 0 = x₀
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.Theorem_4_103.blockVecPt_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockVecPt_one (k : Fin 2 → ℕ) (x₀ : complexProjectiveSpace R (k 0))
    (y₁ : complexProjectiveSpace R (k 1)) : blockVecPt k x₀ y₁ 1 = y₁
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.projection_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem projection_isAlgebraic {k : Fin 2 → ℕ}
    (Ps : Finset (MvPolynomial ((i : Fin 2) × Fin (k i + 1)) (Ri R)))
    (hPs : ∀ P ∈ Ps, ∃ dd : Fin 2 → ℕ, IsMultihomogeneous P dd) :
    ∃ Qs : Finset (MvPolynomial ((_ : Fin 1) × Fin (k 1 + 1)) (Ri R)),
      (∀ Q ∈ Qs, ∃ dd : Fin 1 → ℕ, IsMultihomogeneous Q dd) ∧
      (fun x : (i : Fin 2) → complexProjectiveSpace R (k i) => (fun _ : Fin 1 => x 1)) ''
          projZerOfFinset Ps
        = projZerOfFinset (k := fun _ : Fin 1 => k 1) Qs
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : IsAlgClosed (Ri R) := Theorem2_11.isAlgClosed_Ri
  have : CharZero R := inferInstance
  have : CharZero (Ri R) := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap R (Ri R)).injective
  
  set s := Ps.card with hs
  set enum : Fin s ≃ Ps := Ps.equivFin.symm with henum
  
  set p : Fin s → MvPolynomial (Fin (k 0 + 1)) (MvPolynomial (Fin (k 1 + 1)) (Ri R)) :=
    fun i => split k (enum i).1 with hp
  
  have hmh : ∀ i, ∃ dd : Fin 2 → ℕ, IsMultihomogeneous (enum i).1 dd := fun i =>
    hPs (enum i).1 (enum i).2
  choose dd hdd using hmh
  
  have hpd : ∀ i, (p i).IsHomogeneous (dd i 0) := fun i => split_isHomogeneous (hdd i)
  
  have hpe : ∀ i γ, ((p i).coeff γ).IsHomogeneous (dd i 1) := fun i γ =>
    coeff_split_isHomogeneous (hdd i) γ
  
  obtain ⟨coreQs, hcoreHom, hcoreSpec⟩ :=
    Elimination.elimination (C := Ri R) (k₁ := k 0) (k₂ := k 1) (s := s)
      (fun i => dd i 0) p hpd (fun i => dd i 1) hpe
  
  refine ⟨coreQs.image (rename (e1 (k 1))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro Q hQ
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hQ
    obtain ⟨Q₀, hQ₀mem, rfl⟩ := hQ
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hcoreHom Q₀ hQ₀mem
    exact ⟨fun _ => m, rename_e1_isMultihomogeneous hm⟩
  · 
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_image, projZerOfFinset, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hxvan, rfl⟩
      intro Q hQ
      rw [Finset.mem_image] at hQ
      obtain ⟨Q₀, hQ₀mem, rfl⟩ := hQ
      rw [projVanishes_rename_e1]
      
      have hexists : ∃ z : Fin (k 0 + 1) → Ri R, z ≠ 0 ∧
          ∀ i, eval z (map (eval (x 1).rep) (p i)) = 0 := by
        refine ⟨(x 0).rep, (x 0).rep_nonzero, fun i => ?_⟩
        have := hxvan (enum i).1 (enum i).2
        rw [projVanishes_iff_eval_split] at this
        exact this
      exact (hcoreSpec (x 1).rep).mpr hexists Q₀ hQ₀mem
    · intro hyvan
      
      have hcore0 : ∀ Q₀ ∈ coreQs, eval (y 0).rep Q₀ = 0 := by
        intro Q₀ hQ₀mem
        have := hyvan (rename (e1 (k 1)) Q₀) (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hQ₀mem)
        rwa [projVanishes_rename_e1] at this
      
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzvan⟩ := (hcoreSpec (y 0).rep).mp hcore0
      
      have hzvan' : ∀ P ∈ Ps, eval z (map (eval (y 0).rep) (split k P)) = 0 := by
        intro P hP
        have hi := hzvan (enum.symm ⟨P, hP⟩)
        rw [hp] at hi
        simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at hi
        exact hi
      
      obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := (exists_line_iff_exists_nonzero Ps hPs (y 0)).mpr ⟨z, hz, hzvan'⟩
      
      refine ⟨blockVecPt k x₀ (y 0), fun P hP => ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [projVanishes_iff_eval_split, blockVecPt_zero, blockVecPt_one]
        exact hx₀ P hP
      · funext i
        obtain rfl : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        rw [blockVecPt_one]

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.theorem_4_103
statement:
theorem theorem_4_103 {k : Fin 2 → ℕ}
    (V : Set ((i : Fin 2) → complexProjectiveSpace R (k i))) (hV : IsAlgebraicSet V) :
    IsAlgebraicSet (k := fun _ : Fin 1 => k 1)
      ((fun x : (i : Fin 2) → complexProjectiveSpace R (k i) => fun _ : Fin 1 => x 1) '' V)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Ps, hPs, rfl⟩ := hV
  exact projection_isAlgebraic Ps hPs

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.chartOverlap_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hrep⟩ := exists_rep_smul (Fin.insertNth i 1 x) (insertNth_one_ne_zero i x)
  constructor
  · intro hx
    simp only [chartOverlap, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_inter_iff, chartSet_eq,
      Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hx
    have h2 := hx.2
    rw [chartMap, hrep, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ne_eq, mul_eq_zero, not_or] at h2
    exact h2.2
  · intro hx
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hx
    simp only [chartOverlap, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_inter_iff, chartSet_eq, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [chartMap, hrep]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.insertNth_apply_same, mul_one]; exact hc
    · rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ne_eq, mul_eq_zero, not_or]; exact ⟨hc, hx⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.isSemialgebraicSetC_chartOverlap
statement:
theorem isSemialgebraicSetC_chartOverlap (i j : Fin (k + 1)) :
    IsSemialgebraicSetC (chartOverlap i j : Set (Fin k → Ri R))
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartOverlap_eq]
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst hji
    have huniv : {x : Fin k → Ri R | (Fin.insertNth j (1 : Ri R) x : Fin (k + 1) → Ri R) j ≠ 0}
        = (Set.univ : Set (Fin k → Ri R)) := by
      ext x; simp [Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
    rw [huniv]; exact IsSemialgebraicSetC.univ
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hji
    have hcoord : {x : Fin k → Ri R | (Fin.insertNth i (1 : Ri R) x : Fin (k + 1) → Ri R) j ≠ 0}
        = {x : Fin k → Ri R | x b ≠ 0} := by
      ext x; simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, ← hb, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
    rw [hcoord]; exact isSemialgebraicSetC_coord_ne_zero b

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.hasPartialDerivAtIn_evalMvPoly
statement:
theorem hasPartialDerivAtIn_evalMvPoly {n : ℕ} (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    (U : Set (Fin n → R)) (j : Fin n) (z : Fin n → R) :
    HasPartialDerivAtIn (fun w => eval w Q) U j z (eval z (pderiv j Q))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction Q using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a =>
    simp only [eval_C, pderiv_C, map_zero]
    exact Azurite.BPR.hasPartialDerivAtIn_const a U j z
  | add P P' ihP ihP' =>
    have := ihP.add ihP'
    simpa only [eval_add, map_add] using this
  | mul_X P j' ih =>
    
    have hupd : Function.update z j (z j) = z := Function.update_eq_self j z
    
    have hX : HasPartialDerivAtIn (fun w : Fin n → R => eval w (X j')) U j z
        (eval z (pderiv j (X j'))) := by
      rw [HasPartialDerivAtIn]
      by_cases hjj : j' = j
      · subst hjj
        have heq : (fun t : R => eval (Function.update z j' t) (X j' : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R))
            = fun t => 1 * t + 0 := by
          funext t; rw [eval_X, Function.update_self]; ring
        rw [heq]
        have : eval z (pderiv j' (X j' : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) = 1 := by simp
        rw [this]
        exact Azurite.BPR.hasDerivAtIn_affine 1 0 _ _
      · have heq : (fun t : R => eval (Function.update z j t) (X j' : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R))
            = fun _ => z j' := by
          funext t; rw [eval_X, Function.update_of_ne hjj]
        rw [heq]
        have : eval z (pderiv j (X j' : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) = 0 := by
          rw [pderiv_X_of_ne hjj, map_zero]
        rw [this]
        exact Azurite.BPR.hasDerivAtIn_const (z j') _ _
    
    have hmul := ih.mul hX
    
    have hfun : (fun w : Fin n → R => eval w (P * X j'))
        = fun w => (eval w P) * (eval w (X j')) := by
      funext w; rw [eval_mul]
    have hval : (fun w : Fin n → R => eval w P) (Function.update z j (z j))
          * eval z (pderiv j (X j'))
        + (fun w : Fin n → R => eval w (X j')) (Function.update z j (z j))
          * eval z (pderiv j P)
        = eval z (pderiv j (P * X j')) := by
      simp only [hupd]
      rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_mul, eval_X]
    rw [hfun]
    rw [HasPartialDerivAtIn] at hmul ⊢
    rw [← hval]
    exact hmul

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.aeval_insertNth_one
statement:
theorem aeval_insertNth_one (j₀ : Fin (k + 1)) (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R))
    (v : Fin k → Ri R) :
    aeval (Fin.insertNth j₀ (1 : Ri R) v) φ = aeval v (dehomAt j₀ φ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dehomAt]
  have h : (aeval v).comp (aeval (Fin.insertNth j₀ (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin k) (Ri R)) X))
      = aeval (Fin.insertNth j₀ (1 : Ri R) v) := by
    rw [comp_aeval]
    congr 1
    funext m
    refine Fin.succAboveCases j₀ ?_ (fun b => ?_) m
    · simp [Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
    · simp [Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun h φ).symm

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.HasReImPoly.add
statement:
theorem HasReImPoly.add {N : ℕ} {f g : (Fin N → R) → Ri R}
    (hf : HasReImPoly f) (hg : HasReImPoly g) : HasReImPoly (fun z => f z + g z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨fre, fim, hf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨gre, gim, hg⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨fre + gre, fim + gim, fun z => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [map_add, eval_add, (hf z).1, (hg z).1]
  · rw [map_add, eval_add, (hf z).2, (hg z).2]

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.HasReImPoly.mul
statement:
theorem HasReImPoly.mul {N : ℕ} {f g : (Fin N → R) → Ri R}
    (hf : HasReImPoly f) (hg : HasReImPoly g) : HasReImPoly (fun z => f z * g z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨fre, fim, hf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨gre, gim, hg⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨fre * gre - fim * gim, fre * gim + fim * gre, fun z => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [reL_mul, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_mul, (hf z).1, (hf z).2, (hg z).1, (hg z).2]
  · rw [imL_mul, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_mul, (hf z).1, (hf z).2, (hg z).1, (hg z).2]

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.hasReImPoly_const
statement: theorem hasReImPoly_const {N : ℕ} (c : Ri R) : HasReImPoly (fun _ : Fin N → R => c)
proof:
:=
  ⟨C (Ri.reL c), C (Ri.imL c), fun _ => ⟨by rw [eval_C], by rw [eval_C]⟩⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.hasReImPoly_aeval_xcoordsR
statement:
theorem hasReImPoly_aeval_xcoordsR (j₀ : Fin (k + 1)) (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) :
    HasReImPoly (fun z : Fin ((1 + 1) + (k + k)) → R => aeval (xcoordsR j₀ z) φ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Qre, Qim, hQ⟩ := exists_reL_imL_aeval (dehomAt j₀ φ)
  refine ⟨rename (Fin.natAdd (1 + 1)) Qre, rename (Fin.natAdd (1 + 1)) Qim, fun z => ?_⟩
  have hxc : aeval (xcoordsR j₀ z) φ
      = aeval (realEquiv.symm (z ∘ Fin.natAdd (1 + 1))) (dehomAt j₀ φ) := by
    rw [xcoordsR, aeval_insertNth_one]
  show Ri.reL (aeval (xcoordsR j₀ z) φ) = _ ∧ Ri.imL (aeval (xcoordsR j₀ z) φ) = _
  rw [hxc, eval_rename, eval_rename]
  exact hQ (z ∘ Fin.natAdd (1 + 1))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.hasReImPoly_pcoordsR
statement:
theorem hasReImPoly_pcoordsR (i₀ : Fin 2) (a : Fin 2) :
    HasReImPoly (fun z : Fin ((1 + 1) + (k + k)) → R => pcoordsR i₀ z a)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = i₀
  · subst ha
    have hconst : (fun z : Fin ((1 + 1) + (k + k)) → R => pcoordsR a z a)
        = fun _ => (1 : Ri R) := by
      funext z; rw [pcoordsR, Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
    rw [hconst]
    exact hasReImPoly_const 1
  · 
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : Fin 1, i₀.succAbove b = a := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq ha
    refine ⟨X (Fin.castAdd (k + k) (Fin.castAdd 1 b)),
            X (Fin.castAdd (k + k) (Fin.natAdd 1 b)), fun z => ?_⟩
    have hval : pcoordsR i₀ z a = (realEquiv.symm (z ∘ Fin.castAdd (k + k))) b := by
      rw [pcoordsR, ← hb, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
    simp only [hval]
    constructor
    · rw [reL_symm_apply, eval_X, Function.comp_apply]
    · rw [imL_symm_apply, eval_X, Function.comp_apply]

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.hasReImPoly_cEq
statement:
theorem hasReImPoly_cEq (P : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) (d : Fin k → ℕ)
    (i₀ : Fin 2) (j₀ : Fin (k + 1)) (i : Fin k) :
    HasReImPoly (fun z => cEq P d i₀ j₀ i z)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : (fun z => cEq P d i₀ j₀ i z)
      = fun z => pcoordsR i₀ z 0 * aeval (xcoordsR j₀ z) (P i)
          + pcoordsR i₀ z 1 * aeval (xcoordsR j₀ z) (diagFactor (R := R) (d i) i) := by
    funext z
    show aeval (xcoordsR j₀ z) (homotopyPoly P d (pcoordsR i₀ z 0) (pcoordsR i₀ z 1) i) = _
    rw [homotopyPoly, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, aeval_C, aeval_C,
      Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply]
  rw [hsplit]
  exact ((hasReImPoly_pcoordsR i₀ 0).mul (hasReImPoly_aeval_xcoordsR j₀ (P i))).add
    ((hasReImPoly_pcoordsR i₀ 1).mul (hasReImPoly_aeval_xcoordsR j₀ (diagFactor (R := R) (d i) i)))

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.exists_homotopyF_eq_eval
statement:
theorem exists_homotopyF_eq_eval (P : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) (d : Fin k → ℕ)
    (i₀ : Fin 2) (j₀ : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (k + k)) :
    ∃ Q : MvPolynomial (Fin ((1 + 1) + (k + k))) R,
      ∀ z, homotopyF P d i₀ j₀ l z = eval z Q
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.addCases (fun l' => ?_) (fun l' => ?_) l
  · obtain ⟨Qre, _, hQ⟩ := hasReImPoly_cEq P d i₀ j₀ l'
    exact ⟨Qre, fun z => by rw [homotopyF, Fin.addCases_left]; exact (hQ z).1⟩
  · obtain ⟨_, Qim, hQ⟩ := hasReImPoly_cEq P d i₀ j₀ l'
    exact ⟨Qim, fun z => by rw [homotopyF, Fin.addCases_right]; exact (hQ z).2⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.homotopyPoly_smul
statement:
theorem homotopyPoly_smul (P : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) (d : Fin k → ℕ)
    (s lam mu : Ri R) (i : Fin k) :
    homotopyPoly P d (s * lam) (s * mu) i = C s * homotopyPoly P d lam mu i
proof:
:= by
  rw [homotopyPoly, homotopyPoly, map_mul, map_mul, mul_add]
  ring

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.homotopyF_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem homotopyF_eq_zero_iff (P : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) (d : Fin k → ℕ)
    (hP : ∀ i, (P i).IsHomogeneous (d i))
    (i₀ : Fin 2) (j₀ : Fin (k + 1)) (p : complexProjectiveSpace R 1)
    (x : complexProjectiveSpace R k) (hp : p ∈ chartSet i₀) (hx : x ∈ chartSet j₀) :
    (∀ l, homotopyF P d i₀ j₀ l
        (Fin.append (realEquiv (chartInv i₀ p)) (realEquiv (chartInv j₀ x))) = 0)
      ↔ (∀ i, aeval x.rep (homotopyPoly P d (p.rep 0) (p.rep 1) i) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set z : Fin ((1 + 1) + (k + k)) → R :=
    Fin.append (realEquiv (chartInv i₀ p)) (realEquiv (chartInv j₀ x)) with hz
  
  have hzpt : z ∘ Fin.natAdd (1 + 1) = realEquiv (chartInv j₀ x) := by
    funext m; rw [hz, Function.comp_apply, Fin.append_right]
  have hzparam : z ∘ Fin.castAdd (k + k) = realEquiv (chartInv i₀ p) := by
    funext m; rw [hz, Function.comp_apply, Fin.append_left]
  have hxc : xcoordsR j₀ z = Fin.insertNth j₀ (1 : Ri R) (chartInv j₀ x) := by
    rw [xcoordsR, hzpt, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  
  have hpc : pcoordsR i₀ z = Fin.insertNth i₀ (1 : Ri R) (chartInv i₀ p) := by
    rw [pcoordsR, hzparam, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  
  have hxj : x.rep j₀ ≠ 0 := by rw [chartSet_eq] at hx; exact hx
  obtain ⟨cx, hcx, hxrep⟩ :
      ∃ c : Ri R, c ≠ 0 ∧ Fin.insertNth j₀ (1 : Ri R) (chartInv j₀ x) = c • x.rep := by
    have h1 : mkLine (Fin.insertNth j₀ (1 : Ri R) (chartInv j₀ x)) (insertNth_one_ne_zero j₀ _)
        = mkLine x.rep x.rep_nonzero := by
      rw [mkLine_rep]
      conv_rhs => rw [← chartMap_chartInv j₀ x hxj, chartMap]
    exact (mkLine_eq_mkLine_iff _ _ _ _).mp h1
  
  have hpi : p.rep i₀ ≠ 0 := by rw [chartSet_eq] at hp; exact hp
  obtain ⟨cp, hcp, hprep⟩ :
      ∃ c : Ri R, c ≠ 0 ∧ p.rep = c • Fin.insertNth i₀ (1 : Ri R) (chartInv i₀ p) := by
    have h1 : mkLine p.rep p.rep_nonzero
        = mkLine (Fin.insertNth i₀ (1 : Ri R) (chartInv i₀ p)) (insertNth_one_ne_zero i₀ _) := by
      rw [mkLine_rep]
      conv_lhs => rw [← chartMap_chartInv i₀ p hpi]
      rw [chartMap]
    exact (mkLine_eq_mkLine_iff _ _ _ _).mp h1
  
  have hcEqzero : (∀ l, homotopyF P d i₀ j₀ l z = 0) ↔ (∀ l', cEq P d i₀ j₀ l' z = 0) := by
    constructor
    · intro h l'
      rw [reL_eq_zero_and_imL_eq_zero_iff]
      constructor
      · have := h (Fin.castAdd k l'); rwa [homotopyF, Fin.addCases_left] at this
      · have := h (Fin.natAdd k l'); rwa [homotopyF, Fin.addCases_right] at this
    · intro h l
      refine Fin.addCases (fun l' => ?_) (fun l' => ?_) l
      · rw [homotopyF, Fin.addCases_left, h l', map_zero]
      · rw [homotopyF, Fin.addCases_right, h l', map_zero]
  rw [hcEqzero]
  
  refine forall_congr' fun l' => ?_
  rw [cEq, hxc]
  
  have hparam0 : pcoordsR i₀ z 0 = cp⁻¹ * p.rep 0 := by
    rw [hpc, hprep, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; field_simp
  have hparam1 : pcoordsR i₀ z 1 = cp⁻¹ * p.rep 1 := by
    rw [hpc, hprep, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; field_simp
  rw [hparam0, hparam1]
  
  rw [homotopyPoly_smul, map_mul, aeval_C, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply]
  
  rw [hxrep, aeval_smul_isHomogeneous (homotopyPoly_isHomogeneous P d hP _ _ l')]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hcxpow : (cx : Ri R) ^ d l' ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hcx
    have hcpinv : (cp⁻¹ : Ri R) ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hcp
    
    have h2 : cx ^ d l' * aeval x.rep (homotopyPoly P d (p.rep 0) (p.rep 1) l') = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left hcpinv
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left hcxpow
  · intro h
    rw [h, mul_zero, mul_zero]

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.homotopyF_eq_eval_homotopyQ
statement:
theorem homotopyF_eq_eval_homotopyQ (P : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) (d : Fin k → ℕ)
    (i₀ : Fin 2) (j₀ : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (k + k)) (z : Fin ((1 + 1) + (k + k)) → R) :
    homotopyF P d i₀ j₀ l z = eval z (homotopyQ P d i₀ j₀ l)
proof:
:=
  (exists_homotopyF_eq_eval P d i₀ j₀ l).choose_spec z

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.homotopyF_isSemialgContinuousOn
statement:
theorem homotopyF_isSemialgContinuousOn (P : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R))
    (d : Fin k → ℕ) (i₀ : Fin 2) (j₀ : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (k + k)) :
    IsSemialgContinuousOn (Set.univ : Set (Fin ((1 + 1) + (k + k)) → R))
      (homotopyF P d i₀ j₀ l)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : homotopyF P d i₀ j₀ l = fun z => eval z (homotopyQ P d i₀ j₀ l) :=
    funext (homotopyF_eq_eval_homotopyQ P d i₀ j₀ l)
  rw [heq]
  exact (isSFunction_evalMvPoly Azurite.BPR.isSemialgebraicSet_univ _ 0)

name: Azurite.BPR.Chapter4.homotopyG_isSFunction
statement:
theorem homotopyG_isSFunction (P : Fin k → MvPolynomial (Fin (k + 1)) (Ri R)) (d : Fin k → ℕ)
    (i₀ : Fin 2) (j₀ : Fin (k + 1)) (m : ℕ) (l : Fin (k + k)) (j : Fin ((1 + 1) + (k + k))) :
    IsSFunction m (Set.univ : Set (Fin ((1 + 1) + (k + k)) → R)) (homotopyG P d i₀ j₀ l j)
