statement:
theorem G_coeff_mem_R [IsRealClosed R]
    {p : ℕ} (P : R[X]) (x : Fin p → L)
    (hx : P.map (algebraMap R L) = ∏ j : Fin p, (X - Polynomial.C (x j)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ q : R[X], q.map (algebraMap R L) = (GPoly x).coeff n
proof:
:= by
  rw [poly_in_image_iff_coeffs_in_range]; intro m
  have : Infinite R := Infinite.of_injective (Nat.cast : ℕ → R) Nat.cast_injective
  exact eval_range_implies_coeff_range _ (G_eval_coeff_in_R P x hx n) m

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.H_eval_coeff_in_R
statement:
theorem H_eval_coeff_in_R [IsRealClosed R]
    {p : ℕ} (P : R[X]) (x : Fin p → L)
    (hx : P.map (algebraMap R L) = ∏ j : Fin p, (X - Polynomial.C (x j)))
    (n : ℕ) (r : R) :
    Polynomial.eval (algebraMap R L r) ((HPoly x).coeff n)
      ∈ Set.range (algebraMap R L)
proof:
:= by
  
  set γMv : Fin p × Fin p → MvPolynomial (Fin p) R :=
    fun ij => MvPolynomial.X ij.1 + MvPolynomial.X ij.2 +
      MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X ij.1 * MvPolynomial.X ij.2 with γMv_def
  set pMv : Fin p × Fin p → MvPolynomial (Fin p) R :=
    fun ij => MvPolynomial.X ij.1 * MvPolynomial.X ij.2 with pMv_def
  set HMv : (MvPolynomial (Fin p) R)[X] :=
    ∑ ij ∈ strictPairs p,
      Polynomial.C (pMv ij) *
      ∏ kl ∈ (strictPairs p).erase ij,
        (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (γMv kl)) with HMv_def
  have hγ : ∀ ij ∈ strictPairs p,
      (MvPolynomial.aeval x) (γMv ij) =
        Polynomial.eval (algebraMap R L r) (gammaPoly x ij.1 ij.2) := by
    intro ij _
    simp only [γMv_def, gammaPoly, map_add, map_mul, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, MvPolynomial.aeval_C,
      Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_X]
    ring
  have hp_aeval : ∀ ij ∈ strictPairs p,
      (MvPolynomial.aeval x) (pMv ij) = x ij.1 * x ij.2 := by
    intro ij _; simp only [pMv_def, map_mul, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
  have hH : Polynomial.map (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom HMv =
      Polynomial.map (Polynomial.evalRingHom (algebraMap R L r)) (HPoly x) := by
    simp only [HMv_def, HPoly]
    rw [Polynomial.map_sum, Polynomial.map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro ij hij
    rw [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_C]
    congr 1
    · simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom, Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom,
        Polynomial.eval_C, hp_aeval ij hij]
    · rw [Polynomial.map_prod, Polynomial.map_prod]
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl; intro kl hkl
      simp only [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C,
        AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom, Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom]
      rw [hγ kl (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hkl)]
  have hcoeff : Polynomial.eval (algebraMap R L r) ((HPoly x).coeff n) =
      (MvPolynomial.aeval x) (HMv.coeff n) := by
    have := congr_arg (fun q => q.coeff n) hH
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_map, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom] at this
    exact this.symm
  have hsymm : (HMv.coeff n).IsSymmetric := by
    intro σ
    rw [show MvPolynomial.rename σ (HMv.coeff n) =
        (Polynomial.map (MvPolynomial.rename σ).toRingHom HMv).coeff n from
      (Polynomial.coeff_map _ _).symm]
    suffices hpoly : Polynomial.map (MvPolynomial.rename σ).toRingHom HMv = HMv by rw [hpoly]
    simp only [HMv_def]
    rw [Polynomial.map_sum]
    simp only [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_prod, Polynomial.map_sub,
      Polynomial.map_X, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom]
    have hγ_rename : ∀ ij : Fin p × Fin p,
        MvPolynomial.rename σ (γMv ij) = γMv (σ ij.1, σ ij.2) := by
      intro ij
      simp only [γMv_def, map_add, map_mul, MvPolynomial.rename_X, MvPolynomial.rename_C]
    have hp_rename : ∀ ij : Fin p × Fin p,
        MvPolynomial.rename σ (pMv ij) = pMv (σ ij.1, σ ij.2) := by
      intro ij; simp only [pMv_def, map_mul, MvPolynomial.rename_X]
    simp_rw [hγ_rename, hp_rename]
    have hγ_comm : ∀ i j : Fin p, γMv (i, j) = γMv (j, i) := by
      intro i j; simp only [γMv_def]; ring
    have hp_comm : ∀ i j : Fin p, pMv (i, j) = pMv (j, i) := by
      intro i j; simp only [pMv_def]; ring
    set φ : Fin p × Fin p → Fin p × Fin p :=
      fun ij => if σ ij.1 < σ ij.2 then (σ ij.1, σ ij.2) else (σ ij.2, σ ij.1) with φ_def
    have hφ_mem : ∀ ij ∈ strictPairs p, φ ij ∈ strictPairs p := by
      intro ij hij
      simp only [strictPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hij ⊢
      simp only [φ]; split_ifs with h
      · exact h
      · exact lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp h) (fun heq => hij.ne (σ.injective heq.symm))
    have hφ_inj : ∀ ij₁ ∈ strictPairs p, ∀ ij₂ ∈ strictPairs p,
        φ ij₁ = φ ij₂ → ij₁ = ij₂ := by
      intro ij₁ hij₁ ij₂ hij₂ heq
      have h₁ : ij₁.1 < ij₁.2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hij₁).2
      have h₂ : ij₂.1 < ij₂.2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hij₂).2
      simp only [φ] at heq
      split_ifs at heq with ha hb hb
      all_goals (obtain ⟨hc, hd⟩ := Prod.mk.inj heq)
      · exact Prod.ext (σ.injective hc) (σ.injective hd)
      · exfalso; exact absurd (σ.injective hc ▸ σ.injective hd ▸ h₂ :
          ij₁.2 < ij₁.1) (not_lt.mpr h₁.le)
      · exfalso; exact absurd (σ.injective hc ▸ σ.injective hd ▸ h₁ :
          ij₂.2 < ij₂.1) (not_lt.mpr h₂.le)
      · exact Prod.ext (σ.injective hd) (σ.injective hc)
    have hφ_surj : ∀ ij ∈ strictPairs p, ∃ ij' ∈ strictPairs p, φ ij' = ij := by
      intro ij hij
      have hij_lt : ij.1 < ij.2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hij).2
      by_cases hord : σ.symm ij.1 < σ.symm ij.2
      · refine ⟨(σ.symm ij.1, σ.symm ij.2),
            Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hord⟩, ?_⟩
        simp only [φ, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, ite_eq_left hij_lt]
      · have hord' : σ.symm ij.2 < σ.symm ij.1 :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hord) (fun h => hij_lt.ne (σ.symm.injective h).symm)
        refine ⟨(σ.symm ij.2, σ.symm ij.1),
            Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hord'⟩, ?_⟩
        simp only [φ, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr hij_lt.le)]
    have hφ_γ : ∀ ij, γMv (σ ij.1, σ ij.2) = γMv (φ ij) := by
      intro ij; simp only [φ]; split_ifs <;> [rfl; exact hγ_comm _ _]
    have hφ_p : ∀ ij, pMv (σ ij.1, σ ij.2) = pMv (φ ij) := by
      intro ij; simp only [φ]; split_ifs <;> [rfl; exact hp_comm _ _]
    apply Finset.sum_nbij φ hφ_mem
      (fun ij₁ hij₁ ij₂ hij₂ heq => hφ_inj ij₁ hij₁ ij₂ hij₂ heq)
      (fun ij hij => hφ_surj ij hij)
    intro ij hij
    rw [hφ_p ij]
    suffices hprod : ∏ kl ∈ (strictPairs p).erase ij, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (γMv (σ kl.1, σ kl.2))) =
        ∏ kl ∈ (strictPairs p).erase (φ ij), (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (γMv kl)) by
      rw [hprod]
    apply Finset.prod_nbij φ
    · intro kl hkl
      refine Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, hφ_mem kl (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hkl)⟩
      intro heq
      exact (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hkl)
        (hφ_inj kl (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hkl) ij hij heq)
    · intro kl₁ hkl₁ kl₂ hkl₂ heq
      exact hφ_inj kl₁ (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hkl₁) kl₂ (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hkl₂) heq
    · intro kl hkl
      obtain ⟨kl', hkl'_mem, hkl'_eq⟩ := hφ_surj kl (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hkl)
      refine ⟨kl', Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, hkl'_mem⟩, hkl'_eq⟩
      intro heq
      exact (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hkl) (hkl'_eq ▸ congr_arg φ heq)
    · intro kl _
      simp only [sub_right_inj]
      exact congr_arg Polynomial.C (hφ_γ kl)
  rw [hcoeff]
  exact Azurite.BPR.proposition_2_16 P x hx _ hsymm

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.H_coeff_mem_R
statement:
theorem H_coeff_mem_R [IsRealClosed R]
    {p : ℕ} (P : R[X]) (x : Fin p → L)
    (hx : P.map (algebraMap R L) = ∏ j : Fin p, (X - Polynomial.C (x j)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ q : R[X], q.map (algebraMap R L) = (HPoly x).coeff n
proof:
:= by
  rw [poly_in_image_iff_coeffs_in_range]; intro m
  have : Infinite R := Infinite.of_injective (Nat.cast : ℕ → R) Nat.cast_injective
  exact eval_range_implies_coeff_range _ (H_eval_coeff_in_R P x hx n) m

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.Q_eval_gamma
statement:
theorem Q_eval_gamma (x : Fin p → L) (ij : Fin p × Fin p) (hij : ij ∈ strictPairs p) :
    Polynomial.eval (gammaPoly x ij.1 ij.2) (QPolynomial x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [QPolynomial, Polynomial.eval_prod, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff]
  exact ⟨ij, hij, by simp⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.eval_lagrange_sum
statement:
theorem eval_lagrange_sum {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → A) (γ : ι → A)
    (m : ι) (hm : m ∈ s) :
    Polynomial.eval (γ m)
      (∑ i ∈ s, Polynomial.C (c i) * ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (γ j))) =
    c m * ∏ j ∈ s.erase m, (γ m - γ j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single m]
  · 
    simp [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_prod]
  · 
    intro i hi him
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul]
    apply mul_eq_zero_of_right
    rw [Polynomial.eval_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm him, hm⟩)
    simp
  · intro hm'; exact absurd hm hm'

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.G_eval_gamma
statement:
theorem G_eval_gamma (x : Fin p → L) (ij : Fin p × Fin p) (hij : ij ∈ strictPairs p) :
    Polynomial.eval (gammaPoly x ij.1 ij.2) (GPoly x) =
    Polynomial.C (x ij.1 + x ij.2) *
      ∏ kl ∈ (strictPairs p).erase ij,
        (gammaPoly x ij.1 ij.2 - gammaPoly x kl.1 kl.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [GPoly]
  exact eval_lagrange_sum (strictPairs p)
    (fun kl => Polynomial.C (x kl.1 + x kl.2))
    (fun kl => gammaPoly x kl.1 kl.2) ij hij

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.H_eval_gamma
statement:
theorem H_eval_gamma (x : Fin p → L) (ij : Fin p × Fin p) (hij : ij ∈ strictPairs p) :
    Polynomial.eval (gammaPoly x ij.1 ij.2) (HPoly x) =
    Polynomial.C (x ij.1 * x ij.2) *
      ∏ kl ∈ (strictPairs p).erase ij,
        (gammaPoly x ij.1 ij.2 - gammaPoly x kl.1 kl.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [HPoly]
  exact eval_lagrange_sum (strictPairs p)
    (fun kl => Polynomial.C (x kl.1 * x kl.2))
    (fun kl => gammaPoly x kl.1 kl.2) ij hij

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.quadratic_root_xi
statement:
theorem quadratic_root_xi (x : Fin p → L)
    (ij : Fin p × Fin p) :
    let P
proof:
:= ∏ kl ∈ (strictPairs p).erase ij,
          (gammaPoly x ij.1 ij.2 - gammaPoly x kl.1 kl.2)
    P * Polynomial.C (x ij.1) ^ 2 -
      (Polynomial.C (x ij.1 + x ij.2) * P) * Polynomial.C (x ij.1) +
      (Polynomial.C (x ij.1 * x ij.2) * P) = 0 := by
  simp only []
  have : Polynomial.C (x ij.1) ^ 2 - Polynomial.C (x ij.1 + x ij.2) * Polynomial.C (x ij.1) +
    Polynomial.C (x ij.1 * x ij.2) = 0 := by
    simp [map_add, map_mul]; ring
  calc _ = (∏ kl ∈ (strictPairs p).erase ij,
            (gammaPoly x ij.1 ij.2 - gammaPoly x kl.1 kl.2)) *
           (Polynomial.C (x ij.1) ^ 2 - Polynomial.C (x ij.1 + x ij.2) * Polynomial.C (x ij.1) +
             Polynomial.C (x ij.1 * x ij.2)) := by ring
       _ = _ * 0 := by rw [this]
       _ = 0 := by ring

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.quadratic_root_xj
statement:
theorem quadratic_root_xj (x : Fin p → L)
    (ij : Fin p × Fin p) :
    let P
proof:
:= ∏ kl ∈ (strictPairs p).erase ij,
          (gammaPoly x ij.1 ij.2 - gammaPoly x kl.1 kl.2)
    P * Polynomial.C (x ij.2) ^ 2 -
      (Polynomial.C (x ij.1 + x ij.2) * P) * Polynomial.C (x ij.2) +
      (Polynomial.C (x ij.1 * x ij.2) * P) = 0 := by
  simp only []
  have : Polynomial.C (x ij.2) ^ 2 - Polynomial.C (x ij.1 + x ij.2) * Polynomial.C (x ij.2) +
    Polynomial.C (x ij.1 * x ij.2) = 0 := by
    simp [map_add, map_mul]; ring
  calc _ = (∏ kl ∈ (strictPairs p).erase ij,
            (gammaPoly x ij.1 ij.2 - gammaPoly x kl.1 kl.2)) *
           (Polynomial.C (x ij.2) ^ 2 - Polynomial.C (x ij.1 + x ij.2) * Polynomial.C (x ij.2) +
             Polynomial.C (x ij.1 * x ij.2)) := by ring
       _ = _ * 0 := by rw [this]
       _ = 0 := by ring

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.F_coeff_mem_R
statement:
theorem F_coeff_mem_R [IsRealClosed R]
    {p : ℕ} (P : R[X]) (x : Fin p → L)
    (hx : P.map (algebraMap R L) = ∏ j : Fin p, (X - Polynomial.C (x j)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ q : R[X], q.map (algebraMap R L) = (FPoly x).coeff n
proof:
:= by
  
  simp only [FPoly, Polynomial.coeff_derivative]
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Q_coeff_mem_R P x hx (n + 1)
  refine ⟨Polynomial.C (↑n + 1 : R) * q, ?_⟩
  rw [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C, hq]
  simp [map_add, map_natCast, map_one, mul_comm]

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.monic_QPolynomial
statement:
theorem monic_QPolynomial (x : Fin p → L) :
    (QPolynomial x).Monic
proof:
:= by
  exact Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun ij _ => Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C _)

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.natDegree_QPolynomial
statement:
theorem natDegree_QPolynomial (x : Fin p → L) :
    (QPolynomial x).natDegree = (strictPairs p).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [QPolynomial, Polynomial.natDegree_prod]
  · simp
  · intro ij _; exact (Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C _).ne_zero

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.discPoly_ne_zero
statement:
theorem discPoly_ne_zero (x : Fin p → L)
    (hx_inj : Function.Injective x) :
    discPoly x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [discPoly, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  intro ⟨a, b⟩ hab
  simp only [Finset.mem_offDiag] at hab
  obtain ⟨ha_mem, hb_mem, hab_ne⟩ := hab
  simp only [strictPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at ha_mem hb_mem
  simp only [gammaPoly]
  intro heq
  have hcoeff0 : x a.1 + x a.2 - (x b.1 + x b.2) = 0 := by
    have := congr_arg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p 0) heq
    simp at this; exact this
  have hcoeff1 : x a.1 * x a.2 - x b.1 * x b.2 = 0 := by
    have := congr_arg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p 1) heq
    simp at this; exact this
  have hsum : x a.1 + x a.2 = x b.1 + x b.2 := sub_eq_zero.mp hcoeff0
  have hprod : x a.1 * x a.2 = x b.1 * x b.2 := sub_eq_zero.mp hcoeff1
  
  have hroot : (x a.1 - x b.1) * (x a.1 - x b.2) = 0 := by
    linear_combination x a.1 * hsum - hprod
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hroot with h | h
  · 
    have ha1 : x a.1 = x b.1 := sub_eq_zero.mp h
    have heq1 : a.1 = b.1 := hx_inj ha1
    
    have ha2 : x a.2 = x b.2 := by linear_combination hsum - ha1
    have heq2 : a.2 = b.2 := hx_inj ha2
    exact hab_ne (Prod.ext heq1 heq2)
  · 
    have ha1 : x a.1 = x b.2 := sub_eq_zero.mp h
    have heq1 : a.1 = b.2 := hx_inj ha1
    
    have ha2 : x a.2 = x b.1 := by linear_combination hsum - ha1
    have heq2 : a.2 = b.1 := hx_inj ha2
    
    omega

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.exists_discPoly_eval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_discPoly_eval_ne_zero [IsRealClosed R]
    {p : ℕ} (x : Fin p → L)
    (hx_inj : Function.Injective x) :
    ∃ z : R, Polynomial.eval (algebraMap R L z) (discPoly x) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have : Infinite R := Infinite.of_injective (Nat.cast : ℕ → R) Nat.cast_injective
  have hD : discPoly x ≠ 0 := discPoly_ne_zero x hx_inj
  by_contra h; push Not at h
  classical
  have hinj := (algebraMap R L).injective
  set d := (discPoly x).natDegree
  set emb := Infinite.natEmbedding R
  
  have hcard : Finset.card ((Finset.range (d + 1)).image (fun i => algebraMap R L (emb i))) = d + 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective]
    · exact Finset.card_range (d + 1)
    · exact hinj.comp emb.injective
  
  have hsub : ((Finset.range (d + 1)).image (fun i => algebraMap R L (emb i))).val ⊆
      (discPoly x).roots := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Finset.mem_val, Finset.mem_image] at hy
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [Polynomial.mem_roots hD]
    exact h (emb i)
  
  have hle : d + 1 ≤ d :=
    hcard ▸ Polynomial.card_le_degree_of_subset_roots hsub
  omega

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.separable_Q_eval
statement:
theorem separable_Q_eval (x : Fin p → L) (z : L)
    (hdist : ∀ a ∈ strictPairs p, ∀ b ∈ strictPairs p,
      Polynomial.eval z (gammaPoly x a.1 a.2) = Polynomial.eval z (gammaPoly x b.1 b.2) → a = b) :
    ((QPolynomial x).map (Polynomial.evalRingHom z)).Separable
proof:
:= by
  simp only [QPolynomial, Polynomial.map_prod, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X,
    Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom]
  exact Polynomial.separable_prod_X_sub_C_iff'.mpr hdist

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.D_eval_in_R
statement:
theorem D_eval_in_R [IsRealClosed R]
    {p : ℕ} (P : R[X]) (x : Fin p → L)
    (hx : P.map (algebraMap R L) = ∏ j : Fin p, (X - Polynomial.C (x j)))
    (r : R) :
    Polynomial.eval (algebraMap R L r) (discPoly x) ∈ Set.range (algebraMap R L)
proof:
:= by
  
  set γMv : Fin p × Fin p → MvPolynomial (Fin p) R :=
    fun ij => MvPolynomial.X ij.1 + MvPolynomial.X ij.2 +
      MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X ij.1 * MvPolynomial.X ij.2 with γMv_def
  
  set DMv : MvPolynomial (Fin p) R :=
    ∏ ab ∈ (strictPairs p).offDiag, (γMv ab.1 - γMv ab.2) with DMv_def
  
  have hcoeff : Polynomial.eval (algebraMap R L r) (discPoly x) =
      MvPolynomial.aeval x DMv := by
    simp only [discPoly, DMv_def, map_prod, map_sub, Polynomial.eval_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro ab _
    simp only [γMv_def, map_add, map_mul, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, MvPolynomial.aeval_C,
      gammaPoly, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_X]
    ring
  
  have hsymm : ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin p),
      MvPolynomial.rename σ DMv = DMv := by
    intro σ
    simp only [DMv_def, map_prod, map_sub]
    
    
    
    
    have hγ_rename : ∀ ij : Fin p × Fin p,
        MvPolynomial.rename σ (γMv ij) = γMv (σ ij.1, σ ij.2) := by
      intro ij
      simp only [γMv_def, map_add, map_mul, MvPolynomial.rename_X, MvPolynomial.rename_C]
    have hγ_comm : ∀ i j : Fin p, γMv (i, j) = γMv (j, i) := by
      intro i j; simp only [γMv_def]; ring
    
    set φ : Fin p × Fin p → Fin p × Fin p :=
      fun ij => if σ ij.1 < σ ij.2 then (σ ij.1, σ ij.2) else (σ ij.2, σ ij.1) with φ_def
    have hφ_mem : ∀ ij ∈ strictPairs p, φ ij ∈ strictPairs p := by
      intro ij hij
      simp only [strictPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hij ⊢
      simp only [φ]; split_ifs with h
      · exact h
      · exact lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp h) (fun heq => hij.ne (σ.injective heq.symm))
    have hφ_inj : ∀ ij₁ ∈ strictPairs p, ∀ ij₂ ∈ strictPairs p,
        φ ij₁ = φ ij₂ → ij₁ = ij₂ := by
      intro ij₁ hij₁ ij₂ hij₂ heq
      have h₁ : ij₁.1 < ij₁.2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hij₁).2
      have h₂ : ij₂.1 < ij₂.2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hij₂).2
      simp only [φ] at heq
      split_ifs at heq with ha hb hb
      all_goals (obtain ⟨hc, hd⟩ := Prod.mk.inj heq)
      · exact Prod.ext (σ.injective hc) (σ.injective hd)
      · exfalso; exact absurd (σ.injective hc ▸ σ.injective hd ▸ h₂ :
          ij₁.2 < ij₁.1) (not_lt.mpr h₁.le)
      · exfalso; exact absurd (σ.injective hc ▸ σ.injective hd ▸ h₁ :
          ij₂.2 < ij₂.1) (not_lt.mpr h₂.le)
      · exact Prod.ext (σ.injective hd) (σ.injective hc)
    have hφ_surj : ∀ ij ∈ strictPairs p, ∃ ij' ∈ strictPairs p, φ ij' = ij := by
      intro ij hij
      have hij_lt : ij.1 < ij.2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hij).2
      by_cases hord : σ.symm ij.1 < σ.symm ij.2
      · refine ⟨(σ.symm ij.1, σ.symm ij.2),
            Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hord⟩, ?_⟩
        simp only [φ, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, ite_eq_left hij_lt]
      · have hord' : σ.symm ij.2 < σ.symm ij.1 :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hord) (fun h => hij_lt.ne (σ.symm.injective h).symm)
        refine ⟨(σ.symm ij.2, σ.symm ij.1),
            Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hord'⟩, ?_⟩
        simp only [φ, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr hij_lt.le)]
    have hφ_γ : ∀ ij, γMv (σ ij.1, σ ij.2) = γMv (φ ij) := by
      intro ij; simp only [φ]; split_ifs <;> [rfl; exact hγ_comm _ _]
    
    set ψ : (Fin p × Fin p) × (Fin p × Fin p) → (Fin p × Fin p) × (Fin p × Fin p) :=
      fun ab => (φ ab.1, φ ab.2) with ψ_def
    apply Finset.prod_nbij ψ
    · 
      intro ab hab
      simp only [Finset.mem_offDiag] at hab ⊢
      simp only [ψ]
      exact ⟨hφ_mem ab.1 hab.1, hφ_mem ab.2 hab.2.1,
        fun heq => hab.2.2 (hφ_inj ab.1 hab.1 ab.2 hab.2.1 heq)⟩
    · 
      intro ab₁ hab₁ ab₂ hab₂ heq
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_offDiag] at hab₁ hab₂
      simp only [ψ] at heq
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Prod.mk.inj heq
      exact Prod.ext (hφ_inj _ hab₁.1 _ hab₂.1 h1) (hφ_inj _ hab₁.2.1 _ hab₂.2.1 h2)
    · 
      intro ab hab
      simp only [Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_offDiag] at hab ⊢
      obtain ⟨a', ha'_mem, ha'_eq⟩ := hφ_surj ab.1 hab.1
      obtain ⟨b', hb'_mem, hb'_eq⟩ := hφ_surj ab.2 hab.2.1
      exact ⟨(a', b'), ⟨ha'_mem, hb'_mem,
        fun heq => hab.2.2 (ha'_eq ▸ hb'_eq ▸ congr_arg φ heq)⟩,
        show ψ (a', b') = ab from Prod.ext ha'_eq hb'_eq⟩
    · 
      intro ab _
      simp only [ψ]
      rw [hγ_rename, hγ_rename, hφ_γ, hφ_γ]
  rw [hcoeff]
  exact Azurite.BPR.proposition_2_16 P x hx _ hsymm

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.D_coeff_mem_R
statement:
theorem D_coeff_mem_R [IsRealClosed R]
    {p : ℕ} (P : R[X]) (x : Fin p → L)
    (hx : P.map (algebraMap R L) = ∏ j : Fin p, (X - Polynomial.C (x j)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    (discPoly x).coeff n ∈ Set.range (algebraMap R L)
proof:
:= by
  have : Infinite R := Infinite.of_injective (Nat.cast : ℕ → R) Nat.cast_injective
  exact eval_range_implies_coeff_range _ (D_eval_in_R P x hx) n

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.isSquare_sum_sq
statement: theorem isSquare_sum_sq [IsRealClosed R] (a b : R) : IsSquare (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases IsRealClosed.isSquare_or_isSquare_neg (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) with h | h
  · exact h
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
    have h0 : a * a + b * b + c * c = 0 := by
      have : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c * c = 0 := by linear_combination -hc
      rwa [sq, sq] at this
    
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · subst ha; simp only [zero_mul, zero_add] at h0 ⊢
      by_cases hb : b = 0
      · subst hb; simp
      · 
        exfalso; apply IsSemireal.not_isSumSq_neg_one (R := R)
        have key : (b * b + c * c) * (b⁻¹ * b⁻¹) = 0 := by rw [h0, zero_mul]
        have expand : (b * b + c * c) * (b⁻¹ * b⁻¹) =
          b * b⁻¹ * (b * b⁻¹) + (b⁻¹ * c) * (b⁻¹ * c) := by ring
        rw [expand, mul_inv_cancel₀ hb, one_mul] at key
        
        rw [show (-1 : R) = (b⁻¹ * c) * (b⁻¹ * c) from by linear_combination -key]
        exact IsSumSq.mul_self _
    · 
      exfalso; apply IsSemireal.not_isSumSq_neg_one (R := R)
      have key : (a * a + b * b + c * c) * (a⁻¹ * a⁻¹) = 0 := by rw [h0, zero_mul]
      have expand : (a * a + b * b + c * c) * (a⁻¹ * a⁻¹) =
        a * a⁻¹ * (a * a⁻¹) + (a⁻¹ * b) * (a⁻¹ * b) + (a⁻¹ * c) * (a⁻¹ * c) := by ring
      rw [expand, mul_inv_cancel₀ ha, one_mul] at key
      
      rw [show (-1 : R) = (a⁻¹ * b) * (a⁻¹ * b) + (a⁻¹ * c) * (a⁻¹ * c) from
        by linear_combination -key]
      exact IsSumSq.sq_add _ (IsSumSq.mul_self _)

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.sqrt_exists_Ri
statement: theorem sqrt_exists_Ri [IsRealClosed R] (w : Ri R) : ∃ v : Ri R, v * v = w
proof:
:= by
  
  induction w using AdjoinRoot.induction_on with
  | ih p =>
    set f := (X : R[X]) ^ 2 + 1
    have hfm : f.Monic := monic_X_pow_add_C 1 (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
    set r := p %ₘ f
    
    have haeval_eq : Polynomial.aeval (Ri.i R) p = Polynomial.aeval (Ri.i R) r := by
      have : AdjoinRoot.mk ((X : R[X])^2+1) p = AdjoinRoot.mk ((X : R[X])^2+1) r := by
        rw [AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_mk]
        exact ⟨p /ₘ f, by have := modByMonic_eq_sub_mul_div p f; linear_combination -this⟩
      rw [← AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq, ← AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq] at this; exact this
    rw [show AdjoinRoot.mk _ p = Polynomial.aeval (Ri.i R) p from (AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq p).symm,
        haeval_eq]
    
    have hr_deg : r.natDegree ≤ 1 := by
      have hrd : r.degree < f.degree := degree_modByMonic_lt p hfm
      have hf_deg : f.degree = 2 := by
        have hnat : f.natDegree = 2 := by
          simp [f]
        rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree (Irreducible.ne_zero (Fact.out : Irreducible f)), hnat]
        norm_num
      rw [hf_deg] at hrd
      by_cases hr : r = 0
      · simp [hr]
      · rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hr] at hrd
        exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mp (by exact_mod_cast hrd))
    
    have hr_decomp := Polynomial.eq_X_add_C_of_natDegree_le_one hr_deg
    set a := r.coeff 0
    set b := r.coeff 1
    have haeval_r : ∀ x : Ri R,
        Polynomial.aeval x r = algebraMap R (Ri R) b * x + algebraMap R (Ri R) a := by
      intro x; conv_lhs => rw [hr_decomp]
      simp [Polynomial.aeval_def, eval₂_add, eval₂_mul, eval₂_C, eval₂_X]
    rw [haeval_r]
    
    by_cases hb : b = 0
    · 
      simp only [hb, map_zero, zero_mul, zero_add]
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := sqrt_of_R_in_Ri (R := R) a
      exact ⟨v, by rw [← sq]; exact hv⟩
    · 
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := isSquare_sum_sq a b
      
      
      
      suffices hsuff : ∀ d' : R, a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = d' * d' →
          IsSquare ((a + d') * 2⁻¹) →
          ∃ v, v * v = (algebraMap R (Ri R)) b * Ri.i R + (algebraMap R (Ri R)) a by
        
        rcases IsRealClosed.isSquare_or_isSquare_neg ((a + d) * 2⁻¹) with h₁ | h₁
        · exact hsuff d hd h₁
        · rcases IsRealClosed.isSquare_or_isSquare_neg ((a + -d) * 2⁻¹) with h₂ | h₂
          · exact hsuff (-d) (by rw [neg_mul_neg]; exact hd) h₂
          · 
            
            
            
            
            
            
            exfalso
            obtain ⟨e₁, he₁⟩ := h₁
            obtain ⟨e₂, he₂⟩ := h₂
            apply IsSemireal.not_isSumSq_neg_one (R := R)
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            
            have hprod : e₁ * e₁ * (e₂ * e₂) = -(b * 2⁻¹) * (b * 2⁻¹) := by
              have := he₁; have := he₂
              
              have : e₁ * e₁ * (e₂ * e₂) = -((a+d)*2⁻¹) * -((a + -d)*2⁻¹) := by
                rw [he₁, he₂]
              rw [this]
              have : (a + d) * 2⁻¹ * ((a + -d) * 2⁻¹) = (a * a - d * d) * (2⁻¹ * 2⁻¹) := by ring
              rw [neg_mul_neg, this]
              have hdd : d * d = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := hd.symm
              have : a * a - d * d = -(b * b) := by linear_combination -hdd
              rw [this]; ring
            
            have hb2_ne : b * 2⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
              intro h; simp [mul_eq_zero, hb] at h
            rw [show (-1 : R) = (e₁ * e₂ * (b * 2⁻¹)⁻¹) * (e₁ * e₂ * (b * 2⁻¹)⁻¹) from by
              field_simp
              have := hprod
              nlinarith [hprod,
                          show (b * 2⁻¹) ^ 2 = b ^ 2 * 2⁻¹ ^ 2 from by ring,
                          show e₁ ^ 2 * e₂ ^ 2 = e₁ * e₁ * (e₂ * e₂) from by ring]]
            exact IsSumSq.mul_self _
      
      intro d' hd' ⟨e, he⟩
      
      by_cases he0 : e = 0
      · 
        exfalso; apply hb
        have ha : a + d' = 0 := by
          have h1 : (a + d') * 2⁻¹ = 0 := by rw [he, he0, zero_mul]
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_right (inv_ne_zero two_ne_zero)
        have hd'a : d' = -a := by linarith
        rw [hd'a] at hd'
        have : b ^ 2 = 0 := by linear_combination hd'
        exact pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0) |>.mp this
      · 
        refine ⟨algebraMap R (Ri R) e + algebraMap R (Ri R) (b * (2 * e)⁻¹) * Ri.i R, ?_⟩
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        have hi2 := Ri.i_sq R
        
        have hcoeff : algebraMap R (Ri R) e * algebraMap R (Ri R) (b * (2 * e)⁻¹) =
            algebraMap R (Ri R) (b * 2⁻¹) := by
          rw [← map_mul]; congr 1; field_simp
        
        set c := b * (2 * e)⁻¹
        
        
        
        
        have hexpand : (algebraMap R (Ri R) e + algebraMap R (Ri R) c * Ri.i R) *
            (algebraMap R (Ri R) e + algebraMap R (Ri R) c * Ri.i R) =
            (algebraMap R (Ri R) (e * e) - algebraMap R (Ri R) (c * c)) +
            algebraMap R (Ri R) (e * c + e * c) * Ri.i R := by
          simp only [← map_sub]
          have : Ri.i R * Ri.i R = -(1 : Ri R) := by rw [← sq]; exact hi2
          ring_nf
          rw [show Ri.i R ^ 2 = -(1 : Ri R) from hi2]
          simp only [map_mul, map_sub, map_pow, map_ofNat]; ring
        rw [hexpand]
        
        have him : e * c + e * c = b := by
          simp only [c]; field_simp; ring
        
        have hre : e * e - c * c = a := by
          simp only [c]
          
          
          
          
          
          
          field_simp at he ⊢
          have h1 : d' = 2 * e ^ 2 - a := by linarith
          rw [h1] at hd'
          linear_combination -hd'
        simp only [← map_sub, him, hre]; ring

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.derivative_QPolynomial_eq
proof:
:= by
  simp only [QPolynomial]
  rw [Polynomial.derivative_prod_finset]
  congr 1; ext ij
  simp [Polynomial.derivative_sub, Polynomial.derivative_X, Polynomial.derivative_C]

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.F_eval_gamma
statement:
private lemma F_eval_gamma {L : Type*} [Field L] {p : ℕ} (x : Fin p → L)
    (ij₀ : Fin p × Fin p) (hij₀ : ij₀ ∈ strictPairs p) :
    Polynomial.eval (gammaPoly x ij₀.1 ij₀.2) (FPoly x) =
    ∏ kl ∈ (strictPairs p).erase ij₀,
      (gammaPoly x ij₀.1 ij₀.2 - gammaPoly x kl.1 kl.2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := eval_lagrange_sum (strictPairs p) (fun _ => (1 : L[X]))
    (fun kl => gammaPoly x kl.1 kl.2) ij₀ hij₀
  simp only [Polynomial.C_1, one_mul] at h
  rw [← h]; congr 1
  exact derivative_QPolynomial_eq x

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.odd_degree_has_root_Ri
statement:
theorem odd_degree_has_root_Ri [IsRealClosed R]
    (P : R[X]) (hodd : Odd P.natDegree) :
    ∃ x : Ri R, Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap R (Ri R)) x P = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := IsRealClosed.exists_isRoot_of_odd_natDegree hodd
  exact ⟨algebraMap R (Ri R) r, by
    rw [← Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply,
      show Polynomial.aeval r P = 0 from Polynomial.IsRoot.def.mp hr, map_zero]⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.exists_roots_fin
statement:
private theorem exists_roots_fin {L : Type*} [Field L] (f : L[X]) (d : ℕ)
    (hsplit : f.Splits) (hmonic : f.Monic) (hsep : f.Separable)
    (hdeg : f.natDegree = d) :
    ∃ x : Fin d → L, Function.Injective x ∧
      f = ∏ j : Fin d, (X - C (x j))
proof:
:= by
  subst hdeg
  set rl := f.roots.toList
  have hlen : rl.length = f.natDegree := by
    rw [Multiset.length_toList, hsplit.natDegree_eq_card_roots]
  have hnd : rl.Nodup := by
    rw [← Multiset.coe_nodup, Multiset.coe_toList]
    exact Polynomial.nodup_roots hsep
  refine ⟨fun i => rl[i.val]'(by omega), ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro i j hij
    simp only at hij
    have hi' : i.val < rl.length := by omega
    have hj' : j.val < rl.length := by omega
    have : (⟨i.val, hi'⟩ : Fin rl.length) = ⟨j.val, hj'⟩ :=
      hnd.get_inj_iff.mp (by simpa [List.get_eq_getElem] using hij)
    exact Fin.ext (Fin.mk.inj this)
  · 
    have hprod := hsplit.eq_prod_roots_of_monic hmonic
    conv_lhs => rw [hprod]
    rw [← Multiset.prod_map_toList, ← List.prod_ofFn]
    congr 1
    apply List.ext_getElem
      (by simp [Multiset.length_toList, hsplit.natDegree_eq_card_roots])
      (fun i h1 h2 => by simp [List.getElem_map]; rfl)

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.core_induction
statement:
theorem core_induction [IsRealClosed R]
    (m : ℕ) (n : ℕ) (hn : Odd n) (P : R[X])
    (hmonic : P.Monic) (hdeg : P.natDegree = 2 ^ m * n)
    (hsep : P.Separable) :
    ∃ x : Ri R, Polynomial.aeval x P = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing n P with
  | zero =>
    simp at hdeg
    have hodd : Odd P.natDegree := by rw [hdeg]; exact hn
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := odd_degree_has_root_Ri P hodd
    exact ⟨x, by rwa [Polynomial.aeval_def]⟩
  | succ m' ih =>
    
    set p := P.natDegree with hp_def
    have hn_pos : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Odd.pos hn).ne'
    have hp_pos : 0 < p := by rw [hdeg]; positivity
    
    
    let L := (P * (X ^ 2 + 1 : R[X])).SplittingField
    have hPQ_splits : ((P * (X ^ 2 + 1)).map (algebraMap R L)).Splits :=
      Polynomial.SplittingField.splits (P * (X ^ 2 + 1))
    have hP_ne : P.map (algebraMap R L) ≠ 0 := Polynomial.map_ne_zero hmonic.ne_zero
    have hXi_ne : (X ^ 2 + 1 : R[X]).map (algebraMap R L) ≠ 0 :=
      Polynomial.map_ne_zero (monic_X_pow_add_C 1 (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).ne_zero
    rw [Polynomial.map_mul] at hPQ_splits
    have ⟨hP_splits, hXi_splits⟩ :=
      (Polynomial.splits_mul hP_ne hXi_ne).mp hPQ_splits
    
    have hXi_deg : ((X ^ 2 + 1 : R[X]).map (algebraMap R L)).degree ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [Polynomial.degree_map_eq_of_injective (algebraMap R L).injective]
      have h1 : (X ^ 2 + 1 : R[X]) ≠ 0 := by
        have : (X ^ 2 + 1 : R[X]).natDegree = 2 := by compute_degree!
        exact fun h => by simp [h] at this
      rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree h1,
          show Polynomial.natDegree (X ^ 2 + 1 : R[X]) = 2 from by compute_degree!]
      norm_num
    obtain ⟨ι, hι_root⟩ := hXi_splits.exists_eval_eq_zero hXi_deg
    have hι : Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap R L) ι (X ^ 2 + 1) = 0 := by
      rwa [Polynomial.eval_map] at hι_root
    let φ : Ri R →+* L := AdjoinRoot.lift (algebraMap R L) ι hι
    have hφ_inj : Function.Injective φ := RingHom.injective _
    have hφ_alg : ∀ r : R, φ (algebraMap R (Ri R) r) = algebraMap R L r :=
      fun r => by rw [AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]; exact AdjoinRoot.lift_of hι
    
    have hPL_monic : (P.map (algebraMap R L)).Monic := hmonic.map _
    have hPL_sep : (P.map (algebraMap R L)).Separable := hsep.map
    have hPL_deg : (P.map (algebraMap R L)).natDegree = p :=
      (hmonic.natDegree_map (algebraMap R L)).trans rfl
    obtain ⟨x, hx_inj, hx⟩ := exists_roots_fin (P.map (algebraMap R L)) p
      hP_splits hPL_monic hPL_sep hPL_deg
    
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := exists_discPoly_eval_ne_zero (R := R) x hx_inj
    
    
    
    
    have hQ_in_R : ∃ Q_R : R[X],
        Q_R.map (algebraMap R L) =
          (QPolynomial x).map (Polynomial.evalRingHom (algebraMap R L z₀)) := by
      rw [poly_in_image_iff_coeffs_in_range]
      intro k
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
      obtain ⟨q_k, hq_k⟩ := Q_coeff_mem_R P x hx k
      exact ⟨Polynomial.eval z₀ q_k, by
        rw [← hq_k]; simp [Polynomial.eval_map]⟩
    obtain ⟨Q_R, hQ_R⟩ := hQ_in_R
    
    
    have hQ_R_monic : Q_R.Monic := by
      have : (Q_R.map (algebraMap R L)).Monic := by
        rw [hQ_R]; exact (monic_QPolynomial x).map (Polynomial.evalRingHom _)
      exact Polynomial.monic_of_injective (algebraMap R L).injective this
    
    have hQ_R_ndeg : Q_R.natDegree = (strictPairs p).card := by
      have h1 := hQ_R_monic.natDegree_map (algebraMap R L)
      rw [hQ_R] at h1
      rw [← h1]
      rw [(monic_QPolynomial x).natDegree_map, natDegree_QPolynomial]
    
    have hcard : (strictPairs p).card = p * (p - 1) / 2 := card_strictPairs p
    obtain ⟨n', hn'_odd, hdeg_eq⟩ := half_degree_odd_factor
      (show 1 ≤ m' + 1 from by omega) hn hn_pos
    have hQ_R_deg : Q_R.natDegree = 2 ^ m' * n' := by
      rw [hQ_R_ndeg, hcard, hdeg]; exact hdeg_eq
    
    have hQ_R_sep : Q_R.Separable := by
      rw [← Polynomial.separable_map (algebraMap R L)]
      rw [hQ_R]
      refine separable_Q_eval x ((algebraMap R L) z₀) ?_
      intro a ha b hb heq
      by_contra hab
      apply hz₀
      simp only [discPoly, Polynomial.eval_prod]
      have hmem : (a, b) ∈ (strictPairs p).offDiag := by
        rw [Finset.mem_offDiag]; exact ⟨ha, hb, hab⟩
      refine Finset.prod_eq_zero hmem ?_
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub, heq, sub_self]
    
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := ih n' hn'_odd Q_R hQ_R_monic hQ_R_deg hQ_R_sep
    
    
    have hcomp : φ.comp (algebraMap R (Ri R)) = algebraMap R L := by
      ext r; exact hφ_alg r
    have hγ_L : Polynomial.eval (φ γ) ((QPolynomial x).map
        (Polynomial.evalRingHom (algebraMap R L z₀))) = 0 := by
      have h1 : Polynomial.eval (φ γ) (Q_R.map (algebraMap R L)) = 0 := by
        have : φ (Polynomial.aeval γ Q_R) = 0 := by rw [hγ, map_zero]
        rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.hom_eval₂, hcomp] at this
        rwa [Polynomial.eval_map]
      rwa [hQ_R] at h1
    
    
    set z₀' := (algebraMap R L) z₀ with hz₀'_def
    obtain ⟨ij₀, hij₀, hφγ_eq⟩ : ∃ ij₀ ∈ strictPairs p, φ γ = Polynomial.eval z₀' (gammaPoly x ij₀.1 ij₀.2) := by
      simp only [QPolynomial, Polynomial.map_prod, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X,
        Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom] at hγ_L
      rw [Polynomial.eval_prod] at hγ_L
      obtain ⟨ij₀, hij₀, heq⟩ := (Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff (M₀ := L)).mp hγ_L
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C] at heq
      exact ⟨ij₀, hij₀, sub_eq_zero.mp heq⟩
    have interchange : ∀ (Q' : (L[X])[X]) (f' : L[X]),
        Polynomial.eval (Polynomial.eval z₀' f') (Q'.map (Polynomial.evalRingHom z₀')) =
        Polynomial.eval z₀' (Polynomial.eval f' Q') := by
      intro Q' f'
      induction Q' using Polynomial.induction_on' with
      | add p q hp hq => simp only [Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.eval_add, hp, hq]
      | monomial n a =>
        simp only [Polynomial.map_monomial, Polynomial.eval_monomial, Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom]
        rw [← Polynomial.eval_pow, ← Polynomial.eval_mul]
    have eval_pullback : ∀ (q_k : R[X]),
        (algebraMap R L) (Polynomial.eval z₀ q_k) = Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap R L) z₀' q_k := by
      intro q_k; rw [hz₀'_def, ← Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval]; rfl
    have coeff_pullback : ∀ (Poly_L : (L[X])[X]),
        (∀ k, ∃ q : R[X], q.map (algebraMap R L) = Poly_L.coeff k) →
        ∃ Poly_R : R[X], Poly_R.map (algebraMap R L) = Poly_L.map (Polynomial.evalRingHom z₀') := by
      intro Poly_L hcoeffs
      rw [poly_in_image_iff_coeffs_in_range]; intro k; rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
      simp only [Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom]
      obtain ⟨q_k, hq_k⟩ := hcoeffs k
      exact ⟨Polynomial.eval z₀ q_k, by rw [eval_pullback, ← Polynomial.eval_map, hq_k]⟩
    obtain ⟨G_R, hG_R⟩ := coeff_pullback _ (G_coeff_mem_R P x hx)
    obtain ⟨H_R, hH_R⟩ := coeff_pullback _ (H_coeff_mem_R P x hx)
    obtain ⟨F_R, hF_R⟩ := coeff_pullback _ (F_coeff_mem_R P x hx)
    have φ_aeval : ∀ (w : Ri R) (f : R[X]),
        φ (Polynomial.aeval w f) = Polynomial.eval (φ w) (f.map (algebraMap R L)) := by
      intro w f; rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.hom_eval₂, hcomp, Polynomial.eval_map]
    set γ₀ := Polynomial.eval z₀' (gammaPoly x ij₀.1 ij₀.2) with hγ₀_def
    have hφG : φ (Polynomial.aeval γ G_R) = (x ij₀.1 + x ij₀.2) * φ (Polynomial.aeval γ F_R) := by
      rw [φ_aeval γ G_R, hG_R, hφγ_eq, interchange, G_eval_gamma x ij₀ hij₀]
      rw [φ_aeval γ F_R, hF_R, hφγ_eq, interchange, F_eval_gamma x ij₀ hij₀]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
    have hφH : φ (Polynomial.aeval γ H_R) = (x ij₀.1 * x ij₀.2) * φ (Polynomial.aeval γ F_R) := by
      rw [φ_aeval γ H_R, hH_R, hφγ_eq, interchange, H_eval_gamma x ij₀ hij₀]
      rw [φ_aeval γ F_R, hF_R, hφγ_eq, interchange, F_eval_gamma x ij₀ hij₀]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
    have hF_ne : Polynomial.aeval γ F_R ≠ 0 := by
      intro hF0
      have h0 : φ (Polynomial.aeval γ F_R) = 0 := by rw [hF0, map_zero]
      rw [φ_aeval, hF_R, hφγ_eq, interchange, F_eval_gamma x ij₀ hij₀] at h0
      rw [Polynomial.eval_prod] at h0
      obtain ⟨kl, hkl_mem, hkl_eq⟩ := (Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff (M₀ := L)).mp h0
      rw [Polynomial.eval_sub] at hkl_eq
      have hkl_sp := Finset.mem_erase.mp hkl_mem
      apply hz₀; simp only [discPoly, Polynomial.eval_prod]
      exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := (ij₀, kl))
        (by rw [Finset.mem_offDiag]; exact ⟨hij₀, hkl_sp.2, hkl_sp.1.symm⟩)
        (by simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub, hkl_eq])
    have hφF_ne : φ (Polynomial.aeval γ F_R) ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero_iff φ hφ_inj).mpr hF_ne
    set s := Polynomial.aeval γ G_R * (Polynomial.aeval γ F_R)⁻¹
    set t := Polynomial.aeval γ H_R * (Polynomial.aeval γ F_R)⁻¹
    have hφs : φ s = x ij₀.1 + x ij₀.2 := by
      simp only [s, map_mul, map_inv₀, hφG, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hφF_ne, mul_one]
    have hφt : φ t = x ij₀.1 * x ij₀.2 := by
      simp only [t, map_mul, map_inv₀, hφH, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hφF_ne, mul_one]
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := sqrt_exists_Ri (R := R) (s ^ 2 - 4 * t)
    have h2_ne : (2 : Ri R) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h2; apply (two_ne_zero : (2 : R) ≠ 0)
      exact (algebraMap R (Ri R)).injective
        (show (algebraMap R (Ri R)) 2 = (algebraMap R (Ri R)) 0 by rw [map_zero]; exact_mod_cast h2)
    have hφ_2 : φ 2 = (2 : L) := by
      show φ ((algebraMap R (Ri R)) 2) = (algebraMap R L) 2; rw [hφ_alg]
    have hφ_4 : φ 4 = (4 : L) := by
      show φ ((algebraMap R (Ri R)) 4) = (algebraMap R L) 4; rw [hφ_alg]
    set y := (s + d) * (2 : Ri R)⁻¹
    have hφd_sq : φ d * φ d = (x ij₀.1 - x ij₀.2) ^ 2 := by
      have := congr_arg φ hd
      rw [map_mul, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, hφs, hφt, hφ_4] at this
      rw [this]; ring
    have hφy : φ y = (x ij₀.1 + x ij₀.2 + φ d) * (2 : L)⁻¹ := by
      simp only [y, map_mul, map_add, hφs, map_inv₀, hφ_2]
    have hφy_root : (φ y - x ij₀.1) * (φ y - x ij₀.2) = 0 := by
      rw [hφy]
      have hlhs : ((x ij₀.1 + x ij₀.2 + φ d) * (2 : L)⁻¹ - x ij₀.1) *
                  ((x ij₀.1 + x ij₀.2 + φ d) * (2 : L)⁻¹ - x ij₀.2) =
                  (φ d * φ d - (x ij₀.1 - x ij₀.2) ^ 2) * ((2 : L)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [hlhs, hφd_sq, sub_self, zero_mul]
    have hP_root : ∀ j : Fin p, Polynomial.eval (x j) (P.map (algebraMap R L)) = 0 := by
      intro j; rw [hx, Polynomial.eval_prod]
      exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j)
        (by simp [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C])
    have root_from_φ : ∀ (w : Ri R) (j : Fin p), φ w = x j → Polynomial.aeval w P = 0 := by
      intro w j hwj
      apply hφ_inj
      rw [φ_aeval, Polynomial.eval_map, map_zero, (Polynomial.eval_map _ _).symm, hwj]
      exact hP_root j
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hφy_root with h | h
    · exact ⟨y, root_from_φ y ij₀.1 (sub_eq_zero.mp h)⟩
    · exact ⟨y, root_from_φ y ij₀.2 (sub_eq_zero.mp h)⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.monic_has_root_Ri
statement:
theorem monic_has_root_Ri [IsRealClosed R]
    (P : R[X]) (hdeg : P.natDegree ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x : Ri R, Polynomial.aeval x P = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hnu : ¬ IsUnit P := fun h => hdeg (Polynomial.natDegree_eq_zero_of_isUnit h)
  obtain ⟨q, hq_monic, hq_irr, hq_dvd⟩ := Polynomial.exists_monic_irreducible_factor P hnu
  
  have hq_sep : q.Separable := hq_irr.separable
  
  have hq_deg : q.natDegree ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (hq_monic.natDegree_pos_of_not_isUnit hq_irr.1).ne' |>.ne'
  
  obtain ⟨m, n', hn', hd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_odd hq_deg
  
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := core_induction m n' hn' q hq_monic hd hq_sep
  
  exact ⟨x, by obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hq_dvd; rw [hr, map_mul, hx, zero_mul]⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.Ri_poly_has_root
statement:
theorem Ri_poly_has_root [IsRealClosed R]
    (P : (Ri R)[X]) (hmonic : P.Monic) (hirr : Irreducible P) :
    ∃ x : Ri R, Polynomial.eval x P = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  set Pbar := Polynomial.map (Ri.conj R : Ri R →+* Ri R) P with hPbar_def
  
  have hPP_real : ∃ Q : R[X], Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Ri R)) Q = P * Pbar := by
    rw [← Polynomial.mem_lifts]
    rw [Polynomial.lifts_iff_coeff_lifts]
    intro n
    have := conj_coeff_mul_conjPoly P n
    simp only [conjPoly] at this
    exact Ri.conj_fixed_mem_range _ this
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hPP_real
  
  have hQ_deg : Q.natDegree ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    
    have : (P * Pbar).natDegree = 0 := by
      rw [← hQ, Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective (algebraMap R (Ri R)).injective]; exact h0
    
    have hP_deg : P.natDegree ≥ 1 := Irreducible.natDegree_pos hirr
    have hPbar_deg : Pbar.natDegree = P.natDegree :=
      Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective (Ri.conj_injective R) P
    have hPbar_monic : Pbar.Monic := Polynomial.Monic.map _ hmonic
    have hdeg_mul : (P * Pbar).natDegree = P.natDegree + Pbar.natDegree :=
      Polynomial.Monic.natDegree_mul hmonic hPbar_monic
    omega
  
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := monic_has_root_Ri Q hQ_deg
  
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_def] at hx
  
  have hPP : Polynomial.eval x (P * Pbar) = 0 := by
    rw [← hQ, Polynomial.eval_map]; exact hx
  rw [Polynomial.eval_mul] at hPP
  
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hPP with h | h
  · exact ⟨x, h⟩
  · 
    
    
    
    rw [Polynomial.eval_map] at h
    have h_eval : (Ri.conj R : Ri R →+* Ri R) (Polynomial.eval ((Ri.conj R) x) P) = 0 := by
      have hinv : (Ri.conj R : Ri R →+* Ri R) ((Ri.conj R) x) = x := Ri.conj_conj R x
      rw [← Polynomial.eval₂_hom, hinv]; exact h
    have hinj : Function.Injective (Ri.conj R : Ri R →+* Ri R) := Ri.conj_injective R
    exact ⟨(Ri.conj R) x, hinj (by rw [h_eval, map_zero])⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.isAlgClosed_Ri
statement: theorem isAlgClosed_Ri [IsRealClosed R] : IsAlgClosed (Ri R)
proof:
:=
  IsAlgClosed.of_exists_root _ Ri_poly_has_root

name: Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.theorem_2_11_a_b
statement: theorem theorem_2_11_a_b [IsRealClosed R] : IsAlgClosed (Ri R)
proof: := isAlgClosed_Ri

name: Azurite.BPR.Factorization.exists_split_multiset
statement:
lemma exists_split_multiset (m : Multiset R[X])
    (h : ∀ q ∈ m, (∃ a : R, q = linearFactor a) ∨
        (∃ c d : R, d ≠ 0 ∧ q = quadraticFactor (c, d))) :
    ∃ (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R)),
      (∀ pq ∈ quadratics, pq.2 ≠ 0) ∧
      m.prod = (linears.map linearFactor).prod *
               (quadratics.map quadraticFactor).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => exact ⟨0, 0, by simp, by simp⟩
  | cons q m ih =>
    have h' : ∀ q' ∈ m, (∃ a : R, q' = linearFactor a) ∨
        (∃ c d : R, d ≠ 0 ∧ q' = quadraticFactor (c, d)) :=
      fun q' hq' => h q' (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hq')
    obtain ⟨ls, qs, hqs_d, heq⟩ := ih h'
    rcases h q (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _) with ⟨a, ha⟩ | ⟨c, d, hd, hcd⟩
    · refine ⟨a ::ₘ ls, qs, hqs_d, ?_⟩
      rw [Multiset.prod_cons, ha, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, heq,
          mul_assoc]
    · refine ⟨ls, (c, d) ::ₘ qs, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro pq hpq
        rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp hpq with h1 | h1
        · rw [h1]; exact hd
        · exact hqs_d _ h1
      · rw [Multiset.prod_cons, hcd, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, heq]
        ring

name: Azurite.BPR.Factorization.exists_factorization
statement:
theorem exists_factorization [IsRealClosed R] [DecidableEq R] (P : R[X]) :
    ∃ (linears : Multiset R) (quadratics : Multiset (R × R)),
      (∀ pq ∈ quadratics, pq.2 ≠ 0) ∧
      P = C P.leadingCoeff *
          (linears.map linearFactor).prod *
          (quadratics.map quadraticFactor).prod
proof:
:= by
  let : LinearOrder R := IsRealClosed.toLinearOrder
  let : IsOrderedRing R := IsRealClosed.toIsOrderedRing
  by_cases hP : P = 0
  · refine ⟨0, 0, by simp, ?_⟩
    rw [hP, leadingCoeff_zero, map_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul]
  
  have hfactors : ∀ q ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors P,
      (∃ a : R, q = linearFactor a) ∨
      (∃ c d : R, d ≠ 0 ∧ q = quadraticFactor (c, d)) := by
    intro q hq
    rw [Polynomial.mem_normalizedFactors_iff hP] at hq
    obtain ⟨hirr, hmon, _⟩ := hq
    rcases proposition_2_19_of_isRealClosed hirr hmon with hdeg | ⟨c, d, hd, hcd⟩
    · left
      refine ⟨-q.coeff 0, ?_⟩
      rw [linearFactor, show (X - C (-q.coeff 0) : R[X]) = X + C (q.coeff 0) from by
        rw [C_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]]
      exact hmon.eq_X_add_C hdeg
    · right
      exact ⟨c, d, hd, hcd⟩
  obtain ⟨ls, qs, hqs, heq⟩ := exists_split_multiset _ hfactors
  refine ⟨ls, qs, hqs, ?_⟩
  have hprod := Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul_prod_normalizedFactors P
  rw [heq, ← mul_assoc] at hprod
  exact hprod.symm

name: Azurite.BPR.Factorization.aeval_linearFactor_self
statement:
theorem aeval_linearFactor_self (a : R) :
    aeval (algebraMap R (Ri R) a) (linearFactor a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold linearFactor
  rw [map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C]
  exact sub_self _

name: Azurite.BPR.Factorization.aeval_quadraticFactor_root
statement:
theorem aeval_quadraticFactor_root (c d : R) :
    aeval (algebraMap R (Ri R) c + algebraMap R (Ri R) d * Ri.i R)
      (quadraticFactor (c, d)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show aeval _ ((X - C c) ^ 2 + C (d ^ 2)) = 0
  rw [map_add, map_pow, map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C, aeval_C]
  set ι := algebraMap R (Ri R)
  have hsub : (ι c + ι d * Ri.i R) - ι c = ι d * Ri.i R := by ring
  rw [hsub, mul_pow, Ri.i_sq]
  rw [show ι d ^ 2 * -1 + ι (d ^ 2) = ι d ^ 2 * -1 + ι d ^ 2 from by
    rw [map_pow]]
  ring

name: Azurite.BPR.Factorization.aeval_linearFactor_prod_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : linearFactor a ∈ linears.map linearFactor :=
    Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Multiset.dvd_prod hmem
  rw [hQ, map_mul, aeval_linearFactor_self, zero_mul]

name: Azurite.BPR.Factorization.aeval_quadraticFactor_prod_of_mem
statement:
theorem aeval_quadraticFactor_prod_of_mem {quadratics : Multiset (R × R)}
    {c d : R} (hcd : (c, d) ∈ quadratics) :
    aeval (algebraMap R (Ri R) c + algebraMap R (Ri R) d * Ri.i R)
      ((quadratics.map quadraticFactor).prod) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : quadraticFactor (c, d) ∈ quadratics.map quadraticFactor :=
    Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨(c, d), hcd, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Multiset.dvd_prod hmem
  rw [hQ, map_mul, aeval_quadraticFactor_root, zero_mul]

name: Azurite.BPR.lex_bot
statement:
theorem lex_bot {k : ℕ} {α : Fin k →₀ ℕ} (hα : α ≠ 0) :
    LexOrder k ℕ 0 α
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LexOrder, Pi.Lex, Pi.zero_apply]
  rw [Finsupp.ne_iff] at hα
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hα
  have hi' : 0 < α i := by simp [Finsupp.coe_zero] at hi; omega
  classical
  let S := Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin k => 0 < α j)
  have hS : S.Nonempty := ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hi'⟩⟩
  refine ⟨S.min' hS, fun m hm => ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_contra h; push Not at h
    have : 0 < α m := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by omega)
    exact absurd (Finset.min'_le S m (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, this⟩))
      (not_le.mpr hm)
  · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.min'_mem S hS)).2

name: Azurite.BPR.lex_add_right
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LexOrder, Pi.Lex] at *
  obtain ⟨i, hi_eq, hi_lt⟩ := h
  refine ⟨i, fun m hm => ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [Pi.add_apply, hi_eq m hm]
  · simp [Pi.add_apply]; omega

name: Azurite.BPR.lex_le_set_infinite
proof:
:= by
  
  apply Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem (f := fun n : ℕ => Finsupp.single ⟨1, by omega⟩ n)
  · intro a b hab
    simp [Finsupp.single_eq_single_iff] at hab
    omega
  · intro n
    left
    simp only [LexOrder, Pi.Lex]
    exact ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, fun j hj => absurd hj (not_lt.mpr (Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr (Nat.zero_le _))),
      by simp [Fin.ext_iff]⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.isSumSq_map
statement:
private lemma isSumSq_map {A B : Type*} [Ring A] [Ring B]
    (f : A →+* B) {x : A} (h : IsSumSq x) : IsSumSq (f x)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero => exact map_zero f ▸ .zero
  | sq_add a _ ih => rw [map_add, map_mul]; exact .sq_add (f a) ih

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.weighted_decompose
statement:
theorem weighted_decompose {R : Type*} [Field R] {a : R} [Fact (Irreducible (sqSubC a))]
    {n : ℕ} (γ : Fin n → R) (z : Fin n → AdjoinRoot (sqSubC a))
    (hsum : -1 = ∑ i, algebraMap R _ (γ i) * (z i) ^ 2) :
    ∃ x y : Fin n → R, (-1 : R) = ∑ i, γ i * (x i ^ 2 + a * y i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  choose x y hxy using fun i => repr_exists_sq_sub a (z i)
  set rt := AdjoinRoot.root (sqSubC a)
  have hrt2 : rt ^ 2 = algebraMap R _ a := root_sq_sub_C a
  have hsq : ∀ i, algebraMap R _ (γ i) * (z i) ^ 2 =
      algebraMap R _ (γ i * (x i ^ 2 + a * y i ^ 2)) +
      algebraMap R _ (γ i * (2 * (x i * y i))) * rt := by
    intro i
    rw [hxy i, pow_two]
    have step1 : (algebraMap R (AdjoinRoot (sqSubC a)) (x i) + algebraMap R _ (y i) * rt) *
        (algebraMap R _ (x i) + algebraMap R _ (y i) * rt) =
        algebraMap R _ (x i) * algebraMap R _ (x i) +
        algebraMap R _ (y i) * algebraMap R _ (y i) * (rt * rt) +
        (algebraMap R _ (x i) * algebraMap R _ (y i) +
         algebraMap R _ (x i) * algebraMap R _ (y i)) * rt := by ring
    rw [step1, show rt * rt = rt ^ 2 from (pow_two rt).symm, hrt2]
    simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_ofNat, map_pow]; ring
  have key : (-1 : AdjoinRoot (sqSubC a)) =
      algebraMap R _ (∑ i, γ i * (x i ^ 2 + a * y i ^ 2)) +
      algebraMap R _ (∑ i, γ i * (2 * (x i * y i))) * rt := by
    rw [hsum]; simp_rw [hsq, map_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_mul]
  have hdiff : algebraMap R _ (-1 - ∑ i, γ i * (x i ^ 2 + a * y i ^ 2)) +
      algebraMap R _ (0 - ∑ i, γ i * (2 * (x i * y i))) * rt = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, map_neg, map_one, map_zero]; linear_combination key
  obtain ⟨heq1, _⟩ := repr_unique_sq_sub a hdiff
  exact ⟨x, y, sub_eq_zero.mp heq1⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.mul_closure_form
statement:
private theorem mul_closure_form {B E : Type*} [CommRing B] [CommRing E] [Algebra B E]
    (C : Subsemiring B) (t : E)
    (ht : t ∈ Submonoid.closure ((algebraMap B E '' (C : Set B)) ∪ {x | IsSquare x})) :
    ∃ γ ∈ C, ∃ w, t = algebraMap B E γ * w ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using Submonoid.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ | ⟨w, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨c, hc, 1, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨1, C.one_mem, w, by simp [pow_two]⟩
  | one => exact ⟨1, C.one_mem, 1, by simp⟩
  | mul x y _ _ ihx ihy =>
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ, w, rfl⟩ := ihx
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, v, rfl⟩ := ihy
    exact ⟨γ * δ, C.mul_mem hγ hδ, w * v, by rw [map_mul]; ring⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.add_closure_form
statement:
private theorem add_closure_form {B E : Type*} [CommRing B] [CommRing E] [Algebra B E]
    (C : Subsemiring B) (t : E)
    (ht : t ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Submonoid.closure
      ((algebraMap B E '' (C : Set B)) ∪ {x | IsSquare x}) : Set E)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (γ : Fin n → B) (w : Fin n → E),
      (∀ i, γ i ∈ C) ∧ t = ∑ i, algebraMap B E (γ i) * (w i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using AddSubmonoid.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ, w, rfl⟩ := mul_closure_form C x hx
    exact ⟨1, fun _ => γ, fun _ => w, fun _ => hγ, by simp⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0, fun i => i.elim0, by simp⟩
  | add x y _ _ ihx ihy =>
    obtain ⟨n, γ, w, hγ, rfl⟩ := ihx
    obtain ⟨m, δ, v, hδ, rfl⟩ := ihy
    refine ⟨n + m, Fin.append γ δ, Fin.append w v, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact fun i => Fin.addCases (fun j => by simpa using hγ j) (fun j => by simpa using hδ j) i
    · rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]; simp [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.adjoin_compatible
statement:
theorem adjoin_compatible {R : Type*} [Field R] {a : R} (C : Subsemiring R)
    (hCsq : ∀ x : R, x * x ∈ C) (ha : a ∈ C) (hC : (-1 : R) ∉ C) (ha_sq : ¬ IsSquare a) :
    (-1 : AdjoinRoot (sqSubC a)) ∉ Subsemiring.closure
      ((algebraMap R (AdjoinRoot (sqSubC a)) '' (C : Set R)) ∪ {x | IsSquare x})
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have : Fact (Irreducible (sqSubC a)) := ⟨irred_X_sq_sub_C ha_sq⟩
  rw [Subsemiring.mem_closure_iff] at hmem
  obtain ⟨n, γ, w, hγ, hsum⟩ := add_closure_form C _ hmem
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := weighted_decompose γ w hsum
  refine hC ?_
  rw [hxy]
  refine Subsemiring.sum_mem _ (fun i _ => C.mul_mem (hγ i) (C.add_mem ?_ (C.mul_mem ha ?_)))
  · rw [pow_two]; exact hCsq (x i)
  · rw [pow_two]; exact hCsq (y i)

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.exists_mem_chain
proof:
:= by
  have hdir : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) c := hc.directedOn
  induction n with
  | zero => obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hne; exact ⟨S, hS, fun i => i.elim0⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hSv⟩ := ih (fun i => v i.succ) (fun i => hv i.succ)
    have hmem : ∃ S' ∈ c, v 0 ∈ S' := by
      have hx' : v 0 ∈ (sSup c).toSubfield := hv 0
      rw [IntermediateField.sSup_toSubfield c hne] at hx'
      have hne' : (IntermediateField.toSubfield '' c).Nonempty := hne.image _
      have hdir' : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) (IntermediateField.toSubfield '' c) := by
        rintro _ ⟨Sa, hSa, rfl⟩ _ ⟨Sb, hSb, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨Sc, hSc, haSc, hbSc⟩ := hdir Sa hSa Sb hSb
        exact ⟨Sc.toSubfield, ⟨Sc, hSc, rfl⟩, haSc, hbSc⟩
      obtain ⟨s, ⟨S', hS', rfl⟩, hxs⟩ := (Subfield.mem_sSup_of_directedOn hne' hdir').mp hx'
      exact ⟨S', hS', hxs⟩
    obtain ⟨S', hS', hv0⟩ := hmem
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hST, hS'T⟩ := hdir S hS S' hS'
    exact ⟨T, hT, fun i => Fin.cases (hS'T hv0) (fun j => hST (hSv j)) i⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.mem_genCone_of_repr
proof:
:= by
  refine fun hcomp => hcomp ?_
  rw [genCone, h]
  refine Subsemiring.sum_mem _ (fun i _ => Subsemiring.mul_mem _
    (Subsemiring.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨p i, hp i, rfl⟩))
    (Subsemiring.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨z i, pow_two (z i)⟩)))

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.sSup_compatible_of_chain
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  rw [genCone, Subsemiring.mem_closure_iff] at hmem
  obtain ⟨n, p, z, hp, hsum⟩ := add_closure_form (Subsemiring.nonneg F) _ hmem
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hSz⟩ := exists_mem_chain hc hne (fun i => (z i).val) (fun i => (z i).2)
  set z' : Fin n → ↥S := fun i => ⟨(z i).val, hSz i⟩
  have heq : (-1 : ↥S) = ∑ i, algebraMap F ↥S (p i) * (z' i) ^ 2 := by
    apply (IntermediateField.inclusion (le_sSup hS)).injective
    rw [map_neg, map_one, map_sum]
    simp only [map_mul, map_pow]
    exact hsum
  exact mem_genCone_of_repr S p hp z' heq (hcomp S hS)

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.bot_compatible
statement: private theorem bot_compatible : Compatible (⊥ : IntermediateField F C)
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  rw [genCone, Subsemiring.mem_closure_iff] at hmem
  obtain ⟨n, p, z, hp, hsum⟩ := add_closure_form (Subsemiring.nonneg F) _ hmem
  have key : (-1 : F) = ∑ i, p i * (IntermediateField.botEquiv F C (z i)) ^ 2 := by
    have hb := congrArg (IntermediateField.botEquiv F C) hsum
    rw [map_neg, map_one, map_sum] at hb
    rw [hb]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [map_mul, map_pow, AlgEquiv.commutes]; simp)
  have hnn : (0 : F) ≤ ∑ i, p i * (IntermediateField.botEquiv F C (z i)) ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hp i) (sq_nonneg _))
  rw [← key] at hnn
  exact absurd hnn (by norm_num)

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.exists_maximal_compatible
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_compatible :
    ∃ R : IntermediateField F C,
      Compatible R ∧ ∀ S : IntermediateField F C, Compatible S → R ≤ S → S = R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hmax⟩ := zorn_le₀ {S : IntermediateField F C | Compatible S}
    (fun cc hsub hchain => by
      rcases cc.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
      · exact ⟨⊥, bot_compatible, fun _ h => h.elim⟩
      · exact ⟨sSup cc, sSup_compatible_of_chain hchain hne (fun S hS => hsub hS),
          fun S hS => le_sSup hS⟩)
  exact ⟨R, hR, fun S hS hle => le_antisymm (hmax hS hle) hle⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.transfer
statement:
private theorem transfer {R : IntermediateField F C} (F₁ : Type*) [Field F₁]
    [Algebra (↥R) F₁] [Algebra F F₁] [IsScalarTower F (↥R) F₁] (f : F₁ →ₐ[↥R] C)
    (S : IntermediateField F C) (hSrange : (S : Set C) = Set.range f)
    (s : ↥S) (hs : s ∈ genCone S) :
    ∃ t : F₁, f t = s.val ∧ t ∈ genConeAlg (F := F) F₁
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Subsemiring.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ | ⟨w, rfl⟩
    · refine ⟨algebraMap F F₁ p, ?_, Subsemiring.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)⟩
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F ↥R F₁, f.commutes,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F ↥R C, ← IntermediateField.coe_algebraMap_apply]
    · obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : F₁, f u = w.val := by
        have hw : (w : C) ∈ (S : Set C) := w.2
        rw [hSrange] at hw; exact hw
      exact ⟨u ^ 2, by rw [map_pow, hu]; push_cast; ring,
        Subsemiring.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨u, pow_two u⟩)⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp, Subsemiring.zero_mem _⟩
  | one => exact ⟨1, by simp, Subsemiring.one_mem _⟩
  | add x y _ _ ihx ihy =>
    obtain ⟨tx, htx, hmx⟩ := ihx; obtain ⟨ty, hty, hmy⟩ := ihy
    exact ⟨tx + ty, by rw [map_add, htx, hty]; rfl, Subsemiring.add_mem _ hmx hmy⟩
  | mul x y _ _ ihx ihy =>
    obtain ⟨tx, htx, hmx⟩ := ihx; obtain ⟨ty, hty, hmy⟩ := ihy
    exact ⟨tx * ty, by rw [map_mul, htx, hty]; rfl, Subsemiring.mul_mem _ hmx hmy⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.maximal_no_compatible_ext
statement:
theorem maximal_no_compatible_ext (R : IntermediateField F C)
    (hmax : ∀ S : IntermediateField F C, Compatible S → R ≤ S → S = R)
    (F₁ : Type*) [Field F₁] [Algebra (↥R) F₁] [Algebra F F₁] [IsScalarTower F (↥R) F₁]
    (halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥R) F₁) (hcompat : (-1 : F₁) ∉ genConeAlg (F := F) F₁) :
    Function.Surjective (algebraMap (↥R) F₁)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  let f : F₁ →ₐ[↥R] C := IsAlgClosed.lift
  let S : IntermediateField F C := f.fieldRange.restrictScalars F
  have hSrange : (S : Set C) = Set.range f := by
    simp [S, IntermediateField.coe_restrictScalars, AlgHom.coe_fieldRange]
  have hRS : R ≤ S := fun z hz =>
    AlgHom.mem_fieldRange.mpr ⟨algebraMap (↥R) F₁ ⟨z, hz⟩, f.commutes ⟨z, hz⟩⟩
  have hS_compat : Compatible S := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hmt⟩ := transfer F₁ f S hSrange (-1) hmem
    have htneg : t = -1 := f.injective (by simpa using ht)
    exact hcompat (htneg ▸ hmt)
  have hfy_mem : (f y : C) ∈ R := by
    have hmem : (f y : C) ∈ S := AlgHom.mem_fieldRange.mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [hmax S hS_compat hRS] at hmem; exact hmem
  exact ⟨⟨f y, hfy_mem⟩, f.injective (by simp [f.commutes])⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.square_property
statement:
theorem square_property (R : IntermediateField F C)
    (hmax : ∀ S : IntermediateField F C, Compatible S → R ≤ S → S = R)
    (T : RingCone ↥R) (hTsub : (genCone R : Set ↥R) ⊆ T) {a : ↥R} (ha : a ∈ T) :
    IsSquare a
proof:
:= by
  by_contra ha_sq
  have : Fact (Irreducible (sqSubC a)) := ⟨irred_X_sq_sub_C ha_sq⟩
  have halg := adjoinRoot_isAlgebraic (R := ↥R) (monic_sq_sub_C a)
  have hTsq : ∀ x : ↥R, x * x ∈ T.toSubsemiring :=
    fun x => hTsub (Subsemiring.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨x, rfl⟩))
  have hTneg : (-1 : ↥R) ∉ T.toSubsemiring := fun h =>
    one_ne_zero (T.eq_zero_of_mem_of_neg_mem' T.one_mem h)
  have hadj := adjoin_compatible T.toSubsemiring hTsq ha hTneg ha_sq
  have hcompat : (-1 : AdjoinRoot (sqSubC a)) ∉ genConeAlg (F := F) (AdjoinRoot (sqSubC a)) := by
    intro hmem
    refine hadj (Subsemiring.closure_mono ?_ hmem)
    rintro x (⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ | hsq)
    · refine Or.inl ⟨algebraMap F ↥R p,
        hTsub (Subsemiring.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)), ?_⟩
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F ↥R (AdjoinRoot (sqSubC a))]
    · exact Or.inr hsq
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := maximal_no_compatible_ext R hmax (AdjoinRoot (sqSubC a)) halg hcompat
    (AdjoinRoot.root (sqSubC a))
  refine ha_sq ⟨r, ?_⟩
  have hkey : algebraMap (↥R) (AdjoinRoot (sqSubC a)) (r * r) = algebraMap _ _ a := by
    rw [map_mul, hr, ← pow_two, root_sq_sub_C]
  exact (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (↥R) (AdjoinRoot (sqSubC a)) hkey).symm

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.sq_mem_total
statement:
private theorem sq_mem_total {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (Q : RingCone A)
    (hQ : HasMemOrNegMem Q) (x : A) : x * x ∈ Q
proof:
:= by
  rcases hQ.mem_or_neg_mem x with h | h
  · exact mul_mem h h
  · have := mul_mem h h; simpa using this

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.compatible_isRealField
statement:
private theorem compatible_isRealField (R : IntermediateField F C) (hcomp : Compatible R) :
    IsRealField ↥R
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRealField_iff]
  intro hmem
  refine hcomp ?_
  have hsum : ∀ s : ↥R, IsSumSq s → s ∈ genCone R := by
    intro s hs
    induction hs with
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | sq_add a _ ih => exact add_mem (Subsemiring.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨a, rfl⟩)) ih
  exact hsum _ hmem

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.exists_orderCompatible_realClosure
statement:
theorem exists_orderCompatible_realClosure :
    ∃ R : IntermediateField F C, IsRealClosed ↥R ∧
      ∀ p : F, 0 ≤ p → IsSquare (algebraMap F ↥R p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hcomp, hmax⟩ := exists_maximal_compatible (F := F) (C := C)
  obtain ⟨T, hTsub, hTtotal⟩ := prop_2_8 (F := ↥R)
    ⟨fun x => Subsemiring.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨x, by rw [pow_two]⟩), hcomp⟩
  have hreal : IsRealField ↥R := compatible_isRealField R hcomp
  have hnoext : HasNoNontrivialRealAlgebraicExtension ↥R := by
    refine ⟨hreal, fun F₁ _ _ halg hreal₁ => ?_⟩
    let : Algebra F F₁ := ((algebraMap (↥R) F₁).comp (algebraMap F ↥R)).toAlgebra
    have : IsScalarTower F (↥R) F₁ := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := theorem_2_7_b_of_c (theorem_2_7_a_of_b hreal₁)
    have hcompatF1 : (-1 : F₁) ∉ genConeAlg (F := F) F₁ := by
      intro hmem
      have hsub : genConeAlg (F := F) F₁ ≤ Q.toSubsemiring := by
        apply Subsemiring.closure_le.2
        rintro x (⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ | ⟨y, rfl⟩)
        · have hpT := hTsub (Subsemiring.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩))
          obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := square_property R hmax T hTsub hpT
          rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F ↥R F₁, hs, map_mul]
          exact sq_mem_total Q hQ _
        · exact sq_mem_total Q hQ y
      exact one_ne_zero (Q.eq_zero_of_mem_of_neg_mem' Q.one_mem (hsub hmem))
    exact maximal_no_compatible_ext R hmax F₁ halg hcompatF1
  refine ⟨R, theorem_2_11_d_a hnoext, fun p hp => ?_⟩
  exact square_property R hmax T hTsub
    (hTsub (Subsemiring.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨p, (Subsemiring.mem_nonneg).2 hp, rfl⟩)))

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.bot_isSemireal
statement: private lemma bot_isSemireal : IsSemireal ↥(⊥ : IntermediateField F C)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemireal.of_not_isSumSq_neg_one
  intro h
  have h' := isSumSq_map (IntermediateField.botEquiv F C).toAlgHom.toRingHom h
  simp at h'
  exact IsSemireal.not_isSumSq_neg_one F h'

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.sSup_isSemireal_of_chain
statement:
private lemma sSup_isSemireal_of_chain
    {c : Set (IntermediateField F C)} (hc : IsChain (· ≤ ·) c)
    (hne : c.Nonempty) (hsemi : ∀ S ∈ c, IsSemireal ↥S) :
    IsSemireal ↥(sSup c)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemireal.of_not_isSumSq_neg_one
  intro h
  have hdir : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) c := hc.directedOn
  have hmem : ∀ (x : C), x ∈ (sSup c : IntermediateField F C) → ∃ S ∈ c, x ∈ S := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ (sSup c).toSubfield := hx
    rw [IntermediateField.sSup_toSubfield c hne] at hx'
    have hne' : (IntermediateField.toSubfield '' c).Nonempty := hne.image _
    have hdir' : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) (IntermediateField.toSubfield '' c) := by
      rintro _ ⟨Sa, hSa, rfl⟩ _ ⟨Sb, hSb, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨Sc, hSc, haSc, hbSc⟩ := hdir Sa hSa Sb hSb
      exact ⟨Sc.toSubfield, ⟨Sc, hSc, rfl⟩, haSc, hbSc⟩
    obtain ⟨s, ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩, hxs⟩ := (Subfield.mem_sSup_of_directedOn hne' hdir').mp hx'
    exact ⟨S, hS, hxs⟩
  suffices ∀ (x : ↥(sSup c)), IsSumSq x →
      ∃ S ∈ c, ∃ y : ↥S, (y : C) = (x : C) ∧ IsSumSq y by
    obtain ⟨S, hS, y, hy, hsy⟩ := this _ h
    have : y = -1 := Subtype.val_injective (by simp [hy])
    exact absurd (by rwa [this] at hsy) (hsemi S hS).not_isSumSq_neg_one
  intro x hx
  induction hx with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨S, hS, 0, by simp, .zero⟩
  | sq_add a _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨S₁, hS₁, y₁, hy₁, hsy₁⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨S₂, hS₂, ha_S₂⟩ := hmem a.val a.2
    obtain ⟨S₃, hS₃, h₁₃, h₂₃⟩ := hdir S₁ hS₁ S₂ hS₂
    refine ⟨S₃, hS₃,
      ⟨a.val, h₂₃ ha_S₂⟩ * ⟨a.val, h₂₃ ha_S₂⟩ + IntermediateField.inclusion h₁₃ y₁, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [IntermediateField.coe_inclusion, hy₁]
    · exact .sq_add _ (isSumSq_map (IntermediateField.inclusion h₁₃).toRingHom hsy₁)

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.exists_maximal_semireal
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨R, ⟨hR_semi, hR_max⟩⟩ := zorn_le₀
    {S : IntermediateField F C | IsSemireal ↥S}
    (fun cc hc_sub hc_chain => by
      rcases cc.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
      · exact ⟨⊥, bot_isSemireal C F, fun _ h => h.elim⟩
      · exact ⟨sSup cc, sSup_isSemireal_of_chain C F hc_chain hne (fun S hS => hc_sub hS),
          fun S hS => le_sSup hS⟩)
  exact ⟨R, hR_semi, fun S hS hle => le_antisymm (hR_max hS hle) hle⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.maximal_hasNoNontrivialRealAlgebraicExtension
statement:
private lemma maximal_hasNoNontrivialRealAlgebraicExtension
    (R : IntermediateField F C) (hR : IsSemireal ↥R)
    (hmax : ∀ S : IntermediateField F C, IsSemireal ↥S → R ≤ S → S = R) :
    Azurite.BPR.HasNoNontrivialRealAlgebraicExtension ↥R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact hR
  · intro F₁ _ _ halg hreal x
    let : Algebra F F₁ := (algebraMap ↥R F₁).comp (algebraMap F ↥R) |>.toAlgebra
    have : IsScalarTower F ↥R F₁ := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
    let f : F₁ →ₐ[↥R] C := IsAlgClosed.lift
    let S : IntermediateField F C := f.fieldRange.restrictScalars F
    have hRS : R ≤ S := by
      intro y hy
      show y ∈ f.fieldRange
      exact AlgHom.mem_fieldRange.mpr ⟨algebraMap ↥R F₁ ⟨y, hy⟩, f.commutes ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
    have hS_semi : IsSemireal ↥S := by
      apply IsSemireal.of_not_isSumSq_neg_one
      intro h
      suffices ∀ (s : ↥S), IsSumSq s → ∃ t : F₁, f t = s.val ∧ IsSumSq t by
        obtain ⟨t, ht, hst⟩ := this _ h
        have : t = -1 := f.injective (by simp [ht])
        exact absurd (by rwa [this] at hst) hreal.not_isSumSq_neg_one
      intro s hs
      induction hs with
      | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp, .zero⟩
      | sq_add a _ ih =>
        obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁, hst₁⟩ := ih
        have ha_mem : a.val ∈ f.fieldRange := a.2
        obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := AlgHom.mem_fieldRange.mp ha_mem
        exact ⟨b * b + t₁, by simp [map_add, map_mul, hb, ht₁], .sq_add b hst₁⟩
    have hSR := hmax S hS_semi hRS
    have hfx_mem : (f x : C) ∈ R := by
      have : (f x : C) ∈ S := AlgHom.mem_fieldRange.mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩
      convert this using 1
      exact hSR.symm
    exact ⟨⟨f x, hfx_mem⟩, f.injective (by simp [f.commutes])⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.exists_isRealClosed_intermediateField
statement:
theorem exists_isRealClosed_intermediateField :
    ∃ R : IntermediateField F C, IsRealClosed ↥R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hmax⟩ := exists_maximal_semireal C F
  exact ⟨R, Azurite.BPR.Theorem2_11.theorem_2_11_d_a
    (maximal_hasNoNontrivialRealAlgebraicExtension C F R hR hmax)⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.exists_isRealClosed_algebraic
statement:
theorem exists_isRealClosed_algebraic (F : Type*) [Field F] [IsSemireal F] :
    ∃ R : IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure F), IsRealClosed ↥R
proof:
:=
  exists_isRealClosed_intermediateField (AlgebraicClosure F) F

name: Azurite.BPR.RealClosure.exists_orderCompatible_realClosure_algebraic
statement:
theorem exists_orderCompatible_realClosure_algebraic
    (F : Type*) [Field F] [LinearOrder F] [IsStrictOrderedRing F] :
    ∃ R : IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure F), IsRealClosed ↥R ∧
      ∀ p : F, 0 ≤ p → IsSquare (algebraMap F ↥R p)
proof:
:=
  exists_orderCompatible_realClosure (C := AlgebraicClosure F)

name: Azurite.BPR.IsRealClosedField.isRealField
statement: theorem IsRealClosedField.isRealField [IsRealClosed R] : IsRealField R
proof:
:=
  (isRealField_iff R).mpr (IsSemireal.not_isSumSq_neg_one R)

name: Azurite.BPR.isRealClosedField_iff
statement:
theorem isRealClosedField_iff :
    IsRealClosedField R ↔
    (∀ x : R, 0 ≤ x ↔ IsSquare x) ∧
    (∀ f : R[X], Odd f.natDegree → ∃ x, f.IsRoot x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : IsRealClosed R := h
    exact ⟨fun _ => IsRealClosed.nonneg_iff_isSquare,
           fun f hf => IsRealClosed.exists_isRoot_of_odd_natDegree hf⟩
  · intro ⟨hcone, hroots⟩
    exact IsRealClosed.of_linearOrderedField
      (fun hx => (hcone _).mp hx) (fun {f} hf => hroots f hf)

name: Azurite.BPR.IsRealClosedField.nonneg_iff_isSquare
statement:
theorem IsRealClosedField.nonneg_iff_isSquare [IsRealClosed R] {x : R} :
    0 ≤ x ↔ IsSquare x
proof:
:=
  IsRealClosed.nonneg_iff_isSquare

name: Azurite.BPR.Exercise2_11.isSumSq_coe_of_isSumSq
statement:
private lemma isSumSq_coe_of_isSumSq {x : R_alg} (h : IsSumSq x) :
    IsSumSq (x.val : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero =>
    simp only [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
    exact .zero
  | sq_add a _ ih =>
    simp only [AddMemClass.coe_add, MulMemClass.coe_mul]
    exact .sq_add a.val ih

name: Azurite.BPR.Exercise2_11.comp_X_sq_ne_zero
statement:
private lemma comp_X_sq_ne_zero {p : ℚ[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    p.comp (X ^ 2 : ℚ[X]) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hnd : (X ^ 2 : ℚ[X]).natDegree ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hlc := leadingCoeff_comp hnd (p := p)
  simp at hlc
  exact leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mp (hlc ▸ leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp)

name: Azurite.BPR.Exercise2_11.isAlgebraic_sqrt
statement:
private lemma isAlgebraic_sqrt {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (halg : IsAlgebraic ℚ a) :
    IsAlgebraic ℚ (Real.sqrt a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpa⟩ := halg
  exact ⟨p.comp (X ^ 2), comp_X_sq_ne_zero hp, by
    rw [aeval_comp, aeval_X_pow, Real.sq_sqrt ha, hpa]⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.Exercise2_11.isSquare_or_isSquare_neg_R_alg
statement:
theorem isSquare_or_isSquare_neg_R_alg (x : R_alg) :
    IsSquare x ∨ IsSquare (-x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total 0 x.val with hx | hx
  · 
    left
    have halg : IsAlgebraic ℚ x.val := mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp x.2
    have hsqrt_alg := isAlgebraic_sqrt hx halg
    have hsqrt_mem : Real.sqrt x.val ∈ R_alg :=
      mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mpr hsqrt_alg
    exact ⟨⟨Real.sqrt x.val, hsqrt_mem⟩,
      Subtype.val_injective (by
        show x.val = Real.sqrt x.val * Real.sqrt x.val
        rw [← sq, Real.sq_sqrt hx])⟩
  · 
    right
    have hx' : 0 ≤ (-x).val := by simp; linarith
    have halg : IsAlgebraic ℚ (-x).val := by
      have := mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp x.2
      exact (show (-x).val = -(x.val) by simp) ▸ this.neg
    have hsqrt_alg := isAlgebraic_sqrt hx' halg
    have hsqrt_mem : Real.sqrt (-x).val ∈ R_alg :=
      mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mpr hsqrt_alg
    exact ⟨⟨Real.sqrt (-x).val, hsqrt_mem⟩,
      Subtype.val_injective (by
        show (-x).val = Real.sqrt (-x).val * Real.sqrt (-x).val
        rw [← sq, Real.sq_sqrt hx'])⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.Exercise2_11.natDegree_pos_of_not_isUnit
statement:
private lemma natDegree_pos_of_not_isUnit {f : ℝ[X]} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hu : ¬IsUnit f) :
    0 < f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos f.natDegree with h | h
  · exfalso; apply hu
    rw [isUnit_iff]
    have hc : f.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc; exact hf (by rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero h, hc, map_zero])
    exact ⟨f.coeff 0, Ne.isUnit hc, (eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero h).symm⟩
  · exact h

name: Azurite.BPR.Exercise2_11.exists_root_real_of_odd_natDegree
statement:
private theorem exists_root_real_of_odd_natDegree (f : ℝ[X]) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hodd : Odd f.natDegree) : ∃ r : ℝ, f.IsRoot r
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ n, ∀ g : ℝ[X], g ≠ 0 → g.natDegree = n → Odd n → ∃ r, g.IsRoot r from
    this _ f hf rfl hodd
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro g hg0 hgn hodd_n
    have hnu : ¬IsUnit g := by
      intro hu
      have := natDegree_eq_zero_of_isUnit hu
      rw [hgn] at this; exact Nat.not_odd_zero (this ▸ hodd_n)
    rcases irreducible_or_factor hnu with hirr | ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab⟩
    · 
      have hle2 := hirr.natDegree_le_two
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hodd_n
      have h1 : n = 1 := by omega
      exact exists_root_of_degree_eq_one (by
        rw [degree_eq_natDegree hg0, hgn, h1]; norm_cast)
    · 
      have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul (hab ▸ hg0)
      have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul (hab ▸ hg0)
      have hdeg : n = a.natDegree + b.natDegree := by
        rw [← hgn, hab, natDegree_mul ha0 hb0]
      have ha_pos := natDegree_pos_of_not_isUnit ha0 ha
      have hb_pos := natDegree_pos_of_not_isUnit hb0 hb
      by_cases hoa : Odd a.natDegree
      · have hlt : a.natDegree < n := by omega
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := ih _ hlt a ha0 rfl hoa
        exact ⟨r, hab ▸ root_mul_right_of_isRoot b hr⟩
      · have hob : Odd b.natDegree := by
          rw [hdeg, Nat.odd_add] at hodd_n
          exact Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp (fun heb => hoa (hodd_n.mpr heb))
        have hlt : b.natDegree < n := by omega
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := ih _ hlt b hb0 rfl hob
        exact ⟨r, hab ▸ root_mul_left_of_isRoot a hr⟩

name: Azurite.BPR.Exercise2_11.mem_R_alg_of_root
statement:
private theorem mem_R_alg_of_root {f : R_alg[X]} (hf : f ≠ 0) {r : ℝ}
    (hr : (f.map (algebraMap ↥R_alg ℝ)).IsRoot r) : r ∈ R_alg
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_algebraicClosure_iff]
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ ↥R_alg := algebraicClosure.isAlgebraic ℚ ℝ
  have halg_r : IsAlgebraic (↥R_alg) r := ⟨f, hf, by rwa [aeval_def, ← eval_map]⟩
  exact (isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral.mp halg_r).trans_isAlgebraic ℚ

name: Azurite.BPR.Exercise2_11.exists_isRoot_of_odd_natDegree_R_alg
statement:
theorem exists_isRoot_of_odd_natDegree_R_alg (f : R_alg[X]) (hf : Odd f.natDegree) :
    ∃ r : R_alg, f.IsRoot r
proof:
:= by
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hf
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap ↥R_alg ℝ) := Subtype.val_injective
  set g := f.map (algebraMap ↥R_alg ℝ) with hg_def
  have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff hinj).mpr hf0
  have hdeg : g.natDegree = f.natDegree := natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hinj f
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_root_real_of_odd_natDegree g hg0 (hdeg ▸ hf)
  have hmem := mem_R_alg_of_root hf0 hr
  refine ⟨⟨r, hmem⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [IsRoot]
  apply Subtype.val_injective
  simp only [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
  change (algebraMap ↥R_alg ℝ) (eval ⟨r, hmem⟩ f) = 0
  rw [show eval ⟨r, hmem⟩ f = eval₂ (RingHom.id _) ⟨r, hmem⟩ f from rfl,
      hom_eval₂ f (RingHom.id _) (algebraMap ↥R_alg ℝ) ⟨r, hmem⟩]
  simp only [RingHom.comp_id]
  rw [← eval_map, ← hg_def]
  exact hr

name: Azurite.BPR.Exercise2_11.isSquare_algebraMap_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem isSquare_algebraMap_of_nonneg (p : ℚ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) :
    IsSquare (algebraMap ℚ R_alg p)
proof:
:=
  IsRealClosed.nonneg_iff_isSquare.mp (by
    rw [← Subtype.coe_le_coe]
    simp only [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
    have h : ((algebraMap ℚ R_alg p : R_alg) : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) := by norm_cast
    rw [h]; exact_mod_cast hp)

name: Azurite.BPR.Exercise2_11.nonempty_algEquiv_of_isRealClosure
statement:
theorem nonempty_algEquiv_of_isRealClosure {R' : Type*} [Field R'] [IsRealClosed R']
    [Algebra ℚ R'] (halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ R')
    (hext : ∀ p : ℚ, 0 ≤ p → IsSquare (algebraMap ℚ R' p)) :
    Nonempty (R_alg ≃ₐ[ℚ] R')
proof:
:=
  realClosure_unique (algebraicClosure.isAlgebraic ℚ ℝ) halg
    isSquare_algebraMap_of_nonneg hext

name: Azurite.BPR.Exercise2_11.mem_R_alg_iff_isAlgebraic_int
statement: theorem mem_R_alg_iff_isAlgebraic_int {x : ℝ} : x ∈ R_alg ↔ IsAlgebraic ℤ x
