statement: theorem AGM_agmSeq (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) : AGM (agmA a b j) (agmB a b j) = AGM a b
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j ih =>
    obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb j
    rw [agmA_succ, agmB_succ, ← AGM_step hA hB, ih]

name: Azurite.BZ.agmB_le_agmA'
statement:
theorem agmB_le_agmA' (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : b ≤ a) (n : ℕ) :
    agmB a b n ≤ agmA a b n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | n
  · exact hab
  · exact agmB_le_agmA_succ ha hb n

name: Azurite.BZ.agmDeficit_succ
statement:
theorem agmDeficit_succ (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : b ≤ a) (n : ℕ) :
    agmDeficit a b n = 2 * agmDeficit a b (n + 1)
      - (agmA a b n ^ 2 - agmB a b n ^ 2) / 2 * (π / (2 * AGM a b))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb n
  have h := agmJ_landen hB (agmB_le_agmA' ha hb hab n)
  rw [AGM_agmSeq ha hb] at h
  unfold agmDeficit
  rw [h, agmA_succ, agmB_succ]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.agmDeficit_zero_eq
statement:
theorem agmDeficit_zero_eq (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : b ≤ a) (n : ℕ) :
    agmDeficit a b 0 = 2 ^ n * agmDeficit a b n
      - (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, 2 ^ j / 2 * (agmA a b j ^ 2 - agmB a b j ^ 2))
        * (π / (2 * AGM a b))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [ih, agmDeficit_succ ha hb hab n, Finset.sum_range_succ]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.agmDeficit_bounds
statement:
theorem agmDeficit_bounds (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    -(π / 2 * (1 + agmA a b 1 / agmB a b 1) * (agmA a b n - agmB a b n)) ≤ agmDeficit a b n ∧
      agmDeficit a b n ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb (m + 1)
  obtain ⟨hA1, hB1⟩ := agm_pos ha hb 1
  have hle := agmB_le_agmA_succ ha hb m
  have hM0 : 0 < AGM a b := lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_min ha hb) (min_le_AGM ha hb)
  have hMle := AGM_le_agmA ha hb hn
  have hleM := agmB_le_AGM ha hb hn
  have hB1M := agmB_le_AGM ha hb le_rfl
  have hAn : agmA a b (m + 1) ≤ agmA a b 1 := by simpa using agmA_antitone ha hb (Nat.zero_le m)
  obtain ⟨hJl, hJu⟩ := agmJ_bounds hB hle
  have hg0 : 0 ≤ agmA a b (m + 1) - agmB a b (m + 1) := sub_nonneg.mpr hle
  have hr : 1 ≤ AGM a b / agmB a b 1 := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hB1, one_mul]; exact hB1M
  unfold agmDeficit
  constructor
  · 
    have h1 : agmA a b (m + 1) ^ 2 / AGM a b
        ≤ agmA a b (m + 1) + agmA a b 1 / agmB a b 1 * (agmA a b (m + 1) - agmB a b (m + 1)) := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hM0]
      have e2 : (agmA a b (m + 1) + agmA a b 1 / agmB a b 1 * (agmA a b (m + 1) - agmB a b (m + 1)))
          * AGM a b = agmA a b (m + 1) * AGM a b
            + agmA a b 1 * (agmA a b (m + 1) - agmB a b (m + 1)) * (AGM a b / agmB a b 1) := by
        ring
      rw [e2]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr
        (by positivity : 0 ≤ agmA a b 1 * (agmA a b (m + 1) - agmB a b (m + 1))),
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_sub_left hleM (agmA a b (m + 1))) hA.le,
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAn hg0]
    have e : agmA a b (m + 1) ^ 2 * (π / (2 * AGM a b))
        = π / 2 * (agmA a b (m + 1) ^ 2 / AGM a b) := by ring
    rw [e]
    have hπ : 0 ≤ π / 2 := by positivity
    have h1' : π / 2 * (agmA a b (m + 1) ^ 2 / AGM a b) ≤ π / 2 * agmA a b (m + 1)
        + π / 2 * (agmA a b 1 / agmB a b 1) * (agmA a b (m + 1) - agmB a b (m + 1)) := by
      calc _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hπ
        _ = _ := by ring
    linarith
  · have h2 : agmA a b (m + 1) ≤ agmA a b (m + 1) ^ 2 / AGM a b := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hM0]; nlinarith
    have e : agmA a b (m + 1) ^ 2 * (π / (2 * AGM a b))
        = π / 2 * (agmA a b (m + 1) ^ 2 / AGM a b) := by ring
    rw [e]
    have hπ : 0 ≤ π / 2 := by positivity
    have h2' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hπ
    linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.agm_gap_succ_le_quarter
statement:
theorem agm_gap_succ_le_quarter (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    (h : agmA a b j - agmB a b j ≤ 2 * agmB a b 1) :
    agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1) ≤ (agmA a b j - agmB a b j) / 4
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, j = m + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb (m + 1)
  have hBj : agmB a b 1 ≤ agmB a b (m + 1) := by simpa using agmB_monotone ha hb (Nat.zero_le m)
  have hg0 : 0 ≤ agmA a b (m + 1) - agmB a b (m + 1) := sub_nonneg.mpr (agmB_le_agmA ha hb hj)
  refine (agm_gap_succ_le_sq ha hb hj).trans ?_
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
  have h2 : agmA a b (m + 1) - agmB a b (m + 1) ≤ 2 * agmB a b (m + 1) :=
    h.trans (by linarith)
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hg0]

name: Azurite.BZ.exists_agm_gap_le
statement:
theorem exists_agm_gap_le (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∃ m, 1 ≤ m ∧ agmA a b m - agmB a b m ≤ 2 * agmB a b 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA1, hB1⟩ := agm_pos ha hb 1
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge ((agmA a b 1 - agmB a b 1) / (2 * agmB a b 1))
  refine ⟨N + 1, by omega, (agm_gap_le_half_pow ha hb N).trans ?_⟩
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hN
  have h2 : (N : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ N := by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * agmB a b 1)]

name: Azurite.BZ.agm_gap_add_le
statement:
theorem agm_gap_add_le (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (h : agmA a b m - agmB a b m ≤ 2 * agmB a b 1) (k : ℕ) :
    agmA a b (m + k) - agmB a b (m + k) ≤ (agmA a b m - agmB a b m) / 4 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have hg0 : 0 ≤ agmA a b m - agmB a b m := sub_nonneg.mpr (agmB_le_agmA ha hb hm)
    have hk : agmA a b (m + k) - agmB a b (m + k) ≤ 2 * agmB a b 1 :=
      ih.trans ((div_le_self hg0 (one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num))).trans h)
    rw [← add_assoc]
    refine (agm_gap_succ_le_quarter ha hb (by omega) hk).trans ?_
    rw [pow_succ, ← div_div]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ih (by norm_num)

name: Azurite.BZ.two_pow_mul_agm_gap_le
statement:
theorem two_pow_mul_agm_gap_le (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (h : agmA a b m - agmB a b m ≤ 2 * agmB a b 1) (k : ℕ) :
    2 ^ (k + m) * (agmA a b (k + m) - agmB a b (k + m))
      ≤ 2 ^ m * (agmA a b m - agmB a b m) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm k m]
  have := agm_gap_add_le ha hb hm h k
  have h4 : (4 : ℝ) ^ k = 2 ^ k * 2 ^ k := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
  calc 2 ^ (m + k) * (agmA a b (m + k) - agmB a b (m + k))
      ≤ 2 ^ (m + k) * ((agmA a b m - agmB a b m) / 4 ^ k) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (by positivity)
    _ = 2 ^ m * (agmA a b m - agmB a b m) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
        rw [pow_add, h4, one_div_pow]; field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_two_pow_mul_agm_gap
statement:
theorem tendsto_two_pow_mul_agm_gap (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Tendsto (fun n => 2 ^ n * (agmA a b n - agmB a b n)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, h⟩ := exists_agm_gap_le ha hb
  rw [← tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat m]
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => 2 ^ m * (agmA a b m - agmB a b m) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) atTop
      (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
      (by norm_num)).const_mul (2 ^ m * (agmA a b m - agmB a b m))
  refine squeeze_zero (fun k => ?_) (fun k => two_pow_mul_agm_gap_le ha hb hm h k) hlim
  exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (sub_nonneg.mpr (agmB_le_agmA ha hb (by omega)))

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_two_pow_mul_agm_gap
statement:
theorem summable_two_pow_mul_agm_gap (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Summable fun n => 2 ^ n * (agmA a b n - agmB a b n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, h⟩ := exists_agm_gap_le ha hb
  rw [← summable_nat_add_iff m]
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => ?_) (fun k => two_pow_mul_agm_gap_le ha hb hm h k)
    ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).mul_left _)
  exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (sub_nonneg.mpr (agmB_le_agmA ha hb (by omega)))

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_agm_c_sq
statement:
theorem summable_agm_c_sq (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : b ≤ a) :
    Summable fun j : ℕ => 2 ^ j / 2 * (agmA a b j ^ 2 - agmB a b j ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_)
    ((summable_two_pow_mul_agm_gap ha hb).mul_left a)
  · obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb j
    have := agmB_le_agmA' ha hb hab j
    have : agmB a b j ^ 2 ≤ agmA a b j ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hB.le this 2
    positivity
  · obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb j
    have hle := agmB_le_agmA' ha hb hab j
    have hAj : agmA a b j ≤ a := by
      rcases j with _ | j
      · exact le_rfl
      · calc agmA a b (j + 1) ≤ agmA a b 1 := by simpa using agmA_antitone ha hb (Nat.zero_le j)
          _ = (a + b) / 2 := agmA_succ 0
          _ ≤ a := by linarith
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ j := by positivity
    have hsum : agmA a b j + agmB a b j ≤ 2 * a := by linarith
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)) h2]

name: Azurite.BZ.agmJ_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem agmJ_eq_tsum (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : b ≤ a) :
    agmJ a b = (a ^ 2 - ∑' j : ℕ, 2 ^ j / 2 * (agmA a b j ^ 2 - agmB a b j ^ 2))
      * (π / (2 * AGM a b))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA1, hB1⟩ := agm_pos ha hb 1
  set I := π / (2 * AGM a b) with hI
  set C := π / 2 * (1 + agmA a b 1 / agmB a b 1) with hC
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by positivity
  
  have h1 : Tendsto (fun n => 2 ^ n * agmDeficit a b n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => C * (2 ^ n * (agmA a b n - agmB a b n))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using (tendsto_two_pow_mul_agm_gap ha hb).const_mul C
    refine squeeze_zero_norm' ?_ hlim
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn
    obtain ⟨hl, hu⟩ := agmDeficit_bounds ha hb hn
    have hg0 : 0 ≤ agmA a b n - agmB a b n := sub_nonneg.mpr (agmB_le_agmA ha hb hn)
    have habs : |agmDeficit a b n| ≤ C * (agmA a b n - agmB a b n) :=
      abs_le.mpr ⟨by rw [hC]; linarith, by have := mul_nonneg hC0 hg0; linarith⟩
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ n)]
    calc 2 ^ n * |agmDeficit a b n| ≤ 2 ^ n * (C * (agmA a b n - agmB a b n)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habs (by positivity)
      _ = C * (2 ^ n * (agmA a b n - agmB a b n)) := by ring
  
  have hS := summable_agm_c_sq ha hb hab
  have h2 := hS.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
  have h3 : Tendsto (fun n => 2 ^ n * agmDeficit a b n
      - (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, 2 ^ j / 2 * (agmA a b j ^ 2 - agmB a b j ^ 2)) * I) atTop
      (𝓝 (0 - (∑' j : ℕ, 2 ^ j / 2 * (agmA a b j ^ 2 - agmB a b j ^ 2)) * I)) :=
    h1.sub (h2.mul_const I)
  have h4 : Tendsto (fun n => 2 ^ n * agmDeficit a b n
      - (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, 2 ^ j / 2 * (agmA a b j ^ 2 - agmB a b j ^ 2)) * I) atTop
      (𝓝 (agmDeficit a b 0)) := by
    refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr fun n => ?_
    rw [agmDeficit_zero_eq ha hb hab n]
  have h5 := tendsto_nhds_unique h4 h3
  unfold agmDeficit at h5
  rw [agmA_zero, agmB_zero] at h5
  linear_combination h5

name: Azurite.BZ.ellipticE_eq_AGM_sum
statement:
theorem ellipticE_eq_AGM_sum {k : ℝ} (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk1 : k < 1) :
    ellipticE k
      = (1 - ∑' j : ℕ, 2 ^ j / 2 * (agmA 1 (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2)) j ^ 2
          - agmB 1 (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2)) j ^ 2)) * ellipticK k
proof:
:= by
  set k' := Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2) with hk'
  have hk2 : k ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
  have hk'0 : 0 < k' := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hk'1 : k' ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hk', Real.sqrt_le_one]; nlinarith
  have hk'2 : k' ^ 2 = 1 - k ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hkk : Real.sqrt (1 - k' ^ 2) = k := by
    rw [hk'2, sub_sub_cancel, Real.sqrt_sq hk0.le]
  have hJ : agmJ 1 k' = ellipticE k := by
    rw [agmJ_eq_mul_agmE one_pos, div_one, one_mul, agmE_eq_ellipticE (by nlinarith), hkk]
  have hK : π / (2 * AGM 1 k') = ellipticK k := by
    have h := one_div_AGM_one hk'0 hk'1
    rw [hkk] at h
    have hM : 0 < AGM 1 k' := AGM_one_pos hk'0
    field_simp at h ⊢
    linarith
  rw [← hJ, ← hK, agmJ_eq_tsum one_pos hk'0 hk'1, one_pow]

name: Azurite.BZ.tangentPass_spec
statement:
theorem tangentPass_spec {k m : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (a : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hfin : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j < k → (a j : ℤ) = tangentNumber j)
    (hrow : ∀ j, k ≤ j → j ≤ m → (a j : ℤ) = (tanDerivPoly (j + k - 3)).coeff (j - k + 2))
    (s : ℕ) :
    (∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j < k → (tangentPass k a s j : ℤ) = tangentNumber j)
      ∧ (∀ j, k ≤ j → j < k + s → j ≤ m →
          (tangentPass k a s j : ℤ) = (tanDerivPoly (j + k - 2)).coeff (j - k + 1))
      ∧ (∀ j, k + s ≤ j → j ≤ m →
          (tangentPass k a s j : ℤ) = (tanDerivPoly (j + k - 3)).coeff (j - k + 2))
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨hfin, fun j _ hj _ => absurd hj (by omega), fun j hj hjm => hrow j (by omega) hjm⟩
  | succ s ih =>
    obtain ⟨ih1, ih2, ih3⟩ := ih
    simp only [tangentPass, tangentStep]
    refine ⟨fun j h1 hj => ?_, fun j hkj hj hjm => ?_, fun j hj hjm => ?_⟩
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]
      exact ih1 j h1 hj
    · rcases eq_or_ne j (k + s) with rfl | hne
      · have h3 := ih3 (k + s) le_rfl hjm
        have hrec := coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ (k + s + k - 3) s
        rw [show k + s + k - 3 + 1 = k + s + k - 2 by omega] at hrec
        rw [Function.update_self, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
        push_cast
        rw [h3, hrec, show k + s - k + 2 = s + 2 by omega]
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos s with rfl | hs
        · simp
        · have h2 := ih2 (k + s - 1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
          rw [h2, show k + s - 1 + k - 2 = k + s + k - 3 by omega,
            show k + s - 1 - k + 1 = s by omega]
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hne]
        exact ih2 j hkj (by omega) hjm
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]
      exact ih3 j (by omega) hjm

name: Azurite.BZ.tangentOuter_spec
statement:
theorem tangentOuter_spec (m : ℕ) : ∀ r, r + 1 ≤ m →
    (∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j < r + 2 → (tangentOuter m tangentInit r j : ℤ) = tangentNumber j)
      ∧ (∀ j, r + 2 ≤ j → j ≤ m →
          (tangentOuter m tangentInit r j : ℤ)
            = (tanDerivPoly (j + (r + 2) - 3)).coeff (j - (r + 2) + 2))
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    refine ⟨fun j h1 hj => ?_, fun j hj _ => ?_⟩
    · obtain rfl : j = 1 := by omega
      simp [tangentOuter, tangentInit, tangentNumber_one]
    · simp only [tangentOuter, tangentInit]
      rw [show j + (0 + 2) - 3 = j - 1 by omega, show j - (0 + 2) + 2 = j - 1 + 1 by omega,
        coeff_tanDerivPoly_top]
  | succ r ih =>
    intro hr
    obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih (by omega)
    have hs := tangentPass_spec (k := r + 2) (m := m) (by omega) (tangentOuter m tangentInit r)
      ih1 ih2 (m + 1 - (r + 2))
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, _⟩ := hs
    simp only [tangentOuter]
    refine ⟨fun j hj1 hj => ?_, fun j hj hjm => ?_⟩
    · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (r + 2) with hlt | hge
      · exact h1 j hj1 hlt
      · obtain rfl : j = r + 2 := by omega
        rw [h2 (r + 2) le_rfl (by omega) (by omega), tangentNumber,
          show 2 * (r + 2) - 1 = 2 * r + 2 + 1 by omega, coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ_zero,
          show r + 2 + (r + 2) - 2 = 2 * r + 2 by omega, show r + 2 - (r + 2) + 1 = 1 by omega]
    · rw [h2 j (by omega) (by omega) hjm, show j + (r + 2) - 2 = j + (r + 1 + 2) - 3 by omega,
        show j - (r + 2) + 1 = j - (r + 1 + 2) + 2 by omega]

name: Azurite.BZ.tangentNumbersModel_eq
statement:
theorem tangentNumbersModel_eq {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {j : ℕ} (h1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjm : j ≤ m) :
    (tangentNumbersModel m j : ℤ) = tangentNumber j
proof:
:=
  (tangentOuter_spec m (m - 1) (by omega)).1 j h1 (by omega)

name: Azurite.BZ.tangentNumbersModel_three
statement:
theorem tangentNumbersModel_three :
    tangentNumbersModel 3 1 = 1 ∧ tangentNumbersModel 3 2 = 2 ∧ tangentNumbersModel 3 3 = 16
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := tangentNumbersModel_eq (m := 3) (by norm_num) (j := 1) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have h2 := tangentNumbersModel_eq (m := 3) (by norm_num) (j := 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have h3 := tangentNumbersModel_eq (m := 3) (by norm_num) (j := 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  rw [tangentNumber_one] at h1
  rw [tangentNumber_two] at h2
  rw [tangentNumber_three] at h3
  exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast h1, by exact_mod_cast h2, by exact_mod_cast h3⟩

name: Azurite.BZ.one_sub_two_rpow_neg_mul_zetaReal
statement:
theorem one_sub_two_rpow_neg_mul_zetaReal {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) :
    (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-s)) * zetaReal s = oddZeta s
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : Summable fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ := Real.summable_nat_rpow_inv.mpr hs
  have he : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (((2 * n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹) ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-s) * zetaReal s) := by
    have := hsum.hasSum.mul_left ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-s))
    refine this.congr_fun fun n => ?_
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_nonneg n), mul_inv,
      Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num)]
  have ho : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹) (oddZeta s) :=
    (hsum.comp_injective (i := fun n : ℕ => 2 * n + 1) fun a b h => by simpa using h).hasSum
  have h := HasSum.even_add_odd (f := fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹) he ho
  have h2 : zetaReal s = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-s) * zetaReal s + oddZeta s := hsum.hasSum.unique h
  linear_combination h2

name: Azurite.BZ.neg_one_pow_mul_bernoulli_div_factorial
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_mul_bernoulli_div_factorial {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (-1) ^ (k - 1) * (bernoulli (2 * k) : ℝ) / (2 * k).factorial
      = 2 * zetaReal (2 * k) / (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  have h := scaledBernoulli_eq_zeta hk
  unfold scaledBernoulli at h
  push_cast at h
  obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  have hsq : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ k') ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow]
  rw [show (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k' + 1 + 1) = (-1) ^ k' by rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]; ring] at h
  have hf : ((2 * (k' + 1)).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [mul_div_assoc, h]
  linear_combination
    (2 * zetaReal (2 * ((k' + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * (k' + 1))) * hsq

name: Azurite.BZ.tangentNumber_div_factorial_eq_zeta
statement:
theorem tangentNumber_div_factorial_eq_zeta (k : ℕ) :
    (tangentNumber (k + 1) : ℝ) / (2 * (k + 1) - 1).factorial
      = 2 ^ (2 * (k + 1) + 1) * (1 - ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (k + 1)))⁻¹) * zetaReal (2 * (k + 1))
        / Real.pi ^ (2 * (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hT := congrArg (Rat.cast : ℚ → ℝ) (tangentNumber_eq_bernoulli k)
  push_cast at hT
  have hB := bernoulli_two_mul_eq_zeta (k := k + 1) (by omega)
  rw [show (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1 + 1) = (-1) ^ k by rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]; ring] at hB
  have hsq : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow]
  
  have hB' : (bernoulli (2 * (k + 1)) : ℝ) * (-1) ^ k
      = 2 * (2 * (k + 1)).factorial * zetaReal (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
        / (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * (k + 1)) := by
    rw [hB]
    linear_combination (2 * (2 * (k + 1)).factorial * zetaReal (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
      / (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * (k + 1))) * hsq
  have h2k : (2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1)) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hTZ : (tangentNumber (k + 1) : ℝ) * (2 * (k + 1))
      = 4 ^ (k + 1) * (4 ^ (k + 1) - 1) * (2 * (2 * (k + 1)).factorial
        * zetaReal (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * (k + 1))) := by
    rw [← hB', hT]
    field_simp
  have hT' : (tangentNumber (k + 1) : ℝ) = 4 ^ (k + 1) * (4 ^ (k + 1) - 1)
      * (2 * (2 * (k + 1)).factorial * zetaReal (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
        / (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * (k + 1))) / (2 * (k + 1)) := (eq_div_iff h2k).mpr hTZ
  rw [show 2 * (k + 1) - 1 = 2 * k + 1 by omega]
  have hfac : ((2 * (k + 1)).factorial : ℝ) = (2 * (k + 1)) * (2 * k + 1).factorial := by
    rw [show 2 * (k + 1) = 2 * k + 1 + 1 by ring, Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; ring
  have h4 : (4 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) = 2 ^ (2 * (k + 1)) := by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num
  rw [hT', hfac, h4, mul_pow]
  have hπ : (0 : ℝ) < Real.pi ^ (2 * (k + 1)) := by positivity
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (k + 1)) := by positivity
  have hf : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * k + 1).factorial := by positivity
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.tangentNumber_div_factorial_eq_oddZeta
statement:
theorem tangentNumber_div_factorial_eq_oddZeta (k : ℕ) :
    (tangentNumber (k + 1) : ℝ) / (2 * (k + 1) - 1).factorial
      = 2 ^ (2 * (k + 1) + 1) * oddZeta (2 * (k + 1)) / Real.pi ^ (2 * (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (1 : ℝ) < 2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k]
  rw [tangentNumber_div_factorial_eq_zeta, mul_assoc, ← one_sub_two_rpow_neg_mul_zetaReal hs,
    Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), show (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1)) = 2 ^ (2 * (k + 1)) by
      rw [show (2 : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) + 1) = ((2 * (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring,
        Real.rpow_natCast]]

name: Azurite.BZ.tsum_inv_sq_add_two_le
statement: theorem tsum_inv_sq_add_two_le : ∑' n : ℕ, 1 / ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := hasSum_zeta_two
  have h := Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add' (f := fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) (k := 2)
    ((summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) 2).mpr h2.summable)
  rw [h2.tsum_eq] at h
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ range 2, 1 / (i : ℝ) ^ 2 := sum_nonneg fun i _ => by positivity
  have hpi : Real.pi ^ 2 / 6 ≤ 2 := by nlinarith [Real.pi_lt_d2, Real.pi_pos]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.inv_pow_add_two_le
proof:
:= by
  have hN : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by linarith
  have h4 : (4 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, ← pow_mul]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hN _
  have heq : (4 : ℝ) / 4 ^ (k + 1) * (1 / ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)
      = (4 ^ k * ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [pow_succ]
    field_simp
  rw [show 2 * (k + 1) = 2 * k + 2 by ring, pow_add, heq]
  exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4 (by positivity))

name: Azurite.BZ.zetaReal_two_mul_succ_eq
statement:
theorem zetaReal_two_mul_succ_eq (k : ℕ) :
    zetaReal (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
      = 1 + ∑' n : ℕ, ((((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ (2 * (k + 1)))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hcast : (2 : ℝ) * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((2 * (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
  have hs : Summable fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) ^ (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))⁻¹ :=
    Real.summable_nat_rpow_inv.mpr (by push_cast; linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k])
  unfold zetaReal
  rw [← Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add' (f := fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) ^ (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))⁻¹)
    (k := 2) ((summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) ^ (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))⁻¹) 2).mpr
      hs), sum_range_succ, sum_range_one]
  simp only [hcast, Real.rpow_natCast, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_one, one_pow, inv_one]
  rw [zero_pow (by omega), inv_zero, zero_add]

name: Azurite.BZ.zetaReal_two_mul_sub_one_le
statement: theorem zetaReal_two_mul_sub_one_le {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : zetaReal (2 * k) - 1 ≤ 8 / 4 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [zetaReal_two_mul_succ_eq, add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hs : Summable fun n : ℕ => ((((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ (2 * (k' + 1)))⁻¹ := by
    have := (summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) ^ (2 * ((k' + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))⁻¹) 2).mpr
      (Real.summable_nat_rpow_inv.mpr
        (by push_cast; linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k'] : (1 : ℝ) < 2 * ((k' + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    refine this.congr fun n => ?_
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) * ((k' + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((2 * (k' + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring,
      Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hsum2 : Summable fun n : ℕ => 4 / 4 ^ (k' + 1) * (1 / ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
    ((summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) 2).mpr
      hasSum_zeta_two.summable).mul_left _
  calc ∑' n : ℕ, ((((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ (2 * (k' + 1)))⁻¹
      ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, 4 / 4 ^ (k' + 1) * (1 / ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
        hs.tsum_le_tsum (inv_pow_add_two_le k') hsum2
    _ = 4 / 4 ^ (k' + 1) * ∑' n : ℕ, 1 / ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := tsum_mul_left
    _ ≤ 4 / 4 ^ (k' + 1) * 2 := by gcongr; exact tsum_inv_sq_add_two_le
    _ = 8 / 4 ^ (k' + 1) := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_zetaReal_two_mul
statement: theorem tendsto_zetaReal_two_mul : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => zetaReal (2 * k)) atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h8 : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => 1 + 8 / (4 : ℝ) ^ k) atTop (𝓝 (1 + 8 * 0)) := by
    refine tendsto_const_nhds.add ?_
    have := (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4)
      (by norm_num)).const_mul 8
    refine this.congr fun k => ?_
    rw [one_div_pow]
    ring
  rw [mul_zero, add_zero] at h8
  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds h8 ?_ ?_
  · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with k hk using one_le_zetaReal_two_mul hk
  · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with k hk
    linarith [zetaReal_two_mul_sub_one_le hk]

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_bernoulli_isEquivalent
statement:
theorem abs_bernoulli_isEquivalent :
    (fun k : ℕ => |(bernoulli (2 * k) : ℝ)|)
      ~[atTop] fun k : ℕ => 2 * (2 * k).factorial / (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  refine isEquivalent_of_tendsto_one (tendsto_zetaReal_two_mul.congr' ?_)
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with k hk
  simp only [Pi.div_apply]
  rw [bernoulli_two_mul_eq_zeta hk, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one,
    one_pow, one_mul, abs_two, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * k).factorial),
    abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [one_le_zetaReal_two_mul hk] : (0 : ℝ) ≤ zetaReal (2 * k)),
    abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * k))]
  have hf : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * k).factorial := by positivity
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * k) := by positivity
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.tangentNumber_isEquivalent
statement:
theorem tangentNumber_isEquivalent :
    (fun k : ℕ => (tangentNumber k : ℝ))
      ~[atTop] fun k : ℕ => 2 * (2 * k - 1).factorial * (2 / Real.pi) ^ (2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  refine isEquivalent_of_tendsto_one ?_
  
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (1 - ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * k))⁻¹) * zetaReal (2 * k)) atTop
      (𝓝 ((1 - 0) * 1)) := by
    refine (tendsto_const_nhds.sub ?_).mul tendsto_zetaReal_two_mul
    have := tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4) (by norm_num)
    refine this.congr fun k => ?_
    rw [one_div_pow, pow_mul, one_div]
    norm_num
  rw [sub_zero, one_mul] at hlim
  refine hlim.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with k hk
  simp only [Pi.div_apply]
  obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
  have h := tangentNumber_div_factorial_eq_zeta k'
  have hf : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * (k' + 1) - 1).factorial := by positivity
  have hπ : (0 : ℝ) < Real.pi ^ (2 * (k' + 1)) := by positivity
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (k' + 1)) := by positivity
  rw [div_eq_iff hf.ne'] at h
  rw [h, div_pow, pow_succ (2 : ℝ) (2 * (k' + 1))]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_zero
statement: theorem integral_zero : integral (0 : K⟦X⟧) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [coeff_integral_zero]
  | succ n => simp [coeff_integral_succ]

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_add
statement: theorem integral_add (F G : K⟦X⟧) : integral (F + G) = integral F + integral G
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero => rw [coeff_integral_zero, map_add, coeff_integral_zero, coeff_integral_zero, add_zero]
  | succ n => simp only [map_add, coeff_integral_succ]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_sub
statement: theorem integral_sub (F G : K⟦X⟧) : integral (F - G) = integral F - integral G
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero => rw [coeff_integral_zero, map_sub, coeff_integral_zero, coeff_integral_zero, sub_zero]
  | succ n => simp only [map_sub, coeff_integral_succ]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.constantCoeff_logSeries
statement: theorem constantCoeff_logSeries (A : K⟦X⟧) : constantCoeff (logSeries A) = 0
proof:
:=
  constantCoeff_integral _

name: Azurite.BZ.derivative_logSeries
statement: theorem derivative_logSeries [CharZero K] (A : K⟦X⟧) : d⁄dX (logSeries A) = d⁄dX A * A⁻¹
proof:
:=
  derivative_integral _

name: Azurite.BZ.logSeries_unique
statement:
theorem logSeries_unique [CharZero K] {A L : K⟦X⟧} (h0 : constantCoeff L = 0)
    (hL : d⁄dX L = d⁄dX A * A⁻¹) : L = logSeries A
proof:
:= by
  rw [logSeries, ← hL, integral_derivative, h0, map_zero, sub_zero]

name: Azurite.BZ.logSeries_one
statement: theorem logSeries_one : logSeries (1 : K⟦X⟧) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [logSeries, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, zero_mul, integral_zero]

name: Azurite.BZ.logSeries_exp
statement: theorem logSeries_exp : logSeries (exp ℚ) = X
proof:
:= by
  rw [logSeries, PowerSeries.derivative_exp ℚ,
    PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel _ (by rw [constantCoeff_exp]; exact one_ne_zero)]
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [coeff_integral_zero]
  | succ n =>
    rw [coeff_integral_succ, coeff_one, coeff_X]
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst hn
      norm_num
    · simp [hn]

name: Azurite.BZ.logSeries_mul
statement:
theorem logSeries_mul {A B : K⟦X⟧} (hA : constantCoeff A ≠ 0) (hB : constantCoeff B ≠ 0) :
    logSeries (A * B) = logSeries A + logSeries B
proof:
:= by
  have hAB : constantCoeff (A * B) ≠ 0 := by rw [map_mul]; exact mul_ne_zero hA hB
  have hA0 : A ≠ 0 := fun h => hA (by rw [h, map_zero])
  have hB0 : B ≠ 0 := fun h => hB (by rw [h, map_zero])
  have hinvA := PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel A hA
  have hinvB := PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel B hB
  have hinvAB := PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel (A * B) hAB
  have key : d⁄dX (A * B) * (A * B)⁻¹ = d⁄dX A * A⁻¹ + d⁄dX B * B⁻¹ := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero hA0 hB0)
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    linear_combination (A * d⁄dX B + B * d⁄dX A) * hinvAB - (d⁄dX A * B) * hinvA
      - (d⁄dX B * A) * hinvB
  rw [logSeries, key, integral_add]
  rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.X_pow_dvd_integral
statement: theorem X_pow_dvd_integral {n : ℕ} {F : K⟦X⟧} (h : X ^ n ∣ F) : X ^ (n + 1) ∣ integral F
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_pow_dvd_iff] at h ⊢
  intro m hm
  cases m with
  | zero => exact coeff_integral_zero F
  | succ m => rw [coeff_integral_succ, h m (by omega), zero_div]

name: Azurite.BZ.X_pow_dvd_logSeries_sub
statement:
theorem X_pow_dvd_logSeries_sub {A B : K⟦X⟧} (hA : constantCoeff A ≠ 0)
    (hB : constantCoeff B ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (h : X ^ (n + 1) ∣ A - B) :
    X ^ (n + 1) ∣ logSeries A - logSeries B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := h
  have hAB : A = B + X ^ (n + 1) * R := by rw [← hR]; ring
  have hinvA := PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel A hA
  have hinvB := PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel B hB
  have key : d⁄dX A * A⁻¹ - d⁄dX B * B⁻¹ = (d⁄dX A * B - A * d⁄dX B) * (A⁻¹ * B⁻¹) := by
    linear_combination (-(d⁄dX A * A⁻¹)) * hinvB + (d⁄dX B * B⁻¹) * hinvA
  have hdA : d⁄dX A = d⁄dX B + (((n + 1 : ℕ) : K⟦X⟧) * X ^ n * R + X ^ (n + 1) * d⁄dX R) := by
    rw [hAB, map_add, Derivation.leibniz, Derivation.leibniz_pow, derivative_X]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel, mul_one]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hnum : X ^ n ∣ d⁄dX A * B - A * d⁄dX B :=
    ⟨((n + 1 : ℕ) : K⟦X⟧) * R * B + X * d⁄dX R * B - X * R * d⁄dX B, by rw [hdA, hAB]; ring⟩
  rw [logSeries, logSeries, ← integral_sub, key]
  exact X_pow_dvd_integral (hnum.mul_right _)

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_cost_le
statement:
theorem sum_cost_le (M : ℕ → ℝ) (hM0 : ∀ m, 0 ≤ M m) (hM : ∀ m, 2 * M m ≤ M (2 * m)) (L : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range L, M (2 ^ k) ≤ M (2 ^ L)
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | zero => simpa using hM0 1
  | succ L ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, pow_succ, mul_comm]
    linarith [hM (2 ^ L)]

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_odd_mul_rescale_neg_one
statement:
theorem coeff_odd_mul_rescale_neg_one (s : K⟦X⟧) (j : ℕ) :
    coeff (2 * j + 1) (s * rescale (-1) s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mul]
  set f : ℕ × ℕ → K := fun p => coeff p.1 s * coeff p.2 (rescale (-1) s) with hf
  have hswap : ∀ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal (2 * j + 1), f p.swap = -f p := by
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    simp only [hf, Prod.fst_swap, Prod.snd_swap, coeff_rescale]
    have hodd : (-1 : K) ^ p.1 = -(-1) ^ p.2 := by
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd p.1 with h | h
      · have h2 : Odd p.2 := by
          rcases h with ⟨a, ha⟩
          exact ⟨j - a, by omega⟩
        rw [h.neg_one_pow, h2.neg_one_pow, neg_neg]
      · have h2 : Even p.2 := by
          rcases h with ⟨a, ha⟩
          exact ⟨j - a, by omega⟩
        rw [h.neg_one_pow, h2.neg_one_pow]
    rw [hodd]
    ring
  have h := Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_swap (n := 2 * j + 1) (f := f)
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hswap, Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h
  have h2 : (2 : K) * ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal (2 * j + 1), f p = 0 := by linear_combination -h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left two_ne_zero

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_oddEvenT
statement:
theorem coeff_oddEvenT (s : K⟦X⟧) (j : ℕ) :
    coeff j (oddEvenT s) = coeff (2 * j) (s * rescale (-1) s)
proof:
:=
  coeff_mk _ _

name: Azurite.BZ.constantCoeff_rescale'
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_rescale' (a : K) (f : K⟦X⟧) :
    constantCoeff (rescale a f) = constantCoeff f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_rescale, pow_zero, one_mul,
    coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]

name: Azurite.BZ.mul_rescale_neg_one_eq_expand
statement:
theorem mul_rescale_neg_one_eq_expand (s : K⟦X⟧) :
    s * rescale (-1) s = expand 2 two_ne_zero (oddEvenT s)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_expand]
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [coeff_oddEvenT, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left j two_pos]
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, n = 2 * j + 1 := ⟨n / 2, by omega⟩
    exact coeff_odd_mul_rescale_neg_one s j

name: Azurite.BZ.constantCoeff_oddEvenT
statement: theorem constantCoeff_oddEvenT (s : K⟦X⟧) : constantCoeff (oddEvenT s) = constantCoeff s ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_oddEvenT, mul_zero, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff,
    map_mul, constantCoeff_rescale', sq]

name: Azurite.BZ.inv_eq_rescale_mul_expand_inv
statement:
theorem inv_eq_rescale_mul_expand_inv {s : K⟦X⟧} (hs : constantCoeff s ≠ 0) :
    s⁻¹ = rescale (-1) s * expand 2 two_ne_zero (oddEvenT s)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have ht : constantCoeff (oddEvenT s) ≠ 0 := by rw [constantCoeff_oddEvenT]; exact pow_ne_zero 2 hs
  have hW : s * (rescale (-1) s * expand 2 two_ne_zero (oddEvenT s)⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_rescale_neg_one_eq_expand, ← map_mul, PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel _ ht,
      map_one]
  calc s⁻¹ = s⁻¹ * (s * (rescale (-1) s * expand 2 two_ne_zero (oddEvenT s)⁻¹)) := by
        rw [hW, mul_one]
    _ = _ := by rw [← mul_assoc, PowerSeries.inv_mul_cancel s hs, one_mul]

name: Azurite.BZ.X_pow_dvd_inv_sub_oddEven
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_eq_rescale_mul_expand_inv hs, ← mul_sub, ← map_sub]
  have h := map_dvd (expand 2 two_ne_zero) hu
  rw [map_pow, expand_X, ← pow_mul] at h
  exact h.mul_left _

name: Azurite.BZ.cost_recurrence_le
statement:
theorem cost_recurrence_le (T M : ℕ → ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hM0 : ∀ m, 0 ≤ M m)
    (hM : ∀ k, 2 * M (2 ^ k) ≤ M (2 ^ (k + 1)))
    (hT : ∀ k, T (2 ^ (k + 1)) ≤ T (2 ^ k) + c * M (2 ^ (k + 1))) (L : ℕ) :
    T (2 ^ L) ≤ T 1 + 2 * c * M (2 ^ L)
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | zero => simp only [pow_zero]; nlinarith [hM0 1]
  | succ L ih =>
    have := hT L
    have := hM L
    nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.taylorInverseStep_eq_taylor
statement:
theorem taylorInverseStep_eq_taylor {g h : ℝ → ℝ} {y xj : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ k g)
    (hgh : g (h xj) = xj) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hne : h xj ≠ y) :
    taylorInverseStep g h y k xj = taylorWithinEval g (k - 1) (uIcc (h xj) y) (h xj) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [taylor_within_apply, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk, Finset.range_eq_Ico,
    Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hk]
  have hu : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (uIcc (h xj) y) := uniqueDiffOn_uIcc hne
  have hmem : h xj ∈ uIcc (h xj) y := left_mem_uIcc
  have hw : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Ico 1 k,
      iteratedDerivWithin m g (uIcc (h xj) y) (h xj) = iteratedDeriv m g (h xj) := fun m hm =>
    iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv hu (hg.contDiffAt.of_le (by
      have := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hm).2; exact_mod_cast this.le)) hmem
  rw [iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv hu (hg.contDiffAt.of_le (by simp)) hmem,
    iteratedDeriv_zero, hgh]
  simp only [pow_zero, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, inv_one, mul_one, one_smul]
  unfold taylorInverseStep
  rw [add_right_inj]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm => by rw [hw m hm, smul_eq_mul]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.taylorInverseStep_sub
statement:
theorem taylorInverseStep_sub {g h : ℝ → ℝ} {y xj : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ k g)
    (hgh : g (h xj) = xj) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hne : h xj ≠ y) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ uIoo (h xj) y,
      g y - taylorInverseStep g h y k xj = iteratedDeriv k g ξ * (y - h xj) ^ k / k.factorial
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, k = n + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
  have hg' : ContDiffOn ℝ (n + 1) g (uIcc (h xj) y) := hg.contDiffOn
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, h⟩ := taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange_iteratedDeriv hne hg'
  refine ⟨ξ, hξ, ?_⟩
  rw [taylorInverseStep_eq_taylor hg hgh hk hne, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  exact h

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_sub_taylorInverseStep_le
statement:
theorem abs_sub_taylorInverseStep_le {g h : ℝ → ℝ} {y xj M : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ k g)
    (hgh : g (h xj) = xj) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hM : ∀ ξ ∈ uIcc (h xj) y, |iteratedDeriv k g ξ| ≤ M) :
    |g y - taylorInverseStep g h y k xj| ≤ M * |y - h xj| ^ k / k.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (h xj) y with heq | hne
  · have hstep : taylorInverseStep g h y k xj = xj := by
      unfold taylorInverseStep
      rw [← heq, sub_self]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun m hm => by
        rw [zero_pow (by have := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hm).1; omega)]; ring]
      ring
    rw [hstep, ← heq, hgh, sub_self, abs_zero, sub_self, abs_zero, zero_pow (by omega), mul_zero,
      zero_div]
  · obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hrem⟩ := taylorInverseStep_sub hg hgh hk hne
    rw [hrem, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < k.factorial)]
    have hξ' : ξ ∈ uIcc (h xj) y := uIoo_subset_uIcc_self hξ
    gcongr
    exact hM ξ hξ'

name: Azurite.BZ.taylorInverseStep_order
statement:
theorem taylorInverseStep_order {g h : ℝ → ℝ} {x xj M L : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ k g)
    (hgx : g (h x) = x) (hgh : g (h xj) = xj) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hLip : |h x - h xj| ≤ L * |x - xj|)
    (hM : ∀ ξ ∈ uIcc (h xj) (h x), |iteratedDeriv k g ξ| ≤ M) :
    |x - taylorInverseStep g h (h x) k xj| ≤ M * L ^ k / k.factorial * |x - xj| ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hM (h xj) left_mem_uIcc)
  have h1 := abs_sub_taylorInverseStep_le hg hgh hk hM
  rw [hgx] at h1
  refine h1.trans ?_
  have h2 : |h x - h xj| ^ k ≤ (L * |x - xj|) ^ k := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hLip k
  rw [mul_pow] at h2
  calc M * |h x - h xj| ^ k / k.factorial ≤ M * (L ^ k * |x - xj| ^ k) / k.factorial := by
        gcongr
    _ = M * L ^ k / k.factorial * |x - xj| ^ k := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.iterate_le_of_order
statement:
theorem iterate_le_of_order {e : ℕ → ℝ} {C r : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (he0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ e j) (hstep : ∀ j, e j ≤ r → e (j + 1) ≤ C * e j ^ k)
    (hCr : C * r ^ (k - 1) ≤ 1 / 2) (h0 : e 0 ≤ r) (j : ℕ) : e j ≤ r / 2 ^ j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simpa using h0
  | succ j ih =>
    have hr' : e j ≤ r := ih.trans (by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hr (one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)))
    have h1 := hstep j hr'
    have h2 : e j ^ k = e j ^ (k - 1) * e j := by
      rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk]
    have h3 : e j ^ (k - 1) ≤ r ^ (k - 1) := pow_le_pow_left₀ (he0 j) hr' _
    calc e (j + 1) ≤ C * (e j ^ (k - 1) * e j) := by rw [← h2]; exact h1
      _ ≤ C * (r ^ (k - 1) * e j) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 (he0 j)) hC
      _ = (C * r ^ (k - 1)) * e j := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 / 2 * (r / 2 ^ j) := mul_le_mul hCr ih (he0 j) (by norm_num)
      _ = r / 2 ^ (j + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.forwardHorner_zero
statement: theorem forwardHorner_zero (a : ℕ → K) (y : K) : forwardHorner a y 0 = a 0
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.forwardHorner_succ
statement:
theorem forwardHorner_succ (a : ℕ → K) (y : K) (j : ℕ) :
    forwardHorner a y (j + 1) = forwardHorner a y j * y + a (j + 1)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.forwardHorner_eq_sum
statement:
theorem forwardHorner_eq_sum (a : ℕ → K) (y : K) (j : ℕ) :
    forwardHorner a y j = ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), a i * y ^ (j - i)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [forwardHorner_zero]
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [forwardHorner_succ, ih, sum_range_succ _ (j + 1), Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one,
      sum_mul]
    congr 1
    refine sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
    have : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (mem_range.mp hi)
    rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, show j + 1 - i = j - i + 1 by omega]

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_eq_pow_mul_forwardHorner
statement:
theorem sum_eq_pow_mul_forwardHorner (a : ℕ → K) {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (j : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), a i * x ^ i = x ^ j * forwardHorner a x⁻¹ j
proof:
:= by
  rw [forwardHorner_eq_sum, mul_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  have : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (mem_range.mp hi)
  rw [inv_pow, show x ^ j = x ^ i * x ^ (j - i) by rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' this]]
  have h := mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero (j - i) hx)
  linear_combination (-(a i * x ^ i)) * h

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_abs_term
statement:
theorem summable_abs_term {a : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1) (ha : Antitone fun i => |a i|) :
    Summable fun i => |a i * x ^ i|
proof:
:=
  ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one (abs_nonneg x) hx).mul_left |a 0|).of_nonneg_of_le
    (fun _ => abs_nonneg _) fun i => by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_pow]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (ha (Nat.zero_le i)) (by positivity)

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_tsum_sub_sum_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem abs_tsum_sub_sum_le_two_mul {a : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1 / 2)
    (ha : Antitone fun i => |a i|) (j : ℕ) :
    |∑' i, a i * x ^ i - ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), a i * x ^ i| ≤ 2 * |a (j + 1)| * |x| ^ (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hx1 : |x| < 1 := by linarith
  have hs := (summable_abs_term hx1 ha).of_abs
  rw [← Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add' (f := fun i => a i * x ^ i) (k := j + 1)
    ((summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun i => a i * x ^ i) (j + 1)).mpr hs), add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hgeo : Summable fun i : ℕ => |a (j + 1)| * |x| ^ (j + 1) * |x| ^ i :=
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (abs_nonneg x) hx1).mul_left _
  have hbound : ∀ i : ℕ, |a (i + (j + 1)) * x ^ (i + (j + 1))|
      ≤ |a (j + 1)| * |x| ^ (j + 1) * |x| ^ i := by
    intro i
    rw [abs_mul, abs_pow, pow_add, mul_comm (|x| ^ i)]
    have h1 : |a (i + (j + 1))| ≤ |a (j + 1)| := ha (by omega)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ |x| ^ (j + 1) * |x| ^ i := by positivity
    calc |a (i + (j + 1))| * (|x| ^ (j + 1) * |x| ^ i) ≤ |a (j + 1)| * (|x| ^ (j + 1) * |x| ^ i) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 h2
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hnorm : Summable fun i : ℕ => |a (i + (j + 1)) * x ^ (i + (j + 1))| :=
    hgeo.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => abs_nonneg _) hbound
  calc |∑' i : ℕ, a (i + (j + 1)) * x ^ (i + (j + 1))|
      ≤ ∑' i : ℕ, |a (i + (j + 1)) * x ^ (i + (j + 1))| := by
        rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hnorm)
    _ ≤ ∑' i : ℕ, |a (j + 1)| * |x| ^ (j + 1) * |x| ^ i := hnorm.tsum_le_tsum hbound hgeo
    _ = |a (j + 1)| * |x| ^ (j + 1) * (1 - |x|)⁻¹ := by
        rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (abs_nonneg x) hx1]
    _ ≤ |a (j + 1)| * |x| ^ (j + 1) * 2 := by
        gcongr
        rw [inv_le_comm₀ (by linarith) two_pos]
        linarith
    _ = 2 * |a (j + 1)| * |x| ^ (j + 1) := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_tsum_sub_sum_le_term
statement:
theorem abs_tsum_sub_sum_le_term {a : ℕ → ℝ} {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1 / 2)
    (ha : Antitone fun i => |a i|) (j : ℕ) :
    |∑' i, a i * x ^ i - ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), a i * x ^ i| ≤ |a j * x ^ j|
proof:
:= by
  refine (abs_tsum_sub_sum_le_two_mul hx ha j).trans ?_
  rw [abs_mul, abs_pow, pow_succ]
  have h1 : |a (j + 1)| ≤ |a j| := ha (Nat.le_succ j)
  have h2 : 0 ≤ |x| ^ j := by positivity
  have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (abs_nonneg x)) h2
  have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.le (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg (a j)) h2)
  nlinarith [h3, h4]

name: Azurite.BZ.stop_criterion_iff
statement:
theorem stop_criterion_iff {a : ℕ → ℝ} {x ε : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (j : ℕ) :
    |a j| ≤ ε * |x⁻¹| ^ j ↔ |a j * x ^ j| ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < |x| ^ j := by positivity
  rw [abs_inv, inv_pow, abs_mul, abs_pow, ← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ hpos]

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_tsum_sub_forwardHorner_le
statement:
theorem abs_tsum_sub_forwardHorner_le {a : ℕ → ℝ} {x ε : ℝ} (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (hx : |x| < 1 / 2)
    (ha : Antitone fun i => |a i|) {j : ℕ} (hstop : |a j * x ^ j| ≤ ε) :
    |∑' i, a i * x ^ i - x ^ j * forwardHorner a x⁻¹ j| ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_eq_pow_mul_forwardHorner a hx0]
  exact (abs_tsum_sub_sum_le_term hx ha j).trans hstop

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_series_terms_of_small
statement:
theorem exp_series_terms_of_small {r : ℝ} {m d n : ℕ} (hr : |r| ≤ (1 / 2) ^ m)
    (hd : n + 2 ≤ m * d) :
    |Real.exp r - ∑ i ∈ range d, r ^ i / i.factorial| ≤ (1 / 2) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_exp_sub_sum_le r d
  have hr1 : |r| ≤ 1 := hr.trans (pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
  have hexp : Real.exp |r| ≤ 3 := (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hr1).trans Real.exp_one_lt_three.le
  have hfact : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d.factorial := by exact_mod_cast d.factorial_pos
  have hpow : |r| ^ d ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 2) := by
    calc |r| ^ d ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ d := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg r) hr d
      _ = (1 / 2) ^ (m * d) := by rw [← pow_mul]
      _ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 2) := pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hd
  refine h.trans ?_
  calc |r| ^ d / d.factorial * Real.exp |r| ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 2) / 1 * 3 := by
        gcongr
    _ = (1 / 2) ^ n * (3 / 4) := by ring
    _ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ n := by
        have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ n := by positivity
        linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.doubling_cost_ge
statement: theorem doubling_cost_ge {n m : ℝ} (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hm : 0 < m) : 2 * Real.sqrt n ≤ n / m + m
proof:
:= by
  have := two_sqrt_le_add_div hn hm
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.doubling_cost_sqrt
statement: theorem doubling_cost_sqrt (n : ℝ) : n / Real.sqrt n + Real.sqrt n = 2 * Real.sqrt n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.div_sqrt, two_mul]

name: Azurite.BZ.iteratedDeriv_exp
statement: theorem iteratedDeriv_exp (m : ℕ) : iteratedDeriv m Real.exp = Real.exp
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact iteratedDeriv_zero
  | succ m ih => rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih, Real.deriv_exp]

name: Azurite.BZ.expViaLogStep_eq_taylorInverseStep
statement:
theorem expViaLogStep_eq_taylorInverseStep {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {x z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    expViaLogStep k x z = taylorInverseStep Real.exp Real.log x k z
proof:
:= by
  unfold expViaLogStep taylorInverseStep
  rw [range_eq_Ico, sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot hk, mul_add, pow_zero, Nat.factorial_zero,
    Nat.cast_one, div_one, mul_one, mul_sum]
  congr 1
  refine sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
  rw [iteratedDeriv_exp, Real.exp_log hz]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_log_sub_log_le
statement:
theorem abs_log_sub_log_le {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    |Real.log a - Real.log b| ≤ |a - b| / min a b
proof:
:= by
  wlog hab : a ≤ b generalizing a b
  · have := this hb ha (le_of_not_ge hab)
    rwa [abs_sub_comm b a, min_comm b a, abs_sub_comm (Real.log b)] at this
  rw [min_eq_left hab, abs_sub_comm a b, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hab),
    abs_sub_comm (Real.log a), abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.log_le_log ha hab)),
    ← Real.log_div hb.ne' ha.ne']
  have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hb ha)
  rw [div_sub_one ha.ne'] at this
  exact this

name: Azurite.BZ.expViaLogStep_relative_error
statement:
theorem expViaLogStep_relative_error {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {x z : ℝ}
    (hz : |Real.exp x - z| ≤ Real.exp x / 2) :
    |Real.exp x - expViaLogStep k x z| / Real.exp x
      ≤ 3 * 2 ^ (k - 1) / k.factorial * (|Real.exp x - z| / Real.exp x) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hex : 0 < Real.exp x := Real.exp_pos x
  have hz0 : Real.exp x / 2 ≤ z := by linarith [(abs_le.mp hz).2]
  have hz2 : z ≤ 3 / 2 * Real.exp x := by linarith [(abs_le.mp hz).1]
  have hzpos : 0 < z := by linarith
  rw [expViaLogStep_eq_taylorInverseStep hk hzpos]
  
  have hL : |Real.log (Real.exp x) - Real.log z| ≤ (2 / Real.exp x) * |Real.exp x - z| := by
    refine (abs_log_sub_log_le hex hzpos).trans ?_
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
    gcongr
    rw [inv_le_comm₀ (lt_min hex hzpos) (by positivity), inv_div, le_min_iff]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hM : ∀ ξ ∈ uIcc (Real.log z) (Real.log (Real.exp x)),
      |iteratedDeriv k Real.exp ξ| ≤ 3 / 2 * Real.exp x := by
    intro ξ hξ
    rw [iteratedDeriv_exp, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos ξ)]
    have h1 : Real.exp (Real.log z) ≤ 3 / 2 * Real.exp x := by rw [Real.exp_log hzpos]; exact hz2
    have h2 : Real.exp (Real.log (Real.exp x)) ≤ 3 / 2 * Real.exp x := by
      rw [Real.exp_log hex]; linarith
    rcases mem_uIcc.mp hξ with ⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
    · exact (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h).trans h2
    · exact (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h).trans h1
  have h := taylorInverseStep_order (g := Real.exp) (h := Real.log) (x := Real.exp x) (xj := z)
    (M := 3 / 2 * Real.exp x) (L := 2 / Real.exp x) (Real.contDiff_exp.of_le le_top)
    (Real.exp_log hex) (Real.exp_log hzpos) hk hL hM
  rw [Real.log_exp] at h
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hex]
  refine h.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, k = n + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, div_pow, div_pow]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.geometric_cost_le
statement:
theorem geometric_cost_le (T : ℝ → ℝ) {k : ℝ} (hk : 1 < k) (hT0 : ∀ m, 0 ≤ T m)
    (hT : ∀ m, k * T (m / k) ≤ T m) (n : ℝ) (L : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range L, T (n / k ^ i) ≤ T n * (k / (k - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hk0 : 0 < k := by linarith
  have hterm : ∀ i : ℕ, T (n / k ^ i) ≤ T n * (1 / k) ^ i := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => simp
    | succ i ih =>
      have h := hT (n / k ^ i)
      rw [div_div, ← pow_succ] at h
      calc T (n / k ^ (i + 1)) ≤ T (n / k ^ i) / k := by
            rw [le_div_iff₀ hk0]; linarith
        _ ≤ T n * (1 / k) ^ i / k := by gcongr
        _ = T n * (1 / k) ^ (i + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
  have hgeo : ∑ i ∈ range L, (1 / k) ^ i ≤ k / (k - 1) := by
    have hr : (1 / k : ℝ) < 1 := by rw [div_lt_one hk0]; exact hk
    have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / k := by positivity
    calc ∑ i ∈ range L, (1 / k) ^ i ≤ ∑' i : ℕ, (1 / k) ^ i :=
          (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr0 hr).sum_le_tsum _ fun i _ => by positivity
      _ = (1 - 1 / k)⁻¹ := tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hr0 hr
      _ = k / (k - 1) := by field_simp
  calc ∑ i ∈ range L, T (n / k ^ i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ range L, T n * (1 / k) ^ i :=
        sum_le_sum fun i _ => hterm i
    _ = T n * ∑ i ∈ range L, (1 / k) ^ i := by rw [mul_sum]
    _ ≤ T n * (k / (k - 1)) := by gcongr; exact hT0 n

name: Azurite.BZ.two_pow_mul_le_one_add_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem two_pow_mul_le_one_add_pow_sub_one {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (k : ℕ) :
    2 ^ k * ε ≤ (1 + ε) ^ 2 ^ k - 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := one_add_mul_le_pow (show (-2 : ℝ) ≤ ε by linarith) (2 ^ k)
  push_cast at h
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.one_add_pow_sub_one_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem one_add_pow_sub_one_le_two_mul {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ^ k * ε ≤ 1) :
    (1 + ε) ^ 2 ^ k - 1 ≤ 2 * (2 ^ k * ε)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 + ε) ^ 2 ^ k ≤ Real.exp (2 ^ k * ε) := by
    rw [show (2 ^ k * ε : ℝ) = ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε by push_cast; ring, Real.exp_nat_mul]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp ε]) _
  have h2 := exp_sub_one_le_two_mul (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ k * ε) hk
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.logb_one_add_pow_sub_one_ge
statement:
theorem logb_one_add_pow_sub_one_ge {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (k : ℕ) :
    (k : ℝ) + Real.logb 2 ε ≤ Real.logb 2 ((1 + ε) ^ 2 ^ k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := two_pow_mul_le_one_add_pow_sub_one hε.le k
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ k * ε := by positivity
  calc (k : ℝ) + Real.logb 2 ε = Real.logb 2 (2 ^ k * ε) := by
        rw [Real.logb_mul (by positivity) hε.ne', Real.logb_pow, Real.logb_self_eq_one one_lt_two,
          mul_one]
    _ ≤ Real.logb 2 ((1 + ε) ^ 2 ^ k - 1) := Real.logb_le_logb_of_le one_lt_two hpos h

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_expm1_relError_step_le
statement:
theorem abs_expm1_relError_step_le {x ε : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hε : |ε| ≤ 1) :
    |ε * (2 * (expm1 x + 1) + expm1 x * ε) / (expm1 x + 2)| ≤ |ε| * (1 + expm1 x)
proof:
:= by
  have he : 0 ≤ expm1 x := by unfold expm1; linarith [Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr hx]
  have h2 := expm1_add_two_pos x
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos h2, div_le_iff₀ h2, abs_mul]
  have hb : |2 * (expm1 x + 1) + expm1 x * ε| ≤ 2 + 3 * expm1 x := by
    calc |2 * (expm1 x + 1) + expm1 x * ε| ≤ |2 * (expm1 x + 1)| + |expm1 x * ε| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = 2 * (expm1 x + 1) + expm1 x * |ε| := by
          rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith), abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg he]
      _ ≤ 2 + 3 * expm1 x := by nlinarith
  calc |ε| * |2 * (expm1 x + 1) + expm1 x * ε| ≤ |ε| * (2 + 3 * expm1 x) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (abs_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ |ε| * (1 + expm1 x) * (expm1 x + 2) := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg ε, sq_nonneg (expm1 x)]

name: Azurite.BZ.expm1DoublingSeq_exact
statement:
theorem expm1DoublingSeq_exact (r : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    expm1DoublingSeq (expm1 r) k = expm1 (r * 2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [expm1DoublingSeq]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [expm1DoublingSeq, ih, pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (r * 2 ^ k) 2, expm1_two_mul]

name: Azurite.BZ.prod_one_add_le_exp_sum
statement:
theorem prod_one_add_le_exp_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ a i) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, (1 + a i) ≤ Real.exp (∑ i ∈ s, a i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.exp_sum]
  exact prod_le_prod₀ (fun i hi => by linarith [ha i hi]) fun i _ => by
    linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (a i)]

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_expm1_two_pow_le
statement:
theorem sum_expm1_two_pow_le {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range k, expm1 (r * 2 ^ i) ≤ r * 2 ^ k * Real.exp (r * 2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ range k, expm1 (r * 2 ^ i) ≤ r * 2 ^ i * Real.exp (r * 2 ^ k) := by
    intro i hi
    refine (expm1_le_mul_exp _).trans ?_
    have hi' : (2 : ℝ) ^ i ≤ 2 ^ k :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (mem_range.mp hi).le
    gcongr
  calc ∑ i ∈ range k, expm1 (r * 2 ^ i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ range k, r * 2 ^ i * Real.exp (r * 2 ^ k) :=
        sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = r * Real.exp (r * 2 ^ k) * ∑ i ∈ range k, (2 : ℝ) ^ i := by
        rw [mul_sum]; exact sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
    _ = r * Real.exp (r * 2 ^ k) * (2 ^ k - 1) := by
        rw [geom_sum_eq (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 1)]; ring
    _ ≤ r * 2 ^ k * Real.exp (r * 2 ^ k) := by nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (r * 2 ^ k)]

name: Azurite.BZ.expm1DoublingSeq_relError
statement:
theorem expm1DoublingSeq_relError {r ε : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (k : ℕ)
    (hbound : |ε| * ∏ i ∈ range k, (1 + expm1 (r * 2 ^ i)) ≤ 1) :
    ∃ ε' : ℝ, expm1DoublingSeq (expm1 r * (1 + ε)) k = expm1 (r * 2 ^ k) * (1 + ε')
      ∧ |ε'| ≤ |ε| * ∏ i ∈ range k, (1 + expm1 (r * 2 ^ i))
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ ∏ i ∈ range j, (1 + expm1 (r * 2 ^ i)) := fun j =>
    one_le_prod₀ fun i _ => by
      have : 0 ≤ expm1 (r * 2 ^ i) := by
        unfold expm1; linarith [Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ r * 2 ^ i)]
      linarith
  have hmono : ∀ j ≤ k, ∏ i ∈ range j, (1 + expm1 (r * 2 ^ i))
      ≤ ∏ i ∈ range k, (1 + expm1 (r * 2 ^ i)) := fun j hj =>
    prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le₀ (range_subset_range.mpr hj)
      (fun i _ => by
        have : 0 ≤ expm1 (r * 2 ^ i) := by
          unfold expm1; linarith [Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ r * 2 ^ i)]
        linarith)
      fun i _ _ => by
        have : 0 ≤ expm1 (r * 2 ^ i) := by
          unfold expm1; linarith [Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ r * 2 ^ i)]
        linarith
  
  suffices h : ∀ j ≤ k, ∃ ε' : ℝ, expm1DoublingSeq (expm1 r * (1 + ε)) j
      = expm1 (r * 2 ^ j) * (1 + ε') ∧ |ε'| ≤ |ε| * ∏ i ∈ range j, (1 + expm1 (r * 2 ^ i)) from
    h k le_rfl
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    exact ⟨ε, by simp [expm1DoublingSeq], by simp⟩
  | succ j ih =>
    intro hj
    obtain ⟨ε', heq, hle⟩ := ih (by omega)
    have hε'1 : |ε'| ≤ 1 := hle.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmono j (by omega))
      (abs_nonneg ε)).trans hbound)
    have hx : 0 ≤ r * 2 ^ j := by positivity
    refine ⟨ε' * (2 * (expm1 (r * 2 ^ j) + 1) + expm1 (r * 2 ^ j) * ε') / (expm1 (r * 2 ^ j) + 2),
      ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [expm1DoublingSeq, heq, expm1_two_mul_perturbed]
      congr 2
      ring
    · refine (abs_expm1_relError_step_le hx hε'1).trans ?_
      rw [prod_range_succ, ← mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (by
        linarith [Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr hx, show expm1 (r * 2 ^ j) = Real.exp (r * 2 ^ j) - 1
          from rfl])

name: Azurite.BZ.div_one_add_sqrt_eq
statement:
theorem div_one_add_sqrt_eq {x : ℝ} (hx : -1 < x) :
    x / (1 + Real.sqrt (1 + x)) = Real.sqrt (1 + x) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 0 ≤ 1 + x := by linarith
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt (1 + x) ^ 2 = 1 + x := Real.sq_sqrt h1
  rw [div_eq_iff (by positivity)]
  linear_combination -hs2

name: Azurite.BZ.log1p_reduction
statement:
theorem log1p_reduction {x : ℝ} (hx : -1 < x) :
    log1p x = 2 * log1p (x / (1 + Real.sqrt (1 + x)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_one_add_sqrt_eq hx]
  unfold log1p
  have h1 : 0 < 1 + x := by linarith
  rw [show (1 : ℝ) + (Real.sqrt (1 + x) - 1) = Real.sqrt (1 + x) by ring]
  calc Real.log (1 + x) = Real.log (Real.sqrt (1 + x) ^ 2) := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt h1.le]
    _ = 2 * Real.log (Real.sqrt (1 + x)) := by rw [Real.log_pow]; norm_num

name: Azurite.BZ.sqrt_sub_one_le_half
statement: theorem sqrt_sub_one_le_half {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : Real.sqrt (1 + x) - 1 ≤ x / 2
proof:
:= by
  have : Real.sqrt (1 + x) ≤ 1 + x / 2 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.one_le_sqrt_one_add
statement: theorem one_le_sqrt_one_add {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.le_sqrt zero_le_one (by positivity)]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.reduced_relError_le
statement:
theorem reduced_relError_le {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    ((Real.sqrt (1 + y) - 1) - (Real.sqrt (1 + x) - 1)) / (Real.sqrt (1 + x) - 1)
      ≤ (y - x) / x
proof:
:= by
  set A := Real.sqrt (1 + y) with hA
  set B := Real.sqrt (1 + x) with hB
  have hA2 : A ^ 2 = 1 + y := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hB2 : B ^ 2 = 1 + x := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hB1 : 1 < B := by
    rw [hB, Real.lt_sqrt zero_le_one]
    linarith
  have hAB : B ≤ A := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) hx]
  
  have hx' : x = (B - 1) * (B + 1) := by linear_combination -hB2
  have hyx : y - x = (A - B) * (A + B) := by linear_combination hB2 - hA2
  rw [hyx, hx']
  have h0 : 0 ≤ (A - B) * (B - 1) * (A - 1) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hAB) (sub_nonneg.mpr hB1.le))
      (sub_nonneg.mpr (hB1.le.trans hAB))
  nlinarith [h0]

name: Azurite.BZ.relError_sub_one
statement:
theorem relError_sub_one {y ε : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 1) :
    ((y * (1 + ε) - 1) - (y - 1)) / (y - 1) = ε * (y / (y - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have : y - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hy
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.sinh_eq_sinhExpm1
statement: theorem sinh_eq_sinhExpm1 (x : ℝ) : Real.sinh x = sinhExpm1 (expm1 x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sinhExpm1 expm1
  have he : 0 < Real.exp x := Real.exp_pos x
  rw [Real.sinh_eq, Real.exp_neg, show (1 : ℝ) + (Real.exp x - 1) = Real.exp x by ring]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.sinhExpm1_eq
statement: theorem sinhExpm1_eq {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : sinhExpm1 u = (u + u / (1 + u)) / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold sinhExpm1
  have : (1 : ℝ) + u ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.sinhExpm1_nonneg
statement: theorem sinhExpm1_nonneg {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : 0 ≤ sinhExpm1 u
proof:
:= by
  unfold sinhExpm1; positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.sinh_eq_sign_mul_sinh_abs
statement:
theorem sinh_eq_sign_mul_sinh_abs (x : ℝ) :
    Real.sinh x = (if 0 ≤ x then 1 else -1) * sinhExpm1 (expm1 |x|)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sinh_eq_sinhExpm1]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg h, one_mul]
  · rw [abs_of_neg (not_le.mp h), Real.sinh_neg]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.expm1_abs_nonneg
statement: theorem expm1_abs_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ expm1 |x|
proof:
:= by
  unfold expm1; linarith [Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr (abs_nonneg x)]

name: Azurite.BZ.cosh_eq_expm1
statement: theorem cosh_eq_expm1 (x : ℝ) : Real.cosh x = 1 + expm1 x ^ 2 / (2 * (1 + expm1 x))
proof:
:= by
  unfold expm1
  have he : 0 < Real.exp x := Real.exp_pos x
  rw [Real.cosh_eq, Real.exp_neg, show (1 : ℝ) + (Real.exp x - 1) = Real.exp x by ring]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.mul_sinhExpm1_le
statement:
theorem mul_sinhExpm1_le {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (huv : u ≤ v) :
    u * sinhExpm1 v ≤ v * sinhExpm1 u
proof:
:= by
  unfold sinhExpm1
  have hv : 0 ≤ v := hu.trans huv
  rw [mul_div_assoc', mul_div_assoc', div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hu (sub_nonneg.mpr huv), mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hu hu) (sub_nonneg.mpr huv),
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hu (hu.trans huv)) (sub_nonneg.mpr huv)]

name: Azurite.BZ.sinhExpm1_mono
statement: theorem sinhExpm1_mono {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (huv : u ≤ v) : sinhExpm1 u ≤ sinhExpm1 v
proof:
:= by
  rw [sinhExpm1_eq hu, sinhExpm1_eq (hu.trans huv)]
  have h1 : u / (1 + u) ≤ v / (1 + v) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)]; nlinarith
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.sinhExpm1_relError_le
statement:
theorem sinhExpm1_relError_le {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (huv : u ≤ v) :
    0 ≤ (sinhExpm1 v - sinhExpm1 u) / sinhExpm1 u ∧
      (sinhExpm1 v - sinhExpm1 u) / sinhExpm1 u ≤ (v - u) / u
proof:
:= by
  have hf : 0 < sinhExpm1 u := by unfold sinhExpm1; positivity
  refine ⟨div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (sinhExpm1_mono hu.le huv)) hf.le, ?_⟩
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hf hu]
  nlinarith [mul_sinhExpm1_le hu.le huv]

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_eq_sinh_add_sqrt
statement:
theorem exp_eq_sinh_add_sqrt (x : ℝ) :
    Real.exp x = Real.sinh x + Real.sqrt (1 + Real.sinh x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.cosh_sq', Real.sqrt_sq (Real.cosh_pos x).le, Real.sinh_add_cosh]

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_sinh_series
statement:
theorem hasSum_sinh_series (x : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => x ^ (2 * k + 1) / ((2 * k + 1).factorial : ℝ)) (Real.sinh x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (x ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) - (-x) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) / 2)
      (Real.sinh x) := by
    rw [Real.sinh_eq]
    exact ((hasSum_exp_series x).sub (hasSum_exp_series (-x))).div_const 2
  have hg : Function.Injective (fun k : ℕ => 2 * k + 1) := fun a b hab => by
    simp only at hab; omega
  rw [← hg.hasSum_iff] at h
  · convert h using 1
    ext k
    simp only [Function.comp]
    rw [Odd.neg_pow ⟨k, rfl⟩]
    ring
  · intro n hn
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : Even n := by
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with h | ⟨k, hk⟩
      · exact h
      · exact absurd ⟨k, hk.symm⟩ hn
    rw [Even.neg_pow ⟨m, hm⟩]
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_sinh_series'
statement:
theorem hasSum_sinh_series' (x : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => x * (x ^ 2) ^ k / ((2 * k + 1).factorial : ℝ)) (Real.sinh x)
proof:
:= by
  convert hasSum_sinh_series x using 1
  ext k
  rw [pow_succ x (2 * k), pow_mul]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.sqrt_sub_eq_inv
statement:
theorem sqrt_sub_eq_inv (s : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (1 + s ^ 2) - s = 1 / (s + Real.sqrt (1 + s ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt (1 + s ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 + s ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hpos : 0 < s + Real.sqrt (1 + s ^ 2) := by
    have : |s| < Real.sqrt (1 + s ^ 2) := by
      rw [Real.lt_sqrt (abs_nonneg s), sq_abs]; linarith
    linarith [neg_abs_le s]
  rw [eq_div_iff hpos.ne']
  linear_combination hs2

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_eq_inv_sinh_abs_add_sqrt
statement:
theorem exp_eq_inv_sinh_abs_add_sqrt {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ 0) :
    Real.exp x = 1 / (Real.sinh |x| + Real.sqrt (1 + Real.sinh |x| ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hx, Real.sinh_neg, ← sqrt_sub_eq_inv, neg_sq, sub_neg_eq_add,
    exp_eq_sinh_add_sqrt]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.sinh_add_sqrt_relError_le
statement:
theorem sinh_add_sqrt_relError_le {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    ((t + Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2)) - (s + Real.sqrt (1 + s ^ 2))) / (s + Real.sqrt (1 + s ^ 2))
      ≤ (t - s) / s
proof:
:= by
  have hS : 0 < s + Real.sqrt (1 + s ^ 2) := by positivity
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hS hs]
  
  have key : s * Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2) ≤ t * Real.sqrt (1 + s ^ 2) := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_sq hs.le, ← Real.sqrt_sq (hs.le.trans hst), ← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity),
      ← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq hs.le, Real.sqrt_sq (hs.le.trans hst)]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hs.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hst)]
  nlinarith [key]

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_eq_tanh_half
statement:
theorem exp_eq_tanh_half (x : ℝ) :
    Real.exp x = (1 + Real.tanh (x / 2)) / (1 - Real.tanh (x / 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh]
  have hc : 0 < Real.cosh (x / 2) := Real.cosh_pos _
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) - Real.sinh (x / 2) / Real.cosh (x / 2) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [sub_ne_zero, ne_comm, Ne, div_eq_one_iff_eq hc.ne']
    exact fun h => by linarith [Real.sinh_lt_cosh (x / 2)]
  rw [eq_div_iff h1]
  have hce : Real.cosh (x / 2) + Real.sinh (x / 2) = Real.exp (x / 2) := Real.cosh_add_sinh _
  have h2 : (Real.cosh (x / 2) + Real.sinh (x / 2)) * (Real.cosh (x / 2) - Real.sinh (x / 2))
      = 1 := by linear_combination Real.cosh_sq' (x / 2)
  have hx : Real.exp x = Real.exp (x / 2) * Real.exp (x / 2) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
  field_simp
  rw [hx, ← hce]
  linear_combination (Real.cosh (x / 2) + Real.sinh (x / 2)) * h2

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.val_pure
statement: @[simp] theorem val_pure (a : α) : (pure a : Counted α).val = a
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.mul_pure
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_pure (a : α) : (pure a : Counted α).mul = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.sq_pure
statement: @[simp] theorem sq_pure (a : α) : (pure a : Counted α).sq = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.val_bind
statement: @[simp] theorem val_bind (m : Counted α) (f : α → Counted β) : (m >>= f).val = (f m.val).val
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.mul_bind
statement:
@[simp] theorem mul_bind (m : Counted α) (f : α → Counted β) :
    (m >>= f).mul = m.mul + (f m.val).mul
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.sq_bind
statement:
@[simp] theorem sq_bind (m : Counted α) (f : α → Counted β) :
    (m >>= f).sq = m.sq + (f m.val).sq
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.val_nsMul
statement: @[simp] theorem val_nsMul [Mul α] (a b : α) : (nsMul a b).val = a * b
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.mul_nsMul
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_nsMul [Mul α] (a b : α) : (nsMul a b).mul = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.sq_nsMul
statement: @[simp] theorem sq_nsMul [Mul α] (a b : α) : (nsMul a b).sq = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.val_nsSq
statement: @[simp] theorem val_nsSq [Monoid α] (a : α) : (nsSq a).val = a ^ 2
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.mul_nsSq
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_nsSq [Monoid α] (a : α) : (nsSq a).mul = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.Counted.sq_nsSq
statement: @[simp] theorem sq_nsSq [Monoid α] (a : α) : (nsSq a).sq = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.powersC_length
statement: theorem powersC_length (x : α) (k : ℕ) : (powersC x k).val.length = k + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ k ih =>
    match k with
    | 0 => rfl
    | 1 => rfl
    | m + 2 =>
      simp only [powersC, val_bind]
      split_ifs <;> simp [List.length_append, ih (m + 1) (by omega)]

name: Azurite.BZ.powersC_getD
statement: theorem powersC_getD (x : α) (k : ℕ) : ∀ i ≤ k, (powersC x k).val.getD i 0 = x ^ i
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ k ih =>
    match k with
    | 0 => intro i hi; obtain rfl : i = 0 := (by omega); simp [powersC]
    | 1 =>
      intro i hi
      interval_cases i <;> simp [powersC]
    | m + 2 =>
      intro i hi
      have hlen := powersC_length x (m + 1)
      simp only [powersC, val_bind, val_pure, apply_ite Counted.val, val_nsSq, val_nsMul]
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i (m + 2) with h | h
      · split_ifs <;>
          (rw [List.getD_append _ _ _ _ (by omega)]; exact ih (m + 1) (by omega) i (by omega))
      · obtain rfl : i = m + 2 := (by omega)
        split_ifs with he
        · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)]
          simp only [hlen, Nat.sub_self, List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.getD_some]
          rw [ih (m + 1) (by omega) _ (by omega), ← pow_mul]
          congr 1; omega
        · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)]
          simp only [hlen, Nat.sub_self, List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.getD_some]
          rw [ih (m + 1) (by omega) _ (by omega), ← pow_succ]

name: Azurite.BZ.powersC_sq
statement: theorem powersC_sq (x : α) (k : ℕ) : (powersC x k).sq = k / 2
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ k ih =>
    match k with
    | 0 => rfl
    | 1 => rfl
    | m + 2 =>
      simp only [powersC, sq_bind, sq_pure, apply_ite Counted.sq, sq_nsSq, sq_nsMul,
        ih (m + 1) (by omega)]
      split_ifs with he <;> omega

name: Azurite.BZ.powersC_mul
statement: theorem powersC_mul (x : α) (k : ℕ) : (powersC x k).mul = (k + 1) / 2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ k ih =>
    match k with
    | 0 => rfl
    | 1 => rfl
    | m + 2 =>
      simp only [powersC, mul_bind, mul_pure, apply_ite Counted.mul, mul_nsSq, mul_nsMul,
        ih (m + 1) (by omega)]
      split_ifs with he <;> omega

name: Azurite.BZ.hornerC_val
statement:
theorem hornerC_val (c : ℕ → α) (y : α) (n : ℕ) :
    (hornerC c y n).val = ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), c i * y ^ i
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => simp [hornerC]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [hornerC, val_bind, val_nsMul, val_pure, ih]
    rw [sum_range_succ' (fun i => c i * y ^ i) (n + 1), pow_zero, mul_one, mul_sum, add_comm (c 0)]
    congr 1
    exact sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.hornerC_mul
statement: theorem hornerC_mul (c : ℕ → α) (y : α) (n : ℕ) : (hornerC c y n).mul = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [hornerC, ih]

name: Azurite.BZ.hornerC_sq
statement: theorem hornerC_sq (c : ℕ → α) (y : α) (n : ℕ) : (hornerC c y n).sq = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [hornerC, ih]

name: Azurite.BZ.binPowC_val
statement: theorem binPowC_val (x : α) (j : ℕ) : (binPowC x j).val = x ^ j
proof:
:= by
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ j ih =>
    match j with
    | 0 => simp [binPowC]
    | 1 => simp [binPowC]
    | j + 2 =>
      rw [binPowC]
      simp only [val_bind, val_nsSq, ih ((j + 2) / 2) (by omega)]
      split_ifs with he
      · simp only [val_nsMul]
        rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_succ]
        congr 1; omega
      · simp only [val_pure]
        rw [← pow_mul]
        congr 1; omega

name: Azurite.BZ.binPowC_sq
statement: theorem binPowC_sq (x : α) (j : ℕ) : (binPowC x j).sq = Nat.log 2 j
proof:
:= by
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ j ih =>
    match j with
    | 0 => simp [binPowC]
    | 1 => simp [binPowC]
    | j + 2 =>
      rw [binPowC]
      have h1 : 0 < Nat.log 2 (j + 2) := Nat.log_pos (by norm_num) (by omega)
      have h2 := Nat.log_div_base 2 (j + 2)
      simp only [sq_bind, sq_nsSq, ih ((j + 2) / 2) (by omega)]
      split_ifs <;> simp only [sq_nsMul, sq_pure] <;> omega

name: Azurite.BZ.binPowC_mul
statement:
theorem binPowC_mul (x : α) {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    (binPowC x j).mul + 1 = (Nat.digits 2 j).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ j ih =>
    match j with
    | 0 => omega
    | 1 => simp [binPowC]
    | j + 2 =>
      rw [binPowC, Nat.digits_def' (by norm_num) (by omega), List.sum_cons]
      have := ih ((j + 2) / 2) (by omega) (by omega)
      simp only [mul_bind, mul_nsSq]
      split_ifs with he <;> simp only [mul_nsMul, mul_pure] <;> omega

name: Azurite.BZ.classicalEvalC_val
statement:
theorem classicalEvalC_val (a : ℕ → α) {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (k : ℕ) (x : α) :
    (classicalEvalC a j k x).val = polyEval a (j * k) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [classicalEvalC, val_bind, hornerC_val, powersC_getD x k k le_rfl]
  rw [polyEval_split, show j - 1 + 1 = j by omega]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun ℓ _ => ?_
  rw [mul_comm, innerPoly]
  congr 1
  refine sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
  rw [powersC_getD x k m (by simpa using (mem_range.mp hm).le)]

name: Azurite.BZ.classicalEvalC_mul
statement:
theorem classicalEvalC_mul (a : ℕ → α) (j k : ℕ) (x : α) :
    (classicalEvalC a j k x).mul = ((k + 1) / 2 - 1) + (j - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [classicalEvalC, hornerC_mul, powersC_mul]

name: Azurite.BZ.classicalEvalC_sq
statement:
theorem classicalEvalC_sq (a : ℕ → α) (j k : ℕ) (x : α) :
    (classicalEvalC a j k x).sq = k / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [classicalEvalC, hornerC_sq, powersC_sq]

name: Azurite.BZ.classicalEvalC_total
statement:
theorem classicalEvalC_total (a : ℕ → α) {j k : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hk : 0 < k) (x : α) :
    (classicalEvalC a j k x).mul + (classicalEvalC a j k x).sq = j + k - 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [classicalEvalC_mul, classicalEvalC_sq]; omega

name: Azurite.BZ.modularEvalC_val
statement:
theorem modularEvalC_val (a : ℕ → α) {j k : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hk : 0 < k) (x : α) :
    (modularEvalC a j k x).val = polyEval a (j * k) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [modularEvalC, val_bind, hornerC_val, binPowC_val]
  rw [polyEval_modular_split, show j - 1 + 1 = j by omega]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun ℓ _ => ?_
  rw [mul_comm, modularPoly]
  congr 1
  refine sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
  rw [powersC_getD _ (k - 1) m (by have := mem_range.mp hm; omega)]

name: Azurite.BZ.modularEvalC_sq
statement:
theorem modularEvalC_sq (a : ℕ → α) (j k : ℕ) (x : α) :
    (modularEvalC a j k x).sq = Nat.log 2 j + (k - 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [modularEvalC, hornerC_sq, powersC_sq, binPowC_sq]

name: Azurite.BZ.modularEvalC_mul
statement:
theorem modularEvalC_mul (a : ℕ → α) {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (k : ℕ) (x : α) :
    (modularEvalC a j k x).mul + 1 = (Nat.digits 2 j).sum + (k / 2 - 1) + (j - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [modularEvalC, mul_bind, hornerC_mul, powersC_mul]
  have := binPowC_mul x hj
  omega

name: Azurite.BZ.modularEvalC_total
statement:
theorem modularEvalC_total (a : ℕ → α) {j k : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (x : α) :
    (modularEvalC a j k x).mul + (modularEvalC a j k x).sq
      = (Nat.log 2 j + (Nat.digits 2 j).sum - 1) + (k - 2) + (j - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := modularEvalC_mul a hj k x
  have h2 := modularEvalC_sq a j k x
  have h3 := binPowC_mul x hj
  omega

name: Azurite.BZ.log_add_digits_sum_le
statement: theorem log_add_digits_sum_le (j : ℕ) : Nat.log 2 j + (Nat.digits 2 j).sum ≤ j
proof:
:= by
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ j ih =>
    match j with
    | 0 => simp
    | 1 => simp
    | j + 2 =>
      have h1 : 0 < Nat.log 2 (j + 2) := Nat.log_pos (by norm_num) (by omega)
      have h2 := Nat.log_div_base 2 (j + 2)
      rw [Nat.digits_def' (by norm_num) (by omega), List.sum_cons]
      have := ih ((j + 2) / 2) (by omega)
      omega

name: Azurite.BZ.binPowC_total_le
statement:
theorem binPowC_total_le (x : α) {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    (binPowC x j).mul + (binPowC x j).sq ≤ j - 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := binPowC_mul x hj
  have h2 := binPowC_sq x j
  have h3 := log_add_digits_sum_le j
  omega

name: Azurite.BZ.modularEvalC_total_le
statement:
theorem modularEvalC_total_le (a : ℕ → α) {j k : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (x : α) :
    (modularEvalC a j k x).mul + (modularEvalC a j k x).sq ≤ modularNonscalar j k
proof:
:= by
  rw [modularEvalC_total a hj hk, modularNonscalar]
  have := log_add_digits_sum_le j
  omega

name: Azurite.BZ.digits_sum_le_log_add_one
statement:
theorem digits_sum_le_log_add_one {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    (Nat.digits 2 j).sum ≤ Nat.log 2 j + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (Nat.digits 2 j).length = Nat.log 2 j + 1 :=
    Nat.length_digits 2 j (by norm_num) hj.ne'
  calc (Nat.digits 2 j).sum ≤ (Nat.digits 2 j).length • 1 :=
        List.sum_le_length_nsmul _ _ fun d hd =>
          Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Nat.digits_lt_base (by norm_num) hd)
    _ = Nat.log 2 j + 1 := by rw [hlen, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: Azurite.BZ.splitting_example
statement:
theorem splitting_example (a : ℕ → α) (x : α) :
    (classicalEvalC a 3 4 x).mul = 3 ∧ (classicalEvalC a 3 4 x).sq = 2 ∧
      (modularEvalC a 3 4 x).mul = 4 ∧ (modularEvalC a 3 4 x).sq = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : Nat.log 2 3 = 1 := by
    rw [Nat.log_eq_iff (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  have hdig : (Nat.digits 2 3).sum = 2 := by norm_num
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [classicalEvalC_mul]
  · rw [classicalEvalC_sq]
  · have := modularEvalC_mul a (by norm_num : 0 < 3) 4 x; omega
  · rw [modularEvalC_sq, hlog]

name: Azurite.BZ.ratioHorner_eq
statement:
theorem ratioHorner_eq (r pw : ℕ → α) (k : ℕ) :
    ratioHorner r pw k = ∑ m ∈ range k, pw m * ∏ i ∈ range m, r i
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing r pw with
  | zero => simp [ratioHorner]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [ratioHorner, ih, sum_range_succ', prod_range_zero, mul_one, add_comm, mul_sum]
    congr 1
    refine sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
    rw [prod_range_succ']
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_eq_prod_ratio
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_prod_ratio {a r : ℕ → α} (ha : ∀ i, a (i + 1) = r i * a i) (i : ℕ) :
    a i = a 0 * ∏ i' ∈ range i, r i'
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih => rw [ha, ih, prod_range_succ]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_shift_eq_prod_ratio
statement:
theorem coeff_shift_eq_prod_ratio {a r : ℕ → α} (ha : ∀ i, a (i + 1) = r i * a i) (n m : ℕ) :
    a (n + m) = a n * ∏ i ∈ range m, r (n + i)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih => rw [← add_assoc, ha, ih, prod_range_succ]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.innerPoly_eq_ratioHorner
statement:
theorem innerPoly_eq_ratioHorner {a r : ℕ → α} (ha : ∀ i, a (i + 1) = r i * a i) (k ℓ : ℕ)
    (x : α) :
    innerPoly a k ℓ x = a (k * ℓ) * ratioHorner (fun i => r (k * ℓ + i)) (fun m => x ^ m) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [ratioHorner_eq, innerPoly, mul_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
  rw [coeff_shift_eq_prod_ratio ha]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.scaledHornerC_val
statement:
theorem scaledHornerC_val (c R : ℕ → α) (y : α) (n : ℕ) :
    (scaledHornerC c R y n).val = ∑ ℓ ∈ range (n + 1), c ℓ * y ^ ℓ * ∏ i ∈ range ℓ, R i
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing c R with
  | zero => simp [scaledHornerC]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [scaledHornerC, val_bind, val_nsMul, val_pure, ih]
    rw [sum_range_succ' (fun ℓ => c ℓ * y ^ ℓ * ∏ i ∈ range ℓ, R i) (n + 1), pow_zero, mul_one,
      prod_range_zero, mul_one, mul_sum, mul_sum, add_comm (c 0)]
    congr 1
    refine sum_congr rfl fun ℓ _ => ?_
    rw [prod_range_succ']
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.scaledHornerC_mul
statement: theorem scaledHornerC_mul (c R : ℕ → α) (y : α) (n : ℕ) : (scaledHornerC c R y n).mul = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing c R with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [scaledHornerC, ih]

name: Azurite.BZ.scaledHornerC_sq
statement: theorem scaledHornerC_sq (c R : ℕ → α) (y : α) (n : ℕ) : (scaledHornerC c R y n).sq = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing c R with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [scaledHornerC, ih]

name: Azurite.BZ.prod_range_mul_eq
statement:
theorem prod_range_mul_eq (f : ℕ → α) (k ℓ : ℕ) :
    ∏ i ∈ range ℓ, ∏ i' ∈ range k, f (k * i + i') = ∏ i' ∈ range (k * ℓ), f i'
proof:
:= by
  induction ℓ with
  | zero => simp
  | succ ℓ ih => rw [prod_range_succ, ih, Nat.mul_succ, prod_range_add]

name: Azurite.BZ.ratioEvalC_val
statement:
theorem ratioEvalC_val {a r : ℕ → α} (ha : ∀ i, a (i + 1) = r i * a i) {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j)
