    ∑ i ∈ range (2 * m), f i = ∑ j ∈ range m, f (2 * j) + ∑ j ∈ range m, f (2 * j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [show 2 * (m + 1) = 2 * m + 1 + 1 by ring, sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ, ih,
      sum_range_succ, sum_range_succ]
    abel

name: Azurite.BZ.algebraMap_rat_rat
statement: theorem algebraMap_rat_rat (q : ℚ) : algebraMap ℚ ℚ q = q
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_even
statement:
theorem coeff_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_even (j : ℕ) :
    coeff (2 * j) scaledBernoulliPowerSeries = scaledBernoulli j
proof:
:= by
  unfold scaledBernoulliPowerSeries bernoulliPowerSeries scaledBernoulli
  rw [map_add, coeff_mk, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X, ite_eq_right (by omega), mul_zero, add_zero,
    algebraMap_rat_rat]

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_odd
statement:
theorem coeff_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_odd (j : ℕ) :
    coeff (2 * j + 1) scaledBernoulliPowerSeries = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold scaledBernoulliPowerSeries bernoulliPowerSeries
  rw [map_add, coeff_mk, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X, algebraMap_rat_rat]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj
  · simp [bernoulli_one]
    norm_num
  · rw [bernoulli_eq_zero_of_odd ⟨j, rfl⟩ (by omega), ite_eq_right (by omega)]
    simp

name: Azurite.BZ.scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one
statement:
theorem scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one :
    scaledBernoulliPowerSeries * (exp ℚ - 1) = X + C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * X * (exp ℚ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold scaledBernoulliPowerSeries
  rw [add_mul, bernoulliPowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one]

name: Azurite.BZ.tanh_half_eq
statement: theorem tanh_half_eq (x : ℝ) : Real.tanh (x / 2) = (Real.exp x - 1) / (Real.exp x + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh, Real.sinh_eq, Real.cosh_eq, Real.exp_neg]
  have hu : 0 < Real.exp (x / 2) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hx : Real.exp x = Real.exp (x / 2) * Real.exp (x / 2) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
  rw [hx]
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.div_exp_sub_one_add_half
statement:
theorem div_exp_sub_one_add_half {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    x / (Real.exp x - 1) + x / 2 = (x / 2) / Real.tanh (x / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Real.exp x - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [sub_ne_zero]
    exact fun h => hx (Real.exp_eq_one_iff x |>.mp h)
  have h2 : Real.exp x + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [tanh_half_eq, div_div_eq_mul_div]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.bernoulli_recurrence
statement:
theorem bernoulli_recurrence {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), ((k + 1).choose j : ℚ) * bernoulli j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_bernoulli, ite_eq_right (by omega)]

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_exp_sub_one
statement:
theorem coeff_exp_sub_one (m : ℕ) :
    coeff m (exp ℚ - 1) = if m = 0 then 0 else 1 / (m.factorial : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sub, coeff_exp, coeff_one, algebraMap_rat_rat]
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul (ψ : PowerSeries ℚ) (k : ℕ) :
    coeff (2 * k + 1) (scaledBernoulliPowerSeries * ψ)
      = ∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), scaledBernoulli j * coeff (2 * k + 1 - 2 * j) ψ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff_mul, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  rw [show 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) by ring, sum_range_two_mul,
    show ∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), coeff (2 * j + 1) scaledBernoulliPowerSeries
        * coeff (2 * k + 1 - (2 * j + 1)) ψ = 0 from
      sum_eq_zero fun j _ => by rw [coeff_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_odd, zero_mul], add_zero]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [coeff_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_even]

name: Azurite.BZ.scaledBernoulli_rec
statement:
theorem scaledBernoulli_rec {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), scaledBernoulli j / ((2 * k + 1 - 2 * j).factorial : ℚ)
      = 1 / (2 * (2 * k).factorial)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (coeff (2 * k + 1)) scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one
  rw [coeff_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul, map_add, coeff_X, ite_eq_right (by omega), mul_assoc,
    coeff_C_mul, coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_exp_sub_one, ite_eq_right (by omega), zero_add] at h
  have h2 : ∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), scaledBernoulli j / ((2 * k + 1 - 2 * j).factorial : ℚ)
      = ∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), scaledBernoulli j * coeff (2 * k + 1 - 2 * j) (exp ℚ - 1) :=
    sum_congr rfl fun j hj => by
      have := mem_range.mp hj
      rw [coeff_exp_sub_one, ite_eq_right (by omega), div_eq_mul_one_div]
  rw [h2, h]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_rescale_exp
statement:
theorem coeff_rescale_exp (a : ℚ) (m : ℕ) :
    coeff m (rescale a (exp ℚ)) = a ^ m / m.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_rescale, coeff_exp, algebraMap_rat_rat]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_sub_one_mul_rescale_neg_half
statement:
theorem exp_sub_one_mul_rescale_neg_half :
    (exp ℚ - 1) * rescale (-1 / 2 : ℚ) (exp ℚ)
      = rescale (1 / 2 : ℚ) (exp ℚ) - rescale (-1 / 2 : ℚ) (exp ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := exp_mul_exp_eq_exp_add (1 : ℚ) (-1 / 2)
  rw [rescale_one, RingHom.id_apply, show (1 : ℚ) + -1 / 2 = 1 / 2 by norm_num] at h
  rw [sub_mul, one_mul, h]

name: Azurite.BZ.scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul_sinh
statement:
theorem scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul_sinh :
    scaledBernoulliPowerSeries * (rescale (1 / 2 : ℚ) (exp ℚ) - rescale (-1 / 2 : ℚ) (exp ℚ))
      = C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * X * (rescale (1 / 2 : ℚ) (exp ℚ) + rescale (-1 / 2 : ℚ) (exp ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one
  have h2 := exp_sub_one_mul_rescale_neg_half
  have hc : C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * 2 = (1 : PowerSeries ℚ) := by
    rw [show (2 : PowerSeries ℚ) = C 2 from (map_ofNat C 2).symm, ← map_mul]
    norm_num
  set S := scaledBernoulliPowerSeries
  set Ep := rescale (1 / 2 : ℚ) (exp ℚ)
  set Em := rescale (-1 / 2 : ℚ) (exp ℚ)
  linear_combination Em * h1 + (C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * X - S) * h2 - X * Em * hc

name: Azurite.BZ.scaledBernoulli_rec_stable
statement:
theorem scaledBernoulli_rec_stable (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), scaledBernoulli j / (((2 * k + 1 - 2 * j).factorial : ℚ) * 4 ^ (k - j))
      = 1 / (((2 * k).factorial : ℚ) * 4 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (coeff (2 * k + 1)) scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul_sinh
  rw [coeff_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul, mul_assoc, coeff_C_mul, coeff_succ_X_mul, map_add,
    coeff_rescale_exp, coeff_rescale_exp, div_pow, div_pow, one_pow, Even.neg_one_pow ⟨k, by ring⟩,
    pow_mul] at h
  have h2 : ∀ j ∈ range (k + 1),
      scaledBernoulli j * coeff (2 * k + 1 - 2 * j)
          (rescale (1 / 2 : ℚ) (exp ℚ) - rescale (-1 / 2 : ℚ) (exp ℚ))
        = scaledBernoulli j / (((2 * k + 1 - 2 * j).factorial : ℚ) * 4 ^ (k - j)) := by
    intro j hj
    have hj' := mem_range.mp hj
    rw [map_sub, coeff_rescale_exp, coeff_rescale_exp,
      show 2 * k + 1 - 2 * j = 2 * (k - j) + 1 by omega, div_pow, div_pow, one_pow,
      Odd.neg_one_pow ⟨k - j, rfl⟩, pow_succ, pow_mul, show (4 : ℚ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num]
    ring
  rw [sum_congr rfl h2] at h
  rw [h, show (4 : ℚ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.scaledBernoulli_eq_zeta
statement:
theorem scaledBernoulli_eq_zeta {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (scaledBernoulli k : ℝ)
      = (-1) ^ (k + 1) * 2 * zetaReal (2 * k) / (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold scaledBernoulli
  push_cast
  rw [bernoulli_two_mul_eq_zeta hk]
  have hf : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * k).factorial := by positivity
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_scaledBernoulli_le
statement:
theorem abs_scaledBernoulli_le {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    |(scaledBernoulli k : ℝ)| ≤ (Real.pi ^ 2 / 3) / (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaledBernoulli_eq_zeta hk, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow,
    one_mul, abs_two, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * k)),
    abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [one_le_zetaReal_two_mul hk] : (0 : ℝ) ≤ zetaReal (2 * k))]
  have hζ := zetaReal_two_mul_le hk
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * k) := by positivity
  rw [div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hp]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.gaussTail_zero_eq
statement:
theorem gaussTail_zero_eq (x : ℝ) :
    gaussTail 0 x = Real.sqrt π / 2 - ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, exp (-u ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussTail
  simp only [mul_zero, pow_zero, div_one]
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_Ioi_sub_Ioi' (integrableOn_exp_neg_sq_Ioi 0)
    (integrableOn_exp_neg_sq_Ioi x)
  have hg : ∫ u in Ioi (0 : ℝ), exp (-u ^ 2) = Real.sqrt π / 2 := by
    have := integral_gaussian_Ioi 1
    simpa using this
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.erf_eq_integral
statement: theorem erf_eq_integral (x : ℝ) : erf x = 2 / Real.sqrt π * ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, exp (-u ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [erf, erfc, gaussTail_zero_eq]
  have hpi : Real.sqrt π ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr pi_pos).ne'
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.erf_zero
statement: theorem erf_zero : erf 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [erf_eq_integral]

name: Azurite.BZ.erf_neg
statement: theorem erf_neg (x : ℝ) : erf (-x) = -erf x
proof:
:= by
  rw [erf_eq_integral, erf_eq_integral]
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := x) (fun u : ℝ => exp (-u ^ 2))
  simp only [neg_sq, neg_zero] at h
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm (0 : ℝ) (-x)] at h
  rw [← neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mpr h]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_neg_sq_pow_div_factorial
statement:
theorem integral_neg_sq_pow_div_factorial (x : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, (-u ^ 2) ^ j / j.factorial
      = (-1) ^ j * x ^ (2 * j + 1) / (j.factorial * (2 * j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have : (fun u : ℝ => (-u ^ 2) ^ j / j.factorial)
      = fun u => ((-1 : ℝ) ^ j / j.factorial) * u ^ (2 * j) := by
    funext u
    rw [neg_pow (u ^ 2), pow_mul]
    ring
  rw [this, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.sq_le_sq_of_mem_uIoc
statement: theorem sq_le_sq_of_mem_uIoc {x t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ι (0 : ℝ) x) : t ^ 2 ≤ x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases Set.mem_uIoc.mp ht with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ h1.le h2 2
  · have h := sq_le_sq' (a := t) (b := -x) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    rwa [neg_sq] at h

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_erf_series
statement:
theorem hasSum_erf_series (x : ℝ) :
    HasSum
      (fun j : ℕ => 2 / Real.sqrt π * ((-1) ^ j * x ^ (2 * j + 1) / (j.factorial * (2 * j + 1))))
      (erf x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [erf_eq_integral]
  refine HasSum.mul_left _ ?_
  have key := intervalIntegral.hasSum_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    (F := fun j : ℕ => fun t : ℝ => (-t ^ 2) ^ j / j.factorial) (f := fun t => exp (-t ^ 2))
    (a := 0) (b := x) (μ := volume) (fun j _ => (x ^ 2) ^ j / j.factorial)
    (fun j =>
      (by fun_prop : Continuous fun t : ℝ => (-t ^ 2) ^ j / j.factorial).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (fun j => Eventually.of_forall fun t ht => ?_)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun t _ => Real.summable_pow_div_factorial (x ^ 2))
    intervalIntegrable_const
    (Eventually.of_forall fun t _ => hasSum_exp_series (-t ^ 2))
  · have hfun : (fun j : ℕ => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..x, (-t ^ 2) ^ j / j.factorial)
        = fun j : ℕ => (-1) ^ j * x ^ (2 * j + 1) / (j.factorial * (2 * j + 1)) :=
      funext (integral_neg_sq_pow_div_factorial x)
    rwa [hfun] at key
  · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < j.factorial), abs_pow,
      abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg t)]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (sq_nonneg t) (sq_le_sq_of_mem_uIoc ht) j)
      (by positivity)

name: Azurite.BZ.erfExpCoeff_pos
statement: theorem erfExpCoeff_pos (j : ℕ) : 0 < erfExpCoeff j
proof:
:= by
  unfold erfExpCoeff
  have := Nat.doubleFactorial_pos (2 * j + 1)
  positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.erfExpCoeff_zero
statement: theorem erfExpCoeff_zero : erfExpCoeff 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold erfExpCoeff
  norm_num [Nat.doubleFactorial]

name: Azurite.BZ.erfExpCoeff_succ
statement: theorem erfExpCoeff_succ (j : ℕ) : erfExpCoeff (j + 1) * (2 * j + 3) = 2 * erfExpCoeff j
proof:
:= by
  unfold erfExpCoeff
  rw [show 2 * (j + 1) + 1 = 2 * j + 1 + 2 by ring, Nat.doubleFactorial_add_two]
  have := Nat.doubleFactorial_pos (2 * j + 1)
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_erfExpTerm
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_erfExpTerm (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (erfExpTerm j) (erfExpTerm' j x) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_pow (2 * j + 1) x).const_mul (erfExpCoeff j)
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  unfold erfExpTerm'
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.erfExpBound_succ
statement:
theorem erfExpBound_succ (R : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    erfExpBound R (j + 1) = erfExpBound R j * (2 * R ^ 2 / (2 * j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold erfExpBound
  have h := erfExpCoeff_succ j
  have hj : (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have e : erfExpCoeff j * (2 * j + 1) * R ^ (2 * j) * (2 * R ^ 2 / (2 * j + 1))
      = 2 * erfExpCoeff j * R ^ (2 * j) * R ^ 2 := by
    field_simp
  rw [e, show 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * j + 2 by ring, pow_add]
  push_cast
  linear_combination (R ^ (2 * j) * R ^ 2) * h

name: Azurite.BZ.erfExpBound_nonneg
statement: theorem erfExpBound_nonneg (R : ℝ) (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ erfExpBound R j
proof:
:= by
  unfold erfExpBound
  have := erfExpCoeff_pos j
  exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Even.pow_nonneg (even_two_mul j) R)

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_erfExpBound
statement: theorem summable_erfExpBound (R : ℝ) : Summable (erfExpBound R)
proof:
:= by
  refine summable_of_ratio_norm_eventually_le (r := 1 / 2) (by norm_num) ?_
  rw [Filter.eventually_atTop]
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge (2 * R ^ 2)
  refine ⟨N, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (erfExpBound_nonneg R _),
    abs_of_nonneg (erfExpBound_nonneg R _), erfExpBound_succ, mul_comm (1 / 2 : ℝ)]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (erfExpBound_nonneg R j)
  have hjN : (N : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hj
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_erfExpTerm'_le
statement:
theorem abs_erfExpTerm'_le {R x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ R) (j : ℕ) :
    ‖erfExpTerm' j x‖ ≤ erfExpBound R j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, erfExpTerm', erfExpBound, abs_mul, abs_pow,
    abs_of_pos (by have := erfExpCoeff_pos j; positivity : (0 : ℝ) < erfExpCoeff j * (2 * j + 1))]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by have := erfExpCoeff_pos j; positivity)
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg x) hx _

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_erfExpTerm
statement: theorem summable_erfExpTerm (x : ℝ) : Summable fun j => erfExpTerm j x
proof:
:= by
  refine Summable.of_norm_bounded ((summable_erfExpBound (|x| + 1)).mul_left (|x| + 1)) fun j => ?_
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, erfExpTerm, erfExpBound, abs_mul, abs_pow,
    abs_of_pos (erfExpCoeff_pos j), pow_succ, pow_mul, pow_mul]
  have hc := erfExpCoeff_pos j
  have h1 : |x| ^ 2 ≤ (|x| + 1) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg x) (by linarith) 2
  have h2 : (|x| ^ 2) ^ j ≤ ((|x| + 1) ^ 2) ^ j := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h1 j
  have h3 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * j + 1 := by linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg j : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j)]
  calc erfExpCoeff j * ((|x| ^ 2) ^ j * |x|)
      ≤ erfExpCoeff j * (((|x| + 1) ^ 2) ^ j * (|x| + 1)) := by gcongr; linarith
    _ ≤ (|x| + 1) * (erfExpCoeff j * (2 * j + 1) * ((|x| + 1) ^ 2) ^ j) := by
        have : 0 ≤ erfExpCoeff j * ((|x| + 1) ^ 2) ^ j * (|x| + 1) := by positivity
        nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.erfExpSum_zero
statement: theorem erfExpSum_zero : erfExpSum 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [erfExpSum, erfExpTerm]

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_erfExpSum
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_erfExpSum (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt erfExpSum (∑' j, erfExpTerm' j x) x
proof:
:= by
  set R := |x| + 1 with hR
  have hball : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) R := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, hR]; linarith
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) R := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_self, hR]; positivity
  exact hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected (summable_erfExpBound R) Metric.isOpen_ball
    (convex_ball (0 : ℝ) R).isPreconnected (fun j y _ => hasDerivAt_erfExpTerm j y)
    (fun j y hy => abs_erfExpTerm'_le (by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hy; exact hy.le) j) h0
    (summable_erfExpTerm 0) hball

name: Azurite.BZ.tsum_erfExpTerm'
statement: theorem tsum_erfExpTerm' (x : ℝ) : ∑' j, erfExpTerm' j x = 1 + 2 * x * erfExpSum x
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Summable fun j => erfExpTerm' j x :=
    Summable.of_norm_bounded (summable_erfExpBound (|x| + 1))
      fun j => abs_erfExpTerm'_le (by linarith) j
  rw [← Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add' (f := fun j => erfExpTerm' j x) (k := 1)
    ((summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr hs), sum_range_one]
  have h0 : erfExpTerm' 0 x = 1 := by simp [erfExpTerm', erfExpCoeff_zero]
  rw [h0, erfExpSum, ← tsum_mul_left]
  congr 1
  refine tsum_congr fun j => ?_
  unfold erfExpTerm' erfExpTerm
  have h := erfExpCoeff_succ j
  push_cast
  rw [show 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * j + 1 + 1 by ring, pow_succ]
  linear_combination x ^ (2 * j + 1) * x * h

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_exp_neg_sq_eq
statement:
theorem integral_exp_neg_sq_eq (x : ℝ) :
    ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..x, exp (-u ^ 2) = exp (-x ^ 2) * erfExpSum x
proof:
:= by
  set G : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => exp (-y ^ 2) * erfExpSum y - ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..y, exp (-u ^ 2) with hG
  have hderiv : ∀ y, HasDerivAt G 0 y := by
    intro y
    have hin : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => -y ^ 2) (-(2 * y)) y := by
      refine (hasDerivAt_pow 2 y).neg.congr_deriv ?_
      push_cast
      ring
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => exp (-y ^ 2)) (exp (-y ^ 2) * (-(2 * y))) y := hin.exp
    have h2 := h1.mul (hasDerivAt_erfExpSum y)
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..u, exp (-t ^ 2)) (exp (-y ^ 2)) y :=
      ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun t : ℝ => exp (-t ^ 2)).integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 y)
        |>.hasDerivAt
    refine (h2.sub h3).congr_deriv ?_
    rw [tsum_erfExpTerm']
    ring
  have hconst := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun y => (hderiv y).differentiableAt)
    (fun y => (hderiv y).deriv) x 0
  have hG0 : G 0 = 0 := by simp [hG, erfExpSum_zero]
  have hGx : G x = 0 := by rw [hconst, hG0]
  simp only [hG] at hGx
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.erf_eq_exp_mul_erfExpSum
statement:
theorem erf_eq_exp_mul_erfExpSum (x : ℝ) :
    erf x = 2 / Real.sqrt π * exp (-x ^ 2) * erfExpSum x
proof:
:= by
  rw [erf_eq_integral, integral_exp_neg_sq_eq, mul_assoc]

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_erf_exp_series
statement:
theorem hasSum_erf_exp_series (x : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun j : ℕ => 2 / Real.sqrt π * exp (-x ^ 2) * (erfExpCoeff j * x ^ (2 * j + 1)))
      (erf x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [erf_eq_exp_mul_erfExpSum]
  exact (summable_erfExpTerm x).hasSum.mul_left _

name: Azurite.BZ.log_Gamma_eq_stirlingApprox_add
statement:
theorem log_Gamma_eq_stirlingApprox_add (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    Real.log (Real.Gamma x) = stirlingApprox m x + stirlingRem m x
proof:
:= by
  unfold stirlingRem; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.zetaReal_two_mul_eq
statement:
theorem zetaReal_two_mul_eq {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    zetaReal (2 * k) = (-1) ^ (k + 1) * 2 ^ (2 * k - 1) * π ^ (2 * k) * bernoulli (2 * k)
      / (2 * k).factorial
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasSum_zeta_nat (k := k) (by omega)
  rw [zetaReal, ← h.tsum_eq]
  congr 1
  funext n
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) = ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring, Real.rpow_natCast, one_div]

name: Azurite.BZ.one_le_zetaReal_two_mul
statement: theorem one_le_zetaReal_two_mul {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : 1 ≤ zetaReal (2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold zetaReal
  have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hs : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) ^ (2 * (k : ℝ)))⁻¹) :=
    Real.summable_nat_rpow_inv.mpr (by linarith)
  have h := hs.le_tsum 1 fun n _ => by positivity
  simpa using h

name: Azurite.BZ.zetaReal_two_mul_le
statement: theorem zetaReal_two_mul_le {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : zetaReal (2 * k) ≤ π ^ 2 / 6
proof:
:= by
  unfold zetaReal
  rw [← hasSum_zeta_two.tsum_eq]
  have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hs : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) ^ (2 * (k : ℝ)))⁻¹) :=
    Real.summable_nat_rpow_inv.mpr (by linarith)
  refine hs.tsum_le_tsum (fun n => ?_) hasSum_zeta_two.summable
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) = ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring, Real.rpow_natCast, one_div]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · rw [Nat.cast_zero, zero_pow (by omega), zero_pow two_ne_zero]
  · have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (pow_le_pow_right₀ hn1 (by omega))

name: Azurite.BZ.bernoulli_two_mul_eq_zeta
statement:
theorem bernoulli_two_mul_eq_zeta {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (bernoulli (2 * k) : ℝ)
      = (-1) ^ (k + 1) * 2 * (2 * k).factorial * zetaReal (2 * k) / (2 * π) ^ (2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  have h := zetaReal_two_mul_eq hk
  have hf : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * k).factorial := by positivity
  have hπ : (0 : ℝ) < π ^ (2 * k) := by positivity
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * k) = 2 * 2 ^ (2 * k - 1) := by
    rw [← pow_succ']; congr 1; omega
  have hζF : zetaReal (2 * k) * (2 * k).factorial
      = (-1) ^ (k + 1) * 2 ^ (2 * k - 1) * π ^ (2 * k) * bernoulli (2 * k) := by
    rw [h]; field_simp
  generalize hε : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) = ε at hζF ⊢
  have hε2 : ε ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← hε, ← pow_mul, pow_mul']; simp
  rw [eq_div_iff (by positivity), mul_pow, h2]
  calc (bernoulli (2 * k) : ℝ) * (2 * 2 ^ (2 * k - 1) * π ^ (2 * k))
      = ε ^ 2 * (2 * 2 ^ (2 * k - 1) * π ^ (2 * k) * bernoulli (2 * k)) := by rw [hε2]; ring
    _ = ε * 2 * (zetaReal (2 * k) * (2 * k).factorial) := by rw [hζF]; ring
    _ = ε * 2 * (2 * k).factorial * zetaReal (2 * k) := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.sign_bernoulli_two_mul
statement:
theorem sign_bernoulli_two_mul {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    0 < (-1) ^ (k + 1) * (bernoulli (2 * k) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bernoulli_two_mul_eq_zeta hk]
  have hz := one_le_zetaReal_two_mul hk
  generalize hε : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) = ε
  have hε2 : ε ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← hε, ← pow_mul, pow_mul']; simp
  have : ε * (ε * 2 * (2 * k).factorial * zetaReal (2 * k) / (2 * π) ^ (2 * k))
      = 2 * (2 * k).factorial * zetaReal (2 * k) / (2 * π) ^ (2 * k) := by
    rw [show ε * (ε * 2 * (2 * k).factorial * zetaReal (2 * k) / (2 * π) ^ (2 * k))
      = ε ^ 2 * (2 * (2 * k).factorial * zetaReal (2 * k) / (2 * π) ^ (2 * k)) by ring, hε2,
      one_mul]
  rw [this]
  positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_stirlingTerm_eq
statement:
theorem abs_stirlingTerm_eq {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    |stirlingTerm k x|
      = 2 * (2 * k - 2).factorial * zetaReal (2 * k) / ((2 * π) ^ (2 * k) * x ^ (2 * k - 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold stirlingTerm
  rw [abs_div, bernoulli_two_mul_eq_zeta hk, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg,
    abs_one, one_pow, one_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2),
    abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * k).factorial),
    abs_of_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (one_le_zetaReal_two_mul hk)),
    abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * π) ^ (2 * k))]
  have hk2 : (2 : ℝ) * k * (2 * k - 1) * x ^ (2 * k - 1) > 0 := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * k - 1 := by linarith
    positivity
  rw [abs_of_pos hk2]
  
  have hfac : ((2 * k).factorial : ℝ) = 2 * k * (2 * k - 1) * (2 * k - 2).factorial := by
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = j + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [show 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * j + 1 + 1 by ring, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.factorial_succ,
      show 2 * j + 1 + 1 - 2 = 2 * j by omega]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hfac]
  have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * k - 1 := by linarith
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.stirlingTerm_ratio_bounds
statement:
theorem stirlingTerm_ratio_bounds {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    (2 * k) * (2 * k - 1) / (2 * (2 * π * x) ^ 2) * |stirlingTerm k x| ≤ |stirlingTerm (k + 1) x| ∧
      |stirlingTerm (k + 1) x|
        ≤ 2 * (2 * k) * (2 * k - 1) / (2 * π * x) ^ 2 * |stirlingTerm k x|
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have h2k : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * k - 1 := by linarith
  have hfac : ((2 * (k + 1) - 2).factorial : ℝ)
      = 2 * k * (2 * k - 1) * (2 * k - 2).factorial := by
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = j + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [show 2 * (j + 1 + 1) - 2 = 2 * j + 1 + 1 by omega, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.factorial_succ,
      show 2 * (j + 1) - 2 = 2 * j by omega]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hpow : (2 * π) ^ (2 * (k + 1)) = (2 * π) ^ (2 * k) * (2 * π) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← pow_add]; congr 1
  have hxpow : x ^ (2 * (k + 1) - 1) = x ^ (2 * k - 1) * x ^ 2 := by
    rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  have hz1 := one_le_zetaReal_two_mul hk
  have hz1' := one_le_zetaReal_two_mul (k := k + 1) (by omega)
  have hz2 := zetaReal_two_mul_le hk
  have hz2' := zetaReal_two_mul_le (k := k + 1) (by omega)
  have hπ6 : π ^ 2 / 6 ≤ 2 := by nlinarith [Real.pi_lt_d2, Real.pi_pos]
  push_cast at hz1' hz2'
  rw [abs_stirlingTerm_eq hk hx, abs_stirlingTerm_eq (by omega) hx, hfac, hpow, hxpow]
  push_cast
  have hf : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * k - 2).factorial := by positivity
  have hQ : 0 ≤ 4 * (k : ℝ) * (2 * k - 1) * (2 * k - 2).factorial * (2 * π) ^ (2 * k)
      * x ^ (2 * k - 1) * (2 * π) ^ 2 * x ^ 2 := by positivity
  constructor
  · have hζ : zetaReal (2 * k) ≤ 2 * zetaReal (2 * (k + 1)) := by linarith
    rw [div_mul_div_comm, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hζ hQ]
  · have hζ : zetaReal (2 * (k + 1)) ≤ 2 * zetaReal (2 * k) := by linarith
    rw [div_mul_div_comm, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hζ hQ]

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_stirlingTerm_lt_succ
statement:
theorem abs_stirlingTerm_lt_succ {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (h : 2 * (2 * π * x) ^ 2 < (2 * k) * (2 * k - 1)) :
    |stirlingTerm k x| < |stirlingTerm (k + 1) x|
proof:
:= by
  have hb := (stirlingTerm_ratio_bounds hk hx).1
  have hpos : 0 < |stirlingTerm k x| := by
    rw [abs_stirlingTerm_eq hk hx]
    have := one_le_zetaReal_two_mul hk
    positivity
  have hr : 1 < (2 * k) * (2 * k - 1) / (2 * (2 * π * x) ^ 2) := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]; linarith
  nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.mul_log_ge_neg_inv_exp
statement: theorem mul_log_ge_neg_inv_exp {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) : -(exp 1)⁻¹ ≤ y * Real.log y
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (exp 1 * y)⁻¹)
  rw [Real.log_inv, Real.log_mul (exp_pos 1).ne' hy.ne', Real.log_exp] at h
  have he : 0 < exp 1 := exp_pos 1
  have : -(1 + Real.log y) ≤ (exp 1 * y)⁻¹ - 1 := h
  have h2 : -(1 + Real.log y) * (exp 1 * y) ≤ ((exp 1 * y)⁻¹ - 1) * (exp 1 * y) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this (by positivity)
  rw [sub_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity)] at h2
  rw [show -(exp 1)⁻¹ = (-1) / exp 1 by ring, div_le_iff₀ he]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.div_pow_self_ge
statement: theorem div_pow_self_ge {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (u : ℕ) : exp (-(c / exp 1)) ≤ ((u : ℝ) / c) ^ u
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos u with rfl | hu
  · simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_div, pow_zero]
    exact exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by have := div_pos hc (exp_pos 1); linarith)
  · have hu0 : (0 : ℝ) < u := by exact_mod_cast hu
    have hy : 0 < (u : ℝ) / c := by positivity
    rw [← Real.exp_log (pow_pos hy u), Real.log_pow]
    apply exp_le_exp.mpr
    have h := mul_log_ge_neg_inv_exp hy
    have : (u : ℝ) * Real.log (u / c) = c * ((u / c) * Real.log (u / c)) := by field_simp
    rw [this]
    have hc' : -(c / exp 1) = c * (-(exp 1)⁻¹) := by ring
    rw [hc']
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hc.le

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_stirlingTerm_ge
statement:
theorem abs_stirlingTerm_ge {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    exp (-(2 * π * x)) / (2 * π ^ 2 * x) ≤ |stirlingTerm k x|
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_stirlingTerm_eq hk hx]
  have hz := one_le_zetaReal_two_mul hk
  set u := 2 * k - 2 with hu
  have hku : 2 * k = u + 2 := by omega
  
  have hfac : ((u : ℝ) / exp 1) ^ u ≤ u.factorial := by
    have h := Stirling.le_factorial_stirling u
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos u with hu0 | hu0
    · rw [hu0]; simp
    · have : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * π * u) := by
        rw [Real.le_sqrt (by norm_num) (by positivity)]
        have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ u := by exact_mod_cast hu0
        nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
      nlinarith [pow_pos (div_pos (by exact_mod_cast hu0 : (0:ℝ) < u) (exp_pos 1)) u]
  have hmin := div_pow_self_ge (c := 2 * π * exp 1 * x) (by positivity) u
  have hexp : exp (-(2 * π * x)) = exp (-(2 * π * exp 1 * x / exp 1)) := by
    congr 1; field_simp
  have hpowc : ((u : ℝ) / (2 * π * exp 1 * x)) ^ u
      = ((u : ℝ) / exp 1) ^ u / ((2 * π) ^ u * x ^ u) := by
    rw [div_pow, div_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow]
    field_simp
  rw [hku, show u + 2 - 1 = u + 1 by omega]
  have hA : 0 < (2 * π) ^ (u + 2) * x ^ (u + 1) := by positivity
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hA]
  calc exp (-(2 * π * x)) * ((2 * π) ^ (u + 2) * x ^ (u + 1))
      ≤ ((u : ℝ) / exp 1) ^ u / ((2 * π) ^ u * x ^ u) * ((2 * π) ^ (u + 2) * x ^ (u + 1)) := by
        rw [hexp, ← hpowc]; gcongr
    _ = ((u : ℝ) / exp 1) ^ u * (2 * (2 * π ^ 2 * x)) := by
        rw [pow_add, pow_succ]
        field_simp
        ring
    _ ≤ (u.factorial : ℝ) * (2 * (2 * π ^ 2 * x)) := by gcongr
    _ ≤ 2 * u.factorial * zetaReal (2 * k) * (2 * π ^ 2 * x) := by
        have : 0 ≤ 2 * (u.factorial : ℝ) * (2 * π ^ 2 * x) := by positivity
        nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.log_Gamma_eq_log_Gamma_add_sub
statement:
theorem log_Gamma_eq_log_Gamma_add_sub {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (δ : ℕ) :
    Real.log (Real.Gamma x) = Real.log (Real.Gamma (x + δ)) - ∑ i ∈ range δ, Real.log (x + i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Gamma_add_nat hx δ, Real.log_mul (Gamma_pos_of_pos hx).ne', Real.log_prod]
  · ring
  · intro i _
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ i := Nat.cast_nonneg i
    exact (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < x + i).ne'
  · exact (Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => by
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ i := Nat.cast_nonneg i
      linarith).ne'

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseSeq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem inverseSeq_zero (g g' : ℝ → ℝ) (y x₀ : ℝ) : inverseSeq g g' y x₀ 0 = x₀
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseSeq_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverseSeq_succ (g g' : ℝ → ℝ) (y x₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    inverseSeq g g' y x₀ (n + 1) = inverseStep g g' y (inverseSeq g g' y x₀ n)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseStep_eq_newtonStep
statement:
theorem inverseStep_eq_newtonStep (g g' : ℝ → ℝ) (y x : ℝ) :
    inverseStep g g' y x = newtonStep (fun x => y - g x) (fun x => -g' x) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold inverseStep newtonStep
  rw [div_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseSeq_eq_newtonSeq
statement:
theorem inverseSeq_eq_newtonSeq (g g' : ℝ → ℝ) (y x₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    inverseSeq g g' y x₀ n = newtonSeq (fun x => y - g x) (fun x => -g' x) x₀ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [inverseSeq_succ, newtonSeq_succ, ih, inverseStep_eq_newtonStep]

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseStep_root
statement: theorem inverseStep_root {g g' : ℝ → ℝ} {y ζ : ℝ} (hζ : g ζ = y) : inverseStep g g' y ζ = ζ
proof:
:= by
  simp [inverseStep, hζ]

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_inverseSeq
statement:
theorem tendsto_inverseSeq {g g' g'' : ℝ → ℝ} {y ζ r M m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hζ : g ζ = y)
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt g (g' t) t)
    (hg' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt g' (g'' t) t)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), |g'' t| ≤ M)
    (hm' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), m ≤ |g' t|) {x₀ : ℝ} (hx₀ : |x₀ - ζ| ≤ r)
    (hK : M / (2 * m) * |x₀ - ζ| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (∀ n, |inverseSeq g g' y x₀ n - ζ| ≤ r ∧
      |inverseSeq g g' y x₀ (n + 1) - ζ| ≤ |inverseSeq g g' y x₀ n - ζ| / 2) ∧
    Tendsto (inverseSeq g g' y x₀) atTop (𝓝 ζ)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt (fun x => y - g x) (-g' t) t :=
    fun t ht => (hasDerivAt_const t y).sub (hg t ht) |>.congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hf' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt (fun x => -g' x) (-g'' t) t :=
    fun t ht => (hg' t ht).neg
  have hroot : (fun x => y - g x) ζ = 0 := by simp [hζ]
  have hM' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), |-g'' t| ≤ M := fun t ht => by
    rw [abs_neg]; exact hM t ht
  have hm'' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), m ≤ |-g' t| := fun t ht => by
    rw [abs_neg]; exact hm' t ht
  have hb := fun n => newtonSeq_bounds (f := fun x => y - g x) (f' := fun x => -g' x)
    (f'' := fun x => -g'' x) hm hroot hf hf' hM' hm'' hx₀ hK n
  refine ⟨fun n => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [inverseSeq_eq_newtonSeq, inverseSeq_eq_newtonSeq]
    exact ⟨(hb n).1, (hb n).2.1⟩
  · exact (tendsto_newtonSeq (f := fun x => y - g x) (f' := fun x => -g' x)
      (f'' := fun x => -g'' x) hm hroot hf hf' hM' hm'' hx₀ hK).congr
      (fun n => (inverseSeq_eq_newtonSeq g g' y x₀ n).symm)

name: Azurite.BZ.expSeq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem expSeq_zero (y x₀ : ℝ) : expSeq y x₀ 0 = x₀
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.expSeq_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem expSeq_succ (y x₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : expSeq y x₀ (n + 1) = expStep y (expSeq y x₀ n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseStep_log
statement: theorem inverseStep_log (y x : ℝ) : inverseStep log (fun x => x⁻¹) y x = expStep y x
proof:
:= by
  unfold inverseStep expStep
  rw [div_inv_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_log_one_add_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_log_one_add_sub_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : |ε| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    |log (1 + ε) - (ε - ε ^ 2 / 2)| ≤ 2 * |ε| ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.abs_log_sub_add_sum_range_le (x := -ε) (by rw [abs_neg]; linarith) 2
  rw [abs_neg, sub_neg_eq_add] at h
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add] at h
  have h' : |log (1 + ε) - (ε - ε ^ 2 / 2)| ≤ |ε| ^ 3 / (1 - |ε|) := by
    convert h using 2
    push_cast
    ring
  refine h'.trans ?_
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
  have : 0 ≤ |ε| ^ 3 := by positivity
  nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.expStep_rel
statement:
theorem expStep_rel (y : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < 1 + ε) :
    expStep y (exp y * (1 + ε)) = exp y * ((1 + ε) * (1 - log (1 + ε)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold expStep
  rw [log_mul (exp_pos y).ne' hε.ne', log_exp]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_expStep_relError_le
statement:
theorem abs_expStep_relError_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : |ε| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    |(1 + ε) * (1 - log (1 + ε)) - 1| ≤ 9 / 4 * ε ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hL := abs_log_one_add_sub_le hε
  set r := log (1 + ε) - (ε - ε ^ 2 / 2) with hr
  have hid : (1 + ε) * (1 - log (1 + ε)) - 1 = -ε ^ 2 / 2 + ε ^ 3 / 2 - (1 + ε) * r := by
    rw [hr]; ring
  rw [hid]
  have hε2 : |ε| ^ 2 = ε ^ 2 := sq_abs ε
  have hε3 : |ε| ^ 3 ≤ ε ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [pow_succ, hε2]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg ε]
  have h1ε : |1 + ε| ≤ 3 / 2 := by
    calc |1 + ε| ≤ |1| + |ε| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ 3 / 2 := by rw [abs_one]; linarith
  calc |-ε ^ 2 / 2 + ε ^ 3 / 2 - (1 + ε) * r|
      ≤ |-ε ^ 2 / 2 + ε ^ 3 / 2| + |(1 + ε) * r| := abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ |-ε ^ 2 / 2| + |ε ^ 3 / 2| + |1 + ε| * |r| := by
        rw [abs_mul]; gcongr; exact abs_add_le _ _
    _ = ε ^ 2 / 2 + |ε| ^ 3 / 2 + |1 + ε| * |r| := by
        rw [abs_div, abs_div, abs_neg, abs_pow, abs_pow, sq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]
    _ ≤ ε ^ 2 / 2 + (ε ^ 2 / 2) / 2 + 3 / 2 * (2 * (ε ^ 2 / 2)) := by
        gcongr
        exact hL.trans (by gcongr)
    _ = 9 / 4 * ε ^ 2 := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.liftExp_rel
statement:
theorem liftExp_rel (y δ θ : ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < 1 + ε) :
    exp y * (1 + ε) + exp y * (1 + ε) * (y - (log (exp y * (1 + ε)) + δ)) * (1 + θ)
      = exp y * (1 + (ε - (1 + ε) * (1 + θ) * (log (1 + ε) + δ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [log_mul (exp_pos y).ne' hε.ne', log_exp]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_liftExp_relError_le
statement:
theorem abs_liftExp_relError_le {ε δ θ η : ℝ} (hη : η ≤ 1 / 2) (hε : |ε| ≤ η) (hδ : |δ| ≤ η ^ 2)
    (hθ : |θ| ≤ η) :
    |ε - (1 + ε) * (1 + θ) * (log (1 + ε) + δ)| ≤ 9 * η ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hη0 : 0 ≤ η := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hε
  have hε' : |ε| ≤ 1 / 2 := hε.trans hη
  have hL := abs_log_one_add_sub_le hε'
  set r := log (1 + ε) - (ε - ε ^ 2 / 2) with hr
  
  set s := ε + θ + ε * θ with hs
  have hs_le : |s| ≤ 5 / 2 * η := by
    calc |s| ≤ |ε| + |θ| + |ε * θ| := by
          rw [hs]; exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by gcongr; exact abs_add_le _ _)
      _ ≤ η + η + η * η := by rw [abs_mul]; gcongr
      _ ≤ 5 / 2 * η := by nlinarith
  
  have hεL : |ε - log (1 + ε)| ≤ 3 / 2 * η ^ 2 := by
    have : ε - log (1 + ε) = ε ^ 2 / 2 - r := by rw [hr]; ring
    rw [this]
    have hε2 : ε ^ 2 ≤ η ^ 2 := by rw [← sq_abs]; gcongr
    have hε3 : |ε| ^ 3 ≤ η ^ 2 / 2 := by
      calc |ε| ^ 3 = |ε| ^ 2 * |ε| := by ring
        _ ≤ η ^ 2 * (1 / 2) := by gcongr
        _ = η ^ 2 / 2 := by ring
    calc |ε ^ 2 / 2 - r| ≤ |ε ^ 2 / 2| + |r| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ ε ^ 2 / 2 + 2 * |ε| ^ 3 := by
          rw [abs_div, abs_pow, sq_abs, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]; gcongr
      _ ≤ η ^ 2 / 2 + 2 * (η ^ 2 / 2) := by gcongr
      _ = 3 / 2 * η ^ 2 := by ring
  have hLd : |log (1 + ε) + δ| ≤ 9 / 4 * η := by
    have hLb : |log (1 + ε)| ≤ 7 / 4 * η := by
      calc |log (1 + ε)| = |ε - (ε - log (1 + ε))| := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ |ε| + |ε - log (1 + ε)| := abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ η + 3 / 2 * η ^ 2 := by gcongr
        _ ≤ 7 / 4 * η := by nlinarith
    calc |log (1 + ε) + δ| ≤ |log (1 + ε)| + |δ| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ 7 / 4 * η + η ^ 2 := by gcongr
      _ ≤ 9 / 4 * η := by nlinarith
  have hid : ε - (1 + ε) * (1 + θ) * (log (1 + ε) + δ)
      = (ε - log (1 + ε)) - δ - s * (log (1 + ε) + δ) := by rw [hs]; ring
  rw [hid]
  calc |(ε - log (1 + ε)) - δ - s * (log (1 + ε) + δ)|
      ≤ |ε - log (1 + ε)| + |δ| + |s * (log (1 + ε) + δ)| := by
        exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (by gcongr; exact abs_sub _ _)
    _ ≤ 3 / 2 * η ^ 2 + η ^ 2 + 5 / 2 * η * (9 / 4 * η) := by
        rw [abs_mul]; gcongr
    _ ≤ 9 * η ^ 2 := by nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_arctanTerm
statement: theorem hasSum_arctanTerm (hx : |x| < 1) : HasSum (arctanTerm x) (Real.arctan x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.hasSum_arctan (x := x) (by rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs])
  have e : arctanTerm x = fun n : ℕ => (-1) ^ n * x ^ (2 * n + 1) / ((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    funext n
    simp [arctanTerm]
  rw [e]
  exact h

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_arctan_sub_sum_le
statement:
theorem abs_arctan_sub_sum_le (hx : |x| < 1) (N : ℕ) :
    |Real.arctan x - ∑ j ∈ range N, arctanTerm x j|
      ≤ |x| ^ (2 * N + 1) / ((2 * N + 1) * (1 - x ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (hasSum_arctanTerm hx).summable
  have hx2 : x ^ 2 < 1 := by rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_lt_one₀ (abs_nonneg x) hx two_ne_zero
  have hx2' : 0 ≤ x ^ 2 := sq_nonneg x
  rw [← (hasSum_arctanTerm hx).tsum_eq, ← Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add' (f := arctanTerm x)
    (k := N) ((summable_nat_add_iff (f := arctanTerm x) N).mpr hs), add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hterm : ∀ j : ℕ,
      ‖arctanTerm x (j + N)‖ ≤ |x| ^ (2 * N + 1) / (2 * N + 1) * (x ^ 2) ^ j := by
    intro j
    have hjN : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((j + N : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, arctanTerm, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow,
      one_mul, abs_pow, abs_of_pos hjN, show 2 * (j + N) + 1 = (2 * N + 1) + 2 * j by ring,
      pow_add, pow_mul, sq_abs]
    calc |x| ^ (2 * N + 1) * (x ^ 2) ^ j / (2 * ((j + N : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)
        ≤ |x| ^ (2 * N + 1) * (x ^ 2) ^ j / (2 * N + 1) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity) (by push_cast; linarith)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hgeo : Summable fun j : ℕ => |x| ^ (2 * N + 1) / (2 * N + 1) * (x ^ 2) ^ j :=
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hx2' hx2).mul_left _
  have hnorm : Summable fun j : ℕ => ‖arctanTerm x (j + N)‖ :=
    hgeo.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => norm_nonneg _) hterm
  calc |∑' j : ℕ, arctanTerm x (j + N)| ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, ‖arctanTerm x (j + N)‖ := by
        rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm
    _ ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, |x| ^ (2 * N + 1) / (2 * N + 1) * (x ^ 2) ^ j := hnorm.tsum_le_tsum hterm hgeo
    _ = |x| ^ (2 * N + 1) / (2 * N + 1) * (1 - x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hx2' hx2]
    _ = _ := by rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, div_div]

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_arctan_sub_sum_le_two_pow
statement:
theorem abs_arctan_sub_sum_le_two_pow (hx : |x| ≤ 1 / 2) (n : ℕ) :
    |Real.arctan x - ∑ j ∈ range (n / 2 + 1), arctanTerm x j| ≤ (1 / 2) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hx1 : |x| < 1 := by linarith
  refine (abs_arctan_sub_sum_le hx1 _).trans ?_
  have hx2 : x ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4 := by rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg x]
  have hn : n + 2 ≤ 2 * (n / 2 + 1) + 1 := by omega
  have hpow : |x| ^ (2 * (n / 2 + 1) + 1) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 2) :=
    calc |x| ^ (2 * (n / 2 + 1) + 1) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (2 * (n / 2 + 1) + 1) :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg x) hx _
      _ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 2) := pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hn
  have hden : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * ((n / 2 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - x ^ 2) := by
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((n / 2 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by
      linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg (n / 2 + 1) : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n / 2 + 1 : ℕ))]
    nlinarith
  calc _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 2) / (3 / 4) := div_le_div₀ (by positivity) hpow (by norm_num) hden
    _ = (1 / 2) ^ n / 3 := by ring
    _ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ n := by linarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2) n]

name: Azurite.BZ.arctanDen_pos
statement: theorem arctanDen_pos {q N : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) : 0 < arctanDen q N
proof:
:= by
  unfold arctanDen
  exact mul_pos (pow_pos hq _) (prod_pos fun j _ => by omega)

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_arctanTerm_div_eq
statement:
theorem sum_arctanTerm_div_eq {p : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ range N, arctanTerm ((p : ℝ) / q) j = (arctanNum p q N : ℝ) / (arctanDen q N : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hq' : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  unfold arctanNum arctanDen
  push_cast
  rw [sum_div]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  have hjN : j < N := mem_range.mp hj
  rw [← mul_prod_erase (range N) (fun i => 2 * (i : ℝ) + 1) hj,
    show 2 * N + 1 = (2 * j + 1) + (2 * N - 2 * j) by omega, pow_add]
  have hprod : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ i ∈ (range N).erase j, (2 * (i : ℝ) + 1) :=
    prod_pos fun i _ => by positivity
  unfold arctanTerm
  rw [div_pow]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.log_arctanDen_le
statement:
theorem log_arctanDen_le {q N : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    Real.log (arctanDen q N) ≤ (2 * N + 1) * Real.log q + N * Real.log (2 * N)
proof:
:= by
  unfold arctanDen
  have hq' : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ j ∈ range N, (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) := prod_pos fun j _ => by positivity
  push_cast
  rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) hpos.ne', Real.log_pow]
  have hprod : ∏ j ∈ range N, (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ (2 * N) ^ N := by
    calc ∏ j ∈ range N, (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ ∏ _j ∈ range N, (2 * (N : ℝ)) :=
          Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun j _ => by positivity) (fun j hj => by
            have : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast mem_range.mp hj
            linarith)
      _ = (2 * N) ^ N := by rw [prod_const, card_range]
  have := Real.log_le_log hpos hprod
  rw [Real.log_pow] at this
  push_cast
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.log_factorial_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem log_factorial_mul_pow_le {q N : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    Real.log ((N.factorial : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ N) ≤ N * Real.log N + N * Real.log q
proof:
:= by
  have hq' : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hN' : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hfact : (N.factorial : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ N := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le_pow N
  rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow]
  have := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hfact
  rw [Real.log_pow] at this
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.log_factorial_mul_pow_le'
statement:
theorem log_factorial_mul_pow_le' {q N : ℕ} {n : ℝ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (h : (N : ℝ) * Real.log N ≤ n) :
    Real.log ((N.factorial : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ N) ≤ n + N * Real.log q
proof:
:=
  (log_factorial_mul_pow_le hq hN).trans (by linarith)

name: Azurite.BZ.div_add_div_eq
statement:
theorem div_add_div_eq {K : Type*} [Field K] {P₁ P₂ Q₁ Q₂ : K} (h₁ : Q₁ ≠ 0) (h₂ : Q₂ ≠ 0) :
    P₁ / Q₁ + P₂ / Q₂ = (P₁ * Q₂ + P₂ * Q₁) / (Q₁ * Q₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_add_div _ _ h₁ h₂]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_div_eq_sum_mul_prod_erase_div
statement:
theorem sum_div_eq_sum_mul_prod_erase_div {ι K : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Field K] (s : Finset ι)
    (num den : ι → K) (hden : ∀ i ∈ s, den i ≠ 0) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, num i / den i = (∑ i ∈ s, num i * ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, den j) / ∏ j ∈ s, den j
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_div]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  rw [← mul_prod_erase s den hi]
  have h1 : den i ≠ 0 := hden i hi
  have h2 : ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, den j ≠ 0 :=
    prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun j hj => hden j (mem_of_mem_erase hj)
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.two_pow_mul_quasiLinearCost_div_le
statement:
theorem two_pow_mul_quasiLinearCost_div_le {m : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (k : ℕ) :
    2 ^ k * quasiLinearCost (m / 2 ^ k) ≤ quasiLinearCost m
proof:
:= by
  unfold quasiLinearCost
  have h2k : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ k := by positivity
  rw [Real.logb_div (by positivity) h2k.ne', Real.logb_pow, Real.logb_self_eq_one one_lt_two]
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (m / 2 ^ k * (Real.logb 2 m - k * 1)) = m * Real.logb 2 m - m * k by
    field_simp]
  nlinarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k)]

name: Azurite.BZ.logb_two_natCast_le_self
statement: theorem logb_two_natCast_le_self {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : Real.logb 2 n ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.logb_le_iff_le_rpow one_lt_two (by exact_mod_cast hn), Real.rpow_natCast]
  exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le

name: Azurite.BZ.binary_splitting_cost_le
statement:
theorem binary_splitting_cost_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (L : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 L, 2 ^ k * quasiLinearCost (n * Real.logb 2 n / 2 ^ k)
      ≤ L * (2 * Real.logb 2 n * quasiLinearCost n)
proof:
:= by
  have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ n)
  have hlg : 1 ≤ Real.logb 2 n := by
    rw [Real.le_logb_iff_rpow_le one_lt_two (by linarith), Real.rpow_one]
    exact_mod_cast hn
  have hm : 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 n := by nlinarith
  have hterm : ∀ k ∈ Icc 1 L, 2 ^ k * quasiLinearCost (n * Real.logb 2 n / 2 ^ k)
      ≤ 2 * Real.logb 2 n * quasiLinearCost n := by
    intro k _
    refine (two_pow_mul_quasiLinearCost_div_le hm k).trans ?_
    unfold quasiLinearCost
    have hlglg : Real.logb 2 (Real.logb 2 n) ≤ Real.logb 2 n :=
      Real.logb_le_logb_of_le one_lt_two (by linarith) (logb_two_natCast_le_self (by omega))
    rw [Real.logb_mul (by positivity) (by linarith)]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlglg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n * Real.logb 2 n)]
  calc _ ≤ ∑ _k ∈ Icc 1 L, 2 * Real.logb 2 n * quasiLinearCost n := sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = _ := by rw [sum_const, Nat.card_Icc, Nat.add_sub_cancel, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: Azurite.BZ.clog_le_logb_add_one
statement: theorem clog_le_logb_add_one {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : (Nat.clog 2 n : ℝ) ≤ Real.logb 2 n + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := Nat.pow_pred_clog_lt_self (b := 2) one_lt_two (by omega : 1 < n)
  have hpos : 0 < Nat.clog 2 n := Nat.clog_pos one_lt_two (by omega)
  have h' : ((Nat.clog 2 n).pred : ℝ) < Real.logb 2 n := by
    rw [Real.lt_logb_iff_rpow_lt one_lt_two (by positivity), Real.rpow_natCast]
    exact_mod_cast h
  have e : ((Nat.clog 2 n : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((Nat.clog 2 n).pred : ℝ) + 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_succ, Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hpos]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.binary_splitting_cost
statement:
theorem binary_splitting_cost {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 (Nat.clog 2 n), 2 ^ k * quasiLinearCost (n * Real.logb 2 n / 2 ^ k)
      ≤ 4 * Real.logb 2 n ^ 2 * quasiLinearCost n
proof:
:= by
  refine (binary_splitting_cost_le hn _).trans ?_
  have hL := clog_le_logb_add_one hn
  have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ n)
  have hlg : 1 ≤ Real.logb 2 n := by
    rw [Real.le_logb_iff_rpow_le one_lt_two (by linarith), Real.rpow_one]
    exact_mod_cast hn
  have hM : 0 ≤ quasiLinearCost n := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hL' : (Nat.clog 2 n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.logb 2 n := by linarith
  calc (Nat.clog 2 n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.logb 2 n * quasiLinearCost n)
      ≤ 2 * Real.logb 2 n * (2 * Real.logb 2 n * quasiLinearCost n) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL' (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hM)
    _ = 4 * Real.logb 2 n ^ 2 * quasiLinearCost n := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_exp_sub_sum_div_two_pow_le
statement:
theorem abs_exp_sub_sum_div_two_pow_le {x : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hx : |x| / 2 ^ k ≤ 1) :
    |exp (x / 2 ^ k) - ∑ m ∈ range N, (x / 2 ^ k) ^ m / m.factorial|
      ≤ (|x| / 2 ^ k) ^ N * ((N + 1 : ℕ) / (N.factorial * N : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have h : |x / 2 ^ k| = |x| / 2 ^ k := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ k)]
  have := Real.exp_bound (x := x / 2 ^ k) (by rwa [h]) hN
  rwa [h] at this

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_one_add_pow_sub_one_le
statement: theorem abs_one_add_pow_sub_one_le (a : ℝ) (e : ℕ) : |(1 + a) ^ e - 1| ≤ (1 + |a|) ^ e - 1
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero => simp
  | succ e ih =>
    have hid : (1 + a) ^ (e + 1) - 1 = ((1 + a) ^ e - 1) * (1 + a) + a := by ring
    have h1 : |1 + a| ≤ 1 + |a| := (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by rw [abs_one])
    rw [hid]
    calc |((1 + a) ^ e - 1) * (1 + a) + a| ≤ |(1 + a) ^ e - 1| * |1 + a| + |a| := by
          rw [← abs_mul]; exact abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ((1 + |a|) ^ e - 1) * (1 + |a|) + |a| := by
          gcongr
          exact sub_nonneg.mpr (one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg a]))
      _ = (1 + |a|) ^ (e + 1) - 1 := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_prod_one_add_pow_sub_one_le
statement:
theorem abs_prod_one_add_pow_sub_one_le (a : ℕ → ℝ) (e : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    |∏ i ∈ range n, (1 + a i) ^ e i - 1| ≤ ∏ i ∈ range n, (1 + |a i|) ^ e i - 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [prod_range_succ, prod_range_succ]
    set P := ∏ i ∈ range n, (1 + a i) ^ e i
    set Q := (1 + a n) ^ e n
    set P' := ∏ i ∈ range n, (1 + |a i|) ^ e i
    set Q' := (1 + |a n|) ^ e n
    have hQ : |Q| ≤ Q' := by
      rw [abs_pow]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_add_le _ _).trans (by simp)) _
    have hQ1 : |Q - 1| ≤ Q' - 1 := abs_one_add_pow_sub_one_le _ _
    have hP'1 : 1 ≤ P' := one_le_prod₀ fun i _ => one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [abs_nonneg (a i)])
    have hid : P * Q - 1 = (P - 1) * Q + (Q - 1) := by ring
    rw [hid]
    calc |(P - 1) * Q + (Q - 1)| ≤ |P - 1| * |Q| + |Q - 1| := by
          rw [← abs_mul]; exact abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ (P' - 1) * Q' + (Q' - 1) := by gcongr
      _ = P' * Q' - 1 := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.prod_one_add_abs_pow_le_exp
statement:
theorem prod_one_add_abs_pow_le_exp (a : ℕ → ℝ) (e : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∏ i ∈ range n, (1 + |a i|) ^ e i ≤ exp (∑ i ∈ range n, (e i : ℝ) * |a i|)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.exp_sum]
  gcongr with i _
  rw [Real.exp_nat_mul]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith [add_one_le_exp |a i|]) _

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_sub_one_le_two_mul
statement: theorem exp_sub_one_le_two_mul {S : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ S) (h1 : S ≤ 1) : exp S - 1 ≤ 2 * S
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.exp_bound' h0 h1 (n := 1) one_pos
  simp at h
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.squareSeq_eq
statement:
theorem squareSeq_eq (t : ℝ) (θ : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    squareSeq t θ k = t ^ (2 ^ k) * ∏ i ∈ range k, (1 + θ i) ^ (2 ^ (k - 1 - i))
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [squareSeq]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [squareSeq, ih, prod_range_succ]
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, pow_one]
    rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← prod_pow, ← pow_succ, mul_assoc]
    congr 2
    refine prod_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
    rw [mem_range] at hi
    rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_succ]
    congr 2
    omega

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_squareSeq_sub_exp_le
statement:
theorem abs_squareSeq_sub_exp_le (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hS : (2 ^ k : ℝ) * |ε| + ∑ i ∈ range k, (2 ^ (k - 1 - i) : ℝ) * |θ i| ≤ 1) :
    |squareSeq (exp (x / 2 ^ k) * (1 + ε)) θ k - exp x|
      ≤ 2 * ((2 ^ k : ℝ) * |ε| + ∑ i ∈ range k, (2 ^ (k - 1 - i) : ℝ) * |θ i|) * exp x
proof:
:= by
  set S := (2 ^ k : ℝ) * |ε| + ∑ i ∈ range k, (2 ^ (k - 1 - i) : ℝ) * |θ i| with hS_def
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := by positivity
  
  have hform : squareSeq (exp (x / 2 ^ k) * (1 + ε)) θ k
      = exp x * ((1 + ε) ^ (2 ^ k) * ∏ i ∈ range k, (1 + θ i) ^ (2 ^ (k - 1 - i))) := by
    rw [squareSeq_eq, mul_pow, ← exp_eq_pow_two_pow, mul_assoc]
  
  set a : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if i < k then θ i else ε with ha
  set e : ℕ → ℕ := fun i => if i < k then 2 ^ (k - 1 - i) else 2 ^ k with he
  have hprod : (1 + ε) ^ (2 ^ k) * ∏ i ∈ range k, (1 + θ i) ^ (2 ^ (k - 1 - i))
      = ∏ i ∈ range (k + 1), (1 + a i) ^ e i := by
    rw [prod_range_succ]
    have h1 : ∀ i ∈ range k, (1 + a i) ^ e i = (1 + θ i) ^ (2 ^ (k - 1 - i)) := by
      intro i hi; rw [mem_range] at hi; simp [ha, he, hi]
    have h2 : (1 + a k) ^ e k = (1 + ε) ^ (2 ^ k) := by simp [ha, he]
    rw [prod_congr rfl h1, h2, mul_comm]
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ range (k + 1), (e i : ℝ) * |a i| = S := by
    rw [sum_range_succ, hS_def]
    have h1 : ∀ i ∈ range k, (e i : ℝ) * |a i| = (2 ^ (k - 1 - i) : ℝ) * |θ i| := by
      intro i hi; rw [mem_range] at hi; simp [ha, he, hi]
    have h2 : (e k : ℝ) * |a k| = (2 ^ k : ℝ) * |ε| := by simp [ha, he]
    rw [sum_congr rfl h1, h2, add_comm]
  rw [hform, hprod, ← mul_sub_one, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (exp_pos x), mul_comm]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (exp_pos x).le
  calc |∏ i ∈ range (k + 1), (1 + a i) ^ e i - 1|
      ≤ ∏ i ∈ range (k + 1), (1 + |a i|) ^ e i - 1 := abs_prod_one_add_pow_sub_one_le a e (k + 1)
    _ ≤ exp (∑ i ∈ range (k + 1), (e i : ℝ) * |a i|) - 1 := by
        linarith [prod_one_add_abs_pow_le_exp a e (k + 1)]
    _ = exp S - 1 := by rw [hsum]
    _ ≤ 2 * S := exp_sub_one_le_two_mul hS0 hS

name: Azurite.BZ.expTerm_succ
statement: theorem expTerm_succ (x : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : expTerm x (m + 1) = expTerm x m * (x / (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold expTerm
  rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.expTerm_le_succ
statement:
theorem expTerm_le_succ {x : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (h : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≤ |x|) :
    |expTerm x m| ≤ |expTerm x (m + 1)|
proof:
:= by
  rw [expTerm_succ, abs_mul, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < m + 1)]
  have : 1 ≤ |x| / (m + 1) := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]; linarith
  calc |expTerm x m| = |expTerm x m| * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
    _ ≤ |expTerm x m| * (|x| / (m + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (abs_nonneg _)

name: Azurite.BZ.expTerm_succ_le
statement:
theorem expTerm_succ_le {x : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (h : |x| ≤ (m : ℝ) + 1) :
    |expTerm x (m + 1)| ≤ |expTerm x m|
proof:
:= by
  rw [expTerm_succ, abs_mul, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < m + 1)]
  have : |x| / (m + 1) ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]; linarith
  calc |expTerm x m| * (|x| / (m + 1)) ≤ |expTerm x m| * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = |expTerm x m| := mul_one _

name: Azurite.BZ.expTerm_neg_eq
statement: theorem expTerm_neg_eq (x : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : expTerm (-x) m = (-1) ^ m * expTerm x m
proof:
:= by
  unfold expTerm
  rw [neg_pow, mul_div_assoc]

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_sum_perturbed_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_add_distrib, add_sub_cancel_left, mul_sum]
  exact (abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (sum_le_sum hδ)

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_abs_expTerm_le
statement: theorem sum_abs_expTerm_le (x : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : ∑ m ∈ range N, |expTerm x m| ≤ exp |x|
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ m, |expTerm x m| = |x| ^ m / m.factorial := fun m => by
    unfold expTerm
    rw [abs_div, abs_pow, abs_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast m.factorial_pos : (0 : ℝ) < m.factorial)]
  simp only [this]
  exact Real.sum_le_exp_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg x) N

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_sum_perturbed_le_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem abs_sum_perturbed_le_of_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (N : ℕ) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) {η : ℝ}
    (hδ : ∀ m ∈ range N, |δ m| ≤ η * |expTerm x m|) :
    |∑ m ∈ range N, (expTerm x m + δ m) - ∑ m ∈ range N, expTerm x m|
      ≤ η * ∑ m ∈ range N, expTerm x m
proof:
:= by
  refine (abs_sum_perturbed_le _ _ _ hδ).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  congr 1
  exact sum_congr rfl fun m _ => abs_of_nonneg (by unfold expTerm; positivity)

name: Azurite.BZ.relative_loss_of_neg
statement: theorem relative_loss_of_neg {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ 0) : exp |x| = exp (2 * |x|) * exp x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← exp_add, abs_of_nonpos hx]
  congr 1
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_twenty_gt
statement: theorem exp_twenty_gt : (10 : ℝ) ^ 8 < exp 20
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
  have h2 : (2.7 : ℝ) ^ 20 ≤ exp 1 ^ 20 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by linarith) 20
  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul] at h2
  push_cast at h2
  rw [mul_one] at h2
  calc (10 : ℝ) ^ 8 < 2.7 ^ 20 := by norm_num
    _ ≤ exp 20 := h2

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_eq_inv_exp_neg
statement: theorem exp_eq_inv_exp_neg (x : ℝ) : exp x = (exp (-x))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [exp_neg, inv_inv]

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_tail_le_of_abs_le
statement:
theorem abs_tail_le_of_abs_le {a : ℕ → ℝ} {A : ℝ} (ha : ∀ j, |a j| ≤ A) {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1)
    (d : ℕ) :
    |∑' j : ℕ, a (j + d) * x ^ (j + d)| ≤ A * |x| ^ d / (1 - |x|)
proof:
:= by
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (ha 0)
  have hgeom : Summable (fun j : ℕ => A * |x| ^ d * |x| ^ j) :=
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (abs_nonneg _) hx).mul_left _
  have hb : ∀ j, |a (j + d) * x ^ (j + d)| ≤ A * |x| ^ d * |x| ^ j := by
    intro j
    rw [abs_mul, abs_pow, pow_add, mul_comm (|x| ^ j), ← mul_assoc]
    gcongr
    exact ha _
  have hs : Summable (fun j : ℕ => |a (j + d) * x ^ (j + d)|) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => abs_nonneg _) hb hgeom
  calc |∑' j : ℕ, a (j + d) * x ^ (j + d)| ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, |a (j + d) * x ^ (j + d)| := by
        have := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (f := fun j => a (j + d) * x ^ (j + d)) (by
          simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hs)
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
    _ ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, A * |x| ^ d * |x| ^ j := hs.tsum_le_tsum hb hgeom
    _ = A * |x| ^ d / (1 - |x|) := by
        rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (abs_nonneg _) hx, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Azurite.BZ.terms_suffice_direct
statement:
theorem terms_suffice_direct {a : ℕ → ℝ} {A : ℝ} (ha : ∀ j, |a j| ≤ A) {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1 / 2)
    {d n : ℕ} (hd : (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * A ≤ 2 ^ d) :
    |∑' j : ℕ, a (j + d) * x ^ (j + d)| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (ha 0)
  have hx1 : |x| < 1 := by linarith
  refine (abs_tail_le_of_abs_le ha hx1 d).trans ?_
  have h1 : 1 / 2 ≤ 1 - |x| := by linarith
  rcases hA.eq_or_lt with h | hApos
  · subst h; simp
  calc A * |x| ^ d / (1 - |x|) ≤ A * (1 / 2) ^ d / (1 / 2) := by gcongr
    _ = 2 * A / 2 ^ d := by rw [one_div_pow]; field_simp
    _ ≤ 2 * A / ((2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * A) := by gcongr
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) := by rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, pow_succ]; field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.terms_suffice_reduced
statement:
theorem terms_suffice_reduced {a : ℕ → ℝ} {A : ℝ} (ha : ∀ j, |a j| ≤ A) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ))) {d n : ℕ}
    (hd : (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * A ≤ 2 ^ (k * d)) :
    |∑' j : ℕ, a (j + d) * x ^ (j + d)| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (ha 0)
  have hk2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 : ℤ)) :=
          zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ = 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hx1 : |x| < 1 := by linarith
  refine (abs_tail_le_of_abs_le ha hx1 d).trans ?_
  have h1 : 1 / 2 ≤ 1 - |x| := by linarith
  have hxd : |x| ^ d ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k * d))⁻¹ := by
    calc |x| ^ d ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ))) ^ d := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hx d
      _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k * d))⁻¹ := by
          rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_neg]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
  rcases hA.eq_or_lt with h | hApos
  · subst h; simp
  calc A * |x| ^ d / (1 - |x|) ≤ A * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k * d))⁻¹ / (1 / 2) := by gcongr
    _ = 2 * A / 2 ^ (k * d) := by field_simp
    _ ≤ 2 * A / ((2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * A) := by gcongr
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) := by rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, pow_succ]; field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_terms_suffice_reduced
proof:
:= by
  refine (abs_exp_sub_sum_le x d).trans ?_
  have hx1 : |x| ≤ 1 := by
    calc |x| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) := hx
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (0 : ℤ) := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ = 1 := zpow_zero 2
  have hd1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d.factorial := by exact_mod_cast d.factorial_pos
  have he : exp |x| ≤ 4 := by
    calc exp |x| ≤ exp 1 := exp_le_exp.mpr hx1
      _ ≤ 4 := by linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9]
  have hxd : |x| ^ d ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((k * d : ℕ) : ℤ)) := by
    calc |x| ^ d ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ))) ^ d := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hx d
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((k * d : ℕ) : ℤ)) := by
          rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
  calc |x| ^ d / d.factorial * exp |x| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((k * d : ℕ) : ℤ)) / 1 * 4 := by gcongr
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((k * d : ℕ) : ℤ) + 2) := by
        rw [zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by push_cast; omega)

name: Azurite.BZ.two_sqrt_le_add_div
statement: theorem two_sqrt_le_add_div {n k : ℝ} (hn : 0 ≤ n) (hk : 0 < k) : 2 * Real.sqrt n ≤ k + n / k
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Real.sqrt n ^ 2 = n := Real.sq_sqrt hn
  have h := sq_nonneg (k - Real.sqrt n)
  rw [sub_sq, hs] at h
  have key : k + n / k - 2 * Real.sqrt n = (k ^ 2 - 2 * k * Real.sqrt n + n) / k := by
    field_simp; ring
  have : 0 ≤ (k ^ 2 - 2 * k * Real.sqrt n + n) / k := div_nonneg h hk.le
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_eq_sq_exp_half
statement: theorem exp_eq_sq_exp_half (x : ℝ) : exp x = exp (x / 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← exp_two_mul', mul_div_cancel₀ _ two_ne_zero]

name: Azurite.BZ.log_one_add_eq_two_mul_log_one_add
statement:
theorem log_one_add_eq_two_mul_log_one_add {x : ℝ} (hx : -1 < x) :
    log (1 + x) = 2 * log (1 + x / (1 + Real.sqrt (1 + x)))
proof:
:= by
  have h1x : 0 < 1 + x := by linarith
  set s := Real.sqrt (1 + x) with hs
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h1x
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = 1 + x := Real.sq_sqrt h1x.le
  have hval : 1 + x / (1 + s) = s := by
    have hx' : x = s ^ 2 - 1 := by linarith
    rw [hx']
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hval, hs, Real.log_sqrt h1x.le]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.div_one_add_sqrt_lt_half
statement: theorem div_one_add_sqrt_lt_half {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : x / (1 + Real.sqrt (1 + x)) < x / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 1 < Real.sqrt (1 + x) := by
    rw [Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num)]; linarith
  exact div_lt_div_of_pos_left hx (by norm_num) (by linarith)

name: Azurite.BZ.arctan_eq_two_mul_arctan
statement:
theorem arctan_eq_two_mul_arctan (x : ℝ) :
    arctan x = 2 * arctan (x / (1 + Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  set θ := arctan x with hθ
  have hθ1 : -(π / 2) < θ := neg_pi_div_two_lt_arctan x
  have hθ2 : θ < π / 2 := arctan_lt_pi_div_two x
  have hcos : 0 < cos (θ / 2) := cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith [pi_pos], by linarith [pi_pos]⟩
  
  have htan : tan (θ / 2) = sin θ / (1 + cos θ) := by
    have hsθ : sin θ = 2 * sin (θ / 2) * cos (θ / 2) := by
      rw [← sin_two_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ two_ne_zero]
    have hcθ : cos θ = 2 * cos (θ / 2) ^ 2 - 1 := by
      rw [← cos_two_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ two_ne_zero]
    rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos, hsθ, hcθ]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hval : sin θ / (1 + cos θ) = x / (1 + Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2)) := by
    rw [hθ, sin_arctan, cos_arctan]
    have hr : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [← hval, ← htan, arctan_tan (by linarith) (by linarith)]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_div_one_add_sqrt_sq_le_half
statement:
theorem abs_div_one_add_sqrt_sq_le_half (x : ℝ) :
    |x / (1 + Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2))| ≤ |x| / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2) := by
    rw [Real.le_sqrt (by norm_num) (by positivity)]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg x]
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2))]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg x) (by norm_num) (by linarith)

name: Azurite.BZ.one_add_div_one_sub_eq
statement:
theorem one_add_div_one_sub_eq {x : ℝ} (hx : -1 < x) :
    (1 + symmetricLogVar x) / (1 - symmetricLogVar x) = 1 + x
proof:
:= by
  unfold symmetricLogVar
  have h2 : (2 + x) ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h3 : 1 - x / (2 + x) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [sub_ne_zero]; intro h
    field_simp at h
    linarith
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_symmetricLogVar_lt_one
statement: theorem abs_symmetricLogVar_lt_one {x : ℝ} (hx : -1 < x) : |symmetricLogVar x| < 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold symmetricLogVar
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 2 + x), div_lt_one (by linarith), abs_lt]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_log_one_add_symmetric
statement:
theorem hasSum_log_one_add_symmetric {x : ℝ} (hx : -1 < x) :
    HasSum (fun j : ℕ => 2 * symmetricLogVar x ^ (2 * j + 1) / (2 * j + 1)) (log (1 + x))
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.hasSum_log_sub_log_of_abs_lt_one (abs_symmetricLogVar_lt_one hx)
  have hy1 : 0 < 1 - symmetricLogVar x := by
    have := abs_symmetricLogVar_lt_one hx; rw [abs_lt] at this; linarith
  have hy2 : 0 < 1 + symmetricLogVar x := by
    have := abs_symmetricLogVar_lt_one hx; rw [abs_lt] at this; linarith
  rw [← Real.log_div hy2.ne' hy1.ne', one_add_div_one_sub_eq hx] at h
  refine h.congr_fun fun j => ?_
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.symmetricLogVar_lt_half
statement: theorem symmetricLogVar_lt_half {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : symmetricLogVar x < x / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold symmetricLogVar
  exact div_lt_div_of_pos_left hx (by norm_num) (by linarith)

name: Azurite.BZ.atanhTerm_pos
statement: theorem atanhTerm_pos (hq : 0 < q) (k : ℕ) : 0 < atanhTerm q k
proof: := by unfold atanhTerm; positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_atanhTerm
statement:
theorem hasSum_atanhTerm (hq : 1 < q) :
    HasSum (atanhTerm q) (Real.log ((q + 1) / (q - 1)) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 0 < (q - 1) / 2 := by linarith
  have h := (Real.hasSum_log_one_add_inv ha).div_const 2
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hq1 : q - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have e1 : (2 * ((q - 1) / 2) + 1) = q := by ring
  have e2 : 1 + ((q - 1) / 2)⁻¹ = (q + 1) / (q - 1) := by field_simp; ring
  rw [e1, e2] at h
  refine h.congr_fun fun k => ?_
  rw [atanhTerm, one_div_pow]
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_atanhTerm
statement: theorem summable_atanhTerm (hq : 1 < q) : Summable (atanhTerm q)
proof: := (hasSum_atanhTerm hq).summable

name: Azurite.BZ.atanhInv_eq
statement: theorem atanhInv_eq (hq : 1 < q) : atanhInv q = Real.log ((q + 1) / (q - 1)) / 2
proof:
:=
  (hasSum_atanhTerm hq).tsum_eq

name: Azurite.BZ.atanhTerm_add_le
statement: theorem atanhTerm_add_le (hq : 2 ≤ q) (N i : ℕ) : atanhTerm q (N + i) ≤ atanhTerm q N / 4 ^ i
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  unfold atanhTerm
  rw [div_div]
  apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
  have h4 : (4 : ℝ) ^ i ≤ q ^ (2 * i) := by
    rw [pow_mul]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by nlinarith) i
  have hN : 2 * (N : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 2 * ((N + i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by
    push_cast; linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg i : (0 : ℝ) ≤ i)]
  calc (2 * (N : ℝ) + 1) * q ^ (2 * N + 1) * 4 ^ i
      ≤ (2 * ((N + i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * q ^ (2 * N + 1) * q ^ (2 * i) := by gcongr
    _ = (2 * ((N + i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * q ^ (2 * (N + i) + 1) := by
        rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add, show 2 * N + 1 + 2 * i = 2 * (N + i) + 1 by ring]

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_le_atanhInv
statement: theorem sum_le_atanhInv (hq : 2 ≤ q) (N : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ range N, atanhTerm q k ≤ atanhInv q
proof:
:=
  Summable.sum_le_tsum (range N) (fun k _ => (atanhTerm_pos (by linarith) k).le)
    (summable_atanhTerm (by linarith))

name: Azurite.BZ.atanhInv_sub_sum_le
statement:
theorem atanhInv_sub_sum_le (hq : 2 ≤ q) (N : ℕ) :
    atanhInv q - ∑ k ∈ range N, atanhTerm q k ≤ 4 / 3 * atanhTerm q N
proof:
:= by
  have hs := summable_atanhTerm (by linarith : 1 < q)
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  rw [atanhInv, ← hs.sum_add_tsum_nat_add N, add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hgeo : Summable fun i : ℕ => atanhTerm q N / 4 ^ i := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow] using
      (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4) (by norm_num)).mul_left
        (atanhTerm q N)
  calc ∑' i : ℕ, atanhTerm q (i + N) ≤ ∑' i : ℕ, atanhTerm q N / 4 ^ i :=
        Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun i => by rw [add_comm]; exact atanhTerm_add_le hq N i)
          ((summable_nat_add_iff N).mpr hs) hgeo
    _ = atanhTerm q N * ∑' i : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ i := by
        rw [← tsum_mul_left]; exact tsum_congr fun i => by rw [one_div_pow, div_eq_mul_one_div]
    _ = 4 / 3 * atanhTerm q N := by
        rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]; norm_num; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.atanhTerm_le
statement: theorem atanhTerm_le (hq : 1 ≤ q) (N : ℕ) : atanhTerm q N ≤ (1 / q) ^ (2 * N + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  rw [atanhTerm, one_div_pow]
  apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
  have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * N + 1 := by linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg N : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N)]
  nlinarith [pow_pos hq0 (2 * N + 1)]

name: Azurite.BZ.oddProd_pos
statement: theorem oddProd_pos (N : ℕ) : 0 < oddProd N
proof: := prod_pos fun j _ => by omega

name: Azurite.BZ.dvd_oddProd
statement: theorem dvd_oddProd {k N : ℕ} (hk : k < N) : 2 * k + 1 ∣ oddProd N
proof:
:=
  dvd_prod_of_mem _ (mem_range.mpr hk)

name: Azurite.BZ.atanhDen_pos
statement: theorem atanhDen_pos {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (N : ℕ) : 0 < atanhDen q N
proof:
:= by
  unfold atanhDen; have := oddProd_pos N; positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_atanhTerm_eq_div
statement:
theorem sum_atanhTerm_eq_div {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range N, atanhTerm q k = (atanhNum q N : ℝ) / atanhDen q N
proof:
:= by
  unfold atanhNum atanhDen
  have hqr : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq.ne'
  have hB : (oddProd N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (oddProd_pos N).ne'
  push_cast
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  rw [mem_range] at hk
  have hk0 : ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [Nat.cast_div (dvd_oddProd hk) hk0, atanhTerm,
    show 2 * N + 1 = (2 * k + 1) + 2 * (N - k) by omega, pow_add]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.log_two_eq_machin
statement:
theorem log_two_eq_machin :
    Real.log 2 = 9 * Real.log (27 / 25) - Real.log (4802 / 4800) + 4 * Real.log (8750 / 8748)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((27 : ℝ) / 25) ^ 9 * (8750 / 8748) ^ 4 / (4802 / 4800) = 2 := by norm_num
  rw [← h, Real.log_div (by norm_num) (by norm_num), Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num),
    Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.log_two_eq_atanh
statement:
theorem log_two_eq_atanh :
    Real.log 2 = 18 * atanhInv 26 - 2 * atanhInv 4801 + 8 * atanhInv 8749
proof:
:= by
  rw [atanhInv_eq (by norm_num), atanhInv_eq (by norm_num), atanhInv_eq (by norm_num),
    log_two_eq_machin]
  norm_num
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.log_two_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem log_two_mem_Icc (N₁ N₂ N₃ : ℕ) :
    Real.log 2 ∈ Set.Icc
      (18 * ∑ k ∈ range N₁, atanhTerm 26 k
        - 2 * (∑ k ∈ range N₂, atanhTerm 4801 k + 4 / 3 * atanhTerm 4801 N₂)
        + 8 * ∑ k ∈ range N₃, atanhTerm 8749 k)
      (18 * (∑ k ∈ range N₁, atanhTerm 26 k + 4 / 3 * atanhTerm 26 N₁)
        - 2 * ∑ k ∈ range N₂, atanhTerm 4801 k
        + 8 * (∑ k ∈ range N₃, atanhTerm 8749 k + 4 / 3 * atanhTerm 8749 N₃))
proof:
:= by
  rw [log_two_eq_atanh]
  have h1l := sum_le_atanhInv (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 26) N₁
  have h1u := atanhInv_sub_sum_le (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 26) N₁
  have h2l := sum_le_atanhInv (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 4801) N₂
  have h2u := atanhInv_sub_sum_le (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 4801) N₂
  have h3l := sum_le_atanhInv (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 8749) N₃
  have h3u := atanhInv_sub_sum_le (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 8749) N₃
  constructor <;> linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.log_two_bracket_width
statement:
theorem log_two_bracket_width (N₁ N₂ N₃ : ℕ) :
    (18 * (∑ k ∈ range N₁, atanhTerm 26 k + 4 / 3 * atanhTerm 26 N₁)
        - 2 * ∑ k ∈ range N₂, atanhTerm 4801 k
        + 8 * (∑ k ∈ range N₃, atanhTerm 8749 k + 4 / 3 * atanhTerm 8749 N₃))
      - (18 * ∑ k ∈ range N₁, atanhTerm 26 k
        - 2 * (∑ k ∈ range N₂, atanhTerm 4801 k + 4 / 3 * atanhTerm 4801 N₂)
        + 8 * ∑ k ∈ range N₃, atanhTerm 8749 k)
      = 4 / 3 * (18 * atanhTerm 26 N₁ + 2 * atanhTerm 4801 N₂ + 8 * atanhTerm 8749 N₃)
proof:
:= by
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.log_stirlingSeq_sdiff_le_telescoping
statement:
theorem log_stirlingSeq_sdiff_le_telescoping (n : ℕ) :
    Real.log (Stirling.stirlingSeq (n + 1)) - Real.log (Stirling.stirlingSeq (n + 2))
      ≤ 1 / (12 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) - 1 / (12 * ((n : ℝ) + 2))
proof:
:= by
  have h := Stirling.log_stirlingSeq_sdiff_hasSum n
  set r : ℝ := (1 / (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 with hr
  have hq : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by positivity
  have hr1 : r < 1 := by
    rw [hr]
    refine pow_lt_one₀ (by positivity) ?_ two_ne_zero
    rw [div_lt_one hq]
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hgeo : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => 1 / 3 * r ^ (k + 1)) (1 / 3 * r * (1 - r)⁻¹) := by
    have := (hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one hr0 hr1).mul_left (1 / 3 * r)
    convert this using 1
    funext k
    ring
  refine (hasSum_le (fun k => ?_) h hgeo).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (pow_nonneg hr0 _)
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
    push_cast
    linarith
  · have h1r : (1 : ℝ) - r
        = ((2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 - 1) / (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hr]
      field_simp
    have hnum : (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      push_cast
      nlinarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n)]
    rw [h1r, hr]
    field_simp
    push_cast
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.log_stirlingSeq_sub_log_sqrt_pi_le
statement:
theorem log_stirlingSeq_sub_log_sqrt_pi_le (n : ℕ) :
    Real.log (Stirling.stirlingSeq (n + 1)) - Real.log (Real.sqrt π)
      ≤ 1 / (12 * ((n : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : ∀ M : ℕ, Real.log (Stirling.stirlingSeq (n + 1))
      - Real.log (Stirling.stirlingSeq (n + 1 + M))
      ≤ 1 / (12 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) - 1 / (12 * (((n + 1 + M : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by
    intro M
    induction M with
    | zero => simp
    | succ M ih =>
      have := log_stirlingSeq_sdiff_le_telescoping (n + M)
      rw [show n + M + 1 = n + 1 + M by omega, show n + M + 2 = n + 1 + (M + 1) by omega] at this
      push_cast at this ih ⊢
      ring_nf at this ih ⊢
      linarith
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun M : ℕ => Real.log (Stirling.stirlingSeq (n + 1))
      - Real.log (Stirling.stirlingSeq (n + 1 + M))) atTop
      (𝓝 (Real.log (Stirling.stirlingSeq (n + 1)) - Real.log (Real.sqrt π))) := by
    refine tendsto_const_nhds.sub ?_
    have hc : ContinuousAt Real.log (Real.sqrt π) :=
      Real.continuousAt_log (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr pi_pos).ne'
    have := hc.tendsto.comp
      (Stirling.tendsto_stirlingSeq_sqrt_pi.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat (n + 1)))
    refine this.congr fun M => ?_
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [add_comm M (n + 1)]
  refine le_of_tendsto hlim (Eventually.of_forall fun M => ?_)
  have : 0 ≤ 1 / (12 * (((n + 1 + M : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by positivity
  linarith [hfin M]

name: Azurite.BZ.factorial_le_stirling_refined
statement:
theorem factorial_le_stirling_refined {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (n.factorial : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * π * n) * (n / exp 1) ^ n * exp (1 / (12 * n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  have h := log_stirlingSeq_sub_log_sqrt_pi_le m
  have hs : 0 < Stirling.stirlingSeq (m + 1) := Stirling.stirlingSeq'_pos m
  have hpi : 0 < Real.sqrt π := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr pi_pos
  rw [← Real.log_div hs.ne' hpi.ne', Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (by positivity),
    Stirling.stirlingSeq, div_div, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h
  have hsplit : Real.sqrt (2 * π * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
      = Real.sqrt (2 * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt π := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity)]
    ring_nf
  rw [hsplit]
  push_cast at h ⊢
  refine h.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.reciprocalSeq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem reciprocalSeq_zero (y x₀ : ℝ) : reciprocalSeq y x₀ 0 = x₀
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.reciprocalSeq_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem reciprocalSeq_succ (y x₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    reciprocalSeq y x₀ (n + 1) = reciprocalStep y (reciprocalSeq y x₀ n)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.reciprocalStep_eq_inverseRootStep
statement:
theorem reciprocalStep_eq_inverseRootStep (y x : ℝ) :
    reciprocalStep y x = inverseRootStep 1 y x
proof:
:= by
  simp [reciprocalStep, inverseRootStep]

name: Azurite.BZ.recipError_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem recipError_eq_zero_iff {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) : recipError y x = 0 ↔ x = y⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold recipError
  rw [sub_eq_zero, eq_comm]
  exact ⟨eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left, fun h => by rw [h, inv_mul_cancel₀ hy]⟩

name: Azurite.BZ.eq_of_recipError
statement: theorem eq_of_recipError {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) : x = (1 - recipError y x) / y
proof:
:= by
  unfold recipError
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.recipError_reciprocalStep
statement:
theorem recipError_reciprocalStep (y x : ℝ) :
    recipError y (reciprocalStep y x) = recipError y x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold recipError reciprocalStep
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.recipError_reciprocalSeq
statement:
theorem recipError_reciprocalSeq (y x₀ : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    recipError y (reciprocalSeq y x₀ j) = recipError y x₀ ^ (2 ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih => rw [reciprocalSeq_succ, recipError_reciprocalStep, ih, ← pow_mul, pow_succ]

name: Azurite.BZ.reciprocalSeq_sub_inv
statement:
theorem reciprocalSeq_sub_inv {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (x₀ : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    reciprocalSeq y x₀ j - y⁻¹ = -(recipError y x₀ ^ (2 ^ j)) / y
proof:
:= by
  have h := recipError_reciprocalSeq y x₀ j
  rw [← h]
  unfold recipError
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_recipError_lt_one_iff
statement: theorem abs_recipError_lt_one_iff (y x₀ : ℝ) : |recipError y x₀| < 1 ↔ x₀ * y ∈ Ioo 0 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold recipError
  rw [abs_lt, mem_Ioo]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_recipError_iff
statement:
theorem tendsto_recipError_iff {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (x : ℕ → ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun j => recipError y (x j)) atTop (𝓝 0) ↔ Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : Tendsto (fun j => (1 - recipError y (x j)) / y) atTop (𝓝 ((1 - 0) / y)) :=
      (tendsto_const_nhds.sub h).div_const y
    rw [sub_zero, one_div] at h'
    exact h'.congr (fun j => (eq_of_recipError hy (x j)).symm)
  · intro h
    have h' : Tendsto (fun j => 1 - x j * y) atTop (𝓝 (1 - y⁻¹ * y)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.sub (h.mul_const y)
    rwa [inv_mul_cancel₀ hy, sub_self] at h'

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_reciprocalSeq_iff
statement:
theorem tendsto_reciprocalSeq_iff {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (x₀ : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (reciprocalSeq y x₀) atTop (𝓝 y⁻¹) ↔ |recipError y x₀| < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tendsto_recipError_iff hy]
  simp only [recipError_reciprocalSeq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hu
    push Not at hu
    have hge : ∀ j, 1 ≤ |recipError y x₀ ^ (2 ^ j)| := fun j => by
      rw [abs_pow]; exact one_le_pow₀ hu
    have hev := h.abs.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by simp : |(0 : ℝ)| < 1))
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hev.exists
    have := hge j
    linarith
  · intro h
    exact (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_abs_lt_one h).comp
      (tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt one_lt_two)

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_recipError_reciprocalSeq_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [recipError_reciprocalSeq, abs_pow]
  calc |recipError y x₀| ^ (2 ^ j) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ))) ^ (2 ^ j) :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h _
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((k * 2 ^ j : ℕ) : ℤ)) := by
        rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]; congr 1; push_cast; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_recipError_reciprocalSeq_le_of_le
proof:
:=
  (abs_recipError_reciprocalSeq_le h j).trans
    (zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega))

name: Azurite.BZ.recipError_one_le_half
statement:
theorem recipError_one_le_half {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Ico (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 < recipError y 1 ∧ recipError y 1 ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold recipError
  constructor <;> linarith [hy.1, hy.2]

name: Azurite.BZ.reciprocalStep'_eq
statement: theorem reciprocalStep'_eq (y x : ℝ) : reciprocalStep' y x = reciprocalStep y x
proof:
:= by
  unfold reciprocalStep' reciprocalStep
  ring
