name: Azurite.BZ.recipError_reciprocalStep_perturbed
statement:
theorem recipError_reciprocalStep_perturbed (y x θ : ℝ) :
    recipError y (x + x * (1 - x * y) * (1 + θ))
      = recipError y x ^ 2 - θ * recipError y x * (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold recipError
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.recipError_reciprocalStep'_perturbed
statement:
theorem recipError_reciprocalStep'_perturbed (y x θ : ℝ) :
    recipError y (x * (2 - x * y) * (1 + θ))
      = recipError y x ^ 2 - θ * (1 - recipError y x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold recipError
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_recipError_reciprocalStep_perturbed_le
statement:
theorem abs_recipError_reciprocalStep_perturbed_le {y x θ ε : ℝ} (hε : ε ≤ 1)
    (hu : |recipError y x| ≤ ε) (hθ : |θ| ≤ ε) :
    |recipError y (x + x * (1 - x * y) * (1 + θ))| ≤ 3 * ε ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [recipError_reciprocalStep_perturbed]
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hu
  have hxy : |x * y| ≤ 1 + ε := by
    have : x * y = 1 - recipError y x := by unfold recipError; ring
    rw [this]
    calc |1 - recipError y x| ≤ |1| + |recipError y x| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ 1 + ε := by rw [abs_one]; linarith
  calc |recipError y x ^ 2 - θ * recipError y x * (x * y)|
      ≤ |recipError y x ^ 2| + |θ * recipError y x * (x * y)| := abs_sub _ _
    _ = |recipError y x| ^ 2 + |θ| * |recipError y x| * |x * y| := by
        rw [abs_pow, abs_mul, abs_mul]
    _ ≤ ε ^ 2 + ε * ε * (1 + ε) := by gcongr
    _ ≤ 3 * ε ^ 2 := by nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.log_sub_log_sub_inv_ge
statement:
theorem log_sub_log_sub_inv_ge {m : ℕ} (hm : 4 ≤ m) :
    1 / (8 * (m : ℝ) * (m + 1)) ≤ Real.log m - Real.log (m - 1) - 1 / m
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < m)
  have hm4 : (4 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hm1 : (0 : ℝ) < m - 1 := by linarith
  set x : ℝ := 1 / m with hx
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by positivity
  have hx1 : x ≤ 1 / 4 := by rw [hx]; exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hm4
  have habs : |x| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_pos hx0]; linarith
  have h := Real.abs_log_sub_add_sum_range_le habs 2
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one, abs_le, abs_of_pos hx0] at h
  obtain ⟨-, h1⟩ := h
  norm_num at h1
  have hlog : Real.log m - Real.log (m - 1) = -Real.log (1 - x) := by
    rw [hx, show (1 : ℝ) - 1 / m = (m - 1) / m by field_simp, Real.log_div hm1.ne' hm0.ne']
    ring
  have key : 1 / (8 * (m : ℝ) * (m + 1)) ≤ x ^ 2 / 2 - x ^ 3 / (1 - x) := by
    have e : x ^ 2 / 2 - x ^ 3 / (1 - x) - 1 / (8 * (m : ℝ) * (m + 1))
        = (3 * m ^ 2 - 7 * m - 12) / (8 * m ^ 2 * (m - 1) * (m + 1)) := by
      rw [hx, show (1 : ℝ) - 1 / m = (m - 1) / m by field_simp]
      field_simp
      ring
    have : 0 ≤ (3 * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 - 7 * m - 12) / (8 * m ^ 2 * (m - 1) * (m + 1)) :=
      div_nonneg (by nlinarith) (by positivity)
    linarith
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.harmonic_sub_log_diff_ge
statement:
theorem harmonic_sub_log_diff_ge {N : ℕ} (hN : 3 ≤ N) (M : ℕ) :
    1 / 8 * (1 / ((N : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / (((N + M : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1))
      ≤ ((harmonic N : ℝ) - Real.log N) - ((harmonic (N + M) : ℝ) - Real.log (N + M))
proof:
:= by
  induction M with
  | zero => simp
  | succ M ih =>
    have hstep := log_sub_log_sub_inv_ge (m := N + M + 1) (by omega)
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) + M + 1 := by positivity
    have e : 1 / (8 * ((N : ℝ) + M + 1) * ((N : ℝ) + M + 1 + 1))
        = 1 / 8 * (1 / ((N : ℝ) + M + 1) - 1 / ((N : ℝ) + M + 1 + 1)) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [show N + (M + 1) = N + M + 1 from rfl, harmonic_succ]
    push_cast at hstep ih ⊢
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right, e] at hstep
    rw [show (N : ℝ) + ((M : ℝ) + 1) = N + M + 1 by ring]
    simp only [one_div] at hstep ih ⊢
    linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.harmonic_sub_log_sub_gamma_ge
statement:
theorem harmonic_sub_log_sub_gamma_ge {N : ℕ} (hN : 3 ≤ N) :
    1 / (8 * ((N : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ (harmonic N : ℝ) - Real.log N - eulerMascheroniConstant
proof:
:= by
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun M : ℕ =>
      ((harmonic N : ℝ) - Real.log N) - ((harmonic (N + M) : ℝ) - Real.log (N + M))) atTop
      (𝓝 (((harmonic N : ℝ) - Real.log N) - eulerMascheroniConstant)) := by
    refine tendsto_const_nhds.sub ?_
    have := Real.tendsto_harmonic_sub_log.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat N)
    refine this.congr fun M => ?_
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [add_comm M N]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hR : Tendsto (fun M : ℕ => 1 / 8 * (1 / ((N : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / (((N + M : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)))
      atTop (𝓝 (1 / 8 * (1 / ((N : ℝ) + 1) - 0))) := by
    have h0 : Tendsto (fun M : ℕ => 1 / (((N + M : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have := (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat N)
      refine this.congr fun M => ?_
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [add_comm M N]
    exact (h0.const_sub (1 / ((N : ℝ) + 1))).const_mul (1 / 8)
  have := le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' hR hlim fun M => harmonic_sub_log_diff_ge hN M
  rw [← one_div_mul_one_div]
  simpa using this

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_harmonic_sub_log'
statement:
theorem tendsto_harmonic_sub_log' :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (harmonic N : ℝ) - Real.log N) atTop (𝓝 eulerMascheroniConstant)
proof:
:=
  Real.tendsto_harmonic_sub_log

name: Azurite.BZ.harmonic_sub_log_sub_gamma_bounds
statement:
theorem harmonic_sub_log_sub_gamma_bounds {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    0 < (harmonic N : ℝ) - Real.log N - eulerMascheroniConstant ∧
      (harmonic N : ℝ) - Real.log N - eulerMascheroniConstant ≤ 1 / N
proof:
:= by
  have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hlo := Real.eulerMascheroniSeq_lt_eulerMascheroniConstant N
  have hhi := Real.eulerMascheroniConstant_lt_eulerMascheroniSeq' N
  rw [Real.eulerMascheroniSeq'] at hhi
  rw [ite_eq_right (by omega)] at hhi
  rw [Real.eulerMascheroniSeq] at hlo
  constructor
  · linarith
  · have hlog : Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log N ≤ 1 / N := by
      rw [← Real.log_div (by positivity) hN0.ne', add_div, div_self hN0.ne']
      have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + 1 / N)
      linarith
    linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.zetaReal_eq_riemannZeta
statement: theorem zetaReal_eq_riemannZeta {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) : (zetaReal s : ℂ) = riemannZeta s
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeta_eq_tsum_one_div_nat_cpow (by simpa using hs), zetaReal, Complex.ofReal_tsum]
  congr 1
  funext n
  rw [one_div, Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.ofReal_cpow (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_zetaTail
statement:
theorem summable_zetaTail {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) (p : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun j : ℕ => (((j + p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹)
proof:
:=
  (Real.summable_nat_rpow_inv.mpr hs).comp_injective (add_left_injective p)

name: Azurite.BZ.zetaReal_eq_sum_add_tail
statement:
theorem zetaReal_eq_sum_add_tail {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) (p : ℕ) :
    zetaReal s = ∑ j ∈ range p, ((j : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ + zetaTail s p
proof:
:= by
  unfold zetaReal zetaTail
  exact (Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add' (f := fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹) (k := p)
    (summable_zetaTail hs p)).symm

name: Azurite.BZ.antitoneOn_rpow_neg
statement: theorem antitoneOn_rpow_neg {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) : AntitoneOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-s)) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:=
  fun x hx _ _ hxy => Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hx hxy (by linarith)

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_Ioi_rpow_neg
statement:
theorem integral_Ioi_rpow_neg {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∫ x in Ioi p, x ^ (-s) = p ^ (1 - s) / (s - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) hp]
  rw [show -s + 1 = 1 - s by ring, neg_div, ← div_neg, neg_sub]

name: Azurite.BZ.zetaTail_bounds
statement:
theorem zetaTail_bounds {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (p : ℝ) ^ (1 - s) / (s - 1) ≤ zetaTail s p ∧
      zetaTail s p ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (1 - s) / (s - 1) + ((p : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp
  set f : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x ^ (-s) with hf
  have hfval : ∀ j : ℕ, f (p + j) = (((j + p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ := fun j => by
    rw [hf]; push_cast; rw [Real.rpow_neg (by positivity), add_comm]
  have hanti : ∀ a : ℕ, AntitoneOn f (Icc (p : ℝ) (p + a)) := fun a =>
    (antitoneOn_rpow_neg (by linarith)).mono fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le hp0 hx.1
  
  have hup : ∀ a : ℕ, ∫ x in (p : ℝ)..(p + a), f x ≤ ∑ i ∈ range a, (((i + p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ := by
    intro a
    have h := (hanti a).integral_le_sum
    refine h.trans (le_of_eq (sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_))
    exact hfval i
  have hlow : ∀ a : ℕ,
      ∑ i ∈ range a, (((i + 1 + p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ ≤ ∫ x in (p : ℝ)..(p + a), f x := by
    intro a
    have h := (hanti a).sum_le_integral
    refine le_trans (le_of_eq (sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_)) h
    rw [← hfval (i + 1)]
  
  have hint : Tendsto (fun a : ℕ => ∫ x in (p : ℝ)..(p + a), f x) atTop
      (𝓝 ((p : ℝ) ^ (1 - s) / (s - 1))) := by
    rw [← integral_Ioi_rpow_neg hs hp0]
    exact intervalIntegral_tendsto_integral_Ioi (p : ℝ)
      (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) hp0)
      (tendsto_atTop_add_const_left _ _ tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
  have hsum1 : Tendsto (fun a : ℕ => ∑ i ∈ range a, (((i + p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹) atTop
      (𝓝 (zetaTail s p)) := (summable_zetaTail hs p).hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
  have hsum2 : Tendsto (fun a : ℕ => ∑ i ∈ range a, (((i + 1 + p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹) atTop
      (𝓝 (zetaTail s p - ((p : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹)) := by
    have h := (summable_zetaTail hs (p + 1)).hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
    have hsplit := Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add' (f := fun j : ℕ => (((j + p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹)
      (k := 1) (by
        have := summable_zetaTail hs (p + 1)
        refine this.congr fun j => ?_
        congr 3; omega)
    simp only [sum_range_one, Nat.zero_add] at hsplit
    have heq : zetaTail s p - ((p : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ = ∑' j : ℕ, (((j + (p + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ := by
      unfold zetaTail
      rw [← hsplit]
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_left]
      congr 1
      funext j; congr 3; omega
    rw [heq]
    refine h.congr fun a => sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    congr 3; omega
  constructor
  · exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hint hsum1 (Eventually.of_forall hup)
  · have := le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hsum2 hint (Eventually.of_forall hlow)
    linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_zetaReal_sub_euler_maclaurin_zero_le
statement:
theorem abs_zetaReal_sub_euler_maclaurin_zero_le {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    |zetaReal s - (∑ j ∈ range p, ((j : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ + ((p : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ / 2
      + (p : ℝ) ^ (1 - s) / (s - 1))| ≤ ((p : ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [zetaReal_eq_sum_add_tail hs p]
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := zetaTail_bounds hs hp
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.zeta_tail_le_of_pow
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ ((n : ℝ) / s) := by positivity
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le h2 hp
  rw [← Real.rpow_neg hp0.le]
  calc p ^ (-s) ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) / s)) ^ (-s) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos h2 hp (by linarith)
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℝ)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]
        congr 1
        field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.zetaEMTerm_one
statement: theorem zetaEMTerm_one (p : ℕ) (s : ℝ) : zetaEMTerm 1 p s = s * (p : ℝ) ^ (-s - 1) / 12
proof:
:= by
  unfold zetaEMTerm
  norm_num [bernoulli_two, Nat.factorial]
  ring_nf

name: Azurite.BZ.bessel_rec_term
statement:
theorem bessel_rec_term (n j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x / 2 * (besselCoeff n (j + 1) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * (j + 1) + n))
      + x / 2 * (besselCoeff (n + 2) j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + (n + 2)))
      = (n + 1) * (besselCoeff (n + 1) (j + 1) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * (j + 1) + (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold besselCoeff
  rw [show 2 * (j + 1) + n = 2 * j + n + 2 by ring, show 2 * j + (n + 2) = 2 * j + n + 2 by ring,
    show 2 * (j + 1) + (n + 1) = 2 * j + n + 3 by ring,
    show n + (j + 1) = n + j + 1 by ring, show n + 2 + j = n + j + 1 + 1 by ring,
    show n + 1 + (j + 1) = n + j + 1 + 1 by ring, Nat.factorial_succ (n + j + 1),
    Nat.factorial_succ (n + j), Nat.factorial_succ j, pow_succ (x / 2) (2 * j + n + 2),
    pow_succ (-1 : ℝ) j]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.bessel_rec_term_zero
statement:
theorem bessel_rec_term_zero (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x / 2 * (besselCoeff n 0 * (x / 2) ^ (2 * 0 + n))
      = (n + 1) * (besselCoeff (n + 1) 0 * (x / 2) ^ (2 * 0 + (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold besselCoeff
  rw [show 2 * 0 + n = n by ring, show 2 * 0 + (n + 1) = n + 1 by ring, add_zero, add_zero,
    Nat.factorial_succ n, pow_succ (x / 2) n]
  simp only [pow_zero, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJNat_recurrence
statement:
theorem besselJNat_recurrence (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x / 2 * (besselJNat n x + besselJNat (n + 2) x) = (n + 1) * besselJNat (n + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := summable_besselJNat_term n x
  have h1 := summable_besselJNat_term (n + 1) x
  have h2 := summable_besselJNat_term (n + 2) x
  have hA : HasSum (fun j => x / 2 * (besselCoeff n (j + 1) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * (j + 1) + n)))
      (x / 2 * (besselJNat n x - besselCoeff n 0 * (x / 2) ^ (2 * 0 + n))) := by
    have := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr h0.hasSum
    rw [sum_range_one] at this
    exact this.mul_left (x / 2)
  have hB : HasSum (fun j => x / 2 * (besselCoeff (n + 2) j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + (n + 2))))
      (x / 2 * besselJNat (n + 2) x) := h2.hasSum.mul_left (x / 2)
  have hC : HasSum (fun j => ((n : ℝ) + 1) *
      (besselCoeff (n + 1) (j + 1) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * (j + 1) + (n + 1))))
      ((n + 1) * (besselJNat (n + 1) x - besselCoeff (n + 1) 0 * (x / 2) ^ (2 * 0 + (n + 1)))) := by
    have := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr h1.hasSum
    rw [sum_range_one] at this
    exact this.mul_left _
  have hAB := (hA.add hB).congr_fun fun j => (bessel_rec_term n j x).symm
  have huniq := hC.unique hAB
  have h00 := bessel_rec_term_zero n x
  linear_combination -huniq + h00

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_recurrence
statement:
theorem besselJ_recurrence (ν : ℤ) (x : ℝ) :
    x * (besselJ (ν - 1) x + besselJ (ν + 1) x) = 2 * ν * besselJ ν x
proof:
:= by
  rcases ν with n | n
  · rcases n with _ | n
    · simp only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, Nat.cast_zero, zero_sub, zero_add, Int.cast_zero,
        mul_zero, zero_mul]
      have h := besselJ_neg 1 x
      push_cast at h
      rw [h]
      ring
    · simp only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast]
      rw [show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1 = (n : ℤ) by push_cast; ring,
        show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 = ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, besselJ_natCast,
        besselJ_natCast, besselJ_natCast]
      have := besselJNat_recurrence n x
      push_cast
      linear_combination 2 * this
  · rw [Int.negSucc_eq, show -((n : ℤ) + 1) - 1 = -((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring,
      show -((n : ℤ) + 1) + 1 = -((n : ℕ) : ℤ) by ring, besselJ_neg, besselJ_neg,
      show -((n : ℤ) + 1) = -((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, besselJ_neg, besselJ_natCast,
      besselJ_natCast, besselJ_natCast]
    have := besselJNat_recurrence n x
    push_cast
    linear_combination 2 * (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * this

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_recurrence'
statement:
theorem besselJ_recurrence' {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (ν : ℤ) :
    besselJ (ν - 1) x + besselJ (ν + 1) x = 2 * ν / x * besselJ ν x
proof:
:= by
  have h := besselJ_recurrence ν x
  have : 2 * (ν : ℝ) / x * besselJ ν x = x * (besselJ (ν - 1) x + besselJ (ν + 1) x) / x := by
    rw [h]; ring
  rw [this, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hx]

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_ratio_step
statement:
theorem besselJ_ratio_step {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) {ν : ℤ} (h1 : besselJ ν x ≠ 0) :
    besselJ ν x / besselJ (ν - 1) x = 1 / (2 * ν / x - besselJ (ν + 1) x / besselJ ν x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := besselJ_recurrence' hx ν
  have : 2 * (ν : ℝ) / x - besselJ (ν + 1) x / besselJ ν x = besselJ (ν - 1) x / besselJ ν x := by
    rw [eq_div_iff h1, sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h1]
    linear_combination -h
  rw [this, one_div_div]

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_ratio_eq_cf
statement:
theorem besselJ_ratio_eq_cf {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (ν : ℤ) (k : ℕ)
    (hJ : ∀ i : ℕ, i < k → besselJ (ν + i) x ≠ 0) :
    besselJ ν x / besselJ (ν - 1) x
      = besselRatioCF x ν k (besselJ (ν + k) x / besselJ (ν + k - 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing ν with
  | zero => simp [besselRatioCF]
  | succ k ih =>
    have h1 : besselJ ν x ≠ 0 := by simpa using hJ 0 (by omega)
    rw [besselJ_ratio_step hx h1, besselRatioCF]
    congr 2
    have := ih (ν + 1) (fun i hi => by
      have := hJ (i + 1) (by omega)
      rwa [show ν + ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = ν + 1 + i by push_cast; ring] at this)
    rw [show ν + 1 - 1 = ν by ring] at this
    rw [this, show ν + 1 + (k : ℤ) = ν + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring]

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_besselCF_inner
statement:
theorem approximant_besselCF_inner {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → a j = -1) (x : ℝ) (ν : ℤ)
    (k : ℕ) :
    approximant a (fun j : ℕ => 2 * ((ν : ℝ) + j) / x) k
      = 2 * ν / x - besselRatioCF x (ν + 1) k 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing ν a with
  | zero => simp [besselRatioCF]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [approximant_succ, ha 1 le_rfl]
    have hfun : (fun j : ℕ => 2 * ((ν : ℝ) + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) / x)
        = fun j : ℕ => 2 * (((ν + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) + j) / x := by
      funext j; push_cast; ring
    rw [hfun, ih (fun j hj => ha (j + 1) (by omega)), besselRatioCF]
    push_cast
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_besselCF
statement:
theorem approximant_besselCF (x : ℝ) (ν : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    approximant besselCFNum (besselCFDen x ν) k = besselRatioCF x ν k 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases k with _ | k
  · simp [besselCFDen, besselRatioCF]
  · have hb0 : besselCFDen x ν 0 = 0 := by simp [besselCFDen]
    have ha1 : besselCFNum 1 = 1 := by simp [besselCFNum]
    have ha : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → besselCFNum (j + 1) = -1 := fun j hj => by
      rw [besselCFNum, ite_eq_right (by omega)]
    have hfun : (fun j => besselCFDen x ν (j + 1)) = fun j : ℕ => 2 * ((ν : ℝ) + j) / x := by
      funext j
      rw [besselCFDen, ite_eq_right (Nat.succ_ne_zero j)]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [approximant_succ, hb0, ha1, hfun, approximant_besselCF_inner ha, besselRatioCF, zero_add]

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_besselJ_int
statement: theorem hasSum_besselJ_int (x : ℝ) : HasSum (fun ν : ℤ => besselJ ν x) 1
proof:
:= by
  have := hasSum_besselJ_generating one_ne_zero x
  simpa using this

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_neg_one_zpow_besselJ
statement:
theorem hasSum_neg_one_zpow_besselJ (x : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun ν : ℤ => (-1) ^ ν * besselJ ν x) 1
proof:
:= by
  have := hasSum_besselJ_generating (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≠ 0) x
  rw [show x / 2 * (-1 - 1 / -1) = 0 by norm_num, Real.exp_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_two_mul_besselJ_even
statement:
theorem hasSum_two_mul_besselJ_even (x : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => 2 * besselJ (2 * k) x) (1 + besselJ 0 x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasSum_besselJ_int x).nat_add_neg
  have h2 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (1 + (-1) ^ n) * besselJ n x) (1 + besselJ 0 x) :=
    h.congr_fun fun n => by rw [besselJ_neg]; ring
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun k : ℕ => 2 * k) := mul_right_injective₀ two_ne_zero
  have hzero : ∀ n, n ∉ Set.range (fun k : ℕ => 2 * k) →
      (1 + (-1 : ℝ) ^ n) * besselJ n x = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    have hodd : Odd n := by
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with ⟨m, hm⟩ | ho
      · exact absurd (Set.mem_range.mpr ⟨m, by show 2 * m = n; omega⟩) hn
      · exact ho
    rw [hodd.neg_one_pow]
    ring
  have := (hinj.hasSum_iff hzero).mpr h2
  refine this.congr_fun fun k => ?_
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_even_sum
statement: theorem besselJ_even_sum (x : ℝ) : besselJ 0 x + 2 * ∑' k : ℕ, besselJ (2 * (k + 1)) x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr (hasSum_two_mul_besselJ_even x)
  rw [sum_range_one] at h
  have := h.tsum_eq
  rw [tsum_mul_left, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero] at this
  push_cast at this ⊢
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.millerSeq_of_le
statement: theorem millerSeq_of_le (x : ℝ) {N ν : ℕ} (h : N + 1 ≤ ν) : millerSeq x N ν = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [millerSeq, ite_eq_left h]

name: Azurite.BZ.millerSeq_self
statement: theorem millerSeq_self (x : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : millerSeq x N N = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [millerSeq, ite_eq_right (by omega), ite_eq_left rfl]

name: Azurite.BZ.millerSeq_of_lt
statement:
theorem millerSeq_of_lt (x : ℝ) {N ν : ℕ} (h : ν < N) :
    millerSeq x N ν = 2 * (ν + 1) / x * millerSeq x N (ν + 1) - millerSeq x N (ν + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [millerSeq, ite_eq_right (by omega), ite_eq_right (by omega)]

name: Azurite.BZ.millerSeq_rec
statement:
theorem millerSeq_rec (x : ℝ) {N μ : ℕ} (hμ : 1 ≤ μ) (hμN : μ ≤ N) :
    millerSeq x N (μ - 1) + millerSeq x N (μ + 1) = 2 * μ / x * millerSeq x N μ
proof:
:= by
  have h := millerSeq_of_lt x (N := N) (ν := μ - 1) (by omega)
  rw [show μ - 1 + 1 = μ by omega, show μ - 1 + 2 = μ + 1 by omega, Nat.cast_pred hμ] at h
  rw [h]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.millerSeq_casoratian
statement:
theorem millerSeq_casoratian {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (N : ℕ) :
    ∀ ν, ν ≤ N →
      millerSeq x N ν * besselJ (ν + 1) x - millerSeq x N (ν + 1) * besselJ ν x
        = besselJ (N + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ d ν, ν + d = N →
      millerSeq x N ν * besselJ (ν + 1) x - millerSeq x N (ν + 1) * besselJ ν x
        = besselJ (N + 1) x from fun ν hν => h (N - ν) ν (by omega)
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro ν hν
    obtain rfl : ν = N := by omega
    rw [millerSeq_self, millerSeq_of_le x le_rfl]
    ring
  | succ d ih =>
    intro ν hν
    have hν' := ih (ν + 1) (by omega)
    have hf := millerSeq_of_lt x (N := N) (ν := ν) (by omega)
    have hJ := besselJ_recurrence' hx ((ν : ℤ) + 1)
    rw [show (ν : ℤ) + 1 - 1 = ν by ring] at hJ
    rw [show ν + 1 + 1 = ν + 2 from rfl] at hν'
    push_cast at hν' hJ ⊢
    rw [hf]
    linear_combination (-millerSeq x N (ν + 1)) * hJ + hν'

name: Azurite.BZ.millerSeq_div_sub
statement:
theorem millerSeq_div_sub {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) {N ν : ℕ} (hν : ν ≤ N)
    (h0 : besselJ ν x ≠ 0) (h1 : besselJ (ν + 1) x ≠ 0) :
    millerSeq x N ν / besselJ ν x - millerSeq x N (ν + 1) / besselJ (ν + 1) x
      = besselJ (N + 1) x / (besselJ ν x * besselJ (ν + 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_sub_div _ _ h0 h1, mul_comm (besselJ (ν : ℤ) x) (millerSeq x N (ν + 1)),
    millerSeq_casoratian hx N ν hν]

name: Azurite.BZ.isBesselRecSol_besselJ
statement:
theorem isBesselRecSol_besselJ {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    IsBesselRecSol x fun n : ℕ => besselJ n x
proof:
:= by
  intro μ hμ
  have := besselJ_recurrence' hx μ
  rw [Int.cast_natCast] at this
  simp only
  rw [Nat.cast_pred hμ, Nat.cast_succ]
  exact this

name: Azurite.BZ.IsBesselRecSol.add
statement:
theorem IsBesselRecSol.add {x : ℝ} {f g : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : IsBesselRecSol x f)
    (hg : IsBesselRecSol x g) : IsBesselRecSol x (f + g)
proof:
:= fun μ hμ => by
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  linear_combination hf μ hμ + hg μ hμ

name: Azurite.BZ.IsBesselRecSol.smul
statement:
theorem IsBesselRecSol.smul {x : ℝ} {f : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : IsBesselRecSol x f) (c : ℝ) :
    IsBesselRecSol x (c • f)
proof:
:= fun μ hμ => by
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination c * hf μ hμ

name: Azurite.BZ.IsBesselRecSol.casoratian
statement:
theorem IsBesselRecSol.casoratian {x : ℝ} {f g : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : IsBesselRecSol x f)
    (hg : IsBesselRecSol x g) (n : ℕ) :
    f n * g (n + 1) - f (n + 1) * g n = f 0 * g 1 - f 1 * g 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have hf' := hf (n + 1) (by omega)
    have hg' := hg (n + 1) (by omega)
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hf' hg'
    rw [← ih]
    linear_combination (-g (n + 1)) * hf' + f (n + 1) * hg'

name: Azurite.BZ.IsBesselRecSol.eq_of_init
statement:
theorem IsBesselRecSol.eq_of_init {x : ℝ} {f g : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : IsBesselRecSol x f)
    (hg : IsBesselRecSol x g) (h0 : f 0 = g 0) (h1 : f 1 = g 1) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => exact h0
  | one => exact h1
  | more n ih0 ih1 =>
    have hf' := hf (n + 1) (by omega)
    have hg' := hg (n + 1) (by omega)
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 from rfl] at hf' hg'
    linear_combination hf' - hg' - ih0 + (2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / x) * ih1

name: Azurite.BZ.IsBesselRecSol.exists_eq_comb
statement:
theorem IsBesselRecSol.exists_eq_comb {x : ℝ} {f g h : ℕ → ℝ} (hg : IsBesselRecSol x g)
    (hh : IsBesselRecSol x h) (hW : g 0 * h 1 - g 1 * h 0 ≠ 0) (hf : IsBesselRecSol x f) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, f = fun n => a * g n + b * h n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(f 0 * h 1 - f 1 * h 0) / (g 0 * h 1 - g 1 * h 0),
    (g 0 * f 1 - g 1 * f 0) / (g 0 * h 1 - g 1 * h 0), ?_⟩
  have hc : IsBesselRecSol x fun n => (f 0 * h 1 - f 1 * h 0) / (g 0 * h 1 - g 1 * h 0) * g n
      + (g 0 * f 1 - g 1 * f 0) / (g 0 * h 1 - g 1 * h 0) * h n :=
    (hg.smul _).add (hh.smul _)
  refine hf.eq_of_init hc ?_ ?_
  · rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← add_div, eq_div_iff hW]
    ring
  · rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← add_div, eq_div_iff hW]
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_besselJNat_le
statement:
theorem abs_besselJNat_le (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |besselJNat n x| ≤ (|x| / 2) ^ n / n.factorial * Real.exp (x ^ 2 / 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : Summable fun j => ‖besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)‖ :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
      (fun j => norm_besselCoeff_mul_pow_le (abs_nonneg x) le_rfl n j) (summable_besselBound |x| n)
  have hexp := hasSum_exp_series (x ^ 2 / 4)
  have hbound : ∀ j, ‖besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)‖
      ≤ (|x| / 2) ^ n / n.factorial * ((x ^ 2 / 4) ^ j / j.factorial) := by
    intro j
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_besselCoeff_eq, abs_pow, abs_div, abs_two, pow_add,
      pow_mul, show (|x| / 2) ^ 2 = x ^ 2 / 4 by rw [div_pow, sq_abs]; norm_num]
    have hfac : (n.factorial : ℝ) ≤ (n + j).factorial := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le (Nat.le_add_right n j)
    have hle : (1 : ℝ) / (j.factorial * (n + j).factorial) ≤ 1 / (j.factorial * n.factorial) :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by gcongr)
    calc 1 / (j.factorial * (n + j).factorial : ℝ) * ((x ^ 2 / 4) ^ j * (|x| / 2) ^ n)
        ≤ 1 / (j.factorial * n.factorial : ℝ) * ((x ^ 2 / 4) ^ j * (|x| / 2) ^ n) := by gcongr
      _ = (|x| / 2) ^ n / n.factorial * ((x ^ 2 / 4) ^ j / j.factorial) := by ring
  have h0 : |besselJNat n x| = ‖∑' j, besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)‖ := by
    unfold besselJNat
    exact (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
  have h1 : ‖∑' j, besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)‖
      ≤ ∑' j, ‖besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm
  have h2 : ∑' j, ‖besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)‖
      ≤ ∑' j, (|x| / 2) ^ n / n.factorial * ((x ^ 2 / 4) ^ j / j.factorial) :=
    hnorm.tsum_le_tsum hbound (hexp.summable.mul_left _)
  have h3 : ∑' j, (|x| / 2) ^ n / n.factorial * ((x ^ 2 / 4) ^ j / j.factorial)
      = (|x| / 2) ^ n / n.factorial * Real.exp (x ^ 2 / 4) := by
    rw [tsum_mul_left, hexp.tsum_eq]
  rw [h0, ← h3]
  exact h1.trans h2

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_besselJNat_le_stirling
statement:
theorem abs_besselJNat_le_stirling {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (x : ℝ) :
    |besselJNat n x|
      ≤ Real.exp (x ^ 2 / 4) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * n) * (Real.exp 1 * |x| / (2 * n)) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hs := Stirling.le_factorial_stirling n
  have hn' : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * n) * (n / Real.exp 1) ^ n := by positivity
  calc |besselJNat n x| ≤ (|x| / 2) ^ n / n.factorial * Real.exp (x ^ 2 / 4) :=
        abs_besselJNat_le n x
    _ ≤ (|x| / 2) ^ n / (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * n) * (n / Real.exp 1) ^ n)
          * Real.exp (x ^ 2 / 4) := by gcongr
    _ = Real.exp (x ^ 2 / 4) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * n) * (Real.exp 1 * |x| / (2 * n)) ^ n := by
        rw [div_pow, div_pow, div_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow]
        field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_besselJNat_atTop
statement: theorem tendsto_besselJNat_atTop (x : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun n => besselJNat n x) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (|x| / 2) ^ n / n.factorial * Real.exp (x ^ 2 / 4)) atTop
      (𝓝 (0 * Real.exp (x ^ 2 / 4))) :=
    (FloorSemiring.tendsto_pow_div_factorial_atTop (|x| / 2)).mul_const _
  rw [zero_mul] at h
  exact squeeze_zero_norm (fun n => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact abs_besselJNat_le n x) h

name: Azurite.BZ.rpow_two_thirds_sqrt
statement:
theorem rpow_two_thirds_sqrt {n : ℝ} (hn : 0 ≤ n) :
    Real.sqrt (n ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) = n ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hn]; norm_num

name: Azurite.BZ.div_rpow_two_thirds
statement: theorem div_rpow_two_thirds {n : ℝ} (hn : 0 < n) : n / n ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) = n ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_iff (by positivity), ← Real.rpow_add hn]; norm_num

name: Azurite.BZ.splitCost_ge
statement:
theorem splitCost_ge {n d M : ℝ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    n ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * M ≤ splitCost n d M
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by linarith
  unfold splitCost
  have h3 : 0 ≤ d * n := by positivity
  rcases le_or_gt d (n ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) with h | h
  · have : n ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ n / d := by
      rw [← div_rpow_two_thirds hn0]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hn0.le (by linarith) h
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg d, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this hM]
  · have : n ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt d := by
      rw [← rpow_two_thirds_sqrt hn0.le]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h.le
    have h1 : 0 ≤ n / d * M := by positivity
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this hM]

name: Azurite.BZ.splitCost_le_case1
statement:
theorem splitCost_le_case1 {n M : ℝ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hM : n ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ M) :
    splitCost n (n ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) M ≤ 3 * n ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * M
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by linarith
  unfold splitCost
  rw [div_rpow_two_thirds hn0, rpow_two_thirds_sqrt hn0.le]
  have h3 : n ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * n = n ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * n ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hn0, show (1 / 3 : ℝ) + 4 / 3 = 2 / 3 + 1 by norm_num, Real.rpow_add hn0,
      Real.rpow_one]
  have h13 : 0 ≤ n ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by positivity
  rw [h3]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hM h13]

name: Azurite.BZ.splitCost_le_case2
statement:
theorem splitCost_le_case2 {n M : ℝ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnM : n ≤ M) (hM : M ≤ n ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ)) :
    splitCost n (Real.sqrt M) M ≤ 3 * n * Real.sqrt M
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by linarith
  have hM0 : 0 < M := by linarith
  have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt M := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hM0
  unfold splitCost
  
  have h1 : n / Real.sqrt M * M = n * Real.sqrt M := by
    have : Real.sqrt M * Real.sqrt M = M := Real.mul_self_sqrt hM0.le
    field_simp
    linear_combination (-1 : ℝ) * this
  
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt M) * M ≤ n * Real.sqrt M := by
    have hq : Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt M) = M ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hM0.le]; norm_num
    have hr : Real.sqrt M = M ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_eq_rpow M
    have hq_le : M ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ n ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by
      calc M ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ (n ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow hM0.le hM (by norm_num)
        _ = n ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by rw [← Real.rpow_mul hn0.le]; norm_num
    have hr_le : M ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ n ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by
      calc M ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (n ^ (4 / 3 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow hM0.le hM (by norm_num)
        _ = n ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by rw [← Real.rpow_mul hn0.le]; norm_num
    have hprod : n ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * n ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) = n := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hn0]; norm_num
    rw [hq, hr]
    calc M ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * M ≤ n ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * M :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq_le hM0.le
      _ = n ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * M ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * M ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hM0]; norm_num
      _ ≤ n ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * n ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * M ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by gcongr
      _ = n * M ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by rw [hprod]
  have h3 : Real.sqrt M * n = n * Real.sqrt M := mul_comm _ _
  rw [h1, h3]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.rpow_three_halves_le_mul_sqrt
statement:
theorem rpow_three_halves_le_mul_sqrt {n M : ℝ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnM : n ≤ M) :
    n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ n * Real.sqrt M
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by linarith
  have : n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = n * Real.sqrt n := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, show n * n ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = n ^ (1 : ℝ) * n ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) by
      rw [Real.rpow_one], ← Real.rpow_add hn0]
    norm_num
  rw [this]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hnM) hn0.le

name: Azurite.BZ.four_thirds_lt_logb_iff
statement:
theorem four_thirds_lt_logb_iff {a b : ℝ} (hb : 1 < b) (ha : 0 < a) :
    4 / 3 < Real.logb b a ↔ b ^ 4 < a ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hlb : 0 < Real.log b := Real.log_pos hb
  rw [Real.logb, lt_div_iff₀ hlb]
  have h4 : Real.log (b ^ 4) = 4 * Real.log b := by rw [Real.log_pow]; norm_num
  have h3 : Real.log (a ^ 3) = 3 * Real.log a := by rw [Real.log_pow]; norm_num
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : Real.log (b ^ 4) < Real.log (a ^ 3) := by rw [h4, h3]; linarith
    exact (Real.log_lt_log_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)).mp this
  · intro h
    have := Real.log_lt_log (by positivity) h
    rw [h4, h3] at this
    linarith

statement:

    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => 1 - x ^ 2 * c) (-(2 * x * c)) x

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_ellipticK_integrand
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_ellipticK_integrand {x : ℝ} (hx : x ^ 2 < 1) (θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹)
      (x * Real.sin θ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) ^ 3) x
proof:
:= by
  have hΔ : 0 < 1 - x ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 := one_sub_mul_sin_sq_pos hx θ
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hΔ
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_one_sub_sq_mul x (Real.sin θ ^ 2)).sqrt hΔ.ne').inv hs.ne'
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  field_simp

proof:

proof:

name: Azurite.BZ.one_sub_sq_mul_sin_sq_ge
statement:
theorem one_sub_sq_mul_sin_sq_ge {x m : ℝ} (hxm : |x| ≤ m) (θ : ℝ) :
    1 - m ^ 2 ≤ 1 - x ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Real.sin_sq_le_one θ
  have h2 : x ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2 := by
    rw [← sq_abs x]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg x) hxm 2
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sin θ), sq_nonneg x]

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_ellipticK
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_ellipticK (hk : k ^ 2 < 1) :
    HasDerivAt ellipticK
      (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
        k * Real.sin θ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) ^ 3) k
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : |k| < 1 := by rwa [← sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one]
  set m : ℝ := (|k| + 1) / 2 with hm
  have hm1 : m < 1 := by rw [hm]; linarith
  have hm0 : 0 ≤ m := by positivity
  have hkm : |k| < m := by rw [hm]; linarith
  obtain ⟨hk_lo, hk_hi⟩ := abs_lt.mp hkm
  have hmem : Ioo (-m) m ∈ 𝓝 k := Ioo_mem_nhds hk_lo hk_hi
  have hsq : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-m) m, x ^ 2 < 1 := fun x hx => by
    have : |x| < m := abs_lt.mpr ⟨hx.1, hx.2⟩
    rw [← sq_abs x]
    exact pow_lt_one₀ (abs_nonneg x) (this.trans hm1) two_ne_zero
  have hΔm : 0 < 1 - m ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hsm : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - m ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hΔm
  have key := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := volume)
    (a := 0) (b := π / 2)
    (F := fun x θ => (Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹)
    (F' := fun x θ => x * Real.sin θ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) ^ 3)
    (bound := fun _ => m / Real.sqrt (1 - m ^ 2) ^ 3) hmem
    (Filter.eventually_of_mem hmem fun x hx =>
      (continuous_ellipticK_integrand (hsq x hx)).aestronglyMeasurable)
    ((continuous_ellipticK_integrand hk).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    (continuous_ellipticK_deriv_integrand hk).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ x hx => ?_) intervalIntegrable_const
    (Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ x hx => hasDerivAt_ellipticK_integrand (hsq x hx) θ)
  · exact key.2
  · have hx2 := hsq x hx
    have hxm : |x| ≤ m := (abs_lt.mpr ⟨hx.1, hx.2⟩).le
    have hΔ := one_sub_mul_sin_sq_pos hx2 θ
    have hΔge := one_sub_sq_mul_sin_sq_ge hxm θ
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_of_pos (pow_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hΔ) 3), abs_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (Real.sin θ))]
    refine div_le_div₀ hm0 ?_ (by positivity) ?_
    · calc |x| * Real.sin θ ^ 2 ≤ m * 1 := mul_le_mul hxm (Real.sin_sq_le_one θ) (sq_nonneg _) hm0
        _ = m := mul_one m
    · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hsm.le (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hΔge) 3

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_ellipticE
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_ellipticE (hk : k ^ 2 < 1) :
    HasDerivAt ellipticE
      (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
        -(k * Real.sin θ ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)) k
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : |k| < 1 := by rwa [← sq_lt_one_iff_abs_lt_one]
  set m : ℝ := (|k| + 1) / 2 with hm
  have hm1 : m < 1 := by rw [hm]; linarith
  have hm0 : 0 ≤ m := by positivity
  have hkm : |k| < m := by rw [hm]; linarith
  obtain ⟨hk_lo, hk_hi⟩ := abs_lt.mp hkm
  have hmem : Ioo (-m) m ∈ 𝓝 k := Ioo_mem_nhds hk_lo hk_hi
  have hsq : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (-m) m, x ^ 2 < 1 := fun x hx => by
    have : |x| < m := abs_lt.mpr ⟨hx.1, hx.2⟩
    rw [← sq_abs x]
    exact pow_lt_one₀ (abs_nonneg x) (this.trans hm1) two_ne_zero
  have hΔm : 0 < 1 - m ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hsm : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - m ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hΔm
  have key := intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := volume)
    (a := 0) (b := π / 2)
    (F := fun x θ => Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))
    (F' := fun x θ => -(x * Real.sin θ ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (1 - x ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))
    (bound := fun _ => m / Real.sqrt (1 - m ^ 2)) hmem
    (Eventually.of_forall fun x => (continuous_ellipticE_integrand x).aestronglyMeasurable)
    ((continuous_ellipticE_integrand k).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    (continuous_ellipticE_deriv_integrand hk).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ x hx => ?_) intervalIntegrable_const
    (Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ x hx => hasDerivAt_ellipticE_integrand (hsq x hx) θ)
  · exact key.2
  · have hx2 := hsq x hx
    have hxm : |x| ≤ m := (abs_lt.mpr ⟨hx.1, hx.2⟩).le
    have hΔ := one_sub_mul_sin_sq_pos hx2 θ
    have hΔge := one_sub_sq_mul_sin_sq_ge hxm θ
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_of_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hΔ), abs_neg, abs_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (Real.sin θ))]
    refine div_le_div₀ hm0 ?_ hsm (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hΔge)
    calc |x| * Real.sin θ ^ 2 ≤ m * 1 := mul_le_mul hxm (Real.sin_sq_le_one θ) (sq_nonneg _) hm0
      _ = m := mul_one m

name: Azurite.BZ.mul_ellipticE_deriv
statement:
theorem mul_ellipticE_deriv (hk : k ^ 2 < 1) :
    k * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), -(k * Real.sin θ ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)
      = ellipticE k - ellipticK k
proof:
:= by
  unfold ellipticE ellipticK
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub
    ((continuous_ellipticE_integrand k).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    ((continuous_ellipticK_integrand hk).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
  refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ _ => ?_
  have hΔ := one_sub_mul_sin_sq_pos hk θ
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hΔ
  have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt hΔ.le
  field_simp
  linear_combination -hs2

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_sin_mul_cos_div_sqrt
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_sin_mul_cos_div_sqrt (hk : k ^ 2 < 1) (θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun θ => Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))
      ((1 - 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 4)
        / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) ^ 3) θ
proof:
:= by
  have hΔ := one_sub_mul_sin_sq_pos hk θ
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hΔ
  have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt hΔ.le
  have hcos : Real.cos θ ^ 2 = 1 - Real.sin θ ^ 2 := Real.cos_sq' θ
  have hnum : HasDerivAt (fun θ => Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ)
      (Real.cos θ * Real.cos θ + Real.sin θ * -Real.sin θ) θ :=
    (Real.hasDerivAt_sin θ).mul (Real.hasDerivAt_cos θ)
  have hΔ' : HasDerivAt (fun θ => 1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)
      (-(k ^ 2 * (2 * Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ))) θ := by
    have := (((Real.hasDerivAt_sin θ).pow 2).const_mul (k ^ 2)).const_sub 1
    refine this.congr_deriv ?_
    push_cast
    ring
  have hden : HasDerivAt (fun θ => Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))
      (-(k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ) / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)) θ := by
    refine (hΔ'.sqrt hΔ.ne').congr_deriv ?_
    field_simp
  refine (hnum.div hden hs.ne').congr_deriv ?_
  set D := Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) with hD
  field_simp
  linear_combination (1 - 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) * hs2 + (Real.sin θ ^ 2 * k ^ 2 + D ^ 2) * hcos

name: Azurite.BZ.continuous_sin_cos_deriv
statement:
theorem continuous_sin_cos_deriv (hk : k ^ 2 < 1) :
    Continuous fun θ : ℝ => (1 - 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 4)
      / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) ^ 3
proof:
:=
  Continuous.div (by fun_prop) ((Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (by fun_prop)).pow 3) fun θ =>
    pow_ne_zero 3 (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (one_sub_mul_sin_sq_pos hk θ)).ne'

name: Azurite.BZ.ellipticK_deriv_identity
statement:
theorem ellipticK_deriv_identity (hk : k ^ 2 < 1) :
    k * (1 - k ^ 2) * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
        k * Real.sin θ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) ^ 3
      = ellipticE k - (1 - k ^ 2) * ellipticK k
proof:
:= by
  have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (fun θ _ => hasDerivAt_sin_mul_cos_div_sqrt hk θ)
    ((continuous_sin_cos_deriv hk).intervalIntegrable 0 (π / 2))
  have h0 : Real.sin (π / 2) * Real.cos (π / 2) / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin (π / 2) ^ 2)
      - Real.sin 0 * Real.cos 0 / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin 0 ^ 2) = 0 := by
    simp
  rw [h0] at hFTC
  have hE : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)) volume 0
      (π / 2) := (continuous_ellipticE_integrand k).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hK : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun θ : ℝ => (1 - k ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹) volume 0 (π / 2) := ((continuous_ellipticK_integrand hk).const_mul _).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hD : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun θ : ℝ => k ^ 2 * ((1 - 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 4)
        / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) ^ 3)) volume 0 (π / 2) :=
    ((continuous_sin_cos_deriv hk).const_mul _).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hpt : ∀ θ : ℝ,
      k * (1 - k ^ 2) * (k * Real.sin θ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) ^ 3)
      = Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)
        - (1 - k ^ 2) * (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹
        - k ^ 2 * ((1 - 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 4)
          / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) ^ 3) := by
    intro θ
    have hΔ := one_sub_mul_sin_sq_pos hk θ
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hΔ
    have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt hΔ.le
    field_simp
    linear_combination (-(Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)) ^ 2
      - k ^ 2 * (1 - Real.sin θ ^ 2)) * hs2
  unfold ellipticE ellipticK
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ _ => hpt θ,
    intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hE.sub hK) hD, intervalIntegral.integral_sub hE hK,
    intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hFTC]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_legendreL
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_legendreL (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk1 : k < 1) : HasDerivAt legendreL 0 k
proof:
:= by
  have hk2 : k ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
  set b := Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2) with hb
  have hb0 : 0 < b := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hb2 : b ^ 2 = 1 - k ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by nlinarith)
  have hb1 : b ^ 2 < 1 := by rw [hb2]; nlinarith
  have hb' : HasDerivAt (fun k : ℝ => Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2)) (-k / b) k := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun k : ℝ => 1 - k ^ 2) (-(2 * k)) k := by
      have := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 k).const_sub 1
      refine this.congr_deriv ?_
      push_cast
      ring
    refine (h1.sqrt (by nlinarith : (1 : ℝ) - k ^ 2 ≠ 0)).congr_deriv ?_
    rw [← hb]
    field_simp
  have hE := hasDerivAt_ellipticE hk2
  have hK := hasDerivAt_ellipticK hk2
  have hE' := (hasDerivAt_ellipticE hb1).comp k hb'
  have hK' := (hasDerivAt_ellipticK hb1).comp k hb'
  have h := ((hE.mul hK').add (hE'.mul hK)).sub (hK.mul hK')
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  have r1 := mul_ellipticE_deriv hk2
  have r2 := ellipticK_deriv_identity hk2
  have r3 := mul_ellipticE_deriv hb1
  have r4 := ellipticK_deriv_identity hb1
  have hc : -k / b * b = -k := by field_simp
  set c := -k / b with hc_def
  set E₁ := ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
    -(k * Real.sin θ ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) with hE₁
  set K₁ := ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
    k * Real.sin θ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) ^ 3 with hK₁
  set E₂ := ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
    -(b * Real.sin θ ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (1 - b ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) with hE₂
  set K₂ := ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
    b * Real.sin θ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (1 - b ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) ^ 3 with hK₂
  rw [show (1 : ℝ) - k ^ 2 = b ^ 2 from hb2.symm] at r2
  rw [show (1 : ℝ) - b ^ 2 = k ^ 2 by rw [hb2]; ring] at r4
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [← hb]
  have key : k * b ^ 2 * (E₁ * ellipticK b + ellipticE k * (K₂ * c) + (E₂ * c * ellipticK k
      + ellipticE b * K₁) - (K₁ * ellipticK b + ellipticK k * (K₂ * c))) = 0 := by
    linear_combination (b ^ 2 * ellipticK b) * r1 + (ellipticE b - ellipticK b) * r2
      - (k ^ 2 * ellipticK k) * r3 + (ellipticK k - ellipticE k) * r4
      + (ellipticE k * ellipticK b - ellipticK k * ellipticE b) * hb2
      + (k * b * (ellipticE k * K₂ + ellipticK k * E₂ - ellipticK k * K₂)) * hc
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp key).resolve_left (mul_ne_zero hk0.ne' (pow_ne_zero 2 hb0.ne'))

name: Azurite.BZ.legendreL_eq_of_lt
statement:
theorem legendreL_eq_of_lt {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b < 1) :
    legendreL a = legendreL b
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : ContinuousOn legendreL (Icc a b) := fun x hx =>
    (hasDerivAt_legendreL (by linarith [hx.1]) (by linarith [hx.2])).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope legendreL (fun _ => 0) hab hcont
    fun x hx => hasDerivAt_legendreL (by linarith [hx.1]) (by linarith [hx.2])
  have h := hc.symm
  rw [div_eq_zero_iff] at h
  rcases h with h | h
  · linarith
  · linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.ellipticE_one
statement: theorem ellipticE_one : ellipticE 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold ellipticE
  have : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.sqrt (1 - 1 ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)
      = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.cos θ := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ hθ => ?_
    rw [uIcc_of_le Real.pi_div_two_pos.le] at hθ
    have hcos : 0 ≤ Real.cos θ :=
      Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith [hθ.1, Real.pi_div_two_pos], hθ.2⟩
    simp only [one_pow, one_mul]
    rw [← Real.cos_sq', Real.sqrt_sq hcos]
  rw [this, integral_cos, Real.sin_pi_div_two, Real.sin_zero, sub_zero]

name: Azurite.BZ.ellipticE_sqrt_sub_one_bounds
statement:
theorem ellipticE_sqrt_sub_one_bounds (hk0 : 0 ≤ k) (hk1 : k ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ ellipticE (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2)) - 1
      ∧ ellipticE (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2)) - 1 ≤ π / 2 * k
proof:
:= by
  have hb2 : Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 - k ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by nlinarith)
  set b := Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2) with hb
  have hcosInt : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.cos θ = 1 := by
    rw [integral_cos, Real.sin_pi_div_two, Real.sin_zero, sub_zero]
  have hE : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => Real.sqrt (1 - b ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)) volume 0
      (π / 2) := (continuous_ellipticE_integrand b).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hC : IntervalIntegrable Real.cos volume 0 (π / 2) :=
    Real.continuous_cos.intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hsplit : ellipticE b - 1
      = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), (Real.sqrt (1 - b ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) - Real.cos θ) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hE hC, hcosInt, ellipticE]
  have hpt : ∀ θ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (π / 2),
      0 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - b ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) - Real.cos θ
        ∧ Real.sqrt (1 - b ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) - Real.cos θ ≤ k := by
    intro θ hθ
    have hcos : 0 ≤ Real.cos θ :=
      Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith [hθ.1, Real.pi_div_two_pos], hθ.2⟩
    have hs1 := Real.sin_sq_le_one θ
    have hs0 := sq_nonneg (Real.sin θ)
    set A := 1 - b ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 with hA
    set B := 1 - Real.sin θ ^ 2 with hB
    have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by rw [hB]; linarith
    have hBA : B ≤ A := by rw [hA, hB]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg b]
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := hB0.trans hBA
    have hcosB : Real.cos θ = Real.sqrt B := by
      rw [hB, ← Real.cos_sq', Real.sqrt_sq hcos]
    rw [hcosB]
    refine ⟨sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hBA), ?_⟩
    have hsq : (Real.sqrt A - Real.sqrt B) ^ 2 ≤ A - B := by
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hBA, Real.mul_self_sqrt hB0, Real.sqrt_nonneg B,
        Real.sq_sqrt hA0, Real.sq_sqrt hB0, Real.sqrt_nonneg A]
    have h1 := Real.abs_le_sqrt hsq
    have hAB : A - B = k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 := by rw [hA, hB, hb2]; ring
    have h2 : Real.sqrt (A - B) ≤ k := by
      rw [hAB]
      calc Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (k ^ 2) :=
            Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (mul_le_of_le_one_right (sq_nonneg k) hs1)
        _ = k := Real.sqrt_sq hk0
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h1.trans h2)
  have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => Real.sqrt (1 - b ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) - Real.cos θ)
      volume 0 (π / 2) := hE.sub hC
  rw [hsplit]
  constructor
  · exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg Real.pi_div_two_pos.le fun θ hθ => (hpt θ hθ).1
  · calc _ ≤ ∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), k :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on Real.pi_div_two_pos.le hint
            intervalIntegrable_const fun θ hθ => (hpt θ hθ).2
      _ = π / 2 * k := by simp [mul_comm]

name: Azurite.BZ.ellipticK_sub_ellipticE_bounds
statement:
theorem ellipticK_sub_ellipticE_bounds (hk : k ^ 2 < 1) :
    0 ≤ ellipticK k - ellipticE k ∧ ellipticK k - ellipticE k ≤ k ^ 2 * ellipticK k
proof:
:= by
  have hE : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)) volume 0
      (π / 2) := (continuous_ellipticE_integrand k).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hK : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹) volume 0
      (π / 2) := (continuous_ellipticK_integrand hk).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hsplit : ellipticK k - ellipticE k = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
      ((Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹ - Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hK hE, ellipticK, ellipticE]
  have hpt : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹
        - Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)
      ∧ (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹ - Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)
        ≤ k ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
    intro θ
    have hΔ := one_sub_mul_sin_sq_pos hk θ
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hΔ
    have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt hΔ.le
    have hs1 := Real.sin_sq_le_one θ
    have heq : (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹ - Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)
        = k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      field_simp
      linear_combination -hs2
    rw [heq]
    constructor
    · positivity
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_of_le_one_right (sq_nonneg k) hs1)
        (inv_nonneg.mpr hs.le)
  rw [hsplit]
  constructor
  · exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg Real.pi_div_two_pos.le fun θ _ => (hpt θ).1
  · calc _ ≤ ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), k ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹ :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on Real.pi_div_two_pos.le (hK.sub hE)
            (hK.const_mul _) fun θ _ => (hpt θ).2
      _ = k ^ 2 * ellipticK k := by rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ellipticK]

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_ellipticK_nhdsGT_zero
statement: theorem tendsto_ellipticK_nhdsGT_zero : Tendsto ellipticK (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (π / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2) ∈ 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ) := Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (by norm_num)
  have hlo : Tendsto (fun k : ℝ => π / 2 * (1 + k ^ 2 / 4)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (π / 2)) := by
    have := tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ))
      ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun k : ℝ => π / 2 * (1 + k ^ 2 / 4)).tendsto 0)
    simpa using this
  have hhi : Tendsto (fun k : ℝ => π / 2 * (1 + k ^ 2 / 4 + 3 / 8 * k ^ 4)) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (𝓝 (π / 2)) := by
    have := tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ))
      ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun k : ℝ => π / 2 * (1 + k ^ 2 / 4 + 3 / 8 * k ^ 4)).tendsto 0)
    simpa using this
  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' hlo hhi ?_ ?_
  · filter_upwards [hmem] with k hk
    exact (ellipticK_bounds (by nlinarith [hk.1, hk.2])).1
  · filter_upwards [hmem] with k hk
    exact (ellipticK_bounds (by nlinarith [hk.1, hk.2])).2

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_ellipticE_sqrt_nhdsGT_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_ellipticE_sqrt_nhdsGT_zero :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℝ => ellipticE (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∈ 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ) := Ioo_mem_nhdsGT one_pos
  have hhi : Tendsto (fun k : ℝ => 1 + π / 2 * k) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) := by
    have := tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ))
      ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun k : ℝ => 1 + π / 2 * k).tendsto 0)
    simpa using this
  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds hhi ?_ ?_
  · filter_upwards [hmem] with k hk
    linarith [(ellipticE_sqrt_sub_one_bounds hk.1.le hk.2.le).1]
  · filter_upwards [hmem] with k hk
    linarith [(ellipticE_sqrt_sub_one_bounds hk.1.le hk.2.le).2]

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_ellipticK_sqrt_mul_sub_nhdsGT_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_ellipticK_sqrt_mul_sub_nhdsGT_zero :
    Tendsto (fun k : ℝ => ellipticK (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2)) * (ellipticE k - ellipticK k))
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2) ∈ 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ) := Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (by norm_num)
  have h1 : Tendsto (fun k : ℝ => k ^ 2) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have := tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ))
      ((continuous_pow 2).tendsto (0 : ℝ))
    simpa using this
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun k : ℝ => Real.log k * k ^ 2) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have := tendsto_log_mul_rpow_nhdsGT_zero (r := 2) (by norm_num)
    refine this.congr fun k => ?_
    rw [Real.rpow_two]
  have hg : Tendsto (fun k : ℝ => π * Real.log 4 * k ^ 2 - π * (Real.log k * k ^ 2)
      + π / 2 * (k ^ 2 * k ^ 2) - π / 4 * (k ^ 2 * (Real.log k * k ^ 2))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have := (((h1.const_mul (π * Real.log 4)).sub (h2.const_mul π)).add
      ((h1.mul h1).const_mul (π / 2))).sub ((h1.mul h2).const_mul (π / 4))
    simpa using this
  refine squeeze_zero_norm' ?_ hg
  filter_upwards [hmem] with k hk
  obtain ⟨hk0, hk12⟩ := hk
  have hk1 : k ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hk2 : k ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2 := by nlinarith
  have hk2' : k ^ 2 < 1 := by linarith
  have hKb := abs_ellipticK_sqrt_sub_log_le hk0 hk1
  have hKpos : 0 < ellipticK (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2)) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le Real.pi_div_two_pos
      (pi_div_two_le_ellipticK (by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)]; nlinarith))
  have hKk := ellipticK_bounds hk2
  have hKle : ellipticK k ≤ π := by nlinarith [hKk.2, Real.pi_pos]
  have hsub := ellipticK_sub_ellipticE_bounds hk2'
  have hlogk : Real.log k ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hk0.le hk1
  have hlog4 : Real.log (4 / k) = Real.log 4 - Real.log k :=
    Real.log_div (by norm_num) hk0.ne'
  have hKb' : ellipticK (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2))
      ≤ Real.log 4 - Real.log k + k ^ 2 / 4 * (2 - Real.log k) := by
    have := (abs_le.mp hKb).2
    linarith
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hKpos, abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg hsub.1]
  calc ellipticK (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2)) * (ellipticK k - ellipticE k)
      ≤ (Real.log 4 - Real.log k + k ^ 2 / 4 * (2 - Real.log k)) * (k ^ 2 * π) := by
        refine mul_le_mul hKb' (hsub.2.trans ?_) hsub.1 ?_
        · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hKle (sq_nonneg k)
        · linarith
    _ = π * Real.log 4 * k ^ 2 - π * (Real.log k * k ^ 2)
      + π / 2 * (k ^ 2 * k ^ 2) - π / 4 * (k ^ 2 * (Real.log k * k ^ 2)) := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_legendreL_nhdsGT_zero
statement: theorem tendsto_legendreL_nhdsGT_zero : Tendsto legendreL (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (π / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have h := tendsto_ellipticK_sqrt_mul_sub_nhdsGT_zero.add
    (tendsto_ellipticE_sqrt_nhdsGT_zero.mul tendsto_ellipticK_nhdsGT_zero)
  rw [zero_add, one_mul] at h
  refine h.congr fun k => ?_
  unfold legendreL
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.legendreL_eq
statement: theorem legendreL_eq (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk1 : k < 1) : legendreL k = π / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : Tendsto legendreL (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (legendreL k)) := by
    refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hk0] with a ha
    exact (legendreL_eq_of_lt ha.1 ha.2 hk1).symm
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hconst tendsto_legendreL_nhdsGT_zero

name: Azurite.BZ.legendre_relation
statement:
theorem legendre_relation (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk1 : k < 1) :
    ellipticE k * ellipticK (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2))
      + ellipticE (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2)) * ellipticK k
      - ellipticK k * ellipticK (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2)) = π / 2
proof:
:=
  legendreL_eq hk0 hk1

name: Azurite.BZ.legendre_relation_sqrt_half
statement:
theorem legendre_relation_sqrt_half :
    2 * ellipticE (1 / Real.sqrt 2) * ellipticK (1 / Real.sqrt 2)
      - ellipticK (1 / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 = π / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := by positivity
  have hk : Real.sqrt (1 - (1 / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2) = 1 / Real.sqrt 2 := by
    rw [div_pow, one_pow, Real.sq_sqrt zero_le_two, show (1 : ℝ) - 1 / 2 = 2⁻¹ by norm_num,
      Real.sqrt_inv, one_div]
  have hk0 : 0 < 1 / Real.sqrt 2 := by positivity
  have hk1 : 1 / Real.sqrt 2 < 1 := by
    rw [div_lt_one h2, Real.lt_sqrt zero_le_one]
    norm_num
  have h := legendre_relation hk0 hk1
  rw [hk] at h
  linear_combination h

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_cauchy_coeff
statement:
theorem hasSum_cauchy_coeff {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.closedBall 0 1))
    {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun j : ℕ => ((2 * Real.pi * I)⁻¹ * ∮ w in C(0, 1), f w / w ^ (j + 1)) * z ^ j)
      (f z)
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.closedBall 0 ((1 : NNReal) : ℝ)) := by simpa using hf
  have h := hf'.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall one_pos
  have hz' : z ∈ Metric.eball (0 : ℂ) ((1 : NNReal) : ENNReal) := by
    rw [Metric.mem_eball, edist_dist, dist_zero_right, ENNReal.coe_one, ← ENNReal.ofReal_one]
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff one_pos).mpr hz
  have h2 := h.hasSum hz'
  rw [zero_add] at h2
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one] at h2
  convert h2 using 1
  funext n
  rw [cauchyPowerSeries_apply]
  simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
  have e' : (∮ w in C(0, 1), (z / w) ^ n * (w⁻¹ * f w))
      = z ^ n * ∮ w in C(0, 1), f w / w ^ (n + 1) := by
    rw [← circleIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext w
    rw [div_pow, pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [e']
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_zpow_primitiveRoot
statement:
theorem sum_zpow_primitiveRoot {ζ : ℂ} {k : ℕ} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ k) (d : ℤ) :
    ∑ m ∈ range k, (ζ ^ d) ^ m = if (k : ℤ) ∣ d then (k : ℂ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [(hζ.zpow_eq_one_iff_dvd d).mpr h]
    simp
  · have hne : ζ ^ d ≠ 1 := fun h1 => h ((hζ.zpow_eq_one_iff_dvd d).mp h1)
    rw [geom_sum_eq hne, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, mul_comm, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast,
      hζ.pow_eq_one, one_zpow, sub_self, zero_div]

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_mul_zpow_pow
statement:
theorem summable_mul_zpow_pow (ha : Summable fun l => ‖a l‖) {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ‖ζ‖ = 1) (d : ℤ)
    (m : ℕ) : Summable fun l : ℕ => a l * (ζ ^ ((l : ℤ) - d)) ^ m
proof:
:=
  Summable.of_norm_bounded ha fun l => by
    rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_zpow, hζ, one_zpow, one_pow, mul_one]

name: Azurite.BZ.aliasSum_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem aliasSum_eq_tsum (ha : Summable fun l => ‖a l‖) {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j < k) :
    aliasSum a j k = ∑' m : ℕ, a (j + m * k)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : 0 < k := by omega
  have hk0 : (k : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk.ne'
  set ζ : ℂ := exp (2 * Real.pi * I / k) with hζdef
  have hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ k := Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp k hk.ne'
  have hζ0 : ζ ≠ 0 := hζ.ne_zero hk.ne'
  have hnorm : ‖ζ‖ = 1 := hζ.norm'_eq_one hk.ne'
  have hterm : ∀ m : ℕ, (∑' l : ℕ, a l * (ζ ^ m) ^ l) * ζ⁻¹ ^ (j * m)
      = ∑' l : ℕ, a l * (ζ ^ ((l : ℤ) - j)) ^ m := by
    intro m
    rw [← tsum_mul_right]
    refine tsum_congr fun l => ?_
    rw [mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    simp only [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
    rw [inv_zpow, ← zpow_neg, ← zpow_add₀ hζ0]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  unfold aliasSum
  rw [← hζdef]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [← Summable.tsum_finsetSum fun m _ => summable_mul_zpow_pow ha hnorm j m]
  simp_rw [← mul_sum, sum_zpow_primitiveRoot hζ]
  rw [← tsum_mul_left]
  have hite : ∀ l : ℕ, (1 / k : ℂ) * (a l * if (k : ℤ) ∣ (l : ℤ) - j then (k : ℂ) else 0)
      = if (k : ℤ) ∣ (l : ℤ) - j then a l else 0 := by
    intro l
    split_ifs
    · field_simp
    · simp
  simp_rw [hite]
  symm
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun m : ℕ => j + m * k := fun m₁ m₂ h => by
    have : m₁ * k = m₂ * k := by simpa using h
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hk this
  have hsupp : Function.support (fun l : ℕ => if (k : ℤ) ∣ (l : ℤ) - j then a l else 0)
      ⊆ Set.range fun m : ℕ => j + m * k := by
    intro l hl
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hl
    have hdvd : (k : ℤ) ∣ (l : ℤ) - j := by
      by_contra h
      exact hl (ite_eq_right h)
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hdvd
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      have hjk' : (j : ℤ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hjk
      have hl0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ l := by positivity
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show q ≤ -1 by omega) (show (0 : ℤ) ≤ k by positivity)]
    refine ⟨q.toNat, ?_⟩
    show j + q.toNat * k = l
    zify
    rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hq0]
    linarith
  calc ∑' m : ℕ, a (j + m * k)
      = ∑' m : ℕ, (if (k : ℤ) ∣ ((j + m * k : ℕ) : ℤ) - j then a (j + m * k) else 0) :=
        tsum_congr fun m => by
          rw [ite_eq_left]
          push_cast
          exact ⟨m, by ring⟩
    _ = _ := hinj.tsum_eq hsupp

name: Azurite.BZ.aliasSum_sub_eq
statement:
theorem aliasSum_sub_eq (ha : Summable fun l => ‖a l‖) {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j < k) :
    aliasSum a j k - a j = ∑' m : ℕ, a (j + (m + 1) * k)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : 0 < k := by omega
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun m : ℕ => j + m * k := fun m₁ m₂ h => by
    have : m₁ * k = m₂ * k := by simpa using h
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hk this
  have hs : Summable fun m : ℕ => a (j + m * k) := ha.of_norm.comp_injective hinj
  rw [aliasSum_eq_tsum ha hjk, ← Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add' (f := fun m => a (j + m * k))
    (k := 1) ((summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun m => a (j + m * k)) 1).mpr hs), sum_range_one]
  simp only [zero_mul, add_zero]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_norm_of_le
statement:
theorem summable_norm_of_le {C r : ℝ} (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hC : ∀ l, ‖a l‖ ≤ C * r ^ l) :
    Summable fun l => ‖a l‖
proof:
:=
  ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr0 hr1).mul_left C).of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hC

name: Azurite.BZ.norm_aliasSum_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_aliasSum_sub_le {C r : ℝ} (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1)
    (hC : ∀ l, ‖a l‖ ≤ C * r ^ l) {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j < k) :
    ‖aliasSum a j k - a j‖ ≤ C * r ^ (j + k) / (1 - r ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : 0 < k := by omega
  have ha := summable_norm_of_le hr0 hr1 hC
  have hrk : r ^ k < 1 := pow_lt_one₀ hr0 hr1 hk.ne'
  have hrk0 : 0 ≤ r ^ k := pow_nonneg hr0 k
  rw [aliasSum_sub_eq ha hjk]
  have hbound : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖a (j + (m + 1) * k)‖ ≤ C * r ^ (j + k) * (r ^ k) ^ m := by
    intro m
    refine (hC _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [← pow_mul, mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
    congr 2
    ring
  have hgeo : Summable fun m : ℕ => C * r ^ (j + k) * (r ^ k) ^ m :=
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hrk0 hrk).mul_left _
  have hnorm : Summable fun m : ℕ => ‖a (j + (m + 1) * k)‖ :=
    hgeo.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hbound
  calc ‖∑' m : ℕ, a (j + (m + 1) * k)‖ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖a (j + (m + 1) * k)‖ :=
        norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm
    _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, C * r ^ (j + k) * (r ^ k) ^ m := hnorm.tsum_le_tsum hbound hgeo
    _ = C * r ^ (j + k) / (1 - r ^ k) := by
        rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hrk0 hrk, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Azurite.BZ.bernoulliCoeff_two_mul
statement: theorem bernoulliCoeff_two_mul (j : ℕ) : bernoulliCoeff (2 * j) = (scaledBernoulli j : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bernoulliCoeff, coeff_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_even]

name: Azurite.BZ.bernoulliCoeff_odd
statement: theorem bernoulliCoeff_odd (j : ℕ) : bernoulliCoeff (2 * j + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bernoulliCoeff, coeff_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_odd]
  simp

name: Azurite.BZ.bernoulliCoeff_eq
statement:
theorem bernoulliCoeff_eq {l : ℕ} (hl : l ≠ 1) :
    bernoulliCoeff l = ((bernoulli l / l.factorial : ℚ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl | rfl⟩ := Nat.even_or_odd' l
  · rw [bernoulliCoeff_two_mul, scaledBernoulli]
  · rw [bernoulliCoeff_odd, bernoulli_eq_zero_of_odd ⟨j, by ring⟩ (by omega)]
    simp

name: Azurite.BZ.norm_bernoulliCoeff_le
statement:
theorem norm_bernoulliCoeff_le (l : ℕ) :
    ‖bernoulliCoeff l‖ ≤ Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ l
proof:
:= by
  have hpi := Real.pi_gt_three
  have hC : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.pi ^ 2 / 3 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨j, rfl | rfl⟩ := Nat.even_or_odd' l
  · rw [bernoulliCoeff_two_mul]
    have hnorm : ‖(scaledBernoulli j : ℂ)‖ = |(scaledBernoulli j : ℝ)| := by
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_ratCast, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [hnorm]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj
    · simp [scaledBernoulli_zero]
      linarith
    · refine (abs_scaledBernoulli_le hj).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      rw [one_div_pow, div_eq_mul_one_div]
  · rw [bernoulliCoeff_odd, norm_zero]
    positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.bernoulli_aliasSum_sub_eq
statement:
theorem bernoulli_aliasSum_sub_eq {j k : ℕ} (hjk : 2 * j < k) :
    aliasSum bernoulliCoeff (2 * j) k - (scaledBernoulli j : ℂ)
      = ∑' m : ℕ, bernoulliCoeff (2 * j + (m + 1) * k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bernoulliCoeff_two_mul]
  exact aliasSum_sub_eq (summable_norm_of_le (by positivity)
    (by rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]; linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]) norm_bernoulliCoeff_le) hjk

name: Azurite.BZ.two_mul_le_norm_scaledBernoulli
statement:
theorem two_mul_le_norm_scaledBernoulli {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    2 * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ (2 * j) ≤ ‖(scaledBernoulli j : ℂ)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_ratCast, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, scaledBernoulli_eq_zeta hj,
    abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul, abs_two,
    abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * j)),
    abs_of_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (one_le_zetaReal_two_mul hj)), one_div_pow,
    div_eq_mul_one_div, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  have := one_le_zetaReal_two_mul hj
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * Real.pi) ^ (2 * j) := by positivity
  rw [one_mul, mul_assoc, one_div_mul_cancel hpos.ne', mul_one]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.norm_bernoulli_aliasSum_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_bernoulli_aliasSum_sub_le {j k : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjk : 2 * j < k) :
    ‖aliasSum bernoulliCoeff (2 * j) k - (scaledBernoulli j : ℂ)‖
      ≤ Real.pi ^ 2 / 6 * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ k / (1 - (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ k)
        * ‖(scaledBernoulli j : ℂ)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  have hr1 : 1 / (2 * Real.pi) < 1 := by
    rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]
    linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
  have hk : 0 < k := by omega
  have hrk : (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ k < 1 := pow_lt_one₀ hr0 hr1 hk.ne'
  have h := norm_aliasSum_sub_le (a := bernoulliCoeff) hr0 hr1 norm_bernoulliCoeff_le hjk
  rw [bernoulliCoeff_two_mul] at h
  have hB := two_mul_le_norm_scaledBernoulli hj
  refine h.trans ?_
  have hD : 0 < 1 - (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ k := by linarith
  have e : Real.pi ^ 2 / 6 * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ k / (1 - (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ k)
      * ‖(scaledBernoulli j : ℂ)‖
      = Real.pi ^ 2 / 6 * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ k * ‖(scaledBernoulli j : ℂ)‖
        / (1 - (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ k) := by ring
  rw [pow_add, e, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hD]
  have hR : 0 ≤ Real.pi ^ 2 / 6 * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ k := by positivity
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB hR]

name: Azurite.BZ.cubicStep_inverseRootFun_one
statement:
theorem cubicStep_inverseRootFun_one (y : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    cubicStep (inverseRootFun 1 y) (inverseRootFun' 1) (inverseRootFun'' 1) x
      = x + x * (1 - x * y) + x * (1 - x * y) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold cubicStep inverseRootFun inverseRootFun' inverseRootFun''
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.cubicStep_log
statement:
theorem cubicStep_log (y : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    cubicStep (fun x => y - log x) (fun x => -x⁻¹) (fun x => (x ^ 2)⁻¹) x
      = x + x * (y - log x) + x * (y - log x) ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold cubicStep
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.recipOrderStep_two
statement: theorem recipOrderStep_two (y x : α) : recipOrderStep 2 y x = ringReciprocalStep y x
proof:
:= by
  simp [recipOrderStep, ringReciprocalStep, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.recipOrderStep_three
statement:
theorem recipOrderStep_three (y x : α) :
    recipOrderStep 3 y x = x + x * (1 - x * y) + x * (1 - x * y) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [recipOrderStep, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.ringRecipError_recipOrderStep
statement:
theorem ringRecipError_recipOrderStep (k : ℕ) (y x : α) :
    ringRecipError y (recipOrderStep k y x) = ringRecipError y x ^ k
proof:
:= by
  unfold ringRecipError recipOrderStep
  have h := mul_neg_geom_sum (1 - x * y) k
  linear_combination -h

name: Azurite.BZ.ringRecipError_recipOrderSeq
statement:
theorem ringRecipError_recipOrderSeq (k : ℕ) (y x₀ : α) (j : ℕ) :
    ringRecipError y (recipOrderSeq k y x₀ j) = ringRecipError y x₀ ^ (k ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [recipOrderSeq]
  | succ j ih =>
    show ringRecipError y (recipOrderStep k y (recipOrderSeq k y x₀ j)) = _
    rw [ringRecipError_recipOrderStep, ih, ← pow_mul, pow_succ]

name: Azurite.BZ.inv_eq_mul_tsum_geometric
statement:
theorem inv_eq_mul_tsum_geometric {y x : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (hε : |1 - x * y| < 1) :
    y⁻¹ = x * ∑' m : ℕ, (1 - x * y) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [tsum_geometric_of_abs_lt_one hε, sub_sub_cancel]
  have hxy : x * y ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h, sub_zero, abs_one] at hε; exact lt_irrefl _ hε
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hxy
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.expOrderStep_two
statement: theorem expOrderStep_two (y x : ℝ) : expOrderStep 2 y x = expStep y x
proof:
:= by
  simp [expOrderStep, expStep, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.expOrderStep_three
statement:
theorem expOrderStep_three (y x : ℝ) :
    expOrderStep 3 y x = x + x * (y - log x) + x * (y - log x) ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [expOrderStep, Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_eq_mul_exp_sub_log
statement: theorem exp_eq_mul_exp_sub_log (y : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : exp y = x * exp (y - log x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [exp_sub, exp_log hx, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hx.ne']

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_eq_mul_tsum
statement:
theorem exp_eq_mul_tsum (y : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    exp y = x * ∑' m : ℕ, (y - log x) ^ m / m.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [exp_eq_mul_exp_sub_log y hx, Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ, NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum_div]

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_expOrderStep_sub_exp_le
statement:
theorem abs_expOrderStep_sub_exp_le {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (y : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hε : |y - log x| ≤ 1) :
    |expOrderStep k y x - exp y|
      ≤ x * (|y - log x| ^ k * ((k + 1 : ℕ) / (k.factorial * k : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.exp_bound hε hk
  rw [expOrderStep, exp_eq_mul_exp_sub_log y hx, ← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hx, abs_sub_comm]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hx.le

name: Azurite.BZ.one_le_sqrt_one_add_sq
statement: theorem one_le_sqrt_one_add_sq (t : ℝ) : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.le_sqrt zero_le_one (by positivity)]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]

name: Azurite.BZ.sqrt_one_add_sq_le
statement: theorem sqrt_one_add_sq_le (t : ℝ) : Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2) ≤ 1 + t ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t ^ 2)]

name: Azurite.BZ.one_sub_inv_sqrt_le
statement: theorem one_sub_inv_sqrt_le (t : ℝ) : 1 - (Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2))⁻¹ ≤ t ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  set s := Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2) with hs_def
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = 1 + t ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have h1 : 1 ≤ s := one_le_sqrt_one_add_sq t
  have hs : 0 < s := by linarith
  have ht2 : t ^ 2 = s ^ 2 - 1 := by linarith
  rw [sub_le_iff_le_add, inv_eq_one_div, div_add_div _ _ two_ne_zero hs.ne',
    le_div_iff₀ (by positivity), ht2]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h1) (sub_nonneg.mpr h1))
    (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ s + 2)]

name: Azurite.BZ.one_sub_inv_sqrt_nonneg
statement: theorem one_sub_inv_sqrt_nonneg (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ 1 - (Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2))⁻¹
proof:
:=
  sub_nonneg.mpr (inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (one_le_sqrt_one_add_sq t))

name: Azurite.BZ.le_sqrt_sq_add_sq
statement: theorem le_sqrt_sq_add_sq (ht : 0 ≤ t) : t ≤ Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.le_sqrt ht (by positivity)]
  nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.inv_sub_inv_sqrt_nonneg
statement:
theorem inv_sub_inv_sqrt_nonneg (ht : 0 < t) :
    0 ≤ t⁻¹ - (Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + t ^ 2))⁻¹
proof:
:=
  sub_nonneg.mpr (inv_anti₀ ht (le_sqrt_sq_add_sq ht.le))

name: Azurite.BZ.inv_sub_inv_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem inv_sub_inv_sqrt_le (hk : 0 < k) (ht : 0 < t) :
    t⁻¹ - (Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + t ^ 2))⁻¹ ≤ k ^ 2 / (2 * t ^ 3)
proof:
:= by
  set u := Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + t ^ 2) with hu_def
  have hu2 : u ^ 2 = k ^ 2 + t ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have htu : t ≤ u := le_sqrt_sq_add_sq ht.le
  have hu : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le ht htu
  have hk2 : k ^ 2 = u ^ 2 - t ^ 2 := by linarith
  rw [inv_eq_one_div, inv_eq_one_div, div_sub_div _ _ ht.ne' hu.ne',
    div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < t * u) (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * t ^ 3), hk2]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_self_nonneg (u - t)) ht.le)
    (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ u + 2 * t)]

name: Azurite.BZ.agmKernel_one_eq
statement:
theorem agmKernel_one_eq (k t : ℝ) :
    agmKernel 1 k t = (Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2))⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + t ^ 2))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold agmKernel
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ t ^ 2 + 1 ^ 2) (t ^ 2 + k ^ 2), mul_inv, one_pow,
    add_comm (t ^ 2) 1, add_comm (t ^ 2) (k ^ 2)]

name: Azurite.BZ.continuous_inv_sqrt_sq_add
statement:
theorem continuous_inv_sqrt_sq_add (hk : 0 < k) :
    Continuous fun t : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + t ^ 2))⁻¹
proof:
:=
  (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.pow 2)).sqrt.inv₀ fun t =>
    (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by show (0 : ℝ) < k ^ 2 + t ^ 2; positivity)).ne'

name: Azurite.BZ.continuous_agmLogPhi
statement: theorem continuous_agmLogPhi : Continuous agmLogPhi
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Continuous fun t : ℝ => Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2) :=
    (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.pow 2)).sqrt
  exact continuous_id.div (hs.mul (continuous_const.add hs)) fun t => by positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.agmLogPhi_eq
statement:
theorem agmLogPhi_eq (ht : 0 < t) :
    agmLogPhi t = (1 - (Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2))⁻¹) * t⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  set s := Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2) with hs_def
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = 1 + t ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hs : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  rw [agmLogPhi, ← hs_def, div_eq_iff (by positivity)]
  field_simp
  linear_combination -hs2

name: Azurite.BZ.continuous_agmLogRem
statement: theorem continuous_agmLogRem (hk : 0 < k) : Continuous (agmLogRem k)
proof:
:=
  ((continuous_agmKernel one_pos hk).sub (continuous_inv_sqrt_sq_add hk)).add continuous_agmLogPhi

name: Azurite.BZ.agmLogRem_eq
statement:
theorem agmLogRem_eq (ht : 0 < t) :
    agmLogRem k t = (1 - (Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2))⁻¹) * (t⁻¹ - (Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + t ^ 2))⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [agmLogRem, agmKernel_one_eq, agmLogPhi_eq ht]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.agmLogRem_zero
statement: theorem agmLogRem_zero (k : ℝ) : agmLogRem k 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [agmLogRem, agmKernel, agmLogPhi]

name: Azurite.BZ.agmLogRem_nonneg
statement: theorem agmLogRem_nonneg (ht : 0 ≤ t) : 0 ≤ agmLogRem k t
proof:
:= by
  rcases ht.eq_or_lt with rfl | ht
  · rw [agmLogRem_zero]
  · rw [agmLogRem_eq ht]
    exact mul_nonneg (one_sub_inv_sqrt_nonneg t) (inv_sub_inv_sqrt_nonneg ht)

name: Azurite.BZ.agmLogRem_le_half
statement: theorem agmLogRem_le_half (ht : 0 ≤ t) : agmLogRem k t ≤ t / 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases ht.eq_or_lt with rfl | ht
  · rw [agmLogRem_zero]; simp
  · rw [agmLogRem_eq ht]
    have h2 : t⁻¹ - (Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + t ^ 2))⁻¹ ≤ t⁻¹ := by
      linarith [inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg (k ^ 2 + t ^ 2))]
    calc _ ≤ t ^ 2 / 2 * t⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul (one_sub_inv_sqrt_le t) h2 (inv_sub_inv_sqrt_nonneg ht) (by positivity)
      _ = t / 2 := by field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.agmLogRem_le_div
statement: theorem agmLogRem_le_div (hk : 0 < k) (ht : 0 < t) : agmLogRem k t ≤ k ^ 2 / (4 * t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [agmLogRem_eq ht]
  calc _ ≤ t ^ 2 / 2 * (k ^ 2 / (2 * t ^ 3)) :=
        mul_le_mul (one_sub_inv_sqrt_le t) (inv_sub_inv_sqrt_le hk ht)
          (inv_sub_inv_sqrt_nonneg ht) (by positivity)
    _ = k ^ 2 / (4 * t) := by field_simp; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_inv_sqrt_sq_add
statement:
theorem integral_inv_sqrt_sq_add (hk : 0 < k) :
    ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + t ^ 2))⁻¹ = arsinh (1 / k)
proof:
:= by
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := hk.ne'
  have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivAt (fun y => arsinh (y / k)) ((Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + x ^ 2))⁻¹) x := by
    intro x _
    refine ((hasDerivAt_id' (x := x)).div_const k).arsinh.congr_deriv ?_
    have : Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + x ^ 2) = k * Real.sqrt (1 + (x / k) ^ 2) := by
      rw [show k ^ 2 + x ^ 2 = k ^ 2 * (1 + (x / k) ^ 2) by field_simp,
        Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k ^ 2) (1 + (x / k) ^ 2), Real.sqrt_sq hk.le]
    rw [this, smul_eq_mul, mul_inv]
    ring
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv
    ((continuous_inv_sqrt_sq_add hk).intervalIntegrable 0 1)]
  simp

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_agmLogPhi
statement:
theorem integral_agmLogPhi :
    ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, agmLogPhi t = Real.log (1 + Real.sqrt 2) - Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivAt (fun y => Real.log (1 + Real.sqrt (1 + y ^ 2))) (agmLogPhi x) x := by
    intro x _
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => 1 + y ^ 2) (2 * x) x := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).const_add 1
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
    have h2 := (h1.sqrt (by positivity)).const_add 1
    refine (h2.log (by positivity)).congr_deriv ?_
    unfold agmLogPhi
    field_simp
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv
    (continuous_agmLogPhi.intervalIntegrable 0 1)]
  norm_num

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_neg_arsinh_inv
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_neg_arsinh_inv {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => -arsinh y⁻¹) ((x * Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2))⁻¹) x
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := hx.ne'
  refine ((hasDerivAt_inv hx0).arsinh.neg).congr_deriv ?_
  have : Real.sqrt (1 + (x⁻¹) ^ 2) = Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2) / x := by
    rw [show 1 + (x⁻¹) ^ 2 = (1 + x ^ 2) / x ^ 2 by field_simp; ring,
      Real.sqrt_div (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + x ^ 2) (x ^ 2), Real.sqrt_sq hx.le]
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  rw [this, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_neg_arsinh_inv
statement:
theorem tendsto_neg_arsinh_inv :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => -arsinh y⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero (𝕜 := ℝ)).arsinh.neg

name: Azurite.BZ.integrableOn_inv_mul_sqrt_Ioi
statement:
theorem integrableOn_inv_mul_sqrt_Ioi :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => (t * Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2))⁻¹) (Ioi 1)
proof:
:=
  integrableOn_Ioi_deriv_of_nonneg' (g := fun y : ℝ => -arsinh y⁻¹) (l := 0)
