    (fun x hx => hasDerivAt_neg_arsinh_inv (by linarith [mem_Ici.mp hx]))
    (fun x hx => by
      have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith [mem_Ioi.mp hx]
      positivity)
    tendsto_neg_arsinh_inv

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_inv_mul_sqrt_Ioi
statement:
theorem integral_inv_mul_sqrt_Ioi :
    ∫ t in Ioi (1 : ℝ), (t * Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2))⁻¹ = arsinh 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_nonneg' (a := 1) (g := fun y : ℝ => -arsinh y⁻¹)
    (g' := fun t => (t * Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2))⁻¹) (l := 0)
    (fun x hx => hasDerivAt_neg_arsinh_inv (by linarith [mem_Ici.mp hx]))
    (fun x hx => by
      have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith [mem_Ioi.mp hx]
      positivity)
    tendsto_neg_arsinh_inv
  simpa using h

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_agmKernel_Ioi
statement:
theorem integral_agmKernel_Ioi (hk : 0 < k) :
    ∃ R₁, 0 ≤ R₁ ∧ R₁ ≤ k ^ 2 / 4 ∧ ∫ t in Ioi (1 : ℝ), agmKernel 1 k t = arsinh 1 - R₁
proof:
:= by
  have hint : IntegrableOn (agmKernel 1 k) (Ioi 1) := (integrable_agmKernel one_pos hk).integrableOn
  have hint1 := integrableOn_inv_mul_sqrt_Ioi
  refine ⟨∫ t in Ioi (1 : ℝ), ((t * Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2))⁻¹ - agmKernel 1 k t), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Ioi fun t ht => ?_
    have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith [mem_Ioi.mp ht]
    rw [mul_comm t, mul_inv, agmKernel_one_eq, sub_nonneg]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inv_anti₀ ht0 (le_sqrt_sq_add_sq ht0.le))
      (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  · have hbound : ∀ t ∈ Ioi (1 : ℝ),
        (t * Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2))⁻¹ - agmKernel 1 k t ≤ k ^ 2 / 2 * t ^ (-3 : ℝ) := by
      intro t ht
      have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith [mem_Ioi.mp ht]
      rw [mul_comm t, mul_inv, agmKernel_one_eq, ← mul_sub, Real.rpow_neg ht0.le,
        show (3 : ℝ) = ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]
      calc (Real.sqrt (1 + t ^ 2))⁻¹ * (t⁻¹ - (Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + t ^ 2))⁻¹)
          ≤ 1 * (k ^ 2 / (2 * t ^ 3)) :=
            mul_le_mul (inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (one_le_sqrt_one_add_sq t))
              (inv_sub_inv_sqrt_le hk ht0) (inv_sub_inv_sqrt_nonneg ht0) zero_le_one
        _ = k ^ 2 / 2 * (t ^ 3)⁻¹ := by ring
    have hint2 : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => k ^ 2 / 2 * t ^ (-3 : ℝ)) (Ioi 1) :=
      Integrable.const_mul (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by norm_num) one_pos) _
    calc _ ≤ ∫ t in Ioi (1 : ℝ), k ^ 2 / 2 * t ^ (-3 : ℝ) :=
          setIntegral_mono_on (hint1.sub hint) hint2 measurableSet_Ioi hbound
      _ = k ^ 2 / 4 := by
          rw [integral_const_mul, integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by norm_num) one_pos]
          norm_num
          ring
  · rw [integral_sub hint1 hint, integral_inv_mul_sqrt_Ioi]
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_agmKernel_Ioc
statement:
theorem integral_agmKernel_Ioc (hk : 0 < k) (hk1 : k ≤ 1) :
    ∃ R₂, 0 ≤ R₂ ∧ R₂ ≤ k ^ 2 / 4 * (1 - Real.log k) ∧
      ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, agmKernel 1 k t
        = arsinh (1 / k) - (Real.log (1 + Real.sqrt 2) - Real.log 2) + R₂
proof:
:= by
  have hK : IntervalIntegrable (agmKernel 1 k) volume 0 1 :=
    (continuous_agmKernel one_pos hk).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hU : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + t ^ 2))⁻¹) volume 0 1 :=
    (continuous_inv_sqrt_sq_add hk).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hP : IntervalIntegrable agmLogPhi volume 0 1 := continuous_agmLogPhi.intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hR : Continuous (agmLogRem k) := continuous_agmLogRem hk
  refine ⟨∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, agmLogRem k t, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one fun t ht => agmLogRem_nonneg ht.1
  · rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hR.intervalIntegrable 0 k)
      (hR.intervalIntegrable k 1)]
    have h1 : ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..k, agmLogRem k t ≤ k ^ 2 / 4 := by
      calc _ ≤ ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..k, t / 2 :=
            intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hk.le (hR.intervalIntegrable 0 k)
              ((continuous_id'.div_const 2).intervalIntegrable 0 k)
              fun t ht => agmLogRem_le_half ht.1
        _ = k ^ 2 / 4 := by rw [intervalIntegral.integral_div, integral_id]; ring
    have h2 : ∫ t in k..1, agmLogRem k t ≤ k ^ 2 / 4 * (-Real.log k) := by
      have hc : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => k ^ 2 / 4 * t⁻¹) (uIcc k 1) := by
        refine continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_inv₀.mono ?_)
        intro t ht
        rw [uIcc_of_le hk1] at ht
        exact mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hk ht.1))
      calc _ ≤ ∫ t in k..1, k ^ 2 / 4 * t⁻¹ :=
            intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hk1 (hR.intervalIntegrable k 1) hc.intervalIntegrable
              fun t ht => (agmLogRem_le_div hk (lt_of_lt_of_le hk ht.1)).trans_eq (by ring)
        _ = k ^ 2 / 4 * (-Real.log k) := by
            rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_inv_of_pos hk one_pos, one_div,
              Real.log_inv]
    linarith
  · simp only [agmLogRem]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add
      (f := fun t => agmKernel 1 k t - (Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + t ^ 2))⁻¹) (g := agmLogPhi)
      (hK.sub hU) hP,
      intervalIntegral.integral_sub (f := agmKernel 1 k)
      (g := fun t => (Real.sqrt (k ^ 2 + t ^ 2))⁻¹) hK hU,
      integral_inv_sqrt_sq_add hk, integral_agmLogPhi]
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_pi_div_AGM_sub_log_le
statement:
theorem abs_pi_div_AGM_sub_log_le (hk : 0 < k) (hk1 : k ≤ 1) :
    |(π / 2) / AGM 1 k - Real.log (4 / k)| ≤ k ^ 2 / 4 * (2 - Real.log k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R₁, hR₁0, hR₁, h1⟩ := integral_agmKernel_Ioi hk
  obtain ⟨R₂, hR₂0, hR₂, h2⟩ := integral_agmKernel_Ioc hk hk1
  have hsplit : (π / 2) / AGM 1 k
      = (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, agmKernel 1 k t) + ∫ t in Ioi (1 : ℝ), agmKernel 1 k t := by
    rw [div_div, ← agmIntegral_eq_pi_div_AGM one_pos hk, agmIntegral,
      ← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi (zero_le_one : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1),
      setIntegral_union Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi
        (integrable_agmKernel one_pos hk).integrableOn
        (integrable_agmKernel one_pos hk).integrableOn,
      intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one]
  have hmain : arsinh (1 / k) + Real.log 2 - Real.log (4 / k)
      = Real.log ((1 + Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2)) / 2) := by
    have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := hk.ne'
    have hs : Real.sqrt (1 + (1 / k) ^ 2) = Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2) / k := by
      rw [show 1 + (1 / k) ^ 2 = (1 + k ^ 2) / k ^ 2 by field_simp; ring,
        Real.sqrt_div (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + k ^ 2) (k ^ 2), Real.sqrt_sq hk.le]
    have hpos : 0 < 1 + Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2) := by positivity
    rw [Real.arsinh, hs,
      show 1 / k + Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2) / k = (1 + Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2)) / k by ring,
      Real.log_div hpos.ne' hk0, Real.log_div (by norm_num : (4 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hk0,
      Real.log_div hpos.ne' two_ne_zero, show (4 : ℝ) = 2 * 2 by norm_num,
      Real.log_mul two_ne_zero two_ne_zero]
    ring
  have hR₀0 : 0 ≤ Real.log ((1 + Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2)) / 2) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by linarith [one_le_sqrt_one_add_sq k])
  have hR₀ : Real.log ((1 + Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2)) / 2) ≤ k ^ 2 / 4 := by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (x := (1 + Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2)) / 2) (by positivity)
    linarith [sqrt_one_add_sq_le k]
  have harsinh1 : arsinh 1 = Real.log (1 + Real.sqrt 2) := by rw [Real.arsinh]; norm_num
  have hlog : Real.log k ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hk.le hk1
  have hk2log : 0 ≤ k ^ 2 / 4 * (-Real.log k) := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (by linarith)
  have hk2 : 0 ≤ k ^ 2 := sq_nonneg k
  rw [hsplit, h1, h2, harsinh1, abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_pi_div_AGM_sub_log_le_bz
statement:
theorem abs_pi_div_AGM_sub_log_le_bz (hk : 0 < k) (hk1 : k ≤ 1) :
    |(π / 2) / AGM 1 k - Real.log (4 / k)| ≤ 4 * k ^ 2 * (8 - Real.log k)
proof:
:= by
  refine (abs_pi_div_AGM_sub_log_le hk hk1).trans ?_
  have hlog : Real.log k ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hk.le hk1
  have := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg k) (neg_nonneg.mpr hlog)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg k]

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_agmLog_sub_log_le
statement:
theorem abs_agmLog_sub_log_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 4 ≤ x) :
    |agmLog x - Real.log x| ≤ 4 / x ^ 2 * (2 + Real.log (x / 4))
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hk : 0 < 4 / x := by positivity
  have hk1 : 4 / x ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one hx0]; exact hx
  have h := abs_pi_div_AGM_sub_log_le hk hk1
  rw [show (4 : ℝ) / (4 / x) = x by field_simp, Real.log_div (by norm_num : (4 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hx0.ne']
    at h
  rw [agmLog, Real.log_div hx0.ne' (by norm_num : (4 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
  convert h using 1
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.pi_div_AGM_eq_log_mul
statement:
theorem pi_div_AGM_eq_log_mul (hk : 0 < k) (hk1 : k ≤ 1) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, |ε| ≤ k ^ 2 / 2 ∧ (π / 2) / AGM 1 k = Real.log (4 / k) * (1 + ε)
proof:
:= by
  have hL : 0 < Real.log (4 / k) := Real.log_pos (by rw [lt_div_iff₀ hk]; linarith)
  have hlog4 : 1 ≤ Real.log 4 := by
    rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (by norm_num)]
    exact Real.exp_one_lt_three.le.trans (by norm_num)
  have hlogk : Real.log k ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hk.le hk1
  have hdiv : Real.log (4 / k) = Real.log 4 - Real.log k :=
    Real.log_div (by norm_num : (4 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hk.ne'
  refine ⟨((π / 2) / AGM 1 k - Real.log (4 / k)) / Real.log (4 / k), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hL, div_le_iff₀ hL]
    refine (abs_pi_div_AGM_sub_log_le hk hk1).trans ?_
    rw [hdiv]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg k) (neg_nonneg.mpr hlogk),
      mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg k) (sub_nonneg.mpr hlog4)]
  · field_simp
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_ellipticK_sqrt_sub_log_le
statement:
theorem abs_ellipticK_sqrt_sub_log_le (hk : 0 < k) (hk1 : k ≤ 1) :
    |ellipticK (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2)) - Real.log (4 / k)| ≤ k ^ 2 / 4 * (2 - Real.log k)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (π / 2) / AGM 1 k = ellipticK (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2)) := by
    rw [div_eq_mul_one_div, one_div_AGM_one hk hk1]
    field_simp
  rw [← h]
  exact abs_pi_div_AGM_sub_log_le hk hk1

name: Azurite.BZ.tailFrac_of_lt
statement: theorem tailFrac_of_lt (a b : ℕ → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (h : k < j) : tailFrac a b k j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tailFrac, ite_eq_left h]

name: Azurite.BZ.tailFrac_of_le
statement:
theorem tailFrac_of_le (a b : ℕ → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ k) :
    tailFrac a b k j = a j / (b j + tailFrac a b k (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tailFrac, ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr h)]

name: Azurite.BZ.tailFrac_shift
statement:
theorem tailFrac_shift (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k j : ℕ) :
    tailFrac a b (k + 1) (j + 1) = tailFrac (fun i => a (i + 1)) (fun i => b (i + 1)) k j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : k < j
  · rw [tailFrac_of_lt _ _ (by omega), tailFrac_of_lt _ _ hj]
  · rw [tailFrac_of_le a b (k := k + 1) (j := j + 1) (by omega), tailFrac_of_le _ _ (not_lt.mp hj),
      tailFrac_shift a b k (j + 1)]

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_eq_tailFrac
statement:
theorem approximant_eq_tailFrac (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    approximant a b k = b 0 + tailFrac a b k 1
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing a b with
  | zero => rw [approximant_zero, tailFrac_of_lt _ _ (by omega), add_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [approximant_succ, ih, tailFrac_of_le a b (k := k + 1) (j := 1) (by omega),
      tailFrac_shift a b k 1]

name: Azurite.BZ.tailFrac_nonneg
statement:
theorem tailFrac_nonneg {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k : ℕ) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : 1 ≤ j) : 0 ≤ tailFrac a b k j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hkj : k < j
  · rw [tailFrac_of_lt _ _ hkj]
  · rw [tailFrac_of_le _ _ (not_lt.mp hkj)]
    have hT := tailFrac_nonneg hpos k (j := j + 1) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := hpos j hj
    positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.backR_self
statement: theorem backR_self (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) : backR a b k k = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [backR, ite_eq_left le_rfl]

name: Azurite.BZ.backR_pred_self
statement: theorem backR_pred_self (a b : ℕ → ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : backR a b k (k - 1) = b k
proof:
:= by
  rw [backR, ite_eq_right (by omega), ite_eq_left (by omega)]

name: Azurite.BZ.backR_of_lt
statement:
theorem backR_of_lt (a b : ℕ → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (h : j + 2 ≤ k) :
    backR a b k j = b (j + 1) * backR a b k (j + 1) + a (j + 2) * backR a b k (j + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [backR, ite_eq_right (by omega), ite_eq_right (by omega)]

name: Azurite.BZ.backR_pred
statement:
theorem backR_pred {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) {k j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    backR a b k (j - 1) = (b j + tailFrac a b k (j + 1)) * backR a b k j
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hjk with hkj | hkj
  · subst hkj
    rw [backR_pred_self _ _ hj, backR_self, tailFrac_of_lt _ _ (by omega)]
    ring
  · have hrec := backR_of_lt a b (k := k) (j := j - 1) (by omega)
    rw [show j - 1 + 1 = j by omega, show j - 1 + 2 = j + 1 by omega] at hrec
    have hih := backR_pred hpos (k := k) (j := j + 1) (by omega) hkj
    rw [show j + 1 - 1 = j by omega] at hih
    have hT := tailFrac_of_le a b (k := k) (j := j + 1) hkj
    have hden : 0 < b (j + 1) + tailFrac a b k (j + 2) := by
      have := tailFrac_nonneg hpos k (j := j + 2) (by omega)
      have := hpos (j + 1) (by omega)
      linarith
    rw [hrec, hih, hT]
    field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.backR_pos
statement:
theorem backR_pos {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k : ℕ) (j : ℕ) :
    0 < backR a b k j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hkj : k ≤ j
  · rw [backR, ite_eq_left hkj]; exact one_pos
  · by_cases hk1 : k = j + 1
    · rw [backR, ite_eq_right hkj, ite_eq_left hk1]; exact (hpos k (by omega)).2
    · rw [backR_of_lt a b (by omega)]
      have h1 := backR_pos hpos k (j + 1)
      have h2 := backR_pos hpos k (j + 2)
      obtain ⟨-, hb⟩ := hpos (j + 1) (by omega)
      obtain ⟨ha, -⟩ := hpos (j + 2) (by omega)
      positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.backR_div
statement:
theorem backR_div {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) {k j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j)
    (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    backR a b k j / backR a b k (j - 1) = 1 / (b j + tailFrac a b k (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [backR_pred hpos hj hjk]
  have hR := backR_pos hpos k j
  have hden : 0 < b j + tailFrac a b k (j + 1) := by
    have := tailFrac_nonneg hpos k (j := j + 1) (by omega)
    have := hpos j hj
    linarith
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_eq_backR
statement:
theorem approximant_eq_backR {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) : approximant a b k = b 0 + a 1 * backR a b k 1 / backR a b k 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [approximant_eq_tailFrac, tailFrac_of_le _ _ hk]
  have h := backR_pred hpos (k := k) (j := 1) le_rfl hk
  simp only [Nat.sub_self] at h
  rw [h]
  have hR := backR_pos hpos k 1
  have hden : 0 < b 1 + tailFrac a b k 2 := by
    have := tailFrac_nonneg hpos k (j := 2) (by omega)
    have := hpos 1 le_rfl
    linarith
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.dens_pos
statement:
theorem dens_pos {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (n : ℕ) :
    0 < (contFrac a b).dens n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    match n with
    | 0 => rw [dens_zero]; exact one_pos
    | 1 => rw [dens_one]; exact (hpos 1 le_rfl).2
    | n + 2 =>
      rw [dens_recurrence']
      have h1 := ih (n + 1) (by omega)
      have h0 := ih n (by omega)
      obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := hpos (n + 2) (by omega)
      positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.det_succ
statement:
theorem det_succ (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (contFrac a b).nums (j + 2) * (contFrac a b).dens (j + 1)
        - (contFrac a b).nums (j + 1) * (contFrac a b).dens (j + 2)
      = -a (j + 2) * ((contFrac a b).nums (j + 1) * (contFrac a b).dens j
        - (contFrac a b).nums j * (contFrac a b).dens (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [nums_recurrence', dens_recurrence']
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.diff_eq_det_div
statement:
theorem diff_eq_det_div {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (j : ℕ) :
    diff a b (j + 1) = ((contFrac a b).nums (j + 1) * (contFrac a b).dens j
      - (contFrac a b).nums j * (contFrac a b).dens (j + 1))
        / ((contFrac a b).dens (j + 1) * (contFrac a b).dens j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diff, approximant_eq_convs hpos, approximant_eq_convs hpos, convs, convs]
  have h1 := dens_pos hpos j
  have h2 := dens_pos hpos (j + 1)
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.diff_one
statement: theorem diff_one (a b : ℕ → ℝ) : diff a b 1 = a 1 / b 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [diff, approximant_one, approximant_zero]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.diff_succ
statement:
theorem diff_succ {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (j : ℕ) :
    diff a b (j + 2)
      = -a (j + 2) * (contFrac a b).dens j * diff a b (j + 1) / (contFrac a b).dens (j + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diff_eq_det_div hpos (j + 1), diff_eq_det_div hpos j, det_succ]
  have h0 := dens_pos hpos j
  have h1 := dens_pos hpos (j + 1)
  have h2 := dens_pos hpos (j + 2)
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.sign_diff
statement:
theorem sign_diff {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (j : ℕ) :
    0 < (-1) ^ j * diff a b (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, one_mul, diff_one]
    obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := hpos 1 le_rfl
    positivity
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [diff_succ hpos j, pow_succ]
    have h0 := dens_pos hpos j
    have h2 := dens_pos hpos (j + 2)
    have ha := (hpos (j + 2) (by omega)).1
    have : (-1) ^ j * -1 * (-a (j + 2) * (contFrac a b).dens j * diff a b (j + 1)
        / (contFrac a b).dens (j + 2))
        = (a (j + 2) * (contFrac a b).dens j / (contFrac a b).dens (j + 2))
          * ((-1) ^ j * diff a b (j + 1)) := by ring
    rw [this]
    positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_diff_succ_lt
statement:
theorem abs_diff_succ_lt {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (j : ℕ) :
    |diff a b (j + 2)| < |diff a b (j + 1)|
proof:
:= by
  rw [diff_succ hpos j, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (hpos (j + 2) (by omega)).1,
    abs_of_pos (dens_pos hpos j), abs_of_pos (dens_pos hpos (j + 2)),
    div_lt_iff₀ (dens_pos hpos (j + 2))]
  have hD : 0 < |diff a b (j + 1)| := by
    have := sign_diff hpos j
    exact abs_pos.mpr fun h => by rw [h, mul_zero] at this; exact lt_irrefl _ this
  have hQ : a (j + 2) * (contFrac a b).dens j < (contFrac a b).dens (j + 2) := by
    rw [dens_recurrence']
    have := mul_pos (hpos (j + 2) (by omega)).2 (dens_pos hpos (j + 1))
    linarith
  calc a (j + 2) * (contFrac a b).dens j * |diff a b (j + 1)|
      < (contFrac a b).dens (j + 2) * |diff a b (j + 1)| := by gcongr
    _ = |diff a b (j + 1)| * (contFrac a b).dens (j + 2) := mul_comm _ _

name: Azurite.BZ.diff_odd_pos
statement:
theorem diff_odd_pos {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < diff a b (2 * k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have := sign_diff hpos (2 * k)
  rwa [pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow, one_mul] at this

name: Azurite.BZ.diff_even_neg
statement:
theorem diff_even_neg {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k : ℕ) :
    diff a b (2 * k + 2) < 0
proof:
:= by
  have := sign_diff hpos (2 * k + 1)
  rw [show 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * k + 2 by omega, pow_succ, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow, one_mul,
    neg_one_mul] at this
  exact neg_pos.mp this

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_even_lt_succ
statement:
theorem approximant_even_lt_succ {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k : ℕ) :
    approximant a b (2 * k) < approximant a b (2 * k + 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := diff_odd_pos hpos k
  have h2 := diff_even_neg hpos k
  have h3 := abs_diff_succ_lt hpos (2 * k)
  have hd1 : diff a b (2 * k + 1) = approximant a b (2 * k + 1) - approximant a b (2 * k) := rfl
  have hd2 : diff a b (2 * k + 2) = approximant a b (2 * k + 2) - approximant a b (2 * k + 1) := rfl
  rw [abs_of_neg h2, abs_of_pos h1] at h3
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_odd_succ_lt
statement:
theorem approximant_odd_succ_lt {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k : ℕ) :
    approximant a b (2 * k + 3) < approximant a b (2 * k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := diff_even_neg hpos k
  have h2 : 0 < diff a b (2 * k + 3) := by
    have := diff_odd_pos hpos (k + 1)
    rwa [show 2 * (k + 1) + 1 = 2 * k + 3 by ring] at this
  have h3 := abs_diff_succ_lt hpos (2 * k + 1)
  rw [show 2 * k + 1 + 2 = 2 * k + 3 by omega, show 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * k + 2 by omega,
    abs_of_pos h2, abs_of_neg h1] at h3
  have hd1 : diff a b (2 * k + 2) = approximant a b (2 * k + 2) - approximant a b (2 * k + 1) := rfl
  have hd2 : diff a b (2 * k + 3) = approximant a b (2 * k + 3) - approximant a b (2 * k + 2) := rfl
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_even_strictMono
statement:
theorem approximant_even_strictMono {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) :
    StrictMono (fun k => approximant a b (2 * k))
proof:
:=
  strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun k => by
    simpa [show 2 * (k + 1) = 2 * k + 2 by ring] using approximant_even_lt_succ hpos k

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_odd_strictAnti
statement:
theorem approximant_odd_strictAnti {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) :
    StrictAnti (fun k => approximant a b (2 * k + 1))
proof:
:=
  strictAnti_nat_of_succ_lt fun k => by
    simpa [show 2 * (k + 1) + 1 = 2 * k + 3 by ring] using approximant_odd_succ_lt hpos k

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_even_lt_odd
statement:
theorem approximant_even_lt_odd {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) (k m : ℕ) :
    approximant a b (2 * k) < approximant a b (2 * m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hE := approximant_even_strictMono hpos
  have hO := approximant_odd_strictAnti hpos
  
  have h1 : approximant a b (2 * k) ≤ approximant a b (2 * max k m) := hE.monotone (le_max_left _ _)
  have h2 : approximant a b (2 * max k m) < approximant a b (2 * max k m + 1) := by
    have := diff_odd_pos hpos (max k m)
    have hd : diff a b (2 * max k m + 1)
        = approximant a b (2 * max k m + 1) - approximant a b (2 * max k m) := rfl
    linarith
  have h3 : approximant a b (2 * max k m + 1) ≤ approximant a b (2 * m + 1) :=
    hO.antitone (le_max_right _ _)
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.approximant_even_lt
statement:
theorem approximant_even_lt {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) {f : ℝ}
    (hf : HasContFracValue a b f) (k : ℕ) : approximant a b (2 * k) < f
proof:
:= by
  have hE := approximant_even_strictMono hpos
  have htend : Tendsto (fun k => approximant a b (2 * k)) atTop (𝓝 f) :=
    hf.comp (tendsto_atTop_mono (fun k => by show k ≤ _; omega) tendsto_id)
  have hle := hE.monotone.ge_of_tendsto htend (k + 1)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (hE (Nat.lt_succ_self k)) hle

name: Azurite.BZ.lt_approximant_odd
statement:
theorem lt_approximant_odd {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) {f : ℝ}
    (hf : HasContFracValue a b f) (k : ℕ) : f < approximant a b (2 * k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hO := approximant_odd_strictAnti hpos
  have htend : Tendsto (fun k => approximant a b (2 * k + 1)) atTop (𝓝 f) :=
    hf.comp (tendsto_atTop_mono (fun k => by show k ≤ _; omega) tendsto_id)
  have hle := hO.antitone.le_of_tendsto htend (k + 1)
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle (hO (Nat.lt_succ_self k))

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_sub_midpoint_lt
statement:
theorem abs_sub_midpoint_lt {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → 0 < a j ∧ 0 < b j) {f : ℝ}
    (hf : HasContFracValue a b f) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    |f - (approximant a b (m - 1) + approximant a b m) / 2|
      < |approximant a b m - approximant a b (m - 1)| / 2
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, m - 1 = 2 * k ∨ m - 1 = 2 * k + 1 := ⟨(m - 1) / 2, by omega⟩
  rcases hk with hk | hk
  · 
    have hm' : m = 2 * k + 1 := by omega
    have h1 := approximant_even_lt hpos hf k
    have h2 := lt_approximant_odd hpos hf k
    rw [hk, hm']
    rw [abs_lt, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
    constructor <;> linarith
  · 
    have hm' : m = 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
    have h1 := approximant_even_lt hpos hf (k + 1)
    have h2 := lt_approximant_odd hpos hf k
    rw [hk, hm']
    rw [abs_lt, abs_of_neg (by linarith)]
    constructor <;> linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.isHolonomic_exp
statement: theorem isHolonomic_exp : IsHolonomic Real.exp
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨1, ![C (-1), C 1], ⟨1, by simp⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, iteratedDeriv_one, Real.deriv_exp]

name: Azurite.BZ.isHolonomic_sin
statement: theorem isHolonomic_sin : IsHolonomic Real.sin
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨2, ![C 1, 0, C 1], ⟨0, by simp⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, iteratedDeriv_succ, Real.deriv_sin, Real.deriv_cos']

name: Azurite.BZ.isHolonomic_cos
statement: theorem isHolonomic_cos : IsHolonomic Real.cos
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨2, ![C 1, 0, C 1], ⟨0, by simp⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, iteratedDeriv_succ, Real.deriv_sin, Real.deriv_cos']

name: Azurite.BZ.isHolonomic_log
statement: theorem isHolonomic_log : IsHolonomic Real.log
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨2, ![0, C 1, X], ⟨1, by simp⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
  have h2 : iteratedDeriv 2 Real.log = fun x => -(x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one, Real.deriv_log']
    exact deriv_inv'
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  simp [h2, Real.deriv_log, iteratedDeriv_one]
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
  · simp
  · field_simp
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.RationalRatio.isPRecursive
statement:
theorem RationalRatio.isPRecursive {a : ℕ → ℝ} {δ : ℕ} (h : RationalRatio a δ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    IsPRecursive a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, δ = m + 1 := ⟨δ - 1, by omega⟩
  refine ⟨m + 1, fun j => if j = 0 then -h.num else if j = Fin.last (m + 1) then h.den else 0,
    ⟨Fin.last (m + 1), ?_⟩, fun k => ?_⟩
  · have hne : (Fin.last (m + 1) : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, Fin.ext_iff]
      simp
    simp only [hne, ite_false, ite_true]
    intro hden
    have := h.den_ne_zero 0
    rw [hden] at this
    simp at this
  · have hsplit : ∀ j : Fin (m + 2),
        (if j = 0 then -h.num else if j = Fin.last (m + 1) then h.den else 0).eval (k : ℝ)
            * a (k + j)
          = (if j = 0 then -h.num.eval (k : ℝ) * a k else 0)
            + (if j = Fin.last (m + 1) then h.den.eval (k : ℝ) * a (k + (m + 1)) else 0) := by
      intro j
      have hne : (Fin.last (m + 1) : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Ne, Fin.ext_iff]
        simp
      by_cases h0 : j = 0
      · subst h0
        simp [hne.symm]
      · by_cases hl : j = Fin.last (m + 1)
        · subst hl
          simp [hne]
        · simp [h0, hl]
    simp_rw [hsplit]
    rw [sum_add_distrib, sum_ite_eq', sum_ite_eq']
    simp only [mem_univ, ite_true]
    have hr := h.ratio k
    have hd := h.den_ne_zero k
    rw [hr]
    field_simp
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.iterDeriv_zero
statement: theorem iterDeriv_zero (b : B) : iterDeriv 0 b = b
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.iterDeriv_succ
statement: theorem iterDeriv_succ (n : ℕ) (b : B) : iterDeriv (n + 1) b = (iterDeriv n b)′
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _

name: Azurite.BZ.iterDeriv_add
statement: theorem iterDeriv_add (n : ℕ) (a b : B) : iterDeriv n (a + b) = iterDeriv n a + iterDeriv n b
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [iterDeriv_succ, iterDeriv_succ, iterDeriv_succ, ih, map_add]

name: Azurite.BZ.iterDeriv_zero_right
statement: theorem iterDeriv_zero_right (n : ℕ) : iterDeriv n (0 : B) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [iterDeriv_succ, ih, map_zero]

name: Azurite.BZ.deriv_smul_coeff
statement: theorem deriv_smul_coeff (c : A) (x : B) : (c • x)′ = c′ • x + c • x′
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, Derivation.leibniz, deriv_algebraMap, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
    Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.span_deriv_closed
statement:
theorem span_deriv_closed {s : Set B} (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, x′ ∈ Submodule.span A s) :
    ∀ x ∈ Submodule.span A s, x′ ∈ Submodule.span A s
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact hs x hx
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul c x hxmem hx =>
    rw [deriv_smul_coeff]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hxmem) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx)

name: Azurite.BZ.iterDeriv_mem_derivSpan
statement: theorem iterDeriv_mem_derivSpan (b : B) (n : ℕ) : iterDeriv n b ∈ derivSpan A b
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨n, rfl⟩

name: Azurite.BZ.derivSpan_deriv_closed
statement: theorem derivSpan_deriv_closed (b : B) : ∀ x ∈ derivSpan A b, x′ ∈ derivSpan A b
proof:
:=
  span_deriv_closed (by
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
    show (iterDeriv n b)′ ∈ _
    rw [← iterDeriv_succ]
    exact iterDeriv_mem_derivSpan b (n + 1))

name: Azurite.BZ.fg_of_le_fg
statement: theorem fg_of_le_fg {U V : Submodule A B} (h : U ≤ V) (hV : V.FG) : U.FG
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.fg_iff_finiteDimensional] at hV ⊢
  exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le h

name: Azurite.BZ.IsDFinite.add
statement:
theorem IsDFinite.add {a b : B} (ha : IsDFinite A a) (hb : IsDFinite A b) :
    IsDFinite A (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  refine fg_of_le_fg ?_ (ha.sup hb)
  rw [derivSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
  show iterDeriv n (a + b) ∈ _
  rw [iterDeriv_add]
  exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (iterDeriv_mem_derivSpan a n) (iterDeriv_mem_derivSpan b n)

name: Azurite.BZ.IsDFinite.mul
statement:
theorem IsDFinite.mul {a b : B} (ha : IsDFinite A a) (hb : IsDFinite A b) :
    IsDFinite A (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed : ∀ x ∈ derivSpan A a * derivSpan A b, x′ ∈ derivSpan A a * derivSpan A b := by
    intro x hx
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hx ?_ ?_
    · intro u hu v hv
      rw [Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm v]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.mul_mem_mul hu (derivSpan_deriv_closed b v hv))
        (Submodule.mul_mem_mul (derivSpan_deriv_closed a u hu) hv)
    · intro x y hx hy
      rw [map_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  have hmem : ∀ n, iterDeriv n (a * b) ∈ derivSpan A a * derivSpan A b := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (iterDeriv_mem_derivSpan a 0) (iterDeriv_mem_derivSpan b 0)
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [iterDeriv_succ]
      exact hclosed _ ih
  refine fg_of_le_fg (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_) (Submodule.FG.mul ha hb)
  rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
  exact hmem n

name: Azurite.BZ.IsDFinite.exists_relation
statement:
theorem IsDFinite.exists_relation {b : B} (hb : IsDFinite A b) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (c : Fin (r + 1) → A), (∃ i, c i ≠ 0) ∧ ∑ i, c i • iterDeriv (i : ℕ) b = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfd : FiniteDimensional A (derivSpan A b) :=
    (Submodule.fg_iff_finiteDimensional _).mp hb
  set d := Module.finrank A (derivSpan A b) with hd
  let v : Fin (d + 1) → derivSpan A b := fun i => ⟨iterDeriv i b, iterDeriv_mem_derivSpan b i⟩
  have hnot : ¬ LinearIndependent A v := fun h => by
    have := h.fintype_card_le_finrank
    simp [← hd] at this
  obtain ⟨s, g, hsum, i, hi, hgi⟩ := not_linearIndependent_iff.mp hnot
  refine ⟨d, fun i => if i ∈ s then g i else 0, ⟨i, by simp [hi, hgi]⟩, ?_⟩
  calc ∑ i, (if i ∈ s then g i else 0) • iterDeriv (i : ℕ) b
      = ∑ i ∈ s, g i • iterDeriv (i : ℕ) b := by
        simp_rw [ite_smul, zero_smul]
        rw [sum_ite_mem, univ_inter]
    _ = ((∑ i ∈ s, g i • v i : derivSpan A b) : B) := by simp [v]
    _ = 0 := by rw [hsum]; rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.isDFinite_of_relation
statement:
theorem isDFinite_of_relation {b : B} :
    ∀ (r : ℕ) (c : Fin (r + 1) → A), (∃ i, c i ≠ 0) →
      ∑ i, c i • iterDeriv (i : ℕ) b = 0 → IsDFinite A b
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    intro c ⟨i, hi⟩ hsum
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_one] at hsum
    have hc : c 0 ≠ 0 := by rwa [Subsingleton.elim (0 : Fin 1) i]
    have hb0 : b = 0 := by
      rw [Fin.val_zero, iterDeriv_zero] at hsum
      exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hsum).resolve_left hc
    subst hb0
    refine fg_of_le_fg ?_ Submodule.fg_bot
    rw [derivSpan, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
    simp [iterDeriv_zero_right]
  | succ r ih =>
    intro c hc hsum
    by_cases hlast : c (Fin.last (r + 1)) = 0
    · rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, hlast, zero_smul, add_zero] at hsum
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hc
      have hi' : i ≠ Fin.last (r + 1) := fun h => hi (h ▸ hlast)
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hi'
      exact ih (fun j => c (Fin.castSucc j)) ⟨j, hi⟩ (by simpa using hsum)
    · set W : Submodule A B :=
        Submodule.span A (Set.range fun i : Fin (r + 1) => iterDeriv (i : ℕ) b) with hW
      have hWfg : W.FG := Submodule.fg_span (Set.finite_range _)
      have htop : iterDeriv (r + 1) b ∈ W := by
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc] at hsum
        simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last] at hsum
        have h2 := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hsum
        rw [← inv_smul_smul₀ hlast (iterDeriv (r + 1) b), h2]
        exact W.smul_mem _ (W.neg_mem (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
          W.smul_mem _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)))
      have hclosed : ∀ x ∈ W, x′ ∈ W := span_deriv_closed (by
        rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
        show (iterDeriv (i : ℕ) b)′ ∈ W
        rw [← iterDeriv_succ]
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge ((i : ℕ) + 1) (r + 1) with h | h
        · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, h⟩, rfl⟩
        · have : (i : ℕ) + 1 = r + 1 := by have := i.isLt; omega
          rw [this]
          exact htop)
      have hmem : ∀ n, iterDeriv n b ∈ W := by
        intro n
        induction n with
        | zero => exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, by simp [iterDeriv_zero]⟩
        | succ n ih =>
          rw [iterDeriv_succ]
          exact hclosed _ ih
      refine fg_of_le_fg ?_ hWfg
      rw [derivSpan, Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact hmem n

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_pow_natAbs_sq_le
statement:
theorem abs_pow_natAbs_sq_le (hq : |q| < 1) (m : ℤ) :
    |q ^ (m.natAbs ^ 2)| ≤ |q| ^ m.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_pow]
  exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (abs_nonneg q) hq.le (Nat.le_self_pow two_ne_zero _)

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_abs_pow_natAbs
statement: theorem summable_abs_pow_natAbs (hq : |q| < 1) : Summable fun m : ℤ => |q| ^ m.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  have h := Summable.int_rec (f := fun n : ℕ => |q| ^ n) (g := fun n : ℕ => |q| ^ (n + 1))
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (abs_nonneg q) hq)
    ((summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => |q| ^ n) 1).mpr
      (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (abs_nonneg q) hq))
  refine h.congr fun m => ?_
  rcases m with n | n <;> rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_theta3_term
statement: theorem summable_theta3_term (hq : |q| < 1) : Summable fun m : ℤ => q ^ (m.natAbs ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  (summable_abs_pow_natAbs hq).of_norm_bounded fun m => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact abs_pow_natAbs_sq_le hq m

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_theta4_term
statement:
theorem summable_theta4_term (hq : |q| < 1) :
    Summable fun m : ℤ => (-1) ^ m.natAbs * q ^ (m.natAbs ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  (summable_abs_pow_natAbs hq).of_norm_bounded fun m => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul]
    exact abs_pow_natAbs_sq_le hq m

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_norm_theta3_term
statement:
theorem summable_norm_theta3_term (hq : |q| < 1) :
    Summable fun m : ℤ => ‖q ^ (m.natAbs ^ 2)‖
proof:
:=
  (summable_abs_pow_natAbs hq).of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) fun m => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact abs_pow_natAbs_sq_le hq m

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_norm_theta4_term
statement:
theorem summable_norm_theta4_term (hq : |q| < 1) :
    Summable fun m : ℤ => ‖(-1) ^ m.natAbs * q ^ (m.natAbs ^ 2)‖
proof:
:=
  (summable_abs_pow_natAbs hq).of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) fun m => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul]
    exact abs_pow_natAbs_sq_le hq m

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_pow_succ_sq
statement: theorem summable_pow_succ_sq (hq : |q| < 1) : Summable fun n : ℕ => q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  ((summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => |q| ^ n) 1).mpr
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (abs_nonneg q) hq)).of_norm_bounded fun n => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_pow]
      exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (abs_nonneg q) hq.le (Nat.le_self_pow two_ne_zero _)

name: Azurite.BZ.theta3_eq_one_add
statement: theorem theta3_eq_one_add (hq : |q| < 1) : theta3 q = 1 + 2 * ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Summable fun n : ℕ => q ^ (n ^ 2) :=
    (summable_theta3_term hq).comp_injective (i := fun n : ℕ => (n : ℤ)) Int.ofNat_injective
  have hg := summable_pow_succ_sq hq
  have heq : (fun m : ℤ => q ^ (m.natAbs ^ 2))
      = Int.rec (fun n : ℕ => q ^ (n ^ 2)) (fun n : ℕ => q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2)) := by
    funext m; rcases m with n | n <;> rfl
  unfold theta3
  rw [heq, tsum_int_rec hf hg, hf.tsum_eq_zero_add]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.theta4_eq_one_add
statement:
theorem theta4_eq_one_add (hq : |q| < 1) :
    theta4 q = 1 + 2 * ∑' n : ℕ, (-1) ^ (n + 1) * q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Summable fun n : ℕ => (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * q ^ (n ^ 2) :=
    (summable_theta4_term hq).comp_injective (i := fun n : ℕ => (n : ℤ)) Int.ofNat_injective
  have hg : Summable fun n : ℕ => (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2) :=
    (summable_theta4_term hq).comp_injective (i := fun n : ℕ => Int.negSucc n)
      fun a b h => Int.negSucc.inj h
  have heq : (fun m : ℤ => (-1 : ℝ) ^ m.natAbs * q ^ (m.natAbs ^ 2))
      = Int.rec (fun n : ℕ => (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * q ^ (n ^ 2))
        (fun n : ℕ => (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2)) := by
    funext m; rcases m with n | n <;> rfl
  unfold theta4
  rw [heq, tsum_int_rec hf hg, hf.tsum_eq_zero_add]
  simp only [pow_zero, one_mul]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.theta4_eq_theta3_neg
statement: theorem theta4_eq_theta3_neg (q : ℝ) : theta4 q = theta3 (-q)
proof:
:= by
  unfold theta3 theta4
  refine tsum_congr fun m => ?_
  rw [neg_pow q]
  congr 1
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd m.natAbs with h | h
  · rw [h.neg_one_pow, (Nat.even_pow.mpr ⟨h, two_ne_zero⟩).neg_one_pow]
  · rw [h.neg_one_pow, (Odd.pow h).neg_one_pow]

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_pow_mul_succ
statement:
theorem summable_pow_mul_succ (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    Summable fun n : ℕ => q ^ (n * (n + 1))
proof:
:=
  (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq0 hq1).of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) fun n =>
    pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq0 hq1.le (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right n n.succ_pos)

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2_eq_tsum_int
statement:
theorem theta2_eq_tsum_int (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    theta2 q = ∑' n : ℤ, q ^ (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ, q ^ (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2) = q ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * q ^ (n * (n + 1)) := by
    intro n
    rw [show ((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2 = 1 / 4 + ((n * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring,
      Real.rpow_add hq0, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hs := summable_pow_mul_succ hq0.le hq1
  have hf : Summable fun n : ℕ => q ^ (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2) := by
    simp_rw [hterm]; exact hs.mul_left _
  have hg : Summable fun n : ℕ => q ^ (((Int.negSucc n : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2 := by
    refine hf.congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Int.cast_negSucc]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
  have heq : (fun n : ℤ => q ^ (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2))
      = Int.rec (fun n : ℕ => q ^ (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2))
        (fun n : ℕ => q ^ (((Int.negSucc n : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2) := by
    funext n; rcases n with n | n <;> rfl
  rw [heq, tsum_int_rec hf hg]
  have h2 : ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ (((Int.negSucc n : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2
      = ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ (((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2) :=
    tsum_congr fun n => by rw [Int.cast_negSucc]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
  rw [h2]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [tsum_mul_left]
  unfold theta2
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.tsum_prod_int_split
statement:
theorem tsum_prod_int_split {f : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ} (hf : Summable f) :
    ∑' p, f p = ∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, f (p.1 + p.2, p.1 - p.2)
      + ∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, f (p.1 + p.2 + 1, p.1 - p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Summable.tsum_add_tsum_compl (s := evenPairs) (hf.subtype _) (hf.subtype _),
    ← evenEquiv.tsum_eq, ← oddEquiv.tsum_eq]
  rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.tsum_eq_zero_of_neg_comp
statement:
theorem tsum_eq_zero_of_neg_comp {g : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ} (h : ∀ p, g (flipEquiv p) = -g p) :
    ∑' p, g p = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∑' p, g p = ∑' p, g (flipEquiv p) := (flipEquiv.tsum_eq g).symm
  have h2 : ∑' p, g (flipEquiv p) = -∑' p, g p := by
    rw [show (fun p => g (flipEquiv p)) = fun p => -g p from funext h, tsum_neg]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.neg_one_pow_natAbs_mul
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_natAbs_mul (m n : ℤ) :
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ m.natAbs * (-1) ^ n.natAbs = if Even (m + n) then 1 else -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_add]
  have : Even (m.natAbs + n.natAbs) ↔ Even (m + n) := by
    rw [Nat.even_add, Int.natAbs_even, Int.natAbs_even, Int.even_add]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact (this.mpr h).neg_one_pow
  · exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp (this.not.mpr h)).neg_one_pow

name: Azurite.BZ.natAbs_sq_add_sub
statement:
theorem natAbs_sq_add_sub (a b : ℤ) :
    (a + b).natAbs ^ 2 + (a - b).natAbs ^ 2 = 2 * (a.natAbs ^ 2 + b.natAbs ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  zify
  simp only [sq_abs]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.theta3_mul_theta4
statement: theorem theta3_mul_theta4 (hq : |q| < 1) : theta3 q * theta4 q = theta4 (q ^ 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 : |q ^ 2| < 1 := by rw [abs_pow]; exact pow_lt_one₀ (abs_nonneg q) hq two_ne_zero
  unfold theta3 theta4
  rw [tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm (summable_norm_theta3_term hq) (summable_norm_theta4_term hq),
    sq, tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm (summable_norm_theta4_term hq2)
      (summable_norm_theta4_term hq2)]
  have hs := summable_mul_of_summable_norm (summable_norm_theta3_term hq)
    (summable_norm_theta4_term hq)
  rw [tsum_prod_int_split hs]
  have hodd : ∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, q ^ ((p.1 + p.2 + 1).natAbs ^ 2)
      * ((-1) ^ (p.1 - p.2).natAbs * q ^ ((p.1 - p.2).natAbs ^ 2)) = 0 := by
    refine tsum_eq_zero_of_neg_comp fun p => ?_
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
    simp only [flipEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
    rw [show a + (-b - 1) + 1 = a - b by ring, show a - (-b - 1) = a + b + 1 by ring]
    have h := neg_one_pow_natAbs_mul (a + b + 1) (a - b)
    rw [ite_eq_right (by rw [Int.not_even_iff_odd]; exact ⟨a, by ring⟩)] at h
    have hB : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (a - b).natAbs) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow]
    linear_combination (q ^ ((a - b).natAbs ^ 2) * q ^ ((a + b + 1).natAbs ^ 2)
      * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (a - b).natAbs) * h
      - (q ^ ((a - b).natAbs ^ 2) * q ^ ((a + b + 1).natAbs ^ 2)
        * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (a + b + 1).natAbs) * hB
  rw [hodd, add_zero]
  refine tsum_congr fun p => ?_
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
  simp only
  have hpar : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (a - b).natAbs = (-1) ^ a.natAbs * (-1) ^ b.natAbs := by
    rw [neg_one_pow_natAbs_mul]
    by_cases h : Even (a + b)
    · rw [ite_eq_left h]
      exact (Int.natAbs_even.mpr (Int.even_sub.mpr (Int.even_add.mp h))).neg_one_pow
    · rw [ite_eq_right h]
      have : Odd (a - b).natAbs := by
        rw [Int.natAbs_odd, ← Int.not_even_iff_odd, Int.even_sub]
        rwa [Int.even_add] at h
      exact this.neg_one_pow
  have hexp : q ^ ((a + b).natAbs ^ 2) * q ^ ((a - b).natAbs ^ 2)
      = (q ^ 2) ^ (a.natAbs ^ 2) * (q ^ 2) ^ (b.natAbs ^ 2) := by
    rw [← pow_add, natAbs_sq_add_sub, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add, mul_add]
  rw [hpar]
  linear_combination ((-1 : ℝ) ^ a.natAbs * (-1) ^ b.natAbs) * hexp

name: Azurite.BZ.theta3_sq_add_theta4_sq
statement:
theorem theta3_sq_add_theta4_sq (hq : |q| < 1) :
    (theta3 q ^ 2 + theta4 q ^ 2) / 2 = theta3 (q ^ 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 : |q ^ 2| < 1 := by rw [abs_pow]; exact pow_lt_one₀ (abs_nonneg q) hq two_ne_zero
  unfold theta3 theta4
  rw [sq, sq, sq, tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm (summable_norm_theta3_term hq)
    (summable_norm_theta3_term hq), tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm (summable_norm_theta4_term hq)
    (summable_norm_theta4_term hq), tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm
    (summable_norm_theta3_term hq2) (summable_norm_theta3_term hq2)]
  have hs3 := summable_mul_of_summable_norm (summable_norm_theta3_term hq)
    (summable_norm_theta3_term hq)
  have hs4 := summable_mul_of_summable_norm (summable_norm_theta4_term hq)
    (summable_norm_theta4_term hq)
  rw [← hs3.tsum_add hs4, tsum_prod_int_split (hs3.add hs4)]
  have hodd : ∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, (q ^ ((p.1 + p.2 + 1).natAbs ^ 2) * q ^ ((p.1 - p.2).natAbs ^ 2)
      + (-1) ^ (p.1 + p.2 + 1).natAbs * q ^ ((p.1 + p.2 + 1).natAbs ^ 2)
        * ((-1) ^ (p.1 - p.2).natAbs * q ^ ((p.1 - p.2).natAbs ^ 2))) = 0 := by
    refine (tsum_congr fun p => ?_).trans (tsum_zero (α := ℝ) (β := ℤ × ℤ))
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
    simp only
    have h := neg_one_pow_natAbs_mul (a + b + 1) (a - b)
    rw [ite_eq_right (by rw [Int.not_even_iff_odd]; exact ⟨a, by ring⟩)] at h
    linear_combination (q ^ ((a + b + 1).natAbs ^ 2) * q ^ ((a - b).natAbs ^ 2)) * h
  rw [hodd, add_zero, div_eq_iff (two_ne_zero' ℝ), ← tsum_mul_right]
  refine tsum_congr fun p => ?_
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
  simp only
  have h := neg_one_pow_natAbs_mul (a + b) (a - b)
  rw [ite_eq_left ⟨a, by ring⟩] at h
  have hexp : q ^ ((a + b).natAbs ^ 2) * q ^ ((a - b).natAbs ^ 2)
      = (q ^ 2) ^ (a.natAbs ^ 2) * (q ^ 2) ^ (b.natAbs ^ 2) := by
    rw [← pow_add, natAbs_sq_add_sub, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add, mul_add]
  linear_combination (q ^ ((a + b).natAbs ^ 2) * q ^ ((a - b).natAbs ^ 2)) * h + 2 * hexp

name: Azurite.BZ.tsum_pow_succ_sq_le
statement:
theorem tsum_pow_succ_sq_le (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2) ≤ q / (1 - q)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : |q| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1
  have hg : Summable fun n : ℕ => q ^ (n + 1) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => q ^ n) 1).mpr (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq0 hq1)
  calc ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2) ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ (n + 1) :=
        (summable_pow_succ_sq hq).tsum_le_tsum (fun n =>
          pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq0 hq1.le (Nat.le_self_pow two_ne_zero _)) hg
    _ = q * ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ n := by simp_rw [pow_succ, mul_comm (q ^ _) q]; exact tsum_mul_left
    _ = q / (1 - q) := by rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hq0 hq1, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Azurite.BZ.tsum_pow_succ_sq_nonneg
statement: theorem tsum_pow_succ_sq_nonneg (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) : 0 ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  tsum_nonneg fun n => by positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.one_le_theta3
statement: theorem one_le_theta3 (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : 1 ≤ theta3 q
proof:
:= by
  rw [theta3_eq_one_add (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1)]
  linarith [tsum_pow_succ_sq_nonneg hq0]

name: Azurite.BZ.theta3_pos
statement: theorem theta3_pos (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : 0 < theta3 q
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (one_le_theta3 hq0 hq1)

name: Azurite.BZ.theta3_sub_one_le
statement: theorem theta3_sub_one_le (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : theta3 q - 1 ≤ 2 * q / (1 - q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [theta3_eq_one_add (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1)]
  have h := tsum_pow_succ_sq_le hq0 hq1
  have e : 2 * q / (1 - q) = 2 * (q / (1 - q)) := by ring
  rw [e]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_tsum_neg_one_pow_le
statement:
theorem abs_tsum_neg_one_pow_le (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    |∑' n : ℕ, (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2)| ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : |q| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1
  have hs : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖(-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2)‖ := by
    refine (summable_pow_succ_sq hq).congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  calc |∑' n : ℕ, (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2)|
      = ‖∑' n : ℕ, (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2)‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
    _ ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, ‖(-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2)‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hs
    _ = ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2) := tsum_congr fun n => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul,
          abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]

name: Azurite.BZ.one_sub_theta4_le
statement: theorem one_sub_theta4_le (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : 1 - theta4 q ≤ 2 * q / (1 - q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [theta4_eq_one_add (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1)]
  have h1 := abs_tsum_neg_one_pow_le hq0 hq1
  have h2 := tsum_pow_succ_sq_le hq0 hq1
  rw [abs_le] at h1
  have e : 2 * q / (1 - q) = 2 * (q / (1 - q)) := by ring
  rw [e]
  linarith [h1.1]

name: Azurite.BZ.theta4_le_theta3
statement: theorem theta4_le_theta3 (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : theta4 q ≤ theta3 q
proof:
:= by
  have hq : |q| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1
  unfold theta3 theta4
  refine (summable_theta4_term hq).tsum_le_tsum (fun m => ?_) (summable_theta3_term hq)
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd m.natAbs with h | h
  · rw [h.neg_one_pow, one_mul]
  · rw [h.neg_one_pow, neg_one_mul]
    linarith [pow_nonneg hq0 (m.natAbs ^ 2)]

name: Azurite.BZ.theta4_nonneg
statement: theorem theta4_nonneg (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : 0 ≤ theta4 q
proof:
:= by
  have hq : |q| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1
  have h := theta3_mul_theta4 hq
  have h3 := theta3_pos hq0 hq1
  have hprod : 0 ≤ theta3 q * theta4 q := by rw [h]; positivity
  by_contra hneg
  have hneg' : theta4 q < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hneg
  nlinarith [mul_pos h3 (neg_pos.mpr hneg')]

name: Azurite.BZ.theta4_ne_zero_of_sq
statement: theorem theta4_ne_zero_of_sq (hq : |q| < 1) (h : theta4 (q ^ 2) ≠ 0) : theta4 q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have := theta3_mul_theta4 hq
  rw [h0, mul_zero] at this
  exact h (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp this.symm)

name: Azurite.BZ.theta4_pos_of_lt_third
statement: theorem theta4_pos_of_lt_third (hr0 : 0 ≤ q) (hr : q < 1 / 3) : 0 < theta4 q
proof:
:= by
  have h := one_sub_theta4_le hr0 (by linarith)
  have : 2 * q / (1 - q) < 1 := by rw [div_lt_one (by linarith)]; linarith
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.theta4_pos
statement: theorem theta4_pos (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : 0 < theta4 q
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ q : ℝ, 0 ≤ q → q < 1 → 0 < theta4 (q ^ 2 ^ k) → 0 < theta4 q := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro q _ _ h; simpa using h
    | succ k ih =>
      intro q hq0 hq1 h
      have hq : |q| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1
      have h2 : 0 < theta4 (q ^ 2) := by
        refine ih (q ^ 2) (by positivity) (pow_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 two_ne_zero) ?_
        rwa [← pow_mul, ← pow_succ']
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (theta4_nonneg hq0 hq1)
        (theta4_ne_zero_of_sq hq h2.ne').symm
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3) hq1
  refine key n q hq0 hq1 (theta4_pos_of_lt_third (by positivity) ?_)
  calc q ^ 2 ^ n ≤ q ^ n := pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq0 hq1.le Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le
    _ < 1 / 3 := hn

name: Azurite.BZ.AGM_theta_step
statement:
theorem AGM_theta_step (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    AGM (theta3 q ^ 2) (theta4 q ^ 2) = AGM (theta3 (q ^ 2) ^ 2) (theta4 (q ^ 2) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : |q| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1
  have h3 := theta3_pos hq0 hq1
  have h4 := theta4_pos hq0 hq1
  rw [AGM_step (by positivity) (by positivity), theta3_sq_add_theta4_sq hq,
    show theta3 q ^ 2 * theta4 q ^ 2 = (theta3 q * theta4 q) ^ 2 by ring,
    Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity), theta3_mul_theta4 hq]

name: Azurite.BZ.AGM_theta_pow
statement:
theorem AGM_theta_pow (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (k : ℕ) :
    AGM (theta3 q ^ 2) (theta4 q ^ 2) = AGM (theta3 (q ^ 2 ^ k) ^ 2) (theta4 (q ^ 2 ^ k) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [ih, AGM_theta_step (by positivity) (pow_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 (by positivity)), ← pow_mul,
      ← pow_succ]

name: Azurite.BZ.AGM_theta
statement: theorem AGM_theta (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : AGM (theta3 q ^ 2) (theta4 q ^ 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => q ^ 2 ^ k) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hq0 hq1).comp
      (tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt one_lt_two)
  have hfrac : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => 2 * q ^ 2 ^ k / (1 - q ^ 2 ^ k)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have := (hr.const_mul 2).div (tendsto_const_nhds.sub hr) (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) - 0 ≠ 0)
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) * 0 / (1 - 0) = 0 by norm_num] at this
    exact this
  have hup : ∀ k, AGM (theta3 q ^ 2) (theta4 q ^ 2)
      ≤ (1 + 2 * q ^ 2 ^ k / (1 - q ^ 2 ^ k)) ^ 2 := fun k => by
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ q ^ 2 ^ k := by positivity
    have hr1 : q ^ 2 ^ k < 1 := pow_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 (by positivity)
    have h3 := theta3_pos hr0 hr1
    have h4 := theta4_pos hr0 hr1
    rw [AGM_theta_pow hq0 hq1 k]
    calc AGM (theta3 (q ^ 2 ^ k) ^ 2) (theta4 (q ^ 2 ^ k) ^ 2)
        ≤ max (theta3 (q ^ 2 ^ k) ^ 2) (theta4 (q ^ 2 ^ k) ^ 2) :=
          AGM_le_max (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = theta3 (q ^ 2 ^ k) ^ 2 :=
          max_eq_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ h4.le (theta4_le_theta3 hr0 hr1) 2)
      _ ≤ (1 + 2 * q ^ 2 ^ k / (1 - q ^ 2 ^ k)) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ h3.le (by linarith [theta3_sub_one_le hr0 hr1]) 2
  have hlow : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, (1 - 2 * q ^ 2 ^ k / (1 - q ^ 2 ^ k)) ^ 2
      ≤ AGM (theta3 q ^ 2) (theta4 q ^ 2) := by
    filter_upwards [hr.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3))] with k hk
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ q ^ 2 ^ k := by positivity
    have hr1 : q ^ 2 ^ k < 1 := by linarith
    have h3 := theta3_pos hr0 hr1
    have h4 := theta4_pos hr0 hr1
    have hfr : 2 * q ^ 2 ^ k / (1 - q ^ 2 ^ k) < 1 := by
      rw [div_lt_one (by linarith)]; linarith
    rw [AGM_theta_pow hq0 hq1 k]
    calc (1 - 2 * q ^ 2 ^ k / (1 - q ^ 2 ^ k)) ^ 2 ≤ theta4 (q ^ 2 ^ k) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith [one_sub_theta4_le hr0 hr1]) 2
      _ = min (theta3 (q ^ 2 ^ k) ^ 2) (theta4 (q ^ 2 ^ k) ^ 2) :=
          (min_eq_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ h4.le (theta4_le_theta3 hr0 hr1) 2)).symm
      _ ≤ AGM (theta3 (q ^ 2 ^ k) ^ 2) (theta4 (q ^ 2 ^ k) ^ 2) :=
          min_le_AGM (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hlim_up : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (1 + 2 * q ^ 2 ^ k / (1 - q ^ 2 ^ k)) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    have := ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℝ))).add hfrac).pow 2
    simpa using this
  have hlim_low : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (1 - 2 * q ^ 2 ^ k / (1 - q ^ 2 ^ k)) ^ 2) atTop
      (𝓝 1) := by
    have := ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℝ))).sub hfrac).pow 2
    simpa using this
  exact le_antisymm (ge_of_tendsto' hlim_up hup) (le_of_tendsto hlim_low hlow)

name: Azurite.BZ.nomeK'_pos
statement: theorem nomeK'_pos (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : 0 < nomeK' q
proof:
:= by
  unfold nomeK'
  have := theta4_pos hq0 hq1
  have := theta3_pos hq0 hq1
  positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.nomeK'_le_one
statement: theorem nomeK'_le_one (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : nomeK' q ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold nomeK'
  have h3 := theta3_pos hq0 hq1
  have h4 := theta4_pos hq0 hq1
  rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ h4.le (theta4_le_theta3 hq0 hq1) 2

name: Azurite.BZ.AGM_one_nomeK'
statement: theorem AGM_one_nomeK' (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : AGM 1 (nomeK' q) = 1 / theta3 q ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h3 := theta3_pos hq0 hq1
  have hk := nomeK'_pos hq0 hq1
  have h := AGM_smul (c := theta3 q ^ 2) (by positivity) one_pos hk
  rw [mul_one, show theta3 q ^ 2 * nomeK' q = theta4 q ^ 2 by unfold nomeK'; field_simp,
    AGM_theta hq0 hq1] at h
  rw [eq_div_iff (by positivity)]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.ellipticK_nome
statement:
theorem ellipticK_nome (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    ellipticK (Real.sqrt (1 - nomeK' q ^ 2)) = Real.pi / 2 * theta3 q ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := one_div_AGM_one (nomeK'_pos hq0 hq1) (nomeK'_le_one hq0 hq1)
  rw [AGM_one_nomeK' hq0 hq1, one_div_one_div] at h
  rw [h]
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_one_add_mul_sub_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (1 + t * (1 + ε)) - (1 + t) = t * ε by ring, abs_mul]
  calc |t| * |ε| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) := by gcongr
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((n + k : ℕ) : ℤ)) := by rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]; push_cast; ring_nf

name: Azurite.BZ.relError_one_add_le
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 : ℤ)) :=
          zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ = 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have ht' : |t| ≤ 1 / 2 := ht.trans hk'
  have h1t : 1 / 2 ≤ |1 + t| := by
    rw [abs_le] at ht'
    rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
  calc |(1 + t * (1 + ε)) - (1 + t)| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((n + k : ℕ) : ℤ)) :=
        abs_one_add_mul_sub_le ht hε
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - ((n + k : ℕ) : ℤ)) * (1 / 2) := by
        rw [show (1 : ℤ) - ((n + k : ℕ) : ℤ) = -((n + k : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 by ring,
          zpow_add₀ (by norm_num), zpow_one]
        ring
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - ((n + k : ℕ) : ℤ)) * |1 + t| := by gcongr

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_mul_one_add_sub_one_le
statement:
theorem abs_mul_one_add_sub_one_le (δ₁ δ₂ : ℝ) :
    |(1 + δ₁) * (1 + δ₂) - 1| ≤ |δ₁| + |δ₂| + |δ₁| * |δ₂|
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (1 + δ₁) * (1 + δ₂) - 1 = δ₁ + δ₂ + δ₁ * δ₂ by ring]
  calc |δ₁ + δ₂ + δ₁ * δ₂| ≤ |δ₁ + δ₂| + |δ₁ * δ₂| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ |δ₁| + |δ₂| + |δ₁| * |δ₂| := by rw [abs_mul]; gcongr; exact abs_add_le _ _

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_squareSeq_sub_exp_le_of_uniform
statement:
theorem abs_squareSeq_sub_exp_le_of_uniform (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) {ε η : ℝ} (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hε : |ε| ≤ 3 * η) (hθ : ∀ i, |θ i| ≤ η) (hη : (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2) * η ≤ 1) :
    |squareSeq (exp (x / 2 ^ k) * (1 + ε)) θ k - exp x| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 3) * η * exp x
proof:
:= by
  have hη0 : 0 ≤ η := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hθ 0)
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ range k, (2 ^ (k - 1 - i) : ℝ) * |θ i| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * η := by
    calc ∑ i ∈ range k, (2 ^ (k - 1 - i) : ℝ) * |θ i|
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ range k, (2 ^ (k - 1 - i) : ℝ) * η := by
          gcongr with i _; exact hθ i
      _ = (∑ i ∈ range k, (2 : ℝ) ^ (k - 1 - i)) * η := by rw [sum_mul]
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * η := by
          gcongr
          
          have : ∑ i ∈ range k, (2 : ℝ) ^ (k - 1 - i) = ∑ i ∈ range k, (2 : ℝ) ^ i := by
            rw [← sum_range_reflect]
            exact sum_congr rfl fun i hi => by
              rw [mem_range] at hi; congr 1; omega
          rw [this, geom_sum_eq (by norm_num)]
          have : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ k := by positivity
          rw [div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; linarith
  have hS : (2 ^ k : ℝ) * |ε| + ∑ i ∈ range k, (2 ^ (k - 1 - i) : ℝ) * |θ i|
      ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2) * η := by
    calc (2 ^ k : ℝ) * |ε| + ∑ i ∈ range k, (2 ^ (k - 1 - i) : ℝ) * |θ i|
        ≤ (2 ^ k : ℝ) * (3 * η) + (2 : ℝ) ^ k * η := by gcongr
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2) * η := by rw [pow_add]; ring
  calc |squareSeq (exp (x / 2 ^ k) * (1 + ε)) θ k - exp x|
      ≤ 2 * ((2 ^ k : ℝ) * |ε| + ∑ i ∈ range k, (2 ^ (k - 1 - i) : ℝ) * |θ i|) * exp x :=
        abs_squareSeq_sub_exp_le x k ε θ (hS.trans hη)
    _ ≤ 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2) * η) * exp x := by gcongr
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 3) * η * exp x := by rw [pow_succ]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.forwardSummation_bits
statement:
theorem forwardSummation_bits (x : ℝ) {k n : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hε : |ε| ≤ 3 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ))) (hθ : ∀ i, |θ i| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)))
    (hn : k + 2 ≤ n) :
    |squareSeq (exp (x / 2 ^ k) * (1 + ε)) θ k - exp x|
      ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((n : ℤ) - k - 3)) * exp x
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_squareSeq_sub_exp_le_of_uniform x k θ hε hθ (by
    rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
    exact zpow_le_one_of_nonpos₀ (by norm_num) (by push_cast; omega))
  convert h using 2
  rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
  congr 1; push_cast; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.backwardSummation_bits
statement:
theorem backwardSummation_bits (x : ℝ) {k n : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hε : |ε| ≤ 3 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((n + k : ℕ) : ℤ)))
    (hθ : ∀ i, |θ i| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((n + k : ℕ) : ℤ))) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    |squareSeq (exp (x / 2 ^ k) * (1 + ε)) θ k - exp x|
      ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((n : ℤ) - 3)) * exp x
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_squareSeq_sub_exp_le_of_uniform x k θ hε hθ (by
    rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
    exact zpow_le_one_of_nonpos₀ (by norm_num) (by push_cast; omega))
  convert h using 2
  rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
  congr 1; push_cast; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.expm1_two_mul
statement: theorem expm1_two_mul (x : ℝ) : expm1 (2 * x) = expm1 x * (expm1 x + 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold expm1
  rw [two_mul, exp_add]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.expm1_add_two_pos
statement: theorem expm1_add_two_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < expm1 x + 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold expm1; linarith [exp_pos x]

name: Azurite.BZ.expm1_two_mul_perturbed
statement:
theorem expm1_two_mul_perturbed (x ε : ℝ) :
    expm1 x * (1 + ε) * (expm1 x * (1 + ε) + 2)
      = expm1 (2 * x) * (1 + ε * (2 * (expm1 x + 1) + expm1 x * ε) / (expm1 x + 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [expm1_two_mul]
  have h := (expm1_add_two_pos x).ne'
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_expm1_two_mul_relError_le
statement:
theorem abs_expm1_two_mul_relError_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (ε : ℝ) :
    |ε * (2 * (expm1 x + 1) + expm1 x * ε) / (expm1 x + 2)| ≤ 2 * |ε| + ε ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have he : 0 ≤ expm1 x := by unfold expm1; linarith [one_le_exp_iff.mpr hx]
  have h2 := expm1_add_two_pos x
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos h2, div_le_iff₀ h2, abs_mul]
  have hb : |2 * (expm1 x + 1) + expm1 x * ε| ≤ 2 * (expm1 x + 1) + expm1 x * |ε| := by
    calc |2 * (expm1 x + 1) + expm1 x * ε| ≤ |2 * (expm1 x + 1)| + |expm1 x * ε| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = 2 * (expm1 x + 1) + expm1 x * |ε| := by
          rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith), abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg he]
  calc |ε| * |2 * (expm1 x + 1) + expm1 x * ε| ≤ |ε| * (2 * (expm1 x + 1) + expm1 x * |ε|) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (abs_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (2 * |ε| + ε ^ 2) * (expm1 x + 2) := by
        rw [← sq_abs ε]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg ε, sq_nonneg |ε|]

name: Azurite.BZ.expm1_of_exp_perturbed
statement: theorem expm1_of_exp_perturbed (x ρ : ℝ) : (exp x * (1 + ρ) - 1) - expm1 x = ρ * exp x
proof:
:= by
  unfold expm1; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.expm1_le_mul_exp
statement: theorem expm1_le_mul_exp (x : ℝ) : expm1 x ≤ x * exp x
proof:
:= by
  unfold expm1
  have h := add_one_le_exp (-x)
  rw [exp_neg] at h
  have hpos := exp_pos x
  have h' : (-x + 1) * exp x ≤ 1 := by
    calc (-x + 1) * exp x ≤ (exp x)⁻¹ * exp x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hpos.le
      _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne'
  nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.relError_expm1_of_exp_ge
statement:
theorem relError_expm1_of_exp_ge {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (ρ : ℝ) :
    |ρ| / x ≤ |(exp x * (1 + ρ) - 1) - expm1 x| / expm1 x
proof:
:= by
  rw [expm1_of_exp_perturbed, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (exp_pos x)]
  have hpos : 0 < expm1 x := by unfold expm1; linarith [exp_pos x, add_one_lt_exp hx.ne']
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hx hpos]
  have := expm1_le_mul_exp x
  nlinarith [abs_nonneg ρ]

name: Azurite.BZ.sinh_two_mul'
statement: theorem sinh_two_mul' (x : ℝ) : sinh (2 * x) = 2 * sinh x * cosh x
proof: := sinh_two_mul x

name: Azurite.BZ.cosh_eq_sqrt
statement: theorem cosh_eq_sqrt (x : ℝ) : cosh x = Real.sqrt (1 + sinh x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cosh_sq', Real.sqrt_sq (cosh_pos x).le]

name: Azurite.BZ.sinh_two_mul_sqrt
statement: theorem sinh_two_mul_sqrt (x : ℝ) : sinh (2 * x) = 2 * sinh x * Real.sqrt (1 + sinh x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sinh_two_mul, cosh_eq_sqrt]

name: Azurite.BZ.sinh_three_mul'
statement: theorem sinh_three_mul' (x : ℝ) : sinh (3 * x) = sinh x * (3 + 4 * sinh x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sinh_three_mul]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.three_pow_lt_four_pow
statement: theorem three_pow_lt_four_pow {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : (3 : ℕ) ^ k < 4 ^ k
proof:
:=
  Nat.pow_lt_pow_left (by norm_num) (by omega)

name: Azurite.BZ.sinh_of_exp_perturbed
statement:
theorem sinh_of_exp_perturbed (x ρ : ℝ) :
    (exp x * (1 + ρ) - exp (-x) * (1 - ρ)) / 2 - sinh x = ρ * cosh x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sinh_eq, cosh_eq]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.sinh_le_mul_exp
statement: theorem sinh_le_mul_exp (x : ℝ) : sinh x ≤ x * exp x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sinh_eq]
  have h := add_one_le_exp (-(2 * x))
  have hpos := exp_pos x
  have h2 : exp (-(2 * x)) = exp (-x) * exp (-x) := by rw [← exp_add]; ring_nf
  have h3 : exp (-x) * exp x = 1 := by rw [← exp_add]; simp
  nlinarith [exp_pos (-x)]

name: Azurite.BZ.relError_sinh_of_exp_ge
statement:
theorem relError_sinh_of_exp_ge {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (ρ : ℝ) :
    |ρ| / (2 * x) ≤ |(exp x * (1 + ρ) - exp (-x) * (1 - ρ)) / 2 - sinh x| / sinh x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sinh_of_exp_perturbed, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (cosh_pos x)]
  have hs : 0 < sinh x := by
    rw [sinh_eq]; linarith [exp_lt_exp.mpr (show -x < x by linarith)]
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hs]
  have h1 := sinh_le_mul_exp x
  have h2 : exp x ≤ 2 * cosh x := by rw [cosh_eq]; linarith [exp_pos (-x)]
  calc |ρ| * sinh x ≤ |ρ| * (x * exp x) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (abs_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ |ρ| * (x * (2 * cosh x)) := by gcongr
    _ = |ρ| * cosh x * (2 * x) := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.sinh_eq_expm1
statement: theorem sinh_eq_expm1 (x : ℝ) : sinh x = (expm1 x - expm1 (-x)) / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold expm1; rw [sinh_eq]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.relError_sinh_expm1_le
statement:
theorem relError_sinh_expm1_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) {ρ₁ ρ₂ η : ℝ} (h₁ : |ρ₁| ≤ η) (h₂ : |ρ₂| ≤ η) :
    |(expm1 x * (1 + ρ₁) - expm1 (-x) * (1 + ρ₂)) / 2 - sinh x| ≤ η * sinh x
proof:
:= by
  have hid : (expm1 x * (1 + ρ₁) - expm1 (-x) * (1 + ρ₂)) / 2 - sinh x
      = (expm1 x * ρ₁ - expm1 (-x) * ρ₂) / 2 := by rw [sinh_eq_expm1]; ring
  have he₁ : 0 ≤ expm1 x := by unfold expm1; linarith [one_le_exp_iff.mpr hx]
  have he₂ : expm1 (-x) ≤ 0 := by
    unfold expm1; linarith [exp_le_one_iff.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr hx)]
  rw [hid, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2), div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num),
    sinh_eq_expm1]
  calc |expm1 x * ρ₁ - expm1 (-x) * ρ₂| ≤ |expm1 x * ρ₁| + |expm1 (-x) * ρ₂| := abs_sub _ _
    _ = expm1 x * |ρ₁| + (-expm1 (-x)) * |ρ₂| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg he₁, abs_of_nonpos he₂]
    _ ≤ expm1 x * η + (-expm1 (-x)) * η := by gcongr; linarith
    _ = η * ((expm1 x - expm1 (-x)) / 2) * 2 := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.nome_log
statement: theorem nome_log (hq0 : 0 < q) : nome (-Real.log q / Real.pi) = q
proof:
:= by
  unfold nome
  rw [show -(Real.pi * (-Real.log q / Real.pi)) = Real.log q by field_simp, Real.exp_log hq0]

name: Azurite.BZ.sasaki_kanada'
statement:
theorem sasaki_kanada' (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    Real.log (1 / q) = Real.pi / AGM (theta2 q ^ 2) (theta3 q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < -Real.log q / Real.pi :=
    div_pos (neg_pos.mpr (Real.log_neg hq0 hq1)) Real.pi_pos
  have h := sasaki_kanada hs
  rwa [nome_log hq0] at h

name: Azurite.BZ.log_eq_pi_div_four_div_AGM
statement:
theorem log_eq_pi_div_four_div_AGM (hx : 1 < x) :
    Real.log x = (Real.pi / 4) / AGM (theta2 ((1 / x) ^ 4) ^ 2) (theta3 ((1 / x) ^ 4) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 < (1 / x) ^ 4 := by positivity
  have hq1 : (1 / x) ^ 4 < 1 := pow_lt_one₀ (by positivity) ((div_lt_one hx0).mpr hx) (by norm_num)
  have h := sasaki_kanada' hq0 hq1
  have e : Real.log (1 / (1 / x) ^ 4) = 4 * Real.log x := by
    rw [one_div, one_div, inv_pow, inv_inv, Real.log_pow]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [e] at h
  rw [div_div, mul_comm (4 : ℝ), ← div_div, ← h]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2_pow_four
statement: theorem theta2_pow_four (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : theta2 (q ^ 4) = q * theta2Int (q ^ 4)
proof:
:= by
  rw [theta2_eq_rpow_mul (by positivity) (pow_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 (by norm_num)),
    show (1 / 4 : ℝ) = ((4 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ by norm_num, Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast hq0 (by norm_num)]

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2Int_eq_two_mul_tsum
statement:
theorem theta2Int_eq_two_mul_tsum (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    theta2Int q = 2 * ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ (n * (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := theta2_eq_rpow_mul hq0.le hq1
  have hr : 0 < q ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 _
  unfold theta2 at h1
  have : q ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * theta2Int q = q ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (2 * ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ (n * (n + 1))) := by
    rw [← h1]; ring
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hr.ne' this

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_pow_of_le
statement:
theorem summable_pow_of_le (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) {e : ℕ → ℕ} {M : ℕ}
    (he : ∀ n, M + n ≤ e n) : Summable fun n : ℕ => q ^ e n
proof:
:=
  ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq0 hq1).mul_left (q ^ M)).of_nonneg_of_le
    (fun n => pow_nonneg hq0 _) fun n => by
      rw [← pow_add]
      exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq0 hq1.le (he n)

name: Azurite.BZ.tsum_pow_le_of_le
statement:
theorem tsum_pow_le_of_le (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) {e : ℕ → ℕ} {M : ℕ}
    (he : ∀ n, M + n ≤ e n) : ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ e n ≤ q ^ M / (1 - q)
proof:
:= by
  have hg := (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq0 hq1).mul_left (q ^ M)
  calc ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ e n ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ M * q ^ n :=
        (summable_pow_of_le hq0 hq1 he).tsum_le_tsum (fun n => by
          rw [← pow_add]; exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq0 hq1.le (he n)) hg
    _ = q ^ M / (1 - q) := by rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hq0 hq1, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Azurite.BZ.theta3_trunc
statement:
theorem theta3_trunc (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) (N : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ theta3 q - (1 + 2 * ∑ n ∈ range N, q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2))
      ∧ theta3 q - (1 + 2 * ∑ n ∈ range N, q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2))
        ≤ 2 * q ^ ((N + 1) ^ 2) / (1 - q)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : |q| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1
  have hs := summable_pow_succ_sq hq
  rw [theta3_eq_one_add hq, ← Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add' (f := fun n : ℕ => q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2))
    (k := N) ((summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => q ^ ((n + 1) ^ 2)) N).mpr hs)]
  have he : ∀ n : ℕ, (N + 1) ^ 2 + n ≤ (n + N + 1) ^ 2 := fun n => by
    have h : (n + N + 1) ^ 2 = (N + 1) ^ 2 + n * (n + 2 * N + 2) := by ring
    rw [h]
    exact Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right n (by omega)) _
  have htail := tsum_pow_le_of_le hq0 hq1 (e := fun n => (n + N + 1) ^ 2) he
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ ((n + N + 1) ^ 2) := tsum_nonneg fun n => pow_nonneg hq0 _
  constructor
  · linarith
  · rw [mul_div_assoc]
    linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2Int_trunc
statement:
theorem theta2Int_trunc (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (N : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ theta2Int q - 2 * ∑ n ∈ range N, q ^ (n * (n + 1))
      ∧ theta2Int q - 2 * ∑ n ∈ range N, q ^ (n * (n + 1)) ≤ 2 * q ^ (N * (N + 1)) / (1 - q)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Summable fun n : ℕ => q ^ (n * (n + 1)) :=
    summable_pow_of_le hq0.le hq1 (e := fun n => n * (n + 1)) (M := 0) fun n => by nlinarith
  rw [theta2Int_eq_two_mul_tsum hq0 hq1, ← Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add'
    (f := fun n : ℕ => q ^ (n * (n + 1))) (k := N)
    ((summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => q ^ (n * (n + 1))) N).mpr hs)]
  have he : ∀ n : ℕ, N * (N + 1) + n ≤ (n + N) * (n + N + 1) := fun n => by nlinarith
  have htail := tsum_pow_le_of_le hq0.le hq1 (e := fun n => (n + N) * (n + N + 1)) he
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ ((n + N) * (n + N + 1)) := tsum_nonneg fun n => pow_nonneg hq0.le _
  constructor
  · linarith
  · rw [mul_div_assoc]
    linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.theta3_pow_four_trunc
proof:
:= by
  have h := theta3_trunc (q := q ^ 4) (by positivity) (pow_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 (by norm_num)) 2
  simp only [sum_range_succ, sum_range_zero, zero_add] at h
  norm_num [← pow_mul] at h
  constructor
  · linarith [h.1]
  · linarith [h.2]

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2_pow_four_trunc
statement:
theorem theta2_pow_four_trunc (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    0 ≤ theta2 (q ^ 4) - (2 * q + 2 * q ^ 9 + 2 * q ^ 25)
      ∧ theta2 (q ^ 4) - (2 * q + 2 * q ^ 9 + 2 * q ^ 25) ≤ 2 * q ^ 49 / (1 - q ^ 4)
proof:
:= by
  have h := theta2Int_trunc (q := q ^ 4) (by positivity) (pow_lt_one₀ hq0.le hq1 (by norm_num)) 3
  simp only [sum_range_succ, sum_range_zero, zero_add] at h
  norm_num [← pow_mul] at h
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
  rw [theta2_pow_four hq0.le hq1]
  have hq4 : 0 < 1 - q ^ 4 := by linarith [pow_lt_one₀ hq0.le hq1 (by norm_num : (4 : ℕ) ≠ 0)]
  constructor
  · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hq0.le]
  · have h3 : q * (theta2Int (q ^ 4) - 2 * (1 + q ^ 8 + q ^ 24)) ≤ q * (2 * q ^ 48 / (1 - q ^ 4)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hq0.le
    have e : q * (2 * q ^ 48 / (1 - q ^ 4)) = 2 * q ^ 49 / (1 - q ^ 4) := by
      field_simp
    linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.inv_pow_le_of_two_rpow_le
statement:
theorem inv_pow_le_of_two_rpow_le {n : ℕ} (hx : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 36) ≤ x) :
    (1 / x) ^ 36 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ ((n : ℝ) / 36) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
  have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le h2 hx
  have h36 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 36)) ^ 36 = 2 ^ (n : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul zero_le_two]
    norm_num
  have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℝ) ≤ x ^ 36 := h36 ▸ pow_le_pow_left₀ h2.le hx 36
  rw [one_div, inv_pow, Real.rpow_neg zero_le_two]
  exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) hpow

name: Azurite.BZ.theta3_pow_four_error_le
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ 1 / x := by positivity
  have hq1 : 1 / x < 1 := (div_lt_one hx0).mpr hx1
  have hq4 : 0 < 1 - (1 / x) ^ 4 := by linarith [pow_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 (by norm_num : (4 : ℕ) ≠ 0)]
  refine (theta3_pow_four_trunc hq0 hq1).2.trans ?_
  gcongr
  exact inv_pow_le_of_two_rpow_le hx

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2_pow_four_error_le
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hq0 : 0 < 1 / x := by positivity
  have hq1 : 1 / x < 1 := (div_lt_one hx0).mpr hx1
  have hq4 : 0 < 1 - (1 / x) ^ 4 := by linarith [pow_lt_one₀ hq0.le hq1 (by norm_num : (4 : ℕ) ≠ 0)]
  refine (theta2_pow_four_trunc hq0 hq1).2.trans ?_
  gcongr
  calc (1 / x) ^ 49 ≤ (1 / x) ^ 36 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq0.le hq1.le (by norm_num)
    _ ≤ _ := inv_pow_le_of_two_rpow_le hx

name: Azurite.BZ.AGM_sq_sq
statement:
theorem AGM_sq_sq {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    AGM (a ^ 2) (b ^ 2) = AGM (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) (2 * a * b) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [AGM_step (by positivity) (by positivity),
    show Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 * b ^ 2) = a * b by
      rw [← mul_pow, Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)],
    show (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / 2 = (1 / 2) * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) by ring,
    show a * b = (1 / 2) * (2 * a * b) by ring,
    AGM_smul (by norm_num) (by positivity) (by positivity)]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.sq_add_sq_eq_half_add
statement: theorem sq_add_sq_eq_half_add (a b : ℝ) : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = ((a + b) ^ 2 + (a - b) ^ 2) / 2
proof: := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.two_mul_mul_eq_half_sub
statement: theorem two_mul_mul_eq_half_sub (a b : ℝ) : 2 * a * b = ((a + b) ^ 2 - (a - b) ^ 2) / 2
proof: := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.integrableOn_exp_neg_sq_Ioi
statement: theorem integrableOn_exp_neg_sq_Ioi (x : ℝ) : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => exp (-u ^ 2)) (Ioi x)
proof:
:= by
  have := (integrable_exp_neg_mul_sq (b := 1) one_pos).integrableOn (s := Ioi x)
  refine this.congr_fun (fun u _ => ?_) measurableSet_Ioi
  simp

name: Azurite.BZ.continuousOn_gaussTail_integrand
statement:
theorem continuousOn_gaussTail_integrand {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => exp (-u ^ 2) / u ^ (2 * k)) (Ioi x)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_exp.comp (continuous_pow 2).neg).continuousOn.div (continuousOn_pow _)
    fun _ hu => pow_ne_zero _ (lt_trans hx hu).ne'

name: Azurite.BZ.integrableOn_gaussTail
statement:
theorem integrableOn_gaussTail {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => exp (-u ^ 2) / u ^ (2 * k)) (Ioi x)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => exp (-u ^ 2) * (x ^ (2 * k))⁻¹) (Ioi x) :=
    (integrableOn_exp_neg_sq_Ioi x).mul_const _
  refine Integrable.mono' hg
    ((continuousOn_gaussTail_integrand hx k).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi) ?_
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu
  have hu0 : 0 < u := lt_trans hx hu
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity), div_eq_mul_inv]
  gcongr
  exact le_of_lt hu

name: Azurite.BZ.gaussTail_nonneg
statement: theorem gaussTail_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ gaussTail k x
proof:
:=
  setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Ioi fun u hu => by
    have : 0 < u := lt_trans hx hu
    positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.gaussTail_pos
statement: theorem gaussTail_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) : 0 < gaussTail k x
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussTail
  rw [setIntegral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae]
  · refine lt_of_lt_of_le ENNReal.zero_lt_top ?_
    rw [← Real.volume_Ioi (a := x)]
    refine measure_mono fun u hu => ⟨?_, hu⟩
    have : 0 < u := lt_trans hx hu
    exact (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < exp (-u ^ 2) / u ^ (2 * k)).ne'
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu
    have : 0 < u := lt_trans hx hu
    positivity
  · exact integrableOn_gaussTail hx k

name: Azurite.BZ.gaussTail_succ
statement:
theorem gaussTail_succ {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    gaussTail k x
      = exp (-x ^ 2) / (2 * x ^ (2 * k + 1)) - (2 * k + 1) / 2 * gaussTail (k + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  
  have hu : ∀ t ∈ Ioi x, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹)
      (-(((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t ^ (2 * k + 1 - 1)) / (t ^ (2 * k + 1)) ^ 2) t :=
    fun t ht => (hasDerivAt_pow (2 * k + 1) t).inv (pow_ne_zero _ (lt_trans hx ht).ne')
  have hv : ∀ t ∈ Ioi x, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => -exp (-t ^ 2) / 2) (t * exp (-t ^ 2)) t := by
    intro t _
    have hin : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => -t ^ 2) (-(2 * t)) t :=
      (hasDerivAt_pow 2 t).neg.congr_deriv (by norm_num)
    have h := (((Real.hasDerivAt_exp (-t ^ 2)).comp t hin).neg).div_const 2
    exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)
  have huv' : IntegrableOn ((fun t : ℝ => (t ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹) * fun t => t * exp (-t ^ 2))
      (Ioi x) :=
    (integrableOn_gaussTail hx k).congr_fun (fun t ht => by
      have ht0 : (t : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (lt_trans hx ht).ne'
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
      field_simp
      ring) measurableSet_Ioi
  have hu'v : IntegrableOn
      ((fun t : ℝ => -(((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t ^ (2 * k + 1 - 1)) / (t ^ (2 * k + 1)) ^ 2)
        * fun t => -exp (-t ^ 2) / 2) (Ioi x) := by
    refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun
      ((integrableOn_gaussTail hx (k + 1)).const_mul (((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2))
      (fun t ht => ?_) measurableSet_Ioi
    have ht0 : (t : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (lt_trans hx ht).ne'
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    field_simp
    ring
  have h_zero : Tendsto ((fun t : ℝ => (t ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹) * fun t => -exp (-t ^ 2) / 2) (𝓝[>] x)
      (𝓝 ((x ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹ * (-exp (-x ^ 2) / 2))) := by
    apply Tendsto.mono_left _ nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    exact (((continuous_pow (2 * k + 1)).continuousAt.inv₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hx.ne')).mul
      (((continuous_exp.comp (continuous_pow 2).neg).continuousAt.neg).div_const 2))
  have h_infty : Tendsto ((fun t : ℝ => (t ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹) * fun t => -exp (-t ^ 2) / 2) atTop
      (𝓝 0) := by
    rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
    have hg : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => exp (-t) * ((x ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹ / 2)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero.mul_const ((x ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹ / 2)
    refine squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun t => norm_nonneg _) ?_ hg
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (max x 1)] with t ht
    have ht0 : 0 < t := lt_trans hx (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) ht)
    have ht1 : 1 < t := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) ht
    have htx : x < t := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) ht
    rw [Pi.mul_apply, norm_mul, norm_div, norm_neg, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (t ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹),
      abs_of_pos (exp_pos _), abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    have hexp : exp (-t ^ 2) ≤ exp (-t) := exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
    calc (t ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹ * (exp (-t ^ 2) / 2)
        ≤ (x ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹ * (exp (-t) / 2) := by gcongr
      _ = exp (-t) * ((x ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹ / 2) := by ring
  have key := integral_Ioi_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul hu hv huv' hu'v h_zero h_infty
  have hL : ∫ t in Ioi x, (t ^ (2 * k + 1))⁻¹ * (t * exp (-t ^ 2)) = gaussTail k x := by
    unfold gaussTail
    exact setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun t ht => by
      have ht0 : (t : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (lt_trans hx ht).ne'
      field_simp
      ring
  have hR : ∫ t in Ioi x,
      -(((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t ^ (2 * k + 1 - 1)) / (t ^ (2 * k + 1)) ^ 2 * (-exp (-t ^ 2) / 2)
        = (2 * k + 1) / 2 * gaussTail (k + 1) x := by
    unfold gaussTail
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun t ht => ?_
    have ht0 : (t : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (lt_trans hx ht).ne'
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hL, hR] at key
  rw [key]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.gaussTail_le
statement:
theorem gaussTail_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    gaussTail k x ≤ exp (-x ^ 2) / (2 * x ^ (2 * k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h := gaussTail_succ hx k
  have := gaussTail_nonneg hx (k + 1)
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * k + 1) / 2 := by positivity
  nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.erfcCoeff_pos
statement: theorem erfcCoeff_pos (j : ℕ) : 0 < erfcCoeff j
proof: := by unfold erfcCoeff; positivity
