name: Azurite.BZ.erfcCoeff_succ
statement: theorem erfcCoeff_succ (j : ℕ) : erfcCoeff (j + 1) = erfcCoeff j * ((2 * j + 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold erfcCoeff
  rw [show 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * j + 1 + 1 by ring, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.factorial_succ,
    Nat.factorial_succ, pow_succ]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.erfcCoeff_zero
statement: theorem erfcCoeff_zero : erfcCoeff 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [erfcCoeff]

name: Azurite.BZ.erfcRem_succ
statement:
theorem erfcRem_succ {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    erfcRem k x = erfcTerm k x + erfcRem (k + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold erfcRem erfcTerm
  rw [gaussTail_succ hx k, erfcCoeff_succ, pow_succ]
  have hπ : 0 < Real.sqrt π := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr pi_pos
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.erfc_eq_sum_add_rem
statement:
theorem erfc_eq_sum_add_rem {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    erfc x = ∑ j ∈ range k, erfcTerm j x + erfcRem k x
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [erfc, erfcRem, erfcCoeff_zero]
  | succ k ih => rw [sum_range_succ, ih, erfcRem_succ hx k]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_erfcRem_le_abs_term
statement:
theorem abs_erfcRem_le_abs_term {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    |erfcRem k x| ≤ |erfcTerm k x|
proof:
:= by
  have hπ : 0 < Real.sqrt π := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr pi_pos
  have hc := erfcCoeff_pos k
  have hJ := gaussTail_le hx k
  have hJ0 := gaussTail_pos hx k
  have hL : |erfcRem k x| = 2 / Real.sqrt π * erfcCoeff k * gaussTail k x := by
    unfold erfcRem
    simp only [abs_mul, abs_div, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul]
    rw [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), abs_of_pos hπ, abs_of_pos hc, abs_of_pos hJ0]
  have hR : |erfcTerm k x| = erfcCoeff k * exp (-x ^ 2) / (Real.sqrt π * x ^ (2 * k + 1)) := by
    unfold erfcTerm
    simp only [abs_mul, abs_div, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul]
    rw [abs_of_pos hc, abs_of_pos (exp_pos _), abs_of_pos hπ, abs_of_pos hx]
  rw [hL, hR]
  calc 2 / Real.sqrt π * erfcCoeff k * gaussTail k x
      ≤ 2 / Real.sqrt π * erfcCoeff k * (exp (-x ^ 2) / (2 * x ^ (2 * k + 1))) := by gcongr
    _ = erfcCoeff k * exp (-x ^ 2) / (Real.sqrt π * x ^ (2 * k + 1)) := by
        field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.sign_erfcRem
statement: theorem sign_erfcRem {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) : 0 < (-1) ^ k * erfcRem k x
proof:
:= by
  unfold erfcRem
  have hsq : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ k) * ((-1) ^ k) = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow]; simp
  have hπ : 0 < Real.sqrt π := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr pi_pos
  have hpos : 0 < 2 / Real.sqrt π * erfcCoeff k * gaussTail k x := by
    have := gaussTail_pos hx k; have := erfcCoeff_pos k; positivity
  calc (0 : ℝ) < 2 / Real.sqrt π * erfcCoeff k * gaussTail k x := hpos
    _ = (-1) ^ k * (2 / Real.sqrt π * ((-1) ^ k * erfcCoeff k) * gaussTail k x) := by
        linear_combination (-(2 / Real.sqrt π * erfcCoeff k * gaussTail k x)) * hsq

name: Azurite.BZ.erfc_le_leading
statement: theorem erfc_le_leading {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : erfc x ≤ exp (-x ^ 2) / (x * Real.sqrt π)
proof:
:= by
  have h := gaussTail_le hx 0
  have hπ : 0 < Real.sqrt π := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr pi_pos
  unfold erfc
  simp only [mul_zero, zero_add, pow_one] at h
  calc 2 / Real.sqrt π * gaussTail 0 x ≤ 2 / Real.sqrt π * (exp (-x ^ 2) / (2 * x)) := by gcongr
    _ = exp (-x ^ 2) / (x * Real.sqrt π) := by field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.leading_mul_le_erfc
statement:
theorem leading_mul_le_erfc {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    exp (-x ^ 2) / (x * Real.sqrt π) * (1 - 1 / (2 * x ^ 2)) ≤ erfc x
proof:
:= by
  have h := erfc_eq_sum_add_rem hx 2
  have hs : 0 < erfcRem 2 x := by
    have := sign_erfcRem hx 2
    rwa [show ((-1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 1 by norm_num, one_mul] at this
  have hπ : 0 < Real.sqrt π := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr pi_pos
  simp only [sum_range_succ, sum_range_zero, zero_add] at h
  have h2 : erfcTerm 0 x + erfcTerm 1 x
      = exp (-x ^ 2) / (x * Real.sqrt π) * (1 - 1 / (2 * x ^ 2)) := by
    unfold erfcTerm
    rw [erfcCoeff_succ, erfcCoeff_zero]
    simp only [mul_zero, zero_add, pow_zero, pow_one, one_mul, mul_one]
    field_simp
    ring
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.erfcTermMag_succ_lt
statement:
theorem erfcTermMag_succ_lt {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 * (j : ℝ) + 1 < 2 * x ^ 2) :
    erfcTermMag (j + 1) x < erfcTermMag j x
proof:
:= by
  unfold erfcTermMag
  have hc := erfcCoeff_pos j
  have hxj : 0 < x ^ (2 * j) := by positivity
  rw [erfcCoeff_succ, show 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * j + 2 by ring, pow_add,
    div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hxj]
  have hcx := mul_pos hc hxj
  nlinarith [hcx, hj]

name: Azurite.BZ.pow_div_factorial_le_succ
statement:
theorem pow_div_factorial_le_succ {x : ℝ} {j : ℕ} (hj : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ x ^ 2) :
    x ^ (2 * j) / j.factorial ≤ x ^ (2 * (j + 1)) / (j + 1).factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.factorial_succ, show 2 * (j + 1) = 2 * j + 2 by ring, pow_add]
  push_cast
  have hf : (0 : ℝ) < j.factorial := by positivity
  have hf' : (0 : ℝ) < ((j : ℝ) + 1) * j.factorial := by positivity
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hf hf']
  have hx2 : 0 ≤ x ^ (2 * j) := Even.pow_nonneg (even_two_mul j) x
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hx2 hf.le]

name: Azurite.BZ.erfcCoeff_le_stirling
statement:
theorem erfcCoeff_le_stirling {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    erfcCoeff j ≤ exp 1 / Real.sqrt π * (j / exp 1) ^ j
proof:
:= by
  unfold erfcCoeff
  have hj0 : (0 : ℝ) < j := by exact_mod_cast hj
  have hup := factorial_le_stirling_upper (k := 2 * j) (by omega)
  have hlo := Stirling.le_factorial_stirling j
  have hπ : 0 < Real.sqrt π := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr pi_pos
  have hden : 0 < (j.factorial : ℝ) * 4 ^ j := by positivity
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hden]
  push_cast at hup hlo
  have h4 : (4 : ℝ) ^ j = 2 ^ j * 2 ^ j := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
  have hpow : ((2 * j : ℝ) / exp 1) ^ (2 * j) = 4 ^ j * ((j / exp 1) ^ j) ^ 2 := by
    rw [pow_mul, show ((2 * j : ℝ) / exp 1) ^ 2 = 4 * (j / exp 1) ^ 2 by ring, mul_pow, ← pow_mul,
      ← pow_mul, mul_comm 2 j]
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (2 * j : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt j := Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num) _
  have hsqrt2 : Real.sqrt (2 * π * j) = Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt π * Real.sqrt j := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num)]
  calc ((2 * j).factorial : ℝ)
      ≤ exp 1 * Real.sqrt (2 * j : ℝ) * ((2 * j : ℝ) / exp 1) ^ (2 * j) := hup
    _ = exp 1 / Real.sqrt π * (j / exp 1) ^ j
        * ((Real.sqrt (2 * π * j) * (j / exp 1) ^ j) * 4 ^ j) := by
        rw [hpow, hsqrt, hsqrt2]
        field_simp
    _ ≤ exp 1 / Real.sqrt π * (j / exp 1) ^ j * (j.factorial * 4 ^ j) := by gcongr

name: Azurite.BZ.erfcTermMag_le
statement:
theorem erfcTermMag_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    erfcTermMag j x ≤ exp 1 / Real.sqrt π * (j / (exp 1 * x ^ 2)) ^ j ∧
      ((j : ℝ) ≤ x ^ 2 → erfcTermMag j x ≤ exp 1 / Real.sqrt π * exp (-(j : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hπ : 0 < Real.sqrt π := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr pi_pos
  have h1 : erfcTermMag j x ≤ exp 1 / Real.sqrt π * (j / (exp 1 * x ^ 2)) ^ j := by
    unfold erfcTermMag
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    calc erfcCoeff j ≤ exp 1 / Real.sqrt π * (j / exp 1) ^ j := erfcCoeff_le_stirling hj
      _ = exp 1 / Real.sqrt π * (j / (exp 1 * x ^ 2)) ^ j * x ^ (2 * j) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, pow_mul, ← mul_pow]
          congr 2
          field_simp
  refine ⟨h1, fun hjx => h1.trans ?_⟩
  gcongr
  calc ((j : ℝ) / (exp 1 * x ^ 2)) ^ j ≤ (1 / exp 1) ^ j := by
        refine pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) ?_ j
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (exp_pos 1)]
        nlinarith [exp_pos 1]
    _ = exp (-(j : ℝ)) := by
        rw [one_div, inv_pow, ← Real.exp_nat_mul, mul_one, exp_neg]

name: Azurite.BZ.erfSeriesTerm_le_two_pow
proof:
:= by
  have hj0 : (0 : ℝ) < j := by exact_mod_cast hj
  have hlo := Stirling.le_factorial_stirling j
  have hlo' : ((j : ℝ) / exp 1) ^ j ≤ j.factorial := by
    refine le_trans ?_ hlo
    have : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * π * j) := by
      rw [Real.le_sqrt (by norm_num) (by positivity)]
      have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hj
      nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
    nlinarith [pow_pos (div_pos hj0 (exp_pos 1)) j]
  have hf : (0 : ℝ) < j.factorial := by positivity
  calc x ^ (2 * j) / j.factorial ≤ x ^ (2 * j) / ((j : ℝ) / exp 1) ^ j :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity) hlo'
    _ = exp (-(j * (Real.log j - 2 * Real.log x - 1))) := by
        have hxe : x ^ (2 * j) = exp (((2 * j : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log x) := by
          conv_lhs => rw [← Real.exp_log hx]
          rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
        have hje : ((j : ℝ) / exp 1) ^ j = exp ((j : ℝ) * (Real.log j - 1)) := by
          have : (j : ℝ) / exp 1 = exp (Real.log j - 1) := by
            rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hj0]
          conv_lhs => rw [this]
          rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
        rw [hxe, hje, ← Real.exp_sub]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) := by
        rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, ← Real.exp_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ n), Real.log_pow,
          ← Real.exp_neg]
        exact exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)

name: Azurite.BZ.erf_error_of_erfc
statement: theorem erf_error_of_erfc (x t ε : ℝ) (h : |t - erfc x| ≤ ε) : |(1 - t) - erf x| ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  unfold erf
  rw [show (1 - t) - (1 - erfc x) = -(t - erfc x) by ring, abs_neg]
  exact h

name: Azurite.BZ.asymptotic_gives_bits
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hπ : 0 < Real.sqrt π := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr pi_pos
  set k := ⌊x ^ 2⌋₊ with hk
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by
    rw [hk]; exact Nat.le_floor (by push_cast; nlinarith)
  have hkx : (k : ℝ) ≤ x ^ 2 := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hxk : x ^ 2 < k + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  
  have hL : 0 < exp (-x ^ 2) / (x * Real.sqrt π) := by positivity
  have hterm : |erfcTerm k x| = erfcTermMag k x * (exp (-x ^ 2) / (x * Real.sqrt π)) := by
    unfold erfcTerm erfcTermMag
    rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul,
      abs_of_pos (erfcCoeff_pos k), abs_of_pos (exp_pos _), abs_mul, abs_of_pos hπ,
      abs_of_pos (pow_pos hx0 _), pow_succ]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hlow : exp (-x ^ 2) / (x * Real.sqrt π) / 2 ≤ erfc x := by
    have h := leading_mul_le_erfc hx0
    have : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ 1 - 1 / (2 * x ^ 2) := by
      have : 1 / (2 * x ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]; nlinarith
      linarith
    nlinarith
  
  have hmag := (erfcTermMag_le hx0 hk1).2 hkx
  have hek : exp (-(k : ℝ)) ≤ exp 1 * exp (-x ^ 2) := by
    rw [← exp_add]; exact exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  
  have hconst : 2 * (exp 1 / Real.sqrt π * exp 1) ≤ 16 := by
    have he : exp 1 ≤ 2.72 := by linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9]
    have hπ' : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt π := by
      rw [Real.le_sqrt (by norm_num) pi_pos.le]; nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
    have : exp 1 / Real.sqrt π ≤ exp 1 := div_le_self (exp_pos 1).le hπ'
    nlinarith [exp_pos 1]
  have hexp : 16 * exp (-x ^ 2) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(m : ℤ)) := by
    rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, ← Real.exp_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ m), Real.log_pow,
      ← exp_neg, show (16 : ℝ) = exp (Real.log 16) by rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num)], ← exp_add]
    apply exp_le_exp.mpr
    have h16 : Real.log 16 = 4 * Real.log 2 := by
      rw [show (16 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 4 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]; push_cast; ring
    rw [h16]; linarith
  calc |erfcRem k x| ≤ |erfcTerm k x| := abs_erfcRem_le_abs_term hx0 k
    _ = erfcTermMag k x * (exp (-x ^ 2) / (x * Real.sqrt π)) := hterm
    _ ≤ exp 1 / Real.sqrt π * (exp 1 * exp (-x ^ 2)) * (exp (-x ^ 2) / (x * Real.sqrt π)) := by
        gcongr
        exact hmag.trans (by gcongr)
    _ = 2 * (exp 1 / Real.sqrt π * exp 1) * exp (-x ^ 2)
          * (exp (-x ^ 2) / (x * Real.sqrt π) / 2) := by
        ring
    _ ≤ 16 * exp (-x ^ 2) * erfc x := by gcongr
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(m : ℤ)) * erfc x := by
        have herfc : 0 ≤ erfc x := le_trans (by positivity) hlow
        gcongr

name: Azurite.BZ.tanDerivPoly_zero
statement: theorem tanDerivPoly_zero : tanDerivPoly 0 = X
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.tanDerivPoly_succ
statement:
theorem tanDerivPoly_succ (n : ℕ) :
    tanDerivPoly (n + 1) = derivative (tanDerivPoly n) * (1 + X ^ 2)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.tanDerivPoly_one
statement: theorem tanDerivPoly_one : tanDerivPoly 1 = 1 + X ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [tanDerivPoly_succ, tanDerivPoly_zero, derivative_X, one_mul]

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ_zero (n : ℕ) :
    (tanDerivPoly (n + 1)).coeff 0 = (tanDerivPoly n).coeff 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tanDerivPoly_succ, mul_add, mul_one, coeff_add, coeff_mul_X_pow', coeff_derivative]
  simp

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ
statement:
theorem coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ (n j : ℕ) :
    (tanDerivPoly (n + 1)).coeff (j + 1)
      = j * (tanDerivPoly n).coeff j + (j + 2) * (tanDerivPoly n).coeff (j + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tanDerivPoly_succ, mul_add, mul_one, coeff_add, coeff_mul_X_pow', coeff_derivative]
  rcases j with _ | j
  · simp
    ring
  · rw [ite_eq_left (by omega), show j + 1 + 1 - 2 = j by omega, coeff_derivative,
      show j + 1 + 2 = j + 1 + 1 + 1 from rfl]
    push_cast
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_tanDerivPoly_nonneg
statement: theorem coeff_tanDerivPoly_nonneg (n j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (tanDerivPoly n).coeff j
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing j with
  | zero =>
    rw [tanDerivPoly_zero, coeff_X]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases j with _ | j
    · rw [coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ_zero]; exact ih 1
    · rw [coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ]
      have h1 := ih j
      have h2 := ih (j + 2)
      positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_tanDerivPoly_eq_zero_of_even
statement:
theorem coeff_tanDerivPoly_eq_zero_of_even (n : ℕ) : ∀ j, Even (n + j) →
    (tanDerivPoly n).coeff j = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hj
    rw [tanDerivPoly_zero, coeff_X, ite_eq_right (by omega)]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hj
    rcases j with _ | j
    · rw [coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ_zero, ih 1 ⟨m, by omega⟩]
    · rw [coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ, ih j ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩, ih (j + 2) ⟨m, by omega⟩]
      ring

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_tanDerivPoly_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem coeff_tanDerivPoly_eq_zero_of_lt (n : ℕ) : ∀ j, n + 1 < j →
    (tanDerivPoly n).coeff j = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro j hj
    rw [tanDerivPoly_zero, coeff_X, ite_eq_right (by omega)]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro j hj
    rcases j with _ | j
    · omega
    · rw [coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ, ih j (by omega), ih (j + 2) (by omega)]
      ring

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_tanDerivPoly_top
statement: theorem coeff_tanDerivPoly_top (n : ℕ) : (tanDerivPoly n).coeff (n + 1) = n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [tanDerivPoly_zero, coeff_X]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ, ih, coeff_tanDerivPoly_eq_zero_of_lt n (n + 1 + 2) (by omega),
      Nat.factorial_succ]
    push_cast
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.natDegree_tanDerivPoly
statement: theorem natDegree_tanDerivPoly (n : ℕ) : (tanDerivPoly n).natDegree = n + 1
proof:
:=
  natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero
    (natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr fun N hN => coeff_tanDerivPoly_eq_zero_of_lt n N hN)
    (by rw [coeff_tanDerivPoly_top]; exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)

name: Azurite.BZ.pascal_sum
statement:
theorem pascal_sum {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (q : ℕ → ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ a ∈ range (n + 1), (n.choose a : R) * (q (a + 1) (n - a) + q a (n - a + 1))
      = ∑ a ∈ range (n + 2), ((n + 1).choose a : R) * q a (n + 1 - a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_range_succ' (fun a => ((n + 1).choose a : R) * q a (n + 1 - a))]
  simp only [Nat.choose_succ_succ', Nat.cast_add, add_mul, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one,
    one_mul, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.add_sub_add_right, mul_add]
  rw [sum_add_distrib, sum_add_distrib, sum_range_succ (fun a => (n.choose (a + 1) : R) *
    q (a + 1) (n - a)), Nat.choose_succ_self, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero,
    sum_range_succ' (fun a => (n.choose a : R) * q a (n - a + 1))]
  simp only [Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero]
  have : ∀ a ∈ range n, (n.choose (a + 1) : R) * q (a + 1) (n - (a + 1) + 1)
      = (n.choose (a + 1) : R) * q (a + 1) (n - a) := fun a ha => by
    rw [show n - (a + 1) + 1 = n - a by have := mem_range.mp ha; omega]
  rw [sum_congr rfl this]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.tanDerivPoly_succ_eq_sum
statement:
theorem tanDerivPoly_succ_eq_sum (n : ℕ) :
    tanDerivPoly (n + 1)
      = (if n = 0 then 1 else 0)
        + ∑ a ∈ range (n + 1), (n.choose a : ℤ[X]) * (tanDerivPoly a * tanDerivPoly (n - a))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [tanDerivPoly_one, sum_range_one]
    simp [tanDerivPoly_zero]
    ring
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [tanDerivPoly_succ, ih, derivative_add, derivative_sum, add_mul, sum_mul,
      ite_eq_right (Nat.succ_ne_zero n), zero_add]
    have hd : derivative (if n = 0 then (1 : ℤ[X]) else 0) = 0 := by split_ifs <;> simp
    rw [hd, zero_mul, zero_add]
    have hterm : ∀ a ∈ range (n + 1),
        derivative ((n.choose a : ℤ[X]) * (tanDerivPoly a * tanDerivPoly (n - a))) * (1 + X ^ 2)
          = (n.choose a : ℤ[X]) * (tanDerivPoly (a + 1) * tanDerivPoly (n - a)
            + tanDerivPoly a * tanDerivPoly (n - a + 1)) := fun a _ => by
      rw [derivative_natCast_mul, derivative_mul, tanDerivPoly_succ, tanDerivPoly_succ]
      ring
    rw [sum_congr rfl hterm]
    exact pascal_sum (fun a b => tanDerivPoly a * tanDerivPoly b) n

name: Azurite.BZ.iteratedDeriv_tan
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_tan (n : ℕ) : ∀ x : ℝ, Real.cos x ≠ 0 →
    iteratedDeriv n Real.tan x
      = ((tanDerivPoly n).map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)).eval (Real.tan x)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro x _; simp [tanDerivPoly_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro x hx
    have hU : IsOpen {y : ℝ | Real.cos y ≠ 0} := isOpen_ne_fun Real.continuous_cos continuous_const
    have heq : iteratedDeriv n Real.tan =ᶠ[nhds x]
        fun y => ((tanDerivPoly n).map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)).eval (Real.tan y) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) fun y hy => ih y hy
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, heq.deriv_eq]
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun y => ((tanDerivPoly n).map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)).eval (Real.tan y))
        ((derivative ((tanDerivPoly n).map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))).eval (Real.tan x)
          * (1 / Real.cos x ^ 2)) x :=
      (Polynomial.hasDerivAt _ (Real.tan x)).comp x (Real.hasDerivAt_tan hx)
    rw [hd.deriv, tanDerivPoly_succ, Polynomial.map_mul, derivative_map, eval_mul, one_div,
      ← Real.inv_one_add_tan_sq hx, inv_inv]
    simp

name: Azurite.BZ.iteratedDeriv_tan_zero
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_tan_zero (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv n Real.tan 0 = ((tanDerivPoly n).coeff 0 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedDeriv_tan n 0 (by simp), Real.tan_zero, ← coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, coeff_map,
    eq_intCast]

name: Azurite.BZ.iteratedDeriv_tan_zero_eq
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_tan_zero_eq (j : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv (2 * j - 1) Real.tan 0 = (tangentNumber j : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  iteratedDeriv_tan_zero _

name: Azurite.BZ.tangentNumber_one
statement: theorem tangentNumber_one : tangentNumber 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [tangentNumber, tanDerivPoly_one]

name: Azurite.BZ.tangentNumber_two
statement: theorem tangentNumber_two : tangentNumber 2 = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [tangentNumber, show 2 * 2 - 1 = 2 + 1 by rfl, coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ_zero,
    coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ, tanDerivPoly_one]
  simp [coeff_X_pow, coeff_one]

name: Azurite.BZ.tangentNumber_three
statement: theorem tangentNumber_three : tangentNumber 3 = 16
proof:
:= by
  rw [tangentNumber, show 2 * 3 - 1 = 4 + 1 by rfl, coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ_zero,
    show (4 : ℕ) = 3 + 1 by rfl, coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ, show (3 : ℕ) = 2 + 1 by rfl,
    coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ, show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 by rfl, coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ,
    coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ, coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ, coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ,
    coeff_tanDerivPoly_succ, tanDerivPoly_one]
  simp [tanDerivPoly_zero, coeff_X]

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_zero_tanDerivPoly_succ_div
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_tanDerivPoly_succ_div (n : ℕ) :
    ((tanDerivPoly (n + 1)).coeff 0 : ℚ) / n.factorial
      = (if n = 0 then 1 else 0) + ∑ a ∈ range (n + 1),
          ((tanDerivPoly a).coeff 0 : ℚ) / a.factorial
            * (((tanDerivPoly (n - a)).coeff 0 : ℚ) / (n - a).factorial)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℤ => (p.coeff 0 : ℚ)) (tanDerivPoly_succ_eq_sum n)
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, ← Polynomial.C_eq_natCast,
    Polynomial.mul_coeff_zero, Polynomial.coeff_C_zero] at h
  rw [h]
  have hite : ((if n = 0 then (1 : Polynomial ℤ) else 0).coeff 0 : ℚ) / n.factorial
      = if n = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
    split_ifs with hn <;> simp [hn]
  push_cast
  rw [add_div, hite, sum_div]
  congr 1
  refine sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
  have ha' : a ≤ n := by have := mem_range.mp ha; omega
  rw [Nat.cast_choose ℚ ha']
  have h1 : (a.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h2 : ((n - a).factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h3 : (n.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.derivative_tanDerivSeries
statement: theorem derivative_tanDerivSeries : d⁄dX tanDerivSeries = 1 + tanDerivSeries ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_derivative, map_add, coeff_one, pow_two, coeff_mul,
    Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  simp only [tanDerivSeries, coeff_mk]
  have h := coeff_zero_tanDerivPoly_succ_div n
  rw [Nat.factorial_succ] at *
  push_cast at *
  have h3 : (n.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h4 : ((n : ℚ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [← h]
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_mul_expNeg
statement: theorem exp_mul_expNeg : exp ℚ * expNeg = 1
proof: := exp_mul_exp_neg_eq_one (A := ℚ)

name: Azurite.BZ.derivative_exp
statement: theorem derivative_exp : d⁄dX (exp ℚ) = exp ℚ
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_derivative, coeff_exp, coeff_exp, algebraMap_rat_rat, algebraMap_rat_rat,
    Nat.factorial_succ]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.derivative_rescale
statement:
theorem derivative_rescale (a : ℚ) (f : PowerSeries ℚ) :
    d⁄dX (rescale a f) = C a * rescale a (d⁄dX f)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_derivative, coeff_rescale, coeff_C_mul, coeff_rescale, coeff_derivative, pow_succ]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.derivative_expNeg
statement: theorem derivative_expNeg : d⁄dX expNeg = -expNeg
proof:
:= by
  unfold expNeg
  rw [derivative_rescale, derivative_exp, map_neg, map_one, neg_one_mul]

name: Azurite.BZ.derivative_coshSeries
statement: theorem derivative_coshSeries : d⁄dX coshSeries = sinhSeries
proof:
:= by
  unfold coshSeries sinhSeries
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, derivative_C, smul_zero, add_zero, map_add, derivative_exp,
    derivative_expNeg, smul_eq_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Azurite.BZ.derivative_sinhSeries
statement: theorem derivative_sinhSeries : d⁄dX sinhSeries = coshSeries
proof:
:= by
  unfold coshSeries sinhSeries
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, derivative_C, smul_zero, add_zero, map_sub, derivative_exp,
    derivative_expNeg, smul_eq_mul, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: Azurite.BZ.coshSeries_sq_sub_sinhSeries_sq
statement: theorem coshSeries_sq_sub_sinhSeries_sq : coshSeries ^ 2 - sinhSeries ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold coshSeries sinhSeries
  have hc : C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * 2 = (1 : PowerSeries ℚ) := by
    rw [show (2 : PowerSeries ℚ) = C 2 from (map_ofNat C 2).symm, ← map_mul]
    norm_num
  have h := exp_mul_expNeg
  linear_combination (C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * 2) ^ 2 * h + (C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * 2 + 1) * hc

name: Azurite.BZ.constantCoeff_coshSeries
statement: theorem constantCoeff_coshSeries : constantCoeff coshSeries = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold coshSeries expNeg
  simp only [map_mul, map_add, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_rescale, coeff_exp,
    algebraMap_rat_rat]
  norm_num

name: Azurite.BZ.coshSeries_mul_inv
statement: theorem coshSeries_mul_inv : coshSeries * coshSeries⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:=
  PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel _ (by rw [constantCoeff_coshSeries]; exact one_ne_zero)

name: Azurite.BZ.derivative_tanhSeries
statement: theorem derivative_tanhSeries : d⁄dX tanhSeries = 1 - tanhSeries ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold tanhSeries
  have hinv := coshSeries_mul_inv
  have hdinv : d⁄dX coshSeries⁻¹ = -coshSeries⁻¹ ^ 2 • d⁄dX coshSeries :=
    Derivation.leibniz_of_mul_eq_one d⁄dX (PowerSeries.inv_mul_cancel _
      (by rw [constantCoeff_coshSeries]; exact one_ne_zero))
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, hdinv, derivative_sinhSeries, derivative_coshSeries, smul_eq_mul,
    smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination hinv

name: Azurite.BZ.constantCoeff_tanhSeries
statement: theorem constantCoeff_tanhSeries : constantCoeff tanhSeries = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold tanhSeries sinhSeries expNeg
  simp only [map_mul, map_sub, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_rescale, coeff_exp,
    algebraMap_rat_rat]
  norm_num

name: Azurite.BZ.rescale_C'
statement: theorem rescale_C' (a r : ℚ) : rescale a (C r : PowerSeries ℚ) = C r
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_rescale, coeff_C]
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: Azurite.BZ.rescale_two_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul
statement:
theorem rescale_two_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul :
    rescale (2 : ℚ) scaledBernoulliPowerSeries * (exp ℚ - expNeg) = X * (exp ℚ + expNeg)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (rescale (2 : ℚ)) scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul_sinh
  have hc : C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * C (2 : ℚ) = (1 : PowerSeries ℚ) := by rw [← map_mul]; norm_num
  simp only [map_mul, map_sub, map_add, rescale_X, rescale_C'] at h
  rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, ← rescale_mul, ← RingHom.comp_apply, ← rescale_mul] at h
  rw [show (1 / 2 : ℚ) * 2 = 1 by norm_num, show (-1 / 2 : ℚ) * 2 = -1 by norm_num, rescale_one,
    RingHom.id_apply] at h
  unfold expNeg
  linear_combination h + (X * (exp ℚ + rescale (-1 : ℚ) (exp ℚ))) * hc

name: Azurite.BZ.rescale_four_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul
statement:
theorem rescale_four_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul :
    rescale (4 : ℚ) scaledBernoulliPowerSeries * (exp ℚ ^ 2 - expNeg ^ 2)
      = C 2 * X * (exp ℚ ^ 2 + expNeg ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (rescale (4 : ℚ)) scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul_sinh
  have hc : C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * C (4 : ℚ) = C (2 : ℚ) := by rw [← map_mul]; norm_num
  simp only [map_mul, map_sub, map_add, rescale_X, rescale_C'] at h
  rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, ← rescale_mul, ← RingHom.comp_apply, ← rescale_mul] at h
  rw [show (1 / 2 : ℚ) * 4 = ((2 : ℕ) : ℚ) by norm_num, show (-1 / 2 : ℚ) * 4 = -1 + -1 by norm_num,
    ← exp_pow_eq_rescale_exp, ← exp_mul_exp_eq_exp_add, ← pow_two] at h
  unfold expNeg
  linear_combination h + (X * (exp ℚ ^ 2 + rescale (-1 : ℚ) (exp ℚ) ^ 2)) * hc

name: Azurite.BZ.X_mul_tanhSeries
statement:
theorem X_mul_tanhSeries :
    X * tanhSeries = rescale (4 : ℚ) scaledBernoulliPowerSeries
      - rescale (2 : ℚ) scaledBernoulliPowerSeries
proof:
:= by
  set S₂ := rescale (2 : ℚ) scaledBernoulliPowerSeries
  set S₄ := rescale (4 : ℚ) scaledBernoulliPowerSeries
  set u := exp ℚ
  set v := expNeg
  have h2 : S₂ * (u - v) = X * (u + v) := rescale_two_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul
  have h4 : S₄ * (u ^ 2 - v ^ 2) = C 2 * X * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) :=
    rescale_four_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_mul
  have huv : u * v = 1 := exp_mul_expNeg
  have hc : C (2 : ℚ) = (2 : PowerSeries ℚ) := map_ofNat C 2
  rw [hc] at h4
  
  have hkey : (S₄ - S₂) * (u + v) * (u - v) = X * (u - v) ^ 2 := by
    linear_combination h4 - (u + v) * h2
  have hne : u - v ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have := congrArg (coeff 1) h0
    rw [map_sub, map_zero] at this
    simp [u, v, expNeg, coeff_rescale, coeff_exp] at this
  have hcosh : (S₄ - S₂) * (u + v) = X * (u - v) := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hne
    rw [hkey]; ring
  
  have hinv := coshSeries_mul_inv
  unfold tanhSeries sinhSeries
  have hcosh' : (S₄ - S₂) * coshSeries = X * (C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * (u - v)) := by
    unfold coshSeries
    linear_combination (C (1 / 2 : ℚ)) * hcosh
  calc X * (C (1 / 2 : ℚ) * (u - v) * coshSeries⁻¹)
      = (S₄ - S₂) * coshSeries * coshSeries⁻¹ := by rw [hcosh']; ring
    _ = S₄ - S₂ := by rw [mul_assoc, hinv, mul_one]

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_tanhSeries_odd
statement:
theorem coeff_tanhSeries_odd (k : ℕ) :
    coeff (2 * k + 1) tanhSeries
      = (4 ^ (2 * (k + 1)) - 2 ^ (2 * (k + 1))) * scaledBernoulli (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (coeff (2 * (k + 1))) X_mul_tanhSeries
  rw [show 2 * (k + 1) = 2 * k + 1 + 1 by ring, coeff_succ_X_mul, map_sub, coeff_rescale,
    coeff_rescale, show 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) by ring,
    coeff_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_even] at h
  rw [h]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_tanhSeries_even
statement: theorem coeff_tanhSeries_even (k : ℕ) : coeff (2 * k) tanhSeries = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases k with _ | k
  · rw [mul_zero, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_tanhSeries]
  · have h := congrArg (coeff (2 * (k + 1) + 1)) X_mul_tanhSeries
    rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, map_sub, coeff_rescale, coeff_rescale,
      coeff_scaledBernoulliPowerSeries_odd] at h
    rw [h]
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_tanSeries
statement: theorem coeff_tanSeries (n : ℕ) : coeff n tanSeries = (-1) ^ (n / 2) * coeff n tanhSeries
proof:
:=
  coeff_mk _ _

name: Azurite.BZ.tanSeries_mul_term
statement:
theorem tanSeries_mul_term {k : ℕ} {p : ℕ × ℕ} (hp : p ∈ antidiagonal (2 * k)) :
    coeff p.1 tanSeries * coeff p.2 tanSeries
      = -(-1) ^ k * (coeff p.1 tanhSeries * coeff p.2 tanhSeries)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
  rw [coeff_tanSeries, coeff_tanSeries]
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd p.1 with ⟨a, ha⟩ | ⟨a, ha⟩
  · rw [show p.1 = 2 * a by omega, coeff_tanhSeries_even]
    ring
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, p.2 = 2 * b + 1 := ⟨p.2 / 2, by omega⟩
    obtain rfl : k = a + b + 1 := by omega
    rw [show p.1 = 2 * a + 1 by omega, hb, show (2 * a + 1) / 2 = a by omega,
      show (2 * b + 1) / 2 = b by omega]
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.derivative_tanSeries
statement: theorem derivative_tanSeries : d⁄dX tanSeries = 1 + tanSeries ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_derivative, coeff_tanSeries, map_add, coeff_one, pow_two, coeff_mul]
  have hh := congrArg (coeff n) derivative_tanhSeries
  rw [coeff_derivative, map_sub, coeff_one, pow_two, coeff_mul] at hh
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
  · obtain rfl : n = 2 * k := by omega
    rw [sum_congr rfl fun p hp => tanSeries_mul_term hp, ← mul_sum,
      show (2 * k + 1) / 2 = k by omega]
    have hodd : (if 2 * k = 0 then (1 : ℚ) else 0) = (-1) ^ k * (if 2 * k = 0 then 1 else 0) := by
      split_ifs with h0
      · rw [show k = 0 by omega]; ring
      · ring
    rw [hodd]
    linear_combination (-1 : ℚ) ^ k * hh
  · obtain rfl : n = 2 * k + 1 := by omega
    rw [show 2 * k + 1 + 1 = 2 * (k + 1) by ring, coeff_tanhSeries_even, mul_zero, zero_mul,
      ite_eq_right (by omega), zero_add]
    symm
    refine sum_eq_zero fun p hp => ?_
    have hsum := mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
    rw [coeff_tanSeries, coeff_tanSeries]
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd p.1 with ⟨a, ha⟩ | ⟨a, ha⟩
    · rw [show p.1 = 2 * a by omega, coeff_tanhSeries_even]; ring
    · rw [show p.2 = 2 * (p.2 / 2) by omega, coeff_tanhSeries_even]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.eq_of_derivative_eq_one_add_sq
statement:
theorem eq_of_derivative_eq_one_add_sq {f g : PowerSeries ℚ} (hf : d⁄dX f = 1 + f ^ 2)
    (hg : d⁄dX g = 1 + g ^ 2) (h0 : constantCoeff f = constantCoeff g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    rcases n with _ | n
    · rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, h0]
    · have hf' := congrArg (coeff n) hf
      have hg' := congrArg (coeff n) hg
      rw [coeff_derivative] at hf' hg'
      have hsq : coeff n (f ^ 2) = coeff n (g ^ 2) := by
        rw [pow_two, pow_two, coeff_mul, coeff_mul]
        refine sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
        have := mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
        rw [ih p.1 (by omega), ih p.2 (by omega)]
      have hn : ((n : ℚ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ hn
      rw [hf', hg', map_add, map_add, hsq]

name: Azurite.BZ.tanDerivSeries_eq_tanSeries
statement: theorem tanDerivSeries_eq_tanSeries : tanDerivSeries = tanSeries
proof:
:=
  eq_of_derivative_eq_one_add_sq derivative_tanDerivSeries derivative_tanSeries (by
    rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply,
      coeff_tanSeries, tanDerivSeries, coeff_mk, tanDerivPoly_zero,
      coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_tanhSeries]
    simp)

name: Azurite.BZ.tangentNumber_eq_bernoulli
statement:
theorem tangentNumber_eq_bernoulli (k : ℕ) :
    (tangentNumber (k + 1) : ℚ)
      = (-1) ^ k * 4 ^ (k + 1) * (4 ^ (k + 1) - 1) * bernoulli (2 * (k + 1)) / (2 * (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (coeff (2 * k + 1)) tanDerivSeries_eq_tanSeries
  rw [tanDerivSeries, coeff_mk, coeff_tanSeries, coeff_tanhSeries_odd,
    show (2 * k + 1) / 2 = k by omega] at h
  unfold tangentNumber scaledBernoulli at *
  rw [show 2 * (k + 1) - 1 = 2 * k + 1 by omega]
  rw [show (2 * (k + 1)).factorial = (2 * (k + 1)) * (2 * k + 1).factorial by
      rw [show 2 * (k + 1) = 2 * k + 1 + 1 by ring, Nat.factorial_succ],
    show (4 : ℚ) ^ (2 * (k + 1)) = (4 ^ (k + 1)) ^ 2 by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm],
    show (2 : ℚ) ^ (2 * (k + 1)) = 4 ^ (k + 1) by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num] at h
  have hf : ((2 * k + 1).factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h2 : ((2 * (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  push_cast at h h2 ⊢
  field_simp at h
  rw [eq_div_iff (by positivity)]
  linear_combination h

name: Azurite.BZ.bernoulli_two_mul_eq_tangentNumber
statement:
theorem bernoulli_two_mul_eq_tangentNumber (k : ℕ) :
    bernoulli (2 * (k + 1))
      = (-1) ^ k * (2 * (k + 1)) * tangentNumber (k + 1)
        / (4 ^ (2 * (k + 1)) - 2 ^ (2 * (k + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := tangentNumber_eq_bernoulli k
  have h4 : (1 : ℚ) < 4 ^ (k + 1) := one_lt_pow₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hne : (4 : ℚ) ^ (2 * (k + 1)) - 2 ^ (2 * (k + 1)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℚ) ^ (2 * (k + 1)) = (4 ^ (k + 1)) ^ 2 by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm],
      show (2 : ℚ) ^ (2 * (k + 1)) = 4 ^ (k + 1) by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num]
    nlinarith
  have h2 : (2 * ((k : ℚ) + 1)) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [eq_div_iff h2] at h
  have hsq : ((-1 : ℚ) ^ k) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow]
  rw [eq_div_iff hne,
    show (4 : ℚ) ^ (2 * (k + 1)) = (4 ^ (k + 1)) ^ 2 by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm],
    show (2 : ℚ) ^ (2 * (k + 1)) = 4 ^ (k + 1) by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num]
  linear_combination (-(-1 : ℚ) ^ k) * h
    - (4 ^ (k + 1) * (4 ^ (k + 1) - 1) * bernoulli (2 * (k + 1))) * hsq

name: Azurite.BZ.tangentNumber_pos
statement: theorem tangentNumber_pos (k : ℕ) : 0 < tangentNumber (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (Rat.cast : ℚ → ℝ) (tangentNumber_eq_bernoulli k)
  push_cast at h
  have hs := sign_bernoulli_two_mul (k := k + 1) (by omega)
  rw [show (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1 + 1) = (-1) ^ k by rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]; ring] at hs
  have h4 : (0 : ℝ) < 4 ^ (k + 1) - 1 := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) < 4 ^ (k + 1) := one_lt_pow₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
    linarith
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (tangentNumber (k + 1) : ℝ) := by
    rw [h, show (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * 4 ^ (k + 1) * (4 ^ (k + 1) - 1) * (bernoulli (2 * (k + 1)) : ℝ)
        = 4 ^ (k + 1) * (4 ^ (k + 1) - 1) * ((-1) ^ k * (bernoulli (2 * (k + 1)) : ℝ)) by ring]
    positivity
  exact_mod_cast hpos

name: Azurite.BZ.bernoulli_den_dvd
statement:
theorem bernoulli_den_dvd (k : ℕ) :
    ((bernoulli (2 * (k + 1))).den : ℤ) ∣ 4 ^ (k + 1) * (4 ^ (k + 1) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := bernoulli_two_mul_eq_tangentNumber k
  have heq : bernoulli (2 * (k + 1))
      = Rat.divInt ((-1) ^ k * (2 * (k + 1)) * tangentNumber (k + 1) : ℤ)
        (4 ^ (k + 1) * (4 ^ (k + 1) - 1) : ℤ) := by
    rw [Rat.divInt_eq_div, h,
      show (4 : ℚ) ^ (2 * (k + 1)) = (4 ^ (k + 1)) ^ 2 by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm],
      show (2 : ℚ) ^ (2 * (k + 1)) = 4 ^ (k + 1) by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact Rat.den_dvd _ _

name: Azurite.BZ.odd_prime_dvd_den_bernoulli
statement:
theorem odd_prime_dvd_den_bernoulli {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (k : ℕ)
    (h : p ∣ (bernoulli (2 * (k + 1))).den) : p ∣ 2 ^ (2 * (k + 1)) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (p : ℤ) ∣ 4 ^ (k + 1) * (4 ^ (k + 1) - 1) :=
    (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr h).trans (bernoulli_den_dvd k)
  have h4 : 1 ≤ 4 ^ (k + 1) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by norm_num)
  have h1' : p ∣ 4 ^ (k + 1) * (4 ^ (k + 1) - 1) := by
    have : ((4 ^ (k + 1) * (4 ^ (k + 1) - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) = 4 ^ (k + 1) * (4 ^ (k + 1) - 1) := by
      push_cast [Nat.cast_sub h4]; ring
    rw [← this] at h1
    exact Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mp h1
  rw [show 2 ^ (2 * (k + 1)) = 4 ^ (k + 1) by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num]
  rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).mp h1' with h5 | h5
  · exfalso
    have h6 : p ∣ 4 := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow h5
    have h7 : p ∣ 2 := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow (show p ∣ 2 ^ 2 by norm_num; exact h6)
    exact hp2 ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp Nat.prime_two).mp h7)
  · exact h5

name: Azurite.BZ.lemnIntegrand_le
statement:
theorem lemnIntegrand_le {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    |lemnIntegrand t| ≤ (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / (2 : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht1 with rfl | hlt
  · simp [lemnIntegrand]
  · have h1 : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith
    have ht3 : t ^ 4 ≤ t := by
      have : t ^ 3 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ ht0 ht1
      calc t ^ 4 = t * t ^ 3 := by ring
        _ ≤ t * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this ht0
        _ = t := mul_one t
    have h4 : 1 - t ≤ 1 - t ^ 4 := by linarith
    have hpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - t ^ 4) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    rw [lemnIntegrand, abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hpos.le), Real.rpow_neg h1.le,
      ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    exact inv_anti₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h1) (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h4)

name: Azurite.BZ.measurable_lemnIntegrand
statement: theorem measurable_lemnIntegrand : Measurable lemnIntegrand
proof:
:= by
  unfold lemnIntegrand
  fun_prop

name: Azurite.BZ.intervalIntegrable_lemnIntegrand
statement: theorem intervalIntegrable_lemnIntegrand : IntervalIntegrable lemnIntegrand volume 0 1
proof:
:= by
  have hg : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => (1 - t) ^ (-(1 / (2 : ℝ)))) volume 0 1 := by
    have h := (intervalIntegrable_rpow' (a := 0) (b := 1)
      (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < -(1 / (2 : ℝ)))).comp_sub_left 1
    simp only [sub_zero, sub_self] at h
    exact h.symm
  refine hg.mono_fun' measurable_lemnIntegrand.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_uIoc).mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t ht => ?_)
  rw [uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
  beta_reduce
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact lemnIntegrand_le ht.1.le ht.2

name: Azurite.BZ.sqrt_one_sub_cos_pow_four
statement:
theorem sqrt_one_sub_cos_pow_four (x : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (1 - Real.cos x ^ 4) = |Real.sin x| * Real.sqrt (1 + Real.cos x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h : 1 - Real.cos x ^ 4 = Real.sin x ^ 2 * (1 + Real.cos x ^ 2) := by
    rw [Real.sin_sq]; ring
  rw [h, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]

name: Azurite.BZ.lemnIntegrand_cos_mul_sin_of_pos
statement:
theorem lemnIntegrand_cos_mul_sin_of_pos {x : ℝ} (hs : 0 < Real.sin x) :
    lemnIntegrand (Real.cos x) * Real.sin x = (Real.sqrt (1 + Real.cos x ^ 2))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [lemnIntegrand, sqrt_one_sub_cos_pow_four, abs_of_pos hs, mul_inv, mul_comm, ← mul_assoc,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ hs.ne', one_mul]

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_lemnIntegrand_cos_mul_sin_le
statement:
theorem abs_lemnIntegrand_cos_mul_sin_le (x : ℝ) :
    |lemnIntegrand (Real.cos x) * Real.sin x| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [lemnIntegrand, sqrt_one_sub_cos_pow_four, abs_mul, abs_inv, abs_mul, abs_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
  rcases eq_or_ne (Real.sin x) 0 with h0 | h0
  · simp [h0]
  · have hs : 0 < |Real.sin x| := abs_pos.mpr h0
    have hr : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + Real.cos x ^ 2) := by
      rw [Real.le_sqrt' one_pos]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.cos x)]
    rw [mul_inv, mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hs.ne', one_mul]
    exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hr

name: Azurite.BZ.cos_image_Ioo_subset
statement: theorem cos_image_Ioo_subset : Real.cos '' Ioo 0 (π / 2) ⊆ Ico 0 1
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨(Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith [hx.1, Real.pi_pos], hx.2⟩).le, ?_⟩
  have := Real.cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi_div_two le_rfl hx.2.le hx.1
  rwa [Real.cos_zero] at this

name: Azurite.BZ.cos_image_Icc_subset
statement: theorem cos_image_Icc_subset : Real.cos '' Icc 0 (π / 2) ⊆ Icc 0 1
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith [hx.1, Real.pi_pos], hx.2⟩, Real.cos_le_one x⟩

name: Azurite.BZ.continuousOn_lemnIntegrand
statement: theorem continuousOn_lemnIntegrand : ContinuousOn lemnIntegrand (Ico 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousOn.inv₀ ?_ fun t ht => ?_
  · exact (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_pow 4))).continuousOn
  · have : t ^ 4 < 1 := pow_lt_one₀ ht.1 ht.2 (by norm_num)
    exact (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)).ne'

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_lemnIntegrand
statement:
theorem integral_lemnIntegrand :
    ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, lemnIntegrand t
      = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), lemnIntegrand (Real.cos x) * Real.sin x
proof:
:= by
  have hpi : (0 : ℝ) ≤ π / 2 := by positivity
  have hmin : min (0 : ℝ) (π / 2) = 0 := min_eq_left hpi
  have hmax : max (0 : ℝ) (π / 2) = π / 2 := max_eq_right hpi
  have key := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv''' (a := 0) (b := π / 2) (f := Real.cos)
    (f' := fun x => -Real.sin x) (g := lemnIntegrand) Real.continuous_cos.continuousOn
    (fun x _ => (Real.hasDerivAt_cos x).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (by rw [hmin, hmax]; exact continuousOn_lemnIntegrand.mono cos_image_Ioo_subset)
    (by
      rw [uIcc_of_le hpi]
      exact ((intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le zero_le_one).mp
        intervalIntegrable_lemnIntegrand).mono_set cos_image_Icc_subset)
    (by
      rw [uIcc_of_le hpi]
      refine (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hpi).mp ?_
      refine (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (1 : ℝ))).mono_fun' ?_
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
      · exact ((measurable_lemnIntegrand.comp Real.measurable_cos).mul
          Real.measurable_sin.neg).aestronglyMeasurable
      · simp only [Function.comp, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_neg, abs_neg]
        exact abs_lemnIntegrand_cos_mul_sin_le x)
  rw [Real.cos_zero, Real.cos_pi_div_two, intervalIntegral.integral_symm 0 1] at key
  have h2 : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), (lemnIntegrand ∘ Real.cos) x * (-Real.sin x)
      = -∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), lemnIntegrand (Real.cos x) * Real.sin x := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
    congr 1
    ext x
    simp only [Function.comp, mul_neg]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.lemniscate_eq_sqrt_two_mul_ellipticK
statement:
theorem lemniscate_eq_sqrt_two_mul_ellipticK :
    lemniscate = Real.sqrt 2 * ellipticK salaminB0
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), lemnIntegrand (Real.cos x) * Real.sin x
      = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
          (Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (1 - salaminB0 ^ 2 * Real.sin x ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => ?_
    rw [uIoc_of_le (by positivity)] at hx
    have hs := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hx.1 (by linarith [Real.pi_pos, hx.2])
    have hc : 1 + Real.cos x ^ 2 = 2 * (1 - 1 / 2 * Real.sin x ^ 2) := by
      linear_combination Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq x
    rw [lemnIntegrand_cos_mul_sin_of_pos hs, salaminB0_sq, hc,
      Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), mul_inv]
  rw [lemniscate, integral_lemnIntegrand, h2, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  unfold ellipticK
  have hs : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hsq := Real.mul_self_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
  calc 2 * ((Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
        (Real.sqrt (1 - salaminB0 ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹)
      = (Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 2) * (Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
        (Real.sqrt (1 - salaminB0 ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by rw [hsq]; ring
    _ = Real.sqrt 2 * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
        (Real.sqrt (1 - salaminB0 ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [mul_assoc (Real.sqrt 2), mul_inv_cancel₀ hs, mul_one]

name: Azurite.BZ.AGM_one_sqrt_two
statement: theorem AGM_one_sqrt_two : AGM 1 (Real.sqrt 2) = Real.sqrt 2 * AGM 1 salaminB0
proof:
:= by
  have hs2 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := by positivity
  have hb0 := salaminB0_pos
  rw [AGM_comm 1 salaminB0, ← AGM_smul hs2 hb0 one_pos, mul_one, salaminB0,
    mul_one_div_cancel hs2.ne', AGM_comm]

name: Azurite.BZ.lemniscate_eq_pi_div_AGM
statement: theorem lemniscate_eq_pi_div_AGM : lemniscate = π / AGM 1 (Real.sqrt 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lemniscate_eq_sqrt_two_mul_ellipticK, ellipticK_salaminB0, AGM_one_sqrt_two]
  have hM : 0 < AGM 1 salaminB0 := AGM_one_pos salaminB0_pos
  have hsq := Real.mul_self_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
  rw [eq_div_iff (by positivity)]
  calc Real.sqrt 2 * (π / (2 * AGM 1 salaminB0)) * (Real.sqrt 2 * AGM 1 salaminB0)
      = (Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 2) * AGM 1 salaminB0 * (π / (2 * AGM 1 salaminB0)) := by ring
    _ = π := by rw [hsq]; field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.lemniscate_eq_pi_mul_gauss
statement: theorem lemniscate_eq_pi_mul_gauss : lemniscate = π * (AGM 1 (Real.sqrt 2))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [lemniscate_eq_pi_div_AGM, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Azurite.BZ.lemniscate_pos
statement: theorem lemniscate_pos : 0 < lemniscate
proof:
:= by
  rw [lemniscate_eq_pi_div_AGM]
  exact div_pos Real.pi_pos (AGM_one_pos (by positivity))

name: Azurite.BZ.arctan_sub_arctan
statement:
theorem arctan_sub_arctan {a b : ℝ} (h : -1 < a * b) :
    Real.arctan a - Real.arctan b = Real.arctan ((a - b) / (1 + a * b))
proof:
:= by
  have := Real.arctan_add (x := a) (y := -b) (by nlinarith)
  rw [Real.arctan_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg] at this
  rw [this]
  congr 1
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.arctan_eq_arctan_rat_add
statement:
theorem arctan_eq_arctan_rat_add {p : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 < q) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Real.arctan x = Real.arctan (p / q) + Real.arctan ((q * x - p) / (q + p * x))
proof:
:= by
  have hq' : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hp' : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hxp : 0 ≤ x * ((p : ℝ) / q) := by positivity
  have h := arctan_sub_arctan (a := x) (b := (p : ℝ) / q) (by linarith)
  have e : (x - (p : ℝ) / q) / (1 + x * ((p : ℝ) / q)) = (q * x - p) / (q + p * x) := by
    field_simp
  rw [e] at h
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.delta_nonneg_le
statement:
theorem delta_nonneg_le {p : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 < q) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hpx : (p : ℝ) / q ≤ x) :
    0 ≤ (q * x - p) / (q + p * x) ∧ (q * x - p) / (q + p * x) ≤ x - p / q
proof:
:= by
  have hq' : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hp' : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hnum : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) * x - p := by rw [div_le_iff₀ hq'] at hpx; linarith
  have hden : (q : ℝ) ≤ q + p * x := by nlinarith
  constructor
  · exact div_nonneg hnum (by linarith)
  · calc ((q : ℝ) * x - p) / (q + p * x) ≤ (q * x - p) / q :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum hq' hden
      _ = x - p / q := by field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.delta_lt_inv
statement:
theorem delta_lt_inv {p : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 < q) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hpx : (p : ℝ) / q ≤ x) (hx1 : x < (p + 1) / q) :
    (q * x - p) / (q + p * x) < 1 / q
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : x - (p : ℝ) / q < 1 / q := by
    rw [add_div] at hx1
    linarith
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (delta_nonneg_le hp hq hx hpx).2 h1

name: Azurite.BZ.bitBurstQ_pos
statement: theorem bitBurstQ_pos (i : ℕ) : 0 < bitBurstQ i
proof: := by unfold bitBurstQ; positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.bitBurstQ_succ
statement: theorem bitBurstQ_succ (i : ℕ) : bitBurstQ (i + 1) = bitBurstQ i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold bitBurstQ
  rw [← pow_mul, pow_succ 2 (i + 1), mul_comm]

name: Azurite.BZ.bitBurstRem_zero
statement: theorem bitBurstRem_zero : bitBurstRem x 0 = x
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.bitBurstRem_succ
statement:
theorem bitBurstRem_succ (i : ℕ) :
    bitBurstRem x (i + 1) = ((bitBurstQ (i + 1) : ℝ) * bitBurstRem x i - bitBurstNum x i)
      / (bitBurstQ (i + 1) + bitBurstNum x i * bitBurstRem x i)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.bitBurstRem_bounds
statement:
theorem bitBurstRem_bounds (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x < 1 / 4) (i : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ bitBurstRem x i ∧ bitBurstRem x i < 1 / (bitBurstQ i : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => exact ⟨hx0, by simpa [bitBurstRem_zero, bitBurstQ] using hx⟩
  | succ i ih =>
    obtain ⟨h0, -⟩ := ih
    have hq := bitBurstQ_pos (i + 1)
    have hq' : (0 : ℝ) < bitBurstQ (i + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hq
    have hp : 0 ≤ bitBurstNum x i := Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (by positivity)
    have hpx : (bitBurstNum x i : ℝ) / bitBurstQ (i + 1) ≤ bitBurstRem x i := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hq', mul_comm]
      exact Int.floor_le _
    have hx1 : bitBurstRem x i < ((bitBurstNum x i : ℝ) + 1) / bitBurstQ (i + 1) := by
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ hq', mul_comm]
      exact Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    rw [bitBurstRem_succ]
    exact ⟨(delta_nonneg_le hp hq h0 hpx).1, delta_lt_inv hp hq h0 hpx hx1⟩

name: Azurite.BZ.bitBurstNum_nonneg
statement: theorem bitBurstNum_nonneg (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x < 1 / 4) (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ bitBurstNum x i
proof:
:=
  Int.floor_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (bitBurstRem_bounds hx0 hx i).1)

name: Azurite.BZ.bitBurstNum_lt
statement:
theorem bitBurstNum_lt (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x < 1 / 4) (i : ℕ) :
    bitBurstNum x i < bitBurstQ i
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : (0 : ℝ) < bitBurstQ i := by exact_mod_cast bitBurstQ_pos i
  have hr := (bitBurstRem_bounds hx0 hx i).2
  have h1 : (bitBurstNum x i : ℝ) ≤ bitBurstQ (i + 1) * bitBurstRem x i := Int.floor_le _
  have h2 : (bitBurstQ (i + 1) : ℝ) * bitBurstRem x i < bitBurstQ i := by
    rw [bitBurstQ_succ]
    push_cast
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hQ] at hr
    nlinarith
  exact_mod_cast h1.trans_lt h2

name: Azurite.BZ.bitBurstNum_div_lt
statement:
theorem bitBurstNum_div_lt (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x < 1 / 4) (i : ℕ) :
    (bitBurstNum x i : ℝ) / bitBurstQ (i + 1) < 1 / bitBurstQ i
proof:
:= by
  have hq' : (0 : ℝ) < bitBurstQ (i + 1) := by exact_mod_cast bitBurstQ_pos (i + 1)
  calc (bitBurstNum x i : ℝ) / bitBurstQ (i + 1) ≤ bitBurstRem x i := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hq', mul_comm]
        exact Int.floor_le _
    _ < 1 / bitBurstQ i := (bitBurstRem_bounds hx0 hx i).2

name: Azurite.BZ.arctan_eq_sum_bitBurst
statement:
theorem arctan_eq_sum_bitBurst (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x < 1 / 4) (L : ℕ) :
    Real.arctan x = ∑ i ∈ range L, Real.arctan ((bitBurstNum x i : ℝ) / bitBurstQ (i + 1))
      + Real.arctan (bitBurstRem x L)
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | zero => simp [bitBurstRem_zero]
  | succ L ih =>
    rw [sum_range_succ, ih, add_assoc, bitBurstRem_succ]
    congr 1
    exact arctan_eq_arctan_rat_add (bitBurstNum_nonneg hx0 hx L) (bitBurstQ_pos (L + 1))
      (bitBurstRem_bounds hx0 hx L).1

name: Azurite.BZ.arctan_le_self
statement: theorem arctan_le_self {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : Real.arctan t ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 0 ≤ Real.arctan t := Real.arctan_nonneg.mpr ht
  have h2 := Real.le_tan h1 (Real.arctan_lt_pi_div_two t)
  rwa [Real.tan_arctan] at h2

name: Azurite.BZ.arctan_bitBurstRem_lt
statement:
theorem arctan_bitBurstRem_lt (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x < 1 / 4) (L : ℕ) :
    Real.arctan (bitBurstRem x L) < 1 / (bitBurstQ L : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_lt (arctan_le_self (bitBurstRem_bounds hx0 hx L).1) (bitBurstRem_bounds hx0 hx L).2

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_arctan_sub_sum_bitBurst_le
statement:
theorem abs_arctan_sub_sum_bitBurst_le (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x < 1 / 4) {L n : ℕ}
    (hn : n ≤ 2 ^ (L + 1)) :
    |Real.arctan x - ∑ i ∈ range L, Real.arctan ((bitBurstNum x i : ℝ) / bitBurstQ (i + 1))|
      ≤ (1 / 2) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [arctan_eq_sum_bitBurst hx0 hx L, add_sub_cancel_left]
  have h0 : 0 ≤ Real.arctan (bitBurstRem x L) :=
    Real.arctan_nonneg.mpr (bitBurstRem_bounds hx0 hx L).1
  rw [abs_of_nonneg h0]
  refine (arctan_bitBurstRem_lt hx0 hx L).le.trans ?_
  rw [bitBurstQ, one_div]
  push_cast
  rw [← inv_pow, ← one_div]
  exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hn

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_arctan_sub_sum_bitBurst_clog_le
statement:
theorem abs_arctan_sub_sum_bitBurst_clog_le (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x < 1 / 4) (n : ℕ) :
    |Real.arctan x - ∑ i ∈ range (Nat.clog 2 n),
        Real.arctan ((bitBurstNum x i : ℝ) / bitBurstQ (i + 1))| ≤ (1 / 2) ^ n
proof:
:=
  abs_arctan_sub_sum_bitBurst_le hx0 hx
    ((Nat.le_pow_clog one_lt_two n).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos (Nat.le_succ _)))

name: Azurite.BZ.repeated_binary_splitting_cost
statement:
theorem repeated_binary_splitting_cost {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    (Nat.clog 2 n : ℝ) * (4 * Real.logb 2 n ^ 2 * quasiLinearCost n)
      ≤ 8 * Real.logb 2 n ^ 3 * quasiLinearCost n
proof:
:= by
  have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ n)
  have hlg : 1 ≤ Real.logb 2 n := by
    rw [Real.le_logb_iff_rpow_le one_lt_two (by linarith), Real.rpow_one]
    exact_mod_cast hn
  have hM : 0 ≤ quasiLinearCost n := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hL : (Nat.clog 2 n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.logb 2 n := by linarith [clog_le_logb_add_one hn]
  calc (Nat.clog 2 n : ℝ) * (4 * Real.logb 2 n ^ 2 * quasiLinearCost n)
      ≤ 2 * Real.logb 2 n * (4 * Real.logb 2 n ^ 2 * quasiLinearCost n) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL (by positivity)
    _ = 8 * Real.logb 2 n ^ 3 * quasiLinearCost n := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.int_mul_add_one_nonneg
statement: theorem int_mul_add_one_nonneg (x : ℤ) : 0 ≤ x * (x + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt 0 x with h | h
  · positivity
  · nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.natAbs_mul_natAbs_add_one_ge
statement: theorem natAbs_mul_natAbs_add_one_ge (a : ℤ) : a.natAbs - 1 ≤ a.natAbs * (a + 1).natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a (-1) with rfl | h
  · simp
  · have : 1 ≤ (a + 1).natAbs := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
    calc a.natAbs - 1 ≤ a.natAbs := Nat.sub_le _ _
      _ = a.natAbs * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ ≤ a.natAbs * (a + 1).natAbs := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ this

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_abs_pow_natAbs_sub_one
statement:
theorem summable_abs_pow_natAbs_sub_one (hq : |q| < 1) :
    Summable fun a : ℤ => |q| ^ (a.natAbs - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Summable.int_rec (f := fun n : ℕ => |q| ^ (n - 1)) (g := fun n : ℕ => |q| ^ n)
    (by
      have := (summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => |q| ^ (n - 1)) 1).mpr
      exact (summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => |q| ^ (n - 1)) 1).mp
        ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one (abs_nonneg q) hq).congr fun n => by simp))
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (abs_nonneg q) hq)
  refine h.congr fun m => ?_
  rcases m with n | n
  · rfl
  · show |q| ^ n = |q| ^ ((n + 1) - 1)
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_norm_theta2Int_term
statement:
theorem summable_norm_theta2Int_term (hq : |q| < 1) :
    Summable fun a : ℤ => ‖q ^ (a.natAbs * (a + 1).natAbs)‖
proof:
:=
  (summable_abs_pow_natAbs_sub_one hq).of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) fun a => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_pow]
    exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (abs_nonneg q) hq.le (natAbs_mul_natAbs_add_one_ge a)

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_theta2Int_term
statement:
theorem summable_theta2Int_term (hq : |q| < 1) :
    Summable fun a : ℤ => q ^ (a.natAbs * (a + 1).natAbs)
proof:
:=
  (summable_norm_theta2Int_term hq).of_norm

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2_eq_rpow_mul
statement:
theorem theta2_eq_rpow_mul (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    theta2 q = q ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * theta2Int q
proof:
:= by
  have hq : |q| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1
  have hf : Summable fun n : ℕ => q ^ (n * (n + 1)) :=
    (summable_theta2Int_term hq).comp_injective (i := fun n : ℕ => (n : ℤ)) Int.ofNat_injective
  have hg : Summable fun n : ℕ => q ^ ((n + 1) * n) := by
    refine hf.congr fun n => ?_
    rw [mul_comm]
  have heq : (fun a : ℤ => q ^ (a.natAbs * (a + 1).natAbs))
      = Int.rec (fun n : ℕ => q ^ (n * (n + 1))) (fun n : ℕ => q ^ ((n + 1) * n)) := by
    funext a
    rcases a with n | n
    · rfl
    · show q ^ ((Int.negSucc n).natAbs * (Int.negSucc n + 1).natAbs) = q ^ ((n + 1) * n)
      congr 2
      omega
  unfold theta2 theta2Int
  rw [heq, tsum_int_rec hf hg]
  have h2 : ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ ((n + 1) * n) = ∑' n : ℕ, q ^ (n * (n + 1)) :=
    tsum_congr fun n => by rw [mul_comm]
  rw [h2]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.two_le_theta2Int
statement: theorem two_le_theta2Int (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : 2 ≤ theta2Int q
proof:
:= by
  have hq : |q| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1
  unfold theta2Int
  have hs := summable_theta2Int_term hq
  have := hs.sum_le_tsum {0, -1} (fun a _ => by positivity)
  rw [Finset.sum_pair (by decide)] at this
  norm_num at this
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.natAbs_sq_add_one_add_sub
statement:
theorem natAbs_sq_add_one_add_sub (a b : ℤ) :
    (a + b + 1).natAbs ^ 2 + (a - b).natAbs ^ 2
      = 2 * (a.natAbs * (a + 1).natAbs) + 2 * (b.natAbs * (b + 1).natAbs) + 1
proof:
:= by
  zify
  simp only [sq_abs]
  rw [← abs_mul, ← abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (int_mul_add_one_nonneg a),
    abs_of_nonneg (int_mul_add_one_nonneg b)]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.natAbs_mul_even_split
statement:
theorem natAbs_mul_even_split (c d : ℤ) :
    (c + d).natAbs * (c + d + 1).natAbs + (c - d).natAbs * (c - d + 1).natAbs
      = 2 * (c.natAbs * (c + 1).natAbs) + 2 * d.natAbs ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  zify
  simp only [sq_abs]
  rw [← abs_mul, ← abs_mul, ← abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (int_mul_add_one_nonneg (c + d)),
    abs_of_nonneg (int_mul_add_one_nonneg (c - d)), abs_of_nonneg (int_mul_add_one_nonneg c)]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.natAbs_mul_odd_split
statement:
theorem natAbs_mul_odd_split (c d : ℤ) :
    (c + d + 1).natAbs * (c + d + 1 + 1).natAbs + (c - d).natAbs * (c - d + 1).natAbs
      = 2 * (c + 1).natAbs ^ 2 + 2 * (d.natAbs * (d + 1).natAbs)
proof:
:= by
  zify
  simp only [sq_abs]
  rw [← abs_mul, ← abs_mul, ← abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (int_mul_add_one_nonneg (c + d + 1)),
    abs_of_nonneg (int_mul_add_one_nonneg (c - d)), abs_of_nonneg (int_mul_add_one_nonneg d)]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.theta3_sq_sub_theta4_sq
statement:
theorem theta3_sq_sub_theta4_sq (hq : |q| < 1) :
    theta3 q ^ 2 - theta4 q ^ 2 = 2 * q * theta2Int (q ^ 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 : |q ^ 2| < 1 := by rw [abs_pow]; exact pow_lt_one₀ (abs_nonneg q) hq two_ne_zero
  unfold theta3 theta4 theta2Int
  rw [sq, sq, sq, tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm (summable_norm_theta3_term hq)
    (summable_norm_theta3_term hq), tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm (summable_norm_theta4_term hq)
    (summable_norm_theta4_term hq), tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm
    (summable_norm_theta2Int_term hq2) (summable_norm_theta2Int_term hq2)]
  have hs3 := summable_mul_of_summable_norm (summable_norm_theta3_term hq)
    (summable_norm_theta3_term hq)
  have hs4 := summable_mul_of_summable_norm (summable_norm_theta4_term hq)
    (summable_norm_theta4_term hq)
  rw [← hs3.tsum_sub hs4, tsum_prod_int_split (hs3.sub hs4)]
  have heven : ∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, (q ^ ((p.1 + p.2).natAbs ^ 2) * q ^ ((p.1 - p.2).natAbs ^ 2)
      - (-1) ^ (p.1 + p.2).natAbs * q ^ ((p.1 + p.2).natAbs ^ 2)
        * ((-1) ^ (p.1 - p.2).natAbs * q ^ ((p.1 - p.2).natAbs ^ 2))) = 0 := by
    refine (tsum_congr fun p => ?_).trans (tsum_zero (α := ℝ) (β := ℤ × ℤ))
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
    simp only
    have h := neg_one_pow_natAbs_mul (a + b) (a - b)
    rw [ite_eq_left ⟨a, by ring⟩] at h
    linear_combination (-(q ^ ((a + b).natAbs ^ 2) * q ^ ((a - b).natAbs ^ 2))) * h
  rw [heven, zero_add, ← tsum_mul_left]
  refine tsum_congr fun p => ?_
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
  simp only
  have h := neg_one_pow_natAbs_mul (a + b + 1) (a - b)
  rw [ite_eq_right (by rw [Int.not_even_iff_odd]; exact ⟨a, by ring⟩)] at h
  have hexp : q ^ ((a + b + 1).natAbs ^ 2) * q ^ ((a - b).natAbs ^ 2)
      = q * ((q ^ 2) ^ (a.natAbs * (a + 1).natAbs) * (q ^ 2) ^ (b.natAbs * (b + 1).natAbs)) := by
    rw [← pow_add, natAbs_sq_add_one_add_sub, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add, pow_succ]
    ring
  linear_combination (-(q ^ ((a + b + 1).natAbs ^ 2) * q ^ ((a - b).natAbs ^ 2))) * h
    + 2 * hexp

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2Int_sq
statement: theorem theta2Int_sq (hq : |q| < 1) : theta2Int q ^ 2 = 2 * theta3 (q ^ 2) * theta2Int (q ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 : |q ^ 2| < 1 := by rw [abs_pow]; exact pow_lt_one₀ (abs_nonneg q) hq two_ne_zero
  unfold theta3 theta2Int
  rw [sq, tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm (summable_norm_theta2Int_term hq)
    (summable_norm_theta2Int_term hq), mul_assoc, tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm
    (summable_norm_theta3_term hq2) (summable_norm_theta2Int_term hq2)]
  have hs := summable_mul_of_summable_norm (summable_norm_theta2Int_term hq)
    (summable_norm_theta2Int_term hq)
  rw [tsum_prod_int_split hs]
  have heven : ∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, q ^ ((p.1 + p.2).natAbs * (p.1 + p.2 + 1).natAbs)
      * q ^ ((p.1 - p.2).natAbs * (p.1 - p.2 + 1).natAbs)
      = ∑' z : ℤ × ℤ, (q ^ 2) ^ (z.1.natAbs ^ 2) * (q ^ 2) ^ (z.2.natAbs * (z.2 + 1).natAbs) := by
    
    rw [← (Equiv.prodComm ℤ ℤ).tsum_eq
      (fun z : ℤ × ℤ => (q ^ 2) ^ (z.1.natAbs ^ 2) * (q ^ 2) ^ (z.2.natAbs * (z.2 + 1).natAbs))]
    refine tsum_congr fun p => ?_
    obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := p
    simp only [Equiv.prodComm_apply, Prod.swap]
    rw [← pow_add, natAbs_mul_even_split, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
    ring_nf
  have hodd : ∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, q ^ ((p.1 + p.2 + 1).natAbs * (p.1 + p.2 + 1 + 1).natAbs)
      * q ^ ((p.1 - p.2).natAbs * (p.1 - p.2 + 1).natAbs)
      = ∑' z : ℤ × ℤ, (q ^ 2) ^ (z.1.natAbs ^ 2) * (q ^ 2) ^ (z.2.natAbs * (z.2 + 1).natAbs) := by
    
    rw [← (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.addRight (1 : ℤ)) (Equiv.refl ℤ)).tsum_eq
      (fun z : ℤ × ℤ => (q ^ 2) ^ (z.1.natAbs ^ 2) * (q ^ 2) ^ (z.2.natAbs * (z.2 + 1).natAbs))]
    refine tsum_congr fun p => ?_
    obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := p
    simp only [Equiv.prodCongr_apply, Equiv.coe_addRight, Equiv.refl_apply, Prod.map]
    rw [← pow_add, natAbs_mul_odd_split, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
  rw [heven, hodd]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2_pow_four_add_theta4_pow_four
statement:
theorem theta2_pow_four_add_theta4_pow_four (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    theta2 q ^ 4 + theta4 q ^ 4 = theta3 q ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  have hq : |q| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hq0]; exact hq1
  have h1 := theta3_sq_add_theta4_sq hq
  have h2 := theta3_sq_sub_theta4_sq hq
  have h3 := theta2Int_sq hq
  rw [theta2_eq_rpow_mul hq0 hq1, mul_pow, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hq0,
    show (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ((4 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 1 by norm_num, Real.rpow_one]
  have : theta3 q ^ 4 - theta4 q ^ 4
      = (theta3 q ^ 2 + theta4 q ^ 2) * (theta3 q ^ 2 - theta4 q ^ 2) := by
    ring
  linear_combination q * (theta2Int q ^ 2 + 2 * theta3 (q ^ 2) * theta2Int (q ^ 2)) * h3
    - 4 * q * theta2Int (q ^ 2) ^ 2 * h1 - (theta3 q ^ 2 + theta4 q ^ 2) * h2

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2_nonneg
statement: theorem theta2_nonneg (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : 0 ≤ theta2 q
proof:
:= by
  rw [theta2_eq_rpow_mul hq0 hq1]
  have := two_le_theta2Int hq0 hq1
  positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2_pos
statement: theorem theta2_pos (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) : 0 < theta2 q
proof:
:= by
  rw [theta2_eq_rpow_mul hq0.le hq1]
  have := two_le_theta2Int hq0.le hq1
  positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2_le_theta3
statement: theorem theta2_le_theta3 (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : theta2 q ≤ theta3 q
proof:
:= by
  have h := theta2_pow_four_add_theta4_pow_four hq0 hq1
  have h4 : 0 ≤ theta4 q ^ 4 := by positivity
  have h3 := theta3_pos hq0 hq1
  have h2 := theta2_nonneg hq0 hq1
  exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (4 : ℕ) ≠ 0) h3.le (by linarith)

name: Azurite.BZ.nomeK_sq_add_nomeK'_sq
statement: theorem nomeK_sq_add_nomeK'_sq (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : nomeK q ^ 2 + nomeK' q ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold nomeK nomeK'
  have h3 := theta3_pos hq0 hq1
  have h := theta2_pow_four_add_theta4_pow_four hq0 hq1
  field_simp
  linear_combination h

name: Azurite.BZ.nomeK_nonneg
statement: theorem nomeK_nonneg (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : 0 ≤ nomeK q
proof:
:= by
  unfold nomeK; have := theta2_nonneg hq0 hq1; positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.nomeK_pos
statement: theorem nomeK_pos (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) : 0 < nomeK q
proof:
:= by
  unfold nomeK
  have := theta2_pos hq0 hq1
  have := theta3_pos hq0.le hq1
  positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.nomeK_le_one
statement: theorem nomeK_le_one (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : nomeK q ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold nomeK
  have h3 := theta3_pos hq0 hq1
  rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (theta2_nonneg hq0 hq1) (theta2_le_theta3 hq0 hq1) 2

name: Azurite.BZ.sqrt_one_sub_nomeK'_sq
statement:
theorem sqrt_one_sub_nomeK'_sq (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    Real.sqrt (1 - nomeK' q ^ 2) = nomeK q
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 1 - nomeK' q ^ 2 = nomeK q ^ 2 by linarith [nomeK_sq_add_nomeK'_sq hq0 hq1],
    Real.sqrt_sq (nomeK_nonneg hq0 hq1)]

name: Azurite.BZ.sqrt_one_sub_nomeK_sq
statement:
theorem sqrt_one_sub_nomeK_sq (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    Real.sqrt (1 - nomeK q ^ 2) = nomeK' q
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 1 - nomeK q ^ 2 = nomeK' q ^ 2 by linarith [nomeK_sq_add_nomeK'_sq hq0 hq1],
    Real.sqrt_sq (nomeK'_pos hq0 hq1).le]

name: Azurite.BZ.ellipticK_nomeK
statement:
theorem ellipticK_nomeK (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    ellipticK (nomeK q) = Real.pi / 2 * theta3 q ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sqrt_one_sub_nomeK'_sq hq0 hq1]
  exact ellipticK_nome hq0 hq1

name: Azurite.BZ.nome_pos
statement: theorem nome_pos (s : ℝ) : 0 < nome s
proof: := Real.exp_pos _

name: Azurite.BZ.nome_lt_one
statement: theorem nome_lt_one {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : nome s < 1
proof:
:=
  Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])

name: Azurite.BZ.natAbs_cast_sq_complex
statement: theorem natAbs_cast_sq_complex (n : ℤ) : ((n.natAbs : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ 2 = (n : ℂ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.cast_natCast, ← Int.cast_pow, Int.natAbs_sq, Int.cast_pow]

name: Azurite.BZ.theta3_nome_eq
statement: theorem theta3_nome_eq (s : ℝ) : (theta3 (nome s) : ℂ) = jacobiTheta₂ 0 (I * s)
proof:
:= by
  unfold theta3 jacobiTheta₂ nome
  rw [Complex.ofReal_tsum]
  refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
  unfold jacobiTheta₂_term
  rw [Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_exp, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  rw [natAbs_cast_sq_complex]
  ring_nf
  rw [Complex.I_sq]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.theta4_nome_eq
statement: theorem theta4_nome_eq (s : ℝ) : (theta4 (nome s) : ℂ) = jacobiTheta₂ (1 / 2) (I * s)
proof:
:= by
  unfold theta4 jacobiTheta₂ nome
  rw [Complex.ofReal_tsum]
  refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
  unfold jacobiTheta₂_term
  rw [Complex.exp_add, Complex.ofReal_mul]
  congr 1
  · rw [show 2 * ↑Real.pi * I * (n : ℂ) * (1 / 2) = n * (Real.pi * I) by ring, Complex.exp_int_mul,
      Complex.exp_pi_mul_I, Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_neg, Complex.ofReal_one]
    rcases Int.even_or_odd n with h | h
    · rw [h.neg_one_zpow, (Int.natAbs_even.mpr h).neg_one_pow]
    · rw [h.neg_one_zpow, (Int.natAbs_odd.mpr h).neg_one_pow]
  · rw [Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_exp, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    rw [natAbs_cast_sq_complex]
    ring_nf
    rw [Complex.I_sq]
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2_nome_eq
statement:
theorem theta2_nome_eq {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (theta2 (nome s) : ℂ)
      = Complex.exp (-(Real.pi * s) / 4) * jacobiTheta₂ (I * s / 2) (I * s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [theta2_eq_tsum_int (nome_pos s) (nome_lt_one hs)]
  unfold jacobiTheta₂ nome
  rw [Complex.ofReal_tsum, ← tsum_mul_left]
  refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
  unfold jacobiTheta₂_term
  rw [← Complex.exp_add, ← Real.exp_mul, Complex.ofReal_exp]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring_nf
  rw [Complex.I_sq]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.jacobiTheta₂_neg_left'
statement: theorem jacobiTheta₂_neg_left' (z τ : ℂ) : jacobiTheta₂ (-z) τ = jacobiTheta₂ z τ
proof:
:= by
  unfold jacobiTheta₂
  rw [← (Equiv.neg ℤ).tsum_eq]
  refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
  unfold jacobiTheta₂_term
  simp only [Equiv.neg_apply, Int.cast_neg]
  ring_nf

name: Azurite.BZ.neg_I_mul_I_mul
statement: theorem neg_I_mul_I_mul (s : ℝ) : -I * (I * (s : ℂ)) = s
proof:
:= by
  ring_nf
  rw [Complex.I_sq]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.cpow_half_eq_sqrt
statement: theorem cpow_half_eq_sqrt {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) : ((s : ℂ)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) = (Real.sqrt s : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Complex.ofReal_cpow hs]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.neg_one_div_I_mul
statement: theorem neg_one_div_I_mul {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) : (-1 : ℂ) / (I * s) = I * ((1 / s : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hs' : (s : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hs2 : (1 / (s : ℂ)) * s = 1 := one_div_mul_cancel hs'
  rw [div_eq_iff (mul_ne_zero I_ne_zero hs')]
  push_cast
  linear_combination hs2 - (1 / (s : ℂ) * s) * Complex.I_sq

name: Azurite.BZ.half_div_I_mul
statement:
theorem half_div_I_mul {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    (1 / 2 : ℂ) / (I * s) = -(I * ((1 / s : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hs' : (s : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hs2 : (1 / (s : ℂ)) * s = 1 := one_div_mul_cancel hs'
  rw [div_eq_iff (mul_ne_zero I_ne_zero hs')]
  push_cast
  linear_combination (-(1 / 2 : ℂ)) * hs2 + (1 / (s : ℂ) * s / 2) * Complex.I_sq

name: Azurite.BZ.neg_pi_I_quarter_div
statement:
theorem neg_pi_I_quarter_div {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    -↑Real.pi * I * (1 / 2 : ℂ) ^ 2 / (I * s) = -(Real.pi * (1 / s : ℝ)) / 4
proof:
:= by
  have hs' : (s : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hs2 : (1 / (s : ℂ)) * s = 1 := one_div_mul_cancel hs'
  rw [div_eq_iff (mul_ne_zero I_ne_zero hs')]
  push_cast
  linear_combination (↑Real.pi * I / 4) * hs2

name: Azurite.BZ.theta3_nome_inv
statement:
theorem theta3_nome_inv {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    theta3 (nome (1 / s)) = Real.sqrt s * theta3 (nome s)
proof:
:= by
  have h := jacobiTheta₂_functional_equation 0 (I * s)
  rw [zero_div, zero_pow two_ne_zero, mul_zero, zero_div, Complex.exp_zero, mul_one,
    neg_I_mul_I_mul, cpow_half_eq_sqrt hs.le, neg_one_div_I_mul hs.ne'] at h
  have h3 := theta3_nome_eq s
  have h3' := theta3_nome_eq (1 / s)
  rw [← h3, ← h3'] at h
  have hsq : (Real.sqrt s : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hs).ne'
  have : (theta3 (nome (1 / s)) : ℂ) = Real.sqrt s * theta3 (nome s) := by
    rw [h]
    field_simp
  exact_mod_cast this

name: Azurite.BZ.theta2_nome_inv
statement:
theorem theta2_nome_inv {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    theta2 (nome (1 / s)) = Real.sqrt s * theta4 (nome s)
proof:
:= by
  have h := jacobiTheta₂_functional_equation (1 / 2) (I * s)
  rw [neg_I_mul_I_mul, cpow_half_eq_sqrt hs.le, neg_one_div_I_mul hs.ne', half_div_I_mul hs.ne',
    jacobiTheta₂_neg_left', neg_pi_I_quarter_div hs.ne'] at h
  have h4 := theta4_nome_eq s
  have h2 := theta2_nome_eq (one_div_pos.mpr hs)
  rw [← h4, mul_assoc, ← h2] at h
  have hsq : (Real.sqrt s : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hs).ne'
  have : (theta2 (nome (1 / s)) : ℂ) = Real.sqrt s * theta4 (nome s) := by
    rw [h]
    field_simp
  exact_mod_cast this

name: Azurite.BZ.theta4_nome_inv
statement:
theorem theta4_nome_inv {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    theta4 (nome (1 / s)) = Real.sqrt s * theta2 (nome s)
proof:
:= by
  have h := theta2_nome_inv (one_div_pos.mpr hs)
  rw [one_div_one_div] at h
  have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt s := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hs
  have hsqinv : Real.sqrt (1 / s) = 1 / Real.sqrt s := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_div' _ hs.le, Real.sqrt_one]
  rw [hsqinv] at h
  rw [h]
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.nomeK'_nome_eq_nomeK_inv
statement: theorem nomeK'_nome_eq_nomeK_inv {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : nomeK' (nome s) = nomeK (nome (1 / s))
proof:
:= by
  unfold nomeK nomeK'
  rw [theta2_nome_inv hs, theta3_nome_inv hs, mul_pow, mul_pow]
  have h3 := theta3_pos (nome_pos s).le (nome_lt_one hs)
  have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt s := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hs
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.log_inv_nome
statement:
theorem log_inv_nome {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Real.pi * ellipticK (nomeK' (nome s)) / ellipticK (nomeK (nome s)) = Real.log (1 / nome s)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 := (nome_pos s).le
  have hq1 := nome_lt_one hs
  have hq0' := (nome_pos (1 / s)).le
  have hq1' := nome_lt_one (one_div_pos.mpr hs)
  rw [nomeK'_nome_eq_nomeK_inv hs, ellipticK_nomeK hq0' hq1', ellipticK_nomeK hq0 hq1,
    theta3_nome_inv hs, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hs.le]
  have h3 := theta3_pos hq0 hq1
  have hlog : Real.log (1 / nome s) = Real.pi * s := by
    unfold nome
    rw [one_div, Real.log_inv, Real.log_exp, neg_neg]
  rw [hlog]
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.sasaki_kanada
statement:
theorem sasaki_kanada {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Real.log (1 / nome s) = Real.pi / AGM (theta2 (nome s) ^ 2) (theta3 (nome s) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 := nome_pos s
  have hq1 := nome_lt_one hs
  have h2 := theta2_pos hq0 hq1
  have h3 := theta3_pos hq0.le hq1
  have hk := nomeK_pos hq0 hq1
  have hk1 := nomeK_le_one hq0.le hq1
  
  have hAGM : AGM (theta2 (nome s) ^ 2) (theta3 (nome s) ^ 2)
      = theta3 (nome s) ^ 2 * AGM 1 (nomeK (nome s)) := by
    rw [AGM_comm, ← AGM_smul (by positivity) one_pos hk, mul_one]
    congr 2
    unfold nomeK
    field_simp
  
  have hG := one_div_AGM_one hk hk1
  rw [sqrt_one_sub_nomeK_sq hq0.le hq1] at hG
  have hAGM1 : 0 < AGM 1 (nomeK (nome s)) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_min one_pos hk) (min_le_AGM one_pos hk)
  have h78 := log_inv_nome hs
  rw [ellipticK_nomeK hq0.le hq1] at h78
  rw [hAGM, ← h78]
  have hK' : ellipticK (nomeK' (nome s)) = Real.pi / 2 * (1 / AGM 1 (nomeK (nome s))) := by
    rw [hG]
    field_simp
  rw [hK']
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_inv_Gamma_int_le_one
statement: theorem abs_inv_Gamma_int_le_one (k : ℤ) : |(Real.Gamma k)⁻¹| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases k with n | n
  · rcases n with _ | m
    · simp [Real.Gamma_zero]
    · rw [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, Int.cast_natCast, Nat.cast_succ, Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial,
        abs_inv, Nat.abs_cast, inv_le_one₀ (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos m))]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)
  · rw [Int.cast_negSucc, Real.Gamma_neg_nat_eq_zero]
    simp

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_besselJTerm_le
statement:
theorem abs_besselJTerm_le (ν : ℤ) (x : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    |besselJTerm ν x j| ≤ (x ^ 2 / 4) ^ j / j.factorial
proof:
:= by
  unfold besselJTerm
  have h : |(Real.Gamma (ν + j + 1))⁻¹| ≤ 1 := by
    have := abs_inv_Gamma_int_le_one (ν + j + 1)
    push_cast at this
    exact this
  rw [abs_div, abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast, abs_pow, abs_div, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg x),
    abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 4), div_mul_eq_div_div,
    div_eq_mul_inv ((x ^ 2 / 4) ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ)), ← abs_inv]
  calc (x ^ 2 / 4) ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ) * |(Real.Gamma (ν + j + 1))⁻¹|
      ≤ (x ^ 2 / 4) ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ) * 1 := by gcongr
    _ = (x ^ 2 / 4) ^ j / j.factorial := mul_one _

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_besselJTerm
statement: theorem summable_besselJTerm (ν : ℤ) (x : ℝ) : Summable (besselJTerm ν x)
proof:
:=
  (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial (x ^ 2 / 4)).of_norm_bounded fun j => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact abs_besselJTerm_le ν x j

name: Azurite.BZ.besselCoeff_succ
statement:
theorem besselCoeff_succ (n j : ℕ) :
    besselCoeff n (j + 1) = -besselCoeff n j / ((j + 1) * (n + j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold besselCoeff
  rw [Nat.factorial_succ, show n + (j + 1) = n + j + 1 by ring, Nat.factorial_succ, pow_succ]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_besselBound
statement: theorem summable_besselBound (R : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Summable (besselBound R n)
proof:
:= by
  have : besselBound R n
      = fun j => (4 * (R + 1)) ^ n * (((4 * (R + 1)) ^ 2) ^ j / j.factorial) := by
    funext j
    unfold besselBound
    rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
    ring
  rw [this]
  exact (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial _).mul_left _

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_besselCoeff_eq
statement:
theorem abs_besselCoeff_eq (n j : ℕ) :
    |besselCoeff n j| = 1 / (j.factorial * (n + j).factorial)
proof:
:= by
  unfold besselCoeff
  rw [abs_div, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]

name: Azurite.BZ.pow_le_four_pow
statement: theorem pow_le_four_pow (m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 2) : m ^ k ≤ 4 ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
  · rcases k with _ | k
    · simp
    · simp
  · calc m ^ k ≤ m ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hm hk
      _ ≤ (2 ^ m) ^ 2 := le_of_lt (Nat.pow_lt_pow_left (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := m)) (by norm_num))
      _ = 4 ^ m := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul]; norm_num

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_besselCoeff_mul_le
statement:
theorem abs_besselCoeff_mul_le {R x : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hx : |x| ≤ R) (n j k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 2) :
    |besselCoeff n j| * ((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k * |x / 2| ^ (2 * j + n - k)
      ≤ besselBound R n j
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_besselCoeff_eq]
  unfold besselBound
  set m := 2 * j + n with hm
  have hfac : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n + j).factorial := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
  have h1 : ((m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k ≤ 4 ^ m := by exact_mod_cast pow_le_four_pow m k hk
  have hx2 : |x / 2| ≤ R + 1 := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]
    linarith [div_le_self (abs_nonneg x) (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  have h2 : |x / 2| ^ (m - k) ≤ (R + 1) ^ m := by
    calc |x / 2| ^ (m - k) ≤ (R + 1) ^ (m - k) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ (R + 1) ^ m := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by linarith) (Nat.sub_le _ _)
  have h3 : (1 : ℝ) / (j.factorial * (n + j).factorial) ≤ 1 / j.factorial := by
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
    calc (j.factorial : ℝ) = j.factorial * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ ≤ j.factorial * (n + j).factorial := by gcongr
  calc 1 / (j.factorial * (n + j).factorial : ℝ) * ((m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k * |x / 2| ^ (m - k)
      ≤ 1 / (j.factorial : ℝ) * 4 ^ m * (R + 1) ^ m := by gcongr
    _ = (4 * (R + 1)) ^ m / j.factorial := by rw [mul_pow]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.norm_besselCoeff_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem norm_besselCoeff_mul_pow_le {R x : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hx : |x| ≤ R) (n j : ℕ) :
    ‖besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)‖ ≤ besselBound R n j
proof:
:= by
  have := abs_besselCoeff_mul_le hR hx n j 0 (by norm_num)
  rw [pow_zero, mul_one, Nat.sub_zero] at this
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow]
  exact this

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_besselJNat_term
statement:
theorem summable_besselJNat_term (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    Summable fun j => besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)
proof:
:=
  (summable_besselBound |x| n).of_norm_bounded fun j =>
    norm_besselCoeff_mul_pow_le (abs_nonneg x) le_rfl n j

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJTerm_natCast
statement:
theorem besselJTerm_natCast (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (x / 2) ^ n * besselJTerm n x j = besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold besselJTerm besselCoeff
  have hΓ : Real.Gamma (((n : ℤ) : ℝ) + j + 1) = (n + j).factorial := by
    rw [show ((n : ℤ) : ℝ) + j + 1 = ((n + j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 by push_cast; ring,
      Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial]
  rw [hΓ, show (-x ^ 2 / 4) ^ j = (-1) ^ j * ((x / 2) ^ 2) ^ j by rw [← mul_pow]; congr 1; ring,
    pow_add, pow_mul]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_natCast
statement: theorem besselJ_natCast (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : besselJ n x = besselJNat n x
proof:
:= by
  unfold besselJ besselJNat
  rw [zpow_natCast, ← tsum_mul_left]
  exact tsum_congr (besselJTerm_natCast n x)

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJTerm_neg_of_lt
statement:
theorem besselJTerm_neg_of_lt (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < n) :
    besselJTerm (-n) x j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hΓ : Real.Gamma (((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) + j + 1) = 0 := by
    have : (((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) + j + 1) = -((n - j - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_sub hj.le]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [this, Real.Gamma_neg_nat_eq_zero]
  unfold besselJTerm
  rw [hΓ]
  simp

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJTerm_neg_add
statement:
theorem besselJTerm_neg_add (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (i : ℕ) :
    besselJTerm (-n) x (i + n) = (-x ^ 2 / 4) ^ n * besselJTerm n x i
proof:
:= by
  have hΓ1 : Real.Gamma (((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) + ((i + n : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) = i.factorial := by
    rw [show ((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) + ((i + n : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 by push_cast; ring,
      Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial]
  have hΓ2 : Real.Gamma (((n : ℤ) : ℝ) + i + 1) = (n + i).factorial := by
    rw [show ((n : ℤ) : ℝ) + i + 1 = ((n + i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 by push_cast; ring,
      Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial]
