  unfold besselJTerm
  rw [hΓ1, hΓ2, pow_add, add_comm i n]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_neg
statement: theorem besselJ_neg (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : besselJ (-n) x = (-1) ^ n * besselJ n x
proof:
:= by
  unfold besselJ
  have hsum : ∑' j, besselJTerm (-n) x j = (-x ^ 2 / 4) ^ n * ∑' j, besselJTerm n x j := by
    rw [← Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add' (f := besselJTerm (-n) x) (k := n)
      ((summable_nat_add_iff (f := besselJTerm (-n) x) n).mpr (summable_besselJTerm (-n) x))]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j hj => besselJTerm_neg_of_lt n x (Finset.mem_range.mp hj),
      zero_add, ← tsum_mul_left]
    exact tsum_congr (besselJTerm_neg_add n x)
  rw [hsum]
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
  · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, zpow_zero, pow_zero, one_mul]
    · rw [zero_div, zero_zpow _ (by omega), zpow_natCast, zero_pow hn.ne']
      ring
  · have h : (x / 2) ^ n * ((x / 2) ^ n)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ (by positivity))
    rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, show (-x ^ 2 / 4) ^ n = (-1) ^ n * ((x / 2) ^ n) ^ 2 by
      rw [show -x ^ 2 / 4 = -1 * (x / 2) ^ 2 by ring, mul_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_comm 2 n, pow_mul]]
    linear_combination ((-1) ^ n * (x / 2) ^ n * ∑' j, besselJTerm n x j) * h

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_zero_left
statement: theorem besselJ_zero_left : besselJ 0 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (0 : ℤ) = ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) by rfl, besselJ_natCast]
  unfold besselJNat
  rw [tsum_eq_single 0 fun j hj => by simp [hj]]
  simp [besselCoeff]

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_zero_of_ne
statement: theorem besselJ_zero_of_ne {ν : ℤ} (hν : ν ≠ 0) : besselJ ν 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold besselJ
  rw [zero_div, zero_zpow _ hν, zero_mul]

name: Azurite.BZ.pairEquiv_symm_natCast
statement: theorem pairEquiv_symm_natCast (n i : ℕ) : pairEquiv.symm ((n : ℤ), i) = (i + n, i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairEquiv]

name: Azurite.BZ.pairEquiv_symm_negSucc
statement:
theorem pairEquiv_symm_negSucc (n i : ℕ) :
    pairEquiv.symm (Int.negSucc n, i) = (i, i + (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairEquiv]

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_fiber_nonneg
statement:
theorem hasSum_fiber_nonneg {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (u : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    HasSum (fun i : ℕ => (u * t) ^ (i + n) / (i + n).factorial * ((-u / t) ^ i / i.factorial))
      (t ^ n * ∑' j, besselCoeff n j * u ^ (2 * j + n))
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : Summable fun j => besselCoeff n j * u ^ (2 * j + n) := by
    have := summable_besselJNat_term n (2 * u)
    simpa [mul_div_cancel_left₀ u (two_ne_zero' ℝ)] using this
  refine (hsum.hasSum.mul_left (t ^ n)).congr_fun fun i => ?_
  unfold besselCoeff
  have h : t ^ i * (t ^ i)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ ht)
  rw [div_pow, neg_pow, mul_pow, pow_add u, pow_add t, div_eq_mul_inv ((-1) ^ i * u ^ i),
    add_comm n i]
  linear_combination (u ^ i * u ^ n * t ^ n * (-1) ^ i * u ^ i
    / ((i + n).factorial * i.factorial)) * h

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_fiber_neg
statement:
theorem hasSum_fiber_neg {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (u : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    HasSum (fun i : ℕ => (u * t) ^ i / i.factorial *
      ((-u / t) ^ (i + (n + 1)) / (i + (n + 1)).factorial))
      ((t ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ * (-1) ^ (n + 1) * ∑' j, besselCoeff (n + 1) j * u ^ (2 * j + (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : Summable fun j => besselCoeff (n + 1) j * u ^ (2 * j + (n + 1)) := by
    have := summable_besselJNat_term (n + 1) (2 * u)
    simpa [mul_div_cancel_left₀ u (two_ne_zero' ℝ)] using this
  refine (hsum.hasSum.mul_left ((t ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ * (-1) ^ (n + 1))).congr_fun fun i => ?_
  unfold besselCoeff
  have h : t ^ i * (t ^ i)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ ht)
  rw [div_pow, neg_pow, mul_pow, pow_add (-1 : ℝ) i, pow_add u i, pow_add t i,
    div_eq_mul_inv ((-1) ^ i * (-1) ^ (n + 1) * (u ^ i * u ^ (n + 1))), mul_inv,
    add_comm (n + 1) i]
  linear_combination (u ^ i * (t ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ * (-1) ^ i * (-1) ^ (n + 1) * u ^ i * u ^ (n + 1)
    / (i.factorial * (i + (n + 1)).factorial)) * h

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_besselJ_generating
statement:
theorem hasSum_besselJ_generating {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun ν : ℤ => t ^ ν * besselJ ν x) (Real.exp (x / 2 * (t - 1 / t)))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hf : Summable fun a : ℕ => ‖(x / 2 * t) ^ a / a.factorial‖ := by
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact (hasSum_exp_series (x / 2 * t)).summable.abs
  have hg : Summable fun b : ℕ => ‖(-(x / 2) / t) ^ b / b.factorial‖ := by
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact (hasSum_exp_series (-(x / 2) / t)).summable.abs
  have hF : HasSum (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => (x / 2 * t) ^ p.1 / p.1.factorial *
      ((-(x / 2) / t) ^ p.2 / p.2.factorial)) (Real.exp (x / 2 * (t - 1 / t))) := by
    have hmul := summable_mul_of_summable_norm hf hg
    convert hmul.hasSum using 1
    have := tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm hf hg
    rw [(hasSum_exp_series (x / 2 * t)).tsum_eq, (hasSum_exp_series (-(x / 2) / t)).tsum_eq,
      ← Real.exp_add] at this
    refine Eq.trans ?_ this
    congr 1
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hF' := (pairEquiv.symm.hasSum_iff).mpr hF
  refine hF'.prod_fiberwise fun ν => ?_
  rcases ν with n | n
  · rw [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast, besselJ_natCast]
    refine (hasSum_fiber_nonneg ht (x / 2) n).congr_fun fun i => ?_
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, pairEquiv_symm_natCast]
  · have h : HasSum (fun i : ℕ => (x / 2 * t) ^ i / i.factorial *
        ((-(x / 2) / t) ^ (i + (n + 1)) / (i + (n + 1)).factorial))
        ((t ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ * (-1) ^ (n + 1) * besselJNat (n + 1) x) :=
      hasSum_fiber_neg ht (x / 2) n
    have hval : t ^ Int.negSucc n * besselJ (Int.negSucc n) x
        = (t ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ * (-1) ^ (n + 1) * besselJNat (n + 1) x := by
      rw [zpow_negSucc, Int.negSucc_eq, ← Nat.cast_succ, besselJ_neg, besselJ_natCast, mul_assoc]
    rw [hval]
    refine h.congr_fun fun i => ?_
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, pairEquiv_symm_negSucc]

name: Azurite.BZ.norm_besselCoeff_mul_deriv_le
statement:
theorem norm_besselCoeff_mul_deriv_le {R x : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hx : |x| ≤ R) (n j : ℕ) :
    ‖besselCoeff n j * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1) * (1 / 2))‖
      ≤ besselBound R n j
proof:
:= by
  have := abs_besselCoeff_mul_le hR hx n j 1 (by norm_num)
  rw [pow_one] at this
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, Nat.abs_cast,
    abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1 / 2)]
  calc |besselCoeff n j| * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * |x / 2| ^ (2 * j + n - 1) * (1 / 2))
      ≤ |besselCoeff n j| * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * |x / 2| ^ (2 * j + n - 1) * 1) := by
        gcongr; norm_num
    _ = |besselCoeff n j| * ((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * |x / 2| ^ (2 * j + n - 1) := by ring
    _ ≤ besselBound R n j := this

name: Azurite.BZ.norm_besselCoeff_mul_deriv2_le
statement:
theorem norm_besselCoeff_mul_deriv2_le {R x : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hx : |x| ≤ R) (n j : ℕ) :
    ‖besselCoeff n j * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      (((2 * j + n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1 - 1) * (1 / 2)) * (1 / 2))‖
      ≤ besselBound R n j
proof:
:= by
  have := abs_besselCoeff_mul_le hR hx n j 2 (by norm_num)
  rw [show 2 * j + n - 2 = 2 * j + n - 1 - 1 by omega] at this
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, Nat.abs_cast,
    Nat.abs_cast, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1 / 2)]
  have hm : (((2 * j + n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ ((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le _ _
  calc |besselCoeff n j| * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (((2 * j + n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
        * |x / 2| ^ (2 * j + n - 1 - 1) * (1 / 2)) * (1 / 2))
      ≤ |besselCoeff n j| * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ)
        * |x / 2| ^ (2 * j + n - 1 - 1) * 1) * 1) := by gcongr <;> norm_num
    _ = |besselCoeff n j| * ((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * |x / 2| ^ (2 * j + n - 1 - 1) := by ring
    _ ≤ besselBound R n j := this

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_half_pow
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_half_pow (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (y / 2) ^ m) (((m : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (m - 1) * (1 / 2)) x
proof:
:= by
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y / 2) (1 / 2) x := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).div_const 2
  exact h.pow m

name: Azurite.BZ.mem_ball_abs_add_one
statement: theorem mem_ball_abs_add_one (x : ℝ) : x ∈ ball (0 : ℝ) (|x| + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, Real.norm_eq_abs]; linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_le_of_mem_ball
statement: theorem abs_le_of_mem_ball {x y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ ball (0 : ℝ) (|x| + 1)) : |y| ≤ |x| + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hy).le

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_besselJNat
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_besselJNat (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (besselJNat n) (besselJNat' n x) x
proof:
:=
  hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected (summable_besselBound (|x| + 1) n) isOpen_ball
    isPreconnected_ball
    (fun j y _ => (hasDerivAt_half_pow (2 * j + n) y).const_mul (besselCoeff n j))
    (fun j y hy => norm_besselCoeff_mul_deriv_le (by positivity) (abs_le_of_mem_ball hy) n j)
    (mem_ball_abs_add_one x) (summable_besselJNat_term n x) (mem_ball_abs_add_one x)

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_besselJNat'
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_besselJNat' (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (besselJNat' n) (besselJNat'' n x) x
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : Summable fun j =>
      besselCoeff n j * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1) * (1 / 2)) :=
    (summable_besselBound |x| n).of_norm_bounded fun j =>
      norm_besselCoeff_mul_deriv_le (abs_nonneg x) le_rfl n j
  exact hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected (summable_besselBound (|x| + 1) n) isOpen_ball
    isPreconnected_ball
    (fun j y _ => (((hasDerivAt_half_pow (2 * j + n - 1) y).const_mul
      ((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ)).mul_const (1 / 2)).const_mul (besselCoeff n j))
    (fun j y hy => norm_besselCoeff_mul_deriv2_le (by positivity) (abs_le_of_mem_ball hy) n j)
    (mem_ball_abs_add_one x) hsum (mem_ball_abs_add_one x)

name: Azurite.BZ.bessel_ode_term
statement:
theorem bessel_ode_term (n j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x ^ 2 * (besselCoeff n j * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (((2 * j + n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1 - 1) * (1 / 2)) * (1 / 2)))
      + x * (besselCoeff n j * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1) * (1 / 2)))
      - (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n))
      = 4 * j * (j + n) * besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (2 * j + n) 2 with h | h
  · obtain rfl : j = 0 := by omega
    have hn : n < 2 := by omega
    interval_cases n
    · simp
    · simp
      ring
  · have hp : (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1 - 1) * (x / 2) ^ 2 = (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n) := by
      rw [← pow_add, show 2 * j + n - 1 - 1 + 2 = 2 * j + n by omega]
    have hq : (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1) * (x / 2) = (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n) := by
      rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
    have hc : (((2 * j + n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = 2 * j + n - 1 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_pred (by omega)]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hc]
    push_cast
    linear_combination (besselCoeff n j * (2 * j + n) * (2 * j + n - 1)) * hp
      + (besselCoeff n j * (2 * j + n)) * hq

name: Azurite.BZ.bessel_ode_series
statement:
theorem bessel_ode_series (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x ^ 2 * besselJNat'' n x + x * besselJNat' n x - (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * besselJNat n x
      = -(x ^ 2 * besselJNat n x)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := summable_besselJNat_term n x
  have h1 : Summable fun j =>
      besselCoeff n j * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1) * (1 / 2)) :=
    (summable_besselBound |x| n).of_norm_bounded fun j =>
      norm_besselCoeff_mul_deriv_le (abs_nonneg x) le_rfl n j
  have h2 : Summable fun j => besselCoeff n j * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      (((2 * j + n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1 - 1) * (1 / 2)) * (1 / 2)) :=
    (summable_besselBound |x| n).of_norm_bounded fun j =>
      norm_besselCoeff_mul_deriv2_le (abs_nonneg x) le_rfl n j
  unfold besselJNat besselJNat' besselJNat''
  rw [← tsum_mul_left, ← tsum_mul_left, ← tsum_mul_left, ← tsum_mul_left,
    ← Summable.tsum_add (h2.mul_left _) (h1.mul_left _),
    ← Summable.tsum_sub ((h2.mul_left _).add (h1.mul_left _)) (h0.mul_left _), ← tsum_neg]
  have hT : (fun j => x ^ 2 * (besselCoeff n j * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      (((2 * j + n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1 - 1) * (1 / 2)) * (1 / 2)))
      + x * (besselCoeff n j * (((2 * j + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n - 1) * (1 / 2)))
      - (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n)))
      = fun j => 4 * j * (j + n) * besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n) :=
    funext fun j => bessel_ode_term n j x
  have hS : Summable fun j : ℕ =>
      4 * (j : ℝ) * (j + n) * besselCoeff n j * (x / 2) ^ (2 * j + n) := by
    have := ((h2.mul_left (x ^ 2)).add (h1.mul_left x)).sub (h0.mul_left ((n : ℝ) ^ 2))
    rwa [hT] at this
  rw [hT, hS.tsum_eq_zero_add]
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add]
  refine tsum_congr fun j => ?_
  rw [besselCoeff_succ, show 2 * (j + 1) + n = 2 * j + n + 2 by ring, pow_add]
  have hne : ((j : ℝ) + 1) * (n + j + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJNat_ode
statement:
theorem besselJNat_ode (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (besselJNat n)) x + x * deriv (besselJNat n) x
      + (x ^ 2 - (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * besselJNat n x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd : deriv (besselJNat n) = besselJNat' n :=
    funext fun y => (hasDerivAt_besselJNat n y).deriv
  rw [hd, (hasDerivAt_besselJNat' n x).deriv]
  linear_combination bessel_ode_series n x

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJ_ode
statement:
theorem besselJ_ode (ν : ℤ) (x : ℝ) :
    x ^ 2 * deriv (deriv (besselJ ν)) x + x * deriv (besselJ ν) x
      + (x ^ 2 - (ν : ℝ) ^ 2) * besselJ ν x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases ν with n | n
  · have : besselJ (Int.ofNat n) = besselJNat n := funext (besselJ_natCast n)
    rw [this, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, Int.cast_natCast]
    exact besselJNat_ode n x
  · have : besselJ (Int.negSucc n) = fun y => (-1) ^ (n + 1) * besselJNat (n + 1) y := by
      funext y
      rw [Int.negSucc_eq, ← Nat.cast_succ, besselJ_neg, besselJ_natCast]
    rw [this, Int.cast_negSucc]
    simp only [deriv_const_mul_field']
    have h := besselJNat_ode (n + 1) x
    push_cast at h ⊢
    linear_combination (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * h

name: Azurite.BZ.besselJReal_intCast
statement: theorem besselJReal_intCast (ν : ℤ) (x : ℝ) : besselJReal ν x = besselJ ν x
proof:
:= by
  unfold besselJReal besselJ besselJTerm
  rw [Real.rpow_intCast]

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_add'
statement: theorem exp_add' (x y : ℝ) : exp (x + y) = exp x * exp y
proof: := exp_add x y

name: Azurite.BZ.log_mul'
statement: theorem log_mul' {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) : log (x * y) = log x + log y
proof:
:=
  log_mul hx hy

name: Azurite.BZ.sin_add'
statement: theorem sin_add' (x y : ℝ) : sin (x + y) = sin x * cos y + cos x * sin y
proof: := sin_add x y

name: Azurite.BZ.tan_add'
statement:
theorem tan_add' {x y : ℝ} (hx : cos x ≠ 0) (hy : cos y ≠ 0) (hxy : 1 - tan x * tan y ≠ 0) :
    tan (x + y) = (tan x + tan y) / (1 - tan x * tan y)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : cos (x + y) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [cos_add]
    intro h
    apply hxy
    rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos, tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
    field_simp
    linear_combination h
  rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos, sin_add, cos_add, tan_eq_sin_div_cos, tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
  rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos, tan_eq_sin_div_cos] at hxy
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_two_mul'
statement: theorem exp_two_mul' (x : ℝ) : exp (2 * x) = exp x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_mul, exp_add, sq]

name: Azurite.BZ.sin_two_mul'
statement: theorem sin_two_mul' (x : ℝ) : sin (2 * x) = 2 * sin x * cos x
proof: := sin_two_mul x

name: Azurite.BZ.sin_three_mul'
statement: theorem sin_three_mul' (x : ℝ) : sin (3 * x) = 3 * sin x - 4 * sin x ^ 3
proof: := sin_three_mul x

name: Azurite.BZ.sin_add_pi_div_two'
statement: theorem sin_add_pi_div_two' (x : ℝ) : sin (x + π / 2) = cos x
proof: := sin_add_pi_div_two x

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_eq_pow_two_pow
statement: theorem exp_eq_pow_two_pow (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : exp x = exp (x / 2 ^ k) ^ (2 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← exp_nat_mul]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.sin_sub_int_mul_two_pi
statement: theorem sin_sub_int_mul_two_pi (x : ℝ) (k : ℤ) : sin x = sin (x - k * (2 * π))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [show x = (x - k * (2 * π)) + k * (2 * π) by ring, sin_add_int_mul_two_pi]

name: Azurite.BZ.cos_sub_int_mul_two_pi
statement: theorem cos_sub_int_mul_two_pi (x : ℝ) (k : ℤ) : cos x = cos (x - k * (2 * π))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [show x = (x - k * (2 * π)) + k * (2 * π) by ring, cos_add_int_mul_two_pi]

name: Azurite.BZ.Gamma_add_nat
statement:
theorem Gamma_add_nat {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (n : ℕ) :
    Gamma (x + n) = Gamma x * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x + i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hpos : x + n ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, show x + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (x + n) + 1 by push_cast; ring,
      Gamma_add_one hpos, ih]
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.one_sub_mul_sin_sq_pos
statement:
theorem one_sub_mul_sin_sq_pos {k : ℝ} (hk : k ^ 2 < 1) (θ : ℝ) :
    0 < 1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Real.sin_sq_le_one θ
  have h2 : k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 ≤ k ^ 2 := mul_le_of_le_one_right (sq_nonneg k) h1
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.continuous_ellipticK_integrand
statement:
theorem continuous_ellipticK_integrand {k : ℝ} (hk : k ^ 2 < 1) :
    Continuous fun θ : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹
proof:
:=
  (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (by fun_prop)).inv₀ fun θ =>
    (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (one_sub_mul_sin_sq_pos hk θ)).ne'

name: Azurite.BZ.continuous_ellipticE_integrand
statement:
theorem continuous_ellipticE_integrand (k : ℝ) :
    Continuous fun θ : ℝ => Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (by fun_prop)

name: Azurite.BZ.ellipticK_zero
statement: theorem ellipticK_zero : ellipticK 0 = π / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [ellipticK]

name: Azurite.BZ.ellipticE_zero
statement: theorem ellipticE_zero : ellipticE 0 = π / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [ellipticE]

name: Azurite.BZ.ellipticE_le_pi_div_two
statement: theorem ellipticE_le_pi_div_two (k : ℝ) : ellipticE k ≤ π / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold ellipticE
  have h : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), (1 : ℝ) = π / 2 := by simp
  have hE : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)) volume 0
      (π / 2) := (continuous_ellipticE_integrand k).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have h1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) volume 0 (π / 2) :=
    continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _
  calc ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)
      ≤ ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), (1 : ℝ) := by
        refine integral_mono_on Real.pi_div_two_pos.le hE h1 fun θ _ => ?_
        rw [Real.sqrt_le_one]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg k, sq_nonneg (Real.sin θ)]
    _ = π / 2 := h

name: Azurite.BZ.pi_div_two_le_ellipticK
statement: theorem pi_div_two_le_ellipticK {k : ℝ} (hk : k ^ 2 < 1) : π / 2 ≤ ellipticK k
proof:
:= by
  unfold ellipticK
  have h : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), (1 : ℝ) = π / 2 := by simp
  have hK : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹) volume 0
      (π / 2) := (continuous_ellipticK_integrand hk).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have h1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) volume 0 (π / 2) :=
    continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _
  calc π / 2 = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), (1 : ℝ) := h.symm
    _ ≤ ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        refine integral_mono_on Real.pi_div_two_pos.le h1 hK fun θ _ => ?_
        rw [one_le_inv₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (one_sub_mul_sin_sq_pos hk θ)), Real.sqrt_le_one]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg k, sq_nonneg (Real.sin θ)]

name: Azurite.BZ.inv_sqrt_one_sub_bounds
statement:
theorem inv_sqrt_one_sub_bounds {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x ≤ 1 / 2) :
    1 + x / 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt (1 - x))⁻¹ ∧ (Real.sqrt (1 - x))⁻¹ ≤ 1 + x / 2 + x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1x : 0 < 1 - x := by linarith
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - x) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h1x
  constructor
  · rw [inv_eq_one_div, le_div_iff₀ hs,
      show (1 + x / 2) * Real.sqrt (1 - x) = Real.sqrt ((1 + x / 2) ^ 2 * (1 - x)) by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)],
      Real.sqrt_le_one]
    have e : (1 + x / 2) ^ 2 * (1 - x) = 1 - 3 / 4 * x ^ 2 - 1 / 4 * x ^ 3 := by ring
    rw [e]
    linarith [sq_nonneg x, pow_nonneg hx0 3]
  · rw [inv_eq_one_div, div_le_iff₀ hs,
      show (1 + x / 2 + x ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (1 - x)
          = Real.sqrt ((1 + x / 2 + x ^ 2) ^ 2 * (1 - x)) by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)],
      Real.le_sqrt zero_le_one (by positivity), one_pow]
    have e : (1 + x / 2 + x ^ 2) ^ 2 * (1 - x) = 1 + 5 / 4 * x ^ 2 - 5 / 4 * x ^ 3 - x ^ 5 := by
      ring
    have h3 : x ^ 3 ≤ x ^ 2 / 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg x) (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 - x)]
    have h5 : x ^ 5 ≤ x ^ 2 / 8 := by
      have h8 : x ^ 3 ≤ (1 / 2) ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hx0 hx 3
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h8 (sq_nonneg x)]
    rw [e]
    linarith [sq_nonneg x]

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_sin_sq_pi_div_two
statement: theorem integral_sin_sq_pi_div_two : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.sin θ ^ 2 = π / 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_sin_sq]
  simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_sin_pow_four_pi_div_two
statement:
theorem integral_sin_pow_four_pi_div_two :
    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), Real.sin θ ^ 4 = 3 * π / 16
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 2 + 2 from rfl, integral_sin_pow, integral_sin_sq_pi_div_two]
  simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.ellipticK_bounds
statement:
theorem ellipticK_bounds {k : ℝ} (hk : k ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2) :
    π / 2 * (1 + k ^ 2 / 4) ≤ ellipticK k
      ∧ ellipticK k ≤ π / 2 * (1 + k ^ 2 / 4 + 3 / 8 * k ^ 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : k ^ 2 < 1 := by linarith
  have hcont := continuous_ellipticK_integrand hk1
  have hsin2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => Real.sin θ ^ 2) volume 0 (π / 2) :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous fun θ : ℝ => Real.sin θ ^ 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hsin4 : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => Real.sin θ ^ 4) volume 0 (π / 2) :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous fun θ : ℝ => Real.sin θ ^ 4).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hx : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 ∧ k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2 := fun θ =>
    ⟨by positivity, (mul_le_of_le_one_right (sq_nonneg k) (Real.sin_sq_le_one θ)).trans hk⟩
  constructor
  · have hlow : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), (1 + k ^ 2 / 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2)
        = π / 2 * (1 + k ^ 2 / 4) := by
      rw [integral_add (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hsin2.const_mul _),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_sin_sq_pi_div_two]
      simp
      ring
    rw [← hlow]
    refine integral_mono_on Real.pi_div_two_pos.le
      ((continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul (by fun_prop))).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      (hcont.intervalIntegrable _ _) fun θ _ => ?_
    have := (inv_sqrt_one_sub_bounds (hx θ).1 (hx θ).2).1
    linarith
  · have hup : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
        (1 + k ^ 2 / 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 + k ^ 4 * Real.sin θ ^ 4)
        = π / 2 * (1 + k ^ 2 / 4 + 3 / 8 * k ^ 4) := by
      rw [integral_add ((continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _).add (hsin2.const_mul _))
        (hsin4.const_mul _), integral_add (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (hsin2.const_mul _), intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_sin_sq_pi_div_two,
        integral_sin_pow_four_pi_div_two]
      simp
      ring
    rw [← hup]
    refine integral_mono_on Real.pi_div_two_pos.le (hcont.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      ((continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul (by fun_prop)) |>.add
        (continuous_const.mul (by fun_prop))).intervalIntegrable _ _) fun θ _ => ?_
    have := (inv_sqrt_one_sub_bounds (hx θ).1 (hx θ).2).2
    have h4 : (k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) ^ 2 = k ^ 4 * Real.sin θ ^ 4 := by ring
    linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.agmKernel_pos
statement: theorem agmKernel_pos (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (t : ℝ) : 0 < agmKernel a b t
proof:
:= by
  unfold agmKernel
  exact inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity))

name: Azurite.BZ.agmKernel_neg
statement: theorem agmKernel_neg (a b t : ℝ) : agmKernel a b (-t) = agmKernel a b t
proof:
:= by
  simp [agmKernel]

name: Azurite.BZ.continuous_agmKernel
statement: theorem continuous_agmKernel (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : Continuous (agmKernel a b)
proof:
:=
  (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (by fun_prop)).inv₀ fun t =>
    (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)).ne'

name: Azurite.BZ.agmKernel_comm
statement: theorem agmKernel_comm (a b t : ℝ) : agmKernel a b t = agmKernel b a t
proof:
:= by
  unfold agmKernel; rw [mul_comm]

name: Azurite.BZ.agmKernel_le
statement:
theorem agmKernel_le (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (t : ℝ) :
    agmKernel a b t ≤ (t ^ 2 + min a b ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold agmKernel
  have hm : 0 < min a b := lt_min ha hb
  have h1 : min a b ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hm.le (min_le_left a b) 2
  have h2 : min a b ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hm.le (min_le_right a b) 2
  rw [inv_le_inv₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity))
      (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg t) (pow_pos hm 2)),
    show t ^ 2 + min a b ^ 2 = Real.sqrt ((t ^ 2 + min a b ^ 2) ^ 2) by
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]]
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
  calc (t ^ 2 + min a b ^ 2) ^ 2 = (t ^ 2 + min a b ^ 2) * (t ^ 2 + min a b ^ 2) := sq _
    _ ≤ (t ^ 2 + a ^ 2) * (t ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by gcongr

name: Azurite.BZ.agmKernel_anti
statement:
theorem agmKernel_anti (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) {a' b' : ℝ} (ha' : a ≤ a') (hb' : b ≤ b') (t : ℝ) :
    agmKernel a' b' t ≤ agmKernel a b t
proof:
:= by
  unfold agmKernel
  have ha0 : 0 < a' := ha.trans_le ha'
  have hb0 : 0 < b' := hb.trans_le hb'
  rw [inv_le_inv₀
    (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (t ^ 2 + a' ^ 2) * (t ^ 2 + b' ^ 2)))
    (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (t ^ 2 + a ^ 2) * (t ^ 2 + b ^ 2)))]
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
  have h1 : a ^ 2 ≤ a' ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ ha.le ha' 2
  have h2 : b ^ 2 ≤ b' ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hb.le hb' 2
  gcongr

name: Azurite.BZ.integrable_agmKernel
statement: theorem integrable_agmKernel (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : Integrable (agmKernel a b)
proof:
:= by
  set m := min (min a b) 1 with hm
  have hm0 : 0 < m := lt_min (lt_min ha hb) one_pos
  have hm1 : m ≤ 1 := min_le_right _ _
  have hmab : m ≤ min a b := min_le_left _ _
  refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (m ^ 2)⁻¹).mono'
    (continuous_agmKernel ha hb).aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (agmKernel_pos ha hb t)]
  refine (agmKernel_le ha hb t).trans ?_
  have hmin : 0 < min a b := lt_min ha hb
  have h1 : m ^ 2 ≤ min a b ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hm0.le hmab 2
  rw [← mul_inv, inv_le_inv₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
  have hm2 : m ^ 2 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hm0.le hm1
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm2 (sq_nonneg t)
  nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.agmIntegral_self
statement: theorem agmIntegral_self {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) : agmIntegral c c = π / (2 * c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold agmIntegral
  have h1 : ∀ t : ℝ, agmKernel c c t = (c⁻¹) ^ 2 * (1 + (c⁻¹ * t) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro t
    unfold agmKernel
    rw [← sq, Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
    field_simp
    ring
  simp_rw [h1]
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, integral_comp_mul_left_Ioi (fun x : ℝ => (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) 0
    (inv_pos.mpr hc), mul_zero, integral_Ioi_inv_one_add_sq, Real.arctan_zero, sub_zero,
    inv_inv, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.agmIntegral_anti
statement:
theorem agmIntegral_anti (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) {a' b' : ℝ} (ha' : a ≤ a') (hb' : b ≤ b') :
    agmIntegral a' b' ≤ agmIntegral a b
proof:
:=
  setIntegral_mono_on (integrable_agmKernel (ha.trans_le ha') (hb.trans_le hb')).integrableOn
    (integrable_agmKernel ha hb).integrableOn measurableSet_Ioi
    fun t _ => agmKernel_anti ha hb ha' hb' t

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_landen
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_landen (a b : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (landen a b) ((1 + a * b * (t ^ 2)⁻¹) / 2) t
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_id t).sub ((hasDerivAt_inv ht).const_mul (a * b))).div_const 2
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.landen_injOn
statement: theorem landen_injOn (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : InjOn (landen a b) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs t ht h
  simp only [mem_Ioi] at hs ht
  unfold landen at h
  have h2 : (s - t) * (s * t + a * b) = s * t * ((s - a * b * s⁻¹) - (t - a * b * t⁻¹)) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have h3 : (s - a * b * s⁻¹) - (t - a * b * t⁻¹) = 0 := by linarith
  rw [h3, mul_zero] at h2
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h4 | h4
  · linarith
  · nlinarith [mul_pos hs ht, mul_pos ha hb]

name: Azurite.BZ.landen_image
statement: theorem landen_image (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : landen a b '' Ioi 0 = univ
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_univ_of_forall fun u => ?_
  have hr : 0 ≤ u ^ 2 + a * b := by positivity
  set r := Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 + a * b) with hr_def
  have hr2 : r ^ 2 = u ^ 2 + a * b := Real.sq_sqrt hr
  have hru : |u| < r := by
    rw [hr_def, ← Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
    exact Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (sq_nonneg u) (by nlinarith [mul_pos ha hb])
  have ht : 0 < u + r := by linarith [neg_abs_le u]
  refine ⟨u + r, ht, ?_⟩
  unfold landen
  field_simp
  nlinarith [hr2]

name: Azurite.BZ.landen_kernel
statement:
theorem landen_kernel (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    |(1 + a * b * (t ^ 2)⁻¹) / 2| * agmKernel ((a + b) / 2) (Real.sqrt (a * b)) (landen a b t)
      = 2 * agmKernel a b t
proof:
:= by
  unfold agmKernel landen
  have hab : Real.sqrt (a * b) ^ 2 = a * b := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hA : 0 ≤ (t ^ 2 + a ^ 2) * (t ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by positivity
  have hQ : 0 ≤ (t ^ 2 + a * b) / (4 * t ^ 2) := by positivity
  have hprod : (((t - a * b * t⁻¹) / 2) ^ 2 + ((a + b) / 2) ^ 2)
      * (((t - a * b * t⁻¹) / 2) ^ 2 + Real.sqrt (a * b) ^ 2)
      = (t ^ 2 + a ^ 2) * (t ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * ((t ^ 2 + a * b) / (4 * t ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hab]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hprod, Real.sqrt_mul hA, Real.sqrt_sq hQ, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt ((t ^ 2 + a ^ 2) * (t ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have hq : 0 < t ^ 2 + a * b := by positivity
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_agmKernel
statement:
theorem integral_agmKernel (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∫ t, agmKernel a b t = 2 * agmIntegral a b
proof:
:= by
  have hint := integrable_agmKernel ha hb
  rw [← integral_Iic_add_Ioi hint.integrableOn hint.integrableOn]
  have h : ∫ t in Iic (0 : ℝ), agmKernel a b t = ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), agmKernel a b t := by
    rw [← neg_zero, ← integral_comp_neg_Iic, neg_zero]
    exact setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iic fun t _ => (agmKernel_neg a b t).symm
  rw [h]
  unfold agmIntegral
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.agmIntegral_landen
statement:
theorem agmIntegral_landen (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    agmIntegral ((a + b) / 2) (Real.sqrt (a * b)) = agmIntegral a b
proof:
:= by
  have ha1 : 0 < (a + b) / 2 := by positivity
  have hb1 : 0 < Real.sqrt (a * b) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have hcov := integral_image_eq_integral_abs_deriv_smul (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ))
    (f := landen a b) (f' := fun t => (1 + a * b * (t ^ 2)⁻¹) / 2) measurableSet_Ioi
    (fun t ht => (hasDerivAt_landen a b (ne_of_gt ht)).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (landen_injOn ha hb) (agmKernel ((a + b) / 2) (Real.sqrt (a * b)))
  rw [landen_image ha hb, Measure.restrict_univ, integral_agmKernel ha1 hb1] at hcov
  have h2 : ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), |(1 + a * b * (t ^ 2)⁻¹) / 2|
      • agmKernel ((a + b) / 2) (Real.sqrt (a * b)) (landen a b t)
      = ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), 2 * agmKernel a b t :=
    setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun t ht => by
      rw [smul_eq_mul, landen_kernel ha hb ht]
  rw [h2, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul] at hcov
  unfold agmIntegral at hcov ⊢
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.agmIntegral_agmSeq
statement:
theorem agmIntegral_agmSeq (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) :
    agmIntegral (agmA a b j) (agmB a b j) = agmIntegral a b
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j ih =>
    obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb j
    rw [agmA_succ, agmB_succ, agmIntegral_landen hA hB, ih]

name: Azurite.BZ.agmIntegral_eq_pi_div_AGM
statement:
theorem agmIntegral_eq_pi_div_AGM (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    agmIntegral a b = π / (2 * AGM a b)
proof:
:= by
  have hAGM : 0 < AGM a b := lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_min ha hb) (min_le_AGM ha hb)
  have hup : ∀ j : ℕ, agmIntegral a b ≤ π / (2 * agmB a b (j + 1)) := fun j => by
    obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb (j + 1)
    rw [← agmIntegral_agmSeq ha hb (j + 1), ← agmIntegral_self hB]
    exact agmIntegral_anti hB hB (agmB_le_agmA_succ ha hb j) le_rfl
  have hlow : ∀ j : ℕ, π / (2 * agmA a b (j + 1)) ≤ agmIntegral a b := fun j => by
    obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb (j + 1)
    rw [← agmIntegral_agmSeq ha hb (j + 1), ← agmIntegral_self hA]
    exact agmIntegral_anti hA hB le_rfl (agmB_le_agmA_succ ha hb j)
  have hta : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => π / (2 * agmA a b (j + 1))) atTop (𝓝 (π / (2 * AGM a b))) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div ((tendsto_agmA_succ ha hb).const_mul 2) (by positivity)
  have htb : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => π / (2 * agmB a b (j + 1))) atTop (𝓝 (π / (2 * AGM a b))) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div ((tendsto_agmB_succ ha hb).const_mul 2) (by positivity)
  exact le_antisymm (le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' tendsto_const_nhds htb hup)
    (le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' hta tendsto_const_nhds hlow)

name: Azurite.BZ.tan_image_Ioo
statement: theorem tan_image_Ioo : Real.tan '' Ioo 0 (π / 2) = Ioi 0
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨θ, ⟨h0, hπ⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Real.tan_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi_div_two h0 hπ
  · intro hu
    refine ⟨Real.arctan u, ⟨Real.arctan_pos.mpr hu, Real.arctan_lt_pi_div_two u⟩,
      Real.tan_arctan u⟩

name: Azurite.BZ.tan_kernel
statement:
theorem tan_kernel {k : ℝ} {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ Ioo 0 (π / 2)) :
    |1 / Real.cos θ ^ 2| * agmKernel 1 k (Real.tan θ)
      = (Real.sqrt (Real.sin θ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 * Real.cos θ ^ 2))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 0 < Real.cos θ := Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith [hθ.1, Real.pi_pos], hθ.2⟩
  unfold agmKernel
  rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
  have e : ((Real.sin θ / Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + 1 ^ 2) * ((Real.sin θ / Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + k ^ 2)
      = (Real.sin θ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 * Real.cos θ ^ 2) / (Real.cos θ ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    have hsc := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ
    field_simp
    linear_combination (Real.sin θ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 * Real.cos θ ^ 2) * hsc
  rw [e, Real.sqrt_div' _ (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity),
    abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
  have hsin : 0 < Real.sin θ := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hθ.1 (by linarith [hθ.2, Real.pi_pos])
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (Real.sin θ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 * Real.cos θ ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.agmIntegral_one_eq
statement:
theorem agmIntegral_one_eq (k : ℝ) :
    agmIntegral 1 k = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
      (Real.sqrt (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hcov := integral_image_eq_integral_abs_deriv_smul (s := Ioo 0 (π / 2))
    (f := Real.tan) (f' := fun θ => 1 / Real.cos θ ^ 2) measurableSet_Ioo
    (fun θ hθ => (Real.hasDerivAt_tan
      (Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith [hθ.1, Real.pi_pos], hθ.2⟩).ne').hasDerivWithinAt)
    (Real.strictMonoOn_tan.injOn.mono (Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) le_rfl))
    (agmKernel 1 k)
  rw [tan_image_Ioo] at hcov
  have h2 : ∫ θ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) (π / 2), |1 / Real.cos θ ^ 2| • agmKernel 1 k (Real.tan θ)
      = ∫ θ in Ioo (0 : ℝ) (π / 2), (Real.sqrt (Real.sin θ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 * Real.cos θ ^ 2))⁻¹ :=
    setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo fun θ hθ => by rw [smul_eq_mul]; exact tan_kernel hθ
  have h3 := integral_comp_sub_left (fun θ : ℝ =>
    (Real.sqrt (Real.sin θ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 * Real.cos θ ^ 2))⁻¹) (π / 2) (a := 0) (b := π / 2)
  rw [sub_self, sub_zero] at h3
  unfold agmIntegral
  rw [hcov, h2, ← integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo, ← integral_of_le Real.pi_div_two_pos.le, ← h3]
  refine integral_congr fun θ _ => ?_
  simp only [Real.sin_pi_div_two_sub, Real.cos_pi_div_two_sub]

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_inv_sqrt_eq_pi_div_AGM
statement:
theorem integral_inv_sqrt_eq_pi_div_AGM (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2), (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 * Real.cos θ ^ 2 + b ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹
      = π / (2 * AGM a b)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : 0 < b / a := by positivity
  have h1 : ∀ θ : ℝ, (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 * Real.cos θ ^ 2 + b ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹
      = a⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + (b / a) ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
    intro θ
    rw [show a ^ 2 * Real.cos θ ^ 2 + b ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2
        = a ^ 2 * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + (b / a) ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2) by field_simp,
      Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg a), Real.sqrt_sq ha.le, mul_inv]
  have hAGM : AGM a b = a * AGM 1 (b / a) := by
    rw [← AGM_smul ha one_pos hk, mul_one, show a * (b / a) = b by field_simp]
  simp_rw [h1]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← agmIntegral_one_eq,
    agmIntegral_eq_pi_div_AGM one_pos hk, hAGM]
  have : 0 < AGM 1 (b / a) := lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_min one_pos hk) (min_le_AGM one_pos hk)
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.one_div_AGM_one
statement:
theorem one_div_AGM_one {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hk1 : k ≤ 1) :
    1 / AGM 1 k = 2 / π * ellipticK (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hK : ellipticK (Real.sqrt (1 - k ^ 2)) = agmIntegral 1 k := by
    rw [agmIntegral_one_eq]
    unfold ellipticK
    refine integral_congr fun θ _ => ?_
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by nlinarith), show 1 - (1 - k ^ 2) * Real.sin θ ^ 2
      = Real.cos θ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2 by
        linear_combination (-1 : ℝ) * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ]
  rw [hK, agmIntegral_eq_pi_div_AGM one_pos hk]
  have : 0 < AGM 1 k := lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_min one_pos hk) (min_le_AGM one_pos hk)
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.rsqrtSeq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem rsqrtSeq_zero (y x₀ : ℝ) : rsqrtSeq y x₀ 0 = x₀
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.rsqrtSeq_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem rsqrtSeq_succ (y x₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    rsqrtSeq y x₀ (n + 1) = rsqrtStep y (rsqrtSeq y x₀ n)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.rsqrtStep_eq_inverseRootStep
statement: theorem rsqrtStep_eq_inverseRootStep (y x : ℝ) : rsqrtStep y x = inverseRootStep 2 y x
proof:
:= by
  simp [rsqrtStep, inverseRootStep]

name: Azurite.BZ.rsqrtError_rsqrtStep
statement:
theorem rsqrtError_rsqrtStep (y x : ℝ) :
    rsqrtError y (rsqrtStep y x) = rsqrtError y x ^ 2 * (3 + rsqrtError y x) / 4
proof:
:= by
  unfold rsqrtError rsqrtStep
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_rsqrtError_rsqrtStep_le
statement:
theorem abs_rsqrtError_rsqrtStep_le {y x : ℝ} (h : |rsqrtError y x| ≤ 1) :
    |rsqrtError y (rsqrtStep y x)| ≤ rsqrtError y x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [rsqrtError_rsqrtStep, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_pow, sq_abs, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 4),
    div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)]
  have h3 : |3 + rsqrtError y x| ≤ 4 := by
    calc |3 + rsqrtError y x| ≤ |3| + |rsqrtError y x| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ 4 := by rw [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 3)]; linarith
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (sq_nonneg _)

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_rsqrtError_rsqrtSeq_le
statement:
theorem abs_rsqrtError_rsqrtSeq_le {y x₀ : ℝ} (h : |rsqrtError y x₀| ≤ 1) (j : ℕ) :
    |rsqrtError y (rsqrtSeq y x₀ j)| ≤ |rsqrtError y x₀| ^ (2 ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    have hle : |rsqrtError y (rsqrtSeq y x₀ j)| ≤ 1 :=
      ih.trans (pow_le_one₀ (abs_nonneg _) h)
    rw [rsqrtSeq_succ, pow_succ, pow_mul]
    calc |rsqrtError y (rsqrtStep y (rsqrtSeq y x₀ j))|
        ≤ rsqrtError y (rsqrtSeq y x₀ j) ^ 2 := abs_rsqrtError_rsqrtStep_le hle
      _ = |rsqrtError y (rsqrtSeq y x₀ j)| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ (|rsqrtError y x₀| ^ (2 ^ j)) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) ih 2

name: Azurite.BZ.rsqrtStep_rel
statement:
theorem rsqrtStep_rel {y ζ : ℝ} (hζ : ζ ^ 2 * y = 1) (ε : ℝ) :
    rsqrtStep y (ζ * (1 + ε)) = ζ * (1 + -(3 * ε ^ 2 + ε ^ 3) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rsqrtStep_eq_inverseRootStep, inverseRootStep_rel 2 hζ]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.rsqrtStep_pos
statement: theorem rsqrtStep_pos {y x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hu : |rsqrtError y x| < 1) : 0 < rsqrtStep y x
proof:
:= by
  have : rsqrtStep y x = x * (1 + rsqrtError y x / 2) := by unfold rsqrtStep rsqrtError; ring
  rw [this]
  rw [abs_lt] at hu
  have : 0 < 1 + rsqrtError y x / 2 := by linarith [hu.1]
  positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_rsqrtError_lt_one_iff
statement:
theorem abs_rsqrtError_lt_one_iff (y x₀ : ℝ) :
    |rsqrtError y x₀| < 1 ↔ x₀ ^ 2 * y ∈ Ioo 0 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold rsqrtError
  rw [abs_lt, mem_Ioo]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]

name: Azurite.BZ.rsqrtSeq_pos
statement:
theorem rsqrtSeq_pos {y x₀ : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x₀) (hu : |rsqrtError y x₀| < 1) (j : ℕ) :
    0 < rsqrtSeq y x₀ j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact hx
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [rsqrtSeq_succ]
    apply rsqrtStep_pos ih
    calc |rsqrtError y (rsqrtSeq y x₀ j)| ≤ |rsqrtError y x₀| ^ (2 ^ j) :=
          abs_rsqrtError_rsqrtSeq_le hu.le j
      _ ≤ |rsqrtError y x₀| ^ 1 :=
          pow_le_pow_of_le_one (abs_nonneg _) hu.le Nat.one_le_two_pow
      _ < 1 := by rw [pow_one]; exact hu

name: Azurite.BZ.inv_sqrt_eq_rpow
statement:
theorem inv_sqrt_eq_rpow {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    (Real.sqrt y)⁻¹ = y ^ (-(1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_neg hy.le]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_rsqrtSeq
statement:
theorem tendsto_rsqrtSeq {y x₀ : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x₀) (h2 : x₀ ^ 2 * y < 2) :
    Tendsto (rsqrtSeq y x₀) atTop (𝓝 (Real.sqrt y)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : |rsqrtError y x₀| < 1 := by
    rw [abs_rsqrtError_lt_one_iff]; exact ⟨by positivity, h2⟩
  
  have hu0 : Tendsto (fun j => rsqrtError y (rsqrtSeq y x₀ j)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => |rsqrtError y x₀| ^ (2 ^ j)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
      (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_abs_lt_one (by rwa [abs_abs])).comp
        (tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt one_lt_two)
    exact squeeze_zero_norm (fun j => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact abs_rsqrtError_rsqrtSeq_le hu.le j) hlim
  
  have hx' : ∀ j, rsqrtSeq y x₀ j = Real.sqrt ((1 - rsqrtError y (rsqrtSeq y x₀ j)) / y) := by
    intro j
    have hpos := rsqrtSeq_pos hx hu j
    have : (1 - rsqrtError y (rsqrtSeq y x₀ j)) / y = rsqrtSeq y x₀ j ^ 2 := by
      unfold rsqrtError; field_simp; ring
    rw [this, Real.sqrt_sq hpos.le]
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun j => Real.sqrt ((1 - rsqrtError y (rsqrtSeq y x₀ j)) / y)) atTop
      (𝓝 (Real.sqrt ((1 - 0) / y))) :=
    ((tendsto_const_nhds.sub hu0).div_const y).sqrt
  rw [sub_zero, one_div, Real.sqrt_inv] at hlim
  exact hlim.congr (fun j => (hx' j).symm)

name: Azurite.BZ.sqrt_eq_mul_inv_sqrt
statement: theorem sqrt_eq_mul_inv_sqrt {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) : Real.sqrt y = y * (Real.sqrt y)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h : Real.sqrt y ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hy).ne'
  field_simp
  exact Real.sq_sqrt hy.le

name: Azurite.BZ.mul_inv_sqrt_rel
statement:
theorem mul_inv_sqrt_rel {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (ε : ℝ) :
    y * ((Real.sqrt y)⁻¹ * (1 + ε)) = Real.sqrt y * (1 + ε)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← sqrt_eq_mul_inv_sqrt hy]

name: Azurite.BZ.heronSeq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem heronSeq_zero (y x₀ : ℝ) : heronSeq y x₀ 0 = x₀
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.heronSeq_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem heronSeq_succ (y x₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    heronSeq y x₀ (n + 1) = heronStep y (heronSeq y x₀ n)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonStep_sq_sub
statement:
theorem newtonStep_sq_sub (y : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    newtonStep (fun x => x ^ 2 - y) (fun x => 2 * x) x = heronStep y x
proof:
:= by
  unfold newtonStep heronStep
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.heronStep_sub_sqrt
statement:
theorem heronStep_sub_sqrt {y x : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    heronStep y x - Real.sqrt y = (x - Real.sqrt y) ^ 2 / (2 * x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold heronStep
  have h := Real.mul_self_sqrt hy
  field_simp
  linear_combination -h

name: Azurite.BZ.sqrt_le_heronStep
statement: theorem sqrt_le_heronStep {y x : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hx : 0 < x) : Real.sqrt y ≤ heronStep y x
proof:
:= by
  have h := heronStep_sub_sqrt hy hx.ne'
  have : 0 ≤ (x - Real.sqrt y) ^ 2 / (2 * x) := by positivity
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.heronStep_le
statement:
theorem heronStep_le {y x : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hx : Real.sqrt y ≤ x) (hx0 : 0 < x) :
    heronStep y x ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  unfold heronStep
  have hyx : y ≤ x ^ 2 := by
    calc y = Real.sqrt y ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt hy).symm
      _ ≤ x ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hx 2
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]
  have : y / x ≤ x := by rw [div_le_iff₀ hx0]; nlinarith
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.heronStep_sub_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem heronStep_sub_sqrt_le {y x : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (hx : Real.sqrt y ≤ x) :
    heronStep y x - Real.sqrt y ≤ (x - Real.sqrt y) ^ 2 / (2 * Real.sqrt y) ∧
      heronStep y x - Real.sqrt y ≤ (x - Real.sqrt y) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt y := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hy
  have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hs hx
  rw [heronStep_sub_sqrt hy.le hx0.ne']
  constructor
  · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity) (by linarith)
  · rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith [sub_nonneg.mpr hx]

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_heronSeq
statement:
theorem tendsto_heronSeq {y x₀ : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (hx : 0 < x₀) :
    Tendsto (heronSeq y x₀) atTop (𝓝 (Real.sqrt y))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt y := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hy
  
  have hge : ∀ n, Real.sqrt y ≤ heronSeq y x₀ (n + 1) ∧ 0 < heronSeq y x₀ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact ⟨sqrt_le_heronStep hy.le hx, hx⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      have hpos : 0 < heronSeq y x₀ (n + 1) := lt_of_lt_of_le hs ih.1
      exact ⟨sqrt_le_heronStep hy.le hpos, hpos⟩
  
  have hhalf : ∀ n, heronSeq y x₀ (n + 1) - Real.sqrt y
      ≤ (heronSeq y x₀ 1 - Real.sqrt y) / 2 ^ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      calc heronSeq y x₀ (n + 1 + 1) - Real.sqrt y
          ≤ (heronSeq y x₀ (n + 1) - Real.sqrt y) / 2 :=
            (heronStep_sub_sqrt_le hy (hge n).1).2
        _ ≤ (heronSeq y x₀ 1 - Real.sqrt y) / 2 ^ n / 2 := by gcongr
        _ = (heronSeq y x₀ 1 - Real.sqrt y) / 2 ^ (n + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
  
  have hshift : Tendsto (fun n => heronSeq y x₀ (n + 1)) atTop (𝓝 (Real.sqrt y)) := by
    rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (heronSeq y x₀ 1 - Real.sqrt y) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) atTop
        (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
        (by norm_num)).const_mul (heronSeq y x₀ 1 - Real.sqrt y)
    refine squeeze_zero (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => ?_) hlim
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hge n).1), one_div, inv_pow,
      ← div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact hhalf n
  exact (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mp hshift

name: Azurite.BZ.floor_mul_pow_bounds
statement:
theorem floor_mul_pow_bounds (y : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    2 ^ m * ⌊y⌋ ≤ ⌊(2 : ℝ) ^ m * y⌋ ∧ ⌊(2 : ℝ) ^ m * y⌋ < 2 ^ m * (⌊y⌋ + 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [Int.le_floor]
    push_cast
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Int.floor_le y) (by positivity)
  · rw [Int.floor_lt]
    push_cast
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Int.lt_floor_add_one y) (by positivity)

name: Azurite.BZ.two_pow_two_pow_succ
statement: theorem two_pow_two_pow_succ (i : ℕ) : (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 ^ (i + 1) = 2 ^ 2 ^ i * 2 ^ 2 ^ i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_add, pow_succ, mul_two]

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCosDigit_nonneg
statement: theorem sinCosDigit_nonneg (x : ℝ) (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ sinCosDigit x i
proof:
:= by
  unfold sinCosDigit
  have h := (floor_mul_pow_bounds (x * 2 ^ 2 ^ i) (2 ^ i)).1
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 ^ i * (x * 2 ^ 2 ^ i) = x * 2 ^ 2 ^ (i + 1) by
    rw [two_pow_two_pow_succ]; ring] at h
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCosDigit_lt
statement: theorem sinCosDigit_lt (x : ℝ) (i : ℕ) : sinCosDigit x i < 2 ^ 2 ^ i
proof:
:= by
  unfold sinCosDigit
  have h := (floor_mul_pow_bounds (x * 2 ^ 2 ^ i) (2 ^ i)).2
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 ^ i * (x * 2 ^ 2 ^ i) = x * 2 ^ 2 ^ (i + 1) by
    rw [two_pow_two_pow_succ]; ring] at h
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_sinCosDigit_div
statement:
theorem sum_sinCosDigit_div (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x < 1 / 2) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (k + 1), (sinCosDigit x i : ℝ) / 2 ^ 2 ^ (i + 1)
      = (⌊x * 2 ^ 2 ^ (k + 1)⌋ : ℝ) / 2 ^ 2 ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ i : ℕ, (sinCosDigit x i : ℝ) / 2 ^ 2 ^ (i + 1)
      = (⌊x * 2 ^ 2 ^ (i + 1)⌋ : ℝ) / 2 ^ 2 ^ (i + 1) - (⌊x * 2 ^ 2 ^ i⌋ : ℝ) / 2 ^ 2 ^ i := by
    intro i
    unfold sinCosDigit
    push_cast
    rw [two_pow_two_pow_succ]
    field_simp
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [sum_range_sub (fun i => (⌊x * 2 ^ 2 ^ i⌋ : ℝ) / 2 ^ 2 ^ i)]
  have h0 : ⌊x * 2⌋ = 0 := Int.floor_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨by positivity, by linarith⟩
  simp [h0]

name: Azurite.BZ.sub_sum_sinCosDigit_bounds
statement:
theorem sub_sum_sinCosDigit_bounds (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x < 1 / 2) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ x - ∑ i ∈ range (k + 1), (sinCosDigit x i : ℝ) / 2 ^ 2 ^ (i + 1)
      ∧ x - ∑ i ∈ range (k + 1), (sinCosDigit x i : ℝ) / 2 ^ 2 ^ (i + 1)
        < 1 / 2 ^ 2 ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_sinCosDigit_div hx0 hx]
  have hM : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ 2 ^ (k + 1) := by positivity
  have h1 := Int.floor_le (x * 2 ^ 2 ^ (k + 1))
  have h2 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (x * 2 ^ 2 ^ (k + 1))
  constructor
  · rw [sub_nonneg, div_le_iff₀ hM]
    exact h1
  · rw [sub_lt_iff_lt_add, ← add_div, lt_div_iff₀ hM]
    linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.sub_sum_sinCosDigit_lt_two_pow
proof:
:= by
  refine (sub_sum_sinCosDigit_bounds hx0 hx k).2.trans_le ?_
  rw [one_div, ← inv_pow, ← one_div]
  exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hn

name: Azurite.BZ.tailSum_top
statement: theorem tailSum_top (y : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) : tailSum y k (k + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [tailSum]

name: Azurite.BZ.tailSum_eq_add
statement:
theorem tailSum_eq_add (y : ℕ → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) :
    tailSum y k j = y j + tailSum y k (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tailSum
  rw [sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot (by omega)]

name: Azurite.BZ.sin_cos_add_step
statement:
theorem sin_cos_add_step (a b : ℝ) :
    Real.sin (a + b) = Real.sin a * Real.cos b + Real.cos a * Real.sin b
      ∧ Real.cos (a + b) = Real.cos a * Real.cos b - Real.sin a * Real.sin b
proof:
:=
  ⟨Real.sin_add a b, Real.cos_add a b⟩

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCosProd_top
statement: theorem sinCosProd_top (c s : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) : sinCosProd c s k (k + 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [sinCosProd]

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCosProd_succ
statement:
theorem sinCosProd_succ (c s : ℕ → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) :
    sinCosProd c s k j = ((c j : ℂ) + s j * I) * sinCosProd c s k (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sinCosProd
  rw [prod_eq_prod_Ico_succ_bot (by omega)]

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCosProd_re
statement:
theorem sinCosProd_re (c s : ℕ → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) :
    (sinCosProd c s k j).re
      = c j * (sinCosProd c s k (j + 1)).re - s j * (sinCosProd c s k (j + 1)).im
proof:
:= by
  rw [sinCosProd_succ c s hj]
  simp

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCosProd_im
statement:
theorem sinCosProd_im (c s : ℕ → ℝ) {k j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k) :
    (sinCosProd c s k j).im
      = s j * (sinCosProd c s k (j + 1)).re + c j * (sinCosProd c s k (j + 1)).im
proof:
:= by
  rw [sinCosProd_succ c s hj]
  simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCosProd_exact
statement:
theorem sinCosProd_exact (y : ℕ → ℝ) (k j : ℕ) :
    sinCosProd (fun i => Real.cos (y i)) (fun i => Real.sin (y i)) k j
      = Complex.exp (tailSum y k j * I)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sinCosProd tailSum
  rw [Complex.ofReal_sum, sum_mul, Complex.exp_sum]
  exact prod_congr rfl fun i _ => (exp_mul_I_eq (y i)).symm

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCosProd_exact_im
statement:
theorem sinCosProd_exact_im (y : ℕ → ℝ) (k j : ℕ) :
    (sinCosProd (fun i => Real.cos (y i)) (fun i => Real.sin (y i)) k j).im
      = Real.sin (tailSum y k j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sinCosProd_exact, exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCosProd_exact_re
statement:
theorem sinCosProd_exact_re (y : ℕ → ℝ) (k j : ℕ) :
    (sinCosProd (fun i => Real.cos (y i)) (fun i => Real.sin (y i)) k j).re
      = Real.cos (tailSum y k j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sinCosProd_exact, exp_ofReal_mul_I_re]

name: Azurite.BZ.norm_prod_sub_prod_le
statement:
theorem norm_prod_sub_prod_le {a b : ℕ → ℂ} {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hb : ∀ i, ‖b i‖ = 1)
    (hab : ∀ i, ‖a i - b i‖ ≤ ε) (m : ℕ) :
    ‖∏ i ∈ range m, a i - ∏ i ∈ range m, b i‖ ≤ m * ε * (1 + ε) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [prod_range_succ, prod_range_succ]
    have hbm : ‖∏ i ∈ range m, b i‖ = 1 := by
      rw [norm_prod]
      exact prod_eq_one fun i _ => hb i
    have ham : ‖a m‖ ≤ 1 + ε := by
      calc ‖a m‖ = ‖(a m - b m) + b m‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖a m - b m‖ + ‖b m‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ε + 1 := by linarith [hab m, hb m]
        _ = 1 + ε := by ring
    have hsplit : (∏ i ∈ range m, a i) * a m - (∏ i ∈ range m, b i) * b m
        = (∏ i ∈ range m, a i - ∏ i ∈ range m, b i) * a m
          + (∏ i ∈ range m, b i) * (a m - b m) := by ring
    have hpow : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + ε) ^ (m + 1) := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith)
    calc ‖(∏ i ∈ range m, a i) * a m - (∏ i ∈ range m, b i) * b m‖
        ≤ ‖∏ i ∈ range m, a i - ∏ i ∈ range m, b i‖ * ‖a m‖
          + ‖∏ i ∈ range m, b i‖ * ‖a m - b m‖ := by
          rw [hsplit]
          exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul])
      _ ≤ m * ε * (1 + ε) ^ m * (1 + ε) + 1 * ε :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul ih ham (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
            (by rw [hbm, one_mul, one_mul]; exact hab m)
      _ = m * ε * (1 + ε) ^ (m + 1) + ε := by ring
      _ ≤ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε * (1 + ε) ^ (m + 1) := by
          push_cast
          nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.sinCos_error
statement:
theorem sinCos_error (y c s : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hc : ∀ i, |c i - Real.cos (y i)| ≤ ε) (hs : ∀ i, |s i - Real.sin (y i)| ≤ ε) :
    |(sinCosProd c s k 0).im - Real.sin (tailSum y k 0)|
        ≤ (k + 1) * (2 * ε) * (1 + 2 * ε) ^ (k + 1)
      ∧ |(sinCosProd c s k 0).re - Real.cos (tailSum y k 0)|
        ≤ (k + 1) * (2 * ε) * (1 + 2 * ε) ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ∀ i, ‖Complex.exp (y i * I)‖ = 1 := fun i => norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I (y i)
  have hab : ∀ i, ‖((c i : ℂ) + s i * I) - Complex.exp (y i * I)‖ ≤ 2 * ε := by
    intro i
    rw [exp_mul_I_eq]
    refine (norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _).trans ?_
    have hre : (((c i : ℂ) + s i * I) - (Real.cos (y i) + Real.sin (y i) * I)).re
        = c i - Real.cos (y i) := by
      simp [Complex.cos_ofReal_re, Complex.sin_ofReal_re, Complex.sin_ofReal_im]
    have him : (((c i : ℂ) + s i * I) - (Real.cos (y i) + Real.sin (y i) * I)).im
        = s i - Real.sin (y i) := by
      simp [Complex.sin_ofReal_re, Complex.cos_ofReal_im, Complex.sin_ofReal_im]
    rw [hre, him]
    linarith [hc i, hs i]
  have h := norm_prod_sub_prod_le (by positivity) hb hab (k + 1)
  have hexact : ∏ i ∈ range (k + 1), Complex.exp (y i * I)
      = Complex.exp (tailSum y k 0 * I) := by
    rw [← sinCosProd_exact, sinCosProd, range_eq_Ico]
    exact prod_congr rfl fun i _ => exp_mul_I_eq (y i)
  have hprod : sinCosProd c s k 0 = ∏ i ∈ range (k + 1), ((c i : ℂ) + s i * I) := by
    rw [sinCosProd, range_eq_Ico]
  rw [hexact] at h
  push_cast at h
  have hsin : Real.sin (tailSum y k 0) = (Complex.exp (tailSum y k 0 * I)).im :=
    (exp_ofReal_mul_I_im _).symm
  have hcos : Real.cos (tailSum y k 0) = (Complex.exp (tailSum y k 0 * I)).re :=
    (exp_ofReal_mul_I_re _).symm
  rw [hsin, hcos, hprod]
  constructor
  · exact (abs_im_le_norm _).trans (by simpa using h)
  · exact (abs_re_le_norm _).trans (by simpa using h)

name: Azurite.BZ.pow_lt_two_pow_of_digit
statement:
theorem pow_lt_two_pow_of_digit {p : ℕ} {j : ℕ} (hp : p < 2 ^ 2 ^ j) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    p ^ N < 2 ^ (2 ^ j * N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_mul]
  exact Nat.pow_lt_pow_left hp hN.ne'

name: Azurite.BZ.agmLog_eq_ellipticK
statement: theorem agmLog_eq_ellipticK (hx : 4 ≤ x) : agmLog x = ellipticK (Real.sqrt (1 - (4 / x) ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hk : 0 < 4 / x := by positivity
  have hk1 : 4 / x ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one hx0]; exact hx
  have h := one_div_AGM_one hk hk1
  have hAGM : 0 < AGM 1 (4 / x) := lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_min one_pos hk) (min_le_AGM one_pos hk)
  unfold agmLog
  rw [div_eq_mul_one_div, h]
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.agmLog_eq_integral
statement:
theorem agmLog_eq_integral (hx : 0 < x) :
    agmLog x = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(π / 2),
      (Real.sqrt (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + (4 / x) ^ 2 * Real.sin θ ^ 2))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_inv_sqrt_eq_pi_div_AGM one_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 / x)
  simp only [one_pow, one_mul] at h
  rw [h, agmLog, div_div]

name: Azurite.BZ.log_two_pow_mul
statement:
theorem log_two_pow_mul (ℓ : ℕ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    Real.log (2 ^ ℓ * x) = ℓ * Real.log 2 + Real.log x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) hx.ne', Real.log_pow]

name: Azurite.BZ.log_pow_two_pow
statement: theorem log_pow_two_pow (ℓ : ℕ) : Real.log (x ^ 2 ^ ℓ) = 2 ^ ℓ * Real.log x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.log_pow]; push_cast; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_agmLog_two_pow_mul_sub
proof:
:= by
  rw [log_two_pow_mul ℓ hx] at h
  convert h using 2
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_agmLog_pow_sub
proof:
:= by
  rw [log_pow_two_pow ℓ] at h
  rw [show agmLog (x ^ 2 ^ ℓ) / 2 ^ ℓ - Real.log x
      = (agmLog (x ^ 2 ^ ℓ) - 2 ^ ℓ * Real.log x) / 2 ^ ℓ by field_simp,
    abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ ℓ)]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h (by positivity)

name: Azurite.BZ.agm_ratio_succ
statement:
theorem agm_ratio_succ (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) (hle : agmB a b j ≤ agmA a b j) :
    Real.sqrt (agmB a b j / agmA a b j) ≤ agmB a b (j + 1) / agmA a b (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb j
  rw [agmA_succ, agmB_succ, Real.sqrt_div hB.le, Real.sqrt_mul hA.le,
    div_le_div_iff₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hA) (by positivity)]
  have hsA := Real.sq_sqrt hA.le
  have hsB := Real.sqrt_nonneg (agmB a b j)
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle hsB]

name: Azurite.BZ.agm_ratio_rpow_le
statement:
theorem agm_ratio_rpow_le (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : b ≤ a) (j : ℕ) :
    (b / a) ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) ≤ agmB a b j / agmA a b j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [agmA_zero, agmB_zero]
  | succ j ih =>
    have hle : agmB a b j ≤ agmA a b j := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with rfl | hj
      · exact hab
      · exact agmB_le_agmA ha hb hj
    calc (b / a) ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1))
        = Real.sqrt ((b / a) ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j)) := by
          rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity), pow_succ]
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (agmB a b j / agmA a b j) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ih
      _ ≤ agmB a b (j + 1) / agmA a b (j + 1) := agm_ratio_succ ha hb j hle

name: Azurite.BZ.agmSeq_shift
statement:
theorem agmSeq_shift (a b : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ j, agmSeq (agmA a b m) (agmB a b m) j = agmSeq a b (j + m)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => rw [zero_add]; exact Prod.ext rfl rfl
  | succ j ih =>
    show agmStep _ = agmSeq a b (j + 1 + m)
    rw [ih, show j + 1 + m = j + m + 1 by omega]
    rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.agmA_one_le
statement: theorem agmA_one_le {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hk1 : k ≤ 1) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) : agmA 1 k j ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j', j = j' + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  calc agmA 1 k (j + 1) ≤ agmA 1 k (0 + 1) := agmA_antitone one_pos hk (Nat.zero_le j)
    _ = (1 + k) / 2 := by rw [agmA_succ, agmA_zero, agmB_zero]
    _ ≤ 1 := by linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.agm_ratio_one_half_le
statement:
theorem agm_ratio_one_half_le {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hk1 : k ≤ 1) {n m : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ 2 ^ m)
    (hkn : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ k) : 1 / 2 ≤ agmB 1 k (m + 1) / agmA 1 k (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := agm_ratio_rpow_le one_pos hk hk1 (m + 1)
  rw [div_one] at h
  set e : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) with he
  refine le_trans ?_ h
  have he0 : 0 ≤ e := by positivity
  have hne : (n : ℝ) * e ≤ 1 := by
    have h2 : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (m + 1) := by
      have : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ m := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have : (2 : ℝ) ^ m ≤ 2 ^ (m + 1) := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (Nat.le_succ m)
      linarith
    rw [he, one_div_pow, mul_one_div, div_le_one (by positivity)]
    exact h2
  calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) = (1 / 2) ^ (1 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_one _).symm
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) * e) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hne
    _ = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ e := by rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]
    _ ≤ k ^ e := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hkn he0

name: Azurite.BZ.agm_log_iterations
statement:
theorem agm_log_iterations {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hk1 : k ≤ 1) (n : ℕ)
    (hkn : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ k) :
    agmA 1 k (2 * Nat.clog 2 n + 1) - agmB 1 k (2 * Nat.clog 2 n + 1) ≤ 8 / 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  set m := Nat.clog 2 n with hm
  have hn : n ≤ 2 ^ m := Nat.le_pow_clog one_lt_two n
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos one_pos hk m
  
  have hshiftA : ∀ j, agmA (agmA 1 k m) (agmB 1 k m) j = agmA 1 k (j + m) := fun j =>
    congrArg Prod.fst (agmSeq_shift 1 k m j)
  have hshiftB : ∀ j, agmB (agmA 1 k m) (agmB 1 k m) j = agmB 1 k (j + m) := fun j =>
    congrArg Prod.snd (agmSeq_shift 1 k m j)
  have hratio := agm_ratio_one_half_le hk hk1 hn hkn
  obtain ⟨hA1, hB1⟩ := agm_pos one_pos hk (m + 1)
  have hcond : agmA (agmA 1 k m) (agmB 1 k m) 1 - agmB (agmA 1 k m) (agmB 1 k m) 1
      ≤ 4 * agmB (agmA 1 k m) (agmB 1 k m) 1 := by
    rw [hshiftA, hshiftB, show 1 + m = m + 1 by ring]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hA1] at hratio
    linarith
  have hgap := agm_gap_le_two_pow hA hB hcond (j := m) (n := n) hn
  rw [hshiftA, hshiftB, hshiftB, show m + 1 + m = 2 * m + 1 by ring,
    show 1 + m = m + 1 by ring] at hgap
  have hb1 : agmB 1 k (m + 1) ≤ 1 :=
    (agmB_le_agmA one_pos hk (by omega)).trans (agmA_one_le hk hk1 (by omega))
  calc agmA 1 k (2 * m + 1) - agmB 1 k (2 * m + 1) ≤ 8 * agmB 1 k (m + 1) / 2 ^ n := hgap
    _ ≤ 8 * 1 / 2 ^ n := by gcongr
    _ = 8 / 2 ^ n := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.agmA_zero
statement: theorem agmA_zero : agmA a b 0 = a
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.agmB_zero
statement: theorem agmB_zero : agmB a b 0 = b
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.agmA_succ
statement: theorem agmA_succ (j : ℕ) : agmA a b (j + 1) = (agmA a b j + agmB a b j) / 2
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.agmB_succ
statement: theorem agmB_succ (j : ℕ) : agmB a b (j + 1) = Real.sqrt (agmA a b j * agmB a b j)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.agm_pos
statement: theorem agm_pos (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : ∀ j, 0 < agmA a b j ∧ 0 < agmB a b j
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => exact ⟨ha, hb⟩
  | succ j ih =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [agmA_succ]; linarith [ih.1, ih.2]
    · rw [agmB_succ]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (mul_pos ih.1 ih.2)

name: Azurite.BZ.agmB_le_agmA_succ
statement:
theorem agmB_le_agmA_succ (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) :
    agmB a b (j + 1) ≤ agmA a b (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb j
  rw [agmA_succ, agmB_succ]
  exact Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨by positivity, by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (agmA a b j - agmB a b j)]⟩

name: Azurite.BZ.agmB_le_agmA
statement: theorem agmB_le_agmA (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) : agmB a b j ≤ agmA a b j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j', j = j' + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  exact agmB_le_agmA_succ ha hb j

name: Azurite.BZ.agmA_antitone
statement: theorem agmA_antitone (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : Antitone fun j => agmA a b (j + 1)
proof:
:=
  antitone_nat_of_succ_le fun j => by
    rw [agmA_succ (j + 1)]
    linarith [agmB_le_agmA_succ ha hb j]

name: Azurite.BZ.agmB_monotone
statement: theorem agmB_monotone (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : Monotone fun j => agmB a b (j + 1)
proof:
:=
  monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun j => by
    obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb (j + 1)
    rw [agmB_succ (j + 1)]
    exact (Real.le_sqrt hB.le (by positivity)).mpr
      (by nlinarith [agmB_le_agmA_succ ha hb j])

name: Azurite.BZ.agm_gap_succ
statement:
theorem agm_gap_succ (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) :
    agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1)
      = (Real.sqrt (agmA a b j) - Real.sqrt (agmB a b j)) ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb j
  rw [agmA_succ, agmB_succ, Real.sqrt_mul hA.le]
  have h1 := Real.sq_sqrt hA.le
  have h2 := Real.sq_sqrt hB.le
  linear_combination (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * h1 + (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * h2

name: Azurite.BZ.agm_gap_succ_le_half
statement:
theorem agm_gap_succ_le_half (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1) ≤ (agmA a b j - agmB a b j) / 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb j
  have hle := agmB_le_agmA ha hb hj
  rw [agm_gap_succ ha hb]
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hA.le
  have ht := Real.sq_sqrt hB.le
  have hst := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  have ht0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (agmB a b j)
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hst ht0]

name: Azurite.BZ.agm_gap_succ_le_sq
statement:
theorem agm_gap_succ_le_sq (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1) ≤ (agmA a b j - agmB a b j) ^ 2 / (8 * agmB a b j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb j
  have hle := agmB_le_agmA ha hb hj
  rw [agm_gap_succ ha hb, div_le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num) (by positivity)]
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hA.le
  have ht := Real.sq_sqrt hB.le
  have hst : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (agmA a b j) - Real.sqrt (agmB a b j) := by
    linarith [Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle]
  have ht0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (agmB a b j)
  have hkey : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (agmA a b j) - Real.sqrt (agmB a b j)) ^ 2
      * ((Real.sqrt (agmA a b j) - Real.sqrt (agmB a b j))
        * (Real.sqrt (agmA a b j) + 3 * Real.sqrt (agmB a b j))) :=
    mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hst (by positivity))
  nlinarith [hkey]

name: Azurite.BZ.agm_gap_le_half_pow
statement:
theorem agm_gap_le_half_pow (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) :
    agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1) ≤ (agmA a b 1 - agmB a b 1) / 2 ^ j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    calc agmA a b (j + 1 + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1 + 1)
        ≤ (agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1)) / 2 := agm_gap_succ_le_half ha hb (by omega)
      _ ≤ (agmA a b 1 - agmB a b 1) / 2 ^ j / 2 := by gcongr
      _ = (agmA a b 1 - agmB a b 1) / 2 ^ (j + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.quadratic_decay
statement:
theorem quadratic_decay {e : ℕ → ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (he : ∀ j, 0 ≤ e j)
    (h : ∀ j, e (j + 1) ≤ C * e j ^ 2) : ∀ j, C * e j ≤ (C * e 0) ^ (2 ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    calc C * e (j + 1) ≤ C * (C * e j ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h j) hC
      _ = (C * e j) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ ((C * e 0) ^ (2 ^ j)) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg hC (he j)) ih 2
      _ = (C * e 0) ^ (2 ^ (j + 1)) := by rw [← pow_mul, pow_succ]

name: Azurite.BZ.agm_gap_le
statement:
theorem agm_gap_le (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) :
    agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1)
      ≤ 8 * agmB a b 1 * ((agmA a b 1 - agmB a b 1) / (8 * agmB a b 1)) ^ (2 ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  have hb1 : 0 < agmB a b 1 := (agm_pos ha hb 1).2
  have hC : 0 ≤ 1 / (8 * agmB a b 1) := by positivity
  have hdecay := quadratic_decay (e := fun j => agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1))
    (C := 1 / (8 * agmB a b 1)) hC
    (fun j => by linarith [agmB_le_agmA_succ ha hb j])
    (fun j => by
      have h1 := agm_gap_succ_le_sq ha hb (j := j + 1) (by omega)
      have h2 : agmB a b 1 ≤ agmB a b (j + 1) := agmB_monotone ha hb (Nat.zero_le j)
      have h3 : 0 ≤ (agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1)) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      calc agmA a b (j + 1 + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1 + 1)
          ≤ (agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1)) ^ 2 / (8 * agmB a b (j + 1)) := h1
        _ ≤ (agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1)) ^ 2 / (8 * agmB a b 1) := by gcongr
        _ = 1 / (8 * agmB a b 1) * (agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1)) ^ 2 := by ring) j
  rw [zero_add] at hdecay
  calc agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1)
      = 8 * agmB a b 1 * (1 / (8 * agmB a b 1) * (agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1))) := by
        field_simp
    _ ≤ 8 * agmB a b 1 * (1 / (8 * agmB a b 1) * (agmA a b 1 - agmB a b 1)) ^ (2 ^ j) := by
        gcongr
    _ = 8 * agmB a b 1 * ((agmA a b 1 - agmB a b 1) / (8 * agmB a b 1)) ^ (2 ^ j) := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.agmB_one_le_agmA_succ
statement:
theorem agmB_one_le_agmA_succ (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) :
    agmB a b 1 ≤ agmA a b (j + 1)
proof:
:=
  (agmB_monotone ha hb (Nat.zero_le j)).trans (agmB_le_agmA_succ ha hb j)

name: Azurite.BZ.bddBelow_agmA
statement:
theorem bddBelow_agmA (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    BddBelow (Set.range fun j => agmA a b (j + 1))
proof:
:=
  ⟨agmB a b 1, fun _ ⟨j, hj⟩ => hj ▸ agmB_one_le_agmA_succ ha hb j⟩

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_agmA_succ
statement:
theorem tendsto_agmA_succ (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Tendsto (fun j => agmA a b (j + 1)) atTop (𝓝 (AGM a b))
proof:
:=
  tendsto_atTop_ciInf (agmA_antitone ha hb) (bddBelow_agmA ha hb)

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_agmA
statement: theorem tendsto_agmA (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : Tendsto (agmA a b) atTop (𝓝 (AGM a b))
proof:
:=
  (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mp (tendsto_agmA_succ ha hb)

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_agm_gap
statement:
theorem tendsto_agm_gap (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Tendsto (fun j => agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => (agmA a b 1 - agmB a b 1) / 2 ^ j) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop (tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt one_lt_two)
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds h
    (fun j => by linarith [agmB_le_agmA_succ ha hb j]) (fun j => agm_gap_le_half_pow ha hb j)

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_agmB_succ
statement:
theorem tendsto_agmB_succ (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Tendsto (fun j => agmB a b (j + 1)) atTop (𝓝 (AGM a b))
proof:
:= by
  have := (tendsto_agmA_succ ha hb).sub (tendsto_agm_gap ha hb)
  rw [sub_zero] at this
  refine this.congr fun j => ?_
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_agmB
statement: theorem tendsto_agmB (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : Tendsto (agmB a b) atTop (𝓝 (AGM a b))
proof:
:=
  (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mp (tendsto_agmB_succ ha hb)

name: Azurite.BZ.AGM_le_agmA
statement: theorem AGM_le_agmA (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) : AGM a b ≤ agmA a b j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j', j = j' + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  exact ciInf_le (bddBelow_agmA ha hb) j

name: Azurite.BZ.agmB_le_AGM
statement: theorem agmB_le_AGM (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) : agmB a b j ≤ AGM a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j', j = j' + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  refine le_ciInf fun i => ?_
  rcases le_or_gt j i with hji | hij
  · exact (agmB_monotone ha hb hji).trans (agmB_le_agmA_succ ha hb i)
  · exact (agmB_le_agmA_succ ha hb j).trans (agmA_antitone ha hb hij.le)

name: Azurite.BZ.min_le_AGM
statement: theorem min_le_AGM (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : min a b ≤ AGM a b
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans ?_ (agmB_le_AGM ha hb le_rfl)
  rw [agmB_succ, agmA_zero, agmB_zero]
  refine (Real.le_sqrt (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr ?_
  rcases le_total a b with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h]; nlinarith
  · rw [min_eq_right h]; nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.AGM_le_max
statement: theorem AGM_le_max (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : AGM a b ≤ max a b
proof:
:= by
  refine (AGM_le_agmA ha hb le_rfl).trans ?_
  rw [agmA_succ, agmA_zero, agmB_zero]
  rcases le_total a b with h | h
  · rw [max_eq_right h]; linarith
  · rw [max_eq_left h]; linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.agmSeq_comm_succ
statement: theorem agmSeq_comm_succ (a b : ℝ) : ∀ j, agmSeq a b (j + 1) = agmSeq b a (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    show agmStep (a, b) = agmStep (b, a)
    simp only [agmStep, Prod.mk.injEq]
    exact ⟨by ring, by rw [mul_comm]⟩
  | succ j ih => show agmStep (agmSeq a b (j + 1)) = agmStep (agmSeq b a (j + 1)); rw [ih]

name: Azurite.BZ.AGM_comm
statement: theorem AGM_comm (a b : ℝ) : AGM a b = AGM b a
proof:
:= by
  unfold AGM agmA
  simp only [agmSeq_comm_succ]

name: Azurite.BZ.agmSeq_self
statement: theorem agmSeq_self (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ∀ j, agmSeq a a j = (a, a)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j ih =>
    show agmStep (agmSeq a a j) = (a, a)
    rw [ih]
    simp only [agmStep, Prod.mk.injEq]
    exact ⟨by ring, Real.sqrt_mul_self ha⟩

name: Azurite.BZ.AGM_self
statement: theorem AGM_self (ha : 0 ≤ a) : AGM a a = a
proof:
:= by
  unfold AGM agmA
  simp only [agmSeq_self ha, ciInf_const]

name: Azurite.BZ.agmSeq_step
statement:
theorem agmSeq_step (a b : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    agmSeq ((a + b) / 2) (Real.sqrt (a * b)) j = agmSeq a b (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j ih => show agmStep _ = agmStep _; rw [ih]

name: Azurite.BZ.AGM_step
statement: theorem AGM_step (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : AGM a b = AGM ((a + b) / 2) (Real.sqrt (a * b))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Tendsto (agmA ((a + b) / 2) (Real.sqrt (a * b))) atTop (𝓝 (AGM a b)) := by
    have := tendsto_agmA_succ ha hb
    refine this.congr fun j => ?_
    simp only [agmA, agmSeq_step]
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1
    (tendsto_agmA (by positivity) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (mul_pos ha hb)))

name: Azurite.BZ.agmSeq_smul
statement:
theorem agmSeq_smul {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (a b : ℝ) :
    ∀ j, agmSeq (c * a) (c * b) j = (c * agmA a b j, c * agmB a b j)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j ih =>
    show agmStep _ = _
    rw [ih]
    simp only [agmStep, agmA_succ, agmB_succ, Prod.mk.injEq]
    refine ⟨by ring, ?_⟩
    rw [show c * agmA a b j * (c * agmB a b j) = c ^ 2 * (agmA a b j * agmB a b j) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg c), Real.sqrt_sq hc]

name: Azurite.BZ.AGM_smul
statement:
theorem AGM_smul {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    AGM (c * a) (c * b) = c * AGM a b
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Tendsto (agmA (c * a) (c * b)) atTop (𝓝 (c * AGM a b)) := by
    have := (tendsto_agmA ha hb).const_mul c
    refine this.congr fun j => ?_
    simp only [agmA, agmSeq_smul hc.le]
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (tendsto_agmA (by positivity) (by positivity)) h1

name: Azurite.BZ.agmA_ne_agmB
statement:
theorem agmA_ne_agmB (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≠ b) : ∀ n, agmA a b n ≠ agmB a b n
  | 0 => hab
  | n + 1 => by
    intro h
    have hg
proof:
:= agm_gap_succ ha hb n
    rw [sub_eq_zero.mpr h] at hg
    obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb n
    have hsq : (Real.sqrt (agmA a b n) - Real.sqrt (agmB a b n)) ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
    have := sub_eq_zero.mp (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp hsq)
    exact agmA_ne_agmB ha hb hab n ((Real.sqrt_inj hA.le hB.le).mp this)

name: Azurite.BZ.agmB_lt_agmA
statement:
theorem agmB_lt_agmA (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≠ b) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    agmB a b n < agmA a b n
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_ne (agmB_le_agmA ha hb hn) (agmA_ne_agmB ha hb hab n).symm

name: Azurite.BZ.agmB_lt_AGM
statement:
theorem agmB_lt_AGM (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≠ b) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    agmB a b n < AGM a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb n
  have h1 : agmB a b n < agmB a b (n + 1) := by
    rw [agmB_succ, Real.lt_sqrt hB.le]
    nlinarith [agmB_lt_agmA ha hb hab hn]
  exact h1.trans_le (agmB_le_AGM ha hb (by omega))

name: Azurite.BZ.AGM_lt_agmA
statement:
theorem AGM_lt_agmA (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≠ b) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    AGM a b < agmA a b n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : agmA a b (n + 1) < agmA a b n := by
    rw [agmA_succ]; linarith [agmB_lt_agmA ha hb hab hn]
  exact (AGM_le_agmA ha hb (by omega)).trans_lt h1

name: Azurite.BZ.agm_gap_le_two_pow
statement:
theorem agm_gap_le_two_pow (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (h : agmA a b 1 - agmB a b 1 ≤ 4 * agmB a b 1)
    {j n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ 2 ^ j) :
    agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1) ≤ 8 * agmB a b 1 / 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hb1 : 0 < agmB a b 1 := (agm_pos ha hb 1).2
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ (agmA a b 1 - agmB a b 1) / (8 * agmB a b 1) := by
    have := agmB_le_agmA_succ ha hb 0
    positivity
  have hr1 : (agmA a b 1 - agmB a b 1) / (8 * agmB a b 1) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]; linarith
  calc agmA a b (j + 1) - agmB a b (j + 1)
      ≤ 8 * agmB a b 1 * ((agmA a b 1 - agmB a b 1) / (8 * agmB a b 1)) ^ (2 ^ j) :=
        agm_gap_le ha hb j
    _ ≤ 8 * agmB a b 1 * (1 / 2) ^ (2 ^ j) := by gcongr
    _ ≤ 8 * agmB a b 1 * (1 / 2) ^ n :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (a := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hn)
          (by positivity)
    _ = 8 * agmB a b 1 / 2 ^ n := by rw [one_div_pow]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.agm_iterations
statement:
theorem agm_iterations (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (h : agmA a b 1 - agmB a b 1 ≤ 4 * agmB a b 1)
    (n : ℕ) :
    agmA a b (Nat.clog 2 n + 1) - agmB a b (Nat.clog 2 n + 1) ≤ 8 * agmB a b 1 / 2 ^ n
proof:
:=
  agm_gap_le_two_pow ha hb h (Nat.le_pow_clog one_lt_two n)

name: Azurite.BZ.polyEval_split
statement:
theorem polyEval_split (a : ℕ → α) (j k : ℕ) (x : α) :
    polyEval a (j * k) x = ∑ ℓ ∈ range j, (x ^ k) ^ ℓ * innerPoly a k ℓ x
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [polyEval]
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [sum_range_succ, ← ih, polyEval, polyEval, add_mul, one_mul, sum_range_add, innerPoly,
      mul_sum]
    congr 1
    refine sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
    rw [← pow_mul, pow_add, mul_comm k j]
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.hornerEval_eq
statement:
theorem hornerEval_eq (c : ℕ → α) (n : ℕ) (y : α) :
    hornerEval c n y = ∑ i ∈ range n, c i * y ^ i
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => simp [hornerEval]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [hornerEval, ih, sum_range_succ', pow_zero, mul_one, add_comm, mul_sum]
    congr 1
    exact sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.polyEval_eq_horner
statement:
theorem polyEval_eq_horner (a : ℕ → α) (j k : ℕ) (x : α) :
    polyEval a (j * k) x = hornerEval (fun ℓ => innerPoly a k ℓ x) j (x ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [polyEval_split, hornerEval_eq]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun ℓ _ => mul_comm _ _

name: Azurite.BZ.pow_two_mul_eq_sq
statement: theorem pow_two_mul_eq_sq (x : α) (m : ℕ) : x ^ (2 * m) = (x ^ m) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm]

name: Azurite.BZ.polyEval_modular_split
statement:
theorem polyEval_modular_split (a : ℕ → α) (j k : ℕ) (x : α) :
    polyEval a (j * k) x = ∑ ℓ ∈ range j, x ^ ℓ * modularPoly a j k ℓ (x ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [polyEval, modularPoly]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Nat.mul_succ, polyEval, sum_range_add, ← polyEval, ih]
    simp only [modularPoly, sum_range_succ, mul_add, sum_add_distrib]
    congr 1
    refine sum_congr rfl fun ℓ _ => ?_
    rw [← pow_mul, pow_add]
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.polyEval_eq_horner_modular
statement:
theorem polyEval_eq_horner_modular (a : ℕ → α) (j k : ℕ) (x : α) :
    polyEval a (j * k) x = hornerEval (fun ℓ => modularPoly a j k ℓ (x ^ j)) j x
proof:
:= by
  rw [polyEval_modular_split, hornerEval_eq]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun ℓ _ => mul_comm _ _

name: Azurite.BZ.classical_split_eq_modular_transpose
statement:
theorem classical_split_eq_modular_transpose (a : ℕ → α) (j k : ℕ) (x : α) :
    ∑ ℓ ∈ range j, (x ^ k) ^ ℓ * innerPoly a k ℓ x
      = ∑ ℓ ∈ range k, x ^ ℓ * modularPoly a k j ℓ (x ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [innerPoly, modularPoly, mul_sum]
  rw [sum_comm]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun ℓ _ => sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.classicalNonscalar_le_horner
statement:
theorem classicalNonscalar_le_horner {j k : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    classicalNonscalar j k ≤ j * k - 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold classicalNonscalar
  have : j + k ≤ j * k := by nlinarith
  omega

name: Azurite.BZ.classicalNonscalar_example
statement: theorem classicalNonscalar_example : classicalNonscalar 3 4 = 5 ∧ 3 * 4 - 2 = 10
proof: := by decide
