name: Azurite.BZ.two_sqrt_le_classicalNonscalar_add_two
statement:
theorem two_sqrt_le_classicalNonscalar_add_two {j k : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    2 * Real.sqrt ((j * k : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (classicalNonscalar j k : ℝ) + 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold classicalNonscalar
  have h := two_sqrt_le_add_div (n := ((j * k : ℕ) : ℝ)) (k := (k : ℝ)) (by positivity)
    (by exact_mod_cast hk)
  have hk0 : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : k ≠ 0)
  have hdiv : ((j * k : ℕ) : ℝ) / (k : ℝ) = j := by push_cast; field_simp
  rw [hdiv] at h
  have hcast : ((k - 1 + (j - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2 = (k : ℝ) + j := by
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub hk, Nat.cast_sub hj]; push_cast; ring
  rw [hcast]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.modularNonscalar_example
statement: theorem modularNonscalar_example : modularNonscalar 3 4 = 6
proof: := by decide

name: Azurite.BZ.modularNonscalar_eq
statement:
theorem modularNonscalar_eq (j k : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    modularNonscalar j k = classicalNonscalar j k + (j - 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold modularNonscalar classicalNonscalar
  omega

name: Azurite.BZ.two_pow_sub_mul
statement: theorem two_pow_sub_mul {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) : (2 : ℝ) ^ (b - a) * (x * 2 ^ a) = x * 2 ^ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [show b = a + (b - a) by omega, pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.blockNum_nonneg
statement: theorem blockNum_nonneg {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) : 0 ≤ blockNum x a b
proof:
:= by
  unfold blockNum
  have h := (floor_mul_pow_bounds (x * 2 ^ a) (b - a)).1
  rw [two_pow_sub_mul hab] at h
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.blockNum_lt
statement: theorem blockNum_lt {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) : blockNum x a b < 2 ^ (b - a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold blockNum
  have h := (floor_mul_pow_bounds (x * 2 ^ a) (b - a)).2
  rw [two_pow_sub_mul hab] at h
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.bitBlock_nonneg
statement: theorem bitBlock_nonneg {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) : 0 ≤ bitBlock x a b
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast blockNum_nonneg hab) (by positivity)

name: Azurite.BZ.bitBlock_lt
statement: theorem bitBlock_lt {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) : bitBlock x a b < 1 / 2 ^ a
proof:
:= by
  unfold bitBlock
  have h : (blockNum x a b : ℝ) < 2 ^ (b - a) := by exact_mod_cast blockNum_lt hab
  rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity), one_mul]
  calc (blockNum x a b : ℝ) * 2 ^ a < 2 ^ (b - a) * 2 ^ a := by gcongr
    _ = 2 ^ b := by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega

name: Azurite.BZ.bitBlock_eq_sub
statement:
theorem bitBlock_eq_sub {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    bitBlock x a b = (⌊x * 2 ^ b⌋ : ℝ) / 2 ^ b - (⌊x * 2 ^ a⌋ : ℝ) / 2 ^ a
proof:
:= by
  unfold bitBlock blockNum
  push_cast
  rw [show b = a + (b - a) by omega, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, pow_add]
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.two_pow_sub_one_le
statement: theorem two_pow_sub_one_le (i : ℕ) : 2 ^ i - 1 ≤ 2 ^ (i + 1) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := i)
  rw [pow_succ]
  omega

name: Azurite.BZ.burstBlock_num_lt
statement: theorem burstBlock_num_lt (i : ℕ) : blockNum x (2 ^ i - 1) (2 ^ (i + 1) - 1) < 2 ^ 2 ^ i
proof:
:= by
  have h := blockNum_lt (x := x) (two_pow_sub_one_le i)
  have e : 2 ^ (i + 1) - 1 - (2 ^ i - 1) = 2 ^ i := by
    have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := i)
    rw [pow_succ]
    omega
  rwa [e] at h

name: Azurite.BZ.burstBlock_nonneg
statement: theorem burstBlock_nonneg (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ burstBlock x i
proof: := bitBlock_nonneg (two_pow_sub_one_le i)

name: Azurite.BZ.burstBlock_lt
statement: theorem burstBlock_lt (i : ℕ) : burstBlock x i < 2 * (1 / 2) ^ 2 ^ i
proof:
:= by
  have h := bitBlock_lt (x := x) (two_pow_sub_one_le i)
  have e : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ^ (2 ^ i - 1) = 2 * (1 / 2) ^ 2 ^ i := by
    have hk : 2 ^ i = (2 ^ i - 1) + 1 := by have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := i); omega
    conv_rhs => rw [hk, pow_succ, one_div_pow]
    field_simp
  rwa [e] at h

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_burstBlock
statement:
theorem sum_burstBlock (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x < 1) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range k, burstBlock x i = (⌊x * 2 ^ (2 ^ k - 1)⌋ : ℝ) / 2 ^ (2 ^ k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ i, burstBlock x i
      = (⌊x * 2 ^ (2 ^ (i + 1) - 1)⌋ : ℝ) / 2 ^ (2 ^ (i + 1) - 1)
        - (⌊x * 2 ^ (2 ^ i - 1)⌋ : ℝ) / 2 ^ (2 ^ i - 1) :=
    fun i => bitBlock_eq_sub (two_pow_sub_one_le i)
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [sum_range_sub (fun i => (⌊x * 2 ^ (2 ^ i - 1)⌋ : ℝ) / 2 ^ (2 ^ i - 1))]
  have h0 : ⌊x⌋ = 0 := Int.floor_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨hx0, hx⟩
  simp [h0]

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_burstBlock_eq_self
statement:
theorem sum_burstBlock_eq_self (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x < 1) {n k : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ 2 ^ k - 1)
    (hxn : ∃ m : ℤ, x * 2 ^ n = m) : ∑ i ∈ range k, burstBlock x i = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hxn
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p, 2 ^ k - 1 = n + p := ⟨2 ^ k - 1 - n, by omega⟩
  rw [sum_burstBlock hx0 hx, hp]
  have h2n : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ n := by positivity
  have hxm : x = m / 2 ^ n := by rw [eq_div_iff h2n.ne']; exact hm
  have e : x * 2 ^ (n + p) = ((m * 2 ^ p : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    push_cast
    rw [hxm, pow_add]
    field_simp
  rw [e, Int.floor_intCast]
  push_cast
  rw [hxm, pow_add]
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.sum_shift_sub
statement:
theorem sum_shift_sub (f : ℝ → ℝ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range k, (f (∑ j ∈ range i, r j + r i) - f (∑ j ∈ range i, r j))
      = f (∑ j ∈ range k, r j) - f 0
proof:
:= by
  have := sum_range_sub (fun i => f (∑ j ∈ range i, r j)) k
  simp only [sum_range_succ, sum_range_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Azurite.BZ.eq_sum_shift_sub
statement:
theorem eq_sum_shift_sub {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    f (∑ j ∈ range k, r j)
      = ∑ i ∈ range k, (f (∑ j ∈ range i, r j + r i) - f (∑ j ∈ range i, r j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_shift_sub, hf0, sub_zero]

name: Azurite.BZ.iteratedDeriv_comp_const_add
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_comp_const_add (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (fun t => f (c + t)) = fun t => iteratedDeriv n f (c + t)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing f with
  | zero => simp [iteratedDeriv_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', iteratedDeriv_succ']
    have : deriv (fun t => f (c + t)) = fun t => deriv f (c + t) :=
      funext fun t => deriv_comp_const_add f c t
    rw [this, ih]

name: Azurite.BZ.IsHolonomic.comp_const_add
statement:
theorem IsHolonomic.comp_const_add {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : IsHolonomic f) (c : ℝ) :
    IsHolonomic fun t => f (c + t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, a, ⟨i, hi⟩, h⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨r, fun j => (a j).comp (X + C c), ⟨i, comp_X_add_C_ne_zero_iff.mpr hi⟩, fun t => ?_⟩
  simp only [iteratedDeriv_comp_const_add, eval_comp, eval_add, eval_X, eval_C]
  rw [add_comm t c]
  exact h (c + t)

name: Azurite.BZ.isHolonomic_of_inhomogeneous
statement:
theorem isHolonomic_of_inhomogeneous {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ (iteratedDeriv j f))
    {m : ℕ} (c : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ[X]) (hc : c (Fin.last m) ≠ 0) (b : ℝ[X]) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ t, ∑ j, (c j).eval t * iteratedDeriv j f t = b.eval t) : IsHolonomic f
proof:
:= by
  
  have hF : ∀ t, ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), ((c j).derivative.eval t * iteratedDeriv j f t
      + (c j).eval t * iteratedDeriv (j + 1) f t) = b.derivative.eval t := by
    intro t
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t => ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), (c j).eval t * iteratedDeriv j f t)
        (∑ j : Fin (m + 1), ((c j).derivative.eval t * iteratedDeriv j f t
          + (c j).eval t * iteratedDeriv (j + 1) f t)) t := by
      refine (HasDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
        (A := fun j y => (c j).eval y * iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ) f y)
        (A' := fun j => (c j).derivative.eval t * iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ) f t
          + (c j).eval t * iteratedDeriv ((j : ℕ) + 1) f t) fun j _ => ?_).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => (Finset.sum_apply y Finset.univ
          (fun j y => (c j).eval y * iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ) f y)).symm)
      have hp : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (c j).eval y) ((c j).derivative.eval t) t :=
        (c j).hasDerivAt t
      have hq : HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ) f) (iteratedDeriv ((j : ℕ) + 1) f t) t := by
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        exact (hf j t).hasDerivAt
      exact hp.mul hq
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t => ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), (c j).eval t * iteratedDeriv j f t)
        (b.derivative.eval t) t := by
      have : (fun t => ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), (c j).eval t * iteratedDeriv j f t)
          = fun t => b.eval t := funext h
      rw [this]
      exact b.hasDerivAt t
    exact h1.unique h2
  
  let c' : Fin (m + 2) → ℝ[X] := Fin.snoc c 0
  let c'' : Fin (m + 2) → ℝ[X] := Fin.cons 0 c
  refine ⟨m + 1, fun j => b.derivative * c' j - b * (c' j).derivative - b * c'' j,
    ⟨Fin.last (m + 1), ?_⟩, fun t => ?_⟩
  · have e1 : c' (Fin.last (m + 1)) = 0 := Fin.snoc_last _ _
    have e2 : c'' (Fin.last (m + 1)) = c (Fin.last m) := by
      rw [← Fin.succ_last]
      exact Fin.cons_succ _ _ _
    beta_reduce
    rw [e1, e2]
    simp only [mul_zero, derivative_zero, zero_sub, neg_zero]
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero hb hc)
  · have hsnoc : ∀ g : Fin (m + 2) → ℝ,
        ∑ j : Fin (m + 2), (c' j).eval t * g j
          = ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), (c j).eval t * g j.castSucc := by
      intro g
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp [c', Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
    have hsnoc' : ∀ g : Fin (m + 2) → ℝ,
        ∑ j : Fin (m + 2), (c' j).derivative.eval t * g j
          = ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), (c j).derivative.eval t * g j.castSucc := by
      intro g
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      simp [c', Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
    have hcons : ∀ g : Fin (m + 2) → ℝ,
        ∑ j : Fin (m + 2), (c'' j).eval t * g j = ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), (c j).eval t * g j.succ := by
      intro g
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      simp [c'', Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_mul, sub_mul, sum_sub_distrib, mul_assoc, ← mul_sum]
    rw [hsnoc, hsnoc', hcons]
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]
    have hE := h t
    have hF' := hF t
    rw [sum_add_distrib] at hF'
    linear_combination b.derivative.eval t * hE - b.eval t * hF'

name: Azurite.BZ.isHolonomic_arctan
statement: theorem isHolonomic_arctan : IsHolonomic Real.arctan
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨2, ![0, C 2 * X, C 1 + X ^ 2], ⟨1, by simp⟩, fun t => ?_⟩
  have h2 : iteratedDeriv 2 Real.arctan = fun t => -(2 * t) / (1 + t ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one, Real.deriv_arctan]
    funext t
    have hpos : (1 : ℝ) + t ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h' : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹)
        (-((2 : ℕ) * t ^ (2 - 1)) / (1 + t ^ 2) ^ 2) t :=
      ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 t).const_add 1).inv hpos
    have h1 : (fun x : ℝ => 1 / (1 + x ^ 2)) = fun x => (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      funext x
      rw [one_div]
    rw [h1, h'.deriv]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  simp [h2, Real.deriv_arctan, iteratedDeriv_one]
  have hpos : (1 : ℝ) + t ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.arctan_shift_coeff_recurrence
statement:
theorem arctan_shift_coeff_recurrence {c : ℝ} {g : PowerSeries ℝ}
    (hg : d⁄dX g
      * (PowerSeries.C (1 + c ^ 2) + PowerSeries.C (2 * c) * PowerSeries.X + PowerSeries.X ^ 2)
      = 1) (ℓ : ℕ) :
    (1 + c ^ 2) * (ℓ + 2) * PowerSeries.coeff (ℓ + 2) g
      + 2 * c * (ℓ + 1) * PowerSeries.coeff (ℓ + 1) g + ℓ * PowerSeries.coeff ℓ g = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff (ℓ + 1)) hg
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_one, ite_eq_right (Nat.succ_ne_zero ℓ), mul_add, mul_add, map_add, map_add,
    mul_comm (d⁄dX g) (PowerSeries.C _), PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, ← mul_assoc,
    mul_comm (d⁄dX g) (PowerSeries.C _), PowerSeries.coeff_succ_mul_X,
    PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul_X_pow', PowerSeries.coeff_derivative,
    PowerSeries.coeff_derivative] at h
  push_cast at h
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos ℓ with rfl | hℓ
  · rw [ite_eq_right (by norm_num)] at h
    push_cast
    linear_combination h
  · rw [ite_eq_left (by omega), PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, show ℓ - 1 + 1 = ℓ by omega] at h
    have : ((ℓ - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = ℓ := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hℓ]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [this] at h
    linear_combination h

name: Azurite.BZ.arctan_v_recurrence
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination r ^ (ℓ + 2) * h

name: Azurite.BZ.arctan_s_recurrence
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := hs (ℓ + 2)
  have h2 := hs (ℓ + 1)
  have h3 := hs ℓ
  rw [show ℓ + 2 + 1 = ℓ + 3 by ring] at h1
  rw [show ℓ + 1 + 1 = ℓ + 2 by ring] at h2 h
  rw [show ℓ + 1 + 2 = ℓ + 3 by ring] at h
  linear_combination h + (1 + c ^ 2) * (ℓ + 3) * h1 + 2 * c * r * (ℓ + 2) * h2
    + r ^ 2 * (ℓ + 1) * h3

name: Azurite.BZ.arctan_step_matrix_eq
statement:
theorem arctan_step_matrix_eq {c r : ℝ} {s : ℕ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℕ}
    (h : (1 + c ^ 2) * (ℓ + 3) * (s (ℓ + 3) - s (ℓ + 2))
      + 2 * c * r * (ℓ + 2) * (s (ℓ + 2) - s (ℓ + 1)) + r ^ 2 * (ℓ + 1) * (s (ℓ + 1) - s ℓ) = 0) :
    ![s (ℓ + 3), s (ℓ + 2), s (ℓ + 1)]
      = (arctanStepMatrix c r ℓ).mulVec ![s (ℓ + 2), s (ℓ + 1), s ℓ]
proof:
:= by
  have hD : (1 + c ^ 2) * ((ℓ : ℝ) + 3) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have key : s (ℓ + 3) = ((1 + c ^ 2) * (ℓ + 3) * s (ℓ + 2)
      - 2 * c * r * (ℓ + 2) * (s (ℓ + 2) - s (ℓ + 1)) - r ^ 2 * (ℓ + 1) * (s (ℓ + 1) - s ℓ))
      / ((1 + c ^ 2) * (ℓ + 3)) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff hD]
    linear_combination h
  rw [key]
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  · simp [arctanStepMatrix, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    field_simp
    ring
  · simp [arctanStepMatrix, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  · simp [arctanStepMatrix, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]

name: Azurite.BZ.vec_eq_matProd_mulVec
statement:
theorem vec_eq_matProd_mulVec (M : ℕ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (S : ℕ → Fin m → ℝ) (d : ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ ℓ, S (d + ℓ + 1) = (M (d + ℓ + 1)).mulVec (S (d + ℓ))) (j : ℕ) :
    S (d + j) = (matProd M d j).mulVec (S d)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [matProd]
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [show d + (j + 1) = d + j + 1 by ring, hS, ih, matProd, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]

name: Azurite.BZ.arctan_eq_im_log
statement: theorem arctan_eq_im_log (x : ℝ) : Real.arctan x = (Complex.log (1 + x * I)).im
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.log_im]
  have hre : 0 < (1 + (x : ℂ) * I).re := by simp
  have harg : |arg (1 + (x : ℂ) * I)| < Real.pi / 2 := abs_arg_lt_pi_div_two_iff.mpr (Or.inl hre)
  have htan : Real.tan (arg (1 + (x : ℂ) * I)) = x := by
    rw [tan_arg]
    simp
  conv_lhs => rw [← htan]
  exact Real.arctan_tan (abs_lt.mp harg).1 (abs_lt.mp harg).2

name: Azurite.BZ.arcsin_eq_arctan'

theorem arcsin_eq_arctan' {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1) :

name: Azurite.BZ.arccos_eq_arctan

proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.arccos_eq_pi_div_two_sub_arcsin, arcsin_eq_arctan' hx]

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_exp_series
statement: theorem hasSum_exp_series (x : ℝ) : HasSum (fun j : ℕ => x ^ j / j.factorial) (exp x)
proof:
:= by

name: Azurite.BZ.hasSum_log_one_add_series
statement:
theorem hasSum_log_one_add_series {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1) :
    HasSum (fun j : ℕ => (-1) ^ j * x ^ (j + 1) / (j + 1)) (log (1 + x))
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.hasSum_pow_div_log_of_abs_lt_one (x := -x) (by rwa [abs_neg])
  rw [sub_neg_eq_add] at h
  have h' := h.neg
  rw [neg_neg] at h'
  convert h' using 1
  funext j
  rw [neg_pow, pow_succ]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_exp_sub_sum_le
statement:
theorem abs_exp_sub_sum_le (x : ℝ) (d : ℕ) :
    |exp x - ∑ j ∈ range d, x ^ j / j.factorial| ≤ |x| ^ d / d.factorial * exp |x|
proof:
:= by
  have hs := hasSum_exp_series x
  have hsum := hs.summable
  have hsh : Summable (fun n : ℕ => x ^ (n + d) / (n + d).factorial) :=
    hsum.comp_injective (add_left_injective d)
  have hsplit := Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add' (f := fun n : ℕ => x ^ n / n.factorial) (k := d) hsh
  rw [hs.tsum_eq] at hsplit
  have htail : exp x - ∑ j ∈ range d, x ^ j / j.factorial
      = ∑' n : ℕ, x ^ (n + d) / (n + d).factorial := by
    linarith
  have hsa := hasSum_exp_series |x|
  have hsabs : Summable (fun n : ℕ => |x| ^ n / n.factorial) := hsa.summable
  have hb : ∀ n : ℕ, |x ^ (n + d) / (n + d).factorial|
      ≤ |x| ^ d / d.factorial * (|x| ^ n / n.factorial) := by
    intro n
    have hfpos : (0 : ℝ) < (n + d).factorial := by exact_mod_cast (n + d).factorial_pos
    rw [abs_div, abs_pow, abs_of_pos hfpos, pow_add, div_le_iff₀ hfpos]
    have hdiv : (d.factorial * n.factorial : ℝ) ≤ (n + d).factorial := by
      have := Nat.factorial_mul_factorial_dvd_factorial_add d n
      rw [add_comm] at this
      exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.factorial_pos _) this
    have hd : (0 : ℝ) < d.factorial := by exact_mod_cast d.factorial_pos
    have hn : (0 : ℝ) < n.factorial := by exact_mod_cast n.factorial_pos
    calc |x| ^ n * |x| ^ d
        = |x| ^ d / d.factorial * (|x| ^ n / n.factorial) * (d.factorial * n.factorial) := by
          field_simp
      _ ≤ |x| ^ d / d.factorial * (|x| ^ n / n.factorial) * (n + d).factorial := by
          gcongr
  have hsb : Summable (fun n : ℕ => |x| ^ d / d.factorial * (|x| ^ n / n.factorial)) :=
    hsabs.mul_left _
  rw [htail]
  calc |∑' n : ℕ, x ^ (n + d) / (n + d).factorial|
      ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, |x ^ (n + d) / (n + d).factorial| := by
        have := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hsh.norm
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
    _ ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, |x| ^ d / d.factorial * (|x| ^ n / n.factorial) :=
        hsh.abs.tsum_le_tsum hb hsb
    _ = |x| ^ d / d.factorial * exp |x| := by rw [tsum_mul_left, hsa.tsum_eq]

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_exp_sub_sum_le_of_abs_le_one
statement:
theorem abs_exp_sub_sum_le_of_abs_le_one {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) (d : ℕ) :
    |exp x - ∑ j ∈ range d, x ^ j / j.factorial| ≤ exp 1 / d.factorial
proof:
:= by
  refine (abs_exp_sub_sum_le x d).trans ?_
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < d.factorial := by exact_mod_cast d.factorial_pos
  calc |x| ^ d / d.factorial * exp |x| ≤ 1 ^ d / d.factorial * exp 1 := by gcongr
    _ = exp 1 / d.factorial := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_series_terms_suffice
proof:
:= by
  refine (abs_exp_sub_sum_le_of_abs_le_one hx d).trans ?_
  have hdpos : (0 : ℝ) < d.factorial := by exact_mod_cast d.factorial_pos
  rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, div_le_iff₀ hdpos]
  calc exp 1 = (2 : ℝ) ^ n * exp 1 / 2 ^ n := by field_simp
    _ ≤ d.factorial / 2 ^ n := by gcongr
    _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * d.factorial := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_series_stop
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_exp_sub_sum_le x d
  have hdpos : (0 : ℝ) < d.factorial := by exact_mod_cast d.factorial_pos
  have ht' : |expTerm x d| = |x| ^ d / d.factorial := by
    unfold expTerm; rw [abs_div, abs_pow, abs_of_pos hdpos]
  rw [ht'] at ht
  calc |exp x - ∑ j ∈ range d, x ^ j / j.factorial| ≤ |x| ^ d / d.factorial * exp |x| := h
    _ ≤ |x| ^ d / d.factorial * exp 1 := by gcongr
    _ < (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) / exp 1 * exp 1 :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right ht (exp_pos 1)
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (exp_pos 1).ne'

name: Azurite.BZ.expPartial_succ
statement:
theorem expPartial_succ (x : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    expPartial x (j + 1) = expPartial x j + expTerm x (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold expPartial; rw [sum_range_succ]

name: Azurite.BZ.roundedExpTerm_eq
statement:
theorem roundedExpTerm_eq (x : ℝ) (θ : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    roundedExpTerm x θ j = expTerm x j * ∏ i ∈ range j, (1 + θ (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [roundedExpTerm, expTerm]
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [roundedExpTerm, ih, expTerm_succ, prod_range_succ]
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_roundedExpTerm_sub_le
proof:
:= by
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := by linarith [abs_nonneg (θ 0), hθ 0]
  rw [roundedExpTerm_eq, ← mul_sub_one, abs_mul, mul_comm]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (abs_nonneg _)
  have h1 := abs_prod_one_add_pow_sub_one_le (fun i => θ (i + 1)) (fun _ => 1) j
  have h2 := prod_one_add_abs_pow_le_exp (fun i => θ (i + 1)) (fun _ => 1) j
  simp only [pow_one, Nat.cast_one, one_mul] at h1 h2
  have hS : ∑ i ∈ range j, |θ (i + 1)| ≤ 3 * j * ε := by
    calc ∑ i ∈ range j, |θ (i + 1)| ≤ ∑ _i ∈ range j, 3 * ε := sum_le_sum fun i _ => hθ (i + 1)
      _ = 3 * j * ε := by rw [sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]; ring
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ range j, |θ (i + 1)| := sum_nonneg fun i _ => abs_nonneg _
  calc |∏ i ∈ range j, (1 + θ (i + 1)) - 1| ≤ ∏ i ∈ range j, (1 + |θ (i + 1)|) - 1 := h1
    _ ≤ exp (∑ i ∈ range j, |θ (i + 1)|) - 1 := by linarith
    _ ≤ 2 * ∑ i ∈ range j, |θ (i + 1)| := exp_sub_one_le_two_mul hS0 (hS.trans hj)
    _ ≤ 2 * (3 * j * ε) := by gcongr
    _ = 6 * j * ε := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.roundedSum_sub_le
statement:
theorem roundedSum_sub_le (t tc σ : ℕ → ℝ) {ε η M T : ℝ} (hη0 : 0 ≤ η) (hσ : ∀ j, |σ j| ≤ ε)
    (htc : ∀ j, |tc j - t j| ≤ η * |t j|) (hM : ∀ j, |∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), t i| ≤ M)
    (hT : ∀ j, |t j| ≤ T) (d : ℕ) :
    |roundedSum tc σ d - ∑ i ∈ range (d + 1), t i|
      ≤ (1 + ε) ^ d * (η * ∑ i ∈ range (d + 1), |t i| + d * ε * (M + (1 + η) * T))
proof:
:= by
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hσ 0)
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ T := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hT 0)
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hM 0)
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    simp only [roundedSum, zero_add, sum_range_one, pow_zero, one_mul, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul,
      add_zero]
    exact htc 0
  | succ d ih =>
    set A := roundedSum tc σ d - ∑ i ∈ range (d + 1), t i with hA
    set X := η * ∑ i ∈ range (d + 1), |t i| + d * ε * (M + (1 + η) * T) with hX
    have hX0 : 0 ≤ X := by positivity
    
    have hrec : roundedSum tc σ (d + 1) - ∑ i ∈ range (d + 1 + 1), t i
        = A + (tc (d + 1) - t (d + 1))
          + σ (d + 1) * (∑ i ∈ range (d + 1), t i + A + tc (d + 1)) := by
      rw [roundedSum, sum_range_succ _ (d + 1), hA]; ring
    have htcb : |tc (d + 1)| ≤ (1 + η) * T := by
      calc |tc (d + 1)| = |t (d + 1) + (tc (d + 1) - t (d + 1))| := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ |t (d + 1)| + |tc (d + 1) - t (d + 1)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ T + η * T := by
            gcongr
            · exact hT _
            · exact (htc _).trans (by gcongr; exact hT _)
        _ = (1 + η) * T := by ring
    have hstep : |roundedSum tc σ (d + 1) - ∑ i ∈ range (d + 1 + 1), t i|
        ≤ (1 + ε) * |A| + η * |t (d + 1)| + ε * (M + (1 + η) * T) := by
      rw [hrec]
      calc |A + (tc (d + 1) - t (d + 1)) + σ (d + 1) * (∑ i ∈ range (d + 1), t i + A + tc (d + 1))|
          ≤ |A| + |tc (d + 1) - t (d + 1)|
            + |σ (d + 1)| * (|∑ i ∈ range (d + 1), t i| + |A| + |tc (d + 1)|) := by
            refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
            gcongr
            · exact abs_add_le _ _
            · rw [abs_mul]
              gcongr
              exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by gcongr; exact abs_add_le _ _)
        _ ≤ |A| + η * |t (d + 1)| + ε * (M + |A| + (1 + η) * T) := by
            gcongr
            · exact htc _
            · exact hσ _
            · exact hM _
        _ = (1 + ε) * |A| + η * |t (d + 1)| + ε * (M + (1 + η) * T) := by ring
    have hpow : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + ε) ^ (d + 1) := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith)
    calc |roundedSum tc σ (d + 1) - ∑ i ∈ range (d + 1 + 1), t i|
        ≤ (1 + ε) * |A| + η * |t (d + 1)| + ε * (M + (1 + η) * T) := hstep
      _ ≤ (1 + ε) * ((1 + ε) ^ d * X) + η * |t (d + 1)| + ε * (M + (1 + η) * T) := by
          gcongr
      _ ≤ (1 + ε) ^ (d + 1) * X
          + (1 + ε) ^ (d + 1) * (η * |t (d + 1)| + ε * (M + (1 + η) * T)) := by
          have h0 : 0 ≤ η * |t (d + 1)| + ε * (M + (1 + η) * T) := by positivity
          have h2 := le_mul_of_one_le_left h0 hpow
          have h1 : (1 + ε) * ((1 + ε) ^ d * X) = (1 + ε) ^ (d + 1) * X := by ring
          linarith
      _ = (1 + ε) ^ (d + 1) * (η * ∑ i ∈ range (d + 1 + 1), |t i|
            + (d + 1 : ℕ) * ε * (M + (1 + η) * T)) := by
          rw [sum_range_succ _ (d + 1), hX]; push_cast; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_roundedSum_error
proof:
:= by
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hσ 0)
  
  have hT : ∀ j, |expTerm x j| ≤ 1 := by
    intro j
    unfold expTerm
    have hf : (1 : ℝ) ≤ j.factorial := by exact_mod_cast j.factorial_pos
    have hfpos : (0 : ℝ) < j.factorial := by linarith
    rw [abs_div, abs_pow, abs_of_pos hfpos, div_le_one hfpos]
    exact (pow_le_one₀ (abs_nonneg _) hx).trans hf
  have hM : ∀ j, |∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), expTerm x i| ≤ exp 1 := by
    intro j
    calc |∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), expTerm x i| ≤ ∑ i ∈ range (j + 1), |expTerm x i| :=
          abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ exp |x| := sum_abs_expTerm_le x _
      _ ≤ exp 1 := exp_le_exp.mpr hx
  
  have htc : ∀ j, |roundedExpTerm x θ j - expTerm x j| ≤ 6 * d * ε * |expTerm x j| ∨ d < j := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j ≤ d
    · left
      have hj' : 3 * j * ε ≤ 1 := by
        calc 3 * (j : ℝ) * ε ≤ 3 * d * ε := by gcongr
          _ ≤ 6 * d * ε := by nlinarith
          _ ≤ 1 := hd
      calc |roundedExpTerm x θ j - expTerm x j| ≤ 6 * j * ε * |expTerm x j| :=
            abs_roundedExpTerm_sub_le x hθ hj'
        _ ≤ 6 * d * ε * |expTerm x j| := by gcongr
    · right; omega
  
  set tc : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => if j ≤ d then roundedExpTerm x θ j else expTerm x j with htc_def
  have htc' : ∀ j, |tc j - expTerm x j| ≤ 6 * d * ε * |expTerm x j| := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j ≤ d
    · simp only [htc_def, hj, ↓reduceIte]
      rcases htc j with h | h
      · exact h
      · omega
    · simp only [htc_def, hj, ↓reduceIte, sub_self, abs_zero]; positivity
  have hsame : roundedSum tc σ d = roundedSum (roundedExpTerm x θ) σ d := by
    have : ∀ j ≤ d, roundedSum tc σ j = roundedSum (roundedExpTerm x θ) σ j := by
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero => intro _; simp [roundedSum, htc_def]
      | succ j ih =>
        intro hj
        rw [roundedSum, roundedSum, ih (by omega)]
        simp only [htc_def, hj, ↓reduceIte]
    exact this d le_rfl
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ range (d + 1), |expTerm x i| ≤ exp 1 :=
    (sum_abs_expTerm_le x _).trans (exp_le_exp.mpr hx)
  have hgen := roundedSum_sub_le (expTerm x) tc σ (by positivity) hσ htc' hM hT d
  rw [hsame] at hgen
  have he : exp 1 ≤ 3 := by linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9]
  have hdε : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ) * ε := by positivity
  have hdε1 : (d : ℝ) * ε ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hpow : (1 + ε) ^ d ≤ 2 := by
    calc (1 + ε) ^ d ≤ exp ε ^ d :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith [add_one_le_exp ε]) d
      _ = exp (d * ε) := by rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      _ ≤ 2 := by linarith [exp_sub_one_le_two_mul hdε hdε1]
  have hinner : 6 * d * ε * ∑ i ∈ range (d + 1), |expTerm x i|
      + d * ε * (exp 1 + (1 + 6 * d * ε) * 1) ≤ 6 * d * ε * 3 + d * ε * (3 + 2) := by
    have h1 : 6 * d * ε * ∑ i ∈ range (d + 1), |expTerm x i| ≤ 6 * d * ε * 3 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsum.trans he) (by positivity)
    have h2 : d * ε * (exp 1 + (1 + 6 * d * ε) * 1) ≤ d * ε * (3 + 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hdε
    linarith
  unfold expPartial
  calc |roundedSum (roundedExpTerm x θ) σ d - ∑ i ∈ range (d + 1), expTerm x i|
      ≤ (1 + ε) ^ d * (6 * d * ε * ∑ i ∈ range (d + 1), |expTerm x i|
          + d * ε * (exp 1 + (1 + 6 * d * ε) * 1)) := hgen
    _ ≤ 2 * (6 * d * ε * 3 + d * ε * (3 + 2)) :=
        mul_le_mul hpow hinner (by positivity) (by norm_num)
    _ = 46 * d * ε := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_guard_digits
statement:
theorem exp_guard_digits {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) {θ σ : ℕ → ℝ} {ε : ℝ} {d n : ℕ}
    (hθ : ∀ i, |θ i| ≤ 3 * ε) (hσ : ∀ j, |σ j| ≤ ε) (hd : 6 * d * ε ≤ 1) (hd0 : 0 < d)
    (hε : ε ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) / (46 * d)) :
    |roundedSum (roundedExpTerm x θ) σ d - expPartial x d| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  refine (exp_roundedSum_error hx hθ hσ hd).trans ?_
  have hd' : (0 : ℝ) < 46 * d := by positivity
  calc 46 * (d : ℝ) * ε ≤ 46 * d * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) / (46 * d)) := by gcongr
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) := by field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.guard_digits_of_neg
statement: theorem guard_digits_of_neg (x : ℝ) : Real.logb 2 (exp (2 * |x|)) = 2 * |x| / Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.logb, Real.log_exp]

name: Azurite.BZ.agmCsq_succ
statement:
theorem agmCsq_succ (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) :
    agmCsq a b (j + 1) = ((agmA a b j - agmB a b j) / 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb j
  rw [agmCsq, agmA_succ, agmB_succ, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.salaminB0_pos
statement: theorem salaminB0_pos : 0 < salaminB0
proof: := by unfold salaminB0; positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.salaminB0_lt_one
statement: theorem salaminB0_lt_one : salaminB0 < 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold salaminB0
  rw [div_lt_one (by positivity), Real.lt_sqrt zero_le_one]
  norm_num

name: Azurite.BZ.salaminB0_sq
statement: theorem salaminB0_sq : salaminB0 ^ 2 = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold salaminB0
  rw [div_pow, one_pow, Real.sq_sqrt zero_le_two]

name: Azurite.BZ.sqrt_one_sub_salaminB0_sq
statement: theorem sqrt_one_sub_salaminB0_sq : Real.sqrt (1 - salaminB0 ^ 2) = salaminB0
proof:
:= by
  rw [salaminB0_sq, show (1 : ℝ) - 1 / 2 = 2⁻¹ by norm_num, Real.sqrt_inv, salaminB0, one_div]

name: Azurite.BZ.ellipticK_salaminB0
statement: theorem ellipticK_salaminB0 : ellipticK salaminB0 = π / (2 * AGM 1 salaminB0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := one_div_AGM_one salaminB0_pos salaminB0_lt_one.le
  rw [sqrt_one_sub_salaminB0_sq] at h
  have hM : 0 < AGM 1 salaminB0 := AGM_one_pos salaminB0_pos
  field_simp at h ⊢
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_salaminSum
statement:
theorem summable_salaminSum :
    Summable fun j : ℕ => 2 ^ (j + 2) * agmCsq 1 salaminB0 (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := summable_agm_c_sq one_pos salaminB0_pos salaminB0_lt_one.le
  have h2 := (summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun j : ℕ =>
    2 ^ j / 2 * (agmA 1 salaminB0 j ^ 2 - agmB 1 salaminB0 j ^ 2)) 1).mpr h
  refine (h2.mul_left 4).congr fun j => ?_
  simp only [agmCsq]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.salamin_identity
statement: theorem salamin_identity : π * (1 - salaminSum) = 4 * AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hE := ellipticE_eq_AGM_sum salaminB0_pos salaminB0_lt_one
  rw [sqrt_one_sub_salaminB0_sq] at hE
  have hL : 2 * ellipticE salaminB0 * ellipticK salaminB0 - ellipticK salaminB0 ^ 2 = π / 2 :=
    legendre_relation_sqrt_half
  have hK := ellipticK_salaminB0
  have hS := summable_agm_c_sq one_pos salaminB0_pos salaminB0_lt_one.le
  have hsplit := hS.tsum_eq_zero_add
  have htail : ∑' j : ℕ, 2 ^ (j + 1) / 2
      * (agmA 1 salaminB0 (j + 1) ^ 2 - agmB 1 salaminB0 (j + 1) ^ 2) = salaminSum / 4 := by
    rw [salaminSum, ← tsum_div_const]
    refine tsum_congr fun j => ?_
    simp only [agmCsq]
    ring
  simp only [agmA_zero, agmB_zero, one_pow, salaminB0_sq, pow_zero] at hsplit
  rw [htail] at hsplit
  rw [hsplit] at hE
  have hM : 0 < AGM 1 salaminB0 := AGM_one_pos salaminB0_pos
  rw [hE, hK] at hL
  field_simp at hL
  linear_combination (1 / 4 : ℝ) * hL

name: Azurite.BZ.salamin_denominator_pos
statement: theorem salamin_denominator_pos : 0 < 1 - salaminSum
proof:
:= by
  have hM : 0 < AGM 1 salaminB0 := AGM_one_pos salaminB0_pos
  have : 0 < π * (1 - salaminSum) := by rw [salamin_identity]; positivity
  exact pos_of_mul_pos_right this Real.pi_pos.le

name: Azurite.BZ.salamin_formula
statement: theorem salamin_formula : π = 4 * AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2 / (1 - salaminSum)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_div_iff salamin_denominator_pos.ne', salamin_identity]

name: Azurite.BZ.salamin_agm_pos
statement: theorem salamin_agm_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < sA n ∧ 0 < sB n
proof: := agm_pos one_pos salaminB0_pos n

name: Azurite.BZ.salaminB0_gt
statement: theorem salaminB0_gt : 2 / 3 < salaminB0
proof:
:= by
  unfold salaminB0
  rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  have : Real.sqrt 2 < 3 / 2 := by rw [Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.salamin_agmA_one
statement: theorem salamin_agmA_one : sA 1 = (1 + salaminB0) / 2
proof: := by rw [agmA_succ, agmA_zero, agmB_zero]

name: Azurite.BZ.salamin_agmB_one
statement: theorem salamin_agmB_one : sB 1 = Real.sqrt salaminB0
proof:
:= by
  rw [agmB_succ, agmA_zero, agmB_zero, one_mul]

name: Azurite.BZ.salamin_agmB_one_sq
statement: theorem salamin_agmB_one_sq : sB 1 ^ 2 = salaminB0
proof:
:= by
  rw [salamin_agmB_one, Real.sq_sqrt salaminB0_pos.le]

name: Azurite.BZ.salamin_agmB_one_gt
statement: theorem salamin_agmB_one_gt : 2 / 3 < sB 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [salamin_agmB_one]
  have h0 := salaminB0_pos
  have h1 := salaminB0_lt_one
  calc 2 / 3 < salaminB0 := salaminB0_gt
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt salaminB0 := (Real.le_sqrt' h0).mpr (by nlinarith)

name: Azurite.BZ.salamin_agmA_le_one
statement: theorem salamin_agmA_le_one {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : sA n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  calc sA (m + 1) ≤ sA 1 := by simpa using agmA_antitone one_pos salaminB0_pos (Nat.zero_le m)
    _ = (1 + salaminB0) / 2 := salamin_agmA_one
    _ ≤ 1 := by linarith [salaminB0_lt_one]

name: Azurite.BZ.salamin_agmB_gt
statement: theorem salamin_agmB_gt {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : 2 / 3 < sB n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  calc 2 / 3 < sB 1 := salamin_agmB_one_gt
    _ ≤ sB (m + 1) := by simpa using agmB_monotone one_pos salaminB0_pos (Nat.zero_le m)

name: Azurite.BZ.salamin_gap_le_two_mul
statement: theorem salamin_gap_le_two_mul {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : sA n - sB n ≤ 2 * sB 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  have h1 := agm_gap_le_half_pow one_pos salaminB0_pos m
  have hA1 := salamin_agmA_le_one le_rfl
  have hB1 := salamin_agmB_one_gt
  have h2 : (sA 1 - sB 1) / 2 ^ m ≤ sA 1 - sB 1 :=
    div_le_self (sub_nonneg.mpr (agmB_le_agmA one_pos salaminB0_pos le_rfl))
      (one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num))
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.salaminS_zero
statement: theorem salaminS_zero : salaminS 0 = 1 / 2
proof: := by simp [salaminS]

name: Azurite.BZ.salaminS_succ
statement:
theorem salaminS_succ (N : ℕ) :
    salaminS (N + 1) = salaminS N - 2 ^ (N + 1) * ((sA N - sB N) / 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [salaminS, salaminS, Finset.sum_range_succ, agmCsq_succ one_pos salaminB0_pos]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_salaminSum_add
statement:
theorem summable_salaminSum_add (N : ℕ) :
    Summable fun i : ℕ => 2 ^ (i + N + 2) * agmCsq 1 salaminB0 (i + N + 1)
proof:
:=
  (summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun j : ℕ => 2 ^ (j + 2) * agmCsq 1 salaminB0 (j + 1)) N).mpr
    summable_salaminSum

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_salaminTail
statement:
theorem summable_salaminTail (N : ℕ) :
    Summable fun i : ℕ => 2 ^ (i + N + 1) * agmCsq 1 salaminB0 (i + N + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ((summable_salaminSum_add N).div_const 2).congr fun i => ?_
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.agmCsq_succ_nonneg
statement: theorem agmCsq_succ_nonneg (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ agmCsq a b (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [agmCsq_succ ha hb]; positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.salaminTail_nonneg
statement: theorem salaminTail_nonneg (N : ℕ) : 0 ≤ salaminTail N
proof:
:=
  tsum_nonneg fun i => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (agmCsq_succ_nonneg one_pos salaminB0_pos _)

name: Azurite.BZ.salaminS_eq
statement: theorem salaminS_eq (N : ℕ) : salaminS N = (1 - salaminSum) / 2 + salaminTail N
proof:
:= by
  have h : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, 2 ^ (i + 2) * agmCsq 1 salaminB0 (i + 1))
      + ∑' i : ℕ, 2 ^ (i + N + 2) * agmCsq 1 salaminB0 (i + N + 1) = salaminSum :=
    Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add' (f := fun j : ℕ => 2 ^ (j + 2) * agmCsq 1 salaminB0 (j + 1))
      (k := N) (summable_salaminSum_add N)
  have e1 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, 2 ^ (j + 1) * agmCsq 1 salaminB0 (j + 1)
      = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, 2 ^ (j + 2) * agmCsq 1 salaminB0 (j + 1)) / 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
  have e2 : salaminTail N
      = (∑' i : ℕ, 2 ^ (i + N + 2) * agmCsq 1 salaminB0 (i + N + 1)) / 2 := by
    rw [salaminTail, ← tsum_div_const]
    exact tsum_congr fun i => by ring
  rw [salaminS, e1, e2]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.salaminS_limit_gt
statement: theorem salaminS_limit_gt : 1 / 3 < (1 - salaminSum) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hM := AGM_one_pos salaminB0_pos
  have hb1 : sB 1 ≤ AGM 1 salaminB0 := agmB_le_AGM one_pos salaminB0_pos le_rfl
  have hM2 : sB 1 ^ 2 ≤ AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (salamin_agm_pos 1).2.le hb1 2
  rw [salamin_agmB_one_sq] at hM2
  have hid := salamin_identity
  have hD := salamin_denominator_pos
  have hpi := Real.pi_lt_four
  have hb0 := salaminB0_gt
  nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.salaminS_gt
statement: theorem salaminS_gt (N : ℕ) : 1 / 3 < salaminS N
proof:
:= by
  rw [salaminS_eq]
  linarith [salaminS_limit_gt, salaminTail_nonneg N]

name: Azurite.BZ.pi_eq_div_salaminS_limit
statement:
theorem pi_eq_div_salaminS_limit :
    π = 2 * AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2 / ((1 - salaminSum) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hD := salamin_denominator_pos
  have hid := salamin_identity
  rw [eq_div_iff (by positivity)]
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.salaminTail_le
statement:
theorem salaminTail_le {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    salaminTail N ≤ 4 / 7 * 2 ^ N * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hgap := salamin_gap_le_two_mul hN
  have hg0 : 0 ≤ sA N - sB N := sub_nonneg.mpr (agmB_le_agmA one_pos salaminB0_pos hN)
  have hterm : ∀ i : ℕ, 2 ^ (i + N + 1) * agmCsq 1 salaminB0 (i + N + 1)
      ≤ 2 ^ N / 2 * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 * (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ i := by
    intro i
    rw [agmCsq_succ one_pos salaminB0_pos]
    have h1 := agm_gap_add_le one_pos salaminB0_pos hN hgap i
    rw [add_comm N i] at h1
    have hgi : 0 ≤ sA (i + N) - sB (i + N) :=
      sub_nonneg.mpr (agmB_le_agmA one_pos salaminB0_pos (by omega))
    have h2 : ((sA (i + N) - sB (i + N)) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ ((sA N - sB N) / 4 ^ i / 2) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) 2
    calc 2 ^ (i + N + 1) * ((sA (i + N) - sB (i + N)) / 2) ^ 2
        ≤ 2 ^ (i + N + 1) * ((sA N - sB N) / 4 ^ i / 2) ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity)
      _ = 2 ^ N / 2 * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 * (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ i := by
          rw [show (4 : ℝ) ^ i = 2 ^ i * 2 ^ i by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num,
            show (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ i = 1 / (2 ^ i * 2 ^ i * 2 ^ i) by
              rw [one_div_pow, ← mul_pow, ← mul_pow]; norm_num,
            pow_add, pow_add]
          field_simp
  have hsum : Summable fun i : ℕ => 2 ^ N / 2 * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 * (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ i :=
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).mul_left _
  calc salaminTail N ≤ ∑' i : ℕ, 2 ^ N / 2 * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 * (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ i :=
        Summable.tsum_le_tsum hterm (summable_salaminTail N) hsum
    _ = 2 ^ N / 2 * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 * (8 / 7) := by
        rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
        norm_num
    _ = 4 / 7 * 2 ^ N * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.salaminApprox_sub_pi_le
statement:
theorem salaminApprox_sub_pi_le {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    salaminApprox N - π ≤ 9 / 4 * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hM := AGM_one_pos salaminB0_pos
  have hs := salaminS_gt N
  have hsInf := salaminS_limit_gt
  have hsge : (1 - salaminSum) / 2 ≤ salaminS N := by
    rw [salaminS_eq]; linarith [salaminTail_nonneg N]
  obtain ⟨hA1, hB1⟩ := salamin_agm_pos (N + 1)
  have hMA : AGM 1 salaminB0 ≤ sA (N + 1) := AGM_le_agmA one_pos salaminB0_pos (by omega)
  have hBM : sB (N + 1) ≤ AGM 1 salaminB0 := agmB_le_AGM one_pos salaminB0_pos (by omega)
  have hAle : sA (N + 1) ≤ 1 := salamin_agmA_le_one (by omega)
  have hBgt : 2 / 3 < sB N := salamin_agmB_gt hN
  have hgap := agm_gap_succ_le_sq one_pos salaminB0_pos hN
  have hg0 : 0 ≤ sA N - sB N := sub_nonneg.mpr (agmB_le_agmA one_pos salaminB0_pos hN)
  have h1 : 2 * AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2 / salaminS N
      ≤ 2 * AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2 / ((1 - salaminSum) / 2) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by linarith) hsge
  have h2 : sA (N + 1) ^ 2 - AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2 ≤ 3 / 8 * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 := by
    have e : sA (N + 1) ^ 2 - AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2
        = (sA (N + 1) - AGM 1 salaminB0) * (sA (N + 1) + AGM 1 salaminB0) := by ring
    have h3 : sA (N + 1) - AGM 1 salaminB0 ≤ sA (N + 1) - sB (N + 1) := by linarith
    have h4 : sA (N + 1) + AGM 1 salaminB0 ≤ 2 := by linarith
    have h6 : (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 / (8 * sB N) ≤ (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 / (16 / 3) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    rw [e]
    calc (sA (N + 1) - AGM 1 salaminB0) * (sA (N + 1) + AGM 1 salaminB0)
        ≤ (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 / (16 / 3) * 2 :=
          mul_le_mul (h3.trans (hgap.trans h6)) h4 (by linarith) (by positivity)
      _ = 3 / 8 * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [salaminApprox, pi_eq_div_salaminS_limit]
  calc 2 * sA (N + 1) ^ 2 / salaminS N - 2 * AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2 / ((1 - salaminSum) / 2)
      ≤ 2 * sA (N + 1) ^ 2 / salaminS N - 2 * AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2 / salaminS N := by linarith
    _ = 2 * (sA (N + 1) ^ 2 - AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2) / salaminS N := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 * (3 / 8 * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2) / salaminS N :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by norm_num)) (by linarith)
    _ ≤ 2 * (3 / 8 * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2) / (1 / 3) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by norm_num) hs.le
    _ = 9 / 4 * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.le_salaminApprox_sub_pi
statement:
theorem le_salaminApprox_sub_pi {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    -(48 / 7 * 2 ^ N * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2) ≤ salaminApprox N - π
proof:
:= by
  have hM := AGM_one_pos salaminB0_pos
  have hs := salaminS_gt N
  have hsInf := salaminS_limit_gt
  have hr0 := salaminTail_nonneg N
  have hsN := salaminS_eq N
  obtain ⟨hA1, hB1⟩ := salamin_agm_pos (N + 1)
  have hMA : AGM 1 salaminB0 ≤ sA (N + 1) := AGM_le_agmA one_pos salaminB0_pos (by omega)
  have hπ := pi_eq_div_salaminS_limit
  have h1 : 2 * AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2 / salaminS N ≤ 2 * sA (N + 1) ^ 2 / salaminS N :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) (by linarith)
  have e : 2 * AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2 / salaminS N - 2 * AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2 / ((1 - salaminSum) / 2)
      = -(2 * AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2 / ((1 - salaminSum) / 2)) * (salaminTail N / salaminS N) := by
    set u := (1 - salaminSum) / 2 with hu
    have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hur : u + salaminTail N ≠ 0 := by linarith
    rw [hsN]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [← hπ] at e
  have h2 : π * salaminTail N / salaminS N ≤ 48 / 7 * 2 ^ N * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 := by
    calc π * salaminTail N / salaminS N ≤ 4 * (4 / 7 * 2 ^ N * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2) / (1 / 3) :=
          div_le_div₀ (by positivity)
            (mul_le_mul Real.pi_lt_four.le (salaminTail_le hN) hr0 (by norm_num)) (by norm_num)
            hs.le
      _ = 48 / 7 * 2 ^ N * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 := by ring
  calc -(48 / 7 * 2 ^ N * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2) ≤ -(π * salaminTail N / salaminS N) := by linarith
    _ = 2 * AGM 1 salaminB0 ^ 2 / salaminS N - π := by rw [e]; ring
    _ ≤ 2 * sA (N + 1) ^ 2 / salaminS N - π := by linarith
    _ = salaminApprox N - π := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_salaminApprox_sub_pi_le
statement:
theorem abs_salaminApprox_sub_pi_le {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    |salaminApprox N - π| ≤ 7 * 2 ^ N * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := salaminApprox_sub_pi_le hN
  have h2 := le_salaminApprox_sub_pi hN
  have hg := sq_nonneg (sA N - sB N)
  have h2N : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ N := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  have hprod : (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ N * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hpos : 0 ≤ 2 ^ N * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 := by positivity
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.salaminB0_bounds
statement: theorem salaminB0_bounds : (7071 / 10000 : ℝ) < salaminB0 ∧ salaminB0 < 70711 / 100000
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := salaminB0_pos
  have h2 := salaminB0_sq
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: Azurite.BZ.salamin_gap_one_le
statement: theorem salamin_gap_one_le : sA 1 - sB 1 ≤ 1 / 64
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := salaminB0_bounds
  rw [salamin_agmA_one]
  have hb1 : 0 ≤ sB 1 := (salamin_agm_pos 1).2.le
  have hsq := salamin_agmB_one_sq
  have : (8408 / 10000 : ℝ) ≤ sB 1 := by nlinarith
  linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.salamin_gap_le_pow
statement:
theorem salamin_gap_le_pow {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    sA n - sB n ≤ 8 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (8 * 2 ^ (n - 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, n = j + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  have h := agm_gap_le one_pos salaminB0_pos j
  have hb1 := salamin_agmB_one_gt
  have hb1le : sB 1 ≤ 1 := (agmB_le_agmA one_pos salaminB0_pos le_rfl).trans (salamin_agmA_le_one le_rfl)
  have hg1 := salamin_gap_one_le
  have hg0 : 0 ≤ sA 1 - sB 1 := sub_nonneg.mpr (agmB_le_agmA one_pos salaminB0_pos le_rfl)
  have hratio : (sA 1 - sB 1) / (8 * sB 1) ≤ 1 / 256 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]; nlinarith
  have hratio0 : 0 ≤ (sA 1 - sB 1) / (8 * sB 1) := by positivity
  calc sA (j + 1) - sB (j + 1)
      ≤ 8 * sB 1 * ((sA 1 - sB 1) / (8 * sB 1)) ^ (2 ^ j) := h
    _ ≤ 8 * 1 * (1 / 256 : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ j) := by gcongr
    _ = 8 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (8 * 2 ^ j) := by
        rw [pow_mul, mul_one]; norm_num

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_salaminApprox_sub_pi_le_pow
statement:
theorem abs_salaminApprox_sub_pi_le_pow {N w : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (h : w + N + 9 ≤ 8 * 2 ^ N) :
    |salaminApprox N - π| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := abs_salaminApprox_sub_pi_le hN
  have hg := salamin_gap_le_pow hN
  have hg0 : 0 ≤ sA N - sB N := sub_nonneg.mpr (agmB_le_agmA one_pos salaminB0_pos hN)
  have hK : 8 * 2 ^ (N - 1) * 2 = 8 * 2 ^ N := by
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, N = j + 1 := ⟨N - 1, by omega⟩
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ]; ring
  have hsq : (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 ≤ 64 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (8 * 2 ^ N) := by
    calc (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 ≤ (8 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (8 * 2 ^ (N - 1))) ^ 2 := by gcongr
      _ = 64 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (8 * 2 ^ N) := by rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, hK]; norm_num
  have hnat : (448 : ℕ) * 2 ^ (N + w) ≤ 2 ^ (8 * 2 ^ N) := by
    calc (448 : ℕ) * 2 ^ (N + w) ≤ 2 ^ 9 * 2 ^ (N + w) := by norm_num
      _ = 2 ^ (9 + N + w) := by rw [← pow_add]; ring_nf
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (8 * 2 ^ N) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos (by omega)
  have hreal : (448 : ℝ) * 2 ^ (N + w) ≤ 2 ^ (8 * 2 ^ N) := by exact_mod_cast hnat
  calc |salaminApprox N - π| ≤ 7 * 2 ^ N * (sA N - sB N) ^ 2 := h1
    _ ≤ 7 * 2 ^ N * (64 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (8 * 2 ^ N)) := by gcongr
    _ = 448 * 2 ^ N / 2 ^ (8 * 2 ^ N) := by rw [one_div_pow, one_div]; ring
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
        rw [one_div_pow, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity), one_mul, mul_assoc,
          ← pow_add]
        exact hreal

name: Azurite.BZ.one_le_piSteps
statement: theorem one_le_piSteps (w : ℕ) : 1 ≤ piSteps w
proof: := Nat.le_add_left 1 _

name: Azurite.BZ.piSteps_le
statement: theorem piSteps_le (w : ℕ) (hw : 1 ≤ w) : piSteps w ≤ w
proof:
:= by
  unfold piSteps
  have := Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow' (b := 2) (x := w) (y := w) (by omega) Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  omega

name: Azurite.BZ.piSteps_spec
statement: theorem piSteps_spec (w : ℕ) (hw : 1 ≤ w) : w + piSteps w + 9 ≤ 8 * 2 ^ piSteps w
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (b := 2) one_lt_two w
  have h2 := piSteps_le w hw
  unfold piSteps at *
  omega

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_salaminApprox_piSteps_sub_pi_le
statement:
theorem abs_salaminApprox_piSteps_sub_pi_le (w : ℕ) (hw : 1 ≤ w) :
    |salaminApprox (piSteps w) - π| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:=
  abs_salaminApprox_sub_pi_le_pow (one_le_piSteps w) (piSteps_spec w hw)

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_salaminApprox
statement: theorem tendsto_salaminApprox : Tendsto salaminApprox atTop (𝓝 π)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := tendsto_two_pow_mul_agm_gap one_pos salaminB0_pos
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun N => sA N - sB N) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have := tendsto_agm_gap one_pos salaminB0_pos
    rwa [← tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1]
  have h3 : Tendsto (fun N => 7 * (2 ^ N * (sA N - sB N)) * (sA N - sB N)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (h1.const_mul 7).mul h2
  rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  refine squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun N => norm_nonneg _) ?_ h3
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact (abs_salaminApprox_sub_pi_le hN).trans (le_of_eq (by ring))

name: Azurite.BZ.expIntegral_eq
statement: theorem expIntegral_eq (x : ℝ) : expIntegral x = ∫ u in Ioi x, exp (-u) / u
proof:
:= by
  simp [expIntegral, expTail]

name: Azurite.BZ.continuousOn_expTail_integrand
statement:
theorem continuousOn_expTail_integrand {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => exp (-u) / u ^ (k + 1)) (Ioi x)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_exp.comp continuous_neg).continuousOn.div (continuousOn_pow _)
    fun _ hu => pow_ne_zero _ (lt_trans hx hu).ne'

name: Azurite.BZ.integrableOn_expTail
statement:
theorem integrableOn_expTail {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => exp (-u) / u ^ (k + 1)) (Ioi x)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => exp (-u) * (x ^ (k + 1))⁻¹) (Ioi x) :=
    (integrableOn_exp_neg_Ioi x).mul_const _
  refine Integrable.mono' hg
    ((continuousOn_expTail_integrand hx k).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi) ?_
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu
  have hu0 : 0 < u := lt_trans hx hu
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity), div_eq_mul_inv]
  gcongr
  exact le_of_lt hu

name: Azurite.BZ.expTail_nonneg
statement: theorem expTail_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ expTail k x
proof:
:=
  setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Ioi fun u hu => by
    have : 0 < u := lt_trans hx hu
    positivity

name: Azurite.BZ.expTail_pos
statement: theorem expTail_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) : 0 < expTail k x
proof:
:= by
  unfold expTail
  rw [setIntegral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae]
  · refine lt_of_lt_of_le ENNReal.zero_lt_top ?_
    rw [← Real.volume_Ioi (a := x)]
    refine measure_mono fun u hu => ⟨?_, hu⟩
    have : 0 < u := lt_trans hx hu
    exact (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < exp (-u) / u ^ (k + 1)).ne'
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu
    have : 0 < u := lt_trans hx hu
    positivity
  · exact integrableOn_expTail hx k

name: Azurite.BZ.expTail_le
statement: theorem expTail_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) : expTail k x ≤ exp (-x) / x ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold expTail
  calc ∫ u in Ioi x, exp (-u) / u ^ (k + 1)
      ≤ ∫ u in Ioi x, exp (-u) * (x ^ (k + 1))⁻¹ := by
        refine setIntegral_mono_on (integrableOn_expTail hx k)
          ((integrableOn_exp_neg_Ioi x).mul_const _) measurableSet_Ioi fun u hu => ?_
        have hu0 : 0 < u := lt_trans hx hu
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
        gcongr
        exact le_of_lt hu
    _ = exp (-x) / x ^ (k + 1) := by
        rw [integral_mul_const, integral_exp_neg_Ioi, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Azurite.BZ.expTail_succ
statement:
theorem expTail_succ {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    expTail k x = exp (-x) / x ^ (k + 1) - (k + 1) * expTail (k + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  
  have hu : ∀ t ∈ Ioi x, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t ^ (k + 1))⁻¹)
      (-(((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t ^ (k + 1 - 1)) / (t ^ (k + 1)) ^ 2) t :=
    fun t ht => (hasDerivAt_pow (k + 1) t).inv (pow_ne_zero _ (lt_trans hx ht).ne')
  have hv : ∀ t ∈ Ioi x, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => -exp (-t)) (exp (-t)) t := by
    intro t _
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => -exp (-t)) (-(exp (-t) * -1)) t :=
      ((Real.hasDerivAt_exp (-t)).comp t (hasDerivAt_neg t)).neg
    exact h.congr_deriv (by ring)
  
  have huv' : IntegrableOn ((fun t : ℝ => (t ^ (k + 1))⁻¹) * fun t => exp (-t)) (Ioi x) :=
    (integrableOn_expTail hx k).congr_fun (fun t _ => by simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm])
      measurableSet_Ioi
  have hu'v : IntegrableOn
      ((fun t : ℝ => -(((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t ^ (k + 1 - 1)) / (t ^ (k + 1)) ^ 2)
        * fun t => -exp (-t)) (Ioi x) := by
    refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun ((integrableOn_expTail hx (k + 1)).const_mul ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
      (fun t ht => ?_) measurableSet_Ioi
    have ht0 : (t : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (lt_trans hx ht).ne'
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have h_zero : Tendsto ((fun t : ℝ => (t ^ (k + 1))⁻¹) * fun t => -exp (-t)) (𝓝[>] x)
      (𝓝 ((x ^ (k + 1))⁻¹ * -exp (-x))) := by
    apply Tendsto.mono_left _ nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    exact (((continuous_pow (k + 1)).continuousAt.inv₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hx.ne')).mul
      ((continuous_exp.comp continuous_neg).continuousAt.neg))
  have h_infty : Tendsto ((fun t : ℝ => (t ^ (k + 1))⁻¹) * fun t => -exp (-t)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
    have hg : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => exp (-t) * (x ^ (k + 1))⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero.mul_const ((x ^ (k + 1))⁻¹)
    refine squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun t => norm_nonneg _) ?_ hg
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop x] with t ht
    have ht0 : 0 < t := lt_trans hx ht
    rw [Pi.mul_apply, norm_mul, norm_neg, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (t ^ (k + 1))⁻¹), abs_of_pos (exp_pos _), mul_comm]
    gcongr
  have key := integral_Ioi_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul hu hv huv' hu'v h_zero h_infty
  
  have hL : ∫ t in Ioi x, (t ^ (k + 1))⁻¹ * exp (-t) = expTail k x := by
    unfold expTail
    exact setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun t _ => by rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  have hR : ∫ t in Ioi x, -(((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t ^ (k + 1 - 1)) / (t ^ (k + 1)) ^ 2 * -exp (-t)
      = (k + 1) * expTail (k + 1) x := by
    unfold expTail
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun t ht => ?_
    have ht0 : (t : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (lt_trans hx ht).ne'
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hL, hR] at key
  rw [key]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.asymptoticRemainder_succ
statement:
theorem asymptoticRemainder_succ {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    asymptoticRemainder k x = asymptoticTerm k x + asymptoticRemainder (k + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold asymptoticRemainder asymptoticTerm
  rw [expTail_succ hx k, Nat.factorial_succ, pow_succ]
  push_cast
  have : exp x * exp (-x) = 1 := by rw [← exp_add]; simp
  linear_combination ((k.factorial : ℝ) * (-1) ^ k / x ^ (k + 1)) * this

name: Azurite.BZ.exp_mul_expIntegral_eq
statement:
theorem exp_mul_expIntegral_eq {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    exp x * expIntegral x = ∑ j ∈ range k, asymptoticTerm j x + asymptoticRemainder k x
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [asymptoticRemainder, expIntegral]
  | succ k ih => rw [sum_range_succ, ih, asymptoticRemainder_succ hx k]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_asymptoticRemainder_le
statement:
theorem abs_asymptoticRemainder_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    |asymptoticRemainder k x| ≤ k.factorial / x ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold asymptoticRemainder
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, mul_one,
    abs_of_pos (exp_pos x), abs_of_nonneg (expTail_nonneg hx k),
    abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < k.factorial)]
  calc (k.factorial : ℝ) * exp x * expTail k x
      ≤ k.factorial * exp x * (exp (-x) / x ^ (k + 1)) := by gcongr; exact expTail_le hx k
    _ = k.factorial / x ^ (k + 1) := by
        have : exp x * exp (-x) = 1 := by rw [← exp_add]; simp
        rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_div_assoc, this, mul_one_div]

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_asymptoticRemainder_le_abs_term
statement:
theorem abs_asymptoticRemainder_le_abs_term {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    |asymptoticRemainder k x| ≤ |asymptoticTerm k x|
proof:
:= by
  rw [asymptoticTerm, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, mul_one,
    abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < k.factorial), abs_of_pos (pow_pos hx (k + 1))]
  exact abs_asymptoticRemainder_le hx k

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_asymptoticRemainder_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_asymptoticRemainder_atTop (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (asymptoticRemainder k) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
  have hg : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (k.factorial : ℝ) * (x ^ (k + 1))⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using
      ((tendsto_pow_atTop (by omega : k + 1 ≠ 0)).inv_tendsto_atTop).const_mul (k.factorial : ℝ)
  refine squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun x => norm_nonneg _) ?_ hg
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hx
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact abs_asymptoticRemainder_le hx k

name: Azurite.BZ.not_summable_asymptoticTerm
statement:
theorem not_summable_asymptoticTerm {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ¬ Summable (fun j => asymptoticTerm j x)
proof:
:= by
  have habs : ∀ j, ‖asymptoticTerm j x‖ = j.factorial / x ^ (j + 1) := fun j => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, asymptoticTerm, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow,
      mul_one, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < j.factorial), abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
  refine not_summable_of_ratio_norm_eventually_ge (r := 2) (by norm_num)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun j => by rw [habs]; positivity).frequently ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop ⌈2 * x⌉₊] with j hj
  rw [habs, habs, Nat.factorial_succ]
  push_cast
  have h2x : 2 * x ≤ j := (Nat.le_ceil _).trans (by exact_mod_cast hj)
  rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity), pow_succ x (j + 1)]
  have hf : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j.factorial * x ^ (j + 1) := by positivity
  nlinarith [hf]

name: Azurite.BZ.sign_asymptoticRemainder
statement:
theorem sign_asymptoticRemainder {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < (-1) ^ k * asymptoticRemainder k x
proof:
:= by
  unfold asymptoticRemainder
  have : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ k) * ((-1) ^ k) = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow]; simp
  have hpos : 0 < (k.factorial : ℝ) * exp x * expTail k x := by
    have := expTail_pos hx k; positivity
  calc (0 : ℝ) < (k.factorial : ℝ) * exp x * expTail k x := hpos
    _ = (-1) ^ k * (k.factorial * (-1) ^ k * exp x * expTail k x) := by
        linear_combination (-(k.factorial : ℝ) * exp x * expTail k x) * this

name: Azurite.BZ.between_partialSums
statement:
theorem between_partialSums {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (k : ℕ) :
    (exp x * expIntegral x - ∑ j ∈ range k, asymptoticTerm j x)
      * (exp x * expIntegral x - ∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), asymptoticTerm j x) < 0
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := exp_mul_expIntegral_eq hx k
  have e2 := exp_mul_expIntegral_eq hx (k + 1)
  have h1 : exp x * expIntegral x - ∑ j ∈ range k, asymptoticTerm j x
      = asymptoticRemainder k x := by linarith
  have h2 : exp x * expIntegral x - ∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), asymptoticTerm j x
      = asymptoticRemainder (k + 1) x := by linarith
  rw [h1, h2]
  have s1 := sign_asymptoticRemainder hx k
  have s2 := sign_asymptoticRemainder hx (k + 1)
  rw [pow_succ] at s2
  have hsq : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul]; simp
  nlinarith [mul_pos s1 s2, hsq]

name: Azurite.BZ.factorial_le_stirling_upper
statement:
theorem factorial_le_stirling_upper {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (k.factorial : ℝ) ≤ exp 1 * Real.sqrt k * (k / exp 1) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hanti := Stirling.stirlingSeq'_antitone (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hk 1)
  simp only [Function.comp, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.zero_add,
    Nat.sub_self] at hanti
  rw [Stirling.stirlingSeq_one, Stirling.stirlingSeq] at hanti
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hden : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * k : ℝ) * (k / exp 1) ^ k := by positivity
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hden] at hanti
  calc (k.factorial : ℝ) ≤ exp 1 / Real.sqrt 2 * (Real.sqrt (2 * k : ℝ) * (k / exp 1) ^ k) := hanti
    _ = exp 1 * Real.sqrt k * (k / exp 1) ^ k := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num) (k : ℝ)]
        have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_asymptoticRemainder_self_le
statement:
theorem abs_asymptoticRemainder_self_le {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    |asymptoticRemainder k k| ≤ exp 1 * exp (-(k : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt k
proof:
:= by
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  refine (abs_asymptoticRemainder_le hk0 k).trans ?_
  have hs := factorial_le_stirling_upper hk
  have hsk : 0 < Real.sqrt (k : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hk0
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hsk]
  have hpow : ((k : ℝ) / exp 1) ^ k = (k : ℝ) ^ k * exp (-(k : ℝ)) := by
    rw [div_pow, ← Real.exp_nat_mul, mul_one, exp_neg, div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (k : ℝ) = k := Real.mul_self_sqrt hk0.le
  calc (k.factorial : ℝ) * Real.sqrt k ≤ exp 1 * Real.sqrt k * (k / exp 1) ^ k * Real.sqrt k :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs hsk.le
    _ = exp 1 * exp (-(k : ℝ)) * (k : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
        rw [hpow, pow_succ]
        linear_combination (exp 1 * exp (-(k : ℝ)) * (k : ℝ) ^ k) * hsq

name: Azurite.BZ.exists_uIoo_ratio_eq
statement:
theorem exists_uIoo_ratio_eq {g g' h h' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hg : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt g (g' t) t) (hh : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt h (h' t) t) :
    ∃ c ∈ uIoo a b, (h b - h a) * g' c = (g b - g a) * h' c
proof:
:= by
  have hgc : ContinuousOn g (uIcc a b) := fun t ht => (hg t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hhc : ContinuousOn h (uIcc a b) := fun t ht => (hh t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hg' : ∀ t ∈ uIoo a b, HasDerivAt g (g' t) t := fun t ht => hg t (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)
  have hh' : ∀ t ∈ uIoo a b, HasDerivAt h (h' t) t := fun t ht => hh t (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with hlt | hlt
  · have hI : uIcc a b = Icc a b := uIcc_of_le hlt.le
    have hO : uIoo a b = Ioo a b := by
      rw [uIoo, inf_eq_left.mpr hlt.le, sup_eq_right.mpr hlt.le]
    rw [hI] at hgc hhc
    rw [hO] at hg' hh' ⊢
    exact exists_ratio_hasDerivAt_eq_ratio_slope g g' hlt hgc hg' h h' hhc hh'
  · have hI : uIcc a b = Icc b a := uIcc_of_ge hlt.le
    have hO : uIoo a b = Ioo b a := by
      rw [uIoo, inf_eq_right.mpr hlt.le, sup_eq_left.mpr hlt.le]
    rw [hI] at hgc hhc
    rw [hO] at hg' hh' ⊢
    obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := exists_ratio_hasDerivAt_eq_ratio_slope g g' hlt hgc hg' h h' hhc hh'
    exact ⟨c, hc, by linear_combination -h⟩

name: Azurite.BZ.taylor_one
statement:
theorem taylor_one {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ uIoo a b, f b = f a + (b - a) * f' ξ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := exists_uIoo_ratio_eq hab hf (h := id) (h' := fun _ => 1)
    (fun t _ => hasDerivAt_id t)
  exact ⟨c, hc, by simp only [id] at h; linear_combination -h⟩

name: Azurite.BZ.taylor_two
statement:
theorem taylor_two {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ uIoo a b, f b = f a + (b - a) * f' a + (b - a) ^ 2 / 2 * f'' ξ
proof:
:= by
  
  have hg : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b,
      HasDerivAt (fun t => f b - f t - (b - t) * f' t) (-((b - t) * f'' t)) t := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t => f b - f t - (b - t) * f' t)
        (0 - f' t - (-1 * f' t + (b - t) * f'' t)) t :=
      ((hasDerivAt_const t (f b)).sub (hf t ht)).sub
        (((hasDerivAt_id t).const_sub b).mul (hf' t ht))
    exact h1.congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hh : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt (fun t => (b - t) ^ 2) (-(2 * (b - t))) t := by
    intro t _
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t => (b - t) ^ 2) (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (b - t) ^ (2 - 1) * -1) t :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_sub b).pow 2
    exact h1.congr_deriv (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := exists_uIoo_ratio_eq hab hg hh
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  have hbc : b - c ≠ 0 := by
    rcases hc with ⟨h1, h2⟩
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with hlt | hlt
    · rw [sup_eq_right.mpr hlt.le] at h2; exact (sub_pos.mpr h2).ne'
    · rw [inf_eq_right.mpr hlt.le] at h1; exact (sub_neg.mpr h1).ne
  simp only [sub_self, zero_pow two_ne_zero, zero_sub] at h
  have h2 : (b - c) * (f b - f a - (b - a) * f' a - (b - a) ^ 2 / 2 * f'' c) = 0 := by
    linear_combination -h / 2
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h3 | h3
  · exact absurd h3 hbc
  · linear_combination h3

name: Azurite.BZ.taylor_three
statement:
theorem taylor_three {f f' f'' f''' : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t)
    (hf'' : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f'' (f''' t) t) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ uIoo a b,
      f b = f a + (b - a) * f' a + (b - a) ^ 2 / 2 * f'' a + (b - a) ^ 3 / 6 * f''' ξ
proof:
:= by
  have hg : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b,
      HasDerivAt (fun t => f b - f t - (b - t) * f' t - (b - t) ^ 2 / 2 * f'' t)
        (-((b - t) ^ 2 / 2 * f''' t)) t := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t => f b - f t - (b - t) * f' t - (b - t) ^ 2 / 2 * f'' t)
        (0 - f' t - (-1 * f' t + (b - t) * f'' t)
          - (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (b - t) ^ (2 - 1) * -1 / 2 * f'' t + (b - t) ^ 2 / 2 * f''' t)) t :=
      (((hasDerivAt_const t (f b)).sub (hf t ht)).sub
        (((hasDerivAt_id t).const_sub b).mul (hf' t ht))).sub
        ((((hasDerivAt_id t).const_sub b).pow 2).div_const 2 |>.mul (hf'' t ht))
    exact h1.congr_deriv (by norm_num; ring)
  have hh : ∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, HasDerivAt (fun t => (b - t) ^ 3) (-(3 * (b - t) ^ 2)) t := by
    intro t _
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t => (b - t) ^ 3) (((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (b - t) ^ (3 - 1) * -1) t :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_sub b).pow 3
    exact h1.congr_deriv (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := exists_uIoo_ratio_eq hab hg hh
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  have hbc : b - c ≠ 0 := by
    rcases hc with ⟨h1, h2⟩
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with hlt | hlt
    · rw [sup_eq_right.mpr hlt.le] at h2; exact (sub_pos.mpr h2).ne'
    · rw [inf_eq_right.mpr hlt.le] at h1; exact (sub_neg.mpr h1).ne
  simp only [sub_self, zero_pow two_ne_zero, zero_pow three_ne_zero, zero_mul, zero_sub,
    zero_div] at h
  have h2 : (b - c) ^ 2 * (f b - f a - (b - a) * f' a - (b - a) ^ 2 / 2 * f'' a
      - (b - a) ^ 3 / 6 * f''' c) = 0 := by
    linear_combination -h / 3
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h3 | h3
  · exact absurd (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp h3) hbc
  · linear_combination h3

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonSeq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem newtonSeq_zero (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ) : newtonSeq f f' x₀ 0 = x₀
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonSeq_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem newtonSeq_succ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    newtonSeq f f' x₀ (n + 1) = newtonStep f f' (newtonSeq f f' x₀ n)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonStep_root
statement: theorem newtonStep_root {f f' : ℝ → ℝ} {ζ : ℝ} (hζ : f ζ = 0) : newtonStep f f' ζ = ζ
proof:
:= by
  simp [newtonStep, hζ]

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonStep_sub_root
statement:
theorem newtonStep_sub_root {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} {x₀ ζ : ℝ} (hne : x₀ ≠ ζ) (hζ : f ζ = 0)
    (hd : f' x₀ ≠ 0) (hf : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ uIoo x₀ ζ, newtonStep f f' x₀ - ζ = (x₀ - ζ) ^ 2 * f'' ξ / (2 * f' x₀)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, h⟩ := taylor_two hne hf hf'
  refine ⟨ξ, hξ, ?_⟩
  rw [hζ] at h
  have hfx : f x₀ = -(ζ - x₀) * f' x₀ - (ζ - x₀) ^ 2 / 2 * f'' ξ := by linear_combination -h
  unfold newtonStep
  rw [hfx]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_newtonStep_sub_root_le
statement:
theorem abs_newtonStep_sub_root_le {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} {ζ r M m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hζ : f ζ = 0)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), |f'' t| ≤ M)
    (hm' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), m ≤ |f' t|) {x₀ : ℝ} (hx₀ : |x₀ - ζ| ≤ r) :
    |newtonStep f f' x₀ - ζ| ≤ M / (2 * m) * (x₀ - ζ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hx₀I : x₀ ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r) := by
    rw [abs_le] at hx₀; constructor <;> linarith [hx₀.1, hx₀.2]
  have hζI : ζ ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r) := by
    have : 0 ≤ r := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hx₀
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hM ζ hζI)
  by_cases hne : x₀ = ζ
  · subst hne
    rw [newtonStep_root hζ, sub_self, abs_zero]
    positivity
  have hsub : uIcc x₀ ζ ⊆ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r) := uIcc_subset_Icc hx₀I hζI
  have hd : f' x₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; have := hm' x₀ hx₀I; rw [h, abs_zero] at this; exact absurd this (not_le.mpr hm)
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, h⟩ := newtonStep_sub_root hne hζ hd (fun t ht => hf t (hsub ht))
    (fun t ht => hf' t (hsub ht))
  have hξI : ξ ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r) := hsub (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hξ)
  rw [h, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), abs_pow, sq_abs]
  have hfx : m ≤ |f' x₀| := hm' x₀ hx₀I
  have hfpos : 0 < |f' x₀| := lt_of_lt_of_le hm hfx
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  calc (x₀ - ζ) ^ 2 * |f'' ξ| ≤ (x₀ - ζ) ^ 2 * M :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM ξ hξI) (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = M / (2 * m) * (x₀ - ζ) ^ 2 * (2 * m) := by field_simp
    _ ≤ M / (2 * m) * (x₀ - ζ) ^ 2 * (2 * |f' x₀|) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        linarith

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonSeq_bounds
statement:
theorem newtonSeq_bounds {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} {ζ r M m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hζ : f ζ = 0)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), |f'' t| ≤ M)
    (hm' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), m ≤ |f' t|) {x₀ : ℝ} (hx₀ : |x₀ - ζ| ≤ r)
    (hK : M / (2 * m) * |x₀ - ζ| ≤ 1 / 2) (n : ℕ) :
    |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ| ≤ r ∧
      |newtonSeq f f' x₀ (n + 1) - ζ| ≤ |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ| / 2 ∧
      M / (2 * m) * |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ| ≤ (M / (2 * m) * |x₀ - ζ|) ^ (2 ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  set K := M / (2 * m) with hKdef
  have hζI : ζ ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r) := by
    have : 0 ≤ r := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hx₀
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := by
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hM ζ hζI)
    positivity
  
  have step : ∀ x, |x - ζ| ≤ r → |newtonStep f f' x - ζ| ≤ K * |x - ζ| ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx
    have := abs_newtonStep_sub_root_le hm hζ hf hf' hM hm' hx
    rwa [← sq_abs] at this
  
  have half : ∀ x, |x - ζ| ≤ r → K * |x - ζ| ≤ 1 / 2 →
      |newtonStep f f' x - ζ| ≤ |x - ζ| / 2 := by
    intro x hx hKx
    calc |newtonStep f f' x - ζ| ≤ K * |x - ζ| ^ 2 := step x hx
      _ = (K * |x - ζ|) * |x - ζ| := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 / 2 * |x - ζ| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hKx (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = |x - ζ| / 2 := by ring
  
  have inv : ∀ n, |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ| ≤ r ∧
      K * |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ| ≤ (K * |x₀ - ζ|) ^ (2 ^ n) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact ⟨hx₀, by simp⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih
      have hpow : (K * |x₀ - ζ|) ^ (2 ^ n) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        calc (K * |x₀ - ζ|) ^ (2 ^ n) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ n) :=
              pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hK _
          _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 1 :=
              pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) Nat.one_le_two_pow
          _ = 1 / 2 := pow_one _
      have hKn : K * |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ| ≤ 1 / 2 := h2.trans hpow
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [newtonSeq_succ]
        calc |newtonStep f f' (newtonSeq f f' x₀ n) - ζ| ≤ |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ| / 2 :=
              half _ h1 hKn
          _ ≤ r := by linarith [abs_nonneg (newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ)]
      · rw [newtonSeq_succ, pow_succ, pow_mul]
        calc K * |newtonStep f f' (newtonSeq f f' x₀ n) - ζ|
            ≤ K * (K * |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ| ^ 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (step _ h1) hK0
          _ = (K * |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ|) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ ≤ ((K * |x₀ - ζ|) ^ (2 ^ n)) ^ 2 :=
              pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h2 2
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := inv n
  refine ⟨h1, ?_, h2⟩
  have hpow : (K * |x₀ - ζ|) ^ (2 ^ n) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    calc (K * |x₀ - ζ|) ^ (2 ^ n) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ n) :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hK _
      _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 1 :=
          pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) Nat.one_le_two_pow
      _ = 1 / 2 := pow_one _
  rw [newtonSeq_succ]
  exact half _ h1 (h2.trans hpow)

name: Azurite.BZ.abs_newtonSeq_sub_root_le
statement:
theorem abs_newtonSeq_sub_root_le {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} {ζ r M m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hζ : f ζ = 0)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), |f'' t| ≤ M)
    (hm' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), m ≤ |f' t|) {x₀ : ℝ} (hx₀ : |x₀ - ζ| ≤ r)
    (hK : M / (2 * m) * |x₀ - ζ| ≤ 1 / 2) (n : ℕ) :
    |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ| ≤ |x₀ - ζ| / 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := (newtonSeq_bounds hm hζ hf hf' hM hm' hx₀ hK n).2.1
    calc |newtonSeq f f' x₀ (n + 1) - ζ| ≤ |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - ζ| / 2 := h
      _ ≤ |x₀ - ζ| / 2 ^ n / 2 := by gcongr
      _ = |x₀ - ζ| / 2 ^ (n + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_newtonSeq
statement:
theorem tendsto_newtonSeq {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} {ζ r M m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hζ : f ζ = 0)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t)
    (hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), |f'' t| ≤ M)
    (hm' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), m ≤ |f' t|) {x₀ : ℝ} (hx₀ : |x₀ - ζ| ≤ r)
    (hK : M / (2 * m) * |x₀ - ζ| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Tendsto (newtonSeq f f' x₀) atTop (𝓝 ζ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => |x₀ - ζ| * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
      (by norm_num)).const_mul |x₀ - ζ|
  refine squeeze_zero (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => ?_) hlim
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, one_div, inv_pow, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact abs_newtonSeq_sub_root_le hm hζ hf hf' hM hm' hx₀ hK n

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonStep_sub_root_cubic
statement:
theorem newtonStep_sub_root_cubic {f f' f'' f''' : ℝ → ℝ} {x₀ ζ M₂ M₃ m : ℝ} (hne : x₀ ≠ ζ)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hζ : f ζ = 0)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t)
    (hf'' : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, HasDerivAt f'' (f''' t) t)
    (hM₂ : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, |f'' t| ≤ M₂) (hM₃ : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, |f''' t| ≤ M₃)
    (hm' : ∀ t ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ, m ≤ |f' t|) :
    |newtonStep f f' x₀ - ζ - f'' ζ / (2 * f' ζ) * (x₀ - ζ) ^ 2|
      ≤ (7 * M₃ / (6 * m) + M₂ ^ 2 / (2 * m ^ 2)) * |x₀ - ζ| ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hx₀I : x₀ ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ := left_mem_uIcc
  have hζI : ζ ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ := right_mem_uIcc
  have hd : f' x₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; have := hm' x₀ hx₀I; rw [h, abs_zero] at this; exact absurd this (not_le.mpr hm)
  have hdζ : f' ζ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; have := hm' ζ hζI; rw [h, abs_zero] at this; exact absurd this (not_le.mpr hm)
  
  have hsymm : uIcc ζ x₀ = uIcc x₀ ζ := uIcc_comm ζ x₀
  obtain ⟨ξ₁, hξ₁, h1⟩ := taylor_three hne.symm (fun t ht => hf t (hsymm ▸ ht))
    (fun t ht => hf' t (hsymm ▸ ht)) (fun t ht => hf'' t (hsymm ▸ ht))
  rw [hζ, zero_add] at h1
  have hξ₁I : ξ₁ ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ := by rw [← hsymm]; exact Ioo_subset_Icc_self hξ₁
  
  obtain ⟨ξ₂, hξ₂, h2⟩ := taylor_one hne.symm (fun t ht => hf' t (hsymm ▸ ht))
  have hξ₂I : ξ₂ ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ := by rw [← hsymm]; exact Ioo_subset_Icc_self hξ₂
  
  have hξ₂ne : ζ ≠ ξ₂ := by
    rcases hξ₂ with ⟨hl, hr⟩
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
    · rw [sup_eq_left.mpr hlt.le] at hr; exact hr.ne'
    · rw [inf_eq_left.mpr hlt.le] at hl; exact hl.ne
  have hsub : uIcc ζ ξ₂ ⊆ uIcc x₀ ζ := by
    rw [← hsymm]; exact uIcc_subset_uIcc left_mem_uIcc (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hξ₂)
  obtain ⟨ξ₃, hξ₃, h3⟩ := taylor_one hξ₂ne (fun t ht => hf'' t (hsub ht))
  have hξ₃I : ξ₃ ∈ uIcc x₀ ζ := hsub (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hξ₃)
  
  have hξ₂e : |ξ₂ - ζ| ≤ |x₀ - ζ| := by
    rcases hξ₂ with ⟨hl, hr⟩
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
    · rw [inf_eq_right.mpr hlt.le] at hl; rw [sup_eq_left.mpr hlt.le] at hr
      rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith), abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith
    · rw [inf_eq_left.mpr hlt.le] at hl; rw [sup_eq_right.mpr hlt.le] at hr
      rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith), abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
  
  have hid : newtonStep f f' x₀ - ζ - f'' ζ / (2 * f' ζ) * (x₀ - ζ) ^ 2
      = (x₀ - ζ) ^ 2 * (((ξ₂ - ζ) * f''' ξ₃ - (x₀ - ζ) * f''' ξ₁ / 6) / f' x₀
          - f'' ζ / 2 * (x₀ - ζ) * f'' ξ₂ / (f' x₀ * f' ζ)) := by
    unfold newtonStep
    have h2' : f' x₀ = f' ζ + (x₀ - ζ) * f'' ξ₂ := h2
    have h3' : f'' ξ₂ = f'' ζ + (ξ₂ - ζ) * f''' ξ₃ := h3
    generalize hA : f x₀ = A at h1 ⊢
    generalize hB : f' x₀ = B at h2' hd ⊢
    generalize hC : f'' ξ₂ = C at h3' h2' ⊢
    subst h1 h2' h3'
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hfx : m ≤ |f' x₀| := hm' x₀ hx₀I
  have hfζ : m ≤ |f' ζ| := hm' ζ hζI
  have hA : |((ξ₂ - ζ) * f''' ξ₃ - (x₀ - ζ) * f''' ξ₁ / 6) / f' x₀|
      ≤ 7 * M₃ / (6 * m) * |x₀ - ζ| := by
    rw [abs_div, div_le_iff₀ (lt_of_lt_of_le hm hfx)]
    have hM₃0 : 0 ≤ M₃ := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hM₃ ξ₁ hξ₁I)
    calc |(ξ₂ - ζ) * f''' ξ₃ - (x₀ - ζ) * f''' ξ₁ / 6|
        ≤ |(ξ₂ - ζ) * f''' ξ₃| + |(x₀ - ζ) * f''' ξ₁ / 6| := abs_sub _ _
      _ = |ξ₂ - ζ| * |f''' ξ₃| + |x₀ - ζ| * |f''' ξ₁| / 6 := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 6)]
      _ ≤ |x₀ - ζ| * M₃ + |x₀ - ζ| * M₃ / 6 := by
          gcongr
          · exact hM₃ ξ₃ hξ₃I
          · exact hM₃ ξ₁ hξ₁I
      _ = 7 * M₃ / (6 * m) * |x₀ - ζ| * m := by field_simp; ring
      _ ≤ 7 * M₃ / (6 * m) * |x₀ - ζ| * |f' x₀| := by gcongr
  have hB : |f'' ζ / 2 * (x₀ - ζ) * f'' ξ₂ / (f' x₀ * f' ζ)|
      ≤ M₂ ^ 2 / (2 * m ^ 2) * |x₀ - ζ| := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2),
      div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have hM₂0 : 0 ≤ M₂ := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hM₂ ζ hζI)
    calc |f'' ζ| / 2 * |x₀ - ζ| * |f'' ξ₂| ≤ M₂ / 2 * |x₀ - ζ| * M₂ := by
          gcongr
          · exact hM₂ ζ hζI
          · exact hM₂ ξ₂ hξ₂I
      _ = M₂ ^ 2 / (2 * m ^ 2) * |x₀ - ζ| * (m * m) := by field_simp
      _ ≤ M₂ ^ 2 / (2 * m ^ 2) * |x₀ - ζ| * (|f' x₀| * |f' ζ|) := by gcongr
  rw [hid, abs_mul, abs_pow]
  calc |x₀ - ζ| ^ 2 * |((ξ₂ - ζ) * f''' ξ₃ - (x₀ - ζ) * f''' ξ₁ / 6) / f' x₀
          - f'' ζ / 2 * (x₀ - ζ) * f'' ξ₂ / (f' x₀ * f' ζ)|
      ≤ |x₀ - ζ| ^ 2 * (|((ξ₂ - ζ) * f''' ξ₃ - (x₀ - ζ) * f''' ξ₁ / 6) / f' x₀|
          + |f'' ζ / 2 * (x₀ - ζ) * f'' ξ₂ / (f' x₀ * f' ζ)|) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_sub _ _) (by positivity)
    _ ≤ |x₀ - ζ| ^ 2 * (7 * M₃ / (6 * m) * |x₀ - ζ| + M₂ ^ 2 / (2 * m ^ 2) * |x₀ - ζ|) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hA hB) (by positivity)
    _ = (7 * M₃ / (6 * m) + M₂ ^ 2 / (2 * m ^ 2)) * |x₀ - ζ| ^ 3 := by ring

name: Azurite.BZ.RationalRatio.ratio'
statement: theorem ratio' (h : RationalRatio a δ) (j : ℕ) : a (j + δ) = h.R j * a j
proof: := h.ratio j

name: Azurite.BZ.RationalRatio.eq_mul_prod
statement:
theorem eq_mul_prod (h : RationalRatio a δ) (r k : ℕ) :
    a (δ * k + r) = a r * ∏ i ∈ range k, h.R (δ * i + r)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [prod_range_succ, show δ * (k + 1) + r = (δ * k + r) + δ by ring, h.ratio', ih]
    ring

name: Azurite.BZ.RationalRatio.eq_mul_prod_one
statement:
theorem eq_mul_prod_one (h : RationalRatio a 1) (j : ℕ) :
    a j = a 0 * ∏ i ∈ range j, h.R i
proof:
:= by
  have := h.eq_mul_prod 0 j
  simpa using this

name: Azurite.BZ.RationalRatio.tendsto_zero_of_degree_lt
statement:
theorem tendsto_zero_of_degree_lt (h : RationalRatio a δ) (hdeg : h.num.degree < h.den.degree) :
    Tendsto h.R atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:=
  (div_tendsto_atTop_zero_of_degree_lt h.num h.den hdeg).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop

name: Azurite.BZ.RationalRatio.tendsto_leadingCoeff_div_of_degree_eq
statement:
theorem tendsto_leadingCoeff_div_of_degree_eq (h : RationalRatio a δ)
    (hdeg : h.num.degree = h.den.degree) :
    Tendsto h.R atTop (𝓝 (h.num.leadingCoeff / h.den.leadingCoeff))
proof:
:=
  (div_tendsto_atTop_leadingCoeff_div_of_degree_eq h.num h.den hdeg).comp
    tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop

name: Azurite.BZ.RationalRatio.tendsto_ratio_of_degree_eq
statement:
theorem RationalRatio.tendsto_ratio_of_degree_eq {a : ℕ → ℝ} (h : RationalRatio a 1)
    (ha : ∀ j, a j ≠ 0) (hdeg : h.num.degree = h.den.degree) :
    Tendsto (fun j => a (j + 1) / a j) atTop (𝓝 (h.num.leadingCoeff / h.den.leadingCoeff))
proof:
:= by
  refine (h.tendsto_leadingCoeff_div_of_degree_eq hdeg).congr fun j => ?_
  rw [h.ratio', mul_div_assoc, div_self (ha j), mul_one]

name: Azurite.BZ.norm_term_ratio_eq
statement:
theorem norm_term_ratio_eq {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : ∀ j, a j ≠ 0) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    (fun j => ‖a (j + 1) * x ^ (j + 1)‖ / ‖a j * x ^ j‖) = fun j => |x| * |a (j + 1) / a j|
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_pow, pow_succ, abs_div]
  have := pow_ne_zero j (abs_ne_zero.mpr hx)
  have := abs_ne_zero.mpr (ha j)
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_of_ratio_tendsto
