statement:
theorem summable_of_ratio_tendsto {a : ℕ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (ha : ∀ j, a j ≠ 0)
    (hL : Tendsto (fun j => a (j + 1) / a j) atTop (𝓝 L)) {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| * |L| < 1) :
    Summable (fun j => a j * x ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · subst hx0
    exact summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := {0}) fun j hj => by
      simp only [mem_singleton] at hj
      rw [zero_pow hj, mul_zero]
  refine summable_of_ratio_test_tendsto_lt_one (l := |x| * |L|) hx
    (Eventually.of_forall fun j => mul_ne_zero (ha j) (pow_ne_zero _ hx0)) ?_
  rw [norm_term_ratio_eq ha hx0]
  exact hL.abs.const_mul |x|

name: Azurite.BZ.not_summable_of_ratio_tendsto
statement:
theorem not_summable_of_ratio_tendsto {a : ℕ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (ha : ∀ j, a j ≠ 0)
    (hL : Tendsto (fun j => a (j + 1) / a j) atTop (𝓝 L)) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < |x| * |L|) :
    ¬ Summable (fun j => a j * x ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; norm_num at hx
  refine not_summable_of_ratio_test_tendsto_gt_one (l := |x| * |L|) hx ?_
  rw [norm_term_ratio_eq ha hx0]
  exact hL.abs.const_mul |x|

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_of_ratio_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem summable_of_ratio_tendsto_zero {a : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : ∀ j, a j ≠ 0)
    (hL : Tendsto (fun j => a (j + 1) / a j) atTop (𝓝 0)) (x : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun j => a j * x ^ j)
proof:
:=
  summable_of_ratio_tendsto ha hL (by simp)

name: Azurite.BZ.logCoeff_ne_zero
statement: theorem logCoeff_ne_zero (j : ℕ) : logCoeff j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold logCoeff
  have : ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  exact div_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)) this

name: Azurite.BZ.tendsto_logCoeff_ratio
statement:
theorem tendsto_logCoeff_ratio :
    Tendsto (fun j => logCoeff (j + 1) / logCoeff j) atTop (𝓝 (-1))
proof:
:= by
  have hn : logRatio.num = -(X + C 1) := rfl
  have hd : logRatio.den = X + C 2 := rfl
  have h := logRatio.tendsto_ratio_of_degree_eq logCoeff_ne_zero (by
    rw [hn, hd, degree_neg, degree_X_add_C, degree_X_add_C])
  have hlc : (-(X + C 1) : ℝ[X]).leadingCoeff / (X + C 2 : ℝ[X]).leadingCoeff = (-1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [leadingCoeff_neg, leadingCoeff_X_add_C, leadingCoeff_X_add_C]; norm_num
  rw [hn, hd, hlc] at h
  exact h

name: Azurite.BZ.summable_logCoeff_of_abs_lt_one
statement:
theorem summable_logCoeff_of_abs_lt_one {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 1) :
    Summable (fun j => logCoeff j * x ^ j)
proof:
:=
  summable_of_ratio_tendsto logCoeff_ne_zero tendsto_logCoeff_ratio (by simpa using hx)

name: Azurite.BZ.not_summable_logCoeff_of_one_lt_abs
statement:
theorem not_summable_logCoeff_of_one_lt_abs {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < |x|) :
    ¬ Summable (fun j => logCoeff j * x ^ j)
proof:
:=
  not_summable_of_ratio_tendsto logCoeff_ne_zero tendsto_logCoeff_ratio (by simpa using hx)

name: Azurite.BZ.not_summable_logCoeff_neg_one
statement: theorem not_summable_logCoeff_neg_one : ¬ Summable (fun j => logCoeff j * (-1) ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun j => logCoeff j * (-1 : ℝ) ^ j) = fun j : ℕ => 1 / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    funext j
    unfold logCoeff
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul]
    push_cast
    norm_num
  rw [hfun]
  intro h
  exact Real.not_summable_one_div_natCast ((summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp h)

name: Azurite.BZ.arctanCompressedCoeff_ne_zero
statement: theorem arctanCompressedCoeff_ne_zero (k : ℕ) : arctanCompressedCoeff k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold arctanCompressedCoeff
  exact div_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)) (by positivity)

name: Azurite.BZ.not_summable_arctanCompressedCoeff_of_one_lt_abs
statement:
theorem not_summable_arctanCompressedCoeff_of_one_lt_abs {y : ℝ} (hy : 1 < |y|) :
    ¬ Summable (fun k => arctanCompressedCoeff k * y ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : arctanCompressedRatio.num = -(X + C (1 / 2)) := rfl
  have hd : arctanCompressedRatio.den = X + C (3 / 2) := rfl
  have h := arctanCompressedRatio.tendsto_ratio_of_degree_eq arctanCompressedCoeff_ne_zero (by
    rw [hn, hd, degree_neg, degree_X_add_C, degree_X_add_C])
  have hlc : (-(X + C (1 / 2)) : ℝ[X]).leadingCoeff / (X + C (3 / 2) : ℝ[X]).leadingCoeff
      = (-1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [leadingCoeff_neg, leadingCoeff_X_add_C, leadingCoeff_X_add_C]; norm_num
  rw [hn, hd, hlc] at h
  exact not_summable_of_ratio_tendsto arctanCompressedCoeff_ne_zero h (by simpa using hy)

name: Azurite.BZ.ringReciprocalSeq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem ringReciprocalSeq_zero (y x₀ : α) : ringReciprocalSeq y x₀ 0 = x₀
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.ringReciprocalSeq_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem ringReciprocalSeq_succ (y x₀ : α) (n : ℕ) :
    ringReciprocalSeq y x₀ (n + 1) = ringReciprocalStep y (ringReciprocalSeq y x₀ n)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.ringRecipError_step
statement:
theorem ringRecipError_step (y x : α) :
    ringRecipError y (ringReciprocalStep y x) = ringRecipError y x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold ringRecipError ringReciprocalStep
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.ringRecipError_seq
statement:
theorem ringRecipError_seq (y x₀ : α) (j : ℕ) :
    ringRecipError y (ringReciprocalSeq y x₀ j) = ringRecipError y x₀ ^ (2 ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih => rw [ringReciprocalSeq_succ, ringRecipError_step, ih, ← pow_mul, pow_succ]

name: Azurite.BZ.reciprocalStep_eq_ringReciprocalStep
statement:
theorem reciprocalStep_eq_ringReciprocalStep (y x : ℝ) :
    reciprocalStep y x = ringReciprocalStep y x
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.ringReciprocalSeq_one_sub
statement:
theorem ringReciprocalSeq_one_sub (z : α) (j : ℕ) :
    ringReciprocalSeq (1 - z) 1 j = ∑ n ∈ range (2 ^ j), z ^ n ∧
      (1 - z) * ringReciprocalSeq (1 - z) 1 j = 1 - z ^ (2 ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : ∀ j, ringRecipError (1 - z) (ringReciprocalSeq (1 - z) 1 j) = z ^ (2 ^ j) := by
    intro j; rw [ringRecipError_seq]; unfold ringRecipError; ring_nf
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · induction j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j ih =>
      
      have hstep : ringReciprocalSeq (1 - z) 1 (j + 1)
          = ringReciprocalSeq (1 - z) 1 j * (1 + z ^ (2 ^ j)) := by
        rw [ringReciprocalSeq_succ, ← hu j]
        unfold ringReciprocalStep ringRecipError
        ring
      rw [hstep, ih, pow_succ, mul_two, Finset.sum_range_add, mul_add, mul_one, Finset.sum_mul]
      congr 1
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => by ring
  · have h := hu j
    unfold ringRecipError at h
    linear_combination -h

name: Azurite.BZ.powerSeriesReciprocalSeq_sub_inv
statement:
theorem powerSeriesReciprocalSeq_sub_inv (j : ℕ) :
    ringReciprocalSeq (1 - X : R⟦X⟧) 1 j - mk 1 = -(X ^ (2 ^ j) * mk 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (ringReciprocalSeq_one_sub (X : R⟦X⟧) j).2
  have hinv : (mk 1 : R⟦X⟧) * (1 - X) = 1 := mk_one_mul_one_sub_eq_one R
  
  have hunit : IsUnit (1 - X : R⟦X⟧) :=
    ⟨⟨1 - X, mk 1, by rw [mul_comm]; exact hinv, hinv⟩, rfl⟩
  apply hunit.mul_left_cancel
  linear_combination h - (1 - X ^ (2 ^ j)) * hinv

name: Azurite.BZ.order_powerSeriesReciprocalSeq_sub_inv
statement:
theorem order_powerSeriesReciprocalSeq_sub_inv [Nontrivial R] (j : ℕ) :
    order (ringReciprocalSeq (1 - X : R⟦X⟧) 1 j - mk 1) = ((2 ^ j : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerSeriesReciprocalSeq_sub_inv, order_eq_nat]
  constructor
  · rw [map_neg, coeff_X_pow_mul', ite_eq_left le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, coeff_mk, Pi.one_apply]
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero
  · intro i hi
    rw [map_neg, coeff_X_pow_mul', ite_eq_right (not_le.mpr hi), neg_zero]

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_derivative'
statement:
theorem coeff_derivative' (A : R⟦X⟧) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff n (derivative A) = (n + 1) * coeff (n + 1) A
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_derivative, mul_comm]

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_integral_zero
statement: theorem coeff_integral_zero (A : K⟦X⟧) : coeff 0 (integral A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [integral]

name: Azurite.BZ.coeff_integral_succ
statement:
theorem coeff_integral_succ (A : K⟦X⟧) (j : ℕ) :
    coeff (j + 1) (integral A) = coeff j A / (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [integral]

name: Azurite.BZ.constantCoeff_integral
statement: theorem constantCoeff_integral (A : K⟦X⟧) : constantCoeff (integral A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_integral_zero]

name: Azurite.BZ.derivative_integral
statement: theorem derivative_integral [CharZero K] (A : K⟦X⟧) : derivative (integral A) = A
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_derivative', coeff_integral_succ]
  have : ((n : K) + 1) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n
  field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.integral_derivative
statement:
theorem integral_derivative [CharZero K] (A : K⟦X⟧) :
    integral (derivative A) = A - C (constantCoeff A)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [coeff_integral_zero]
  | succ n =>
    rw [coeff_integral_succ, coeff_derivative', map_sub, coeff_C, ite_eq_right (Nat.succ_ne_zero n),
      sub_zero]
    have : ((n : K) + 1) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n
    field_simp

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseRootSeq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem inverseRootSeq_zero (m : ℕ) (y x₀ : ℝ) : inverseRootSeq m y x₀ 0 = x₀
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseRootSeq_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverseRootSeq_succ (m : ℕ) (y x₀ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    inverseRootSeq m y x₀ (n + 1) = inverseRootStep m y (inverseRootSeq m y x₀ n)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_inverseRootFun
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_inverseRootFun {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (y : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (inverseRootFun m y) (inverseRootFun' m x) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun x => y - (x ^ (k + 1))⁻¹)
      (0 - -(((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * x ^ (k + 1 - 1)) / (x ^ (k + 1)) ^ 2) x :=
    (hasDerivAt_const x y).sub ((hasDerivAt_pow (k + 1) x).inv (pow_ne_zero _ hx))
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  unfold inverseRootFun'
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.hasDerivAt_inverseRootFun'
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_inverseRootFun' (m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (inverseRootFun' m) (inverseRootFun'' m x) x
proof:
:= by
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun x => (m : ℝ) * (x ^ (m + 1))⁻¹)
      ((m : ℝ) * (-(((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * x ^ (m + 1 - 1)) / (x ^ (m + 1)) ^ 2)) x :=
    ((hasDerivAt_pow (m + 1) x).inv (pow_ne_zero _ hx)).const_mul (m : ℝ)
  have hfun : inverseRootFun' m = fun x => (m : ℝ) * (x ^ (m + 1))⁻¹ := by
    funext x; simp [inverseRootFun', div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [hfun]
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  unfold inverseRootFun''
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.newtonStep_inverseRootFun
statement:
theorem newtonStep_inverseRootFun {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (y : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    newtonStep (inverseRootFun m y) (inverseRootFun' m) x = inverseRootStep m y x
proof:
:= by
  unfold newtonStep inverseRootFun inverseRootFun' inverseRootStep
  have hm' : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm.ne'
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.rpow_neg_inv_pow_mul
statement:
theorem rpow_neg_inv_pow_mul {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    (y ^ (-(1 / (m : ℝ)))) ^ m * y = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hm' : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm.ne'
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hy.le,
    show -(1 / (m : ℝ)) * (m : ℕ) = -1 by field_simp, Real.rpow_neg_one, inv_mul_cancel₀ hy.ne']

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseRootFun_root
statement:
theorem inverseRootFun_root {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    inverseRootFun m y (y ^ (-(1 / (m : ℝ)))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold inverseRootFun
  have h := rpow_neg_inv_pow_mul hm hy
  rw [sub_eq_zero, eq_comm, inv_eq_iff_eq_inv]
  exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left h

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseRootStep_rel
statement:
theorem inverseRootStep_rel (m : ℕ) {y ζ : ℝ} (hζ : ζ ^ m * y = 1) (ε : ℝ) :
    inverseRootStep m y (ζ * (1 + ε)) = ζ * ((1 + ε) * (1 + (1 - (1 + ε) ^ m) / m))
proof:
:= by
  have h : (ζ * (1 + ε)) ^ m * y = (1 + ε) ^ m := by rw [mul_pow, mul_right_comm, hζ, one_mul]
  unfold inverseRootStep
  rw [h]
  ring

name: Azurite.BZ.inverseRoot_pos
statement: theorem inverseRoot_pos {m : ℕ} {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) : 0 < y ^ (-(1 / (m : ℝ)))
proof:
:=
  Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy _

name: Azurite.BZ.exists_tendsto_inverseRootSeq
statement:
theorem exists_tendsto_inverseRootSeq {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x₀, |x₀ - y ^ (-(1 / (m : ℝ)))| ≤ δ →
      (∀ n, |inverseRootSeq m y x₀ n - y ^ (-(1 / (m : ℝ)))| ≤ y ^ (-(1 / (m : ℝ))) / 2) ∧
      (∀ n, inverseRootSeq m y x₀ n
        = newtonSeq (inverseRootFun m y) (inverseRootFun' m) x₀ n) ∧
      Tendsto (inverseRootSeq m y x₀) atTop (𝓝 (y ^ (-(1 / (m : ℝ)))))
proof:
:= by
  set ζ := y ^ (-(1 / (m : ℝ))) with hζ_def
  have hζ : 0 < ζ := inverseRoot_pos hy
  have hroot : inverseRootFun m y ζ = 0 := inverseRootFun_root hm hy
  set r := ζ / 2 with hr
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by positivity
  
  have hI : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), ζ / 2 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 3 * ζ / 2 := by
    intro t ht; constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
  have hIpos : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), 0 < t := fun t ht => by linarith [(hI t ht).1]
  
  set M : ℝ := (m * (m + 1) : ℝ) / (ζ / 2) ^ (m + 2) with hM_def
  set mlo : ℝ := (m : ℝ) / (3 * ζ / 2) ^ (m + 1) with hmlo_def
  have hmlo : 0 < mlo := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
    positivity
  have hM : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), |inverseRootFun'' m t| ≤ M := by
    intro t ht
    have ht0 := hIpos t ht
    unfold inverseRootFun''
    rw [abs_div, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity), abs_of_pos (by positivity), hM_def]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity)
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (hI t ht).1 _
  have hm' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), mlo ≤ |inverseRootFun' m t| := by
    intro t ht
    have ht0 := hIpos t ht
    unfold inverseRootFun'
    rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity), hmlo_def]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity)
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ ht0.le (hI t ht).2 _
  have hf : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r), HasDerivAt (inverseRootFun m y) (inverseRootFun' m t) t :=
    fun t ht => hasDerivAt_inverseRootFun hm y (hIpos t ht).ne'
  have hf' : ∀ t ∈ Icc (ζ - r) (ζ + r),
      HasDerivAt (inverseRootFun' m) (inverseRootFun'' m t) t :=
    fun t ht => hasDerivAt_inverseRootFun' m (hIpos t ht).ne'
  set K := M / (2 * mlo) with hK_def
  have hK0 : 0 < K := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
    positivity
  refine ⟨min r (1 / (2 * K)), lt_min hr0 (by positivity), fun x₀ hx₀ => ?_⟩
  have hx₀r : |x₀ - ζ| ≤ r := hx₀.trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hx₀K : K * |x₀ - ζ| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have h := hx₀.trans (min_le_right _ _)
    calc K * |x₀ - ζ| ≤ K * (1 / (2 * K)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hK0.le
      _ = 1 / 2 := by field_simp
  have hbounds := fun n => newtonSeq_bounds hmlo hroot hf hf' hM hm' hx₀r hx₀K n
  
  have heq : ∀ n, inverseRootSeq m y x₀ n
      = newtonSeq (inverseRootFun m y) (inverseRootFun' m) x₀ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [inverseRootSeq_succ, newtonSeq_succ, ih]
      have hn := (hbounds n).1
      have hne : newtonSeq (inverseRootFun m y) (inverseRootFun' m) x₀ n ≠ 0 := by
        rw [abs_le] at hn
        have : 0 < newtonSeq (inverseRootFun m y) (inverseRootFun' m) x₀ n := by
          linarith [hn.1]
        exact this.ne'
      exact (newtonStep_inverseRootFun hm y hne).symm
  refine ⟨fun n => ?_, heq, ?_⟩
  · rw [heq]; exact (hbounds n).1
  · have h := tendsto_newtonSeq hmlo hroot hf hf' hM hm' hx₀r hx₀K
    exact h.congr (fun n => (heq n).symm)

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.toFn_kronecker_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AzMatrix.toFn_kronecker_apply (A : AzMatrix R m n) (B : AzMatrix R p q)
    (r : Fin (m * p)) (c : Fin (n * q)) :
    (A.kronecker B).toFn r c =
      A.toFn (finProdFinEquiv.symm r).1 (finProdFinEquiv.symm c).1 *
        B.toFn (finProdFinEquiv.symm r).2 (finProdFinEquiv.symm c).2
proof:
:= by
  simp [kronecker]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.toFn_kronecker
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.toFn_kronecker (A : AzMatrix R m n) (B : AzMatrix R p q) :
    (A.kronecker B).toFn =
      Matrix.reindex finProdFinEquiv finProdFinEquiv (A.toFn ⊗ₖ B.toFn)
proof:
:= by
  funext r c
  simp [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.toMat_pow
statement:
@[simp] theorem AzMatrix.toMat_pow (A : AzMatrix R n n) (k : ℕ) :
    toMat (A.pow k) = toMat A ^ k

theorem AzMatrix.get_pow (A : AzMatrix R n n) (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) :

name: Azurite.toMat_ofFn
statement:
private lemma toMat_ofFn (f : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) :
    toMat (AzMatrix.ofFn f) = f

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.ofFn_pow

@[simp] theorem AzMatrix.ofFn_pow (f : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (k : ℕ) :
    (AzMatrix.ofFn f).pow k = AzMatrix.ofFn (f ^ k)
proof:
:= by

  have h := AzMatrix.toMat_pow (AzMatrix.ofFn f) k
  rw [toMat_ofFn] at h

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.toFn_smul

theorem AzMatrix.toFn_smul [SMul α R] (c : α) (M : AzMatrix R m n) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :

name: isNilpotent_pow_sub_pow
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hab.geom_sum₂_mul k]
  refine Commute.isNilpotent_mul_left ?_ h
  refine Commute.sum_left _ _ _ (fun i _ => ?_)
  exact Commute.sub_right
    (Commute.mul_left ((Commute.refl a).pow_left i) (hab.symm.pow_left _))
    (Commute.mul_left (hab.pow_left i) ((Commute.refl b).pow_left _))

name: Module.End.trace_restrict_pow_maxGenEigenspace
statement:
private theorem trace_restrict_pow_maxGenEigenspace (f : End K V) (μ : K) (k : ℕ)
    (h : MapsTo (f ^ k) (f.maxGenEigenspace μ) (f.maxGenEigenspace μ)) :
    LinearMap.trace K _ ((f ^ k).restrict h)
      = μ ^ k * (Module.finrank K (f.maxGenEigenspace μ) : K)
proof:
:= by
  set W := f.maxGenEigenspace μ with hW
  have hf : MapsTo f W W := mapsTo_maxGenEigenspace_of_comm (Commute.refl f) μ
  set g : End K W := f.restrict hf with hg
  
  have hgk : (f ^ k).restrict h = g ^ k := (Module.End.pow_restrict k hf).symm
  
  have hnil1 : IsNilpotent (g - algebraMap K (End K W) μ) := by
    have heq : g - algebraMap K (End K W) μ
        = (f - algebraMap K (End K V) μ).restrict
            (mapsTo_maxGenEigenspace_of_comm (Algebra.mul_sub_algebraMap_commutes f μ) μ) := by
      refine LinearMap.ext fun x => Subtype.ext ?_
      simp only [hg, LinearMap.sub_apply, AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub,
        Module.algebraMap_end_apply, SetLike.val_smul]
      rfl
    rw [heq]
    exact isNilpotent_restrict_maxGenEigenspace_sub_algebraMap f μ
  have hnil : IsNilpotent (g ^ k - algebraMap K (End K W) (μ ^ k)) := by
    rw [map_pow]
    exact isNilpotent_pow_sub_pow (Algebra.commute_algebraMap_right μ g) hnil1 k
  rw [hgk]
  have ht := trace_comp_eq_mul_of_commute_of_isNilpotent (μ ^ k) (Commute.one_left (g ^ k)) hnil
  rw [← Module.End.mul_eq_comp, one_mul] at ht
  rw [ht, LinearMap.trace_one]

name: Module.End.trace_pow_eq_sum_roots_pow
statement:
theorem trace_pow_eq_sum_roots_pow (f : End K V) (k : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.trace K V (f ^ k) = (f.charpoly.roots.map (· ^ k)).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hInternal : DirectSum.IsInternal (f.maxGenEigenspace) :=
    DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
      (f.independent_genEigenspace ⊤) (f.iSup_maxGenEigenspace_eq_top)
  have hmaps : ∀ μ, MapsTo (f ^ k) (f.maxGenEigenspace μ) (f.maxGenEigenspace μ) := fun μ =>
    mapsTo_maxGenEigenspace_of_comm ((Commute.refl f).pow_right k) μ
  
  have hbot : ∀ μ : K, f.maxGenEigenspace μ ≠ ⊥ ↔ μ ∈ f.charpoly.roots.toFinset := by
    intro μ
    rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, ← Multiset.count_pos, Polynomial.count_roots,
      ← finrank_maxGenEigenspace_eq, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, ne_eq,
      not_iff_not, Submodule.finrank_eq_zero]
  have hfin : {μ : K | f.maxGenEigenspace μ ≠ ⊥}.Finite :=
    Set.Finite.subset f.charpoly.roots.toFinset.finite_toSet (fun μ hμ => (hbot μ).mp hμ)
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_trace_restrict' hInternal hfin hmaps]
  simp_rw [trace_restrict_pow_maxGenEigenspace f _ k]
  rw [Finset.sum_multiset_map_count]
  have hset : hfin.toFinset = f.charpoly.roots.toFinset := by
    ext μ; rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, mem_ofPred_eq, hbot μ]
  rw [hset]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun μ _ => ?_)
  rw [finrank_maxGenEigenspace_eq, Polynomial.count_roots, nsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Matrix.trace_pow_eq_sum_roots_pow
statement:
theorem trace_pow_eq_sum_roots_pow {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (B : Matrix ι ι K) (k : ℕ) :
    (B ^ k).trace = (B.charpoly.roots.map (· ^ k)).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.trace_toLin'_eq, Matrix.toLin'_pow,
    Module.End.trace_pow_eq_sum_roots_pow, Matrix.charpoly_toLin']

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.traceMul_eq_trace
statement:
theorem traceMul_eq_trace (X Y : AzMatrix A n n) :
    traceMul X Y = Matrix.trace (toMat X * toMat Y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [traceMul, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, Matrix.mul_apply]
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.toPoly_charPoly
statement:
theorem toPoly_charPoly [CharZero A] (M : AzMatrix A n n) :
    toPoly M.charPoly = (toMat M).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set C := AlgebraicClosure A
  set r := n.sqrt + 1 with hr_def
  have hr : 0 < r := Nat.succ_pos _
  set P : Azurite.AzPolynomial A := ofPoly (toMat M).charpoly with hP
  have hPtoPoly : toPoly P = (toMat M).charpoly := by rw [hP, toPoly_ofPoly]
  have hPmonic : P.Monic := (Monic_toPoly P).mp (hPtoPoly ▸ (toMat M).charpoly_monic)
  have hPdeg : P.natDegree = n := by
    rw [hP, natDegree_ofPoly, (toMat M).charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim, Fintype.card_fin]
  
  have hstep : ∀ k, k < n + 1 →
      traceMul ((Array.ofFn (n := r) (fun i : Fin r => M ^ (i : ℕ))).getD (k % r) 1)
        ((Array.ofFn (n := r) (fun j : Fin r => M ^ (r * (j : ℕ)))).getD (k / r) 1)
        = P.newtonSumMonic k := by
    intro k hk
    have hkr : k % r < r := Nat.mod_lt _ hr
    have hkdr : k / r < r := by
      have h1 : n < r * r := Nat.lt_succ_sqrt n
      have h2 : k / r ≤ n / r := Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega)
      have h3 : n / r < r := (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hr).mpr h1
      omega
    
    have hb : (Array.ofFn (n := r) (fun i : Fin r => M ^ (i : ℕ))).getD (k % r) 1 = M ^ (k % r) := by
      rw [Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?, Array.getElem?_ofFn]; simp [hkr]
    have hgi : (Array.ofFn (n := r) (fun j : Fin r => M ^ (r * (j : ℕ)))).getD (k / r) 1
        = M ^ (r * (k / r)) := by
      rw [Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?, Array.getElem?_ofFn]; simp [hkdr]
    rw [hb, hgi, traceMul_eq_trace, toMat_npow, toMat_npow, ← pow_add, Nat.mod_add_div]
    
    apply (algebraMap A C).injective
    rw [newtonSumMonic_toPoly P hPmonic k, hPtoPoly]
    
    rw [AddMonoidHom.map_trace, Matrix.map_pow, Matrix.trace_pow_eq_sum_roots_pow,
      Matrix.charpoly_map, newtonSum, Polynomial.aroots]
  
  have hcp : M.charPoly = P := by
    have hunfold : M.charPoly
        = polyFromNewtonSumsMonic ((Array.range (n + 1)).map
            (fun k => traceMul ((Array.ofFn (n := r) (fun i : Fin r => M ^ (i : ℕ))).getD (k % r) 1)
              ((Array.ofFn (n := r) (fun j : Fin r => M ^ (r * (j : ℕ)))).getD (k / r) 1))) := rfl
    rw [hunfold, ← polyFromNewtonSumsMonic_newtonSumsMonic P hPmonic]
    congr 1
    rw [newtonSumsMonic, hPdeg]
    apply Array.ext
    · simp
    · intro k hk1 _
      simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_range]
      exact hstep k (by simpa using hk1)
  rw [hcp]; exact hPtoPoly

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols (M : AzMatrix K n n) (j₁ j₂ i j : Fin n) :
    (M.swapCols j₁ j₂).toFn i j =
      (if j = j₁ then M.toFn i j₂
       else if j = j₂ then M.toFn i j₁
       else M.toFn i j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzMatrix.swapCols
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_ofFn]
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.findPivotAux_eq_none
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.findPivotAux_eq_none [Zero K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n) :
    ∀ (start : Nat), M.findPivotAux k start = none →
      ∀ j : Fin n, start ≤ j.val → M.toFn k j = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply AzMatrix.findPivotAux.induct M k
    (motive := fun start => M.findPivotAux k start = none →
      ∀ j : Fin n, start ≤ j.val → M.toFn k j = 0)
  · intro start h_lt h_zero ih h_rec j h_ge
    have hrec_eq : M.findPivotAux k (start + 1) = none := by
      rw [AzMatrix.findPivotAux.eq_def] at h_rec
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, ite_eq_left h_zero] at h_rec
      exact h_rec
    by_cases h_eq : j.val = start
    · have hj : j = ⟨start, h_lt⟩ := Fin.ext h_eq
      rw [hj]; exact h_zero
    · exact ih hrec_eq j (by omega)
  · intro start h_lt h_nz h_rec
    have h_eq : M.findPivotAux k start = some ⟨start, h_lt⟩ := by
      rw [AzMatrix.findPivotAux.eq_def]
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, ite_eq_right h_nz]
    rw [h_eq] at h_rec
    nomatch h_rec
  · intro start h_ge _ j _
    have : j.val < n := j.isLt
    omega

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.findPivot_eq_none
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.findPivot_eq_none [Zero K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n) (h : M.findPivot k = none) :
    ∀ j : Fin n, k.val ≤ j.val → M.toFn k j = 0
proof:
:=
  M.findPivotAux_eq_none k k.val h

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.findPivotAux_some_le
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.findPivotAux_some_le [Zero K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n) :
    ∀ (start : Nat) (j : Fin n),
      M.findPivotAux k start = some j → start ≤ j.val
proof:
:= by
  intro start
  apply AzMatrix.findPivotAux.induct M k
    (motive := fun start => ∀ j : Fin n,
      M.findPivotAux k start = some j → start ≤ j.val)
  · intro start h_lt h_zero ih j h_rec
    have hrec_eq : M.findPivotAux k (start + 1) = some j := by
      rw [AzMatrix.findPivotAux.eq_def] at h_rec
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, ite_eq_left h_zero] at h_rec
      exact h_rec
    have := ih j hrec_eq
    omega
  · intro start h_lt h_nz j h_rec
    have h_eq : M.findPivotAux k start = some ⟨start, h_lt⟩ := by
      rw [AzMatrix.findPivotAux.eq_def]
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, ite_eq_right h_nz]
    rw [h_eq] at h_rec
    have h_eq_j : ⟨start, h_lt⟩ = j := by injection h_rec
    have : j.val = start := by rw [← h_eq_j]
    omega
  · intro start h_ge j h_rec
    rw [AzMatrix.findPivotAux.eq_def] at h_rec
    simp only [dite_eq_right h_ge] at h_rec
    nomatch h_rec

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.findPivot_some_le
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.findPivot_some_le [Zero K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k j : Fin n) (h : M.findPivot k = some j) :
    k.val ≤ j.val
proof:
:=
  M.findPivotAux_some_le k k.val j h

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.findPivotAux_some_nonzero
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.findPivotAux_some_nonzero [Zero K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n) :
    ∀ (start : Nat) (j : Fin n),
      M.findPivotAux k start = some j → M.toFn k j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro start
  apply AzMatrix.findPivotAux.induct M k
    (motive := fun start => ∀ j : Fin n,
      M.findPivotAux k start = some j → M.toFn k j ≠ 0)
  · intro start h_lt h_zero ih j h_rec
    have hrec_eq : M.findPivotAux k (start + 1) = some j := by
      rw [AzMatrix.findPivotAux.eq_def] at h_rec
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, ite_eq_left h_zero] at h_rec
      exact h_rec
    exact ih j hrec_eq
  · intro start h_lt h_nz j h_rec
    have h_eq : M.findPivotAux k start = some ⟨start, h_lt⟩ := by
      rw [AzMatrix.findPivotAux.eq_def]
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, ite_eq_right h_nz]
    rw [h_eq] at h_rec
    have h_j_eq : j = ⟨start, h_lt⟩ := (Option.some.inj h_rec).symm
    rw [h_j_eq]
    exact h_nz
  · intro start h_ge j h_rec
    rw [AzMatrix.findPivotAux.eq_def] at h_rec
    simp only [dite_eq_right h_ge] at h_rec
    nomatch h_rec

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.findPivot_some_nonzero
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.findPivot_some_nonzero [Zero K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k j : Fin n) (h : M.findPivot k = some j) :
    M.toFn k j ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  M.findPivotAux_some_nonzero k k.val j h

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.det_eliminateBelow
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.det_eliminateBelow
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n)
    (h_pivot : M.toFn k k ≠ 0)
    (h_row : ∀ j : Fin n, j.val < k.val → M.toFn k j = 0) :
    Matrix.det (M.eliminateBelow k).toFn = Matrix.det M.toFn
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.det_eq_of_forall_row_eq_smul_add_const
    (c := fun i => if k.val < i.val then -(M.toFn i k / M.toFn k k) else 0) k
  · simp
  · intro i j
    rw [AzMatrix.toFn_eliminateBelow]
    by_cases h_i_le : i.val ≤ k.val
    · rw [ite_eq_left h_i_le]
      have h_not_lt : ¬ k.val < i.val := by omega
      rw [ite_eq_right h_not_lt]
      ring
    · rw [ite_eq_right h_i_le]
      have h_i_gt : k.val < i.val := by omega
      rw [ite_eq_left h_i_gt]
      by_cases h_j_lt : j.val < k.val
      · rw [ite_eq_left h_j_lt]
        rw [h_row j h_j_lt]
        ring
      · rw [ite_eq_right h_j_lt]
        by_cases h_j_eq : j = k
        · rw [ite_eq_left h_j_eq, h_j_eq]
          field_simp
          ring
        · rw [ite_eq_right h_j_eq]
          ring

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols_eq_submatrix
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols_eq_submatrix
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (j₁ j₂ : Fin n) :
    (M.swapCols j₁ j₂).toFn =
      Matrix.submatrix M.toFn id (Equiv.swap j₁ j₂)
proof:
:= by
  funext i j
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols]
  show _ = M.toFn i ((Equiv.swap j₁ j₂) j)
  by_cases h₁ : j = j₁
  · rw [ite_eq_left h₁, h₁, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
  · by_cases h₂ : j = j₂
    · rw [ite_eq_right h₁, ite_eq_left h₂, h₂, Equiv.swap_apply_right]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h₁, ite_eq_right h₂, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h₁ h₂]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.det_swapCols
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.det_swapCols
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (j₁ j₂ : Fin n) (h_neq : j₁ ≠ j₂) :
    Matrix.det (M.swapCols j₁ j₂).toFn = -Matrix.det M.toFn
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols_eq_submatrix]
  rw [show Matrix.submatrix M.toFn id ⇑(Equiv.swap j₁ j₂)
      = Matrix.submatrix (Matrix.of M.toFn) id ⇑(Equiv.swap j₁ j₂) from rfl]
  rw [Matrix.det_permute']
  rw [Equiv.Perm.sign_swap h_neq]
  push_cast
  rw [neg_one_mul]
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.swapCols_preservesPartialZero
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.swapCols_preservesPartialZero
    (M : AzMatrix R m m) (start : Nat) (h_lt : start < m)
    (h_inv : M.PartialZero start) (jₚ : Fin m) (h_jₚ_ge : start ≤ jₚ.val) :
    (M.swapCols ⟨start, h_lt⟩ jₚ).PartialZero start
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h_lt_ij h_bnd
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols]
  have h_j_neq_kp : j ≠ ⟨start, h_lt⟩ := by
    intro h_eq
    have : j.val = start := by rw [h_eq]
    omega
  have h_j_neq_jₚ : j ≠ jₚ := by
    intro h_eq
    have : j.val = jₚ.val := by rw [h_eq]
    omega
  rw [ite_eq_right h_j_neq_kp, ite_eq_right h_j_neq_jₚ]
  exact h_inv i j h_lt_ij h_bnd

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.swapCols_row_zeros
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.swapCols_row_zeros
    (M : AzMatrix R m m) (start : Nat) (h_lt : start < m)
    (h_inv : M.PartialZero start) (jₚ : Fin m) (h_jₚ_ge : start ≤ jₚ.val) :
    ∀ j : Fin m, j.val < start →
      (M.swapCols ⟨start, h_lt⟩ jₚ).toFn ⟨start, h_lt⟩ j = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro j h_j_lt
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols]
  have h_j_neq_kp : j ≠ ⟨start, h_lt⟩ := by
    intro h_eq
    have : j.val = start := by rw [h_eq]
    omega
  have h_j_neq_jₚ : j ≠ jₚ := by
    intro h_eq
    have : j.val = jₚ.val := by rw [h_eq]
    omega
  rw [ite_eq_right h_j_neq_kp, ite_eq_right h_j_neq_jₚ]
  exact h_inv ⟨start, h_lt⟩ j h_j_lt h_j_lt

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.eliminateBelow_preservesPartialZero
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.eliminateBelow_preservesPartialZero
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (start : Nat) (h_lt : start < n)
    (h_inv : M.PartialZero start) :
    (M.eliminateBelow ⟨start, h_lt⟩).PartialZero (start + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h_lt_ij h_bnd
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_eliminateBelow]
  by_cases h_i_le : i.val ≤ start
  · rw [ite_eq_left h_i_le]
    have h_j_lt_start : j.val < start := by omega
    exact h_inv i j h_lt_ij h_j_lt_start
  · rw [ite_eq_right h_i_le]
    by_cases h_j_lt : j.val < start
    · rw [ite_eq_left h_j_lt]
      exact h_inv i j h_lt_ij h_j_lt
    · rw [ite_eq_right h_j_lt]
      have h_j_eq : j.val = start := by omega
      have h_j_kp : j = ⟨start, h_lt⟩ := Fin.ext h_j_eq
      rw [ite_eq_left h_j_kp]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.gaussAux_det_eq
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.gaussAux_det_eq
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (start s : Nat) (h_inv : M.PartialZero start) :
    Matrix.det M.toFn * (-1 : K)^s =
      (-1 : K)^((M.gaussAux start s).2) *
        ∏ i : Fin n, (M.gaussAux start s).1.toFn i i
proof:
:= by
  induction M, start, s using AzMatrix.gaussAux.induct with
  | case1 M start s h_lt kp h_findPivot =>
    
    have h_findPivot' : M.findPivot ⟨start, by omega⟩ = none := h_findPivot
    have h_step_eq : M.gaussAux start s = (M, s) := by
      rw [AzMatrix.gaussAux.eq_def]
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, h_findPivot']
    rw [h_step_eq]
    have h_start_lt : start < n := by omega
    have h_start_zero : ∀ j : Fin n, M.toFn ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j = 0 := by
      intro j
      by_cases h_j_lt : j.val < start
      · exact h_inv ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j h_j_lt h_j_lt
      · have h_j_ge : start ≤ j.val := by omega
        exact M.findPivot_eq_none ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ h_findPivot' j h_j_ge
    have h_det_zero : Matrix.det M.toFn = 0 :=
      Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ h_start_zero
    have h_prod_zero : ∏ i : Fin n, M.toFn i i = 0 := by
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩) (Finset.mem_univ _)
      exact h_start_zero _
    rw [h_det_zero, h_prod_zero]
    ring
  | case2 M start s h_lt kp h_pivot_kp ih =>
    
    have h_start_lt : start < n := by omega
    have h_pivot_kp' :
        M.findPivot ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ = some ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ := h_pivot_kp
    have h_pivot_nz : M.toFn ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ ≠ 0 :=
      M.findPivot_some_nonzero ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ h_pivot_kp'
    have h_row_zeros : ∀ j : Fin n, j.val < (⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ : Fin n).val →
        M.toFn ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j = 0 := by
      intro j h_j_lt
      have h_j_lt' : j.val < start := h_j_lt
      exact h_inv ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j h_j_lt' h_j_lt'
    have h_det_eq :
        Matrix.det (M.eliminateBelow ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩).toFn =
          Matrix.det M.toFn :=
      M.det_eliminateBelow ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ h_pivot_nz h_row_zeros
    have h_inv_next :
        (M.eliminateBelow ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩).PartialZero (start + 1) :=
      M.eliminateBelow_preservesPartialZero start h_start_lt h_inv
    have h_step_eq : M.gaussAux start s =
        (M.eliminateBelow ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩).gaussAux (start + 1) s := by
      rw [AzMatrix.gaussAux.eq_def]
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, h_pivot_kp', ite_true]
    rw [h_step_eq]
    rw [← h_det_eq]
    exact ih h_inv_next
  | case3 M start s h_lt kp j h_pivot_j h_neq ih =>
    
    have h_start_lt : start < n := by omega
    have h_pivot_j' : M.findPivot ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ = some j := h_pivot_j
    have h_neq' : ¬ j = ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ := h_neq
    have h_j_ge : start ≤ j.val :=
      M.findPivot_some_le ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j h_pivot_j'
    have h_orig_nz : M.toFn ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j ≠ 0 :=
      M.findPivot_some_nonzero ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j h_pivot_j'
    have h_swap_pivot_nz :
        (M.swapCols ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j).toFn
          ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols, ite_eq_left rfl]
      exact h_orig_nz
    have h_swap_row_zeros : ∀ j' : Fin n,
        j'.val < (⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ : Fin n).val →
        (M.swapCols ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j).toFn ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j' = 0 := by
      intro j' h_j'_lt
      exact M.swapCols_row_zeros start h_start_lt h_inv j h_j_ge j' h_j'_lt
    have h_det_elim_eq :
        Matrix.det ((M.swapCols ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j).eliminateBelow
          ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩).toFn =
        Matrix.det (M.swapCols ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j).toFn :=
      (M.swapCols ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j).det_eliminateBelow
        ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ h_swap_pivot_nz h_swap_row_zeros
    have h_kp_neq_j : (⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ : Fin n) ≠ j := fun h => h_neq' h.symm
    have h_det_swap_eq :
        Matrix.det (M.swapCols ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j).toFn =
          -Matrix.det M.toFn :=
      M.det_swapCols ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j h_kp_neq_j
    have h_inv_next :
        ((M.swapCols ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j).eliminateBelow
          ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩).PartialZero (start + 1) :=
      (M.swapCols ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j).eliminateBelow_preservesPartialZero
        start h_start_lt
        (M.swapCols_preservesPartialZero start h_start_lt h_inv j h_j_ge)
    have h_step_eq : M.gaussAux start s =
        ((M.swapCols ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩ j).eliminateBelow
          ⟨start, h_start_lt⟩).gaussAux (start + 1) (s + 1) := by
      rw [AzMatrix.gaussAux.eq_def]
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, h_pivot_j', ite_eq_right h_neq']
    rw [h_step_eq]
    have h_ih := ih h_inv_next
    rw [h_det_elim_eq, h_det_swap_eq] at h_ih
    have h_pow_succ : (-1 : K)^(s + 1) = (-1 : K)^s * (-1 : K) := pow_succ _ _
    rw [h_pow_succ] at h_ih
    linear_combination h_ih
  | case4 M start s h_no_step =>
    have h_step_eq : M.gaussAux start s = (M, s) := by
      rw [AzMatrix.gaussAux.eq_def]
      simp only [dite_eq_right h_no_step]
    rw [h_step_eq]
    have h_upper : Matrix.BlockTriangular M.toFn id := by
      intro i j h_lt_ij
      have h_lt' : j.val < i.val := h_lt_ij
      have h_i_lt : i.val < n := i.isLt
      have h_j_lt_start : j.val < start := by omega
      exact h_inv i j h_lt' h_j_lt_start
    rw [Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular h_upper]
    ring

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.gaussDet_eq_Matrix_det
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.gaussDet_eq_Matrix_det (M : AzMatrix K n n) :
    M.gaussDet = Matrix.det M.toFn
proof:
:= by
  have h_inv : M.PartialZero 0 := fun _ _ _ h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  have h := M.gaussAux_det_eq 0 0 h_inv
  rw [pow_zero, mul_one] at h
  show (let (U, s) := M.gauss; (-1 : K) ^ s * ∏ i, U.get i i) =
    Matrix.det M.toFn
  unfold AzMatrix.gauss
  show (-1 : K) ^ (M.gaussAux 0 0).2 *
      ∏ i, (M.gaussAux 0 0).1.toFn i i = Matrix.det M.toFn
  rw [← h]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.toFn_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AzMatrix.toFn_neg (M : AzMatrix R m n) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
    (-M).toFn i j = -(M.toFn i j)
proof:
:= by
  show (M.map (- ·)).toFn i j = -(M.toFn i j); simp

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.ofFn_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AzMatrix.ofFn_neg (f : Fin m → Fin n → R) :
    -(AzMatrix.ofFn f) = AzMatrix.ofFn (fun i j => -(f i j))
proof:
:= by
  apply AzMatrix.toFn_injective; ext i j; simp

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.toFn_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AzMatrix.toFn_add (M N : AzMatrix R m n) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
    (M + N).toFn i j = M.toFn i j + N.toFn i j
proof:
:= by
  show (M.zip (· + ·) N).toFn i j = M.toFn i j + N.toFn i j; simp

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.ofFn_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AzMatrix.ofFn_add (f g : Fin m → Fin n → R) :
    AzMatrix.ofFn f + AzMatrix.ofFn g = AzMatrix.ofFn (fun i j => f i j + g i j)
proof:
:= by
  apply AzMatrix.toFn_injective; ext i j; simp

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.toFn_eliminateBelow
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.toFn_eliminateBelow [Field K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k i j : Fin n) :
    (M.eliminateBelow k).toFn i j =
      (if i.val ≤ k.val then M.toFn i j
       else if j.val < k.val then M.toFn i j
       else if j = k then 0
       else M.toFn i j - (M.toFn i k / M.toFn k k) * M.toFn k j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzMatrix.eliminateBelow
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_ofFn]
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows (M : AzMatrix K n n) (i₁ i₂ i j : Fin n) :
    (M.swapRows i₁ i₂).toFn i j =
      (if i = i₁ then M.toFn i₂ j
       else if i = i₂ then M.toFn i₁ j
       else M.toFn i j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzMatrix.swapRows
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_ofFn]
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.findRowPivotAux_eq_none
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.findRowPivotAux_eq_none [Zero K] [DecidableEq K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n) :
    ∀ (start : Nat), M.findRowPivotAux k start = none →
      ∀ i : Fin n, start ≤ i.val → M.toFn i k = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply AzMatrix.findRowPivotAux.induct M k
    (motive := fun start => M.findRowPivotAux k start = none →
      ∀ i : Fin n, start ≤ i.val → M.toFn i k = 0)
  · 
    intro start h_lt h_zero ih h_rec i h_ge
    have hrec_eq : M.findRowPivotAux k (start + 1) = none := by
      rw [AzMatrix.findRowPivotAux.eq_def] at h_rec
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, ite_eq_left h_zero] at h_rec
      exact h_rec
    by_cases h_eq : i.val = start
    · have hi : i = ⟨start, h_lt⟩ := Fin.ext h_eq
      rw [hi]
      exact h_zero
    · exact ih hrec_eq i (by omega)
  · 
    intro start h_lt h_nz h_rec
    have h_eq : M.findRowPivotAux k start = some ⟨start, h_lt⟩ := by
      rw [AzMatrix.findRowPivotAux.eq_def]
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, ite_eq_right h_nz]
    rw [h_eq] at h_rec
    nomatch h_rec
  · 
    intro start h_ge _ i _
    have : i.val < n := i.isLt
    omega

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.findRowPivot_eq_none
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.findRowPivot_eq_none [Zero K] [DecidableEq K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n) (h : M.findRowPivot k = none) :
    ∀ i : Fin n, k.val ≤ i.val → M.toFn i k = 0
proof:
:=
  M.findRowPivotAux_eq_none k k.val h

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.findRowPivotAux_some_le
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.findRowPivotAux_some_le [Zero K] [DecidableEq K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n) :
    ∀ (start : Nat) (j : Fin n),
      M.findRowPivotAux k start = some j → start ≤ j.val
proof:
:= by
  intro start
  apply AzMatrix.findRowPivotAux.induct M k
    (motive := fun start => ∀ j : Fin n,
      M.findRowPivotAux k start = some j → start ≤ j.val)
  · intro start h_lt h_zero ih j h_rec
    have hrec_eq : M.findRowPivotAux k (start + 1) = some j := by
      rw [AzMatrix.findRowPivotAux.eq_def] at h_rec
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, ite_eq_left h_zero] at h_rec
      exact h_rec
    have := ih j hrec_eq
    omega
  · intro start h_lt h_nz j h_rec
    have h_eq : M.findRowPivotAux k start = some ⟨start, h_lt⟩ := by
      rw [AzMatrix.findRowPivotAux.eq_def]
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, ite_eq_right h_nz]
    rw [h_eq] at h_rec
    have h_eq_j : ⟨start, h_lt⟩ = j := by injection h_rec
    have : j.val = start := by rw [← h_eq_j]
    omega
  · intro start h_ge j h_rec
    rw [AzMatrix.findRowPivotAux.eq_def] at h_rec
    simp only [dite_eq_right h_ge] at h_rec
    nomatch h_rec

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.findRowPivot_some_le
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.findRowPivot_some_le [Zero K] [DecidableEq K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k j : Fin n) (h : M.findRowPivot k = some j) :
    k.val ≤ j.val
proof:
:=
  M.findRowPivotAux_some_le k k.val j h

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.rowEchelonAux_blockTriangular
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.rowEchelonAux_blockTriangular [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (start s : Nat)
    (h_inv : ∀ i j : Fin n, j.val < i.val → j.val < start → M.toFn i j = 0) :
    ∀ i j : Fin n, j.val < i.val →
      (M.rowEchelonAux start s).1.toFn i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction M, start, s using AzMatrix.rowEchelonAux.induct with
  | case1 M start s h_lt kp h_none ih =>
    
    
    have h_kp_val : kp.val = start := rfl
    
    have h_none' : M.findRowPivot ⟨start, by omega⟩ = none := h_none
    have h_inv' : ∀ i' j' : Fin n, j'.val < i'.val → j'.val < start + 1 →
        M.toFn i' j' = 0 := by
      intro i' j' h_lt_ij' h_bnd
      by_cases h_j_start : j'.val = start
      · have h_j_eq : j' = ⟨start, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext h_j_start
        rw [h_j_eq]
        have h_le : (⟨start, by omega⟩ : Fin n).val ≤ i'.val := by
          show start ≤ i'.val
          omega
        exact M.findRowPivot_eq_none ⟨start, by omega⟩ h_none' i' h_le
      · exact h_inv i' j' h_lt_ij' (by omega)
    have h_step_eq : M.rowEchelonAux start s =
        M.rowEchelonAux (start + 1) s := by
      rw [AzMatrix.rowEchelonAux.eq_def]
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, h_none']
    intro i j h_lt_ij
    rw [h_step_eq]
    exact ih h_inv' i j h_lt_ij
  | case2 M start s h_lt kp h_pivot_kp ih =>
    have h_kp_val : kp.val = start := rfl
    have h_kp_eq : kp = ⟨start, by omega⟩ := rfl
    have h_pivot_kp' :
        M.findRowPivot ⟨start, by omega⟩ = some ⟨start, by omega⟩ := h_pivot_kp
    have h_inv' : ∀ i' j' : Fin n, j'.val < i'.val → j'.val < start + 1 →
        (M.eliminateBelow ⟨start, by omega⟩).toFn i' j' = 0 := by
      intro i' j' h_lt_ij' h_bnd
      rw [AzMatrix.toFn_eliminateBelow]
      by_cases h_i'_le : i'.val ≤ (⟨start, by omega⟩ : Fin n).val
      · rw [ite_eq_left h_i'_le]
        have h_j_lt_start : j'.val < start := by
          have : i'.val ≤ start := h_i'_le
          omega
        exact h_inv i' j' h_lt_ij' h_j_lt_start
      · rw [ite_eq_right h_i'_le]
        by_cases h_j_lt : j'.val < (⟨start, by omega⟩ : Fin n).val
        · rw [ite_eq_left h_j_lt]
          exact h_inv i' j' h_lt_ij' h_j_lt
        · rw [ite_eq_right h_j_lt]
          have h_j_eq : j'.val = start := by
            have h1 : j'.val ≥ start := by
              have : ¬ j'.val < (⟨start, by omega⟩ : Fin n).val := h_j_lt
              omega
            omega
          have h_j_kp : j' = ⟨start, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext h_j_eq
          rw [ite_eq_left h_j_kp]
    have h_step_eq : M.rowEchelonAux start s =
        (M.eliminateBelow ⟨start, by omega⟩).rowEchelonAux (start + 1) s := by
      rw [AzMatrix.rowEchelonAux.eq_def]
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, h_pivot_kp', ite_true]
    intro i j h_lt_ij
    rw [h_step_eq]
    
    
    exact ih h_inv' i j h_lt_ij
  | case3 M start s h_lt kp j h_pivot_j h_neq ih =>
    have h_kp_val : kp.val = start := rfl
    have h_kp_eq : kp = ⟨start, by omega⟩ := rfl
    have h_pivot_j' : M.findRowPivot ⟨start, by omega⟩ = some j := h_pivot_j
    have h_neq' : ¬ j = ⟨start, by omega⟩ := h_neq
    have h_j_ge : start ≤ j.val :=
      M.findRowPivot_some_le ⟨start, by omega⟩ j h_pivot_j'
    have h_inv' : ∀ i'' j'' : Fin n, j''.val < i''.val → j''.val < start + 1 →
        ((M.swapRows ⟨start, by omega⟩ j).eliminateBelow
          ⟨start, by omega⟩).toFn i'' j'' = 0 := by
      intro i'' j'' h_lt_ij'' h_bnd
      rw [AzMatrix.toFn_eliminateBelow]
      by_cases h_i''_le : i''.val ≤ (⟨start, by omega⟩ : Fin n).val
      · rw [ite_eq_left h_i''_le]
        rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows]
        by_cases h_i_kp : i'' = ⟨start, by omega⟩
        · rw [ite_eq_left h_i_kp]
          have h_j''_lt_start : j''.val < start := by
            have : i''.val ≤ start := h_i''_le
            omega
          have h_j''_lt_j : j''.val < j.val := by omega
          exact h_inv j j'' h_j''_lt_j h_j''_lt_start
        · rw [ite_eq_right h_i_kp]
          by_cases h_i_j : i'' = j
          · rw [ite_eq_left h_i_j]
            
            have h_j''_lt_start : j''.val < start := by
              have : i''.val ≤ start := h_i''_le
              omega
            exact h_inv ⟨start, by omega⟩ j''
              (show j''.val < (⟨start, by omega⟩ : Fin n).val from h_j''_lt_start)
              h_j''_lt_start
          · rw [ite_eq_right h_i_j]
            have h_j''_lt_start : j''.val < start := by
              have : i''.val ≤ start := h_i''_le
              omega
            exact h_inv i'' j'' h_lt_ij'' h_j''_lt_start
      · rw [ite_eq_right h_i''_le]
        by_cases h_j_lt : j''.val < (⟨start, by omega⟩ : Fin n).val
        · rw [ite_eq_left h_j_lt]
          rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows]
          have h_j''_lt_start : j''.val < start := h_j_lt
          by_cases h_i_kp : i'' = ⟨start, by omega⟩
          · rw [ite_eq_left h_i_kp]
            have h_j''_lt_j : j''.val < j.val := by omega
            exact h_inv j j'' h_j''_lt_j h_j''_lt_start
          · rw [ite_eq_right h_i_kp]
            by_cases h_i_j : i'' = j
            · rw [ite_eq_left h_i_j]
              exact h_inv ⟨start, by omega⟩ j''
                (show j''.val < (⟨start, by omega⟩ : Fin n).val from h_j''_lt_start)
                h_j''_lt_start
            · rw [ite_eq_right h_i_j]
              exact h_inv i'' j'' h_lt_ij'' h_j''_lt_start
        · rw [ite_eq_right h_j_lt]
          have h_j_eq : j''.val = start := by
            have h1 : j''.val ≥ start := by
              have : ¬ j''.val < (⟨start, by omega⟩ : Fin n).val := h_j_lt
              omega
            omega
          have h_j_kp : j'' = ⟨start, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext h_j_eq
          rw [ite_eq_left h_j_kp]
    have h_step_eq : M.rowEchelonAux start s =
        ((M.swapRows ⟨start, by omega⟩ j).eliminateBelow
          ⟨start, by omega⟩).rowEchelonAux (start + 1) (s + 1) := by
      rw [AzMatrix.rowEchelonAux.eq_def]
      simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, h_pivot_j', ite_eq_right h_neq']
    intro i' j' h_lt_ij'
    rw [h_step_eq]
    exact ih h_inv' i' j' h_lt_ij'
  | case4 M start s h_no_step =>
    intro i j h_lt_ij
    have h_step_eq : M.rowEchelonAux start s = (M, s) := by
      rw [AzMatrix.rowEchelonAux.eq_def]
      simp only [dite_eq_right h_no_step]
    rw [h_step_eq]
    apply h_inv i j h_lt_ij
    have h_i_lt : i.val < n := i.isLt
    omega

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.rowEchelon_blockTriangular
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.rowEchelon_blockTriangular [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) :
    Matrix.BlockTriangular (M.rowEchelon).1.toFn id
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h_lt
  have h_lt' : j.val < i.val := h_lt
  exact M.rowEchelonAux_blockTriangular 0 0
    (fun _ _ _ h_bnd => absurd h_bnd (Nat.not_lt_zero _)) i j h_lt'

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.bareissElimMatrix_apply_diag
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.bareissElimMatrix_apply_diag
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n) (b_prev : K) (i : Fin n) :
    M.bareissElimMatrix k b_prev i i =
      (if k.val < i.val then M.toFn k k / b_prev else 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzMatrix.bareissElimMatrix
  rw [ite_eq_left rfl]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.bareissElimMatrix_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.bareissElimMatrix_apply_of_ne
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n) (b_prev : K) (i l : Fin n) (h : i ≠ l) :
    M.bareissElimMatrix k b_prev i l =
      (if k.val < i.val ∧ l = k then -(M.toFn i k / b_prev) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzMatrix.bareissElimMatrix
  rw [ite_eq_right h]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.bareissElimMatrix_blockTriangular
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.bareissElimMatrix_blockTriangular
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n) (b_prev : K) :
    (M.bareissElimMatrix k b_prev).BlockTriangular OrderDual.toDual
proof:
:= by
  intro i l h_lt
  
  have h_lt' : i.val < l.val := h_lt
  unfold AzMatrix.bareissElimMatrix
  have h_neq : i ≠ l := fun h => by rw [h] at h_lt'; exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ h_lt'
  rw [ite_eq_right h_neq]
  have h_neg : ¬ (k.val < i.val ∧ l = k) := by
    intro ⟨h_ki, h_lk⟩
    have h_l_val : l.val = k.val := by rw [h_lk]
    omega
  rw [ite_eq_right h_neg]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.det_bareissElimMatrix_ne_zero
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.det_bareissElimMatrix_ne_zero
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n) (b_prev : K)
    (h_pivot : M.toFn k k ≠ 0) (h_b_prev : b_prev ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.det (M.bareissElimMatrix k b_prev) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_of_isLowerTriangular _
        (M.bareissElimMatrix_blockTriangular k b_prev)]
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro i _
  rw [M.bareissElimMatrix_apply_diag k b_prev]
  by_cases h_ki : k.val < i.val
  · rw [ite_eq_left h_ki]; exact div_ne_zero h_pivot h_b_prev
  · rw [ite_eq_right h_ki]; exact one_ne_zero

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.isUnit_det_bareissElimMatrix
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.isUnit_det_bareissElimMatrix
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n) (b_prev : K)
    (h_pivot : M.toFn k k ≠ 0) (h_b_prev : b_prev ≠ 0) :
    IsUnit (Matrix.det (M.bareissElimMatrix k b_prev))
proof:
:=
  isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    (M.det_bareissElimMatrix_ne_zero k b_prev h_pivot h_b_prev)

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.toFn_bareissEliminate_eq_bareissElimMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.toFn_bareissEliminate_eq_bareissElimMatrix_mul
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n) (b_prev : K)
    (h_pivot : M.toFn k k ≠ 0) (h_b_prev : b_prev ≠ 0)
    (h_partial : M.PartialZero k.val) :
    Matrix.of (M.bareissEliminate k b_prev).toFn =
      M.bareissElimMatrix k b_prev * Matrix.of M.toFn
proof:
:= by
  funext i j
  rw [Matrix.of_apply, AzMatrix.toFn_bareissEliminate, Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
  by_cases h_ile : i.val ≤ k.val
  · 
    rw [ite_eq_left h_ile]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · rw [M.bareissElimMatrix_apply_diag k b_prev]
      have h_not_lt : ¬ k.val < i.val := by omega
      rw [ite_eq_right h_not_lt, one_mul]
    · intro l _ h_li
      rw [M.bareissElimMatrix_apply_of_ne k b_prev i l (Ne.symm h_li)]
      have h_neg : ¬ (k.val < i.val ∧ l = k) := by
        intro ⟨h, _⟩; omega
      rw [ite_eq_right h_neg, zero_mul]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
  · 
    rw [ite_eq_right h_ile]
    have h_ki : k.val < i.val := by omega
    have h_ik_ne : i ≠ k := by
      intro h; rw [h] at h_ki; exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ h_ki
    have h_sum :
        ∑ l, M.bareissElimMatrix k b_prev i l * M.toFn l j =
          (M.toFn k k / b_prev) * M.toFn i j +
            -(M.toFn i k / b_prev) * M.toFn k j := by
      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
      rw [M.bareissElimMatrix_apply_diag k b_prev]
      rw [ite_eq_left h_ki]
      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _
            (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm h_ik_ne, Finset.mem_univ k⟩)]
      rw [M.bareissElimMatrix_apply_of_ne k b_prev i k h_ik_ne]
      have h_elim_k : (if k.val < i.val ∧ k = k then
            -(M.toFn i k / b_prev) else 0) = -(M.toFn i k / b_prev) :=
        ite_eq_left ⟨h_ki, rfl⟩
      rw [h_elim_k]
      have h_rest :
          ∑ l ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i).erase k,
            M.bareissElimMatrix k b_prev i l * M.toFn l j = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro l h_l
        rw [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase] at h_l
        obtain ⟨h_lk, h_li, _⟩ := h_l
        rw [M.bareissElimMatrix_apply_of_ne k b_prev i l (Ne.symm h_li)]
        have h_neg : ¬ (k.val < i.val ∧ l = k) := fun ⟨_, h⟩ => h_lk h
        rw [ite_eq_right h_neg, zero_mul]
      rw [h_rest, add_zero]
    rw [h_sum]
    by_cases h_jk_lt : j.val < k.val
    · 
      rw [ite_eq_left h_jk_lt]
      have h_M_i_j : M.toFn i j = 0 := h_partial i j (by omega) h_jk_lt
      have h_M_k_j : M.toFn k j = 0 := h_partial k j h_jk_lt h_jk_lt
      rw [h_M_i_j, h_M_k_j]
      ring
    · rw [ite_eq_right h_jk_lt]
      by_cases h_jk : j = k
      · 
        rw [ite_eq_left h_jk]
        subst h_jk
        show (0 : K) = M.toFn j j / b_prev * M.toFn i j +
          -(M.toFn i j / b_prev) * M.toFn j j
        field_simp; ring
      · 
        rw [ite_eq_right h_jk]
        show Azurite.ExactDiv.exactDiv
              (M.toFn k k * M.toFn i j - M.toFn i k * M.toFn k j) b_prev =
            M.toFn k k / b_prev * M.toFn i j +
              -(M.toFn i k / b_prev) * M.toFn k j
        show (M.toFn k k * M.toFn i j - M.toFn i k * M.toFn k j) / b_prev = _
        field_simp; ring

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.rank_bareissEliminate
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.rank_bareissEliminate
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Fin n) (b_prev : K)
    (h_pivot : M.toFn k k ≠ 0) (h_b_prev : b_prev ≠ 0)
    (h_partial : M.PartialZero k.val) :
    Matrix.rank (Matrix.of (M.bareissEliminate k b_prev).toFn) =
      Matrix.rank (Matrix.of M.toFn)
proof:
:= by
  rw [M.toFn_bareissEliminate_eq_bareissElimMatrix_mul k b_prev
        h_pivot h_b_prev h_partial]
  exact Matrix.rank_mul_eq_right_of_isUnit_det _ _
    (M.isUnit_det_bareissElimMatrix k b_prev h_pivot h_b_prev)

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.bareissEliminate_preservesDiag
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.bareissEliminate_preservesDiag
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (kp : Fin n) (b_prev : K)
    (i : Fin n) (h_i_lt : i.val < kp.val) :
    (M.bareissEliminate kp b_prev).toFn i i = M.toFn i i
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_bareissEliminate]
  have h_i_le_kp : i.val ≤ kp.val := Nat.le_of_lt h_i_lt
  rw [ite_eq_left h_i_le_kp]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.bareissRankAux_eq_rank_field
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.bareissRankAux_eq_rank_field
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (start : Nat) (b_prev : K)
    (h_start_le : start ≤ n)
    (h_partial : M.PartialZero start)
    (h_diag : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < start → M.toFn i i ≠ 0)
    (h_b_prev : b_prev ≠ 0) :
    M.bareissRankAux start b_prev = Matrix.rank (Matrix.of M.toFn)
proof:
:= by
  induction h_k : n - start using Nat.strong_induction_on
    generalizing M start b_prev
  case _ k ih =>
    rw [AzMatrix.bareissRankAux.eq_def]
    split
    · rename_i h_lt
      set kp : Fin n := ⟨start, by omega⟩
      cases h_pivot : M.findFirstNonzero start start with
      | none =>
        simp only
        symm
        apply M.rank_eq_of_pivoted_zero_below start h_start_le h_partial h_diag
        intro i j h_i_ge h_j_ge
        exact M.findFirstNonzero_eq_none start start h_pivot i j h_i_ge h_j_ge
      | some ij =>
        obtain ⟨i_p, j_p⟩ := ij
        obtain ⟨h_i_ge, h_j_ge, h_pivot_nz⟩ :=
          M.findFirstNonzero_some_mem start start i_p j_p h_pivot
        set M_row := if i_p = kp then M else M.swapRows kp i_p with hM_row
        set M_swapped := if j_p = kp then M_row
          else M_row.swapCols kp j_p with hM_swapped
        set M_new := M_swapped.bareissEliminate kp b_prev with hM_new
        have h_rank_row :
            Matrix.rank (Matrix.of M_row.toFn) =
              Matrix.rank (Matrix.of M.toFn) := by
          by_cases h_eq : i_p = kp
          · rw [hM_row, ite_eq_left h_eq]
          · rw [hM_row, ite_eq_right h_eq]; exact M.rank_swapRows kp i_p
        have h_rank_swapped :
            Matrix.rank (Matrix.of M_swapped.toFn) =
              Matrix.rank (Matrix.of M.toFn) := by
          by_cases h_eq : j_p = kp
          · rw [hM_swapped, ite_eq_left h_eq]; exact h_rank_row
          · rw [hM_swapped, ite_eq_right h_eq]
            rw [M_row.rank_swapCols kp j_p]
            exact h_rank_row
        have h_partial_row : M_row.PartialZero start := by
          by_cases h_eq : i_p = kp
          · rw [hM_row, ite_eq_left h_eq]; exact h_partial
          · rw [hM_row, ite_eq_right h_eq]
            exact M.swapRows_preservesPartialZero start (by omega) h_partial
              i_p h_i_ge
        have h_partial_swapped : M_swapped.PartialZero start := by
          by_cases h_eq : j_p = kp
          · rw [hM_swapped, ite_eq_left h_eq]; exact h_partial_row
          · rw [hM_swapped, ite_eq_right h_eq]
            exact M_row.swapCols_preservesPartialZero start (by omega)
              h_partial_row j_p h_j_ge
        have h_M_swapped_kp_kp : M_swapped.toFn kp kp = M.toFn i_p j_p := by
          by_cases h_jp_kp : j_p = kp
          · rw [hM_swapped, ite_eq_left h_jp_kp]
            by_cases h_ip_kp : i_p = kp
            · rw [hM_row, ite_eq_left h_ip_kp, h_ip_kp, h_jp_kp]
            · rw [hM_row, ite_eq_right h_ip_kp, AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows]
              rw [ite_eq_left rfl, h_jp_kp]
          · rw [hM_swapped, ite_eq_right h_jp_kp, AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols]
            rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
            by_cases h_ip_kp : i_p = kp
            · rw [hM_row, ite_eq_left h_ip_kp, h_ip_kp]
            · rw [hM_row, ite_eq_right h_ip_kp, AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows]
              rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
        have h_M_swapped_kp_kp_nz : M_swapped.toFn kp kp ≠ 0 := by
          rw [h_M_swapped_kp_kp]; exact h_pivot_nz
        have h_diag_swapped : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < start →
            M_swapped.toFn i i ≠ 0 := by
          intro i h_i_lt
          have h_row_eq : M_row.toFn i i = M.toFn i i := by
            by_cases h_eq : i_p = kp
            · rw [hM_row, ite_eq_left h_eq]
            · rw [hM_row, ite_eq_right h_eq]
              exact M.swapRows_preservesDiag kp i_p h_i_ge i
                (by show i.val < kp.val; exact h_i_lt)
          have h_swapped_eq : M_swapped.toFn i i = M_row.toFn i i := by
            by_cases h_eq : j_p = kp
            · rw [hM_swapped, ite_eq_left h_eq]
            · rw [hM_swapped, ite_eq_right h_eq]
              exact M_row.swapCols_preservesDiag kp j_p h_j_ge i
                (by show i.val < kp.val; exact h_i_lt)
          rw [h_swapped_eq, h_row_eq]
          exact h_diag i h_i_lt
        
        have h_partial_new : M_new.PartialZero (start + 1) := by
          rw [hM_new]
          exact M_swapped.bareissEliminate_preservesPartialZero start
            (by omega) b_prev h_partial_swapped
        have h_rank_new :
            Matrix.rank (Matrix.of M_new.toFn) =
              Matrix.rank (Matrix.of M.toFn) := by
          rw [hM_new]
          rw [M_swapped.rank_bareissEliminate kp b_prev h_M_swapped_kp_kp_nz
                h_b_prev h_partial_swapped]
          exact h_rank_swapped
        have h_M_new_kp_kp : M_new.toFn kp kp = M_swapped.toFn kp kp := by
          rw [hM_new, AzMatrix.toFn_bareissEliminate]
          rw [ite_eq_left (le_refl _)]
        have h_diag_new : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < start + 1 →
            M_new.toFn i i ≠ 0 := by
          intro i h_i_lt
          by_cases h_i_eq : i.val = start
          · have h_i_eq_kp : i = kp := Fin.ext h_i_eq
            rw [h_i_eq_kp, h_M_new_kp_kp]
            exact h_M_swapped_kp_kp_nz
          · have h_i_lt' : i.val < start := by omega
            rw [hM_new]
            rw [M_swapped.bareissEliminate_preservesDiag kp b_prev i
                  (by show i.val < kp.val; exact h_i_lt')]
            exact h_diag_swapped i h_i_lt'
        
        
        have h_new_b_prev_nz : M_swapped.get kp kp ≠ 0 := by
          show M_swapped.toFn kp kp ≠ 0
          exact h_M_swapped_kp_kp_nz
        have h_start_le' : start + 1 ≤ n := by omega
        have h_dec : n - (start + 1) < k := by omega
        change M_new.bareissRankAux (start + 1) (M_swapped.get kp kp) =
          (Matrix.of M.toFn).rank
        rw [ih (n - (start + 1)) h_dec M_new (start + 1) (M_swapped.get kp kp)
              h_start_le' h_partial_new h_diag_new h_new_b_prev_nz rfl]
        exact h_rank_new
    · rename_i h_ge
      split
      · rename_i hn
        set kp_last : Fin n := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
        cases h_pivot : M.findFirstNonzero (n - 1) (n - 1) with
        | none =>
          simp only
          symm
          have h_partial' : M.PartialZero (n - 1) := by
            intro i j h_lt_ij h_bnd
            exact h_partial i j h_lt_ij (by omega)
          have h_diag' : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n - 1 → M.toFn i i ≠ 0 := by
            intro i h_i
            exact h_diag i (by omega)
          apply M.rank_eq_of_pivoted_zero_below (n - 1) (by omega)
            h_partial' h_diag'
          intro i j h_i_ge h_j_ge
          exact M.findFirstNonzero_eq_none (n - 1) (n - 1) h_pivot i j
            h_i_ge h_j_ge
        | some ij =>
          obtain ⟨i_p, j_p⟩ := ij
          obtain ⟨h_i_ge, h_j_ge, h_pivot_nz⟩ :=
            M.findFirstNonzero_some_mem (n - 1) (n - 1) i_p j_p h_pivot
          have h_ip : i_p.val = n - 1 := by
            have : i_p.val < n := i_p.isLt; omega
          have h_jp : j_p.val = n - 1 := by
            have : j_p.val < n := j_p.isLt; omega
          have h_kp_last_eq_ip : kp_last = i_p := Fin.ext h_ip.symm
          have h_kp_last_eq_jp : kp_last = j_p := Fin.ext h_jp.symm
          simp only
          symm
          have h_diag_full : ∀ i : Fin n, i.val < n → M.toFn i i ≠ 0 := by
            intro i h_i_lt
            by_cases h_i_lt' : i.val < start
            · exact h_diag i h_i_lt'
            · have h_i_val : i.val = n - 1 := by omega
              have h_i_eq_ip : i = i_p := Fin.ext (h_i_val.trans h_ip.symm)
              have h_i_eq_jp : i = j_p := Fin.ext (h_i_val.trans h_jp.symm)
              have h_pt : M.toFn i i = M.toFn i_p j_p := by
                rw [h_i_eq_ip]
                congr 1
                exact h_i_eq_ip.symm.trans h_i_eq_jp
              rw [h_pt]
              exact h_pivot_nz
          have h_partial_full : M.PartialZero n := by
            intro i j h_lt_ij _
            by_cases h_j_lt_start : j.val < start
            · exact h_partial i j h_lt_ij h_j_lt_start
            · have h_i_lt : i.val < n := i.isLt
              have h_j_lt : j.val < n := j.isLt
              omega
          apply M.rank_eq_of_pivoted_zero_below n (le_refl _)
            h_partial_full h_diag_full
          intro i j h_i_ge _
          have : i.val < n := i.isLt; omega
      · rename_i h_zero_not
        push Not at h_zero_not
        have h_n_eq : n = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp h_zero_not
        subst h_n_eq
        symm
        rw [show Matrix.of M.toFn = (0 : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 0) K) from ?_]
        · exact Matrix.rank_zero
        · funext i
          exact i.elim0

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.algebraMap_exactDiv
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.algebraMap_exactDiv (a b : D) (h_div : b ∣ a) (h_b_ne : b ≠ 0) :
    algebraMap D (FractionRing D) (Azurite.ExactDiv.exactDiv a b) =
      algebraMap D (FractionRing D) a / algebraMap D (FractionRing D) b
proof:
:= by
  have h_law : Azurite.ExactDiv.exactDiv a b * b = a :=
    Azurite.ExactDiv.exactDiv_mul_self a b h_div h_b_ne
  have h_b_K_ne : algebraMap D (FractionRing D) b ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h_inj : Function.Injective (algebraMap D (FractionRing D)) :=
      IsFractionRing.injective D (FractionRing D)
    exact h_b_ne (h_inj (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  rw [eq_div_iff h_b_K_ne]
  rw [← map_mul, h_law]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.bareissEliminate_map_algebraMap_of_sylvester
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.bareissEliminate_map_algebraMap_of_sylvester
    (M : AzMatrix D n n) (kp : Fin n) (b_prev : D)
    (h_b_prev_ne : b_prev ≠ 0)
    (h_sylvester : ∀ i j : Fin n, kp.val < i.val → kp.val < j.val →
      b_prev ∣ (M.toFn kp kp * M.toFn i j - M.toFn i kp * M.toFn kp j)) :
    (M.bareissEliminate kp b_prev).map (algebraMap D (FractionRing D)) =
      (M.map (algebraMap D (FractionRing D))).bareissEliminate kp
        (algebraMap D (FractionRing D) b_prev)
proof:
:= by
  apply AzMatrix.toFn_injective
  funext i j
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_map, AzMatrix.toFn_bareissEliminate,
      AzMatrix.toFn_bareissEliminate]
  simp only [AzMatrix.toFn_map]
  by_cases h_ile : i.val ≤ kp.val
  · rw [ite_eq_left h_ile, ite_eq_left h_ile]
  · rw [ite_eq_right h_ile, ite_eq_right h_ile]
    by_cases h_jlt : j.val < kp.val
    · rw [ite_eq_left h_jlt, ite_eq_left h_jlt]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h_jlt, ite_eq_right h_jlt]
      by_cases h_jeq : j = kp
      · rw [ite_eq_left h_jeq, ite_eq_left h_jeq, map_zero]
      · rw [ite_eq_right h_jeq, ite_eq_right h_jeq]
        
        have h_ki : kp.val < i.val := by omega
        have h_kj : kp.val < j.val := by omega
        have h_div := h_sylvester i j h_ki h_kj
        rw [AzMatrix.algebraMap_exactDiv _ b_prev h_div h_b_prev_ne]
        show algebraMap D (FractionRing D) _ /
              algebraMap D (FractionRing D) b_prev = _
        congr 1
        rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.SylvesterInv_one
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.SylvesterInv_one (M : AzMatrix D n n) :
    M.SylvesterInv 0 1
proof:
:= by
  intro i j _ _ _
  exact one_dvd _

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows_eq_submatrix_gen
statement:
private theorem AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows_eq_submatrix_gen
    (M : AzMatrix D n n) (i₁ i₂ : Fin n) :
    (M.swapRows i₁ i₂).toFn =
      Matrix.submatrix M.toFn (Equiv.swap i₁ i₂) id
proof:
:= by
  funext i j
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows]
  show (if i = i₁ then M.toFn i₂ j
        else if i = i₂ then M.toFn i₁ j
        else M.toFn i j) = M.toFn ((Equiv.swap i₁ i₂) i) j
  by_cases h₁ : i = i₁
  · rw [ite_eq_left h₁, h₁, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
  · by_cases h₂ : i = i₂
    · rw [ite_eq_right h₁, ite_eq_left h₂, h₂, Equiv.swap_apply_right]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h₁, ite_eq_right h₂, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h₁ h₂]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.bareissMinor_swapRows
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.bareissMinor_swapRows
    (M : AzMatrix D n n) (k : Nat) (hk : k ≤ n) (i : Fin n) (h_i_gt : k < i.val)
    (i' j : Fin n) :
    (M.swapRows ⟨k, lt_trans h_i_gt i.isLt⟩ i).bareissMinor k hk i' j =
      M.bareissMinor k hk
        (Equiv.swap (⟨k, lt_trans h_i_gt i.isLt⟩ : Fin n) i i') j
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzMatrix.bareissMinor
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_bareissBlock, AzMatrix.toFn_bareissBlock,
      AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows_eq_submatrix_gen]
  show Matrix.det (Matrix.submatrix M.toFn
      (Equiv.swap _ i ∘ AzMatrix.bareissIdx k hk i')
      (id ∘ AzMatrix.bareissIdx k hk j)) = _
  rw [Function.id_comp]
  rw [AzMatrix.bareissIdx_swap_comp hk i i' h_i_gt]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.principalMinor_swapRows_low_level
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.principalMinor_swapRows_low_level
    (M : AzMatrix D n n) (k : Nat) (hk : k < n) (i : Fin n) (h_ik : k < i.val)
    (ℓ : Nat) (hℓ : ℓ < k) :
    (M.swapRows ⟨k, hk⟩ i).principalMinor ℓ (by omega) =
      M.principalMinor ℓ (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzMatrix.principalMinor_eq_top_left_det,
      AzMatrix.principalMinor_eq_top_left_det]
  congr 1
  funext i' j'
  show (M.swapRows ⟨k, hk⟩ i).toFn
      (Fin.castLE (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (show ℓ < n by omega)) i')
      (Fin.castLE (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (show ℓ < n by omega)) j')
    = M.toFn (Fin.castLE (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (show ℓ < n by omega)) i')
      (Fin.castLE (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (show ℓ < n by omega)) j')
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows]
  set i'_lift : Fin n := Fin.castLE (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (show ℓ < n by omega)) i'
    with hi'_lift
  have h_i'_val : i'_lift.val = i'.val := rfl
  have h_neq_kp : i'_lift ≠ ⟨k, hk⟩ := by
    intro h_eq
    have : i'_lift.val = k := congrArg Fin.val h_eq
    rw [h_i'_val] at this; have := i'.isLt; omega
  have h_neq_i : i'_lift ≠ i := by
    intro h_eq
    have : i'_lift.val = i.val := congrArg Fin.val h_eq
    rw [h_i'_val] at this; have := i'.isLt; omega
  rw [ite_eq_right h_neq_kp, ite_eq_right h_neq_i]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.swapRows_preservesPartialZero_gen
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.swapRows_preservesPartialZero_gen
    (M : AzMatrix D n n) (start : Nat) (h_lt : start < n)
    (h_inv : M.PartialZero start) (i_p : Fin n) (h_i_ge : start ≤ i_p.val) :
    (M.swapRows ⟨start, h_lt⟩ i_p).PartialZero start
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h_lt_ij h_bnd
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows]
  by_cases h_i_kp : i = ⟨start, h_lt⟩
  · rw [ite_eq_left h_i_kp]
    apply h_inv i_p j
    · have h_j_lt : j.val < start := h_bnd
      omega
    · exact h_bnd
  · by_cases h_i_iₚ : i = i_p
    · rw [ite_eq_right h_i_kp, ite_eq_left h_i_iₚ]
      apply h_inv ⟨start, h_lt⟩ j h_bnd h_bnd
    · rw [ite_eq_right h_i_kp, ite_eq_right h_i_iₚ]
      exact h_inv i j h_lt_ij h_bnd

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.BareissInv.swapRows_preserves
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.BareissInv.swapRows_preserves
    {M_curr M_ref : AzMatrix D n n} {start : Nat} {b_prev : D}
    (h_inv : M_curr.BareissInv M_ref start b_prev)
    (h_lt : start < n) (i_p : Fin n) (h_i_ge : start ≤ i_p.val) :
    (M_curr.swapRows ⟨start, h_lt⟩ i_p).BareissInv
      (M_ref.swapRows ⟨start, h_lt⟩ i_p) start b_prev
proof:
:= by
  set kp : Fin n := ⟨start, h_lt⟩ with hkp
  by_cases h_eq : i_p = kp
  · subst h_eq
    show (M_curr.swapRows kp kp).BareissInv (M_ref.swapRows kp kp) start b_prev
    have h_id_curr : M_curr.swapRows kp kp = M_curr := by
      apply AzMatrix.toFn_injective
      funext i j
      rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows]
      by_cases h : i = kp
      · rw [ite_eq_left h, h]
      · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right h]
    have h_id_ref : M_ref.swapRows kp kp = M_ref := by
      apply AzMatrix.toFn_injective
      funext i j
      rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows]
      by_cases h : i = kp
      · rw [ite_eq_left h, h]
      · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right h]
    rw [h_id_curr, h_id_ref]
    exact h_inv
  · 
    have h_i_gt : start < i_p.val := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h_i_ge with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd (Fin.ext h.symm : i_p = kp) h_eq
    refine ⟨h_inv.start_le_pred, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact M_curr.swapRows_preservesPartialZero_gen start h_lt h_inv.partialZero
        i_p h_i_ge
    · intro i j hi hj
      rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows]
      rw [M_ref.bareissMinor_swapRows start h_inv.start_le i_p h_i_gt i j]
      by_cases h_i_eq : i = kp
      · rw [ite_eq_left h_i_eq, h_i_eq, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
        exact h_inv.bareiss i_p j h_i_ge hj
      · by_cases h_i_eq' : i = i_p
        · rw [ite_eq_right h_i_eq, ite_eq_left h_i_eq', h_i_eq', Equiv.swap_apply_right]
          exact h_inv.bareiss kp j (le_refl _) hj
        · rw [ite_eq_right h_i_eq, ite_eq_right h_i_eq']
          rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h_i_eq h_i_eq']
          exact h_inv.bareiss i j hi hj
    · 
      by_cases hs : 0 < start
      · simp only [dite_eq_left hs]
        have h_bp := h_inv.b_prev_eq
        simp only [dite_eq_left hs] at h_bp
        have h_pm_eq := M_ref.principalMinor_swapRows_low_level start h_lt i_p
          h_i_gt (start - 1) (by omega)
        exact h_bp.trans h_pm_eq.symm
      · simp only [dite_eq_right hs]
        have h_bp := h_inv.b_prev_eq
        simp only [dite_eq_right hs] at h_bp
        exact h_bp
    · intro ℓ hℓ h
      rw [M_ref.principalMinor_swapRows_low_level start h_lt i_p h_i_gt ℓ hℓ]
      exact h_inv.principalMinors_nz ℓ hℓ h

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.BareissInv.swapCols_preserves
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.BareissInv.swapCols_preserves
    {M_curr M_ref : AzMatrix D n n} {start : Nat} {b_prev : D}
    (h_inv : M_curr.BareissInv M_ref start b_prev)
    (h_lt : start < n) (j_p : Fin n) (h_j_ge : start ≤ j_p.val) :
    (M_curr.swapCols ⟨start, h_lt⟩ j_p).BareissInv
      (M_ref.swapCols ⟨start, h_lt⟩ j_p) start b_prev
proof:
:= by
  set kp : Fin n := ⟨start, h_lt⟩ with hkp
  by_cases h_eq : j_p = kp
  · subst h_eq
    have h_id_curr : M_curr.swapCols kp kp = M_curr := by
      apply AzMatrix.toFn_injective
      funext i j
      rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols]
      by_cases h : j = kp
      · rw [ite_eq_left h, h]
      · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right h]
    have h_id_ref : M_ref.swapCols kp kp = M_ref := by
      apply AzMatrix.toFn_injective
      funext i j
      rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols]
      by_cases h : j = kp
      · rw [ite_eq_left h, h]
      · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right h]
    rw [h_id_curr, h_id_ref]
    exact h_inv
  · 
    have h_j_gt : start < j_p.val := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h_j_ge with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd (Fin.ext h.symm : j_p = kp) h_eq
    refine ⟨h_inv.start_le_pred, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact M_curr.swapCols_preservesPartialZero start h_lt h_inv.partialZero
        j_p h_j_ge
    · intro i j hi hj
      rw [AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols]
      rw [M_ref.bareissMinor_swapCols start h_inv.start_le j_p h_j_gt i j]
      by_cases h_j_eq : j = kp
      · rw [ite_eq_left h_j_eq, h_j_eq, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
        exact h_inv.bareiss i j_p hi h_j_ge
      · by_cases h_j_eq' : j = j_p
        · rw [ite_eq_right h_j_eq, ite_eq_left h_j_eq', h_j_eq', Equiv.swap_apply_right]
          exact h_inv.bareiss i kp hi (le_refl _)
        · rw [ite_eq_right h_j_eq, ite_eq_right h_j_eq']
          rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h_j_eq h_j_eq']
          exact h_inv.bareiss i j hi hj
    · by_cases hs : 0 < start
      · simp only [dite_eq_left hs]
        have h_bp := h_inv.b_prev_eq
        simp only [dite_eq_left hs] at h_bp
        have h_pm_eq := M_ref.principalMinor_swapCols_low_level start h_lt j_p
          h_j_gt (start - 1) (by omega)
        exact h_bp.trans h_pm_eq.symm
      · simp only [dite_eq_right hs]
        have h_bp := h_inv.b_prev_eq
        simp only [dite_eq_right hs] at h_bp
        exact h_bp
    · intro ℓ hℓ h
      rw [M_ref.principalMinor_swapCols_low_level start h_lt j_p h_j_gt ℓ hℓ]
      exact h_inv.principalMinors_nz ℓ hℓ h

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.BareissInv.sylvester
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.BareissInv.sylvester
    {M_curr M_ref : AzMatrix D n n} {start : Nat} {b_prev : D}
    (h_inv : M_curr.BareissInv M_ref start b_prev)
    (h_lt : start + 1 < n)
    (h_pivot_nz : M_curr.toFn ⟨start, by omega⟩ ⟨start, by omega⟩ ≠ 0) :
    ∀ i j : Fin n, start < i.val → start < j.val →
      b_prev ∣ M_curr.toFn ⟨start, by omega⟩ ⟨start, by omega⟩ *
                  M_curr.toFn i j -
                M_curr.toFn i ⟨start, by omega⟩ *
                  M_curr.toFn ⟨start, by omega⟩ j
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hi hj
  set kp : Fin n := ⟨start, by omega⟩ with hkp
  rw [h_inv.bareiss kp kp (le_refl _) (le_refl _),
      h_inv.bareiss i j (le_of_lt hi) (le_of_lt hj),
      h_inv.bareiss i kp (le_of_lt hi) (le_refl _),
      h_inv.bareiss kp j (le_refl _) (le_of_lt hj)]
  
  by_cases h_start_zero : start = 0
  · 
    have h_b_prev_one : b_prev = 1 := by
      have h_be := h_inv.b_prev_eq
      simp only [h_start_zero, Nat.lt_irrefl, dite_false] at h_be
      exact h_be
    subst h_b_prev_one
    exact one_dvd _
  · 
    have h_start_pos : 0 < start := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h_start_zero
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero h_start_zero
    have h_b_prev_eq : b_prev = M_ref.principalMinor k (by omega) := by
      have h_be := h_inv.b_prev_eq
      simp only [show 0 < k + 1 from by omega, dite_eq_left] at h_be
      have h_sub : (k + 1) - 1 = k := by omega
      have : b_prev = M_ref.principalMinor ((k + 1) - 1) (by omega) := h_be
      simp only [h_sub] at this
      exact this
    
    have h_kp_pm : M_curr.toFn kp kp = M_ref.principalMinor (k + 1) (by omega) := by
      rw [h_inv.bareiss kp kp (le_refl _) (le_refl _)]
      rfl
    have h_pm_kp_nz : M_ref.principalMinor (k + 1) (by omega) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← h_kp_pm]; exact h_pivot_nz
    have h_pms : ∀ ℓ : Nat, ℓ ≤ k + 1 → (h : ℓ < n) →
        M_ref.principalMinor ℓ h ≠ 0 := by
      intro ℓ hℓ h
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hℓ with hℓ' | hℓ'
      · exact h_inv.principalMinors_nz ℓ hℓ' h
      · subst hℓ'; exact h_pm_kp_nz
    have h_rec := M_ref.bareissMinor_recurrence_domain k i j
      (by omega) (by omega) h_pms
    
    use M_ref.bareissMinor (k + 2) (by omega) i j
    
    
    
    have h_target_eq :
        M_ref.bareissMinor (k + 1) h_inv.start_le kp kp =
          M_ref.principalMinor (k + 1) (by omega) := rfl
    rw [h_target_eq]
    have : b_prev * M_ref.bareissMinor (k + 2) (by omega) i j =
        M_ref.bareissMinor (k + 2) (by omega) i j * M_ref.principalMinor k (by omega) := by
      rw [h_b_prev_eq]; ring
    rw [this, h_rec]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.map_swapRows
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.map_swapRows {E : Type _} (f : D → E)
    (M : AzMatrix D n n) (i j : Fin n) :
    (M.swapRows i j).map f = (M.map f).swapRows i j
proof:
:= by
  apply AzMatrix.toFn_injective
  funext r c
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_map, AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows, AzMatrix.toFn_swapRows]
  by_cases h₁ : r = i
  · rw [ite_eq_left h₁, ite_eq_left h₁, AzMatrix.toFn_map]
  · by_cases h₂ : r = j
    · rw [ite_eq_right h₁, ite_eq_left h₂, ite_eq_right h₁, ite_eq_left h₂, AzMatrix.toFn_map]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h₁, ite_eq_right h₂, ite_eq_right h₁, ite_eq_right h₂, AzMatrix.toFn_map]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.map_swapCols
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.map_swapCols {E : Type _} (f : D → E)
    (M : AzMatrix D n n) (i j : Fin n) :
    (M.swapCols i j).map f = (M.map f).swapCols i j
proof:
:= by
  apply AzMatrix.toFn_injective
  funext r c
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_map, AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols, AzMatrix.toFn_swapCols]
  by_cases h₁ : c = i
  · rw [ite_eq_left h₁, ite_eq_left h₁, AzMatrix.toFn_map]
  · by_cases h₂ : c = j
    · rw [ite_eq_right h₁, ite_eq_left h₂, ite_eq_right h₁, ite_eq_left h₂, AzMatrix.toFn_map]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h₁, ite_eq_right h₂, ite_eq_right h₁, ite_eq_right h₂, AzMatrix.toFn_map]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.findFirstNonzeroAux_some_mem_gen
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.findFirstNonzeroAux_some_mem_gen
    (M : AzMatrix D n n) (c_start : Nat) :
    ∀ (i : Nat) (i' j' : Fin n),
      M.findFirstNonzeroAux i c_start = some (i', j') →
        i ≤ i'.val ∧ c_start ≤ j'.val ∧ M.toFn i' j' ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i i' j'
  apply AzMatrix.findFirstNonzeroAux.induct M c_start
    (motive := fun i => ∀ i' j' : Fin n,
      M.findFirstNonzeroAux i c_start = some (i', j') →
        i ≤ i'.val ∧ c_start ≤ j'.val ∧ M.toFn i' j' ≠ 0)
  · intro i h_lt j h_match i' j' h_rec
    rw [AzMatrix.findFirstNonzeroAux.eq_def] at h_rec
    simp only [dite_eq_left h_lt, h_match, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h_rec
    obtain ⟨h_i', h_j'⟩ := h_rec
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← h_i']
    · rw [← h_j']
      exact M.findPivotAux_some_le ⟨i, h_lt⟩ c_start j h_match
    · rw [← h_i', ← h_j']
