name: Azurite.AzMatrix.bareissIdx_val_of_lt
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.bareissIdx_val_of_lt {k : Nat} (hk : k ≤ n) (i : Fin n)
    (l' : Fin (k + 1)) (h : l'.val < k) :
    AzMatrix.bareissIdx k hk i l' = ⟨l'.val, lt_of_lt_of_le h hk⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq : l' = (⟨l'.val, h⟩ : Fin k).castSucc := by ext; rfl
  conv_lhs => rw [h_eq]
  unfold AzMatrix.bareissIdx
  rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.bareissIdx_of_val_eq
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.bareissIdx_of_val_eq {k : Nat} (hk : k ≤ n) (i : Fin n)
    (l' : Fin (k + 1)) (h : l'.val = k) :
    AzMatrix.bareissIdx k hk i l' = i
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [show l' = Fin.last k by ext; exact h]
  unfold AzMatrix.bareissIdx
  rw [Fin.snoc_last]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.gaussSteps_bareissBlock_toFn
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.gaussSteps_bareissBlock_toFn [Field K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Nat) (hk : k ≤ n) (i j : Fin n)
    (hi : k ≤ i.val) (hj : k ≤ j.val) :
    ∀ ℓ : Nat, ℓ ≤ k → ∀ l' m' : Fin (k + 1),
      ((M.bareissBlock k hk i j).gaussSteps ℓ).toFn l' m' =
        (M.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn
          (AzMatrix.bareissIdx k hk i l')
          (AzMatrix.bareissIdx k hk j m')
proof:
:= by
  intro ℓ hℓ
  induction ℓ with
  | zero =>
    intro l' m'
    rw [AzMatrix.gaussSteps_zero, AzMatrix.gaussSteps_zero]
    show (M.bareissBlock k hk i j).toFn l' m' = _
    rw [AzMatrix.toFn_bareissBlock]
    rfl
  | succ ℓ ih =>
    intro l' m'
    have hℓ_lt_k : ℓ < k := by omega
    have hℓ_lt_succk : ℓ < k + 1 := by omega
    have hℓ_lt_n : ℓ < n := lt_of_lt_of_le hℓ_lt_k hk
    rw [AzMatrix.gaussSteps_succ _ _ hℓ_lt_succk]
    rw [AzMatrix.gaussSteps_succ _ _ hℓ_lt_n]
    rw [AzMatrix.toFn_eliminateBelow, AzMatrix.toFn_eliminateBelow]
    
    have ih' := ih (by omega)
    
    have h_pivot_block : AzMatrix.bareissIdx k hk i ⟨ℓ, hℓ_lt_succk⟩ =
        ⟨ℓ, hℓ_lt_n⟩ := AzMatrix.bareissIdx_val_of_lt hk i ⟨ℓ, hℓ_lt_succk⟩ hℓ_lt_k
    have h_pivot_block_j : AzMatrix.bareissIdx k hk j ⟨ℓ, hℓ_lt_succk⟩ =
        ⟨ℓ, hℓ_lt_n⟩ := AzMatrix.bareissIdx_val_of_lt hk j ⟨ℓ, hℓ_lt_succk⟩ hℓ_lt_k
    
    have h_l'_le_iff : l'.val ≤ ℓ ↔
        (AzMatrix.bareissIdx k hk i l').val ≤ ℓ := by
      by_cases h_l' : l'.val < k
      · rw [AzMatrix.bareissIdx_val_of_lt hk i l' h_l']
      · have h_l'_eq : l'.val = k := by have := l'.isLt; omega
        rw [AzMatrix.bareissIdx_of_val_eq hk i l' h_l'_eq]
        constructor
        · intro h
          rw [h_l'_eq] at h
          omega
        · intro h
          have : i.val ≤ ℓ := h
          omega
    have h_m'_lt_iff : m'.val < ℓ ↔
        (AzMatrix.bareissIdx k hk j m').val < ℓ := by
      by_cases h_m' : m'.val < k
      · rw [AzMatrix.bareissIdx_val_of_lt hk j m' h_m']
      · have h_m'_eq : m'.val = k := by have := m'.isLt; omega
        rw [AzMatrix.bareissIdx_of_val_eq hk j m' h_m'_eq]
        constructor
        · intro h
          rw [h_m'_eq] at h
          omega
        · intro h
          have : j.val < ℓ := h
          omega
    have h_m'_eq_iff : m' = ⟨ℓ, hℓ_lt_succk⟩ ↔
        AzMatrix.bareissIdx k hk j m' = ⟨ℓ, hℓ_lt_n⟩ := by
      by_cases h_m' : m'.val < k
      · rw [AzMatrix.bareissIdx_val_of_lt hk j m' h_m']
        constructor
        · intro h
          have h_val : m'.val = ℓ := congrArg Fin.val h
          apply Fin.ext
          exact h_val
        · intro h
          have h_val : m'.val = ℓ := congrArg Fin.val h
          apply Fin.ext
          exact h_val
      · have h_m'_eq : m'.val = k := by have := m'.isLt; omega
        rw [AzMatrix.bareissIdx_of_val_eq hk j m' h_m'_eq]
        constructor
        · intro h
          have : m'.val = ℓ := congrArg Fin.val h
          omega
        · intro h
          have : j.val = ℓ := congrArg Fin.val h
          omega
    
    by_cases h_l'_le : l'.val ≤ ℓ
    · rw [ite_eq_left h_l'_le, ite_eq_left (h_l'_le_iff.mp h_l'_le)]
      exact ih' l' m'
    · rw [ite_eq_right h_l'_le, ite_eq_right (fun h => h_l'_le ((h_l'_le_iff.mpr h)))]
      by_cases h_m'_lt : m'.val < ℓ
      · rw [ite_eq_left h_m'_lt, ite_eq_left (h_m'_lt_iff.mp h_m'_lt)]
        exact ih' l' m'
      · rw [ite_eq_right h_m'_lt, ite_eq_right (fun h => h_m'_lt (h_m'_lt_iff.mpr h))]
        by_cases h_m'_eq : m' = ⟨ℓ, hℓ_lt_succk⟩
        · rw [ite_eq_left h_m'_eq, ite_eq_left (h_m'_eq_iff.mp h_m'_eq)]
        · rw [ite_eq_right h_m'_eq, ite_eq_right (fun h => h_m'_eq (h_m'_eq_iff.mpr h))]
          
          rw [ih' l' m']
          rw [ih' l' ⟨ℓ, hℓ_lt_succk⟩]
          rw [ih' ⟨ℓ, hℓ_lt_succk⟩ ⟨ℓ, hℓ_lt_succk⟩]
          rw [ih' ⟨ℓ, hℓ_lt_succk⟩ m']
          rw [h_pivot_block, h_pivot_block_j]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.gaussSteps_partialZero
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.gaussSteps_partialZero [Field K] (M : AzMatrix K n n) (ℓ : Nat) :
    ∀ i j : Fin n, j.val < i.val → j.val < ℓ →
      (M.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction ℓ with
  | zero => intros _ _ _ h_bnd; omega
  | succ ℓ ih =>
    intro i j h_lt_ij h_bnd
    by_cases h_ℓ_lt : ℓ < n
    · rw [AzMatrix.gaussSteps_succ _ _ h_ℓ_lt]
      rw [AzMatrix.toFn_eliminateBelow]
      by_cases h_i_le : i.val ≤ ℓ
      · rw [ite_eq_left h_i_le]
        exact ih i j h_lt_ij (by omega)
      · rw [ite_eq_right h_i_le]
        by_cases h_j_lt : j.val < ℓ
        · rw [ite_eq_left h_j_lt]
          exact ih i j h_lt_ij h_j_lt
        · rw [ite_eq_right h_j_lt]
          have h_j_eq : j.val = ℓ := by omega
          have h_j_kp : j = ⟨ℓ, h_ℓ_lt⟩ := Fin.ext h_j_eq
          rw [ite_eq_left h_j_kp]
    · rw [AzMatrix.gaussSteps_of_ge _ _ h_ℓ_lt]
      exact ih i j h_lt_ij (by omega)

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.gaussSteps_row_unchanged
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.gaussSteps_row_unchanged [Field K] (M : AzMatrix K n n)
    (ℓ : Nat) (hℓ : ℓ < n) :
    ∀ k : Nat, ℓ ≤ k → ∀ j : Fin n,
      (M.gaussSteps k).toFn ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ j = (M.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ j
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro h_ge j
    have hℓ_eq : ℓ = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp h_ge
    subst hℓ_eq
    rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    intro h_ge j
    by_cases h_eq : ℓ = k + 1
    · rw [← h_eq]
    · have h_le_k : ℓ ≤ k := by omega
      by_cases hk_lt : k < n
      · rw [AzMatrix.gaussSteps_succ _ _ hk_lt]
        rw [AzMatrix.toFn_eliminateBelow]
        have hle : (⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ : Fin n).val ≤ k := h_le_k
        rw [ite_eq_left hle]
        exact ih h_le_k j
      · rw [AzMatrix.gaussSteps_of_ge _ _ hk_lt]
        exact ih h_le_k j

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.gaussSteps_diag_stable
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.gaussSteps_diag_stable [Field K] (M : AzMatrix K n n)
    (ℓ k : Nat) (hℓk : ℓ ≤ k) (hℓ : ℓ < n) :
    (M.gaussSteps k).toFn ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ =
      (M.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩
proof:
:=
  M.gaussSteps_row_unchanged ℓ hℓ k hℓk ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.det_gaussSteps
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.det_gaussSteps [Field K] (M : AzMatrix K n n) :
    ∀ ℓ : Nat,
      (∀ k' : Nat, k' < ℓ → (h : k' < n) →
        (M.gaussSteps k').toFn ⟨k', h⟩ ⟨k', h⟩ ≠ 0) →
      Matrix.det (M.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn = Matrix.det M.toFn
proof:
:= by
  intro ℓ
  induction ℓ with
  | zero =>
    intro _; rw [AzMatrix.gaussSteps_zero]
  | succ ℓ ih =>
    intro h_pivots
    by_cases h_ℓ_lt : ℓ < n
    · rw [AzMatrix.gaussSteps_succ _ _ h_ℓ_lt]
      have h_pivot_nz :
          (M.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn ⟨ℓ, h_ℓ_lt⟩ ⟨ℓ, h_ℓ_lt⟩ ≠ 0 :=
        h_pivots ℓ (Nat.lt_succ_self _) h_ℓ_lt
      have h_row_zeros : ∀ j' : Fin n, j'.val < (⟨ℓ, h_ℓ_lt⟩ : Fin n).val →
          (M.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn ⟨ℓ, h_ℓ_lt⟩ j' = 0 := by
        intro j' h_j_lt
        exact M.gaussSteps_partialZero ℓ ⟨ℓ, h_ℓ_lt⟩ j' h_j_lt h_j_lt
      rw [AzMatrix.det_eliminateBelow _ _ h_pivot_nz h_row_zeros]
      exact ih (fun k' hk' h => h_pivots k' (by omega) h)
    · rw [AzMatrix.gaussSteps_of_ge _ _ h_ℓ_lt]
      exact ih (fun k' hk' h => h_pivots k' (by omega) h)

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.gaussSteps_blockTriangular
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.gaussSteps_blockTriangular [Field K]
    (M : AzMatrix K (k + 1) (k + 1)) :
    Matrix.BlockTriangular (M.gaussSteps k).toFn id
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h_lt
  have h_j_lt : j.val < i.val := h_lt
  have h_j_lt_k : j.val < k := by
    have h_i_lt : i.val < k + 1 := i.isLt
    omega
  exact M.gaussSteps_partialZero k i j h_j_lt h_j_lt_k

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.bareissMinor_eq_prod_pivots_times_gaussSteps
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.bareissMinor_eq_prod_pivots_times_gaussSteps
    [Field K] [DecidableEq K] (M : AzMatrix K n n)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k < n) (i j : Fin n) (hi : k ≤ i.val) (hj : k ≤ j.val)
    (h_pivots : ∀ ℓ : Nat, ℓ < k → (h : ℓ < n) →
      (M.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ≠ 0) :
    M.bareissMinor k (le_of_lt hk) i j =
      (∏ ℓ : Fin (k + 1),
        if hℓ : ℓ.val < k then
          (M.gaussSteps ℓ.val).toFn
            ⟨ℓ.val, lt_of_lt_of_le hℓ (le_of_lt hk)⟩
            ⟨ℓ.val, lt_of_lt_of_le hℓ (le_of_lt hk)⟩
        else
          (M.gaussSteps k).toFn i j)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  
  
  unfold AzMatrix.bareissMinor
  set B := M.bareissBlock k (le_of_lt hk) i j with hB
  
  have h_block_pivots : ∀ ℓ : Nat, ℓ < k → (h : ℓ < k + 1) →
      (B.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ≠ 0 := by
    intro ℓ hℓk hℓ_succk
    have hℓ_n : ℓ < n := lt_of_lt_of_le hℓk (le_of_lt hk)
    have h_corr := M.gaussSteps_bareissBlock_toFn k (le_of_lt hk) i j hi hj
      ℓ (le_of_lt hℓk) ⟨ℓ, hℓ_succk⟩ ⟨ℓ, hℓ_succk⟩
    rw [hB.symm] at h_corr
    rw [h_corr]
    rw [AzMatrix.bareissIdx_val_of_lt (le_of_lt hk) i ⟨ℓ, hℓ_succk⟩ hℓk]
    rw [AzMatrix.bareissIdx_val_of_lt (le_of_lt hk) j ⟨ℓ, hℓ_succk⟩ hℓk]
    exact h_pivots ℓ hℓk hℓ_n
  have h_det_block : Matrix.det (B.gaussSteps k).toFn = Matrix.det B.toFn :=
    B.det_gaussSteps k h_block_pivots
  rw [← h_det_block]
  
  rw [Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular B.gaussSteps_blockTriangular]
  
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro ℓ _
  by_cases hℓ : ℓ.val < k
  · rw [dite_eq_left hℓ]
    have hℓ_n : ℓ.val < n := lt_of_lt_of_le hℓ (le_of_lt hk)
    have h_corr := M.gaussSteps_bareissBlock_toFn k (le_of_lt hk) i j hi hj
      k (le_refl k) ⟨ℓ.val, ℓ.isLt⟩ ⟨ℓ.val, ℓ.isLt⟩
    rw [hB.symm] at h_corr
    rw [h_corr]
    rw [AzMatrix.bareissIdx_val_of_lt (le_of_lt hk) i ⟨ℓ.val, ℓ.isLt⟩ hℓ]
    rw [AzMatrix.bareissIdx_val_of_lt (le_of_lt hk) j ⟨ℓ.val, ℓ.isLt⟩ hℓ]
    
    
    exact M.gaussSteps_diag_stable ℓ.val k hℓ.le hℓ_n
  · rw [dite_eq_right hℓ]
    have h_ℓ_eq : ℓ.val = k := by
      have := ℓ.isLt
      omega
    have h_corr := M.gaussSteps_bareissBlock_toFn k (le_of_lt hk) i j hi hj
      k (le_refl k) ⟨ℓ.val, ℓ.isLt⟩ ⟨ℓ.val, ℓ.isLt⟩
    rw [hB.symm] at h_corr
    rw [h_corr]
    rw [AzMatrix.bareissIdx_of_val_eq (le_of_lt hk) i ⟨ℓ.val, ℓ.isLt⟩ h_ℓ_eq]
    rw [AzMatrix.bareissIdx_of_val_eq (le_of_lt hk) j ⟨ℓ.val, ℓ.isLt⟩ h_ℓ_eq]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.pivotProd_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AzMatrix.pivotProd_zero [Field K] (M : AzMatrix K n n) :
    M.pivotProd 0 (Nat.zero_le n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [AzMatrix.pivotProd]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.pivotProd_succ
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.pivotProd_succ [Field K] (M : AzMatrix K n n)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k < n) :
    M.pivotProd (k + 1) hk =
      M.pivotProd k hk.le * (M.gaussSteps k).toFn ⟨k, hk⟩ ⟨k, hk⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzMatrix.pivotProd
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.bareissMinor_eq_pivotProd_mul_gaussSteps
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.bareissMinor_eq_pivotProd_mul_gaussSteps
    [Field K] [DecidableEq K] (M : AzMatrix K n n)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k < n) (i j : Fin n) (hi : k ≤ i.val) (hj : k ≤ j.val)
    (h_pivots : ∀ ℓ : Nat, ℓ < k → (h : ℓ < n) →
      (M.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ≠ 0) :
    M.bareissMinor k (le_of_lt hk) i j =
      M.pivotProd k hk.le * (M.gaussSteps k).toFn i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [M.bareissMinor_eq_prod_pivots_times_gaussSteps k hk i j hi hj h_pivots]
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro ℓ _
    have h_lt : ℓ.castSucc.val < k := ℓ.isLt
    rw [dite_eq_left h_lt]
    rfl
  · have h_not_lt : ¬ (Fin.last k).val < k := by simp
    rw [dite_eq_right h_not_lt]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.principalMinor_eq_pivotProd
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.principalMinor_eq_pivotProd
    [Field K] [DecidableEq K] (M : AzMatrix K n n)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k < n)
    (h_pivots : ∀ ℓ : Nat, ℓ < k → (h : ℓ < n) →
      (M.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ≠ 0) :
    M.principalMinor k hk = M.pivotProd (k + 1) hk
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzMatrix.principalMinor
  rw [M.bareissMinor_eq_pivotProd_mul_gaussSteps k hk ⟨k, hk⟩ ⟨k, hk⟩
      (le_refl k) (le_refl k) h_pivots]
  rw [M.pivotProd_succ k hk]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.gaussSteps_succ_apply
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.gaussSteps_succ_apply [Field K]
    (M : AzMatrix K n n) (k : Nat) (hk : k < n) (i j : Fin n)
    (hi : k < i.val) (hj : k < j.val) :
    (M.gaussSteps (k + 1)).toFn i j =
      (M.gaussSteps k).toFn i j -
        ((M.gaussSteps k).toFn i ⟨k, hk⟩ /
          (M.gaussSteps k).toFn ⟨k, hk⟩ ⟨k, hk⟩) *
        (M.gaussSteps k).toFn ⟨k, hk⟩ j
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzMatrix.gaussSteps_succ _ _ hk]
  rw [AzMatrix.toFn_eliminateBelow]
  have h_not_i_le : ¬ i.val ≤ k := by omega
  rw [ite_eq_right h_not_i_le]
  have h_not_j_lt : ¬ j.val < k := by omega
  rw [ite_eq_right h_not_j_lt]
  have h_j_ne : j ≠ ⟨k, hk⟩ := by
    intro heq
    have h : j.val = k := by rw [heq]
    omega
  rw [ite_eq_right h_j_ne]

name: Azurite.AzMatrix.bareissMinor_recurrence
statement:
theorem AzMatrix.bareissMinor_recurrence
    [Field K] [DecidableEq K] (M : AzMatrix K n n)
    (k : Nat) (i j : Fin n) (hi : k + 2 ≤ i.val) (hj : k + 2 ≤ j.val)
    (h_pivots : ∀ ℓ : Nat, ℓ ≤ k + 1 → (h : ℓ < n) →
      (M.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ≠ 0) :
    M.bareissMinor (k + 2) (by have := i.isLt; omega) i j *
        M.principalMinor k (by have := i.isLt; omega) =
      M.principalMinor (k + 1) (by have := i.isLt; omega) *
          M.bareissMinor (k + 1) (by have := i.isLt; omega) i j -
        M.bareissMinor (k + 1) (by have := i.isLt; omega) i
          ⟨k + 1, by have
proof:
:= i.isLt; omega⟩ *
          M.bareissMinor (k + 1) (by have := i.isLt; omega)
            ⟨k + 1, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩ j := by
  have hi_lt : i.val < n := i.isLt
  have hkp2_lt_n : k + 2 < n + 1 := by omega
  have hkp2_le_n : k + 2 ≤ n := by omega
  have hk1_lt_n : k + 1 < n := by omega
  have hk_lt_n : k < n := by omega
  
  have h_piv_kp2 : ∀ ℓ : Nat, ℓ < k + 2 → (h : ℓ < n) →
      (M.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ≠ 0 :=
    fun ℓ hℓ h => h_pivots ℓ (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hℓ) h
  have h_piv_kp1 : ∀ ℓ : Nat, ℓ < k + 1 → (h : ℓ < n) →
      (M.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ≠ 0 :=
    fun ℓ hℓ h => h_pivots ℓ (by omega) h
  have h_piv_k : ∀ ℓ : Nat, ℓ < k → (h : ℓ < n) →
      (M.gaussSteps ℓ).toFn ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ⟨ℓ, h⟩ ≠ 0 :=
    fun ℓ hℓ h => h_pivots ℓ (by omega) h
  have h_pivot_kp1 :
      (M.gaussSteps (k + 1)).toFn ⟨k + 1, hk1_lt_n⟩ ⟨k + 1, hk1_lt_n⟩ ≠ 0 :=
    h_pivots (k + 1) (le_refl _) hk1_lt_n
  
  have hkp2_lt_n' : k + 2 < n := by omega
  rw [M.bareissMinor_eq_pivotProd_mul_gaussSteps (k + 2) hkp2_lt_n' i j
      (by omega) (by omega) h_piv_kp2]
  rw [M.principalMinor_eq_pivotProd k hk_lt_n h_piv_k]
  rw [M.principalMinor_eq_pivotProd (k + 1) hk1_lt_n h_piv_kp1]
  rw [M.bareissMinor_eq_pivotProd_mul_gaussSteps (k + 1) hk1_lt_n i j
      (by omega) (by omega) h_piv_kp1]
  rw [M.bareissMinor_eq_pivotProd_mul_gaussSteps (k + 1) hk1_lt_n i
      ⟨k + 1, hk1_lt_n⟩ (by omega) (Nat.le_refl _) h_piv_kp1]
  rw [M.bareissMinor_eq_pivotProd_mul_gaussSteps (k + 1) hk1_lt_n
      ⟨k + 1, hk1_lt_n⟩ j (Nat.le_refl _) (by omega) h_piv_kp1]
  
  rw [show M.pivotProd (k + 2) hkp2_lt_n'.le =
      M.pivotProd ((k + 1) + 1) hkp2_lt_n'.le from rfl]
  rw [M.pivotProd_succ (k + 1) hk1_lt_n]
  
  rw [M.gaussSteps_succ_apply (k + 1) hk1_lt_n i j (by omega) (by omega)]
  
  field_simp

name: Azurite.gramSchmidt_eq_foldl
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.gsProj_eq
statement:
private theorem gsProj_eq (acc : List (AzVector R n)) (v : AzVector R n) :
    gsProj acc v = v - (acc.map (fun w => (v.dot w / w.normSq : R) • w)).sum
proof:
:= by
  unfold gsProj
  
  suffices h : ∀ (l : List (AzVector R n)) (init : AzVector R n),
      l.foldl (fun u w => u - ((v.dot w / w.normSq : R) • w)) init =
        init - (l.map (fun w => (v.dot w / w.normSq : R) • w)).sum by
    simpa using h acc v
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro init; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro init
    rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    abel

name: Azurite.dot_comm
statement: private theorem dot_comm (v w : AzVector R n) : v.dot w = w.dot v
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzVector.dot_eq_dotProduct, AzVector.dot_eq_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm]

name: Azurite.toFn_list_sum
statement:
private theorem toFn_list_sum (l : List (AzVector R n)) :
    (l.sum).toFn = (l.map AzVector.toFn).sum
proof:
:= by
  have := map_list_sum (AzVector.toFnLM (R := R) (n := n)) l
  simpa [AzVector.toFnLM] using this

name: Azurite.gsProj_sum_collapse
statement:
private theorem gsProj_sum_collapse (v w : AzVector R n)
    (hnorm : w.toFn ⬝ᵥ w.toFn ≠ 0) :
    ∀ (acc : List (AzVector R n)), acc.Pairwise (fun a b => a.dot b = 0) → w ∈ acc →
      (acc.map (fun w' => w.toFn ⬝ᵥ ((v.dot w' / w'.normSq : R) • w').toFn)).sum
        = w.toFn ⬝ᵥ v.toFn
proof:
:= by
  intro acc
  induction acc with
  | nil => intro _ hw; exact absurd hw (List.not_mem_nil)
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hpair hw
    rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hpair
    obtain ⟨hhead, htail⟩ := hpair
    rw [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    
    have head_val : ∀ x : AzVector R n,
        w.toFn ⬝ᵥ ((v.dot x / x.normSq : R) • x).toFn
          = (v.dot x / x.normSq : R) * (w.toFn ⬝ᵥ x.toFn) := by
      intro x
      rw [AzVector.toFn_smul, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases ha : a = w
    · 
      subst ha
      rw [head_val a, AzVector.normSq_eq_dotProduct, AzVector.dot_eq_dotProduct,
          div_mul_cancel₀ _ hnorm, dotProduct_comm a.toFn v.toFn]
      
      have htzero : (t.map (fun w' => a.toFn ⬝ᵥ ((v.dot w' / w'.normSq : R) • w').toFn)).sum = 0 := by
        apply List.sum_eq_zero
        intro x hx
        rw [List.mem_map] at hx
        obtain ⟨w', hw'mem, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [head_val w', AzVector.dot_eq_dotProduct] at *
        have : a.toFn ⬝ᵥ w'.toFn = 0 := by
          have := hhead w' hw'mem
          rwa [AzVector.dot_eq_dotProduct] at this
        rw [this, mul_zero]
      rw [htzero, add_zero]
    · 
      have hwt : w ∈ t := by
        cases hw with
        | head => exact absurd rfl ha
        | tail _ h => exact h
      have hazero : w.toFn ⬝ᵥ ((v.dot a / a.normSq : R) • a).toFn = 0 := by
        rw [head_val a]
        have : w.toFn ⬝ᵥ a.toFn = 0 := by
          
          have hd : a.dot w = 0 := hhead w hwt
          rw [dot_comm, AzVector.dot_eq_dotProduct] at hd
          exact hd
        rw [this, mul_zero]
      rw [hazero, zero_add]
      exact ih htail hwt

name: Azurite.dotProduct_list_sum
statement:
private theorem dotProduct_list_sum (u : Fin n → R) (l : List (Fin n → R)) :
    u ⬝ᵥ l.sum = (l.map (fun x => u ⬝ᵥ x)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [dotProduct_zero]
  | cons a t ih => rw [List.sum_cons, dotProduct_add, ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]

name: Azurite.gsProj_orthogonal
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  rw [gsProj_eq, dot_comm, AzVector.dot_eq_dotProduct,
      AzVector.toFn_sub, dotProduct_sub, toFn_list_sum, List.map_map,
      dotProduct_list_sum, List.map_map]
  simp only [Function.comp_def]
  
  by_cases hw0 : w = 0
  · subst hw0
    simp [AzVector.toFn_zero]
  · have hwne : w.toFn ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc; exact hw0 (AzVector.toFn_injective (by simpa [AzVector.toFn_zero] using hc))
    have hnorm : w.toFn ⬝ᵥ w.toFn ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, dotProduct_self_eq_zero]; exact hwne
    rw [gsProj_sum_collapse v w hnorm acc hacc hw, sub_self]

name: Azurite.AzVector.gramSchmidt_length
statement:
theorem AzVector.gramSchmidt_length (vs : List (AzVector R n)) :
    (AzVector.gramSchmidt vs).length = vs.length
proof:
:= by
  rw [gramSchmidt_eq_foldl]
  suffices h : ∀ (l : List (AzVector R n)) (acc : List (AzVector R n)),
      (l.foldl (fun acc v => acc ++ [gsProj acc v]) acc).length = acc.length + l.length by
    simpa using h vs []
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro acc; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro acc
    rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil,
        List.length_cons]
    omega

name: Azurite.gramSchmidt_foldl_pairwise
statement:
private theorem gramSchmidt_foldl_pairwise (vs : List (AzVector R n)) :
    ∀ (acc : List (AzVector R n)), acc.Pairwise (fun u w => u.dot w = 0) →
      (vs.foldl (fun acc v => acc ++ [gsProj acc v]) acc).Pairwise
        (fun u w => u.dot w = 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction vs with
  | nil => intro acc hacc; simpa using hacc
  | cons v vs' ih =>
    intro acc hacc
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    apply ih
    
    rw [List.pairwise_append]
    refine ⟨hacc, List.pairwise_singleton _ _, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb
    rw [List.mem_singleton] at hb
    subst hb
    
    have := gsProj_orthogonal acc v hacc a ha
    rw [dot_comm]; exact this

name: Azurite.AzVector.gramSchmidt_pairwise_orthogonal
statement:
theorem AzVector.gramSchmidt_pairwise_orthogonal (vs : List (AzVector R n)) :
    (AzVector.gramSchmidt vs).Pairwise (fun u w => u.dot w = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gramSchmidt_eq_foldl]
  exact gramSchmidt_foldl_pairwise vs [] List.Pairwise.nil

name: Azurite.AzVector.toFn_smul'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AzVector.toFn_smul' [SMul α R] (c : α) (v : AzVector R n) :
    (c • v).toFn = c • v.toFn
proof: := AzVector.toFn_smul c v

name: Azurite.AzVector.ofFn_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AzVector.ofFn_smul [SMul α R] (c : α) (f : Fin n → R) :
    AzVector.ofFn (c • f) = c • (AzVector.ofFn f)
proof:
:= by
  apply AzVector.toFn_injective; ext i; simp

name: Azurite.AzVector.toFn_neg'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AzVector.toFn_neg' (v : AzVector R n) :
    (-v).toFn = -v.toFn
proof: := AzVector.toFn_neg v

name: Azurite.AzVector.ofFn_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AzVector.ofFn_neg (f : Fin n → R) :
    AzVector.ofFn (-f) = -(AzVector.ofFn f)
proof:
:= by
  apply AzVector.toFn_injective; ext i; simp

name: Azurite.AzVector.toFn_add'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AzVector.toFn_add' (v w : AzVector R n) :
    (v + w).toFn = v.toFn + w.toFn
proof: := AzVector.toFn_add v w

name: Azurite.AzVector.ofFn_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AzVector.ofFn_add (f g : Fin n → R) :
    AzVector.ofFn (f + g) = AzVector.ofFn f + AzVector.ofFn g
proof:
:= by
  apply AzVector.toFn_injective; ext i; simp

name: Azurite.AzVector.toFn_cross
statement:
theorem AzVector.toFn_cross (v w : AzVector R 3) :
    (v.cross w).toFn = (crossProduct v.toFn) w.toFn
proof:
:= by
  funext ⟨i, hi⟩
  match i, hi with
  | 0, _ => simp [cross, crossProduct, AzVector.toFn, Vector.get, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
  | 1, _ => simp [cross, crossProduct, AzVector.toFn, Vector.get, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
                   Matrix.cons_val_one]
  | 2, _ => simp [cross, crossProduct, AzVector.toFn, Vector.get]

name: Azurite.AzVector.ofFn_cross
statement:
theorem AzVector.ofFn_cross (f g : Fin 3 → R) :
    (AzVector.ofFn f).cross (AzVector.ofFn g) = AzVector.ofFn ((crossProduct f) g)
proof:
:= by
  apply AzVector.toFn_injective
  rw [toFn_cross]
  funext ⟨i, hi⟩
  match i, hi with
  | 0, _ =>
    simp [crossProduct, AzVector.toFn, AzVector.ofFn, Vector.get, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
    rfl
  | 1, _ =>
    simp [crossProduct, AzVector.toFn, AzVector.ofFn, Vector.get, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Matrix.cons_val_one]
    rfl
  | 2, _ =>
    simp [crossProduct, AzVector.toFn, AzVector.ofFn, Vector.get]
    rfl

name: Azurite.AzVector.ofFn_injective
statement:
theorem AzVector.ofFn_injective :
    Function.Injective (AzVector.ofFn (R := R) (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  funext i
  have := congrArg (fun v => v.toFn i) h
  simp [AzVector.toFn, AzVector.ofFn, Vector.get] at this
  exact this

name: Azurite.AzInt.toNat_sumProducts
statement:
theorem toNat_sumProducts (l : List (AzNat × AzNat)) :
    (sumProducts l).toNat = (l.map mag).sum
proof:
:= by
  unfold sumProducts
  suffices h : ∀ acc : AzNat, (l.foldl (fun acc p => acc + p.1 * p.2) acc).toNat
      = acc.toNat + (l.map mag).sum by
    simpa [AzNat.toNat_zero] using h 0
  induction l with
  | nil => intro acc; simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    intro acc
    rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, AzNat.toNat_add, AzNat.toNat_mul, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    unfold mag
    ring

name: Azurite.AzInt.extractMax_eq_none_iff
statement: theorem extractMax_eq_none_iff (l : List (AzNat × AzNat)) : extractMax l = none ↔ l = []
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp [extractMax]
  | cons p ps =>
    simp only [extractMax, List.cons_ne_nil, iff_false]
    split
    · simp
    · split_ifs <;> simp

name: Azurite.AzInt.sum_extractMax
statement:
theorem sum_extractMax : ∀ (l : List (AzNat × AzNat)) (p : AzNat × AzNat)
    (rest : List (AzNat × AzNat)), extractMax l = some (p, rest) →
    p ∈ l ∧ (l.map mag).sum = mag p + (rest.map mag).sum
  | [], p, rest, h => by simp [extractMax] at h
  | q :: qs, p, rest, h => by
    simp only [extractMax] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i hnone
      rw [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
proof:
:= h
      have := (extractMax_eq_none_iff qs).mp hnone
      subst this
      simp
    · rename_i r rest' hsome
      split_ifs at h
      · rw [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
        simp
      · rw [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
        obtain ⟨hmem, ih⟩ := sum_extractMax qs r rest' hsome
        refine ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hmem, ?_⟩
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
        omega

name: Azurite.AzInt.compare_add_sub
statement:
private theorem compare_add_sub {a b c : ℕ} (h : b < c) :
    Ord.compare a (c - b) = Ord.compare (a + b) c
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (a + b) c with h' | h' | h'
  · rw [(compare_Nat_lt_iff _ _).mpr h', (compare_Nat_lt_iff _ _).mpr (by omega)]
  · rw [(compare_Nat_eq_iff _ _).mpr h', (compare_Nat_eq_iff _ _).mpr (by omega)]
  · rw [(compare_Nat_gt_iff _ _).mpr h', (compare_Nat_gt_iff _ _).mpr (by omega)]

name: Azurite.AzInt.compare_swap
statement: private theorem compare_swap (a b : ℕ) : (Ord.compare a b).swap = Ord.compare b a
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a b with h | h | h
  · rw [(compare_Nat_lt_iff _ _).mpr h, (compare_Nat_gt_iff _ _).mpr h]; rfl
  · rw [(compare_Nat_eq_iff _ _).mpr h, (compare_Nat_eq_iff _ _).mpr h.symm]; rfl
  · rw [(compare_Nat_gt_iff _ _).mpr h, (compare_Nat_lt_iff _ _).mpr h]; rfl

name: Azurite.AzInt.le_maxSize
statement:
theorem le_maxSize {l : List (AzNat × AzNat)} {p : AzNat × AzNat} (hp : p ∈ l) :
    p.1.size + p.2.size ≤ maxSize l
proof:
:= by
  unfold maxSize
  suffices h : ∀ m : ℕ, p.1.size + p.2.size ≤ l.foldl (fun m p => max m (p.1.size + p.2.size)) m
    from h 0
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at hp
  | cons q qs ih =>
    intro m
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hp with rfl | hp'
    · have hmono : ∀ (l : List (AzNat × AzNat)) (a b : ℕ), a ≤ b →
          l.foldl (fun m p => max m (p.1.size + p.2.size)) a
            ≤ l.foldl (fun m p => max m (p.1.size + p.2.size)) b := by
        intro l
        induction l with
        | nil => intro a b h; exact h
        | cons r rs ih' => intro a b h; exact ih' _ _ (max_le_max_right _ h)
      have hbase : ∀ (l : List (AzNat × AzNat)) (a : ℕ),
          a ≤ l.foldl (fun m p => max m (p.1.size + p.2.size)) a := by
        intro l
        induction l with
        | nil => intro a; exact le_rfl
        | cons r rs ih' => intro a; exact (le_max_left _ _).trans (ih' _)
      exact (le_max_right m _).trans (hbase qs _)
    · exact ih hp' _

name: Azurite.AzInt.foldl_max_eq_or_mem
statement:
private theorem foldl_max_eq_or_mem : ∀ (l : List (AzNat × AzNat)) (m : ℕ),
    l.foldl (fun m p => max m (p.1.size + p.2.size)) m = m ∨
      ∃ p ∈ l, p.1.size + p.2.size = l.foldl (fun m p => max m (p.1.size + p.2.size)) m
  | [], m => Or.inl rfl
  | q :: qs, m => by
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases foldl_max_eq_or_mem qs (max m (q.1.size + q.2.size)) with h | ⟨p, hp, hpe⟩
    · rw [h]
      rcases Nat.le_total m (q.1.size + q.2.size) with hle | hle
      · exact Or.inr ⟨q, List.mem_cons_self .., (Nat.max_eq_right hle).symm⟩
      · exact Or.inl (Nat.max_eq_left hle)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨p, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hp, hpe⟩

name: Azurite.AzInt.exists_eq_maxSize
statement:
theorem exists_eq_maxSize {l : List (AzNat × AzNat)} (hl : l ≠ []) :
    ∃ p ∈ l, p.1.size + p.2.size = maxSize l
proof:
:= by
  rcases foldl_max_eq_or_mem l 0 with h | h
  · cases l with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hl
    | cons q qs =>
      refine ⟨q, List.mem_cons_self .., ?_⟩
      have := le_maxSize (l := q :: qs) (p := q) (List.mem_cons_self ..)
      unfold maxSize at this ⊢
      omega
  · exact h

name: Azurite.AzInt.sum_mag_lt
statement:
theorem sum_mag_lt (l : List (AzNat × AzNat)) :
    (l.map mag).sum < 2 ^ (maxSize l + Nat.size l.length)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ p ∈ l, mag p < 2 ^ maxSize l := by
    intro p hp
    unfold mag
    calc p.1.toNat * p.2.toNat < 2 ^ p.1.toNat.size * 2 ^ p.2.toNat.size :=
          Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_size_self _) (Nat.lt_size_self _).le
            (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
      _ = 2 ^ (p.1.size + p.2.size) := by rw [← pow_add, AzNat.size_toNat, AzNat.size_toNat]
      _ ≤ 2 ^ maxSize l := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (le_maxSize hp)
  calc (l.map mag).sum ≤ l.length * 2 ^ maxSize l := by
        have := List.sum_le_length_nsmul (l.map mag) (2 ^ maxSize l)
          (fun x hx => by
            obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
            exact (hterm p hp).le)
        simpa using this
    _ < 2 ^ Nat.size l.length * 2 ^ maxSize l :=
        Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (Nat.lt_size_self _) (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
    _ = 2 ^ (maxSize l + Nat.size l.length) := by rw [← pow_add, add_comm]

name: Azurite.AzInt.two_pow_le_sum_mag
statement:
theorem two_pow_le_sum_mag {l : List (AzNat × AzNat)} (hl : l ≠ [])
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ l, 0 < p.1.toNat ∧ 0 < p.2.toNat) :
    2 ^ (maxSize l - 2) ≤ (l.map mag).sum
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpe⟩ := exists_eq_maxSize hl
  have hx := (hpos p hp).1
  have hy := (hpos p hp).2
  have hsx := Nat.size_pos.mpr hx
  have hsy := Nat.size_pos.mpr hy
  calc 2 ^ (maxSize l - 2) = 2 ^ (p.1.toNat.size - 1) * 2 ^ (p.2.toNat.size - 1) := by
        rw [← pow_add, ← hpe, AzNat.size_toNat, AzNat.size_toNat]
        congr 1
        rw [AzNat.size_toNat] at hsx hsy
        omega
    _ ≤ p.1.toNat * p.2.toNat :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul (AzNat.two_pow_size_sub_one_le hx) (AzNat.two_pow_size_sub_one_le hy)
    _ ≤ (l.map mag).sum := List.le_sum_of_mem (List.mem_map_of_mem hp)

name: Azurite.AzInt.compareSumsGeneral_eq
statement:
theorem compareSumsGeneral_eq (pos neg : List (AzNat × AzNat))
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ pos, 0 < p.1.toNat ∧ 0 < p.2.toNat)
    (hneg : ∀ p ∈ neg, 0 < p.1.toNat ∧ 0 < p.2.toNat) (hp : pos ≠ []) (hq : neg ≠ []) :
    compareSumsGeneral pos neg = Ord.compare (pos.map mag).sum (neg.map mag).sum
proof:
:= by
  unfold compareSumsGeneral
  split_ifs with hscr₁ hscr₂
  · symm; rw [compare_Nat_lt_iff]
    calc (pos.map mag).sum < 2 ^ (maxSize pos + Nat.size pos.length) := sum_mag_lt pos
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (maxSize neg - 2) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ ≤ (neg.map mag).sum := two_pow_le_sum_mag hq hneg
  · symm; rw [compare_Nat_gt_iff]
    calc (neg.map mag).sum < 2 ^ (maxSize neg + Nat.size neg.length) := sum_mag_lt neg
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (maxSize pos - 2) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ ≤ (pos.map mag).sum := two_pow_le_sum_mag hp hpos
  rcases h1 : extractMax pos with _ | ⟨p, pos'⟩
  · exact absurd ((extractMax_eq_none_iff pos).mp h1) hp
  rcases h2 : extractMax neg with _ | ⟨q, neg'⟩
  · exact absurd ((extractMax_eq_none_iff neg).mp h2) hq
  obtain ⟨hpmem, hP⟩ := sum_extractMax pos p pos' h1
  obtain ⟨hqmem, hQ⟩ := sum_extractMax neg q neg' h2
  have hTp : 0 < mag p := Nat.mul_pos (hpos p hpmem).1 (hpos p hpmem).2
  have hTq : 0 < mag q := Nat.mul_pos (hneg q hqmem).1 (hneg q hqmem).2
  dsimp only
  split_ifs with hsize hle₁ hle₂
  · 
    rw [AzNat.le_iff_toNat_le, toNat_sumProducts, toNat_sumProducts] at hle₁
    symm; rw [compare_Nat_gt_iff]; omega
  · rw [AzNat.le_iff_toNat_le, toNat_sumProducts, toNat_sumProducts] at hle₁
    rw [AzNat.compareProduct_eq, AzNat.toNat_sub, toNat_sumProducts, toNat_sumProducts]
    show Ord.compare (mag p) _ = _
    rw [compare_add_sub (by omega), hP]
  · 
    rw [AzNat.le_iff_toNat_le, toNat_sumProducts, toNat_sumProducts] at hle₂
    symm; rw [compare_Nat_lt_iff]; omega
  · rw [AzNat.le_iff_toNat_le, toNat_sumProducts, toNat_sumProducts] at hle₂
    rw [AzNat.compareProduct_eq, AzNat.toNat_sub, toNat_sumProducts, toNat_sumProducts]
    show (Ord.compare (mag q) _).swap = _
    rw [compare_add_sub (by omega), compare_swap, hQ]

name: Azurite.AzInt.compareSums_eq
statement:
theorem compareSums_eq (pos neg : List (AzNat × AzNat))
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ pos, 0 < p.1.toNat ∧ 0 < p.2.toNat)
    (hneg : ∀ p ∈ neg, 0 < p.1.toNat ∧ 0 < p.2.toNat) :
    compareSums pos neg = Ord.compare (pos.map mag).sum (neg.map mag).sum
proof:
:= by
  have hsum_pos : ∀ (l : List (AzNat × AzNat)), (∀ p ∈ l, 0 < p.1.toNat ∧ 0 < p.2.toNat) →
      l ≠ [] → 0 < (l.map mag).sum := by
    intro l hl hne
    cases l with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
    | cons p ps =>
      rw [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.mul_pos (hl p (List.mem_cons_self ..)).1
        (hl p (List.mem_cons_self ..)).2) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  rcases pos with _ | ⟨p, ps⟩ <;> rcases neg with _ | ⟨q, qs⟩
  · rfl
  · show Ordering.lt = _
    symm; rw [compare_Nat_lt_iff]
    simpa using hsum_pos (q :: qs) hneg (List.cons_ne_nil q qs)
  · show Ordering.gt = _
    symm; rw [compare_Nat_gt_iff]
    simpa using hsum_pos (p :: ps) hpos (List.cons_ne_nil p ps)
  · rcases ps with _ | ⟨p₂, ps₂⟩ <;> rcases qs with _ | ⟨q₂, qs₂⟩
    · show AzNat.compareProducts p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 = _
      rw [AzNat.compareProducts_eq]
      simp [mag]
    all_goals
      show compareSumsGeneral _ _ = _
      exact compareSumsGeneral_eq _ _ hpos hneg (List.cons_ne_nil _ _) (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)

name: Azurite.AzInt.splitTerms_spec
statement:
theorem splitTerms_spec : ∀ l : List (AzInt × AzInt),
    (l.map fun p => p.1.toInt * p.2.toInt).sum
        = (((splitTerms l).1.map mag).sum : ℤ) - (((splitTerms l).2.map mag).sum : ℤ) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ (splitTerms l).1, 0 < p.1.toNat ∧ 0 < p.2.toNat) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ (splitTerms l).2, 0 < p.1.toNat ∧ 0 < p.2.toNat)
  | [] => by simp [splitTerms]
  | (a, b) :: rest => by
    obtain ⟨hsum, hpos, hneg⟩
proof:
:= splitTerms_spec rest
    simp only [splitTerms, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    have hterm : a.toInt * b.toInt
        = if (a.sign == b.sign) then ((a.abs.toNat * b.abs.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ)
          else -((a.abs.toNat * b.abs.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      unfold toInt; exact toInt_mul_signed a.sign b.sign a.abs b.abs
    split_ifs with hz hs
    · 
      have h0 : a.abs.toNat * b.abs.toNat = 0 := by
        rcases hz with h | h <;> simp [(AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat _).mp h]
      refine ⟨?_, hpos, hneg⟩
      rw [hterm, h0, hsum]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    · rw [not_or, AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat, AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat] at hz
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, hneg⟩
      · rw [hterm, hsum, ite_eq_left hs]
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, mag]
        push_cast
        ring
      · intro p hp
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hp with rfl | hp
        · exact ⟨Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz.1, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz.2⟩
        · exact hpos p hp
    · rw [not_or, AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat, AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat] at hz
      refine ⟨?_, hpos, ?_⟩
      · rw [hterm, hsum, ite_eq_right hs]
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, mag]
        push_cast
        ring
      · intro p hp
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hp with rfl | hp
        · exact ⟨Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz.1, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz.2⟩
        · exact hneg p hp

name: Azurite.AzInt.compare_sub_zero
statement:
private theorem compare_sub_zero (P N : ℕ) :
    Ord.compare ((P : ℤ) - (N : ℤ)) 0 = Ord.compare P N
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy P N with h | h | h
  · rw [(compare_Nat_lt_iff _ _).mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt]; omega
  · rw [(compare_Nat_eq_iff _ _).mpr h, compare_eq_iff_eq]; omega
  · rw [(compare_Nat_gt_iff _ _).mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt]; omega

name: Azurite.AzInt.dotSign_eq
statement:
theorem dotSign_eq (v w : AzVector AzInt n) :
    dotSign v w = Ord.compare (∑ i, (v.toFn i).toInt * (w.toFn i).toInt) 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold dotSign dotTerms
  obtain ⟨hsum, hpos, hneg⟩ :=
    splitTerms_spec ((List.finRange n).map fun i => (v.toFn i, w.toFn i))
  rw [compareSums_eq _ _ hpos hneg, ← compare_sub_zero, ← hsum, List.map_map,
    ← List.ofFn_eq_map, List.sum_ofFn]
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzInt.dotSign_eq_compare_dot
statement:
theorem dotSign_eq_compare_dot (v w : AzVector AzInt n) :
    dotSign v w = Ord.compare (v.dot w).toInt 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotSign_eq, AzVector.dot_eq_dotProduct, dotProduct, ← toIntRingHom_apply, map_sum]
  congr 2
  funext i
  rw [map_mul, toIntRingHom_apply, toIntRingHom_apply]

name: Azurite.Frac.val_add
statement:
theorem Frac.val_add {p q : Frac} (hp : p.den.toNat ≠ 0) (hq : q.den.toNat ≠ 0) :
    (p + q).val = p.val + q.val
proof:
:= by
  unfold Frac.val
  rw [Frac.add_def]
  simp only [AzNat.toNat_add, AzNat.toNat_mul]
  push_cast
  rw [div_add_div _ _ (by exact_mod_cast hp) (by exact_mod_cast hq)]
  congr 1
  ring

name: Azurite.Frac.den_sum
statement: theorem Frac.den_sum (l : List Frac) : (l.sum).den.toNat = (l.map fun p => p.den.toNat).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [Frac.zero_def, AzNat.toNat_one]
  | cons p ps ih =>
    rw [List.sum_cons, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, ← ih]
    show (p.den * ps.sum.den).toNat = _
    exact AzNat.toNat_mul _ _

name: Azurite.Frac.den_sum_ne_zero
statement:
theorem Frac.den_sum_ne_zero {l : List Frac} (h : ∀ p ∈ l, p.den.toNat ≠ 0) :
    (l.sum).den.toNat ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Frac.den_sum]
  exact (List.prod_pos (fun x hx => by
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (h p hp))).ne'

name: Azurite.Frac.val_sum
statement:
theorem Frac.val_sum {l : List Frac} (h : ∀ p ∈ l, p.den.toNat ≠ 0) :
    (l.sum).val = (l.map Frac.val).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [Frac.val, Frac.zero_def, AzNat.toNat_zero]
  | cons p ps ih =>
    rw [List.sum_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons,
      Frac.val_add (h p (List.mem_cons_self ..))
        (Frac.den_sum_ne_zero fun q hq => h q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq)),
      ih fun q hq => h q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq)]

name: Azurite.Frac.sum_eq
statement: theorem Frac.sum_eq (l : List Frac) : Frac.sum l = l.sum
proof: := Azurite.balancedSum_eq_sum l

name: Azurite.AzRat.Term.val_eq
statement:
theorem Term.val_eq (t : Term) :
    t.val = ((t.nx.toNat * t.ny.toNat : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((t.dx.toNat * t.dy.toNat : ℕ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Term.val Frac.val Term.toFrac
  rw [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_mul]

name: Azurite.AzRat.Term.val_pos
statement: theorem Term.val_pos {t : Term} (h : t.Pos) : 0 < t.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [Term.val_eq]
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h
  exact div_pos (by exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_pos h1 h2) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_pos h3 h4)

name: Azurite.AzRat.Term.toFrac_den_ne_zero
statement: theorem Term.toFrac_den_ne_zero {t : Term} (h : t.Pos) : t.toFrac.den.toNat ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold Term.toFrac
  rw [AzNat.toNat_mul]
  exact (Nat.mul_pos h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2).ne'

name: Azurite.AzRat.two_zpow_nat
statement: private theorem two_zpow_nat (a : ℕ) : (2 : ℚ) ^ (a : ℤ) = ((2 ^ a : ℕ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [zpow_natCast]; push_cast; rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.Term.val_lt
statement: theorem Term.val_lt {t : Term} (h : t.Pos) : t.val < (2 : ℚ) ^ (t.exp + 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h
  have hs3 := Nat.size_pos.mpr h3
  have hs4 := Nat.size_pos.mpr h4
  rw [Term.val_eq, div_lt_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_pos h3 h4)]
  have hnum : t.nx.toNat * t.ny.toNat < 2 ^ (t.nx.size + t.ny.size) := by
    rw [pow_add, ← AzNat.size_toNat, ← AzNat.size_toNat]
    exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_size_self _) (Nat.lt_size_self _).le
      (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
  have h2 : 2 ≤ t.dx.size + t.dy.size := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, ← AzNat.size_toNat]; omega
  have hden : 2 ^ (t.dx.size + t.dy.size - 2) ≤ t.dx.toNat * t.dy.toNat := by
    rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, ← AzNat.size_toNat]
    rw [show t.dx.toNat.size + t.dy.toNat.size - 2 = (t.dx.toNat.size - 1) + (t.dy.toNat.size - 1)
      by omega, pow_add]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul (two_pow_size_sub_one_le h3) (two_pow_size_sub_one_le h4)
  have hexp : (2 : ℚ) ^ (t.exp + 2) * ((2 ^ (t.dx.size + t.dy.size - 2) : ℕ) : ℚ)
      = ((2 ^ (t.nx.size + t.ny.size) : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    rw [← two_zpow_nat, ← two_zpow_nat, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
    congr 1
    unfold Term.exp
    push_cast [Nat.cast_sub h2]
    ring
  calc ((t.nx.toNat * t.ny.toNat : ℕ) : ℚ) < ((2 ^ (t.nx.size + t.ny.size) : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hnum
    _ = (2 : ℚ) ^ (t.exp + 2) * ((2 ^ (t.dx.size + t.dy.size - 2) : ℕ) : ℚ) := hexp.symm
    _ ≤ (2 : ℚ) ^ (t.exp + 2) * ((t.dx.toNat * t.dy.toNat : ℕ) : ℚ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by exact_mod_cast hden) (zpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)

name: Azurite.AzRat.Term.two_zpow_le_val
statement: theorem Term.two_zpow_le_val {t : Term} (h : t.Pos) : (2 : ℚ) ^ (t.exp - 2) ≤ t.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h
  have hs1 := Nat.size_pos.mpr h1
  have hs2 := Nat.size_pos.mpr h2
  rw [Term.val_eq, le_div_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_pos h3 h4)]
  have h2' : 2 ≤ t.nx.size + t.ny.size := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, ← AzNat.size_toNat]; omega
  have hnum : 2 ^ (t.nx.size + t.ny.size - 2) ≤ t.nx.toNat * t.ny.toNat := by
    rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, ← AzNat.size_toNat]
    rw [show t.nx.toNat.size + t.ny.toNat.size - 2 = (t.nx.toNat.size - 1) + (t.ny.toNat.size - 1)
      by omega, pow_add]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul (two_pow_size_sub_one_le h1) (two_pow_size_sub_one_le h2)
  have hden : t.dx.toNat * t.dy.toNat < 2 ^ (t.dx.size + t.dy.size) := by
    rw [pow_add, ← AzNat.size_toNat, ← AzNat.size_toNat]
    exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_size_self _) (Nat.lt_size_self _).le
      (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
  have hexp : (2 : ℚ) ^ (t.exp - 2) * ((2 ^ (t.dx.size + t.dy.size) : ℕ) : ℚ)
      = ((2 ^ (t.nx.size + t.ny.size - 2) : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    rw [← two_zpow_nat, ← two_zpow_nat, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
    congr 1
    unfold Term.exp
    push_cast [Nat.cast_sub h2']
    ring
  calc (2 : ℚ) ^ (t.exp - 2) * ((t.dx.toNat * t.dy.toNat : ℕ) : ℚ)
      ≤ (2 : ℚ) ^ (t.exp - 2) * ((2 ^ (t.dx.size + t.dy.size) : ℕ) : ℚ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by exact_mod_cast hden.le) (zpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)
    _ = ((2 ^ (t.nx.size + t.ny.size - 2) : ℕ) : ℚ) := hexp
    _ ≤ ((t.nx.toNat * t.ny.toNat : ℕ) : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hnum

name: Azurite.AzRat.maxExp_cons
statement:
theorem maxExp_cons (t : Term) (ts : List Term) :
    maxExp (t :: ts) = (ts.map Term.exp).foldl max t.exp
proof:
:= by
  simp [maxExp, List.foldl_map]

name: Azurite.AzRat.le_maxExp
statement: theorem le_maxExp {l : List Term} {t : Term} (ht : t ∈ l) : t.exp ≤ maxExp l
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp at ht
  | cons s ss =>
    rw [maxExp_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp ht with rfl | ht
    · exact le_foldl_max _ _
    · exact le_foldl_max_of_mem _ _ (List.mem_map_of_mem ht)

name: Azurite.AzRat.exists_eq_maxExp
statement: theorem exists_eq_maxExp {l : List Term} (hl : l ≠ []) : ∃ t ∈ l, t.exp = maxExp l
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hl
  | cons s ss =>
    rw [maxExp_cons]
    rcases foldl_max_eq_or_mem (ss.map Term.exp) s.exp with h | h
    · exact ⟨s, List.mem_cons_self .., h.symm⟩
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, hte⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
      exact ⟨t, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ht, hte⟩

name: Azurite.AzRat.sum_val_lt
statement:
theorem sum_val_lt (l : List Term) (h : ∀ t ∈ l, t.Pos) :
    (l.map Term.val).sum < (2 : ℚ) ^ (maxExp l + (Nat.size l.length : ℤ) + 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ t ∈ l, t.val ≤ (2 : ℚ) ^ (maxExp l + 2) := fun t ht =>
    (Term.val_lt (h t ht)).le.trans
      (zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by have := le_maxExp ht; omega))
  calc (l.map Term.val).sum ≤ (l.map Term.val).length • (2 : ℚ) ^ (maxExp l + 2) :=
        List.sum_le_length_nsmul _ _ (fun x hx => by
          obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
          exact hterm t ht)
    _ = (l.length : ℚ) * (2 : ℚ) ^ (maxExp l + 2) := by rw [List.length_map, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ < (2 : ℚ) ^ (Nat.size l.length : ℤ) * (2 : ℚ) ^ (maxExp l + 2) := by
        apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right _ (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _)
        rw [two_zpow_nat]
        exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_size_self _
    _ = (2 : ℚ) ^ (maxExp l + (Nat.size l.length : ℤ) + 2) := by
        rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]; congr 1; ring

name: Azurite.AzRat.two_zpow_le_sum_val
statement:
theorem two_zpow_le_sum_val {l : List Term} (hl : l ≠ []) (h : ∀ t ∈ l, t.Pos) :
    (2 : ℚ) ^ (maxExp l - 2) ≤ (l.map Term.val).sum
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hte⟩ := exists_eq_maxExp hl
  calc (2 : ℚ) ^ (maxExp l - 2) = (2 : ℚ) ^ (t.exp - 2) := by rw [hte]
    _ ≤ t.val := Term.two_zpow_le_val (h t ht)
    _ ≤ (l.map Term.val).sum :=
        List.single_le_sum (fun x hx => by
          obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
          exact (Term.val_pos (h s hs)).le) _ (List.mem_map_of_mem ht)

name: Azurite.AzRat.compare_div_nat
statement:
theorem compare_div_nat (a b c d : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hd : 0 < d) :
    Ord.compare ((a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)) ((c : ℚ) / (d : ℚ)) = Ord.compare (a * d) (c * b)
proof:
:= by
  have := compare_div (a : ℤ) (c : ℤ) (b : ℤ) (d : ℤ) (by exact_mod_cast hb) (by exact_mod_cast hd)
  push_cast at this
  rw [this]
  rcases lt_trichotomy (a * d) (c * b) with h | h | h
  · rw [(compare_Nat_lt_iff _ _).mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt]; exact_mod_cast h
  · rw [(compare_Nat_eq_iff _ _).mpr h, compare_eq_iff_eq]; exact_mod_cast h
  · rw [(compare_Nat_gt_iff _ _).mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt]; exact_mod_cast h

name: Azurite.AzRat.compareSumsGeneral_eq
statement:
theorem compareSumsGeneral_eq (pos neg : List Term) (hpos : ∀ t ∈ pos, t.Pos)
    (hneg : ∀ t ∈ neg, t.Pos) (hp : pos ≠ []) (hq : neg ≠ []) :
    compareSumsGeneral pos neg = Ord.compare (pos.map Term.val).sum (neg.map Term.val).sum
proof:
:= by
  unfold compareSumsGeneral
  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · symm; rw [compare_lt_iff_lt]
    calc (pos.map Term.val).sum < (2 : ℚ) ^ (maxExp pos + (Nat.size pos.length : ℤ) + 2) :=
          sum_val_lt pos hpos
      _ ≤ (2 : ℚ) ^ (maxExp neg - 2) := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ ≤ (neg.map Term.val).sum := two_zpow_le_sum_val hq hneg
  · symm; rw [compare_gt_iff_gt]
    calc (neg.map Term.val).sum < (2 : ℚ) ^ (maxExp neg + (Nat.size neg.length : ℤ) + 2) :=
          sum_val_lt neg hneg
      _ ≤ (2 : ℚ) ^ (maxExp pos - 2) := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ ≤ (pos.map Term.val).sum := two_zpow_le_sum_val hp hpos
  · have hPd := Frac.den_sum_ne_zero (l := pos.map Term.toFrac) fun f hf => by
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hf
      exact Term.toFrac_den_ne_zero (hpos t ht)
    have hNd := Frac.den_sum_ne_zero (l := neg.map Term.toFrac) fun f hf => by
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hf
      exact Term.toFrac_den_ne_zero (hneg t ht)
    have hP : ((pos.map Term.toFrac).sum).val = (pos.map Term.val).sum := by
      rw [Frac.val_sum (fun f hf => by
        obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hf
        exact Term.toFrac_den_ne_zero (hpos t ht)), List.map_map]
      rfl
    have hN : ((neg.map Term.toFrac).sum).val = (neg.map Term.val).sum := by
      rw [Frac.val_sum (fun f hf => by
        obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hf
        exact Term.toFrac_den_ne_zero (hneg t ht)), List.map_map]
      rfl
    rw [AzNat.compareProducts_eq, Frac.sum_eq, Frac.sum_eq, ← hP, ← hN]
    unfold Frac.val
    rw [compare_div_nat _ _ _ _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hPd) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hNd)]

name: Azurite.AzRat.compareSums_eq
statement:
theorem compareSums_eq (pos neg : List Term) (hpos : ∀ t ∈ pos, t.Pos)
    (hneg : ∀ t ∈ neg, t.Pos) :
    compareSums pos neg = Ord.compare (pos.map Term.val).sum (neg.map Term.val).sum
proof:
:= by
  have hsum_pos : ∀ (l : List Term), (∀ t ∈ l, t.Pos) → l ≠ [] → 0 < (l.map Term.val).sum := by
    intro l hl hne
    cases l with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
    | cons t ts =>
      rw [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      have := Term.val_pos (hl t (List.mem_cons_self ..))
      have : 0 ≤ (ts.map Term.val).sum := List.sum_nonneg (fun x hx => by
        obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
        exact (Term.val_pos (hl s (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hs))).le)
      linarith
  rcases pos with _ | ⟨p, ps⟩ <;> rcases neg with _ | ⟨q, qs⟩
  · rfl
  · show Ordering.lt = _
    symm; rw [compare_lt_iff_lt]
    simpa using hsum_pos (q :: qs) hneg (List.cons_ne_nil q qs)
  · show Ordering.gt = _
    symm; rw [compare_gt_iff_gt]
    simpa using hsum_pos (p :: ps) hpos (List.cons_ne_nil p ps)
  · rcases ps with _ | ⟨p₂, ps₂⟩ <;> rcases qs with _ | ⟨q₂, qs₂⟩
    · show compareProductsMag p.nx p.dx p.ny p.dy q.nx q.dx q.ny q.dy = _
      obtain ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3, hp4⟩ := hpos p (List.mem_cons_self ..)
      obtain ⟨hq1, hq2, hq3, hq4⟩ := hneg q (List.mem_cons_self ..)
      rw [compareProductsMag_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hp1 hp3 hp2 hp4 hq1 hq3 hq2 hq4]
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, add_zero, Term.val_eq]
      rw [compare_div_nat _ _ _ _ (Nat.mul_pos hp3 hp4) (Nat.mul_pos hq3 hq4)]
    all_goals
      show compareSumsGeneral _ _ = _
      exact compareSumsGeneral_eq _ _ hpos hneg (List.cons_ne_nil _ _) (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)

name: Azurite.AzRat.splitTerms_spec
statement:
theorem splitTerms_spec : ∀ l : List (AzRat × AzRat),
    (l.map fun p => toRat p.1 * toRat p.2).sum
        = ((splitTerms l).1.map Term.val).sum - ((splitTerms l).2.map Term.val).sum ∧
      (∀ t ∈ (splitTerms l).1, t.Pos) ∧ (∀ t ∈ (splitTerms l).2, t.Pos)
  | [] => by simp [splitTerms]
  | (x, y) :: rest => by
    obtain ⟨hsum, hpos, hneg⟩
proof:
:= splitTerms_spec rest
    simp only [splitTerms, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    have hdx : 0 < x.den.toNat :=
      Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => x.den_nz ((AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat _).mpr h)
    have hdy : 0 < y.den.toNat :=
      Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => y.den_nz ((AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat _).mpr h)
    have hterm : toRat x * toRat y
        = (if (x.sign == y.sign) then ((x.num.toNat * y.num.toNat : ℕ) : ℚ)
            else -((x.num.toNat * y.num.toNat : ℕ) : ℚ))
          / ((x.den.toNat * y.den.toNat : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
      rw [toRat_eq_divInt, toRat_eq_divInt, Rat.divInt_mul_divInt, Rat.divInt_eq_div,
        AzInt.toInt_mul_signed]
      split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> ring
    split_ifs with hz hs
    · 
      have h0 : x.num.toNat * y.num.toNat = 0 := by
        rcases hz with h | h <;> simp [(AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat _).mp h]
      refine ⟨?_, hpos, hneg⟩
      rw [hterm, h0, hsum]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    · rw [not_or, AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat, AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat] at hz
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, hneg⟩
      · rw [hterm, hsum, ite_eq_left hs]
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Term.val_eq]
        ring
      · intro t ht
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp ht with rfl | ht
        · exact ⟨Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz.1, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz.2, hdx, hdy⟩
        · exact hpos t ht
    · rw [not_or, AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat, AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat] at hz
      refine ⟨?_, hpos, ?_⟩
      · rw [hterm, hsum, ite_eq_right hs]
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Term.val_eq]
        ring
      · intro t ht
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp ht with rfl | ht
        · exact ⟨Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz.1, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz.2, hdx, hdy⟩
        · exact hneg t ht

name: Azurite.AzRat.compare_sub_zero
statement: private theorem compare_sub_zero (P N : ℚ) : Ord.compare (P - N) 0 = Ord.compare P N
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy P N with h | h | h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt]; linarith
  · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h, compare_eq_iff_eq]; linarith
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt]; linarith

name: Azurite.AzRat.dotSign_eq
statement:
theorem dotSign_eq (v w : AzVector AzRat n) :
    dotSign v w = Ord.compare (∑ i, toRat (v.toFn i) * toRat (w.toFn i)) 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold dotSign
  obtain ⟨hsum, hpos, hneg⟩ :=
    splitTerms_spec ((List.finRange n).map fun i => (v.toFn i, w.toFn i))
  rw [compareSums_eq _ _ hpos hneg, ← compare_sub_zero, ← hsum, List.map_map,
    ← List.ofFn_eq_map, List.sum_ofFn]
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.dotSign_eq_compare_dot
statement:
theorem dotSign_eq_compare_dot (v w : AzVector AzRat n) :
    dotSign v w = Ord.compare (toRat (v.dot w)) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotSign_eq, AzVector.dot_eq_dotProduct, dotProduct, ← toRatRingHom_apply, map_sum]
  congr 2
  funext i
  rw [map_mul, toRatRingHom_apply, toRatRingHom_apply]

name: Azurite.AzNat.dotSign_eq
statement:
theorem dotSign_eq (v w : AzVector AzNat n) :
    dotSign v w = Ord.compare (∑ i, (v.toFn i).toNat * (w.toFn i).toNat) 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold dotSign
  have hany : (v.zip (fun a b => decide (a ≠ 0) && decide (b ≠ 0)) w).data.any id = true ↔
      ∃ i : Fin n, (v.toFn i).toNat ≠ 0 ∧ (w.toFn i).toNat ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Vector.any_iff_exists]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, h⟩
      refine ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, ?_⟩
      have := AzVector.toFn_zip (fun a b => decide (a ≠ 0) && decide (b ≠ 0)) v w ⟨i, hi⟩
      change (v.zip _ w).data[i] = _ at this
      rw [this] at h
      simpa [eq_zero_iff_toNat] using h
    · rintro ⟨i, h⟩
      refine ⟨i, i.isLt, ?_⟩
      have := AzVector.toFn_zip (fun a b => decide (a ≠ 0) && decide (b ≠ 0)) v w i
      change (v.zip _ w).data[i.val] = _ at this
      rw [this]
      simpa [eq_zero_iff_toNat] using h
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨i, hv, hw⟩ := hany.mp h
    symm; rw [compare_Nat_gt_iff]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hv) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hw))
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => (v.toFn i).toNat * (w.toFn i).toNat)
        (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i))
  · symm; rw [compare_Nat_eq_iff]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    rw [Nat.mul_eq_zero]
    by_contra hne
    rw [not_or] at hne
    exact h (hany.mpr ⟨i, hne.1, hne.2⟩)

name: Azurite.AzNat.dotSign_eq_compare_dot
statement:
theorem dotSign_eq_compare_dot (v w : AzVector AzNat n) :

proof:

  rw [dotSign_eq, AzVector.dot_eq_dotProduct, dotProduct, ← toNatRingHom_apply, map_sum]
  congr 2
  funext i
  rw [map_mul, toNatRingHom_apply, toNatRingHom_apply]

proof:

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.newton_identity
statement:
theorem newton_identity (U Y f : ℤ) (hE : U * Y ^ 2 = 1 - 2 * f) :
    1 - U * (Y * (1 + f)) ^ 2 = f ^ 2 * (3 + 2 * f)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (-(1 + f) ^ 2) * hE

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.newton_perturb
proof:
:= by
  ring

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.err_val_eq
statement:
theorem err_val_eq (u y : AzZModPow2 k) :
    ∃ c : ℤ, ((1 - u * y * y).val.toNat : ℤ)
      = 1 - (u.val.toNat : ℤ) * (y.val.toNat : ℤ) ^ 2 - 2 ^ k * c
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : toZMod (1 - u * y * y)
      = ((1 - (u.val.toNat : ℤ) * (y.val.toNat : ℤ) ^ 2 : ℤ) : ZMod (2 ^ k)) := by
    rw [toZMod_sub, toZMod_mul, toZMod_mul, toZMod_one]
    unfold toZMod
    push_cast; ring
  have h2 : (((1 - u * y * y).val.toNat : ℤ) : ZMod (2 ^ k))
      = ((1 - (u.val.toNat : ℤ) * (y.val.toNat : ℤ) ^ 2 : ℤ) : ZMod (2 ^ k)) := by
    rw [Int.cast_natCast]; exact h1
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub _ _ _).mp h2
  push_cast at hc
  exact ⟨c, by linarith⟩

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.invSqrtStep_of_dvd
statement:
theorem invSqrtStep_of_dvd (u y : AzZModPow2 k)
    (h : (2 : ℤ) ^ k ∣ 1 - (u.val.toNat : ℤ) * (y.val.toNat : ℤ) ^ 2) :
    invSqrtStep u y = y
proof:
:= by
  have he : (1 - u * y * y) = 0 := by
    apply toZMod_injective
    rw [toZMod_sub, toZMod_mul, toZMod_mul, toZMod_one, toZMod_zero]
    have : (((1 - (u.val.toNat : ℤ) * (y.val.toNat : ℤ) ^ 2 : ℤ)) : ZMod (2 ^ k)) = 0 := by
      rw [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]; exact_mod_cast h
    push_cast at this
    unfold toZMod
    linear_combination this
  unfold invSqrtStep
  dsimp only
  rw [he]
  have h0 : ofAzNat k ((0 : AzZModPow2 k).val >>> 1) = 0 := by
    apply eq_of_toNat_val
    rw [toNat_val_ofAzNat, AzNat.toNat_hShiftRight, toNat_val_zero]
    simp
  rw [h0, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.invSqrtStep_spec
statement:
theorem invSqrtStep_spec (u y : AzZModPow2 k) (j : ℕ) (hj3 : 3 ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k)
    (h : (2 : ℤ) ^ j ∣ 1 - (u.val.toNat : ℤ) * (y.val.toNat : ℤ) ^ 2) :
    (2 : ℤ) ^ min k (2 * j - 2) ∣
      1 - (u.val.toNat : ℤ) * ((invSqrtStep u y).val.toNat : ℤ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set U : ℤ := (u.val.toNat : ℤ) with hU
  set Y : ℤ := (y.val.toNat : ℤ) with hY
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := err_val_eq u y
  rw [← hU, ← hY] at hc
  set N : ℕ := (1 - u * y * y).val.toNat with hN
  
  have h2E : (2 : ℤ) ∣ 1 - U * Y ^ 2 := (dvd_pow_self 2 (by omega : j ≠ 0)).trans h
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h2E
  have hjf : (2 : ℤ) ^ (j - 1) ∣ f := by
    have : (2 : ℤ) ^ (j - 1) * 2 ∣ f * 2 := by
      rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega), mul_comm f, ← hf]; exact h
    exact (mul_dvd_mul_iff_right two_ne_zero).mp this
  set K2 : ℤ := 2 ^ (k - 2) with hK2
  have h4 : (2 : ℤ) ^ k = 4 * K2 := by
    rw [hK2, show (4 : ℤ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (by omega : 2 ≤ k)]
  
  set H : ℕ := ((1 - u * y * y).val >>> 1).toNat with hHdef
  have hH2 : 2 * (H : ℤ) = N := by
    have h2N : 2 ∣ N := by
      have : (2 : ℤ) ∣ (N : ℤ) := by
        rw [hc, hf, h4]
        exact ⟨f - 2 * K2 * c, by ring⟩
      exact_mod_cast this
    rw [hHdef, AzNat.toNat_hShiftRight, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow, pow_one]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_div_cancel' h2N
  
  have hY' : ∃ d : ℤ, ((invSqrtStep u y).val.toNat : ℤ) = Y * (1 + H) - 2 ^ k * d := by
    have h1 : toZMod (invSqrtStep u y) = ((Y * (1 + H) : ℤ) : ZMod (2 ^ k)) := by
      unfold invSqrtStep
      rw [toZMod_add, toZMod_mul, toZMod_ofAzNat, ← hHdef, hY]
      unfold toZMod
      push_cast; ring
    have h2 : (((invSqrtStep u y).val.toNat : ℤ) : ZMod (2 ^ k))
        = ((Y * (1 + H) : ℤ) : ZMod (2 ^ k)) := by
      rw [Int.cast_natCast]; exact h1
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub _ _ _).mp h2
    push_cast at hd
    exact ⟨d, by linarith⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hY'
  rw [hd]
  have hE' : U * Y ^ 2 = 1 - 2 * f := by linarith
  have hH' : (H : ℤ) = f + 2 * K2 * (-c) := by
    have : (2 : ℤ) * H = 2 * (f + 2 * K2 * (-c)) := by rw [hH2, hc, hf, h4]; ring
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ two_ne_zero this
  have hdiff : 1 - U * (Y * (1 + H) - 2 ^ k * d) ^ 2
      = (1 - U * (Y * (1 + H)) ^ 2) + 2 ^ k * (U * d * (2 * Y * (1 + H) - 2 ^ k * d)) := by
    ring
  rw [hdiff, hH', newton_perturb, newton_identity U Y f hE', h4]
  have hmin_k : (2 : ℤ) ^ min k (2 * j - 2) ∣ 4 * K2 := by
    rw [← h4]; exact pow_dvd_pow 2 (min_le_left _ _)
  have hmin_f : (2 : ℤ) ^ min k (2 * j - 2) ∣ f ^ 2 * (3 + 2 * f) := by
    apply Dvd.dvd.mul_right
    have : (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * j - 2) ∣ f ^ 2 := by
      have := pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd hjf 2
      rwa [← pow_mul, show (j - 1) * 2 = 2 * j - 2 by omega] at this
    exact (pow_dvd_pow 2 (min_le_right _ _)).trans this
  exact dvd_add (dvd_sub hmin_f (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hmin_k _)) (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hmin_k _)

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.invSqrtAux_spec
statement:
theorem invSqrtAux_spec (u : AzZModPow2 k) (hu : u.val.toNat % 8 = 1) : ∀ n : ℕ,
    (2 : ℤ) ^ min k (2 ^ n + 2) ∣
      1 - (u.val.toNat : ℤ) * ((invSqrtAux u n).val.toNat : ℤ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    show (2 : ℤ) ^ min k (2 ^ 0 + 2) ∣ 1 - _ * (((1 : AzZModPow2 k).val.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) ^ 2
    rw [toNat_val_one]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 1 with hk | hk
    · have : k = 0 := by omega
      subst this; simp
    · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.one_lt_two_pow (by omega))]
      push_cast
      have h8 : (8 : ℤ) ∣ 1 - (u.val.toNat : ℤ) := by
        have : (u.val.toNat : ℤ) % 8 = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hu
        omega
      have h8' : (2 : ℤ) ^ min k 3 ∣ 8 := by
        have := pow_dvd_pow (2 : ℤ) (min_le_right k 3)
        norm_num at this
        exact this
      rw [mul_one]
      exact h8'.trans h8
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [invSqrtAux]
    by_cases hk : k ≤ 2 ^ n + 2
    · rw [min_eq_left hk] at ih
      rw [invSqrtStep_of_dvd _ _ ih, min_eq_left (by rw [pow_succ]; omega)]
      exact ih
    · have hk' := not_le.mp hk
      rw [min_eq_right hk'.le] at ih
      have h1 : 1 ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.one_le_two_pow
      have := invSqrtStep_spec u (invSqrtAux u n) (2 ^ n + 2) (by omega) hk'.le ih
      rwa [show 2 * (2 ^ n + 2) - 2 = 2 ^ (n + 1) + 2 by rw [pow_succ]; omega] at this

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.oddSqrt_mul_self
statement:
theorem oddSqrt_mul_self (u : AzZModPow2 k) (hu : u.val.toNat % 8 = 1) :
    oddSqrt u * oddSqrt u = u
proof:
:= by
  have h := invSqrtAux_spec u hu (Nat.clog 2 k)
  rw [min_eq_left ((Nat.le_pow_clog (by norm_num) k).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _))] at h
  set y := invSqrtAux u (Nat.clog 2 k) with hy
  have hz : ((1 - (u.val.toNat : ℤ) * (y.val.toNat : ℤ) ^ 2 : ℤ) : ZMod (2 ^ k)) = 0 := by
    rw [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]; exact_mod_cast h
  have key : u * y * y = 1 := by
    apply toZMod_injective
    rw [toZMod_mul, toZMod_mul, toZMod_one]
    push_cast at hz
    unfold toZMod
    linear_combination (-1 : ZMod (2 ^ k)) * hz
  unfold oddSqrt
  rw [← hy]
  calc u * y * (u * y) = u * (u * y * y) := by ring
    _ = u := by rw [key, mul_one]

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.odd_mul_self_mod_eight
statement: theorem odd_mul_self_mod_eight {t : ℕ} (ht : t % 2 = 1) : t * t % 8 = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, t = 2 * m + 1 := ⟨t / 2, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Nat.even_mul_succ_self m
  have hmc : m * (m + 1) = 2 * c := by rw [two_mul]; exact hc
  have : (2 * m + 1) * (2 * m + 1) = 8 * c + 1 := by
    calc (2 * m + 1) * (2 * m + 1) = 4 * (m * (m + 1)) + 1 := by ring
      _ = 8 * c + 1 := by rw [hmc]; ring
  rw [this]; omega

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.mod_eight_of_odd_sq
statement:
theorem mod_eight_of_odd_sq (u t n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (ht : t % 2 = 1)
    (htt : t * t % 2 ^ n = u) : u % 8 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h8 := odd_mul_self_mod_eight ht
  have h8pow : (8 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 3 := by norm_num
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 3 with hn3 | hn3
  · have hdvd : 2 ^ n ∣ 8 := by rw [h8pow]; exact Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 (by omega)
    have : u = 1 := by
      rw [← htt, ← Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd (t * t) hdvd, h8]
      exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.one_lt_two_pow (by omega))
    omega
  · have hdvd : 8 ∣ 2 ^ n := by rw [h8pow]; exact Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 hn3
    rw [← htt, Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd (t * t) hdvd, h8]

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.sq_mod_pow2_structure
statement:
theorem sq_mod_pow2_structure (r a : ℕ) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hak : a < 2 ^ k)
    (hr : r * r % 2 ^ k = a) :
    padicValNat 2 a % 2 = 0 ∧ padicValNat 2 a < k ∧
      ∃ t, r = 2 ^ (padicValNat 2 a / 2) * t ∧ t % 2 = 1 ∧
        t * t % 2 ^ (k - padicValNat 2 a) = a / 2 ^ padicValNat 2 a
proof:
:= by
  set v := padicValNat 2 a with hv
  have hu := Nat.mul_div_cancel' (pow_padicValNat_dvd (p := 2) (n := a))
  set u := a / 2 ^ v with hudef
  have huodd : u % 2 = 1 := AzNat.odd_div_pow_padicValNat_two ha0
  have hvk : v < k := by
    by_contra hge
    have h1 : 2 ^ k ≤ 2 ^ v := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (not_lt.mp hge)
    have h2 : 2 ^ v ≤ a := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ha0) pow_padicValNat_dvd
    omega
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hr
    exact ha0 hr.symm
  set q := r * r / 2 ^ k with hq
  have hrr : r * r = 2 ^ k * q + a := by rw [← hr, hq, Nat.div_add_mod]
  have hk : 2 ^ k = 2 ^ v * 2 ^ (k - v) := by rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hvk.le]
  set m := u + 2 ^ (k - v) * q with hm
  have hmodd : m % 2 = 1 := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : 2 ∣ 2 ^ (k - v) := dvd_pow_self 2 (by omega)
    rw [hm, hc, mul_assoc]; omega
  have hrr' : r * r = 2 ^ v * m := by
    rw [hrr, hk, hm, ← hu]; ring
  have hval : padicValNat 2 (r * r) = v := by
    rw [hrr', padicValNat.mul (by positivity) (by omega), padicValNat.prime_pow,
      padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd (by omega), add_zero]
  have hval2 : padicValNat 2 (r * r) = 2 * padicValNat 2 r := by
    rw [← sq, padicValNat.pow]
  set w := padicValNat 2 r with hw
  have hv2 : v = 2 * w := by rw [← hval, hval2]
  refine ⟨by omega, hvk, r / 2 ^ w, ?_, AzNat.odd_div_pow_padicValNat_two hr0, ?_⟩
  · rw [show v / 2 = w by omega]
    exact (Nat.mul_div_cancel' pow_padicValNat_dvd).symm
  · set t := r / 2 ^ w with ht
    have hrt : r = 2 ^ w * t := (Nat.mul_div_cancel' pow_padicValNat_dvd).symm
    have htt : t * t = m := by
      have h2v : 2 ^ v = 2 ^ w * 2 ^ w := by rw [← pow_add, hv2, two_mul]
      have h1 : 2 ^ v * (t * t) = 2 ^ v * m := by
        rw [← hrr', hrt, h2v]; ring
      exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by positivity) h1
    rw [htt, hm, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left]
    apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
    have := hak
    rw [← hu, hk] at this
    exact Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left this

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.int_roots_of_odd_sq
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 2 with hn2 | hn2
  · have : n = 1 := by omega
    subst this
    left; simp only [pow_one]; omega
  · obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ : ∃ α, t - s = 2 * α := ⟨(t - s) / 2, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ : ∃ β, t + s = 2 * β := ⟨(t + s) / 2, by omega⟩
    have hts : t * t - s * s = 2 ^ 2 * (α * β) := by
      have : t * t - s * s = (t - s) * (t + s) := by ring
      rw [this, hα, hβ]; ring
    have hn' : (2 : ℤ) ^ n = 2 ^ (n - 2) * 2 ^ 2 := by
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hn2]
    have hn1 : (2 : ℤ) ^ (n - 1) = 2 ^ (n - 2) * 2 := by
      rw [← pow_succ]; congr 1; omega
    have hαβ : (2 : ℤ) ^ (n - 2) ∣ α * β := by
      rw [hts, hn', mul_comm ((2 : ℤ) ^ (n - 2))] at h
      exact (mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (by positivity : (2 : ℤ) ^ 2 ≠ 0)).mp h
    have hsum : α + β = t := by omega
    have hcop : ∀ x : ℤ, x % 2 = 1 → IsCoprime ((2 : ℤ) ^ (n - 2)) x := fun x hx =>
      IsCoprime.pow_left ((Int.prime_two.irreducible.coprime_iff_not_dvd).mpr (by omega))
    rcases Int.emod_two_eq_zero_or_one α with hα2 | hα2
    · 
      have hβ2 : β % 2 = 1 := by omega
      obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := (hcop β hβ2).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hαβ
      rcases Int.emod_two_eq_zero_or_one γ with hγ2 | hγ2
      · left
        obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ, γ = 2 * δ := ⟨γ / 2, by omega⟩
        exact ⟨δ, by rw [hα, hγ, hδ, hn']; ring⟩
      · right; right; left
        obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ, γ = 2 * δ + 1 := ⟨γ / 2, by omega⟩
        exact ⟨δ, by rw [hn1, hn']; linear_combination hα + 2 * hγ + 2 * (2 : ℤ) ^ (n - 2) * hδ⟩
    · 
      obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := (hcop α hα2).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hαβ
      rcases Int.emod_two_eq_zero_or_one γ with hγ2 | hγ2
      · right; left
        obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ, γ = 2 * δ := ⟨γ / 2, by omega⟩
        exact ⟨δ, by rw [sub_neg_eq_add, hβ, hγ, hδ, hn']; ring⟩
      · right; right; right
        obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ, γ = 2 * δ + 1 := ⟨γ / 2, by omega⟩
        exact ⟨δ, by rw [hn1, hn']; linear_combination hβ + 2 * hγ + 2 * (2 : ℤ) ^ (n - 2) * hδ⟩

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.mod_eq_val_of_dvd
statement:
theorem mod_eq_val_of_dvd {n : ℕ} (t : ℕ) (x : AzZModPow2 n) (c : ℤ)
    (hc : toZMod x = (c : ZMod (2 ^ n))) (h : (2 : ℤ) ^ n ∣ (t : ℤ) - c) :
    t % 2 ^ n = x.val.toNat
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((t : ℤ) : ZMod (2 ^ n)) = (c : ZMod (2 ^ n)) := by
    rw [ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub]
    push_cast
    exact dvd_sub_comm.mp h
  rw [← val_toZMod x, hc, ← h1, Int.cast_natCast, ZMod.val_natCast]

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.leastRoot_some
statement:
theorem leastRoot_some (u : AzNat) (n : ℕ) : ∀ (l : List AzNat) (c : AzNat),
    leastRoot u n l = some c → c ∈ l ∧ (c * c).modPow2 n = u
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro c h; simp [leastRoot] at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro c h
    unfold leastRoot at h
    dsimp only at h
    split_ifs at h with hx
    · obtain rfl := Option.some.inj h
      split
      · exact ⟨List.mem_cons_self .., hx⟩
      · rename_i m hm
        obtain ⟨hmem, hmroot⟩ := ih m hm
        rcases min_choice x m with hmin | hmin
        · rw [hmin]; exact ⟨List.mem_cons_self .., hx⟩
        · rw [hmin]; exact ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hmem, hmroot⟩
    · obtain ⟨hmem, hroot⟩ := ih c h
      exact ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hmem, hroot⟩

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.leastRoot_le
statement:
theorem leastRoot_le (u : AzNat) (n : ℕ) : ∀ (l : List AzNat) (c : AzNat),
    c ∈ l → (c * c).modPow2 n = u → ∃ m, leastRoot u n l = some m ∧ m ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro c h; simp at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro c hc hroot
    unfold leastRoot
    dsimp only
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hc with rfl | hmem
    · rw [ite_eq_left hroot]
      split
      · exact ⟨c, rfl, le_rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨_, rfl, min_le_left _ _⟩
    · obtain ⟨m, hm, hle⟩ := ih c hmem hroot
      split_ifs with hx
      · rw [hm]
        exact ⟨_, rfl, (min_le_right _ _).trans hle⟩
      · exact ⟨m, hm, hle⟩

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.sqrt?_some
statement: theorem sqrt?_some {a r : AzZModPow2 k} (h : sqrt? a = some r) : r * r = a
proof:
:= by
  unfold sqrt? at h
  split at h
  · rename_i hz
    obtain rfl := Option.some.inj h
    have : a = 0 := by
      apply ext
      by_contra hne
      rw [AzNat.trailingZeros_eq_padicValNat _ hne] at hz
      cases hz
    rw [this, mul_zero]
  · try dsimp only at h
    split_ifs at h with h1 h2
    split at h
    · cases h
    · try dsimp only at h
      split_ifs at h with h3
      obtain rfl := Option.some.inj h
      exact h3

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.exists_candidate
statement:
theorem exists_candidate {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (s t : ℕ) (hs : s % 2 = 1) (ht : t % 2 = 1)
    (hst : s * s % 2 ^ n = t * t % 2 ^ n) :
    let S : AzZModPow2 n
proof:
:= ofAzNat n (AzNat.ofNat s)
    let H : AzZModPow2 n := ofAzNat n ((1 : AzNat) <<< (n - 1))
    ∃ X ∈ [S.val, (-S).val, (S + H).val, (-S + H).val], t % 2 ^ n = X.toNat := by
  intro S H
  have hdvd : (2 : ℤ) ^ n ∣ (t : ℤ) * t - (s : ℤ) * s := by
    have := (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd.mp (hst : s * s ≡ t * t [MOD 2 ^ n]))
    push_cast at this
    exact this
  have hS : toZMod S = ((s : ℤ) : ZMod (2 ^ n)) := by
    rw [toZMod_ofAzNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, Int.cast_natCast]
  have hH : toZMod H = (((2 : ℤ) ^ (n - 1) : ℤ) : ZMod (2 ^ n)) := by
    rw [toZMod_ofAzNat, AzNat.toNat_hShiftLeft, Nat.shiftLeft_eq, AzNat.toNat_one, one_mul]
    push_cast; rfl
  rcases int_roots_of_odd_sq s t n hn (by exact_mod_cast hs) (by exact_mod_cast ht) hdvd
    with h | h | h | h
  · exact ⟨S.val, by simp, mod_eq_val_of_dvd t S _ hS h⟩
  · exact ⟨(-S).val, by simp, mod_eq_val_of_dvd t (-S) _ (by rw [toZMod_neg, hS]; push_cast; rfl) h⟩
  · exact ⟨(S + H).val, by simp,
      mod_eq_val_of_dvd t (S + H) _ (by rw [toZMod_add, hS, hH]; push_cast; rfl) h⟩
  · exact ⟨(-S + H).val, by simp,
      mod_eq_val_of_dvd t (-S + H) _ (by rw [toZMod_add, toZMod_neg, hS, hH]; push_cast; rfl) h⟩

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.sqrt?_of_root
statement:
theorem sqrt?_of_root {a r' : AzZModPow2 k} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hr' : r' * r' = a) :
    ∃ r, sqrt? a = some r ∧ r.val.toNat ≤ r'.val.toNat
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : a.val.toNat ≠ 0 := fun h => ha (eq_of_toNat_val (by rw [h, toNat_val_zero]))
  have hav : a.val ≠ 0 := fun h => ha0 (by rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero])
  have hak : a.val.toNat < 2 ^ k := a.isLt
  have hrr : r'.val.toNat * r'.val.toNat % 2 ^ k = a.val.toNat := by
    rw [← toNat_val_mul, hr']
  obtain ⟨hveven, hvk, t, hrt, htodd, htt⟩ :=
    sq_mod_pow2_structure r'.val.toNat a.val.toNat ha0 hak hrr
  set v := padicValNat 2 a.val.toNat with hv
  set w := v / 2 with hw
  have hvw : v = 2 * w := by omega
  set n := k - v with hn
  set uN := a.val.toNat / 2 ^ v with huN
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by omega
  have hu2 := Nat.mul_div_cancel' (pow_padicValNat_dvd (p := 2) (n := a.val.toNat))
  rw [← huN] at hu2
  have hk : 2 ^ k = 2 ^ v * 2 ^ n := by rw [← pow_add, hn, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hvk.le]
  have huN_lt : uN < 2 ^ n := by
    have := hak
    rw [← hu2, hk] at this
    exact Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left this
  have hu8 : uN % 8 = 1 := mod_eight_of_odd_sq uN t n hn1 htodd htt
  have hu_toNat : (a.val >>> v).toNat = uN := by
    rw [AzNat.toNat_hShiftRight, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  have hnk : 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
  
  unfold sqrt?
  rw [AzNat.trailingZeros_eq_padicValNat _ hav]
  try dsimp only
  rw [ite_eq_right (by omega : ¬ v % 2 = 1)]
  have hmod3 : (a.val >>> v).modPow2 3 = 1 := by
    apply AzNat.toNat_injective
    rw [AzNat.toNat_modPow2, hu_toNat, AzNat.toNat_one]
    exact hu8
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_not.mpr hmod3)]
  try dsimp only
  
  set s := (oddSqrt (ofAzNat k (a.val >>> v))).val with hs
  have hs_sq : s.toNat * s.toNat % 2 ^ k = uN := by
    have h1 := oddSqrt_mul_self (ofAzNat k (a.val >>> v))
      (by rw [toNat_val_ofAzNat, hu_toNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le huN_lt hnk)]; exact hu8)
    have := congrArg (fun x : AzZModPow2 k => x.val.toNat) h1
    rwa [toNat_val_mul, toNat_val_ofAzNat, hu_toNat,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le huN_lt hnk)] at this
  have hs_sq_n : s.toNat * s.toNat % 2 ^ n = uN := by
    rw [← Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd (s.toNat * s.toNat) (Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 (by omega : n ≤ k)), hs_sq,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt huN_lt]
  have hsodd : s.toNat % 2 = 1 := by
    rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one s.toNat with h0 | h1
    · exfalso
      have h2 : s.toNat * s.toNat % 2 = 0 := by rw [Nat.mul_mod, h0]
      have h3 : uN % 2 = s.toNat * s.toNat % 2 := by
        rw [← hs_sq_n, Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ (dvd_pow_self 2 (by omega : n ≠ 0))]
      omega
    · exact h1
  
  obtain ⟨X, hXmem, hXt⟩ := exists_candidate hn1 s.toNat t hsodd htodd (by rw [hs_sq_n, htt])
  have hX_root : (X * X).modPow2 n = a.val >>> v := by
    apply AzNat.toNat_injective
    rw [AzNat.toNat_modPow2, AzNat.toNat_mul, hu_toNat, ← hXt, ← Nat.mul_mod, htt]
  have hofNat : AzNat.ofNat s.toNat = s := AzNat.toNat_injective (AzNat.toNat_ofNat _)
  rw [hofNat] at hXmem
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmle⟩ := leastRoot_le (a.val >>> v) n _ X hXmem hX_root
  rw [hm]
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨_, hmroot⟩ := leastRoot_some _ _ _ _ hm
  have hm_sq : m.toNat * m.toNat % 2 ^ n = uN := by
    have := congrArg AzNat.toNat hmroot
    rwa [AzNat.toNat_modPow2, AzNat.toNat_mul, hu_toNat] at this
  
  have hm_lt : m.toNat < 2 ^ n := by
    have := (AzNat.le_iff_toNat_le _ _).mp hmle
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt this (by rw [← hXt]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by positivity))
  set r := ofAzNat k (m <<< w) with hr
  have hr_val : r.val.toNat = m.toNat * 2 ^ w := by
    rw [hr, toNat_val_ofAzNat, AzNat.toNat_hShiftLeft, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
    apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
    calc m.toNat * 2 ^ w < 2 ^ n * 2 ^ w := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hm_lt (by positivity)
      _ = 2 ^ (n + w) := by rw [pow_add]
      _ ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hcheck : r * r = a := by
    apply eq_of_toNat_val
    rw [toNat_val_mul, hr_val]
    set q := m.toNat * m.toNat / 2 ^ n with hq
    have hmq : m.toNat * m.toNat = 2 ^ n * q + uN := by rw [← hm_sq, hq, Nat.div_add_mod]
    have : m.toNat * 2 ^ w * (m.toNat * 2 ^ w) = 2 ^ k * q + a.val.toNat := by
      calc m.toNat * 2 ^ w * (m.toNat * 2 ^ w) = (m.toNat * m.toNat) * (2 ^ w * 2 ^ w) := by ring
        _ = (2 ^ n * q + uN) * 2 ^ v := by rw [hmq, ← pow_add, hvw, two_mul]
        _ = 2 ^ k * q + a.val.toNat := by rw [hk, ← hu2]; ring
    rw [this, Nat.mul_add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hak]
  rw [ite_eq_left hcheck]
  refine ⟨r, rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [hr_val, hrt, mul_comm (2 ^ w)]
  apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
  calc m.toNat ≤ X.toNat := (AzNat.le_iff_toNat_le _ _).mp hmle
    _ = t % 2 ^ n := hXt.symm
    _ ≤ t := Nat.mod_le _ _

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.sqrt?_isSome_iff
statement: theorem sqrt?_isSome_iff (a : AzZModPow2 k) : (sqrt? a).isSome ↔ IsSquare (toZMod a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSquare_toZMod_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp h
    exact ⟨r, sqrt?_some hr⟩
  · rintro ⟨r', hr'⟩
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · subst ha
      unfold sqrt?
      rw [show (0 : AzZModPow2 k).val = 0 from rfl, AzNat.trailingZeros_zero]
      rfl
    · obtain ⟨r, hr, _⟩ := sqrt?_of_root ha hr'
      rw [hr]; rfl

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.sqrt?_le
statement:
theorem sqrt?_le {a r : AzZModPow2 k} (h : sqrt? a = some r) (r' : AzZModPow2 k)
    (hr' : r' * r' = a) : r.val ≤ r'.val
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · subst ha
    unfold sqrt? at h
    rw [show (0 : AzZModPow2 k).val = 0 from rfl, AzNat.trailingZeros_zero] at h
    obtain rfl := Option.some.inj h
    rw [AzNat.le_iff_toNat_le, toNat_val_zero]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  · obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hle⟩ := sqrt?_of_root ha hr'
    rw [h] at hr₀
    obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hr₀
    exact (AzNat.le_iff_toNat_le _ _).mpr hle

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.toZMod_ofAzNat
statement:
@[simp] theorem toZMod_ofAzNat (n : AzNat) :
    toZMod (ofAzNat k n) = (n.toNat : ZMod (2 ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  show (((n.modPow2 k).toNat : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ k)) = (n.toNat : ZMod (2 ^ k))
  rw [AzNat.toNat_modPow2, ZMod.natCast_mod]

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.toZMod_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem toZMod_zero : toZMod (0 : AzZModPow2 k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show ((0 : AzNat).toNat : ZMod (2 ^ k)) = 0
  rw [AzNat.toNat_zero, Nat.cast_zero]

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.toZMod_one
statement: @[simp] theorem toZMod_one : toZMod (1 : AzZModPow2 k) = 1
proof:
:= by
  show toZMod (ofAzNat k 1) = 1
  rw [toZMod_ofAzNat]
  show ((1 : AzNat).toNat : ZMod (2 ^ k)) = 1
  rw [AzNat.toNat_one, Nat.cast_one]

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.toZMod_ofZMod
statement: theorem toZMod_ofZMod (z : ZMod (2 ^ k)) : toZMod (ofZMod z) = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofZMod, toZMod_ofAzNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.ofZMod_toZMod
statement: theorem ofZMod_toZMod (a : AzZModPow2 k) : ofZMod (toZMod a) = a
proof:
:= by
  have hv : (toZMod a).val = a.val.toNat := by
    show ((a.val.toNat : ZMod (2 ^ k)).val) = a.val.toNat
    rw [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt a.isLt]
  apply ext
  apply AzNat.toNat_injective
  show ((AzNat.ofNat (toZMod a).val).modPow2 k).toNat = a.val.toNat
  rw [AzNat.toNat_modPow2, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, hv, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt a.isLt]

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.equivZMod_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem equivZMod_apply (a : AzZModPow2 k) : equivZMod a = toZMod a
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.equivZMod_symm_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem equivZMod_symm_apply (z : ZMod (2 ^ k)) : equivZMod.symm z = ofZMod z
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.toZMod_injective
statement: theorem toZMod_injective : Function.Injective (toZMod (k := k))
proof: := equivZMod.injective

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.toZMod_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem toZMod_neg (a : AzZModPow2 k) : toZMod (-a) = -(toZMod a)
proof:
:= by
  show toZMod (neg a) = -(toZMod a)
  unfold neg
  by_cases h : a.val.limbs.size = 0
  · rw [dite_eq_left h]
    have hz : toZMod a = 0 := by
      show ((a.val.toNat : ℕ) : ZMod (2 ^ k)) = 0
      rw [(AzNat.toNat_eq_zero_iff a.val).mpr h, Nat.cast_zero]
    rw [toZMod_zero, hz, neg_zero]
  · rw [dite_eq_right h]
    show ((AzNat.lowMask k - a.val + 1).toNat : ZMod (2 ^ k)) = -(toZMod a)
    rw [AzNat.toNat_add, AzNat.toNat_one, AzNat.toNat_sub, AzNat.toNat_lowMask]
    have h2 : a.val.toNat ≤ 2 ^ k := le_of_lt a.isLt
    have hval : 2 ^ k - 1 - a.val.toNat + 1 = 2 ^ k - a.val.toNat := by
      have hlt : a.val.toNat < 2 ^ k := a.isLt
      omega
    rw [hval, Nat.cast_sub h2, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_sub]
    rfl

name: Azurite.AzZModPow2.ofZMod_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem ofZMod_neg (z : ZMod (2 ^ k)) : ofZMod (-z) = -(ofZMod z)
proof:
:= by
  apply toZMod_injective
