:= fun q _ m =>
  setPrecRound_eq_roundVal (toVal_of_isFinite hx) q m

name: Azurite.AzFloat.setPrecRound_floor_spec
statement:
theorem setPrecRound_floor_spec (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ}
    (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal)) :
    ∃ bv : ℝ, (setPrecRound x (p + 1) .Floor).1.toVal = some (bv : EReal) ∧
      ((bv : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ floatSet (p + 1) ∧ bv ≤ xv ∧
      ∀ c : ℝ, ((c : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ floatSet (p + 1) → c ≤ xv → c ≤ bv
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero (p + 1) := ⟨Nat.succ_ne_zero p⟩
  rw [setPrecRound_eq_roundVal hx]
  obtain ⟨bv, hbv⟩ :
      ∃ r : ℝ, ((r : ℝ) : EReal) = (roundFloor (floatSet (p + 1)) xv).val := by
    rw [val_roundFloor_floatSet]; exact precisionSet_exists_real _
  refine ⟨bv, ?_, hbv ▸ (roundFloor _ _).property, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [(roundVal_coe (p + 1) .Floor xv).1]
    exact congrArg some hbv.symm
  · have := (isGreatest_roundFloor (floatSet (p + 1)) xv).1.2
    rw [← hbv] at this
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp this
  · intro c hc hcx
    have := (isGreatest_roundFloor (floatSet (p + 1)) xv).2 ⟨hc, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hcx⟩
    rw [← hbv] at this
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_congr_of_no_boundary_Ioo
statement:
theorem roundVal_congr_of_no_boundary_Ioo (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode)
    (a b lo hi : ℝ) (ha : lo < a) (ha' : a < hi) (hb : lo < b) (hb' : b < hi)
    (h : ∀ c : ℝ, ((c : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ floatSet (p + 1) → ¬ (lo < c ∧ c < hi)) :
    roundVal p mode (some (a : EReal)) = roundVal p mode (some (b : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hab
  · exact roundVal_congr_of_no_boundary p mode a b hab
      (fun c hc ⟨h1, h2⟩ => h c hc ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
  · exact (roundVal_congr_of_no_boundary p mode b a hab
      (fun c hc ⟨h1, h2⟩ => h c hc ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)).symm

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_addPrecRound_floor
statement:
theorem toVal_addPrecRound_floor {x y : AzFloat} {xv yv : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal))
    (hy : y.toVal = some (yv : EReal)) (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    (addPrecRound x y w .Floor).1 = (roundVal w .Floor (some ((xv + yv : ℝ) : EReal))).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [addPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂]
  unfold liftVal₂
  rw [hx, hy, Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some, Spec.add_coe_coe]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sumFinite_eq
statement:
theorem sumFinite_eq (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (l : List AzFloat), IsNormalList l → l.length < fuel →
      sumFinite p mode fuel l = roundVal p mode (some ((realSum l : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 1 ≤ p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro l _ h; omega
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro l hl hlen
    cases l with
    | nil =>
      show (zero, Ordering.eq) = _
      rw [realSum_nil, EReal.coe_zero]
      exact (roundVal_of_toVal p mode zero 0 (Or.inr rfl) rfl).symm
    | cons x xs =>
      have hne : x :: xs ≠ [] := List.cons_ne_nil x xs
      set W := p + lengthBits (x :: xs) + 3 + zivGuardBits with hW
      obtain ⟨hwinN, hrestN, hsum, hlenW, hwinne, hrestexp, hsingle⟩ :=
        splitWindow_spec (x :: xs) W hl hne
      have hsplit : splitWindow (x :: xs) W
          = ((splitWindow (x :: xs) W).1, (splitWindow (x :: xs) W).2) := Prod.ext rfl rfl
      obtain ⟨hs₁fin, hs₁val⟩ := exactSum_spec _ hwinN.isFiniteList
      rw [sumFinite.eq_def]
      dsimp only
      rw [hsplit]
      dsimp only
      set win := (splitWindow (x :: xs) W).1 with hwin
      set rest := (splitWindow (x :: xs) W).2 with hrest
      set s₁ := exactSum win with hs₁
      clear_value win rest s₁
      rw [hsum, ← hs₁val]
      cases rest with
      | nil =>
        dsimp only
        rw [realSum_nil, add_zero, setPrecRound_eq_liftE]
        unfold liftE liftVal
        rw [toVal_of_isFinite hs₁fin, Option.bind_some]
        simp only [id_eq]
      | cons r rs =>
        dsimp only
        have hrne : r :: rs ≠ [] := List.cons_ne_nil r rs
        obtain ⟨hTval, hTnorm, hTbound⟩ := tailBound_spec (r :: rs) hrestN hrne
        have hTfin : (tailBound (r :: rs)).isFinite = true :=
          ((isNormal_iff_isFinite_ne_zero _).mp hTnorm).1
        set Tv : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ ((maxExponent (r :: rs)).toInt + lengthBits (r :: rs)) with hTv
        have hTf : fval (tailBound (r :: rs)) = Tv := fval_of_toVal_coe hTval
        have hTpos : 0 < Tv := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
        set Rv := realSum (r :: rs) with hRv
        
        have hTsfin : (tailBound (r :: rs) <<< (p + 4)).isFinite = true :=
          isFinite_of_toVal_coe (toVal_shiftLeft_nat hTfin (p + 4))
        have hTsf :
            fval (tailBound (r :: rs) <<< (p + 4)) = Tv * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
          rw [fval_of_toVal_coe (toVal_shiftLeft_nat hTfin (p + 4)), hTf]
        by_cases hlt : absLt s₁ (tailBound (r :: rs) <<< (p + 4)) = true
        · 
          rw [ite_eq_left hlt]
          rw [absLt_iff hs₁fin hTsfin, hTsf] at hlt
          have hwin2 : 2 ≤ win.length := by
            by_contra hlt2
            have h1 : win.length = 1 := by
              have := List.length_pos_of_ne_nil hwinne; omega
            obtain ⟨y, hy, hye⟩ := hsingle h1
            have hyN : y.isNormal = true := hwinN y (by rw [hy]; exact List.mem_singleton_self y)
            have hs₁y : fval s₁ = fval y := by
              rw [hs₁val, hy, realSum_cons, realSum_nil, add_zero]
            have hlow := (abs_fval_bounds hyN).1
            rw [hye] at hlow
            obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hr₀e⟩ := exists_expOf_eq_maxExponent hrne
            have hr₀ := hrestexp r₀ hr₀
            rw [hr₀e] at hr₀
            have hk : lengthBits (r :: rs) ≤ lengthBits (x :: xs) := by
              rw [lengthBits_eq, lengthBits_eq]
              exact Nat.size_le_size (by rw [hlenW]; omega)
            have hT : Tv * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ)
                ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ ((maxExponent (x :: xs)).toInt - 64) := by
              rw [hTv, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
              apply zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num)
              rw [hW] at hr₀
              simp only [zivGuardBits] at hr₀
              push_cast at hr₀ ⊢
              omega
            have : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((maxExponent (x :: xs)).toInt - 64)
                < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((maxExponent (x :: xs)).toInt - 1) :=
              zpow_lt_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
            rw [hs₁y] at hlt
            linarith
          have hlen' : (if s₁ = zero then r :: rs else s₁ :: r :: rs).length < fuel := by
            split_ifs <;> simp only [List.length_cons] at hlenW hlen ⊢ <;> omega
          have hN' : IsNormalList (if s₁ = zero then r :: rs else s₁ :: r :: rs) := by
            split_ifs with h0
            · exact hrestN
            · intro y hy
              rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with rfl | hy
              · exact isNormal_of_isFinite_ne_zero hs₁fin h0
              · exact hrestN y hy
          rw [ih _ hN' hlen']
          split_ifs with h0
          · rw [h0, fval_zero, zero_add]
          · rw [realSum_cons]
        · 
          rw [ite_eq_right hlt]
          rw [absLt_iff hs₁fin hTsfin, hTsf] at hlt
          have hge : Tv * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ |fval s₁| := not_lt.mp hlt
          have hs₁ne : s₁ ≠ zero := by
            intro h0
            rw [h0, fval_zero, abs_zero] at hge
            have : 0 < Tv * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by positivity
            linarith
          have hs₁N : s₁.isNormal = true := isNormal_of_isFinite_ne_zero hs₁fin hs₁ne
          have hs₁tv : s₁.toVal = some ((fval s₁ : ℝ) : EReal) := toVal_of_isFinite hs₁fin
          have hs₁negtv : (-s₁).toVal = some ((-fval s₁ : ℝ) : EReal) :=
            toVal_neg_of_isFinite hs₁fin
          have hTnegtv : (-(tailBound (r :: rs))).toVal = some ((-Tv : ℝ) : EReal) := by
            rw [toVal_neg_of_isFinite hTfin, hTf]
          set s₁v := fval s₁ with hs₁v
          set E := (expOf s₁).toInt with hE
          obtain ⟨hElow, hEhigh⟩ := abs_fval_bounds hs₁N
          rw [← hs₁v, ← hE] at hElow hEhigh
          
          set B : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (E - p - 4) with hB
          have hBpos : 0 < B := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
          have hTB : Tv < B := by
            have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ) * B = (2 : ℝ) ^ E := by
              rw [hB, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
            have h3 : Tv * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ) < 2 ^ E := lt_of_le_of_lt hge hEhigh
            rw [← h2] at h3
            have hpow : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by positivity
            nlinarith
          have hB5 : B ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (E - 5) := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
          have hE2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (E - 2) = 8 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (E - 5) := by
            rw [show E - 2 = (E - 5) + 3 by ring, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]; norm_num; ring
          have hE1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (E - 1) = 16 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (E - 5) := by
            rw [show E - 1 = (E - 5) + 4 by ring, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]; norm_num; ring
          have h4B : (2 : ℝ) ^ (E - 2 - p) = 4 * B := by
            rw [hB, show E - 2 - p = (E - p - 4) + 2 by ring, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
            norm_num; ring
          have hw2 : 2 ≤ W := by rw [hW, zivGuardBits]; omega
          have : NeZero W := ⟨by omega⟩
          set δ : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (E + 3 - W) with hδ
          have hδpos : 0 < δ := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
          have hδB : 4 * δ ≤ B := by
            have : (2 : ℝ) ^ (E + 3 - W) * 4 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (E - p - 4) := by
              rw [show (4 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℤ) by norm_num, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
              apply zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num)
              rw [hW, zivGuardBits]; push_cast; omega
            linarith
          
          have hxbound : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ Tv → |s₁v + t| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (E + 1) := by
            intro t ht
            have : (2 : ℝ) ^ (E + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ E := by rw [zpow_add_one₀ (by norm_num)]; ring
            calc |s₁v + t| ≤ |s₁v| + |t| := abs_add_le _ _
              _ ≤ 2 ^ E + Tv := by linarith
              _ ≤ 2 * 2 ^ E := by linarith [hTB, hB5, hE2, hE1]
              _ = _ := this.symm
          obtain ⟨lov, hlo, hlo1, hlo2⟩ := floor_err_le W hw2 (s₁v + -Tv) E
            (hxbound (-Tv) (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hTpos]))
          rw [← toVal_addPrecRound_floor hs₁tv hTnegtv W] at hlo
          obtain ⟨yv, hyv, hyv1, hyv2⟩ := floor_err_le W hw2 (-s₁v + -Tv) E
            (by rw [show -s₁v + -Tv = -(s₁v + Tv) by ring, abs_neg]
                exact hxbound Tv (by rw [abs_of_pos hTpos]))
          rw [← toVal_addPrecRound_floor hs₁negtv hTnegtv W] at hyv
          set lo := (addPrecRound s₁ (-(tailBound (r :: rs))) W .Floor).1 with hlodef
          set hi := -(addPrecRound (-s₁) (-(tailBound (r :: rs))) W .Floor).1 with hhidef
          have hhi : hi.toVal = some ((-yv : ℝ) : EReal) := by
            rw [hhidef, toVal_neg, hyv, Option.map_some, EReal.coe_neg]
          set hiv := -yv with hhiv
          have hlofin : lo.isFinite = true := isFinite_of_toVal_coe hlo
          have hhifin : hi.isFinite = true := isFinite_of_toVal_coe hhi
          have hlof : fval lo = lov := fval_of_toVal_coe hlo
          have hhif : fval hi = hiv := fval_of_toVal_coe hhi
          
          set v := s₁v + Rv with hv
          have hRlt : -Tv < Rv ∧ Rv < Tv := abs_lt.mp hTbound
          have hlov : lov < v := by linarith
          have hvhi : v < hiv := by linarith
          have hwidth : hiv - lov < 4 * B := by linarith
          
          have hmag : ∀ c : ℝ, lov < c → c ≤ hiv → (2 : ℝ) ^ (E - 2) ≤ |c| := by
            intro c hc1 hc2
            have h1 : |c - s₁v| ≤ Tv + δ := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
            have h2 : |s₁v| - |c| ≤ |s₁v - c| := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub _ _
            rw [abs_sub_comm] at h2
            linarith
          have huniq : ∀ b c : ℝ, ((b : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ floatSet (p + 1) →
              ((c : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ floatSet (p + 1) →
              lov < b → b ≤ hiv → lov < c → c ≤ hiv → b = c := by
            intro b c hb hc hb1 hb2 hc1 hc2
            by_contra hne
            have := boundary_dist p E b c hb hc (hmag b hb1 hb2) (hmag c hc1 hc2) hne
            rw [h4B] at this
            have : |b - c| < 4 * B := by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
            linarith
          have hRl : Rounds (fun q m => setPrecRound lo q m) lov :=
            hlof ▸ rounds_setPrecRound hlofin
          have hRh : Rounds (fun q m => setPrecRound hi q m) hiv :=
            hhif ▸ rounds_setPrecRound hhifin
          split
          · rename_i res hres
            exact roundingPossible_eq p mode hRl hRh hlov.le hvhi.le
              (fun h => absurd h hlov.ne) hres
          · 
            obtain ⟨bv, hbtv, hbmem, hbhi, hbgreatest⟩ := setPrecRound_floor_spec p hhi
            set b := (setPrecRound hi (p + 1) .Floor).1 with hbdef
            have hbfin : b.isFinite = true := isFinite_of_toVal_coe hbtv
            have hbf : fval b = bv := fval_of_toVal_coe hbtv
            have hdtv : (exactSub s₁ b).toVal = some ((s₁v - bv : ℝ) : EReal) := by
              rw [toVal_exactSub hs₁fin hbfin, hbf]
            have hdfin : (exactSub s₁ b).isFinite = true := isFinite_of_toVal_coe hdtv
            have hdf : fval (exactSub s₁ b) = s₁v - bv := fval_of_toVal_coe hdtv
            set d := exactSub s₁ b with hddef
            have hL : ∃ L : List AzFloat, (if d = zero then r :: rs else d :: r :: rs) = L ∧
                IsNormalList L ∧ L.length < (r :: rs).length + 2 ∧ realSum L = v - bv := by
              by_cases h0 : d = zero
              · refine ⟨r :: rs, ite_eq_left h0, hrestN,
                  by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega, ?_⟩
                have : fval d = 0 := by rw [h0, fval_zero]
                rw [hdf] at this
                rw [hv]; linarith
              · refine ⟨d :: r :: rs, ite_eq_right h0, ?_,
                  by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega, ?_⟩
                · intro y hy
                  rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with rfl | hy
                  · exact isNormal_of_isFinite_ne_zero hdfin h0
                  · exact hrestN y hy
                · rw [realSum_cons, hdf, hv]; ring
            obtain ⟨L, hLeq, hLN, hLlen, hLsum⟩ := hL
            rw [hLeq, signSum_eq _ L hLN hLlen, hLsum]
            rcases lt_trichotomy v bv with hvb | hvb | hvb
            · 
              rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (by linarith : v - bv < 0)]
              dsimp only
              have hmfin := isFinite_exactAdd hlofin hbfin
              have hmtv : (exactAdd lo b >>> (1 : ℕ)).toVal
                  = some (((lov + bv) / 2 : ℝ) : EReal) := by
                rw [toVal_shiftRight_one hmfin, fval_exactAdd hlofin hbfin, hlof, hbf]
              rw [setPrecRound_eq_roundVal hmtv]
              apply roundVal_congr_of_no_boundary_Ioo p mode _ _ lov bv (by linarith) (by linarith)
                hlov hvb
              intro c hc ⟨h1, h2⟩
              have := huniq c bv hc hbmem h1 (by linarith) (by linarith) hbhi
              linarith
            · 
              rw [hvb, sub_self, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl]
              dsimp only
              rw [setPrecRound_eq_roundVal hbtv]
            · 
              rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (by linarith : v - bv > 0)]
              dsimp only
              have hmfin := isFinite_exactAdd hbfin hhifin
              have hmtv : (exactAdd b hi >>> (1 : ℕ)).toVal
                  = some (((bv + hiv) / 2 : ℝ) : EReal) := by
                rw [toVal_shiftRight_one hmfin, fval_exactAdd hbfin hhifin, hbf, hhif]
              rw [setPrecRound_eq_roundVal hmtv]
              apply roundVal_congr_of_no_boundary_Ioo p mode _ _ bv hiv (by linarith) (by linarith)
                hvb hvhi
              intro c hc ⟨h1, h2⟩
              have := hbgreatest c hc h2.le
              linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.fval_of_not_isNormal
statement: theorem fval_of_not_isNormal {x : AzFloat} (h : x.isNormal = false) : fval x = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> simp_all [isNormal, fval]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.realSum_filter_isNormal
statement:
theorem realSum_filter_isNormal (xs : List AzFloat) :
    realSum (xs.filter isNormal) = realSum xs
proof:
:= by
  rw [realSum_filter xs isNormal]
  have : realSum (xs.filter fun x => !isNormal x) = 0 := by
    induction xs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons x xs ih =>
      rw [List.filter_cons]
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [realSum_cons, ih, fval_of_not_isNormal (by simpa using h), add_zero]
      · exact ih
  rw [this, add_zero]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sumPrecRound_eq
statement:
theorem sumPrecRound_eq (xs : List AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    sumPrecRound xs p mode = roundVal p mode (Spec.sum xs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Spec.sum_eq]
  unfold sumPrecRound
  dsimp only
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true]
  split_ifs
  · exact (roundVal_none p mode).symm
  · exact (roundVal_none p mode).symm
  · exact (roundVal_of_toVal p mode (infinity true) ⊤ (Or.inr rfl) rfl).symm
  · exact (roundVal_of_toVal p mode (infinity false) ⊥ (Or.inr rfl) rfl).symm
  · rw [sumFinite_eq p mode _ _ (fun x hx => (List.mem_filter.mp hx).2) (Nat.lt_succ_self _),
      realSum_filter_isNormal]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_one'
statement: theorem toVal_one' : one.toVal = some ((1 : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [one, toVal_powerOf2]; simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_sumFloat64
statement:
theorem toVal_sumFloat64 (xs : List Float) :
    (sumFloat64 xs).toModel.unpack.toVal
      = roundBinary64Val ((xs.map fun x => x.toModel.unpack.toVal).foldr
          (fun a acc => a.bind fun a => acc.bind fun b => Spec.add a b) (some 0))
proof:
:= by
  unfold sumFloat64
  rw [toVal_emulateList sumPrecRound Spec.sum (fun xs => sumPrecRound_eq xs 53 .Nearest)]
  have hsum : ∀ xs : List Float,
      xs.foldr (fun x acc => (ofFloat64 x).toVal.bind fun a => acc.bind fun b => Spec.add a b)
          (some 0)
        = xs.foldr (fun x acc => x.toModel.unpack.toVal.bind fun a =>
            acc.bind fun b => Spec.add a b) (some 0) := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons x xs ih => rw [List.foldr_cons, List.foldr_cons, ih, toVal_ofFloat64]
  unfold Spec.sum
  rw [List.foldr_map, List.foldr_map, hsum]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toNat_wordOfBits
statement:
theorem toNat_wordOfBits (f : ℕ → Bool) :
    (wordOfBits f).toNat = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range 64, (if f l then 1 else 0) * 2 ^ l
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ j, j ≤ 64 →
      ((List.range j).foldl
        (fun acc l => if f l then acc + ((1 : UInt64) <<< UInt64.ofNat l) else acc) 0).toNat
        = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range j, (if f l then 1 else 0) * 2 ^ l ∧
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.range j, (if f l then 1 else 0) * 2 ^ l < 2 ^ j := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro _; simp
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih (by omega)
      rw [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil,
        Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have hbnd : (if f j then 1 else 0) * 2 ^ j ≤ 2 ^ j := by split_ifs <;> omega
      have hlt : ∑ l ∈ Finset.range j, (if f l then 1 else 0) * 2 ^ l
          + (if f j then 1 else 0) * 2 ^ j < 2 ^ (j + 1) := by
        rw [pow_succ]; omega
      refine ⟨?_, hlt⟩
      by_cases hf : f j = true
      · simp only [hf, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [UInt64.toNat_add, UInt64.toNat_shiftLeft, UInt64.toNat_one, UInt64.toNat_ofNat', ih1]
        have hj1 : j < 2 ^ 64 := lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega : j < 64) (by norm_num)
        have hj' : j % 2 ^ 64 % 64 = j := by
          rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hj1, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
        have hpj : 2 ^ j < 2 ^ 64 := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
        have hle64 : 2 ^ (j + 1) ≤ 2 ^ 64 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hj
        simp only [hf, ↓reduceIte, one_mul] at hlt ⊢
        rw [hj', Nat.shiftLeft_eq, one_mul, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hpj, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
      · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hf
        simp only [hf, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul, add_zero]
        exact ih1
  exact (key 64 le_rfl).1

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sum_mul_pow_regroup
statement:
theorem sum_mul_pow_regroup (N : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (∑ l ∈ Finset.range 64, g (64 * i + l) * 2 ^ l) * 2 ^ (64 * i)
      = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (64 * N), g m * 2 ^ m
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, show 64 * (N + 1) = 64 * N + 64 by ring, Finset.sum_range_add,
      Finset.sum_mul]
    refine congrArg₂ (· + ·) rfl ?_
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro l _
    rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add, add_comm]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.pcBit_le_one
statement: theorem pcBit_le_one (n : ℕ) : pcBit n ≤ 1
proof: := by unfold pcBit; split_ifs <;> omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toNat_primeConstantLimbs
statement:
theorem toNat_primeConstantLimbs (N : ℕ) :
    (primeConstantLimbs N).toNat
      = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (64 * N + 1), pcBit n * 2 ^ (64 * N - n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold primeConstantLimbs
  simp only
  rw [AzNat.toNat_ofLimbs, Array.toList_ofFn,
    toNatLimbsList_ofFn N (fun i => wordOfBits fun l => (AzNat.primeSieve (64 * N)).testBit
      (64 * N - (64 * i + l)))]
  have hw : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range N,
      (wordOfBits fun l => (AzNat.primeSieve (64 * N)).testBit (64 * N - (64 * i + l))).toNat
        * 2 ^ (64 * i)
      = (∑ l ∈ Finset.range 64, pcBit (64 * N - (64 * i + l)) * 2 ^ l) * 2 ^ (64 * i) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    rw [toNat_wordOfBits]
    refine congrArg₂ (· * ·) ?_ rfl
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro l hl
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hl
    have hiff := AzNat.primeSieve_testBit_iff (n := 64 * N) (j := 64 * N - (64 * i + l)) (by omega)
    unfold pcBit
    by_cases hp : Nat.Prime (64 * N - (64 * i + l))
    · rw [ite_eq_left (hiff.mpr hp), ite_eq_left hp]
    · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h => hp (hiff.mp h)), ite_eq_right hp]
  have h0 : pcBit 0 * 2 ^ (64 * N - 0) = 0 := by
    simp [pcBit, Nat.not_prime_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hw, sum_mul_pow_regroup N (fun m => pcBit (64 * N - m)),
    Finset.sum_range_succ', h0, add_zero,
    ← Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun j => pcBit (j + 1) * 2 ^ (64 * N - (j + 1))) (64 * N)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj
  rw [show 64 * N - 1 - j + 1 = 64 * N - j by omega, show 64 * N - (64 * N - j) = j by omega]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.pcTerm_nonneg
statement: theorem pcTerm_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ pcTerm n
proof: := by unfold pcTerm; positivity

name: Azurite.AzFloat.pcTerm_le
statement: theorem pcTerm_le (n : ℕ) : pcTerm n ≤ 1 / 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold pcTerm
  have h' : (pcBit n : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast pcBit_le_one n
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h' (by positivity)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.summable_pcTerm_shift
statement: theorem summable_pcTerm_shift (K : ℕ) : Summable fun n => pcTerm (n + K)
proof:
:= by
  apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => pcTerm_nonneg _) _ summable_geometric_two
  intro n
  have h1 := pcTerm_le (n + K)
  have h2 : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ^ (n + K) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ n := by
    rw [one_div_pow]
    gcongr
    · norm_num
    · omega
  exact h1.trans h2

name: Azurite.AzFloat.summable_pcTerm
statement: theorem summable_pcTerm : Summable pcTerm
proof:
:= by
  simpa using summable_pcTerm_shift 0

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sum_pcTerm
statement:
theorem sum_pcTerm (E : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (E + 1), pcTerm n
      = ((∑ n ∈ Finset.range (E + 1), pcBit n * 2 ^ (E - n) : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 ^ E
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_sum, Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n hn
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hn
  unfold pcTerm
  push_cast
  rw [div_eq_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity), mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
  congr 2
  omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.tail_bounds'
statement:
theorem tail_bounds' (E : ℕ) :
    0 < ∑' n, pcTerm (n + (E + 1)) ∧ ∑' n, pcTerm (n + (E + 1)) < 1 / 2 ^ E
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨q, hq, hqp⟩ := Nat.exists_infinite_primes (E + 1)
    have hi : pcTerm (q - (E + 1) + (E + 1)) = 1 / 2 ^ q := by
      unfold pcTerm pcBit
      rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hq, ite_eq_left hqp]
      simp
    calc (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 ^ q := by positivity
      _ = pcTerm (q - (E + 1) + (E + 1)) := hi.symm
      _ ≤ ∑' n, pcTerm (n + (E + 1)) :=
        (summable_pcTerm_shift (E + 1)).le_tsum _ (fun j _ => pcTerm_nonneg _)
  · have hsum : ∑' n : ℕ, (1 : ℝ) / 2 ^ E / 2 / 2 ^ n = 1 / 2 ^ E := tsum_geometric_two' _
    rw [← hsum]
    apply Summable.tsum_lt_tsum (i := 3 * (E + 1)) _ _ (summable_pcTerm_shift (E + 1))
      (summable_geometric_two' _)
    · intro n
      have := pcTerm_le (n + (E + 1))
      calc pcTerm (n + (E + 1)) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ (n + (E + 1)) := this
        _ = 1 / 2 ^ E / 2 / 2 ^ n := by
          rw [pow_add, pow_succ]
          field_simp
    · have hcomp : ¬ Nat.Prime (3 * (E + 1) + (E + 1)) := by
        rw [show 3 * (E + 1) + (E + 1) = 2 * (2 * (E + 1)) by ring]
        exact Nat.not_prime_mul (by norm_num) (by omega)
      have hzero : pcTerm (3 * (E + 1) + (E + 1)) = 0 := by
        unfold pcTerm pcBit
        rw [ite_eq_right hcomp]
        simp
      rw [hzero]
      positivity

name: Azurite.AzFloat.primeConstantReal_mul_two_pow
statement:
theorem primeConstantReal_mul_two_pow (E : ℕ) :
    ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ ∧ θ < 1 ∧
      primeConstantReal * 2 ^ E
        = ((∑ n ∈ Finset.range (E + 1), pcBit n * 2 ^ (E - n) : ℕ) : ℝ) + θ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := tail_bounds' E
  refine ⟨(∑' n, pcTerm (n + (E + 1))) * 2 ^ E, by positivity, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hhi (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ E)
    rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by positivity)] at this
  · unfold primeConstantReal
    rw [← summable_pcTerm.sum_add_tsum_nat_add (E + 1), sum_pcTerm, add_mul,
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by positivity)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.primeConstantReal_bounds
statement: theorem primeConstantReal_bounds : 1 / 4 < primeConstantReal ∧ primeConstantReal < 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ0, hθ1, h⟩ := primeConstantReal_mul_two_pow 2
  have hsum : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (2 + 1), pcBit n * 2 ^ (2 - n) : ℕ) = 1 := by
    simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, pcBit, Nat.not_prime_zero, Nat.not_prime_one, Nat.prime_two]
  rw [hsum] at h
  push_cast at h
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.primeConstantPrecRound_eq_liftVal₀
statement:
theorem primeConstantPrecRound_eq_liftVal₀ (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    primeConstantPrecRound p mode = liftVal₀ (some ((primeConstantReal : ℝ) : EReal)) p mode
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  unfold primeConstantPrecRound liftVal₀
  rw [ite_eq_right hp.ne']
  simp only
  set N := (p + 2) / 64 + 1 with hN
  have hK : p + 2 < 64 * N := by omega
  set s := 64 * N - (p + 2) with hs
  set ρ := primeConstantReal with hρ
  obtain ⟨hρlo, hρhi⟩ := primeConstantReal_bounds
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ0, hθ1, hX⟩ := primeConstantReal_mul_two_pow (64 * N)
  rw [← toNat_primeConstantLimbs N] at hX
  set X := (primeConstantLimbs N).toNat with hXdef
  set Y := X / 2 ^ s with hY
  have hYeq : ((primeConstantLimbs N).shiftRight s).toNat = Y := by
    rw [AzNat.toNat_shiftRight]
  have h2s : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ s := by positivity
  have hXY : (X : ℝ) = Y * 2 ^ s + (X % 2 ^ s : ℕ) := by
    rw [hY]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.div_add_mod' X (2 ^ s)).symm
  have hr : (X % 2 ^ s : ℕ) < 2 ^ s := Nat.mod_lt _ (by positivity)
  have hr' : ((X % 2 ^ s : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 2 ^ s := by exact_mod_cast hr
  set θ' : ℝ := ((X % 2 ^ s : ℕ) + θ) / 2 ^ s with hθ'
  have hθ'0 : 0 < θ' := by rw [hθ']; positivity
  have hθ'1 : θ' < 1 := by
    rw [hθ', div_lt_one h2s]
    linarith
  have hρp2 : ρ * 2 ^ (p + 2) = Y + θ' := by
    have h64 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * N) = 2 ^ (p + 2) * 2 ^ s := by
      rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
    have := hX
    rw [h64, ← mul_assoc, hXY] at this
    rw [hθ']
    field_simp
    linarith
  set m := Y / 2 with hm
  have hmeq : ((primeConstantLimbs N).shiftRight s |>.shiftRight 1).toNat = m := by
    rw [AzNat.toNat_shiftRight, hYeq, pow_one]
  set r := Y % 2 with hr2
  have hYm : (Y : ℝ) = 2 * m + r := by
    rw [hm, hr2]; exact_mod_cast (Nat.div_add_mod Y 2).symm
  have hr1 : r < 2 := Nat.mod_lt _ two_pos
  set y : ℝ := ρ * 2 ^ (p + 1) with hy
  have hy2 : y = m + ((r : ℝ) + θ') / 2 := by
    have : y * 2 = Y + θ' := by rw [hy, mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]; exact hρp2
    rw [hYm] at this
    linarith
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ r := by positivity
  have hlo : (m : ℝ) ≤ y := by
    rw [hy2]
    linarith
  have hhi : y < m + 1 := by
    rw [hy2]
    have : (r : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hr1
    linarith
  have hex : false = true ↔ y = (m : ℝ) := by
    constructor
    · intro h; exact absurd h (by simp)
    · intro h
      rw [hy2] at h
      linarith
  have hodd : ((primeConstantLimbs N).shiftRight s).isOdd = true ↔ r = 1 := by
    rw [AzNat.isOdd_iff, hYeq, Nat.odd_iff]
  have hmid : (if ((primeConstantLimbs N).shiftRight s).isOdd then Ordering.gt else Ordering.lt)
      = compare y ((m : ℝ) + 1 / 2) := by
    by_cases hodd' : ((primeConstantLimbs N).shiftRight s).isOdd = true
    · have hr1' : r = 1 := hodd.mp hodd'
      have hgt : (m : ℝ) + 1 / 2 < y := by
        rw [hy2, hr1']
        push_cast
        linarith
      rw [ite_eq_left hodd', eq_comm, compare_gt_iff_gt]
      exact hgt
    · have hr0' : r = 0 := by
        have : r ≠ 1 := fun h => hodd' (hodd.mpr h)
        omega
      have hlt : y < (m : ℝ) + 1 / 2 := by
        rw [hy2, hr0']
        push_cast
        linarith
      rw [ite_eq_right hodd', eq_comm, compare_lt_iff_lt]
      exact hlt
  obtain ⟨hR, htag⟩ := roundFromFloor_spec y
    ((primeConstantLimbs N).shiftRight s |>.shiftRight 1)
    false (if ((primeConstantLimbs N).shiftRight s).isOdd then Ordering.gt else Ordering.lt) mode
    (by rw [hmeq]; exact hlo) (by rw [hmeq]; exact hhi) (by rw [hmeq]; exact hex)
    (by rw [hmeq]; exact hmid)
  set ro := roundFromFloor ((primeConstantLimbs N).shiftRight s |>.shiftRight 1) false
    (if ((primeConstantLimbs N).shiftRight s).isOdd then Ordering.gt else Ordering.lt) mode
    with hro
  clear_value ro
  have hρ0 : ρ ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hρabs : |ρ| = ρ := abs_of_pos (by linarith)
  have hlog : Int.log 2 |ρ| = -2 := by
    rw [hρabs]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Int.lt_add_one_iff.mp
      apply (Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt (b := 2) (by norm_num) (by linarith)).mp
      push_cast
      norm_num
      linarith
    · apply (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log (b := 2) (by norm_num) (by linarith)).mp
      push_cast
      norm_num
      linarith
  have hscale : precScale 2 p ρ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((p : ℤ) + 1)) := by
    unfold precScale
    rw [hlog]
    push_cast
    congr 1
    ring
  have h2w : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((p : ℤ) + 1)) := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hyρ : ρ / (2 : ℝ) ^ (-((p : ℤ) + 1)) = y := by
    rw [hy, zpow_neg, div_inv_eq_mul, show ((p : ℤ) + 1) = ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring,
      zpow_natCast]
  have hround : (round (floatSet p) mode ρ).val
      = ((((AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).toInt : ℝ) * 2 ^ (-((p : ℤ) + 1)) : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [val_round_floatSet, val_round_precisionSet mode ρ hρ0, hscale, hyρ, hR,
      AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true]
  have h2p : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ (p + 1) := by positivity
  have hylo : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ y := by
    rw [hy, show ((p : ℤ) - 1) = (p + 1 : ℕ) + (-(2 : ℤ)) by push_cast; ring,
      zpow_add₀ (by norm_num), zpow_natCast, show (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(2 : ℤ)) = 1 / 4 by norm_num]
    nlinarith
  have hyhi : y < (2 : ℝ) ^ (p : ℤ) := by
    rw [hy, show (p : ℤ) = (p + 1 : ℕ) + (-(1 : ℤ)) by push_cast; ring, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num),
      zpow_natCast, show (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 : ℤ)) = 1 / 2 by norm_num]
    nlinarith
  have hypos : 0 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _) hylo
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := abs_toInt_round_bounds p hp mode y (by rw [abs_of_pos hypos]; exact hylo)
    (by rw [abs_of_pos hypos]; exact hyhi)
  rw [hR] at hb1 hb2
  have habsR : ((AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat : ℤ) = |(ro.1.toNat : ℤ)| := by
    rw [AzInt.abs_toNat_eq, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true]
  have hlo' : 2 ^ (p - 1) ≤ (AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat := by
    have : ((2 ^ (p - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ ((AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat : ℤ) := by
      rw [habsR]; exact hb1
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hhi' : (AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ p := by
    have : ((AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat : ℤ) ≤ ((2 ^ p : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      rw [habsR]; exact hb2
    exact_mod_cast this
  obtain ⟨hRval, hRprec⟩ := normalizeCarry_spec (AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1) p hp (AzInt.ofInt (-1))
    hlo' hhi'
  have hep : (AzInt.ofInt (-1)).toInt - p = -((p : ℤ) + 1) := by
    rw [AzInt.toInt_ofInt]; ring
  rw [hep] at hRval
  symm
  refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
  · exact toVal_injective p (ofEReal_spec p mode ρ).1 (Or.inl hRprec)
      (by rw [fst_roundVal, ofVal_some, (ofEReal_spec p mode ρ).2, hround, hRval])
  · show (roundVal p mode (some (ρ : EReal))).2 = ro.2
    rw [(roundVal_coe p mode ρ).2, hround, compare_coe_coe, htag, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true,
      Int.cast_natCast, ← hyρ]
    conv_rhs => rw [← compare_mul_right_pos _ _ _ h2w, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h2w.ne']

name: Azurite.AzFloat.exists_rat_of_toVal
statement:
theorem exists_rat_of_toVal {x : AzFloat} {v : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (v : EReal)) :
    ∃ r : ℚ, v = r
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : x.isFinite = true := isFinite_of_toVal_coe hx
  have hs : x.toAzRat?.isSome = true := by rw [isSome_toAzRat?]; exact hfin
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hs
  have := toVal_of_toAzRat? x r hr
  rw [hx, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at this
  exact ⟨AzRat.toRat r, this⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ln2Lo_le_log_two_le
statement: theorem ln2Lo_le_log_two_le (w : ℕ) : ln2Lo w ≤ Real.log 2 ∧ Real.log 2 ≤ ln2Hi w
proof:
:=
  log_two_mem_Icc _ _ _

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ln2N_spec
statement:
theorem ln2N_spec (w : ℕ) :
    w + 6 ≤ (2 * ln2N₁ w + 1) * 4 ∧ w + 6 ≤ (2 * ln2N₂ w + 1) * 12 ∧
      w + 6 ≤ (2 * ln2N₃ w + 1) * 13
proof:
:= by
  unfold ln2N₁ ln2N₂ ln2N₃
  omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.atanhTerm_le_half_pow
statement:
theorem atanhTerm_le_half_pow {q b N w : ℕ} (hq : 2 ^ b ≤ q) (h : w + 6 ≤ (2 * N + 1) * b) :
    atanhTerm q N ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w + 6)
proof:
:= by
  have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by
    have : 1 ≤ 2 ^ b := Nat.one_le_two_pow
    exact_mod_cast this.trans hq
  have hqr : (2 : ℝ) ^ b ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  refine (atanhTerm_le hq1 N).trans ?_
  calc (1 / (q : ℝ)) ^ (2 * N + 1) ≤ (1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ b) ^ (2 * N + 1) := by
        gcongr
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((2 * N + 1) * b) := by rw [one_div_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_comm, one_div_pow]
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w + 6) := pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ln2Hi_sub_ln2Lo
statement: theorem ln2Hi_sub_ln2Lo (w : ℕ) : ln2Hi w - ln2Lo w ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:= by
  unfold ln2Lo ln2Hi
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ln2N_spec w
  have t1 := atanhTerm_le_half_pow (by norm_num : 2 ^ 4 ≤ 26) h1
  have t2 := atanhTerm_le_half_pow (by norm_num : 2 ^ 12 ≤ 4801) h2
  have t3 := atanhTerm_le_half_pow (by norm_num : 2 ^ 13 ≤ 8749) h3
  have hp : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w + 6) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w / 64 := by rw [pow_add]; norm_num; ring
  rw [hp] at t1 t2 t3
  simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at t1 t2 t3
  have := pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2) w
  linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sum_atanhTerm_le
statement:
theorem sum_atanhTerm_le {q : ℝ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range N, atanhTerm q k ≤ 1 / (q - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hq1 : 1 < q := by linarith
  have hne : q - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hpos : 0 < (q + 1) / (q - 1) := div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  calc ∑ k ∈ range N, atanhTerm q k ≤ atanhInv q := sum_le_atanhInv hq N
    _ = Real.log ((q + 1) / (q - 1)) / 2 := atanhInv_eq hq1
    _ ≤ ((q + 1) / (q - 1) - 1) / 2 := by
        have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hpos
        linarith
    _ = 1 / (q - 1) := by field_simp; ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.atanhNumDen_den_ne_zero
statement:
theorem atanhNumDen_den_ne_zero {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    ((AzNat.atanhNumDen q N).2.toNat : ℝ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := AzNat.atanhNumDen_eq hq N
  rw [h, div_zero] at this
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ k ∈ range N, atanhTerm q k :=
    sum_pos (fun k _ => atanhTerm_pos (by exact_mod_cast hq) k) (nonempty_range_iff.mpr hN.ne')
  exact hpos.ne this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.seriesBracket_spec
statement:
theorem seriesBracket_spec {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {k : ℕ} (hk : 4 ≤ k) :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, (seriesBracket (AzNat.atanhNumDen q N) k).1.toVal = some (lv : EReal) ∧
      (seriesBracket (AzNat.atanhNumDen q N) k).2.toVal = some (hv : EReal) ∧
      0 ≤ lv ∧ lv ≤ ∑ i ∈ range N, atanhTerm q i ∧
      (∑ i ∈ range N, atanhTerm q i) * (1 - 6 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) ≤ lv ∧
      ∑ i ∈ range N, atanhTerm q i ≤ hv ∧
      hv ≤ (∑ i ∈ range N, atanhTerm q i) * (1 + 8 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero k := ⟨by omega⟩
  set S := ∑ i ∈ range N, atanhTerm q i with hSdef
  set n : ℝ := ((AzNat.atanhNumDen q N).1.toNat : ℝ) with hndef
  set d : ℝ := ((AzNat.atanhNumDen q N).2.toNat : ℝ) with hddef
  have hSeq : n / d = S := AzNat.atanhNumDen_eq hq N
  have hd0 : 0 < d := lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (atanhNumDen_den_ne_zero hq hN).symm
  have hn : n = S * d := by rw [← hSeq]; field_simp
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := sum_nonneg fun i _ => (atanhTerm_pos (by exact_mod_cast hq) i).le
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ n := by rw [hn]; exact mul_nonneg hS0 hd0.le
  set x := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k with hx
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by positivity
  have hx1 : x ≤ 1 / 16 := by
    calc x ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hk
      _ = 1 / 16 := by norm_num
  obtain ⟨n₁, hn₁, hfn₁⟩ := setPrecFloor_err (toVal_ofAzNat (AzNat.atanhNumDen q N).1) hn0 k
  obtain ⟨d₁, hd₁, hcd₁⟩ := setPrecCeiling_err (toVal_ofAzNat (AzNat.atanhNumDen q N).2) hd0.le k
  obtain ⟨n₂, hn₂, hcn₂⟩ := setPrecCeiling_err (toVal_ofAzNat (AzNat.atanhNumDen q N).1) hn0 k
  obtain ⟨d₂, hd₂, hfd₂⟩ := setPrecFloor_err (toVal_ofAzNat (AzNat.atanhNumDen q N).2) hd0.le k
  have hd₁0 : 0 < d₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hd0 hcd₁.ge
  have hd₂0 : 0 < d₂ := by
    have h0 : d ≤ d₂ + 2 * d * x := hfd₂.ge
    have h1 : 2 * d * x ≤ 2 * d * (1 / 16) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx1 (by positivity)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨lv, hlv, hfl⟩ := divFloor_err hn₁ hd₁ hd₁0 hfn₁.nonneg k
  obtain ⟨hv, hhv, hcl⟩ := divCeiling_err hn₂ hd₂ hd₂0 (hn0.trans hcn₂.ge) k
  have hq1 : n₁ / d₁ ≤ S := by
    rw [← hSeq]; exact div_le_div₀ hn0 hfn₁.le hd0 hcd₁.ge
  have hq2 : S ≤ n₂ / d₂ := by
    rw [← hSeq]; exact div_le_div₀ (hn0.trans hcn₂.ge) hcn₂.ge hd₂0 hfd₂.le
  have hq1' : S * (1 - 4 * x) ≤ n₁ / d₁ := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hd₁0]
    have hc : 0 ≤ S * (1 - 4 * x) := mul_nonneg hS0 (by linarith)
    have h0 : d₁ ≤ d + 2 * d * x := hcd₁.le
    have h1 : S * (1 - 4 * x) * d₁ ≤ S * (1 - 4 * x) * (d + 2 * d * x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h0 hc
    have h2 : S * (1 - 4 * x) * (d + 2 * d * x) = S * d * (1 - 2 * x) - 8 * (S * d * (x * x)) := by
      ring
    have h3 : 0 ≤ S * d * (x * x) := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hS0 hd0.le) (mul_nonneg hx0.le hx0.le)
    have h4 : n ≤ n₁ + 2 * n * x := hfn₁.ge
    rw [hn] at h4
    linarith
  have hq2' : n₂ / d₂ ≤ S * (1 + 5 * x) := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hd₂0]
    have h0 : d ≤ d₂ + 2 * d * x := hfd₂.ge
    have h1 : S * (1 + 5 * x) * (d - 2 * d * x) ≤ S * (1 + 5 * x) * d₂ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (mul_nonneg hS0 (by linarith))
    have h2 : S * (1 + 5 * x) * (d - 2 * d * x)
        = S * d * (1 + 2 * x) + S * d * (x * (1 - 10 * x)) := by ring
    have h3 : 0 ≤ S * d * (x * (1 - 10 * x)) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hS0 hd0.le) (mul_nonneg hx0.le (by linarith))
    have h4 : n₂ ≤ n + 2 * n * x := hcn₂.le
    rw [hn] at h4
    linarith
  have hfl1 := hfl.le
  have hfl2 : n₁ / d₁ ≤ lv + 2 * (n₁ / d₁) * x := hfl.ge
  have hcl1 := hcl.ge
  have hcl2 : hv ≤ n₂ / d₂ + 2 * (n₂ / d₂) * x := hcl.le
  refine ⟨lv, hv, hlv, hhv, hfl.nonneg, hfl1.trans hq1, ?_, hq2.trans hcl1, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : S * (1 - 4 * x) * (1 - 2 * x) ≤ n₁ / d₁ * (1 - 2 * x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq1' (by linarith)
    have h2 : S * (1 - 4 * x) * (1 - 2 * x) = S * (1 - 6 * x) + 8 * (S * (x * x)) := by ring
    have h3 : 0 ≤ S * (x * x) := mul_nonneg hS0 (mul_nonneg hx0.le hx0.le)
    linarith
  · have h1 : n₂ / d₂ * (1 + 2 * x) ≤ S * (1 + 5 * x) * (1 + 2 * x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq2' (by linarith)
    have h2 : S * (1 + 5 * x) * (1 + 2 * x) = S * (1 + 8 * x) - S * (x * (1 - 10 * x)) := by ring
    have h3 : 0 ≤ S * (x * (1 - 10 * x)) := mul_nonneg hS0 (mul_nonneg hx0.le (by linarith))
    linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_tail
statement:
theorem toVal_tail (w : ℕ) :
    (powerOf2 (-(AzNat.ofNat (w + 5)).toAzInt)).toVal
      = some (((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w + 5) : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toVal_powerOf2, AzInt.toInt_neg, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast,
    one_div_pow, one_div]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ln2Bracket_spec
statement:
theorem ln2Bracket_spec (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, (ln2Bracket w).1.toVal = some (lv : EReal) ∧
      (ln2Bracket w).2.toVal = some (hv : EReal) ∧
      lv ≤ Real.log 2 ∧ Real.log 2 ≤ hv ∧ hv - lv ≤ 8 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ∧
      (2 ≤ w → 1 / 5 ≤ lv)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : NeZero (w + 8) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hw1 : 1 ≤ w := NeZero.one_le
  
  have hlo := (ln2Lo_le_log_two_le w).1
  have hhi := (ln2Lo_le_log_two_le w).2
  have hwid := ln2Hi_sub_ln2Lo w
  unfold ln2Lo at hlo
  unfold ln2Hi at hhi
  unfold ln2Lo ln2Hi at hwid
  obtain ⟨hN1, hN2, hN3⟩ := ln2N_spec w
  have t1 := atanhTerm_le_half_pow (by norm_num : 2 ^ 4 ≤ 26) hN1
  have t2 := atanhTerm_le_half_pow (by norm_num : 2 ^ 12 ≤ 4801) hN2
  have t3 := atanhTerm_le_half_pow (by norm_num : 2 ^ 13 ≤ 8749) hN3
  simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at t1 t2 t3
  have hL1 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
  have hL2 := Real.log_two_lt_d9
  
  set u := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w with hu
  set uk := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w + 8) with huk
  set tv := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w + 5) with htv
  have hu0 : 0 < u := by positivity
  have huk0 : 0 < uk := by positivity
  have htv0 : 0 < tv := by positivity
  have hukU : uk = u / 256 := by rw [huk, hu, pow_add]; ring
  have htvU : tv = u / 32 := by rw [htv, hu, pow_add]; ring
  have hu1 : u ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    calc u ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 1 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hw1
      _ = 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have ht6 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (w + 6) = tv / 2 := by rw [htv, pow_add, pow_add]; ring
  rw [ht6] at t1 t2 t3
  
  set S₁ := ∑ k ∈ range (ln2N₁ w), atanhTerm 26 k with hS₁
  set S₂ := ∑ k ∈ range (ln2N₂ w), atanhTerm 4801 k with hS₂
  set S₃ := ∑ k ∈ range (ln2N₃ w), atanhTerm 8749 k with hS₃
  have hS₁0 : 0 ≤ S₁ := sum_nonneg fun i _ => (atanhTerm_pos (by norm_num) i).le
  have hS₂0 : 0 ≤ S₂ := sum_nonneg fun i _ => (atanhTerm_pos (by norm_num) i).le
  have hS₃0 : 0 ≤ S₃ := sum_nonneg fun i _ => (atanhTerm_pos (by norm_num) i).le
  have hS₁1 : S₁ ≤ 1 / 25 := by
    have := sum_atanhTerm_le (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 26) (ln2N₁ w); norm_num at this ⊢; exact this
  have hS₂1 : S₂ ≤ 1 / 4800 := by
    have := sum_atanhTerm_le (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 4801) (ln2N₂ w); norm_num at this ⊢
    exact this
  have hS₃1 : S₃ ≤ 1 / 8748 := by
    have := sum_atanhTerm_le (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 8749) (ln2N₃ w); norm_num at this ⊢
    exact this
  obtain ⟨l₁, h₁, hl₁, hh₁, hl₁0, hl₁S, hSl₁, hSh₁, hh₁S⟩ :=
    seriesBracket_spec (by norm_num : 0 < 26) (N := ln2N₁ w) (by unfold ln2N₁; omega)
      (k := w + 8) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨l₂, h₂, hl₂, hh₂, hl₂0, hl₂S, hSl₂, hSh₂, hh₂S⟩ :=
    seriesBracket_spec (by norm_num : 0 < 4801) (N := ln2N₂ w) (by unfold ln2N₂; omega)
      (k := w + 8) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨l₃, h₃, hl₃, hh₃, hl₃0, hl₃S, hSl₃, hSh₃, hh₃S⟩ :=
    seriesBracket_spec (by norm_num : 0 < 8749) (N := ln2N₃ w) (by unfold ln2N₃; omega)
      (k := w + 8) (by omega)
  push_cast at hl₁S hSl₁ hSh₁ hh₁S hl₂S hSl₂ hSh₂ hh₂S hl₃S hSl₃ hSh₃ hh₃S
  
  have hc18 : (ofAzNat (AzNat.ofNat 18)).toVal = some ((18 : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    have := toVal_ofAzNat_ofNat 18; push_cast at this; exact this
  have hc8 : (ofAzNat (AzNat.ofNat 8)).toVal = some ((8 : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    have := toVal_ofAzNat_ofNat 8; push_cast at this; exact this
  have hc2 : (ofAzNat (AzNat.ofNat 2)).toVal = some ((2 : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    have := toVal_ofAzNat_ofNat 2; push_cast at this; exact this
  have ht := toVal_tail w
  
  have hl₁1 : l₁ ≤ 1 / 25 := hl₁S.trans hS₁1
  have hl₂1 : l₂ ≤ 1 / 4800 := hl₂S.trans hS₂1
  have hl₃1 : l₃ ≤ 1 / 8748 := hl₃S.trans hS₃1
  have huk1 : uk ≤ 1 / 512 := by rw [hukU]; linarith
  have htv1 : tv ≤ 1 / 64 := by rw [htvU]; linarith
  have hh₁1 : h₁ ≤ 1 / 24 := by
    have : S₁ * (1 + 8 * uk) ≤ 1 / 25 * (1 + 8 / 512) :=
      mul_le_mul hS₁1 (by linarith) (by linarith) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hh₂1 : h₂ ≤ 1 / 4000 := by
    have : S₂ * (1 + 8 * uk) ≤ 1 / 4800 * (1 + 8 / 512) :=
      mul_le_mul hS₂1 (by linarith) (by linarith) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hh₃1 : h₃ ≤ 1 / 8000 := by
    have : S₃ * (1 + 8 * uk) ≤ 1 / 8748 * (1 + 8 / 512) :=
      mul_le_mul hS₃1 (by linarith) (by linarith) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hh₁0 : 0 ≤ h₁ := hS₁0.trans hSh₁
  have hh₂0 : 0 ≤ h₂ := hS₂0.trans hSh₂
  have hh₃0 : 0 ≤ h₃ := hS₃0.trans hSh₃
  
  have hl₁e : S₁ - uk ≤ l₁ := by
    have : S₁ * (6 * uk) ≤ 1 / 25 * (6 * uk) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS₁1 (by positivity)
    linarith
  have hl₂e : S₂ - uk ≤ l₂ := by
    have : S₂ * (6 * uk) ≤ 1 / 4800 * (6 * uk) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS₂1 (by positivity)
    linarith
  have hl₃e : S₃ - uk ≤ l₃ := by
    have : S₃ * (6 * uk) ≤ 1 / 8748 * (6 * uk) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS₃1 (by positivity)
    linarith
  have hh₁e : h₁ ≤ S₁ + uk := by
    have : S₁ * (8 * uk) ≤ 1 / 25 * (8 * uk) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS₁1 (by positivity)
    linarith
  have hh₂e : h₂ ≤ S₂ + uk := by
    have : S₂ * (8 * uk) ≤ 1 / 4800 * (8 * uk) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS₂1 (by positivity)
    linarith
  have hh₃e : h₃ ≤ S₃ + uk := by
    have : S₃ * (8 * uk) ≤ 1 / 8748 * (8 * uk) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS₃1 (by positivity)
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁, hfa₁⟩ := mulFloor_err hc18 hl₁ (w + 8) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hl₁0)
  obtain ⟨a₃, ha₃, hfa₃⟩ := mulFloor_err hc8 hl₃ (w + 8) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hl₃0)
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ := addFloor_err ha₁ ha₃ (w + 8) (add_nonneg hfa₁.nonneg hfa₃.nonneg)
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hcm⟩ := addCeiling_err hh₂ ht (w + 8) (add_nonneg hh₂0 htv0.le)
  obtain ⟨m2, hm2, hcm2⟩ := mulCeiling_err hc2 hm (w + 8)
    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) ((add_nonneg hh₂0 htv0.le).trans hcm.ge))
  obtain ⟨lo, hlo', hlo1, hlo2⟩ := subFloor_abs hp hm2 (w + 8)
  have ea₁ : 18 * l₁ ≤ a₁ + 2 * 2 * uk := hfa₁.ge_of_le (by linarith)
  have ea₃ : 8 * l₃ ≤ a₃ + 2 * 2 * uk := hfa₃.ge_of_le (by linarith)
  have ea₁' : a₁ ≤ 18 * l₁ := hfa₁.le
  have ea₃' : a₃ ≤ 8 * l₃ := hfa₃.le
  have ep : a₁ + a₃ ≤ p + 2 * 2 * uk := hfp.ge_of_le (by linarith)
  have ep' : p ≤ a₁ + a₃ := hfp.le
  have em : m ≤ h₂ + tv + 2 * 2 * uk := hcm.le_of_le (by linarith)
  have em' : h₂ + tv ≤ m := hcm.ge
  have em2 : m2 ≤ 2 * m + 2 * 2 * uk := hcm2.le_of_le (by linarith)
  have em2' : 2 * m ≤ m2 := hcm2.ge
  have hlo2' : p - m2 ≤ lo + 2 * |p - m2| * uk := hlo2
  have habs1 : |p - m2| ≤ 2 := by
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hr1 : 2 * |p - m2| * uk ≤ 2 * 2 * uk := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right habs1 huk0.le; linarith
  
  obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁, hcm₁⟩ := addCeiling_err hh₁ ht (w + 8) (add_nonneg hh₁0 htv0.le)
  obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁, hcb₁⟩ := mulCeiling_err hc18 hm₁ (w + 8)
    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) ((add_nonneg hh₁0 htv0.le).trans hcm₁.ge))
  obtain ⟨m₃, hm₃, hcm₃⟩ := addCeiling_err hh₃ ht (w + 8) (add_nonneg hh₃0 htv0.le)
  obtain ⟨b₃, hb₃, hcb₃⟩ := mulCeiling_err hc8 hm₃ (w + 8)
    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) ((add_nonneg hh₃0 htv0.le).trans hcm₃.ge))
  obtain ⟨qq, hqq, hcq⟩ := addCeiling_err hb₁ hb₃ (w + 8)
    (add_nonneg ((mul_nonneg (by norm_num) ((add_nonneg hh₁0 htv0.le).trans hcm₁.ge)).trans hcb₁.ge)
      ((mul_nonneg (by norm_num) ((add_nonneg hh₃0 htv0.le).trans hcm₃.ge)).trans hcb₃.ge))
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hfc⟩ := mulFloor_err hc2 hl₂ (w + 8) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hl₂0)
  obtain ⟨hi, hhi', hhi1, hhi2⟩ := subCeiling_abs hqq hc (w + 8)
  have em₁ : m₁ ≤ h₁ + tv + 2 * 2 * uk := hcm₁.le_of_le (by linarith)
  have em₁' : h₁ + tv ≤ m₁ := hcm₁.ge
  have eb₁ : b₁ ≤ 18 * m₁ + 2 * 2 * uk := hcb₁.le_of_le (by linarith)
  have eb₁' : 18 * m₁ ≤ b₁ := hcb₁.ge
  have em₃ : m₃ ≤ h₃ + tv + 2 * 2 * uk := hcm₃.le_of_le (by linarith)
  have em₃' : h₃ + tv ≤ m₃ := hcm₃.ge
  have eb₃ : b₃ ≤ 8 * m₃ + 2 * 2 * uk := hcb₃.le_of_le (by linarith)
  have eb₃' : 8 * m₃ ≤ b₃ := hcb₃.ge
  have eq₁ : qq ≤ b₁ + b₃ + 2 * 2 * uk := hcq.le_of_le (by linarith)
  have eq₁' : b₁ + b₃ ≤ qq := hcq.ge
  have ec : 2 * l₂ ≤ c + 2 * 2 * uk := hfc.ge_of_le (by linarith)
  have ec' : c ≤ 2 * l₂ := hfc.le
  have hhi2' : hi ≤ qq - c + 2 * |qq - c| * uk := hhi2
  have habs2 : |qq - c| ≤ 2 := by
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hr2 : 2 * |qq - c| * uk ≤ 2 * 2 * uk := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right habs2 huk0.le; linarith
  
  refine ⟨lo, hi, hlo', hhi', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith
  · linarith
  · intro hw
    have hu2 : u ≤ 1 / 4 := by
      calc u ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hw
        _ = 1 / 4 := by norm_num
    linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ln2Approx_spec
statement:
theorem ln2Approx_spec (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, Rounds (ln2Approx w).1 lv ∧ Rounds (ln2Approx w).2 hv ∧
      lv < Real.log 2 ∧ Real.log 2 < hv ∧ hv - lv ≤ 8 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ∧
      (2 ≤ w → 1 / 5 ≤ lv)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨lv, hv, hlv, hhv, hlo, hhi, hwid, hpos⟩ := ln2Bracket_spec w
  refine ⟨lv, hv, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hwid, hpos⟩
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hlv)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hlv] at hR
    exact hR
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hhv)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hhv] at hR
    exact hR
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hlv
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hlo fun h => irrational_log_two.ne_rat r (h.symm.trans hr)
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hhv
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hhi fun h => irrational_log_two.ne_rat r (h.trans hr)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ln2Approx_isSome_exists
statement:
theorem ln2Approx_isSome_exists (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (w₀ : ℕ)
    (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) :
    ∃ f : ℕ, (roundingPossible (ln2Approx (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).1 (ln2Approx (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).2 p
      mode).isSome = true
proof:
:=
  exists_isSome_of_irrational p mode ln2Approx irrational_log_two (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 8)
    (fun w hw => by
      have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo, hhi, hwid, -⟩ := ln2Approx_spec w
      exact ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, hwid⟩) w₀ hw₀

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2EBracket_spec
statement:
theorem log2EBracket_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 2 ≤ w) :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, (log2EBracket w).1.toVal = some (lv : EReal) ∧
      (log2EBracket w).2.toVal = some (hv : EReal) ∧
      lv ≤ (Real.log 2)⁻¹ ∧ (Real.log 2)⁻¹ ≤ hv ∧ hv - lv ≤ 80 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, haL, hLb, hab, hapos⟩ := ln2Bracket_spec w
  have ha5 : 1 / 5 ≤ a := hapos hw
  have hL1 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
  have hL2 := Real.log_two_lt_d9
  have hL0 : 0 < Real.log 2 := by linarith
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by linarith
  obtain ⟨lv, hlv, hfl⟩ := divFloor_err toVal_one' hb hb0 (by norm_num) w
  obtain ⟨hv, hhv, hcl⟩ := divCeiling_err toVal_one' ha ha0 (by norm_num) w
  set u := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w with hu
  have hu0 : 0 < u := by positivity
  refine ⟨lv, hv, hlv, hhv, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc lv ≤ 1 / b := hfl.le
      _ ≤ 1 / Real.log 2 := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hL0 hLb
      _ = (Real.log 2)⁻¹ := one_div _
  · calc (Real.log 2)⁻¹ = 1 / Real.log 2 := (one_div _).symm
      _ ≤ 1 / a := one_div_le_one_div_of_le ha0 haL
      _ ≤ hv := hcl.ge
  · have h1a : 1 / a ≤ 5 := by rw [div_le_iff₀ ha0]; linarith
    have h1b : 1 / b ≤ 3 / 2 := by rw [div_le_iff₀ hb0]; linarith
    have hprod : (1 / 5 : ℝ) * (69 / 100) ≤ a * b :=
      mul_le_mul ha5 (by linarith) (by norm_num) ha0.le
    have hdiff : 1 / a - 1 / b ≤ 60 * u := by
      rw [div_sub_div _ _ ha0.ne' hb0.ne', div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have h3 : 60 * u * ((1 / 5 : ℝ) * (69 / 100)) ≤ 60 * u * (a * b) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (by positivity)
      linarith
    have h4 := hfl.ge
    have h5 := hcl.le
    rw [← hu] at h4 h5
    have h6 : 2 * (1 / a) * u ≤ 2 * 5 * u := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1a hu0.le; linarith
    have h7 : 2 * (1 / b) * u ≤ 2 * (3 / 2) * u := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1b hu0.le; linarith
    linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2EApprox_spec
statement:
theorem log2EApprox_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 2 ≤ w) :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, Rounds (log2EApprox w).1 lv ∧ Rounds (log2EApprox w).2 hv ∧
      lv < (Real.log 2)⁻¹ ∧ (Real.log 2)⁻¹ < hv ∧ hv - lv ≤ 80 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨lv, hv, hlv, hhv, hlo, hhi, hwid⟩ := log2EBracket_spec hw
  have hirr : Irrational (Real.log 2)⁻¹ := irrational_log_two.inv
  refine ⟨lv, hv, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hwid⟩
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hlv)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hlv] at hR
    exact hR
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hhv)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hhv] at hR
    exact hR
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hlv
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hlo fun h => hirr.ne_rat r (h.symm.trans hr)
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hhv
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hhi fun h => hirr.ne_rat r (h.trans hr)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2EApprox_isSome_exists
statement:
theorem log2EApprox_isSome_exists (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (w₀ : ℕ)
    (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) :
    ∃ f : ℕ, (roundingPossible (log2EApprox (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).1 (log2EApprox (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).2 p
      mode).isSome = true
proof:
:=
  exists_isSome_of_irrational_threshold p mode log2EApprox irrational_log_two.inv
    (fun w => 80 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w)
    (by
      have := (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
        (by norm_num)).const_mul (80 : ℝ)
      rwa [mul_zero] at this)
    2
    (fun w hw => by
      obtain ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo, hhi, hwid⟩ := log2EApprox_spec hw
      exact ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, hwid⟩) w₀ hw₀

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_shiftLeftMod
statement:
theorem AzNat.toNat_shiftLeftMod (a : AzNat) (k : ℕ) (n : AzNat) :
    (a.shiftLeftMod k n).toNat = a.toNat * 2 ^ k % n.toNat
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzNat.shiftLeftMod
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h, AzNat.toNat_hShiftLeft, Nat.shiftLeft_eq, AzNat.toNat_zero, Nat.mod_zero]
  · have : NeZero n.toNat := ⟨fun h0 => h (AzNat.toNat_injective (by rw [h0]; rfl))⟩
    set z := AzZMod.ofAzNat n a * AzZMod.pow (AzZMod.ofAzNat n (AzNat.ofNat 2)) k with hz
    have hval : z.val.toNat = (AzZMod.toZMod z).val :=
      (ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt z.isLt).symm
    rw [hval, hz, AzZMod.toZMod_mul, AzZMod.toZMod_pow, AzZMod.toZMod_ofAzNat,
      AzZMod.toZMod_ofAzNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, ← Nat.cast_ofNat, ← Nat.cast_pow,
      ← Nat.cast_mul, ZMod.val_natCast]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.rem_coe_coe
statement:
theorem rem_coe_coe (a b : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    rem a b = some (((a - b * (toInt (round intSet .Down (a / b)) : ℝ)) : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rem
  rw [ite_eq_right (by simp [EReal.coe_eq_zero, hb]), ite_eq_right (by simp), EReal.toReal_coe,
    EReal.toReal_coe]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_round_down
statement:
theorem toInt_round_down (v : ℝ) :
    toInt (round intSet .Down v) = if 0 ≤ v then ⌊v⌋ else ⌈v⌉
proof:
:= by
  show toInt (if 0 ≤ v then roundFloor intSet v else roundCeiling intSet v) = _
  split_ifs
  · exact toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundFloor_intSet v).symm
  · exact toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundCeiling_intSet v).symm

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_round_down_of_abs_lt_one
statement:
theorem toInt_round_down_of_abs_lt_one {v : ℝ} (hv : |v| < 1) :
    toInt (round intSet .Down v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hv
  rw [toInt_round_down]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact Int.floor_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨h, h2⟩
  · exact Int.ceil_eq_iff.mpr ⟨by push_cast; linarith, by push_cast; linarith⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_round_down_sign_div
statement:
theorem toInt_round_down_sign_div (σ : ℝ) (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (X Y : ℕ) (hY : 0 < Y) :
    (toInt (round intSet .Down (σ * ((X : ℝ) / Y))) : ℝ) = σ * ((X / Y : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (⌊(X : ℝ) / (Y : ℕ)⌋ : ℤ) = ((X / Y : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    rw [Int.floor_div_natCast, Int.floor_natCast]; rfl
  have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) / Y := by positivity
  rcases hσ with rfl | rfl
  · rw [one_mul, one_mul, toInt_round_down, ite_eq_left hnn, hq]; rfl
  · rw [neg_one_mul, neg_one_mul, toInt_round_down]
    rcases eq_or_ne ((X : ℝ) / Y) 0 with h0 | h0
    · rw [h0, neg_zero, ite_eq_left le_rfl, Int.floor_zero]
      have : (X : ℝ) = 0 := by
        rcases div_eq_zero_iff.mp h0 with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h (by positivity)
      have hX : X = 0 := by exact_mod_cast this
      subst hX
      simp
    · have hneg : ¬ (0 : ℝ) ≤ -((X : ℝ) / Y) :=
        not_le.mpr (neg_neg_of_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne hnn (Ne.symm h0)))
      rw [ite_eq_right hneg, Int.ceil_neg, hq, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.rem_scaled
statement:
theorem rem_scaled (σx σy : ℝ) (hσx : σx = 1 ∨ σx = -1) (hσy : σy = 1 ∨ σy = -1)
    (X Y : ℕ) (hY : 0 < Y) (c : ℤ) :
    σx * X * (2 : ℝ) ^ c - σy * Y * (2 : ℝ) ^ c
        * (toInt (round intSet .Down ((σx * X * (2 : ℝ) ^ c) / (σy * Y * (2 : ℝ) ^ c))) : ℝ)
      = σx * ((X % Y : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ c
proof:
:= by
  have hY' : (Y : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hY.ne'
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ c ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero _ two_ne_zero
  have hσy2 : σy * σy = 1 := by rcases hσy with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  have hσy0 : σy ≠ 0 := by rcases hσy with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  have hq : (σx * X * (2 : ℝ) ^ c) / (σy * Y * (2 : ℝ) ^ c)
      = (σx * σy) * ((X : ℝ) / Y) := by
    rw [div_eq_iff (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hσy0 hY') h2)]
    have hXY : (X : ℝ) / Y * Y = X := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hY'
    linear_combination (-(σx * ((X : ℝ) / Y) * Y * (2 : ℝ) ^ c)) * hσy2
      + (-(σx * (2 : ℝ) ^ c)) * hXY
  have hσ : σx * σy = 1 ∨ σx * σy = -1 := by
    rcases hσx with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hσy with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  rw [hq, toInt_round_down_sign_div _ hσ X Y hY]
  have hmod : ((X % Y : ℕ) : ℝ) = X - Y * ((X / Y : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have := Nat.mod_add_div X Y
    have h' : ((X % Y + Y * (X / Y) : ℕ) : ℝ) = X := by rw [this]
    push_cast at h'
    linarith
  rw [hmod]
  linear_combination (-(σx * Y * ((X / Y : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ c)) * hσy2

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sign_eq_one_or
statement:
theorem sign_eq_one_or (s : Bool) : (if s then (1 : ℝ) else -1) = 1 ∨
    (if s then (1 : ℝ) else -1) = -1
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_eq_sign_mul
statement:
theorem finiteVal_eq_sign_mul (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) :
    finiteVal s e m = (if s then 1 else -1) * (m.toNat : ℝ)
      * (2 : ℝ) ^ (e - (AzNat.ofNat m.size).toAzInt).toInt
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteVal
  rw [AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_mkFinite_scaled
statement:
theorem toVal_mkFinite_scaled (s : Bool) (c : AzInt) (r : AzNat) :
    (mkFinite s (c + (AzNat.ofNat r.size).toAzInt) r.size r).toVal
      = some ((((if s then 1 else -1) * (r.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ c.toInt : ℝ)) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne r 0 with rfl | hr
  · rw [mkFinite_zero, toVal_zero, AzNat.toNat_zero]; simp
  · rw [toVal_mkFinite s _ _ r hr, finiteVal_eq_sign_mul]
    congr 3
    rw [AzInt.toInt_sub, AzInt.toInt_add, toInt_toAzInt]
    ring_nf

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_remExact
statement:
theorem toVal_remExact (x y : AzFloat) :
    (remExact x y).toVal = x.toVal.bind fun a => y.toVal.bind fun b => Spec.rem a b
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nan => cases y <;> simp [remExact]
  | infinity s =>
    cases y with
    | nan => simp [remExact]
    | infinity t => cases s <;> cases t <;> simp [remExact, Spec.rem]
    | zero => cases s <;> simp [remExact, Spec.rem]
    | finite t e q m hv => cases s <;> simp [remExact, Spec.rem]
  | zero =>
    cases y with
    | nan => simp [remExact]
    | infinity t => cases t <;> simp [remExact, Spec.rem]
    | zero => simp [remExact, Spec.rem]
    | finite t e q m hv =>
      have hv0 : finiteVal t e m ≠ 0 := finiteVal_ne_zero_of_valid t e hv
      simp only [remExact, toVal_zero, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      rw [show (0 : EReal) = ((0 : ℝ) : EReal) from rfl, Spec.rem_coe_coe _ _ hv0, zero_div,
        show (0 : ℝ) = ((0 : ℤ) : ℝ) from Int.cast_zero.symm, toInt_round_intCast]
      simp
  | finite sx ex qx mx hx =>
    cases y with
    | nan => simp [remExact]
    | infinity t => cases t <;> simp [remExact, Spec.rem]
    | zero => simp [remExact, Spec.rem]
    | finite sy ey qy my hy =>
      have hx0 : finiteVal sx ex mx ≠ 0 := finiteVal_ne_zero_of_valid sx ex hx
      have hy0 : finiteVal sy ey my ≠ 0 := finiteVal_ne_zero_of_valid sy ey hy
      simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      rw [Spec.rem_coe_coe _ _ hy0]
      have hmx : mx ≠ 0 := fun h => hx0 (by rw [finiteVal_eq_sign_mul, h]; simp)
      have hmy : my ≠ 0 := fun h => hy0 (by rw [finiteVal_eq_sign_mul, h]; simp)
      have hmxN : 0 < mx.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hmx)
      have hmyN : 0 < my.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hmy)
      show (if absLt (finite sx ex qx mx hx) (finite sy ey qy my hy).abs
          then finite sx ex qx mx hx else _).toVal = _
      by_cases hlt : absLt (finite sx ex qx mx hx) (finite sy ey qy my hy).abs = true
      · 
        rw [ite_eq_left hlt, toVal_finite]
        have habs := (absLt_iff rfl (isFinite_of_toVal_coe
          (toVal_abs_of_isFinite (x := finite sy ey qy my hy) rfl))).mp hlt
        rw [fval_of_toVal_coe (toVal_abs_of_isFinite (x := finite sy ey qy my hy) rfl)] at habs
        simp only [fval] at habs
        have : |finiteVal sx ex mx / finiteVal sy ey my| < 1 := by
          rw [abs_div, div_lt_one (abs_pos.mpr hy0)]; exact habs
        rw [toInt_round_down_of_abs_lt_one this]
        simp
      · rw [ite_eq_right hlt]
        simp only []
        set ax := ex - (AzNat.ofNat mx.size).toAzInt with hax
        set ay := ey - (AzNat.ofNat my.size).toAzInt with hay
        have hvx := finiteVal_eq_sign_mul sx ex mx
        have hvy := finiteVal_eq_sign_mul sy ey my
        rw [← hax] at hvx
        rw [← hay] at hvy
        have hσx := sign_eq_one_or sx
        have hσy := sign_eq_one_or sy
        by_cases hle : ay ≤ ax
        · rw [ite_eq_left hle, toVal_mkFinite_scaled]
          set k := (ax - ay).abs.toNat with hk
          have hkI : (k : ℤ) = ax.toInt - ay.toInt := by
            rw [hk, AzInt.abs_toNat_eq, AzInt.toInt_sub,
              abs_of_nonneg (by have := (AzInt.le_iff_toInt_le ay ax).mp hle; omega)]
          have hsplit : (2 : ℝ) ^ ax.toInt = (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (2 : ℝ) ^ ay.toInt := by
            rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), hkI]
            congr 1; ring
          rw [AzNat.toNat_shiftLeftMod]
          have := rem_scaled _ _ hσx hσy (mx.toNat * 2 ^ k) my.toNat hmyN ay.toInt
          push_cast at this
          have hX : (if sx then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (mx.toNat : ℝ)
                * ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * 2 ^ ay.toInt)
              = (if sx then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ((mx.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ k) * 2 ^ ay.toInt := by
            ring
          rw [hvx, hvy, hsplit, hX]
          exact congrArg (fun v : ℝ => some ((v : ℝ) : EReal)) this.symm
        · rw [ite_eq_right hle, toVal_mkFinite_scaled]
          set k := (ay - ax).abs.toNat with hk
          have hkI : (k : ℤ) = ay.toInt - ax.toInt := by
            rw [hk, AzInt.abs_toNat_eq, AzInt.toInt_sub,
              abs_of_nonneg (by
                have := (AzInt.le_iff_toInt_le ay ax).not.mp hle; push Not at this; omega)]
          have hsplit : (2 : ℝ) ^ ay.toInt = (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (2 : ℝ) ^ ax.toInt := by
            rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), hkI]
            congr 1; ring
          rw [AzNat.toNat_mod, AzNat.toNat_hShiftLeft, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
          have := rem_scaled _ _ hσx hσy mx.toNat (my.toNat * 2 ^ k) (by positivity) ax.toInt
          push_cast at this
          have hY : (if sy then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (my.toNat : ℝ)
                * ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * 2 ^ ax.toInt)
              = (if sy then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ((my.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ k) * 2 ^ ax.toInt := by
            ring
          rw [hvx, hvy, hsplit, hY]
          exact congrArg (fun v : ℝ => some ((v : ℝ) : EReal)) this.symm

name: Azurite.AzFloat.remPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂
statement:
theorem remPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂ (x y : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    remPrecRound x y p mode = liftVal₂ Spec.rem x y p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold remPrecRound liftVal₂
  rw [setPrecRound_eq_liftE]
  unfold liftE liftVal
  rw [toVal_remExact]
  cases x.toVal <;> simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.sqrt_coe
statement: theorem sqrt_coe (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) : sqrt (r : EReal) = some ((Real.sqrt r : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sqrt
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hr)), ite_eq_right (EReal.coe_ne_top r),
    EReal.toReal_coe]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.sqrt_coe_neg
statement: theorem sqrt_coe_neg (r : ℝ) (hr : r < 0) : sqrt (r : EReal) = none
proof:
:= by
  unfold sqrt
  rw [ite_eq_left (EReal.coe_neg'.mpr hr)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.sqrt_top
statement: @[simp] theorem sqrt_top : sqrt ⊤ = some ⊤
proof:
:= by
  unfold sqrt
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr le_top), ite_eq_left rfl]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.sqrt_bot
statement: @[simp] theorem sqrt_bot : sqrt ⊥ = none
proof:

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.sqrt_zero
