name: Azurite.AzFloat.compareScaled_eq
statement:
theorem compareScaled_eq (n : AzNat) (t : AzInt) (c : AzNat) :
    compareScaled n t c = compare ((n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt) (c.toNat : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold compareScaled
  have habs : (t.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |t.toInt| := AzInt.abs_toNat_eq t
  by_cases hsg : t.sign = true
  · have hg0 : 0 ≤ t.toInt := (AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff t).mp hsg
    rw [ite_eq_left hsg]
    show AzNat.compare (n.shiftLeft t.abs.toNat) c = _
    rw [AzNat.compare_eq_compare_toNat, ← compare_natCast, AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft]
    push_cast
    rw [← zpow_natCast, show ((t.abs.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = t.toInt by rw [habs, abs_of_nonneg hg0]]
  · have hg0 : t.toInt < 0 := by
      have := (AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff t).not.mp hsg; push Not at this; exact this
    rw [ite_eq_right hsg]
    show AzNat.compare n (c.shiftLeft t.abs.toNat) = _
    rw [AzNat.compare_eq_compare_toNat, ← compare_natCast, AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft]
    push_cast
    rw [← zpow_natCast, show ((t.abs.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = -t.toInt by rw [habs, abs_of_neg hg0],
      zpow_neg]
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
    rcases lt_trichotomy ((n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt) (c.toNat : ℝ) with h | h | h
    · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr ((lt_mul_inv_iff₀ hpos).mpr h)]
    · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr ((eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq₀ hpos.ne').mpr h)]
    · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr ((mul_inv_lt_iff₀ hpos).mpr h)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.scaled_floor
statement:
theorem scaled_floor (n : AzNat) (t : AzInt) :
    ((if t.sign then n.shiftLeft t.abs.toNat else n.shiftRight t.abs.toNat).toNat : ℝ)
        ≤ (n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt ∧
      (n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt
        < ((if t.sign then n.shiftLeft t.abs.toNat else n.shiftRight t.abs.toNat).toNat : ℝ) + 1 ∧
      ((n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt
          = ((if t.sign then n.shiftLeft t.abs.toNat else n.shiftRight t.abs.toNat).toNat : ℝ) ↔
        (t.sign || n.isMultipleOfPow2 t.abs.toNat) = true)
proof:
:= by
  have habs : (t.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |t.toInt| := AzInt.abs_toNat_eq t
  by_cases hsg : t.sign = true
  · have hg0 : 0 ≤ t.toInt := (AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff t).mp hsg
    rw [ite_eq_left hsg, AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft, hsg, Bool.true_or]
    push_cast
    rw [← zpow_natCast, show ((t.abs.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = t.toInt by rw [habs, abs_of_nonneg hg0]]
    exact ⟨le_rfl, by linarith, by simp⟩
  · have hg0 : t.toInt < 0 := by
      have := (AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff t).not.mp hsg; push Not at this; exact this
    have hsf : t.sign = false := by simpa using hsg
    rw [ite_eq_right hsg, AzNat.toNat_shiftRight, hsf, Bool.false_or,
      AzNat.isMultipleOfPow2_eq, decide_eq_true_eq]
    set k := t.abs.toNat with hk
    have hkI : (k : ℤ) = -t.toInt := by rw [hk, habs, abs_of_neg hg0]
    have h2k : (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt = ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      push_cast
      rw [← zpow_natCast, hkI, zpow_neg, inv_inv]
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hdiv := Nat.div_add_mod n.toNat (2 ^ k)
    have hmod := Nat.mod_lt n.toNat (by positivity : 0 < 2 ^ k)
    rw [h2k]
    set Q := n.toNat / 2 ^ k with hQ
    set R := n.toNat % 2 ^ k with hR
    have hn : (n.toNat : ℝ) = (2 ^ k : ℕ) * Q + R := by exact_mod_cast hdiv.symm
    have hR0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ R := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hRlt : (R : ℝ) < (2 ^ k : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hmod
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hn, le_mul_inv_iff₀ hpos]; nlinarith
    · rw [hn, mul_inv_lt_iff₀ hpos]; nlinarith
    · constructor
      · intro h
        rw [hn, mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul₀ hpos.ne'] at h
        have : (R : ℝ) = 0 := by linarith
        have hR0' : R = 0 := by exact_mod_cast this
        exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hR0'
      · intro h
        have hR0' : R = 0 := by rw [hR]; exact Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h
        rw [hn, hR0', Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, mul_comm, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hpos.ne']

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sqrtCore_eq
statement:
theorem sqrtCore_eq (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    sqrtCore e (coreSignificand q m) q p mode
      = roundVal p mode
          (some ((Real.sqrt (finiteVal true e (coreSignificand q m)) : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  set n := coreSignificand q m with hn
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := coreSignificand_ne_zero hv
  have hs : n.size = q := size_coreSignificand hv
  clear_value n
  have hb : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((q : ℤ) - 1) ≤ (n.toNat : ℝ) ∧ (n.toNat : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (q : ℤ) := by
    obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := toNat_bounds_of_ne_zero n hn0
    rw [hs] at hlo hhi
    have hq : 0 < q := hv.pos
    constructor
    · rw [show (q : ℤ) - 1 = ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega, zpow_natCast]; exact_mod_cast hlo
    · rw [zpow_natCast]; exact_mod_cast hhi
  set N : ℝ := (n.toNat : ℝ) with hN
  clear_value N
  have hNpos : 0 < N := lt_of_lt_of_le (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _) hb.1
  unfold sqrtCore
  simp only []
  
  set δ : ℕ := if e.isOdd then 1 else 0 with hδ_def
  have hδ : (δ : ℤ) % 2 = e.toInt % 2 := by
    rw [hδ_def]
    rcases Int.even_or_odd e.toInt with h | h
    · have : e.isOdd = false := by
        cases hi : e.isOdd
        · rfl
        · exact absurd ((AzInt.isOdd_iff e).mp hi) (Int.not_odd_iff_even.mpr h)
      rw [this]; simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Nat.cast_zero]
      rw [Int.even_iff] at h; omega
    · rw [(AzInt.isOdd_iff e).mpr h]; simp only [↓reduceIte, Nat.cast_one]
      rw [Int.odd_iff] at h; omega
  have hδle : δ ≤ 1 := by rw [hδ_def]; split_ifs <;> omega
  clear_value δ
  
  set t : AzInt := (AzNat.ofNat (2 * p)).toAzInt - (AzNat.ofNat (q + δ)).toAzInt with ht_def
  have htI : t.toInt = 2 * (p : ℤ) - q - δ := by
    rw [ht_def, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat,
      AzNat.toNat_ofNat]; push_cast; ring
  clear_value t
  set w' : AzInt := e - (AzNat.ofNat (2 * p)).toAzInt + (AzNat.ofNat δ).toAzInt with hw'_def
  have hw'I : w'.toInt = e.toInt - 2 * p + δ := by
    rw [hw'_def, AzInt.toInt_add, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat,
      AzNat.toNat_ofNat]; push_cast; ring
  clear_value w'
  set w := w'.shiftRight 1 with hw_def
  have hwI : 2 * w.toInt = w'.toInt := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℤ, w'.toInt = 2 * k := by
      refine ⟨w'.toInt / 2, ?_⟩
      have : w'.toInt % 2 = 0 := by rw [hw'I]; omega
      omega
    have h := AzInt.toInt_shiftRight w' 1
    rw [pow_one, hk, ← hw_def] at h
    have h2 : toInt (round intSet .Floor (((2 * k : ℤ) : ℝ) / 2)) = w.toInt := toInt_eq_of_val h
    rw [show toInt (round intSet .Floor (((2 * k : ℤ) : ℝ) / 2)) = ⌊((2 * k : ℤ) : ℝ) / 2⌋ from
      toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundFloor_intSet _).symm] at h2
    rw [show ((2 * k : ℤ) : ℝ) / 2 = (k : ℝ) by push_cast; ring, Int.floor_intCast] at h2
    rw [hk, ← h2]
  clear_value w
  have htw : t.toInt + 2 * w.toInt = e.toInt - q := by rw [hwI, hw'I, htI]; ring
  
  set Mr : ℝ := N * (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt with hMr
  have hMr0 : 0 < Mr := by positivity
  obtain ⟨hMle, hMlt, hMex⟩ := scaled_floor n t
  rw [← hN] at hMle hMlt hMex
  set M := if t.sign then n.shiftLeft t.abs.toNat else n.shiftRight t.abs.toNat with hM_def
  clear_value M
  rw [← hMr] at hMle hMlt hMex
  
  have hMlo : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (p : ℤ) - 2) ≤ Mr := by
    rw [hMr, htI]
    calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (p : ℤ) - 2) ≤ 2 ^ ((q : ℤ) - 1) * 2 ^ (2 * (p : ℤ) - q - δ) := by
          rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
          exact zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ ≤ N * 2 ^ (2 * (p : ℤ) - q - δ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb.1 (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _).le
  have hMhi : Mr < (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (p : ℤ)) := by
    rw [hMr, htI]
    calc N * 2 ^ (2 * (p : ℤ) - q - δ) < 2 ^ (q : ℤ) * 2 ^ (2 * (p : ℤ) - q - δ) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hb.2 (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _)
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (2 * (p : ℤ)) := by
          rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
          exact zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  
  set sr := AzNat.sqrtRem M with hsr
  clear_value sr
  have hsN : sr.1.toNat = Nat.sqrt M.toNat := by rw [hsr]; exact AzNat.toNat_sqrtRem_fst M
  have hrN : sr.2.toNat = M.toNat - Nat.sqrt M.toNat * Nat.sqrt M.toNat := by
    rw [hsr]; exact AzNat.toNat_sqrtRem_snd M
  set y : ℝ := Real.sqrt Mr with hy_def
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsq_le : Nat.sqrt M.toNat ^ 2 ≤ M.toNat := Nat.sqrt_le' _
  have hlt_sq : M.toNat < (Nat.sqrt M.toNat + 1) ^ 2 := Nat.lt_succ_sqrt' _
  have hlo : (sr.1.toNat : ℝ) ≤ y := by
    rw [hsN, hy_def]
    exact le_trans Real.nat_sqrt_le_real_sqrt (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hMle)
  have hhi : y < sr.1.toNat + 1 := by
    rw [hsN, hy_def]
    calc Real.sqrt Mr < Real.sqrt (M.toNat + 1) := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt hMr0.le hMlt
      _ ≤ Nat.sqrt M.toNat + 1 := by
          rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)]
          exact_mod_cast hlt_sq
  have hex : (decide (sr.2 = 0) && (t.sign || n.isMultipleOfPow2 t.abs.toNat)) = true ↔
      y = sr.1.toNat := by
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, ← hMex, hsN, hy_def,
      Real.sqrt_eq_iff_eq_sq hMr0.le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hr, hM⟩
      have hr' : sr.2.toNat = 0 := by rw [hr]; rfl
      rw [hrN] at hr'
      have hM2 : M.toNat = Nat.sqrt M.toNat * Nat.sqrt M.toNat := by
        have := Nat.sqrt_le M.toNat; omega
      have hMs : (M.toNat : ℝ) = (Nat.sqrt M.toNat : ℝ) ^ 2 := by rw [sq]; exact_mod_cast hM2
      rw [hM, hMs]
    · intro h
      have hMle' : Mr ≤ (M.toNat : ℝ) := by
        rw [h]; exact_mod_cast hsq_le
      have hMeq : Mr = (M.toNat : ℝ) := le_antisymm hMle' hMle
      refine ⟨?_, hMeq⟩
      have : (M.toNat : ℝ) = (Nat.sqrt M.toNat : ℝ) ^ 2 := by rw [← hMeq, h]
      have hM2 : M.toNat = Nat.sqrt M.toNat * Nat.sqrt M.toNat := by
        have : (M.toNat : ℝ) = ((Nat.sqrt M.toNat * Nat.sqrt M.toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
          rw [this]; push_cast; ring
        exact_mod_cast this
      apply AzNat.toNat_injective
      rw [hrN, AzNat.toNat_zero]
      exact Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hM2.le
  have hmid : compareScaled n (t + (AzNat.ofNat 2).toAzInt)
      (AzNat.square ((sr.1.shiftLeft 1).addUInt64 1))
      = compare y ((sr.1.toNat : ℝ) + 1 / 2) := by
    have htt : (t + (AzNat.ofNat 2).toAzInt).toInt = t.toInt + 2 := by
      rw [AzInt.toInt_add, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]; push_cast; ring
    have hL : N * (2 : ℝ) ^ (t.toInt + 2) = Mr * 4 := by
      rw [hMr, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), show (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℤ) = 4 by norm_num]; ring
    have hRt : ((AzNat.square ((sr.1.shiftLeft 1).addUInt64 1)).toNat : ℝ)
        = ((sr.1.toNat : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2 * 4 := by
      rw [AzNat.toNat_square, AzNat.toNat_addUInt64, AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft, UInt64.toNat_one]
      push_cast; ring
    rw [compareScaled_eq, htt, ← hN, hL, hRt, hy_def, compare_mul_right_pos _ _ _ (by norm_num)]
    have hmid_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (sr.1.toNat : ℝ) + 1 / 2 := by positivity
    rcases lt_trichotomy (Real.sqrt Mr) ((sr.1.toNat : ℝ) + 1 / 2) with h | h | h
    · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h]
      rw [Real.sqrt_lt' hmid_pos] at h
      exact compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h
    · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h]
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_eq_sq hMr0.le hmid_pos.le] at h
      exact compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h
    · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h]
      rw [Real.lt_sqrt hmid_pos.le] at h
      exact compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h
  obtain ⟨hR, htag⟩ := roundFromFloor_spec y sr.1 _ _ mode hlo hhi hex hmid
  set ro := roundFromFloor sr.1 (decide (sr.2 = 0) && (t.sign || n.isMultipleOfPow2 t.abs.toNat))
    (compareScaled n (t + (AzNat.ofNat 2).toAzInt)
      (AzNat.square ((sr.1.shiftLeft 1).addUInt64 1))) mode with hro
  clear_value ro
  
  have h2w : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ w.toInt := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  set v : ℝ := Real.sqrt (finiteVal true e n) with hv_def
  have hv : v = y * (2 : ℝ) ^ w.toInt := by
    rw [hv_def, hy_def, finiteVal_true_eq, hs, ← hN, ← htw, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num),
      show (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * w.toInt) = (2 ^ w.toInt) ^ 2 by
        rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]; congr 1; push_cast; ring,
      ← mul_assoc, ← hMr, Real.sqrt_mul hMr0.le, Real.sqrt_sq h2w.le]
  clear_value v
  have hylo : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ y := by
    rw [hy_def, Real.le_sqrt (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _).le hMr0.le, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
    convert hMlo using 2; push_cast; ring
  have hyhi : y < (2 : ℝ) ^ (p : ℤ) := by
    rw [hy_def, Real.sqrt_lt' (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _), ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
    convert hMhi using 2; push_cast; ring
  have hypos : 0 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _) hylo
  have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by rw [hv]; positivity
  have hvabs : |v| = y * (2 : ℝ) ^ w.toInt := by rw [hv, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
  have hvpos : 0 < |v| := by rw [hvabs]; positivity
  have hlog : Int.log 2 |v| = w.toInt + p - 1 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · have h := (Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt (b := 2) (by norm_num) hvpos).mp (by
        rw [hvabs, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num), mul_comm]
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hyhi h2w)
      omega
    · exact (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log (b := 2) (by norm_num) hvpos).mp (by
        rw [hvabs, show w.toInt + p - 1 = ((p : ℤ) - 1) + w.toInt by ring, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hylo h2w.le)
  have hscale : precScale 2 p v = (2 : ℝ) ^ w.toInt := by
    unfold precScale
    rw [hlog]
    push_cast
    congr 1
    ring
  have hyv : v / (2 : ℝ) ^ w.toInt = y := by rw [hv, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ h2w.ne']
  have hround : (round (floatSet p) mode v).val
      = ((((AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).toInt : ℝ) * 2 ^ w.toInt : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [val_round_floatSet, val_round_precisionSet mode v hv0, hscale, hyv, hR,
      AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true]
  
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := abs_toInt_round_bounds p hp mode y (by rw [abs_of_pos hypos]; exact hylo)
    (by rw [abs_of_pos hypos]; exact hyhi)
  rw [hR] at hb1 hb2
  have habsR : ((AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat : ℤ) = |(ro.1.toNat : ℤ)| := by
    rw [AzInt.abs_toNat_eq, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true]
  have hlo' : 2 ^ (p - 1) ≤ (AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat := by
    have : ((2 ^ (p - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ ((AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat : ℤ) := by
      rw [habsR]; exact hb1
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hhi' : (AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ p := by
    have : ((AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat : ℤ) ≤ ((2 ^ p : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      rw [habsR]; exact hb2
    exact_mod_cast this
  obtain ⟨hRval, hRprec⟩ := normalizeCarry_spec (AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1) p hp
    (w + (AzNat.ofNat p).toAzInt) hlo' hhi'
  have hep : (w + (AzNat.ofNat p).toAzInt).toInt - p = w.toInt := by
    rw [AzInt.toInt_add, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]; ring
  rw [hep] at hRval
  symm
  refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
  · have hgoal : (roundVal p mode (some (v : EReal))).1
        = normalizeCarry (AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1) (w + (AzNat.ofNat p).toAzInt) p :=
      toVal_injective p (ofEReal_spec p mode v).1 (Or.inl hRprec)
        (by rw [fst_roundVal, ofVal_some, (ofEReal_spec p mode v).2, hround, hRval])
    exact hgoal
  · show (roundVal p mode (some (v : EReal))).2 = ro.2
    rw [(roundVal_coe p mode v).2, hround, compare_coe_coe, htag, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true,
      Int.cast_natCast, hv, compare_mul_right_pos _ _ _ h2w]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sqrtPrecRound_eq_liftVal
statement:
theorem sqrtPrecRound_eq_liftVal (x : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    sqrtPrecRound x p mode = liftVal Spec.sqrt x p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold liftVal
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity s => cases s <;> simp [sqrtPrecRound]
  | zero => simp [sqrtPrecRound]
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    cases s with
    | true =>
      simp only [sqrtPrecRound, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [finiteVal_eq_core true e hv,
        Spec.sqrt_coe _ (finiteVal_true_pos' e _ (coreSignificand_ne_zero hv)).le,
        sqrtCore_eq e hv p mode]
    | false =>
      simp only [sqrtPrecRound, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [finiteVal_eq_core false e hv, finiteVal_false,
        Spec.sqrt_coe_neg _ (neg_neg_iff_pos.mpr
          (finiteVal_true_pos' e _ (coreSignificand_ne_zero hv))), roundVal_none]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBasePow2RatPrecRound_eq
statement:
theorem logBasePow2RatPrecRound_eq (q : AzRat) (k : AzInt) (hk : k ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    logBasePow2RatPrecRound q k p mode
      = roundVal p mode (Spec.logBasePow2 k.toInt ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  have hkI := toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hk
  unfold logBasePow2RatPrecRound
  rw [dite_eq_right hk]
  split_ifs with h0 hs hp
  · rw [(AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr h0, EReal.coe_zero, Spec.logBasePow2_zero _ hkI,
      sign_eq_decide_pos_toInt k hk]
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hkI with h | h
    · rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr h.le), decide_eq_false (not_lt.mpr h.le)]
      exact (roundVal_inf p mode true).symm
    · rw [ite_eq_left h, decide_eq_true h]
      exact (roundVal_inf p mode false).symm
  · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
  · have hq := toRat_pos_of_sign q hs h0
    have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
    rw [Spec.logBasePow2_coe _ _ hqr]
    split
    · rename_i j hj
      obtain ⟨h2, rfl⟩ := AzRat.checkedLogBase2_eq_some q j hj
      rw [ofAzRatRound_eq_roundVal, AzRat.toRat_ofAzInts, AzRat.toRat_of_isPowerOfTwo q h2,
        logb_two_zpow]
      push_cast
      rfl
    · rename_i hj
      have h2 := AzRat.isPowerOfTwo_eq_false_of_checkedLogBase2_eq_none q hj
      exact zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode _ (Real.logb 2 (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) / k.toInt) _
        (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
        (fun w hw => by
          obtain ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
            logBasePow2RatApprox_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega) q hq h2 k hk
          exact ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩) _
  · have hneg := toRat_neg_of_sign q (by simpa using hs) h0
    rw [Spec.logBasePow2_coe_neg _ _ hneg, roundVal_none]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_eq_core_mul
statement:
theorem finiteVal_eq_core_mul (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) :
    finiteVal s e m
      = (if s then 1 else -1) * ((coreSignificand q m).toNat : ℝ)
        * (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteVal_eq_core s e hv, finiteVal_sign, finiteVal_true_eq, size_coreSignificand hv]
  ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.abs_sign_mul
statement: theorem abs_sign_mul (s : Bool) (r : ℝ) : |(if s then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * r| = |r|
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.isInteger_finite
statement:
theorem isInteger_finite (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) :
    isInteger (finite s e q m hv) = true ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, finiteVal s e m = n
proof:
:= by
  have hval := finiteVal_eq_core_mul s e hv
  set c := coreSignificand q m with hc
  simp only [isInteger, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, AzNat.isMultipleOfPow2_eq,
    AzInt.le_iff_toInt_le, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
  by_cases hqe : (q : ℤ) ≤ e.toInt
  · simp only [hqe, true_or, true_iff]
    refine ⟨(if s then 1 else -1) * c.toNat * 2 ^ (e.toInt - q).toNat, ?_⟩
    rw [hval]
    push_cast
    rw [← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)]
  · simp only [hqe, false_or]
    set j : ℕ := ((AzNat.ofNat q).toAzInt - e).abs.toNat with hj
    have hjI : (j : ℤ) = q - e.toInt := by
      rw [hj, AzInt.abs_toNat_eq, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat,
        abs_of_pos (by omega)]
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - q) = ((2 : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹ := by
      rw [← zpow_natCast, hjI, ← zpow_neg]; congr 1; ring
    have h2pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ j := by positivity
    rw [hval, h2]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
      refine ⟨(if s then 1 else -1) * t, ?_⟩
      rw [ht]
      push_cast
      rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_comm ((2 : ℝ) ^ j), mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2pos.ne',
        mul_one]
    · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
      have habs : (c.toNat : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹ = (n.natAbs : ℝ) := by
        have h' : |(if s then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (c.toNat : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹|
            = |(n : ℝ)| := by
          rw [hn]
        rw [mul_assoc, abs_sign_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _),
          abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr h2pos)] at h'
        rw [h', ← Int.cast_natCast (R := ℝ) n.natAbs, Int.natCast_natAbs, Int.cast_abs]
      have hc' : c.toNat = n.natAbs * 2 ^ j := by
        have : (c.toNat : ℝ) = (n.natAbs : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ j := by
          rw [← habs]; field_simp
        exact_mod_cast this
      exact Dvd.intro_left _ hc'.symm

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundToIntegerPrecRound_nan
statement:
@[simp] theorem roundToIntegerPrecRound_nan (p : ℕ) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    roundToIntegerPrecRound nan p mode = (nan, .eq, false)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundToIntegerPrecRound_infinity
statement:
@[simp] theorem roundToIntegerPrecRound_infinity (s : Bool) (p : ℕ) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    roundToIntegerPrecRound (infinity s) p mode = (infinity s, .eq, false)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundToIntegerPrecRound_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem roundToIntegerPrecRound_zero (p : ℕ) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    roundToIntegerPrecRound zero p mode = (zero, .eq, true)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundToIntegerPrecRound_spec
statement:
theorem roundToIntegerPrecRound_spec (x : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode)
    (v : ℝ) (hx : x.toVal = some (v : EReal)) :
    (roundToIntegerPrecRound x p mode).1.toVal = some (round (intPrecisionSet p) mode v).val ∧
      (roundToIntegerPrecRound x p mode).2.1
        = compare (round (intPrecisionSet p) mode v).val (v : EReal) ∧
      ((roundToIntegerPrecRound x p mode).2.2 = true ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, v = n)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 1 ≤ p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  cases x with
  | nan => simp at hx
  | infinity s => cases s <;> simp at hx
  | zero =>
    have hv : v = 0 := by
      simp only [toVal_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hx
      exact EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp hx.symm
    subst hv
    have h0 : (round (intPrecisionSet p) mode (0 : ℝ)).val = (((0 : ℝ)) : EReal) :=
      val_round_of_mem _ mode (by simpa using int_mem_intPrecisionSet (p := p) 0 (by simp))
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [roundToIntegerPrecRound_zero, h0]; rfl
    · rw [roundToIntegerPrecRound_zero, h0]; simp
    · simp only [roundToIntegerPrecRound_zero, true_iff]
      exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | finite s e q m hv =>
  simp only [toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at hx
  subst hx
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_finiteVal_bounds s e hv
  have hval := finiteVal_eq_core_mul s e hv
  set c := coreSignificand q m with hc
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := coreSignificand_ne_zero hv
  have hint := isInteger_finite s e hv
  unfold roundToIntegerPrecRound
  simp only []
  by_cases hbr : ((AzNat.ofNat p).toAzInt ≤ e || (AzNat.ofNat q).toAzInt ≤ e) = true
  · rw [ite_eq_left hbr]
    simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, AzInt.le_iff_toInt_le, toInt_toAzInt,
      AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at hbr
    rw [setPrecRound_eq_liftE]
    unfold liftE liftVal
    rw [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
    simp only [id_eq]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := roundVal_coe p mode (finiteVal s e m)
    rw [val_round_floatSet] at h1 h2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hint⟩
    all_goals
      rcases le_or_gt (p : ℤ) e.toInt with hpe | hpe
      · 
        have hlarge : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ |finiteVal s e m| :=
          (zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)).trans hlo
        rw [val_round_intPrecision_large mode _ hlarge]
        first | exact h1 | exact h2
      · 
        have hqe : (q : ℤ) ≤ e.toInt := by omega
        obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀⟩ := hint.mp (by
          simp only [isInteger, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, AzInt.le_iff_toInt_le,
            toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
          exact Or.inl hqe)
        have hsmall : |finiteVal s e m| < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) :=
          hhi.trans_le (zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega))
        have hbound : |n₀| < 2 ^ p := by
          rw [hn₀, two_zpow_pred_eq hp, ← Int.cast_abs] at hsmall
          have : |n₀| < 2 ^ (p - 1) := by exact_mod_cast hsmall
          exact this.trans (two_pow_pred_lt hp)
        have hS : (round (intPrecisionSet p) mode (finiteVal s e m)).val
            = ((finiteVal s e m : ℝ) : EReal) := by
          rw [val_round_intPrecision_small mode _ hsmall, ← toInt_spec, hn₀,
            toInt_round_intCast]
        have hP : (round (precisionSet 2 p) mode (finiteVal s e m)).val
            = ((finiteVal s e m : ℝ) : EReal) := by
          rw [hn₀]; exact val_round_of_mem _ mode (int_mem_precisionSet n₀ hbound)
        rw [hS]
        first | (rw [h1, hP]) | (rw [h2, hP])
  · rw [ite_eq_right hbr]
    simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, AzInt.le_iff_toInt_le, toInt_toAzInt,
      AzNat.toNat_ofNat, not_or, not_le] at hbr
    obtain ⟨hpe, hqe⟩ := hbr
    set z := AzInt.mkNorm s c with hz_def
    set sh : ℕ := ((AzNat.ofNat q).toAzInt - e).abs.toNat with hsh
    have hshI : (sh : ℤ) = q - e.toInt := by
      rw [hsh, AzInt.abs_toNat_eq, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat,
        abs_of_pos (by omega)]
    have hz : (z.toInt : ℝ) = (if s then 1 else -1) * (c.toNat : ℝ) := by
      rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true s with hs | hs <;>
        simp [hz_def, hs, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_false c hc0]
    have heq : (z.toInt : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ sh = finiteVal s e m := by
      rw [hz, hval, ← zpow_natCast, hshI, show e.toInt - q = -((q : ℤ) - e.toInt) by ring,
        zpow_neg, div_eq_mul_inv]
    set r := z.shiftRightRound mode sh with hr_def
    have hr1 : ((r.1.toInt : ℝ) : EReal) = (round intSet mode (finiteVal s e m)).val := by
      rw [← heq]; exact AzInt.toInt_shiftRightRound z mode sh
    have hr2 : r.2 = compare (r.1.toInt : ℝ) (finiteVal s e m) := by
      rw [← heq]; exact AzInt.snd_shiftRightRound z mode sh
    have hsmall : |finiteVal s e m| < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) :=
      hhi.trans_le (zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega))
    have hS : (round (intPrecisionSet p) mode (finiteVal s e m)).val
        = ((r.1.toInt : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      rw [val_round_intPrecision_small mode _ hsmall, hr1]
    have hti : toInt (round intSet mode (finiteVal s e m)) = r.1.toInt := toInt_eq_of_val hr1
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [setPrecRound_eq_liftE]
      unfold liftE liftVal
      rw [toVal_ofAzInt, Option.bind_some]
      simp only [id_eq]
      have hk : |r.1.toInt| ≤ 2 ^ p := by
        rw [← hti]
        have hB : |finiteVal s e m| ≤ ((2 ^ (p - 1) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
          rw [← two_zpow_pred_eq hp]; exact hsmall.le
        exact (abs_toInt_round_le mode _ _ hB).trans (two_pow_pred_lt hp).le
      have hmem := mem_floatSet_mul_zpow p r.1.toInt 0 hk
      simp only [zpow_zero, mul_one] at hmem
      rw [(roundVal_of_mem p mode _ hmem).1, hS]
    · rw [hS, compare_coe_coe, hr2]
    · rw [decide_eq_true_iff, hr2, compare_eq_iff_eq]
      constructor
      · intro h; exact ⟨r.1.toInt, h.symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
        rw [hn, ← hti, hn, toInt_round_intCast]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_roundToIntegerPrecRound_self
statement:
theorem toVal_roundToIntegerPrecRound_self (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat}
    (hv : FiniteValid q m) (irm : RoundingMode) :
    (roundToIntegerPrecRound (finite s e q m hv) q irm).1.toVal
      = some (round intSet irm (finiteVal s e m)).val
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero q := ⟨hv.pos.ne'⟩
  obtain ⟨h1, -, -⟩ := roundToIntegerPrecRound_spec (finite s e q m hv) q irm _ rfl
  rw [h1]
  obtain ⟨-, hhi⟩ := abs_finiteVal_bounds s e hv
  rcases lt_or_ge |finiteVal s e m| ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((q : ℤ) - 1)) with hsmall | hlarge
  · rw [val_round_intPrecision_small irm _ hsmall]
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hkb⟩ := finiteVal_eq_int_mul_prec s e hv
    have hqe : (q : ℤ) ≤ e.toInt := by
      have : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((q : ℤ) - 1) < 2 ^ e.toInt := hlarge.trans_lt hhi
      have := (zpow_lt_zpow_iff_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)).mp this
      omega
    have hmem := mem_floatSet_mul_zpow q k (e.toInt - q) hkb.le
    rw [val_round_intPrecision_large irm _ hlarge, ← val_round_floatSet, hk,
      val_round_of_mem _ irm hmem]
    have hint : ((k : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - q) : ℝ)
        = ((k * 2 ^ (e.toInt - q).toNat : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      push_cast
      rw [← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)]
    rw [hint, val_round_of_mem intSet irm ⟨_, rfl⟩]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.rint_coe
statement: theorem rint_coe (irm : RoundingMode) (v : ℝ) : rint irm v = (round intSet irm v).val
proof:
:= by
  unfold rint
  rw [ite_eq_right (EReal.coe_ne_top v), ite_eq_right (EReal.coe_ne_bot v), EReal.toReal_coe]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundToIntegerThenPrecRound_eq_liftE
statement:
theorem roundToIntegerThenPrecRound_eq_liftE (x : AzFloat) (irm : RoundingMode) (p : ℕ)
    [NeZero p] (rm : RoundingMode) :
    roundToIntegerThenPrecRound x irm p rm = liftE (Spec.rint irm) x p rm
proof:
:= by
  unfold roundToIntegerThenPrecRound
  cases x with
  | nan => rw [roundToIntegerPrecRound_nan, setPrecRound_eq_liftE]; rfl
  | infinity s =>
    rw [roundToIntegerPrecRound_infinity, setPrecRound_eq_liftE]
    unfold liftE liftVal
    rw [toVal_infinity]
    cases s <;> simp [Spec.rint]
  | zero =>
    rw [roundToIntegerPrecRound_zero, setPrecRound_eq_liftE]
    unfold liftE liftVal
    rw [toVal_zero]
    have h0 : Spec.rint irm 0 = 0 := by
      rw [show (0 : EReal) = ((0 : ℝ) : EReal) from rfl, Spec.rint_coe,
        val_round_of_mem intSet irm ⟨0, by simp⟩]
    simp [h0]
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    show setPrecRound (roundToIntegerPrecRound (finite s e q m hv) q irm).1 p rm = _
    rw [setPrecRound_eq_liftE]
    unfold liftE liftVal
    rw [toVal_roundToIntegerPrecRound_self s e hv irm, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some,
      Option.bind_some, Spec.rint_coe]
    rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_azIntOfInt
statement: theorem toInt_azIntOfInt (i : ℤ) : (azIntOfInt i).toInt = i
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | ofNat n =>
    show ((AzNat.ofNat n).toAzInt).toInt = _
    rw [toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]; rfl
  | negSucc n =>
    show (-(AzNat.ofNat (n + 1)).toAzInt).toInt = _
    rw [AzInt.toInt_neg, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, Int.negSucc_eq]
    push_cast
    ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofNat_ne_zero_of_pos
statement: theorem ofNat_ne_zero_of_pos {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : AzNat.ofNat m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg AzNat.toNat h
  rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_zero] at this
  omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_ofUnpacked
statement: theorem toVal_ofUnpacked (u : UnpackedFloat) : toVal (ofUnpacked u) = u.toVal
proof:
:= by
  cases u with
  | notANumber => rfl
  | infinity s => cases s <;> rfl
  | zero s => rfl
  | finite s m e hm =>
    show toVal (mkFinite _ _ 53 (AzNat.ofNat m)) = _
    rw [toVal_mkFinite _ _ _ _ (ofNat_ne_zero_of_pos hm), finiteVal_sign, finiteVal_true_eq,
      AzInt.toInt_add, toInt_azIntOfInt, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat,
      add_sub_cancel_right]
    simp only [UnpackedFloat.toVal, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff]
    cases s <;> simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_ofFloat64
statement: theorem toVal_ofFloat64 (f : Float) : toVal (ofFloat64 f) = f.toModel.unpack.toVal
proof:
:=
  toVal_ofUnpacked _

name: Azurite.AzFloat.smallToNat_eq
statement: theorem smallToNat_eq (n : AzNat) (h : n.toNat < 2 ^ 64) : smallToNat n = n.toNat
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (a : Array UInt64), (a = #[] ∨ ∃ u, a = #[u]) →
      (a.getD 0 0).toNat = AzNat.toNatLimbsList a.toList := by
    rintro _ (rfl | ⟨u, rfl⟩)
    · rfl
    · show u.toNat = AzNat.toNatLimbsList [u]
      simp [AzNat.toNatLimbsList]
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n.limbs.size 2 with hs | hs
  · show (n.limbs.getD 0 0).toNat = AzNat.toNatLimbsList n.limbs.toList
    apply key
    interval_cases hsz : n.limbs.size
    · exact Or.inl (Array.eq_empty_of_size_eq_zero hsz)
    · obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u, n.limbs.toList = [u] :=
        List.length_eq_one_iff.mp (by rw [Array.length_toList]; exact hsz)
      exact Or.inr ⟨u, Array.toList_inj.mp (by rw [hu])⟩
  · exfalso
    have := AzNat.toNat_pos_of_size_pos n (by omega)
    have h2 : 2 ^ 64 ≤ 2 ^ (64 * (n.limbs.size - 1)) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.unpackSign_packComponents
statement:
theorem unpackSign_packComponents {spec : Format} {sign : Sign} {exponent mantissa} :
    UnpackedFloat.unpackSign (UnpackedFloat.packComponents spec sign exponent mantissa)
      = sign.toBitVec
proof:
:= by
  ext i hi
  simp only [UnpackedFloat.unpackSign, UnpackedFloat.packComponents, BitVec.getElem_extractLsb',
    BitVec.getLsbD_append]
  rw [ite_eq_right (by omega), ite_eq_right (by omega),
    show spec.mantissaBitsWithoutImplicit + spec.exponentBits + i - spec.mantissaBitsWithoutImplicit
      - spec.exponentBits = i by omega, BitVec.getLsbD_eq_getElem]

name: Float.Model.UnpackedFloat.Sign.ofBitVec_toBitVec
statement:
theorem _root_.Float.Model.UnpackedFloat.Sign.ofBitVec_toBitVec (s : Sign) :
    Sign.ofBitVec s.toBitVec = s
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> decide

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2_eq_52
statement: theorem log2_eq_52 {m : ℕ} (h1 : 2 ^ 52 ≤ m) (h2 : m < 2 ^ 53) : m.log2 = 52
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.log2_eq_log_two]
  exact Nat.log_eq_of_pow_le_of_lt_pow h1 h2

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2_lt_52
statement: theorem log2_lt_52 {m : ℕ} (h0 : 0 < m) (h2 : m < 2 ^ 52) : m.log2 + 1 ≠ 53
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := Nat.log2_self_le h0.ne'
  rw [show m.log2 = 52 by omega] at this
  omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.unpack_pack
statement:
theorem unpack_pack (u : UnpackedFloat) (hu : u.Binary64) :
    UnpackedFloat.unpack Format.binary64 (UnpackedFloat.pack Format.binary64 u) = u
proof:
:= by
  cases u with
  | notANumber =>
    unfold UnpackedFloat.pack UnpackedFloat.packedNaN UnpackedFloat.unpack
    simp +decide only [↓reduceIte]
  | infinity s =>
    unfold UnpackedFloat.pack UnpackedFloat.packedInfinity UnpackedFloat.unpack
    simp +decide only [UnpackedFloat.unpackMantissa_packComponents,
      UnpackedFloat.unpackExponent_packComponents, unpackSign_packComponents,
      Sign.ofBitVec_toBitVec, ↓reduceIte]
  | zero s =>
    unfold UnpackedFloat.pack UnpackedFloat.packedZero UnpackedFloat.unpack
    simp +decide only [UnpackedFloat.unpackMantissa_packComponents,
      UnpackedFloat.unpackExponent_packComponents, unpackSign_packComponents,
      Sign.ofBitVec_toBitVec, ↓reduceIte, ↓reduceDIte]
  | finite s m e hm =>
    simp only [UnpackedFloat.Binary64] at hu
    unfold UnpackedFloat.pack
    simp only
    rcases hu with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · 
      have hlog := log2_eq_52 h1 h2
      have hbias : (e + (Format.binary64.exponentBias : ℤ)
          + (Format.binary64.mantissaBitsWithoutImplicit : ℤ)).toNat = (e + 1075).toNat := by
        show (e + ((2 ^ (11 - 1) - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + ((52 : ℕ) : ℤ)).toNat = _
        norm_num
        rw [show e + 1023 + 52 = e + 1075 by ring]
      have hb : ((e + 1075).toNat : ℤ) = e + 1075 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
      have hblt : (e + 1075).toNat < 2047 := by omega
      have hbpos : 0 < (e + 1075).toNat := by omega
      rw [hbias, ite_eq_right (by show ¬ 2 ^ 11 ≤ _; omega), ite_eq_left (by rw [hlog]; rfl)]
      unfold UnpackedFloat.unpack
      simp only [UnpackedFloat.unpackMantissa_packComponents,
        UnpackedFloat.unpackExponent_packComponents, unpackSign_packComponents,
        Sign.ofBitVec_toBitVec]
      have hne1 : BitVec.ofNat Format.binary64.exponentBits (e + 1075).toNat ≠ -1#_ := by
        rw [Ne, BitVec.toNat_eq, BitVec.toNat_ofNat, BitVec.neg_one_eq_allOnes,
          BitVec.toNat_allOnes]
        show ¬ (e + 1075).toNat % 2 ^ 11 = 2 ^ 11 - 1
        omega
      have hne0 : BitVec.ofNat Format.binary64.exponentBits (e + 1075).toNat ≠ 0#_ := by
        rw [Ne, BitVec.toNat_eq, BitVec.toNat_ofNat, BitVec.toNat_zero]
        show ¬ (e + 1075).toNat % 2 ^ 11 = 0
        omega
      rw [ite_eq_right hne1, ite_eq_right hne0]
      have hmant :
          (1#1 ++ BitVec.ofNat Format.binary64.mantissaBitsWithoutImplicit m).toNat = m := by
        rw [BitVec.toNat_append, BitVec.toNat_ofNat]
        show 1 <<< 52 ||| m % 2 ^ 52 = m
        have h := Nat.two_pow_add_eq_or_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt m (by norm_num : 0 < 2 ^ 52)) 1
        rw [mul_one] at h
        rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, one_mul, ← h]
        omega
      have hexp : ((BitVec.ofNat Format.binary64.exponentBits (e + 1075).toNat).toNat : ℤ)
          - ((Format.binary64.exponentBias : ℤ) + (Format.binary64.mantissaBitsWithoutImplicit : ℤ))
          = e := by
        rw [BitVec.toNat_ofNat]
        show (((e + 1075).toNat % 2 ^ 11 : ℕ) : ℤ)
          - (((2 ^ (11 - 1) - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + ((52 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = e
        rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
        norm_num
        omega
      simp only [hmant, hexp]
    · 
      subst h2
      have hbias : ((-1074 : ℤ) + (Format.binary64.exponentBias : ℤ) +
          (Format.binary64.mantissaBitsWithoutImplicit : ℤ)).toNat = 1 := by
        show ((-1074 : ℤ) + ((2 ^ (11 - 1) - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + ((52 : ℕ) : ℤ)).toNat = 1
        norm_num
      rw [hbias, ite_eq_right (by show ¬ 2 ^ 11 ≤ 1 + 1; omega),
        ite_eq_right (by show ¬ (m.log2 + 1 = 53); exact log2_lt_52 hm h1)]
      unfold UnpackedFloat.unpack
      have hne0 : BitVec.ofNat 52 m ≠ 0#52 := by
        rw [Ne, BitVec.toNat_eq, BitVec.toNat_ofNat, BitVec.toNat_zero, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h1]
        omega
      have hmant : (BitVec.ofNat 52 m).toNat = m := by
        rw [BitVec.toNat_ofNat]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h1
      have hexp : (((0#11 : BitVec 11).toNat : ℤ) -
          ((Format.binary64.exponentBias : ℤ) + ((52 : ℕ) : ℤ))) + 1 = -1074 := by decide
      simp +decide only [UnpackedFloat.unpackMantissa_packComponents,
        UnpackedFloat.unpackExponent_packComponents, unpackSign_packComponents,
        Sign.ofBitVec_toBitVec, hne0, hmant, hexp, ↓reduceIte, ↓reduceDIte]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.model_unpack_pack
statement:
theorem model_unpack_pack (u : UnpackedFloat) (hu : u.Binary64) :
    (Float.Model.pack u).unpack = u
proof:
:= by
  show UnpackedFloat.unpack Format.binary64
    (UInt64.ofBitVec (UnpackedFloat.pack Format.binary64 u)).toBitVec = u
  rw [UInt64.toBitVec_ofBitVec]
  exact unpack_pack u hu

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_round_nonneg
statement:
theorem toInt_round_nonneg (mode : RoundingMode) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    0 ≤ toInt (round intSet mode y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases AzRat.toInt_round_intSet_eq_floor_or_ceil mode y with h | h <;> rw [h]
  · exact Int.floor_nonneg.mpr hy
  · exact Int.ceil_nonneg hy

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_round_nonpos
statement:
theorem toInt_round_nonpos (mode : RoundingMode) (y : ℝ) (hy : y ≤ 0) :
    toInt (round intSet mode y) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases AzRat.toInt_round_intSet_eq_floor_or_ceil mode y with h | h <;> rw [h]
  · exact Int.floor_nonpos hy
  · exact Int.ceil_nonpos.mpr hy

name: Azurite.AzFloat.abs_toInt_round_le
statement:
theorem abs_toInt_round_le (mode : RoundingMode) (y : ℝ) (B : ℤ) (hB : |y| ≤ B) :
    |toInt (round intSet mode y)| ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp hB
  rcases AzRat.toInt_round_intSet_eq_floor_or_ceil mode y with h | h <;> rw [h, abs_le]
  · exact ⟨Int.le_floor.mpr (by exact_mod_cast h1), Int.floor_le_iff.mpr (by linarith)⟩
  · exact ⟨Int.le_ceil_iff.mpr (by rw [Int.cast_neg]; linarith), Int.ceil_le.mpr h2⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_round_intCast
statement:
theorem toInt_round_intCast (mode : RoundingMode) (z : ℤ) :
    toInt (round intSet mode (z : ℝ)) = z
proof:
:= by
  rcases AzRat.toInt_round_intSet_eq_floor_or_ceil mode (z : ℝ) with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.AzInt.toInt_max
statement: theorem AzInt.toInt_max (a b : AzInt) : (max a b).toInt = max a.toInt b.toInt
proof:
:= by
  show (if a ≤ b then b else a).toInt = _
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [max_eq_right ((AzInt.le_iff_toInt_le a b).mp h)]
  · rw [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge (fun h' => h ((AzInt.le_iff_toInt_le a b).mpr h')))]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.AzInt.lt_iff_toInt_lt
statement: theorem AzInt.lt_iff_toInt_lt (a b : AzInt) : a < b ↔ a.toInt < b.toInt
proof:
:= by
  show AzInt.compare a b = .lt ↔ _
  rw [AzInt.compare_eq_compare_toInt, compare_lt_iff_lt]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.signOfBool_eq_positive
statement: theorem signOfBool_eq_positive (s : Bool) : (signOfBool s = .positive) ↔ s = true
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> simp [signOfBool]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.size_eq_54_iff
statement: theorem size_eq_54_iff (n : AzNat) (hn : n.toNat ≤ 2 ^ 53) : n.size = 54 ↔ n.toNat = 2 ^ 53
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AzNat.size_toNat]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := Nat.lt_size.mp (show 53 < n.toNat.size by omega)
    omega
  · intro h
    rw [h, Nat.size_pow]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finishUnpacked_binary64
statement:
theorem finishUnpacked_binary64 (s : Bool) (r t : AzInt) (mode : RoundingMode)
    (hr : r.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ 53) (ht : -1074 ≤ t.toInt)
    (hlow : r.abs.toNat < 2 ^ 52 → t.toInt = -1074) :
    (finishUnpacked s r t mode).Binary64
proof:
:= by
  unfold finishUnpacked
  simp only []
  by_cases h0 : r.abs = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left h0]; trivial
  · rw [ite_eq_right h0]
    have hpos : 0 < r.abs.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero h0)
    have hmax : (maxFinite64 (signOfBool s)).Binary64 := by
      unfold maxFinite64; show (_ ∨ _); left; norm_num
    have h1 : (1 : AzInt).toInt = 1 := rfl
    by_cases hc : r.abs.size = 54
    · have h53 : r.abs.toNat = 2 ^ 53 := (size_eq_54_iff r.abs hr).mp hc
      rw [ite_eq_left hc, ite_eq_left hc]
      by_cases hov : azIntOfInt 971 < t + 1
      · rw [ite_eq_left hov]; split_ifs <;> first | exact hmax | trivial
      · rw [ite_eq_right hov]
        rw [AzInt.lt_iff_toInt_lt, toInt_azIntOfInt, AzInt.toInt_add, h1] at hov
        have hM : smallToNat (r.abs.shiftRight 1) = 2 ^ 52 := by
          rw [smallToNat_eq _ (by rw [AzNat.toNat_shiftRight, h53]; norm_num),
            AzNat.toNat_shiftRight, h53]
          norm_num
        rw [dite_eq_left (by rw [hM]; norm_num)]
        show (_ ∨ _)
        rw [hM, AzInt.toInt_add, h1]
        left
        refine ⟨le_rfl, by norm_num, by omega, by omega⟩
    · have hne : r.abs.toNat ≠ 2 ^ 53 := fun h => hc ((size_eq_54_iff r.abs hr).mpr h)
      rw [ite_eq_right hc, ite_eq_right hc]
      by_cases hov : azIntOfInt 971 < t
      · rw [ite_eq_left hov]; split_ifs <;> first | exact hmax | trivial
      · rw [ite_eq_right hov]
        rw [AzInt.lt_iff_toInt_lt, toInt_azIntOfInt] at hov
        have hM : smallToNat r.abs = r.abs.toNat := smallToNat_eq _ (by omega)
        rw [dite_eq_left (by rw [hM]; exact hpos)]
        show (_ ∨ _)
        rw [hM]
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge r.abs.toNat (2 ^ 52) with hlt | hge
        · right; exact ⟨hlt, hlow hlt⟩
        · left; exact ⟨hge, by omega, ht, by omega⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_finishUnpacked
statement:
theorem toVal_finishUnpacked (s : Bool) (r t : AzInt) (mode : RoundingMode)
    (hr : r.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ 53) (hsign : r.toInt ≠ 0 → (0 < r.toInt ↔ s = true))
    (hno : t.toInt + (if r.abs.toNat = 2 ^ 53 then 1 else 0) ≤ 971) :
    (finishUnpacked s r t mode).toVal
      = some (((r.toInt : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold finishUnpacked
  simp only []
  have habs : (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |r.toInt| := AzInt.abs_toNat_eq r
  have h1 : (1 : AzInt).toInt = 1 := rfl
  by_cases h0 : r.abs = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left h0]
    have hr0 : r.toInt = 0 := by
      have := congrArg AzNat.toNat h0
      rw [AzNat.toNat_zero] at this
      rw [this] at habs
      exact abs_eq_zero.mp (by exact_mod_cast habs.symm)
    simp [UnpackedFloat.toVal, hr0]
  · rw [ite_eq_right h0]
    have hpos : 0 < r.abs.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero h0)
    have hr0 : r.toInt ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, abs_zero] at habs
      exact (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero h0) (by exact_mod_cast habs)
    have hsgn := hsign hr0
    have habsR : (r.abs.toNat : ℝ) = |(r.toInt : ℝ)| := by
      rw [← Int.cast_abs, ← habs, Int.cast_natCast]
    have hsgn' : (if signOfBool s = Sign.positive then (1 : ℝ) else -1) = if s then 1 else -1 := by
      cases s <;> simp [signOfBool]
    have hsr : (if s then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (r.abs.toNat : ℝ) = r.toInt := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hr0 with hneg | hpos'
      · have hs : ¬ s = true := fun hs => absurd (hsgn.mpr hs) (not_lt.mpr hneg.le)
        rw [ite_eq_right hs, habsR, abs_of_neg (by exact_mod_cast hneg)]; ring
      · rw [ite_eq_left (hsgn.mp hpos'), habsR, abs_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hpos')]; ring
    by_cases hc : r.abs.size = 54
    · have h53 : r.abs.toNat = 2 ^ 53 := (size_eq_54_iff r.abs hr).mp hc
      rw [ite_eq_left hc, ite_eq_left hc]
      rw [ite_eq_left h53] at hno
      have hnov : ¬ azIntOfInt 971 < t + 1 := by
        rw [AzInt.lt_iff_toInt_lt, toInt_azIntOfInt, AzInt.toInt_add, h1]; omega
      rw [ite_eq_right hnov]
      have hM : smallToNat (r.abs.shiftRight 1) = 2 ^ 52 := by
        rw [smallToNat_eq _ (by rw [AzNat.toNat_shiftRight, h53]; norm_num),
          AzNat.toNat_shiftRight, h53]
        norm_num
      rw [dite_eq_left (by rw [hM]; norm_num)]
      simp only [UnpackedFloat.toVal, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff]
      rw [hM, hsgn', AzInt.toInt_add, h1, zpow_add_one₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), ← hsr, h53]
      push_cast
      ring
    · have hne : r.abs.toNat ≠ 2 ^ 53 := fun h => hc ((size_eq_54_iff r.abs hr).mpr h)
      rw [ite_eq_right hc, ite_eq_right hc]
      rw [ite_eq_right hne, add_zero] at hno
      have hnov : ¬ azIntOfInt 971 < t := by
        rw [AzInt.lt_iff_toInt_lt, toInt_azIntOfInt]; omega
      rw [ite_eq_right hnov]
      have hM : smallToNat r.abs = r.abs.toNat := smallToNat_eq _ (by omega)
      rw [dite_eq_left (by rw [hM]; exact hpos)]
      simp only [UnpackedFloat.toVal, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff]
      rw [hM, hsgn', ← hsr]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.round_shift_eq
statement:
theorem round_shift_eq (s : Bool) (n : AzNat) (hn : n ≠ 0) (k : AzInt) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    (if k.sign then (AzInt.mkNorm s n).shiftLeft k.abs.toNat
        else (AzInt.shiftRightRound (AzInt.mkNorm s n) mode k.abs.toNat).1).toInt
      = toInt (round intSet mode ((if s then 1 else -1) * (n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt))
proof:
:= by
  have hz : ((AzInt.mkNorm s n).toInt : ℝ) = (if s then 1 else -1) * (n.toNat : ℝ) := by
    rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true s with hs | hs <;>
      simp [hs, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_false n hn]
  have habs : (k.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |k.toInt| := AzInt.abs_toNat_eq k
  by_cases hsg : k.sign = true
  · have hk0 : 0 ≤ k.toInt := (AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff k).mp hsg
    rw [ite_eq_left hsg, AzInt.toInt_shiftLeft]
    have hk : ((k.abs.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = k.toInt := by rw [habs, abs_of_nonneg hk0]
    have : (if s then 1 else -1) * (n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt
        = (((AzInt.mkNorm s n).toInt * 2 ^ k.abs.toNat : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      push_cast
      rw [hz, ← zpow_natCast, hk]
    rw [this, toInt_round_intCast]
  · have hk0 : k.toInt < 0 := by
      have := (AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff k).not.mp hsg; push Not at this; exact this
    rw [ite_eq_right hsg]
    have h := AzInt.toInt_shiftRightRound (AzInt.mkNorm s n) mode k.abs.toNat
    have hk : ((k.abs.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = -k.toInt := by rw [habs, abs_of_neg hk0]
    have heq : ((AzInt.mkNorm s n).toInt : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k.abs.toNat
        = (if s then 1 else -1) * (n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt := by
      rw [hz, ← zpow_natCast, hk, zpow_neg, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_inv]
    rw [heq] at h
    exact (toInt_eq_of_val h).symm

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toUnpacked_finite
statement:
theorem toUnpacked_finite (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid p m)
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    ∃ r t : AzInt, toUnpacked (finite s e p m hv) mode = finishUnpacked s r t mode ∧
      t.toInt = max (e.toInt - 53) (-1074) ∧
      r.toInt = toInt (round intSet mode (finiteVal s e m / (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt)) ∧
      (r.toInt ≠ 0 → (0 < r.toInt ↔ s = true))
proof:
:= by
  unfold toUnpacked
  simp only []
  set n := coreSignificand p m with hn
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := coreSignificand_ne_zero hv
  have hs : n.size = p := size_coreSignificand hv
  clear_value n
  set t : AzInt := max (e - (AzNat.ofNat 53).toAzInt) (azIntOfInt (-1074)) with ht_def
  have htI : t.toInt = max (e.toInt - 53) (-1074) := by
    rw [ht_def, AzInt.toInt_max, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat,
      toInt_azIntOfInt]
    push_cast
    rfl
  clear_value t
  set k : AzInt := e - (AzNat.ofNat p).toAzInt - t with hk_def
  have hkI : k.toInt = e.toInt - p - t.toInt := by
    rw [hk_def, AzInt.toInt_sub, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
  clear_value k
  refine ⟨_, t, rfl, htI, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [round_shift_eq s n hn0 k mode, finiteVal_eq_core s e hv, ← hn, finiteVal_sign,
      finiteVal_true_eq, hs, hkI]
    have key : (if s then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - p - t.toInt)
        = (if s then 1 else -1) * ((n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - p)) / 2 ^ t.toInt := by
      rw [zpow_sub₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]; ring
    rw [key]
  · intro hr0
    rw [round_shift_eq s n hn0 k mode] at hr0 ⊢
    have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < (n.toNat : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hn0)
    have h2k : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
    cases s with
    | true =>
      simp only [↓reduceIte, one_mul, iff_true] at hr0 ⊢
      have := toInt_round_nonneg mode _ (mul_pos hNpos h2k).le
      omega
    | false =>
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, neg_one_mul, iff_false, not_lt] at hr0 ⊢
      exact toInt_round_nonpos mode _ (by nlinarith)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toUnpacked_binary64
statement:
theorem toUnpacked_binary64 (x : AzFloat) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    (toUnpacked x mode).Binary64
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nan => trivial
  | infinity s => trivial
  | zero => trivial
  | finite s e p m hv =>
    obtain ⟨r, t, hx, htI, hr, -⟩ := toUnpacked_finite s e hv mode
    rw [hx]
    have hv0 : finiteVal s e m ≠ 0 := by
      rw [finiteVal_eq_core s e hv]
      exact finiteVal_ne_zero' s e _ (coreSignificand_ne_zero hv)
    obtain ⟨hvlo, hvhi⟩ := abs_finiteVal_bounds s e hv
    have habs : (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |r.toInt| := AzInt.abs_toNat_eq r
    have h2t : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
    rcases le_or_gt (-1021 : ℤ) e.toInt with hlo | hhi
    · 
      have ht : t.toInt = e.toInt - 53 := by rw [htI]; exact max_eq_left (by omega)
      have hscale : precScale 2 53 (finiteVal s e m) = (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt := by
        rw [precScale_finiteVal s e hv 53, ht]; rfl
      obtain ⟨hlo', hhi'⟩ := abs_div_precScale_bounds (b := 2) (p := 53) (finiteVal s e m) hv0
      rw [hscale] at hlo' hhi'
      obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := abs_toInt_round_bounds 53 (by norm_num) mode _ (by simpa using hlo')
        (by simpa using hhi')
      rw [← hr] at hb1 hb2
      apply finishUnpacked_binary64 s r t mode
      · have : (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) ≤ ((2 ^ 53 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [habs]; exact hb2
        exact_mod_cast this
      · omega
      · intro hlt
        exfalso
        have : ((2 ^ (53 - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [habs]; exact hb1
        have : (2 ^ 52 : ℕ) ≤ r.abs.toNat := by exact_mod_cast this
        omega
    · 
      have ht : t.toInt = -1074 := by rw [htI]; exact max_eq_right (by omega)
      have hsmall : |finiteVal s e m / (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt| ≤ ((2 ^ 52 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        rw [show ((2 ^ 52 : ℤ) : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (52 : ℤ) by norm_num]
        apply le_of_lt
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos h2t, div_lt_iff₀ h2t, ht]
        calc |finiteVal s e m| < (2 : ℝ) ^ e.toInt := hvhi
          _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1022 : ℤ) := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (52 : ℤ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1074 : ℤ) := by
            rw [← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]; norm_num
      have hb := abs_toInt_round_le mode _ _ hsmall
      rw [← hr] at hb
      have hr52 : r.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ 52 := by
        have : (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) ≤ 2 ^ 52 := by rw [habs]; exact hb
        exact_mod_cast this
      exact finishUnpacked_binary64 s r t mode (by omega) (by omega) (fun _ => ht)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_toUnpacked_normal
statement:
theorem toVal_toUnpacked_normal (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat}
    (hv : FiniteValid p m) (hlo : -1021 ≤ e.toInt) (hhi : e.toInt ≤ 1023) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    (toUnpacked (finite s e p m hv) mode).toVal
      = some (round (precisionSet 2 53) mode (finiteVal s e m)).val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, t, hx, htI, hr, hsign⟩ := toUnpacked_finite s e hv mode
  rw [hx]
  have hv0 : finiteVal s e m ≠ 0 := by
    rw [finiteVal_eq_core s e hv]
    exact finiteVal_ne_zero' s e _ (coreSignificand_ne_zero hv)
  have habs : (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |r.toInt| := AzInt.abs_toNat_eq r
  have ht : t.toInt = e.toInt - 53 := by rw [htI]; exact max_eq_left (by omega)
  have hscale : precScale 2 53 (finiteVal s e m) = (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt := by
    rw [precScale_finiteVal s e hv 53, ht]; rfl
  obtain ⟨hlo', hhi'⟩ := abs_div_precScale_bounds (b := 2) (p := 53) (finiteVal s e m) hv0
  rw [hscale] at hlo' hhi'
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := abs_toInt_round_bounds 53 (by norm_num) mode _ (by simpa using hlo')
    (by simpa using hhi')
  rw [← hr] at hb1 hb2
  have hr53 : r.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ 53 := by
    have : (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) ≤ ((2 ^ 53 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [habs]; exact hb2
    exact_mod_cast this
  rw [toVal_finishUnpacked s r t mode hr53 hsign (by rw [ht]; split_ifs <;> omega),
    val_round_precisionSet mode _ hv0, hscale, ← hr]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_toUnpacked_subnormal
statement:
theorem toVal_toUnpacked_subnormal (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat}
    (hv : FiniteValid p m) (hhi : e.toInt ≤ -1022) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    (toUnpacked (finite s e p m hv) mode).toVal
      = some ((((toInt (round intSet mode (finiteVal s e m * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1074 : ℤ))) : ℝ)
          * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1074 : ℤ) : ℝ)) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, t, hx, htI, hr, hsign⟩ := toUnpacked_finite s e hv mode
  rw [hx]
  obtain ⟨-, hvhi⟩ := abs_finiteVal_bounds s e hv
  have habs : (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |r.toInt| := AzInt.abs_toNat_eq r
  have ht : t.toInt = -1074 := by rw [htI]; exact max_eq_right (by omega)
  have h2t : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hsmall : |finiteVal s e m / (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt| ≤ ((2 ^ 52 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [show ((2 ^ 52 : ℤ) : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (52 : ℤ) by norm_num]
    apply le_of_lt
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos h2t, div_lt_iff₀ h2t, ht]
    calc |finiteVal s e m| < (2 : ℝ) ^ e.toInt := hvhi
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1022 : ℤ) := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (52 : ℤ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1074 : ℤ) := by
        rw [← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]; norm_num
  have hb := abs_toInt_round_le mode _ _ hsmall
  rw [← hr] at hb
  have hr52 : r.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ 52 := by
    have : (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) ≤ 2 ^ 52 := by rw [habs]; exact hb
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hdiv : finiteVal s e m / (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt = finiteVal s e m * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1074 : ℤ) := by
    rw [ht, div_eq_mul_inv, ← zpow_neg]; norm_num
  rw [toVal_finishUnpacked s r t mode (by omega) hsign (by rw [ht]; split_ifs <;> omega), hr, hdiv,
    ht]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofFloat64_toFloat64
statement:
theorem ofFloat64_toFloat64 (x : AzFloat) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    ofFloat64 (toFloat64 x mode) = ofUnpacked (toUnpacked x mode)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofFloat64 toFloat64
  rw [show (Float.ofModel (Float.Model.pack (toUnpacked x mode))).toModel
    = Float.Model.pack (toUnpacked x mode) from rfl,
    model_unpack_pack _ (toUnpacked_binary64 x mode)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_ofFloat64_toFloat64_normal
statement:
theorem toVal_ofFloat64_toFloat64_normal (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat}
    (hv : FiniteValid p m) (hlo : -1021 ≤ e.toInt) (hhi : e.toInt ≤ 1023) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    toVal (ofFloat64 (toFloat64 (finite s e p m hv) mode))
      = some (round (precisionSet 2 53) mode (finiteVal s e m)).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofFloat64_toFloat64, toVal_ofUnpacked, toVal_toUnpacked_normal s e hv hlo hhi mode]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_ofFloat64_toFloat64_subnormal
statement:
theorem toVal_ofFloat64_toFloat64_subnormal (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat}
    (hv : FiniteValid p m) (hhi : e.toInt ≤ -1022) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    toVal (ofFloat64 (toFloat64 (finite s e p m hv) mode))
      = some ((((toInt (round intSet mode (finiteVal s e m * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1074 : ℤ))) : ℝ)
          * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1074 : ℤ) : ℝ)) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofFloat64_toFloat64, toVal_ofUnpacked, toVal_toUnpacked_subnormal s e hv hhi mode]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toSciNumber_eq

proof:

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toSci_eq
statement:
theorem toSci_eq (x : AzFloat) (q : AzRat) (hq : x.toAzRat? = some q) (o : SciOptions) :
    x.toSci o = q.toSci o
proof:
:= by

  | infinity _ => simp [toAzRat?] at hq

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toSciNumber_value_precision
statement:
theorem toSciNumber_value_precision (x : AzFloat) (q : AzRat) (hq : x.toAzRat? = some q)
    (o : SciOptions) (hv : o.valid = true) (p : ℕ) (hp : o.size = .precision p)
    [Fact (1 < o.base.toNat)] [NeZero p] :
    ∃ sn, x.toSciNumber o = some sn ∧ x.toVal = some ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal) ∧
      ((sn.value : ℝ) : EReal)
        = (RoundingTarget.round (precisionSet o.base.toNat p) o.mode (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)).val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sn, hsn, hval⟩ := AzRat.toSciNumber_value_precision q o hv p hp
  exact ⟨sn, by rw [toSciNumber_eq x q hq, hsn], toVal_of_toAzRat? x q hq, hval⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.one_ne_bot
statement: theorem one_ne_bot : (1 : EReal) ≠ ⊥
proof: := by rw [← EReal.coe_one]; exact EReal.coe_ne_bot 1

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseFloatP1Finite_eq
statement:
theorem logBaseFloatP1Finite_eq (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m)
    (hgt : -1 < finiteVal s e m) (eb : AzInt) {qb : ℕ} {mb : AzNat} (hvb : FiniteValid qb mb)
    (hb1 : finiteVal true eb mb ≠ 1) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    logBaseFloatP1Finite s e hv hgt eb hvb hb1 p mode
      = roundVal p mode
          (some ((Real.log (1 + finiteVal s e m) / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb) : ℝ) :
            EReal))
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBaseFloatP1Finite
  split
  · rename_i r hx
    rw [ofAzRatRound_eq_roundVal, logBaseFloatP1_exact_value s e hv hgt eb hvb hb1 r hx]
  · rename_i hx
    have hirr := irrational_logBaseFloatP1_of_none s e hv hgt eb hvb hb1 hx
    exact zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode _ _ _ (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
      (fun w hw => by
        obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
          logBaseFloatP1Approx_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega)
            (toVal_finite s e q m hv) hgt eb hvb hb1 hirr
        exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩) _

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseFloatP1Pos_eq
statement:
theorem logBaseFloatP1Pos_eq (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m)
    (hgt : -1 < finiteVal s e m) (b : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    logBaseFloatP1Pos s e hv hgt b p mode
      = roundVal p mode
          (b.toVal.bind fun bv => Spec.logBaseFloat ((1 + finiteVal s e m : ℝ) : EReal) bv)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : 0 < 1 + finiteVal s e m := by linarith
  have hx1 : 1 + finiteVal s e m ≠ 1 := fun h => finiteVal_ne_zero s e hv (by linarith)
  cases b with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity sb =>
    cases sb
    · simp only [logBaseFloatP1Pos, toVal_infinity, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
        Option.bind_some, Spec.logBaseFloat_neg_right _ EReal.bot_lt_zero, roundVal_none]
    · simp only [logBaseFloatP1Pos, toVal_infinity, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some,
        Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_top hx, roundVal_zero]
  | zero =>
    simp only [logBaseFloatP1Pos, toVal_zero, Option.bind_some, Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_zero hx,
      roundVal_zero]
  | finite sb eb qb mb hvb =>
    cases sb with
    | false =>
      simp only [logBaseFloatP1Pos, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      rw [finiteVal_false, Spec.logBaseFloat_neg_right _
        (EReal.coe_neg'.mpr (neg_neg_iff_pos.mpr (finiteVal_true_pos eb hvb))), roundVal_none]
    | true =>
      have hb := finiteVal_true_pos eb hvb
      simp only [logBaseFloatP1Pos, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      split_ifs with hb1 hp
      · 
        rw [finiteVal_eq_one_of_eqIEEE eb hvb hb1, EReal.coe_one, Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_one hx,
          ite_eq_right hx1]
        cases s with
        | true =>
          rw [ite_eq_left (by linarith [finiteVal_true_pos e hv])]
          exact (roundVal_inf p mode true).symm
        | false =>
          have := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
          rw [finiteVal_false] at hgt ⊢
          rw [ite_eq_right (by push Not; linarith)]
          exact (roundVal_inf p mode false).symm
      · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
      · have hbne := finiteVal_ne_one_of_not_eqIEEE eb hvb hb1
        rw [Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_coe hx hb hbne]
        exact logBaseFloatP1Finite_eq s e hv hgt eb hvb hbne p mode

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseFloatP1PrecRound_eq_liftVal₂
statement:
theorem logBaseFloatP1PrecRound_eq_liftVal₂ (x b : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    logBaseFloatP1PrecRound x b p mode
      = liftVal₂ (fun a bv => Spec.logBaseFloat (a + 1) bv) x b p mode
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity sx =>
    cases sx with
    | false =>
      unfold liftVal₂
      simp only [logBaseFloatP1PrecRound, toVal_infinity, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
        Option.bind_some, EReal.bot_add]
      rw [bind_none_of_forall (Spec.logBaseFloat_neg_left EReal.bot_lt_zero), roundVal_none]
    | true =>
      simp only [logBaseFloatP1PrecRound]
      rw [logBaseFloatPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂]
      unfold liftVal₂
      simp only [toVal_infinity, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some, EReal.top_add_of_ne_bot one_ne_bot]
  | zero =>
    simp only [logBaseFloatP1PrecRound]
    rw [logBaseFloatPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂]
    unfold liftVal₂
    simp only [toVal_zero, toVal_one', Option.bind_some, zero_add, EReal.coe_one]
  | finite sx ex qx mx hvx =>
    cases sx with
    | true =>
      unfold liftVal₂
      simp only [logBaseFloatP1PrecRound, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      rw [logBaseFloatP1Pos_eq, ← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, add_comm (finiteVal true ex mx) 1]
    | false =>
      simp only [logBaseFloatP1PrecRound]
      split_ifs with hneg heq
      · 
        rw [logBaseFloatPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂]
        unfold liftVal₂
        obtain ⟨v, hx, h1⟩ := (eqIEEE_iff _ _).mp heq
        rw [toVal_finite] at hx
        rw [toVal_neg_one, ← hx, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at h1
        simp only [toVal_zero, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
        rw [← h1, ← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, neg_add_cancel, EReal.coe_zero]
      · 
        unfold liftVal₂
        have hle := finiteVal_false_le_neg_one ex hvx hneg
        have hne : finiteVal false ex mx ≠ -1 := fun h => heq ((eqIEEE_iff _ _).mpr
          ⟨((-1 : ℝ) : EReal), by rw [toVal_finite, h], toVal_neg_one⟩)
        have hlt : finiteVal false ex mx + 1 < 0 := by
          rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle with h | h
          · linarith
          · exact absurd h hne
        simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
        rw [← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add,
          bind_none_of_forall (Spec.logBaseFloat_neg_left (EReal.coe_neg'.mpr hlt)), roundVal_none]
      · unfold liftVal₂
        simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
        rw [logBaseFloatP1Pos_eq, ← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add,
          add_comm (finiteVal false ex mx) 1]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2P1_finite_eq
statement:
theorem log2P1_finite_eq (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ}
    {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) (hgt : -1 < finiteVal s e m) :
    (match h : onePlusPow2Exponent? (finite s e q m hv) (p + zivGuardBits + leadingZeroBits e)
        with
      | some k => setPrecRound (ofAzInt k) p mode
      | none =>
        zivLoopCertified (log2P1Approx (finite s e q m hv)) p mode
          (p + zivGuardBits + leadingZeroBits e)
          (log2P1Approx_isSome_exists p mode (toVal_finite s e q m hv) hgt
            (irrational_logb_two_one_add_of_none (toVal_finite s e q m hv)
              (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega) (by linarith) h)
            _ (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)))
      = roundVal p mode (some ((Real.logb 2 (1 + finiteVal s e m) : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < 1 + finiteVal s e m := by linarith
  have hw : NeZero (p + zivGuardBits + leadingZeroBits e) := ⟨by unfold zivGuardBits; omega⟩
  split
  · rename_i k h
    rw [setPrecRound_eq_roundVal (toVal_ofAzInt k),
      onePlusPow2Exponent?_some (toVal_finite s e q m hv) _ h, logb_two_zpow]
  · rename_i h
    have hirr := irrational_logb_two_one_add_of_none (toVal_finite s e q m hv)
      (w := p + zivGuardBits + leadingZeroBits e) (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega) hpos h
    exact zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode _ (Real.logb 2 (1 + finiteVal s e m)) _
      (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
      (fun w hw => by
        obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
          log2P1Approx_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega)
            (toVal_finite s e q m hv) hgt hirr
        exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩) _

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2P1PrecRound_eq_liftVal
statement:
theorem log2P1PrecRound_eq_liftVal (x : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    log2P1PrecRound x p mode = liftVal (fun a => Spec.log2 (a + 1)) x p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold liftVal
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity s =>
    cases s
    · simp only [log2P1PrecRound, toVal_infinity, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
        Option.bind_some, EReal.bot_add, Spec.log2_bot, roundVal_none]
    · simp only [log2P1PrecRound, toVal_infinity, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some]
      rw [← EReal.coe_one, EReal.top_add_coe, Spec.log2_top, roundVal_top]
  | zero =>
    simp only [log2P1PrecRound, toVal_zero, Option.bind_some]
    rw [zero_add, ← EReal.coe_one, Spec.log2_coe _ one_pos, Real.logb_one, EReal.coe_zero,
      roundVal_zero]
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    cases s with
    | true =>
      have hpos := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
      simp only [log2P1PrecRound, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      split_ifs with hp
      · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
      rw [← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, Spec.log2_coe _ (by linarith),
        add_comm (finiteVal true e m) 1]
      exact log2P1_finite_eq p mode true e hv (by linarith)
    | false =>
      simp only [log2P1PrecRound, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      split_ifs with hneg heq hp
      · obtain ⟨v, hx, h1⟩ := (eqIEEE_iff _ _).mp heq
        rw [toVal_finite] at hx
        rw [toVal_neg_one, ← hx, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at h1
        rw [← h1, ← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, neg_add_cancel, EReal.coe_zero,
          Spec.log2_zero, roundVal_bot]
      · have hle := finiteVal_false_le_neg_one e hv hneg
        have hne : finiteVal false e m ≠ -1 := fun h => heq ((eqIEEE_iff _ _).mpr
          ⟨((-1 : ℝ) : EReal), by rw [toVal_finite, h], toVal_neg_one⟩)
        have hlt : finiteVal false e m + 1 < 0 := by
          rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle with h | h
          · linarith
          · exact absurd h hne
        rw [← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, Spec.log2_coe_neg _ hlt, roundVal_none]
      · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
      · have hgt := finiteVal_false_gt_neg_one e hv hneg
        rw [← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, Spec.log2_coe _ (by linarith),
          add_comm (finiteVal false e m) 1]
        exact log2P1_finite_eq p mode false e hv hgt

name: Azurite.AzFloat.FloorOf.ge
statement: theorem FloorOf.ge {w : ℕ} {x r : ℝ} (h : FloorOf w x r) : x ≤ r + 2 * x * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w

name: Azurite.AzFloat.CeilOf.le

name: Azurite.AzFloat.FloorOf.ge_of_le
statement:
theorem FloorOf.ge_of_le {w : ℕ} {x r B : ℝ} (h : FloorOf w x r) (hB : x ≤ B) :
    x ≤ r + 2 * B * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:= by
  have := h.ge
  have h2 : 2 * x * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 2 * B * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
    gcongr
  linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.CeilOf.le_of_le
statement:
theorem CeilOf.le_of_le {w : ℕ} {x r B : ℝ} (h : CeilOf w x r) (hB : x ≤ B) :
    r ≤ x + 2 * B * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:= by
  have := h.le
  have h2 : 2 * x * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 2 * B * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
    gcongr
  linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.floor_data
statement:
theorem floor_data (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    ∃ yv εv : ℝ, (roundVal w .Floor (some (x : EReal))).1.toVal = some (yv : EReal) ∧
      FloorOf w x yv ∧ x ≤ yv + εv ∧ 0 ≤ εv ∧ εv ≤ 2 * x * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ∧
      ((yv + εv : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ floatSet w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨yv, εv, hy, -, hyx, hxy, -, hε0, hεeq, hmem⟩ := truncError_spec w x
  obtain ⟨v, hv, -, hv0⟩ := roundVal_floor_spec w x
  have hvy : v = yv := by
    have := hv.symm.trans hy
    exact EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp (Option.some_injective _ this)
  subst hvy
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ v := hv0 hx
  have hεle : εv ≤ 2 * x * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
    rcases eq_or_ne εv 0 with h0 | h0
    · rw [h0]; positivity
    · obtain ⟨e, he, he1, -⟩ := hεeq h0
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hy0] at he1
      have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ (e - (w : ℤ)) = 2 ^ (e - 1) * (2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w) := by
        rw [one_div_pow, one_div, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_neg, ← zpow_one_add₀ (by norm_num),
          ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
        congr 1; ring
      rw [he, hpow]
      have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by positivity
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (e - 1) * (2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w) ≤ v * (2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he1 h2
        _ ≤ x * (2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hyx h2
        _ = 2 * x * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by ring
  exact ⟨v, εv, hy, ⟨hy0, hyx, by linarith⟩, hxy, hε0, hεle, hmem⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_floor_err
statement:
theorem roundVal_floor_err (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, (roundVal w .Floor (some (x : EReal))).1.toVal = some (r : EReal) ∧ FloorOf w x r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨yv, -, hy, hf, -⟩ := floor_data w hx
  exact ⟨yv, hy, hf⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_ceiling_err
statement:
theorem roundVal_ceiling_err (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, (roundVal w .Ceiling (some (x : EReal))).1.toVal = some (r : EReal) ∧
      CeilOf w x r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨yv, εv, -, hf, hxy, -, hεle, hmem⟩ := floor_data w hx
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, ((v : ℝ) : EReal) = (roundCeiling (floatSet w) x).val := by
    rw [val_roundCeiling_floatSet]; exact precisionSet_exists_real _
  refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [(roundVal_coe w .Ceiling x).1]; exact congrArg some hv.symm
  · have := (isLeast_roundCeiling (floatSet w) x).1.2
    rw [← hv] at this
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp this
  · have := (isLeast_roundCeiling (floatSet w) x).2 ⟨hmem, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hxy⟩
    rw [← hv] at this
    have h1 := EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp this
    linarith [hf.le]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.sub_coe_coe

name: Azurite.AzFloat.addFloor_err

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sqrtFloor_err
statement:
theorem sqrtFloor_err (hu : u.toVal = some (uv : EReal)) (h0 : 0 ≤ uv) (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∃ r : ℝ, (sqrtPrecRound u w .Floor).1.toVal = some (r : EReal) ∧
      FloorOf w (Real.sqrt uv) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [sqrtPrecRound_eq_liftVal, liftVal, hu, Option.bind_some, Spec.sqrt_coe uv h0]
  exact roundVal_floor_err w (Real.sqrt_nonneg uv)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_sign_of_isNegative
statement:
theorem toVal_sign_of_isNegative {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal)) :
    (x.isNegative = true → xv < 0) ∧ (x.isNegative = false → 0 ≤ xv)
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nan => simp at hx
  | infinity s => cases s <;> simp at hx
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨fun h => absurd h (by decide), fun _ => ?_⟩
    simp only [toVal_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hx
    have : xv = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hx.symm
    rw [this]
  | finite s e q m h =>
    rw [toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at hx
    subst hx
    have hneg : (finite s e q m h).isNegative = !s := rfl
    rw [hneg]
    cases s with
    | true =>
      refine ⟨fun h' => absurd h' (by decide), fun _ => (finiteVal_true_pos e h).le⟩
    | false =>
      refine ⟨fun _ => ?_, fun h' => absurd h' (by decide)⟩
      rw [finiteVal_false]
      exact neg_neg_of_pos (finiteVal_true_pos e h)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.val_roundFloor_neg
statement:
theorem val_roundFloor_neg (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] (x : ℝ) :
    (roundFloor (floatSet w) (-x)).val = -(roundCeiling (floatSet w) x).val
proof:
:= by
  apply (isGreatest_roundFloor (floatSet w) (-x)).unique
  constructor
  · refine ⟨floatSet_neg_mem w (isLeast_roundCeiling (floatSet w) x).1.1, ?_⟩
    have := (isLeast_roundCeiling (floatSet w) x).1.2
    rw [EReal.coe_neg]
    exact EReal.neg_le_neg_iff.mpr this
  · rintro s ⟨hs, hsx⟩
    have h1 : -s ∈ floatSet w := floatSet_neg_mem w hs
    rw [EReal.coe_neg] at hsx
    have h2 : (x : EReal) ≤ -s := EReal.le_neg_of_le_neg hsx
    exact EReal.le_neg_of_le_neg ((isLeast_roundCeiling (floatSet w) x).2 ⟨h1, h2⟩)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_floor_abs
statement:
theorem roundVal_floor_abs (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] (x : ℝ) :
    ∃ v : ℝ, (roundVal w .Floor (some (x : EReal))).1.toVal = some (v : EReal) ∧ v ≤ x ∧
      x ≤ v + 2 * |x| * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt 0 x with hx | hx
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, hf⟩ := roundVal_floor_err w hx
    exact ⟨v, hv, hf.le, by rw [abs_of_nonneg hx]; exact hf.ge⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hcf⟩ := roundVal_ceiling_err w (neg_nonneg.mpr hx.le)
    refine ⟨-c, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [(roundVal_coe w .Floor x).1]
      have e : (round (floatSet w) .Floor x).val = (roundFloor (floatSet w) x).val := rfl
      have e2 : (round (floatSet w) .Ceiling (-x)).val = (roundCeiling (floatSet w) (-x)).val :=
        rfl
      rw [(roundVal_coe w .Ceiling (-x)).1, Option.some.injEq, e2] at hc
      have := val_roundFloor_neg w (-x)
      rw [neg_neg] at this
      rw [e, this, hc, EReal.coe_neg]
    · linarith [hcf.ge]
    · rw [abs_of_neg hx]; linarith [hcf.le]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_ceiling_abs
statement:
theorem roundVal_ceiling_abs (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] (x : ℝ) :
    ∃ v : ℝ, (roundVal w .Ceiling (some (x : EReal))).1.toVal = some (v : EReal) ∧ x ≤ v ∧
      v ≤ x + 2 * |x| * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt 0 x with hx | hx
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, hc⟩ := roundVal_ceiling_err w hx
    exact ⟨v, hv, hc.ge, by rw [abs_of_nonneg hx]; exact hc.le⟩
  · obtain ⟨f, hf, hff⟩ := roundVal_floor_err w (neg_nonneg.mpr hx.le)
    refine ⟨-f, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [(roundVal_coe w .Ceiling x).1]
      have e : (round (floatSet w) .Ceiling x).val = (roundCeiling (floatSet w) x).val := rfl
      have e2 : (round (floatSet w) .Floor (-x)).val = (roundFloor (floatSet w) (-x)).val := rfl
      rw [(roundVal_coe w .Floor (-x)).1, Option.some.injEq, e2] at hf
      have := val_roundFloor_neg w x
      rw [hf] at this
      have h2 : (roundCeiling (floatSet w) x).val = -((f : ℝ) : EReal) := by
        rw [this, neg_neg]
      rw [e, h2, EReal.coe_neg]
    · linarith [hff.le]
    · rw [abs_of_neg hx]; linarith [hff.ge]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.subFloor_abs
statement:

    ∃ r : ℝ, (subPrecRound u v w .Floor).1.toVal = some (r : EReal) ∧ r ≤ uv - vv ∧

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2RatPrecRound_eq
statement:
theorem log2RatPrecRound_eq (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    log2RatPrecRound q p mode = roundVal p mode (Spec.log2 ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  unfold log2RatPrecRound
  split_ifs with h0 hs hp
  · rw [(AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr h0]
    simp only [EReal.coe_zero, Spec.log2_zero, roundVal_bot]
  · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
  · have hq := toRat_pos_of_sign q hs h0
    have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
    split
    · rename_i k hk
      obtain ⟨h2, rfl⟩ := AzRat.checkedLogBase2_eq_some q k hk
      rw [setPrecRound_eq_roundVal (toVal_ofAzInt _), Spec.log2_coe _ hqr,
        AzRat.toRat_of_isPowerOfTwo q h2, logb_two_zpow]
    · rename_i hk
      have h2 := AzRat.isPowerOfTwo_eq_false_of_checkedLogBase2_eq_none q hk
      rw [Spec.log2_coe _ hqr]
      exact zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode _ (Real.logb 2 (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)) _
        (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
        (fun w hw => by
          obtain ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
            log2RatApprox_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega) q hq h2
          exact ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩) _
  · have hneg := toRat_neg_of_sign q (by simpa using hs) h0
    rw [Spec.log2_coe_neg _ hneg, roundVal_none]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_true_le
statement:
theorem finiteVal_true_le (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) :
    finiteVal true e m + (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - m.size) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ e.toInt
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteVal_true_eq]
  have hhi : m.toNat + 1 ≤ 2 ^ m.size := by
    have : m.toNat < 2 ^ m.size := by rw [← Nat.size_le, AzNat.size_toNat]
    omega
  have hhi' : (m.toNat : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m.size := by exact_mod_cast hhi
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - m.size) := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  calc (m.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ (e.toInt - m.size) + 2 ^ (e.toInt - m.size)
      = ((m.toNat : ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ (e.toInt - m.size) := by ring
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m.size * 2 ^ (e.toInt - m.size) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hhi' h2.le
    _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ e.toInt := by
        rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]; congr 1; ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_far
statement:
theorem roundVal_far (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (s add : Bool) (eb : AzInt)
    (nb : AzNat) (hnb : nb ≠ 0) (T : ℕ) (hT : nb.size ≤ T) (hTp : p ≤ T) (C : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 < C)
    (hC : C < (2 : ℝ) ^ (eb.toInt - T - 2)) :
    roundVal p mode (some (((if s then 1 else -1) *
        (finiteVal true eb nb + (if add then C else -C)) : ℝ) : EReal))
      = roundVal p mode (some (((if s then 1 else -1) *
        (finiteVal true eb nb + (if add then 1 else -1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (eb.toInt - T - 3)) : ℝ)
          : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  set B := finiteVal true eb nb with hB
  set j : ℤ := eb.toInt - T - 2 with hj
  have h2j : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ j := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hhalf : (2 : ℝ) ^ (eb.toInt - T - 3) = 2 ^ j / 2 := by
    rw [hj, show eb.toInt - T - 3 = (eb.toInt - T - 2) - 1 by ring, zpow_sub_one₀ (by norm_num)]
    ring
  
  set K : ℤ := (nb.toNat : ℤ) * 2 ^ (T - nb.size + 2) with hK
  have hBK : B = (K : ℝ) * 2 ^ j := by
    rw [hB, finiteVal_true_eq, hK, hj]
    push_cast
    rw [mul_assoc, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
    congr 2
    push_cast
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hT]
    ring
  have hK4 : 4 ≤ K := by
    rw [hK]
    have h1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ nb.toNat := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hnb)
    have h2 : (4 : ℤ) ≤ 2 ^ (T - nb.size + 2) := by
      calc (4 : ℤ) = 2 ^ 2 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ 2 ^ (T - nb.size + 2) := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
    nlinarith
  
  have hBlo : (2 : ℝ) ^ (eb.toInt - 1) ≤ B := by
    have := (abs_finiteVal_bounds' true eb nb hnb).1
    rwa [abs_of_pos (finiteVal_true_pos' eb nb hnb)] at this
  have hjlt : (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ 2 ^ (eb.toInt - 2) := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hlog_lb : ∀ z : ℝ, (2 : ℝ) ^ (eb.toInt - 2) ≤ z → eb.toInt - 2 ≤ Int.log 2 z := fun z hz =>
    (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log (b := 2) (by norm_num) (lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hz)).mp
      (by simpa using hz)
  
  have cell_of : ∀ (k : ℤ) (L z : ℝ), (k : ℝ) * 2 ^ j = L → L < z → z < L + 2 ^ j →
      (k : ℝ) * 2 ^ j < z ∧ z < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ j := by
    intro k L z hk h1 h2
    rw [add_mul, one_mul, hk]
    exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have hKm : (((K - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ)) * 2 ^ j = B - 2 ^ j := by push_cast; rw [hBK]; ring
  have hKn : (((-(K + 1) : ℤ) : ℝ)) * 2 ^ j = -(B + 2 ^ j) := by push_cast; rw [hBK]; ring
  have hKn' : (((-K : ℤ) : ℝ)) * 2 ^ j = -B := by push_cast; rw [hBK]; ring
