name: Azurite.AzFloat.productSign_cons
statement:
theorem productSign_cons (x : AzFloat) (xs : List AzFloat) :
    productSign (x :: xs) = ((!x.isNegative) == productSign xs)
proof:
:= by
  unfold productSign
  rw [List.countP_cons]
  cases x.isNegative <;> cases h : decide (List.countP isNegative xs % 2 = 0) <;>
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at h <;> simp <;> omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.decide_pos_finiteVal_of_valid
statement:
theorem decide_pos_finiteVal_of_valid (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat}
    (hv : FiniteValid q m) : decide (0 < finiteVal s e m) = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteVal_eq_core s e hv, decide_pos_finiteVal s e _ (coreSignificand_ne_zero hv)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.decide_pos_fval
statement:
theorem decide_pos_fval {x : AzFloat} (hx : x.isNormal = true) :
    decide (0 < fval x) = !x.isNegative
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    show decide (0 < finiteVal s e m) = !(!s)
    rw [Bool.not_not, decide_pos_finiteVal_of_valid s e hv]
  | _ => simp [isNormal] at hx

name: Azurite.AzFloat.fval_ne_zero
statement: theorem fval_ne_zero {x : AzFloat} (hx : x.isNormal = true) : fval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | finite s e q m hv => exact finiteVal_ne_zero_of_valid s e hv
  | _ => simp [isNormal] at hx

name: Azurite.AzFloat.realProd_spec
statement:
theorem realProd_spec (xs : List AzFloat) (h : ∀ x ∈ xs, x.isNormal = true) :
    realProd xs ≠ 0 ∧ decide (0 < realProd xs) = productSign xs
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [productSign_nil]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx := h x (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    obtain ⟨hne, hsign⟩ := ih (fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons_of_mem x hy))
    rw [realProd_cons, productSign_cons, ← hsign, ← decide_pos_fval hx]
    refine ⟨mul_ne_zero (fval_ne_zero hx) hne, ?_⟩
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (fval_ne_zero hx) with h1 | h1 <;>
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h2 | h2
    · rw [decide_eq_true (mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg h1 h2), decide_eq_false (not_lt.mpr h1.le),
        decide_eq_false (not_lt.mpr h2.le)]; rfl
    · rw [decide_eq_false (not_lt.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg h1.le h2.le)),
        decide_eq_false (not_lt.mpr h1.le), decide_eq_true h2]; rfl
    · rw [decide_eq_false (not_lt.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos h1.le h2.le)),
        decide_eq_true h1, decide_eq_false (not_lt.mpr h2.le)]; rfl
    · rw [decide_eq_true (mul_pos h1 h2), decide_eq_true h1, decide_eq_true h2]; rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.product_eq
statement:
theorem Spec.product_eq (xs : List AzFloat) :
    Spec.product xs =
      if xs.any isNaN = true then none
      else if xs.any isZero = true ∧ xs.any isInfinite = true then none
      else if xs.any isInfinite = true then some (if productSign xs then ⊤ else ⊥)
      else if xs.any isZero = true then some 0
      else some ((realProd xs : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [Spec.product]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [Spec.product, List.foldr_cons, ← Spec.product, ih]
    simp only [List.any_cons, realProd_cons, productSign_cons]
    by_cases hN : xs.any isNaN = true
    · cases x <;> simp [hN]
    have hN' : xs.any isNaN = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hN
    by_cases hI : xs.any isInfinite = true
    · by_cases hZ : xs.any isZero = true
      · cases x <;> simp [hN', hI, hZ]
      · have hZ' : xs.any isZero = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hZ
        cases x with
        | nan => simp
        | infinity s => simp [hN', hI, hZ', Spec.mul_inf_inf]
        | zero => simp [hN', hI, hZ', Spec.mul_zero_inf]
        | finite s e q m hv =>
          simp only [isNaN_finite, isInfinite_finite, isZero_finite, isNegative_finite, hN', hI,
            hZ', Bool.false_eq_true, false_and, Bool.not_not, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some,
            ↓reduceIte]
          rw [Spec.mul_coe_inf _ (finiteVal_ne_zero_of_valid s e hv) _,
            decide_pos_finiteVal_of_valid s e hv]
          simp
    · have hI' : xs.any isInfinite = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hI
      by_cases hZ : xs.any isZero = true
      · cases x with
        | nan => simp
        | infinity s => simp [hN', hI', hZ, Spec.mul_inf_zero]
        | zero => simp [hN', hI', hZ, Spec.mul_zero_zero]
        | finite s e q m hv => simp [hN', hI', hZ, Spec.mul_coe_zero]
      · have hZ' : xs.any isZero = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hZ
        obtain ⟨hne, hsign⟩ := realProd_spec xs (isNormal_of_any_flags hN hI hZ)
        cases x with
        | nan => simp
        | infinity s =>
          simp only [isNaN_infinity, isInfinite_infinity, isZero_infinity, isNegative_infinity,
            hN', hI', hZ', Bool.false_eq_true, and_false, Bool.not_not, toVal_infinity,
            Option.bind_some, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [Spec.mul_inf_coe s _ hne, hsign]
          simp
        | zero => simp [hN', hI', hZ', Spec.mul_zero_coe]
        | finite s e q m hv =>
          simp only [isNaN_finite, isInfinite_finite, isZero_finite, hN', hI', hZ',
            Bool.false_eq_true, and_false, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some, ↓reduceIte,
            Spec.mul_coe_coe]
          rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.realProd_eq
statement:
theorem realProd_eq (xs : List AzFloat) (h : ∀ x ∈ xs, x.isNormal = true) :
    (if productSign xs then (1 : ℝ) else -1)
        * (((AzNat.product ((xs.filterMap coreParts).map fun t => t.2.1)).toNat : ℕ) : ℝ)
        * (2 : ℝ) ^ (AzInt.sum ((xs.filterMap coreParts).map fun t => t.2.2)).toInt
      = realProd xs
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [productSign_nil, AzNat.toNat_product, AzInt.toInt_sum]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx := h x (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have ih := ih (fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons_of_mem x hy))
    cases x with
    | finite s e q m hv =>
      rw [realProd_cons, ← ih, productSign_cons, List.filterMap_cons_some
        (show coreParts (finite s e q m hv)
          = some (s, coreSignificand q m, e - (AzNat.ofNat q).toAzInt) from rfl),
        List.map_cons, List.map_cons, AzNat.toNat_product, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons,
        ← AzNat.toNat_product, AzInt.toInt_sum, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ← AzInt.toInt_sum]
      show _ = finiteVal s e m * _
      rw [finiteVal_eq_core s e hv, finiteVal_sign s e, finiteVal_true_eq, size_coreSignificand hv,
        AzInt.toInt_sub, AzNat.toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
      simp only [isNegative, Bool.not_not]
      push_cast
      rw [← signed_mul]
      ring
    | _ => simp [isNormal] at hx

name: Azurite.AzFloat.productPrecRound_eq
statement:
theorem productPrecRound_eq (xs : List AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    productPrecRound xs p mode = roundVal p mode (Spec.product xs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Spec.product_eq]
  unfold productPrecRound
  dsimp only
  by_cases hN : xs.any isNaN = true
  · simp only [hN, ↓reduceIte]
    rfl
  have hN' : xs.any isNaN = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hN
  by_cases hI : xs.any isInfinite = true <;> by_cases hZ : xs.any isZero = true
  · simp only [hN', hI, hZ, Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.and_self, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
    rfl
  · have hZ' : xs.any isZero = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hZ
    simp only [hN', hI, hZ', Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.false_and, false_and, ↓reduceIte]
    exact (roundVal_of_toVal p mode (infinity _) _ (Or.inr rfl) rfl).symm
  · have hI' : xs.any isInfinite = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hI
    simp only [hN', hI', hZ, Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.and_false, and_false, ↓reduceIte]
    exact (roundVal_of_toVal p mode zero 0 (Or.inr rfl) rfl).symm
  · have hI' : xs.any isInfinite = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hI
    have hZ' : xs.any isZero = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hZ
    simp only [hN', hI', hZ', Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.and_self, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [roundScaled_eq_roundVal, realProd_eq xs (isNormal_of_any_flags hN hI hZ)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_productFloat64
statement:
theorem toVal_productFloat64 (xs : List Float) :
    (productFloat64 xs).toModel.unpack.toVal
      = roundBinary64Val ((xs.map fun x => x.toModel.unpack.toVal).foldr
          (fun a acc => a.bind fun a => acc.bind fun b => Spec.mul a b) (some 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold productFloat64
  rw [toVal_emulateList productPrecRound Spec.product
    (fun xs => productPrecRound_eq xs 53 .Nearest)]
  have hprod : ∀ xs : List Float,
      xs.foldr (fun x acc => (ofFloat64 x).toVal.bind fun a => acc.bind fun b => Spec.mul a b)
          (some 1)
        = xs.foldr (fun x acc => x.toModel.unpack.toVal.bind fun a =>
            acc.bind fun b => Spec.mul a b) (some 1) := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons x xs ih => rw [List.foldr_cons, List.foldr_cons, ih, toVal_ofFloat64]
  unfold Spec.product
  rw [List.foldr_map, List.foldr_map, hprod]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toNat_bounds_of_valid
statement:
theorem toNat_bounds_of_valid {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid p m) :
    2 ^ (alignedBits p - 1) ≤ m.toNat ∧ m.toNat < 2 ^ alignedBits p
proof:
:= by
  have hs := hv.size_eq
  have hB : 0 < alignedBits p := lt_of_lt_of_le hv.pos (le_alignedBits p)
  rw [← AzNat.size_toNat] at hs
  constructor
  · rw [← Nat.lt_size, hs]; omega
  · rw [← Nat.size_le, hs]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.floatSet_eq
statement: theorem floatSet_eq (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] : floatSet p = precisionSet 2 p ∪ {⊤, ⊥}
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  ext v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hprec, hval⟩
    cases x with
    | nan => simp at hval
    | infinity s =>
      simp only [toVal_infinity, Option.some.injEq] at hval
      cases s <;> simp [← hval]
    | zero =>
      simp only [toVal_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hval
      exact Or.inl (Or.inl hval.symm)
    | finite s e p' m hv =>
      simp only [precision?, Option.some.injEq, reduceCtorEq, or_false] at hprec
      rw [hprec] at hv
      simp only [toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq] at hval
      rw [← hval]
      refine Or.inl (Or.inr ?_)
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hv.dvd
      obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := toNat_bounds_of_valid hv
      have hB := le_alignedBits p
      have hcpos : c ≠ 0 := by
        rintro rfl
        rw [mul_zero] at hc
        have : 0 < m.toNat := lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.two_pow_pos _) hlo
        omega
      have hclt : c < 2 ^ p := by
        have h1 : 2 ^ (alignedBits p - p) * c < 2 ^ alignedBits p := hc ▸ hhi
        have h2 : (2 : ℕ) ^ alignedBits p = 2 ^ (alignedBits p - p) * 2 ^ p := by
          rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
        rw [h2] at h1
        exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h1 (Nat.zero_le _)
      refine ⟨if s then (c : ℤ) else -(c : ℤ), e.toInt - p, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · cases s <;> simp [hcpos]
      · cases s <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, abs_neg, Nat.abs_cast] <;>
          exact_mod_cast hclt
      · unfold finiteVal
        rw [hv.size_eq, hc]
        have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - p)
            = 2 ^ (e.toInt - alignedBits p) * 2 ^ ((alignedBits p - p : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
          rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]; congr 1; rw [Nat.cast_sub hB]; ring
        apply congrArg
        push_cast
        rw [h2, zpow_natCast]
        cases s <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] <;> ring
  · rintro (h | h)
    · rcases h with h0 | ⟨m, k, hm, hlt, hv⟩
      · exact ⟨zero, Or.inr rfl, by rw [toVal_zero, h0]⟩
      · 
        have hsz : (AzNat.ofNat m.natAbs).size ≤ p := by
          rw [AzNat.size_ofNat, Nat.size_le]
          have : (m.natAbs : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ p := by rw [Int.natCast_natAbs]; exact hlt
          exact_mod_cast this
        have hne : AzNat.ofNat m.natAbs ≠ 0 := by
          intro h
          have := congrArg AzNat.toNat h
          rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_zero] at this
          exact hm (Int.natAbs_eq_zero.mp this)
        refine ⟨mkFinite (decide (0 ≤ m)) (AzInt.ofInt (k + (AzNat.ofNat m.natAbs).size)) p
          (AzNat.ofNat m.natAbs), Or.inl (precision?_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hne hsz), ?_⟩
        rw [toVal_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hne, ← hv]
        congr 2
        unfold finiteVal
        rw [AzInt.toInt_ofInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, add_sub_cancel_right]
        congr 1
        rcases le_or_gt 0 m with hm0 | hm0
        · rw [ite_eq_left (decide_eq_true hm0), Nat.cast_natAbs,
            abs_of_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hm0), one_mul]
        · rw [ite_eq_right (by simpa using hm0.not_ge), Nat.cast_natAbs,
            abs_of_neg (by exact_mod_cast hm0)]
          push_cast
          ring
    · rcases h with rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨infinity true, Or.inr rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨infinity false, Or.inr rfl, rfl⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.isLeast_union_top_bot
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨Or.inl h.1.1, h.1.2⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro s ⟨hs | hs, hxs⟩
  · exact h.2 ⟨hs, hxs⟩
  · rcases hs with rfl | rfl
    · exact le_top
    · exact absurd hxs (by simp)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.isGreatest_union_top_bot
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨Or.inl h.1.1, h.1.2⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro s ⟨hs | hs, hsx⟩
  · exact h.2 ⟨hs, hsx⟩
  · rcases hs with rfl | rfl
    · exact absurd hsx (by simp)
    · exact bot_le

name: Azurite.AzFloat.mem_floatSet_of_mem_precisionSet
statement:
theorem mem_floatSet_of_mem_precisionSet (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] {e : EReal}
    (h : e ∈ precisionSet 2 p) : e ∈ floatSet p
proof:
:= by
  rw [floatSet_eq]; exact Or.inl h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.eq_top_or_bot_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem eq_top_or_bot_of_not_mem (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] {e : EReal} (he : e ∈ floatSet p)
    (h : e ∉ precisionSet 2 p) : e = ⊤ ∨ e = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [floatSet_eq] at he
  rcases he with he | he
  · exact absurd he h
  · simpa using he

name: Azurite.AzFloat.top_not_mem_precisionSet
statement: theorem top_not_mem_precisionSet (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] : (⊤ : EReal) ∉ precisionSet 2 p
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := precisionSet_exists_real ⟨⊤, h⟩
  exact EReal.coe_ne_top r hr

name: Azurite.AzFloat.bot_not_mem_precisionSet
statement: theorem bot_not_mem_precisionSet (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] : (⊥ : EReal) ∉ precisionSet 2 p
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := precisionSet_exists_real ⟨⊥, h⟩
  exact EReal.coe_ne_bot r hr

name: Azurite.AzFloat.neg_mem_precisionSet_iff
statement:
theorem neg_mem_precisionSet_iff (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (e : EReal) :
    -e ∈ precisionSet 2 p ↔ e ∈ precisionSet 2 p
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using precisionSet_neg_mem h, precisionSet_neg_mem⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.floatSet_neg_mem
statement: theorem floatSet_neg_mem (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] {e : EReal} (h : e ∈ floatSet p) : -e ∈ floatSet p
proof:
:= by
  rw [floatSet_eq] at h ⊢
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (precisionSet_neg_mem h)
  · rcases h with rfl | rfl <;> simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.val_roundFloor_floatSet
statement:
theorem val_roundFloor_floatSet (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (x : ℝ) :
    (roundFloor (floatSet p) x).val = (roundFloor (precisionSet 2 p) x).val
proof:
:= by
  apply (isGreatest_roundFloor (floatSet p) x).unique
  have := isGreatest_union_top_bot (isGreatest_roundFloor (precisionSet 2 p) x)
  rwa [← floatSet_eq] at this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.val_roundCeiling_floatSet
statement:
theorem val_roundCeiling_floatSet (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (x : ℝ) :
    (roundCeiling (floatSet p) x).val = (roundCeiling (precisionSet 2 p) x).val
proof:
:= by
  apply (isLeast_roundCeiling (floatSet p) x).unique
  have := isLeast_union_top_bot (isLeast_roundCeiling (precisionSet 2 p) x)
  rwa [← floatSet_eq] at this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.val_round_floatSet
statement:
theorem val_round_floatSet (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (x : ℝ) :
    (RoundingTarget.round (floatSet p) mode x).val
      = (RoundingTarget.round (precisionSet 2 p) mode x).val
proof:
:= by
  have hF := val_roundFloor_floatSet p x
  have hC := val_roundCeiling_floatSet p x
  cases mode with
  | Floor => exact hF
  | Ceiling => exact hC
  | Down => unfold RoundingTarget.round; split_ifs <;> assumption
  | Up => unfold RoundingTarget.round; split_ifs <;> assumption
  | Nearest =>
    unfold RoundingTarget.round
    simp only [hF, hC]
    cases h : compare ((x : EReal) - (roundFloor (precisionSet 2 p) x).val)
        ((roundCeiling (precisionSet 2 p) x).val - (x : EReal))
    · exact hF
    · 
      have hFm : (roundFloor (floatSet p) x).val ∈ precisionSet 2 p := by
        rw [hF]; exact (roundFloor (precisionSet 2 p) x).property
      have hCm : (roundCeiling (floatSet p) x).val ∈ precisionSet 2 p := by
        rw [hC]; exact (roundCeiling (precisionSet 2 p) x).property
      show (floatTiebreak p _ _).val = (precTiebreak _ _).val
      unfold floatTiebreak
      rw [dite_eq_left hFm, dite_eq_left hCm]
      have e1 : (⟨(roundFloor (floatSet p) x).val, hFm⟩ : ↥(precisionSet 2 p))
          = roundFloor (precisionSet 2 p) x := Subtype.ext hF
      have e2 : (⟨(roundCeiling (floatSet p) x).val, hCm⟩ : ↥(precisionSet 2 p))
          = roundCeiling (precisionSet 2 p) x := Subtype.ext hC
      show (precTiebreak ⟨(roundFloor (floatSet p) x).val, hFm⟩
        ⟨(roundCeiling (floatSet p) x).val, hCm⟩).val = _
      rw [e1, e2]
    · exact hC

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofEReal_spec
statement:
theorem ofEReal_spec (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (r : ℝ) :
    ((ofEReal p mode r).precision? = some p ∨ (ofEReal p mode r).precision? = none) ∧
      (ofEReal p mode r).toVal = some (RoundingTarget.round (floatSet p) mode r).val
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofEReal
  have hx : ∃ r' : ℝ, (r' : EReal) = (r : EReal) := ⟨r, rfl⟩
  rw [dite_eq_left hx]
  have hr : hx.choose = r := EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp hx.choose_spec
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ :=
    Classical.choose_spec (RoundingTarget.round (floatSet p) mode hx.choose).property
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  rw [h2, hr]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_ofEReal_coe
statement:
theorem toVal_ofEReal_coe (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (r : ℝ) :
    (ofEReal p mode r).toVal = some (RoundingTarget.round (precisionSet 2 p) mode r).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [(ofEReal_spec p mode r).2, val_round_floatSet]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofEReal_top
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofEReal_top (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    ofEReal p mode ⊤ = infinity true
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofEReal
  rw [dite_eq_right (by rintro ⟨r, hr⟩; exact EReal.coe_ne_top r hr), ite_eq_left rfl]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofEReal_bot
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofEReal_bot (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    ofEReal p mode ⊥ = infinity false
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofEReal
  rw [dite_eq_right (by rintro ⟨r, hr⟩; exact EReal.coe_ne_bot r hr), ite_eq_right (by simp)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofVal_none
statement: @[simp] theorem ofVal_none (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) : ofVal p mode none = nan
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofVal_some
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofVal_some (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (x : EReal) :
    ofVal p mode (some x) = ofEReal p mode x
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_pos_iff
statement:
theorem finiteVal_pos_iff (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    0 < finiteVal s e m ↔ s = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteVal
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - m.size) := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hm' : (0 : ℝ) < m.toNat := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hm)
  cases s
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, iff_false, not_lt]
    nlinarith
  · simp only [↓reduceIte, one_mul, iff_true]
    positivity

name: Azurite.AzFloat.abs_finiteVal_bounds
statement:
theorem abs_finiteVal_bounds (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid p m) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - 1) ≤ |finiteVal s e m| ∧ |finiteVal s e m| < (2 : ℝ) ^ e.toInt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := toNat_bounds_of_valid hv
  have hB : 0 < alignedBits p := lt_of_lt_of_le hv.pos (le_alignedBits p)
  have habs : |finiteVal s e m| = (m.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - alignedBits p) := by
    unfold finiteVal
    rw [hv.size_eq]
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - alignedBits p) := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
    cases s <;> simp [abs_mul, abs_of_pos h2]
  rw [habs]
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - alignedBits p) := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  constructor
  · have hlo' : (2 : ℝ) ^ (alignedBits p - 1) ≤ m.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hlo
    calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - 1)
        = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((alignedBits p - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * 2 ^ (e.toInt - alignedBits p) := by
          rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]; congr 1; rw [Nat.cast_sub hB]; ring
      _ ≤ (m.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ (e.toInt - alignedBits p) := by
          rw [zpow_natCast]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlo' h2.le
  · have hhi' : (m.toNat : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ alignedBits p := by exact_mod_cast hhi
    calc (m.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ (e.toInt - alignedBits p)
        < (2 : ℝ) ^ alignedBits p * 2 ^ (e.toInt - alignedBits p) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hhi' h2
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ e.toInt := by
          rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]; congr 1; ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finite_eq_of_finiteVal_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hm₁ : m₁ ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_size_pos (by
    rw [h₁.size_eq]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le h₁.pos (le_alignedBits p))
  have hm₂ : m₂ ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_size_pos (by
    rw [h₂.size_eq]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le h₂.pos (le_alignedBits p))
  have hs : s₁ = s₂ := by
    have := finiteVal_pos_iff s₁ e₁ m₁ hm₁
    rw [h, finiteVal_pos_iff s₂ e₂ m₂ hm₂] at this
    cases s₁ <;> cases s₂ <;> simp_all
  subst hs
  obtain ⟨hlo₁, hhi₁⟩ := abs_finiteVal_bounds s₁ e₁ h₁
  obtain ⟨hlo₂, hhi₂⟩ := abs_finiteVal_bounds s₁ e₂ h₂
  rw [h] at hlo₁ hhi₁
  have he : e₁.toInt = e₂.toInt := by
    by_contra hne
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
    · have : (2 : ℝ) ^ e₁.toInt ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (e₂.toInt - 1) :=
        zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
      linarith
    · have : (2 : ℝ) ^ e₂.toInt ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (e₁.toInt - 1) :=
        zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
      linarith
  have he' : e₁ = e₂ := by
    rw [← AzInt.ofInt_toInt e₁, ← AzInt.ofInt_toInt e₂, he]
  subst he'
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  unfold finiteVal at h
  rw [h₁.size_eq, h₂.size_eq] at h
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (e₁.toInt - alignedBits p) := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hsign : (if s₁ then (1 : ℝ) else -1) ≠ 0 := by cases s₁ <;> simp
  have : (m₁.toNat : ℝ) = m₂.toNat := by
    have h' := mul_right_cancel₀ h2.ne' h
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hsign h'
  exact AzNat.toNat_injective (by exact_mod_cast this)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_injective
statement:
theorem toVal_injective (p : ℕ) {x y : AzFloat} (hx : x.precision? = some p ∨ x.precision? = none)
    (hy : y.precision? = some p ∨ y.precision? = none) (h : x.toVal = y.toVal) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nan =>
    cases y with
    | nan => rfl
    | infinity _ => simp at h
    | zero => simp at h
    | finite _ _ _ _ _ => simp at h
  | infinity s =>
    cases y with
    | nan => simp at h
    | infinity t =>
      simp only [toVal_infinity, Option.some.injEq] at h
      cases s <;> cases t <;> simp_all
    | zero =>
      simp only [toVal_infinity, toVal_zero, Option.some.injEq] at h
      cases s <;> simp at h
    | finite _ _ _ _ _ =>
      simp only [toVal_infinity, toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq] at h
      cases s
      · exact absurd h.symm (EReal.coe_ne_bot _)
      · exact absurd h.symm (EReal.coe_ne_top _)
  | zero =>
    cases y with
    | nan => simp at h
    | infinity t =>
      simp only [toVal_infinity, toVal_zero, Option.some.injEq] at h
      cases t <;> simp at h
    | zero => rfl
    | finite t e q m hv =>
      simp only [toVal_zero, toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq] at h
      have hm : m ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_size_pos (by
        rw [hv.size_eq]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hv.pos (le_alignedBits q))
      have := (abs_finiteVal_bounds t e hv).1
      have h0 : finiteVal t e m = 0 := EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp h.symm
      rw [h0, abs_zero] at this
      have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - 1) := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
      linarith
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    cases y with
    | nan => simp at h
    | infinity t =>
      simp only [toVal_infinity, toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq] at h
      cases t
      · exact absurd h (EReal.coe_ne_bot _)
      · exact absurd h (EReal.coe_ne_top _)
    | zero =>
      simp only [toVal_zero, toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq] at h
      have := (abs_finiteVal_bounds s e hv).1
      have h0 : finiteVal s e m = 0 := EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp h
      rw [h0, abs_zero] at this
      have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - 1) := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
      linarith
    | finite t f q' m' hv' =>
      simp only [precision?, Option.some.injEq, reduceCtorEq, or_false] at hx hy
      subst hx hy
      simp only [toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at h
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := finite_eq_of_finiteVal_eq hv hv' h
      rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.precision?_ofAzRatRound'
statement:
theorem precision?_ofAzRatRound' (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (q : AzRat) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    (ofAzRatRound q p mode).1.precision? = some p ∨
      (ofAzRatRound q p mode).1.precision? = none
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  by_cases h0 : q.num = 0
  · unfold ofAzRatRound
    rw [ite_eq_right hp.ne', ite_eq_left h0]
    exact Or.inr rfl
  · exact Or.inl (precision?_ofAzRatRound q p hp mode h0)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofAzRatRound_eq_ofEReal
statement:
theorem ofAzRatRound_eq_ofEReal (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (q : AzRat) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    (ofAzRatRound q p mode).1 = ofEReal p mode (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  toVal_injective p (precision?_ofAzRatRound' p q mode) (ofEReal_spec p mode _).1
    (by rw [toVal_ofAzRatRound, toVal_ofEReal_coe])

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofVal_toVal
statement:
theorem ofVal_toVal (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (x : AzFloat)
    (hx : x.precision? = some p ∨ x.precision? = none) : ofVal p mode x.toVal = x
proof:
:= by
  cases hv : x.toVal with
  | none =>
    cases x <;> simp at hv
    rfl
  | some v =>
    rw [ofVal_some]
    have hmem : v ∈ floatSet p := ⟨x, hx, hv⟩
    rw [floatSet_eq] at hmem
    rcases hmem with hmem | hmem
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := precisionSet_exists_real ⟨v, hmem⟩
      simp only at hr
      rw [← hr]
      refine toVal_injective p (ofEReal_spec p mode r).1 hx ?_
      rw [toVal_ofEReal_coe, hv, ← hr, val_round_of_mem _ mode (hr ▸ hmem)]
    · rcases hmem with rfl | rfl
      · rw [ofEReal_top]
        cases x <;> simp at hv
        rename_i s
        cases s <;> simp_all
      · rw [ofEReal_bot]
        cases x <;> simp at hv
        rename_i s
        cases s <;> simp_all

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_none
statement:
@[simp] theorem roundVal_none (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    roundVal p mode none = (nan, .eq)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.fst_roundVal
statement:
theorem fst_roundVal (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (v : Option EReal) :
    (roundVal p mode v).1 = ofVal p mode v
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_coe
statement:
theorem roundVal_coe (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (r : ℝ) :
    (roundVal p mode (some (r : EReal))).1.toVal
        = some (RoundingTarget.round (floatSet p) mode r).val ∧
      (roundVal p mode (some (r : EReal))).2
        = compare (RoundingTarget.round (floatSet p) mode r).val (r : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(ofEReal_spec p mode r).2, ?_⟩
  show (match (ofEReal p mode r).toVal, some (r : EReal) with
    | some a, some b => compare a b
    | _, _ => .eq) = _
  rw [(ofEReal_spec p mode r).2]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_of_toVal
statement:
theorem roundVal_of_toVal (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (x : AzFloat) (v : EReal)
    (hx : x.precision? = some p ∨ x.precision? = none) (hv : x.toVal = some v) :
    roundVal p mode (some v) = (x, .eq)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ofVal p mode (some v) = x := by rw [← hv]; exact ofVal_toVal p mode x hx
  unfold roundVal
  simp only [h1, hv, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.liftVal_nan
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftVal_nan (f : EReal → Option EReal) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) : liftVal f nan p mode = (nan, .eq)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.applyReal_coe
statement:
theorem applyReal_coe (f : ℝ → ℝ) (top bot : Option EReal) (r : ℝ) :
    applyReal f top bot r = some ((f r : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold applyReal
  rw [ite_eq_right (EReal.coe_ne_top r), ite_eq_right (EReal.coe_ne_bot r), EReal.toReal_coe]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.lift_coe
statement:
theorem lift_coe (f : ℝ → ℝ) (top bot : Option EReal) (x : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) (r : ℝ) (hx : x.toVal = some (r : EReal)) :
    lift f top bot x p mode = roundVal p mode (some ((f r : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  unfold lift liftVal
  rw [hx, Option.bind_some, applyReal_coe]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.precision?_neg
statement: theorem precision?_neg (x : AzFloat) : (-x).precision? = x.precision?
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.neg_eq_lift
statement:
theorem neg_eq_lift (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (x : AzFloat)
    (hx : x.precision? = some p ∨ x.precision? = none) :
    liftE (fun v => -v) x p mode = (-x, .eq)
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : (-x).precision? = some p ∨ (-x).precision? = none := by rwa [precision?_neg]
  have h : x.toVal.bind (fun v => some (-v)) = (-x).toVal := by
    rw [toVal_neg]
    cases x.toVal <;> rfl
  unfold liftE liftVal
  rw [h]
  cases hv : (-x).toVal with
  | none =>
    cases x <;> simp [toVal_neg] at hv
    rfl
  | some v => exact roundVal_of_toVal p mode (-x) v hx' hv

name: Azurite.AzFloat.piPrecRound_eq_liftVal₀
statement:
theorem piPrecRound_eq_liftVal₀ (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    piPrecRound p mode = liftVal₀ (some ((Real.pi : ℝ) : EReal)) p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold piPrecRound liftVal₀
  split_ifs with hp
  · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
  apply zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode piApprox Real.pi (p + zivGuardBits)
    (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
    piApprox_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega)
  exact ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.maxPowExp_spec
statement:
theorem maxPowExp_spec (b : AzNat) (t : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ maxPowExp b t ∧
      (maxPowExp b t = 1 ∨
        (2 ≤ maxPowExp b t ∧ maxPowExp b t ≤ t ∧ b.isPow (maxPowExp b t) = true)) ∧
      ∀ u, maxPowExp b t < u → u ≤ t → b.isPow u = false
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact ⟨le_rfl, Or.inl rfl, fun u h1 h2 => by simp [maxPowExp] at h1; omega⟩
  | succ t ih =>
    cases t with
    | zero => exact ⟨le_rfl, Or.inl rfl, fun u h1 h2 => by simp [maxPowExp] at h1; omega⟩
    | succ s =>
      unfold maxPowExp
      split_ifs with h
      · refine ⟨by omega, Or.inr ⟨by omega, le_rfl, h⟩, fun u h1 h2 => by omega⟩
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih
        refine ⟨h1, ?_, fun u hu1 hu2 => ?_⟩
        · rcases h2 with h2 | ⟨h2a, h2b, h2c⟩
          · exact Or.inl h2
          · exact Or.inr ⟨h2a, by omega, h2c⟩
        · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u (s + 2) with hu | hu
          · exact h3 u hu1 (by omega)
          · have : u = s + 2 := by omega
            rw [this]; exact Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.maxRootBaseBounded_spec
statement:
theorem maxRootBaseBounded_spec (b : AzNat) (t : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) :
    b.toNat = (maxRootBaseBounded b t).1.toNat ^ (maxRootBaseBounded b t).2 ∧
      1 ≤ (maxRootBaseBounded b t).2 ∧
      2 ≤ (maxRootBaseBounded b t).1.toNat ∧
      ∀ u, (maxRootBaseBounded b t).2 < u → u ≤ t → ¬ ∃ y, y ^ u = b.toNat
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := maxPowExp_spec b t
  unfold maxRootBaseBounded
  simp only []
  set s := maxPowExp b t with hs
  have hmax : ∀ u, s < u → u ≤ t → ¬ ∃ y, y ^ u = b.toNat := by
    intro u hu1 hu2 hy
    have := (AzNat.isPow_eq_true_iff b u (by omega)).mpr hy
    rw [h3 u hu1 hu2] at this
    cases this
  rcases h2 with h2 | ⟨h2a, h2b, h2c⟩
  · rw [ite_eq_left h2, h2, pow_one]
    exact ⟨rfl, le_rfl, hb, by rw [h2] at hmax; exact hmax⟩
  · rw [ite_eq_right (by omega)]
    have hpow : (b.rootInt s).toNat ^ s = b.toNat := by
      unfold AzNat.isPow at h2c
      rw [decide_eq_true_iff] at h2c
      have := congrArg AzNat.toNat h2c
      rwa [AzNat.toNat_pow] at this
    refine ⟨hpow.symm, h1, ?_, hmax⟩
    by_contra hlt
    push Not at hlt
    have : (b.rootInt s).toNat ^ s ≤ 1 := by
      calc (b.rootInt s).toNat ^ s ≤ 1 ^ s := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) s
        _ = 1 := one_pow s
    omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.maxRootBaseBounded_not_pow
statement:
theorem maxRootBaseBounded_not_pow (b : AzNat) (t : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat)
    (hbt : b.toNat < 2 ^ (t + 1)) :
    ∀ u, 2 ≤ u → ¬ ∃ d, (maxRootBaseBounded b t).1.toNat = d ^ u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcs, hs1, hc2, hmax⟩ := maxRootBaseBounded_spec b t hb
  rintro u hu ⟨d, hd⟩
  set c := (maxRootBaseBounded b t).1.toNat with hc
  set s := (maxRootBaseBounded b t).2 with hs
  have hd2 : 2 ≤ d := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have : d ^ u ≤ 1 := by
      calc d ^ u ≤ 1 ^ u := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) u
        _ = 1 := one_pow u
    omega
  have hbd : b.toNat = d ^ (u * s) := by rw [hcs, hd, ← pow_mul]
  have hus : u * s ≤ t := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have : 2 ^ (t + 1) ≤ d ^ (u * s) := by
      calc 2 ^ (t + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (u * s) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
        _ ≤ d ^ (u * s) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hd2 _
    omega
  exact hmax (u * s) (by nlinarith) hus ⟨d, hbd.symm⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.maxRootBase_spec
statement:
theorem maxRootBase_spec (b : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) :
    b.toNat = (maxRootBase b).1.toNat ^ (maxRootBase b).2 ∧ 1 ≤ (maxRootBase b).2 ∧
      2 ≤ (maxRootBase b).1.toNat ∧
      ∀ u, (maxRootBase b).2 < u → u ≤ 63 → ¬ ∃ y, y ^ u = b.toNat
proof:
:=
  maxRootBaseBounded_spec b 63 hb

name: Azurite.AzFloat.maxRootBase_not_pow
statement:
theorem maxRootBase_not_pow (b : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hb64 : b.toNat < 2 ^ 64) :
    ∀ t, 2 ≤ t → ¬ ∃ d, (maxRootBase b).1.toNat = d ^ t
proof:
:=
  maxRootBaseBounded_not_pow b 63 hb (by simpa using hb64)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toRat_eq_of_int_den_one
statement:
theorem toRat_eq_of_int_den_one (q : AzRat) (hs : q.sign = true) (hd : q.den = 1) :
    (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) = q.num.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzRat.toRat_cast_eq, hs, hd]
  simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log_pos_of_two_le
statement: theorem log_pos_of_two_le {n : ℕ} (h : 2 ≤ n) : 0 < Real.log n
proof:
:=
  Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < n))

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseExact?_some
statement:
theorem logBaseExact?_some (x : AzFloat) (b : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (r : AzRat)
    (h : logBaseExact? x b = some r) :
    ∃ v : ℝ, x.toVal = some (v : EReal) ∧ 0 < v ∧
      Real.log v / Real.log b.toNat = (AzRat.toRat r : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcs, hs1, hc2, -⟩ := maxRootBase_spec b hb
  unfold logBaseExact? at h
  rcases hq : x.toAzRat? with _ | q
  · rw [hq] at h; cases h
  · rw [hq] at h
    simp only [] at h
    split_ifs at h with hg
    · obtain ⟨hsg, hd1, hn0⟩ := hg
      rcases hr : AzNat.checkedLogBase (maxRootBase b).1 q.num with _ | e
      · rw [hr] at h; cases h
      · rw [hr, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h
        have hne : q.num.toNat = (maxRootBase b).1.toNat ^ e :=
          (AzNat.checkedLogBase_eq_some_iff _ _ hc2 hn0 e).mp hr
        have hv := toVal_of_toAzRat? x q hq
        rw [toRat_eq_of_int_den_one q hsg hd1] at hv
        have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < q.num.toNat := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hn0)
        refine ⟨_, hv, hnpos, ?_⟩
        rw [← h, AzRat.toRat_ofAzInts, toInt_toAzInt, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat,
          AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
        push_cast
        have hlogc : 0 < Real.log (maxRootBase b).1.toNat := log_pos_of_two_le hc2
        rw [hne, hcs, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]
        field_simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.pow_eq_zpow_of_log_div_log
statement:
theorem pow_eq_zpow_of_log_div_log {v B : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) (hB : 0 < B) (hB1 : B ≠ 1) (r : ℚ)
    (hr : (r : ℝ) = Real.log v / Real.log B) : v ^ r.den = B ^ r.num
proof:
:= by
  have hlogB : Real.log B ≠ 0 := Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one hB hB1
  have hden : (r.den : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast r.den_nz
  have hrq : (r : ℝ) * r.den = r.num := by rw [Rat.cast_def]; field_simp
  have key : (r.den : ℝ) * Real.log v = r.num * Real.log B := by
    rw [← hrq, hr, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hlogB, mul_comm]
  have h1 : v ^ r.den = Real.exp (r.den * Real.log v) := by
    rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log hv]
  have h2 : B ^ r.num = Real.exp (r.num * Real.log B) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_intCast, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hB, mul_comm]
  rw [h1, h2, key]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_eq_odd_mul_zpow
statement:
theorem finiteVal_eq_odd_mul_zpow (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) :
    ∃ (o : ℕ) (j : ℤ), Odd o ∧ finiteVal true e m = (o : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ j
proof:
:= by
  have hc := coreSignificand_ne_zero hv
  obtain ⟨k, o, hodd, hko⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_odd (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hc)
  refine ⟨o, k + (e.toInt - q), hodd, ?_⟩
  rw [finiteVal_eq_core_mul true e hv, hko]
  simp only [↓reduceIte, one_mul]
  push_cast
  rw [zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), zpow_natCast]
  ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.odd_pow_eq_two_pow
statement: theorem odd_pow_eq_two_pow {o d i : ℕ} (ho : Odd o) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (h : o ^ d = 2 ^ i) : o = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with hi | hi
  · rw [hi, pow_zero] at h
    exact (Nat.pow_eq_one.mp h).resolve_right (by omega)
  · exfalso
    have : Even (o ^ d) := by rw [h]; exact (Nat.even_pow.mpr ⟨even_two, by omega⟩)
    rw [Nat.even_pow] at this
    exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr ho) this.1

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_log_div_log_of_not_int
statement:
theorem irrational_log_div_log_of_not_int (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m)
    (b : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hnp : ∀ i, b.toNat ≠ 2 ^ i)
    (hni : ¬ ∃ n : ℤ, finiteVal true e m = n) :
    Irrational (Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log b.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨o, j, hodd, hval⟩ := finiteVal_eq_odd_mul_zpow e hv
  have hv0 := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
  have hB : (0 : ℝ) < b.toNat := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < b.toNat)
  have hB1 : (b.toNat : ℝ) ≠ 1 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : b.toNat ≠ 1)
  have ho0 : 0 < o := hodd.pos
  
  have hj : j < 0 := by
    by_contra hj
    push Not at hj
    apply hni
    refine ⟨o * 2 ^ j.toNat, ?_⟩
    rw [hval]; push_cast
    rw [← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hj]
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℕ, j = -(t : ℤ) ∧ 1 ≤ t := ⟨j.natAbs, by omega, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨ht, ht1⟩ := ht
  rw [ht, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast] at hval
  rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
  have key := pow_eq_zpow_of_log_div_log hv0 hB hB1 r hr
  rw [hval] at key
  have hd : 1 ≤ r.den := r.den_pos
  rcases le_or_gt 0 r.num with hn | hn
  · 
    obtain ⟨n, hn'⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, r.num = n := ⟨r.num.toNat, by omega⟩
    rw [hn', zpow_natCast] at key
    have hnat : o ^ r.den = b.toNat ^ n * 2 ^ (t * r.den) := by
      have : ((o : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ t)⁻¹) ^ r.den = (b.toNat : ℝ) ^ n := key
      rw [mul_pow, inv_pow, ← pow_mul] at this
      have h2 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (t * r.den)) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have := (mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul₀ h2).mp this
      exact_mod_cast this
    have heven : Even (o ^ r.den) := by
      rw [hnat]
      exact (Nat.even_pow.mpr ⟨even_two, by positivity⟩).mul_left _
    rw [Nat.even_pow] at heven
    exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hodd) heven.1
  · 
    obtain ⟨n, hn'⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, r.num = -(n : ℤ) := ⟨r.num.natAbs, by omega⟩
    rw [hn', zpow_neg, zpow_natCast] at key
    have hnat : o ^ r.den * b.toNat ^ n = 2 ^ (t * r.den) := by
      have : ((o : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ t)⁻¹) ^ r.den = ((b.toNat : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ := key
      rw [mul_pow, inv_pow, ← pow_mul] at this
      have h2 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (t * r.den)) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hb' : ((b.toNat : ℝ) ^ n) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hdvd : o ^ r.den ∣ 2 ^ (t * r.den) := ⟨_, hnat.symm⟩
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow Nat.prime_two).mp hdvd
    have ho1 : o = 1 := odd_pow_eq_two_pow hodd hd hi
    rw [ho1, one_pow, one_mul] at hnat
    have hbdvd : b.toNat ∣ 2 ^ (t * r.den) := by
      rw [← hnat]
      exact dvd_pow_self _ (by
        intro h; rw [h, pow_zero] at hnat
        have : 1 < 2 ^ (t * r.den) := Nat.one_lt_two_pow (by positivity)
        omega)
    obtain ⟨i', -, hi'⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow Nat.prime_two).mp hbdvd
    exact hnp i' hi'

name: Azurite.AzFloat.exists_eq_pow_maxRootBounded_of_pow_eq_pow
statement:
theorem exists_eq_pow_maxRootBounded_of_pow_eq_pow (b : AzNat) (t : ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat)
    (hbt : b.toNat < 2 ^ (t + 1)) {N d n : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hnat : N ^ d = b.toNat ^ n) : ∃ k, N = (maxRootBaseBounded b t).1.toNat ^ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcs, hs1, hc2, -⟩ := maxRootBaseBounded_spec b t hb
  have hnotpow := maxRootBaseBounded_not_pow b t hb hbt
  set c := (maxRootBaseBounded b t).1.toNat with hc
  set s := (maxRootBaseBounded b t).2 with hs
  
  set g := Nat.gcd d n with hg
  have hg0 : 0 < g := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ hd
  set d' := d / g with hd'
  set n' := n / g with hn''
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime d' n' := Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd hg0
  have hdg : d = g * d' := (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)).symm
  have hng : n = g * n' := (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)).symm
  have hred : N ^ d' = b.toNat ^ n' := by
    have : (N ^ d') ^ g = (b.toNat ^ n') ^ g := by
      rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, mul_comm d', mul_comm n', ← hdg, ← hng]; exact hnat
    exact (pow_left_inj₀ (by positivity) (by positivity) hg0.ne').mp this
  obtain ⟨C, hNC, hbC⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_pow_of_exponent_coprime_of_pow_eq_pow hcop hred
  
  have hcC : c ^ s = C ^ d' := by rw [← hcs, hbC]
  obtain ⟨D, hcD, hCD⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_pow_of_pow_eq_pow (Or.inl (by omega)) hcC
  set g' := Nat.gcd s d' with hg'
  have hd'1 : 1 ≤ d' := Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hd (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)) hg0
  have hg'0 : 0 < g' := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (by omega : 0 < s)
  have hq1 : d' / g' = 1 := by
    have hq1' : 1 ≤ d' / g' :=
      Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hd'1 (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)) hg'0
    by_contra h
    exact hnotpow (d' / g') (by omega) ⟨D, hcD⟩
  rw [hq1, pow_one] at hcD
  have hg'd : g' = d' := by
    have := Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_right s d')
    rw [hq1, one_mul] at this; exact this
  have hdvd : d' ∣ s := by rw [← hg'd]; exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdvd
  have hCc : C = c ^ k := by
    rw [hCD, hcD, hk, hg'd, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hd'1]
  exact ⟨n' * k, by rw [hNC, hCc, ← pow_mul, mul_comm]⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.exists_eq_pow_maxRoot_of_pow_eq_pow
statement:
theorem exists_eq_pow_maxRoot_of_pow_eq_pow (b : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat)
    (hb64 : b.toNat < 2 ^ 64) {N d n : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hnat : N ^ d = b.toNat ^ n) : ∃ k, N = (maxRootBase b).1.toNat ^ k
proof:
:=
  exists_eq_pow_maxRootBounded_of_pow_eq_pow b 63 hb (by simpa using hb64) hN hd hnat

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_log_div_log_of_int
statement:
theorem irrational_log_div_log_of_int (b : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hb64 : b.toNat < 2 ^ 64)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (hno : ∀ r, N ≠ (maxRootBase b).1.toNat ^ r) :
    Irrational (Real.log N / Real.log b.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcs, hs1, hc2, -⟩ := maxRootBase_spec b hb
  have hnotpow := maxRootBase_not_pow b hb hb64
  set c := (maxRootBase b).1.toNat with hc
  set s := (maxRootBase b).2 with hs
  have hB : (0 : ℝ) < b.toNat := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < b.toNat)
  have hB1 : (b.toNat : ℝ) ≠ 1 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : b.toNat ≠ 1)
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
  have key := pow_eq_zpow_of_log_div_log hNpos hB hB1 r hr
  have hd : 1 ≤ r.den := r.den_pos
  
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ r.num := by
    by_contra hn
    push Not at hn
    obtain ⟨n, hn'⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, r.num = -(n : ℤ) := ⟨r.num.natAbs, by omega⟩
    rw [hn', zpow_neg, zpow_natCast] at key
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ r.den := one_le_pow₀ (by exact_mod_cast hN)
    have h2 : ((b.toNat : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ < 1 := by
      rw [inv_lt_one_iff₀]
      right
      exact one_lt_pow₀ (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < b.toNat)) (by omega)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn'⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, r.num = n := ⟨r.num.toNat, by omega⟩
  rw [hn', zpow_natCast] at key
  have hnat : N ^ r.den = b.toNat ^ n := by exact_mod_cast key
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_eq_pow_maxRoot_of_pow_eq_pow b hb hb64 hN hd hnat
  exact hno k hk

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_log_div_log_of_rat
statement:
theorem irrational_log_div_log_of_rat (b : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hb64 : b.toNat < 2 ^ 64)
    (q : ℚ) (hq : 0 < q) (hno : ∀ r : ℤ, (q : ℝ) ≠ ((maxRootBase b).1.toNat : ℝ) ^ r) :
    Irrational (Real.log q / Real.log b.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcs, hs1, hc2, -⟩ := maxRootBase_spec b hb
  have hB : (0 : ℝ) < b.toNat := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < b.toNat)
  have hB1 : (b.toNat : ℝ) ≠ 1 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : b.toNat ≠ 1)
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hnum := Rat.num_pos.mpr hq
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ, q.num = N := ⟨q.num.toNat, by omega⟩
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ N := by omega
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime N q.den := by
    have := q.reduced
    rwa [hN, Int.natAbs_natCast] at this
  have hqND : (q : ℝ) = (N : ℝ) / q.den := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Rat.num_div_den q, hN]
    push_cast
    rfl
  rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
  have key := pow_eq_zpow_of_log_div_log hqr hB hB1 r hr
  have hd : 1 ≤ r.den := r.den_pos
  rw [hqND, div_pow] at key
  have hDd : ((q.den : ℝ) ^ r.den) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rcases le_or_gt 0 r.num with hn | hn
  · 
    obtain ⟨n, hn'⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, r.num = n := ⟨r.num.toNat, by omega⟩
    rw [hn', zpow_natCast, div_eq_iff hDd] at key
    have hnat : N ^ r.den = b.toNat ^ n * q.den ^ r.den := by exact_mod_cast key
    have hdvd : q.den ^ r.den ∣ N ^ r.den := ⟨_, by rw [hnat, mul_comm]⟩
    have hD1 : q.den ^ r.den = 1 :=
      Nat.Coprime.eq_one_of_dvd (Nat.Coprime.pow _ _ hcop.symm) hdvd
    rw [hD1, mul_one] at hnat
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_eq_pow_maxRoot_of_pow_eq_pow b hb hb64 hN1 hd hnat
    have hD1' : q.den = 1 := (Nat.pow_eq_one.mp hD1).resolve_right (by omega)
    apply hno k
    rw [hqND, hD1', hk, zpow_natCast]
    push_cast
    ring
  · 
    obtain ⟨n, hn'⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, r.num = -(n : ℤ) := ⟨r.num.natAbs, by omega⟩
    rw [hn', zpow_neg, zpow_natCast] at key
    have hnat : N ^ r.den * b.toNat ^ n = q.den ^ r.den := by
      have hb' : ((b.toNat : ℝ) ^ n) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp at key
      exact_mod_cast key
    have hdvd : N ^ r.den ∣ q.den ^ r.den := ⟨_, hnat.symm⟩
    have hN1' : N ^ r.den = 1 := Nat.Coprime.eq_one_of_dvd (Nat.Coprime.pow _ _ hcop) hdvd
    rw [hN1', one_mul] at hnat
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_eq_pow_maxRoot_of_pow_eq_pow b hb hb64 q.den_pos hd hnat.symm
    have hNone : N = 1 := (Nat.pow_eq_one.mp hN1').resolve_right (by omega)
    apply hno (-k)
    rw [hqND, hNone, hk, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
    push_cast
    ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toAzRat?_of_nat
statement:
theorem toAzRat?_of_nat (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) (Nn : ℕ)
    (hN : finiteVal true e m = Nn) :
    ∃ qr, (finite true e q m hv).toAzRat? = some qr ∧ qr.sign = true ∧ qr.den = 1 ∧
      qr.num ≠ 0 ∧ qr.num.toNat = Nn
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
  have hNn0 : 0 < Nn := by exact_mod_cast (hN ▸ hv0)
  obtain ⟨qr, hqr⟩ : ∃ qr, (finite true e q m hv).toAzRat? = some qr := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hval := toVal_of_toAzRat? _ qr hqr
  rw [toVal_finite, hN] at hval
  simp only [Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at hval
  
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < qr.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast AzRat.den_toNat_pos qr
  have hcast := AzRat.toRat_cast_eq qr
  have hsg : qr.sign = true := by
    by_contra hs
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hs
    rw [hcast, hs] at hval
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast] at hval
    have : -(qr.num.toNat : ℝ) / qr.den.toNat ≤ 0 :=
      div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) hD.le
    have : (0 : ℝ) < Nn := by exact_mod_cast hNn0
    linarith
  rw [hcast, hsg] at hval
  simp only [↓reduceIte, Int.cast_natCast] at hval
  have hnum : qr.num.toNat = Nn * qr.den.toNat := by
    have : (qr.num.toNat : ℝ) = Nn * qr.den.toNat := by
      rw [eq_div_iff hD.ne'] at hval; linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime qr.num.toNat qr.den.toNat := (AzNat.coprime_iff _ _).mp qr.reduced
  have hden1 : qr.den.toNat = 1 :=
    Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes hcop ⟨_, by rw [hnum, Nat.mul_comm]⟩ (dvd_refl _)
  rw [hden1, mul_one] at hnum
  have hd1 : qr.den = 1 := AzNat.toNat_injective (by rw [hden1]; rfl)
  have hn0 : qr.num ≠ 0 := fun h0 => by
    rw [h0, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hnum; omega
  exact ⟨qr, hqr, hsg, hd1, hn0, hnum⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_of_logBaseExact?_none
statement:
theorem irrational_of_logBaseExact?_none (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m)
    (b : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hb64 : b.toNat < 2 ^ 64) (hnp : ∀ i, b.toNat ≠ 2 ^ i)
    (h : logBaseExact? (finite true e q m hv) b = none) :
    Irrational (Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log b.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hint : ∃ n : ℤ, finiteVal true e m = n
  · obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hint
    have hv0 := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
    have hNpos : 0 < N := by exact_mod_cast (hN ▸ hv0)
    obtain ⟨Nn, hNn⟩ : ∃ Nn : ℕ, N = Nn := ⟨N.toNat, by omega⟩
    rw [hNn, Int.cast_natCast] at hN
    rw [hN]
    apply irrational_log_div_log_of_int b hb hb64 Nn (by omega)
    intro r hr
    
    obtain ⟨hcs, hs1, hc2, -⟩ := maxRootBase_spec b hb
    unfold logBaseExact? at h
    obtain ⟨qr, hqr, hsg, hd1, hn0, hnum⟩ := toAzRat?_of_nat e hv Nn hN
    rw [hqr] at h
    simp only [] at h
    rw [ite_eq_left ⟨hsg, hd1, hn0⟩] at h
    rw [Option.map_eq_none_iff] at h
    have := (AzNat.checkedLogBase_eq_none_iff _ _ hc2 hn0).mp h r
    rw [hnum] at this
    exact this hr
  · exact irrational_log_div_log_of_not_int e hv b hb hnp hint

name: Azurite.AzFloat.maxRootBase_lt_size
statement:
theorem maxRootBase_lt_size (b : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hb64 : b.toNat < 2 ^ 64) :
    (maxRootBase b).1.toNat < UInt64.size
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcs, hs1, -, -⟩ := maxRootBase_spec b hb
  have : (maxRootBase b).1.toNat ≤ b.toNat := by
    rw [hcs]; exact Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) _
  have hsize : UInt64.size = 2 ^ 64 := by decide
  omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toNat_rootUInt
statement:
theorem toNat_rootUInt (b : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hb64 : b.toNat < 2 ^ 64) :
    (UInt64.ofNat (maxRootBase b).1.toNat).toNat = (maxRootBase b).1.toNat
proof:
:=
  UInt64.toNat_ofNat_of_lt' (maxRootBase_lt_size b hb hb64)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseExactRat?_some
statement:
theorem logBaseExactRat?_some (q : AzRat) (hq : (0 : ℚ) < AzRat.toRat q) (b : AzNat)
    (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hb64 : b.toNat < 2 ^ 64) (r : AzRat) (h : logBaseExactRat? q b = some r) :
    Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) / Real.log b.toNat = (AzRat.toRat r : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcs, hs1, hc2, -⟩ := maxRootBase_spec b hb
  have hcU := toNat_rootUInt b hb hb64
  unfold logBaseExactRat? at h
  simp only [] at h
  rw [Option.map_eq_some_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := h
  rw [AzRat.checkedLogBaseAbs_eq_some_iff _ (by rw [hcU]; exact hc2) q e, hcU] at he
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < AzRat.toRat q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  rw [abs_of_pos hqr] at he
  have hlogc : 0 < Real.log (maxRootBase b).1.toNat := log_pos_of_two_le hc2
  rw [AzRat.toRat_ofAzInts, AzInt.toInt_ofInt, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, he, hcs,
    Real.log_zpow, Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_of_logBaseExactRat?_none
statement:
theorem irrational_of_logBaseExactRat?_none (q : AzRat) (hq : (0 : ℚ) < AzRat.toRat q)
    (b : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hb64 : b.toNat < 2 ^ 64) (h : logBaseExactRat? q b = none) :
    Irrational (Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) / Real.log b.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, hc2, -⟩ := maxRootBase_spec b hb
  have hcU := toNat_rootUInt b hb hb64
  unfold logBaseExactRat? at h
  simp only [] at h
  rw [Option.map_eq_none_iff, AzRat.checkedLogBaseAbs_eq_none_iff _ (by rw [hcU]; exact hc2),
    hcU] at h
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < AzRat.toRat q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  refine irrational_log_div_log_of_rat b hb hb64 _ hq fun e he => h e ?_
  rw [abs_of_pos hqr]
  exact he

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseP1Exact?_some
statement:
theorem logBaseP1Exact?_some (x : AzFloat) (b : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (r : AzRat)
    (h : logBaseP1Exact? x b = some r) :
    ∃ v : ℝ, x.toVal = some (v : EReal) ∧ 0 < v ∧
      Real.log (1 + v) / Real.log b.toNat = (AzRat.toRat r : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcs, hs1, hc2, -⟩ := maxRootBase_spec b hb
  unfold logBaseP1Exact? at h
  split_ifs at h with hint
  rcases hq : x.toAzRat? with _ | q
  · rw [hq] at h; cases h
  · rw [hq] at h
    simp only [] at h
    split_ifs at h with hg
    obtain ⟨hsg, hd1, hn0⟩ := hg
    have h10 : (q.num + 1).toNat = q.num.toNat + 1 := by rw [AzNat.toNat_add]; rfl
    have hne1 : q.num + 1 ≠ 0 := fun h0 => by rw [h0, AzNat.toNat_zero] at h10; omega
    rcases hr : AzNat.checkedLogBase (maxRootBase b).1 (q.num + 1) with _ | e
    · rw [hr] at h; cases h
    · rw [hr, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h
      have hne : (q.num + 1).toNat = (maxRootBase b).1.toNat ^ e :=
        (AzNat.checkedLogBase_eq_some_iff _ _ hc2 hne1 e).mp hr
      have hv := toVal_of_toAzRat? x q hq
      rw [toRat_eq_of_int_den_one q hsg hd1] at hv
      have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < q.num.toNat := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hn0)
      refine ⟨_, hv, hnpos, ?_⟩
      rw [← h, AzRat.toRat_ofAzInts, toInt_toAzInt, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat,
        AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
      push_cast
      have hlogc : 0 < Real.log (maxRootBase b).1.toNat := log_pos_of_two_le hc2
      rw [h10] at hne
      have h1v : (1 : ℝ) + q.num.toNat = (maxRootBase b).1.toNat ^ e := by
        rw [add_comm]; exact_mod_cast hne
      rw [h1v, hcs, Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]
      field_simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.one_add_odd_mul_eq
statement:
theorem one_add_odd_mul_eq (o t : ℕ) (hodd : Odd o) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (σ : Bool)
    (hlt : σ = false → o < 2 ^ t) :
    ∃ u : ℕ, Odd u ∧
      1 + (if σ then 1 else -1 : ℝ) * (o * ((2 : ℝ) ^ t)⁻¹) = u / 2 ^ t
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ t ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have heven : Even (2 ^ t) := Nat.even_pow.mpr ⟨even_two, by omega⟩
  cases σ with
  | true =>
    refine ⟨2 ^ t + o, heven.add_odd hodd, ?_⟩
    simp only [↓reduceIte, one_mul]
    push_cast
    field_simp
  | false =>
    refine ⟨2 ^ t - o, Nat.Even.sub_odd (hlt rfl).le heven hodd, ?_⟩
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, neg_one_mul]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (hlt rfl).le]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.one_add_finiteVal_eq_odd_div_two_pow
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨o, j, hodd, hval⟩ := finiteVal_eq_odd_mul_zpow e hv
  
  have hj : j < 0 := by
    by_contra hj
    push Not at hj
    apply hni
    cases s with
    | true =>
      refine ⟨o * 2 ^ j.toNat, ?_⟩
      rw [hval]; push_cast
      rw [← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hj]
    | false =>
      refine ⟨-(o * 2 ^ j.toNat), ?_⟩
      rw [finiteVal_false, hval]; push_cast
      rw [← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hj]
  obtain ⟨t, ht, ht1⟩ : ∃ t : ℕ, j = -(t : ℤ) ∧ 1 ≤ t := ⟨j.natAbs, by omega, by omega⟩
  have hsv : finiteVal s e m = (if s then 1 else -1 : ℝ) * (o * ((2 : ℝ) ^ t)⁻¹) := by
    cases s
    · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, neg_one_mul]
      rw [finiteVal_false, hval, ht, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
    · simp only [↓reduceIte, one_mul]
      rw [hval, ht, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
  have hlt : s = false → o < 2 ^ t := by
    intro hs
    subst hs
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, neg_one_mul] at hsv
    rw [hsv] at hgt
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ t := by positivity
    have h1 : (o : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ t)⁻¹ < 1 := by linarith
    rw [mul_inv_lt_iff₀ h2, one_mul] at h1
    exact_mod_cast h1
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩ := one_add_odd_mul_eq o t hodd ht1 s hlt
  exact ⟨u, t, hu, ht1, by rw [hsv]; exact hu'⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_log_div_log_one_add_of_not_int
statement:
theorem irrational_log_div_log_one_add_of_not_int (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat}
    (hv : FiniteValid q m) (b : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hb64 : b.toNat < 2 ^ 64)
    (hnp : ∀ i, b.toNat ≠ 2 ^ i) (hgt : -1 < finiteVal s e m)
    (hni : ¬ ∃ n : ℤ, finiteVal s e m = n) :
    Irrational (Real.log (1 + finiteVal s e m) / Real.log b.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcs, hs1, hc2, -⟩ := maxRootBase_spec b hb
  obtain ⟨u, t, hu, ht1, hval⟩ := one_add_finiteVal_eq_odd_div_two_pow s e hv hgt hni
  obtain ⟨qr, hqr⟩ : ∃ qr, (finite s e q m hv).toAzRat? = some qr := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hrx := toVal_of_toAzRat? _ qr hqr
  rw [toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at hrx
  have hpos : 0 < 1 + finiteVal s e m := by linarith
  have h1rx : ((1 + AzRat.toRat qr : ℚ) : ℝ) = 1 + finiteVal s e m := by push_cast; rw [hrx]
  rw [← h1rx]
  apply irrational_log_div_log_of_rat b hb hb64 (1 + AzRat.toRat qr)
    (by exact_mod_cast (h1rx ▸ hpos))
  intro r hr
  rw [h1rx, hval] at hr
  set c := (maxRootBase b).1.toNat with hc
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ t := by positivity
  rcases le_or_gt 0 r with hn | hn
  · 
    obtain ⟨n, hn'⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, r = n := ⟨r.toNat, by omega⟩
    rw [hn', zpow_natCast, div_eq_iff h2.ne'] at hr
    have hnat : u = c ^ n * 2 ^ t := by exact_mod_cast hr
    have heven : Even u := by
      rw [hnat]; exact (Nat.even_pow.mpr ⟨even_two, by omega⟩).mul_left _
    exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hu) heven
  · 
    obtain ⟨n, hn', hn1⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, r = -(n : ℤ) ∧ 1 ≤ n := ⟨r.natAbs, by omega, by omega⟩
    rw [hn', zpow_neg, zpow_natCast] at hr
    have hnat : u * c ^ n = 2 ^ t := by
      have hc' : ((c : ℝ) ^ n) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp at hr
      exact_mod_cast hr
    have hdvd : c ^ n ∣ 2 ^ t := ⟨_, by rw [← hnat, mul_comm]⟩
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow Nat.prime_two).mp hdvd
    have hcdvd : c ∣ 2 ^ i := by rw [← hi]; exact dvd_pow_self _ (by omega)
    obtain ⟨i', -, hi'⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow Nat.prime_two).mp hcdvd
    exact hnp (i' * (maxRootBase b).2) (by rw [hcs, hi', ← pow_mul])

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_of_logBaseP1Exact?_none
statement:
theorem irrational_of_logBaseP1Exact?_none (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat}
    (hv : FiniteValid q m) (b : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hb64 : b.toNat < 2 ^ 64)
    (hnp : ∀ i, b.toNat ≠ 2 ^ i) (hgt : -1 < finiteVal s e m)
    (h : logBaseP1Exact? (finite s e q m hv) b = none) :
    Irrational (Real.log (1 + finiteVal s e m) / Real.log b.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hint : ∃ n : ℤ, finiteVal s e m = n
  · obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hint
    cases s with
    | false =>
      
      exfalso
      have hpos := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
      rw [finiteVal_false] at hN hgt
      have h1 : (-1 : ℝ) < N := by rw [← hN]; exact hgt
      have h2 : (N : ℝ) < 0 := by rw [← hN]; linarith
      have h1' : (-1 : ℤ) < N := by exact_mod_cast h1
      have h2' : N < 0 := by exact_mod_cast h2
      omega
    | true =>
      have hv0 := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
      have hNpos : 0 < N := by exact_mod_cast (hN ▸ hv0)
      obtain ⟨Nn, hNn⟩ : ∃ Nn : ℕ, N = Nn := ⟨N.toNat, by omega⟩
      rw [hNn, Int.cast_natCast] at hN
      rw [hN]
      have h1N : (1 : ℝ) + Nn = ((Nn + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h1N]
      apply irrational_log_div_log_of_int b hb hb64 (Nn + 1) (by omega)
      intro r hr
      
      obtain ⟨hcs, hs1, hc2, -⟩ := maxRootBase_spec b hb
      obtain ⟨qr, hqr, hsg, hd1, hn0, hnum⟩ := toAzRat?_of_nat e hv Nn hN
      unfold logBaseP1Exact? at h
      rw [ite_eq_left ((isInteger_finite true e hv).mpr ⟨Nn, by rw [Int.cast_natCast]; exact hN⟩),
        hqr] at h
      simp only [] at h
      rw [ite_eq_left ⟨hsg, hd1, hn0⟩, Option.map_eq_none_iff] at h
      have h10 : (qr.num + 1).toNat = Nn + 1 := by rw [AzNat.toNat_add, hnum]; rfl
      have hne1 : qr.num + 1 ≠ 0 := fun h0 => by rw [h0, AzNat.toNat_zero] at h10; omega
      have := (AzNat.checkedLogBase_eq_none_iff _ _ hc2 hne1).mp h r
      rw [h10] at this
      exact this hr
  · exact irrational_log_div_log_one_add_of_not_int s e hv b hb hb64 hnp hgt hint

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero'
statement: theorem toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero' {k : AzInt} (hk : k ≠ 0) : k.toInt ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h =>
  hk (by rw [← AzInt.ofInt_toInt k, h, AzInt.ofInt_zero])

name: Azurite.AzFloat.oddPart_spec
statement:
theorem oddPart_spec (m : AzNat) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    m.toNat = 2 ^ twoAdic m * (oddPart m).toNat ∧ Odd (oddPart m).toNat ∧ twoAdic m < m.size
proof:
:= by
  have hk : twoAdic m = m.toNat.factorization 2 := by
    unfold twoAdic
    rw [AzNat.trailingZeros_eq_padicValNat m hm, Nat.factorization_def _ Nat.prime_two]
    rfl
  have hn : m.toNat ≠ 0 := toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hm
  have hdvd : 2 ^ m.toNat.factorization 2 ∣ m.toNat := Nat.ordProj_dvd _ _
  have hop : (oddPart m).toNat = m.toNat / 2 ^ twoAdic m := by
    unfold oddPart
    exact AzNat.toNat_shiftRight m (twoAdic m)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hop, hk, Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd]
  · rw [hop, hk]
    have := Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl Nat.prime_two hn
    exact Nat.odd_iff.mpr (by omega)
  · obtain ⟨-, hsz⟩ := AzNat.size_bounds m hm
    have : 2 ^ twoAdic m ≤ m.toNat := by rw [hk]; exact Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) hdvd
    by_contra hge
    push Not at hge
    have := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num : 0 < 2) hge
    omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_eq_oddPart
statement:
theorem finiteVal_eq_oddPart (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) :
    finiteVal true e m = ((oddPart m).toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (dyadicExp e m).toInt
proof:
:= by
  have hm : m ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := (toNat_bounds_of_valid hv).1
    rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero] at this
    have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := alignedBits q - 1)
    omega
  obtain ⟨hdec, -, hlt⟩ := oddPart_spec m hm
  have hexp : (dyadicExp e m).toInt = e.toInt - m.size + twoAdic m := by
    unfold dyadicExp
    rw [AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, Nat.cast_sub hlt.le]
    ring
  unfold finiteVal
  simp only [↓reduceIte, one_mul]
  rw [hdec, hexp, zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), zpow_natCast]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.odd_mul_two_zpow_inj
statement:
theorem odd_mul_two_zpow_inj {o s : ℕ} (ho : Odd o) (hs : Odd s) {I J : ℤ}
    (h : (o : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ I = (s : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ J) : o = s ∧ I = J
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ {o s : ℕ} {I J : ℤ}, Odd o → I ≤ J →
      (o : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ I = (s : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ J → o = s ∧ I = J := by
    intro o s I J ho hIJ h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, J = I + k := ⟨(J - I).toNat, by omega⟩
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ I := zpow_pos two_pos _
    have hnat : o = s * 2 ^ k := by
      have : (o : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ I = ((s * 2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ I := by
        rw [h, hk, zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), zpow_natCast]
        push_cast
        ring
      exact_mod_cast mul_right_cancel₀ h2.ne' this
    rcases k with _ | k
    · rw [pow_zero, mul_one] at hnat
      exact ⟨hnat, by omega⟩
    · exfalso
      have : Even o := by
        rw [hnat]; exact (Nat.even_pow.mpr ⟨even_two, by omega⟩).mul_left _
      exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr ho) this
  rcases le_total I J with hIJ | hIJ
  · exact key ho hIJ h
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := key hs hIJ h.symm
    exact ⟨h1.symm, h2.symm⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.pow_eq_zpow_sep
statement:
theorem pow_eq_zpow_sep {o s : ℕ} (ho : Odd o) (hs : Odd s) {i j : ℤ} {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    {n : ℤ} (key : ((o : ℝ) * 2 ^ i) ^ d = ((s : ℝ) * 2 ^ j) ^ n) :
    o ^ d = s ^ n.toNat ∧ (n < 0 → o = 1 ∧ s = 1) ∧ i * d = j * n
proof:
:= by
  have ho0 : 0 < o := ho.pos
  have hs0 : 0 < s := hs.pos
  rcases le_or_gt 0 n with hn | hn
  · obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ, n = N := ⟨n.toNat, by omega⟩
    have hG : ((o ^ d : ℕ) : ℝ) * 2 ^ (i * d) = ((s ^ N : ℕ) : ℝ) * 2 ^ (j * N) := by
      push_cast
      rw [zpow_mul, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, ← mul_pow, ← mul_pow]
      rw [hN, zpow_natCast] at key
      exact key
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := odd_mul_two_zpow_inj ho.pow hs.pow hG
    refine ⟨?_, fun h => absurd h (by omega), by rw [hN]; exact h2⟩
    rw [hN, Int.toNat_natCast]
    exact h1
  · obtain ⟨N, hN, hN1⟩ : ∃ N : ℕ, n = -(N : ℤ) ∧ 1 ≤ N := ⟨n.natAbs, by omega, by omega⟩
    have hG : ((o ^ d * s ^ N : ℕ) : ℝ) * 2 ^ (i * d + j * N) = ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * 2 ^ (0 : ℤ) := by
      push_cast
      rw [zpow_zero, mul_one, zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), zpow_mul, zpow_mul,
        zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]
      rw [hN, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast] at key
      have hkey1 : ((o : ℝ) * 2 ^ i) ^ d * ((s : ℝ) * 2 ^ j) ^ N = 1 := by
        rw [key]; exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity)
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow] at hkey1
      linear_combination hkey1
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := odd_mul_two_zpow_inj (ho.pow.mul hs.pow) odd_one hG
    have ho1 := Nat.eq_one_of_mul_eq_one_right h1
    have hs1 := Nat.eq_one_of_mul_eq_one_left h1
    have ho1' : o = 1 := (Nat.pow_eq_one.mp ho1).resolve_right (by omega)
    have hs1' : s = 1 := (Nat.pow_eq_one.mp hs1).resolve_right (by omega)
    refine ⟨?_, fun _ => ⟨ho1', hs1'⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [ho1', hN, one_pow, hs1', one_pow]
    · rw [hN]; linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.num_den_of_div
statement:
theorem num_den_of_div {n : ℤ} {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hcop : Nat.Coprime n.natAbs d) :
    ((n : ℚ) / d).num = n ∧ ((n : ℚ) / d).den = d
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : (0 : ℤ) < d := by omega
  have h1 := Rat.num_div_eq_of_coprime hd0 (by simpa using hcop)
  have h2 := Rat.den_div_eq_of_coprime hd0 (by simpa using hcop)
  push_cast at h1 h2
  exact ⟨h1, by exact_mod_cast h2⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toRat_num
statement:
theorem toRat_num (q : AzRat) :
    (AzRat.toRat q).num = if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℤ)
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toRat_den
statement: theorem toRat_den (q : AzRat) : (AzRat.toRat q).den = q.den.toNat
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseFloatExact?_some
statement:
theorem logBaseFloatExact?_some (i : AzInt) (o : AzNat) (j : AzInt) (s : AzNat)
    (ho : Odd o.toNat) (hs : Odd s.toNat) (hb1 : (s.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ j.toInt ≠ 1) (r : AzRat)
    (h : logBaseFloatExact? i o j s = some r) :
    Real.log ((o.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ i.toInt) / Real.log ((s.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ j.toInt)
      = (AzRat.toRat r : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have ho0 : 0 < o.toNat := ho.pos
  have hs0 : 0 < s.toNat := hs.pos
  have hlog2 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
  have hlogb : Real.log ((s.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ j.toInt) ≠ 0 :=
    Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one (by positivity) hb1
  unfold logBaseFloatExact? at h
  simp only [] at h
  split_ifs at h with hj hi hsign hchk hone
  · 
    subst hj; subst hi
    simp only [AzInt.toInt_zero, zpow_zero, mul_one] at hlogb ⊢
    have hs2 : 2 ≤ s.toNat := by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge s.toNat 2 with h2 | h2
      · exfalso
        have : s.toNat = 1 := by omega
        apply hlogb
        rw [this, Nat.cast_one, Real.log_one]
      · exact h2
    obtain ⟨hcs, hs1, hc2, -⟩ := maxRootBaseBounded_spec s s.size hs2
    rw [Option.map_eq_some_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := h
    have hok := (AzNat.checkedLogBase_eq_some_iff _ _ hc2
      (fun h0 => by rw [h0, AzNat.toNat_zero] at ho0; omega) k).mp hk
    have hlogc : 0 < Real.log (maxRootBaseBounded s s.size).1.toNat := log_pos_of_two_le hc2
    rw [AzRat.toRat_ofAzInts, toInt_toAzInt, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat,
      hok, hcs, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_pow, Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]
    push_cast
    field_simp
  · 
    rw [Option.some.injEq] at h
    subst h
    set r := AzRat.ofAzInts i j with hr
    obtain ⟨hpow_s, hpow_o, hroot⟩ := hchk
    have hj' : j.toInt ≠ 0 := toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero' hj
    have hd : 1 ≤ r.den.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero r.den_nz)
    
    set c := (s.rootInt r.den.toNat).toNat with hc
    have hsc : s.toNat = c ^ r.den.toNat := by
      have := (AzNat.isPow_eq_true_iff s _ hd).mp hpow_s
      rw [hc, AzNat.toNat_rootInt]
      exact ((AzNat.rootIntNat_pow_eq_iff _ _ hd).mpr this).symm
    have hoc : o.toNat = c ^ r.num.toNat := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r.num.toNat with h0 | h0
      · 
        rw [h0, pow_zero]
        unfold AzNat.isPow at hpow_o
        rw [h0, decide_eq_true_iff] at hpow_o
        have := congrArg AzNat.toNat hpow_o
        rw [AzNat.toNat_pow, pow_zero] at this
        exact this.symm
      · have := (AzNat.isPow_eq_true_iff o _ h0).mp hpow_o
        rw [hc, hroot, AzNat.toNat_rootInt]
        exact ((AzNat.rootIntNat_pow_eq_iff _ _ h0).mpr this).symm
    
    have hval : (AzRat.toRat r : ℝ) = (i.toInt : ℝ) / j.toInt := by
      rw [hr, AzRat.toRat_ofAzInts]; push_cast; rfl
    have hval' : (AzRat.toRat r : ℝ) = (r.num.toNat : ℝ) / r.den.toNat := by
      rw [AzRat.toRat_cast_eq, hsign]; push_cast; rfl
    have hid : (i.toInt : ℝ) * r.den.toNat = j.toInt * r.num.toNat := by
      have hdr : (r.den.toNat : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have := hval.symm.trans hval'
      rw [div_eq_div_iff (by exact_mod_cast hj') hdr] at this
      linarith
    have hc0 : (c : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have : c = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h0
      rw [this, zero_pow (by omega)] at hsc
      omega
    rw [hval, div_eq_div_iff hlogb (by exact_mod_cast hj'), hsc, hoc, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_pow,
      Real.log_mul (pow_ne_zero _ hc0) (zpow_ne_zero _ two_ne_zero),
      Real.log_mul (pow_ne_zero _ hc0) (zpow_ne_zero _ two_ne_zero),
      Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow, Real.log_zpow, Real.log_zpow]
    linear_combination (-(Real.log (c : ℝ))) * hid
  · 
    rw [Option.some.injEq] at h
    subst h
    obtain ⟨ho1, hs1⟩ := hone
    subst ho1; subst hs1
    rw [AzRat.toRat_ofAzInts, AzNat.toNat_one, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, one_mul, Real.log_zpow,
      Real.log_zpow]
    push_cast
    have hj' : (j.toInt : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero' hj
    field_simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_of_logBaseFloatExact?_none
statement:
theorem irrational_of_logBaseFloatExact?_none (i : AzInt) (o : AzNat) (j : AzInt) (s : AzNat)
    (ho : Odd o.toNat) (hs : Odd s.toNat) (hb1 : (s.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ j.toInt ≠ 1)
    (hx1 : (o.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ i.toInt ≠ 1) (h : logBaseFloatExact? i o j s = none) :
    Irrational
      (Real.log ((o.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ i.toInt) / Real.log ((s.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ j.toInt))
proof:
:= by
  have ho0 : 0 < o.toNat := ho.pos
  have hs0 : 0 < s.toNat := hs.pos
  have hxpos : (0 : ℝ) < (o.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ i.toInt := by positivity
  have hbpos : (0 : ℝ) < (s.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ j.toInt := by positivity
  rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
  have key := pow_eq_zpow_of_log_div_log hxpos hbpos hb1 r hr
  have hd : 1 ≤ r.den := r.den_pos
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime r.num.natAbs r.den := r.reduced
  obtain ⟨h1, hneg, h2⟩ := pow_eq_zpow_sep ho hs hd key
  
  have hnot1 : ¬ (o.toNat = 1 ∧ i.toInt = 0) := fun ⟨h1', h2'⟩ => hx1 (by
    rw [h1', h2', Nat.cast_one, zpow_zero, mul_one])
  unfold logBaseFloatExact? at h
  simp only [] at h
  split_ifs at h with hj hi hsign hchk hone
  · 
    subst hj; subst hi
    rw [AzInt.toInt_zero, zpow_zero, mul_one] at hb1
    rw [AzInt.toInt_zero] at hnot1
    have hs2 : 2 ≤ s.toNat := by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge s.toNat 2 with h2 | h2
      · exfalso
        have : s.toNat = 1 := by omega
        apply hb1
        rw [this, Nat.cast_one]
      · exact h2
    obtain ⟨hcs, hs1, hc2, -⟩ := maxRootBaseBounded_spec s s.size hs2
    have hn0 : 0 ≤ r.num := by
      by_contra hn
      push Not at hn
      obtain ⟨-, hs1'⟩ := hneg hn
      omega
    have hN1 : 1 ≤ r.num.toNat := by
      by_contra hN
      push Not at hN
      have hN0 : r.num.toNat = 0 := by omega
      rw [hN0, pow_zero] at h1
      exact hnot1 ⟨(Nat.pow_eq_one.mp h1).resolve_right (by omega), rfl⟩
    have hbt : s.toNat < 2 ^ (s.size + 1) := by
      have := (AzNat.size_bounds s (fun h0 => by rw [h0, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hs0; omega)).2
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le this (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega))
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_eq_pow_maxRootBounded_of_pow_eq_pow s s.size hs2 hbt ho0 hd h1
    rw [Option.map_eq_none_iff] at h
    exact (AzNat.checkedLogBase_eq_none_iff _ _ hc2
      (fun h0 => by rw [h0, AzNat.toNat_zero] at ho0; omega)).mp h k hk
  · 
    subst hj
    rw [AzInt.toInt_zero, zero_mul] at h2
    have : i.toInt = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h | h
      · exact h
      · omega
    exact hi (by rw [← AzInt.ofInt_toInt i, this, AzInt.ofInt_zero])
  · 
    set r' := AzRat.ofAzInts i j with hr'
    have hj' : j.toInt ≠ 0 := toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero' hj
    
    have hval : AzRat.toRat r' = (r.num : ℚ) / r.den := by
      rw [hr', AzRat.toRat_ofAzInts, div_eq_div_iff (by exact_mod_cast hj') (by positivity)]
      exact_mod_cast (by linarith : i.toInt * r.den = r.num * j.toInt)
    obtain ⟨hnum, hden⟩ := num_den_of_div hd hcop
    rw [← hval, toRat_num] at hnum
    rw [← hval, toRat_den] at hden
    simp only [hsign, ↓reduceIte] at hnum
    have hN : r.num.toNat = r'.num.toNat := by omega
    have hN1 : 1 ≤ r'.num.toNat := by
      by_contra hN0
      push Not at hN0
      have : r.num.toNat = 0 := by omega
      rw [this, pow_zero] at h1
      have ho1 : o.toNat = 1 := (Nat.pow_eq_one.mp h1).resolve_right (by omega)
      have : r.num = 0 := by omega
      rw [this, mul_zero] at h2
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h | h
      · exact hnot1 ⟨ho1, h⟩
      · omega
    rw [hN, ← hden] at h1
    have hcop' : Nat.Coprime r'.den.toNat r'.num.toNat := by
      have hna : r.num.natAbs = r.num.toNat := by omega
      rw [hden, ← hN, ← hna]; exact hcop.symm
    obtain ⟨c, hoc, hsc⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_pow_of_exponent_coprime_of_pow_eq_pow hcop' h1
    have hd' : 1 ≤ r'.den.toNat := by omega
    apply hchk
    refine ⟨(AzNat.isPow_eq_true_iff s _ hd').mpr ⟨c, hsc.symm⟩,
      (AzNat.isPow_eq_true_iff o _ hN1).mpr ⟨c, hoc.symm⟩, ?_⟩
    apply AzNat.toNat_injective
    rw [AzNat.toNat_rootInt, AzNat.toNat_rootInt]
    have e1 : AzNat.rootIntNat s.toNat r'.den.toNat = c := by
      apply Nat.pow_left_injective (by omega : r'.den.toNat ≠ 0)
      show AzNat.rootIntNat s.toNat r'.den.toNat ^ r'.den.toNat = c ^ r'.den.toNat
      rw [(AzNat.rootIntNat_pow_eq_iff _ _ hd').mpr ⟨c, hsc.symm⟩, hsc]
    have e2 : AzNat.rootIntNat o.toNat r'.num.toNat = c := by
      apply Nat.pow_left_injective (by omega : r'.num.toNat ≠ 0)
      show AzNat.rootIntNat o.toNat r'.num.toNat ^ r'.num.toNat = c ^ r'.num.toNat
      rw [(AzNat.rootIntNat_pow_eq_iff _ _ hN1).mpr ⟨c, hoc.symm⟩, hoc]
    rw [e1, e2]
  · 
    set r' := AzRat.ofAzInts i j with hr'
    have hj' : j.toInt ≠ 0 := toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero' hj
    have hval : AzRat.toRat r' = (r.num : ℚ) / r.den := by
      rw [hr', AzRat.toRat_ofAzInts, div_eq_div_iff (by exact_mod_cast hj') (by positivity)]
      exact_mod_cast (by linarith : i.toInt * r.den = r.num * j.toInt)
    obtain ⟨hnum, -⟩ := num_den_of_div hd hcop
    rw [← hval, toRat_num] at hnum
    simp only [hsign, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hnum
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (by omega : r.num ≤ 0) with hn | hn
    · obtain ⟨ho1, hs1⟩ := hneg hn
      exact hone ⟨AzNat.toNat_injective (by rw [ho1]; rfl),
        AzNat.toNat_injective (by rw [hs1]; rfl)⟩
    · have : r.num.toNat = 0 := by omega
      rw [this, pow_zero] at h1
      have ho1 : o.toNat = 1 := (Nat.pow_eq_one.mp h1).resolve_right (by omega)
      rw [hn, mul_zero] at h2
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h | h
      · exact hnot1 ⟨ho1, h⟩
      · omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.significand_ne_zero_of_valid
statement: theorem significand_ne_zero_of_valid {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) : m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := (toNat_bounds_of_valid hv).1
  rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero] at this
  have := Nat.one_le_two_pow (n := alignedBits q - 1)
  omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseFloat_exact_value
statement:
theorem logBaseFloat_exact_value (ex : AzInt) {qx : ℕ} {mx : AzNat} (hvx : FiniteValid qx mx)
    (eb : AzInt) {qb : ℕ} {mb : AzNat} (hvb : FiniteValid qb mb)
    (hb1 : finiteVal true eb mb ≠ 1) (r : AzRat)
    (h : logBaseFloatExact? (dyadicExp ex mx) (oddPart mx) (dyadicExp eb mb) (oddPart mb)
      = some r) :
    Real.log (finiteVal true ex mx) / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb) = (AzRat.toRat r : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteVal_eq_oddPart eb hvb] at hb1 ⊢
  rw [finiteVal_eq_oddPart ex hvx]
  exact logBaseFloatExact?_some _ _ _ _ (oddPart_spec mx (significand_ne_zero_of_valid hvx)).2.1
    (oddPart_spec mb (significand_ne_zero_of_valid hvb)).2.1 hb1 r h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_logBaseFloat_of_none
statement:
theorem irrational_logBaseFloat_of_none (ex : AzInt) {qx : ℕ} {mx : AzNat}
    (hvx : FiniteValid qx mx) (eb : AzInt) {qb : ℕ} {mb : AzNat} (hvb : FiniteValid qb mb)
    (hb1 : finiteVal true eb mb ≠ 1) (hx1 : finiteVal true ex mx ≠ 1)
    (h : logBaseFloatExact? (dyadicExp ex mx) (oddPart mx) (dyadicExp eb mb) (oddPart mb)
      = none) :
    Irrational (Real.log (finiteVal true ex mx) / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb))
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteVal_eq_oddPart eb hvb] at hb1 ⊢
  rw [finiteVal_eq_oddPart ex hvx] at hx1 ⊢
  exact irrational_of_logBaseFloatExact?_none _ _ _ _
    (oddPart_spec mx (significand_ne_zero_of_valid hvx)).2.1
    (oddPart_spec mb (significand_ne_zero_of_valid hvb)).2.1 hb1 hx1 h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.abs_toNat_eq_natAbs
statement: theorem abs_toNat_eq_natAbs (k : AzInt) : k.abs.toNat = k.toInt.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzInt.toInt
