name: Azurite.AzFloat.toNat_hShiftLeft
statement: theorem toNat_hShiftLeft (a : AzNat) (k : ℕ) : (a <<< k).toNat = a.toNat * 2 ^ k
proof:
:=
  AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft a k

name: Azurite.AzFloat.one_add_eq_of_scaled
statement:
theorem one_add_eq_of_scaled {v : ℝ} {u o' k t : ℕ} (hdec : u = 2 ^ k * o')
    (huv : (u : ℝ) = (1 + v) * 2 ^ t) :
    1 + v = (o' : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℤ) - t)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ t := by positivity
  have key : (1 + v) * 2 ^ t = (o' : ℝ) * 2 ^ k := by
    rw [← huv, hdec]; push_cast; ring
  calc 1 + v = (1 + v) * 2 ^ t / 2 ^ t := by field_simp
    _ = (o' : ℝ) * 2 ^ k / 2 ^ t := by rw [key]
    _ = (o' : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℤ) - t) := by
        rw [zpow_sub₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]; ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.onePlusDyadic_spec
statement:
theorem onePlusDyadic_spec (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m)
    (hgt : -1 < finiteVal s e m) :
    Odd (onePlusDyadic s (dyadicExp e m) (oddPart m)).1.toNat ∧
      1 + finiteVal s e m
        = ((onePlusDyadic s (dyadicExp e m) (oddPart m)).1.toNat : ℝ)
          * (2 : ℝ) ^ (onePlusDyadic s (dyadicExp e m) (oddPart m)).2.toInt
proof:
:= by
  have hm := significand_ne_zero_of_valid hv
  obtain ⟨-, hodd, -⟩ := oddPart_spec m hm
  have hval := finiteVal_eq_oddPart e hv
  set o := oddPart m with ho
  set i := dyadicExp e m with hi
  have hab : (i.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |i.toInt| := by
    rw [abs_toNat_eq_natAbs]; exact Int.natCast_natAbs _
  have ho0 : 0 < o.toNat := hodd.pos
  have hcancel : i.toInt < 0 → (2 : ℝ) ^ i.toInt * 2 ^ i.abs.toNat = 1 := by
    intro hneg
    rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0),
      show i.toInt + (i.abs.toNat : ℤ) = 0 by rw [hab, abs_of_neg hneg]; ring, zpow_zero]
  unfold onePlusDyadic
  cases s with
  | true =>
    simp only [↓reduceIte]
    split_ifs with hsg
    · 
      rw [AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff] at hsg
      have hi' : (i.abs.toNat : ℤ) = i.toInt := by rw [hab, abs_of_nonneg hsg]
      set n := (o <<< i.abs.toNat) + 1 with hn
      have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have := congrArg AzNat.toNat h0
        rw [hn, AzNat.toNat_add, AzNat.toNat_one, AzNat.toNat_zero] at this
        omega
      obtain ⟨hdec, hodd', -⟩ := oddPart_spec n hn0
      refine ⟨hodd', ?_⟩
      rw [toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, zpow_natCast]
      have hnv : (n.toNat : ℝ) = 1 + finiteVal true e m := by
        rw [hval, hn, AzNat.toNat_add, AzNat.toNat_one, toNat_hShiftLeft]
        push_cast
        rw [← hi', zpow_natCast]
        ring
      rw [← hnv, hdec]
      push_cast
      ring
    · 
      rw [AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff] at hsg
      push Not at hsg
      set u := ((1 : AzNat) <<< i.abs.toNat) + o with hu
      have huN : u.toNat = 2 ^ i.abs.toNat + o.toNat := by
        rw [hu, AzNat.toNat_add, toNat_hShiftLeft, AzNat.toNat_one, one_mul]
      have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have := congrArg AzNat.toNat h0
        have h2 : 0 < 2 ^ i.abs.toNat := by positivity
        rw [huN, AzNat.toNat_zero] at this
        omega
      obtain ⟨hdec, hodd', -⟩ := oddPart_spec u hu0
      refine ⟨hodd', ?_⟩
      rw [AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
      apply one_add_eq_of_scaled hdec
      rw [huN, hval]
      push_cast
      linear_combination (-(o.toNat : ℝ)) * hcancel hsg
  | false =>
    
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [finiteVal_false, hval] at hgt
    have hneg : i.toInt < 0 := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ i.toInt := one_le_zpow₀ one_le_two h
      have h2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ o.toNat := by exact_mod_cast ho0
      nlinarith
    have hlt : o.toNat < 2 ^ i.abs.toNat := by
      have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ i.abs.toNat := by positivity
      have : (o.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ i.toInt * 2 ^ i.abs.toNat < 1 * 2 ^ i.abs.toNat :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith) h2
      rw [mul_assoc, hcancel hneg, mul_one, one_mul] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    set u := ((1 : AzNat) <<< i.abs.toNat) - o with hu
    have huN : u.toNat = 2 ^ i.abs.toNat - o.toNat := by
      rw [hu, AzNat.toNat_sub, toNat_hShiftLeft, AzNat.toNat_one, one_mul]
    have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := congrArg AzNat.toNat h0
      rw [huN, AzNat.toNat_zero] at this
      omega
    obtain ⟨hdec, hodd', -⟩ := oddPart_spec u hu0
    refine ⟨hodd', ?_⟩
    rw [AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat,
      finiteVal_false, hval]
    apply one_add_eq_of_scaled hdec
    rw [huN, Nat.cast_sub hlt.le]
    push_cast
    linear_combination (o.toNat : ℝ) * hcancel hneg

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseFloatP1_exact_value
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hodd, hval⟩ := onePlusDyadic_spec s e hv hgt
  rw [finiteVal_eq_oddPart eb hvb] at hb1 ⊢
  rw [hval]
  exact logBaseFloatExact?_some _ _ _ _ hodd
    (oddPart_spec mb (significand_ne_zero_of_valid hvb)).2.1 hb1 r h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_logBaseFloatP1_of_none
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hodd, hval⟩ := onePlusDyadic_spec s e hv hgt
  have hx1 : 1 + finiteVal s e m ≠ 1 := fun h1 => finiteVal_ne_zero s e hv (by linarith)
  rw [finiteVal_eq_oddPart eb hvb] at hb1 ⊢
  rw [hval] at hx1 ⊢
  exact irrational_of_logBaseFloatExact?_none _ _ _ _ hodd
    (oddPart_spec mb (significand_ne_zero_of_valid hvb)).2.1 hb1 hx1 h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.tendsto_logBasePow2Eps
statement:
theorem tendsto_logBasePow2Eps (e : ℤ) (A : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (logBasePow2Eps e A) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hL := tendsto_log2Eps e A
  have hu := tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hA : Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => 2 * A) Filter.atTop (nhds (2 * A)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  have := hL.add (((hA.add hL).const_mul 4).mul hu)
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at this
  exact this

proof:

    (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hA : Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => 2 * A) Filter.atTop (nhds (2 * A)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  have := hL.add (((hA.add hL).const_mul 4).mul hu)
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero {k : AzInt} (hk : k ≠ 0) : k.toInt ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hk
  have hdef : k.toInt = if k.sign then (k.abs.toNat : ℤ) else -(k.abs.toNat : ℤ) := rfl
  rw [hdef] at h
  have habs : k.abs.toNat = 0 := by split_ifs at h <;> omega
  have hzero : k.abs = 0 := AzNat.toNat_injective (by rw [habs, AzNat.toNat_zero])
  have hs : k.sign = true := k.zero_sign hzero
  rcases k with ⟨s, a, hz⟩
  simp only at hs hzero
  subst hs
  subst hzero
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.abs_toNat_cast
statement: theorem abs_toNat_cast (k : AzInt) : ((k.abs.toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) = |(k.toInt : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.cast_abs, ← AzInt.abs_toNat_eq, Int.cast_natCast]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.abs_log_div_log_two_le
statement: theorem abs_log_div_log_two_le (x : ℝ) : |Real.log x / Real.log 2| ≤ 2 * |Real.log x|
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)),
    div_le_iff₀ (Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2))]
  have := Real.log_two_gt_d9
  nlinarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log x)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.divBracketByInt_spec
statement:
theorem divBracketByInt_spec {w : ℕ} [NeZero w] {B : AzFloat × AzFloat} {lo hi L ε : ℝ}
    (hlo : B.1.toVal = some (lo : EReal)) (hhi : B.2.toVal = some (hi : EReal))
    (hlo1 : lo ≤ L) (hhi1 : L ≤ hi) (hwid : hi - lo ≤ ε) (k : AzInt) (hk : k ≠ 0)
    (hirr : Irrational (L / k.toInt)) :
    ∃ lv hv' : ℝ, Rounds (divBracketByInt B k w).1 lv ∧ Rounds (divBracketByInt B k w).2 hv' ∧
      lv < L / k.toInt ∧ L / k.toInt < hv' ∧
      hv' - lv ≤ ε + 4 * (|L| + ε) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:= by
  
  set K := ofAzNat k.abs with hK_def
  have hK : K.toVal = some ((k.abs.toNat : ℝ) : EReal) := toVal_ofAzNat _
  have hkabs : ((k.abs.toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) = |(k.toInt : ℝ)| := abs_toNat_cast k
  have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k.abs.toNat := by
    rw [hkabs]
    have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |k.toInt| := Int.one_le_abs (toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hk)
    rw [← Int.cast_abs]; exact_mod_cast this
  have hKpos : (0 : ℝ) < k.abs.toNat := by linarith
  obtain ⟨lo', hlo', hlo'1, hlo'2⟩ := log2Lower_spec w hlo hK hK hKpos le_rfl le_rfl hlo1
  obtain ⟨hi', hhi', hhi'1, hhi'2⟩ := log2Upper_spec w hhi hK hK hKpos le_rfl le_rfl hhi1
  rw [ite_self] at hlo' hhi'
  simp only [sub_self, mul_zero, sub_zero, add_zero] at hlo'2 hhi'2
  
  have hu : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by positivity
  have hlo_abs : |lo| ≤ |L| + ε := by
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [le_abs_self L, neg_abs_le L]
  have hhi_abs : |hi| ≤ |L| + ε := by
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [le_abs_self L, neg_abs_le L]
  have hwid' : hi' - lo' ≤ ε + 4 * (|L| + ε) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
    have h1 : hi / k.abs.toNat - lo / k.abs.toNat ≤ hi - lo := by
      rw [← sub_div, div_le_iff₀ hKpos]
      nlinarith [sub_nonneg.mpr (hlo1.trans hhi1)]
    have h2 : 2 * (|hi| / k.abs.toNat) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
        + 2 * (|lo| / k.abs.toNat) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
        ≤ 4 * (|L| + ε) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
      have h3 : |hi| / k.abs.toNat ≤ |hi| := div_le_self (abs_nonneg _) hk1
      have h4 : |lo| / k.abs.toNat ≤ |lo| := div_le_self (abs_nonneg _) hk1
      nlinarith
    linarith
  
  unfold divBracketByInt
  simp only []
  rw [← hK_def]
  by_cases hs : k.sign = true
  · have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k.toInt := by
      have h0 := (AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff k).mp hs
      have hne := toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hk
      exact_mod_cast lt_of_le_of_ne h0 (Ne.symm hne)
    have hkK : (k.abs.toNat : ℝ) = k.toInt := by rw [hkabs, abs_of_pos hkpos]
    rw [ite_eq_left hs]
    rw [hkK] at hlo'1 hhi'1
    refine ⟨lo', hi', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hwid'⟩
    · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hlo')
      rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hlo'] at hR; exact hR
    · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hhi')
      rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hhi'] at hR; exact hR
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hlo'
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hlo'1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r (h.symm.trans hr)
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hhi'
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hhi'1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r (h.trans hr)
  · have hkneg : (k.toInt : ℝ) < 0 := by
      have := (AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff k).not.mp hs
      push Not at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hkK : (k.abs.toNat : ℝ) = -k.toInt := by rw [hkabs, abs_of_neg hkneg]
    rw [ite_eq_right hs]
    rw [hkK, div_neg] at hlo'1 hhi'1
    have hnlo : (-(divPrecRound B.2 K w .Ceiling).1).toVal = some ((-hi' : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      rw [toVal_neg, hhi', Option.map_some, EReal.coe_neg]
    have hnhi : (-(divPrecRound B.1 K w .Floor).1).toVal = some ((-lo' : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      rw [toVal_neg, hlo', Option.map_some, EReal.coe_neg]
    refine ⟨-hi', -lo', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, by linarith⟩
    · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hnlo)
      rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hnlo] at hR; exact hR
    · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hnhi)
      rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hnhi] at hR; exact hR
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hnlo
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (by linarith) fun h => hirr.ne_rat r (h.symm.trans hr)
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hnhi
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (by linarith) fun h => hirr.ne_rat r (h.trans hr)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBasePow2Approx_spec
statement:
theorem logBasePow2Approx_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat}
    (hv : FiniteValid q m) (hnp : m.isPowerOfTwo = false) (k : AzInt) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    ∃ lv hv' : ℝ, Rounds (logBasePow2Approx (finite true e q m hv) e k w).1 lv ∧
      Rounds (logBasePow2Approx (finite true e q m hv) e k w).2 hv' ∧
      lv < Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log 2 / k.toInt ∧
      Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log 2 / k.toInt < hv' ∧
      hv' - lv ≤ logBasePow2Eps e.toInt |Real.log (finiteVal true e m)| w
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hirr : Irrational (Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log 2 / k.toInt) := by
    apply Irrational.div_intCast _ (toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hk)
    rw [Real.log_div_log]
    exact irrational_logb_two_finiteVal e m (ne_zero_of_finiteValid e hv)
      (fun h => by rw [← AzNat.isPowerOfTwo_iff] at h; rw [h] at hnp; cases hnp)
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, haL, hLb, hwid⟩ := lnBracket_spec hw e hv
  obtain ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, hwidth⟩ := log2Quotients_spec hw ha hb haL hLb hwid
  obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo', hhi', hw'⟩ :=
    divBracketByInt_spec (w := w) hlo hhi hlo1 hhi1 hwidth k hk hirr
  refine ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo', hhi', hw'.trans ?_⟩
  unfold logBasePow2Eps log2Eps
  have hu : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by positivity
  have := abs_log_div_log_two_le (finiteVal true e m)
  nlinarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBasePow2Approx_isSome_exists
statement:
theorem logBasePow2Approx_isSome_exists (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (e : AzInt)
    {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) (hnp : m.isPowerOfTwo = false) (k : AzInt)
    (hk : k ≠ 0) (w₀ : ℕ) (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) :
    ∃ f : ℕ, (roundingPossible (logBasePow2Approx (finite true e q m hv) e k (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).1
      (logBasePow2Approx (finite true e q m hv) e k (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).2 p mode).isSome = true
proof:
:= by
  have hirr : Irrational (Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log 2 / k.toInt) := by
    apply Irrational.div_intCast _ (toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hk)
    rw [Real.log_div_log]
    exact irrational_logb_two_finiteVal e m (ne_zero_of_finiteValid e hv)
      (fun h => by rw [← AzNat.isPowerOfTwo_iff] at h; rw [h] at hnp; cases hnp)
  exact exists_isSome_of_irrational_threshold p mode (logBasePow2Approx (finite true e q m hv) e k)
    hirr (logBasePow2Eps e.toInt |Real.log (finiteVal true e m)|) (tendsto_logBasePow2Eps _ _) 64
    (fun w hw => by
      obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, hwid⟩ := logBasePow2Approx_spec hw e hv hnp k hk
      exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, hwid⟩) w₀ hw₀

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBasePow2RatApprox_spec
statement:
theorem logBasePow2RatApprox_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) (q : AzRat)
    (hq : (0 : ℚ) < AzRat.toRat q) (hnp : q.isPowerOfTwo = false) (k : AzInt) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    ∃ lv hv' : ℝ, Rounds (logBasePow2RatApprox q k w).1 lv ∧
      Rounds (logBasePow2RatApprox q k w).2 hv' ∧
      lv < Real.logb 2 (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) / k.toInt ∧
      Real.logb 2 (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) / k.toInt < hv' ∧
      hv' - lv ≤ logBasePow2RatEps (⌊2 * |Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|⌋₊ + 2)
        |Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)| w
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hirr : Irrational (Real.logb 2 (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) / k.toInt) :=
    Irrational.div_intCast (irrational_logb_two_toRat q hq hnp) (toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hk)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hr1, hr2⟩ := ofAzRatRound_floor_abs q w
  have hqv0 : (0 : ℝ) < (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
  rw [abs_of_pos hqv0] at hr2
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, haL, hLb, hwid⟩ := lnFloorBracket_spec hw hr hqv0 hr1 hr2
  obtain ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, hwidth⟩ := log2Quotients_spec hw ha hb haL hLb hwid
  rw [Real.log_div_log] at hlo1 hhi1
  obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo', hhi', hw'⟩ :=
    divBracketByInt_spec (w := w) hlo hhi hlo1 hhi1 hwidth k hk hirr
  refine ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo', hhi', hw'.trans ?_⟩
  unfold logBasePow2RatEps log2RatEps
  have hu : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by positivity
  have := abs_log_div_log_two_le (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)
  rw [Real.log_div_log] at this
  nlinarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBasePow2RatApprox_isSome_exists
statement:
theorem logBasePow2RatApprox_isSome_exists (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (q : AzRat)
    (hq : (0 : ℚ) < AzRat.toRat q) (hnp : q.isPowerOfTwo = false) (k : AzInt) (hk : k ≠ 0)
    (w₀ : ℕ) (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) :
    ∃ f : ℕ, (roundingPossible (logBasePow2RatApprox q k (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).1
      (logBasePow2RatApprox q k (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).2 p mode).isSome = true
proof:
:=
  exists_isSome_of_irrational_threshold p mode (logBasePow2RatApprox q k)
    (Irrational.div_intCast (irrational_logb_two_toRat q hq hnp) (toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hk))
    (logBasePow2RatEps (⌊2 * |Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|⌋₊ + 2) |Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|)
    (tendsto_logBasePow2RatEps _ _) 64
    (fun w hw => by
      obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, hwid⟩ := logBasePow2RatApprox_spec hw q hq hnp k hk
      exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, hwid⟩) w₀ hw₀

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBasePow2P1Approx_spec
statement:
theorem logBasePow2P1Approx_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ}
    (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal)) (hx1 : -1 < xv) (k : AzInt) (hk : k ≠ 0)
    (hirr : Irrational (Real.logb 2 (1 + xv) / k.toInt)) :
    ∃ lv hv' : ℝ, Rounds (logBasePow2P1Approx x k w).1 lv ∧
      Rounds (logBasePow2P1Approx x k w).2 hv' ∧
      lv < Real.logb 2 (1 + xv) / k.toInt ∧ Real.logb 2 (1 + xv) / k.toInt < hv' ∧
      hv' - lv ≤ logBasePow2RatEps (⌊2 * |Real.log (1 + xv)|⌋₊ + 2) |Real.log (1 + xv)| w
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hpos : 0 < 1 + xv := by linarith
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hf⟩ := addFloor_err toVal_one' hx w hpos.le
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, haL, hLb, hwid⟩ := lnFloorBracket_spec hw hr hpos hf.le hf.ge
  obtain ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, hwidth⟩ := log2Quotients_spec hw ha hb haL hLb hwid
  rw [Real.log_div_log] at hlo1 hhi1
  obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo', hhi', hw'⟩ :=
    divBracketByInt_spec (w := w) hlo hhi hlo1 hhi1 hwidth k hk hirr
  refine ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo', hhi', hw'.trans ?_⟩
  unfold logBasePow2RatEps log2RatEps
  have hu : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by positivity
  have := abs_log_div_log_two_le (1 + xv)
  rw [Real.log_div_log] at this
  nlinarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBasePow2P1Approx_isSome_exists
statement:
theorem logBasePow2P1Approx_isSome_exists (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode)
    {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal)) (hx1 : -1 < xv) (k : AzInt)
    (hk : k ≠ 0) (hirr : Irrational (Real.logb 2 (1 + xv) / k.toInt)) (w₀ : ℕ) (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) :
    ∃ f : ℕ, (roundingPossible (logBasePow2P1Approx x k (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).1
      (logBasePow2P1Approx x k (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).2 p mode).isSome = true
proof:
:=
  exists_isSome_of_irrational_threshold p mode (logBasePow2P1Approx x k) hirr
    (logBasePow2RatEps (⌊2 * |Real.log (1 + xv)|⌋₊ + 2) |Real.log (1 + xv)|)
    (tendsto_logBasePow2RatEps _ _) 64
    (fun w hw => by
      obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, hwid⟩ := logBasePow2P1Approx_spec hw hx hx1 k hk hirr
      exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, hwid⟩) w₀ hw₀

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseP1Finite_eq
statement:
theorem logBaseP1Finite_eq (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m)
    (hgt : -1 < finiteVal s e m) (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    logBaseP1Finite s e hv hgt b hb p mode
      = roundVal p mode
          (some ((Real.log (1 + finiteVal s e m) / Real.log b.toNat : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < 1 + finiteVal s e m := by linarith
  have hw : NeZero (p + zivGuardBits + leadingZeroBits e) := ⟨by unfold zivGuardBits; omega⟩
  unfold logBaseP1Finite
  split
  · 
    next k hk =>
      have hbk : b.toNat = 2 ^ k := by
        have := (AzNat.checkedLogBase2_eq_some_iff _ k).mp hk
        rwa [AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at this
      split
      · next j hj =>
        rw [ofAzRatRound_eq_roundVal, AzRat.toRat_ofAzInts, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat,
          onePlusPow2Exponent?_some (toVal_finite s e q m hv) _ hj, hbk, log_div_log_two_pow,
          logb_two_zpow]
        push_cast
        rfl
      · next hj =>
        have hirr := irrational_log_div_log_one_add_of_pow2 s e hv hgt b hb hk
          (w := p + zivGuardBits + leadingZeroBits e) (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega) hj
        exact zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode _
          (Real.log (1 + finiteVal s e m) / Real.log b.toNat) _ (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
          (fun w hw => by
            obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
              logBaseP1Approx_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega)
                (toVal_finite s e q m hv) hgt b hb hirr
            exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩) _
  · next hk =>
    split
    · next r hx =>
      obtain ⟨v, hvv, -, hval⟩ :=
        logBaseP1Exact?_some _ _ (by rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat]; exact hb) r hx
      rw [toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at hvv
      rw [ofAzRatRound_eq_roundVal, ← hval, hvv, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
    · next hx =>
      have hirr := AzNat.toNat_ofNat b.toNat ▸
        irrational_of_logBaseP1Exact?_none s e hv (AzNat.ofNat b.toNat)
          (by rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat]; exact hb) (by rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat]; exact b.toBitVec.isLt)
          ((AzNat.checkedLogBase2_eq_none_iff _).mp hk) hgt hx
      exact zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode _
        (Real.log (1 + finiteVal s e m) / Real.log b.toNat) _ (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
        (fun w hw => by
          obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
            logBaseP1Approx_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega)
              (toVal_finite s e q m hv) hgt b hb hirr
          exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩) _

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseP1PrecRound_eq_liftVal
statement:
theorem logBaseP1PrecRound_eq_liftVal (x : AzFloat) (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (p : ℕ)
    [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    logBaseP1PrecRound x b p mode
      = liftVal (fun a => Spec.logBase b.toNat (a + 1)) x p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBaseP1PrecRound liftVal
  rw [dite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr hb)]
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity s =>
    cases s
    · simp only [toVal_infinity, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some, EReal.bot_add,
        Spec.logBase_bot, roundVal_none]
    · simp only [toVal_infinity, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some]
      rw [← EReal.coe_one, EReal.top_add_coe, Spec.logBase_top _ hb, roundVal_top]
  | zero =>
    simp only [toVal_zero, Option.bind_some]
    rw [zero_add, ← EReal.coe_one, Spec.logBase_coe _ hb _ one_pos, Real.log_one, zero_div,
      EReal.coe_zero, roundVal_zero]
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    cases s with
    | true =>
      have hpos := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
      simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      split_ifs with hp
      · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
      rw [← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, Spec.logBase_coe _ hb _ (by linarith),
        add_comm (finiteVal true e m) 1]
      exact logBaseP1Finite_eq true e hv _ b hb p mode
    | false =>
      simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      split_ifs with hneg heq hp
      · obtain ⟨v, hx, h1⟩ := (eqIEEE_iff _ _).mp heq
        rw [toVal_finite] at hx
        rw [toVal_neg_one, ← hx, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at h1
        rw [← h1, ← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, neg_add_cancel, EReal.coe_zero,
          Spec.logBase_zero _ hb, roundVal_bot]
      · have hle := finiteVal_false_le_neg_one e hv hneg
        have hne : finiteVal false e m ≠ -1 := fun h => heq ((eqIEEE_iff _ _).mpr
          ⟨((-1 : ℝ) : EReal), by rw [toVal_finite, h], toVal_neg_one⟩)
        have hlt : finiteVal false e m + 1 < 0 := by
          rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle with h | h
          · linarith
          · exact absurd h hne
        rw [← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, Spec.logBase_coe_neg _ _ hlt, roundVal_none]
      · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
      · have hgt := finiteVal_false_gt_neg_one e hv hneg
        rw [← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, Spec.logBase_coe _ hb _ (by linarith),
          add_comm (finiteVal false e m) 1]
        exact logBaseP1Finite_eq false e hv hgt b hb p mode

name: Azurite.AzFloat.quotientBracket_spec
statement:
theorem quotientBracket_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) {bx cd : AzFloat × AzFloat}
    {a bv c d L M ε δ : ℝ} (ha : bx.1.toVal = some (a : EReal))
    (hb : bx.2.toVal = some (bv : EReal))
    (hc : cd.1.toVal = some (c : EReal)) (hd : cd.2.toVal = some (d : EReal))
    (hc0 : 1 / 2 ≤ c) (hcM : c ≤ M) (hMd : M ≤ d) (hcd : d - c ≤ δ)
    (haL : a ≤ L) (hLb : L ≤ bv) (hwid : bv - a ≤ ε) :
    ∃ lo hi : ℝ, (quotientBracket bx cd w).1.toVal = some (lo : EReal) ∧
      (quotientBracket bx cd w).2.toVal = some (hi : EReal) ∧
      lo ≤ L / M ∧ L / M ≤ hi ∧
      hi - lo ≤ 2 * ε + 8 * (|L| + ε) * (δ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w)
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  set u := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w with hu
  have hu0 : 0 < u := by positivity
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by linarith
  have hM0 : 0 < M := by linarith
  have hd0 : 0 < d := by linarith
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := by linarith
  have hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ := by linarith
  have hLa : L ≤ |L| := le_abs_self L
  have hLa' : -|L| ≤ L := neg_abs_le L
  have habs_a : |a| ≤ |L| + ε := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have habs_b : |bv| ≤ |L| + ε := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hcd' : 1 / c - 1 / d ≤ 4 * δ := by
    rw [div_sub_div _ _ hcpos.ne' hd0.ne', div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have hprod : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / 2) ≤ c * d :=
      mul_le_mul hc0 (by linarith) (by norm_num) hcpos.le
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * δ)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨lo, hlo, hlo1, hlo2⟩ := log2Lower_spec w ha hc hd hcpos hcM hMd haL
  obtain ⟨hi, hhi, hhi1, hhi2⟩ := log2Upper_spec w hb hc hd hcpos hcM hMd hLb
  rw [← hu] at hlo2 hhi2
  have h2a : |a| / c ≤ 2 * |a| := by rw [div_le_iff₀ hcpos]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg a]
  have h2b : |bv| / c ≤ 2 * |bv| := by rw [div_le_iff₀ hcpos]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg bv]
  have h2ab : bv / c - a / c ≤ 2 * (bv - a) := by
    rw [← sub_div, div_le_iff₀ hcpos]; nlinarith
  have hqa : |a| * (1 / c - 1 / d) ≤ |a| * (4 * δ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcd' (abs_nonneg a)
  have hqb : |bv| * (1 / c - 1 / d) ≤ |bv| * (4 * δ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcd' (abs_nonneg bv)
  have hra : 2 * (|a| / c) * u ≤ 2 * (2 * |a|) * u := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2a hu0.le; linarith
  have hrb : 2 * (|bv| / c) * u ≤ 2 * (2 * |bv|) * u := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2b hu0.le; linarith
  have hau : |a| * u ≤ (|L| + ε) * u := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right habs_a hu0.le
  have hbu : |bv| * u ≤ (|L| + ε) * u := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right habs_b hu0.le
  have haδ : |a| * δ ≤ (|L| + ε) * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right habs_a hδ0
  have hbδ : |bv| * δ ≤ (|L| + ε) * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right habs_b hδ0
  exact ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, by nlinarith⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_halfFloat
statement: theorem toVal_halfFloat : halfFloat.toVal = some (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : EReal)
proof:

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_clampHalf
statement:
theorem toVal_clampHalf (z : AzFloat) (v : ℝ) (hz : z.toVal = some (v : EReal)) :
    (clampHalf z).toVal = some ((max v (1 / 2) : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold clampHalf
  rw [partialCompare_eq, hz, toVal_halfFloat]
  simp only [compare_coe_coe, beq_iff_eq, Option.some.injEq]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt] at h
    rw [toVal_halfFloat, max_eq_right h.le]
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt] at h
    push Not at h
    rw [hz, max_eq_left h]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_baseFloat
statement: theorem toVal_baseFloat (b : UInt64) : (baseFloat b).toVal = some ((b.toNat : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold baseFloat

name: Azurite.AzFloat.lnBaseBracket_spec
statement:
theorem lnBaseBracket_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) :
    ∃ c d : ℝ, (lnBaseBracket b w).1.toVal = some (c : EReal) ∧
      (lnBaseBracket b w).2.toVal = some (d : EReal) ∧
      1 / 2 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ Real.log b.toNat ∧ Real.log b.toNat ≤ d ∧
      d - c ≤ lnEps ((baseFloat b).exponent?.getD 0).toInt w
proof:
:= by
  have hval := toVal_baseFloat b
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < b.toNat := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < b.toNat)
  have hlog : 1 / 2 ≤ Real.log b.toNat := by
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ b.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hb
    have := Real.log_two_gt_d9
    have := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) h2
    linarith
  unfold lnBaseBracket
  simp only []
  rcases hy : baseFloat b with _ | s | _ | ⟨s, e, q, m, hv⟩
  · rw [hy] at hval; simp at hval
  · rw [hy] at hval
    simp only [toVal_infinity, Option.some.injEq] at hval
    cases s <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hval
    · exact absurd hval (EReal.bot_ne_coe _)
    · exact absurd hval (EReal.top_ne_coe _)
  · rw [hy] at hval
    simp only [toVal_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hval
    exact absurd (EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp hval.symm) hpos.ne'
  · rw [hy] at hval
    simp only [toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at hval
    cases s with
    | false =>
      exfalso
      rw [finiteVal_false] at hval
      have := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
      linarith
    | true =>
      simp only [exponent?, Option.getD_some]
      obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, hwid⟩ := lnBracket_spec hw e hv
      rw [hval] at hlo hhi
      refine ⟨max lv (1 / 2), hv', toVal_clampHalf _ _ hl, hh, le_max_right _ _,
        max_le hlo hlog, hhi, ?_⟩
      have := le_max_left lv (1 / 2)
      linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.tendsto_logBaseEps
statement:
theorem tendsto_logBaseEps (ex eb : ℤ) (A : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (logBaseEps ex eb A) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hx := tendsto_lnEps ex
  have hb := tendsto_lnEps eb
  have hu := tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hA : Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => A) Filter.atTop (nhds A) := tendsto_const_nhds
  have := (hx.const_mul 2).add (((hA.add hx).const_mul 8).mul (hb.add hu))
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseApprox_spec
statement:
theorem logBaseApprox_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat}
    (hv : FiniteValid q m) (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat)
    (hirr : Irrational (Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log b.toNat)) :
    ∃ lv hv' : ℝ, Rounds (logBaseApprox (finite true e q m hv) e b w).1 lv ∧
      Rounds (logBaseApprox (finite true e q m hv) e b w).2 hv' ∧
      lv < Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log b.toNat ∧
      Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log b.toNat < hv' ∧
      hv' - lv ≤ logBaseEps e.toInt ((baseFloat b).exponent?.getD 0).toInt
        |Real.log (finiteVal true e m)| w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, bv, ha, hb', haL, hLb, hwid⟩ := lnBracket_spec hw e hv
  obtain ⟨c, d, hc, hd, hc0, hcM, hMd, hcd⟩ := lnBaseBracket_spec hw b hb
  obtain ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, hwidth⟩ :=
    quotientBracket_spec hw ha hb' hc hd hc0 hcM hMd hcd haL hLb hwid
  refine ⟨lo, hi, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hwidth⟩
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hlo)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hlo] at hR
    exact hR
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hhi)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hhi] at hR
    exact hR
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hlo
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hlo1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r (h.symm.trans hr)
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hhi
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hhi1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r (h.trans hr)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseApprox_isSome_exists
statement:
theorem logBaseApprox_isSome_exists (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (e : AzInt)
    {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat)
    (hirr : Irrational (Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log b.toNat)) (w₀ : ℕ)
    (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) :
    ∃ f : ℕ, (roundingPossible (logBaseApprox (finite true e q m hv) e b (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).1
      (logBaseApprox (finite true e q m hv) e b (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).2 p mode).isSome = true
proof:
:=
  exists_isSome_of_irrational_threshold p mode (logBaseApprox (finite true e q m hv) e b) hirr
    (logBaseEps e.toInt ((baseFloat b).exponent?.getD 0).toInt |Real.log (finiteVal true e m)|)
    (tendsto_logBaseEps _ _ _) 64
    (fun w hw => by
      obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, hwid⟩ := logBaseApprox_spec hw e hv b hb hirr
      exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, hwid⟩) w₀ hw₀

name: Azurite.AzFloat.tendsto_logBaseRatEps
statement:
theorem tendsto_logBaseRatEps (E : ℕ) (eb : ℤ) (A : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (logBaseRatEps E eb A) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hx := tendsto_lnRatEps E A
  have hb := tendsto_lnEps eb
  have hu := tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hA : Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => A) Filter.atTop (nhds A) := tendsto_const_nhds
  have := (hx.const_mul 2).add (((hA.add hx).const_mul 8).mul (hb.add hu))
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseRatApprox_spec
statement:
theorem logBaseRatApprox_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) (q : AzRat) (hq : (0 : ℚ) < AzRat.toRat q)
    (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat)
    (hirr : Irrational (Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) / Real.log b.toNat)) :
    ∃ lv hv' : ℝ, Rounds (logBaseRatApprox q b w).1 lv ∧ Rounds (logBaseRatApprox q b w).2 hv' ∧
      lv < Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) / Real.log b.toNat ∧
      Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) / Real.log b.toNat < hv' ∧
      hv' - lv ≤ logBaseRatEps (⌊2 * |Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|⌋₊ + 2)
        ((baseFloat b).exponent?.getD 0).toInt |Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)| w
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hr1, hr2⟩ := ofAzRatRound_floor_abs q w
  have hqv0 : (0 : ℝ) < (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
  rw [abs_of_pos hqv0] at hr2
  obtain ⟨a, bv, ha, hb', haL, hLb, hwid⟩ := lnFloorBracket_spec hw hr hqv0 hr1 hr2
  obtain ⟨c, d, hc, hd, hc0, hcM, hMd, hcd⟩ := lnBaseBracket_spec hw b hb
  obtain ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, hwidth⟩ :=
    quotientBracket_spec hw ha hb' hc hd hc0 hcM hMd hcd haL hLb hwid
  refine ⟨lo, hi, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hwidth⟩
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hlo)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hlo] at hR
    exact hR
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hhi)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hhi] at hR
    exact hR
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hlo
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hlo1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r (h.symm.trans hr)
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hhi
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hhi1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r (h.trans hr)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseRatApprox_isSome_exists
statement:
theorem logBaseRatApprox_isSome_exists (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (q : AzRat)
    (hq : (0 : ℚ) < AzRat.toRat q) (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat)
    (hirr : Irrational (Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) / Real.log b.toNat)) (w₀ : ℕ)
    (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) :
    ∃ f : ℕ, (roundingPossible (logBaseRatApprox q b (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).1
      (logBaseRatApprox q b (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).2 p mode).isSome = true
proof:
:=
  exists_isSome_of_irrational_threshold p mode (logBaseRatApprox q b) hirr
    (logBaseRatEps (⌊2 * |Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|⌋₊ + 2)
      ((baseFloat b).exponent?.getD 0).toInt |Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|)
    (tendsto_logBaseRatEps _ _ _) 64
    (fun w hw => by
      obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, hwid⟩ := logBaseRatApprox_spec hw q hq b hb hirr
      exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, hwid⟩) w₀ hw₀

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseP1Approx_spec
statement:
theorem logBaseP1Approx_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ}
    (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal)) (hx1 : -1 < xv) (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat)
    (hirr : Irrational (Real.log (1 + xv) / Real.log b.toNat)) :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, Rounds (logBaseP1Approx x b w).1 lv ∧ Rounds (logBaseP1Approx x b w).2 hv ∧
      lv < Real.log (1 + xv) / Real.log b.toNat ∧ Real.log (1 + xv) / Real.log b.toNat < hv ∧
      hv - lv ≤ logBaseRatEps (⌊2 * |Real.log (1 + xv)|⌋₊ + 2)
        ((baseFloat b).exponent?.getD 0).toInt |Real.log (1 + xv)| w
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hpos : 0 < 1 + xv := by linarith
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hf⟩ := addFloor_err toVal_one' hx w hpos.le
  obtain ⟨a, bv, ha, hb', haL, hLb, hwid⟩ := lnFloorBracket_spec hw hr hpos hf.le hf.ge
  obtain ⟨c, d, hc, hd, hc0, hcM, hMd, hcd⟩ := lnBaseBracket_spec hw b hb
  obtain ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, hwidth⟩ :=
    quotientBracket_spec hw ha hb' hc hd hc0 hcM hMd hcd haL hLb hwid
  refine ⟨lo, hi, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hwidth⟩
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hlo)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hlo] at hR
    exact hR
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hhi)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hhi] at hR
    exact hR
  · obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hlo
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hlo1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r' (h.symm.trans hr')
  · obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hhi
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hhi1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r' (h.trans hr')

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseP1Approx_isSome_exists
statement:
theorem logBaseP1Approx_isSome_exists (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) {x : AzFloat}
    {xv : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal)) (hx1 : -1 < xv) (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat)

    (logBaseRatEps (⌊2 * |Real.log (1 + xv)|⌋₊ + 2) ((baseFloat b).exponent?.getD 0).toInt
      |Real.log (1 + xv)|)
    (tendsto_logBaseRatEps _ _ _) 64
    (fun w hw => by

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log_div_log_two_pow
statement:
theorem log_div_log_two_pow (k : ℕ) (v : ℝ) :
    Real.log v / Real.log ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) = Real.logb 2 v / k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, Real.log_pow, ← Real.log_div_log]
  ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_log_div_log_one_add_of_pow2
proof:
:= by
  have hbk : b.toNat = 2 ^ k := by
    have := (AzNat.checkedLogBase2_eq_some_iff _ k).mp hk
    rwa [AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at this
  have hk1 : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [pow_zero] at hbk
    omega
  rw [hbk, log_div_log_two_pow]
  exact Irrational.div_natCast
    (irrational_logb_two_one_add_of_none (toVal_finite s e q m hv) hw (by linarith) h) hk1

name: Azurite.AzFloat.coe_toRat_eq
statement:
theorem coe_toRat_eq (q : AzRat) :
    (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)
      = (((if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℝ) /
        (q.den.toNat : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rat.cast_def]
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.abs_toRat_lt
statement: theorem abs_toRat_lt (q : AzRat) : |(AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)| < (2 : ℝ) ^ (q.num.size : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzRat.abs_toRat_eq]
  have hden : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast AzRat.den_toNat_pos q
  have hnum : (q.num.toNat : ℝ) < 2 ^ q.num.size := by
    have := Nat.lt_size_self q.num.toNat
    rw [AzNat.size_toNat] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  rw [zpow_natCast]
  calc (q.num.toNat : ℝ) / q.den.toNat ≤ q.num.toNat := div_le_self (by positivity) hden
    _ < _ := hnum

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_eq_int_mul
statement:
theorem finiteVal_eq_int_mul (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) :
    finiteVal s e m
      = (((if s then (m.toNat : ℤ) else -(m.toNat : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℝ) * 2 ^ (e.toInt - m.size)
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteVal
  cases s
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]; ring
  · simp only [↓reduceIte, Int.cast_natCast]; ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.dist_sum_boundary
statement:
theorem dist_sum_boundary (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) (q : AzRat) (b : ℝ) (M k : ℤ)
    (hb : b = M * 2 ^ k) (a : ℕ) (ha : (m.size : ℤ) - e.toInt ≤ a) (hk : -k ≤ a)
    (hne : finiteVal s e m + AzRat.toRat q ≠ b) :
    1 / (q.den.toNat * 2 ^ a) ≤ |finiteVal s e m + AzRat.toRat q - b|
proof:
:= by
  generalize hc : (if s then (m.toNat : ℤ) else -(m.toNat : ℤ)) = c
  generalize hσ : (if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℤ)) = σ
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_int_mul_sub_dyadic c M (e.toInt - m.size) k a (by omega) hk
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < q.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast AzRat.den_toNat_pos q
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < q.den.toNat * 2 ^ a := by positivity
  have h1 : (finiteVal s e m - b) * 2 ^ a = N := by
    rw [finiteVal_eq_int_mul, hc, hb]
    exact hN
  have h2 : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) * q.den.toNat = σ := by
    rw [coe_toRat_eq, hσ]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden.ne'
  apply one_div_le_abs_of_mul_eq_int _ _ hD (σ * 2 ^ a + N * q.den.toNat) _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  push_cast
  linear_combination (q.den.toNat : ℝ) * h1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ a * h2

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toRat_mem_precisionSet_of_dyadic
statement:
theorem toRat_mem_precisionSet_of_dyadic (q : AzRat) (N : ℤ) (a : ℕ)
    (h : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) * 2 ^ a = N) (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] (hw : q.num.size ≤ w) :
    ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ precisionSet 2 w
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : q.num = 0
  · left
    rw [(AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr h0]
    simp
  have hden := AzRat.den_toNat_pos q
  have hnum := AzRat.num_toNat_pos q h0
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime q.num.toNat q.den.toNat := (AzNat.coprime_iff _ _).mp q.reduced
  generalize hσ : (if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℤ)) = σ
  have hσabs : σ.natAbs = q.num.toNat := by
    rw [← hσ]; cases q.sign <;> simp
  have hσ0 : σ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, Int.natAbs_zero] at hσabs
    omega
  
  have hint : σ * 2 ^ a = N * q.den.toNat := by
    have h' := h
    rw [coe_toRat_eq, hσ] at h'
    have hd : (q.den.toNat : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have : (σ : ℝ) * 2 ^ a = N * q.den.toNat := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_iff hd] at h'
      exact h'
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hdvd : q.den.toNat ∣ 2 ^ a * q.num.toNat := by
    have := congrArg Int.natAbs hint
    rw [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_pow, hσabs, Int.natAbs_natCast] at this
    have h2 : Int.natAbs 2 = 2 := rfl
    rw [h2] at this
    exact ⟨N.natAbs, by rw [mul_comm (2 ^ a), this, mul_comm]⟩
  have hdvd2 : q.den.toNat ∣ 2 ^ a := hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hdvd
  obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow Nat.prime_two).mp hdvd2
  right
  refine ⟨σ, -(t : ℤ), hσ0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : (q.num.toNat : ℤ) < 2 ^ q.num.size := by
      have := Nat.lt_size_self q.num.toNat
      rw [AzNat.size_toNat] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    have h2 : (2 : ℤ) ^ q.num.size ≤ 2 ^ w := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hw
    rw [Int.abs_eq_natAbs, hσabs]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h2
  · rw [EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff, coe_toRat_eq, hσ, ht]
    push_cast
    rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.truncErr_le
statement:
theorem truncErr_le (q : AzRat) (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] (lov e₁ : ℝ)
    (hlofl : ((lov : ℝ) : EReal) = (roundFloor (precisionSet 2 w) (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)).val)
    (hlo1 : lov ≤ AzRat.toRat q)
    (hlo5 : e₁ ≠ 0 → ∃ k : ℤ, e₁ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (k - w) ∧ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k - 1) ≤ |lov| ∧
      |lov| < (2 : ℝ) ^ k) :
    e₁ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ ((q.num.size : ℤ) + 1 - w)
proof:
:= by
  have hq_lo : AzRat.toRat q - lov ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ ((q.num.size : ℤ) - w) := by
    rcases eq_or_ne (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) 0 with hq0 | hq0
    · have hmem : ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ precisionSet 2 w := Or.inl (by rw [hq0]; simp)
      have h := val_roundFloor_of_mem (precisionSet 2 w) hmem
      rw [← hlofl] at h
      rw [EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp h]
      simp only [sub_self]
      positivity
    · have h := sub_roundFloor_lt_precScale w (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) hq0 lov hlofl
      have hsc : precScale 2 w (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ ((q.num.size : ℤ) - w) := by
        unfold precScale
        push_cast
        apply zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num)
        have := (Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt (b := 2) (by norm_num) (abs_pos.mpr hq0)).mp
          (by push_cast; exact abs_toRat_lt q)
        omega
      linarith
  have hlov_abs : |lov| < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((q.num.size : ℤ) + 1) := by
    have h1 := abs_toRat_lt q
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((q.num.size : ℤ) - w) ≤ 2 ^ (q.num.size : ℤ) :=
      zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
    have h3 : |lov| ≤ |(AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)| + (AzRat.toRat q - lov) :=
      abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [neg_abs_le (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)],
        by linarith [le_abs_self (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)]⟩
    rw [zpow_add_one₀ (by norm_num)]
    linarith
  rcases eq_or_ne e₁ 0 with h0 | h0
  · rw [h0]; positivity
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hk1, hk2⟩ := hlo5 h0
    have : k - 1 < (q.num.size : ℤ) + 1 :=
      (zpow_lt_zpow_iff_right₀ (by norm_num)).mp (lt_of_le_of_lt hk1 hlov_abs)
    rw [hk]
    exact zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.addRatApprox_spec
statement:
theorem addRatApprox_spec (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (p' : ℕ) (m : AzNat) (hv : FiniteValid p' m)
    (q : AzRat) (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∃ lov e₁ : ℝ,
      ((lov : ℝ) : EReal) = (roundFloor (precisionSet 2 w) (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)).val ∧
      lov ≤ AzRat.toRat q ∧ AzRat.toRat q ≤ lov + e₁ ∧ (lov = AzRat.toRat q → e₁ = 0) ∧
      0 ≤ e₁ ∧
      (e₁ ≠ 0 → ∃ k : ℤ, e₁ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (k - w) ∧ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k - 1) ≤ |lov| ∧
        |lov| < (2 : ℝ) ^ k) ∧
      Rounds (addRatApprox (finite s e p' m hv) q w).1 (finiteVal s e m + lov) ∧
      Rounds (addRatApprox (finite s e p' m hv) q w).2 (finiteVal s e m + lov + e₁)
proof:
:= by
  unfold addRatApprox
  simp only
  rw [ofAzRatRound_eq_roundVal]
  obtain ⟨lov, e₁, hlo, he₁, hlo1, hlo2, hlo3, hlo4, hlo5, hmem⟩ :=
    truncError_spec w (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)
  have hlofl : ((lov : ℝ) : EReal) = (roundFloor (precisionSet 2 w) (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)).val := by
    rw [fst_roundVal] at hlo
    change (ofEReal w .Floor (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)).toVal = _ at hlo
    have h := (ofEReal_spec w .Floor (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)).2
    rw [val_round_floatSet] at h
    rw [h, Option.some.injEq] at hlo
    exact hlo.symm
  
  have hhi : (addPrecRound (roundVal w .Floor (some ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal))).1
      (truncError (roundVal w .Floor (some ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal)))) w .Ceiling).1.toVal
      = some ((lov + e₁ : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [addPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂]
    unfold liftVal₂
    rw [hlo, he₁, Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some, Spec.add_coe_coe, fst_roundVal]
    change (ofEReal w .Ceiling ((lov + e₁ : ℝ) : EReal)).toVal = _
    rw [(ofEReal_spec w .Ceiling (lov + e₁)).2, val_round_of_mem _ .Ceiling hmem]
  refine ⟨lov, e₁, hlofl, hlo1, hlo2, hlo3, hlo4, hlo5, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p'' _ mo
    beta_reduce
    rw [addPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂ (finite s e p' m hv)]
    unfold liftVal₂
    rw [toVal_finite, hlo, Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some, Spec.add_coe_coe]
  · intro p'' _ mo
    beta_reduce
    rw [addPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂ (finite s e p' m hv)]
    unfold liftVal₂
    rw [toVal_finite, hhi, Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some, Spec.add_coe_coe, add_assoc]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.addRatApprox_possible
statement:
theorem addRatApprox_possible (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (p' : ℕ) (m : AzNat) (hv : FiniteValid p' m)
    (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (w : ℕ)
    (hw : p + q.num.size + 2 * q.den.size + m.size + e.abs.toNat + 2 ≤ w) :
    (roundingPossible (addRatApprox (finite s e p' m hv) q w).1
      (addRatApprox (finite s e p' m hv) q w).2 p mode).isSome = true
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨lov, e₁, hlofl, hlo1, hlo2, hlo3, hlo4, hlo5, hl, hh⟩ :=
    addRatApprox_spec s e p' m hv q w
  set xv := finiteVal s e m with hxv
  set v := xv + AzRat.toRat q with hvdef
  apply roundingPossible_isSome_of_no_boundary p mode hl hh (by linarith)
  have hden_pos := AzRat.den_toNat_pos q
  have hden_lt : q.den.toNat < 2 ^ q.den.size := by
    have := Nat.lt_size_self q.den.toNat
    rwa [AzNat.size_toNat] at this
  have habs_e : (e.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |e.toInt| := (AzInt.abs_toInt e).symm
  set a₀ : ℕ := m.size + e.abs.toNat with ha₀def
  have ha₀ : (m.size : ℤ) - e.toInt ≤ a₀ := by
    have := neg_abs_le e.toInt
    push_cast [ha₀def]
    omega
  by_cases hvB : ((v : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ floatSet (p + 1)
  · 
    obtain ⟨M, k, hMk⟩ : ∃ M k : ℤ, v = M * 2 ^ k := by
      rcases eq_or_ne v 0 with hv0 | hv0
      · exact ⟨0, 0, by simp [hv0]⟩
      · obtain ⟨M, k, hMk, _⟩ := boundary_repr p v hvB hv0
        exact ⟨M, k, hMk⟩
    set a : ℕ := (max ((m.size : ℤ) - e.toInt) (-k)).toNat with hadef
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_int_mul_sub_dyadic M (if s then (m.toNat : ℤ) else -(m.toNat : ℤ))
      k (e.toInt - m.size) a
      (by have := Int.self_le_toNat (max ((m.size : ℤ) - e.toInt) (-k)); omega)
      (by have := Int.self_le_toNat (max ((m.size : ℤ) - e.toInt) (-k)); omega)
    have hq : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) * 2 ^ a = N := by
      rw [← hN, ← finiteVal_eq_int_mul, ← hMk]
      ring
    have hqmem := toRat_mem_precisionSet_of_dyadic q N a hq w (by omega)
    have hlo_exact : lov = AzRat.toRat q := by
      have := val_roundFloor_of_mem (precisionSet 2 w) hqmem
      rw [← hlofl] at this
      exact EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp this
    rw [hlo3 hlo_exact, add_zero]
    intro b _ ⟨h1, h2⟩
    linarith
  · 
    have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := fun h => hvB (by rw [h]; exact ⟨zero, Or.inr rfl, by simp⟩)
    have hv_lower : 1 / (q.den.toNat * 2 ^ a₀) ≤ |v| := by
      have := dist_sum_boundary s e m q 0 0 0 (by simp) a₀ ha₀ (by simp) (by simpa using hv0)
      simpa using this
    have hLlow := neg_le_log_of_one_div_le v hv0 _ hden_pos _ hden_lt a₀ hv_lower
    set a : ℕ := p + a₀ + q.den.size with hadef
    have hdist : ∀ b : ℝ, ((b : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ floatSet (p + 1) → b ≠ v →
        (b = 0 ∨ Int.log 2 |v| ≤ Int.log 2 |b|) → 1 / (q.den.toNat * 2 ^ a) ≤ |v - b| := by
      intro b hb hne hlog
      obtain ⟨M, k, hMk, hk⟩ : ∃ M k : ℤ, b = M * 2 ^ k ∧ -k ≤ a := by
        rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with hb0 | hb0
        · exact ⟨0, 0, by simp [hb0], by simp⟩
        · obtain ⟨M, k, hMk, hk⟩ := boundary_repr p b hb hb0
          refine ⟨M, k, hMk, ?_⟩
          rcases hlog with h | h
          · exact absurd h hb0
          · push_cast [hadef]
            omega
      exact dist_sum_boundary s e m q b M k hMk a (by push_cast [hadef]; omega) hk
        (fun h => hne h.symm)
    have he₁ := truncErr_le q w lov e₁ hlofl hlo1 hlo5
    have hgap : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((q.num.size : ℤ) + 1 - w) ≤ 2 ^ (-(q.den.size : ℤ) - a) := by
      apply zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num)
      push_cast [hadef, ha₀def]
      omega
    have hwidth : xv + lov + e₁ - (xv + lov) < 1 / (q.den.toNat * 2 ^ a) := by
      have := two_zpow_lt_one_div _ hden_pos _ hden_lt a
      linarith
    exact no_boundary_of_dist p v (xv + lov) (xv + lov + e₁) _ hv0 hvB (by linarith) (by linarith)
      hdist hwidth

name: Azurite.AzFloat.addRatBound_le
statement:
theorem addRatBound_le (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (p' : ℕ) (m : AzNat) (hv : FiniteValid p' m)
    (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) :
    p + q.num.size + 2 * q.den.size + m.size + e.abs.toNat + 2
      ≤ zivStart q p * 2 ^ addRatFuel (finite s e p' m hv) q p
proof:
:= by
  set A := p + q.num.size + 2 * q.den.size + m.size + 2 with hA
  have hA' : A < 2 ^ zivFuel A := by
    have := le_mul_two_pow_zivFuel A 1 one_pos
    have h2 : A ≠ 2 ^ zivFuel A := by
      unfold zivFuel
      have h3 : (AzNat.ofNat A).size = A.size := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
      rw [h3]
      exact (Nat.lt_size_self A).ne
    omega
  have he : e.abs.toNat < 2 ^ e.abs.size := by
    have := Nat.lt_size_self e.abs.toNat
    rwa [AzNat.size_toNat] at this
  have hstart : 1 ≤ zivStart q p := by
    simp only [zivStart, zivGuardBits]; split_ifs <;> omega
  have hW : p + q.num.size + 2 * q.den.size + m.size + e.abs.toNat + 2 = A + e.abs.toNat := by
    omega
  rw [hW]
  show A + e.abs.toNat ≤ zivStart q p * 2 ^ (zivFuel A + e.abs.size + 1)
  have h1 : 2 ^ zivFuel A ≤ 2 ^ (zivFuel A + e.abs.size) :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have h2 : 2 ^ e.abs.size ≤ 2 ^ (zivFuel A + e.abs.size) :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have h3 : 2 ^ (zivFuel A + e.abs.size + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ (zivFuel A + e.abs.size) := by
    rw [pow_succ]; ring
  calc A + e.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ zivFuel A + 2 ^ e.abs.size := by omega
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (zivFuel A + e.abs.size + 1) := by omega
    _ ≤ zivStart q p * 2 ^ (zivFuel A + e.abs.size + 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hstart

name: Azurite.AzFloat.addRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal
statement:
theorem addRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal (x : AzFloat) (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    addRatPrecRound x q p mode
      = liftVal (fun a => Spec.add a ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal)) x p mode
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity s =>
    cases s <;> simp [addRatPrecRound, liftVal, Spec.add]
  | zero =>
    show ofAzRatRound q p mode = _
    unfold liftVal
    rw [toVal_zero, Option.bind_some, Spec.add_zero_left, ofAzRatRound_eq_roundVal]
  | finite s e p' m hv =>
    show zivLoop _ p mode _ _ = _
    unfold liftVal
    rw [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some, Spec.add_coe_coe]
    apply zivLoop_eq p mode _ (finiteVal s e m + AzRat.toRat q) ?_
      (p + q.num.size + 2 * q.den.size + m.size + e.abs.toNat + 2) ?_ _ _ ?_
      (addRatBound_le s e p' m hv q p)
    · intro w hw
      have : NeZero w := ⟨hw.ne'⟩
      obtain ⟨lov, e₁, _, hlo1, hlo2, hlo3, _, _, hl, hh⟩ := addRatApprox_spec s e p' m hv q w
      refine ⟨_, _, hl, hh, by linarith, by linarith, ?_⟩
      intro h
      have h1 : lov = AzRat.toRat q := by linarith
      rw [hlo3 h1, add_zero, h1]
    · intro w hw
      exact addRatApprox_possible s e p' m hv q p mode w hw
    · simp only [zivStart, zivGuardBits]
      split_ifs <;> omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.coe_toRat_neg
statement:
theorem coe_toRat_neg (q : AzRat) :
    ((AzRat.toRat (-q) : ℝ) : EReal) = -((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzRat.toRat_neg]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.subRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal
statement:
theorem subRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal (x : AzFloat) (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    subRatPrecRound x q p mode
      = liftVal (fun a => Spec.sub a ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal)) x p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold subRatPrecRound
  rw [addRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal, coe_toRat_neg]
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ratSubPrecRound_eq_liftVal
statement:
theorem ratSubPrecRound_eq_liftVal (q : AzRat) (x : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    ratSubPrecRound q x p mode
      = liftVal (fun a => Spec.sub ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal) a) x p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold ratSubPrecRound
  rw [addRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal]
  unfold liftVal
  rw [toVal_neg]
  cases x.toVal with
  | none => rfl
  | some a =>
    simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]
    unfold Spec.sub Spec.add
    congr 1
    rw [add_comm]
    by_cases h1 : a = ⊤
    · subst h1; simp
    · by_cases h2 : a = ⊥
      · subst h2; simp
      · simp [h1, h2, EReal.neg_eq_top_iff, EReal.neg_eq_bot_iff]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.mul_coe_coe
statement: theorem mul_coe_coe (x y : ℝ) : mul (x : EReal) (y : EReal) = some ((x * y : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mul
  rw [ite_eq_right (by simp), EReal.coe_mul]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.mul_inf_coe
statement:
theorem mul_inf_coe (s : Bool) (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    mul (if s then ⊤ else ⊥) (r : EReal) = some (if (s == decide (0 < r)) then ⊤ else ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mul
  rw [ite_eq_right (by cases s <;> simp [EReal.top_ne_zero, EReal.bot_ne_zero, hr])]
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hr with h | h
  · rw [decide_eq_false (not_lt.mpr h.le)]
    cases s
    · simp [EReal.bot_mul_coe_of_neg h]
    · simp [EReal.top_mul_coe_of_neg h]
  · rw [decide_eq_true h]
    cases s
    · simp [EReal.bot_mul_coe_of_pos h]
    · simp [EReal.top_mul_coe_of_pos h]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.mul_coe_inf
statement:
theorem mul_coe_inf (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (t : Bool) :
    mul (r : EReal) (if t then ⊤ else ⊥) = some (if (decide (0 < r) == t) then ⊤ else ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mul
  rw [ite_eq_right (by cases t <;> simp [EReal.top_ne_zero, EReal.bot_ne_zero, hr])]
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hr with h | h
  · rw [decide_eq_false (not_lt.mpr h.le)]
    cases t
    · simp [EReal.coe_mul_bot_of_neg h]
    · simp [EReal.coe_mul_top_of_neg h]
  · rw [decide_eq_true h]
    cases t
    · simp [EReal.coe_mul_bot_of_pos h]
    · simp [EReal.coe_mul_top_of_pos h]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.signed_mul
statement:
theorem signed_mul (s t : Bool) :
    (if s then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (if t then 1 else -1) = if (s == t) then 1 else -1
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> cases t <;> simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.mul_cores_scaled
statement:
theorem mul_cores_scaled (e₁ : AzInt) {p₁ : ℕ} {m₁ : AzNat} (h₁ : FiniteValid p₁ m₁) (e₂ : AzInt)
    {p₂ : ℕ} {m₂ : AzNat} (h₂ : FiniteValid p₂ m₂) :
    (((coreSignificand p₁ m₁ * coreSignificand p₂ m₂).toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (e₁ - (AzNat.ofNat p₁).toAzInt + (e₂ - (AzNat.ofNat p₂).toAzInt)).toInt
      = finiteVal true e₁ (coreSignificand p₁ m₁) * finiteVal true e₂ (coreSignificand p₂ m₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzInt.toInt_add, AzInt.toInt_sub, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, toInt_toAzInt,
    AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_mul, finiteVal_true_eq, finiteVal_true_eq,
    size_coreSignificand h₁, size_coreSignificand h₂, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.mulPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂
statement:
theorem mulPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂ (x y : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    mulPrecRound x y p mode = liftVal₂ Spec.mul x y p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold liftVal₂
  cases x with
  | nan => cases y <;> rfl
  | infinity s =>
    cases y with
    | nan => rfl
    | infinity t =>
      cases s <;> cases t <;>
        simp [mulPrecRound, Spec.mul, EReal.top_ne_zero, EReal.bot_ne_zero]
    | zero => cases s <;> simp [mulPrecRound, Spec.mul]
    | finite t e q m hv =>
      simp only [mulPrecRound, toVal_infinity, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      rw [Spec.mul_inf_coe s _ (by
          rw [finiteVal_eq_core t e hv]
          exact finiteVal_ne_zero' t e _ (coreSignificand_ne_zero hv)),
        finiteVal_eq_core t e hv, decide_pos_finiteVal t e _ (coreSignificand_ne_zero hv),
        roundVal_inf]
  | zero =>
    cases y with
    | nan => rfl
    | infinity t => cases t <;> simp [mulPrecRound, Spec.mul]
    | zero => simp [mulPrecRound, Spec.mul, EReal.zero_ne_top, EReal.zero_ne_bot]
    | finite t e q m hv => simp [mulPrecRound, Spec.mul, EReal.zero_ne_top, EReal.zero_ne_bot]
  | finite s e₁ p₁ m₁ h₁ =>
    cases y with
    | nan => rfl
    | infinity t =>
      simp only [mulPrecRound, toVal_infinity, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      rw [Spec.mul_coe_inf _ (by
          rw [finiteVal_eq_core s e₁ h₁]
          exact finiteVal_ne_zero' s e₁ _ (coreSignificand_ne_zero h₁)) t,
        finiteVal_eq_core s e₁ h₁, decide_pos_finiteVal s e₁ _ (coreSignificand_ne_zero h₁),
        roundVal_inf]
    | zero => simp [mulPrecRound, Spec.mul, EReal.zero_ne_top, EReal.zero_ne_bot]
    | finite t e₂ p₂ m₂ h₂ =>
      simp only [mulPrecRound, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some, Spec.mul_coe_coe]
      rw [roundScaled_eq_roundVal, mul_assoc, mul_cores_scaled e₁ h₁ e₂ h₂,
        finiteVal_eq_core s e₁ h₁, finiteVal_eq_core t e₂ h₂, finiteVal_sign s e₁,
        finiteVal_sign t e₂, ← signed_mul, mul_mul_mul_comm]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sqrPrecRound_eq_liftE
statement:
theorem sqrPrecRound_eq_liftE (x : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    sqrPrecRound x p mode = liftE (fun v => v * v) x p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold liftE liftVal
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity s => cases s <;> simp [sqrPrecRound]
  | zero => simp [sqrPrecRound]
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    simp only [sqrPrecRound, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some, ← EReal.coe_mul]
    have hS : (((AzNat.square (coreSignificand q m)).toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (e - (AzNat.ofNat q).toAzInt + (e - (AzNat.ofNat q).toAzInt)).toInt
        = finiteVal s e m * finiteVal s e m := by
      rw [AzInt.toInt_add, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_square,
        finiteVal_eq_core s e hv, finiteVal_sign s e, finiteVal_true_eq, size_coreSignificand hv,
        zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
      push_cast
      cases s <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] <;> ring
    rw [roundScaled_eq_roundVal, ite_eq_left rfl, one_mul, hS]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_nan

proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_infinity

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_finite

@[simp] theorem toVal_finite (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (p : ℕ) (m : AzNat)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_eq_aligned
statement:
theorem finiteVal_eq_aligned (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (h : FiniteValid p m) :
    finiteVal s e m
      = (if s then 1 else -1) * (m.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - alignedBits p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteVal
  rw [h.size_eq]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero {m : AzNat} (hm : m ≠ 0) : m.toNat ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h => hm (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm))

name: Azurite.AzFloat.size_pos_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem size_pos_of_ne_zero {m : AzNat} (hm : m ≠ 0) : 0 < m.size
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AzNat.size_toNat]
  exact Nat.size_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hm))

name: Azurite.AzFloat.size_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem size_zero : (0 : AzNat).size = 0
proof:
:= by

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ne_zero_of_size_pos
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_size_pos {m : AzNat} (h : 0 < m.size) : m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  simp at h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_shiftLeft
statement:
theorem finiteVal_shiftLeft (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) (hm : m ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    finiteVal s e (m.shiftLeft k) = finiteVal s e m
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteVal
  have hm0 := toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hm
  have hsize : (m.shiftLeft k).size = m.size + k := by
    rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft, ← Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.size_shiftLeft hm0,
      AzNat.size_toNat]
  rw [hsize, AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft]
  push_cast
  rw [show e.toInt - ((m.size : ℤ) + k) = (e.toInt - m.size) - k by ring,
    zpow_sub₀ (by norm_num), zpow_natCast]
  field_simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_mkFinite
statement:
theorem toVal_mkFinite (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (p : ℕ) (m : AzNat) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    toVal (mkFinite s e p m) = some ((finiteVal s e m : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mkFinite
  rw [dite_eq_right hm]
  simp only [toVal, finiteVal_shiftLeft s e m hm]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.mkFinite_zero
