name: Azurite.AzFloat.AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff
statement: theorem AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff (z : AzInt) : z.sign = true ↔ 0 ≤ z.toInt
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzInt.toInt
  cases hz : z.sign
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, false_iff, not_le, Left.neg_neg_iff, Nat.cast_pos]
    have : z.abs ≠ 0 := fun h => by have := z.zero_sign h; rw [hz] at this; cases this
    exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero this)
  · simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.AzInt.mkNorm_sign_abs
statement: theorem AzInt.mkNorm_sign_abs (z : AzInt) (h : z.abs ≠ 0) : AzInt.mkNorm z.sign z.abs = z
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzInt.mkNorm
  rw [dite_eq_right h]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.AzInt.abs_toNat_eq
statement: theorem AzInt.abs_toNat_eq (z : AzInt) : (z.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |z.toInt|
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzInt.toInt; cases z.sign <;> simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_not
statement:
theorem finiteVal_not (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) :
    finiteVal (!s) e m = -finiteVal s e m
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteVal
  cases s <;> simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_neg
statement: theorem toVal_neg (x : AzFloat) : toVal (-x) = (toVal x).map fun v => -v
proof:
:= by
  show toVal x.neg = _
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity s => cases s <;> simp [neg, toVal]
  | zero => simp [neg, toVal]
  | finite s e p m h => simp [neg, toVal, finiteVal_not]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_true_eq_abs
statement:
theorem finiteVal_true_eq_abs (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) :
    finiteVal true e m = |finiteVal s e m|
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteVal
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - m.size) := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  cases s
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, one_mul, neg_mul, abs_neg]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  · simp only [↓reduceIte, one_mul]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_abs
statement: theorem toVal_abs (x : AzFloat) : toVal x.abs = (toVal x).map fun v => max v (-v)
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity s => cases s <;> simp [abs, toVal]
  | zero => simp [abs, toVal]
  | finite s e p m h =>
    simp only [abs, toVal, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
    rw [finiteVal_true_eq_abs s, abs_eq_max_neg, EReal.coe_strictMono.monotone.map_max,
      EReal.coe_neg]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toNat_eq_core_mul
statement:
theorem toNat_eq_core_mul {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid p m) :
    m.toNat = (coreSignificand p m).toNat * 2 ^ (alignedBits p - p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold coreSignificand
  rw [AzNat.toNat_shiftRight]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hv.dvd
  rw [hc, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (Nat.two_pow_pos _), mul_comm]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.size_coreSignificand
statement:
theorem size_coreSignificand {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid p m) :
    (coreSignificand p m).size = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := toNat_bounds_of_valid hv
  have hm := toNat_eq_core_mul hv
  have hB := le_alignedBits p
  have hp := hv.pos
  have hsplit : (2 : ℕ) ^ alignedBits p = 2 ^ p * 2 ^ (alignedBits p - p) := by
    rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  have hsplit' : (2 : ℕ) ^ (alignedBits p - 1) = 2 ^ (p - 1) * 2 ^ (alignedBits p - p) := by
    rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  rw [← AzNat.size_toNat]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Nat.size_le]
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have : 2 ^ p * 2 ^ (alignedBits p - p) ≤ m.toNat := by
      rw [hm]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h
    omega
  · have h : 2 ^ (p - 1) ≤ (coreSignificand p m).toNat := by
      rw [hsplit', hm] at hlo
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hlo (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
    have := Nat.lt_size.mpr h
    omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.coreSignificand_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coreSignificand_ne_zero {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid p m) :
    coreSignificand p m ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ne_zero_of_size_pos (by rw [size_coreSignificand hv]; exact hv.pos)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_eq_core
statement:
theorem finiteVal_eq_core (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid p m) :
    finiteVal s e m = finiteVal s e (coreSignificand p m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteVal_eq_aligned s e hv]
  unfold finiteVal
  rw [size_coreSignificand hv, toNat_eq_core_mul hv]
  have hB := le_alignedBits p
  push_cast
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) ^ (alignedBits p - p : ℕ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((alignedBits p : ℤ) - p) by
    rw [← zpow_natCast]; congr 1; rw [Nat.cast_sub hB]]
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - p)
      = 2 ^ ((alignedBits p : ℤ) - p) * 2 ^ (e.toInt - alignedBits p) := by
    rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]; congr 1; ring
  rw [h2]
  ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log_abs_finiteVal
statement:
theorem log_abs_finiteVal (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid p m) :
    Int.log 2 |finiteVal s e m| = e.toInt - 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_finiteVal_bounds s e hv
  have hpos : 0 < |finiteVal s e m| := lt_of_lt_of_le (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _) hlo
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h := (Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt (b := 2) (by norm_num) hpos).mp (by simpa using hhi)
    omega
  · exact (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log (b := 2) (by norm_num) hpos).mp (by simpa using hlo)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_ne_zero
statement:
theorem finiteVal_ne_zero (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid p m) :
    finiteVal s e m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := (abs_finiteVal_bounds s e hv).1
  rw [h, abs_zero] at this
  exact absurd this (not_le.mpr (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _))

name: Azurite.AzFloat.precScale_finiteVal
statement:
theorem precScale_finiteVal (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m)
    (p : ℕ) : precScale 2 p (finiteVal s e m) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold precScale
  rw [log_abs_finiteVal s e hv]
  push_cast
  congr 1
  ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.abs_toInt_round_bounds
statement:
theorem abs_toInt_round_bounds (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (mode : RoundingMode) (y : ℝ)
    (hlo : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ |y|) (hhi : |y| < (2 : ℝ) ^ (p : ℤ)) :
    ((2 ^ (p - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ |toInt (round intSet mode y)| ∧
      |toInt (round intSet mode y)| ≤ ((2 ^ p : ℕ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hlo' : (((2 ^ (p - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ |y| := by
    push_cast; rw [← zpow_natCast, Nat.cast_sub hp]; simpa using hlo
  have hhi' : |y| < (((2 ^ p : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    push_cast; rw [← zpow_natCast]; exact hhi
  obtain ⟨hf1, hc1⟩ := le_abs_floor_ceil y _ (by positivity) hlo'
  obtain ⟨hf2, hc2⟩ := AzRat.floor_ceil_abs_le y _ hhi'
  rcases AzRat.toInt_round_intSet_eq_floor_or_ceil mode y with h | h <;> rw [h]
  · exact ⟨hf1, hf2⟩
  · exact ⟨hc1, hc2⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.normalize_spec
statement:
theorem normalize_spec (r : AzInt) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (e : AzInt)
    (hlo : 2 ^ (p - 1) ≤ r.abs.toNat) (hhi : r.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ p) :
    (if r.abs.size = p + 1 then mkFinite r.sign (e + 1) p (r.abs.shiftRight 1)
      else mkFinite r.sign e p r.abs).toVal
        = some (((r.toInt : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - p) : ℝ) : EReal) ∧
    (if r.abs.size = p + 1 then mkFinite r.sign (e + 1) p (r.abs.shiftRight 1)
      else mkFinite r.sign e p r.abs).precision? = some p
proof:
:= by
  have hsign : (r.toInt : ℝ) = (if r.sign then 1 else -1) * (r.abs.toNat : ℝ) := by
    unfold AzInt.toInt; cases r.sign <;> simp
  by_cases hsz : r.abs.size = p + 1
  · rw [ite_eq_left hsz]
    have hge : 2 ^ p ≤ r.abs.toNat := by
      rw [← Nat.lt_size, AzNat.size_toNat, hsz]; omega
    have hn : r.abs.toNat = 2 ^ p := le_antisymm hhi hge
    have hhalf : (r.abs.shiftRight 1).toNat = 2 ^ (p - 1) := by
      rw [AzNat.toNat_shiftRight, hn, pow_one, Nat.pow_div hp (by norm_num)]
    have hhalf_size : (r.abs.shiftRight 1).size = p := by
      rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, hhalf, Nat.size_pow]; omega
    have hne : r.abs.shiftRight 1 ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_size_pos (hhalf_size ▸ hp)
    refine ⟨?_, precision?_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hne hhalf_size.le⟩
    rw [toVal_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hne]
    congr 2
    unfold finiteVal
    rw [hhalf_size, hhalf, AzInt.toInt_add, hsign, hn, show (1 : AzInt).toInt = 1 from rfl]
    push_cast
    rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_natCast, Nat.cast_sub hp]
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num), ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
    congr 2
    push_cast
    ring
  · rw [ite_eq_right hsz]
    have hsize : r.abs.size = p := by
      have h1 : r.abs.size ≤ p + 1 := by
        rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, Nat.size_le]
        calc r.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ p := hhi
          _ < 2 ^ (p + 1) := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
      have h2 : p ≤ r.abs.size := by
        rw [← AzNat.size_toNat]
        have := Nat.lt_size.mpr hlo
        omega
      omega
    have hne : r.abs ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_size_pos (hsize ▸ hp)
    refine ⟨?_, precision?_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hne hsize.le⟩
    rw [toVal_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hne]
    congr 2
    unfold finiteVal
    rw [hsize, hsign]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.compare_coe_coe
statement: theorem compare_coe_coe (a b : ℝ) : compare (a : EReal) (b : EReal) = compare a b
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a b with h | h | h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr h)]
  · rw [h, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl]
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr h)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.compare_mul_right_pos
statement: theorem compare_mul_right_pos (a b c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) : compare (a * c) (b * c) = compare a b
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a b with h | h | h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h hc)]
  · rw [h, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl]
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h hc)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.setPrecRound_eq_liftE
statement:
theorem setPrecRound_eq_liftE (x : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    setPrecRound x p mode = liftE id x p mode
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  cases x with
  | nan => unfold setPrecRound; rw [ite_eq_right hp.ne']; rfl
  | infinity s =>
    unfold setPrecRound
    rw [ite_eq_right hp.ne']
    exact (roundVal_of_toVal p mode (infinity s) _ (Or.inr rfl) rfl).symm
  | zero =>
    unfold setPrecRound
    rw [ite_eq_right hp.ne']
    exact (roundVal_of_toVal p mode zero _ (Or.inr rfl) rfl).symm
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    unfold setPrecRound
    rw [ite_eq_right hp.ne']
    simp only []
    set n := coreSignificand q m with hn_def
    have hn_size : n.size = q := size_coreSignificand hv
    have hn : n ≠ 0 := coreSignificand_ne_zero hv
    have hval : finiteVal s e m = finiteVal s e n := finiteVal_eq_core s e hv
    show _ = roundVal p mode (some ((finiteVal s e m : ℝ) : EReal))
    by_cases hqp : q ≤ p
    · rw [ite_eq_left hqp]
      symm
      refine roundVal_of_toVal p mode _ _ (Or.inl (precision?_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hn ?_)) ?_
      · rw [hn_size]; exact hqp
      · rw [toVal_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hn, hval]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hqp]
      have hqp' : p < q := not_le.mp hqp
      have hv0 : finiteVal s e m ≠ 0 := finiteVal_ne_zero s e hv
      set u : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - p) with hu_def
      have hu : 0 < u := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
      have hscale : precScale 2 p (finiteVal s e m) = u := precScale_finiteVal s e hv p
      have hz : ((AzInt.mkNorm s n).toInt : ℝ) = (if s then 1 else -1) * (n.toNat : ℝ) := by
        rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true s with hs | hs <;>
          simp [hs, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_false n hn]
      have hvu : finiteVal s e m / u = ((AzInt.mkNorm s n).toInt : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (q - p) := by
        rw [hval, hz]
        unfold finiteVal
        rw [hn_size, hu_def]
        have h : (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - q) / 2 ^ (e.toInt - p) = 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (q - p) := by
          rw [div_eq_div_iff (zpow_ne_zero _ two_ne_zero) (pow_ne_zero _ two_ne_zero), one_mul,
            ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ two_ne_zero]
          congr 1
          rw [Nat.cast_sub hqp'.le]
          ring
        rw [mul_div_assoc, h]
        ring
      set v := finiteVal s e m with hv_def
      set r := AzInt.shiftRightRound (AzInt.mkNorm s n) mode (q - p) with hr_def
      have hr := AzInt.toInt_shiftRightRound (AzInt.mkNorm s n) mode (q - p)
      rw [← hvu, ← hr_def] at hr
      have hrI : toInt (round intSet mode (v / u)) = r.1.toInt := toInt_eq_of_val hr
      have hround : (round (floatSet p) mode v).val = (((r.1.toInt : ℝ) * u : ℝ) : EReal) := by
        rw [val_round_floatSet, val_round_precisionSet mode v hv0, hscale, hrI]
      
      obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_div_precScale_bounds (b := 2) (p := p) v hv0
      rw [hscale] at hlo hhi
      obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := abs_toInt_round_bounds p hp mode (v / u) (by simpa using hlo)
        (by simpa using hhi)
      rw [hrI] at hb1 hb2
      have habs : (r.1.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |r.1.toInt| := by
        unfold AzInt.toInt; cases r.1.sign <;> simp
      have hlo' : 2 ^ (p - 1) ≤ r.1.abs.toNat := by
        have : ((2 ^ (p - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (r.1.abs.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [habs]; exact hb1
        exact_mod_cast this
      have hhi' : r.1.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ p := by
        have : (r.1.abs.toNat : ℤ) ≤ ((2 ^ p : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [habs]; exact hb2
        exact_mod_cast this
      obtain ⟨hRval, hRprec⟩ := normalize_spec r.1 p hp e hlo' hhi'
      have hR : (if r.1.abs.size = p + 1 then
            (mkFinite r.1.sign (e + 1) p (r.1.abs.shiftRight 1), r.2)
          else (mkFinite r.1.sign e p r.1.abs, r.2))
          = ((if r.1.abs.size = p + 1 then mkFinite r.1.sign (e + 1) p (r.1.abs.shiftRight 1)
            else mkFinite r.1.sign e p r.1.abs), r.2) := by
        split_ifs <;> rfl
      rw [hR]
      symm
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · exact toVal_injective p (ofEReal_spec p mode v).1 (Or.inl hRprec)
          (by rw [fst_roundVal, ofVal_some, (ofEReal_spec p mode v).2, hround, hRval])
      · show (roundVal p mode (some (v : EReal))).2 = r.2
        rw [(roundVal_coe p mode v).2, hround, compare_coe_coe, hr_def,
          AzInt.snd_shiftRightRound, ← hr_def, ← hvu]
        conv_rhs => rw [← compare_mul_right_pos _ _ u hu, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hu.ne']

name: Azurite.AzFloat.setPrec_eq
statement:
theorem setPrec_eq (x : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] :
    setPrec x p = (liftE id x p .Nearest).1
proof:
:= by
  unfold setPrec
  rw [setPrecRound_eq_liftE]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ulp?_spec
statement:
theorem ulp?_spec (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (p : ℕ) (m : AzNat) (hv : FiniteValid p m) :
    ∃ y, ulp? (finite s e p m hv) = some y ∧
      y.toVal = some (((2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - p) : ℝ) : EReal) ∧ y.precision? = some 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold powerOf2
    rw [toVal_mkFinite _ _ _ _ (by decide)]
    congr 2
    unfold finiteVal
    rw [AzInt.toInt_add, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
    simp only [↓reduceIte, one_mul, show (1 : AzNat).toNat = 1 from rfl, Nat.cast_one,
      show (1 : AzNat).size = 1 from rfl, show (1 : AzInt).toInt = 1 from rfl]
    congr 1
    ring
  · unfold powerOf2
    exact precision?_mkFinite _ _ _ _ (by decide) (by rfl)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_toAzInt
statement: theorem toInt_toAzInt (n : AzNat) : n.toAzInt.toInt = n.toNat
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_self
statement:
theorem finiteVal_self (s : Bool) (m : AzNat) :
    finiteVal s (AzNat.ofNat m.size).toAzInt m = (if s then 1 else -1) * (m.toNat : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteVal
  rw [toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, sub_self, zpow_zero, mul_one]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_ofAzNat
statement: theorem toVal_ofAzNat (n : AzNat) : toVal (ofAzNat n) = some ((n.toNat : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofAzNat
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst hn
    simp
  · rw [toVal_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hn, finiteVal_self]
    simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_ofAzInt
statement: theorem toVal_ofAzInt (z : AzInt) : toVal (ofAzInt z) = some ((z.toInt : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofAzInt
  by_cases hz : z.abs = 0
  · rw [hz, mkFinite_zero]
    have : z.toInt = 0 := by
      unfold AzInt.toInt
      rw [hz, AzNat.toNat_zero]
      cases z.sign <;> simp
    rw [this]
    simp
  · rw [toVal_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hz, finiteVal_self]
    congr 2
    unfold AzInt.toInt
    rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true z.sign with hs | hs <;> simp [hs]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_of_toAzRat?
statement:
theorem toVal_of_toAzRat? (x : AzFloat) (r : AzRat) (h : x.toAzRat? = some r) :
    x.toVal = some ((AzRat.toRat r : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nan => simp [toAzRat?] at h
  | infinity s => simp [toAzRat?] at h
  | zero =>
    simp only [toAzRat?, Option.some.injEq] at h
    subst h
    simp
  | finite s e p m hv =>
    simp only [toAzRat?, Option.some.injEq] at h
    subst h
    rw [toVal_finite]
    congr 2
    have hm : m ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_size_pos (by
      rw [hv.size_eq]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hv.pos (le_alignedBits p))
    set d := e - (AzNat.ofNat m.size).toAzInt with hd
    have hdI : d.toInt = e.toInt - m.size := by
      rw [hd, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
    have hbase : (AzRat.toRat (AzInt.mkNorm s m).toAzRat : ℝ)
        = (if s then 1 else -1) * (m.toNat : ℝ) := by
      rw [AzRat.toRat_toAzRat_int]
      cases s <;> simp [AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_false m hm]
    unfold finiteVal
    rw [← hdI]
    have hsgn : d.toInt = if d.sign then (d.abs.toNat : ℤ) else -(d.abs.toNat : ℤ) := rfl
    by_cases hs : d.sign = true
    · rw [ite_eq_left hs, AzRat.toRat_shiftLeft]
      push_cast
      rw [hbase, hsgn, ite_eq_left hs, zpow_natCast]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hs, AzRat.toRat_shiftRight]
      push_cast
      rw [hbase, hsgn, ite_eq_right hs, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.isSome_toAzRat?
statement: theorem isSome_toAzRat? (x : AzFloat) : x.toAzRat?.isSome = x.isFinite
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.le_abs_floor_ceil
statement:
theorem le_abs_floor_ceil (y : ℝ) (B : ℤ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hy : (B : ℝ) ≤ |y|) :
    B ≤ |⌊y⌋| ∧ B ≤ |⌈y⌉|
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_abs'.mp hy with h | h
  · 
    have h1 : ⌈y⌉ ≤ -B := Int.ceil_le.mpr (by push_cast; exact h)
    have h2 : ⌊y⌋ ≤ ⌈y⌉ := Int.floor_le_ceil y
    constructor
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by omega)]; omega
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by omega)]; omega
  · have h1 : B ≤ ⌊y⌋ := Int.le_floor.mpr h
    have h2 : ⌊y⌋ ≤ ⌈y⌉ := Int.floor_le_ceil y
    constructor
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by omega)]; exact h1
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by omega)]; omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofAzRatRound_spec
statement:
theorem ofAzRatRound_spec (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode)
    (h0 : q.num ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (s : Bool) (e' : ℤ) (n : AzNat),
      (ofAzRatRound q p mode).1 = mkFinite s (AzInt.ofInt e') p n ∧ n.size = p ∧
      ((finiteVal s (AzInt.ofInt e') n : ℝ) : EReal)
        = (RoundingTarget.round (precisionSet 2 p) mode (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)).val ∧
      (ofAzRatRound q p mode).2
        = compare (finiteVal s (AzInt.ofInt e') n) (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  unfold ofAzRatRound
  rw [ite_eq_right hp.ne', ite_eq_right h0]
  simp only []
  set x : ℝ := (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) with hx_def
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := fun h => h0 ((AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mp h)
  have h2 : (2 : UInt64).toNat = 2 := rfl
  have hlog : AzRat.floorLogBaseAbs 2 q = Int.log 2 |x| := by
    rw [AzRat.floorLogBaseAbs_eq 2 (by decide) q h0, h2]
  set e := Int.log 2 |x| with he
  rw [hlog]
  set u := precScale 2 p x with hu_def
  have hu_eq : u = (2 : ℝ) ^ (e - p + 1) := by
    rw [hu_def]; unfold precScale; rw [← he]; norm_num
  have hu : 0 < u := by rw [hu_eq]; exact zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  set sc : ℤ := (p : ℤ) - 1 - e with hsc
  have hpow : ((2 : UInt64).toNat : ℝ) ^ sc = u⁻¹ := by
    rw [h2, hu_eq, ← zpow_neg]; push_cast; congr 1; rw [hsc]; ring
  have hr := AzRat.toInt_scaledRound q 2 (by decide) sc mode
  rw [hpow, ← div_eq_mul_inv, ← hx_def] at hr
  have hrI : toInt (RoundingTarget.round intSet mode (x / u))
      = (AzRat.scaledRound q 2 sc mode).1.toInt :=
    toInt_eq_of_val hr
  set r := AzRat.scaledRound q 2 sc mode with hr_def
  
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_div_precScale_bounds (b := 2) (p := p) x hx
  rw [← hu_def] at hlo hhi
  have hlo' : (((2 ^ (p - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ |x / u| := by
    push_cast
    rw [← zpow_natCast, Nat.cast_sub hp]
    simpa using hlo
  have hhi' : |x / u| < (((2 ^ p : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    push_cast
    rw [← zpow_natCast]
    simpa using hhi
  have habs : (r.1.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |r.1.toInt| := by
    unfold AzInt.toInt; cases r.1.sign <;> simp
  have hbounds : (2 ^ (p - 1) : ℕ) ≤ r.1.abs.toNat ∧ r.1.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ p := by
    obtain ⟨hf1, hc1⟩ := le_abs_floor_ceil (x / u) _ (by positivity) hlo'
    obtain ⟨hf2, hc2⟩ := AzRat.floor_ceil_abs_le (x / u) _ hhi'
    rcases AzRat.toInt_round_intSet_eq_floor_or_ceil mode (x / u) with h | h <;> rw [hrI] at h
    · constructor
      · have : ((2 ^ (p - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (r.1.abs.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [habs, h]; exact hf1
        exact_mod_cast this
      · have : (r.1.abs.toNat : ℤ) ≤ ((2 ^ p : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [habs, h]; exact hf2
        exact_mod_cast this
    · constructor
      · have : ((2 ^ (p - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (r.1.abs.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [habs, h]; exact hc1
        exact_mod_cast this
      · have : (r.1.abs.toNat : ℤ) ≤ ((2 ^ p : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [habs, h]; exact hc2
        exact_mod_cast this
  have hval : (RoundingTarget.round (precisionSet 2 p) mode x).val
      = (((r.1.toInt : ℝ) * u : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [val_round_precisionSet mode x hx, hrI, ← hu_def]
  have hsign : (r.1.toInt : ℝ) = (if r.1.sign then 1 else -1) * (r.1.abs.toNat : ℝ) := by
    unfold AzInt.toInt; cases r.1.sign <;> simp
  have htag := AzRat.snd_scaledRound q 2 (by decide) sc mode
  rw [hpow, ← div_eq_mul_inv, ← hx_def, ← hr_def] at htag
  have hcmp : ∀ v : ℝ, v = (r.1.toInt : ℝ) * u →
      r.2 = compare v x := by
    intro v hv
    rw [htag, hv]
    rcases lt_trichotomy ((r.1.toInt : ℤ) : ℝ) (x / u) with h | h | h
    · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr]
      rwa [lt_div_iff₀ hu] at h
    · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr]
      rw [h, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hu.ne']
    · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr]
      rwa [div_lt_iff₀ hu] at h
  by_cases hsz : r.1.abs.size = p + 1
  · rw [ite_eq_left hsz]
    
    have hge : 2 ^ p ≤ r.1.abs.toNat := by
      rw [← Nat.lt_size, AzNat.size_toNat, hsz]; omega
    have hn : r.1.abs.toNat = 2 ^ p := le_antisymm hbounds.2 hge
    refine ⟨r.1.sign, e + 2, r.1.abs.shiftRight 1, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, AzNat.toNat_shiftRight, hn, pow_one, Nat.pow_div hp (by norm_num),
        Nat.size_pow]
      omega
    · rw [hval]
      congr 1
      unfold finiteVal
      rw [AzInt.toInt_ofInt, ← AzNat.size_toNat, AzNat.toNat_shiftRight, hn, pow_one,
        Nat.pow_div hp (by norm_num), Nat.size_pow, hsign, hn, hu_eq]
      push_cast
      rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_natCast, Nat.cast_sub hp]
      rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num), ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring
    · apply hcmp
      unfold finiteVal
      rw [AzInt.toInt_ofInt, ← AzNat.size_toNat, AzNat.toNat_shiftRight, hn, pow_one,
        Nat.pow_div hp (by norm_num), Nat.size_pow, hsign, hn, hu_eq]
      push_cast
      rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_natCast, Nat.cast_sub hp]
      rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num), ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring
  · rw [ite_eq_right hsz]
    have hsize : r.1.abs.size = p := by
      have h1 : r.1.abs.size ≤ p + 1 := by
        rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, Nat.size_le]
        calc r.1.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ p := hbounds.2
          _ < 2 ^ (p + 1) := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
      have h2 : p ≤ r.1.abs.size := by
        rw [← AzNat.size_toNat]
        have := Nat.lt_size.mpr hbounds.1
        omega
      omega
    refine ⟨r.1.sign, e + 1, r.1.abs, rfl, hsize, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hval]
      congr 1
      unfold finiteVal
      rw [AzInt.toInt_ofInt, hsize, hsign, hu_eq]
      congr 2
      ring
    · apply hcmp
      unfold finiteVal
      rw [AzInt.toInt_ofInt, hsize, hsign, hu_eq]
      congr 2
      ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_ofAzRatRound
statement:
theorem toVal_ofAzRatRound (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    toVal (ofAzRatRound q p mode).1
      = some (RoundingTarget.round (precisionSet 2 p) mode (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)).val
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  by_cases h0 : q.num = 0
  · have hq : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) = 0 := (AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr h0
    unfold ofAzRatRound
    rw [ite_eq_right hp.ne', ite_eq_left h0, hq,
      val_round_of_mem (precisionSet 2 p) mode (x := (0 : ℝ)) (Or.inl (by simp))]
    simp
  · obtain ⟨s, e', n, heq, hsize, hval, -⟩ := ofAzRatRound_spec q p mode h0
    have hn : n ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_size_pos (hsize ▸ hp)
    rw [heq, toVal_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hn, hval]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.precision?_ofAzRatRound
statement:
theorem precision?_ofAzRatRound (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (mode : RoundingMode)
    (h0 : q.num ≠ 0) : precision? (ofAzRatRound q p mode).1 = some p
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne'⟩
  obtain ⟨s, e', n, heq, hsize, -, -⟩ := ofAzRatRound_spec q p mode h0
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_size_pos (hsize ▸ hp)
  rw [heq, precision?_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hn hsize.le]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.snd_ofAzRatRound
statement:
theorem snd_ofAzRatRound (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    ∃ v : ℝ, toVal (ofAzRatRound q p mode).1 = some (v : EReal) ∧
      (ofAzRatRound q p mode).2 = compare v (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : q.num = 0
  · have hq : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) = 0 := (AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr h0
    unfold ofAzRatRound
    rw [ite_eq_right hp.ne', ite_eq_left h0, hq]
    exact ⟨0, by simp, by simp⟩
  · have : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne'⟩
    obtain ⟨s, e', n, heq, hsize, -, htag⟩ := ofAzRatRound_spec q p mode h0
    have hn : n ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_size_pos (hsize ▸ hp)
    exact ⟨_, by rw [heq, toVal_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hn], htag⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_ofAzRat
statement:
theorem toVal_ofAzRat (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] :
    toVal (ofAzRat q p)
      = some (RoundingTarget.round (precisionSet 2 p) .Nearest (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)).val
proof:
:=
  toVal_ofAzRatRound q p .Nearest

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.log_coe
statement: theorem log_coe (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : log (r : EReal) = some ((Real.log r : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold log
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hr.le)),
    ite_eq_right (mt EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp hr.ne'), ite_eq_right (EReal.coe_ne_top r),
    EReal.toReal_coe]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.log_coe_neg
statement: theorem log_coe_neg (r : ℝ) (hr : r < 0) : log (r : EReal) = none
proof:
:= by
  unfold log
  rw [ite_eq_left (EReal.coe_neg'.mpr hr)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.log_top
statement: @[simp] theorem log_top : log ⊤ = some ⊤
proof:
:= by
  unfold log
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr le_top), ite_eq_right (EReal.zero_ne_top).symm, ite_eq_left rfl]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.log_bot
statement: @[simp] theorem log_bot : log ⊥ = none
proof:
:= by
  unfold log
  rw [ite_eq_left EReal.bot_lt_zero]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.log_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem log_zero : log 0 = some ⊥
proof:
:= by
  unfold log
  rw [ite_eq_right (lt_irrefl 0), ite_eq_left rfl]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.lnPrecRound_eq_liftVal
statement:
theorem lnPrecRound_eq_liftVal (x : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    lnPrecRound x p mode = liftVal Spec.log x p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold liftVal
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity s => cases s <;> simp [lnPrecRound]
  | zero => simp [lnPrecRound]
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    cases s with
    | true =>
      have hv0 := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
      simp only [lnPrecRound, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some, Spec.log_coe _ hv0]
      split_ifs with h1 hp
      · obtain ⟨v, hx, h1v⟩ := (eqIEEE_iff _ _).mp h1
        rw [toVal_finite] at hx
        rw [toVal_one', ← hx, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at h1v
        rw [← h1v, Real.log_one, EReal.coe_zero, roundVal_zero]
      · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
      · exact zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode _ (Real.log (finiteVal true e m)) _
          (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
          (fun w hw => by
            obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
              lnApprox_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega) e hv
                (finiteVal_ne_one_of_not_eqIEEE e hv h1)
            exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩) _
    | false =>
      simp only [lnPrecRound, toVal_finite]
      rw [finiteVal_false, Option.bind_some,
        Spec.log_coe_neg _ (neg_neg_iff_pos.mpr (finiteVal_true_pos e hv)), roundVal_none]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.recipPrecRound_eq_liftVal
statement:
theorem recipPrecRound_eq_liftVal (y : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    recipPrecRound y p mode = liftVal (fun a => Spec.div 1 a) y p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold recipPrecRound liftVal
  rw [divPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂, liftVal₂, toVal_one', Option.bind_some, EReal.coe_one]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.salaminS_le_half
statement: theorem salaminS_le_half (n : ℕ) : salaminS n ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [salaminS_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [salaminS_succ]
    have : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * ((sA n - sB n) / 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
    linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.salamin_facts
statement: theorem salamin_facts (n : ℕ) : 2 / 3 < sB n ∧ sB n ≤ sA n ∧ sA n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · simp only [agmA_zero, agmB_zero]
    exact ⟨salaminB0_gt, salaminB0_lt_one.le, le_rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨salamin_agmB_gt hn, agmB_le_agmA one_pos salaminB0_pos hn, salamin_agmA_le_one hn⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.cube_mul_le_two_pow
statement: theorem cube_mul_le_two_pow {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) : w ^ 3 * 2 ^ 30 ≤ 2 ^ w
proof:
:= by
  induction w, hw using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => norm_num
  | succ w hw ih =>
    have h64 : 64 * w ^ 2 ≤ w ^ 3 := by
      calc 64 * w ^ 2 ≤ w * w ^ 2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hw
        _ = w ^ 3 := by ring
    have h3 : 3 * w + 1 ≤ 61 * w ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h1 : (w + 1) ^ 3 ≤ 2 * w ^ 3 := by nlinarith
    calc (w + 1) ^ 3 * 2 ^ 30 ≤ 2 * w ^ 3 * 2 ^ 30 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h1
      _ = 2 * (w ^ 3 * 2 ^ 30) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * 2 ^ w := by omega
      _ = 2 ^ (w + 1) := by ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.cube_mul_half_pow_le
statement:
theorem cube_mul_half_pow_le {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) :
    (w : ℝ) ^ 3 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 30
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((w : ℝ) ^ 3 * 2 ^ 30 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ w := by exact_mod_cast cube_mul_le_two_pow hw
  rw [one_div_pow, one_div_pow, mul_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
  linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.two_pow_piSteps_le
statement: theorem two_pow_piSteps_le {w : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) : (2 : ℝ) ^ piSteps w ≤ 2 * w
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((2 ^ Nat.log 2 w : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ w := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (by omega : w ≠ 0)
  unfold piSteps
  rw [pow_succ]
  push_cast at h
  linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.two_pow_le_piEps
statement:
theorem two_pow_le_piEps {w : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * piSteps w + 16) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ piEps w
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := two_pow_piSteps_le hw
  have h3 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * piSteps w + 16) = 2 ^ 16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ piSteps w) ^ 3 := by
    rw [pow_add, ← pow_mul, mul_comm (piSteps w) 3, mul_comm]
  have h4 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ piSteps w) ^ 3 ≤ (2 * w) ^ 3 := by gcongr
  unfold piEps
  calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * piSteps w + 16) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
      = 2 ^ 16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ piSteps w) ^ 3 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by rw [h3]
    _ ≤ 2 ^ 16 * (2 * w) ^ 3 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by gcongr
    _ = 2 ^ 19 * (w : ℝ) ^ 3 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.piEps_le
statement: theorem piEps_le {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) : piEps w ≤ 1 / 16
proof:
:= by
  have h := cube_mul_half_pow_le hw
  unfold piEps
  calc 2 ^ 19 * (w : ℝ) ^ 3 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w = 2 ^ 19 * ((w : ℝ) ^ 3 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w) := by
        ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ 19 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 30 := by gcongr
    _ ≤ 1 / 16 := by norm_num

name: Azurite.AzFloat.piSteps_pow_mul_le
statement:
theorem piSteps_pow_mul_le {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * piSteps w + 16) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 1 / 16
proof:
:=
  (two_pow_le_piEps (by omega)).trans (piEps_le hw)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.tendsto_piEps
statement: theorem tendsto_piEps : Filter.Tendsto piEps Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (tendsto_pow_const_mul_const_pow_of_abs_lt_one 3
    (by norm_num : |(1 / 2 : ℝ)| < 1)).const_mul (2 ^ 19 : ℝ)
  rw [mul_zero] at h
  refine h.congr fun w => ?_
  simp only [piEps]
  ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_double
statement:
theorem toVal_double {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal)) :
    (x <<< (1 : Nat)).toVal = some ((2 * xv : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toVal_shiftLeft_nat (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hx), fval_of_toVal_coe hx]
  push_cast
  rw [zpow_one, mul_comm]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_powerOf2_one_sub
statement:
theorem toVal_powerOf2_one_sub (w : ℕ) :
    (powerOf2 (1 - (w : AzInt))).toVal = some ((2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toVal_powerOf2, AzInt.toInt_sub, AzInt.toInt_natCast]
  have h1 : (1 : AzInt).toInt = 1 := rfl
  rw [h1, zpow_sub₀ (by norm_num), zpow_one, zpow_natCast, one_div_pow, one_div, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_natCast_sub_one
statement: theorem toInt_natCast_sub_one (n : ℕ) : ((n : AzInt) - 1).toInt = (n : ℤ) - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzInt.toInt_sub, AzInt.toInt_natCast]; rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.clampNonneg_spec
statement:
theorem clampNonneg_spec {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal)) :
    ∃ cv : ℝ, (clampNonneg x).toVal = some (cv : EReal) ∧ 0 ≤ cv ∧ cv ≤ max xv 0 ∧
      (0 ≤ xv → cv = xv)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hneg, hnonneg⟩ := toVal_sign_of_isNegative hx
  unfold clampNonneg
  cases hb : x.isNegative with
  | true =>
    simp only [↓reduceIte]
    exact ⟨0, by simp, le_rfl, le_max_right _ _, fun h => absurd (hneg hb) (not_lt.mpr h)⟩
  | false =>
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    exact ⟨xv, hx, hnonneg hb, le_max_left _ _, fun _ => rfl⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.mul_le_one_of
statement: theorem mul_le_one_of {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ 1) (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hy : y ≤ 1) : x * y ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  nlinarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sqrt_four
statement: theorem sqrt_four : Real.sqrt 4 = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num]
  exact Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.mean_step
statement:
theorem mean_step (hal : aLo.toVal = some (al : EReal)) (hah : aHi.toVal = some (ah : EReal))
    (hbl : bLo.toVal = some (bl : EReal)) (hbh : bHi.toVal = some (bh : EReal))
    (hal0 : 0 ≤ al) (hala : al ≤ a) (haah : a ≤ ah) (hbl0 : 0 ≤ bl) (hblb : bl ≤ b)
    (hbbh : b ≤ bh) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (hb1 : b ≤ 1) (hW : (ah - al) + (bh - bl) ≤ 1 / 16) :
    ∃ r1 r2 : ℝ,
      ((addPrecRound aLo bLo w .Floor).1 >>> (1 : Nat)).toVal = some ((r1 / 2 : ℝ) : EReal) ∧
      ((addPrecRound aHi bHi w .Ceiling).1 >>> (1 : Nat)).toVal = some ((r2 / 2 : ℝ) : EReal) ∧
      0 ≤ r1 / 2 ∧ r1 / 2 ≤ (a + b) / 2 ∧ (a + b) / 2 ≤ r2 / 2 ∧
      r2 / 2 - r1 / 2 ≤ ((ah - al) + (bh - bl)) / 2 + 5 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r1, hr1, hf1⟩ := addFloor_err hal hbl w (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨r2, hr2, hc2⟩ := addCeiling_err hah hbh w (by linarith)
  have hr1ge := hf1.ge_of_le (B := 2) (by linarith)
  have hr2le := hc2.le_of_le (B := 3) (by linarith)
  have hf1le := hf1.le
  have hc2ge := hc2.ge
  exact ⟨r1, r2, toVal_half hr1, toVal_half hr2, by linarith [hf1.nonneg], by linarith,
    by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.geo_step
statement:
theorem geo_step (hal : aLo.toVal = some (al : EReal)) (hah : aHi.toVal = some (ah : EReal))
    (hbl : bLo.toVal = some (bl : EReal)) (hbh : bHi.toVal = some (bh : EReal))
    (hala : al ≤ a) (haah : a ≤ ah) (hblb : bl ≤ b) (hbbh : b ≤ bh) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (hb1 : b ≤ 1)
    (hal23 : 29 / 48 ≤ al) (hbl23 : 29 / 48 ≤ bl) (hW : (ah - al) + (bh - bl) ≤ 1 / 16)
    (hu : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 1 / 4096) :
    ∃ q1 q2 : ℝ,
      (sqrtPrecRound (mulPrecRound aLo bLo w .Floor).1 w .Floor).1.toVal = some (q1 : EReal) ∧
      (sqrtPrecRound (mulPrecRound aHi bHi w .Ceiling).1 w .Ceiling).1.toVal
        = some (q2 : EReal) ∧
      0 ≤ q1 ∧ q1 ≤ Real.sqrt (a * b) ∧ Real.sqrt (a * b) ≤ q2 ∧
      q2 - q1 ≤ 2 * ((ah - al) + (bh - bl)) + 16 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:= by
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by positivity
  have hal0 : 0 ≤ al := by linarith
  have hbl0 : 0 ≤ bl := by linarith
  have hWa : 0 ≤ ah - al := by linarith
  have hWb : 0 ≤ bh - bl := by linarith
  have hal1 : al ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hbl1 : bl ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hah1 : ah ≤ 1 + 1 / 16 := by linarith
  have hbh1 : bh ≤ 1 + 1 / 16 := by linarith
  have hah0 : 0 ≤ ah := by linarith
  have hbh0 : 0 ≤ bh := by linarith
  
  obtain ⟨m1, hm1, hfm1⟩ := mulFloor_err hal hbl w (mul_nonneg hal0 hbl0)
  obtain ⟨m2, hm2, hcm2⟩ := mulCeiling_err hah hbh w (mul_nonneg hah0 hbh0)
  have hab1 : al * bl ≤ 1 := mul_le_one_of hal1 hbl0 hbl1
  have hab2 : ah * bh ≤ (1 + 1 / 16) * (1 + 1 / 16) := mul_le_mul hah1 hbh1 hbh0 (by norm_num)
  have hablo : 29 / 48 * (29 / 48) ≤ al * bl := mul_le_mul hal23 hbl23 (by norm_num) hal0
  have hab12 : al * bl ≤ ah * bh := mul_le_mul (by linarith) (by linarith) hbl0 hah0
  have hm1ge := hfm1.ge_of_le (B := 1) hab1
  have hm2le := hcm2.le_of_le (B := 2) (by linarith)
  have hfm1le := hfm1.le
  have hcm2ge := hcm2.ge
  have hm1lo : 9 / 25 ≤ m1 := by linarith
  have hm1le1 : m1 ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hm2le4 : m2 ≤ 4 := by linarith
  have hm2nn : 0 ≤ m2 := by linarith [mul_nonneg hah0 hbh0]
  have hm12 : m1 ≤ m2 := by linarith
  have hm1nn := hfm1.nonneg
  
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1, hfq1⟩ := sqrtFloor_err hm1 hm1nn w
  obtain ⟨q2, hq2, hcq2⟩ := sqrtCeiling_err hm2 hm2nn w
  have hsqrt_m1 : 3 / 5 ≤ Real.sqrt m1 := by
    rw [Real.le_sqrt' (by norm_num)]; linarith
  have hsq1 : Real.sqrt m1 ≤ 1 := by
    have := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hm1le1; rwa [Real.sqrt_one] at this
  have hsq2 : Real.sqrt m2 ≤ 2 := by
    have := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hm2le4; rwa [sqrt_four] at this
  have hq1ge := hfq1.ge_of_le (B := 1) hsq1
  have hq2le := hcq2.le_of_le (B := 2) hsq2
  have hsqdiff : (Real.sqrt m2 - Real.sqrt m1) * (3 / 5) ≤ m2 - m1 := by
    have hle := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hm12
    have key : (Real.sqrt m2 - Real.sqrt m1) * (Real.sqrt m2 + Real.sqrt m1) = m2 - m1 := by
      ring_nf
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt hm2nn, Real.sq_sqrt hm1nn]
    have h1 : (Real.sqrt m2 - Real.sqrt m1) * (3 / 5)
        ≤ (Real.sqrt m2 - Real.sqrt m1) * (Real.sqrt m2 + Real.sqrt m1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg m2]) (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hm2m1 : m2 - m1 ≤ (1 + 1 / 16) * (bh - bl) + (ah - al) + 6 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
    have e0 : ah * bh - al * bl = ah * (bh - bl) + bl * (ah - al) := by ring
    have e1 : ah * (bh - bl) ≤ (1 + 1 / 16) * (bh - bl) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hah1 hWb
    have e2 : bl * (ah - al) ≤ 1 * (ah - al) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbl1 hWa
    linarith
  refine ⟨q1, q2, hq1, hq2, hfq1.nonneg, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hfq1.le.trans (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hfm1le.trans (mul_le_mul hala hblb hbl0 (by linarith))))
  · exact (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ((mul_le_mul haah hbbh (by linarith) hah0).trans hcm2ge)).trans
      hcq2.ge
  · have hsqdiff' : Real.sqrt m2 - Real.sqrt m1 ≤ (m2 - m1) * (5 / 3) := by linarith
    linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.diffsq_step
statement:
theorem diffsq_step (hal : aLo.toVal = some (al : EReal)) (hah : aHi.toVal = some (ah : EReal))
    (hbl : bLo.toVal = some (bl : EReal)) (hbh : bHi.toVal = some (bh : EReal))
    (hala : al ≤ a) (haah : a ≤ ah) (hblb : bl ≤ b) (hbbh : b ≤ bh) (ha1 : a ≤ 1)
    (hb23 : 2 / 3 < b) (hba : b ≤ a) (hW : (ah - al) + (bh - bl) ≤ 1 / 16)
    (hu : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 1 / 4096) :
    ∃ e1 e2 : ℝ,
      (sqrPrecRound (clampNonneg (subPrecRound aLo bHi w .Floor).1) w .Floor).1.toVal
        = some (e1 : EReal) ∧
      (sqrPrecRound (subPrecRound aHi bLo w .Ceiling).1 w .Ceiling).1.toVal
        = some (e2 : EReal) ∧
      0 ≤ e1 ∧ e1 ≤ (a - b) ^ 2 ∧ (a - b) ^ 2 ≤ e2 ∧
      e2 - e1 ≤ 4 * ((ah - al) + (bh - bl)) + 12 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:= by
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by positivity
  have hWa : 0 ≤ ah - al := by linarith
  have hWb : 0 ≤ bh - bl := by linarith
  have hg0 : 0 ≤ a - b := by linarith
  have hg13 : a - b ≤ 1 / 3 := by linarith
  have hgW : a - b ≤ ah - bl := by linarith
  obtain ⟨d2, hd2, hcd2⟩ := subCeiling_err hah hbl w (by linarith)
  have hd2le := hcd2.le_of_le (B := 1) (by linarith)
  have hd2ge : a - b ≤ d2 := hgW.trans hcd2.ge
  have hd2one : d2 ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hc : ∃ c : ℝ, (clampNonneg (subPrecRound aLo bHi w .Floor).1).toVal = some (c : EReal) ∧
      0 ≤ c ∧ c ≤ a - b ∧ d2 - c ≤ 2 * ((ah - al) + (bh - bl)) + 4 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
    by_cases hpos : 0 ≤ al - bh
    · obtain ⟨d1, hd1, hfd1⟩ := subFloor_err hal hbh w hpos
      obtain ⟨c, hcv, -, -, hceq⟩ := clampNonneg_spec hd1
      have hcd := hceq hfd1.nonneg
      subst hcd
      refine ⟨c, hcv, hfd1.nonneg, by linarith [hfd1.le], ?_⟩
      have := hfd1.ge_of_le (B := 1) (by linarith)
      linarith
    · obtain ⟨d1, hd1, hd1le, -⟩ := subFloor_le hal hbh w
      obtain ⟨c, hcv, hc0, hcle, -⟩ := clampNonneg_spec hd1
      have hneg := not_le.mp hpos
      have hd1neg : d1 < 0 := by linarith
      have hcz : c ≤ 0 := by rw [max_eq_right hd1neg.le] at hcle; exact hcle
      refine ⟨c, hcv, hc0, by linarith, ?_⟩
      have : a - b ≤ (ah - al) + (bh - bl) := by linarith
      linarith
  obtain ⟨c, hcv, hc0, hcg, hd2c⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨e1, he1, hfe1⟩ := sqrFloor_err hcv w
  obtain ⟨e2, he2, hce2⟩ := sqrCeiling_err hd2 w
  have hcc : c * c ≤ 1 := mul_le_one_of (by linarith) hc0 (by linarith)
  have hdd : d2 * d2 ≤ 1 := mul_le_one_of hd2one (by linarith) hd2one
  have he1ge := hfe1.ge_of_le (B := 1) hcc
  have he2le := hce2.le_of_le (B := 1) hdd
  have hgsq : (a - b) ^ 2 = (a - b) * (a - b) := sq _
  refine ⟨e1, e2, he1, he2, hfe1.nonneg, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hgsq]; exact hfe1.le.trans (mul_le_mul hcg hcg hc0 hg0)
  · rw [hgsq]; exact (mul_le_mul hd2ge hd2ge hg0 (by linarith)).trans hce2.ge
  · have e0 : d2 * d2 - c * c = (d2 - c) * (d2 + c) := by ring
    have h1 : (d2 - c) * (d2 + c) ≤ (2 * ((ah - al) + (bh - bl)) + 4 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w) * 2 :=
      mul_le_mul hd2c (by linarith) (by linarith) (by positivity)
    have hfe1le := hfe1.le
    have hce2ge := hce2.ge
    linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.piEncloses_init
statement: theorem piEncloses_init (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] : PiEncloses w 0 (piInit w)
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : salaminB0 = Real.sqrt 2 / 2 := by rw [salaminB0, one_div, inv_sqrt_eq]
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 / 2 := by positivity
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ≤ 2 := by
    have h := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
    have h0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 2
    nlinarith
  have hfl := sqrt2Over2PrecRound_eq_liftVal₀ w .Floor
  have hce := sqrt2Over2PrecRound_eq_liftVal₀ w .Ceiling
  unfold liftVal₀ at hfl hce
  obtain ⟨bl, hbl, hfbl⟩ := roundVal_floor_err w hx0
  obtain ⟨bh, hbh, hcbh⟩ := roundVal_ceiling_err w hx0
  rw [← hfl] at hbl
  rw [← hce] at hbh
  have hu : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by positivity
  refine ⟨1, 1, bl, bh, 1 / 2, 1 / 2, toVal_one', toVal_one', hbl, hbh, toVal_oneHalf,
    toVal_oneHalf, zero_le_one, ?_, ?_, hfbl.nonneg, ?_, ?_, by norm_num, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [agmA_zero]
  · simp [agmA_zero]
  · rw [agmB_zero, hb0]; exact hfbl.le
  · rw [agmB_zero, hb0]; exact hcbh.ge
  · rw [salaminS_zero]
  · rw [salaminS_zero]
  · have h1 := hfbl.ge_of_le (B := 1) (by linarith)
    have h2 := hcbh.le_of_le (B := 1) (by linarith)
    have : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * 0 + 4) = 16 := by norm_num
    rw [this]
    linarith
  · simp only [sub_self]; positivity

name: Azurite.AzFloat.piEncloses_step
statement:
theorem piEncloses_step {w : ℕ} [NeZero w] (hw : 64 ≤ w) {n : ℕ} (hn : n < piSteps w)
    {s : PiBounds} (h : PiEncloses w n s) : PiEncloses w (n + 1) (piStep w n s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨al, ah, bl, bh, sl, sh, hal, hah, hbl, hbh, hsl, hsh, hal0, hala, hahA, hbl0, hblb,
    hbhB, hsl0, hsls, hshS, hW, hWs⟩ := h
  have hu : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by positivity
  obtain ⟨hb23, hba, ha1⟩ := salamin_facts n
  have hS3 := salaminS_gt n
  have hS2 := salaminS_le_half n
  have hS3' := salaminS_gt (n + 1)
  have hSsucc := salaminS_succ n
  
  have hsmall := piSteps_pow_mul_le hw
  have hpowle : ∀ k, k ≤ 3 * piSteps w + 16 → (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 1 / 16 :=
    fun k hk =>
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two hk) hu.le).trans hsmall
  have hW16 : (ah - al) + (bh - bl) ≤ 1 / 16 := hW.trans (hpowle _ (by omega))
  have hWs16 : sh - sl ≤ 1 / 16 := hWs.trans (hpowle _ (by omega))
  have hu4096 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 1 / 4096 := by
    have := hpowle 8 (by omega)
    norm_num at this
    linarith
  have hb1 : sB n ≤ 1 := hba.trans ha1
  
  obtain ⟨r1, r2, hr1, hr2, hr10, hr1A, hr2A, hWa'⟩ :=
    mean_step (w := w) hal hah hbl hbh hal0 hala hahA hbl0 hblb hbhB ha1 hb1 hW16
  obtain ⟨q1, q2, hq1, hq2, hq10, hq1B, hq2B, hWb'⟩ :=
    geo_step (w := w) hal hah hbl hbh hala hahA hblb hbhB ha1 hb1 (by linarith) (by linarith)
      hW16 hu4096
  obtain ⟨e1, e2, he1, he2, he10, he1g, he2g, he21⟩ :=
    diffsq_step (w := w) hal hah hbl hbh hala hahA hblb hbhB ha1 hb23 hba hW16 hu4096
  
  have hPdef : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℤ) - 1) = 2 ^ n / 2 := by
    rw [zpow_sub_one₀ (by norm_num), zpow_natCast]; ring
  have htLo := toVal_shiftLeft_of_toVal he1 ((n : AzInt) - 1)
  have htHi := toVal_shiftLeft_of_toVal he2 ((n : AzInt) - 1)
  rw [toInt_natCast_sub_one, hPdef] at htLo htHi
  have hQ0 : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ n / 2 := by positivity
  have htn : (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * ((sA n - sB n) / 2) ^ 2 = (sA n - sB n) ^ 2 * (2 ^ n / 2) := by
    ring
  have htLo_le : e1 * (2 ^ n / 2) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * ((sA n - sB n) / 2) ^ 2 := by
    rw [htn]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he1g hQ0.le
  have htHi_ge : (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * ((sA n - sB n) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ e2 * (2 ^ n / 2) := by
    rw [htn]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he2g hQ0.le
  have htW : e2 * (2 ^ n / 2) - e1 * (2 ^ n / 2) ≤ 2 ^ (3 * n + 6) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
    have e0 : e2 * (2 ^ n / 2) - e1 * (2 ^ n / 2) = (e2 - e1) * (2 ^ n / 2) := by ring
    have h6 : (6 : ℝ) * 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ (3 * n + 5) := by
      calc (6 : ℝ) * 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ 5 * 2 ^ n := by
            have : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ n := by positivity
            linarith
        _ = 2 ^ (5 + n) := by rw [pow_add]
        _ ≤ 2 ^ (3 * n + 5) := pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two (by omega)
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6) = 2 * 2 ^ (3 * n + 5) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
    rw [e0, h2]
    calc (e2 - e1) * (2 ^ n / 2)
        ≤ (4 * (2 ^ (2 * n + 4) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w) + 12 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w) * (2 ^ n / 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hQ0.le
      _ = (2 ^ (3 * n + 5) + 6 * 2 ^ n) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 ^ (3 * n + 5) + 2 ^ (3 * n + 5)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by gcongr
      _ = 2 * 2 ^ (3 * n + 5) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by ring
  have htW16 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 1 / 16 := hpowle _ (by omega)
  
  have hsl1 : 0 ≤ sl - e2 * (2 ^ n / 2) := by linarith
  obtain ⟨s1, hs1, hfs1⟩ := subFloor_err hsl htHi w hsl1
  have htLo0 : 0 ≤ e1 * (2 ^ n / 2) := mul_nonneg he10 hQ0.le
  have htn0 : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * ((sA n - sB n) / 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨s2, hs2, hcs2⟩ := subCeiling_err hsh htLo w (by linarith)
  have hs1ge := hfs1.ge_of_le (B := 1) (by linarith)
  have hs2le := hcs2.le_of_le (B := 1) (by linarith)
  have hfs1le := hfs1.le
  have hcs2ge := hcs2.ge
  
  refine ⟨r1 / 2, r2 / 2, q1, q2, s1, s2, hr1, hr2, hq1, hq2, hs1, hs2, hr10, ?_, ?_, hq10, ?_,
    ?_, hfs1.nonneg, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [agmA_succ]; exact hr1A
  · rw [agmA_succ]; exact hr2A
  · rw [agmB_succ]; exact hq1B
  · rw [agmB_succ]; exact hq2B
  · rw [hSsucc]; linarith
  · rw [hSsucc]; linarith
  · 
    have hX : (16 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * n + 4) := by
      calc (16 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 4 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ 2 ^ (2 * n + 4) := pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two (by omega)
    have hXu : 16 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 2 ^ (2 * n + 4) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hX hu.le
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (n + 1) + 4) = 4 * 2 ^ (2 * n + 4) := by
      rw [show 2 * (n + 1) + 4 = (2 * n + 4) + 2 by ring, pow_add]; ring
    rw [h2]
    linarith
  · 
    have hY : (128 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (3 * n + 7) := by
      calc (128 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 7 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ 2 ^ (3 * n + 7) := pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two (by omega)
    have hYu : 128 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 2 ^ (3 * n + 7) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hY hu.le
    have h67 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * n + 6) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 2 ^ (3 * n + 7) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two (by omega)) hu.le
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * (n + 1) + 7) = 8 * 2 ^ (3 * n + 7) := by
      rw [show 3 * (n + 1) + 7 = (3 * n + 7) + 3 by ring, pow_add]; ring
    rw [h2]
    linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.piEncloses_iter
statement:
theorem piEncloses_iter {w : ℕ} [NeZero w] (hw : 64 ≤ w) :
    ∀ n, n ≤ piSteps w → PiEncloses w n (piIter w n (piInit w))
  | 0, _ => piEncloses_init w
  | n + 1, hn => piEncloses_step hw (by omega) (piEncloses_iter hw n (by omega))

name: Azurite.AzFloat.piBracket_spec
statement:
theorem piBracket_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, (piBracket w).1.toVal = some (lv : EReal) ∧
      (piBracket w).2.toVal = some (hv : EReal) ∧
      0 ≤ lv ∧ lv < Real.pi ∧ Real.pi ≤ hv ∧ hv - lv ≤ piEps w
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ piSteps w := one_le_piSteps w
  obtain ⟨al, ah, bl, bh, sl, sh, hal, hah, hbl, hbh, hsl, hsh, hal0, hala, hahA, hbl0, hblb,
    hbhB, hsl0, hsls, hshS, hW, hWs⟩ := piEncloses_iter hw (piSteps w) le_rfl
  have hu : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by positivity
  have hsmall := piSteps_pow_mul_le hw
  have hpowle : ∀ k, k ≤ 3 * piSteps w + 16 → (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 1 / 16 :=
    fun k hk =>
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two hk) hu.le).trans hsmall
  have hW16 : (ah - al) + (bh - bl) ≤ 1 / 16 := hW.trans (hpowle _ (by omega))
  have hWs16 : sh - sl ≤ 1 / 16 := hWs.trans (hpowle _ (by omega))
  have hu4096 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 1 / 4096 := by
    have := hpowle 8 (by omega)
    norm_num at this
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hb23, hba, ha1⟩ := salamin_facts (piSteps w)
  have hb1 : sB (piSteps w) ≤ 1 := hba.trans ha1
  have hS3 := salaminS_gt (piSteps w)
  have hS2 := salaminS_le_half (piSteps w)
  have hpi := abs_salaminApprox_piSteps_sub_pi_le w (by omega)
  rw [abs_le] at hpi
  obtain ⟨hpi1, hpi2⟩ := hpi
  have hpi3 := Real.pi_gt_three
  have hpi4 := Real.pi_lt_four
  have hWa : 0 ≤ ah - al := by linarith
  have hWb : 0 ≤ bh - bl := by linarith
  have hWs0 : 0 ≤ sh - sl := by linarith
  
  obtain ⟨r1, r2, hr1, hr2, hr10, hr1A, hr2A, hWa'⟩ :=
    mean_step (w := w) hal hah hbl hbh hal0 hala hahA hbl0 hblb hbhB ha1 hb1 hW16
  rw [← agmA_succ] at hr1A hr2A
  have hA1le : sA (piSteps w + 1) ≤ 1 := salamin_agmA_le_one (by omega)
  have hA0 : 0 < sA (piSteps w + 1) := (salamin_agm_pos _).1
  have hr2le1 : r2 / 2 ≤ 1 + 1 / 16 := by linarith
  
  obtain ⟨e1, he1, hfe1⟩ := sqrFloor_err hr1 w
  obtain ⟨e2, he2, hce2⟩ := sqrCeiling_err hr2 w
  have hr1sq1 : r1 / 2 * (r1 / 2) ≤ 1 := mul_le_one_of (by linarith) hr10 (by linarith)
  have hr2sq : r2 / 2 * (r2 / 2) ≤ (1 + 1 / 16) * (1 + 1 / 16) :=
    mul_le_mul hr2le1 hr2le1 (by linarith) (by norm_num)
  have he1ge := hfe1.ge_of_le (B := 1) hr1sq1
  have he2le := hce2.le_of_le (B := 2) (by linarith)
  have hnLo := toVal_double he1
  have hnHi := toVal_double he2
  have hsq1 : r1 / 2 * (r1 / 2) ≤ sA (piSteps w + 1) ^ 2 := by
    rw [sq]; exact mul_le_mul hr1A hr1A hr10 hA0.le
  have hsq2 : sA (piSteps w + 1) ^ 2 ≤ r2 / 2 * (r2 / 2) := by
    rw [sq]; exact mul_le_mul hr2A hr2A hA0.le (by linarith)
  have he1A : e1 ≤ sA (piSteps w + 1) ^ 2 := hfe1.le.trans hsq1
  have he2A : sA (piSteps w + 1) ^ 2 ≤ e2 := hsq2.trans hce2.ge
  have he21 : e2 - e1 ≤ 2 * ((ah - al) + (bh - bl)) + 17 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
    have e0 : r2 / 2 * (r2 / 2) - r1 / 2 * (r1 / 2) = (r2 / 2 - r1 / 2) * (r2 / 2 + r1 / 2) := by
      ring
    have h1 : (r2 / 2 - r1 / 2) * (r2 / 2 + r1 / 2)
        ≤ (((ah - al) + (bh - bl)) / 2 + 5 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w) * (33 / 16) :=
      mul_le_mul hWa' (by linarith) (by linarith) (by positivity)
    have hfe1le := hfe1.le
    have hce2ge := hce2.ge
    linarith
  have he10 : 0 ≤ e1 := hfe1.nonneg
  have he2le12 : e2 ≤ 6 / 5 := by linarith
  have he12 : e1 ≤ e2 := he1A.trans he2A
  
  have hsl14 : 1 / 4 ≤ sl := by linarith
  have hsh13 : 1 / 3 < sh := by linarith
  have hsl1 : sl ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hsl0' : 0 < sl := by linarith
  have hsh0' : 0 < sh := by linarith
  obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hfp1⟩ := divFloor_err hnLo hsh hsh0' (by linarith) w
  obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hcp2⟩ := divCeiling_err hnHi hsl hsl0' (by linarith) w
  have hq1 : 2 * e1 / sh ≤ salaminApprox (piSteps w) := by
    unfold salaminApprox
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hsh0' (by linarith)]
    exact mul_le_mul (by linarith) hshS (by linarith) (by positivity)
  have hq2 : salaminApprox (piSteps w) ≤ 2 * e2 / sl := by
    unfold salaminApprox
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) hsl0']
    exact mul_le_mul (by linarith) hsls hsl0'.le (by linarith)
  have hq2le : 2 * e2 / sl ≤ 10 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hsl0']; linarith
  have hq10 : 0 ≤ 2 * e1 / sh := by positivity
  have hp1ge := hfp1.ge_of_le (B := 5) (by linarith)
  have hp2le := hcp2.le_of_le (B := 10) hq2le
  have hfp1le := hfp1.le
  have hcp2ge := hcp2.ge
  have hqW : 2 * e2 / sl - 2 * e1 / sh
      ≤ 32 * (sh - sl) + 12 * (2 * e2 - 2 * e1) := by
    rw [div_sub_div _ _ hsl0'.ne' hsh0'.ne', div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hsl0' hsh0')]
    have e0 : 2 * e2 * sh - sl * (2 * e1) = 2 * e2 * (sh - sl) + sl * (2 * e2 - 2 * e1) := by
      ring
    have h1 : 2 * e2 * (sh - sl) ≤ 12 / 5 * (sh - sl) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hWs0
    have h2 : sl * (2 * e2 - 2 * e1) ≤ 1 * (2 * e2 - 2 * e1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsl1 (by linarith)
    have hprod : 1 / 12 ≤ sl * sh := by
      have := mul_le_mul hsl14 hsh13.le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3) hsl0'.le
      linarith only [this]
    have hC : 0 ≤ 32 * (sh - sl) + 12 * (2 * e2 - 2 * e1) := by linarith only [hWs0, he12]
    have h3 : (32 * (sh - sl) + 12 * (2 * e2 - 2 * e1)) * (1 / 12)
        ≤ (32 * (sh - sl) + 12 * (2 * e2 - 2 * e1)) * (sl * sh) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod hC
    linarith only [e0, h1, h2, h3, hWs0]
  
  have hX : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * piSteps w + 4) * 48 ≤ 2 ^ (3 * piSteps w + 7) * 8 := by
    have h8 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * piSteps w + 4) * 8 ≤ 2 ^ (3 * piSteps w + 7) := by
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * piSteps w + 4) * 8 = 2 ^ (2 * piSteps w + 7) := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 ^ (3 * piSteps w + 7) := pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two (by omega)
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (3 * piSteps w + 7) := by positivity
    linarith only [h8, hpos]
  have hY : (512 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (3 * piSteps w + 7) := by
    calc (512 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 9 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (3 * piSteps w + 7) := pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two (by omega)
  have hXu := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hX hu.le
  have hYu := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hY hu.le
  have hbig : (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * piSteps w + 7) * 64 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
      ≤ 2 ^ (3 * piSteps w + 16) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hu.le
    calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * piSteps w + 7) * 64 = 2 ^ (3 * piSteps w + 13) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (3 * piSteps w + 16) := pow_le_pow_right₀ one_le_two (by omega)
  have hXpos : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * piSteps w + 7) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by positivity
  have hp21 : p2 - p1 ≤ 2 ^ (3 * piSteps w + 7) * 44 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
    linarith only [hp2le, hp1ge, hqW, he21, hW, hWs, hXu, hYu, hu.le]
  have hp21_16 : p2 - p1 ≤ 1 / 16 := by
    linarith only [hp21, hbig, hsmall, hXpos]
  have hqlow : salaminApprox (piSteps w) - 1 / 16 ≤ 2 * e1 / sh := by
    linarith only [hqW, hq2, he21, hW, hWs, hXu, hYu, hbig, hsmall, hu.le, hXpos]
  
  have hpow := toVal_powerOf2_one_sub w
  have hp1pos : 0 ≤ p1 - 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
    linarith only [hp1ge, hqlow, hpi1, hpi3, hu4096]
  obtain ⟨lv, hlv, hflv⟩ := subFloor_err hp1 hpow w hp1pos
  obtain ⟨hv, hhv, hchv⟩ := addCeiling_err hp2 hpow w
    (by linarith only [hcp2ge, hq2, hpi1, hpi3, hu.le])
  have hlvge := hflv.ge_of_le (B := 5) (by linarith only [hfp1le, hq1, hpi2, hpi4, hu.le])
  have hhvle := hchv.le_of_le (B := 12) (by linarith only [hp2le, hq2le, hu4096])
  have hflvle := hflv.le
  have hchvge := hchv.ge
  refine ⟨lv, hv, hlv, hhv, hflv.nonneg, by linarith only [hflvle, hfp1le, hq1, hpi2, hu],
    by linarith only [hchvge, hcp2ge, hq2, hpi1, hu.le], ?_⟩
  have := two_pow_le_piEps (w := w) (by omega)
  linarith only [hhvle, hlvge, hp21, hYu, hbig, this, hXpos, hu.le]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.piApprox_spec
statement:
theorem piApprox_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, Rounds (piApprox w).1 lv ∧ Rounds (piApprox w).2 hv ∧
      lv < Real.pi ∧ Real.pi ≤ hv ∧ hv - lv ≤ piEps w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨lv, hv, hlv, hhv, -, hlo, hhi, hwidth⟩ := piBracket_spec hw
  refine ⟨lv, hv, ?_, ?_, hlo, hhi, hwidth⟩
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hlv)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hlv] at hR
    exact hR
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hhv)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hhv] at hR
    exact hR

name: Azurite.AzFloat.piApprox_isSome_exists
statement:
theorem piApprox_isSome_exists (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (w₀ : ℕ)
    (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) :
    ∃ f : ℕ, (roundingPossible (piApprox (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).1 (piApprox (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).2 p
      mode).isSome = true
proof:
:=
  exists_isSome_of_irrational_threshold p mode piApprox irrational_pi piEps tendsto_piEps 64
    (fun w hw => by
      obtain ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo, hhi, hwidth⟩ := piApprox_spec hw
      exact ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi, hwidth⟩) w₀ hw₀

name: Azurite.AzFloat.compare_natCast
statement: theorem compare_natCast (a b : ℕ) : compare (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) = compare a b
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a b with h | h | h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (by exact_mod_cast h)]
  · rw [h, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl]
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (by exact_mod_cast h)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.compare_neg_neg
statement: theorem compare_neg_neg (a b : ℝ) : compare (-a) (-b) = (compare a b).swap
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a b with h | h | h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (neg_lt_neg h)]; rfl
  · rw [h, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl]; rfl
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (neg_lt_neg h)]; rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_false
statement: theorem finiteVal_false (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) : finiteVal false e m = -finiteVal true e m
proof:
:=
  finiteVal_not true e m

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_true_pos
statement:
theorem finiteVal_true_pos (e : AzInt) {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid p m) :
    0 < finiteVal true e m
proof:
:= by
  have hm : m ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_size_pos (by
    rw [hv.size_eq]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hv.pos (le_alignedBits p))
  exact (finiteVal_pos_iff true e m hm).mpr rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_lt_of_exponent_lt
statement:
theorem finiteVal_lt_of_exponent_lt (e₁ : AzInt) {p₁ : ℕ} {m₁ : AzNat} (h₁ : FiniteValid p₁ m₁)
    (e₂ : AzInt) {p₂ : ℕ} {m₂ : AzNat} (h₂ : FiniteValid p₂ m₂) (h : e₁.toInt < e₂.toInt) :
    finiteVal true e₁ m₁ < finiteVal true e₂ m₂
proof:
:= by
  have hb₁ := (abs_finiteVal_bounds true e₁ h₁).2
  have hb₂ := (abs_finiteVal_bounds true e₂ h₂).1
  rw [abs_of_pos (finiteVal_true_pos e₁ h₁)] at hb₁
  rw [abs_of_pos (finiteVal_true_pos e₂ h₂)] at hb₂
  calc finiteVal true e₁ m₁ < (2 : ℝ) ^ e₁.toInt := hb₁
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (e₂.toInt - 1) := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
    _ ≤ finiteVal true e₂ m₂ := hb₂

name: Azurite.AzFloat.compare_aligned
statement:
theorem compare_aligned (e : AzInt) (m₁ m₂ : AzNat) (hs : m₁.size ≤ m₂.size) :
    AzNat.compare (m₁.shiftLeft (m₂.size - m₁.size)) m₂
      = compare (finiteVal true e m₁) (finiteVal true e m₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzNat.compare_eq_compare_toNat, AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft, ← compare_natCast]
  unfold finiteVal
  simp only [↓reduceIte, one_mul]
  conv_rhs => rw [← compare_mul_right_pos _ _ ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((m₂.size : ℤ) - e.toInt))
    (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _)]
  congr 1
  · push_cast
    rw [mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num), ← zpow_natCast]
    congr 2
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hs]
    ring
  · rw [mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
    simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.compare_aligned'
statement:
theorem compare_aligned' (e : AzInt) (m₁ m₂ : AzNat) (hs : m₂.size ≤ m₁.size) :
    AzNat.compare m₁ (m₂.shiftLeft (m₁.size - m₂.size))
      = compare (finiteVal true e m₁) (finiteVal true e m₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzNat.compare_eq_compare_toNat, AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft, ← compare_natCast]
  unfold finiteVal
  simp only [↓reduceIte, one_mul]
  conv_rhs => rw [← compare_mul_right_pos _ _ ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((m₁.size : ℤ) - e.toInt))
    (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _)]
  congr 1
  · rw [mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
    simp
  · push_cast
    rw [mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num), ← zpow_natCast]
    congr 2
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hs]
    ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.compareMagnitude_eq
statement:
theorem compareMagnitude_eq (e₁ : AzInt) {p₁ : ℕ} {m₁ : AzNat} (h₁ : FiniteValid p₁ m₁)
    (e₂ : AzInt) {p₂ : ℕ} {m₂ : AzNat} (h₂ : FiniteValid p₂ m₂) :
    compareMagnitude e₁ m₁ e₂ m₂ = compare (finiteVal true e₁ m₁) (finiteVal true e₂ m₂)
proof:
:= by
  unfold compareMagnitude
  rw [AzInt.compare_eq_compare_toInt]
  rcases lt_trichotomy e₁.toInt e₂.toInt with h | h | h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h]
    exact (compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (finiteVal_lt_of_exponent_lt e₁ h₁ e₂ h₂ h)).symm
  · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h]
    have he : e₁ = e₂ := by rw [← AzInt.ofInt_toInt e₁, ← AzInt.ofInt_toInt e₂, h]
    subst he
    by_cases hs : m₁.size ≤ m₂.size
    · rw [ite_eq_left hs]
      exact compare_aligned e₁ m₁ m₂ hs
    · rw [ite_eq_right hs]
      exact compare_aligned' e₁ m₁ m₂ (le_of_not_ge hs)
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h]
    exact (compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (finiteVal_lt_of_exponent_lt e₂ h₂ e₁ h₁ h)).symm

name: Azurite.AzFloat.partialCompare_eq
statement:
theorem partialCompare_eq (x y : AzFloat) :
    partialCompare x y = match x.toVal, y.toVal with
      | some a, some b => some (compare a b)
      | _, _ => none
proof:
:= by
  have hT : ∀ r : ℝ, compare (⊤ : EReal) (r : EReal) = .gt := fun r =>
    compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (EReal.coe_lt_top r)
  have hB : ∀ r : ℝ, compare (⊥ : EReal) (r : EReal) = .lt := fun r =>
    compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (EReal.bot_lt_coe r)
  have hT' : ∀ r : ℝ, compare (r : EReal) (⊤ : EReal) = .lt := fun r =>
    compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (EReal.coe_lt_top r)
  have hB' : ∀ r : ℝ, compare (r : EReal) (⊥ : EReal) = .gt := fun r =>
    compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (EReal.bot_lt_coe r)
  have h0 : ((0 : ℝ) : EReal) = 0 := EReal.coe_zero
  cases x with
  | nan => cases y <;> rfl
  | infinity s =>
    cases y with
    | nan => rfl
    | infinity t =>
      cases s <;> cases t <;> simp only [partialCompare, compareSigns, toVal_infinity,
        Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.true_eq_false, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq]
      · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl]
      · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr bot_lt_top]
      · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr bot_lt_top]
      · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl]
    | zero =>
      cases s <;> simp only [partialCompare, toVal_infinity, toVal_zero, Bool.false_eq_true,
        ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq]
      · rw [← h0, hB]
      · rw [← h0, hT]
    | finite t e q m hv =>
      cases s <;> simp only [partialCompare, toVal_infinity, toVal_finite, Bool.false_eq_true,
        ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq]
      · rw [hB]
      · rw [hT]
  | zero =>
    cases y with
    | nan => rfl
    | infinity t =>
      cases t <;> simp only [partialCompare, toVal_infinity, toVal_zero, Bool.false_eq_true,
        ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq]
      · rw [← h0, hB']
      · rw [← h0, hT']
    | zero =>
      simp only [partialCompare, toVal_zero, Option.some.injEq]
      rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl]
    | finite t e q m hv =>
      have hpos := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
      simp only [partialCompare, toVal_zero, toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq]
      rw [← h0, compare_coe_coe]
      cases t
      · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [finiteVal_false]
        exact (compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (by linarith)).symm
      · simp only [↓reduceIte]
        exact (compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr hpos).symm
  | finite s e₁ q₁ m₁ h₁ =>
    cases y with
    | nan => rfl
    | infinity t =>
      cases t <;> simp only [partialCompare, toVal_infinity, toVal_finite, Bool.false_eq_true,
        ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq]
      · rw [hB']
      · rw [hT']
    | zero =>
      have hpos := finiteVal_true_pos e₁ h₁
      simp only [partialCompare, toVal_zero, toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq]
      rw [← h0, compare_coe_coe]
      cases s
      · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [finiteVal_false]
        exact (compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (by linarith)).symm
      · simp only [↓reduceIte]
        exact (compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr hpos).symm
    | finite t e₂ q₂ m₂ h₂ =>
      have hpos₁ := finiteVal_true_pos e₁ h₁
      have hpos₂ := finiteVal_true_pos e₂ h₂
      simp only [partialCompare, toVal_finite]
      rw [compare_coe_coe]
      by_cases hst : s = t
      · subst hst
        rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
        cases s
        · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq]
          rw [finiteVal_false, finiteVal_false, compare_neg_neg,
            compareMagnitude_eq e₁ h₁ e₂ h₂]
        · simp only [↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq]
          exact compareMagnitude_eq e₁ h₁ e₂ h₂
      · rw [ite_eq_right hst]
        cases s <;> cases t <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq]
          at hst ⊢
        · exact absurd trivial hst
        · rw [finiteVal_false]
          exact (compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (by linarith)).symm
        · rw [finiteVal_false]
          exact (compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (by linarith)).symm
        · exact absurd trivial hst

name: Azurite.AzFloat.partialCompare_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem partialCompare_eq_none_iff (x y : AzFloat) :
    partialCompare x y = none ↔ x.isNaN = true ∨ y.isNaN = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [partialCompare_eq]
  cases x <;> cases y <;> simp [isNaN]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.eqIEEE_iff
statement:
theorem eqIEEE_iff (x y : AzFloat) :
    eqIEEE x y = true ↔ ∃ v, x.toVal = some v ∧ y.toVal = some v
proof:
:= by
  unfold eqIEEE
  rw [partialCompare_eq]
  cases hx : x.toVal with
  | none => simp
  | some a =>
    cases hy : y.toVal with
    | none => simp
    | some b =>
      simp only [beq_iff_eq, Option.some.injEq, compare_eq_iff_eq]
      constructor
      · rintro rfl
        exact ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨v, hv, hv'⟩
        rw [hv, hv']

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_div_toRat
statement:
theorem finiteVal_div_toRat (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) (q : AzRat) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) :
    finiteVal s e m / AzRat.toRat q
      = ((if (s == q.sign) then 1 else -1) * (((m * q.den).toNat : ℝ) / (q.num.toNat : ℝ)) : ℝ)
        * 2 ^ (e - (AzNat.ofNat m.size).toAzInt).toInt
proof:
:= by
  have hnum : (q.num.toNat : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (AzRat.num_toNat_pos q hq).ne'
  have hden : (q.den.toNat : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (AzRat.den_toNat_pos q).ne'
  rw [AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_mul, coe_toRat_eq]
  unfold finiteVal
  cases s <;> cases q.sign <;> simp <;> field_simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toRat_div_finiteVal
statement:
theorem toRat_div_finiteVal (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) (hm : m ≠ 0) (q : AzRat) :
    AzRat.toRat q / finiteVal s e m
      = ((if (q.sign == s) then 1 else -1) * ((q.num.toNat : ℝ) / ((q.den * m).toNat : ℝ)) : ℝ)
        * 2 ^ ((AzNat.ofNat m.size).toAzInt - e).toInt
proof:
:= by
  have hm'' : m.toNat ≠ 0 := fun h => hm (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm))
  have hm' : (m.toNat : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm''
  have hden : (q.den.toNat : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (AzRat.den_toNat_pos q).ne'
  have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((AzNat.ofNat m.size).toAzInt - e).toInt
      = (2 ^ (e.toInt - m.size))⁻¹ := by
    rw [AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, ← zpow_neg]
    congr 1
    ring
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - m.size) ≠ 0 := (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _).ne'
  rw [hpow, AzNat.toNat_mul, coe_toRat_eq]
  unfold finiteVal
  cases s <;> cases q.sign <;> simp <;> field_simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.divRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal
statement:
theorem divRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal (x : AzFloat) (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    divRatPrecRound x q p mode
      = liftVal (fun a => Spec.div a ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal)) x p mode
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity s =>
    unfold liftVal
    rw [toVal_infinity, Option.bind_some]
    by_cases hq : q.num = 0
    · have hq0 : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) = 0 := (AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr hq
      rw [hq0, EReal.coe_zero, Spec.div_inf_zero, roundVal_inf]
      simp [divRatPrecRound, hq]
    · have hq0 : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hq ((AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mp h)
      rw [Spec.div_inf_coe s _ hq0, roundVal_inf]
      simp [divRatPrecRound, hq, sign_eq_decide_pos q hq]
  | zero =>
    unfold liftVal
    rw [toVal_zero, Option.bind_some]
    by_cases hq : q.num = 0
    · have hq0 : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) = 0 := (AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr hq
      simp [divRatPrecRound, hq, hq0, Spec.div]
    · have hq0 : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hq ((AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mp h)
      rw [Spec.div_zero_coe _ hq0, roundVal_zero]
      simp [divRatPrecRound, hq]
  | finite s e p' m hv =>
    unfold liftVal
    rw [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
      intro hm; rw [hm] at hv; exact absurd hv.size_eq (by simp; exact
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hv.pos (le_alignedBits p')).ne)
    have hx0 := finiteVal_ne_zero s e hv
    by_cases hq : q.num = 0
    · have hq0 : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) = 0 := (AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr hq
      rw [hq0, EReal.coe_zero, Spec.div_coe_zero _ hx0]
      simp only [divRatPrecRound, hq, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hpos : 0 < finiteVal s e m
      · have hs : s = true := (finiteVal_pos_iff s e m hm0).mp hpos
        rw [ite_eq_left hpos, roundVal_top, hs]
      · have hs : s = false := by
          cases s
          · rfl
          · exact absurd ((finiteVal_pos_iff true e m hm0).mpr rfl) hpos
        rw [ite_eq_right hpos, roundVal_bot, hs]
    · have hq0 : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hq ((AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mp h)
      rw [Spec.div_coe_coe _ _ hq0]
      simp only [divRatPrecRound, hq, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [shift_ofFractionRound_eq _ _ _ (fun h => hq h), finiteVal_div_toRat s e m q hq]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ratDivPrecRound_eq_liftVal
statement:
theorem ratDivPrecRound_eq_liftVal (q : AzRat) (x : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    ratDivPrecRound q x p mode
      = liftVal (fun a => Spec.div ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal) a) x p mode
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity t =>
    show (zero, Ordering.eq) = _
    unfold liftVal
    rw [toVal_infinity, Option.bind_some, Spec.div_coe_inf, roundVal_zero]
  | zero =>
    unfold liftVal
    rw [toVal_zero, Option.bind_some]
    by_cases hq : q.num = 0
    · have hq0 : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) = 0 := (AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr hq
      simp [ratDivPrecRound, hq, hq0, Spec.div]
    · have hq0 : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hq ((AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mp h)
      rw [Spec.div_coe_zero _ hq0]
      simp only [ratDivPrecRound, hq, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hpos : 0 < (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)
      · have hs : q.sign = true := by rw [sign_eq_decide_pos q hq]; exact decide_eq_true hpos
        rw [ite_eq_left hpos, roundVal_top, hs]
      · have hs : q.sign = false := by rw [sign_eq_decide_pos q hq]; exact decide_eq_false hpos
        rw [ite_eq_right hpos, roundVal_bot, hs]
  | finite s e p' m hv =>
    unfold liftVal
    rw [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
      intro hm; rw [hm] at hv; exact absurd hv.size_eq (by simp; exact
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hv.pos (le_alignedBits p')).ne)
    have hx0 := finiteVal_ne_zero s e hv
    rw [Spec.div_coe_coe _ _ hx0]
    show ((ofFractionRound _ _ _ p mode).1 <<< _, (ofFractionRound _ _ _ p mode).2) = _
    have hdm : q.den * m ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg AzNat.toNat h
      rw [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_zero] at this
      rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp this with h1 | h1
      · exact (AzRat.den_toNat_pos q).ne' h1
      · exact hm0 (AzNat.toNat_injective (h1.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm))
    rw [shift_ofFractionRound_eq _ _ _ hdm, toRat_div_finiteVal s e m hm0 q]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.lemniscateApprox_spec
statement:
theorem lemniscateApprox_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, Rounds (lemniscateApprox w).1 lv ∧ Rounds (lemniscateApprox w).2 hv ∧
      lv ≤ BZ.lemniscate ∧ BZ.lemniscate ≤ hv ∧ (lv = BZ.lemniscate → hv = BZ.lemniscate)
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨lπ, hπ, hlπ, hhπ, hlπ0, hlπlt, hπle, -⟩ := piBracket_spec hw
  obtain ⟨lG, hG, hlG, hhG, hlG0, hlGlt, hGle⟩ := gaussBracket_spec w
  obtain ⟨lo, hlo, hlole⟩ := mulFloor_spec hlπ hlG w
  obtain ⟨hi, hhi, hhige⟩ := mulCeiling_spec hhπ hhG w
  have hGpos : 0 < (AGM 1 (Real.sqrt 2))⁻¹ := by linarith
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  have hlt : lo < BZ.lemniscate := by
    rw [lemniscate_eq_pi_mul_gauss]
    have h1 : lπ * lG ≤ Real.pi * lG := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlπlt.le hlG0
    have h2 : Real.pi * lG < Real.pi * (AGM 1 (Real.sqrt 2))⁻¹ :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlGlt hpi
    linarith
  have hge : BZ.lemniscate ≤ hi := by
    rw [lemniscate_eq_pi_mul_gauss]
    exact (mul_le_mul hπle hGle hGpos.le (by linarith)).trans hhige
  refine ⟨lo, hi, ?_, ?_, hlt.le, hge, fun h => absurd h hlt.ne⟩
  · have := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hlo)
    rwa [fval_of_toVal_coe hlo] at this
  · have := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hhi)
    rwa [fval_of_toVal_coe hhi] at this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.lemniscateConstantPrecRound_eq_or
statement:
theorem lemniscateConstantPrecRound_eq_or (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    lemniscateConstantPrecRound p mode = liftVal₀ (some ((BZ.lemniscate : ℝ) : EReal)) p mode ∨
      lemniscateConstantPrecRound p mode = (nan, .eq)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lemniscateConstantPrecRound liftVal₀
  rcases eq_or_ne (zivLoop lemniscateApprox p mode (agmFuel p) (p + zivGuardBits)) (nan, .eq)
    with hz | hz
  · right; exact hz
  · left
    exact zivLoop_eq_of_ne_nan_threshold p mode _ _ 64 (fun w hw => lemniscateApprox_spec hw) _ _
      (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega) hz

proof:
:= by
  have h5 : ¬ IsSquare 5 := by
    rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
