  have := (irrational_sqrt_natCast_iff (n := 5)).mpr h5
  simpa using this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.phiApprox_spec
statement:
theorem phiApprox_spec (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∃ lov e₁ : ℝ, lov ≤ Real.sqrt 5 ∧ Real.sqrt 5 ≤ lov + e₁ ∧ (lov = Real.sqrt 5 → e₁ = 0) ∧
      0 ≤ e₁ ∧ e₁ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 - (w : ℤ)) ∧
      Rounds (phiApprox w).1 (lov / 2 + 1 / 2) ∧
      Rounds (phiApprox w).2 ((lov + e₁) / 2 + 1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold phiApprox
  simp only
  rw [sqrtPrecRound_eq_liftVal]
  unfold liftVal
  rw [toVal_ofAzNat_ofNat, Nat.cast_ofNat, Option.bind_some, Spec.sqrt_coe 5 (by norm_num)]
  obtain ⟨lov, e₁, hlo, he₁, hlo1, hlo2, hlo3, hlo4, hlo5, hmem⟩ := truncError_spec w (Real.sqrt 5)
  obtain ⟨_, hs5gt, hs5lt⟩ := sqrt5_facts
  
  have hlofl : ((lov : ℝ) : EReal) = (roundFloor (precisionSet 2 w) (Real.sqrt 5)).val := by
    rw [fst_roundVal] at hlo
    change (ofEReal w .Floor (Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ)).toVal = _ at hlo
    have h := (ofEReal_spec w .Floor (Real.sqrt 5)).2
    rw [val_round_floatSet] at h
    rw [h, Option.some.injEq] at hlo
    exact hlo.symm
  have hlo0 : 0 ≤ lov := by
    have := (isGreatest_roundFloor (precisionSet 2 w) (Real.sqrt 5)).2
      ⟨Or.inl (by simp), EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg 5)⟩
    rw [← hlofl] at this
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp (by simpa using this)
  have hbound : e₁ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 - (w : ℤ)) := by
    rcases eq_or_ne e₁ 0 with h0 | h0
    · rw [h0]; positivity
    · obtain ⟨k, hk, hk1, _⟩ := hlo5 h0
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hlo0] at hk1
      have : k - 1 < 2 := (zpow_lt_zpow_iff_right₀ (by norm_num)).mp
        (lt_of_le_of_lt hk1 (by linarith : lov < (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℤ)))
      rw [hk]
      exact zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  
  have hhi : (addPrecRound (roundVal w .Floor (some ((Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) : EReal))).1
      (truncError (roundVal w .Floor (some ((Real.sqrt 5 : ℝ) : EReal)))) w .Ceiling).1.toVal
      = some ((lov + e₁ : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [addPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂]
    unfold liftVal₂
    rw [hlo, he₁, Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some, Spec.add_coe_coe, fst_roundVal]
    change (ofEReal w .Ceiling ((lov + e₁ : ℝ) : EReal)).toVal = _
    rw [(ofEReal_spec w .Ceiling (lov + e₁)).2, val_round_of_mem _ .Ceiling hmem]
  have hshift : ∀ (f : AzFloat) (v : ℝ), f.toVal = some (v : EReal) →
      (f >>> (1 : Nat)).toVal = some ((v / 2 : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    intro f v hf
    show (shiftRight f (AzNat.ofNat 1).toAzInt).toVal = _
    rw [toVal_shiftRight, hf, Option.map_some, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, ← EReal.coe_mul]
    congr 2
    push_cast
    rw [zpow_neg_one, div_eq_mul_inv]
  refine ⟨lov, e₁, hlo1, hlo2, hlo3, hlo4, hbound, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p'' _ mo
    beta_reduce
    rw [addPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂]
    unfold liftVal₂
    rw [hshift _ _ hlo, toVal_oneHalf, Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some, Spec.add_coe_coe]
  · intro p'' _ mo
    beta_reduce
    rw [addPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂]
    unfold liftVal₂
    rw [hshift _ _ hhi, toVal_oneHalf, Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some, Spec.add_coe_coe]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.phiApprox_possible
statement:
theorem phiApprox_possible (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (w : ℕ)
    (hw : 2 * p + 6 ≤ w) :
    (roundingPossible (phiApprox w).1 (phiApprox w).2 p mode).isSome = true
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨lov, e₁, h1, h2, h3, h4, he₁, hl, hh⟩ := phiApprox_spec w
  obtain ⟨hs5, hs5gt, hs5lt⟩ := sqrt5_facts
  set φ := (1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2 with hφ
  have hφlo : 1 < φ := by rw [hφ]; linarith
  have hφhi : φ < 2 := by rw [hφ]; linarith
  have hφ0 : φ ≠ 0 := by linarith
  apply roundingPossible_isSome_of_no_boundary p mode hl hh (by linarith)
  
  have hφB : ((φ : ℝ) : EReal) ∉ floatSet (p + 1) := by
    intro hB
    obtain ⟨M, k, hMk, _⟩ := boundary_repr p φ hB hφ0
    set a : ℕ := (-k).toNat with ha
    have hka : 0 ≤ k + a := by have := Int.self_le_toNat (-k); omega
    have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ k * 2 ^ a = (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + a).toNat := by
      rw [← zpow_natCast (2 : ℝ) (k + a).toNat, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hka, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num),
        zpow_natCast]
    have h5 : Real.sqrt 5 = 2 * ((M : ℝ) * 2 ^ k) - 1 := by rw [← hMk, hφ]; ring
    have hrat : Real.sqrt 5
        = ((2 * M * 2 ^ (k + a).toNat - 2 ^ a : ℤ) : ℝ) / ((2 ^ a : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      have hb : ((2 ^ a : ℤ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      rw [eq_div_iff hb, h5]
      push_cast
      rw [← hpow]
      ring
    exact (irrational_iff_ne_rational _).mp irrational_sqrt5 _ _ (by positivity) hrat
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ (-(2 * (p : ℤ)) - 4) := by positivity
  have hDsmall : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(2 * (p : ℤ)) - 4) ≤ 1 / 16 := by
    calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(2 * (p : ℤ)) - 4) ≤ 2 ^ (-(4 : ℤ)) :=
          zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ = 1 / 16 := by norm_num
  
  have hlogφ : Int.log 2 |φ| = 0 := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Int.lt_add_one_iff.mp
      apply (Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt (b := 2) (by norm_num) (by linarith)).mp
      push_cast
      simpa using hφhi
    · apply (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log (b := 2) (by norm_num) (by linarith)).mp
      push_cast
      simpa using hφlo.le
  have hdist : ∀ b : ℝ, ((b : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ floatSet (p + 1) → b ≠ φ →
      (b = 0 ∨ Int.log 2 |φ| ≤ Int.log 2 |b|) → 2 ^ (-(2 * (p : ℤ)) - 4) ≤ |φ - b| := by
    intro b hb hne hlog
    rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with hb0 | hb0
    · rw [hb0, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
      linarith
    have hb1 : 1 ≤ |b| := by
      rcases hlog with h | h
      · exact absurd h hb0
      · rw [hlogφ] at h
        have := Int.zpow_log_le_self (b := 2) (by norm_num) (abs_pos.mpr hb0)
        have h0 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (0 : ℤ) ≤ 2 ^ Int.log 2 |b| := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) h
        push_cast at this h0
        linarith [h0, this]
    rcases le_or_gt b (-1) with hneg | hpos
    · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
      linarith
    have hbpos : 1 ≤ b := by
      rcases le_abs.mp hb1 with h | h
      · exact h
      · linarith
    rcases le_or_gt (5 / 2) b with hfar | hnear
    · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]
      linarith
    
    obtain ⟨M, k, hMk, hk⟩ := boundary_repr p b hb hb0
    have hlogb : 0 ≤ Int.log 2 |b| := by
      rcases hlog with h | h
      · exact absurd h hb0
      · rwa [hlogφ] at h
    have hkp : 0 ≤ k + p := by omega
    have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ k * 2 ^ p = (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + p).toNat := by
      rw [← zpow_natCast (2 : ℝ) (k + p).toNat, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hkp, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num),
        zpow_natCast]
    set c : ℝ := 2 * b - 1 with hc
    set N : ℤ := 2 * M * 2 ^ (k + p).toNat - 2 ^ p with hN
    have hcN : c * 2 ^ p = N := by
      rw [hc, hMk, hN]
      push_cast
      rw [← hpow]
      ring
    have hc1 : 1 ≤ c := by rw [hc]; linarith
    have hc4 : c < 4 := by rw [hc]; linarith
    
    have hc5 : c ^ 2 ≠ 5 := by
      intro h
      have hceq : c = Real.sqrt 5 := by
        rw [← h, Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)]
      have hrat : Real.sqrt 5 = (N : ℝ) / ((2 ^ p : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        rw [← hceq, eq_div_iff (by positivity)]
        push_cast
        exact hcN
      exact (irrational_iff_ne_rational _).mp irrational_sqrt5 _ _ (by positivity) hrat
    have h4 : (4 : ℝ) ^ p = (2 ^ p) ^ 2 := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul]; norm_num
    have hp2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 ^ p) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hint : (5 * 4 ^ p - N ^ 2 : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hc5
      have h' : (5 : ℝ) * 4 ^ p = (N : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        have := congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (z : ℝ)) h
        push_cast at this
        linarith
      rw [h4, ← hcN, mul_pow] at h'
      exact (mul_right_cancel₀ hp2.ne' (by linarith : 5 * (2 ^ p) ^ 2 = c ^ 2 * (2 ^ p) ^ 2)).symm
    have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |((5 * 4 ^ p - N ^ 2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| := by
      exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hint
    have hdiff : |5 - c ^ 2| * (2 ^ p) ^ 2 = |((5 * 4 ^ p - N ^ 2 : ℤ) : ℝ)| := by
      have hx : ((5 * 4 ^ p - N ^ 2 : ℤ) : ℝ) = (5 - c ^ 2) * (2 ^ p) ^ 2 := by
        push_cast
        rw [h4, ← hcN]
        ring
      rw [hx, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hp2]
    have hdiff' : (1 : ℝ) / (2 ^ p) ^ 2 ≤ |5 - c ^ 2| := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hp2]
      linarith
    
    have hfactor : |Real.sqrt 5 - c| * (Real.sqrt 5 + c) = |5 - c ^ 2| := by
      rw [← abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt 5 + c), ← abs_mul]
      congr 1
      nlinarith [hs5]
    have hsum : Real.sqrt 5 + c < 8 := by linarith
    have hsc : |Real.sqrt 5 - c| ≥ 1 / (2 ^ p) ^ 2 / 8 := by
      have := hfactor
      have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt 5 + c := by linarith
      rw [ge_iff_le, div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 8)]
      calc (1 : ℝ) / (2 ^ p) ^ 2 ≤ |5 - c ^ 2| := hdiff'
        _ = |Real.sqrt 5 - c| * (Real.sqrt 5 + c) := hfactor.symm
        _ ≤ |Real.sqrt 5 - c| * 8 := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum.le (abs_nonneg _)
    have hφb : |φ - b| = |Real.sqrt 5 - c| / 2 := by
      rw [hφ, hc, ← abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2), ← abs_div]
      congr 1
      ring
    have hpow2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(2 * (p : ℤ)) - 4) = 1 / (2 ^ p) ^ 2 / 8 / 2 := by
      rw [show -(2 * (p : ℤ)) - 4 = -((p * 2 + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, zpow_neg,
        zpow_natCast, pow_add, pow_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hφb, hpow2]
    linarith
  
  have hwidth : (lov + e₁) / 2 + 1 / 2 - (lov / 2 + 1 / 2) < 2 ^ (-(2 * (p : ℤ)) - 4) := by
    have : (lov + e₁) / 2 + 1 / 2 - (lov / 2 + 1 / 2) = e₁ / 2 := by ring
    rw [this]
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 - (w : ℤ)) / 2 = 2 ^ (1 - (w : ℤ)) := by
      rw [show (2 : ℤ) - w = (1 - (w : ℤ)) + 1 by ring, zpow_add_one₀ (by norm_num)]
      ring
    have h3 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - (w : ℤ)) < 2 ^ (-(2 * (p : ℤ)) - 4) :=
      zpow_lt_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
    linarith
  exact no_boundary_of_dist p φ _ _ _ hφ0 hφB (by rw [hφ]; linarith) (by rw [hφ]; linarith)
    hdist hwidth

name: Azurite.AzFloat.phiPrecRound_eq_liftVal₀
statement:
theorem phiPrecRound_eq_liftVal₀ (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    phiPrecRound p mode = liftVal₀ (some (((1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2 : ℝ) : EReal)) p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold phiPrecRound liftVal₀
  have hstart : 0 < p + zivGuardBits := by unfold zivGuardBits; omega
  apply zivLoop_eq p mode phiApprox ((1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2) ?_ (2 * p + 6) ?_ _ _ hstart
    (le_mul_two_pow_zivFuel _ _ hstart)
  · intro w hw
    have : NeZero w := ⟨hw.ne'⟩
    obtain ⟨lov, e₁, h1, h2, h3, _, _, hl, hh⟩ := phiApprox_spec w
    refine ⟨_, _, hl, hh, by linarith, by linarith, ?_⟩
    intro h
    have : lov = Real.sqrt 5 := by linarith
    rw [h3 this, add_zero, this]
    ring
  · intro w hw
    exact phiApprox_possible p mode w hw

name: Azurite.AzFloat.mem_hexDigits
statement:
theorem mem_hexDigits (N : AzNat) (u : Bool) (c : Char) (hc : c ∈ hexDigits N u) :
    ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < 16
proof:
:= by
  unfold hexDigits at hc
  rw [Array.toList_map, List.mem_map] at hc
  obtain ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩ := hc
  have hlt := AzRat.digits_rev_lt_base 16 (by decide) N d (Array.mem_toList_iff.mp hd)
  rw [show (16 : UInt64).toNat = 16 from rfl] at hlt
  exact ⟨d, AzRat.charToDigit_digitToChar' d (by omega) u, hlt⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.mem_decDigits
statement:
theorem mem_decDigits (N : AzNat) (c : Char) (hc : c ∈ decDigits N) :
    ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < 10
proof:
:= by
  unfold decDigits at hc
  rw [Array.toList_map, List.mem_map] at hc
  obtain ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩ := hc
  have hlt := AzRat.digits_rev_lt_base 10 (by decide) N d (Array.mem_toList_iff.mp hd)
  rw [show (10 : UInt64).toNat = 10 from rfl] at hlt
  exact ⟨d, AzRat.charToDigit_digitToChar' d (by omega) false, hlt⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.map_digitVal_hexDigits
statement:
theorem map_digitVal_hexDigits (N : AzNat) (u : Bool) :
    (hexDigits N u).map AzRat.digitVal = (Nat.digits 16 N.toNat).reverse
proof:
:= by
  unfold hexDigits
  rw [Array.toList_map, List.map_map, Array.toList_reverse, List.map_reverse]
  have h := AzNat.limbDigits_eq 16 (by decide) N
  rw [show (16 : UInt64).toNat = 16 from rfl] at h
  congr 1
  rw [← h]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro d hd
  have hlt := AzRat.digits_rev_lt_base 16 (by decide) N d (by simpa using hd)
  rw [show (16 : UInt64).toNat = 16 from rfl] at hlt
  exact AzRat.digitVal_digitToChar d (by omega) u

name: Azurite.AzFloat.map_digitVal_decDigits
statement:
theorem map_digitVal_decDigits (N : AzNat) :
    (decDigits N).map AzRat.digitVal = (Nat.digits 10 N.toNat).reverse
proof:
:= by
  unfold decDigits
  rw [Array.toList_map, List.map_map, Array.toList_reverse, List.map_reverse]
  have h := AzNat.limbDigits_eq 10 (by decide) N
  rw [show (10 : UInt64).toNat = 10 from rfl] at h
  congr 1
  rw [← h]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro d hd
  have hlt := AzRat.digits_rev_lt_base 10 (by decide) N d (by simpa using hd)
  rw [show (10 : UInt64).toNat = 10 from rfl] at hlt
  exact AzRat.digitVal_digitToChar d (by omega) false

name: Azurite.AzFloat.length_hexDigits
statement:
theorem length_hexDigits (N : AzNat) (u : Bool) :
    (hexDigits N u).length = (Nat.digits 16 N.toNat).length
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg List.length (map_digitVal_hexDigits N u)
  rwa [List.length_map, List.length_reverse] at this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.zero_char_spec
statement: theorem zero_char_spec : AzRat.digitVal '0' = 0 ∧ ∃ d, charToDigit '0' = some d ∧ d.toNat < 16
proof:
:=
  ⟨AzRat.digitVal_zero, 0, by decide, by decide⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.parseMagnitude_hexDigits
statement:
theorem parseMagnitude_hexDigits (N : AzNat) (hN : N ≠ 0) (u : Bool) (pre zs : List Char)
    (hpre : ∀ c ∈ pre, AzRat.digitVal c = 0 ∧ ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < 16)
    (hzs : ∀ c ∈ zs, AzRat.digitVal c = 0 ∧ ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < 16) :
    ∃ N', AzRat.parseMagnitude 16 (pre ++ hexDigits N u ++ zs) = some N' ∧
      N'.toNat = N.toNat * 16 ^ zs.length
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ∀ l : List Char,
      (∀ c ∈ l, AzRat.digitVal c = 0 ∧ ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < 16) →
      l.map AzRat.digitVal = List.replicate l.length 0 := fun l hl => by
    rw [List.eq_replicate_iff]
    exact ⟨by rw [List.length_map], fun x hx => by
      rw [List.mem_map] at hx
      obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact (hl c hc).1⟩
  obtain ⟨N', hN', hval⟩ := AzRat.parseMagnitude_eq 16 (by decide) (pre ++ hexDigits N u ++ zs)
    (by
      intro h
      have := congrArg List.length h
      rw [List.length_append, List.length_append, length_hexDigits, List.length_nil] at this
      have hpos : 0 < (Nat.digits 16 N.toNat).length :=
        List.length_pos_of_ne_nil (Nat.digits_ne_nil_iff_ne_zero.mpr (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hN))
      omega)
    (fun c hc => by
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with hc | hc
      · rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with hc | hc
        · obtain ⟨-, d, hd, hlt⟩ := hpre c hc
          exact ⟨d, hd, hlt⟩
        · obtain ⟨d, hd, hlt⟩ := mem_hexDigits N u c hc
          exact ⟨d, hd, hlt⟩
      · obtain ⟨-, d, hd, hlt⟩ := hzs c hc
        exact ⟨d, hd, hlt⟩)
  refine ⟨N', hN', ?_⟩
  rw [hval, show (16 : UInt64).toNat = 16 from rfl, List.map_append, List.map_append,
    map_digitVal_hexDigits, hzero pre hpre, hzero zs hzs, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_append,
    List.reverse_reverse, List.reverse_replicate, List.reverse_replicate, Nat.ofDigits_append,
    Nat.ofDigits_replicate_zero, Nat.ofDigits_append_replicate_zero, Nat.ofDigits_digits,
    List.length_replicate]
  ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.parseMagnitude_decDigits
statement:
theorem parseMagnitude_decDigits (N : AzNat) (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    AzRat.parseMagnitude 10 (decDigits N) = some N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N', hN', hval⟩ := AzRat.parseMagnitude_eq 10 (by decide) (decDigits N)
    (by
      intro h
      have := congrArg List.length (map_digitVal_decDigits N)
      rw [h, List.length_map, List.length_nil, List.length_reverse] at this
      exact Nat.digits_ne_nil_iff_ne_zero.mpr (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hN)
        (List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp this.symm))
    (fun c hc => by
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hlt⟩ := mem_decDigits N c hc
      exact ⟨d, hd, hlt⟩)
  rw [hN']
  congr 1
  apply AzNat.toNat_injective
  rw [hval, show (10 : UInt64).toNat = 10 from rfl, map_digitVal_decDigits, List.reverse_reverse,
    Nat.ofDigits_digits]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.charToDigit_hash
statement: theorem charToDigit_hash : charToDigit '#' = none
proof: := by decide

name: Azurite.AzFloat.beq_hash_eq_false_of_charToDigit
statement:
theorem beq_hash_eq_false_of_charToDigit {c : Char} {d : UInt64} (h : charToDigit c = some d) :
    (c == '#') = false
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  have : c = '#' := by simpa using hc
  subst this
  rw [charToDigit_hash] at h
  cases h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.splitHexExponent_no_sign
statement:
theorem splitHexExponent_no_sign (cs : List Char) (h : ∀ c ∈ cs, AzRat.isSignChar c = false) :
    splitHexExponent cs = some (cs, 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold splitHexExponent
  rw [AzRat.splitLast_eq_none _ _ h]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.splitHexExponent_append
statement:
theorem splitHexExponent_append (pre : List Char) (sgn : Char) (hs : AzRat.isSignChar sgn = true)
    (n : AzNat) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    splitHexExponent (pre ++ 'E' :: sgn :: decDigits n)
      = some (pre, AzInt.mkNorm (sgn == '+') n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold splitHexExponent
  rw [show pre ++ 'E' :: sgn :: decDigits n = (pre ++ ['E']) ++ sgn :: decDigits n by simp,
    AzRat.splitLast_append _ _ _ _ hs (fun c hc => by
      obtain ⟨d, hd, -⟩ := mem_decDigits n c hc
      exact AzRat.isSignChar_eq_false_of_charToDigit c d hd)]
  simp only [List.getLast?_concat, show AzRat.isExpChar 'E' = true from by decide, ↓reduceIte,
    parseMagnitude_decDigits n hn, Option.map_some, List.dropLast_concat]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofHexChars_shape
statement:
theorem ofHexChars_shape (neg : Bool) (pre post expPart : List Char) (E : AzInt) (p : ℕ)
    (hp : 0 < p)
    (hpre : ∀ c ∈ pre, ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < 16)
    (hpost : ∀ c ∈ post, ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < 16)
    (hexp : (expPart = [] ∧ E = 0) ∨
      ∃ sgn n, AzRat.isSignChar sgn = true ∧ n ≠ 0 ∧ expPart = 'E' :: sgn :: decDigits n ∧
        E = AzInt.mkNorm (sgn == '+') n)
    (N : AzNat) (hN : AzRat.parseMagnitude 16 (pre ++ post) = some N) (hN0 : N ≠ 0)
    (hdiv : N.isMultipleOfPow2 (N.size - p) = true) :
    ofHexChars ((if neg then ['-'] else []) ++
        '0' :: 'x' :: (pre ++ '.' :: post ++ expPart ++ '#' :: Nat.toDigits 10 p))
      = some (mkFinite (!neg)
          ((AzNat.ofNat N.size).toAzInt + (E - (AzNat.ofNat post.length).toAzInt).shiftLeft 2)
          p (N.shiftRight (N.size - p)))
proof:
:= by
  have hpre' : ∀ c ∈ pre, (c == '.') = false := fun c hc => by
    obtain ⟨d, hd, -⟩ := hpre c hc; exact AzRat.beq_point_eq_false_of_charToDigit c d hd
  have hmant_nosign : ∀ c ∈ pre ++ '.' :: post, AzRat.isSignChar c = false := fun c hc => by
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with hc | hc
    · obtain ⟨d, hd, -⟩ := hpre c hc; exact AzRat.isSignChar_eq_false_of_charToDigit c d hd
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hc with rfl | hc
      · decide
      · obtain ⟨d, hd, -⟩ := hpost c hc; exact AzRat.isSignChar_eq_false_of_charToDigit c d hd
  have hmant_nohash : ∀ c ∈ pre ++ '.' :: post ++ expPart, (c == '#') = false := fun c hc => by
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with hc | hc
    · rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with hc | hc
      · obtain ⟨d, hd, -⟩ := hpre c hc; exact beq_hash_eq_false_of_charToDigit hd
      · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hc with rfl | hc
        · decide
        · obtain ⟨d, hd, -⟩ := hpost c hc; exact beq_hash_eq_false_of_charToDigit hd
    · rcases hexp with ⟨rfl, -⟩ | ⟨sgn, n, hs, -, rfl, -⟩
      · simp at hc
      · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hc with rfl | hc
        · decide
        · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hc with rfl | hc
          · have : c = '+' ∨ c = '-' := by simpa [AzRat.isSignChar] using hs
            rcases this with rfl | rfl <;> decide
          · obtain ⟨d, hd, -⟩ := mem_decDigits n c hc; exact beq_hash_eq_false_of_charToDigit hd
  have hsplitE : splitHexExponent (pre ++ '.' :: post ++ expPart)
      = some (pre ++ '.' :: post, E) := by
    rcases hexp with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨sgn, n, hs, hn, rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [List.append_nil]; exact splitHexExponent_no_sign _ hmant_nosign
    · exact splitHexExponent_append _ sgn hs n hn
  have hbody : pre ++ '.' :: post ++ expPart ++ '#' :: Nat.toDigits 10 p ≠ "0.0".toList := by
    intro h
    have : '#' ∈ pre ++ '.' :: post ++ expPart ++ '#' :: Nat.toDigits 10 p := by simp
    rw [h] at this
    simp at this
  have h1 := AzRat.splitFirst_append (· == '#') (pre ++ '.' :: post ++ expPart) '#'
    (Nat.toDigits 10 p) hmant_nohash (by decide)
  have h2 := AzRat.parseDecimalDigits_toDigits p
  have h3 := AzRat.splitFirst_append (· == '.') pre '.' post hpre' (by decide)
  have hpN : ¬ (p = 0 ∨ N = 0) := by push Not; exact ⟨hp.ne', hN0⟩
  have hne : ('0' : Char) ≠ '-' := by decide
  unfold ofHexChars
  rw [ite_eq_right (by cases neg <;> simp), ite_eq_right (by cases neg <;> simp),
    ite_eq_right (by cases neg <;> simp)]
  cases neg <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.nil_append, List.singleton_append,
    List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq, hne, List.tail_cons, Bool.not_false, Bool.not_true] <;>
  · rw [ite_eq_right hbody]
    simp only [Bind.bind, Option.bind, h1, h2, hsplitE, h3, hN, hpN, ↓reduceIte, hdiv]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_ediv4
statement: theorem toInt_ediv4 (z : AzInt) : (z.ediv (AzInt.ofInt 4)).toInt = z.toInt / 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzInt.toInt_ediv, AzInt.toInt_ofInt]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_emod4
statement: theorem toInt_emod4 (z : AzInt) : (z.emod (AzInt.ofInt 4)).toInt = z.toInt % 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzInt.toInt_emod, AzInt.toInt_ofInt]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_sub_one
statement: theorem toInt_sub_one (z : AzInt) : (z - 1).toInt = z.toInt - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzInt.toInt_sub]; rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_toAzInt_ofNat
statement: theorem toInt_toAzInt_ofNat (k : ℕ) : (AzNat.ofNat k).toAzInt.toInt = k
proof:
:= by
  rw [toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_rebuilt_exponent
statement:
theorem toInt_rebuilt_exponent (sz k : ℕ) (E : AzInt) :
    ((AzNat.ofNat sz).toAzInt + (E - (AzNat.ofNat k).toAzInt).shiftLeft 2).toInt
      = (sz : ℤ) + (E.toInt - k) * 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzInt.toInt_add, toInt_toAzInt_ofNat, AzInt.toInt_shiftLeft, AzInt.toInt_sub,
    toInt_toAzInt_ofNat]
  norm_num

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofHexChars_toHexChars
statement: theorem ofHexChars_toHexChars (x : AzFloat) (u : Bool) : ofHexChars (toHexChars x u) = some x
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity s => cases s <;> rfl
  | zero => rfl
  | finite s e p m hv =>
    have hp := hv.pos
    
    set n := coreSignificand p m with hn_def
    have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := coreSignificand_ne_zero hv
    have hn_size : n.size = p := size_coreSignificand hv
    have hn_lo : 2 ^ (p - 1) ≤ n.toNat := by
      rw [← Nat.lt_size, AzNat.size_toNat, hn_size]; omega
    have hn_hi : n.toNat < 2 ^ p := by rw [← Nat.size_le, AzNat.size_toNat, hn_size]
    have hn_toNat : n.toNat ≠ 0 := toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hn0
    
    set E := (e - 1).ediv (AzInt.ofInt 4) with hE_def
    set r := (e - 1).emod (AzInt.ofInt 4) with hr_def
    have hE : E.toInt = (e.toInt - 1) / 4 := by rw [hE_def, toInt_ediv4, toInt_sub_one]
    have hr : r.toInt = (e.toInt - 1) % 4 := by rw [hr_def, toInt_emod4, toInt_sub_one]
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ r.toInt := by rw [hr]; exact Int.emod_nonneg _ (by norm_num)
    have hr4 : r.toInt < 4 := by rw [hr]; exact Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ (by norm_num)
    set m' := r.abs.toNat + 1 with hm'_def
    have hm' : (m' : ℤ) = r.toInt + 1 := by
      rw [hm'_def]; push_cast; rw [AzInt.abs_toNat_eq, abs_of_nonneg hr0]
    have he : e.toInt = 4 * E.toInt + m' := by omega
    have hm'1 : 1 ≤ m' := by omega
    have hm'4 : m' ≤ 4 := by omega
    
    set D := hexDigitCount p m' with hD_def
    have hD : D = (p - m' + 3) / 4 + 1 := rfl
    have hsh : p ≤ 4 * (D - 1) + m' := by rw [hD]; omega
    have hD4 : 4 * (D - 1) + m' ≤ p + 3 := by rw [hD]; omega
    set sh := 4 * (D - 1) + m' - p with hsh_def
    set N := n.shiftLeft sh with hN_def
    have hNtoNat : N.toNat = n.toNat * 2 ^ sh := AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft _ _
    have hN_toNat : N.toNat ≠ 0 := by rw [hNtoNat]; positivity
    have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := fun h => hN_toNat (by rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero])
    have hNsize : N.size = p + sh := by
      rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, hNtoNat, ← Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.size_shiftLeft hn_toNat,
        AzNat.size_toNat, hn_size]
    have hDlen : (Nat.digits 16 N.toNat).length = D := by
      rw [Nat.length_digits 16 _ (by norm_num) hN_toNat]
      have h16 : (16 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 4 := by norm_num
      have hlog : Nat.log 16 N.toNat = D - 1 := by
        apply Nat.log_eq_of_pow_le_of_lt_pow
        · rw [h16, ← pow_mul, hNtoNat]
          calc 2 ^ (4 * (D - 1)) ≤ 2 ^ (p - 1 + sh) :=
                Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
            _ = 2 ^ (p - 1) * 2 ^ sh := pow_add _ _ _
            _ ≤ n.toNat * 2 ^ sh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hn_lo
        · rw [h16, ← pow_mul, hNtoNat]
          calc n.toNat * 2 ^ sh < 2 ^ p * 2 ^ sh :=
                Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hn_hi (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
            _ = 2 ^ (p + sh) := (pow_add _ _ _).symm
            _ ≤ 2 ^ (4 * (D - 1 + 1)) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
      omega
    set ds := hexDigits N u with hds_def
    have hds_len : ds.length = D := by rw [hds_def, length_hexDigits, hDlen]
    have hds_dig : ∀ c ∈ ds, ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < 16 := mem_hexDigits N u
    have hds_ne : ds ≠ [] := by
      intro h; rw [h, List.length_nil] at hds_len; omega
    have hnil : ∀ c ∈ ([] : List Char),
        AzRat.digitVal c = 0 ∧ ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < 16 :=
      fun _ h => (List.not_mem_nil h).elim
    
    have hclose : ∀ (N' : AzNat) (j : ℕ) (ex : AzInt), N'.toNat = N.toNat * 16 ^ j →
        ex.toInt = e.toInt →
        N'.isMultipleOfPow2 (N'.size - p) = true ∧
          mkFinite s ex p (N'.shiftRight (N'.size - p)) = finite s e p m hv := by
      intro N' j ex hN' hex
      have h16 : (16 : ℕ) ^ j = 2 ^ (4 * j) := by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num
      have hN'toNat : N'.toNat = n.toNat * 2 ^ (sh + 4 * j) := by
        rw [hN', hNtoNat, h16, pow_add]; ring
      have hN'size : N'.size = p + (sh + 4 * j) := by
        rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, hN'toNat, ← Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.size_shiftLeft hn_toNat,
          AzNat.size_toNat, hn_size]
      have hsub : N'.size - p = sh + 4 * j := by omega
      have hcore : N'.shiftRight (N'.size - p) = n := by
        apply AzNat.toNat_injective
        rw [AzNat.toNat_shiftRight, hsub, hN'toNat, Nat.mul_div_cancel _ (Nat.two_pow_pos _)]
      have hex' : ex = e := by rw [← AzInt.ofInt_toInt ex, ← AzInt.ofInt_toInt e, hex]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [AzNat.isMultipleOfPow2_eq, decide_eq_true_eq, hsub, hN'toNat]
        exact Dvd.intro_left _ rfl
      · rw [hcore, hex']
        apply toVal_injective p (Or.inl (precision?_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hn0 hn_size.le)) (Or.inl rfl)
        rw [toVal_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hn0, toVal_finite, finiteVal_eq_core s e hv]
    
    have hsign : (if s then ([] : List Char) else ['-']) = (if !s then ['-'] else []) := by
      cases s <;> rfl
    have hcond : (E ≤ AzInt.ofInt (-6) ∨ (AzNat.ofNat ds.length).toAzInt ≤ E)
        ↔ (E.toInt ≤ -6 ∨ (D : ℤ) ≤ E.toInt) := by
      rw [AzInt.le_iff_toInt_le, AzInt.le_iff_toInt_le, AzInt.toInt_ofInt, toInt_toAzInt_ofNat,
        hds_len]
    show ofHexChars ((if s then [] else ['-']) ++ '0' :: 'x' :: hexLayout ds E ++
      '#' :: Nat.toDigits 10 p) = some (finite s e p m hv)
    rw [hsign, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.cons_append]
    unfold hexLayout
    by_cases hc1 : E.toInt ≤ -6 ∨ (D : ℤ) ≤ E.toInt
    · 
      rw [ite_eq_left (hcond.mpr hc1)]
      obtain ⟨d, rest, hds⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hds_ne
      have hE0 : E.toInt ≠ 0 := by omega
      have hEabs : E.abs ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        have := AzInt.abs_toNat_eq E
        rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero] at this
        exact hE0 (abs_eq_zero.mp (by exact_mod_cast this.symm))
      have hmk : AzInt.mkNorm ((if E.sign then '+' else '-') == '+') E.abs = E := by
        have hsgn : ((if E.sign then '+' else '-') == '+') = E.sign := by cases E.sign <;> rfl
        rw [hsgn]
        exact AzInt.mkNorm_sign_abs E hEabs
      have hexp : ∃ sgn nn, AzRat.isSignChar sgn = true ∧ nn ≠ 0 ∧
          'E' :: (if E.sign then '+' else '-') :: decDigits E.abs = 'E' :: sgn :: decDigits nn ∧
          E = AzInt.mkNorm (sgn == '+') nn :=
        ⟨_, E.abs, by cases E.sign <;> decide, hEabs, rfl, hmk.symm⟩
      rw [hds]
      have hd : ∀ c ∈ [d], ∃ k, charToDigit c = some k ∧ k.toNat < 16 := fun c hc => by
        rw [List.mem_singleton] at hc; rw [hc]; exact hds_dig d (hds ▸ List.mem_cons_self)
      cases rest with
      | nil =>
        
        have hD1 : D = 1 := by rw [← hds_len, hds]; rfl
        simp only [List.isEmpty_nil, ↓reduceIte]
        obtain ⟨N', hN', hN'val⟩ := parseMagnitude_hexDigits N hN0 u [] ['0'] hnil
          (fun c hc => by rw [List.mem_singleton] at hc; rw [hc]; exact zero_char_spec)
        norm_num at hN'val
        rw [List.nil_append, ← hds_def, hds, List.singleton_append] at hN'
        have hN'0 : N' ≠ 0 := fun h => by
          rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hN'val; exact hN_toNat (by omega)
        obtain ⟨hdiv, hfin⟩ := hclose N' 1 ((AzNat.ofNat N'.size).toAzInt +
          (E - (AzNat.ofNat (['0'] : List Char).length).toAzInt).shiftLeft 2)
          (by rw [hN'val]; norm_num) (by
          rw [toInt_rebuilt_exponent, ← AzNat.size_toNat, hN'val, hNtoNat]
          rw [show n.toNat * 2 ^ sh * 16 = n.toNat * 2 ^ (sh + 4) by rw [pow_add]; ring,
            ← Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.size_shiftLeft hn_toNat, AzNat.size_toNat, hn_size]
          simp only [List.length_singleton]
          push_cast
          omega)
        have := ofHexChars_shape (!s) [d] ['0'] _ E p hp hd
          (fun c hc => by rw [List.mem_singleton] at hc; rw [hc]; exact zero_char_spec.2)
          (Or.inr hexp) N' hN' hN'0 hdiv
        rw [Bool.not_not] at this
        rw [show (d :: '.' :: ['0'] ++ 'E' :: (if E.sign then '+' else '-') :: decDigits E.abs ++
          '#' :: Nat.toDigits 10 p) = ([d] ++ '.' :: ['0'] ++
            'E' :: (if E.sign then '+' else '-') :: decDigits E.abs ++ '#' :: Nat.toDigits 10 p)
          from rfl]
        rw [this, hfin]
      | cons c rest =>
        simp only [List.isEmpty_cons, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
        obtain ⟨N', hN', hN'val⟩ := parseMagnitude_hexDigits N hN0 u [] [] hnil hnil
        norm_num at hN'val
        rw [List.nil_append, List.append_nil, ← hds_def, hds] at hN'
        have hN'0 : N' ≠ 0 := fun h => by
          rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hN'val; exact hN_toNat (by omega)
        have hrest : ∀ x ∈ c :: rest, ∃ k, charToDigit x = some k ∧ k.toNat < 16 := fun x hx =>
          hds_dig x (hds ▸ List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)
        have hlen : (c :: rest).length = D - 1 := by
          have := hds_len; rw [hds, List.length_cons] at this; omega
        obtain ⟨hdiv, hfin⟩ := hclose N' 0 ((AzNat.ofNat N'.size).toAzInt +
          (E - (AzNat.ofNat (c :: rest).length).toAzInt).shiftLeft 2)
          (by rw [hN'val]; norm_num) (by
          rw [toInt_rebuilt_exponent, ← AzNat.size_toNat, hN'val, hNtoNat,
            ← Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.size_shiftLeft hn_toNat, AzNat.size_toNat, hn_size, hlen]
          push_cast
          omega)
        have := ofHexChars_shape (!s) [d] (c :: rest) _ E p hp hd hrest (Or.inr hexp) N'
          (by rw [List.singleton_append]; exact hN') hN'0 hdiv
        rw [Bool.not_not] at this
        rw [show (d :: '.' :: (c :: rest) ++ 'E' :: (if E.sign then '+' else '-') :: decDigits E.abs
          ++ '#' :: Nat.toDigits 10 p) = ([d] ++ '.' :: (c :: rest) ++
            'E' :: (if E.sign then '+' else '-') :: decDigits E.abs ++ '#' :: Nat.toDigits 10 p)
          from rfl]
        rw [this, hfin]
    · rw [ite_eq_right (fun h => hc1 (hcond.mp h))]
      push Not at hc1
      obtain ⟨hc1a, hc1b⟩ := hc1
      by_cases hsgn : E.sign = true
      · 
        rw [ite_eq_left hsgn]
        have hEnn : 0 ≤ E.toInt := (AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff E).mp hsgn
        have hbefore : (E.abs.toNat : ℤ) + 1 = E.toInt + 1 := by
          rw [AzInt.abs_toNat_eq, abs_of_nonneg hEnn]
        set before := E.abs.toNat + 1 with hb_def
        have hbD : before ≤ D := by omega
        dsimp only
        by_cases hlt : before < ds.length
        · rw [ite_eq_left hlt]
          obtain ⟨N', hN', hN'val⟩ := parseMagnitude_hexDigits N hN0 u [] [] hnil hnil
          norm_num at hN'val
          rw [List.nil_append, List.append_nil, ← hds_def, ← List.take_append_drop before ds] at hN'
          have hN'0 : N' ≠ 0 := fun h => by
            rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hN'val; exact hN_toNat (by omega)
          have hklen : (ds.drop before).length = D - before := by rw [List.length_drop, hds_len]
          obtain ⟨hdiv, hfin⟩ := hclose N' 0 ((AzNat.ofNat N'.size).toAzInt +
            (0 - (AzNat.ofNat (ds.drop before).length).toAzInt).shiftLeft 2)
            (by rw [hN'val]; norm_num) (by
            rw [toInt_rebuilt_exponent, ← AzNat.size_toNat, hN'val, hNtoNat,
              ← Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.size_shiftLeft hn_toNat, AzNat.size_toNat, hn_size, hklen,
              show (0 : AzInt).toInt = 0 from rfl]
            push_cast
            rw [Nat.cast_sub hbD]
            omega)
          have := ofHexChars_shape (!s) (ds.take before) (ds.drop before) [] 0 p hp
            (fun c hc => hds_dig c (List.mem_of_mem_take hc))
            (fun c hc => hds_dig c (List.mem_of_mem_drop hc)) (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) N' hN' hN'0 hdiv
          rw [Bool.not_not, List.append_nil] at this
          rw [this, hfin]
        · rw [ite_eq_right hlt]
          have hbeq : before = D := by omega
          have htake : ds.take before = ds := List.take_of_length_le (by omega)
          rw [htake]
          obtain ⟨N', hN', hN'val⟩ := parseMagnitude_hexDigits N hN0 u [] ['0'] hnil
            (fun c hc => by rw [List.mem_singleton] at hc; rw [hc]; exact zero_char_spec)
          norm_num at hN'val
          rw [List.nil_append, ← hds_def] at hN'
          have hN'0 : N' ≠ 0 := fun h => by
            rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hN'val; exact hN_toNat (by omega)
          obtain ⟨hdiv, hfin⟩ := hclose N' 1 ((AzNat.ofNat N'.size).toAzInt +
            (0 - (AzNat.ofNat (['0'] : List Char).length).toAzInt).shiftLeft 2)
            (by rw [hN'val]; norm_num) (by
            rw [toInt_rebuilt_exponent, ← AzNat.size_toNat, hN'val, hNtoNat]
            rw [show n.toNat * 2 ^ sh * 16 = n.toNat * 2 ^ (sh + 4) by rw [pow_add]; ring,
              ← Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.size_shiftLeft hn_toNat, AzNat.size_toNat, hn_size,
              show (0 : AzInt).toInt = 0 from rfl]
            simp only [List.length_singleton]
            push_cast
            omega)
          have := ofHexChars_shape (!s) ds ['0'] [] 0 p hp hds_dig
            (fun c hc => by rw [List.mem_singleton] at hc; rw [hc]; exact zero_char_spec.2)
            (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) N' hN' hN'0 hdiv
          rw [Bool.not_not, List.append_nil] at this
          rw [this, hfin]
      · 
        rw [ite_eq_right hsgn]
        have hEneg : E.toInt < 0 := by
          have := (AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff E).not.mp hsgn; omega
        set z := E.abs.toNat - 1 with hz_def
        have hz : (z : ℤ) = -E.toInt - 1 := by
          have h1 : (E.abs.toNat : ℤ) = -E.toInt := by
            rw [AzInt.abs_toNat_eq, abs_of_neg hEneg]
          have h2 : 1 ≤ E.abs.toNat := by omega
          rw [hz_def]; rw [Nat.cast_sub h2]; push_cast; omega
        obtain ⟨N', hN', hN'val⟩ :=
          parseMagnitude_hexDigits N hN0 u ('0' :: List.replicate z '0') []
          (fun c hc => by
            rcases List.mem_cons.mp hc with rfl | hc
            · exact zero_char_spec
            · rw [List.mem_replicate] at hc; rw [hc.2]; exact zero_char_spec)
          hnil
        norm_num at hN'val
        rw [List.append_nil, ← hds_def] at hN'
        have hN'0 : N' ≠ 0 := fun h => by
          rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hN'val; exact hN_toNat (by omega)
        have hklen : (List.replicate z '0' ++ ds).length = z + D := by
          rw [List.length_append, List.length_replicate, hds_len]
        obtain ⟨hdiv, hfin⟩ := hclose N' 0 ((AzNat.ofNat N'.size).toAzInt +
          (0 - (AzNat.ofNat (List.replicate z '0' ++ ds).length).toAzInt).shiftLeft 2)
          (by rw [hN'val]; norm_num) (by
          rw [toInt_rebuilt_exponent, ← AzNat.size_toNat, hN'val, hNtoNat,
            ← Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.size_shiftLeft hn_toNat, AzNat.size_toNat, hn_size, hklen,
            show (0 : AzInt).toInt = 0 from rfl]
          push_cast
          omega)
        have := ofHexChars_shape (!s) ['0'] (List.replicate z '0' ++ ds) [] 0 p hp
          (fun c hc => by rw [List.mem_singleton] at hc; rw [hc]; exact zero_char_spec.2)
          (fun c hc => by
            rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with hc | hc
            · rw [List.mem_replicate] at hc; rw [hc.2]; exact zero_char_spec.2
            · exact hds_dig c hc)
          (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) N' (by rw [List.singleton_append, ← List.cons_append]; exact hN')
          hN'0 hdiv
        rw [Bool.not_not, List.append_nil, List.singleton_append] at this
        rw [this, hfin]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofHexString_toHexString
statement:
theorem ofHexString_toHexString (x : AzFloat) (u : Bool) :
    ofHexString (toHexString x u) = some x
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofHexString toHexString
  rw [String.toList_ofList]
  exact ofHexChars_toHexChars x u

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBasePow2_coe
statement:
theorem logBasePow2_coe (k : ℤ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    logBasePow2 k (r : EReal) = some ((Real.logb 2 r / k : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBasePow2
  rw [log2_coe r hr, Option.map_some, ← EReal.coe_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBasePow2_coe_neg
statement: theorem logBasePow2_coe_neg (k : ℤ) (r : ℝ) (hr : r < 0) : logBasePow2 k (r : EReal) = none
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBasePow2
  rw [log2_coe_neg r hr, Option.map_none]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBasePow2_top
statement:
theorem logBasePow2_top (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    logBasePow2 k ⊤ = some (if 0 < k then ⊤ else ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBasePow2
  rw [log2_top, Option.map_some]
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hk with h | h
  · rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr h.le), EReal.top_mul_coe_of_neg (by simpa using h)]
  · rw [ite_eq_left h, EReal.top_mul_coe_of_pos (by simpa using h)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBasePow2_zero
statement:
theorem logBasePow2_zero (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    logBasePow2 k 0 = some (if 0 < k then ⊥ else ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBasePow2
  rw [log2_zero, Option.map_some]
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hk with h | h
  · rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr h.le), EReal.bot_mul_coe_of_neg (by simpa using h)]
  · rw [ite_eq_left h, EReal.bot_mul_coe_of_pos (by simpa using h)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBasePow2_bot
statement: @[simp] theorem logBasePow2_bot (k : ℤ) : logBasePow2 k ⊥ = none
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBasePow2
  rw [log2_bot, Option.map_none]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sign_eq_decide_pos_toInt
statement: theorem sign_eq_decide_pos_toInt (k : AzInt) (hk : k ≠ 0) : k.sign = decide (0 < k.toInt)
proof:
:= by
  have hne := toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hk
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff, decide_eq_true_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h; exact lt_of_le_of_ne h (Ne.symm hne)
  · intro h; exact h.le

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBasePow2PrecRound_eq_liftVal
statement:
theorem logBasePow2PrecRound_eq_liftVal (x : AzFloat) (k : AzInt) (hk : k ≠ 0) (p : ℕ)
    [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    logBasePow2PrecRound x k p mode = liftVal (Spec.logBasePow2 k.toInt) x p mode
proof:
:= by
  have hkI := toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hk
  unfold logBasePow2PrecRound liftVal
  rw [dite_eq_right hk]
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity s =>
    cases s
    · simp
    · simp only [↓reduceIte, toVal_infinity, Option.bind_some, Spec.logBasePow2_top _ hkI]
      rw [sign_eq_decide_pos_toInt k hk]
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hkI with h | h
      · rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr h.le), decide_eq_false (not_lt.mpr h.le)]
        exact (roundVal_inf p mode false).symm
      · rw [ite_eq_left h, decide_eq_true h]
        exact (roundVal_inf p mode true).symm
  | zero =>
    simp only [toVal_zero, Option.bind_some, Spec.logBasePow2_zero _ hkI]
    rw [sign_eq_decide_pos_toInt k hk]
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hkI with h | h
    · rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr h.le), decide_eq_false (not_lt.mpr h.le)]
      exact (roundVal_inf p mode true).symm
    · rw [ite_eq_left h, decide_eq_true h]
      exact (roundVal_inf p mode false).symm
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    cases s with
    | true =>
      have hv0 := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
      simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some, Spec.logBasePow2_coe _ _ hv0]
      split_ifs with hp h2
      · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
      · rw [ofAzRatRound_eq_roundVal, AzRat.toRat_ofAzInts, finiteVal_true_of_isPowerOfTwo e m h2,
          logb_two_zpow, AzInt.toInt_sub]
        push_cast
        rw [show (1 : AzInt).toInt = 1 from rfl, Int.cast_one]
      · rw [← Real.log_div_log]
        exact zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode _
          (Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log 2 / k.toInt) _ (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
          (fun w hw => by
            obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
              logBasePow2Approx_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega) e hv
                (Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr h2) k hk
            exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩) _
    | false =>
      simp only [toVal_finite]
      rw [finiteVal_false, Option.bind_some,
        Spec.logBasePow2_coe_neg _ _ (neg_neg_iff_pos.mpr (finiteVal_true_pos e hv)), roundVal_none]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.lnRatPrecRound_eq
statement:
theorem lnRatPrecRound_eq (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    lnRatPrecRound q p mode = roundVal p mode (Spec.log ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  unfold lnRatPrecRound
  split_ifs with h0 hs h1 hp
  · rw [(AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr h0]
    simp only [EReal.coe_zero, Spec.log_zero, roundVal_bot]
  · rw [toRat_eq_one_of_num_eq_den q hs h1]
    simp only [Rat.cast_one]
    rw [Spec.log_coe _ one_pos, Real.log_one, EReal.coe_zero, roundVal_zero]
  · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
  · have hq := toRat_pos_of_sign q hs h0
    have hq1 := toRat_ne_one_of_num_ne_den q hs h1
    rw [Spec.log_coe _ (by exact_mod_cast hq)]
    exact zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode _ (Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)) _
      (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
      (fun w hw => by
        obtain ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
          lnRatApprox_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega) q hq hq1
        exact ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩) _
  · have hneg := toRat_neg_of_sign q (by simpa using hs) h0
    rw [Spec.log_coe_neg _ hneg, roundVal_none]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.bind_products
statement:
theorem bind_products (g : EReal → EReal → Option EReal) (x y z w : AzFloat) :
    ((x.toVal.bind fun a => y.toVal.bind fun b => Spec.mul a b).bind fun ab =>
        (z.toVal.bind fun c => w.toVal.bind fun d => Spec.mul c d).bind fun cd => g ab cd)
      = x.toVal.bind fun a => y.toVal.bind fun b => z.toVal.bind fun c => w.toVal.bind fun d =>
          (Spec.mul a b).bind fun ab => (Spec.mul c d).bind fun cd => g ab cd
proof:
:= by
  cases x.toVal <;> cases y.toVal <;> simp only [Option.bind_none, Option.bind_some]
  rename_i a b
  cases z.toVal <;> cases w.toVal <;> simp only [Option.bind_none, Option.bind_some]
  · cases Spec.mul a b <;> rfl
  · cases Spec.mul a b <;> rfl
  · cases Spec.mul a b <;> rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.mulAddMulPrecRound_eq_liftVal₄
statement:
theorem mulAddMulPrecRound_eq_liftVal₄ (x y z w : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :

proof:
:= by

  rw [addPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂]
  unfold liftVal₂
  rw [toVal_exactMul, toVal_exactMul, bind_products Spec.add]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_logb_two_of_odd
statement:
theorem irrational_logb_two_of_odd {n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd n) (hn1 : n ≠ 1) :
    Irrational (Real.logb 2 n)
proof:
:= by
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hodd.pos
  rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (r : ℝ) = n := by
    rw [hr]; exact Real.rpow_logb (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hnpos
  have hq0 : (r.den : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast r.den_nz
  have hrq : (r : ℝ) * r.den = r.num := by rw [Rat.cast_def]; field_simp
  have h3 : (n : ℝ) ^ r.den = (2 : ℝ) ^ r.num := by
    rw [← h2, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num), hrq, Real.rpow_intCast]
  rcases le_or_gt 0 r.num with hp0 | hp0
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hp0
    rw [hk, zpow_natCast] at h3
    have h4 : n ^ r.den = 2 ^ k := by exact_mod_cast h3
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hkpos
    · rw [hk0, pow_zero, Nat.pow_eq_one] at h4
      rcases h4 with h | h
      · exact hn1 h
      · exact r.den_nz h
    · have heven : Even (n ^ r.den) := by
        rw [h4]; exact Nat.even_pow.mpr ⟨even_two, hkpos.ne'⟩
      rw [Nat.even_pow] at heven
      exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hodd) heven.1
  · have h5 : (2 : ℝ) ^ r.num < 1 := zpow_lt_one_of_neg₀ (by norm_num) hp0
    have h6 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ r.den := one_le_pow₀ (by exact_mod_cast hodd.pos)
    linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logb_two_zpow
statement: theorem logb_two_zpow (j : ℤ) : Real.logb 2 ((2 : ℝ) ^ j) = j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.logb, Real.log_zpow, mul_div_assoc, div_self (Real.log_pos one_lt_two).ne', mul_one]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_logb_two_finiteVal
statement:
theorem irrational_logb_two_finiteVal (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) (hm : m ≠ 0)
    (hnp : ¬ m.toNat.isPowerOfTwo) : Irrational (Real.logb 2 (finiteVal true e m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteVal_true_eq]
  obtain ⟨k, n, hodd, hmn⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_odd (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hm)
  have hn1 : n ≠ 1 := by rintro rfl; exact hnp ⟨k, by rw [hmn, mul_one]⟩
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hodd.pos.ne'
  rw [hmn]
  push_cast
  have h2k : (2 : ℝ) ^ k * n * 2 ^ (e.toInt - m.size)
      = n * 2 ^ ((k : ℤ) + (e.toInt - m.size)) := by
    rw [zpow_add₀ (by norm_num), zpow_natCast]; ring
  rw [h2k, Real.logb_mul hn0 (zpow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)), logb_two_zpow]
  exact (irrational_logb_two_of_odd hodd hn1).add_intCast _

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_true_of_isPowerOfTwo
statement:
theorem finiteVal_true_of_isPowerOfTwo (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) (h : m.isPowerOfTwo = true) :
    finiteVal true e m = (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (AzNat.isPowerOfTwo_iff m).mp h
  have hsize : m.size = k + 1 := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, hk, Nat.size_pow]
  rw [finiteVal_true_eq, hk, hsize]
  push_cast
  rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
  congr 1
  ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ne_zero_of_finiteValid
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_finiteValid (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) : m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  have := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
  rw [finiteVal_true_eq, AzNat.toNat_zero] at this
  simp at this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2Lower_spec
statement:
theorem log2Lower_spec (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] {xa xc xd : AzFloat} {a c d M L : ℝ}
    (ha : xa.toVal = some (a : EReal)) (hc : xc.toVal = some (c : EReal))
    (hd : xd.toVal = some (d : EReal)) (hc0 : 0 < c) (hcM : c ≤ M) (hMd : M ≤ d) (haL : a ≤ L) :
    ∃ lo : ℝ, (if xa.isNegative then (divPrecRound xa xc w .Floor).1
        else (divPrecRound xa xd w .Floor).1).toVal = some (lo : EReal) ∧
      lo ≤ L / M ∧
      a / c - |a| * (1 / c - 1 / d) - 2 * (|a| / c) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ lo
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 < M := hc0.trans_le hcM
  have hd0 : 0 < d := hM0.trans_le hMd
  have hcd : 0 ≤ 1 / c - 1 / d := by
    rw [sub_nonneg]; exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hc0 (hcM.trans hMd)
  obtain ⟨hneg, hnonneg⟩ := toVal_sign_of_isNegative ha
  cases hs : xa.isNegative
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    have ha0 := hnonneg hs
    obtain ⟨lo, hlo, h1, h2⟩ := divFloor_abs ha hd hd0.ne' w
    refine ⟨lo, hlo, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc lo ≤ a / d := h1
        _ ≤ a / M := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left ha0 hM0 hMd
        _ ≤ L / M := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right haL hM0.le
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg ha0]
      have e : a / d = a / c - a * (1 / c - 1 / d) := by field_simp; ring
      have h3 : |a / d| ≤ a / c := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg ha0 hd0.le)]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left ha0 hc0 (hcM.trans hMd)
      have h4 : 2 * |a / d| * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 2 * (a / c) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w)
        linarith
      linarith
  · simp only [↓reduceIte]
    have haneg := hneg hs
    obtain ⟨lo, hlo, h1, h2⟩ := divFloor_abs ha hc hc0.ne' w
    refine ⟨lo, hlo, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc lo ≤ a / c := h1
        _ ≤ a / M := by
          rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hc0 hM0]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hcM haneg.le
        _ ≤ L / M := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right haL hM0.le
    · rw [abs_of_neg haneg]
      have h3 : |a / c| = -a / c := by rw [abs_div, abs_of_neg haneg, abs_of_pos hc0]
      have h4 : 0 ≤ -a * (1 / c - 1 / d) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hcd
      rw [h3] at h2
      linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2Upper_spec
statement:
theorem log2Upper_spec (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] {xb xc xd : AzFloat} {b c d M L : ℝ}
    (hb : xb.toVal = some (b : EReal)) (hc : xc.toVal = some (c : EReal))
    (hd : xd.toVal = some (d : EReal)) (hc0 : 0 < c) (hcM : c ≤ M) (hMd : M ≤ d) (hLb : L ≤ b) :
    ∃ hi : ℝ, (if xb.isNegative then (divPrecRound xb xd w .Ceiling).1
        else (divPrecRound xb xc w .Ceiling).1).toVal = some (hi : EReal) ∧
      L / M ≤ hi ∧
      hi ≤ b / c + |b| * (1 / c - 1 / d) + 2 * (|b| / c) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 < M := hc0.trans_le hcM
  have hd0 : 0 < d := hM0.trans_le hMd
  have hcd : 0 ≤ 1 / c - 1 / d := by
    rw [sub_nonneg]; exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hc0 (hcM.trans hMd)
  obtain ⟨hneg, hnonneg⟩ := toVal_sign_of_isNegative hb
  cases hs : xb.isNegative
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    have hb0 := hnonneg hs
    obtain ⟨hi, hhi, h1, h2⟩ := divCeiling_abs hb hc hc0.ne' w
    refine ⟨hi, hhi, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc L / M ≤ b / M := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hLb hM0.le
        _ ≤ b / c := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hb0 hc0 hcM
        _ ≤ hi := h1
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg hb0]
      have h3 : |b / c| = b / c := abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hb0 hc0.le)
      have h4 : 0 ≤ b * (1 / c - 1 / d) := mul_nonneg hb0 hcd
      rw [h3] at h2
      linarith
  · simp only [↓reduceIte]
    have hbneg := hneg hs
    obtain ⟨hi, hhi, h1, h2⟩ := divCeiling_abs hb hd hd0.ne' w
    refine ⟨hi, hhi, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc L / M ≤ b / M := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hLb hM0.le
        _ ≤ b / d := by
          rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hM0 hd0]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hMd hbneg.le
        _ ≤ hi := h1
    · rw [abs_of_neg hbneg]
      have e : b / d = b / c + (-b) * (1 / c - 1 / d) := by field_simp; ring
      have h3 : |b / d| ≤ -b / c := by
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_neg hbneg, abs_of_pos hd0]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hc0 (hcM.trans hMd)
      have h4 : 2 * |b / d| * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 2 * (-b / c) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w)
        linarith
      linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.tendsto_log2Eps
statement:
theorem tendsto_log2Eps (e : ℤ) (A : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (log2Eps e A) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hL := tendsto_lnEps e
  have hu := tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hA : Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => A) Filter.atTop (nhds A) := tendsto_const_nhds
  have := (hL.const_mul 5).add (((hA.add hL).const_mul 140).mul hu)
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2Quotients_spec
statement:
theorem log2Quotients_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) {b : AzFloat × AzFloat} {a bv L ε : ℝ}
    (ha : b.1.toVal = some (a : EReal)) (hb : b.2.toVal = some (bv : EReal)) (haL : a ≤ L)
    (hLb : L ≤ bv) (hwid : bv - a ≤ ε) :
    ∃ lo hi : ℝ, (log2Quotients b w).1.toVal = some (lo : EReal) ∧
      (log2Quotients b w).2.toVal = some (hi : EReal) ∧
      lo ≤ L / Real.log 2 ∧ L / Real.log 2 ≤ hi ∧
      hi - lo ≤ 5 * ε + 140 * (|L| + ε) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨c, d, hc, hd, hcM, hMd, hcd, hcpos⟩ := ln2Bracket_spec w
  set u := (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w with hu
  have hu0 : 0 < u := by positivity
  have hc5 : 1 / 5 ≤ c := hcpos (by omega)
  have hL1 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
  have hc0 : 0 < c := by linarith
  have hM0 : 0 < Real.log 2 := by linarith
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := by linarith
  have hLa : L ≤ |L| := le_abs_self L
  have hLa' : -|L| ≤ L := neg_abs_le L
  have habs_a : |a| ≤ |L| + ε := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have habs_b : |bv| ≤ |L| + ε := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hcd' : 1 / c - 1 / d ≤ 60 * u := by
    have hd0 : 0 < d := by linarith
    rw [div_sub_div _ _ hc0.ne' hd0.ne', div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have hprod : (1 / 5 : ℝ) * (69 / 100) ≤ c * d :=
      mul_le_mul hc5 (by linarith) (by norm_num) hc0.le
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 60 * u)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨lo, hlo, hlo1, hlo2⟩ := log2Lower_spec w ha hc hd hc0 hcM hMd haL
  obtain ⟨hi, hhi, hhi1, hhi2⟩ := log2Upper_spec w hb hc hd hc0 hcM hMd hLb
  rw [← hu] at hlo2 hhi2
  have h5a : |a| / c ≤ 5 * |a| := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hc0]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg a]
  have h5b : |bv| / c ≤ 5 * |bv| := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hc0]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg bv]
  have h5ab : bv / c - a / c ≤ 5 * (bv - a) := by
    rw [← sub_div, div_le_iff₀ hc0]; nlinarith
  have hqa : |a| * (1 / c - 1 / d) ≤ |a| * (60 * u) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcd' (abs_nonneg a)
  have hqb : |bv| * (1 / c - 1 / d) ≤ |bv| * (60 * u) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcd' (abs_nonneg bv)
  have hra : 2 * (|a| / c) * u ≤ 2 * (5 * |a|) * u := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h5a hu0.le; linarith
  have hrb : 2 * (|bv| / c) * u ≤ 2 * (5 * |bv|) * u := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h5b hu0.le; linarith
  have hau : |a| * u ≤ (|L| + ε) * u := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right habs_a hu0.le
  have hbu : |bv| * u ≤ (|L| + ε) * u := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right habs_b hu0.le
  exact ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, by linarith⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2Approx_spec
statement:
theorem log2Approx_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat}
    (hv : FiniteValid q m) (hnp : m.isPowerOfTwo = false) :
    ∃ lv hv' : ℝ, Rounds (log2Approx (finite true e q m hv) e w).1 lv ∧
      Rounds (log2Approx (finite true e q m hv) e w).2 hv' ∧
      lv < Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log 2 ∧
      Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log 2 < hv' ∧
      hv' - lv ≤ log2Eps e.toInt |Real.log (finiteVal true e m)| w
proof:
:= by
  have hirr : Irrational (Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log 2) := by
    rw [Real.log_div_log]
    exact irrational_logb_two_finiteVal e m (ne_zero_of_finiteValid e hv)
      (fun h => by rw [← AzNat.isPowerOfTwo_iff] at h; rw [h] at hnp; cases hnp)
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, haL, hLb, hwid⟩ := lnBracket_spec hw e hv
  obtain ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, hwidth⟩ := log2Quotients_spec hw ha hb haL hLb hwid
  refine ⟨lo, hi, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hwidth⟩
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hlo)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hlo] at hR
    exact hR
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hhi)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hhi] at hR
    exact hR
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hlo
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hlo1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r (h.symm.trans hr)
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hhi
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hhi1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r (h.trans hr)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2Approx_isSome_exists
statement:
theorem log2Approx_isSome_exists (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ}
    {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) (hnp : m.isPowerOfTwo = false) (w₀ : ℕ) (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) :
    ∃ f : ℕ, (roundingPossible (log2Approx (finite true e q m hv) e (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).1
      (log2Approx (finite true e q m hv) e (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).2 p mode).isSome = true
proof:
:= by
  have hirr : Irrational (Real.log (finiteVal true e m) / Real.log 2) := by
    rw [Real.log_div_log]
    exact irrational_logb_two_finiteVal e m (ne_zero_of_finiteValid e hv)
      (fun h => by rw [← AzNat.isPowerOfTwo_iff] at h; rw [h] at hnp; cases hnp)
  exact exists_isSome_of_irrational_threshold p mode (log2Approx (finite true e q m hv) e) hirr
    (log2Eps e.toInt |Real.log (finiteVal true e m)|) (tendsto_log2Eps _ _) 64
    (fun w hw => by
      obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, hwid⟩ := log2Approx_spec hw e hv hnp
      exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, hwid⟩) w₀ hw₀

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_logb_two_of_odd_div
statement:
theorem irrational_logb_two_of_odd_div {n d : ℕ} (hn : Odd n) (hd : Odd d)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime n d) (hne : ¬ (n = 1 ∧ d = 1)) :
    Irrational (Real.logb 2 ((n : ℝ) / d))
proof:
:= by
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn.pos
  have hdpos : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd.pos
  rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (r : ℝ) = n / d := by
    rw [hr]; exact Real.rpow_logb (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (div_pos hnpos hdpos)
  have hq0 : (r.den : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast r.den_nz
  have hrq : (r : ℝ) * r.den = r.num := by rw [Rat.cast_def]; field_simp
  have h3 : ((n : ℝ) / d) ^ r.den = (2 : ℝ) ^ r.num := by
    rw [← h2, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num), hrq, Real.rpow_intCast]
  have h4 : (n : ℝ) ^ r.den = (2 : ℝ) ^ r.num * (d : ℝ) ^ r.den := by
    rw [div_pow] at h3
    rw [← h3]
    field_simp
  have hqpos : r.den ≠ 0 := r.den_nz
  rcases le_or_gt 0 r.num with hp0 | hp0
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hp0
    rw [hk, zpow_natCast] at h4
    have h5 : n ^ r.den = 2 ^ k * d ^ r.den := by exact_mod_cast h4
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hkpos
    · rw [hk0, pow_zero, one_mul] at h5
      have hnd : n = d := Nat.pow_left_injective hqpos h5
      subst hnd
      have := (Nat.coprime_self n).mp hcop
      exact hne ⟨this, this⟩
    · have heven : Even (n ^ r.den) := by
        rw [h5]; exact (Nat.even_pow.mpr ⟨even_two, hkpos.ne'⟩).mul_right _
      rw [Nat.even_pow] at heven
      exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hn) heven.1
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, r.num = -(k : ℤ) := ⟨(-r.num).toNat, by omega⟩
    have hk1 : 0 < k := by omega
    rw [hk, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast] at h4
    have h6 : (n : ℝ) ^ r.den * 2 ^ k = (d : ℝ) ^ r.den := by rw [h4]; field_simp
    have h7 : n ^ r.den * 2 ^ k = d ^ r.den := by exact_mod_cast h6
    have heven : Even (d ^ r.den) := by
      rw [← h7]; exact (Nat.even_pow.mpr ⟨even_two, hk1.ne'⟩).mul_left _
    rw [Nat.even_pow] at heven
    exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hd) heven.1

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_logb_two_div
statement:
theorem irrational_logb_two_div {N D : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (hD : D ≠ 0) (hcop : Nat.Coprime N D)
    (hnp : ¬ (N.isPowerOfTwo ∧ D.isPowerOfTwo)) : Irrational (Real.logb 2 ((N : ℝ) / D))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, n, hn, hNn⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_odd hN
  obtain ⟨b, d, hd, hDd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_odd hD
  have hcop' : Nat.Coprime n d :=
    Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_right (Dvd.intro_left _ hDd.symm)
      (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (Dvd.intro_left _ hNn.symm) hcop)
  have hne : ¬ (n = 1 ∧ d = 1) := by
    rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact hnp ⟨⟨a, by rw [hNn, mul_one]⟩, ⟨b, by rw [hDd, mul_one]⟩⟩
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn.pos.ne'
  have hd0 : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd.pos.ne'
  rw [hNn, hDd]
  push_cast
  have e : (2 : ℝ) ^ a * n / (2 ^ b * d) = (n / d) * 2 ^ ((a : ℤ) - b) := by
    rw [zpow_sub₀ (by norm_num), zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]
    field_simp
  rw [e, Real.logb_mul (div_ne_zero hn0 hd0) (zpow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)), logb_two_zpow]
  exact (irrational_logb_two_of_odd_div hn hd hcop' hne).add_intCast _

name: Azurite.AzFloat.coe_toRat_eq_div_of_sign
statement:
theorem coe_toRat_eq_div_of_sign (q : AzRat) (hs : q.sign = true) :
    (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) = (q.num.toNat : ℝ) / q.den.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_toRat_eq, hs]; simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_logb_two_toRat
statement:
theorem irrational_logb_two_toRat (q : AzRat) (hq : (0 : ℚ) < AzRat.toRat q)
    (hnp : q.isPowerOfTwo = false) : Irrational (Real.logb 2 (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have h0 : q.num ≠ 0 := fun h => by
    rw [(AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr h] at hqr; exact lt_irrefl _ hqr
  have hs : q.sign = true := by
    by_contra hs
    have := toRat_neg_of_sign q (Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hs) h0
    linarith
  rw [coe_toRat_eq_div_of_sign q hs]
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime q.num.toNat q.den.toNat := (AzNat.coprime_iff _ _).mp q.reduced
  have hnp' : ¬ (q.num.toNat.isPowerOfTwo ∧ q.den.toNat.isPowerOfTwo) := by
    rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have : q.isPowerOfTwo = true := (AzRat.isPowerOfTwo_iff q).mpr ⟨hs, h1, h2⟩
    rw [this] at hnp; cases hnp
  exact irrational_logb_two_div (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero h0) (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero q.den_nz)
    hcop hnp'

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toRat_ne_one_of_not_isPowerOfTwo
statement:
theorem toRat_ne_one_of_not_isPowerOfTwo (q : AzRat) (hs : q.sign = true)
    (hnp : q.isPowerOfTwo = false) : AzRat.toRat q ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h1
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < q.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast AzRat.den_toNat_pos q
  have h1' : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
  rw [coe_toRat_eq_div_of_sign q hs, div_eq_one_iff_eq hden.ne'] at h1'
  have heq : q.num.toNat = q.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast h1'
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime q.num.toNat q.den.toNat := (AzNat.coprime_iff _ _).mp q.reduced
  rw [heq, Nat.coprime_self] at hcop
  have : q.isPowerOfTwo = true :=
    (AzRat.isPowerOfTwo_iff q).mpr
      ⟨hs, ⟨0, by rw [heq, hcop, pow_zero]⟩, ⟨0, by rw [hcop, pow_zero]⟩⟩
  rw [this] at hnp; cases hnp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.tendsto_log2RatEps
statement:
theorem tendsto_log2RatEps (E : ℕ) (A : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (log2RatEps E A) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hL := tendsto_lnRatEps E A
  have hu := tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hA : Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => A) Filter.atTop (nhds A) := tendsto_const_nhds
  have := (hL.const_mul 5).add (((hA.add hL).const_mul 140).mul hu)
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2RatApprox_spec
statement:
theorem log2RatApprox_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) (q : AzRat) (hq : (0 : ℚ) < AzRat.toRat q)
    (hnp : q.isPowerOfTwo = false) :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, Rounds (log2RatApprox q w).1 lv ∧ Rounds (log2RatApprox q w).2 hv ∧
      lv < Real.logb 2 (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) ∧ Real.logb 2 (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) < hv ∧
      hv - lv ≤ log2RatEps (⌊2 * |Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|⌋₊ + 2)
        |Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)| w
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hirr := irrational_logb_two_toRat q hq hnp
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hr1, hr2⟩ := ofAzRatRound_floor_abs q w
  have hqv0 : (0 : ℝ) < (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
  rw [abs_of_pos hqv0] at hr2
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, haL, hLb, hwid⟩ := lnFloorBracket_spec hw hr hqv0 hr1 hr2
  obtain ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, hwidth⟩ := log2Quotients_spec hw ha hb haL hLb hwid
  rw [Real.log_div_log] at hlo1 hhi1
  refine ⟨lo, hi, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hwidth⟩
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hlo)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hlo] at hR
    exact hR
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hhi)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hhi] at hR
    exact hR
  · obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hlo
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hlo1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r' (h.symm.trans hr')
  · obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hhi
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hhi1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r' (h.trans hr')

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2RatApprox_isSome_exists
statement:
theorem log2RatApprox_isSome_exists (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (q : AzRat)
    (hq : (0 : ℚ) < AzRat.toRat q) (hnp : q.isPowerOfTwo = false) (w₀ : ℕ) (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) :
    ∃ f : ℕ, (roundingPossible (log2RatApprox q (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).1 (log2RatApprox q (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).2 p
      mode).isSome = true
proof:
:=
  exists_isSome_of_irrational_threshold p mode (log2RatApprox q)
    (irrational_logb_two_toRat q hq hnp)
    (log2RatEps (⌊2 * |Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|⌋₊ + 2) |Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|)
    (tendsto_log2RatEps _ _) 64
    (fun w hw => by
      obtain ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo, hhi, hwid⟩ := log2RatApprox_spec hw q hq hnp
      exact ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, hwid⟩) w₀ hw₀

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_logb_two_of_rat
statement:
theorem irrational_logb_two_of_rat {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) {r : ℚ} (hr : v = r)
    (hnp : ∀ j : ℤ, v ≠ 2 ^ j) : Irrational (Real.logb 2 v)
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < (r : ℝ) := hr ▸ hv
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hnum : 0 < r.num := Rat.num_pos.mpr hr0
  have hNeq : (r.num : ℝ) = (r.num.natAbs : ℝ) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_natAbs, abs_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hnum)]
  have hv' : v = (r.num.natAbs : ℝ) / r.den := by rw [hr, Rat.cast_def, hNeq]
  have hN0 : r.num.natAbs ≠ 0 := (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hnum.ne').ne'
  rw [hv']
  apply irrational_logb_two_div hN0 r.den_nz r.reduced
  rintro ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩
  apply hnp ((a : ℤ) - b)
  rw [hv', ha, hb]
  push_cast
  rw [zpow_sub₀ (by norm_num), zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.isPowerOfTwo_of_finiteVal_eq_zpow
statement:
theorem isPowerOfTwo_of_finiteVal_eq_zpow (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) (j : ℤ)
    (h : finiteVal true e m = (2 : ℝ) ^ j) : m.isPowerOfTwo = true
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteVal_true_eq] at h
  have hE : (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - m.size) ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
  have hm : (m.toNat : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (j - (e.toInt - m.size)) := by
    rw [zpow_sub₀ (by norm_num), eq_div_iff hE, h]
  have ht : 0 ≤ j - (e.toInt - m.size) := by
    by_contra hlt
    have h1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (j - (e.toInt - m.size)) < 1 := zpow_lt_one_of_neg₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (j - (e.toInt - m.size)) := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
    have h3 : m.toNat < 1 := by exact_mod_cast (hm ▸ h1 : (m.toNat : ℝ) < 1)
    have h4 : (m.toNat : ℝ) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_one_iff.mp h3
    linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le ht
  rw [hn, zpow_natCast] at hm
  exact (AzNat.isPowerOfTwo_iff m).mpr ⟨n, by exact_mod_cast hm⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_onePlus_floor
statement:
theorem toVal_onePlus_floor {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal)) (w : ℕ)
    [NeZero w] :
    (addPrecRound one x w .Floor).1.toVal
      = some (RoundingTarget.round (floatSet w) .Floor (1 + xv)).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [addPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂, liftVal₂, toVal_one', hx, Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some,
    Spec.add_coe_coe]
  exact (roundVal_coe w .Floor _).1

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_onePlus_ceiling
statement:
theorem toVal_onePlus_ceiling {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal)) (w : ℕ)
    [NeZero w] :
    (addPrecRound one x w .Ceiling).1.toVal
      = some (RoundingTarget.round (floatSet w) .Ceiling (1 + xv)).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [addPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂, liftVal₂, toVal_one', hx, Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some,
    Spec.add_coe_coe]
  exact (roundVal_coe w .Ceiling _).1

name: Azurite.AzFloat.onePlusPow2Exponent?_some
statement:
theorem onePlusPow2Exponent?_some {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal))
    (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] {k : AzInt} (h : onePlusPow2Exponent? x w = some k) :
    1 + xv = (2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨lo, hlo, hlo1, -⟩ := addFloor_abs toVal_one' hx w
  obtain ⟨hi, hhi, hhi1, -⟩ := addCeiling_abs toVal_one' hx w
  rcases hs : (addPrecRound one x w .Floor).1 with _ | s | _ | ⟨s, e', q', m', hv'⟩ <;>
    simp only [onePlusPow2Exponent?, hs] at h
  · cases h
  · cases h
  · cases h
  · cases s with
    | false => simp at h
    | true =>
      simp only at h
      split_ifs at h with hc
      rw [Option.some.injEq] at h
      subst h
      rw [Bool.and_eq_true] at hc
      obtain ⟨v, hv1, hv2⟩ := (eqIEEE_iff _ _).mp hc.1
      rw [hs, toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq] at hlo
      rw [toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq] at hv1
      rw [hhi, Option.some.injEq, ← hv1, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at hv2
      rw [EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at hlo
      have h1 : 1 + xv = finiteVal true e' m' := by linarith
      rw [h1, finiteVal_true_of_isPowerOfTwo e' m' hc.2, AzInt.toInt_sub]
      rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.onePlusPow2Exponent?_none
statement:
theorem onePlusPow2Exponent?_none {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal))
    {w : ℕ} (hw : 2 ≤ w) (hpos : 0 < 1 + xv) (h : onePlusPow2Exponent? x w = none) (j : ℤ) :
    1 + xv ≠ (2 : ℝ) ^ j
proof:
:= by
  intro hj
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hmem : ((1 + xv : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ floatSet w := by
    have := mem_floatSet_mul_zpow w 1 j (by rw [abs_one]; exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_two_pow)
    rw [hj]
    simpa using this
  have hlo : (addPrecRound one x w .Floor).1.toVal = some ((1 + xv : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [toVal_onePlus_floor hx w, RoundingTarget.val_round_of_mem _ _ hmem]
  have hhi : (addPrecRound one x w .Ceiling).1.toVal = some ((1 + xv : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [toVal_onePlus_ceiling hx w, RoundingTarget.val_round_of_mem _ _ hmem]
  obtain ⟨e', q', m', hv', hs, hval⟩ := eq_finite_true_of_toVal_pos hlo hpos
  have heq : eqIEEE (addPrecRound one x w .Floor).1 (addPrecRound one x w .Ceiling).1 = true :=
    (eqIEEE_iff _ _).mpr ⟨_, hlo, hhi⟩
  have hpow : m'.isPowerOfTwo = true :=
    isPowerOfTwo_of_finiteVal_eq_zpow e' m' j (by rw [hval, hj])
  rw [hs] at heq
  simp only [onePlusPow2Exponent?, hs, heq, hpow, Bool.and_self, ↓reduceIte] at h
  exact absurd h (Option.some_ne_none _)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.irrational_logb_two_one_add_of_none
statement:
theorem irrational_logb_two_one_add_of_none {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ}
    (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal))
    {w : ℕ} (hw : 2 ≤ w) (hpos : 0 < 1 + xv) (h : onePlusPow2Exponent? x w = none) :
    Irrational (Real.logb 2 (1 + xv))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rx, hrx⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hx
  exact irrational_logb_two_of_rat hpos (r := 1 + rx) (by push_cast; rw [hrx])
    (onePlusPow2Exponent?_none hx hw hpos h)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2P1Approx_spec
statement:
theorem log2P1Approx_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ}
    (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal)) (hx1 : -1 < xv)
    (hirr : Irrational (Real.logb 2 (1 + xv))) :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, Rounds (log2P1Approx x w).1 lv ∧ Rounds (log2P1Approx x w).2 hv ∧
      lv < Real.logb 2 (1 + xv) ∧ Real.logb 2 (1 + xv) < hv ∧
      hv - lv ≤ log2RatEps (⌊2 * |Real.log (1 + xv)|⌋₊ + 2) |Real.log (1 + xv)| w
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hpos : 0 < 1 + xv := by linarith
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hf⟩ := addFloor_err toVal_one' hx w hpos.le
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, haL, hLb, hwid⟩ := lnFloorBracket_spec hw hr hpos hf.le hf.ge
  obtain ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, hwidth⟩ := log2Quotients_spec hw ha hb haL hLb hwid
  rw [Real.log_div_log] at hlo1 hhi1
  refine ⟨lo, hi, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hwidth⟩
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hlo)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hlo] at hR
    exact hR
  · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hhi)
    rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hhi] at hR
    exact hR
  · obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hlo
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hlo1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r' (h.symm.trans hr')
  · obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hhi
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hhi1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r' (h.trans hr')

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log2P1Approx_isSome_exists
statement:
theorem log2P1Approx_isSome_exists (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) {x : AzFloat}
    {xv : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal)) (hx1 : -1 < xv)
    (hirr : Irrational (Real.logb 2 (1 + xv))) (w₀ : ℕ) (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) :
    ∃ f : ℕ, (roundingPossible (log2P1Approx x (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).1 (log2P1Approx x (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).2 p
      mode).isSome = true
proof:
:=
  exists_isSome_of_irrational_threshold p mode (log2P1Approx x) hirr
    (log2RatEps (⌊2 * |Real.log (1 + xv)|⌋₊ + 2) |Real.log (1 + xv)|) (tendsto_log2RatEps _ _) 64
    (fun w hw => by
      obtain ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo, hhi, hwid⟩ := log2P1Approx_spec hw hx hx1 hirr
      exact ⟨lv, hv, hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, hwid⟩) w₀ hw₀

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_maxOf
statement:
theorem toVal_maxOf {x y : AzFloat} {xv yv : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal))
    (hy : y.toVal = some (yv : EReal)) : (maxOf x y).toVal = some ((max xv yv : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold maxOf
  rw [partialCompare_eq, hx, hy]
  simp only [compare_coe_coe, beq_iff_eq, Option.some.injEq]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt] at h
    rw [hy, max_eq_right h.le]
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt] at h
    push Not at h
    rw [hx, max_eq_left h]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_minOf
statement:
theorem toVal_minOf {x y : AzFloat} {xv yv : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal))
    (hy : y.toVal = some (yv : EReal)) : (minOf x y).toVal = some ((min xv yv : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold minOf
  rw [partialCompare_eq, hx, hy]
  simp only [compare_coe_coe, beq_iff_eq, Option.some.injEq]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt] at h
    rw [hy, min_eq_right h.le]
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt] at h
    push Not at h
    rw [hx, min_eq_left h]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.normShift_spec
statement:
theorem normShift_spec {c : AzFloat} {cv : ℝ} (hc : c.toVal = some (cv : EReal)) (hpos : 0 < cv) :
    1 / 2 ≤ cv * (2 : ℝ) ^ (normShift c).toInt ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (normShift c).toInt ≤ 1 + 1 / cv
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with _ | s | _ | ⟨s, e, q, m, hv⟩
  · simp at hc
  · cases s <;> simp at hc
  · simp only [toVal_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hc
    exact absurd (EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp hc.symm) hpos.ne'
  · simp only [toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at hc
    cases s with
    | false =>
      exfalso
      rw [finiteVal_false] at hc
      have := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
      linarith
    | true =>
      obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_finiteVal_bounds true e hv
      rw [abs_of_pos (finiteVal_true_pos e hv), hc] at hlo hhi
      have hns : normShift (finite true e q m hv) = if e ≤ 0 then -e else 0 := rfl
      rw [hns]
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [AzInt.le_iff_toInt_le, AzInt.toInt_zero] at h
        rw [AzInt.toInt_neg]
        have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (-e.toInt) := zpow_pos two_pos _
        constructor
        · calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-e.toInt) := by
                rw [← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0),
                  show e.toInt - 1 + -e.toInt = -1 by ring, zpow_neg_one]
                norm_num
            _ ≤ cv * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-e.toInt) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlo h2.le
        · rw [zpow_neg]
          have : ((2 : ℝ) ^ e.toInt)⁻¹ < cv⁻¹ := inv_strictAnti₀ hpos hhi
          rw [one_div]
          linarith [inv_pos.mpr hpos]
      · rw [AzInt.le_iff_toInt_le, AzInt.toInt_zero] at h
        push Not at h
        rw [AzInt.toInt_zero, zpow_zero, mul_one]
        have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - 1) := one_le_zpow₀ one_le_two (by omega)
        constructor
        · linarith
        · linarith [one_div_pos.mpr hpos]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.divEps_mono
statement:
theorem divEps_mono {K K' A ε δ : ℝ} (w : ℕ) (hK : K ≤ K') (hK0 : 0 ≤ K) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) : divEps K A ε δ w ≤ divEps K' A ε δ w
proof:
:= by
  unfold divEps
  have hu : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by positivity
  have h1 : (1 + K) * δ ≤ (1 + K') * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hδ
  have h2 : 8 * (A + ε) * ((1 + K) * δ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w)
      ≤ 8 * (A + ε) * ((1 + K') * δ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
  exact mul_le_mul (by linarith) (by linarith) (by positivity) (by linarith)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.divBracketByPosBracket_spec
statement:
theorem divBracketByPosBracket_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) {X B : AzFloat × AzFloat}
    {a bv c d L M ε δ : ℝ} (ha : X.1.toVal = some (a : EReal)) (hb : X.2.toVal = some (bv : EReal))
    (hc : B.1.toVal = some (c : EReal)) (hd : B.2.toVal = some (d : EReal))
    (hc0 : 0 < c) (hcM : c ≤ M) (hMd : M ≤ d) (hcd : d - c ≤ δ)
    (haL : a ≤ L) (hLb : L ≤ bv) (hwid : bv - a ≤ ε) :
    ∃ lo hi : ℝ, (divBracketByPosBracket X B w).1.toVal = some (lo : EReal) ∧
      (divBracketByPosBracket X B w).2.toVal = some (hi : EReal) ∧
      lo ≤ L / M ∧ L / M ≤ hi ∧ hi - lo ≤ divEps (1 / c) |L| ε δ w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h12, hK⟩ := normShift_spec hc hc0
  unfold divBracketByPosBracket
  simp only []
  set l := normShift B.1 with hl
  set K := (2 : ℝ) ^ l.toInt with hK_def
  have hK0 : 0 < K := zpow_pos two_pos _
  have hM0 : 0 < M := lt_of_lt_of_le hc0 hcM
  have hc' := toVal_shiftLeft_of_toVal hc l
  have hd' := toVal_shiftLeft_of_toVal hd l
  rw [← hK_def] at hc' hd'
  obtain ⟨lo', hi', hlo', hhi', hlo1, hhi1, hwidth⟩ :=
    quotientBracket_spec hw ha hb (cd := (B.1 <<< l, B.2 <<< l)) (δ := δ * K) hc' hd' h12
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcM hK0.le)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMd hK0.le)
      (by rw [← sub_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcd hK0.le) haL hLb hwid
  have hlo := toVal_shiftLeft_of_toVal hlo' l
  have hhi := toVal_shiftLeft_of_toVal hhi' l
  rw [← hK_def] at hlo hhi
  refine ⟨lo' * K, hi' * K, hlo, hhi, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc lo' * K ≤ L / (M * K) * K := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlo1 hK0.le
      _ = L / M := by field_simp
  · calc L / M = L / (M * K) * K := by field_simp
      _ ≤ hi' * K := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hhi1 hK0.le
  · have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := by linarith
    have hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ := by linarith
    have hu : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w := by positivity
    have hA : 0 ≤ |L| := abs_nonneg L
    have hinner : 2 * ε + 8 * (|L| + ε) * (δ * K + (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w)
        ≤ 2 * ε + 8 * (|L| + ε) * ((1 + 1 / c) * δ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w) := by
      have : δ * K ≤ (1 + 1 / c) * δ := by
        rw [mul_comm]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK hδ0
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add_right this ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w))
        (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 8 * (|L| + ε))
      linarith
    calc hi' * K - lo' * K = (hi' - lo') * K := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 * ε + 8 * (|L| + ε) * (δ * K + (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w)) * K :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hwidth hK0.le
      _ ≤ (2 * ε + 8 * (|L| + ε) * ((1 + 1 / c) * δ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w)) * (1 + 1 / c) :=
          mul_le_mul hinner hK (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = divEps (1 / c) |L| ε δ w := by unfold divEps; ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.lnKappa_pos
statement: theorem lnKappa_pos {bv : ℝ} (hb1 : bv ≠ 1) : 0 < lnKappa bv
proof:
:= by
  unfold lnKappa
  split_ifs with h
  · exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  · push Not at h
    exact div_pos (by linarith [lt_of_le_of_ne h hb1]) (by norm_num)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.lnBaseFloatBracket_spec
statement:
theorem lnBaseFloatBracket_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) (eb : AzInt) {qb : ℕ} {mb : AzNat}
    (hvb : FiniteValid qb mb) (hb1 : finiteVal true eb mb ≠ 1) :
    ∃ c d : ℝ, (lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).1.toVal = some (c : EReal) ∧
      (lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).2.toVal = some (d : EReal) ∧
      c ≤ Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb) ∧ Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb) ≤ d ∧
      d - c ≤ lnEps eb.toInt w ∧
      (eb.sign = true ∧ eb.abs ≠ 0 → lnKappa (finiteVal true eb mb) ≤ c) ∧
      (¬ (eb.sign = true ∧ eb.abs ≠ 0) → d ≤ -lnKappa (finiteVal true eb mb))
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  set bv := finiteVal true eb mb with hbv
  have hb := toVal_finite true eb qb mb hvb
  rw [← hbv] at hb
  have hpos : 0 < bv := finiteVal_true_pos eb hvb
  have hu : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ 1 / 4 := by
