    calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ w ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ = 1 / 4 := by norm_num
  obtain ⟨c₀, d₀, hc₀, hd₀, hlo, hhi, hwid⟩ := lnBracket_spec hw eb hvb
  rw [← hbv] at hlo hhi
  unfold lnBaseFloatBracket
  simp only []
  split_ifs with hge
  · 
    have h1 : 1 ≤ bv := by
      have := finiteVal_false_le_neg_one eb hvb hge
      rw [finiteVal_false, ← hbv] at this
      linarith
    have hgt : 1 < bv := lt_of_le_of_ne h1 (Ne.symm hb1)
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hft⟩ := addFloor_err hb toVal_neg_one w (by linarith)
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := hft.nonneg
    obtain ⟨c', hc', hfc⟩ := divFloor_err ht hb hpos ht0 w
    refine ⟨max c₀ c', d₀, toVal_maxOf hc₀ hc', hd₀, ?_, hhi, ?_, ?_, fun h => absurd hge h⟩
    · apply max_le hlo
      calc c' ≤ t / bv := hfc.le
        _ ≤ (bv + -1) / bv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hft.le hpos.le
        _ = 1 - bv⁻¹ := by field_simp; ring
        _ ≤ Real.log bv := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos hpos
    · linarith [le_max_left c₀ c']
    · intro _
      refine le_trans ?_ (le_max_right c₀ c')
      unfold lnKappa
      rw [ite_eq_left hgt]
      
      have ht2 : (bv - 1) / 2 ≤ t := by
        have := hft.ge
        have hx : 0 ≤ bv + -1 := by linarith
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu hx]
      have hc2 : t / bv / 2 ≤ c' := by
        have := hfc.ge
        have hx : 0 ≤ t / bv := div_nonneg ht0 hpos.le
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu hx]
      calc (bv - 1) / (4 * bv) = (bv - 1) / 2 / bv / 2 := by field_simp; ring
        _ ≤ t / bv / 2 := by gcongr
        _ ≤ c' := hc2
  · 
    have hlt : bv < 1 := by
      have := finiteVal_false_gt_neg_one eb hvb hge
      rw [finiteVal_false, ← hbv] at this
      linarith
    have hnb : (-finite true eb qb mb hvb).toVal = some ((-bv : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      rw [toVal_neg, hb, Option.map_some, EReal.coe_neg]
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hft⟩ := addFloor_err toVal_one' hnb w (by linarith)
    have hnt : (-(addPrecRound one (-finite true eb qb mb hvb) w .Floor).1).toVal
        = some ((-t : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      rw [toVal_neg, ht, Option.map_some, EReal.coe_neg]
    refine ⟨c₀, min d₀ (-t), hc₀, toVal_minOf hd₀ hnt, hlo, ?_, ?_, fun h => absurd h hge, ?_⟩
    · apply le_min hhi
      calc Real.log bv ≤ bv - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hpos
        _ ≤ -t := by linarith [hft.le]
    · linarith [min_le_left d₀ (-t)]
    · intro _
      refine le_trans (min_le_right d₀ (-t)) ?_
      unfold lnKappa
      rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr hlt.le)]
      have ht2 : (1 - bv) / 2 ≤ t := by
        have := hft.ge
        have hx : 0 ≤ 1 + -bv := by linarith
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu hx]
      linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseFloatQuot_spec
statement:
theorem logBaseFloatQuot_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) {X : AzFloat × AzFloat} {a bv L ε : ℝ}
    (ha : X.1.toVal = some (a : EReal)) (hb' : X.2.toVal = some (bv : EReal)) (haL : a ≤ L)
    (hLb : L ≤ bv) (hwid : bv - a ≤ ε) (eb : AzInt) {qb : ℕ} {mb : AzNat}
    (hvb : FiniteValid qb mb) (hb1 : finiteVal true eb mb ≠ 1)
    (hirr : Irrational (L / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb))) :
    ∃ lv hv' : ℝ, Rounds (logBaseFloatQuot X (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).1 lv ∧
      Rounds (logBaseFloatQuot X (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).2 hv' ∧
      lv < L / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb) ∧ L / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb) < hv' ∧
      hv' - lv ≤ divEps (1 / lnKappa (finiteVal true eb mb)) |L| ε (lnEps eb.toInt w) w
proof:
:= by
  set M := Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb) with hM
  have hκ := lnKappa_pos hb1
  set κ := lnKappa (finiteVal true eb mb) with hκ_def
  obtain ⟨c, d, hc, hd, hcM, hMd, hcd, hκc, hdκ⟩ := lnBaseFloatBracket_spec hw eb hvb hb1
  rw [← hM] at hcM hMd
  rw [← hκ_def] at hκc hdκ
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := by linarith
  have hδ0 : 0 ≤ lnEps eb.toInt w := by linarith
  unfold logBaseFloatQuot
  simp only []
  
  suffices h : ∃ lo hi : ℝ,
      (if eb.sign = true ∧ eb.abs ≠ 0 then
        divBracketByPosBracket X (lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w) w
      else
        (-(divBracketByPosBracket X
          (-(lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).2,
            -(lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).1) w).2,
         -(divBracketByPosBracket X
          (-(lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).2,
            -(lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).1) w).1)).1.toVal
        = some (lo : EReal) ∧
      (if eb.sign = true ∧ eb.abs ≠ 0 then
        divBracketByPosBracket X (lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w) w
      else
        (-(divBracketByPosBracket X
          (-(lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).2,
            -(lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).1) w).2,
         -(divBracketByPosBracket X
          (-(lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).2,
            -(lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).1) w).1)).2.toVal
        = some (hi : EReal) ∧
      lo ≤ L / M ∧ L / M ≤ hi ∧ hi - lo ≤ divEps (1 / κ) |L| ε (lnEps eb.toInt w) w by
    obtain ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, hwidth⟩ := h
    refine ⟨lo, hi, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hwidth⟩
    · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hlo)
      rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hlo] at hR
      exact hR
    · have hR := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hhi)
      rw [fval_of_toVal_coe hhi] at hR
      exact hR
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hlo
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hlo1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r (h.symm.trans hr)
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rat_of_toVal hhi
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hhi1 fun h => hirr.ne_rat r (h.trans hr)
  split_ifs with hge
  · 
    have hκc' := hκc hge
    have hc0 : 0 < c := lt_of_lt_of_le hκ hκc'
    obtain ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, hwidth⟩ :=
      divBracketByPosBracket_spec hw ha hb' hc hd hc0 hcM hMd hcd haL hLb hwid
    refine ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, hwidth.trans ?_⟩
    exact divEps_mono w (one_div_le_one_div_of_le hκ hκc') (by positivity) (abs_nonneg L) hε0 hδ0
  · 
    have hdκ' := hdκ hge
    have hd0 : 0 < -d := by linarith
    have hnc : (-(lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).1).toVal
        = some ((-c : ℝ) : EReal) := by rw [toVal_neg, hc, Option.map_some, EReal.coe_neg]
    have hnd : (-(lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).2).toVal
        = some ((-d : ℝ) : EReal) := by rw [toVal_neg, hd, Option.map_some, EReal.coe_neg]
    obtain ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, hlo1, hhi1, hwidth⟩ :=
      divBracketByPosBracket_spec hw ha hb' (B := (_, _)) (M := -M) (δ := lnEps eb.toInt w) hnd hnc
        hd0 (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) haL hLb hwid
    have hnlo : (-(divBracketByPosBracket X
        (-(lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).2,
          -(lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).1) w).2).toVal
        = some ((-hi : ℝ) : EReal) := by rw [toVal_neg, hhi, Option.map_some, EReal.coe_neg]
    have hnhi : (-(divBracketByPosBracket X
        (-(lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).2,
          -(lnBaseFloatBracket (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).1) w).1).toVal
        = some ((-lo : ℝ) : EReal) := by rw [toVal_neg, hlo, Option.map_some, EReal.coe_neg]
    refine ⟨-hi, -lo, hnlo, hnhi, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [div_neg] at hhi1; linarith
    · rw [div_neg] at hlo1; linarith
    · have := hwidth.trans (divEps_mono w (one_div_le_one_div_of_le hκ (by linarith))
        (by positivity) (abs_nonneg L) hε0 hδ0)
      linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.tendsto_logBaseFloatEps
statement:
theorem tendsto_logBaseFloatEps (ex eb : ℤ) (K A : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (logBaseFloatEps ex eb K A) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hx := tendsto_lnEps ex
  have hb := tendsto_lnEps eb
  have hu := tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hA : Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => A) Filter.atTop (nhds A) := tendsto_const_nhds
  have := (((hx.const_mul 2).add (((hA.add hx).const_mul 8).mul
    ((hb.const_mul (1 + K)).add hu)))).const_mul (1 + K)
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseFloatApprox_spec
statement:
theorem logBaseFloatApprox_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) (ex : AzInt) {qx : ℕ} {mx : AzNat}
    (hvx : FiniteValid qx mx) (eb : AzInt) {qb : ℕ} {mb : AzNat} (hvb : FiniteValid qb mb)
    (hb1 : finiteVal true eb mb ≠ 1)
    (hirr : Irrational (Real.log (finiteVal true ex mx) / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb))) :
    ∃ lv hv' : ℝ,
      Rounds (logBaseFloatApprox (finite true ex qx mx hvx) ex (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).1
        lv ∧
      Rounds (logBaseFloatApprox (finite true ex qx mx hvx) ex (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).2
        hv' ∧
      lv < Real.log (finiteVal true ex mx) / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb) ∧
      Real.log (finiteVal true ex mx) / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb) < hv' ∧
      hv' - lv ≤ logBaseFloatEps ex.toInt eb.toInt (1 / lnKappa (finiteVal true eb mb))
        |Real.log (finiteVal true ex mx)| w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, bv, ha, hb', haL, hLb, hwid⟩ := lnBracket_spec hw ex hvx
  exact logBaseFloatQuot_spec hw ha hb' haL hLb hwid eb hvb hb1 hirr

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseFloatApprox_isSome_exists
statement:
theorem logBaseFloatApprox_isSome_exists (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (ex : AzInt)
    {qx : ℕ} {mx : AzNat} (hvx : FiniteValid qx mx) (eb : AzInt) {qb : ℕ} {mb : AzNat}
    (hvb : FiniteValid qb mb) (hb1 : finiteVal true eb mb ≠ 1)
    (hirr : Irrational (Real.log (finiteVal true ex mx) / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb)))
    (w₀ : ℕ) (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) :
    ∃ f : ℕ, (roundingPossible
      (logBaseFloatApprox (finite true ex qx mx hvx) ex (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb
        (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).1
      (logBaseFloatApprox (finite true ex qx mx hvx) ex (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb
        (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).2 p mode).isSome = true
proof:
:=
  exists_isSome_of_irrational_threshold p mode
    (logBaseFloatApprox (finite true ex qx mx hvx) ex (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb) hirr
    (logBaseFloatEps ex.toInt eb.toInt (1 / lnKappa (finiteVal true eb mb))
      |Real.log (finiteVal true ex mx)|)
    (tendsto_logBaseFloatEps _ _ _ _) 64
    (fun w hw => by
      obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, hwid⟩ := logBaseFloatApprox_spec hw ex hvx eb hvb hb1 hirr
      exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, hwid⟩) w₀ hw₀

name: Azurite.AzFloat.tendsto_logBaseFloatP1Eps
statement:
theorem tendsto_logBaseFloatP1Eps (E : ℕ) (eb : ℤ) (K A : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (logBaseFloatP1Eps E eb K A) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hx := tendsto_lnRatEps E A
  have hb := tendsto_lnEps eb
  have hu := tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hA : Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => A) Filter.atTop (nhds A) := tendsto_const_nhds
  have := (((hx.const_mul 2).add (((hA.add hx).const_mul 8).mul
    ((hb.const_mul (1 + K)).add hu)))).const_mul (1 + K)
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseFloatP1Approx_spec
statement:
theorem logBaseFloatP1Approx_spec {w : ℕ} (hw : 64 ≤ w) {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ}
    (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal)) (hx1 : -1 < xv) (eb : AzInt) {qb : ℕ} {mb : AzNat}
    (hvb : FiniteValid qb mb) (hb1 : finiteVal true eb mb ≠ 1)
    (hirr : Irrational (Real.log (1 + xv) / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb))) :
    ∃ lv hv' : ℝ, Rounds (logBaseFloatP1Approx x (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).1 lv ∧
      Rounds (logBaseFloatP1Approx x (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb w).2 hv' ∧
      lv < Real.log (1 + xv) / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb) ∧
      Real.log (1 + xv) / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb) < hv' ∧
      hv' - lv ≤ logBaseFloatP1Eps (⌊2 * |Real.log (1 + xv)|⌋₊ + 2) eb.toInt
        (1 / lnKappa (finiteVal true eb mb)) |Real.log (1 + xv)| w
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero w := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hpos : 0 < 1 + xv := by linarith
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hf⟩ := addFloor_err toVal_one' hx w hpos.le
  obtain ⟨a, bv, ha, hb', haL, hLb, hwid⟩ := lnFloorBracket_spec hw hr hpos hf.le hf.ge
  exact logBaseFloatQuot_spec hw ha hb' haL hLb hwid eb hvb hb1 hirr

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseFloatP1Approx_isSome_exists
statement:
theorem logBaseFloatP1Approx_isSome_exists (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode)
    {x : AzFloat} {xv : ℝ} (hx : x.toVal = some (xv : EReal)) (hx1 : -1 < xv) (eb : AzInt)
    {qb : ℕ} {mb : AzNat} (hvb : FiniteValid qb mb) (hb1 : finiteVal true eb mb ≠ 1)
    (hirr : Irrational (Real.log (1 + xv) / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb))) (w₀ : ℕ)
    (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) :
    ∃ f : ℕ, (roundingPossible
      (logBaseFloatP1Approx x (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).1
      (logBaseFloatP1Approx x (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb (w₀ * 2 ^ f)).2 p mode).isSome
        = true
proof:
:=
  exists_isSome_of_irrational_threshold p mode
    (logBaseFloatP1Approx x (finite true eb qb mb hvb) eb) hirr
    (logBaseFloatP1Eps (⌊2 * |Real.log (1 + xv)|⌋₊ + 2) eb.toInt
      (1 / lnKappa (finiteVal true eb mb)) |Real.log (1 + xv)|)
    (tendsto_logBaseFloatP1Eps _ _ _ _) 64
    (fun w hw => by
      obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, hwid⟩ :=
        logBaseFloatP1Approx_spec hw hx hx1 eb hvb hb1 hirr
      exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, hwid⟩) w₀ hw₀

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ensurePoint_of_mem
statement: theorem ensurePoint_of_mem (cs : List Char) (h : '.' ∈ cs) : ensurePoint cs = cs
proof:
:= by
  unfold ensurePoint
  rw [ite_eq_left (by simpa using h)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ensurePoint_no_e
statement:
theorem ensurePoint_no_e (cs : List Char) (h1 : '.' ∉ cs) (h2 : ∀ c ∈ cs, (c == 'e') = false) :
    ensurePoint cs = cs ++ ['.', '0']
proof:
:= by
  unfold ensurePoint
  rw [ite_eq_right (by simpa using h1), splitFirst_eq_none _ _ h2]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ensurePoint_e
statement:
theorem ensurePoint_e (L M : List Char) (h1 : '.' ∉ L ++ 'e' :: M)
    (hL : ∀ c ∈ L, (c == 'e') = false) :
    ensurePoint (L ++ 'e' :: M) = L ++ '.' :: '0' :: 'e' :: M
proof:
:= by
  unfold ensurePoint
  rw [ite_eq_right (by simpa using h1), splitFirst_append _ L 'e' M hL rfl]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sciVal_append_zero
statement:
theorem sciVal_append_zero (b : UInt64) (hb : 0 < b.toNat) (neg : Bool) (cs : List Char)
    (E : ℤ) : sciVal b neg (cs ++ ['0']) (E - 1) = sciVal b neg cs E
proof:
:= by
  have hbq : (b.toNat : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hb.ne'
  unfold sciVal
  rw [List.map_append, List.map_singleton, digitVal_zero, List.reverse_append,
    List.reverse_singleton, List.singleton_append, Nat.ofDigits_cons, zpow_sub_one₀ hbq]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.digit_char_facts
statement:
theorem digit_char_facts (b : UInt64) (hb' : b.toNat ≤ 14) (c : Char)
    (hc : ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < b.toNat) : (c == 'e') = false ∧ c ≠ '.'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdb⟩ := hc
  have h1 := isExpChar_eq_false_of_charToDigit c d hd (by omega)
  have h2 := beq_point_eq_false_of_charToDigit c d hd
  refine ⟨?_, by simpa using h2⟩
  simp only [isExpChar, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h1
  exact h1.1

name: Azurite.AzFloat.exponentChars_lower
statement:
theorem exponentChars_lower (fmt : SciFormat) (hlow : fmt.eLowercase = true) (b : UInt64)
    (e : ℤ) : ∃ tail, SciNumber.exponentChars fmt b e = 'e' :: tail ∧ '.' ∉ tail
proof:
:= by
  unfold SciNumber.exponentChars
  rw [hlow]
  refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro h
  rw [List.mem_append] at h
  rcases h with h | h
  · split at h <;> simp at h
  · rw [toList_toString_int] at h
    rw [List.mem_append] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · split at h <;> simp at h
    · have := isDigit_of_mem_toDigits10 h
      simp at this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.fromSci_ensurePoint_toString
statement:
theorem fromSci_ensurePoint_toString (x : SciNumber) (fmt : SciFormat) (hb : 2 ≤ x.base.toNat)
    (hb' : x.base.toNat ≤ 14) (hlow : fmt.eLowercase = true)
    (hd : ∀ d ∈ x.digits, d.toNat < x.base.toNat)
    (hlead : ∀ h : 0 < x.digits.size, x.digits[0]'h ≠ 0)
    (hs : x.scale.natAbs < 2 ^ 62) (he : x.exponent.natAbs < 2 ^ 62) :
    fromSci (String.ofList (ensurePoint (x.toString fmt).toList)) x.base
      = some (ofRat x.value)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨neg, b, digits, scale⟩ := x
  simp only [SciNumber.exponent] at hb hb' hd hlead hs he ⊢
  have hb0 : 0 < b.toNat := by omega
  have hb36 : b.toNat ≤ 36 := by omega
  set u := !fmt.lowercase with hu
  have hcs_map : (digits.map fun d => digitToChar d u).toList
      = digits.toList.map fun d => digitToChar d u := Array.toList_map
  set cs := digits.toList.map fun d => digitToChar d u with hcs
  have hcs_dig : ∀ c ∈ cs, ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < b.toNat := by
    intro c hc
    rw [hcs, List.mem_map] at hc
    obtain ⟨d, hd', rfl⟩ := hc
    have hdb := hd d (Array.mem_toList_iff.mp hd')
    exact ⟨d, charToDigit_digitToChar' d (by omega) u, hdb⟩
  have hcs_val : cs.map digitVal = digits.toList.map UInt64.toNat := by
    rw [hcs, List.map_map]
    refine List.map_congr_left fun d hd' => ?_
    exact digitVal_digitToChar d (by have := hd d (Array.mem_toList_iff.mp hd'); omega) u
  have hcs_len : cs.length = digits.size := by rw [hcs, List.length_map, Array.length_toList]
  have hval : SciNumber.value ⟨neg, b, digits, scale⟩ = sciVal b neg cs (-scale) := by
    simp only [SciNumber.value, sciVal, mantissa_eq_ofDigits, hcs_val]
  have key : ∀ (cs' : List Char) (k : ℕ) (E : ℤ), cs = cs' ++ List.replicate k '0' →
      E = k - scale → sciVal b neg cs' E = SciNumber.value ⟨neg, b, digits, scale⟩ := by
    intro cs' k E hcs' hE
    rw [hval, hcs', sciVal, sciVal, List.map_append, List.map_replicate, digitVal_zero,
      sciValue_eq b.toNat hb0 neg _ k scale E hE]
  
  have hsign_e : ∀ c ∈ signChars neg, (c == 'e') = false := by
    intro c hc; unfold signChars at hc; split at hc <;> simp at hc; subst hc; decide
  have hsign_p : '.' ∉ signChars neg := by
    intro hc; unfold signChars at hc; split at hc <;> simp at hc
  have hdig_e : ∀ (L : List Char), (∀ c ∈ L, ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < b.toNat) →
      ∀ c ∈ L, (c == 'e') = false := fun L hL c hc => (digit_char_facts b hb' c (hL c hc)).1
  have hdig_p : ∀ (L : List Char), (∀ c ∈ L, ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < b.toNat) →
      '.' ∉ L := fun L hL hc => (digit_char_facts b hb' '.' (hL '.' hc)).2 rfl
  have hno_e_sign_digits : ∀ (L : List Char),
      (∀ c ∈ L, ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < b.toNat) →
      ∀ c ∈ signChars neg ++ L, (c == 'e') = false := by
    intro L hL c hc
    rw [List.mem_append] at hc
    rcases hc with hc | hc
    · exact hsign_e c hc
    · exact hdig_e L hL c hc
  have hno_p_sign_digits : ∀ (L : List Char),
      (∀ c ∈ L, ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < b.toNat) →
      '.' ∉ signChars neg ++ L := by
    intro L hL hc
    rw [List.mem_append] at hc
    rcases hc with hc | hc
    · exact hsign_p hc
    · exact hdig_p L hL hc
  
  have plain_case : ∀ (cs' : List Char), cs' ≠ [] →
      (∀ c ∈ cs', ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < b.toNat) →
      fromSci (String.ofList (ensurePoint (signChars neg ++ cs'))) b
        = some (ofRat (sciVal b neg cs' 0)) := by
    intro cs' hne hdig
    rw [ensurePoint_no_e _ (hno_p_sign_digits cs' hdig) (hno_e_sign_digits cs' hdig)]
    have hdig0 : ∀ c ∈ cs' ++ ['0'], ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < b.toNat := by
      intro c hc
      rw [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hc
      rcases hc with hc | rfl
      · exact hdig c hc
      · exact charToDigit_zero_below b hb
    have hpos : 0 < cs'.length := List.length_pos_of_ne_nil hne
    have B := fromSci_split_shape b hb hb36 neg (cs' ++ ['0']) cs'.length hpos
      (by simp) hdig0 (by simp)
    rw [List.take_left, List.drop_left] at B
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,
      Nat.cast_one] at B
    rw [List.append_assoc, B, show (-1 : ℤ) = 0 - 1 by ring, sciVal_append_zero b hb0]
  simp only [SciNumber.toString, SciNumber.toChars, SciNumber.exponent, String.toList_ofList]
  rw [hcs_map]
  by_cases h0 : digits.isEmpty
  · rw [ite_eq_left h0]
    have hdig0 : digits = #[] := Array.isEmpty_iff.mp h0
    have hcs0 : cs = [] := by rw [hcs, hdig0]; rfl
    have hv0 : SciNumber.value ⟨neg, b, digits, scale⟩ = 0 := by
      rw [hval, hcs0]; simp [sciVal]
    rw [hv0]
    by_cases hitz : (fmt.includeTrailingZeros && decide (0 < scale)) = true
    · 
      rw [ite_eq_left hitz, ensurePoint_of_mem _ (by simp)]
      have B := fromSci_zero_shape b hb hb36 neg scale (by omega) fmt.includeTrailingZeros
      simp only [signChars] at B
      rw [ite_eq_left hitz] at B
      exact B
    · 
      rw [ite_eq_right hitz]
      have B := plain_case ['0'] (by simp) (fun c hc => by
        rw [List.mem_singleton] at hc; subst hc; exact charToDigit_zero_below b hb)
      simp only [signChars] at B
      rw [B, show sciVal b neg ['0'] 0 = 0 by cases neg <;> simp [sciVal, digitVal_zero]]
  · have hsz : 0 < digits.size := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos digits.size with h | h
      · exact absurd (Array.isEmpty_iff.mpr (Array.eq_empty_of_size_eq_zero h)) h0
      · exact h
    rw [ite_eq_right h0]
    have hhead : ∃ c, cs.head? = some c ∧ c ≠ '0' := by
      obtain ⟨d0, ds, hds⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (show digits.toList ≠ [] by
        intro h
        have := congrArg List.length h
        simp only [Array.length_toList, List.length_nil] at this
        omega)
      refine ⟨digitToChar d0 u, by rw [hcs, hds]; rfl, ?_⟩
      have hd0 : digits[0]'hsz = d0 := by
        rw [← Array.getElem_toList (by simpa using hsz)]
        simp [hds]
      refine digitToChar_ne_zero d0
        (by have := hd d0 (Array.mem_toList_iff.mp (hds ▸ List.mem_cons_self)); omega) ?_ u
      rw [← hd0]
      exact hlead hsz
    obtain ⟨c0, hc0, hc0ne⟩ := hhead
    have hcs_ne : cs ≠ [] := by
      intro h
      rw [h] at hc0
      simp at hc0
    have htrim : ∀ (cs' : List Char) (k : ℕ), cs = cs' ++ List.replicate k '0' →
        cs' ≠ [] ∧ (∀ c ∈ cs', ∃ d, charToDigit c = some d ∧ d.toNat < b.toNat) ∧
          cs.length = cs'.length + k := by
      intro cs' k hk
      refine ⟨ne_nil_of_eq_append_replicate cs cs' k c0 hk hc0 hc0ne,
        fun c hc => hcs_dig c (hk ▸ List.mem_append_left _ hc), ?_⟩
      rw [hk, List.length_append, List.length_replicate]
    split
    · 
      rename_i hcond
      simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hcond
      generalize hcs' : (if fmt.includeTrailingZeros then cs else SciNumber.dropTrailingZeros cs)
        = cs'
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, cs = cs' ++ List.replicate k '0' := by
        rw [← hcs']
        split
        · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
        · exact dropTrailingZeros_spec cs
      obtain ⟨hne', hdig', hlen'⟩ := htrim cs' k hk
      obtain ⟨d, rest, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hne'
      simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen'
      obtain ⟨tail, htail, htail_p⟩ := exponentChars_lower fmt hlow b (↑digits.size - 1 - scale)
      cases rest with
      | nil =>
        simp only [List.length_nil] at hlen'
        
        have hd_dig : ∃ k, charToDigit d = some k ∧ k.toNat < b.toNat := hdig' d List.mem_cons_self
        rw [htail]
        show fromSci (String.ofList (ensurePoint ((signChars neg ++ [d]) ++ 'e' :: tail))) b = _
        rw [ensurePoint_e _ _ (by
            intro h
            simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at h
            rcases h with (h | h) | h | h
            · exact hsign_p h
            · exact (digit_char_facts b hb' d hd_dig).2 h.symm
            · exact absurd h (by decide)
            · exact htail_p h)
          (hno_e_sign_digits [d] (fun c hc => by
            rw [List.mem_singleton] at hc; subst hc; exact hd_dig))]
        have hdig0 : ∀ c ∈ d :: ['0'], ∃ k, charToDigit c = some k ∧ k.toNat < b.toNat := by
          intro c hc
          rw [List.mem_cons, List.mem_singleton] at hc
          rcases hc with rfl | rfl
          · exact hd_dig
          · exact charToDigit_zero_below b hb
        have B := fromSci_exp_point_shape b hb hb36 neg d ['0'] hdig0 fmt (↑digits.size - 1 - scale)
          (by omega) (fun h => absurd h (by omega)) (by simp only [List.length_singleton]; omega)
        rw [htail] at B
        simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at B ⊢
        rw [B, List.length_singleton, Nat.cast_one, show [d, '0'] = [d] ++ ['0'] from rfl,
          sciVal_append_zero b hb0, key [d] k (↑digits.size - 1 - scale) hk (by omega)]
      | cons c rest =>
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen'
        rw [ensurePoint_of_mem _ (by simp)]
        have B := fromSci_exp_point_shape b hb hb36 neg d (c :: rest) hdig' fmt
          (↑digits.size - 1 - scale) (by omega) (fun h => absurd h (by omega))
          (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
        simp only [signChars] at B
        rw [B, key (d :: c :: rest) k (↑digits.size - 1 - scale - ↑(c :: rest).length) hk
          (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)]
    · rename_i hcond
      simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, not_or, not_lt] at hcond
      split
      · 
        rename_i hscale
        have B := plain_case cs hcs_ne hcs_dig
        simp only [signChars] at B
        rw [B, key cs 0 0 (by simp) (by omega)]
      · rename_i hscale
        generalize hcs' : (if fmt.includeTrailingZeros then cs
          else SciNumber.dropTrailingZerosWithin scale.toNat cs) = cs'
        obtain ⟨k, hk, hkle⟩ :
            ∃ k, cs = cs' ++ List.replicate k '0' ∧ k ≤ scale.toNat := by
          rw [← hcs']
          split
          · exact ⟨0, by simp, by omega⟩
          · obtain ⟨k, hk, hle⟩ := dropTrailingZerosWithin_spec scale.toNat cs
            refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
            have := congrArg List.length hk
            rw [List.length_append, List.length_replicate] at this
            omega
        obtain ⟨hne', hdig', hlen'⟩ := htrim cs' k hk
        have hpos : 0 < cs'.length := List.length_pos_of_ne_nil hne'
        split
        · 
          rw [ensurePoint_of_mem _ (by simp)]
          have B := fromSci_small_shape b hb hb36 neg (-(↑digits.size - 1 - scale) - 1).toNat cs'
            hdig' (by omega)
          simp only [signChars] at B
          rw [B, key cs' k
            (-(((-(↑digits.size - 1 - scale) - 1).toNat + cs'.length : ℕ) : ℤ)) hk (by omega)]
        · by_cases hlt : (↑digits.size - 1 - scale).toNat + 1 < cs'.length
          · 
            rw [ite_eq_left hlt, ensurePoint_of_mem _ (by simp)]
            have B := fromSci_split_shape b hb hb36 neg cs' ((↑digits.size - 1 - scale).toNat + 1)
              (by omega) hlt hdig' (by omega)
            simp only [signChars] at B
            rw [B, key cs' k
              (-((cs'.length - ((↑digits.size - 1 - scale).toNat + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) hk
              (by omega)]
          · 
            rw [ite_eq_right hlt]
            have B := plain_case cs' hne' hdig'
            simp only [signChars] at B
            rw [B, key cs' k 0 hk (by omega)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.mem_ensurePoint
statement: theorem mem_ensurePoint (cs : List Char) : '.' ∈ ensurePoint cs
proof:
:= by
  unfold ensurePoint
  split
  · rename_i h; simpa using h
  · split
    · simp
    · simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ensurePoint_ne_special
statement:
theorem ensurePoint_ne_special (cs : List Char) :
    String.ofList (ensurePoint cs) ≠ "NaN" ∧ String.ofList (ensurePoint cs) ≠ "Infinity" ∧
      String.ofList (ensurePoint cs) ≠ "-Infinity"
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := mem_ensurePoint cs
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro h <;> have h' := congrArg String.toList h <;>
    rw [String.toList_ofList] at h' <;> rw [h'] at hmem <;> revert hmem <;> decide

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofDecimalStringRound_of_fromSci
statement:
theorem ofDecimalStringRound_of_fromSci (s : String) (q : AzRat) (hq : fromSci s = some q)
    (hne : s ≠ "NaN" ∧ s ≠ "Infinity" ∧ s ≠ "-Infinity") (p : ℕ) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    ofDecimalStringRound s p mode = some (ofAzRatRound q p mode)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofDecimalStringRound
  rw [ite_eq_right hne.1, ite_eq_right hne.2.1, ite_eq_right hne.2.2, hq, Option.map_some]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_ofDecimalStringRound
statement:
theorem toVal_ofDecimalStringRound (s : String) (q : AzRat) (hq : fromSci s = some q)
    (hne : s ≠ "NaN" ∧ s ≠ "Infinity" ∧ s ≠ "-Infinity") (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    ∃ r, ofDecimalStringRound s p mode = some r ∧
      r.1.toVal = some (RoundingTarget.round (floatSet p) mode (toRat q : ℝ)).val ∧
      ∃ v : ℝ, r.1.toVal = some (v : EReal) ∧ r.2 = compare v (toRat q : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ofAzRatRound q p mode, ofDecimalStringRound_of_fromSci s q hq hne p mode, ?_,
    snd_ofAzRatRound q p (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)) mode⟩
  rw [toVal_ofAzRatRound, val_round_floatSet]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofDecimalStringRound_nan
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofDecimalStringRound_nan (p : ℕ) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    ofDecimalStringRound "NaN" p mode = some (nan, .eq)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofDecimalStringRound
  rw [ite_eq_left rfl]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofDecimalStringRound_infinity
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofDecimalStringRound_infinity (p : ℕ) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    ofDecimalStringRound "Infinity" p mode = some (infinity true, .eq)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofDecimalStringRound
  rw [ite_eq_right (by decide), ite_eq_left rfl]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofDecimalStringRound_neg_infinity
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofDecimalStringRound_neg_infinity (p : ℕ) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    ofDecimalStringRound "-Infinity" p mode = some (infinity false, .eq)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofDecimalStringRound
  rw [ite_eq_right (by decide), ite_eq_right (by decide), ite_eq_left rfl]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.pos_of_precision?_eq_some
statement: theorem pos_of_precision?_eq_some (x : AzFloat) (P : ℕ) (hP : x.precision? = some P) : 0 < P
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | finite s e p m hv => simp only [precision?, Option.some.injEq] at hP; subst hP; exact hv.pos
  | _ => simp [precision?] at hP

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ofDecimalString_toDecimalString
statement:
theorem ofDecimalString_toDecimalString (x : AzFloat) (q : AzRat) (hq : x.toAzRat? = some q)
    (P : ℕ) (hP : x.precision? = some P)
    (hrt : decimalRoundTrips x q P (shortestDecimalPrecision x) = true)
    (hbounds : ∀ sn, q.toSciNumber (decimalOptions (shortestDecimalPrecision x)) = some sn →
      sn.scale.natAbs < 2 ^ 62 ∧ sn.exponent.natAbs < 2 ^ 62) :
    ofDecimalString (toDecimalString x) P = some x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sn, hsn, hstr, hback⟩ := toDecimalString_spec x q hq P hP
  obtain ⟨hs, he⟩ := hbounds sn hsn
  obtain ⟨hbase, hd, hlead⟩ := toSciNumber_wellFormed q _ sn hsn
  have hbase10 : (decimalOptions (shortestDecimalPrecision x)).base = 10 := rfl
  rw [hbase10] at hbase hd
  have hb : 2 ≤ sn.base.toNat := by rw [hbase]; decide
  have hb' : sn.base.toNat ≤ 14 := by rw [hbase]; decide
  have hd' : ∀ d ∈ sn.digits, d.toNat < sn.base.toNat := by rw [hbase]; exact hd
  have hparse := fromSci_ensurePoint_toString sn {} hb hb' rfl hd' hlead hs he
  rw [hbase] at hparse
  have : NeZero P := ⟨(pos_of_precision?_eq_some x P hP).ne'⟩
  unfold ofDecimalString
  rw [hstr, ofDecimalStringRound_of_fromSci _ _ hparse (ensurePoint_ne_special _), Option.map_some,
    Option.some.injEq, ofAzRatRound_eq_ofEReal, toRat_ofRat, ← SciNumber.toRat_toAzRat sn hb hd',
    ← ofAzRatRound_eq_ofEReal]
  exact hback hrt

name: Azurite.SciNumber.toNat_ofLimbDigits_mantissa
statement:
theorem toNat_ofLimbDigits_mantissa (x : SciNumber) (hb : 2 ≤ x.base.toNat)
    (hd : ∀ d ∈ x.digits, d.toNat < x.base.toNat) :
    (AzNat.ofLimbDigits x.base x.digits.reverse).toNat = x.mantissa
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzNat.toNat_ofLimbDigits x.base hb _ (fun v hv => by
    rw [Array.toList_reverse, List.map_reverse, List.mem_reverse, List.mem_map] at hv
    obtain ⟨d, hd', rfl⟩ := hv
    exact hd d (Array.mem_toList_iff.mp hd')),
    AzRat.mantissa_eq_ofDigits, Array.toList_reverse, List.map_reverse]

name: Azurite.SciNumber.toRat_toAzRat
statement:
theorem toRat_toAzRat (x : SciNumber) (hb : 2 ≤ x.base.toNat)
    (hd : ∀ d ∈ x.digits, d.toNat < x.base.toNat) : AzRat.toRat x.toAzRat = x.value
proof:
:= by
  unfold toAzRat value
  have hm := toNat_ofLimbDigits_mantissa x hb hd
  have hv : AzRat.toRat ((AzNat.ofLimbDigits x.base x.digits.reverse).toAzRat *
      x.base.toAzRat.zpow (-x.scale)) = (x.mantissa : ℚ) * (x.base.toNat : ℚ) ^ (-x.scale) := by
    rw [AzRat.toRat_mul, AzRat.toRat_toAzRat, AzRat.toRat_zpow, UInt64.toRat_toAzRat, hm]
  cases x.negative
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, one_mul, hv]
  · simp only [↓reduceIte, AzRat.toRat_neg, hv]
    ring

name: Azurite.SciNumber.value_eq_fraction
statement:
theorem value_eq_fraction (x : SciNumber) (hb : 2 ≤ x.base.toNat)
    (hd : ∀ d ∈ x.digits, d.toNat < x.base.toNat) :
    ((x.value : ℚ) : ℝ) = (if !x.negative then 1 else -1) *
        ((x.fraction.1.toNat : ℝ) / (x.fraction.2.toNat : ℝ)) ∧
      x.fraction.2 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hm := toNat_ofLimbDigits_mantissa x hb hd
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < x.base.toNat := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < x.base.toNat by omega)
  have hsign : ((if x.negative then (-1 : ℚ) else 1 : ℚ) : ℝ)
      = (if !x.negative then 1 else -1) := by
    cases x.negative <;> simp
  unfold fraction value
  by_cases hsc : x.scale < 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left hsc]
    have hk : ((-x.scale).toNat : ℤ) = -x.scale := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
    refine ⟨?_, one_ne_zero⟩
    have hz : (x.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ (-x.scale) = (x.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ ((-x.scale).toNat) := by
      rw [← zpow_natCast, hk]
    simp only [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_pow, UInt64.toNat_toAzNat, AzNat.toNat_one, hm]
    push_cast
    rw [hz, hsign]
    ring
  · rw [ite_eq_right hsc]
    have hk : (x.scale.toNat : ℤ) = x.scale := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have hz : (x.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ (-x.scale) = ((x.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ x.scale.toNat)⁻¹ := by
        rw [zpow_neg, ← zpow_natCast, hk]
      simp only [AzNat.toNat_pow, UInt64.toNat_toAzNat, hm]
      push_cast
      rw [hz, hsign]
      ring
    · intro h
      have := congrArg AzNat.toNat h
      rw [AzNat.toNat_pow, UInt64.toNat_toAzNat, AzNat.toNat_zero] at this
      exact pow_ne_zero _ (by omega) this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.searchLeast_pred
statement:
theorem searchLeast_pred (pred : Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (n lo hi : Nat), hi - lo = n → pred hi = true → pred (searchLeast pred lo hi) = true
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro lo hi hn h
    rw [searchLeast]
    dsimp only
    split_ifs with hlt hmid
    · exact ih _ (by omega) lo _ rfl hmid
    · exact ih _ (by omega) _ hi rfl h
    · exact h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.le_searchLeast
statement:
theorem le_searchLeast (pred : Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (n lo hi : Nat), hi - lo = n → lo ≤ hi →
      lo ≤ searchLeast pred lo hi ∧ searchLeast pred lo hi ≤ hi
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro lo hi hn hlo
    rw [searchLeast]
    dsimp only
    split_ifs with hlt hmid
    · have := ih _ (by omega) lo ((lo + hi) / 2) rfl (by omega)
      omega
    · have := ih _ (by omega) ((lo + hi) / 2 + 1) hi rfl (by omega)
      omega
    · omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.searchLeast_min
statement:
theorem searchLeast_min (pred : Nat → Bool)
    (hmono : ∀ a b, a ≤ b → pred a = true → pred b = true) :
    ∀ (n lo hi : Nat), hi - lo = n → lo ≤ hi → ∀ q, lo ≤ q → pred q = true →
      searchLeast pred lo hi ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro lo hi hn hlo q hq hpq
    rw [searchLeast]
    dsimp only
    split_ifs with hlt hmid
    · exact ih _ (by omega) lo ((lo + hi) / 2) rfl (by omega) q hq hpq
    · have hq' : (lo + hi) / 2 + 1 ≤ q := by
        by_contra h
        push Not at h
        have := hmono q ((lo + hi) / 2) (by omega) hpq
        rw [this] at hmid
        exact absurd hmid (by decide)
      exact ih _ (by omega) ((lo + hi) / 2 + 1) hi rfl (by omega) q hq' hpq
    · have := le_searchLeast pred (hi - hi) hi hi rfl le_rfl
      omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.searchLeastFromTop_pred
statement:
theorem searchLeastFromTop_pred (pred : Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (hi step : Nat), pred hi = true → pred (searchLeastFromTop pred step hi) = true
proof:
:= by
  intro hi
  induction hi using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ hi ih =>
    intro step h
    unfold searchLeastFromTop
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact ih (hi - (step + 1)) (by omega) _ h2
    · exact searchLeast_pred _ _ _ _ rfl h
    · exact searchLeast_pred _ _ _ _ rfl h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.le_searchLeastFromTop
statement:
theorem le_searchLeastFromTop (pred : Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (hi step : Nat), 1 ≤ hi →
      1 ≤ searchLeastFromTop pred step hi ∧ searchLeastFromTop pred step hi ≤ hi
proof:
:= by
  intro hi
  induction hi using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ hi ih =>
    intro step h1
    unfold searchLeastFromTop
    split_ifs with hlt hp
    · have := ih (hi - (step + 1)) (by omega) (2 * step + 1) (by omega); omega
    · have := le_searchLeast pred _ (hi - step) hi rfl (by omega); omega
    · exact le_searchLeast pred _ 1 hi rfl h1

name: Azurite.AzFloat.searchLeastFromTop_min
statement:
theorem searchLeastFromTop_min (pred : Nat → Bool)
    (hmono : ∀ a b, a ≤ b → pred a = true → pred b = true) :
    ∀ (hi step : Nat), 1 ≤ hi → ∀ q, 1 ≤ q → pred q = true →
      searchLeastFromTop pred step hi ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  intro hi
  induction hi using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ hi ih =>
    intro step h1 q hq hpq
    unfold searchLeastFromTop
    split_ifs with hlt hp
    · exact ih (hi - (step + 1)) (by omega) _ (by omega) q hq hpq
    · have hq' : hi - step ≤ q := by
        by_contra hcon
        push Not at hcon
        exact absurd (hmono q (hi - (step + 1)) (by omega) hpq) hp
      exact searchLeast_min pred hmono _ (hi - step) hi rfl (by omega) q hq' hpq
    · exact searchLeast_min pred hmono _ 1 hi rfl h1 q hq hpq

name: Azurite.AzFloat.expandUntil_pred
statement:
theorem expandUntil_pred (pred : Nat → Bool) (p fuel : Nat) (h : pred p = true) :
    expandUntil pred p fuel = p
proof:
:= by
  cases fuel with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel => simp [expandUntil, h]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.le_expandUntil
statement: theorem le_expandUntil (pred : Nat → Bool) (p fuel : Nat) : p ≤ expandUntil pred p fuel
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing p with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    unfold expandUntil
    split_ifs
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact le_trans (by omega) (ih (2 * p))

name: Azurite.AzFloat.decimalRoundTrips_iff
statement:
theorem decimalRoundTrips_iff (x : AzFloat) (q : AzRat) (P p : Nat) :
    decimalRoundTrips x q P p = true ↔
      ∃ sn, q.toSciNumber (decimalOptions p) = some sn ∧ ofAzRat sn.toAzRat P = x
proof:
:= by
  unfold decimalRoundTrips
  cases h : q.toSciNumber (decimalOptions p) with
  | none => simp
  | some sn =>
    obtain ⟨hbase, hd, -⟩ := AzRat.toSciNumber_wellFormed q _ sn h
    have hb : 2 ≤ sn.base.toNat := by rw [hbase]; show 2 ≤ (10 : UInt64).toNat; decide
    have hd' : ∀ d ∈ sn.digits, d.toNat < sn.base.toNat := by rw [hbase]; exact hd
    obtain ⟨hval, hden⟩ := SciNumber.value_eq_fraction sn hb hd'
    have hq : (AzRat.toRat sn.toAzRat : ℝ) = (if !sn.negative then 1 else -1) *
        ((sn.fraction.1.toNat : ℝ) / (sn.fraction.2.toNat : ℝ)) := by
      rw [SciNumber.toRat_toAzRat sn hb hd']; exact hval
    simp only
    rw [fst_ofFractionRound _ _ _ hden P .Nearest sn.toAzRat hq]
    simp [ofAzRat, beq_iff_eq]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.decimalOptions_valid
statement: theorem decimalOptions_valid (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) : (decimalOptions p).valid = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold decimalOptions SciOptions.valid SciSizeOptions.valid
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, bne_iff_ne, ne_eq]
  exact ⟨⟨⟨by decide, by decide⟩, by decide⟩, hp.ne'⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.decimalRoundTrips_shortest
statement:
theorem decimalRoundTrips_shortest (x : AzFloat) (q : AzRat) (hq : x.toAzRat? = some q) (P : ℕ)
    (hP : x.precision? = some P)
    (hhi : decimalRoundTrips x q P (P * 30103 / 100000 + 2) = true) :
    decimalRoundTrips x q P (shortestDecimalPrecision x) = true
proof:
:= by
  unfold shortestDecimalPrecision
  rw [hq, hP]
  simp only
  rw [expandUntil_pred _ _ _ hhi]
  exact searchLeastFromTop_pred _ _ _ hhi

name: Azurite.AzFloat.shortestDecimalPrecision_pos
statement:
theorem shortestDecimalPrecision_pos (x : AzFloat) (q : AzRat) (hq : x.toAzRat? = some q)
    (P : ℕ) (hP : x.precision? = some P) : 0 < shortestDecimalPrecision x
proof:
:= by
  unfold shortestDecimalPrecision
  rw [hq, hP]
  simp only
  have h1 : 1 ≤ expandUntil (decimalRoundTrips x q P) (P * 30103 / 100000 + 2) 64 :=
    le_trans (by omega) (le_expandUntil _ _ _)
  exact (le_searchLeastFromTop _ _ _ h1).1

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toDecimalString_spec
statement:
theorem toDecimalString_spec (x : AzFloat) (q : AzRat) (hq : x.toAzRat? = some q) (P : ℕ)
    (hP : x.precision? = some P) :
    ∃ sn : SciNumber,
      q.toSciNumber (decimalOptions (shortestDecimalPrecision x)) = some sn ∧
      toDecimalString x = String.ofList (ensurePoint (sn.toString {}).toList) ∧
      (decimalRoundTrips x q P (shortestDecimalPrecision x) = true →
        ofAzRat sn.toAzRat P = x)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := shortestDecimalPrecision_pos x q hq P hP
  have hvalid := decimalOptions_valid _ hpos
  have : Fact (1 < (decimalOptions (shortestDecimalPrecision x)).base.toNat) :=
    ⟨by show (1 : ℕ) < (10 : UInt64).toNat; decide⟩
  have : NeZero (shortestDecimalPrecision x) := ⟨hpos.ne'⟩
  obtain ⟨sn, hsn, -⟩ := AzRat.toSciNumber_value_precision q
    (decimalOptions (shortestDecimalPrecision x)) hvalid (shortestDecimalPrecision x) rfl
  refine ⟨sn, hsn, ?_, ?_⟩
  · cases x with
    | nan => simp [precision?] at hP
    | infinity _ => simp [precision?] at hP
    | zero => simp [precision?] at hP
    | finite s e p m hv =>
      show (toDecimalAt (finite s e p m hv) (shortestDecimalPrecision (finite s e p m hv))).getD ""
        = _
      unfold toDecimalAt
      rw [hq]
      dsimp only
      unfold AzRat.toSci
      rw [hsn]
      rfl
  · intro hrt
    rw [decimalRoundTrips_iff] at hrt
    obtain ⟨sn', hsn', h⟩ := hrt
    rw [hsn] at hsn'
    cases hsn'
    exact h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBaseFloat_neg_left
statement: theorem logBaseFloat_neg_left {a : EReal} (ha : a < 0) (b : EReal) : logBaseFloat a b = none
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBaseFloat
  rw [ite_eq_left (Or.inl ha)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBaseFloat_neg_right
statement:
theorem logBaseFloat_neg_right (a : EReal) {b : EReal} (hb : b < 0) :
    logBaseFloat a b = none
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBaseFloat
  rw [ite_eq_left (Or.inr hb)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBaseFloat_top_right
statement:
theorem logBaseFloat_top_right {a : EReal} (ha : ¬ a < 0) :
    logBaseFloat a ⊤ = if a = ⊤ ∨ a = 0 then none else some 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBaseFloat
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨ha, not_lt.mpr le_top⟩), ite_eq_left (Or.inl rfl)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBaseFloat_zero_right
statement:
theorem logBaseFloat_zero_right {a : EReal} (ha : ¬ a < 0) :
    logBaseFloat a 0 = if a = ⊤ ∨ a = 0 then none else some 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBaseFloat
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨ha, lt_irrefl 0⟩), ite_eq_left (Or.inr rfl)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.one_ne_top
statement: theorem one_ne_top : (1 : EReal) ≠ ⊤
proof: := by rw [← EReal.coe_one]; exact EReal.coe_ne_top 1

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBaseFloat_one_right
statement:
theorem logBaseFloat_one_right {a : EReal} (ha : ¬ a < 0) :
    logBaseFloat a 1 = if a = 1 then none else if 1 < a then some ⊤ else some ⊥
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBaseFloat
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨ha, not_lt.mpr zero_le_one⟩),
    ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨one_ne_top, one_ne_zero⟩), ite_eq_left rfl]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBaseFloat_top_left
statement:
theorem logBaseFloat_top_left {bv : ℝ} (hb : 0 < bv) :
    logBaseFloat ⊤ (bv : EReal) = some (if 1 ≤ bv then ⊤ else ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb1 : bv = 1
  · rw [hb1, EReal.coe_one, logBaseFloat_one_right (not_lt.mpr le_top),
      ite_eq_right one_ne_top.symm, ite_eq_left (by rw [← EReal.coe_one]; exact EReal.coe_lt_top 1),
      ite_eq_left le_rfl]
  · unfold logBaseFloat
    rw [ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨not_lt.mpr le_top, not_lt.mpr (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hb.le)⟩),
      ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨EReal.coe_ne_top bv, mt EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp hb.ne'⟩),
      ite_eq_right (by rw [← EReal.coe_one]; exact mt EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp hb1),
      ite_eq_left rfl]
    by_cases h : 1 < bv
    · rw [ite_eq_left (by rw [← EReal.coe_one]; exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr h), ite_eq_left h.le]
    · rw [ite_eq_right (by rw [← EReal.coe_one]; exact mt EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp h),
        ite_eq_right (fun h' => h (lt_of_le_of_ne h' (Ne.symm hb1)))]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBaseFloat_zero_left
statement:
theorem logBaseFloat_zero_left {bv : ℝ} (hb : 0 < bv) :
    logBaseFloat 0 (bv : EReal) = some (if 1 ≤ bv then ⊥ else ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb1 : bv = 1
  · rw [hb1, EReal.coe_one, logBaseFloat_one_right (lt_irrefl 0), ite_eq_right zero_ne_one,
      ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr zero_le_one), ite_eq_left le_rfl]
  · unfold logBaseFloat
    rw [ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨lt_irrefl 0, not_lt.mpr (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hb.le)⟩),
      ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨EReal.coe_ne_top bv, mt EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp hb.ne'⟩),
      ite_eq_right (by rw [← EReal.coe_one]; exact mt EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp hb1),
      ite_eq_right EReal.zero_ne_top, ite_eq_left rfl]
    by_cases h : 1 < bv
    · rw [ite_eq_left (by rw [← EReal.coe_one]; exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mpr h), ite_eq_left h.le]
    · rw [ite_eq_right (by rw [← EReal.coe_one]; exact mt EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.mp h),
        ite_eq_right (fun h' => h (lt_of_le_of_ne h' (Ne.symm hb1)))]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_top
statement: theorem logBaseFloat_coe_top {xv : ℝ} (hx : 0 < xv) : logBaseFloat (xv : EReal) ⊤ = some 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [logBaseFloat_top_right (not_lt.mpr (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hx.le)),
    ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨EReal.coe_ne_top xv, mt EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp hx.ne'⟩)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_zero
statement: theorem logBaseFloat_coe_zero {xv : ℝ} (hx : 0 < xv) : logBaseFloat (xv : EReal) 0 = some 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [logBaseFloat_zero_right (not_lt.mpr (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hx.le)),
    ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨EReal.coe_ne_top xv, mt EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp hx.ne'⟩)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_one
statement:
theorem logBaseFloat_coe_one {xv : ℝ} (hx : 0 < xv) :
    logBaseFloat (xv : EReal) 1 = if xv = 1 then none else if 1 < xv then some ⊤ else some ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [logBaseFloat_one_right (not_lt.mpr (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hx.le))]
  simp only [← EReal.coe_one, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_coe
statement:
theorem logBaseFloat_coe_coe {xv bv : ℝ} (hx : 0 < xv) (hb : 0 < bv) (hb1 : bv ≠ 1) :
    logBaseFloat (xv : EReal) (bv : EReal) = some ((Real.log xv / Real.log bv : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBaseFloat
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨not_lt.mpr (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hx.le),
      not_lt.mpr (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hb.le)⟩),
    ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨EReal.coe_ne_top bv, mt EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp hb.ne'⟩),
    ite_eq_right (by rw [← EReal.coe_one]; exact mt EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp hb1),
    ite_eq_right (EReal.coe_ne_top xv), ite_eq_right (mt EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp hx.ne'),
    EReal.toReal_coe, EReal.toReal_coe]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.bind_none_of_forall
statement:
theorem bind_none_of_forall {α β : Type} {o : Option α} {f : α → Option β}
    (h : ∀ a, f a = none) : o.bind f = none
proof:
:= by
  cases o with
  | none => rfl
  | some a => exact h a

name: Azurite.AzFloat.one_le_finiteVal_iff
statement:
theorem one_le_finiteVal_iff (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) :
    1 ≤ finiteVal true e m ↔ (e.sign = true ∧ e.abs ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hge
    have := finiteVal_false_gt_neg_one e hv hge
    rw [finiteVal_false] at this
    linarith
  · intro hge
    have := finiteVal_false_le_neg_one e hv hge
    rw [finiteVal_false] at this
    linarith

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_eq_one_of_eqIEEE
statement:
theorem finiteVal_eq_one_of_eqIEEE (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m)
    (h : eqIEEE (finite true e q m hv) one = true) : finiteVal true e m = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hx, h1⟩ := (eqIEEE_iff _ _).mp h
  rw [toVal_finite] at hx
  rw [toVal_one', ← hx, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at h1
  exact h1.symm

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseFloatFinite_eq
statement:
theorem logBaseFloatFinite_eq (ex : AzInt) {qx : ℕ} {mx : AzNat} (hvx : FiniteValid qx mx)
    (eb : AzInt) {qb : ℕ} {mb : AzNat} (hvb : FiniteValid qb mb)
    (hb1 : finiteVal true eb mb ≠ 1) (hx1 : finiteVal true ex mx ≠ 1) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    logBaseFloatFinite ex hvx eb hvb hb1 hx1 p mode
      = roundVal p mode
          (some ((Real.log (finiteVal true ex mx) / Real.log (finiteVal true eb mb) : ℝ) :
            EReal))
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBaseFloatFinite
  split
  · rename_i r hx
    rw [ofAzRatRound_eq_roundVal, logBaseFloat_exact_value ex hvx eb hvb hb1 r hx]
  · rename_i hx
    have hirr := irrational_logBaseFloat_of_none ex hvx eb hvb hb1 hx1 hx
    exact zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode _ _ _ (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
      (fun w hw => by
        obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
          logBaseFloatApprox_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega) ex hvx eb hvb hb1
            hirr
        exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩) _

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseFloatPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂
statement:
theorem logBaseFloatPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂ (x b : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    logBaseFloatPrecRound x b p mode = liftVal₂ Spec.logBaseFloat x b p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold liftVal₂
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity sx =>
    cases sx with
    | false =>
      simp only [logBaseFloatPrecRound, toVal_infinity, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
        Option.bind_some]
      rw [bind_none_of_forall (Spec.logBaseFloat_neg_left EReal.bot_lt_zero), roundVal_none]
    | true =>
      simp only [logBaseFloatPrecRound, toVal_infinity, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some]
      cases b with
      | nan => rfl
      | infinity sb =>
        cases sb
        · simp only [toVal_infinity, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some,
            Spec.logBaseFloat_neg_right _ EReal.bot_lt_zero, roundVal_none]
        · simp only [toVal_infinity, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some]
          rw [Spec.logBaseFloat_top_right (not_lt.mpr le_top), ite_eq_left (Or.inl rfl),
            roundVal_none]
      | zero =>
        simp only [toVal_zero, Option.bind_some]
        rw [Spec.logBaseFloat_zero_right (not_lt.mpr le_top), ite_eq_left (Or.inl rfl),
          roundVal_none]
      | finite sb eb qb mb hvb =>
        cases sb with
        | false =>
          simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
          rw [finiteVal_false, Spec.logBaseFloat_neg_right _
            (EReal.coe_neg'.mpr (neg_neg_iff_pos.mpr (finiteVal_true_pos eb hvb))), roundVal_none]
        | true =>
          simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
          rw [Spec.logBaseFloat_top_left (finiteVal_true_pos eb hvb)]
          by_cases hge : eb.sign = true ∧ eb.abs ≠ 0
          · rw [ite_eq_left hge, ite_eq_left ((one_le_finiteVal_iff eb hvb).mpr hge)]
            exact (roundVal_inf p mode true).symm
          · rw [ite_eq_right hge, ite_eq_right (mt (one_le_finiteVal_iff eb hvb).mp hge)]
            exact (roundVal_inf p mode false).symm
  | zero =>
    simp only [logBaseFloatPrecRound, toVal_zero, Option.bind_some]
    cases b with
    | nan => rfl
    | infinity sb =>
      cases sb
      · simp only [toVal_infinity, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some,
          Spec.logBaseFloat_neg_right _ EReal.bot_lt_zero, roundVal_none]
      · simp only [toVal_infinity, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some]
        rw [Spec.logBaseFloat_top_right (lt_irrefl 0), ite_eq_left (Or.inr rfl), roundVal_none]
    | zero =>
      simp only [toVal_zero, Option.bind_some]
      rw [Spec.logBaseFloat_zero_right (lt_irrefl 0), ite_eq_left (Or.inr rfl), roundVal_none]
    | finite sb eb qb mb hvb =>
      cases sb with
      | false =>
        simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
        rw [finiteVal_false, Spec.logBaseFloat_neg_right _
          (EReal.coe_neg'.mpr (neg_neg_iff_pos.mpr (finiteVal_true_pos eb hvb))), roundVal_none]
      | true =>
        simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
        rw [Spec.logBaseFloat_zero_left (finiteVal_true_pos eb hvb)]
        by_cases hge : eb.sign = true ∧ eb.abs ≠ 0
        · rw [ite_eq_left hge, ite_eq_left ((one_le_finiteVal_iff eb hvb).mpr hge)]
          exact (roundVal_inf p mode false).symm
        · rw [ite_eq_right hge, ite_eq_right (mt (one_le_finiteVal_iff eb hvb).mp hge)]
          exact (roundVal_inf p mode true).symm
  | finite sx ex qx mx hvx =>
    cases sx with
    | false =>
      simp only [logBaseFloatPrecRound, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      rw [finiteVal_false, bind_none_of_forall (Spec.logBaseFloat_neg_left
        (EReal.coe_neg'.mpr (neg_neg_iff_pos.mpr (finiteVal_true_pos ex hvx)))), roundVal_none]
    | true =>
      have hx := finiteVal_true_pos ex hvx
      simp only [logBaseFloatPrecRound, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      cases b with
      | nan => rfl
      | infinity sb =>
        cases sb
        · simp only [toVal_infinity, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some,
            Spec.logBaseFloat_neg_right _ EReal.bot_lt_zero, roundVal_none]
        · simp only [toVal_infinity, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some, Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_top hx,
            roundVal_zero]
      | zero =>
        simp only [toVal_zero, Option.bind_some, Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_zero hx, roundVal_zero]
      | finite sb eb qb mb hvb =>
        cases sb with
        | false =>
          simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
          rw [finiteVal_false, Spec.logBaseFloat_neg_right _
            (EReal.coe_neg'.mpr (neg_neg_iff_pos.mpr (finiteVal_true_pos eb hvb))), roundVal_none]
        | true =>
          have hb := finiteVal_true_pos eb hvb
          simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
          split_ifs with hb1 hx1 hge hx1' hp
          · 
            rw [finiteVal_eq_one_of_eqIEEE eb hvb hb1, EReal.coe_one, Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_one hx,
              ite_eq_left (finiteVal_eq_one_of_eqIEEE ex hvx hx1), roundVal_none]
          · 
            have hne := finiteVal_ne_one_of_not_eqIEEE ex hvx hx1
            have hgt : 1 < finiteVal true ex mx :=
              lt_of_le_of_ne ((one_le_finiteVal_iff ex hvx).mpr hge) (Ne.symm hne)
            rw [finiteVal_eq_one_of_eqIEEE eb hvb hb1, EReal.coe_one, Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_one hx,
              ite_eq_right hne, ite_eq_left hgt]
            exact (roundVal_inf p mode true).symm
          · 
            have hne := finiteVal_ne_one_of_not_eqIEEE ex hvx hx1
            have hlt : ¬ 1 < finiteVal true ex mx := fun h =>
              hge ((one_le_finiteVal_iff ex hvx).mp h.le)
            rw [finiteVal_eq_one_of_eqIEEE eb hvb hb1, EReal.coe_one, Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_one hx,
              ite_eq_right hne, ite_eq_right hlt]
            exact (roundVal_inf p mode false).symm
          · 
            have hbne := finiteVal_ne_one_of_not_eqIEEE eb hvb hb1
            rw [Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_coe hx hb hbne, finiteVal_eq_one_of_eqIEEE ex hvx hx1',
              Real.log_one, zero_div, EReal.coe_zero, roundVal_zero]
          · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
          · have hbne := finiteVal_ne_one_of_not_eqIEEE eb hvb hb1
            rw [Spec.logBaseFloat_coe_coe hx hb hbne]
            exact logBaseFloatFinite_eq ex hvx eb hvb hbne _ p mode

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBaseRatPrecRound_eq
statement:
theorem logBaseRatPrecRound_eq (q : AzRat) (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    logBaseRatPrecRound q b p mode
      = roundVal p mode (Spec.logBase b.toNat ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  unfold logBaseRatPrecRound
  rw [dite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr hb)]
  split
  · 
    next k hk =>
      have hbk : b.toNat = 2 ^ k := by
        have := (AzNat.checkedLogBase2_eq_some_iff _ k).mp hk
        rwa [AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at this
      have hk0 : (AzNat.ofNat k).toAzInt ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have h1 := congrArg AzInt.toInt h0
        rw [toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, show (0 : AzInt).toInt = 0 from rfl] at h1
        have : k = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h1
        subst this
        omega
      rw [logBasePow2RatPrecRound_eq q _ hk0 p mode, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, hbk,
        Spec.logBase_two_pow]
  · next =>
    split_ifs with h0 hs hp
    · rw [(AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr h0, EReal.coe_zero, Spec.logBase_zero _ hb]
      exact (roundVal_inf p mode false).symm
    · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
    · have hq := toRat_pos_of_sign q hs h0
      have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
      rw [Spec.logBase_coe _ hb _ hqr]
      split
      · rename_i r hx
        have hval := logBaseExactRat?_some q hq _ (by rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat]; exact hb)
          (by rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat]; exact b.toBitVec.isLt) r hx
        rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat] at hval
        rw [ofAzRatRound_eq_roundVal, ← hval]
      · rename_i hx
        exact zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode _
          (Real.log (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) / Real.log b.toNat) _ (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
          (fun w hw => by
            obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
              logBaseRatApprox_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega) q hq b hb
                (AzNat.toNat_ofNat b.toNat ▸
                  irrational_of_logBaseExactRat?_none q hq (AzNat.ofNat b.toNat)
                    (by rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat]; exact hb)
                    (by rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat]; exact b.toBitVec.isLt) hx)
            exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩) _
    · have hneg := toRat_neg_of_sign q (by simpa using hs) h0
      rw [Spec.logBase_coe_neg _ _ hneg, roundVal_none]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.lnP1PrecRound_eq_liftVal
statement:
theorem lnP1PrecRound_eq_liftVal (x : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    lnP1PrecRound x p mode = liftVal (fun a => Spec.log (a + 1)) x p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold liftVal
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity s =>
    cases s
    · simp only [lnP1PrecRound, toVal_infinity, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some,
        EReal.bot_add, Spec.log_bot, roundVal_none]
    · simp only [lnP1PrecRound, toVal_infinity, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some]
      rw [← EReal.coe_one, EReal.top_add_coe, Spec.log_top, roundVal_top]
  | zero =>
    simp only [lnP1PrecRound, toVal_zero, Option.bind_some]
    rw [zero_add, ← EReal.coe_one, Spec.log_coe _ one_pos, Real.log_one, EReal.coe_zero,
      roundVal_zero]
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    cases s with
    | true =>
      have hpos := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
      simp only [lnP1PrecRound, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      split_ifs with hp
      · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
      rw [← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, Spec.log_coe _ (by linarith),
        add_comm (finiteVal true e m) 1]
      exact zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode _ (Real.log (1 + finiteVal true e m)) _
        (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
        (fun w hw => by
          obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
            lnP1Approx_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega)
              (toVal_finite true e q m hv) (by linarith) hpos.ne'
          exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩) _
    | false =>
      simp only [lnP1PrecRound, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      split_ifs with hneg heq hp
      · 
        obtain ⟨v, hx, h1⟩ := (eqIEEE_iff _ _).mp heq
        rw [toVal_finite] at hx
        rw [toVal_neg_one, ← hx, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at h1
        rw [← h1, ← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, neg_add_cancel, EReal.coe_zero, Spec.log_zero,
          roundVal_bot]
      · 
        have hle := finiteVal_false_le_neg_one e hv hneg
        have hne : finiteVal false e m ≠ -1 := fun h => heq ((eqIEEE_iff _ _).mpr
          ⟨((-1 : ℝ) : EReal), by rw [toVal_finite, h], toVal_neg_one⟩)
        have hlt : finiteVal false e m + 1 < 0 := by
          rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle with h | h
          · linarith
          · exact absurd h hne
        rw [← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, Spec.log_coe_neg _ hlt, roundVal_none]
      · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
      · have hgt := finiteVal_false_gt_neg_one e hv hneg
        rw [← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, Spec.log_coe _ (by linarith),
          add_comm (finiteVal false e m) 1]
        exact zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode _ (Real.log (1 + finiteVal false e m)) _
          (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
          (fun w hw => by
            obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
              lnP1Approx_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega)
                (toVal_finite false e q m hv) hgt (finiteVal_false_ne_zero e hv)
            exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩) _

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.agm_coe_coe
statement:
theorem agm_coe_coe {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    agm (a : EReal) (b : EReal) = some ((AGM a b : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ¬ ((a : EReal) < 0 ∨ (b : EReal) < 0) := by
    push Not
    exact ⟨EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr ha.le, EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hb.le⟩
  have h2 : ¬ ((a : EReal) = 0 ∨ (b : EReal) = 0) := by
    push Not
    exact ⟨EReal.coe_ne_zero.mpr ha.ne', EReal.coe_ne_zero.mpr hb.ne'⟩
  have h3 : ¬ ((a : EReal) = ⊤ ∨ (b : EReal) = ⊤) := by
    push Not
    exact ⟨EReal.coe_ne_top a, EReal.coe_ne_top b⟩
  rw [agm]
  simp only [h1, h2, h3, ite_false, EReal.toReal_coe]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.agm_of_neg_left
statement: theorem agm_of_neg_left {a : EReal} (ha : a < 0) (b : EReal) : agm a b = none
proof:
:= by
  rw [agm]; simp only [ha, true_or, ite_true]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.agm_of_neg_right
statement: theorem agm_of_neg_right (a : EReal) {b : EReal} (hb : b < 0) : agm a b = none
proof:
:= by
  rw [agm]; simp only [hb, or_true, ite_true]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.agm_zero_of_nonneg_ne_top
statement: theorem agm_zero_of_nonneg_ne_top {b : EReal} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hbt : b ≠ ⊤) : agm 0 b = some 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ¬ ((0 : EReal) < 0 ∨ b < 0) := by push Not; exact ⟨le_rfl, hb⟩
  have h3 : ¬ ((0 : EReal) = ⊤ ∨ b = ⊤) := by push Not; exact ⟨EReal.zero_ne_top, hbt⟩
  rw [agm]; simp only [h1, h3, ite_false, true_or, ite_true]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.agm_of_nonneg_ne_top_zero
statement: theorem agm_of_nonneg_ne_top_zero {a : EReal} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hat : a ≠ ⊤) : agm a 0 = some 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ¬ (a < 0 ∨ (0 : EReal) < 0) := by push Not; exact ⟨ha, le_rfl⟩
  have h3 : ¬ (a = ⊤ ∨ (0 : EReal) = ⊤) := by push Not; exact ⟨hat, EReal.zero_ne_top⟩
  rw [agm]; simp only [h1, h3, ite_false, or_true, ite_true]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.agm_zero_top
statement: theorem agm_zero_top : agm 0 ⊤ = none
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ¬ ((0 : EReal) < 0 ∨ (⊤ : EReal) < 0) := by push Not; exact ⟨le_rfl, le_top⟩
  rw [agm]; simp only [h1, ite_false, true_or, or_true, ite_true]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.agm_top_zero
statement: theorem agm_top_zero : agm ⊤ 0 = none
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ¬ ((⊤ : EReal) < 0 ∨ (0 : EReal) < 0) := by push Not; exact ⟨le_top, le_rfl⟩
  rw [agm]; simp only [h1, ite_false, true_or, or_true, ite_true]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.agm_top_of_pos
statement: theorem agm_top_of_pos {b : EReal} (hb : 0 < b) : agm ⊤ b = some ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ¬ ((⊤ : EReal) < 0 ∨ b < 0) := by push Not; exact ⟨le_top, hb.le⟩
  have h2 : ¬ ((⊤ : EReal) = 0 ∨ b = 0) := by push Not; exact ⟨EReal.top_ne_zero, hb.ne'⟩
  rw [agm]; simp only [h1, h2, ite_false, true_or, ite_true]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.agm_of_pos_top
statement: theorem agm_of_pos_top {a : EReal} (ha : 0 < a) : agm a ⊤ = some ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ¬ (a < 0 ∨ (⊤ : EReal) < 0) := by push Not; exact ⟨ha.le, le_top⟩
  have h2 : ¬ (a = 0 ∨ (⊤ : EReal) = 0) := by push Not; exact ⟨ha.ne', EReal.top_ne_zero⟩
  rw [agm]; simp only [h1, h2, ite_false, or_true, ite_true]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_floor_spec
statement:
theorem roundVal_floor_spec (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] (r : ℝ) :
    ∃ v : ℝ, (roundVal w .Floor (some (r : EReal))).1.toVal = some (v : EReal) ∧ v ≤ r ∧
      (0 ≤ r → 0 ≤ v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, ((v : ℝ) : EReal) = (roundFloor (floatSet w) r).val := by
    rw [val_roundFloor_floatSet]; exact precisionSet_exists_real _
  refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [(roundVal_coe w .Floor r).1]; exact congrArg some hv.symm
  · have := (isGreatest_roundFloor (floatSet w) r).1.2
    rw [← hv] at this
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp this
  · intro hr
    have h0 : ((0 : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ floatSet w := ⟨zero, Or.inr rfl, by rw [toVal_zero]; rfl⟩
    have := (isGreatest_roundFloor (floatSet w) r).2 ⟨h0, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hr⟩
    rw [← hv] at this
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_ceiling_spec
statement:
theorem roundVal_ceiling_spec (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] (r : ℝ) :
    ∃ v : ℝ, (roundVal w .Ceiling (some (r : EReal))).1.toVal = some (v : EReal) ∧ r ≤ v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, ((v : ℝ) : EReal) = (roundCeiling (floatSet w) r).val := by
    rw [val_roundCeiling_floatSet]; exact precisionSet_exists_real _
  refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [(roundVal_coe w .Ceiling r).1]; exact congrArg some hv.symm
  · have := (isLeast_roundCeiling (floatSet w) r).1.2
    rw [← hv] at this
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.addFloor_spec
statement:
theorem addFloor_spec (hu : u.toVal = some (uv : EReal)) (hv : v.toVal = some (vv : EReal))
    (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∃ r : ℝ, (addPrecRound u v w .Floor).1.toVal = some (r : EReal) ∧ r ≤ uv + vv ∧
      (0 ≤ uv + vv → 0 ≤ r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [addPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂, liftVal₂, hu, hv, Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some,
    Spec.add_coe_coe]
  exact roundVal_floor_spec w _

name: Azurite.AzFloat.addCeiling_spec
statement:
theorem addCeiling_spec (hu : u.toVal = some (uv : EReal)) (hv : v.toVal = some (vv : EReal))
    (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∃ r : ℝ, (addPrecRound u v w .Ceiling).1.toVal = some (r : EReal) ∧ uv + vv ≤ r

  rw [addPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂, liftVal₂, hu, hv, Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some,
    Spec.add_coe_coe]
  exact roundVal_ceiling_spec w _

name: Azurite.AzFloat.mulFloor_spec
statement:
theorem mulFloor_spec (hu : u.toVal = some (uv : EReal)) (hv : v.toVal = some (vv : EReal))
    (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∃ r : ℝ, (mulPrecRound u v w .Floor).1.toVal = some (r : EReal) ∧ r ≤ uv * vv ∧
      (0 ≤ uv * vv → 0 ≤ r)

    Spec.mul_coe_coe]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.mulCeiling_spec
statement:
theorem mulCeiling_spec (hu : u.toVal = some (uv : EReal)) (hv : v.toVal = some (vv : EReal))
    (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∃ r : ℝ, (mulPrecRound u v w .Ceiling).1.toVal = some (r : EReal) ∧ uv * vv ≤ r
proof:
