name: Azurite.AzFloat.sqrtFloor_spec
statement:
theorem sqrtFloor_spec (hu : u.toVal = some (uv : EReal)) (h0 : 0 ≤ uv) (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∃ r : ℝ, (sqrtPrecRound u w .Floor).1.toVal = some (r : EReal) ∧ r ≤ Real.sqrt uv ∧
      0 ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [sqrtPrecRound_eq_liftVal, liftVal, hu, Option.bind_some, Spec.sqrt_coe uv h0]
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hle, hnn⟩ := roundVal_floor_spec w (Real.sqrt uv)
  exact ⟨r, hr, hle, hnn (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sqrtCeiling_spec
statement:
theorem sqrtCeiling_spec (hu : u.toVal = some (uv : EReal)) (h0 : 0 ≤ uv) (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∃ r : ℝ, (sqrtPrecRound u w .Ceiling).1.toVal = some (r : EReal) ∧ Real.sqrt uv ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [sqrtPrecRound_eq_liftVal, liftVal, hu, Option.bind_some, Spec.sqrt_coe uv h0]
  exact roundVal_ceiling_spec w _

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_half
statement:
theorem toVal_half (hu : u.toVal = some (uv : EReal)) :
    (u >>> (1 : Nat)).toVal = some ((uv / 2 : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toVal_shiftRight_one (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hu), fval_of_toVal_coe hu]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.encloses_init
statement:
theorem encloses_init {x y : AzFloat} (hx : x.toVal = some (a : EReal))
    (hy : y.toVal = some (b : EReal)) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Encloses a b 0 ⟨x, x, y, y⟩
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨a, hx, ha.le, le_rfl⟩, ⟨a, hx, le_rfl⟩, ⟨b, hy, hb.le, le_rfl⟩, ⟨b, hy, le_rfl⟩⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.encloses_agmStep
statement:
theorem encloses_agmStep (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) {n : ℕ} {s : AgmBounds} (w : ℕ) [NeZero w]
    (h : Encloses a b n s) : Encloses a b (n + 1) (agmStep w s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨al, hal, hal0, halle⟩, ⟨ah, hah, hahge⟩, ⟨bl, hbl, hbl0, hblle⟩, ⟨bh, hbh, hbhge⟩⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := agm_pos ha hb n
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨r, hr, hrle, hr0⟩ := addFloor_spec hal hbl w
    refine ⟨r / 2, toVal_half hr, by linarith [hr0 (by linarith)], ?_⟩
    rw [agmA_succ]; linarith
  · obtain ⟨r, hr, hrge⟩ := addCeiling_spec hah hbh w
    refine ⟨r / 2, toVal_half hr, ?_⟩
    rw [agmA_succ]; linarith
  · obtain ⟨m, hm, hmle, hm0⟩ := mulFloor_spec hal hbl w
    have hm0' : 0 ≤ m := hm0 (mul_nonneg hal0 hbl0)
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrle, hr0⟩ := sqrtFloor_spec hm hm0' w
    refine ⟨r, hr, hr0, ?_⟩
    rw [agmB_succ]
    exact hrle.trans (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hmle.trans (mul_le_mul halle hblle hbl0 hA.le)))
  · obtain ⟨m, hm, hmge⟩ := mulCeiling_spec hah hbh w
    have hm0 : 0 ≤ m := le_trans (mul_nonneg (hA.le.trans hahge) (hB.le.trans hbhge)) hmge
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrge⟩ := sqrtCeiling_spec hm hm0 w
    refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
    rw [agmB_succ]
    exact (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ((mul_le_mul hahge hbhge hB.le (by linarith)).trans hmge)).trans hrge

name: Azurite.AzFloat.encloses_agmIter
statement:
theorem encloses_agmIter (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (s : AgmBounds) (n : ℕ), Encloses a b n s →
      ∃ m, n ≤ m ∧ Encloses a b m (agmIter w fuel s)
  | 0, s, n, h => ⟨n, le_rfl, h⟩
  | fuel + 1, s, n, h => by
    rw [agmIter]
    split_ifs
    · exact ⟨n, le_rfl, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨m, hm, hm'⟩
proof:
:=
        encloses_agmIter ha hb w fuel (agmStep w s) (n + 1) (encloses_agmStep ha hb w h)
      exact ⟨m, by omega, hm'⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.agmApproxFrom_spec
statement:
theorem agmApproxFrom_spec {s₀ : AgmBounds} (h₀ : Encloses a b 0 s₀) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (fuel w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, Rounds (agmApproxFrom s₀ fuel w).1 lv ∧ Rounds (agmApproxFrom s₀ fuel w).2 hv ∧
      lv ≤ AGM a b ∧ AGM a b ≤ hv ∧ (lv = AGM a b → hv = AGM a b)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := encloses_agmStep ha hb w h₀
  obtain ⟨m, hm, ⟨-, ⟨ah, hah, hahge⟩, ⟨bl, hbl, -, hblle⟩, -⟩⟩ :=
    encloses_agmIter ha hb w fuel _ 1 h1
  refine ⟨bl, ah, ?_, ?_, hblle.trans (agmB_le_AGM ha hb hm), (AGM_le_agmA ha hb hm).trans hahge,
    fun h => absurd (h ▸ hblle) (not_le.mpr (agmB_lt_AGM ha hb hab hm))⟩
  · have := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hbl)
    rwa [fval_of_toVal_coe hbl] at this
  · have := rounds_setPrecRound (isFinite_of_toVal_coe hah)
    rwa [fval_of_toVal_coe hah] at this

name: Azurite.AzFloat.agmApprox_spec
statement:
theorem agmApprox_spec {x y : AzFloat} (hx : x.toVal = some (a : EReal))
    (hy : y.toVal = some (b : EReal)) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≠ b) (w : ℕ)
    [NeZero w] :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, Rounds (agmApprox x y w).1 lv ∧ Rounds (agmApprox x y w).2 hv ∧
      lv ≤ AGM a b ∧ AGM a b ≤ hv ∧ (lv = AGM a b → hv = AGM a b)
proof:
:=
  agmApproxFrom_spec (encloses_init hx hy ha hb) ha hb hab _ w

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_true_pos_ereal
statement:
theorem finiteVal_true_pos_ereal (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) :
    (0 : EReal) < ((finiteVal true e m : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:=
  EReal.coe_pos.mpr (finiteVal_true_pos e hv)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_false_neg_ereal
statement:
theorem finiteVal_false_neg_ereal (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m) :
    ((finiteVal false e m : ℝ) : EReal) < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteVal_false]
  exact EReal.coe_neg'.mpr (neg_neg_of_pos (finiteVal_true_pos e hv))

name: Azurite.AzFloat.ratBounds_spec
statement:
theorem ratBounds_spec (q : AzRat) (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∃ lo hi : ℝ, (ratBounds q w).1.toVal = some (lo : EReal) ∧
      (ratBounds q w).2.toVal = some (hi : EReal) ∧ lo ≤ (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) ∧
      (0 ≤ (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) → 0 ≤ lo) ∧ (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) ≤ hi
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨lo, hlo, hle, hnn⟩ := roundVal_floor_spec w (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)
  obtain ⟨hi, hhi, hge⟩ := roundVal_ceiling_spec w (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)
  refine ⟨lo, hi, ?_, ?_, hle, hnn, hge⟩
  · show (ofAzRatRound q w .Floor).1.toVal = _
    rw [ofAzRatRound_eq_roundVal]; exact hlo
  · show (ofAzRatRound q w .Ceiling).1.toVal = _
    rw [ofAzRatRound_eq_roundVal]; exact hhi

name: Azurite.AzFloat.encloses_init_bounds
statement:
theorem encloses_init_bounds {aLo aHi bLo bHi : AzFloat} {al ah bl bh : ℝ}
    (hal : aLo.toVal = some (al : EReal)) (hah : aHi.toVal = some (ah : EReal))
    (hbl : bLo.toVal = some (bl : EReal)) (hbh : bHi.toVal = some (bh : EReal))
    (hal0 : 0 ≤ al) (hale : al ≤ a) (hage : a ≤ ah) (hbl0 : 0 ≤ bl) (hble : bl ≤ b)
    (hbge : b ≤ bh) : Encloses a b 0 ⟨aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi⟩
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨al, hal, hal0, hale⟩, ⟨ah, hah, hage⟩, ⟨bl, hbl, hbl0, hble⟩, ⟨bh, hbh, hbge⟩⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.agmRatApprox_spec
statement:
theorem agmRatApprox_spec {q₁ q₂ : AzRat} (ha : 0 < (AzRat.toRat q₁ : ℝ))
    (hb : 0 < (AzRat.toRat q₂ : ℝ)) (hab : (AzRat.toRat q₁ : ℝ) ≠ AzRat.toRat q₂) (w : ℕ)
    [NeZero w] :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, Rounds (agmRatApprox q₁ q₂ w).1 lv ∧ Rounds (agmRatApprox q₁ q₂ w).2 hv ∧
      lv ≤ AGM (AzRat.toRat q₁) (AzRat.toRat q₂) ∧ AGM (AzRat.toRat q₁) (AzRat.toRat q₂) ≤ hv ∧
      (lv = AGM (AzRat.toRat q₁) (AzRat.toRat q₂) →
        hv = AGM (AzRat.toRat q₁) (AzRat.toRat q₂))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨lo₁, hi₁, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := ratBounds_spec q₁ w
  obtain ⟨lo₂, hi₂, h1', h2', h3', h4', h5'⟩ := ratBounds_spec q₂ w
  exact agmApproxFrom_spec (encloses_init_bounds h1 h2 h1' h2' (h4 ha.le) h3 h5 (h4' hb.le) h3' h5')
    ha hb hab _ w

name: Azurite.AzFloat.agmFloatRatApprox_spec
statement:
theorem agmFloatRatApprox_spec {x : AzFloat} {q : AzRat} (hx : x.toVal = some (a : EReal))
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)) (hab : a ≠ AzRat.toRat q) (w : ℕ) [NeZero w] :
    ∃ lv hv : ℝ, Rounds (agmFloatRatApprox x q w).1 lv ∧ Rounds (agmFloatRatApprox x q w).2 hv ∧
      lv ≤ AGM a (AzRat.toRat q) ∧ AGM a (AzRat.toRat q) ≤ hv ∧
      (lv = AGM a (AzRat.toRat q) → hv = AGM a (AzRat.toRat q))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨lo, hi, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := ratBounds_spec q w
  exact agmApproxFrom_spec (encloses_init_bounds hx hx h1 h2 ha.le le_rfl le_rfl (h4 hb.le) h3 h5)
    ha hb hab _ w

name: Azurite.AzFloat.azRat_lt_zero_iff
statement: theorem azRat_lt_zero_iff (q : AzRat) : q < 0 ↔ (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) < 0
proof:
:= by
  show AzRat.cmp q 0 = .lt ↔ _
  rw [AzRat.cmp_eq_compare, AzRat.toRat_zero, compare_lt_iff_lt]
  exact (Rat.cast_lt_zero (K := ℝ)).symm

name: Azurite.AzFloat.azRat_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem azRat_eq_zero_iff (q : AzRat) : q = 0 ↔ (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl; simp
  · intro h
    apply AzRat.toRat_injective
    rw [AzRat.toRat_zero]; exact_mod_cast h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.azRat_toRat_eq_iff
statement:
theorem azRat_toRat_eq_iff (q₁ q₂ : AzRat) :
    q₁ = q₂ ↔ (AzRat.toRat q₁ : ℝ) = AzRat.toRat q₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [h], fun h => AzRat.toRat_injective (by exact_mod_cast h)⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.isZero_iff_toVal
statement: theorem isZero_iff_toVal (x : AzFloat) : x.isZero = true ↔ x.toVal = some 0
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nan => simp [isZero, toVal]
  | infinity s => cases s <;> simp [isZero, toVal, EReal.top_ne_zero, EReal.bot_ne_zero]
  | zero => simp [isZero, toVal]
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    constructor
    · intro h; exact absurd h (by simp [isZero])
    · intro h
      simp only [toVal, Option.some.injEq] at h
      exact absurd (EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp h) (finiteVal_ne_zero s e hv)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.subRat_isZero_iff
statement:
theorem subRat_isZero_iff {x : AzFloat} (hx : x.toVal = some (a : EReal)) (q : AzRat) :
    (subRatPrecRound x q 1 .Floor).1.isZero = true ↔ a = AzRat.toRat q
proof:
:= by
  rw [isZero_iff_toVal, subRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal, liftVal, hx, Option.bind_some, Spec.sub,
    ← EReal.coe_neg, Spec.add_coe_coe]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [(roundVal_coe 1 .Floor _).1, Option.some.injEq] at h
    have h' : (roundFloor (floatSet 1) (a + -(AzRat.toRat q : ℝ))).val = 0 := h
    rw [val_roundFloor_floatSet] at h'
    have := eq_zero_of_roundFloor_eq_zero 1 _ h'
    linarith
  · intro h
    rw [h, add_neg_cancel, EReal.coe_zero, roundVal_zero]
    rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.agmRatPrecRound_eq_or
statement:
theorem agmRatPrecRound_eq_or (q₁ q₂ : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    agmRatPrecRound q₁ q₂ p mode
        = liftVal₀ (Spec.agm (AzRat.toRat q₁ : ℝ) (AzRat.toRat q₂ : ℝ)) p mode ∨
      agmRatPrecRound q₁ q₂ p mode = (nan, .eq)
proof:
:= by
  unfold agmRatPrecRound liftVal₀
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h3
  · left
    rcases h1 with h | h
    · rw [Spec.agm_of_neg_left (EReal.coe_neg'.mpr ((azRat_lt_zero_iff q₁).mp h))]; rfl
    · rw [Spec.agm_of_neg_right _ (EReal.coe_neg'.mpr ((azRat_lt_zero_iff q₂).mp h))]; rfl
  · left
    push Not at h1
    obtain ⟨hq₁, hq₂⟩ := h1
    rw [azRat_lt_zero_iff, not_lt] at hq₁ hq₂
    rcases h2 with h | h
    · rw [(azRat_eq_zero_iff q₁).mp h, EReal.coe_zero,
        Spec.agm_zero_of_nonneg_ne_top (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hq₂) (EReal.coe_ne_top _),
        roundVal_zero]
    · rw [(azRat_eq_zero_iff q₂).mp h, EReal.coe_zero,
        Spec.agm_of_nonneg_ne_top_zero (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hq₁) (EReal.coe_ne_top _),
        roundVal_zero]
  · left
    push Not at h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hq₁, -⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨hz₁, -⟩ := h2
    rw [azRat_lt_zero_iff, not_lt] at hq₁
    have hz₁' : (AzRat.toRat q₁ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hz₁ ((azRat_eq_zero_iff q₁).mpr h)
    have ha : 0 < (AzRat.toRat q₁ : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_ne hq₁ (Ne.symm hz₁')
    rw [← h3, Spec.agm_coe_coe ha ha, AGM_self ha.le, ofAzRatRound_eq_roundVal]
  · push Not at h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hq₁, hq₂⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨hz₁, hz₂⟩ := h2
    rw [azRat_lt_zero_iff, not_lt] at hq₁ hq₂
    have hz₁' : (AzRat.toRat q₁ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hz₁ ((azRat_eq_zero_iff q₁).mpr h)
    have hz₂' : (AzRat.toRat q₂ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hz₂ ((azRat_eq_zero_iff q₂).mpr h)
    have ha : 0 < (AzRat.toRat q₁ : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_ne hq₁ (Ne.symm hz₁')
    have hb : 0 < (AzRat.toRat q₂ : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_ne hq₂ (Ne.symm hz₂')
    have hab : (AzRat.toRat q₁ : ℝ) ≠ AzRat.toRat q₂ := fun h =>
      h3 ((azRat_toRat_eq_iff q₁ q₂).mpr h)
    rcases eq_or_ne (zivLoop (agmRatApprox q₁ q₂) p mode (agmFuel p) (p + zivGuardBits))
      (nan, .eq) with hz | hz
    · right; exact hz
    · left
      rw [Spec.agm_coe_coe ha hb]
      exact zivLoop_eq_of_ne_nan p mode _ (AGM _ _) (fun w hw => by
        have : NeZero w := ⟨hw.ne'⟩
        exact agmRatApprox_spec ha hb hab w) _ _ (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega) hz

name: Azurite.AzFloat.agmFloatRatPrecRound_eq_or
statement:
theorem agmFloatRatPrecRound_eq_or (x : AzFloat) (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    agmFloatRatPrecRound x q p mode
        = roundVal p mode (x.toVal.bind fun a => Spec.agm a (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)) ∨
      agmFloatRatPrecRound x q p mode = (nan, .eq)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal) ≠ ⊤ := EReal.coe_ne_top _
  cases x with
  | nan => left; simp [agmFloatRatPrecRound, isNaN]
  | infinity s =>
    left
    cases s with
    | false =>
      simp [agmFloatRatPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, Spec.agm_of_neg_left EReal.bot_lt_zero]
    | true =>
      by_cases hneg : q < 0
      · have h := EReal.coe_neg'.mpr ((azRat_lt_zero_iff q).mp hneg)
        simp [agmFloatRatPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, hneg, Spec.agm_of_neg_right _ h]
      · by_cases hz : q = 0
        · subst hz
          simp [agmFloatRatPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, isInfinite, hneg, Spec.agm_top_zero]
        · have hpos : (0 : EReal) < ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal) := by
            rw [azRat_lt_zero_iff, not_lt] at hneg
            rw [azRat_eq_zero_iff] at hz
            exact EReal.coe_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne hneg (Ne.symm hz))
          simp [agmFloatRatPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, isZero, isInfinite, hneg, hz,
            Spec.agm_top_of_pos hpos]
  | zero =>
    left
    by_cases hneg : q < 0
    · have h := EReal.coe_neg'.mpr ((azRat_lt_zero_iff q).mp hneg)
      simp [agmFloatRatPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, hneg, Spec.agm_of_neg_right _ h]
    · have hq : (0 : EReal) ≤ ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal) := by
        rw [azRat_lt_zero_iff, not_lt] at hneg
        exact EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hneg
      by_cases hz : q = 0
      · subst hz
        simp [agmFloatRatPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, isInfinite, hneg,
          Spec.agm_zero_of_nonneg_ne_top le_rfl EReal.zero_ne_top]
      · simp [agmFloatRatPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, isZero, hneg, hz,
          Spec.agm_zero_of_nonneg_ne_top hq hq0]
  | finite s e q' m hv =>
    cases s with
    | false =>
      left
      simp [agmFloatRatPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative,
        Spec.agm_of_neg_left (finiteVal_false_neg_ereal e hv)]
    | true =>
      set X := finite true e q' m hv with hX
      have hx : X.toVal = some ((finiteVal true e m : ℝ) : EReal) := rfl
      have ha := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
      by_cases hneg : q < 0
      · left
        have h := EReal.coe_neg'.mpr ((azRat_lt_zero_iff q).mp hneg)
        simp [agmFloatRatPrecRound, hX, isNaN, isNegative, hneg, Spec.agm_of_neg_right _ h]
      · have hq : 0 ≤ (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) := by rwa [azRat_lt_zero_iff, not_lt] at hneg
        by_cases hz : q = 0
        · left
          subst hz
          simp [agmFloatRatPrecRound, hX, isNaN, isNegative, isInfinite, hneg,
            Spec.agm_of_nonneg_ne_top_zero (finiteVal_true_pos_ereal e hv).le (EReal.coe_ne_top _)]
        · have hb : 0 < (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) := by
            rw [azRat_eq_zero_iff] at hz
            exact lt_of_le_of_ne hq (Ne.symm hz)
          have hred : agmFloatRatPrecRound X q p mode
              = if (subRatPrecRound X q 1 .Floor).1.isZero then setPrecRound X p mode
                else zivLoop (agmFloatRatApprox X q) p mode (agmFuel p) (p + zivGuardBits) := by
            simp [agmFloatRatPrecRound, hX, isNaN, isNegative, isZero, isInfinite, hneg, hz]
          rw [hred, hx, Option.bind_some, Spec.agm_coe_coe ha hb]
          by_cases heq : (subRatPrecRound X q 1 .Floor).1.isZero = true
          · left
            simp only [heq, ↓reduceIte]
            have hab := (subRat_isZero_iff hx q).mp heq
            rw [← hab, AGM_self ha.le]
            exact setPrecRound_eq_roundVal hx p mode
          · simp only [heq]
            have hab : finiteVal true e m ≠ AzRat.toRat q := fun h =>
              heq ((subRat_isZero_iff hx q).mpr h)
            rcases eq_or_ne (zivLoop (agmFloatRatApprox X q) p mode (agmFuel p) (p + zivGuardBits))
              (nan, .eq) with hzv | hzv
            · right; exact hzv
            · left
              exact zivLoop_eq_of_ne_nan p mode _ (AGM _ _) (fun w hw => by
                have : NeZero w := ⟨hw.ne'⟩
                exact agmFloatRatApprox_spec hx ha hb hab w) _ _ (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega) hzv

name: Azurite.AzFloat.agmPrecRound_eq_or
statement:
theorem agmPrecRound_eq_or (x y : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    agmPrecRound x y p mode = liftVal₂ Spec.agm x y p mode ∨
      agmPrecRound x y p mode = (nan, .eq)
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nan => left; simp [agmPrecRound, isNaN, liftVal₂]
  | infinity s =>
    cases y with
    | nan => left; simp [agmPrecRound, isNaN, liftVal₂]
    | infinity t =>
      left
      cases s <;> cases t <;>
        simp [agmPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, isZero, isInfinite, liftVal₂, Spec.agm_top_of_pos,
          Spec.agm_of_neg_left, Spec.agm_of_neg_right, EReal.bot_lt_zero, EReal.zero_lt_top]
    | zero =>
      left
      cases s <;> simp [agmPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, isZero, isInfinite, liftVal₂,
        Spec.agm_top_zero, Spec.agm_of_neg_left, EReal.bot_lt_zero]
    | finite t e q m hv =>
      left
      cases s <;> cases t <;>
        simp [agmPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, isZero, isInfinite, liftVal₂,
          Spec.agm_top_of_pos (finiteVal_true_pos_ereal e hv), Spec.agm_of_neg_left,
          Spec.agm_of_neg_right, EReal.bot_lt_zero, finiteVal_false_neg_ereal e hv]
  | zero =>
    cases y with
    | nan => left; simp [agmPrecRound, isNaN, liftVal₂]
    | infinity t =>
      left
      cases t <;> simp [agmPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, isZero, isInfinite, liftVal₂,
        Spec.agm_zero_top, Spec.agm_of_neg_right, EReal.bot_lt_zero]
    | zero =>
      left
      simp [agmPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, isZero, isInfinite, liftVal₂,
        Spec.agm_zero_of_nonneg_ne_top le_rfl EReal.zero_ne_top]
    | finite t e q m hv =>
      left
      cases t <;> simp [agmPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, isZero, isInfinite, liftVal₂,
        Spec.agm_of_neg_right, finiteVal_false_neg_ereal e hv,
        Spec.agm_zero_of_nonneg_ne_top (finiteVal_true_pos_ereal e hv).le (EReal.coe_ne_top _)]
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    cases y with
    | nan => left; simp [agmPrecRound, isNaN, liftVal₂]
    | infinity t =>
      left
      cases s <;> cases t <;>
        simp [agmPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, isZero, isInfinite, liftVal₂,
          Spec.agm_of_pos_top (finiteVal_true_pos_ereal e hv), Spec.agm_of_neg_left,
          Spec.agm_of_neg_right, EReal.bot_lt_zero, finiteVal_false_neg_ereal e hv]
    | zero =>
      left
      cases s <;> simp [agmPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, isZero, isInfinite, liftVal₂,
        Spec.agm_of_neg_left, finiteVal_false_neg_ereal e hv,
        Spec.agm_of_nonneg_ne_top_zero (finiteVal_true_pos_ereal e hv).le (EReal.coe_ne_top _)]
    | finite t e' q' m' hv' =>
      cases s with
      | false =>
        left
        simp [agmPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, liftVal₂, Spec.agm_of_neg_left,
          finiteVal_false_neg_ereal e hv]
      | true =>
        cases t with
        | false =>
          left
          simp [agmPrecRound, isNaN, isNegative, liftVal₂, Spec.agm_of_neg_right,
            finiteVal_false_neg_ereal e' hv']
        | true =>
          set X := finite true e q m hv with hX
          set Y := finite true e' q' m' hv' with hY
          have hx : X.toVal = some ((finiteVal true e m : ℝ) : EReal) := rfl
          have hy : Y.toVal = some ((finiteVal true e' m' : ℝ) : EReal) := rfl
          have ha := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
          have hb := finiteVal_true_pos e' hv'
          have hred : agmPrecRound X Y p mode
              = if eqIEEE X Y then setPrecRound X p mode
                else zivLoop (agmApprox X Y) p mode (agmFuel p) (p + zivGuardBits) := by
            simp [agmPrecRound, hX, hY, isNaN, isNegative, isZero, isInfinite]
          rw [hred, liftVal₂, hx, hy, Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some, Spec.agm_coe_coe ha hb]
          by_cases heq : eqIEEE X Y = true
          · left
            simp only [heq, ↓reduceIte]
            obtain ⟨v, hXv, hYv⟩ := (eqIEEE_iff X Y).mp heq
            rw [hx] at hXv
            rw [hy] at hYv
            have hab : finiteVal true e' m' = finiteVal true e m :=
              EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp (Option.some_injective _ (hYv.trans hXv.symm))
            rw [hab, AGM_self ha.le]
            exact setPrecRound_eq_roundVal hx p mode
          · simp only [heq]
            have hab : finiteVal true e m ≠ finiteVal true e' m' := fun h =>
              heq ((eqIEEE_iff X Y).mpr ⟨_, hx, by rw [hy, h]⟩)
            rcases eq_or_ne (zivLoop (agmApprox X Y) p mode (agmFuel p) (p + zivGuardBits))
              (nan, .eq) with hz | hz
            · right; exact hz
            · left
              exact zivLoop_eq_of_ne_nan p mode _ (AGM _ _) (fun w hw => by
                have : NeZero w := ⟨hw.ne'⟩
                exact agmApprox_spec hx hy ha hb hab w) _ _ (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega) hz

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toNat_ten
statement: theorem toNat_ten : (10 : UInt64).toNat = 10
proof: := by decide

theorem log10PrecRound_eq_liftVal (x : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :

statement:

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_fst_roundVal
statement:
theorem toVal_fst_roundVal (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (w : Option EReal)
    (h : ∀ r : ℝ, w = some (r : EReal) → ((r : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ floatSet p) :
    (roundVal p mode w).1.toVal = w
proof:
:= by
  cases w with
  | none => rfl
  | some e =>
    induction e using EReal.rec with
    | bot => rw [roundVal_of_toVal p mode (infinity false) ⊥ (Or.inr rfl) rfl]; rfl
    | coe r => exact (roundVal_of_mem p mode r (h r rfl)).1
    | top => rw [roundVal_of_toVal p mode (infinity true) ⊤ (Or.inr rfl) rfl]; rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.zero_mem_floatSet
statement: theorem zero_mem_floatSet (p : ℕ) : (((0 : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ floatSet p
proof:
:=
  ⟨zero, Or.inr rfl, rfl⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.exactProductPrec_pos
statement: theorem exactProductPrec_pos (y z : AzFloat) : 0 < exactProductPrec y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold exactProductPrec
  rcases y with _ | _ | _ | ⟨_, _, p₁, _, h₁⟩ <;>
    rcases z with _ | _ | _ | ⟨_, _, p₂, _, h₂⟩ <;>
    simp only [precision?, Option.getD_some, Option.getD_none]
  all_goals
    first
    | omega
    | exact Nat.add_pos_left h₁.pos _

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_exactMul
statement:
theorem toVal_exactMul (y z : AzFloat) :
    (exactMul y z).toVal = y.toVal.bind fun b => z.toVal.bind fun c => Spec.mul b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold exactMul
  have : NeZero (exactProductPrec y z) := ⟨(exactProductPrec_pos y z).ne'⟩
  rw [mulPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂]
  unfold liftVal₂
  apply toVal_fst_roundVal
  intro r hr
  cases y with
  | nan => simp at hr
  | infinity s =>
    cases z with
    | nan => simp at hr
    | infinity t =>
      cases s <;> cases t <;> simp [Spec.mul, EReal.top_ne_zero, EReal.bot_ne_zero] at hr
    | zero => simp [Spec.mul] at hr
    | finite t e q m hv =>
      simp only [toVal_infinity, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some] at hr
      rw [Spec.mul_inf_coe s _ (finiteVal_ne_zero_of_valid t e hv)] at hr
      split_ifs at hr <;> simp at hr
  | zero =>
    cases z with
    | nan => simp at hr
    | infinity t => simp [Spec.mul] at hr
    | zero =>
      simp [Spec.mul, EReal.zero_ne_top, EReal.zero_ne_bot] at hr
      obtain rfl : r = 0 := by
        first | exact hr | exact hr.symm | exact EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp hr.symm
      exact zero_mem_floatSet _
    | finite t e q m hv =>
      simp [Spec.mul, EReal.zero_ne_top, EReal.zero_ne_bot] at hr
      obtain rfl : r = 0 := by
        first | exact hr | exact hr.symm | exact EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp hr.symm
      exact zero_mem_floatSet _
  | finite s e₁ p₁ m₁ h₁ =>
    cases z with
    | nan => simp at hr
    | infinity t =>
      simp only [toVal_infinity, toVal_finite, Option.bind_some] at hr
      rw [Spec.mul_coe_inf _ (finiteVal_ne_zero_of_valid s e₁ h₁) t] at hr
      split_ifs at hr <;> simp at hr
    | zero =>
      simp [Spec.mul, EReal.zero_ne_top, EReal.zero_ne_bot] at hr
      obtain rfl : r = 0 := by
        first | exact hr | exact hr.symm | exact EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp hr.symm
      exact zero_mem_floatSet _
    | finite t e₂ p₂ m₂ h₂ =>
      simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some, Spec.mul_coe_coe, Option.some.injEq,
        EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at hr
      rw [← hr]
      have hq : exactProductPrec (finite s e₁ p₁ m₁ h₁) (finite t e₂ p₂ m₂ h₂)
          = p₁ + p₂ := rfl
      rw [hq]
      have : NeZero (p₁ + p₂) := ⟨by have := h₁.pos; omega⟩
      obtain ⟨k₁, hk₁, hk₁b⟩ := finiteVal_eq_int_mul_prec s e₁ h₁
      obtain ⟨k₂, hk₂, hk₂b⟩ := finiteVal_eq_int_mul_prec t e₂ h₂
      have hprod : finiteVal s e₁ m₁ * finiteVal t e₂ m₂
          = ((k₁ * k₂ : ℤ) : ℝ)
            * (2 : ℝ) ^ (e₁.toInt - p₁ + (e₂.toInt - p₂)) := by
        rw [hk₁, hk₂, zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]; push_cast; ring
      rw [hprod]
      apply mem_floatSet_mul_zpow
      rw [abs_mul, pow_add]
      exact (mul_le_mul hk₁b.le hk₂b.le (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity))

name: Azurite.AzFloat.addMulPrecRound_eq_liftVal₃
statement:
theorem addMulPrecRound_eq_liftVal₃ (x y z : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    addMulPrecRound x y z p mode = liftVal₃ Spec.addMul x y z p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold addMulPrecRound liftVal₃
  rw [addPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂]
  unfold liftVal₂
  simp only [toVal_exactMul, Option.bind_assoc, Spec.addMul]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.subMulPrecRound_eq_liftVal₃
statement:
theorem subMulPrecRound_eq_liftVal₃ (x y z : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    subMulPrecRound x y z p mode = liftVal₃ Spec.subMul x y z p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold subMulPrecRound liftVal₃
  rw [subPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂]
  unfold liftVal₂
  simp only [toVal_exactMul, Option.bind_assoc, Spec.subMul]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_addMulFloat64
statement:
theorem toVal_addMulFloat64 (x y z : Float) :
    (addMulFloat64 x y z).toModel.unpack.toVal
      = roundBinary64Val (x.toModel.unpack.toVal.bind fun a =>
          y.toModel.unpack.toVal.bind fun b => z.toModel.unpack.toVal.bind fun c =>
            Spec.addMul a b c)
proof:
:=
  toVal_emulate₃ addMulPrecRound Spec.addMul
    (fun x y z => addMulPrecRound_eq_liftVal₃ x y z 53 .Nearest) x y z

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_subMulFloat64
statement:
theorem toVal_subMulFloat64 (x y z : Float) :

    (fun x y z => subMulPrecRound_eq_liftVal₃ x y z 53 .Nearest) x y z

name: Azurite.AzFloat.shiftLeft_nan
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftLeft_nan (k : AzInt) : shiftLeft nan k = nan
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.shiftLeft_infinity
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftLeft_infinity (s : Bool) (k : AzInt) : shiftLeft (infinity s) k = infinity s
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.shiftLeft_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftLeft_zero (k : AzInt) : shiftLeft zero k = zero
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.shiftLeft_finite
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftLeft_finite (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (p : ℕ) (m : AzNat)
    (h : FiniteValid p m) (k : AzInt) :
    shiftLeft (finite s e p m h) k = finite s (e + k) p m h
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.precision?_shiftLeft
statement:
theorem precision?_shiftLeft (x : AzFloat) (k : AzInt) :
    (shiftLeft x k).precision? = x.precision?
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_add
statement:
theorem finiteVal_add (s : Bool) (e k : AzInt) (m : AzNat) :
    finiteVal s (e + k) m = finiteVal s e m * (2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteVal
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt + k.toInt - m.size) = 2 ^ (e.toInt - m.size) * 2 ^ k.toInt := by
    rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]; congr 1; ring
  rw [AzInt.toInt_add, h2]
  ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_shiftLeft
statement:
theorem toVal_shiftLeft (x : AzFloat) (k : AzInt) :
    (shiftLeft x k).toVal = x.toVal.map fun v => v * (((2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : (0 : EReal) < (((2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt : ℝ) : EReal) :=
    EReal.coe_pos.mpr (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _)
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity s =>
    cases s
    · simp only [shiftLeft_infinity, toVal_infinity, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
        Option.map_some, EReal.bot_mul_of_pos hpos]
    · simp only [shiftLeft_infinity, toVal_infinity, ↓reduceIte, Option.map_some,
        EReal.top_mul_of_pos hpos]
  | zero => simp
  | finite s e p m h =>
    simp only [shiftLeft_finite, toVal_finite, Option.map_some, finiteVal_add, EReal.coe_mul]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_shiftRight
statement:
theorem toVal_shiftRight (x : AzFloat) (k : AzInt) :
    (shiftRight x k).toVal = x.toVal.map fun v => v * (((2 : ℝ) ^ (-k.toInt) : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftRight
  rw [toVal_shiftLeft, AzInt.toInt_neg]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.shiftLeft_eq_liftE
statement:
theorem shiftLeft_eq_liftE (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (x : AzFloat) (k : AzInt)
    (hx : x.precision? = some p ∨ x.precision? = none) :
    liftE (fun v => v * (((2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt : ℝ) : EReal)) x p mode = (shiftLeft x k, .eq)
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : (shiftLeft x k).precision? = some p ∨ (shiftLeft x k).precision? = none := by
    rwa [precision?_shiftLeft]
  have h : x.toVal.bind (fun v => some (v * (((2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt : ℝ) : EReal)))
      = (shiftLeft x k).toVal := by
    rw [toVal_shiftLeft]
    cases x.toVal <;> rfl
  unfold liftE liftVal
  rw [h]
  cases hv : (shiftLeft x k).toVal with
  | none =>
    cases x <;> simp at hv
    rfl
  | some v => exact roundVal_of_toVal p mode _ v hx' hv

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log_abs_mul_two_zpow
statement:
theorem log_abs_mul_two_zpow (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (k : ℤ) :
    Int.log 2 |r * 2 ^ k| = Int.log 2 |r| + k
proof:
:= by
  have h2k : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ k := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  have habs : |r * 2 ^ k| = |r| * 2 ^ k := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos h2k]
  have hpos : 0 < |r| := abs_pos.mpr hr
  have hpos' : 0 < |r * 2 ^ k| := by rw [habs]; positivity
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Int.lt_add_one_iff.mp
    apply (Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt (b := 2) (by norm_num) hpos').mp
    push_cast
    rw [habs, show Int.log 2 |r| + k + 1 = (Int.log 2 |r| + 1) + k by ring,
      zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (Int.lt_zpow_succ_log_self (by norm_num) |r|) h2k
  · apply (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log (b := 2) (by norm_num) hpos').mp
    push_cast
    rw [habs, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Int.zpow_log_le_self (by norm_num) hpos) h2k.le

name: Azurite.AzFloat.val_round_mul_two_zpow
statement:
theorem val_round_mul_two_zpow (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (r : ℝ) (k : ℤ) :
    (RoundingTarget.round (floatSet p) mode (r * 2 ^ k)).val
      = (RoundingTarget.round (floatSet p) mode r).val * (((2 : ℝ) ^ k : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [val_round_floatSet, val_round_floatSet]
  have h2k : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ k := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  rcases eq_or_ne r 0 with rfl | hr
  · rw [zero_mul, RoundingTarget.val_round_of_mem _ mode (Or.inl (by simp))]
    simp
  · rw [RoundingTarget.val_round_precisionSet mode _ (mul_ne_zero hr h2k.ne'),
      RoundingTarget.val_round_precisionSet mode r hr]
    have hu : RoundingTarget.precScale 2 p (r * 2 ^ k)
        = RoundingTarget.precScale 2 p r * 2 ^ k := by
      unfold RoundingTarget.precScale
      rw [log_abs_mul_two_zpow r hr k]
      push_cast
      rw [show Int.log 2 |r| + k - p + 1 = (Int.log 2 |r| - p + 1) + k by ring,
        zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
    rw [hu, mul_div_mul_right _ _ h2k.ne', ← EReal.coe_mul]
    congr 1
    ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_mul_two_zpow
statement:
theorem roundVal_mul_two_zpow (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (r : ℝ) (k : AzInt) :
    roundVal p mode (some ((r * 2 ^ k.toInt : ℝ) : EReal))
      = ((roundVal p mode (some (r : EReal))).1 <<< k, (roundVal p mode (some (r : EReal))).2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := roundVal_coe p mode (r * 2 ^ k.toInt)
  obtain ⟨h1', h2'⟩ := roundVal_coe p mode r
  have h2k : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ k.toInt := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, ((R : ℝ) : EReal) = (RoundingTarget.round (floatSet p) mode r).val := by
    rw [val_round_floatSet]
    exact RoundingTarget.precisionSet_exists_real _
  refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
  · apply toVal_injective p
    · rw [fst_roundVal]; exact (ofEReal_spec p mode _).1
    · show (shiftLeft _ k).precision? = some p ∨ (shiftLeft _ k).precision? = none
      rw [precision?_shiftLeft, fst_roundVal]
      exact (ofEReal_spec p mode _).1
    · show toVal _ = toVal (shiftLeft _ k)
      rw [toVal_shiftLeft, h1, h1', Option.map_some, val_round_mul_two_zpow]
  · show (roundVal p mode (some ((r * 2 ^ k.toInt : ℝ) : EReal))).2 = _
    rw [h2, h2', val_round_mul_two_zpow, ← hR, ← EReal.coe_mul, compare_coe_coe, compare_coe_coe,
      compare_mul_right_pos _ _ _ h2k]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundFromFloor_normalizeCarry_eq
statement:
theorem roundFromFloor_normalizeCarry_eq (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (y : ℝ)
    (s : AzNat) (exact : Bool) (cmpMid : Ordering) (E : AzInt)
    (hylo : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ y) (hyhi : y < (2 : ℝ) ^ (p : ℤ))
    (hlo : (s.toNat : ℝ) ≤ y) (hhi : y < s.toNat + 1) (hex : exact = true ↔ y = s.toNat)
    (hmid : cmpMid = compare y ((s.toNat : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) :
    (normalizeCarry (AzInt.mkNorm true (roundFromFloor s exact cmpMid mode).1) E p,
        (roundFromFloor s exact cmpMid mode).2)
      = roundVal p mode (some ((y * (2 : ℝ) ^ (E.toInt - p) : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  obtain ⟨hR, htag⟩ := roundFromFloor_spec y s exact cmpMid mode hlo hhi hex hmid
  set ro := roundFromFloor s exact cmpMid mode with hro
  clear_value ro
  set w : ℤ := E.toInt - p with hw
  have h2w : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ w := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  set v : ℝ := y * (2 : ℝ) ^ w with hv
  have hypos : 0 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _) hylo
  have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by rw [hv]; positivity
  have hvabs : |v| = y * (2 : ℝ) ^ w := by rw [hv, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
  have hvpos : 0 < |v| := by rw [hvabs]; positivity
  have hlog : Int.log 2 |v| = w + p - 1 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · have h := (Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt (b := 2) (by norm_num) hvpos).mp (by
        rw [hvabs, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num), mul_comm]
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hyhi h2w)
      omega
    · exact (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log (b := 2) (by norm_num) hvpos).mp (by
        rw [hvabs, show w + p - 1 = ((p : ℤ) - 1) + w by ring, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hylo h2w.le)
  have hscale : precScale 2 p v = (2 : ℝ) ^ w := by
    unfold precScale
    rw [hlog]
    push_cast
    congr 1
    ring
  have hyv : v / (2 : ℝ) ^ w = y := by rw [hv, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ h2w.ne']
  have hround : (round (floatSet p) mode v).val
      = ((((AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).toInt : ℝ) * 2 ^ w : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [val_round_floatSet, val_round_precisionSet mode v hv0, hscale, hyv, hR,
      AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true]
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := abs_toInt_round_bounds p hp mode y (by rw [abs_of_pos hypos]; exact hylo)
    (by rw [abs_of_pos hypos]; exact hyhi)
  rw [hR] at hb1 hb2
  have habsR : ((AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat : ℤ) = |(ro.1.toNat : ℤ)| := by
    rw [AzInt.abs_toNat_eq, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true]
  have hlo' : 2 ^ (p - 1) ≤ (AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat := by
    have : ((2 ^ (p - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ ((AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat : ℤ) := by
      rw [habsR]; exact hb1
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hhi' : (AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ p := by
    have : ((AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1).abs.toNat : ℤ) ≤ ((2 ^ p : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      rw [habsR]; exact hb2
    exact_mod_cast this
  obtain ⟨hRval, hRprec⟩ := normalizeCarry_spec (AzInt.mkNorm true ro.1) p hp E hlo' hhi'
  rw [← hw] at hRval
  symm
  refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
  · exact toVal_injective p (ofEReal_spec p mode v).1 (Or.inl hRprec)
      (by rw [fst_roundVal, ofVal_some, (ofEReal_spec p mode v).2, hround, hRval])
  · show (roundVal p mode (some (v : EReal))).2 = ro.2
    rw [(roundVal_coe p mode v).2, hround, compare_coe_coe, htag, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true,
      Int.cast_natCast, hv, compare_mul_right_pos _ _ _ h2w]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.floorLog2_bounds
statement:
theorem floorLog2_bounds (n d : AzNat) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n.size : ℤ) - d.size - if AzNat.normalizedCompare n d == .lt then 1 else 0)
        ≤ (n.toNat : ℝ) / d.toNat ∧
      (n.toNat : ℝ) / d.toNat
        < (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n.size : ℤ) - d.size - (if AzNat.normalizedCompare n d == .lt then 1 else 0)
          + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hn1, hn2⟩ := toNat_bounds_of_ne_zero n hn
  obtain ⟨hd1, hd2⟩ := toNat_bounds_of_ne_zero d hd
  have hns : 1 ≤ n.size := size_pos_of_ne_zero hn
  have hds : 1 ≤ d.size := size_pos_of_ne_zero hd
  have hn0 : 0 < n.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hn)
  have hd0 : 0 < d.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hd)
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hd0
  have hcross := AzNat.normalizedCompare_eq_cross n d hn0 hd0
  
  have hn1R : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n.size : ℤ) - 1) ≤ n.toNat := by
    rw [show (n.size : ℤ) - 1 = ((n.size - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega, zpow_natCast]; exact_mod_cast hn1
  have hn2R : (n.toNat : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (n.size : ℤ) := by rw [zpow_natCast]; exact_mod_cast hn2
  have hd1R : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((d.size : ℤ) - 1) ≤ d.toNat := by
    rw [show (d.size : ℤ) - 1 = ((d.size - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega, zpow_natCast]; exact_mod_cast hd1
  have hd2R : (d.toNat : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (d.size : ℤ) := by rw [zpow_natCast]; exact_mod_cast hd2
  have h2 : ∀ a b : ℤ, (2 : ℝ) ^ (a - b) = 2 ^ a / 2 ^ b := fun a b => zpow_sub₀ (by norm_num) a b
  by_cases hlt : AzNat.normalizedCompare n d == .lt
  · rw [ite_eq_left hlt]
    have h : n.toNat * 2 ^ d.size < d.toNat * 2 ^ n.size := by
      rw [hcross, beq_iff_eq, compare_lt_iff_lt] at hlt; exact hlt
    have hR : (n.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ (d.size : ℤ) < d.toNat * 2 ^ (n.size : ℤ) := by
      rw [zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]; exact_mod_cast h
    constructor
    · rw [le_div_iff₀ hdR, show (n.size : ℤ) - d.size - 1 = ((n.size : ℤ) - 1) - d.size by ring,
        h2]
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n.size : ℤ) - 1) / 2 ^ (d.size : ℤ) * d.toNat
          ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n.size : ℤ) - 1) / 2 ^ (d.size : ℤ) * 2 ^ (d.size : ℤ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd2R.le (by positivity)
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n.size : ℤ) - 1) := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by positivity)
        _ ≤ n.toNat := hn1R
    · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hdR, show (n.size : ℤ) - d.size - 1 + 1 = (n.size : ℤ) - d.size by ring, h2,
        div_mul_eq_mul_div, lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      linarith
  · rw [ite_eq_right hlt]
    have h : d.toNat * 2 ^ n.size ≤ n.toNat * 2 ^ d.size := by
      rw [hcross, beq_iff_eq] at hlt
      exact not_lt.mp (fun h => hlt (compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h))
    have hR : (d.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ (n.size : ℤ) ≤ n.toNat * 2 ^ (d.size : ℤ) := by
      rw [zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]; exact_mod_cast h
    constructor
    · rw [sub_zero, le_div_iff₀ hdR, h2, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      linarith
    · rw [sub_zero, div_lt_iff₀ hdR,
        show (n.size : ℤ) - d.size + 1 = (n.size : ℤ) - ((d.size : ℤ) - 1) by ring, h2]
      calc (n.toNat : ℝ) < 2 ^ (n.size : ℤ) := hn2R
        _ = 2 ^ (n.size : ℤ) / 2 ^ ((d.size : ℤ) - 1) * 2 ^ ((d.size : ℤ) - 1) :=
            (div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by positivity)).symm
        _ ≤ 2 ^ (n.size : ℤ) / 2 ^ ((d.size : ℤ) - 1) * d.toNat :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd1R (by positivity)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sqrtRatCore_eq
statement:
theorem sqrtRatCore_eq (n d : AzNat) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    sqrtRatCore n d p mode
      = roundVal p mode (some ((Real.sqrt ((n.toNat : ℝ) / d.toNat) : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : 0 < d.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hd)
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hd0
  have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n.toNat := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hn)
  set x : ℝ := (n.toNat : ℝ) / d.toNat with hx
  have hxpos : 0 < x := by rw [hx]; exact div_pos hnR hdR
  unfold sqrtRatCore
  simp only []
  
  obtain ⟨hxlo, hxhi⟩ := floorLog2_bounds n d hn hd
  rw [← hx] at hxlo hxhi
  set e : AzInt := if AzNat.normalizedCompare n d == .lt then
      (AzNat.ofNat n.size).toAzInt - (AzNat.ofNat d.size).toAzInt - (AzNat.ofNat 1).toAzInt
    else (AzNat.ofNat n.size).toAzInt - (AzNat.ofNat d.size).toAzInt with he_def
  have heI : e.toInt
      = (n.size : ℤ) - d.size - if AzNat.normalizedCompare n d == .lt then 1 else 0 := by
    rw [he_def]
    split_ifs <;> simp only [AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat] <;> push_cast <;>
      ring
  rw [← heI] at hxlo hxhi
  clear_value e
  
  set h₁ : AzInt := e.shiftRight 1 + (AzNat.ofNat 1).toAzInt with hh₁_def
  have hh : 2 * h₁.toInt - 2 ≤ e.toInt ∧ e.toInt < 2 * h₁.toInt := by
    rw [hh₁_def, AzInt.toInt_add, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzInt.toInt_shiftRight_one]
    push_cast
    omega
  clear_value h₁
  
  set k : AzInt := (AzNat.ofNat p).toAzInt - h₁ with hk_def
  have hkI : k.toInt = p - h₁.toInt := by
    rw [hk_def, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
  clear_value k
  have habs : (k.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |k.toInt| := AzInt.abs_toNat_eq k
  
  set Mr : ℝ := x * (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * k.toInt) with hMr
  have hMr0 : 0 < Mr := by positivity
  set A := if k.sign then n.shiftLeft (2 * k.abs.toNat) else n with hA_def
  set D := if k.sign then d else d.shiftLeft (2 * k.abs.toNat) with hD_def
  have hD0 : 0 < D.toNat := by
    rw [hD_def]; split_ifs
    · exact hd0
    · rw [AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft]; positivity
  have hDR : (0 : ℝ) < D.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hD0
  have hAD : (A.toNat : ℝ) / D.toNat = Mr := by
    rw [hMr, hx, hA_def, hD_def]
    by_cases hsg : k.sign = true
    · have hg0 : 0 ≤ k.toInt := (AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff k).mp hsg
      rw [ite_eq_left hsg, ite_eq_left hsg, AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft]
      push_cast
      rw [← zpow_natCast, show ((2 * k.abs.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = 2 * k.toInt by
        push_cast; rw [habs, abs_of_nonneg hg0]]
      ring
    · have hg0 : k.toInt < 0 := by
        have := (AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff k).not.mp hsg; push Not at this; exact this
      rw [ite_eq_right hsg, ite_eq_right hsg, AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft]
      push_cast
      rw [← zpow_natCast, show ((2 * k.abs.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = -(2 * k.toInt) by
        push_cast; rw [habs, abs_of_neg hg0]; ring, zpow_neg]
      field_simp
  clear_value A D
  
  have hMlo : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (p : ℤ) - 2) ≤ Mr := by
    rw [hMr]
    calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (p : ℤ) - 2) ≤ 2 ^ e.toInt * 2 ^ (2 * k.toInt) := by
          rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
          exact zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
      _ ≤ x * 2 ^ (2 * k.toInt) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hxlo (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _).le
  have hMhi : Mr < (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (p : ℤ)) := by
    rw [hMr]
    calc x * 2 ^ (2 * k.toInt) < 2 ^ (e.toInt + 1) * 2 ^ (2 * k.toInt) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hxhi (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _)
      _ ≤ 2 ^ (2 * (p : ℤ)) := by
          rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
          exact zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  
  set s := AzNat.sqrt (A / D) with hs_def
  have hsN : s.toNat = Nat.sqrt (A.toNat / D.toNat) := by
    rw [hs_def, AzNat.toNat_sqrt, AzNat.toNat_div]
  clear_value s
  set Q := A.toNat / D.toNat with hQ
  have hQle : (Q : ℝ) ≤ Mr := by rw [← hAD, hQ]; exact Nat.cast_div_le
  have hQlt : Mr < Q + 1 := by
    rw [← hAD, div_lt_iff₀ hDR, hQ]
    have := Nat.lt_div_mul_add (a := A.toNat) hD0
    have : (A.toNat : ℝ) < (A.toNat / D.toNat : ℕ) * D.toNat + D.toNat := by exact_mod_cast this
    linarith
  set y : ℝ := Real.sqrt Mr with hy_def
  have hsq_le : Nat.sqrt Q ^ 2 ≤ Q := Nat.sqrt_le' _
  have hlt_sq : Q < (Nat.sqrt Q + 1) ^ 2 := Nat.lt_succ_sqrt' _
  have hlo : (s.toNat : ℝ) ≤ y := by
    rw [hsN, hy_def]
    exact le_trans Real.nat_sqrt_le_real_sqrt (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hQle)
  have hhi : y < s.toNat + 1 := by
    rw [hsN, hy_def]
    calc Real.sqrt Mr < Real.sqrt (Q + 1) := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt hMr0.le hQlt
      _ ≤ Nat.sqrt Q + 1 := by
          rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)]
          exact_mod_cast hlt_sq
  
  have hex : (AzNat.compareProduct (AzNat.square s) D A == .eq) = true ↔ y = s.toNat := by
    rw [beq_iff_eq, AzNat.compareProduct_eq, AzNat.toNat_square, compare_eq_iff_eq, hy_def,
      Real.sqrt_eq_iff_eq_sq hMr0.le (Nat.cast_nonneg _), ← hAD, div_eq_iff hDR.ne']
    constructor
    · intro h; exact_mod_cast h.symm
    · intro h; exact_mod_cast h.symm
  
  have hmid : (AzNat.compareProduct (AzNat.square ((s.shiftLeft 1).addUInt64 1)) D
      (A.shiftLeft 2)).swap = compare y ((s.toNat : ℝ) + 1 / 2) := by
    rw [AzNat.compareProduct_eq, AzNat.toNat_square, AzNat.toNat_addUInt64, AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft,
      AzNat.toNat_shiftLeft, UInt64.toNat_one, ← compare_natCast]
    push_cast
    have hL : ((s.toNat : ℝ) * 2 + 1) ^ 2 * D.toNat
        = ((s.toNat : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2 * (4 * D.toNat) := by
      ring
    have hR : (A.toNat : ℝ) * 4 = Mr * (4 * D.toNat) := by
      rw [← hAD]; field_simp
    rw [hL, hR, compare_mul_right_pos _ _ _ (by positivity), hy_def]
    have hmid_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (s.toNat : ℝ) + 1 / 2 := by positivity
    rcases lt_trichotomy (Real.sqrt Mr) ((s.toNat : ℝ) + 1 / 2) with h | h | h
    · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h]
      rw [Real.sqrt_lt' hmid_pos] at h
      rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h]; rfl
    · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h]
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_iff_eq_sq hMr0.le hmid_pos.le] at h
      rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h.symm]; rfl
    · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h]
      rw [Real.lt_sqrt hmid_pos.le] at h
      rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h]; rfl
  
  have hylo : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((p : ℤ) - 1) ≤ y := by
    rw [hy_def, Real.le_sqrt (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _).le hMr0.le, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
    convert hMlo using 2; push_cast; ring
  have hyhi : y < (2 : ℝ) ^ (p : ℤ) := by
    rw [hy_def, Real.sqrt_lt' (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _), ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
    convert hMhi using 2; push_cast; ring
  rw [roundFromFloor_normalizeCarry_eq p mode y s _ _ h₁ hylo hyhi hlo hhi hex hmid]
  congr 3
  
  rw [hy_def, hMr, Real.sqrt_mul hxpos.le, show (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * k.toInt) = (2 ^ k.toInt) ^ 2 by
      rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]; congr 1; push_cast; ring,
    Real.sqrt_sq (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _).le, mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num),
    show k.toInt + (h₁.toInt - p) = 0 by rw [hkI]; ring, zpow_zero, mul_one]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.sqrtRatPrecRound_eq
statement:
theorem sqrtRatPrecRound_eq (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    sqrtRatPrecRound q p mode = roundVal p mode (Spec.sqrt ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  unfold sqrtRatPrecRound
  by_cases hq : q.num = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left hq, (AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr hq, EReal.coe_zero, Spec.sqrt_zero,
      roundVal_zero]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hq]
    have hnum : (0 : ℝ) < q.num.toNat := by exact_mod_cast AzRat.num_toNat_pos q hq
    have hden : (0 : ℝ) < q.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast AzRat.den_toNat_pos q
    cases hs : q.sign
    · have hneg : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) < 0 := by
        rw [coe_toRat_eq, hs]
        simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]
        exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (neg_neg_of_pos hnum) hden
      rw [Spec.sqrt_coe_neg _ hneg, roundVal_none]; rfl
    · have hval : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) = (q.num.toNat : ℝ) / q.den.toNat := by
        rw [coe_toRat_eq, hs]; simp
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl, hval, Spec.sqrt_coe _ (div_pos hnum hden).le,
        sqrtRatCore_eq q.num q.den hq q.den_nz]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.rsqrtRatPrecRound_eq
statement:
theorem rsqrtRatPrecRound_eq (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    rsqrtRatPrecRound q p mode = roundVal p mode (Spec.rsqrt ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  unfold rsqrtRatPrecRound
  by_cases hq : q.num = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left hq, (AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr hq, EReal.coe_zero, Spec.rsqrt_zero,
      roundVal_top]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hq]
    have hnum : (0 : ℝ) < q.num.toNat := by exact_mod_cast AzRat.num_toNat_pos q hq
    have hden : (0 : ℝ) < q.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast AzRat.den_toNat_pos q
    cases hs : q.sign
    · have hneg : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) < 0 := by
        rw [coe_toRat_eq, hs]
        simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]
        exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (neg_neg_of_pos hnum) hden
      rw [Spec.rsqrt_coe_neg _ hneg, roundVal_none]; rfl
    · have hval : (AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) = (q.num.toNat : ℝ) / q.den.toNat := by
        rw [coe_toRat_eq, hs]; simp
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl, hval, Spec.rsqrt_coe _ (div_pos hnum hden), ← Real.sqrt_inv, inv_div,
        sqrtRatCore_eq q.den q.num q.den_nz hq]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.bind_product_left
statement:
theorem bind_product_left (h : EReal → EReal → Option EReal) (x y z : AzFloat) :
    ((x.toVal.bind fun a => y.toVal.bind fun b => Spec.mul a b).bind fun ab =>
        z.toVal.bind fun c => h ab c)
      = x.toVal.bind fun a => y.toVal.bind fun b => z.toVal.bind fun c =>
          (Spec.mul a b).bind fun ab => h ab c
proof:
:= by
  cases x.toVal <;> cases y.toVal <;> simp only [Option.bind_none, Option.bind_some]
  rename_i a b
  cases z.toVal <;> simp only [Option.bind_none, Option.bind_some]
  cases Spec.mul a b <;> rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.mulAddMulRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal₃
statement:
theorem mulAddMulRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal₃ (x y z : AzFloat) (w : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    mulAddMulRatPrecRound x y z w p mode
      = liftVal₃ (fun a b c => Spec.mulAddMul a b c ((AzRat.toRat w : ℝ) : EReal))
          x y z p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold mulAddMulRatPrecRound liftVal₃
  rw [addMulRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal₂]
  unfold liftVal₂
  rw [toVal_exactMul, bind_product_left]
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.mulSubMulRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal₃

theorem mulSubMulRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal₃ (x y z : AzFloat) (w : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_mulAddMulRatFloat64
statement:
theorem toVal_mulAddMulRatFloat64 (x y z : Float) (w : AzRat) :
    (mulAddMulRatFloat64 x y z w).toModel.unpack.toVal
      = roundBinary64Val (x.toModel.unpack.toVal.bind fun a =>
          y.toModel.unpack.toVal.bind fun b => z.toModel.unpack.toVal.bind fun c =>
            Spec.mulAddMul a b c ((AzRat.toRat w : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:=
  toVal_emulate₃Rat mulAddMulRatPrecRound
    (fun a b c w => Spec.mulAddMul a b c ((AzRat.toRat w : ℝ) : EReal))
    (fun x y z w => mulAddMulRatPrecRound_eq_liftVal₃ x y z w 53 .Nearest) x y z w

name: Azurite.AzFloat.fusedMulRat_eq
statement:
theorem fusedMulRat_eq (opF : AzFloat → AzFloat → ℕ → RoundingMode → AzFloat × Ordering)
    (opR : AzFloat → AzRat → ℕ → RoundingMode → AzFloat × Ordering)
    (opE : EReal → EReal → Option EReal)
    (hF : ∀ (x y : AzFloat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode),
      opF x y p mode = liftVal₂ opE x y p mode)
    (hR : ∀ (x : AzFloat) (q : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode),
      opR x q p mode = liftVal (fun a => opE a ((AzRat.toRat q : ℝ) : EReal)) x p mode)
    (x y : AzFloat) (z : AzRat) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    fusedMulRat opF opR x y z p mode
      = liftVal₂ (fun a b => (Spec.mul b ((AzRat.toRat z : ℝ) : EReal)).bind (opE a))
          x y p mode
proof:
:= by
  unfold fusedMulRat liftVal₂
  cases y with
  | nan =>
    simp only [toAzRat?, toVal_nan, Option.bind_none]
    cases x.toVal <;> rfl
  | infinity s =>
    simp only [toAzRat?, toVal_infinity, Option.bind_some]
    by_cases hz : z.num = 0
    · have hz0 : (AzRat.toRat z : ℝ) = 0 := (AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff z).mpr hz
      rw [ite_eq_left hz, hz0]
      have : Spec.mul (if s then ⊤ else ⊥) (((0 : ℝ) : ℝ) : EReal) = none := by
        cases s <;> simp [Spec.mul]
      rw [this]
      simp only [Option.bind_none]
      cases x.toVal <;> rfl
    · have hz0 : (AzRat.toRat z : ℝ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hz ((AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff z).mp h)
      rw [ite_eq_right hz, hF, liftVal₂, toVal_infinity, Spec.mul_inf_coe s _ hz0,
        ← sign_eq_decide_pos z hz]
  | zero =>
    simp only [toAzRat?, toVal_zero]
    rw [hR, liftVal]
    have h0 : ((AzRat.toRat (0 * z) : ℝ) : EReal) = ((0 : ℝ) : EReal) := by simp
    have : Spec.mul (0 : EReal) ((AzRat.toRat z : ℝ) : EReal) = some 0 := by
      rw [show (0 : EReal) = ((0 : ℝ) : EReal) by simp, Spec.mul_coe_coe, zero_mul]
    simp only [this, Option.bind_some, h0, EReal.coe_zero]
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r, (finite s e q m hv).toAzRat? = some r := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [hr]
    simp only []
    rw [hR, liftVal, toVal_of_toAzRat? _ r hr]
    simp only [Option.bind_some, Spec.mul_coe_coe, AzRat.toRat_mul, Rat.cast_mul]
