name: Azurite.AzFloat.abs_finiteVal_bounds'
statement:
theorem abs_finiteVal_bounds' (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - 1) ≤ |finiteVal s e m| ∧ |finiteVal s e m| < (2 : ℝ) ^ e.toInt
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 := toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hm
  have hlo : 2 ^ (m.size - 1) ≤ m.toNat := by
    rw [← Nat.lt_size, AzNat.size_toNat]; have := size_pos_of_ne_zero hm; omega
  have hhi : m.toNat < 2 ^ m.size := by rw [← Nat.size_le, AzNat.size_toNat]
  have hsz := size_pos_of_ne_zero hm
  have habs : |finiteVal s e m| = (m.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - m.size) := by
    unfold finiteVal
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - m.size) := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
    cases s <;> simp [abs_mul, abs_of_pos h2]
  rw [habs]
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - m.size) := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  constructor
  · have hlo' : (2 : ℝ) ^ (m.size - 1) ≤ m.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hlo
    calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - 1)
        = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((m.size - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * 2 ^ (e.toInt - m.size) := by
          rw [← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]; congr 1; rw [Nat.cast_sub hsz]; ring
      _ ≤ (m.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ (e.toInt - m.size) := by
          rw [zpow_natCast]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlo' h2.le
  · have hhi' : (m.toNat : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ m.size := by exact_mod_cast hhi
    calc (m.toNat : ℝ) * 2 ^ (e.toInt - m.size)
        < (2 : ℝ) ^ m.size * 2 ^ (e.toInt - m.size) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hhi' h2
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ e.toInt := by
          rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]; congr 1; ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log_abs_finiteVal'
statement:
theorem log_abs_finiteVal' (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    Int.log 2 |finiteVal s e m| = e.toInt - 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_finiteVal_bounds' s e m hm
  have hpos : 0 < |finiteVal s e m| := lt_of_lt_of_le (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _) hlo
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h := (Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt (b := 2) (by norm_num) hpos).mp (by simpa using hhi)
    omega
  · exact (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log (b := 2) (by norm_num) hpos).mp (by simpa using hlo)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_true_pos'
statement: theorem finiteVal_true_pos' (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) (hm : m ≠ 0) : 0 < finiteVal true e m
proof:
:=
  (finiteVal_pos_iff true e m hm).mpr rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_ne_zero'
statement:
theorem finiteVal_ne_zero' (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    finiteVal s e m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := (abs_finiteVal_bounds' s e m hm).1
  rw [h, abs_zero] at this
  exact absurd this (not_le.mpr (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _))

name: Azurite.AzFloat.precScale_finiteVal'
statement:
theorem precScale_finiteVal' (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) (hm : m ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) :
    precScale 2 p (finiteVal s e m) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold precScale
  rw [log_abs_finiteVal' s e m hm]
  push_cast
  congr 1
  ring

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_scaled
statement:
theorem finiteVal_scaled (s : Bool) (S : AzNat) (w : AzInt) :
    finiteVal s (w + (AzNat.ofNat S.size).toAzInt) S
      = (if s then 1 else -1) * (S.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ w.toInt
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteVal
  rw [AzInt.toInt_add, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundScaled_eq_roundVal
statement:
theorem roundScaled_eq_roundVal (s : Bool) (S : AzNat) (w : AzInt) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    roundScaled s S w p mode
      = roundVal p mode (some (((if s then 1 else -1) * (S.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ w.toInt : ℝ)
          : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  unfold roundScaled
  rw [ite_eq_right hp.ne']
  by_cases hS : S = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left hS, hS]
    simp only [AzNat.toNat_zero, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, EReal.coe_zero]
    exact (roundVal_of_toVal p mode zero 0 (Or.inr rfl) rfl).symm
  · rw [ite_eq_right hS]
    simp only []
    set ex := w + (AzNat.ofNat S.size).toAzInt with hex
    have hval : finiteVal s ex S = (if s then 1 else -1) * (S.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ w.toInt :=
      finiteVal_scaled s S w
    rw [← hval]
    by_cases hle : S.size ≤ p
    · rw [ite_eq_left hle]
      symm
      refine roundVal_of_toVal p mode _ _ (Or.inl (precision?_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hS hle)) ?_
      rw [toVal_mkFinite _ _ _ _ hS]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hle]
      have hlt : p < S.size := not_le.mp hle
      have hexI : ex.toInt = w.toInt + S.size := by
        show (w + (AzNat.ofNat S.size).toAzInt).toInt = _
        rw [AzInt.toInt_add, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
      have hv0 : finiteVal s ex S ≠ 0 := finiteVal_ne_zero' s ex S hS
      have hscale : precScale 2 p (finiteVal s ex S) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (ex.toInt - p) :=
        precScale_finiteVal' s ex S hS p
      have hz : ((AzInt.mkNorm s S).toInt : ℝ) = (if s then 1 else -1) * (S.toNat : ℝ) := by
        rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true s with hs | hs <;>
          simp [hs, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_false S hS]
      have hvu : finiteVal s ex S / (2 : ℝ) ^ (ex.toInt - p)
          = ((AzInt.mkNorm s S).toInt : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (S.size - p) := by
        rw [hval, hz, hexI]
        have h : (2 : ℝ) ^ w.toInt / 2 ^ (w.toInt + S.size - p) = 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ (S.size - p) := by
          rw [div_eq_div_iff (zpow_ne_zero _ two_ne_zero) (pow_ne_zero _ two_ne_zero), one_mul,
            ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ two_ne_zero]
          congr 1
          rw [Nat.cast_sub hlt.le]
          ring
        rw [mul_div_assoc, h]
        ring
      set v := finiteVal s ex S with hv_def
      set u : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (ex.toInt - p) with hu_def
      have hu : 0 < u := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
      set r := AzInt.shiftRightRound (AzInt.mkNorm s S) mode (S.size - p) with hr_def
      have hr := AzInt.toInt_shiftRightRound (AzInt.mkNorm s S) mode (S.size - p)
      rw [← hvu, ← hr_def] at hr
      have hrI : toInt (round intSet mode (v / u)) = r.1.toInt := toInt_eq_of_val hr
      have hround : (round (floatSet p) mode v).val = (((r.1.toInt : ℝ) * u : ℝ) : EReal) := by
        rw [val_round_floatSet, val_round_precisionSet mode v hv0, hscale, hrI]
      obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_div_precScale_bounds (b := 2) (p := p) v hv0
      rw [hscale] at hlo hhi
      obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := abs_toInt_round_bounds p hp mode (v / u) (by simpa using hlo)
        (by simpa using hhi)
      rw [hrI] at hb1 hb2
      have habs : (r.1.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |r.1.toInt| := by
        unfold AzInt.toInt; cases r.1.sign <;> simp
      have hlo' : 2 ^ (p - 1) ≤ r.1.abs.toNat := by
        have : ((2 ^ (p - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (r.1.abs.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [habs]; exact hb1
        exact_mod_cast this
      have hhi' : r.1.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ p := by
        have : (r.1.abs.toNat : ℤ) ≤ ((2 ^ p : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [habs]; exact hb2
        exact_mod_cast this
      obtain ⟨hRval, hRprec⟩ := normalize_spec r.1 p hp ex hlo' hhi'
      have hR : (if r.1.abs.size = p + 1 then
            (mkFinite r.1.sign (ex + 1) p (r.1.abs.shiftRight 1), r.2)
          else (mkFinite r.1.sign ex p r.1.abs, r.2))
          = ((if r.1.abs.size = p + 1 then mkFinite r.1.sign (ex + 1) p (r.1.abs.shiftRight 1)
            else mkFinite r.1.sign ex p r.1.abs), r.2) := by
        split_ifs <;> rfl
      rw [hR]
      symm
      refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
      · exact toVal_injective p (ofEReal_spec p mode v).1 (Or.inl hRprec)
          (by rw [fst_roundVal, ofVal_some, (ofEReal_spec p mode v).2, hround, hRval])
      · show (roundVal p mode (some (v : EReal))).2 = r.2
        rw [(roundVal_coe p mode v).2, hround, compare_coe_coe, hr_def,
          AzInt.snd_shiftRightRound, ← hr_def, ← hvu]
        conv_rhs => rw [← compare_mul_right_pos _ _ u hu, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hu.ne']

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toInt_round_intSet_congr
statement:
theorem toInt_round_intSet_congr (mode : RoundingMode) (m : ℤ) (y y' : ℝ)
    (hy : (m : ℝ) / 2 < y ∧ y < ((m : ℝ) + 1) / 2)
    (hy' : (m : ℝ) / 2 < y' ∧ y' < ((m : ℝ) + 1) / 2) :
    toInt (round intSet mode y) = toInt (round intSet mode y')
proof:
:= by
  set n : ℤ := m / 2 with hn
  have hn1 : 2 * n ≤ m := by omega
  have hn2 : m < 2 * n + 2 := by omega
  have hn1' : (n : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) / 2 := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; exact_mod_cast (by omega : n * 2 ≤ m)
  have hn2' : ((m : ℝ) + 1) / 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; exact_mod_cast (by omega : m + 1 ≤ (n + 1) * 2)
  have hfl : ∀ z : ℝ, (m : ℝ) / 2 < z → z < ((m : ℝ) + 1) / 2 → ⌊z⌋ = n := fun z h1 h2 =>
    Int.floor_eq_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hce : ∀ z : ℝ, (m : ℝ) / 2 < z → z < ((m : ℝ) + 1) / 2 → ⌈z⌉ = n + 1 := fun z h1 h2 =>
    Int.ceil_eq_iff.mpr ⟨by push_cast; linarith, by push_cast; linarith⟩
  have hF : ∀ z : ℝ, toInt (roundFloor intSet z) = ⌊z⌋ := fun z =>
    toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundFloor_intSet z).symm
  have hC : ∀ z : ℝ, toInt (roundCeiling intSet z) = ⌈z⌉ := fun z =>
    toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundCeiling_intSet z).symm
  have hsign : 0 ≤ y ↔ 0 ≤ y' := by
    rcases le_or_gt 0 m with hm | hm
    · have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
      constructor <;> intro <;> linarith
    · have : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : m + 1 ≤ 0)
      constructor <;> intro <;> linarith
  
  have hnear : ∀ z : ℝ, (m : ℝ) / 2 < z → z < ((m : ℝ) + 1) / 2 →
      toInt (round intSet .Nearest z) = if Even m then n else n + 1 := by
    intro z h1 h2
    have hfz := hfl z h1 h2
    have hcz := hce z h1 h2
    show toInt (match compare (((z : ℝ) : EReal) - (roundFloor intSet z).val)
        ((roundCeiling intSet z).val - ((z : ℝ) : EReal)) with
      | .lt => roundFloor intSet z
      | .gt => roundCeiling intSet z
      | .eq => tiebreak (roundFloor intSet z) (roundCeiling intSet z)) = _
    rw [val_roundFloor_intSet, val_roundCeiling_intSet, hfz, hcz, ← EReal.coe_sub,
      ← EReal.coe_sub, compare_coe_coe]
    rcases Int.even_or_odd m with hev | hod
    · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hev
      have hnq : n = q := by omega
      have hlt : z - (n : ℝ) < ((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) - z := by
        have : (m : ℝ) = 2 * q := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : m = 2 * q)
        push_cast; rw [hnq]; linarith
      rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr hlt]
      simp only [hF, hfz, ite_eq_left (show Even m from ⟨q, hq⟩)]
    · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hod
      have hnq : n = q := by omega
      have hgt : ((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) - z < z - (n : ℝ) := by
        have : (m : ℝ) = 2 * q + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hq
        push_cast; rw [hnq]; linarith
      rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr hgt]
      simp only [hC, hcz, ite_eq_right (Int.not_even_iff_odd.mpr ⟨q, hq⟩)]
  cases mode with
  | Floor =>
    show toInt (roundFloor intSet y) = toInt (roundFloor intSet y')
    rw [hF, hF, hfl y hy.1 hy.2, hfl y' hy'.1 hy'.2]
  | Ceiling =>
    show toInt (roundCeiling intSet y) = toInt (roundCeiling intSet y')
    rw [hC, hC, hce y hy.1 hy.2, hce y' hy'.1 hy'.2]
  | Down =>
    show toInt (if 0 ≤ y then roundFloor intSet y else roundCeiling intSet y)
      = toInt (if 0 ≤ y' then roundFloor intSet y' else roundCeiling intSet y')
    by_cases h0 : 0 ≤ y
    · rw [ite_eq_left h0, ite_eq_left (hsign.mp h0), hF, hF, hfl y hy.1 hy.2, hfl y' hy'.1 hy'.2]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h0, ite_eq_right (fun h => h0 (hsign.mpr h)), hC, hC, hce y hy.1 hy.2,
        hce y' hy'.1 hy'.2]
  | Up =>
    show toInt (if 0 ≤ y then roundCeiling intSet y else roundFloor intSet y)
      = toInt (if 0 ≤ y' then roundCeiling intSet y' else roundFloor intSet y')
    by_cases h0 : 0 ≤ y
    · rw [ite_eq_left h0, ite_eq_left (hsign.mp h0), hC, hC, hce y hy.1 hy.2, hce y' hy'.1 hy'.2]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h0, ite_eq_right (fun h => h0 (hsign.mpr h)), hF, hF, hfl y hy.1 hy.2,
        hfl y' hy'.1 hy'.2]
  | Nearest => rw [hnear y hy.1 hy.2, hnear y' hy'.1 hy'.2]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.compare_int_congr
statement:
theorem compare_int_congr (m R : ℤ) (y y' : ℝ)
    (hy : (m : ℝ) / 2 < y ∧ y < ((m : ℝ) + 1) / 2)
    (hy' : (m : ℝ) / 2 < y' ∧ y' < ((m : ℝ) + 1) / 2) :
    compare (R : ℝ) y = compare (R : ℝ) y'
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt (2 * R) m with h | h
  · have hR : (R : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) / 2 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; exact_mod_cast (by omega : R * 2 ≤ m)
    rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (by linarith), compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (by linarith)]
  · have hR : ((m : ℝ) + 1) / 2 ≤ (R : ℝ) := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; exact_mod_cast (by omega : m + 1 ≤ R * 2)
    rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (by linarith), compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (by linarith)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.log_eq_of_cell
statement:
theorem log_eq_of_cell (j k : ℤ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (v v' : ℝ)
    (hv : (k : ℝ) * 2 ^ j < v ∧ v < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ j)
    (hv' : (k : ℝ) * 2 ^ j < v' ∧ v' < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ j) :
    Int.log 2 v = Int.log 2 v'
proof:
:= by
  have h2j : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ j := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hk' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hpos : 0 < v := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hv.1.le
  have hpos' : 0 < v' := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hv'.1.le
  
  have key : ∀ (a b : ℝ), (k : ℝ) * 2 ^ j < a → a < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ j →
      (k : ℝ) * 2 ^ j < b → b < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ j → ∀ i : ℤ,
      (2 : ℝ) ^ i ≤ a → (2 : ℝ) ^ i ≤ b := by
    intro a b ha1 ha2 hb1 hb2 i hi
    rcases le_or_gt j i with hji | hji
    · 
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℕ, i = j + d := ⟨(i - j).toNat, by omega⟩
      have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ i = ((2 ^ d : ℕ) : ℝ) * 2 ^ j := by
        rw [hd, zpow_add₀ (by norm_num), zpow_natCast]; push_cast; ring
      rw [hpow] at hi ⊢
      rcases le_or_gt ((2 ^ d : ℕ) : ℤ) k with hdk | hdk
      · have : ((2 ^ d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hdk
        exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this h2j.le) hb1.le
      · have : (k : ℝ) + 1 ≤ ((2 ^ d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast (by omega : k + 1 ≤ ((2 ^ d : ℕ) : ℤ))
        exact absurd hi (not_le.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le ha2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this h2j.le)))
    · have : (2 : ℝ) ^ i ≤ 2 ^ j := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) hji.le
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ i ≤ 2 ^ j := this
        _ ≤ (k : ℝ) * 2 ^ j := le_mul_of_one_le_left h2j.le hk'
        _ ≤ b := hb1.le
  have h1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ Int.log 2 v ≤ v := by
    simpa using Int.zpow_log_le_self (b := 2) (by norm_num) hpos
  have h1' : (2 : ℝ) ^ Int.log 2 v' ≤ v' := by
    simpa using Int.zpow_log_le_self (b := 2) (by norm_num) hpos'
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log (b := 2) (by norm_num) hpos').mp
      (by simpa using key v v' hv.1 hv.2 hv'.1 hv'.2 (Int.log 2 v) h1)
  · exact (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log (b := 2) (by norm_num) hpos).mp
      (by simpa using key v' v hv'.1 hv'.2 hv.1 hv.2 (Int.log 2 v') h1')

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_congr_cell
statement:
theorem roundVal_congr_cell (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (j k : ℤ) (v v' : ℝ)
    (hv : (k : ℝ) * 2 ^ j < v ∧ v < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ j)
    (hv' : (k : ℝ) * 2 ^ j < v' ∧ v' < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ j)
    (hlog : Int.log 2 |v| = Int.log 2 |v'|) (hj : j ≤ Int.log 2 |v| - p) :
    roundVal p mode (some (v : EReal)) = roundVal p mode (some (v' : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  have h2j : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ j := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  
  have hne : ∀ z : ℝ, (k : ℝ) * 2 ^ j < z → z < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ j → z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z h1 h2 hz
    rw [hz] at h1 h2
    rcases le_or_gt 0 k with hk | hk
    · have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
      nlinarith
    · have : (k : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : k + 1 ≤ 0)
      nlinarith
  have hv0 := hne v hv.1 hv.2
  have hv'0 := hne v' hv'.1 hv'.2
  set L := Int.log 2 |v| with hL
  set u : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (L - p + 1) with hu_def
  have hu : 0 < u := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hscale : precScale 2 p v = u := by
    show ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (L - p + 1) = u
    rw [hu_def]; norm_num
  have hscale' : precScale 2 p v' = u := by
    show ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (Int.log 2 |v'| - p + 1) = u
    rw [← hlog, hu_def]; norm_num
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℕ, L - p - j = t := ⟨(L - p - j).toNat, by omega⟩
  set c : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ t with hc_def
  have hc : 0 < c := by positivity
  have hu_eq : u = 2 ^ j * (2 * c) := by
    rw [hu_def, hc_def, ← zpow_natCast, show (2 : ℝ) * 2 ^ (t : ℤ) = 2 ^ ((t : ℤ) + 1) by
      rw [zpow_add_one₀ (by norm_num)]; ring, ← zpow_add₀ (by norm_num)]
    congr 1; omega
  set m : ℤ := k / (2 ^ t : ℤ) with hm
  have h2t : (0 : ℤ) < 2 ^ t := by positivity
  have hm1 : m * 2 ^ t ≤ k := Int.ediv_mul_le k (by positivity)
  have hm2 : k < (m + 1) * 2 ^ t := by
    have := Int.lt_ediv_add_one_mul_self k h2t; linarith
  have hcell : ∀ z : ℝ, (k : ℝ) * 2 ^ j < z → z < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ j →
      (m : ℝ) / 2 < z / u ∧ z / u < ((m : ℝ) + 1) / 2 := by
    intro z h1 h2
    have hm1' : (m : ℝ) * c ≤ k := by
      have : ((m * 2 ^ t : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hm1
      push_cast at this; rwa [hc_def]
    have hm2' : (k : ℝ) + 1 ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * c := by
      have : ((k + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (((m + 1) * 2 ^ t : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (by omega : k + 1 ≤ (m + 1) * 2 ^ t)
      push_cast at this; rwa [hc_def]
    constructor
    · rw [lt_div_iff₀ hu, hu_eq]
      calc (m : ℝ) / 2 * (2 ^ j * (2 * c)) = (m : ℝ) * c * 2 ^ j := by ring
        _ ≤ (k : ℝ) * 2 ^ j := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm1' h2j.le
        _ < z := h1
    · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hu, hu_eq]
      calc z < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ j := h2
        _ ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * c * 2 ^ j := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm2' h2j.le
        _ = ((m : ℝ) + 1) / 2 * (2 ^ j * (2 * c)) := by ring
  have hy := hcell v hv.1 hv.2
  have hy' := hcell v' hv'.1 hv'.2
  have hR := toInt_round_intSet_congr mode m (v / u) (v' / u) hy hy'
  set R := toInt (round intSet mode (v / u)) with hR_def
  have hval : (round (floatSet p) mode v).val = (((R : ℝ) * u : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [val_round_floatSet, val_round_precisionSet mode v hv0, hscale]
  have hval' : (round (floatSet p) mode v').val = (((R : ℝ) * u : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [val_round_floatSet, val_round_precisionSet mode v' hv'0, hscale', ← hR]
  refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
  · rw [fst_roundVal, fst_roundVal, ofVal_some, ofVal_some]
    exact toVal_injective p (ofEReal_spec p mode v).1 (ofEReal_spec p mode v').1
      (by rw [(ofEReal_spec p mode v).2, (ofEReal_spec p mode v').2, hval, hval'])
  · show (match (ofEReal p mode v).toVal, some (v : EReal) with
        | some a, some b => compare a b
        | _, _ => .eq) = (match (ofEReal p mode v').toVal, some (v' : EReal) with
        | some a, some b => compare a b
        | _, _ => .eq)
    rw [(ofEReal_spec p mode v).2, (ofEReal_spec p mode v').2, hval, hval']
    simp only [compare_coe_coe]
    rw [← compare_mul_right_pos _ _ u⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hu), ← compare_mul_right_pos (R * u) v' u⁻¹
      (inv_pos.mpr hu), mul_inv_cancel_right₀ hu.ne', ← div_eq_mul_inv, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact compare_int_congr m R (v / u) (v' / u) hy hy'

name: Azurite.AzFloat.AzInt.toInt_min
statement: theorem AzInt.toInt_min (a b : AzInt) : (min a b).toInt = min a.toInt b.toInt
proof:
:= by
  show (if a ≤ b then a else b).toInt = _
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [min_eq_left ((AzInt.le_iff_toInt_le a b).mp h)]
  · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge fun h' => h ((AzInt.le_iff_toInt_le a b).mpr h'))]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.AzInt.abs_toNat_sub
statement:
theorem AzInt.abs_toNat_sub (a b : AzInt) (h : b.toInt ≤ a.toInt) :
    (((a - b).abs.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = a.toInt - b.toInt
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzInt.abs_toNat_eq, AzInt.toInt_sub, abs_of_nonneg (by omega)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_true_eq
statement:
theorem finiteVal_true_eq (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) :
    finiteVal true e m = (m.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - m.size)
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteVal; simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_sign
statement:
theorem finiteVal_sign (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) :
    finiteVal s e m = (if s then 1 else -1) * finiteVal true e m
proof:
:= by
  cases s
  · rw [finiteVal_false]; simp
  · simp

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_top
statement:
@[simp] theorem roundVal_top (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    roundVal p mode (some ⊤) = (infinity true, .eq)
proof:
:=
  roundVal_of_toVal p mode (infinity true) ⊤ (Or.inr rfl) rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_bot
statement:
@[simp] theorem roundVal_bot (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    roundVal p mode (some ⊥) = (infinity false, .eq)
proof:
:=
  roundVal_of_toVal p mode (infinity false) ⊥ (Or.inr rfl) rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem roundVal_zero (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    roundVal p mode (some 0) = (zero, .eq)
proof:
:=
  roundVal_of_toVal p mode zero 0 (Or.inr rfl) rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundVal_inf
statement:
@[simp] theorem roundVal_inf (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) (b : Bool) :
    roundVal p mode (some (if b then ⊤ else ⊥)) = (infinity b, .eq)
proof:
:=
  roundVal_of_toVal p mode (infinity b) _ (Or.inr rfl) rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toNat_bounds_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem toNat_bounds_of_ne_zero (m : AzNat) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    2 ^ (m.size - 1) ≤ m.toNat ∧ m.toNat < 2 ^ m.size
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 := toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hm
  constructor
  · rw [← Nat.lt_size, AzNat.size_toNat]; have := size_pos_of_ne_zero hm; omega
  · rw [← Nat.size_le, AzNat.size_toNat]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.normalizeCarry_spec
statement:
theorem normalizeCarry_spec (r : AzInt) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (e : AzInt)
    (hlo : 2 ^ (p - 1) ≤ r.abs.toNat) (hhi : r.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ p) :
    (normalizeCarry r e p).toVal = some (((r.toInt : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - p) : ℝ) : EReal) ∧
    (normalizeCarry r e p).precision? = some p
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizeCarry
  exact normalize_spec r p hp e hlo hhi

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundFromFloor_spec
statement:
theorem roundFromFloor_spec (y : ℝ) (s : AzNat) (exact : Bool) (cmpMid : Ordering)
    (mode : RoundingMode) (hlo : (s.toNat : ℝ) ≤ y) (hhi : y < s.toNat + 1)
    (hex : exact = true ↔ y = s.toNat) (hmid : cmpMid = compare y ((s.toNat : ℝ) + 1 / 2)) :
    toInt (round intSet mode y) = ((roundFromFloor s exact cmpMid mode).1.toNat : ℤ) ∧
    (roundFromFloor s exact cmpMid mode).2
      = compare (((roundFromFloor s exact cmpMid mode).1.toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) y
proof:
:= by
  have hF : toInt (roundFloor intSet y) = ⌊y⌋ := toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundFloor_intSet y).symm
  have hC : toInt (roundCeiling intSet y) = ⌈y⌉ :=
    toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundCeiling_intSet y).symm
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := le_trans (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hlo
  have hs1 : ((s.addUInt64 1).toNat : ℝ) = s.toNat + 1 := by
    rw [AzNat.toNat_addUInt64, UInt64.toNat_one]; push_cast; ring
  have hs1' : ((s.addUInt64 1).toNat : ℤ) = s.toNat + 1 := by
    rw [AzNat.toNat_addUInt64, UInt64.toNat_one]; push_cast; ring
  unfold roundFromFloor
  by_cases hexact : exact = true
  · rw [ite_eq_left hexact]
    have hy : y = s.toNat := hex.mp hexact
    have hfl : ⌊y⌋ = s.toNat := by rw [hy]; exact Int.floor_natCast _
    have hce : ⌈y⌉ = s.toNat := by rw [hy]; exact Int.ceil_natCast _
    refine ⟨?_, by show Ordering.eq = compare _ y; rw [hy, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl]⟩
    cases mode with
    | Floor => show toInt (roundFloor intSet y) = _; rw [hF, hfl]
    | Ceiling => show toInt (roundCeiling intSet y) = _; rw [hC, hce]
    | Down =>
      show toInt (if 0 ≤ y then roundFloor intSet y else roundCeiling intSet y) = _
      rw [ite_eq_left hy0, hF, hfl]
    | Up =>
      show toInt (if 0 ≤ y then roundCeiling intSet y else roundFloor intSet y) = _
      rw [ite_eq_left hy0, hC, hce]
    | Nearest =>
      show toInt (match compare (((y : ℝ) : EReal) - (roundFloor intSet y).val)
          ((roundCeiling intSet y).val - ((y : ℝ) : EReal)) with
        | .lt => roundFloor intSet y
        | .gt => roundCeiling intSet y
        | .eq => tiebreak (roundFloor intSet y) (roundCeiling intSet y)) = _
      rw [val_roundFloor_intSet, val_roundCeiling_intSet, hfl, hce, Int.cast_natCast,
        ← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_sub, compare_coe_coe,
        compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr (show y - (s.toNat : ℝ) = (s.toNat : ℝ) - y by rw [hy])]
      show toInt (tiebreak (roundFloor intSet y) (roundCeiling intSet y)) = _
      rcases tiebreak_mem (roundFloor intSet y) (roundCeiling intSet y) with hT | hT <;> rw [hT]
      · rw [hF, hfl]
      · rw [hC, hce]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hexact]
    have hne : y ≠ s.toNat := fun h => hexact (hex.mpr h)
    have hlt : (s.toNat : ℝ) < y := lt_of_le_of_ne hlo (Ne.symm hne)
    have hfl : ⌊y⌋ = s.toNat := Int.floor_eq_iff.mpr ⟨by exact_mod_cast hlo, by exact_mod_cast hhi⟩
    have hce : ⌈y⌉ = s.toNat + 1 :=
      Int.ceil_eq_iff.mpr ⟨by push_cast; linarith, by push_cast; linarith⟩
    have htagF : Ordering.lt = compare (s.toNat : ℝ) y := (compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr hlt).symm
    have htagC : Ordering.gt = compare (((s.addUInt64 1).toNat : ℕ) : ℝ) y := by
      rw [hs1]; exact (compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr hhi).symm
    cases mode with
    | Floor => exact ⟨by show toInt (roundFloor intSet y) = _; rw [hF, hfl], htagF⟩
    | Ceiling => exact ⟨by show toInt (roundCeiling intSet y) = _; rw [hC, hce, hs1'], htagC⟩
    | Down =>
      refine ⟨?_, htagF⟩
      show toInt (if 0 ≤ y then roundFloor intSet y else roundCeiling intSet y) = _
      rw [ite_eq_left hy0, hF, hfl]
    | Up =>
      refine ⟨?_, htagC⟩
      show toInt (if 0 ≤ y then roundCeiling intSet y else roundFloor intSet y) = _
      rw [ite_eq_left hy0, hC, hce, hs1']
    | Nearest =>
      have hcmp : compare (y - (s.toNat : ℝ)) (((s.toNat + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) - y)
          = compare y ((s.toNat : ℝ) + 1 / 2) := by
        push_cast
        rcases lt_trichotomy y ((s.toNat : ℝ) + 1 / 2) with h | h | h
        · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (by linarith)]
        · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr (by linarith)]
        · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (by linarith)]
      show toInt (match compare (((y : ℝ) : EReal) - (roundFloor intSet y).val)
          ((roundCeiling intSet y).val - ((y : ℝ) : EReal)) with
        | .lt => roundFloor intSet y
        | .gt => roundCeiling intSet y
        | .eq => tiebreak (roundFloor intSet y) (roundCeiling intSet y)) = _ ∧ _
      rw [val_roundFloor_intSet, val_roundCeiling_intSet, hfl, hce, Int.cast_natCast,
        ← EReal.coe_sub, ← EReal.coe_sub, compare_coe_coe, hcmp, ← hmid]
      cases cmpMid with
      | lt => exact ⟨by rw [hF, hfl], htagF⟩
      | gt => exact ⟨by rw [hC, hce, hs1'], htagC⟩
      | eq =>
        show toInt (intTiebreak (roundFloor intSet y) (roundCeiling intSet y)) = _ ∧ _
        unfold intTiebreak
        rw [hF, hC, hfl, hce]
        by_cases hodd : s.isOdd = true
        · have ho : Odd (s.toNat : ℤ) := (Int.odd_coe_nat _).mpr ((AzNat.isOdd_iff s).mp hodd)
          have hno : ¬ Even (s.toNat : ℤ) := Int.not_even_iff_odd.mpr ho
          have he1 : Even ((s.toNat : ℤ) + 1) := Int.even_add_one.mpr hno
          rw [ite_eq_right (fun h => hno h.1), ite_eq_left ⟨he1, hno⟩, ite_eq_left hodd]
          exact ⟨by rw [hC, hce, hs1'], htagC⟩
        · have hev : Even (s.toNat : ℤ) := by
            rcases Int.even_or_odd (s.toNat : ℤ) with h | h
            · exact h
            · exact absurd ((AzNat.isOdd_iff s).mpr ((Int.odd_coe_nat _).mp h)) hodd
          have hno1 : ¬ Even ((s.toNat : ℤ) + 1) := fun h => Int.even_add_one.mp h hev
          rw [ite_eq_left ⟨hev, hno1⟩, ite_eq_right hodd]
          exact ⟨by rw [hF, hfl], htagF⟩

name: Azurite.AzFloat.AzInt.toInt_shiftRight_one
statement: theorem AzInt.toInt_shiftRight_one (z : AzInt) : (z.shiftRight 1).toInt = z.toInt / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := AzInt.toInt_shiftRight z 1
  rw [pow_one] at h
  have h2 : toInt (round intSet .Floor ((z.toInt : ℝ) / 2)) = (z.shiftRight 1).toInt :=
    toInt_eq_of_val h
  rw [show toInt (round intSet .Floor ((z.toInt : ℝ) / 2)) = ⌊(z.toInt : ℝ) / 2⌋ from
    toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundFloor_intSet _).symm] at h2
  rw [← h2]
  apply Int.floor_eq_iff.mpr
  constructor
  · rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; exact_mod_cast (by omega : z.toInt / 2 * 2 ≤ z.toInt)
  · rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; exact_mod_cast (by omega : z.toInt < (z.toInt / 2 + 1) * 2)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.decide_pos_finiteVal
statement:
theorem decide_pos_finiteVal (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) (m : AzNat) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    decide (0 < finiteVal s e m) = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, decide_eq_true_iff, finiteVal_pos_iff s e m hm]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBasePow2P1Finite_eq
statement:
theorem logBasePow2P1Finite_eq (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {q : ℕ} {m : AzNat} (hv : FiniteValid q m)
    (hgt : -1 < finiteVal s e m) (k : AzInt) (hk : k ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) [NeZero p]
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    logBasePow2P1Finite s e hv hgt k hk p mode
      = roundVal p mode
          (some ((Real.logb 2 (1 + finiteVal s e m) / k.toInt : ℝ) : EReal))
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < 1 + finiteVal s e m := by linarith
  have hw : NeZero (p + zivGuardBits + leadingZeroBits e) := ⟨by unfold zivGuardBits; omega⟩
  unfold logBasePow2P1Finite
  split
  · rename_i j hj
    rw [ofAzRatRound_eq_roundVal, AzRat.toRat_ofAzInts,
      onePlusPow2Exponent?_some (toVal_finite s e q m hv) _ hj, logb_two_zpow]
    push_cast
    rfl
  · rename_i hj
    have hirr := Irrational.div_intCast
      (irrational_logb_two_one_add_of_none (toVal_finite s e q m hv)
        (w := p + zivGuardBits + leadingZeroBits e) (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega) hpos hj)
      (toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hk)
    exact zivLoopCertified_eq_threshold p mode _
      (Real.logb 2 (1 + finiteVal s e m) / k.toInt) _ (by unfold zivGuardBits; omega)
      (fun w hw => by
        obtain ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo, hhi, -⟩ :=
          logBasePow2P1Approx_spec (w := w) (by unfold zivGuardBits at hw; omega)
            (toVal_finite s e q m hv) hgt k hk hirr
        exact ⟨lv, hv', hl, hh, hlo.le, hhi.le, fun h => absurd h hlo.ne⟩) _

name: Azurite.AzFloat.logBasePow2P1PrecRound_eq_liftVal
statement:
theorem logBasePow2P1PrecRound_eq_liftVal (x : AzFloat) (k : AzInt) (hk : k ≠ 0) (p : ℕ)
    [NeZero p] (mode : RoundingMode) :
    logBasePow2P1PrecRound x k p mode
      = liftVal (fun a => Spec.logBasePow2 k.toInt (a + 1)) x p mode
proof:
:= by
  have hkI := toInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hk
  unfold logBasePow2P1PrecRound liftVal
  rw [dite_eq_right hk]
  cases x with
  | nan => rfl
  | infinity s =>
    cases s
    · simp only [toVal_infinity, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some, EReal.bot_add,
        Spec.logBasePow2_bot, roundVal_none]
    · simp only [toVal_infinity, ↓reduceIte, Option.bind_some]
      rw [← EReal.coe_one, EReal.top_add_coe, Spec.logBasePow2_top _ hkI,
        sign_eq_decide_pos_toInt k hk]
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hkI with h | h
      · rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr h.le), decide_eq_false (not_lt.mpr h.le)]
        exact (roundVal_inf p mode false).symm
      · rw [ite_eq_left h, decide_eq_true h]
        exact (roundVal_inf p mode true).symm
  | zero =>
    simp only [toVal_zero, Option.bind_some]
    rw [zero_add, ← EReal.coe_one, Spec.logBasePow2_coe _ _ one_pos, Real.logb_one, zero_div,
      EReal.coe_zero, roundVal_zero]
  | finite s e q m hv =>
    cases s with
    | true =>
      have hpos := finiteVal_true_pos e hv
      simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      split_ifs with hp
      · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
      rw [← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, Spec.logBasePow2_coe _ _ (by linarith),
        add_comm (finiteVal true e m) 1]
      exact logBasePow2P1Finite_eq true e hv _ k hk p mode
    | false =>
      simp only [toVal_finite, Option.bind_some]
      split_ifs with hneg heq hp
      · obtain ⟨v, hx, h1⟩ := (eqIEEE_iff _ _).mp heq
        rw [toVal_finite] at hx
        rw [toVal_neg_one, ← hx, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at h1
        rw [← h1, ← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, neg_add_cancel, EReal.coe_zero,
          Spec.logBasePow2_zero _ hkI, sign_eq_decide_pos_toInt k hk]
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hkI with h | h
        · rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr h.le), decide_eq_false (not_lt.mpr h.le)]
          exact (roundVal_inf p mode true).symm
        · rw [ite_eq_left h, decide_eq_true h]
          exact (roundVal_inf p mode false).symm
      · have hle := finiteVal_false_le_neg_one e hv hneg
        have hne : finiteVal false e m ≠ -1 := fun h => heq ((eqIEEE_iff _ _).mpr
          ⟨((-1 : ℝ) : EReal), by rw [toVal_finite, h], toVal_neg_one⟩)
        have hlt : finiteVal false e m + 1 < 0 := by
          rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle with h | h
          · linarith
          · exact absurd h hne
        rw [← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, Spec.logBasePow2_coe_neg _ _ hlt, roundVal_none]
      · exact absurd hp (NeZero.ne p)
      · have hgt := finiteVal_false_gt_neg_one e hv hneg
        rw [← EReal.coe_one, ← EReal.coe_add, Spec.logBasePow2_coe _ _ (by linarith),
          add_comm (finiteVal false e m) 1]
        exact logBasePow2P1Finite_eq false e hv hgt k hk p mode

name: Azurite.AzFloat.coe_roundNearest53
statement:
theorem coe_roundNearest53 (v : ℝ) :
    ((roundNearest53 v : ℝ) : EReal) = (round (precisionSet 2 53) .Nearest v).val
proof:

name: Azurite.AzFloat.nearestTernary_intCast
statement: theorem nearestTernary_intCast (R : ℤ) (o : Ordering) : NearestTernary (R : ℝ) R o
proof:
:= by
  unfold NearestTernary
  refine ⟨by rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; norm_num, fun h => ?_⟩
  rw [sub_self, abs_zero] at h
  norm_num at h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.eq_of_nearestTernary_intCast
statement:
theorem eq_of_nearestTernary_intCast {n R : ℤ} {o : Ordering}
    (h : NearestTernary (n : ℝ) R o) : R = n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := h.1
  have : |((n - R : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1 / 2 := by push_cast; exact h1
  have h2 : |n - R| ≤ 0 := by
    have : (|n - R| : ℤ) < 1 := by
      have : ((|n - R| : ℤ) : ℝ) < 1 := by rw [Int.cast_abs]; linarith
      exact_mod_cast this
    omega
  have := abs_nonpos_iff.mp h2
  omega

name: Azurite.AzFloat.shift_ternary_spec
statement:
theorem shift_ternary_spec (s : Bool) (n : AzNat) (hn : n ≠ 0) (k : AzInt) (o : Ordering) :
    NearestTernary ((if s then 1 else -1) * (n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt)
      (if k.sign then (AzInt.mkNorm s n).shiftLeft k.abs.toNat
        else AzInt.shiftRightNearestTernary (AzInt.mkNorm s n) o k.abs.toNat).toInt o
proof:
:= by
  have hz : ((AzInt.mkNorm s n).toInt : ℝ) = (if s then 1 else -1) * (n.toNat : ℝ) := by
    rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true s with hs | hs <;>
      simp [hs, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true, AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_false n hn]
  have habs : (k.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |k.toInt| := AzInt.abs_toNat_eq k
  by_cases hsg : k.sign = true
  · have hk0 : 0 ≤ k.toInt := (AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff k).mp hsg
    rw [ite_eq_left hsg, AzInt.toInt_shiftLeft]
    have hk : ((k.abs.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = k.toInt := by rw [habs, abs_of_nonneg hk0]
    have : (if s then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt
        = (((AzInt.mkNorm s n).toInt * 2 ^ k.abs.toNat : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      push_cast
      rw [hz, ← zpow_natCast, hk]
    rw [this]
    exact nearestTernary_intCast _ o
  · have hk0 : k.toInt < 0 := by
      have := (AzInt.sign_eq_true_iff k).not.mp hsg; push Not at this; exact this
    rw [ite_eq_right hsg]
    have h := AzInt.toInt_shiftRightNearestTernary (AzInt.mkNorm s n) o k.abs.toNat
    have hk : ((k.abs.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = -k.toInt := by rw [habs, abs_of_neg hk0]
    have heq : ((AzInt.mkNorm s n).toInt : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k.abs.toNat
        = (if s then 1 else -1) * (n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt := by
      rw [hz, ← zpow_natCast, hk, zpow_neg, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_inv]
    rw [heq] at h
    exact h

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toUnpackedTernary_finite
statement:
theorem toUnpackedTernary_finite (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat}
    (hv : FiniteValid p m) (o : Ordering) :
    ∃ r t : AzInt, toUnpackedTernary (finite s e p m hv) o = finishUnpacked s r t .Nearest ∧
      t.toInt = max (e.toInt - 53) (-1074) ∧
      NearestTernary (finiteVal s e m / (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt) r.toInt o ∧
      (r.toInt ≠ 0 → (0 < r.toInt ↔ s = true))
proof:
:= by
  unfold toUnpackedTernary
  simp only []
  set n := coreSignificand p m with hn
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := coreSignificand_ne_zero hv
  have hs : n.size = p := size_coreSignificand hv
  clear_value n
  set t : AzInt := max (e - (AzNat.ofNat 53).toAzInt) (azIntOfInt (-1074)) with ht_def
  have htI : t.toInt = max (e.toInt - 53) (-1074) := by
    rw [ht_def, AzInt.toInt_max, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat,
      toInt_azIntOfInt]
    push_cast
    rfl
  clear_value t
  set k : AzInt := e - (AzNat.ofNat p).toAzInt - t with hk_def
  have hkI : k.toInt = e.toInt - p - t.toInt := by
    rw [hk_def, AzInt.toInt_sub, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
  clear_value k
  have hval : finiteVal s e m / (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt
      = (if s then 1 else -1) * (n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt := by
    rw [finiteVal_eq_core s e hv, ← hn, finiteVal_sign, finiteVal_true_eq, hs, hkI]
    simp only [zpow_sub₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
    ring
  refine ⟨_, t, rfl, htI, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hval]
    exact shift_ternary_spec s n hn0 k o
  · intro hr0
    have hnt := shift_ternary_spec s n hn0 k o
    set r := (if k.sign then (AzInt.mkNorm s n).shiftLeft k.abs.toNat
      else AzInt.shiftRightNearestTernary (AzInt.mkNorm s n) o k.abs.toNat) with hr
    clear_value r
    have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < (n.toNat : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hn0)
    have h2k : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
    have h1 := hnt.1
    have hr0' : (r.toInt : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hr0
    have hhalf : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(r.toInt : ℝ)| := by
      have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |r.toInt| := Int.one_le_abs hr0
      exact_mod_cast this
    cases s with
    | true =>
      simp only [↓reduceIte, one_mul, iff_true] at h1 ⊢
      have hy : 0 < (n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt := mul_pos hNpos h2k
      by_contra hneg
      push Not at hneg
      have : (r.toInt : ℝ) ≤ -1 := by
        have : r.toInt ≤ -1 := by omega
        exact_mod_cast this
      have := abs_le.mp h1
      linarith [this.1, this.2]
    | false =>
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, neg_one_mul, iff_false, not_lt] at h1 ⊢
      have hy : (n.toNat : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt > 0 := mul_pos hNpos h2k
      by_contra hpos
      push Not at hpos
      have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (r.toInt : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hpos
      have := abs_le.mp h1
      linarith [this.1, this.2]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_finishUnpacked_overflow
statement:
theorem toVal_finishUnpacked_overflow (s : Bool) (r t : AzInt) (hr : r.abs ≠ 0)
    (ht : 971 < t.toInt) :
    (finishUnpacked s r t .Nearest).toVal = some (if s then ⊤ else ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  unfold finishUnpacked
  simp only []
  rw [ite_eq_right hr]
  have h1 : (1 : AzInt).toInt = 1 := rfl
  have hov : ∀ t' : AzInt, 971 < t'.toInt → azIntOfInt 971 < t' := fun t' h => by
    rw [AzInt.lt_iff_toInt_lt, toInt_azIntOfInt]; exact h
  have hsgn : (if signOfBool s = Sign.positive then (⊤ : EReal) else ⊥)
      = if s then ⊤ else ⊥ := by
    cases s <;> simp [signOfBool]
  by_cases hc : r.abs.size = 54
  · rw [ite_eq_left hc, ite_eq_left (hov _ (by rw [AzInt.toInt_add, h1]; omega))]
    simp only [overflowToInfinity, ↓reduceIte, UnpackedFloat.toVal, hsgn]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hc, ite_eq_left (hov _ ht)]
    simp only [overflowToInfinity, ↓reduceIte, UnpackedFloat.toVal, hsgn]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toUnpackedTernary_binary64
statement:
theorem toUnpackedTernary_binary64 (x : AzFloat) (o : Ordering) :
    (toUnpackedTernary x o).Binary64
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | nan => trivial
  | infinity s => trivial
  | zero => trivial
  | finite s e p m hv =>
    obtain ⟨r, t, hx, htI, hr, -⟩ := toUnpackedTernary_finite s e hv o
    rw [hx]
    have hv0 : finiteVal s e m ≠ 0 := by
      rw [finiteVal_eq_core s e hv]
      exact finiteVal_ne_zero' s e _ (coreSignificand_ne_zero hv)
    obtain ⟨hvlo, hvhi⟩ := abs_finiteVal_bounds s e hv
    have habs : (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |r.toInt| := AzInt.abs_toNat_eq r
    have h2t : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
    have hclose := hr.1
    rcases le_or_gt (-1021 : ℤ) e.toInt with hlo | hhi
    · 
      have ht : t.toInt = e.toInt - 53 := by rw [htI]; exact max_eq_left (by omega)
      have hX : |finiteVal s e m / (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt| < (2 : ℝ) ^ (53 : ℤ) ∧
          (2 : ℝ) ^ (52 : ℤ) ≤ |finiteVal s e m / (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt| := by
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos h2t, div_lt_iff₀ h2t, le_div_iff₀ h2t, ht,
          ← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0),
          ← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
        constructor
        · convert hvhi using 2; ring
        · convert hvlo using 2; ring
      have hRlo : (2 : ℝ) ^ (52 : ℤ) - 1 / 2 ≤ |(r.toInt : ℝ)| := by
        have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (finiteVal s e m / (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt) (r.toInt : ℝ)
        linarith [hX.2]
      have hRhi : |(r.toInt : ℝ)| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (53 : ℤ) + 1 / 2 := by
        have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (r.toInt : ℝ) (finiteVal s e m / (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt)
        rw [abs_sub_comm] at this
        linarith [hX.1]
      have hr53 : |r.toInt| ≤ 2 ^ 53 := by
        have : ((|r.toInt| : ℤ) : ℝ) < 2 ^ 53 + 1 := by
          rw [Int.cast_abs]; norm_num at hRhi ⊢; linarith
        have : (|r.toInt| : ℤ) < 2 ^ 53 + 1 := by exact_mod_cast this
        omega
      have hr52 : 2 ^ 52 ≤ |r.toInt| := by
        have : (2 ^ 52 - 1 : ℝ) < ((|r.toInt| : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
          rw [Int.cast_abs]; norm_num at hRlo ⊢; linarith
        have : (2 ^ 52 - 1 : ℤ) < |r.toInt| := by exact_mod_cast this
        omega
      apply finishUnpacked_binary64 s r t .Nearest
      · have : (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) ≤ ((2 ^ 53 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [habs]; exact_mod_cast hr53
        exact_mod_cast this
      · omega
      · intro hlt
        exfalso
        have : ((2 ^ 52 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [habs]; exact_mod_cast hr52
        have : (2 ^ 52 : ℕ) ≤ r.abs.toNat := by exact_mod_cast this
        omega
    · 
      have ht : t.toInt = -1074 := by rw [htI]; exact max_eq_right (by omega)
      have hsmall : |finiteVal s e m / (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (52 : ℤ) := by
        apply le_of_lt
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos h2t, div_lt_iff₀ h2t, ht]
        calc |finiteVal s e m| < (2 : ℝ) ^ e.toInt := hvhi
          _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1022 : ℤ) := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (52 : ℤ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1074 : ℤ) := by
            rw [← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]; norm_num
      have hRhi : |(r.toInt : ℝ)| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (52 : ℤ) + 1 / 2 := by
        have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (r.toInt : ℝ) (finiteVal s e m / (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt)
        rw [abs_sub_comm] at this
        linarith
      have hr52 : |r.toInt| ≤ 2 ^ 52 := by
        have : ((|r.toInt| : ℤ) : ℝ) < 2 ^ 52 + 1 := by
          rw [Int.cast_abs]; norm_num at hRhi ⊢; linarith
        have : (|r.toInt| : ℤ) < 2 ^ 52 + 1 := by exact_mod_cast this
        omega
      have hr52' : r.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ 52 := by
        have : (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) ≤ 2 ^ 52 := by rw [habs]; exact hr52
        exact_mod_cast this
      exact finishUnpacked_binary64 s r t .Nearest (by omega) (by omega) (fun _ => ht)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.compare_mul_pos_right
statement:
theorem compare_mul_pos_right (a b c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    compare (a * c) (b * c) = compare a b
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a b with h | h | h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h hc)]
  · subst h; rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl]
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h hc)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.finiteVal_ne_zero_of_valid
statement:
theorem finiteVal_ne_zero_of_valid (s : Bool) (e : AzInt) {p : ℕ} {m : AzNat}
    (hv : FiniteValid p m) : finiteVal s e m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteVal_eq_core s e hv]
  exact finiteVal_ne_zero' s e _ (coreSignificand_ne_zero hv)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_toUnpackedTernary_roundVal
statement:
theorem toVal_toUnpackedTernary_roundVal (v : ℝ) :
    (toUnpackedTernary (roundVal 53 .Nearest (some (v : EReal))).1
        (roundVal 53 .Nearest (some (v : EReal))).2).toVal = some (roundBinary64 v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx, ho⟩ := roundVal_coe 53 .Nearest v
  have hprec : (roundVal 53 .Nearest (some (v : EReal))).1.precision? = some 53 ∨
      (roundVal 53 .Nearest (some (v : EReal))).1.precision? = none :=
    (ofEReal_spec 53 .Nearest v).1
  set x := (roundVal 53 .Nearest (some (v : EReal))).1 with hx_def
  set o := (roundVal 53 .Nearest (some (v : EReal))).2 with ho_def
  rw [val_round_floatSet, ← coe_roundNearest53] at hx ho
  clear_value x o
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  rcases eq_or_ne v 0 with hv0 | hv0
  · 
    subst hv0
    have h0 : roundNearest53 0 = 0 := by
      have : ((roundNearest53 0 : ℝ) : EReal) = ((0 : ℝ) : EReal) := by
        rw [coe_roundNearest53, val_round_of_mem _ _ (Or.inl (by simp))]
      exact EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp this
    rw [h0] at hx
    have hR : roundBinary64 0 = 0 := by
      unfold roundBinary64
      rw [ite_eq_left (by rw [abs_zero]; exact zpow_pos h2 _), zero_mul,
        show (0 : ℝ) = ((0 : ℤ) : ℝ) from Int.cast_zero.symm, toInt_round_intCast]
      simp
    rw [hR]
    cases x with
    | nan => simp at hx
    | infinity s => cases s <;> simp at hx
    | zero => rfl
    | finite s e p m hv =>
      exfalso
      simp only [toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at hx
      exact finiteVal_ne_zero_of_valid s e hv hx
  
  set σ := precScale 2 53 v with hσ_def
  have hσ : (0 : ℝ) < σ := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  set y := v / σ with hy
  set R := toInt (round intSet .Nearest y) with hR
  have hRσ : roundNearest53 v = (R : ℝ) * σ := by
    have := coe_roundNearest53 v
    rw [val_round_precisionSet .Nearest v hv0] at this
    exact EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp this
  obtain ⟨hylo, hyhi⟩ := abs_div_precScale_bounds (b := 2) (p := 53) v hv0
  obtain ⟨hRlo, hRhi⟩ := abs_toInt_round_bounds 53 (by norm_num) .Nearest y
    (by simpa using hylo) (by simpa using hyhi)
  rw [← hR] at hRlo hRhi
  norm_num at hRlo hRhi
  have hR0 : R ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, abs_zero] at hRlo; omega
  have hvy : v = y * σ := by rw [hy, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hσ.ne']
  set L := Int.log 2 |v| with hL
  have hσL : σ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (L - 52) := by
    rw [hσ_def]; unfold precScale; push_cast; congr 1; ring
  
  rw [hRσ] at hx ho
  cases x with
  | nan => simp at hx
  | infinity s =>
    exfalso
    simp only [toVal_infinity, Option.some.injEq] at hx
    cases s
    · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hx; exact EReal.bot_ne_coe _ hx
    · simp only [↓reduceIte] at hx; exact EReal.top_ne_coe _ hx
  | zero =>
    exfalso
    simp only [toVal_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hx
    have : (R : ℝ) * σ = 0 := EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp (by rw [EReal.coe_zero]; exact hx.symm)
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
    · exact hR0 (by exact_mod_cast h)
    · exact hσ.ne' h
  | finite s e p m hv =>
  simp only [toVal_finite, Option.some.injEq, EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff] at hx
  have hp : p = 53 := by
    rcases hprec with h | h
    · exact Option.some.inj h
    · simp [precision?] at h
  subst hp
  rw [compare_coe_coe] at ho
  obtain ⟨r, t, hu, htI, hNT, hsign⟩ := toUnpackedTernary_finite s e hv o
  rw [hu]
  obtain ⟨hvlo, hvhi⟩ := abs_finiteVal_bounds s e hv
  rw [hx] at hvlo hvhi hNT
  have habs : (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) = |r.toInt| := AzInt.abs_toNat_eq r
  have hRσabs : |(R : ℝ) * σ| = |(R : ℝ)| * σ := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hσ]
  have hRabs : (2 : ℝ) ^ (52 : ℤ) ≤ |(R : ℝ)| ∧
      |(R : ℝ)| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (53 : ℤ) := by
    constructor
    · have : ((2 ^ 52 : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ ((|R| : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hRlo
      rw [Int.cast_abs] at this; norm_num at this ⊢; exact this
    · have : ((|R| : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ ((2 ^ 53 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hRhi
      rw [Int.cast_abs] at this; norm_num at this ⊢; exact this
  by_cases hsmall : |v| < (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1022 : ℤ)
  · 
    have hLlt : L < -1022 :=
      (Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt (by norm_num) (abs_pos.mpr hv0)).mp (by simpa using hsmall)
    have hσle : σ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1075 : ℤ) := by
      rw [hσL]; exact zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
    have hfv : |(R : ℝ) * σ| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1022 : ℤ) := by
      rw [hRσabs]
      calc |(R : ℝ)| * σ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (53 : ℤ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1075 : ℤ) :=
            mul_le_mul hRabs.2 hσle hσ.le (by positivity)
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1022 : ℤ) := by
            rw [← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]; norm_num
    have he : e.toInt ≤ -1021 := by
      have : (2 : ℝ) ^ (e.toInt - 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1022 : ℤ) := hvlo.trans hfv
      have := (zpow_le_zpow_iff_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)).mp this
      omega
    have ht : t.toInt = -1074 := by rw [htI]; exact max_eq_right (by omega)
    
    set X := (R : ℝ) * σ / (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt with hX
    set w := v * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1074 : ℤ) with hw
    have h2t : (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1074 : ℤ))⁻¹ := by
      rw [ht, zpow_neg]
    have hXw : X = (R : ℝ) * σ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1074 : ℤ) := by rw [hX, h2t, div_inv_eq_mul]
    have hc : (0 : ℝ) < σ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1074 : ℤ) := by positivity
    have hcmp : compare X w = o := by
      rw [ho, hXw, hw, compare_mul_pos_right _ _ _ (zpow_pos h2 _)]
    
    set J : ℕ := (-1023 - L).toNat with hJ
    have hJ' : (J : ℤ) = -1023 - L := by rw [hJ]; exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
    have hgrid : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1075 : ℤ) = σ * (2 : ℝ) ^ J := by
      rw [hσL, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), hJ']
      congr 1; ring
    
    have key : ∀ n : ℤ, |X - w| ≤ |(n : ℝ) / 2 - w| := by
      intro n
      have h1 : X - w = (R - y) * (σ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1074 : ℤ)) := by
        rw [hXw, hw, hvy]; ring
      have h2' : (n : ℝ) / 2 - w = ((n * 2 ^ J : ℤ) - y) * (σ * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1074 : ℤ)) := by
        have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1075 : ℤ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1074 : ℤ) = 2⁻¹ := by
          rw [← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]; norm_num
        rw [show (n : ℝ) / 2 = n * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-1075 : ℤ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1074 : ℤ)) by
          rw [hpow]; ring, hgrid, hw, hvy]
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h1, h2', abs_mul ((R : ℝ) - y), abs_mul (((n * 2 ^ J : ℤ) : ℝ) - y), abs_of_pos hc]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hc.le
      rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_sub_comm ((n * 2 ^ J : ℤ) : ℝ)]
      exact abs_toInt_round_nearest_sub_le y _
    have hB : |w| < ((2 ^ 52 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [hw, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (zpow_pos h2 _)]
      calc |v| * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1074 : ℤ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1022 : ℤ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1074 : ℤ) :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hsmall (zpow_pos h2 _)
        _ = ((2 ^ 52 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
            rw [← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]; norm_num
    have hclose : ∀ m : ℤ, |m| ≤ 2 ^ 52 → |X - w| ≤ |(m : ℝ) - w| := by
      intro m _
      have := key (2 * m)
      push_cast at this
      rwa [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)] at this
    have hclose' : ∀ m : ℤ, -(2 ^ 52) ≤ m → m ≤ 2 ^ 52 - 1 →
        |X - w| ≤ |(m : ℝ) + 1 / 2 - w| := by
      intro m _ _
      have := key (2 * m + 1)
      push_cast at this
      rwa [show ((2 : ℝ) * m + 1) / 2 = m + 1 / 2 by ring] at this
    have hround : toInt (round intSet .Nearest w) = r.toInt := by
      rw [← hcmp] at hNT
      exact toInt_round_nearest_of_ternary hB hclose hclose' hNT
    have hr52 : r.abs.toNat ≤ 2 ^ 52 := by
      have := abs_toInt_round_le .Nearest w (2 ^ 52) hB.le
      rw [hround] at this
      have : (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) ≤ 2 ^ 52 := by rw [habs]; exact this
      exact_mod_cast this
    rw [toVal_finishUnpacked s r t .Nearest (by omega) hsign (by rw [ht]; split_ifs <;> omega)]
    unfold roundBinary64
    rw [ite_eq_left hsmall, ← hw, hround, ht]
  · 
    push Not at hsmall
    have hLge : -1022 ≤ L :=
      (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log (by norm_num) (abs_pos.mpr hv0)).mp (by simpa using hsmall)
    have hσge : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1074 : ℤ) ≤ σ := by
      rw [hσL]; exact zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
    have hfv : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1022 : ℤ) ≤ |(R : ℝ) * σ| := by
      rw [hRσabs]
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1022 : ℤ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (52 : ℤ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1074 : ℤ) := by
            rw [← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]; norm_num
        _ ≤ |(R : ℝ)| * σ := mul_le_mul hRabs.1 hσge (by positivity) (abs_nonneg _)
    have he : -1021 ≤ e.toInt := by
      have : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1022 : ℤ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ e.toInt := hfv.trans_lt hvhi
      have := (zpow_lt_zpow_iff_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)).mp this
      omega
    have ht : t.toInt = e.toInt - 53 := by rw [htI]; exact max_eq_left (by omega)
    
    set n := coreSignificand 53 m with hn
    have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := coreSignificand_ne_zero hv
    have hs : n.size = 53 := size_coreSignificand hv
    have hnlt : n.toNat < 2 ^ 53 := by rw [← Nat.size_le, AzNat.size_toNat, hs]
    set N : ℤ := if s then (n.toNat : ℤ) else -(n.toNat : ℤ) with hN
    have hNval : (R : ℝ) * σ / (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt = (N : ℝ) := by
      rw [← hx, finiteVal_eq_core s e hv, ← hn, finiteVal_sign, finiteVal_true_eq, hs, ht, hN]
      push_cast
      cases s <;> simp [div_eq_iff (zpow_pos h2 _).ne']
    rw [hNval] at hNT
    have hrN : r.toInt = N := eq_of_nearestTernary_intCast hNT
    have hNabs : |N| = (n.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [hN]; cases s <;> simp
    have hrabs : r.abs.toNat = n.toNat := by
      have : (r.abs.toNat : ℤ) = (n.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [habs, hrN, hNabs]
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hval : ((r.toInt : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ t.toInt : ℝ) = (R : ℝ) * σ := by
      rw [hrN, ← hNval, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (zpow_pos h2 _).ne']
    have hn0' : n.toNat ≠ 0 := toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hn0
    have hsgn : (0 < (R : ℝ) * σ ↔ s = true) := by
      rw [← hx, finiteVal_sign]
      have := finiteVal_true_pos' e m (fun h => by
        obtain ⟨hlo, -⟩ := toNat_bounds_of_valid hv
        rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hlo
        exact absurd hlo (not_le.mpr (Nat.two_pow_pos _)))
      cases s <;> simp <;> linarith
    unfold roundBinary64
    rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr hsmall), hRσ]
    by_cases hov : 1025 ≤ e.toInt
    · 
      have hr0 : r.abs ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        have := congrArg AzNat.toNat h
        rw [AzNat.toNat_zero, hrabs] at this
        exact hn0' this
      rw [toVal_finishUnpacked_overflow s r t hr0 (by omega)]
      have hbig : (2 : ℝ) ^ (1024 : ℤ) ≤ |(R : ℝ) * σ| :=
        (zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega : (1024 : ℤ) ≤ e.toInt - 1)).trans hvlo
      cases s with
      | true =>
        have hpos : 0 < (R : ℝ) * σ := hsgn.mpr rfl
        rw [abs_of_pos hpos] at hbig
        rw [ite_eq_left hbig]; rfl
      | false =>
        have hneg : (R : ℝ) * σ < 0 := by
          have := hsgn.not.mpr (by decide); push Not at this
          exact lt_of_le_of_ne this (fun h => by
            rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
            · exact hR0 (by exact_mod_cast h)
            · exact hσ.ne' h)
        rw [abs_of_neg hneg] at hbig
        have h2p : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (1024 : ℤ) := zpow_pos h2 _
        rw [ite_eq_right (not_le.mpr (hneg.trans h2p)), ite_eq_left (le_neg.mp hbig)]
        rfl
    · push Not at hov
      have hlt : |(R : ℝ) * σ| < (2 : ℝ) ^ (1024 : ℤ) :=
        hvhi.trans_le (zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega))
      have hno : t.toInt + (if r.abs.toNat = 2 ^ 53 then 1 else 0) ≤ 971 := by
        rw [ite_eq_right (by rw [hrabs]; omega), ht]; omega
      rw [toVal_finishUnpacked s r t .Nearest (by rw [hrabs]; omega) hsign hno, hval]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2'⟩ := abs_lt.mp hlt
      rw [ite_eq_right (not_le.mpr h2'), ite_eq_right (not_le.mpr h1)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.unpack_emulateFinish
statement:
theorem unpack_emulateFinish (r : AzFloat × Ordering) :
    (emulateFinish r).toModel.unpack = toUnpackedTernary r.1 r.2
proof:
:= by
  unfold emulateFinish
  rw [show (Float.ofModel (Float.Model.pack (toUnpackedTernary r.1 r.2))).toModel
    = Float.Model.pack (toUnpackedTernary r.1 r.2) from rfl,
    model_unpack_pack _ (toUnpackedTernary_binary64 _ _)]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundBinary64Val_none
statement: @[simp] theorem roundBinary64Val_none : roundBinary64Val none = none
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzFloat.roundBinary64Val_coe
statement:
theorem roundBinary64Val_coe (v : ℝ) :
    roundBinary64Val (some (v : EReal)) = some (roundBinary64 v)
proof:
:= by
  show (if (v : EReal) = ⊤ then some ⊤ else if (v : EReal) = ⊥ then some ⊥
    else some (roundBinary64 (v : EReal).toReal)) = _
  rw [ite_eq_right (EReal.coe_ne_top v), ite_eq_right (EReal.coe_ne_bot v), EReal.toReal_coe]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_emulateFinish_roundVal
statement:
theorem toVal_emulateFinish_roundVal (w : Option EReal) :
    (emulateFinish (roundVal 53 .Nearest w)).toModel.unpack.toVal = roundBinary64Val w
proof:
:= by
  rw [unpack_emulateFinish]
  cases w with
  | none => rfl
  | some e =>
    induction e using EReal.rec with
    | bot =>
      rw [roundVal_of_toVal 53 .Nearest (infinity false) ⊥ (Or.inr rfl) rfl]
      show (toUnpackedTernary (infinity false) .eq).toVal
        = (if (⊥ : EReal) = ⊤ then some ⊤ else if (⊥ : EReal) = ⊥ then some ⊥
          else some (roundBinary64 (⊥ : EReal).toReal))
      rw [ite_eq_right bot_ne_top, ite_eq_left rfl]
      simp [toUnpackedTernary, UnpackedFloat.toVal, signOfBool]
    | coe v => rw [roundBinary64Val_coe]; exact toVal_toUnpackedTernary_roundVal v
    | top =>
      rw [roundVal_of_toVal 53 .Nearest (infinity true) ⊤ (Or.inr rfl) rfl]
      show (toUnpackedTernary (infinity true) .eq).toVal
        = (if (⊤ : EReal) = ⊤ then some ⊤ else if (⊤ : EReal) = ⊥ then some ⊥
          else some (roundBinary64 (⊤ : EReal).toReal))
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
      simp [toUnpackedTernary, UnpackedFloat.toVal, signOfBool]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_emulate
statement:
theorem toVal_emulate (g : AzFloat → ℕ → RoundingMode → AzFloat × Ordering)
    (f : EReal → Option EReal) (hg : ∀ x, g x 53 .Nearest = liftVal f x 53 .Nearest)
    (x : Float) :
    (emulate g x).toModel.unpack.toVal = roundBinary64Val (x.toModel.unpack.toVal.bind f)
proof:
:= by
  unfold emulate
  rw [hg, liftVal, toVal_emulateFinish_roundVal, toVal_ofFloat64]

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_emulate₂
statement:
theorem toVal_emulate₂ (g : AzFloat → AzFloat → ℕ → RoundingMode → AzFloat × Ordering)

          y.toModel.unpack.toVal.bind fun b => f a b)

    (g : AzFloat → AzFloat → AzFloat → ℕ → RoundingMode → AzFloat × Ordering)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.toVal_emulate₄
statement:
theorem toVal_emulate₄
    (g : AzFloat → AzFloat → AzFloat → AzFloat → ℕ → RoundingMode →
      AzFloat × Ordering)
    (f : EReal → EReal → EReal → EReal → Option EReal)

name: Azurite.AzFloat.Spec.rsqrt_coe
statement:

    rsqrt (r : EReal) = some (((Real.sqrt r)⁻¹ : ℝ) : EReal)
proof:
:= by

  rw [ite_eq_right (not_lt.mpr (EReal.coe_nonneg.mpr hr.le)),
    ite_eq_right (fun h => hr.ne' (EReal.coe_eq_zero.mp h)), ite_eq_right (EReal.coe_ne_top r),
