  exact rename_isPrenex e (AtomRename.renameEquiv e) h

name: Azurite.renameFormulaEquiv_isNNF
statement:
theorem renameFormulaEquiv_isNNF [AtomRename α σ] (e : σ ≃ σ)
    {Φ : Formula σ α} (h : IsNNF Φ) : IsNNF (renameFormulaEquiv e Φ)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | atom a => exact .atom _
  | and _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact .and ih₁ ih₂
  | or _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact .or ih₁ ih₂
  | exists_ x _ ih => exact .exists_ (e x) ih
  | forall_ x _ ih => exact .forall_ (e x) ih

name: Azurite.isQF_quantifierDepth_zero
statement:
theorem isQF_quantifierDepth_zero {Φ : Formula σ α} (h : Φ.IsQuantifierFree) :
    Φ.quantifierDepth = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction Φ with
  | atom => rfl
  | not _ ih => exact ih h
  | and _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => simp [quantifierDepth, ih₁ h.1, ih₂ h.2]
  | or _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => simp [quantifierDepth, ih₁ h.1, ih₂ h.2]
  | implies _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => simp [quantifierDepth, ih₁ h.1, ih₂ h.2]
  | exists_ => exact absurd h (by simp [IsQuantifierFree])
  | forall_ => exact absurd h (by simp [IsQuantifierFree])

name: Azurite.mergePrenex_isPrenex
statement:
theorem mergePrenex_isPrenex [DecidableEq σ] [AtomRename α σ]
    (op : Formula σ α → Formula σ α → Formula σ α)
    (hop : ∀ Φ₁ Φ₂, Φ₁.IsQuantifierFree → Φ₂.IsQuantifierFree →
      (op Φ₁ Φ₂).IsQuantifierFree)
    (left right : Formula σ α) (fv : List σ)
    (hl : IsPrenex left) (hr : IsPrenex right)
    (hlen : left.quantifierDepth + right.quantifierDepth ≤ fv.length) :
    IsPrenex (mergePrenex op left right fv).1
proof:
:= by
  induction left, right, fv using mergePrenex.induct op with
  | case1 x body right fresh rest =>
    simp only [mergePrenex]; apply IsPrenex.exists_
    rename_i body' _ _ _ ih
    have hbody := by cases hl with
      | exists_ h => exact h
      | qf h => exact absurd h (by simp [IsQuantifierFree])
    refine ih (renameFormulaEquiv_isPrenex _ hbody) hr ?_
    show (renameFormulaEquiv _ body).quantifierDepth + _ ≤ _
    rw [renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth]
    simp [quantifierDepth, List.length_cons] at hlen; omega
  | case2 x body right fresh rest =>
    simp only [mergePrenex]; apply IsPrenex.forall_
    rename_i body' _ _ _ ih
    have hbody := by cases hl with
      | forall_ h => exact h
      | qf h => exact absurd h (by simp [IsQuantifierFree])
    refine ih (renameFormulaEquiv_isPrenex _ hbody) hr ?_
    show (renameFormulaEquiv _ body).quantifierDepth + _ ≤ _
    rw [renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth]
    simp [quantifierDepth, List.length_cons] at hlen; omega
  | case3 left y body fresh rest h_not_ex h_not_all h_qd_eq =>
    simp only [mergePrenex, h_qd_eq, ↓reduceIte]; apply IsPrenex.exists_
    rename_i body' _ _ _ ih
    have hbody := by cases hr with
      | exists_ h => exact h
      | qf h => exact absurd h (by simp [IsQuantifierFree])
    refine ih hl (renameFormulaEquiv_isPrenex _ hbody) ?_
    show left.quantifierDepth + (renameFormulaEquiv _ body).quantifierDepth ≤ _
    rw [renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth]
    simp [quantifierDepth, List.length_cons, h_qd_eq] at hlen; omega
  | case4 left y body fresh rest h_not_ex h_not_all h_qd =>
    exfalso; apply h_qd
    cases hl with
    | qf h => exact isQF_quantifierDepth_zero h
    | exists_ h => exact absurd rfl (h_not_ex _ _)
    | forall_ h => exact absurd rfl (h_not_all _ _)
  | case5 left y body fresh rest h_not_ex h_not_all h_qd_eq =>
    simp only [mergePrenex, h_qd_eq, ↓reduceIte]; apply IsPrenex.forall_
    rename_i body' _ _ _ ih
    have hbody := by cases hr with
      | forall_ h => exact h
      | qf h => exact absurd h (by simp [IsQuantifierFree])
    refine ih hl (renameFormulaEquiv_isPrenex _ hbody) ?_
    show left.quantifierDepth + (renameFormulaEquiv _ body).quantifierDepth ≤ _
    rw [renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth]
    simp [quantifierDepth, List.length_cons, h_qd_eq] at hlen; omega
  | case6 left y body fresh rest h_not_ex h_not_all h_qd =>
    exfalso; apply h_qd
    cases hl with
    | qf h => exact isQF_quantifierDepth_zero h
    | exists_ h => exact absurd rfl (h_not_ex _ _)
    | forall_ h => exact absurd rfl (h_not_all _ _)
  | case7 =>
    simp only [mergePrenex]
    apply IsPrenex.qf; apply hop
    · rename_i fv h_nexl h_nall h_nexr h_nforr
      cases hl with
      | qf h => exact h
      | exists_ h =>
        exfalso
        cases fv with
        | nil => simp [quantifierDepth] at hlen
        | cons f r => exact h_nexl _ _ _ _ rfl rfl
      | forall_ h =>
        exfalso
        cases fv with
        | nil => simp [quantifierDepth] at hlen
        | cons f r => exact h_nall _ _ _ _ rfl rfl
    · rename_i fv h_nexl h_nall h_nexr h_nforr
      cases hr with
      | qf h => exact h
      | exists_ h =>
        exfalso
        cases fv with
        | nil => simp [quantifierDepth] at hlen
        | cons f r => exact h_nexr _ _ _ _ rfl rfl
      | forall_ h =>
        exfalso
        cases fv with
        | nil => simp [quantifierDepth] at hlen
        | cons f r => exact h_nforr _ _ _ _ rfl rfl

name: Azurite.mergePrenex_snd_length
statement:
theorem mergePrenex_snd_length [DecidableEq σ] [AtomRename α σ]
    (op : Formula σ α → Formula σ α → Formula σ α)
    (left right : Formula σ α) (fv : List σ)
    (hlen : left.quantifierDepth + right.quantifierDepth ≤ fv.length)
    (hl : left.IsPrenex) (hr : right.IsPrenex) :
    (mergePrenex op left right fv).2.length +
      left.quantifierDepth + right.quantifierDepth = fv.length
proof:
:= by
  induction left, right, fv using mergePrenex.induct (op := op) with
  | case1 x body right fresh rest =>
    simp only [mergePrenex, quantifierDepth, List.length_cons] at hlen ⊢
    rename_i body' _ _ _ ih
    have hbody : body.IsPrenex := by cases hl with
      | exists_ h => exact h | qf h => exact absurd h (by simp [IsQuantifierFree])
    have h_ih := ih (by
      show (renameFormulaEquiv _ body).quantifierDepth + _ ≤ _
      rw [renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth]; omega)
      (renameFormulaEquiv_isPrenex _ hbody) hr
    rw [show body' = renameFormulaEquiv _ body from rfl,
        renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth] at h_ih
    omega
  | case2 x body right fresh rest =>
    simp only [mergePrenex, quantifierDepth, List.length_cons] at hlen ⊢
    rename_i body' _ _ _ ih
    have hbody : body.IsPrenex := by cases hl with
      | forall_ h => exact h | qf h => exact absurd h (by simp [IsQuantifierFree])
    have h_ih := ih (by
      show (renameFormulaEquiv _ body).quantifierDepth + _ ≤ _
      rw [renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth]; omega)
      (renameFormulaEquiv_isPrenex _ hbody) hr
    rw [show body' = renameFormulaEquiv _ body from rfl,
        renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth] at h_ih
    omega
  | case3 left y body fresh rest h_not_ex h_not_all h_qd_eq =>
    simp only [mergePrenex, h_qd_eq, ↓reduceIte, quantifierDepth, List.length_cons] at hlen ⊢
    rename_i body' _ _ _ ih
    have hbody : body.IsPrenex := by cases hr with
      | exists_ h => exact h | qf h => exact absurd h (by simp [IsQuantifierFree])
    have h_ih := ih (by
      show _ + (renameFormulaEquiv _ body).quantifierDepth ≤ _
      rw [renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth]; omega)
      hl (renameFormulaEquiv_isPrenex _ hbody)
    rw [show body' = renameFormulaEquiv _ body from rfl,
        renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth] at h_ih
    omega
  | case4 left y body fresh rest h_not_ex h_not_all h_qd =>
    
    exfalso; apply h_qd
    cases hl with
    | qf h => exact isQF_quantifierDepth_zero h
    | exists_ h => exact absurd rfl (h_not_ex _ _)
    | forall_ h => exact absurd rfl (h_not_all _ _)
  | case5 left y body fresh rest h_not_ex h_not_all h_qd_eq =>
    simp only [mergePrenex, h_qd_eq, ↓reduceIte, quantifierDepth, List.length_cons] at hlen ⊢
    rename_i body' _ _ _ ih
    have hbody : body.IsPrenex := by cases hr with
      | forall_ h => exact h | qf h => exact absurd h (by simp [IsQuantifierFree])
    have h_ih := ih (by
      show _ + (renameFormulaEquiv _ body).quantifierDepth ≤ _
      rw [renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth]; omega)
      hl (renameFormulaEquiv_isPrenex _ hbody)
    rw [show body' = renameFormulaEquiv _ body from rfl,
        renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth] at h_ih
    omega
  | case6 left y body fresh rest h_not_ex h_not_all h_qd =>
    exfalso; apply h_qd
    cases hl with
    | qf h => exact isQF_quantifierDepth_zero h
    | exists_ h => exact absurd rfl (h_not_ex _ _)
    | forall_ h => exact absurd rfl (h_not_all _ _)
  | case7 =>
    simp only [mergePrenex]
    
    rename_i left right fv h_nexl h_nall h_nexr h_nforr
    have hql : left.quantifierDepth = 0 := by
      cases hl with
      | qf h => exact isQF_quantifierDepth_zero h
      | exists_ h =>
        cases fv with
        | nil => simp [quantifierDepth] at hlen
        | cons f r => exact absurd rfl (h_nexl _ _ _ _ rfl)
      | forall_ h =>
        cases fv with
        | nil => simp [quantifierDepth] at hlen
        | cons f r => exact absurd rfl (h_nall _ _ _ _ rfl)
    have hqr : right.quantifierDepth = 0 := by
      cases hr with
      | qf h => exact isQF_quantifierDepth_zero h
      | exists_ h =>
        cases fv with
        | nil => simp [quantifierDepth] at hlen
        | cons f r => exact absurd rfl (h_nexr _ _ _ _ rfl)
      | forall_ h =>
        cases fv with
        | nil => simp [quantifierDepth] at hlen
        | cons f r => exact absurd rfl (h_nforr _ _ _ _ rfl)
    omega

name: Azurite.mergePrenex_fst_quantifierDepth
statement:
theorem mergePrenex_fst_quantifierDepth [DecidableEq σ] [AtomRename α σ]
    (op : Formula σ α → Formula σ α → Formula σ α)
    (hop : ∀ Φ₁ Φ₂ : Formula σ α, (op Φ₁ Φ₂).quantifierDepth =
      Φ₁.quantifierDepth + Φ₂.quantifierDepth)
    (left right : Formula σ α) (fv : List σ) :
    (mergePrenex op left right fv).1.quantifierDepth =
      left.quantifierDepth + right.quantifierDepth
proof:
:= by
  induction left, right, fv using mergePrenex.induct (op := op) with
  | case1 x body right fresh rest =>
    simp only [mergePrenex, quantifierDepth]
    rename_i body' _ _ _ ih
    rw [ih, show body' = renameFormulaEquiv _ body from rfl,
        renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth]; omega
  | case2 x body right fresh rest =>
    simp only [mergePrenex, quantifierDepth]
    rename_i body' _ _ _ ih
    rw [ih, show body' = renameFormulaEquiv _ body from rfl,
        renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth]; omega
  | case3 left y body fresh rest h_not_ex h_not_all h_qd_eq =>
    simp only [mergePrenex, h_qd_eq, ↓reduceIte, quantifierDepth]
    rename_i body' _ _ _ ih
    rw [ih, show body' = renameFormulaEquiv _ body from rfl,
        renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth]; omega
  | case4 left y body fresh rest h_not_ex h_not_all h_qd =>
    simp only [mergePrenex, ite_eq_right h_qd, hop, quantifierDepth]
  | case5 left y body fresh rest h_not_ex h_not_all h_qd_eq =>
    simp only [mergePrenex, h_qd_eq, ↓reduceIte, quantifierDepth]
    rename_i body' _ _ _ ih
    rw [ih, show body' = renameFormulaEquiv _ body from rfl,
        renameFormulaEquiv_quantifierDepth]; omega
  | case6 left y body fresh rest h_not_ex h_not_all h_qd =>
    simp only [mergePrenex, ite_eq_right h_qd, hop, quantifierDepth]
  | case7 => simp only [mergePrenex, hop]

name: Azurite.toPrenexNNF_properties
statement:
theorem toPrenexNNF_properties [DecidableEq σ] [AtomRename α σ]
    (Φ : Formula σ α) (fv : List σ) (hnnf : IsNNF Φ)
    (hlen : freshVarsNeeded Φ ≤ fv.length) :
    (toPrenexNNF Φ fv).1.quantifierDepth = Φ.quantifierDepth ∧
    (toPrenexNNF Φ fv).2.length + freshVarsNeeded Φ = fv.length ∧
    IsPrenex (toPrenexNNF Φ fv).1
proof:
:= by
  induction Φ generalizing fv with
  | atom _ => exact ⟨rfl, by simp [toPrenexNNF, freshVarsNeeded], .qf trivial⟩
  | not _ _ => cases hnnf
  | exists_ x Φ ih =>
    have hnnf' : IsNNF Φ := by cases hnnf with | exists_ _ h => exact h
    simp only [toPrenexNNF, freshVarsNeeded] at hlen ⊢
    have ⟨hqd, hsnd, hpre⟩ := ih fv hnnf' hlen
    exact ⟨by simp [quantifierDepth, hqd], hsnd, .exists_ hpre⟩
  | forall_ x Φ ih =>
    have hnnf' : IsNNF Φ := by cases hnnf with | forall_ _ h => exact h
    simp only [toPrenexNNF, freshVarsNeeded] at hlen ⊢
    have ⟨hqd, hsnd, hpre⟩ := ih fv hnnf' hlen
    exact ⟨by simp [quantifierDepth, hqd], hsnd, .forall_ hpre⟩
  | and Φ₁ Φ₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    have ⟨hnnf1, hnnf2⟩ : IsNNF Φ₁ ∧ IsNNF Φ₂ := by cases hnnf with | and a b => exact ⟨a, b⟩
    simp only [toPrenexNNF, freshVarsNeeded] at hlen ⊢
    have ⟨hqd₁, hl₁, hp₁⟩ := ih₁ fv hnnf1 (by omega)
    have ⟨hqd₂, hl₂, hp₂⟩ := ih₂ (toPrenexNNF Φ₁ fv).2 hnnf2 (by omega)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [mergePrenex_fst_quantifierDepth _ (by intros; simp [quantifierDepth]),
          hqd₁, hqd₂]; simp [quantifierDepth]
    · have h₃ := mergePrenex_snd_length .and (toPrenexNNF Φ₁ fv).1
        (toPrenexNNF Φ₂ (toPrenexNNF Φ₁ fv).2).1
        (toPrenexNNF Φ₂ (toPrenexNNF Φ₁ fv).2).2
        (by rw [hqd₁, hqd₂]; omega) hp₁ hp₂
      rw [hqd₁, hqd₂] at h₃; omega
    · exact mergePrenex_isPrenex .and (fun _ _ a b => ⟨a, b⟩) _ _ _
        hp₁ hp₂ (by rw [hqd₁, hqd₂]; omega)
  | or Φ₁ Φ₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    have ⟨hnnf1, hnnf2⟩ : IsNNF Φ₁ ∧ IsNNF Φ₂ := by cases hnnf with | or a b => exact ⟨a, b⟩
    simp only [toPrenexNNF, freshVarsNeeded] at hlen ⊢
    have ⟨hqd₁, hl₁, hp₁⟩ := ih₁ fv hnnf1 (by omega)
    have ⟨hqd₂, hl₂, hp₂⟩ := ih₂ (toPrenexNNF Φ₁ fv).2 hnnf2 (by omega)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [mergePrenex_fst_quantifierDepth _ (by intros; simp [quantifierDepth]),
          hqd₁, hqd₂]; simp [quantifierDepth]
    · have h₃ := mergePrenex_snd_length .or (toPrenexNNF Φ₁ fv).1
        (toPrenexNNF Φ₂ (toPrenexNNF Φ₁ fv).2).1
        (toPrenexNNF Φ₂ (toPrenexNNF Φ₁ fv).2).2
        (by rw [hqd₁, hqd₂]; omega) hp₁ hp₂
      rw [hqd₁, hqd₂] at h₃; omega
    · exact mergePrenex_isPrenex .or (fun _ _ a b => ⟨a, b⟩) _ _ _
        hp₁ hp₂ (by rw [hqd₁, hqd₂]; omega)
  | implies _ _ _ _ => cases hnnf

name: Azurite.toPrenexNNF_isPrenex
statement:
theorem toPrenexNNF_isPrenex [DecidableEq σ] [AtomRename α σ]
    (Φ : Formula σ α) (fv : List σ) (hnnf : IsNNF Φ)
    (hlen : freshVarsNeeded Φ ≤ fv.length) :
    IsPrenex (toPrenexNNF Φ fv).1
proof:
:=
  (toPrenexNNF_properties Φ fv hnnf hlen).2.2

name: Azurite.rename_isNNF
statement:
theorem rename_isNNF {τ : Type*} {β : Type*} (f : σ → τ) (ra : α → β)
    {Φ : Formula σ α} (h : IsNNF Φ) : IsNNF (Φ.rename f ra)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | atom a => exact .atom (ra a)
  | and _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact .and ih₁ ih₂
  | or _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact .or ih₁ ih₂
  | exists_ x _ ih => exact .exists_ (f x) ih
  | forall_ x _ ih => exact .forall_ (f x) ih

name: Azurite.rename_freshVarsNeeded
statement:
theorem rename_freshVarsNeeded {τ : Type*} {β : Type*} (f : σ → τ) (ra : α → β)
    (Φ : Formula σ α) :
    freshVarsNeeded (Φ.rename f ra) = freshVarsNeeded Φ
proof:
:= by
  induction Φ with
  | atom _ => simp [Formula.rename, freshVarsNeeded]
  | not _ ih => simp [Formula.rename, freshVarsNeeded, ih]
  | exists_ _ _ ih => simp [Formula.rename, freshVarsNeeded, ih]
  | forall_ _ _ ih => simp [Formula.rename, freshVarsNeeded, ih]
  | and _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => simp [Formula.rename, freshVarsNeeded, ih₁, ih₂,
    Formula.rename_quantifierDepth]
  | or _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => simp [Formula.rename, freshVarsNeeded, ih₁, ih₂,
    Formula.rename_quantifierDepth]
  | implies _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => simp [Formula.rename, freshVarsNeeded, ih₁, ih₂]

name: Azurite.toPrenex_isPrenex
statement:
theorem toPrenex_isPrenex
    {n : ℕ} {R' : Type*} [Semiring R']
    {ord' : MonomialOrder}
    (Φ : Formula (Fin n) (AzFieldAtom n R' ord')) :
    IsPrenex (toPrenex Φ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold toPrenex
  apply (toPrenexNNF_properties _ _ _ _).2.2
  · exact rename_isNNF _ _ (toNNF_isNNF Φ)
  · rw [rename_freshVarsNeeded]
    simp [freshVars, List.length_map, List.length_finRange]

name: Azurite.toPrenex_azRealization
statement:
theorem toPrenex_azRealization
    {n : ℕ} {R' : Type*} [CommRing R']
    [NoZeroDivisors R'] [DecidableEq R'] {ord' : MonomialOrder}
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra R' K]
    (Φ : Formula (Fin n) (AzFieldAtom n R' ord')) :
    azRealization (C := K) (toPrenex Φ) =
      (· ∘ Fin.castLE (Nat.le_add_right n (freshVarsNeeded (toNNF Φ)))) ⁻¹'
        azRealization (C := K) Φ
proof:
:= by
  
  set fvn := freshVarsNeeded (toNNF Φ)
  set m := n + fvn
  set h_le : n ≤ m := Nat.le_add_right n fvn
  set nnf := toNNF Φ with hnnf
  set embedded : Formula (Fin m) (AzFieldAtom m R' ord') :=
    nnf.rename (Fin.castLE h_le)
    (AzFieldAtom.renameVarsMonotone (Fin.castLE h_le)
      (fun _ _ hab => hab)) with hemb
  set fv := freshVars m n fvn (le_refl m) with hfv

  
  rw [show toPrenex Φ = (toPrenexNNF embedded fv).1 from rfl]
  rw [← gRealization_eq_azRealization]

  
  rw [toPrenexNNF_gRealization embedded fv
    (freshVars_fresh m n fvn (le_refl m) embedded
      (allVarsOf_rename_embed_bound h_le nnf))
    (freshVars_nodup m n fvn (le_refl m))
    (fun e a => azFieldAtom_rename_vars e a)]

  
  rw [gRealization_eq_azRealization]
  rw [azRealization_rename (Fin.castLE h_le)
    (Fin.castLE_injective h_le)
    (fun _ _ hab => hab) nnf]

  
  rw [hnnf]
  congr 1
  rw [← gRealization_eq_azRealization, ← gRealization_eq_azRealization,
    toNNF_gRealization]

name: Azurite.AzRat.div_eq_mul_inv
statement: theorem div_eq_mul_inv (x y : AzRat) : x / y = x * y⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  show AzRat.div x y = AzRat.mul x (AzRat.inv y)
  by_cases hx : x.num = 0
  · by_cases hy : y.num = 0
    · rw [AzRat.div, dite_eq_left hx, AzRat.inv, dite_eq_left hy, AzRat.mul, dite_eq_left hx]
    · rw [AzRat.div, dite_eq_left hx, AzRat.inv, dite_eq_right hy, AzRat.mul, dite_eq_left hx]
  · by_cases hy : y.num = 0
    · rw [AzRat.div, dite_eq_right hx, dite_eq_left hy, AzRat.inv, dite_eq_left hy, AzRat.mul,
          dite_eq_right hx, dite_eq_left (show (0 : AzRat).num = 0 from rfl)]
    · rw [AzRat.div, dite_eq_right hx, dite_eq_right hy, AzRat.inv, dite_eq_right hy, AzRat.mul,
          dite_eq_right hx, dite_eq_right (show ¬((⟨y.sign, y.den, y.num, hy,
            fun h => absurd h y.den_nz,
            (AzNat.coprime_iff _ _).mpr ((AzNat.coprime_iff _ _).mp y.reduced).symm⟩ :
              AzRat).num = 0) from y.den_nz)]

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_div
statement: @[simp] theorem toRat_div (x y : AzRat) : toRat (x / y) = toRat x / toRat y
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, toRat_mul, toRat_inv, _root_.div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Azurite.AzRat.ofRat_div
statement: @[simp] theorem ofRat_div (r s : ℚ) : ofRat (r / s) = ofRat r / ofRat s
proof:
:=
  toRat_injective (by rw [toRat_ofRat, toRat_div, toRat_ofRat, toRat_ofRat])

name: Azurite.AzRat.ringEquivRat_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem ringEquivRat_apply (q : AzRat) : ringEquivRat q = q.toRat
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.ringEquivRat_symm_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem ringEquivRat_symm_apply (r : ℚ) : ringEquivRat.symm r = ofRat r

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRatRingHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem toRatRingHom_apply (q : AzRat) : toRatRingHom q = q.toRat

statement:
@[simp] theorem orderRingIsoRat_symm_apply (r : ℚ) :

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_pow
statement: @[simp] theorem toRat_pow (q : AzRat) (n : ℕ) : toRat (q.pow n) = toRat q ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [toRat_eq_divInt, toRat_eq_divInt q]
  have hsign : (q.pow n).sign = (q.sign || (n % 2 == 0)) := rfl
  have hnum : ((q.pow n).num.toNat : ℤ) = (q.num.toNat : ℤ) ^ n := by
    show ((q.num.pow n).toNat : ℤ) = _
    rw [AzNat.toNat_pow]; push_cast; ring
  have hden : ((q.pow n).den.toNat : ℤ) = (q.den.toNat : ℤ) ^ n := by
    show ((q.den.pow n).toNat : ℤ) = _
    rw [AzNat.toNat_pow]; push_cast; ring
  rw [hsign, hnum, hden]
  cases hs : q.sign
  · 
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with he | ho
    · rw [show (false || (n % 2 == 0)) = true by simp [Nat.even_iff.mp he],
        ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true,
        Rat.divInt_eq_div, Rat.divInt_eq_div, div_pow]
      push_cast [Even.neg_pow he]; ring
    · rw [show (false || (n % 2 == 0)) = false by simp [Nat.odd_iff.mp ho],
        ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true, ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true,
        Rat.divInt_eq_div, Rat.divInt_eq_div, div_pow]
      push_cast [Odd.neg_pow ho]; ring
  · 
    rw [show (true || (n % 2 == 0)) = true from rfl, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left rfl,
      Rat.divInt_eq_div, Rat.divInt_eq_div, div_pow]
    push_cast; ring

name: Azurite.AzRat.ofRat_pow
statement: @[simp] theorem ofRat_pow (r : ℚ) (n : ℕ) : (ofRat r).pow n = ofRat (r ^ n)
proof:
:=
  toRat_injective (by rw [toRat_pow, toRat_ofRat, toRat_ofRat])

name: Azurite.AzRat.zpow_negSucc
statement:
theorem zpow_negSucc (q : AzRat) (n : ℕ) :
    q.zpow (Int.negSucc n) = (q.pow (n + 1))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  show q.zpow (Int.negSucc n) = AzRat.inv (q.pow (n + 1))
  by_cases h : q.num = 0
  · have hp : (q.pow (n + 1)).num = 0 := by
      show q.num.pow (n + 1) = 0
      rw [h]
      exact AzNat.toNat_injective (by
        rw [AzNat.toNat_pow, AzNat.toNat_zero, Nat.zero_pow (Nat.succ_pos n)])
    simp only [AzRat.zpow]
    rw [dite_eq_left h, AzRat.inv, dite_eq_left hp]
  · have hp : (q.pow (n + 1)).num ≠ 0 := fun h0 => by
      have h1 := congrArg AzNat.toNat (show q.num.pow (n + 1) = 0 from h0)
      rw [AzNat.toNat_pow, AzNat.toNat_zero] at h1
      exact h (AzNat.toNat_injective (by
        rw [(Nat.pow_eq_zero.mp h1).1, AzNat.toNat_zero]))
    simp only [AzRat.zpow]
    rw [dite_eq_right h, AzRat.inv, dite_eq_right hp]
    rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_zpow
statement: @[simp] theorem toRat_zpow (q : AzRat) (z : ℤ) : toRat (q.zpow z) = toRat q ^ z
proof:
:= by
  cases z with
  | ofNat n =>
    show toRat (q.pow n) = _
    rw [toRat_pow, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast]
  | negSucc n =>
    rw [zpow_negSucc, toRat_inv, toRat_pow, _root_.zpow_negSucc]

name: Azurite.AzRat.ofRat_zpow
statement: @[simp] theorem ofRat_zpow (r : ℚ) (z : ℤ) : (ofRat r).zpow z = ofRat (r ^ z)
proof:
:=
  toRat_injective (by rw [toRat_zpow, toRat_ofRat, toRat_ofRat])

statement: @[simp] theorem toRat_zero : toRat (0 : AzRat) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_one
statement: @[simp] theorem toRat_one : toRat (1 : AzRat) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.default_eq_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem default_eq_zero : (default : AzRat) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.ofRat_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem ofRat_zero : ofRat 0 = 0

  toRat_injective (by rw [toRat_ofRat, toRat_zero])

name: Azurite.AzRat.ofRat_one
statement: @[simp] theorem ofRat_one : ofRat 1 = 1

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_ofSignAzNats
statement:
theorem toRat_ofSignAzNats (s : Bool) (n d : AzNat) :
    toRat (ofSignAzNats s n d) =
      (if s then 1 else -1) * ((n.toNat : ℚ) / (d.toNat : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · simp [ofSignAzNats, hd]
  · by_cases hn : n = 0
    · simp [ofSignAzNats, hd, hn]
    · 
      have hd' : d.toNat ≠ 0 :=
        fun h => hd (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm))
      have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd n.toNat d.toNat :=
        Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd')
      have hgQ : (Nat.gcd n.toNat d.toNat : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hg)
      rw [ofSignAzNats, dite_eq_right hd, dite_eq_right hn]
      rw [toRat, Rat.mk_eq_divInt, Rat.divInt_eq_div]
      simp only [AzNat.toNat_div, AzNat.toNat_gcd]
      cases s with
      | true =>
        rw [ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left rfl]
        simp only [Int.cast_natCast]
        rw [Rat.natCast_div _ _ (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _),
            Rat.natCast_div _ _ (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _),
            div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hgQ, one_mul]
      | false =>
        rw [ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true, ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true]
        simp only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]
        rw [Rat.natCast_div _ _ (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _),
            Rat.natCast_div _ _ (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _),
            neg_div, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hgQ, neg_one_mul]

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_ofAzNats
statement:
theorem toRat_ofAzNats (n d : AzNat) :
    toRat (ofAzNats n d) = (n.toNat : ℚ) / (d.toNat : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofAzNats, toRat_ofSignAzNats]
  simp

name: Azurite.AzRat.ofSignAzNats_self
statement: theorem ofSignAzNats_self (q : AzRat) : ofSignAzNats q.sign q.num q.den = q
proof:
:= by
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime q.num.toNat q.den.toNat := (AzNat.coprime_iff _ _).mp q.reduced
  rw [ofSignAzNats, dite_eq_right q.den_nz]
  by_cases hn : q.num = 0
  · rw [dite_eq_left hn]
    
    
    have hsign : q.sign = true := q.zero_sign hn
    have hden : q.den = 1 := by
      apply AzNat.toNat_injective
      rw [AzNat.toNat_one]
      have h0 : q.num.toNat = 0 := by rw [hn, AzNat.toNat_zero]
      rw [h0] at hcop
      exact Nat.coprime_zero_left _ |>.mp hcop
    exact AzRat.ext hsign.symm hn.symm hden.symm
  · rw [dite_eq_right hn]
    have hg1 : Nat.gcd q.num.toNat q.den.toNat = 1 := hcop
    refine AzRat.ext rfl ?_ ?_
    · apply AzNat.toNat_injective
      rw [AzNat.toNat_div, AzNat.toNat_gcd, hg1, Nat.div_one]
    · apply AzNat.toNat_injective
      rw [AzNat.toNat_div, AzNat.toNat_gcd, hg1, Nat.div_one]

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_ofAzInts
statement:
theorem toRat_ofAzInts (n d : AzInt) :
    toRat (ofAzInts n d) = (n.toInt : ℚ) / (d.toInt : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofAzInts, toRat_ofSignAzNats]
  cases hn : n.sign <;> cases hd : d.sign <;>
    simp [AzInt.toInt, hn, hd, neg_div, div_neg, neg_neg]

name: Azurite.AzRat.combineSigned_int_spec
statement:
theorem combineSigned_int_spec (sx sy : Bool) (u v : AzNat) :
    (if (combineSigned sx sy u v).1 then ((combineSigned sx sy u v).2.toNat : ℤ)
     else -((combineSigned sx sy u v).2.toNat : ℤ))
    = (if sx then (u.toNat : ℤ) else -(u.toNat : ℤ))
      + (if sy then (v.toNat : ℤ) else -(v.toNat : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  unfold combineSigned
  cases sx <;> cases sy
  · 
    rw [ite_eq_left (show ((false : Bool) == false) = true by decide)]
    dsimp only
    rw [ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true, ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true,
        ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true, AzNat.toNat_add]
    push_cast
    ring
  · 
    rw [ite_eq_right (show ¬(((false : Bool) == true) = true) by decide)]
    have hc := AzNat.compare_eq_compare_toNat u v
    rcases hcc : AzNat.compare u v with _ | _ | _ <;> rw [hcc] at hc
    · 
      have hlt : u.toNat < v.toNat := compare_lt_iff_lt.mp hc.symm
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true, ite_eq_left rfl, AzNat.toNat_sub,
          Int.ofNat_sub (Nat.le_of_lt hlt)]
      ring
    · 
      have heq : u.toNat = v.toNat := compare_eq_iff_eq.mp hc.symm
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true, ite_eq_left rfl, AzNat.toNat_zero, heq]
      push_cast
      ring
    · 
      have hgt : v.toNat < u.toNat := compare_gt_iff_gt.mp hc.symm
      rw [ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true, ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true, ite_eq_left rfl,
          AzNat.toNat_sub, Int.ofNat_sub (Nat.le_of_lt hgt)]
      ring
  · 
    rw [ite_eq_right (show ¬(((true : Bool) == false) = true) by decide)]
    have hc := AzNat.compare_eq_compare_toNat u v
    rcases hcc : AzNat.compare u v with _ | _ | _ <;> rw [hcc] at hc
    · 
      have hlt : u.toNat < v.toNat := compare_lt_iff_lt.mp hc.symm
      rw [ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true,
          AzNat.toNat_sub, Int.ofNat_sub (Nat.le_of_lt hlt)]
      ring
    · 
      have heq : u.toNat = v.toNat := compare_eq_iff_eq.mp hc.symm
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true, AzNat.toNat_zero, heq]
      push_cast
      ring
    · 
      have hgt : v.toNat < u.toNat := compare_gt_iff_gt.mp hc.symm
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true, AzNat.toNat_sub,
          Int.ofNat_sub (Nat.le_of_lt hgt)]
      ring
  · 
    rw [ite_eq_left (show ((true : Bool) == true) = true by decide)]
    dsimp only
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left rfl, AzNat.toNat_add]
    push_cast
    ring

name: Azurite.AzRat.ite_neg_mul
statement:
private lemma ite_neg_mul {P : Prop} [Decidable P] (a k : ℤ) :
    (if P then a * k else -(a * k)) = (if P then a else -a) * k
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_add
statement: @[simp] theorem toRat_add (x y : AzRat) : toRat (x + y) = toRat x + toRat y
proof:
:= by
  show toRat (AzRat.add x y) = _
  by_cases hx : x.num = 0
  · rw [AzRat.add, dite_eq_left hx, toRat_of_num_zero x hx, zero_add]
  by_cases hy : y.num = 0
  · rw [AzRat.add, dite_eq_right hx, dite_eq_left hy, toRat_of_num_zero y hy, add_zero]
  have hxdN : x.den.toNat ≠ 0 :=
    fun h => x.den_nz (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm))
  have hydN : y.den.toNat ≠ 0 :=
    fun h => y.den_nz (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm))
  rw [AzRat.add, dite_eq_right hx, dite_eq_right hy, toRat_eq_divInt x, toRat_eq_divInt y,
      Rat.divInt_add_divInt _ _ (Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr hxdN)
        (Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr hydN)]
  by_cases hg : AzNat.gcd x.den y.den = 1
  · 
    rw [dite_eq_left hg]
    have hspec := combineSigned_int_spec x.sign y.sign (x.num * y.den) (x.den * y.num)
    rw [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_mul] at hspec
    simp only [Nat.cast_mul] at hspec
    rw [mul_comm ((x.den.toNat : ℤ)) ((y.num.toNat : ℤ)), ite_neg_mul, ite_neg_mul]
      at hspec
    by_cases hm : (combineSigned x.sign y.sign (x.num * y.den) (x.den * y.num)).2 = 0
    · rw [dite_eq_left hm, toRat_zero]
      rw [hm, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hspec
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, ite_self] at hspec
      symm
      rw [show ((if x.sign = true then (x.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(x.num.toNat : ℤ)) *
            (y.den.toNat : ℤ) +
            (if y.sign = true then (y.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(y.num.toNat : ℤ)) *
            (x.den.toNat : ℤ)) = (0 : ℤ) from by linear_combination -hspec,
          Rat.zero_divInt]
    · rw [dite_eq_right hm, toRat_eq_divInt]
      dsimp only
      have hz1 : (((x.den * y.den).toNat : ℤ)) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [AzNat.toNat_mul]
        exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_ne_zero hxdN hydN
      have hz2 : ((x.den.toNat : ℤ)) * (y.den.toNat : ℤ) ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero (Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr hxdN) (Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr hydN)
      rw [Rat.divInt_eq_divInt_iff hz1 hz2]
      simp only [AzNat.toNat_mul, Nat.cast_mul]
      linear_combination ((x.den.toNat : ℤ) * (y.den.toNat : ℤ)) * hspec
  · 
    rw [dite_eq_right hg]
    have hspec := combineSigned_int_spec x.sign y.sign
      (x.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den))
      (x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den * y.num)
    rw [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_div, AzNat.toNat_div,
        AzNat.toNat_gcd] at hspec
    simp only [Nat.cast_mul] at hspec
    rw [mul_comm ((x.den.toNat / Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ)
          ((y.num.toNat : ℤ)), ite_neg_mul, ite_neg_mul] at hspec
    have hGpos : 0 < Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat :=
      Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hxdN)
    have hBs : (x.den.toNat : ℤ) =
        ↑(x.den.toNat / Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat) *
          ↑(Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)).symm
    have hDs : (y.den.toNat : ℤ) =
        ↑(y.den.toNat / Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat) *
          ↑(Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)).symm
    by_cases hm : (combineSigned x.sign y.sign
        (x.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den))
        (x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den * y.num)).2 = 0
    · rw [dite_eq_left hm, toRat_zero]
      rw [hm, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hspec
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, ite_self] at hspec
      symm
      rw [show ((if x.sign = true then (x.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(x.num.toNat : ℤ)) *
            (y.den.toNat : ℤ) +
            (if y.sign = true then (y.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(y.num.toNat : ℤ)) *
            (x.den.toNat : ℤ)) = (0 : ℤ) from by
              rw [hBs, hDs]
              linear_combination (-(↑(Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat) : ℤ)) * hspec,
          Rat.zero_divInt]
    · rw [dite_eq_right hm, toRat_eq_divInt]
      dsimp only
      have hg2pos : 0 < Nat.gcd (combineSigned x.sign y.sign
          (x.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den))
          (x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den * y.num)).2.toNat
          (Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat) :=
        Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ hGpos
      have hz1 : ((x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den *
          (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den *
            (AzNat.gcd x.den y.den / AzNat.gcd (combineSigned x.sign y.sign
              (x.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den))
              (x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den * y.num)).2
              (AzNat.gcd x.den y.den)))).toNat : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
        simp only [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_div, AzNat.toNat_gcd]
        have hb : 0 < x.den.toNat / Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat :=
          Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hxdN)
            (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)) hGpos
        have hd : 0 < y.den.toNat / Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat :=
          Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hydN)
            (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)) hGpos
        have hw : 0 < Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat /
            Nat.gcd (combineSigned x.sign y.sign
              (x.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den))
              (x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den * y.num)).2.toNat
              (Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat) :=
          Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hGpos (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)) hg2pos
        exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.mul_pos hb (Nat.mul_pos hd hw))
      have hz2 : ((x.den.toNat : ℤ)) * (y.den.toNat : ℤ) ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero (Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr hxdN) (Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr hydN)
      rw [Rat.divInt_eq_divInt_iff hz1 hz2]
      simp only [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_div, AzNat.toNat_gcd, Nat.cast_mul]
      have hMs : ((combineSigned x.sign y.sign
          (x.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den))
          (x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den * y.num)).2.toNat : ℤ) =
          ↑((combineSigned x.sign y.sign
            (x.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den))
            (x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den * y.num)).2.toNat /
            Nat.gcd (combineSigned x.sign y.sign
              (x.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den))
              (x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den * y.num)).2.toNat
              (Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat)) *
          ↑(Nat.gcd (combineSigned x.sign y.sign
            (x.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den))
            (x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den * y.num)).2.toNat
            (Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat)) := by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)).symm
      have hGs : ((Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat : ℤ)) =
          ↑(Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat /
            Nat.gcd (combineSigned x.sign y.sign
              (x.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den))
              (x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den * y.num)).2.toNat
              (Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat)) *
          ↑(Nat.gcd (combineSigned x.sign y.sign
            (x.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den))
            (x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den * y.num)).2.toNat
            (Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat)) := by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)).symm
      rw [hMs, ite_neg_mul] at hspec
      rw [hBs, hDs, hGs]
      linear_combination
        ((↑(x.den.toNat / Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat) : ℤ) *
          ↑(y.den.toNat / Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat) *
          ↑(Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat /
            Nat.gcd (combineSigned x.sign y.sign
              (x.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den))
              (x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den * y.num)).2.toNat
              (Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat)) *
          ↑(Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat /
            Nat.gcd (combineSigned x.sign y.sign
              (x.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den))
              (x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den * y.num)).2.toNat
              (Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat)) *
          ↑(Nat.gcd (combineSigned x.sign y.sign
            (x.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den))
            (x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.den * y.num)).2.toNat
            (Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.den.toNat))) * hspec

name: Azurite.AzRat.ofRat_add
statement: @[simp] theorem ofRat_add (r s : ℚ) : ofRat (r + s) = ofRat r + ofRat s
proof:
:=
  toRat_injective (by rw [toRat_ofRat, toRat_add, toRat_ofRat, toRat_ofRat])

name: Azurite.round_den_pos
statement: private lemma round_den_pos (q : AzRat) : 0 < (q.den.toAzInt).abs.toNat
proof:
:= by
  show 0 < q.den.toNat
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q.den.toNat with h | h
  · exact absurd (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm)) q.den_nz
  · exact h

name: Azurite.round_ratio_eq
proof:
:= by
  
  have hnumI : (mkNorm q.sign q.num).toInt = (AzRat.toRat q).num := by
    have hrfl : (AzRat.toRat q).num
        = if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℤ) := rfl
    rw [hrfl]
    cases hs : q.sign with
    | false =>
      have hnz : q.num ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        have hsig := q.zero_sign h
        rw [hs] at hsig
        exact absurd hsig (by decide)
      rw [AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_false q.num hnz]; simp
    | true => rw [AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true q.num]; simp
  
  have hdenI : (q.den.toAzInt).toInt = ((AzRat.toRat q).den : ℤ) := by
    rw [Azurite.AzNat.toInt_toAzInt]; rfl
  rw [hnumI, hdenI, Rat.cast_def, Int.cast_natCast]

name: Azurite.AzRat.toInt_round
statement:
theorem AzRat.toInt_round (q : AzRat) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    (((q.round mode).1.toInt : ℝ) : EReal) =
      (RoundingTarget.round intSet mode ((AzRat.toRat q : ℚ) : ℝ)).val
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzRat.round
  rw [AzInt.toInt_divRound (mkNorm q.sign q.num) q.den.toAzInt mode (round_den_pos q),
      round_ratio_eq q]

name: Azurite.AzRat.snd_round
statement:
theorem AzRat.snd_round (q : AzRat) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    (q.round mode).2 =
      compare (((q.round mode).1.toInt : ℤ) : ℝ) ((AzRat.toRat q : ℚ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzRat.round
  rw [AzInt.snd_divRound (mkNorm q.sign q.num) q.den.toAzInt mode (round_den_pos q),
      round_ratio_eq q]

name: Azurite.AzRat.size_bounds
statement:
private lemma size_bounds (N : ℕ) (hN : N > 0) :
    ((Nat.size N - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ logb 2 (N : ℝ) ∧ logb 2 (N : ℝ) < (Nat.size N : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hl1 : 2 ^ (Nat.size N - 1) ≤ N := Nat.lt_size.mp (Nat.pred_lt (Nat.size_pos.mpr hN).ne')
  have hl2 : N < 2 ^ Nat.size N := Nat.size_le.mp (le_refl _)
  have h_base : (1 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN
  constructor
  · have hcast1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.size N - 1) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hl1
    have h_pow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.size N - 1) := by positivity
    have hlog1 : logb 2 ((2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.size N - 1)) ≤ logb 2 (N : ℝ) :=
      (logb_le_logb h_base h_pow_pos hN_pos).mpr hcast1
    have h_simp : logb 2 ((2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.size N - 1)) = ((Nat.size N - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [logb_pow, logb_self_eq_one h_base, mul_one]
    rwa [h_simp] at hlog1
  · have hcast2 : (N : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ Nat.size N := by exact_mod_cast hl2
    have hN_pow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ Nat.size N := by positivity
    have hlog2 : logb 2 (N : ℝ) < logb 2 ((2 : ℝ) ^ Nat.size N) :=
      (logb_lt_logb_iff h_base hN_pos hN_pow_pos).mpr hcast2
    have h_simp : logb 2 ((2 : ℝ) ^ Nat.size N) = (Nat.size N : ℝ) := by
      rw [logb_pow, logb_self_eq_one h_base, mul_one]
    rwa [h_simp] at hlog2

name: Azurite.AzRat.normalizedCompare_eq_realFrac
proof:
:= by
  rw [AzNat.normalizedCompare_eq_cross x y hx hy]
  have hsx : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ x.size := by positivity
  have hsy : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ y.size := by positivity
  have ordNat : Ord.compare (x.toNat * 2 ^ y.size) (y.toNat * 2 ^ x.size) =
      if x.toNat * 2 ^ y.size < y.toNat * 2 ^ x.size then Ordering.lt
      else if x.toNat * 2 ^ y.size = y.toNat * 2 ^ x.size then Ordering.eq
      else Ordering.gt := rfl
  rw [ordNat]
  rcases lt_trichotomy (x.toNat * 2 ^ y.size) (y.toNat * 2 ^ x.size) with h | h | h
  · rw [ite_eq_left h]
    have hf : (x.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ x.size < (y.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ y.size := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hsx hsy]; exact_mod_cast h
    exact (compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr hf).symm
  · rw [ite_eq_right (by omega), ite_eq_left h]
    have hf : (x.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ x.size = (y.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ y.size := by
      rw [div_eq_div_iff hsx.ne' hsy.ne']; exact_mod_cast h
    exact (compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr hf).symm
  · rw [ite_eq_right (by omega), ite_eq_right (by omega)]
    have hf : (y.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ y.size < (x.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ x.size := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hsy hsx]; exact_mod_cast h
    exact (compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr hf).symm

name: Azurite.AzRat.logb_frac
statement:
private lemma logb_frac (x : AzNat) (hx : 0 < x.toNat) :
    logb 2 ((x.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ x.size) = logb 2 (x.toNat : ℝ) - (x.size : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (1 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  have hxr : (x.toNat : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hx.ne'
  rw [logb_div hxr (by positivity), logb_pow, logb_self_eq_one hb, mul_one]

name: Azurite.AzRat.logb_diff_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (1 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  have hpx : (0 : ℝ) < (x.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ x.size := div_pos (by exact_mod_cast hx) (by positivity)
  have hpy : (0 : ℝ) < (y.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ y.size := div_pos (by exact_mod_cast hy) (by positivity)
  have hc := normalizedCompare_eq_realFrac x y hx hy
  rw [h] at hc
  have hf : (x.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ x.size < (y.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ y.size := compare_lt_iff_lt.mp hc.symm
  have := (logb_lt_logb_iff hb hpx hpy).mpr hf
  rw [logb_frac x hx, logb_frac y hy] at this
  linarith

name: Azurite.AzRat.logb_diff_ge
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (1 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  have hpx : (0 : ℝ) < (x.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ x.size := div_pos (by exact_mod_cast hx) (by positivity)
  have hpy : (0 : ℝ) < (y.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ y.size := div_pos (by exact_mod_cast hy) (by positivity)
  have hc := normalizedCompare_eq_realFrac x y hx hy
  have hcne : compare ((x.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ x.size) ((y.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ y.size) ≠ Ordering.lt :=
    hc ▸ h
  have hf : (y.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ y.size ≤ (x.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ x.size :=
    not_lt.mp (fun hlt => hcne (compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr hlt))
  have := (logb_le_logb hb hpy hpx).mpr hf
  rw [logb_frac x hx, logb_frac y hy] at this
  linarith

name: Azurite.AzRat.logb_diff_gt
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (1 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  have hpx : (0 : ℝ) < (x.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ x.size := div_pos (by exact_mod_cast hx) (by positivity)
  have hpy : (0 : ℝ) < (y.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ y.size := div_pos (by exact_mod_cast hy) (by positivity)
  have hc := normalizedCompare_eq_realFrac x y hx hy
  rw [h] at hc
  have hf : (y.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ y.size < (x.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ x.size := compare_gt_iff_gt.mp hc.symm
  have := (logb_lt_logb_iff hb hpy hpx).mpr hf
  rw [logb_frac x hx, logb_frac y hy] at this
  linarith

name: Azurite.AzRat.logb_diff_le
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (1 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  have hpx : (0 : ℝ) < (x.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ x.size := div_pos (by exact_mod_cast hx) (by positivity)
  have hpy : (0 : ℝ) < (y.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ y.size := div_pos (by exact_mod_cast hy) (by positivity)
  have hc := normalizedCompare_eq_realFrac x y hx hy
  have hcne : compare ((x.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ x.size) ((y.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ y.size) ≠ Ordering.gt :=
    hc ▸ h
  have hf : (x.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ x.size ≤ (y.toNat : ℝ) / 2 ^ y.size :=
    not_lt.mp (fun hlt => hcne (compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr hlt))
  have := (logb_le_logb hb hpx hpy).mpr hf
  rw [logb_frac x hx, logb_frac y hy] at this
  linarith

name: Azurite.AzRat.logb_abs_setup
proof:
:= by
  have hN : 0 < q.num.toNat :=
    Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => hq (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm)))
  have hD : 0 < q.den.toNat :=
    Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => q.den_nz (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm)))
  refine ⟨hN, hD, ?_⟩
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < q.num.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hD_pos : (0 : ℝ) < q.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hD
  have hnum : (AzRat.toRat q).num = if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℤ) := rfl
  have hden : (AzRat.toRat q).den = q.den.toNat := rfl
  have h_abs : |(AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)| = (q.num.toNat : ℝ) / (q.den.toNat : ℝ) := by
    rw [Rat.cast_def, abs_div, hnum, hden]
    congr 1
    · cases q.sign <;> push_cast <;> simp
    · exact abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)
  rw [h_abs, logb_div hN_pos.ne' hD_pos.ne']

name: Azurite.AzRat.floorLogBase2Abs_eq
statement:
lemma floorLogBase2Abs_eq (q : AzRat) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) :
    floorLogBase2Abs q = ⌊logb 2 |(AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|⌋
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hN, hD, h_log_div⟩ := logb_abs_setup q hq
  have h_exp : (floorLogBase2Abs q : ℝ) =
      if AzNat.normalizedCompare q.num q.den == Ordering.lt then
        (q.num.size : ℝ) - (q.den.size : ℝ) - 1
      else
        (q.num.size : ℝ) - (q.den.size : ℝ) := by
    unfold floorLogBase2Abs
    split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> ring
  have h_floor_iff : ⌊logb 2 |(AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|⌋ = floorLogBase2Abs q ↔
      (floorLogBase2Abs q : ℝ) ≤ logb 2 |(AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)| ∧
        logb 2 |(AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)| < (floorLogBase2Abs q : ℝ) + 1 :=
    Int.floor_eq_iff (z := floorLogBase2Abs q) (a := logb 2 |(AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|)
  rw [eq_comm, h_floor_iff, h_exp, h_log_div]
  have h_sizeN := size_bounds q.num.toNat hN
  have h_sizeD := size_bounds q.den.toNat hD
  rw [AzNat.size_toNat q.num] at h_sizeN
  rw [AzNat.size_toNat q.den] at h_sizeD
  have hsN1 : 1 ≤ q.num.size := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat]; exact Nat.size_pos.mpr hN
  have hsD1 : 1 ≤ q.den.size := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat]; exact Nat.size_pos.mpr hD
  have hcastN : ((q.num.size - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (q.num.size : ℝ) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hsN1, Nat.cast_one]
  have hcastD : ((q.den.size - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (q.den.size : ℝ) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hsD1, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [hcastN] at h_sizeN
  rw [hcastD] at h_sizeD
  split_ifs with h_lt
  · rw [beq_iff_eq] at h_lt
    have h_cmp := logb_diff_lt q.num q.den hN hD h_lt
    exact ⟨by linarith [h_sizeN.1, h_sizeD.2], by linarith [h_cmp]⟩
  · have h_lt_ne : AzNat.normalizedCompare q.num q.den ≠ Ordering.lt := by
      intro hc; rw [hc] at h_lt; simp at h_lt
    have h_cmp := logb_diff_ge q.num q.den hN hD h_lt_ne
    exact ⟨by linarith [h_cmp], by linarith [h_sizeN.2, h_sizeD.1]⟩

name: Azurite.AzRat.ceilingLogBase2Abs_eq
statement:
lemma ceilingLogBase2Abs_eq (q : AzRat) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) :
    ceilingLogBase2Abs q = ⌈logb 2 |(AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|⌉
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hN, hD, h_log_div⟩ := logb_abs_setup q hq
  have h_exp : (ceilingLogBase2Abs q : ℝ) =
      if AzNat.normalizedCompare q.num q.den == Ordering.gt then
        (q.num.size : ℝ) - (q.den.size : ℝ) + 1
      else
        (q.num.size : ℝ) - (q.den.size : ℝ) := by
    unfold ceilingLogBase2Abs
    split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> ring
  have h_ceil_iff : ⌈logb 2 |(AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|⌉ = ceilingLogBase2Abs q ↔
      (ceilingLogBase2Abs q : ℝ) - 1 < logb 2 |(AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)| ∧
        logb 2 |(AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)| ≤ (ceilingLogBase2Abs q : ℝ) :=
    Int.ceil_eq_iff (z := ceilingLogBase2Abs q) (a := logb 2 |(AzRat.toRat q : ℝ)|)
  rw [eq_comm, h_ceil_iff, h_exp, h_log_div]
  have h_sizeN := size_bounds q.num.toNat hN
  have h_sizeD := size_bounds q.den.toNat hD
  rw [AzNat.size_toNat q.num] at h_sizeN
  rw [AzNat.size_toNat q.den] at h_sizeD
  have hsN1 : 1 ≤ q.num.size := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat]; exact Nat.size_pos.mpr hN
  have hsD1 : 1 ≤ q.den.size := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat]; exact Nat.size_pos.mpr hD
  have hcastN : ((q.num.size - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (q.num.size : ℝ) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hsN1, Nat.cast_one]
  have hcastD : ((q.den.size - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (q.den.size : ℝ) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hsD1, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [hcastN] at h_sizeN
  rw [hcastD] at h_sizeD
  split_ifs with h_gt
  · rw [beq_iff_eq] at h_gt
    have h_cmp := logb_diff_gt q.num q.den hN hD h_gt
    exact ⟨by linarith [h_cmp], by linarith [h_sizeN.2, h_sizeD.1]⟩
  · have h_gt_ne : AzNat.normalizedCompare q.num q.den ≠ Ordering.gt := by
      intro hc; rw [hc] at h_gt; simp at h_gt
    have h_cmp := logb_diff_le q.num q.den hN hD h_gt_ne
    exact ⟨by linarith [h_sizeN.1, h_sizeD.2], by linarith [h_cmp]⟩

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_cast_eq
statement:
theorem toRat_cast_eq (q : AzRat) :
    (toRat q : ℝ) = (((if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℝ)
      / (q.den.toNat : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rat.cast_def]
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.toInt_toAzInt'
statement: theorem toInt_toAzInt' (n : AzNat) : n.toAzInt.toInt = n.toNat
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_of_isPowerOfTwo
statement:
theorem toRat_of_isPowerOfTwo (q : AzRat) (h : q.isPowerOfTwo = true) :
    (toRat q : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ q.powerOfTwoExponent.toInt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hs, ⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩ := (isPowerOfTwo_iff q).mp h
  have hsa : q.num.size = a + 1 := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, ha, Nat.size_pow]
  have hsb : q.den.size = b + 1 := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, hb, Nat.size_pow]
  rw [toRat_cast_eq, hs, ha, hb, powerOfTwoExponent, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt',
    toInt_toAzInt', AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, hsa, hsb]
  simp only [↓reduceIte]
  push_cast
  rw [show ((a : ℤ) + 1 - ((b : ℤ) + 1)) = (a : ℤ) - b by ring, zpow_sub₀ (by norm_num),
    zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]

name: Azurite.AzRat.isPowerOfTwo_of_toRat_eq_zpow
statement:
theorem isPowerOfTwo_of_toRat_eq_zpow (q : AzRat) (j : ℤ) (h : (toRat q : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ j) :
    q.isPowerOfTwo = true ∧ q.powerOfTwoExponent.toInt = j
proof:
:= by
  have h2pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ j := zpow_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < q.den.toNat := by
    have : q.den.toNat ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
      q.den_nz (AzNat.toNat_injective (by rw [h0, AzNat.toNat_zero]))
    exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero this
  have hs : q.sign = true := by
    by_contra hs
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hs
    rw [toRat_cast_eq, hs] at h
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast] at h
    have : -(q.num.toNat : ℝ) / q.den.toNat ≤ 0 :=
      div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) hden.le
    linarith
  rw [toRat_cast_eq, hs] at h
  simp only [↓reduceIte, Int.cast_natCast] at h
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime q.num.toNat q.den.toNat := (AzNat.coprime_iff _ _).mp q.reduced
  have hexp : q.powerOfTwoExponent.toInt = (q.num.size : ℤ) - q.den.size := by
    rw [powerOfTwoExponent, AzInt.toInt_sub, toInt_toAzInt', toInt_toAzInt', AzNat.toNat_ofNat,
      AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
  rcases le_or_gt 0 j with hj | hj
  · have hnum : q.num.toNat = q.den.toNat * 2 ^ j.toNat := by
      have : (q.num.toNat : ℝ) = q.den.toNat * 2 ^ j.toNat := by
        rw [div_eq_iff hden.ne'] at h
        rw [h, ← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hj]
        ring
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hden1 : q.den.toNat = 1 := Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes hcop ⟨_, hnum⟩ (dvd_refl _)
    rw [hden1, one_mul] at hnum
    have hsn : q.num.size = j.toNat + 1 := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, hnum, Nat.size_pow]
    have hsd : q.den.size = 1 := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, hden1, Nat.size_one]
    refine ⟨(isPowerOfTwo_iff q).mpr
      ⟨hs, ⟨j.toNat, hnum⟩, ⟨0, by rw [hden1, pow_zero]⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hexp, hsn, hsd]
    omega
  · have hden' : q.den.toNat = q.num.toNat * 2 ^ (-j).toNat := by
      have : (q.den.toNat : ℝ) = q.num.toNat * 2 ^ (-j).toNat := by
        rw [div_eq_iff hden.ne'] at h
        rw [← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega), h, mul_comm ((2 : ℝ) ^ j),
          mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero,
          mul_one]
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hnum1 : q.num.toNat = 1 :=
      Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes hcop.symm ⟨_, hden'⟩ (dvd_refl _)
    rw [hnum1, one_mul] at hden'
    have hsd : q.den.size = (-j).toNat + 1 := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, hden', Nat.size_pow]
    have hsn : q.num.size = 1 := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, hnum1, Nat.size_one]
    refine ⟨(isPowerOfTwo_iff q).mpr
      ⟨hs, ⟨0, by rw [hnum1, pow_zero]⟩, ⟨(-j).toNat, hden'⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hexp, hsn, hsd]
    omega

name: Azurite.AzRat.checkedLogBase2_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem checkedLogBase2_eq_some_iff (q : AzRat) (k : AzInt) :
    q.checkedLogBase2 = some k ↔ (toRat q : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ k.toInt
proof:
:= by
  unfold checkedLogBase2
  constructor
  · intro h
    split_ifs at h with hp
    · simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
      rw [← h]
      exact toRat_of_isPowerOfTwo q hp
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨hp, he⟩ := isPowerOfTwo_of_toRat_eq_zpow q k.toInt h
    rw [ite_eq_left hp, Option.some.injEq]
    rw [← AzInt.ofInt_toInt k, ← AzInt.ofInt_toInt q.powerOfTwoExponent, he]

name: Azurite.AzRat.checkedLogBase2_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem checkedLogBase2_eq_none_iff (q : AzRat) :
    q.checkedLogBase2 = none ↔ ∀ j : ℤ, (toRat q : ℝ) ≠ (2 : ℝ) ^ j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h j hj
    obtain ⟨hp, -⟩ := isPowerOfTwo_of_toRat_eq_zpow q j hj
    unfold checkedLogBase2 at h
    rw [ite_eq_left hp] at h
    cases h
  · intro h
    unfold checkedLogBase2
    rw [ite_eq_right]
    intro hp
    exact h _ (toRat_of_isPowerOfTwo q hp)

name: Azurite.AzRat.isPowerOfTwo_eq_false_of_checkedLogBase2_eq_none
statement:
theorem isPowerOfTwo_eq_false_of_checkedLogBase2_eq_none (q : AzRat)
    (h : q.checkedLogBase2 = none) : q.isPowerOfTwo = false
proof:
:= by
  unfold checkedLogBase2 at h
  by_contra hp
  rw [Bool.not_eq_false] at hp
  rw [ite_eq_left hp] at h
  cases h

name: Azurite.AzRat.checkedLogBase2_eq_some
statement:
theorem checkedLogBase2_eq_some (q : AzRat) (k : AzInt) (h : q.checkedLogBase2 = some k) :
    q.isPowerOfTwo = true ∧ k = q.powerOfTwoExponent
proof:
:= by
  unfold checkedLogBase2 at h
  split_ifs at h with hp
  · exact ⟨hp, (Option.some.inj h).symm⟩

name: Azurite.AzRat.mul3_lt_of_le
statement:
theorem mul3_lt_of_le {a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ : ℕ} (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂) (ha₃ : 0 < a₃)
    (h₁ : a₁ ≤ b₁) (h₂ : a₂ ≤ b₂) (h₃ : a₃ ≤ b₃) (hs : a₁ < b₁ ∨ a₂ < b₂ ∨ a₃ < b₃) :
    a₁ * a₂ * a₃ < b₁ * b₂ * b₃
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs with h | h | h
  · calc a₁ * a₂ * a₃ < b₁ * a₂ * a₃ :=
          Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h ha₂) ha₃
      _ ≤ b₁ * b₂ * b₃ := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul le_rfl h₂) h₃
  · calc a₁ * a₂ * a₃ < a₁ * b₂ * a₃ :=
          Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h ha₁) ha₃
      _ ≤ b₁ * b₂ * b₃ := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul h₁ le_rfl) h₃
  · calc a₁ * a₂ * a₃ < a₁ * a₂ * b₃ := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h (Nat.mul_pos ha₁ ha₂)
      _ ≤ b₁ * b₂ * b₃ := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul h₁ h₂) le_rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.screen3_spec
statement:
theorem screen3_spec {a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ : ℕ} (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂) (ha₃ : 0 < a₃)
    (hb₁ : 0 < b₁) (hb₂ : 0 < b₂) (hb₃ : 0 < b₃) {o : Ordering}
    (h : screen3 (Ord.compare a₁ b₁) (Ord.compare a₂ b₂) (Ord.compare a₃ b₃) = some o) :
    Ord.compare (a₁ * a₂ * a₃) (b₁ * b₂ * b₃) = o
proof:
:= by
  unfold screen3 at h
  split_ifs at h with hle hall hge
  · obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, e₃⟩ := hall
    rw [compare_Nat_eq_iff] at e₁ e₂ e₃
    rw [Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [← h, e₁, e₂, e₃, compare_Nat_eq_iff]
  · obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, l₃⟩ := hle
    rw [Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [← h, compare_Nat_lt_iff]
    have h₁ : a₁ ≤ b₁ := not_lt.mp (fun hlt => l₁ ((compare_Nat_gt_iff _ _).mpr hlt))
    have h₂ : a₂ ≤ b₂ := not_lt.mp (fun hlt => l₂ ((compare_Nat_gt_iff _ _).mpr hlt))
    have h₃ : a₃ ≤ b₃ := not_lt.mp (fun hlt => l₃ ((compare_Nat_gt_iff _ _).mpr hlt))
    apply mul3_lt_of_le ha₁ ha₂ ha₃ h₁ h₂ h₃
    by_contra hns
    push Not at hns
    apply hall
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [compare_Nat_eq_iff] <;> omega
  · obtain ⟨g₁, g₂, g₃⟩ := hge
    rw [Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [← h, compare_Nat_gt_iff]
    have h₁ : b₁ ≤ a₁ := not_lt.mp (fun hlt => g₁ ((compare_Nat_lt_iff _ _).mpr hlt))
    have h₂ : b₂ ≤ a₂ := not_lt.mp (fun hlt => g₂ ((compare_Nat_lt_iff _ _).mpr hlt))
    have h₃ : b₃ ≤ a₃ := not_lt.mp (fun hlt => g₃ ((compare_Nat_lt_iff _ _).mpr hlt))
    apply mul3_lt_of_le hb₁ hb₂ hb₃ h₁ h₂ h₃
    by_contra hns
    push Not at hns
    apply hle
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro hg <;> rw [compare_Nat_gt_iff] at hg <;> omega

name: Azurite.AzRat.mul3_lt_of_size
statement:
theorem mul3_lt_of_size {a₁ a₂ a₃ b₁ b₂ b₃ : ℕ} (hb₁ : 0 < b₁) (hb₂ : 0 < b₂) (hb₃ : 0 < b₃)
    (h : a₁.size + a₂.size + a₃.size + 3 ≤ b₁.size + b₂.size + b₃.size) :
    a₁ * a₂ * a₃ < b₁ * b₂ * b₃
proof:
:= by
  have hs₁ := Nat.size_pos.mpr hb₁
  have hs₂ := Nat.size_pos.mpr hb₂
  have hs₃ := Nat.size_pos.mpr hb₃
  calc a₁ * a₂ * a₃ < 2 ^ a₁.size * 2 ^ a₂.size * 2 ^ a₃.size := by
        apply Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le _ (Nat.lt_size_self a₃).le (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
        exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_size_self a₁) (Nat.lt_size_self a₂).le
          (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
    _ = 2 ^ (a₁.size + a₂.size + a₃.size) := by rw [pow_add, pow_add]
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (b₁.size - 1 + (b₂.size - 1) + (b₃.size - 1)) :=
        Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    _ = 2 ^ (b₁.size - 1) * 2 ^ (b₂.size - 1) * 2 ^ (b₃.size - 1) := by rw [pow_add, pow_add]
    _ ≤ b₁ * b₂ * b₃ :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul (two_pow_size_sub_one_le hb₁) (two_pow_size_sub_one_le hb₂))
          (two_pow_size_sub_one_le hb₃)

name: Azurite.AzRat.compareProductMag_eq
statement:
theorem compareProductMag_eq (nx dx ny dy nz dz : AzNat) (hnx : 0 < nx.toNat)
    (hdx : 0 < dx.toNat) (hny : 0 < ny.toNat) (hdy : 0 < dy.toNat) (hnz : 0 < nz.toNat)
    (hdz : 0 < dz.toNat) :
    compareProductMag nx dx ny dy nz dz
      = Ord.compare (nx.toNat * ny.toNat * dz.toNat) (nz.toNat * (dx.toNat * dy.toNat))
proof:
:= by
  unfold compareProductMag
  simp only [AzNat.compare_eq_compare_toNat, ← AzNat.size_toNat]
  split_ifs with hs hs'
  · symm; rw [compare_Nat_gt_iff]
    have := mul3_lt_of_size (a₁ := nz.toNat) (a₂ := dx.toNat) (a₃ := dy.toNat)
      hnx hny hdz (by omega)
    rw [mul_assoc nz.toNat] at this
    exact this
  · symm; rw [compare_Nat_lt_iff]
    have := mul3_lt_of_size (a₁ := nx.toNat) (a₂ := ny.toNat) (a₃ := dz.toNat)
      hnz hdx hdy (by omega)
    rw [mul_assoc nz.toNat] at this
    exact this
  split
  · rename_i o h
    rw [← screen3_spec hnx hny hdz hdx hdy hnz h]
    congr 1
    ring
  · split
    · rename_i o h
      rw [← screen3_spec hnx hny hdz hnz hdy hdx h]
      congr 1
      ring
    · split
      · rename_i o h
        rw [← screen3_spec hnx hny hdz hdx hnz hdy h]
        congr 1
        ring
      · rw [AzNat.compareProducts_eq, AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_mul,
          mul_comm (dx.toNat * dy.toNat)]

name: Azurite.AzRat.compare_div
statement:
theorem compare_div (A C B D : ℤ) (hB : 0 < B) (hD : 0 < D) :
    Ord.compare ((A : ℚ) / (B : ℚ)) ((C : ℚ) / (D : ℚ)) = Ord.compare (A * D) (C * B)
proof:
:= by
  have hB' : (0 : ℚ) < B := by exact_mod_cast hB
  have hD' : (0 : ℚ) < D := by exact_mod_cast hD
  rcases h : Ord.compare (A * D) (C * B) with _ | _ | _
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt] at h
    rw [compare_lt_iff_lt, div_lt_iff₀ hB', div_mul_eq_mul_div, lt_div_iff₀ hD']
    exact_mod_cast h
  · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq] at h
    rw [compare_eq_iff_eq, div_eq_div_iff hB'.ne' hD'.ne']
    exact_mod_cast h
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt] at h
    rw [compare_gt_iff_gt, div_lt_iff₀ hD', div_mul_eq_mul_div, lt_div_iff₀ hB']
    exact_mod_cast h

name: Azurite.AzRat.signed_mul_natCast
statement:
theorem signed_mul_natCast (s : Bool) (P E : ℕ) :
    (if s then (P : ℤ) else -(P : ℤ)) * (E : ℤ)
      = if s then ((P * E : ℕ) : ℤ) else -((P * E : ℕ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> simp [Nat.cast_mul]

name: Azurite.AzRat.compareProduct_eq
statement:
theorem compareProduct_eq (x y z : AzRat) :
    compareProduct x y z = Ord.compare (toRat x * toRat y) (toRat z)
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨xs, nx, dx, hdx, _, _⟩
  rcases y with ⟨ys, ny, dy, hdy, _, _⟩
  rcases z with ⟨zs, nz, dz, hdz, _, _⟩
  have hdx' : 0 < dx.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => hdx ((AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat dx).mpr h))
  have hdy' : 0 < dy.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => hdy ((AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat dy).mpr h))
  have hdz' : 0 < dz.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => hdz ((AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat dz).mpr h))
  unfold compareProduct
  dsimp only
  rw [toRat_eq_divInt, toRat_eq_divInt, toRat_eq_divInt]
  dsimp only
  rw [Rat.divInt_mul_divInt, Rat.divInt_eq_div, Rat.divInt_eq_div, ← Nat.cast_mul,
    compare_div _ _ _ _ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_pos hdx' hdy') (by exact_mod_cast hdz'),
    AzInt.toInt_mul_signed, signed_mul_natCast, signed_mul_natCast, AzInt.compare_signed]
  simp only [AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat, Nat.mul_eq_zero, hdx'.ne', hdy'.ne', hdz'.ne', or_false]
  split_ifs
  all_goals first
    | rfl
    | rw [compareProductMag_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) hdx' (by omega) hdy' (by omega) hdz']

name: Azurite.AzRat.le_iff_toRat_le
statement: lemma le_iff_toRat_le (q r : AzRat) : q ≤ r ↔ toRat q ≤ toRat r
proof:
:= by
  change cmp q r ≠ Ordering.gt ↔ toRat q ≤ toRat r
  rw [cmp_eq_compare]
  exact compare_le_iff_le

name: Azurite.AzRat.lt_iff_toRat_lt
statement: lemma lt_iff_toRat_lt (q r : AzRat) : q < r ↔ toRat q < toRat r
proof:
:= by
  change cmp q r = Ordering.lt ↔ toRat q < toRat r
  rw [cmp_eq_compare]
  exact compare_lt_iff_lt

name: Azurite.AzRat.le_refl
statement: lemma le_refl (q : AzRat) : q ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_toRat_le]

name: Azurite.AzRat.le_trans
statement: lemma le_trans (q r s : AzRat) (h1 : q ≤ r) (h2 : r ≤ s) : q ≤ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_toRat_le] at *
  exact _root_.le_trans h1 h2

name: Azurite.AzRat.le_antisymm
statement: lemma le_antisymm (q r : AzRat) (h1 : q ≤ r) (h2 : r ≤ q) : q = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_toRat_le] at *
  exact toRat_injective (_root_.le_antisymm h1 h2)

name: Azurite.AzRat.le_total
statement: lemma le_total (q r : AzRat) : q ≤ r ∨ r ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_toRat_le, le_iff_toRat_le]
  exact _root_.le_total (toRat q) (toRat r)

name: Azurite.AzRat.lt_iff_le_not_ge
statement: lemma lt_iff_le_not_ge (q r : AzRat) : q < r ↔ q ≤ r ∧ ¬ r ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_iff_toRat_lt, le_iff_toRat_le, le_iff_toRat_le]
  exact _root_.lt_iff_le_not_ge

name: Azurite.AzRat.compare_eq_compareOfLessAndEq
statement:
lemma compare_eq_compareOfLessAndEq (q r : AzRat) :
    cmp q r = compareOfLessAndEq q r
proof:
:= by
  change cmp q r = (if q < r then Ordering.lt else if q = r then Ordering.eq else Ordering.gt)
  rw [cmp_eq_compare]
  rcases lt_trichotomy (toRat q) (toRat r) with h | h | h
  · rw [ite_eq_left ((lt_iff_toRat_lt q r).mpr h)]
    exact compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h
  · rw [ite_eq_right (by rw [lt_iff_toRat_lt, h]; exact lt_irrefl _),
        ite_eq_left (toRat_injective h)]
    exact compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h
  · rw [ite_eq_right (by rw [lt_iff_toRat_lt]; exact not_lt_of_gt h),
        ite_eq_right (fun he => absurd (congrArg toRat he) (by simpa using ne_of_gt h))]
    exact compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h

name: Azurite.AzRat.orderIsoRat_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem orderIsoRat_apply (q : AzRat) : orderIsoRat q = toRat q
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.orderIsoRat_symm_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem orderIsoRat_symm_apply (r : ℚ) : orderIsoRat.symm r = ofRat r
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_max
statement:
@[simp] theorem toRat_max (q r : AzRat) :
    toRat (max q r) = max (toRat q) (toRat r)
proof:
:=
  orderIsoRat.monotone.map_max

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_min
statement:
@[simp] theorem toRat_min (q r : AzRat) :
    toRat (min q r) = min (toRat q) (toRat r)
proof:
:=
  orderIsoRat.monotone.map_min

name: Azurite.AzRat.abs_eq_max_neg
statement: theorem abs_eq_max_neg (q : AzRat) : q.abs = max q (-q)
proof:
:= by
  apply toRat_injective
  rw [toRat_abs, toRat_max, toRat_neg]
  exact _root_.abs_eq_max_neg

name: Azurite.AzRat.cross_assoc
proof:
:= by
  subst hA hB hC hD; ring

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_mul
statement: @[simp] theorem toRat_mul (x y : AzRat) : toRat (x * y) = toRat x * toRat y
proof:
:= by
  show toRat (AzRat.mul x y) = toRat x * toRat y
  by_cases hx : x.num = 0
  · rw [AzRat.mul, dite_eq_left hx, toRat_zero, toRat_of_num_zero x hx, zero_mul]
  by_cases hy : y.num = 0
  · rw [AzRat.mul, dite_eq_right hx, dite_eq_left hy, toRat_zero, toRat_of_num_zero y hy, mul_zero]
  rw [AzRat.mul, dite_eq_right hx, dite_eq_right hy,
      toRat_eq_divInt, toRat_eq_divInt x, toRat_eq_divInt y, Rat.divInt_mul_divInt]
  dsimp only
  
  
  have hxn : x.num.toNat ≠ 0 :=
    fun h => hx (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm))
  have hyn : y.num.toNat ≠ 0 :=
    fun h => hy (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm))
  have hxd : x.den.toNat ≠ 0 :=
    fun h => x.den_nz (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm))
  have hyd : y.den.toNat ≠ 0 :=
    fun h => y.den_nz (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm))
  have hcore : x.num.toNat / Nat.gcd x.num.toNat y.den.toNat *
        (y.num.toNat / Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.num.toNat) * (x.den.toNat * y.den.toNat)
      = x.num.toNat * y.num.toNat *
        (x.den.toNat / Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.num.toNat *
          (y.den.toNat / Nat.gcd x.num.toNat y.den.toNat)) :=
    cross_assoc (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _))
      (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _))
      (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _))
      (Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _))
  have hz : (↑(x.num.toNat / Nat.gcd x.num.toNat y.den.toNat) *
        ↑(y.num.toNat / Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.num.toNat) *
        ((x.den.toNat : ℤ) * (y.den.toNat : ℤ)) : ℤ)
      = (x.num.toNat : ℤ) * (y.num.toNat : ℤ) *
        (↑(x.den.toNat / Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.num.toNat) *
          ↑(y.den.toNat / Nat.gcd x.num.toNat y.den.toNat)) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcore
  have hb' : x.den.toNat / Nat.gcd x.den.toNat y.num.toNat ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.div_pos
      (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hxd) (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _))
      (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hxd)))
  have hd' : y.den.toNat / Nat.gcd x.num.toNat y.den.toNat ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.div_pos
      (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hyd) (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _))
      (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hyd)))
  have hz1 : ((x.den / AzNat.gcd x.den y.num * (y.den / AzNat.gcd x.num y.den)).toNat : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_div, AzNat.toNat_div, AzNat.toNat_gcd, AzNat.toNat_gcd]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_ne_zero hb' hd'
  have hz2 : ((x.den.toNat : ℤ) * (y.den.toNat : ℤ)) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr hxd) (Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr hyd)
  rw [Rat.divInt_eq_divInt_iff hz1 hz2]
  simp only [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_div, AzNat.toNat_gcd, Nat.cast_mul]
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h3 <;>
    first
      | linear_combination hz
      | linear_combination -hz
      | (rw [beq_iff_eq] at h1; simp_all)

name: Azurite.AzRat.ofRat_mul
statement: @[simp] theorem ofRat_mul (r s : ℚ) : ofRat (r * s) = ofRat r * ofRat s
proof:
:=
  toRat_injective (by rw [toRat_ofRat, toRat_mul, toRat_ofRat, toRat_ofRat])

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_ofRat
statement: theorem toRat_ofRat (r : ℚ) : toRat (ofRat r) = r
proof:
:= by
  apply Rat.ext
  · show (if (decide (0 ≤ r.num)) then ((AzNat.ofNat r.num.natAbs).toNat : ℤ)
            else -((AzNat.ofNat r.num.natAbs).toNat : ℤ)) = r.num
    rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
    split
    · rename_i h; rw [decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      exact Int.natAbs_of_nonneg h
    · rename_i h; rw [decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      rw [Int.ofNat_natAbs_of_nonpos (le_of_lt (not_le.mp h)), neg_neg]
  · show (AzNat.ofNat r.den).toNat = r.den
    rw [AzNat.toNat_ofNat]

name: Azurite.AzRat.ofRat_toRat
statement: theorem ofRat_toRat (q : AzRat) : ofRat (toRat q) = q
proof:
:= by
  have hnum : (toRat q).num = if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℤ) := rfl
  have hden : (toRat q).den = q.den.toNat := rfl
  apply AzRat.ext
  · 
    show decide (0 ≤ (toRat q).num) = q.sign
    rw [hnum]
    cases hs : q.sign
    · have hnz' : q.num.toNat ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        have hz : q.num = 0 := AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm)
        rw [q.zero_sign hz] at hs; exact absurd hs (by decide)
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
      omega
    · simp only [ite_true, decide_eq_true_eq]; omega
  · 
    show AzNat.ofNat (toRat q).num.natAbs = q.num
    rw [hnum]
    cases hs : q.sign <;>
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true, Int.natAbs_neg, Int.natAbs_natCast] <;>
      exact AzNat.ofNat_toNat q.num
  · 
    show AzNat.ofNat (toRat q).den = q.den
    rw [hden, AzNat.ofNat_toNat]

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_injective
statement: theorem toRat_injective : Function.Injective toRat
proof:
:= fun a b h => by
  rw [← ofRat_toRat a, h, ofRat_toRat]

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_toAzRat
statement: theorem toRat_toAzRat (n : AzNat) : toRat n.toAzRat = (n.toNat : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Rat.ext
  · show (if (true : Bool) then (n.toNat : ℤ) else -(n.toNat : ℤ)) = ((n.toNat : ℚ)).num
    simp
  · show ((1 : AzNat).toNat : ℕ) = ((n.toNat : ℚ)).den
    rw [AzNat.toNat_one]; simp

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_toAzRat_int
statement: theorem toRat_toAzRat_int (z : AzInt) : toRat z.toAzRat = (z.toInt : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Rat.ext
  · show (if z.sign then (z.abs.toNat : ℤ) else -(z.abs.toNat : ℤ)) = ((z.toInt : ℚ)).num
    rw [Rat.num_intCast]; rfl
  · show ((1 : AzNat).toNat : ℕ) = ((z.toInt : ℚ)).den
    rw [AzNat.toNat_one]; simp

name: Azurite.AzRat.cmp_ord_lt_lt
statement: @[local simp] private lemma cmp_ord_lt_lt : compare Ordering.lt Ordering.lt = Ordering.eq
proof: := by decide

name: Azurite.AzRat.cmp_ord_lt_eq
statement: @[local simp] private lemma cmp_ord_lt_eq : compare Ordering.lt Ordering.eq = Ordering.lt
proof: := by decide

name: Azurite.AzRat.cmp_ord_lt_gt
statement: @[local simp] private lemma cmp_ord_lt_gt : compare Ordering.lt Ordering.gt = Ordering.lt
proof: := by decide

name: Azurite.AzRat.cmp_ord_eq_lt
statement: @[local simp] private lemma cmp_ord_eq_lt : compare Ordering.eq Ordering.lt = Ordering.gt
proof: := by decide

name: Azurite.AzRat.cmp_ord_eq_eq
statement: @[local simp] private lemma cmp_ord_eq_eq : compare Ordering.eq Ordering.eq = Ordering.eq

statement: @[local simp] private lemma cmp_ord_eq_gt : compare Ordering.eq Ordering.gt = Ordering.lt
