      show (countFactor pm.1 acc.2).2.toNat.factorization r = _
      rw [hm]
      by_cases hr : r = pm.1.toNat
      · rw [hr, Finsupp.erase_same]
        rw [ite_eq_left ⟨pm, by simp, rfl⟩]
      · rw [Finsupp.erase_ne hr, hfact r]
        by_cases hex : ∃ x ∈ T', x.1.toNat = r
        · rw [ite_eq_left hex, ite_eq_left]
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hxr⟩ := hex
          exact ⟨x, List.mem_append_left _ hx, hxr⟩
        · rw [ite_eq_right hex, ite_eq_right]
          rintro ⟨x, hx, hxr⟩
          rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx' | hx'
          · exact hex ⟨x, hx', hxr⟩
          · rw [List.mem_singleton] at hx'
            subst hx'
            exact hr hxr.symm
    have hlen' : ∀ L, (lapStep acc pm).1 ≤ L ↔
        ∀ x ∈ T' ++ [pm], D.factorization x.1.toNat ≤ x.2 * L := by
      intro L
      show max acc.1 (((countFactor pm.1 acc.2).1 + pm.2 - 1) / pm.2) ≤ L ↔ _
      rw [max_le_iff, hlen L, ceilDiv_le_iff _ _ _ hpm.2, hc, hfact pm.1.toNat]
      rw [ite_eq_right (by rintro ⟨x, hx, hxr⟩; exact hnew x hx hxr)]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ x hx
        rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx' | hx'
        · exact h1 x hx'
        · rw [List.mem_singleton] at hx'; subst hx'; exact h2
      · intro h
        exact ⟨fun x hx => h x (List.mem_append_left _ hx), h pm (by simp)⟩
    have := ih (T' ++ [pm]) (lapStep acc pm) hT_shift hnd_shift hs0 hfact' hlen'
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] at this
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    exact this

name: Azurite.AzRat.dvd_pow_iff
statement:
theorem dvd_pow_iff (D B L : ℕ) (hD : D ≠ 0) (hB : B ≠ 0) :
    D ∣ B ^ L ↔ ∀ r, D.factorization r ≤ L * B.factorization r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.factorization_le_iff_dvd hD (pow_ne_zero _ hB), Nat.factorization_pow,
    Finsupp.le_def]
  simp only [Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: Azurite.AzRat.lengthAfterPoint_spec
statement:
theorem lengthAfterPoint_spec (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat ∧ b.toNat ≤ 36) (q : AzRat) :
    (∀ L, lengthAfterPoint b q = some L ↔
      q.den.toNat ∣ b.toNat ^ L ∧ ∀ L' < L, ¬ q.den.toNat ∣ b.toNat ^ L') ∧
    (lengthAfterPoint b q = none ↔ ∀ L, ¬ q.den.toNat ∣ b.toNat ^ L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hT, hnd, hprod⟩ := basePrimeFactors_spec b.toNat hb.1 hb.2
  set T := basePrimeFactors b.toNat with hT_def
  set D := q.den.toNat with hD_def
  have hD : D ≠ 0 := fun h => q.den_nz (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm))
  have hB : b.toNat ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hden0 : q.den ≠ 0 := q.den_nz
  have hfold := foldl_lapStep_spec D T [] (0, q.den) (by simpa using hT) (by simpa using hnd)
    hden0 (fun r => by rw [ite_eq_right (by simp)]) (fun L => by simp)
  simp only [List.nil_append] at hfold
  obtain ⟨hres0, hresfact, hreslen⟩ := hfold
  set res := T.foldl lapStep (0, q.den) with hres_def
  
  have hBfact : ∀ r, b.toNat.factorization r = tableMult T r := by
    intro r; rw [← hprod]; exact factorization_tableProd T hT r
  
  have hkey : ∀ L, D ∣ b.toNat ^ L ↔ (res.1 ≤ L ∧ res.2 = 1) := by
    intro L
    rw [dvd_pow_iff D _ L hD hB, hreslen L]
    have hres1 : res.2 = 1 ↔ ∀ r, (¬ ∃ pm ∈ T, pm.1.toNat = r) → D.factorization r = 0 := by
      constructor
      · intro h1 r hr
        have := hresfact r
        rw [ite_eq_right hr] at this
        rw [← this, h1]
        simp
      · intro h
        have hz : res.2.toNat.factorization = 0 := by
          ext r
          rw [hresfact r]
          split_ifs with hex
          · rfl
          · exact h r hex
        rcases (Nat.factorization_eq_zero_iff' _).mp hz with h0 | h1
        · exact absurd (AzNat.toNat_injective (h0.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm)) hres0
        · exact AzNat.toNat_injective (h1.trans AzNat.toNat_one.symm)
    rw [hres1]
    constructor
    · intro h
      refine ⟨fun pm hpm => ?_, fun r hr => ?_⟩
      · have := h pm.1.toNat
        rwa [hBfact, tableMult_of_mem T hnd pm hpm, Nat.mul_comm] at this
      · have := h r
        rwa [hBfact, tableMult_of_not_mem T r (fun pm hpm heq => hr ⟨pm, hpm, heq⟩),
          Nat.mul_zero, Nat.le_zero] at this
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ r
      rw [hBfact]
      by_cases hex : ∃ pm ∈ T, pm.1.toNat = r
      · obtain ⟨pm, hpm, rfl⟩ := hex
        rw [tableMult_of_mem T hnd pm hpm, Nat.mul_comm]
        exact h1 pm hpm
      · rw [tableMult_of_not_mem T r (fun pm hpm heq => hex ⟨pm, hpm, heq⟩), Nat.mul_zero,
          h2 r hex]
  
  have hunfold : lengthAfterPoint b q = if res.2 = 1 then some res.1 else none := by
    unfold lengthAfterPoint
    rw [ite_eq_left hb]
    rfl
  rw [hunfold]
  constructor
  · intro L
    by_cases h1 : res.2 = 1
    · rw [ite_eq_left h1]
      constructor
      · intro hL
        have hL' : res.1 = L := Option.some.inj hL
        refine ⟨(hkey L).mpr ⟨hL' ▸ Nat.le_refl _, h1⟩, fun L' hL'' hdvd => ?_⟩
        have := ((hkey L').mp hdvd).1
        omega
      · rintro ⟨hdvd, hmin⟩
        have hle := ((hkey L).mp hdvd).1
        congr
        by_contra hne
        have hlt : res.1 < L := lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne
        exact hmin res.1 hlt ((hkey res.1).mpr ⟨Nat.le_refl _, h1⟩)
    · rw [ite_eq_right h1]
      constructor
      · intro h; exact absurd h (by simp)
      · rintro ⟨hdvd, _⟩
        exact absurd ((hkey L).mp hdvd).2 h1
  · by_cases h1 : res.2 = 1
    · rw [ite_eq_left h1]
      constructor
      · intro h; exact absurd h (by simp)
      · intro h
        exact absurd ((hkey res.1).mpr ⟨Nat.le_refl _, h1⟩) (h res.1)
    · rw [ite_eq_right h1]
      simp only [true_iff]
      intro L hdvd
      exact h1 ((hkey L).mp hdvd).2

name: Azurite.AzRat.lengthAfterPoint_some_iff
statement:
theorem lengthAfterPoint_some_iff (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat ∧ b.toNat ≤ 36) (q : AzRat)
    (L : ℕ) :
    lengthAfterPoint b q = some L ↔
      q.den.toNat ∣ b.toNat ^ L ∧ ∀ L' < L, ¬ q.den.toNat ∣ b.toNat ^ L'
proof:
:=
  (lengthAfterPoint_spec b hb q).1 L

name: Azurite.AzRat.lengthAfterPoint_none_iff
statement:
theorem lengthAfterPoint_none_iff (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat ∧ b.toNat ≤ 36) (q : AzRat) :
    lengthAfterPoint b q = none ↔ ∀ L, ¬ q.den.toNat ∣ b.toNat ^ L
proof:
:=
  (lengthAfterPoint_spec b hb q).2

name: Azurite.AzRat.sub_eq_add_neg
statement: theorem sub_eq_add_neg (x y : AzRat) : x - y = x + -y
proof:
:= by
  show AzRat.sub x y = AzRat.add x (AzRat.neg y)
  by_cases hx : x.num = 0
  · rw [AzRat.sub, dite_eq_left hx, AzRat.add, dite_eq_left hx]
    rfl
  · by_cases hy : y.num = 0
    · rw [AzRat.sub, dite_eq_right hx, dite_eq_left hy, AzRat.add, dite_eq_right hx,
          dite_eq_left (show (AzRat.neg y).num = 0 from hy)]
    · have hneg : AzRat.neg y = ⟨!y.sign, y.num, y.den, y.den_nz,
          fun h => absurd h hy, y.reduced⟩ :=
        AzRat.ext (ite_eq_right hy) rfl rfl
      rw [AzRat.sub, dite_eq_right hx, dite_eq_right hy, hneg, AzRat.add, dite_eq_right hx,
          dite_eq_right (show ¬((⟨!y.sign, y.num, y.den, y.den_nz,
            fun h => absurd h hy, y.reduced⟩ : AzRat).num = 0) from hy)]

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_sub
statement: @[simp] theorem toRat_sub (x y : AzRat) : toRat (x - y) = toRat x - toRat y
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, toRat_add, toRat_neg, _root_.sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Azurite.AzRat.ofRat_sub
statement: @[simp] theorem ofRat_sub (r s : ℚ) : ofRat (r - s) = ofRat r - ofRat s
proof:
:=
  toRat_injective (by rw [toRat_ofRat, toRat_sub, toRat_ofRat, toRat_ofRat])

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_eq_divInt
statement:
lemma toRat_eq_divInt (q : AzRat) :
    toRat q = Rat.divInt
      (if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℤ)) (q.den.toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toRat, Rat.mk_eq_divInt]

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_of_num_zero
statement: lemma toRat_of_num_zero (q : AzRat) (h : q.num = 0) : toRat q = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [toRat_eq_divInt, q.zero_sign h, ite_eq_left rfl, h, AzNat.toNat_zero]
  simp

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem toRat_neg (q : AzRat) : toRat (-q) = -(toRat q)
proof:
:= by
  show toRat q.neg = -(toRat q)
  by_cases hn : q.num = 0
  · rw [toRat_of_num_zero q hn, toRat_of_num_zero q.neg hn, neg_zero]
  · rw [toRat_eq_divInt q.neg, toRat_eq_divInt q]
    simp only [neg]
    simp only [ite_eq_right hn]
    rw [Rat.neg_divInt]
    cases q.sign <;> simp

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_abs
statement: @[simp] theorem toRat_abs (q : AzRat) : toRat q.abs = |toRat q|
proof:
:= by
  have habs : toRat q.abs = Rat.divInt (q.num.toNat : ℤ) (q.den.toNat : ℤ) := by
    rw [toRat_eq_divInt]
    simp only [AzRat.abs]
    rw [ite_eq_left trivial]
  have hnn : (0 : ℚ) ≤ Rat.divInt (q.num.toNat : ℤ) (q.den.toNat : ℤ) :=
    Rat.divInt_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg _) (Int.natCast_nonneg _)
  by_cases hs : q.sign
  · rw [habs, toRat_eq_divInt, ite_eq_left hs, abs_of_nonneg hnn]
  · rw [habs, toRat_eq_divInt, ite_eq_right hs, ← Rat.neg_divInt, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hnn]

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem toRat_inv (q : AzRat) : toRat q⁻¹ = (toRat q)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  show toRat q.inv = (toRat q)⁻¹
  by_cases hn : q.num = 0
  · rw [inv, dite_eq_left hn, toRat_zero, toRat_of_num_zero q hn, inv_zero]
  · rw [inv, dite_eq_right hn, toRat_eq_divInt, toRat_eq_divInt q]
    dsimp only
    cases hs : q.sign with
    | true => rw [ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left rfl, Rat.inv_divInt]
    | false =>
      rw [ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true, ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true,
          ← Rat.neg_divInt, ← Rat.neg_divInt, inv_neg, Rat.inv_divInt]

name: Azurite.AzRat.ofRat_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem ofRat_neg (r : ℚ) : ofRat (-r) = -(ofRat r)
proof:
:=
  toRat_injective (by rw [toRat_ofRat, toRat_neg, toRat_ofRat])

name: Azurite.AzRat.ofRat_abs
statement: @[simp] theorem ofRat_abs (r : ℚ) : ofRat |r| = (ofRat r).abs
proof:
:=
  toRat_injective (by rw [toRat_ofRat, toRat_abs, toRat_ofRat])

name: Azurite.AzRat.ofRat_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem ofRat_inv (r : ℚ) : ofRat r⁻¹ = (ofRat r)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  toRat_injective (by rw [toRat_ofRat, toRat_inv, toRat_ofRat])

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_real_eq
statement:
lemma toRat_real_eq (q : AzRat) :
    (toRat q : ℝ) = (if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℝ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℝ)) / q.den.toNat
proof:
:= by
  have hnum : (toRat q).num = if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℤ) := rfl
  have hden : (toRat q).den = q.den.toNat := rfl
  rw [Rat.cast_def, hnum, hden]
  cases q.sign <;> push_cast <;> rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.toInt_mkNorm_sign
statement:
private lemma toInt_mkNorm_sign (q : AzRat) (m : AzNat) (hm : q.sign = false → m ≠ 0) :
    ((AzInt.mkNorm q.sign m).toInt : ℝ) = (if q.sign then (m.toNat : ℝ) else -(m.toNat : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  cases hs : q.sign with
  | true => rw [AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_true]; simp
  | false => rw [AzInt.toInt_mkNorm_false m (hm hs)]; simp

name: Azurite.AzRat.den_real_pos
statement: private lemma den_real_pos (q : AzRat) : (0 : ℝ) < q.den.toNat
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast den_toNat_pos q

name: Azurite.AzRat.toInt_scaledRound
statement:
theorem toInt_scaledRound (q : AzRat) (b : UInt64) (hb : 0 < b.toNat) (scale : ℤ)
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    (((scaledRound q b scale mode).1.toInt : ℝ) : EReal)
      = (RoundingTarget.round intSet mode ((toRat q : ℝ) * (b.toNat : ℝ) ^ scale)).val
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hD := den_real_pos q
  have hnum0 : q.sign = false → q.num ≠ 0 := by
    intro hs h0
    have := q.zero_sign h0
    rw [hs] at this
    exact absurd this (by decide)
  unfold scaledRound
  cases scale with
  | ofNat s =>
    have hden_pos : 0 < (q.den.toAzInt).abs.toNat := by
      show 0 < q.den.toNat; exact den_toNat_pos q
    rw [AzInt.toInt_divRound _ _ mode hden_pos]
    congr 2
    rw [Azurite.AzNat.toInt_toAzInt, Int.cast_natCast]
    rw [toInt_mkNorm_sign q _ (fun hs => by
      intro h0
      have h := congrArg AzNat.toNat h0
      rw [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_pow, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_zero] at h
      rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp h with h1 | h1
      · exact hnum0 hs (AzNat.toNat_injective (h1.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm))
      · exact absurd h1 (pow_ne_zero _ hb.ne'))]
    rw [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_pow, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, toRat_real_eq, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast,
      zpow_natCast]
    push_cast
    cases q.sign <;> (try simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]) <;> field_simp
  | negSucc s =>
    have hden_pos : 0 < ((q.den * (AzNat.ofNat b.toNat).pow (s + 1)).toAzInt).abs.toNat := by
      show 0 < (q.den * (AzNat.ofNat b.toNat).pow (s + 1)).toNat
      rw [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_pow, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
      exact Nat.mul_pos (den_toNat_pos q) (pow_pos hb _)
    rw [AzInt.toInt_divRound _ _ mode hden_pos]
    congr 2
    rw [Azurite.AzNat.toInt_toAzInt, Int.cast_natCast, AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_pow,
      AzNat.toNat_ofNat, toInt_mkNorm_sign q _ hnum0, toRat_real_eq, zpow_negSucc]
    push_cast
    cases q.sign <;> (try simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]) <;> field_simp

name: Azurite.AzRat.snd_scaledRound
statement:
theorem snd_scaledRound (q : AzRat) (b : UInt64) (hb : 0 < b.toNat) (scale : ℤ)
    (mode : RoundingMode) :
    (scaledRound q b scale mode).2
      = compare (((scaledRound q b scale mode).1.toInt : ℤ) : ℝ)
          ((toRat q : ℝ) * (b.toNat : ℝ) ^ scale)
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hD := den_real_pos q
  have hnum0 : q.sign = false → q.num ≠ 0 := by
    intro hs h0
    have := q.zero_sign h0
    rw [hs] at this
    exact absurd this (by decide)
  unfold scaledRound
  cases scale with
  | ofNat s =>
    have hden_pos : 0 < (q.den.toAzInt).abs.toNat := by
      show 0 < q.den.toNat; exact den_toNat_pos q
    rw [AzInt.snd_divRound _ _ mode hden_pos]
    congr 1
    rw [Azurite.AzNat.toInt_toAzInt, Int.cast_natCast]
    rw [toInt_mkNorm_sign q _ (fun hs => by
      intro h0
      have h := congrArg AzNat.toNat h0
      rw [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_pow, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, AzNat.toNat_zero] at h
      rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp h with h1 | h1
      · exact hnum0 hs (AzNat.toNat_injective (h1.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm))
      · exact absurd h1 (pow_ne_zero _ hb.ne'))]
    rw [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_pow, AzNat.toNat_ofNat, toRat_real_eq, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast,
      zpow_natCast]
    push_cast
    cases q.sign <;> (try simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]) <;> field_simp
  | negSucc s =>
    have hden_pos : 0 < ((q.den * (AzNat.ofNat b.toNat).pow (s + 1)).toAzInt).abs.toNat := by
      show 0 < (q.den * (AzNat.ofNat b.toNat).pow (s + 1)).toNat
      rw [AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_pow, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
      exact Nat.mul_pos (den_toNat_pos q) (pow_pos hb _)
    rw [AzInt.snd_divRound _ _ mode hden_pos]
    congr 1
    rw [Azurite.AzNat.toInt_toAzInt, Int.cast_natCast, AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_pow,
      AzNat.toNat_ofNat, toInt_mkNorm_sign q _ hnum0, toRat_real_eq, zpow_negSucc]
    push_cast
    cases q.sign <;> (try simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]) <;> field_simp

name: Azurite.AzRat.foldl_horner_eq_ofDigits
statement:
lemma foldl_horner_eq_ofDigits (b : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) :
    l.foldl (fun acc d => acc * b + d) 0 = Nat.ofDigits b l.reverse
proof:
:= by
  induction l using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => simp
  | append_singleton l d ih =>
    rw [List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, ih, List.reverse_append,
      List.reverse_singleton, List.singleton_append, Nat.ofDigits_cons]
    ring

name: Azurite.AzRat.mantissa_digits
statement:
lemma mantissa_digits (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (n : AzNat) (neg : Bool) (sc : Int) :
    (SciNumber.mantissa ⟨neg, b, (n.limbDigits b).reverse, sc⟩) = n.toNat
proof:
:= by
  unfold SciNumber.mantissa
  simp only []
  rw [← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_reverse]
  have h : ((n.limbDigits b).toList.reverse).foldl (fun acc d => acc * b.toNat + d.toNat) 0
      = (((n.limbDigits b).toList.map UInt64.toNat).reverse).foldl
          (fun acc d => acc * b.toNat + d) 0 := by
    rw [← List.map_reverse, List.foldl_map]
  rw [h, foldl_horner_eq_ofDigits, List.reverse_reverse, AzNat.limbDigits_eq b hb,
    Nat.ofDigits_digits]

name: Azurite.AzRat.value_of_azint
statement:
lemma value_of_azint (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (r : AzInt) (sc : Int) :
    (SciNumber.value ⟨!r.sign, b, (r.abs.limbDigits b).reverse, sc⟩ : ℝ)
      = (r.toInt : ℝ) * (b.toNat : ℝ) ^ (-sc)
proof:
:= by
  unfold SciNumber.value
  rw [mantissa_digits b hb]
  simp only []
  push_cast
  unfold AzInt.toInt
  cases r.sign <;> simp

name: Azurite.AzRat.valid_base
statement: lemma valid_base {o : SciOptions} (hv : o.valid = true) : 2 ≤ o.base.toNat ∧ o.base.toNat ≤ 36
proof:
:= by
  unfold SciOptions.valid at hv
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hv
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, _⟩, _⟩ := hv
  rw [UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le] at h1 h2
  exact ⟨by simpa using h1, by simpa using h2⟩

name: Azurite.AzRat.value_zero_digits
statement:
lemma value_zero_digits (neg : Bool) (b : UInt64) (sc : Int) :
    (SciNumber.value ⟨neg, b, #[], sc⟩ : ℚ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold SciNumber.value SciNumber.mantissa
  simp

name: Azurite.AzRat.toInt_eq_zero_of_abs
statement: private lemma toInt_eq_zero_of_abs {r : AzInt} (h : r.abs = 0) : r.toInt = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold AzInt.toInt
  rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero]
  cases r.sign <;> simp

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma toRat_eq_zero_iff (q : AzRat) : (toRat q : ℝ) = 0 ↔ q.num = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rat.cast_eq_zero, Rat.zero_iff_num_zero]
  have hnum : (toRat q).num = if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℤ) := rfl
  rw [hnum]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : q.num.toNat = 0 := by
      cases hs : q.sign
      · rw [hs] at h
        simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, neg_eq_zero, Nat.cast_eq_zero] at h
        exact h
      · rw [hs] at h
        simp only [↓reduceIte, Nat.cast_eq_zero] at h
        exact h
    exact AzNat.toNat_injective (by rw [AzNat.toNat_zero]; exact h')
  · intro h
    rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero]
    cases q.sign <;> simp

name: Azurite.AzRat.toSciNumber_value_scale
statement:
theorem toSciNumber_value_scale (q : AzRat) (o : SciOptions) (hv : o.valid = true) (s : ℕ)
    (hs : o.size = .scale s) [NeZero o.base.toNat] :
    ∃ x, q.toSciNumber o = some x ∧
      ((x.value : ℝ) : EReal)
        = (RoundingTarget.round (scaleSet o.base.toNat s) o.mode (toRat q : ℝ)).val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hb2, _⟩ := valid_base hv
  have hb0 : 0 < o.base.toNat := by omega
  rw [val_round_scaleSet]
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < o.base.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hb0
  set y : ℝ := (toRat q : ℝ) * (o.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ s with hy
  
  have hr := toInt_scaledRound q o.base hb0 (s : ℤ) o.mode
  rw [zpow_natCast, ← hy] at hr
  have hrI : toInt (RoundingTarget.round intSet o.mode y) = (scaledRound q o.base (s : ℤ) o.mode).1.toInt :=
    toInt_eq_of_val hr
  rw [hrI]
  unfold toSciNumber
  rw [hv]
  simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
  by_cases h0 : q.num = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left h0]
    refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [value_zero_digits]
    
    have hq0 : (toRat q : ℝ) = 0 := (toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr h0
    have hy0 : y = 0 := by rw [hy, hq0, zero_mul]
    have hval := val_round_of_mem intSet o.mode (x := y) (by rw [hy0]; exact ⟨0, by simp⟩)
    have : toInt (RoundingTarget.round intSet o.mode y) = 0 := toInt_eq_of_val (by rw [hval, hy0]; simp)
    rw [hrI] at this
    rw [this]
    simp
  · rw [ite_eq_right h0]
    simp only [sizeScale, hs]
    set r := scaledRound q o.base (s : ℤ) o.mode with hr_def
    by_cases hn : r.1.abs = 0
    · rw [ite_eq_left hn]
      refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
      rw [value_zero_digits, toInt_eq_zero_of_abs hn]
      simp
    · rw [ite_eq_right hn]
      refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
      rw [value_of_azint o.base hb2]
      congr 1
      rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: Azurite.AzRat.scaled_mem_intSet
statement:
private lemma scaled_mem_intSet (q : AzRat) (b : UInt64) (L : ℕ) (hdvd : q.den.toNat ∣ b.toNat ^ L) :
    (((toRat q : ℝ) * (b.toNat : ℝ) ^ L : ℝ) : EReal) ∈ intSet
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdvd
  have hD := den_real_pos q
  refine ⟨(if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℤ)) * k, ?_⟩
  congr 1
  rw [toRat_real_eq]
  have hkR : (b.toNat : ℝ) ^ L = (q.den.toNat : ℝ) * k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  rw [hkR]
  push_cast
  cases q.sign <;> (try simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]) <;> field_simp

name: Azurite.AzRat.toSciNumber_complete
statement:
theorem toSciNumber_complete (q : AzRat) (o : SciOptions) (hv : o.valid = true)
    (hc : o.size = .complete) :
    (∀ x, q.toSciNumber o = some x → (x.value : ℝ) = toRat q) ∧
    ((q.toSciNumber o).isSome ↔ (lengthAfterPoint o.base q).isSome)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hb2, hb36⟩ := valid_base hv
  have hb0 : 0 < o.base.toNat := by omega
  unfold toSciNumber
  rw [hv]
  simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
  by_cases h0 : q.num = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left h0]
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hx
      rw [value_zero_digits, (toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr h0]
      simp
    · 
      have hden : q.den.toNat = 1 := by
        have hcop := (AzNat.coprime_iff _ _).mp q.reduced
        rw [h0, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hcop
        exact (Nat.coprime_zero_left _).mp hcop
      have : lengthAfterPoint o.base q = some 0 :=
        (lengthAfterPoint_some_iff o.base ⟨hb2, hb36⟩ q 0).mpr
          ⟨by rw [hden]; exact one_dvd _, fun L' hL' => absurd hL' (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
      simp [this]
  · rw [ite_eq_right h0]
    simp only [sizeScale, hc]
    rcases hlen : lengthAfterPoint o.base q with _ | L
    · simp
    · simp only [Option.map_some]
      have hdvd := ((lengthAfterPoint_some_iff o.base ⟨hb2, hb36⟩ q L).mp hlen).1
      set r := scaledRound q o.base (L : ℤ) o.mode with hr_def
      
      have hmem := scaled_mem_intSet q o.base L hdvd
      have hr := toInt_scaledRound q o.base hb0 (L : ℤ) o.mode
      rw [zpow_natCast, val_round_of_mem intSet o.mode hmem] at hr
      have hrR : (r.1.toInt : ℝ) = (toRat q : ℝ) * (o.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ L :=
        EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp hr
      have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < o.base.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hb0
      constructor
      · intro x hx
        by_cases hn : r.1.abs = 0
        · rw [ite_eq_left hn] at hx
          rw [Option.some.inj hx |>.symm, value_zero_digits]
          
          have : (toRat q : ℝ) * (o.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ L = 0 := by
            rw [← hrR, toInt_eq_zero_of_abs hn]; simp
          rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h
          · simp [h]
          · exact absurd h (pow_pos hbR _).ne'
        · rw [ite_eq_right hn] at hx
          rw [Option.some.inj hx |>.symm, value_of_azint o.base hb2, hrR]
          rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_pos hbR _).ne', mul_one]
      · constructor
        · intro _; simp
        · intro _
          by_cases hn : r.1.abs = 0
          · rw [ite_eq_left hn]; simp
          · rw [ite_eq_right hn]; simp

name: Azurite.AzRat.toInt_round_intSet_eq_floor_or_ceil
statement:
lemma toInt_round_intSet_eq_floor_or_ceil (mode : RoundingMode) (y : ℝ) :
    toInt (RoundingTarget.round intSet mode y) = ⌊y⌋ ∨
    toInt (RoundingTarget.round intSet mode y) = ⌈y⌉
proof:
:= by
  have hF : toInt (roundFloor intSet y) = ⌊y⌋ := toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundFloor_intSet y).symm
  have hC : toInt (roundCeiling intSet y) = ⌈y⌉ :=
    toInt_eq_of_val (val_roundCeiling_intSet y).symm
  cases mode with
  | Floor => exact Or.inl hF
  | Ceiling => exact Or.inr hC
  | Down =>
    unfold RoundingTarget.round
    split_ifs
    · exact Or.inl hF
    · exact Or.inr hC
  | Up =>
    unfold RoundingTarget.round
    split_ifs
    · exact Or.inr hC
    · exact Or.inl hF
  | Nearest =>
    unfold RoundingTarget.round
    simp only []
    split
    · exact Or.inl hF
    · exact Or.inr hC
    · rcases RoundingTarget.tiebreak_mem (roundFloor intSet y) (roundCeiling intSet y) with h | h
      · rw [h]; exact Or.inl hF
      · rw [h]; exact Or.inr hC

name: Azurite.AzRat.floor_ceil_abs_le
statement:
lemma floor_ceil_abs_le (y : ℝ) (B : ℤ) (hy : |y| < (B : ℝ)) :
    |⌊y⌋| ≤ B ∧ |⌈y⌉| ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_lt] at hy
  constructor
  · rw [abs_le]
    constructor
    · exact Int.le_floor.mpr (by push_cast; exact hy.1.le)
    · exact Int.le_of_lt_add_one (Int.floor_lt.mpr (by linarith [hy.2]) |>.trans_le (by omega))
  · rw [abs_le]
    constructor
    · have : (-B : ℤ) < ⌈y⌉ := Int.lt_ceil.mpr (by push_cast; exact hy.1)
      omega
    · exact Int.ceil_le.mpr hy.2.le

name: Azurite.AzRat.toSciNumber_value_precision
statement:
theorem toSciNumber_value_precision (q : AzRat) (o : SciOptions) (hv : o.valid = true) (p : ℕ)
    (hp : o.size = .precision p) [Fact (1 < o.base.toNat)] [NeZero p] :
    ∃ x, q.toSciNumber o = some x ∧
      ((x.value : ℝ) : EReal)
        = (RoundingTarget.round (precisionSet o.base.toNat p) o.mode (toRat q : ℝ)).val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hb2, _⟩ := valid_base hv
  have hb0 : 0 < o.base.toNat := by omega
  have hb1 : 1 < o.base.toNat := hb2
  have hbR : (1 : ℝ) < o.base.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hb1
  have hbR0 : (0 : ℝ) < o.base.toNat := by linarith
  have hp0 : 0 < p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne p)
  unfold toSciNumber
  rw [hv]
  simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
  by_cases h0 : q.num = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left h0]
    refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
    have hq0 : (toRat q : ℝ) = 0 := (toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr h0
    rw [value_zero_digits, hq0,
      val_round_of_mem (precisionSet o.base.toNat p) o.mode (x := (0 : ℝ)) (Or.inl (by simp))]
    simp
  · rw [ite_eq_right h0]
    simp only [sizeScale, hp]
    set x : ℝ := (toRat q : ℝ) with hx_def
    have hx : x ≠ 0 := fun h => h0 ((toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mp h)
    rw [val_round_precisionSet o.mode x hx]
    set e := Int.log o.base.toNat |x| with he
    have hlog : floorLogBaseAbs o.base q = e := by
      rw [he, hx_def]; exact floorLogBaseAbs_eq o.base hb2 q h0
    rw [hlog]
    set u := precScale o.base.toNat p x with hu_def
    have hu : 0 < u := zpow_pos hbR0 _
    have hu_eq : u = (o.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ (e - p + 1) := by
      rw [hu_def]; unfold precScale; rw [← he]
    set sc : ℤ := (p : ℤ) - 1 - e with hsc
    have hpow : (o.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ sc = u⁻¹ := by
      rw [hu_eq, ← zpow_neg]; congr 1; rw [hsc]; ring
    have hr := toInt_scaledRound q o.base hb0 sc o.mode
    rw [hpow, ← div_eq_mul_inv, ← hx_def] at hr
    have hrI : toInt (RoundingTarget.round intSet o.mode (x / u))
        = (scaledRound q o.base sc o.mode).1.toInt := toInt_eq_of_val hr
    rw [hrI]
    set r := scaledRound q o.base sc o.mode with hr_def
    by_cases hn : r.1.abs = 0
    · rw [ite_eq_left hn]
      refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
      rw [value_zero_digits, toInt_eq_zero_of_abs hn]
      simp
    · rw [ite_eq_right hn]
      set ds := (r.1.abs.limbDigits o.base).reverse with hds
      by_cases hsz : ds.size = p + 1
      · rw [ite_eq_left hsz]
        refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
        
        set n := r.1.abs.toNat with hn_def
        have hnpos : n ≠ 0 := fun h => hn (AzNat.toNat_injective (by rw [← hn_def, h]; rfl))
        have hlen : (Nat.digits o.base.toNat n).length = p + 1 := by
          have := congrArg List.length (AzNat.limbDigits_eq o.base hb2 r.1.abs)
          rw [List.length_map, Array.length_toList] at this
          rw [hds, Array.size_reverse] at hsz
          rw [← this, hsz]
        rw [Nat.length_digits _ _ hb1 hnpos] at hlen
        have hlogn : Nat.log o.base.toNat n = p := by omega
        have hge : o.base.toNat ^ p ≤ n := by
          rw [← hlogn]; exact Nat.pow_log_le_self _ hnpos
        have hle : n ≤ o.base.toNat ^ p := by
          have habs : (n : ℤ) = |r.1.toInt| := by
            rw [hn_def]; unfold AzInt.toInt; cases r.1.sign <;> simp
          have hyb : |x / u| < (o.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ (p : ℤ) :=
            (abs_div_precScale_bounds (b := o.base.toNat) (p := p) x hx).2
          have hB : ((o.base.toNat ^ p : ℕ) : ℤ) = (o.base.toNat : ℤ) ^ p := by push_cast; rfl
          have hyb' : |x / u| < (((o.base.toNat ^ p : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
            rw [hB]; push_cast; rw [← zpow_natCast]; exact hyb
          obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := floor_ceil_abs_le (x / u) _ hyb'
          rcases toInt_round_intSet_eq_floor_or_ceil o.mode (x / u) with h | h <;> rw [hrI] at h
          · have : (n : ℤ) ≤ ((o.base.toNat ^ p : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [habs, h]; exact h1
            exact_mod_cast this
          · have : (n : ℤ) ≤ ((o.base.toNat ^ p : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [habs, h]; exact h2
            exact_mod_cast this
        have hn_eq : n = o.base.toNat ^ p := le_antisymm hle hge
        
        have hdig : Nat.digits o.base.toNat n = List.replicate p 0 ++ [1] := by
          rw [hn_eq, ← mul_one (o.base.toNat ^ p), Nat.digits_base_pow_mul hb1 one_pos,
            Nat.digits_of_lt _ _ one_ne_zero hb1]
        
        have hmant : SciNumber.mantissa ⟨!r.1.sign, o.base, ds.pop, sc - 1⟩
            = o.base.toNat ^ (p - 1) := by
          unfold SciNumber.mantissa
          simp only []
          rw [← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_pop, hds, Array.toList_reverse]
          set l := (r.1.abs.limbDigits o.base).toList with hl
          have hfold : (l.reverse.dropLast).foldl (fun acc d => acc * o.base.toNat + d.toNat) 0
              = ((l.reverse.dropLast).map UInt64.toNat).foldl
                  (fun acc d => acc * o.base.toNat + d) 0 := by
            rw [List.foldl_map]
          rw [hfold, foldl_horner_eq_ofDigits, ← List.map_reverse]
          have htail : l.reverse.dropLast.reverse = l.tail := by
            have := List.tail_reverse (l := l.reverse)
            rw [List.reverse_reverse] at this
            exact this.symm
          rw [htail, List.map_tail, hl, AzNat.limbDigits_eq o.base hb2, ← hn_def, hdig]
          obtain ⟨p', hp'⟩ : ∃ p', p = p' + 1 := ⟨p - 1, by omega⟩
          rw [hp', List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append, List.tail_cons, Nat.ofDigits_append,
            Nat.ofDigits_replicate_zero, Nat.ofDigits_singleton, List.length_replicate]
          simp
        
        have hsign : (r.1.toInt : ℝ) = (if r.1.sign then (n : ℝ) else -(n : ℝ)) := by
          unfold AzInt.toInt; rw [hn_def]; cases r.1.sign <;> simp
        unfold SciNumber.value
        rw [hmant]
        simp only []
        congr 1
        push_cast
        rw [hsign, hn_eq, hu_eq]
        push_cast
        have hsc1 : -(sc - 1) = (e - p + 1) + 1 := by rw [hsc]; ring
        rw [hsc1, zpow_add_one₀ hbR0.ne']
        have hpp : ((o.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ (p - 1) : ℝ) * (o.base.toNat : ℝ)
            = (o.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ p := by
          rw [← pow_succ]; congr 1; omega
        rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true r.1.sign with hs | hs
        · simp only [hs, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Rat.cast_one]
          linear_combination ((o.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ (e - p + 1)) * hpp
        · simp only [hs, Bool.not_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Rat.cast_one, Rat.cast_neg]
          linear_combination (-(o.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ (e - p + 1)) * hpp
      · rw [ite_eq_right hsz]
        refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
        rw [value_of_azint o.base hb2]
        congr 3
        rw [hsc]; ring

name: Azurite.AzRat.valid_precision
statement:
lemma valid_precision {o : SciOptions} (hv : o.valid = true) {p : ℕ} (hp : o.size = .precision p) :
    0 < p
proof:
:= by
  unfold SciOptions.valid at hv
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hv
  have h := hv.2
  rw [hp] at h
  unfold SciSizeOptions.valid at h
  simp only [bne_iff_ne, ne_eq] at h
  omega

name: Azurite.AzRat.toSciNumber_value_eq_scaledRound
statement:
theorem toSciNumber_value_eq_scaledRound (q : AzRat) (o : SciOptions) (hv : o.valid = true)
    (h0 : q.num ≠ 0) (scale prec : ℤ)
    (hsz : sizeScale o.base q o.size (floorLogBaseAbs o.base q) = some (scale, prec))
    (hc : o.size ≠ .complete) :
    ∃ x, q.toSciNumber o = some x ∧
      (x.value : ℝ) = ((scaledRound q o.base scale o.mode).1.toInt : ℝ)
        * (o.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ (-scale)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hb2, _⟩ := valid_base hv
  have hb0 : 0 < o.base.toNat := by omega
  have hbR0 : (0 : ℝ) < o.base.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hb0
  have hx : (toRat q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := fun h => h0 ((toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mp h)
  rcases hsize : o.size with _ | p | s
  · exact absurd hsize hc
  · 
    rw [hsize] at hsz
    simp only [sizeScale, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hsz
    obtain ⟨hscale, -⟩ := hsz
    have : Fact (1 < o.base.toNat) := ⟨hb2⟩
    have : NeZero p := ⟨(valid_precision hv hsize).ne'⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx_eq, hval⟩ := toSciNumber_value_precision q o hv p hsize
    refine ⟨x, hx_eq, ?_⟩
    rw [val_round_precisionSet o.mode _ hx] at hval
    set e := Int.log o.base.toNat |(toRat q : ℝ)| with he
    have hlog : floorLogBaseAbs o.base q = e := floorLogBaseAbs_eq o.base hb2 q h0
    have hu_eq : precScale o.base.toNat p (toRat q : ℝ) = (o.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ (-scale) := by
      unfold precScale; rw [← he, ← hscale, hlog]; congr 1; ring
    have hpow : (o.base.toNat : ℝ) ^ scale = (precScale o.base.toNat p (toRat q : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
      rw [hu_eq, ← zpow_neg, neg_neg]
    have hr := toInt_scaledRound q o.base hb0 scale o.mode
    rw [hpow, ← div_eq_mul_inv] at hr
    have hrI := toInt_eq_of_val hr
    rw [hrI, hu_eq] at hval
    exact EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp hval
  · 
    rw [hsize] at hsz
    simp only [sizeScale, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hsz
    obtain ⟨hscale, -⟩ := hsz
    have : NeZero o.base.toNat := ⟨hb0.ne'⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx_eq, hval⟩ := toSciNumber_value_scale q o hv s hsize
    refine ⟨x, hx_eq, ?_⟩
    rw [val_round_scaleSet] at hval
    have hr := toInt_scaledRound q o.base hb0 scale o.mode
    rw [← hscale, zpow_natCast] at hr
    have hrI := toInt_eq_of_val hr
    rw [hrI] at hval
    rw [← hscale, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, div_eq_mul_inv] at *
    exact EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp hval

name: Azurite.AzRat.toSciExact_iff
statement:
theorem toSciExact_iff (q : AzRat) (o : SciOptions) :
    q.toSciExact o = true ↔ ∃ x, q.toSciNumber o = some x ∧ (x.value : ℝ) = toRat q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv : o.valid = true
  swap
  · have hv' : o.valid = false := by simpa using hv
    unfold toSciExact toSciNumber
    rw [hv']
    simp
  obtain ⟨hb2, hb36⟩ := valid_base hv
  have hb0 : 0 < o.base.toNat := by omega
  have hbR0 : (0 : ℝ) < o.base.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hb0
  unfold toSciExact
  rw [hv, Bool.true_and, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  by_cases h0 : q.num = 0
  · simp only [h0, true_or, true_iff]
    refine ⟨⟨false, o.base, #[], zeroScale o.size⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold toSciNumber
      rw [hv]
      simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, h0]
    · rw [value_zero_digits, (toRat_eq_zero_iff q).mpr h0]; simp
  · simp only [h0, false_or]
    rcases hsize : o.size with _ | p | s
    · 
      obtain ⟨hval, hiff⟩ := toSciNumber_complete q o hv hsize
      simp only []
      constructor
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp (hiff.mpr h)
        exact ⟨x, hx, hval x hx⟩
      · rintro ⟨x, hx, _⟩
        exact hiff.mp (Option.isSome_iff_exists.mpr ⟨x, hx⟩)
    · 
      simp only [sizeScale]
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hval⟩ := toSciNumber_value_eq_scaledRound q o hv h0
        ((p : ℤ) - 1 - floorLogBaseAbs o.base q) p (by rw [hsize]; rfl)
        (by rw [hsize]; exact SciSizeOptions.noConfusion)
      rw [snd_scaledRound q o.base hb0 _ o.mode, beq_iff_eq, compare_eq_iff_eq]
      constructor
      · intro h
        refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
        rw [hval, h, mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hbR0.ne', add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero, mul_one]
      · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyv⟩
        rw [hx] at hy
        obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hy
        rw [hval] at hyv
        rw [← hyv, mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hbR0.ne', neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero, mul_one]
    · 
      simp only [sizeScale]
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hval⟩ := toSciNumber_value_eq_scaledRound q o hv h0 (s : ℤ)
        ((s : ℤ) + floorLogBaseAbs o.base q + 1) (by rw [hsize]; rfl)
        (by rw [hsize]; exact SciSizeOptions.noConfusion)
      rw [snd_scaledRound q o.base hb0 (s : ℤ) o.mode, beq_iff_eq, compare_eq_iff_eq]
      constructor
      · intro h
        refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
        rw [hval, h, mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hbR0.ne', add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero, mul_one]
      · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyv⟩
        rw [hx] at hy
        obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hy
        rw [hval] at hyv
        rw [← hyv, mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hbR0.ne', neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero, mul_one]

name: Azurite.AzRat.digits_rev_lt_base
statement:
lemma digits_rev_lt_base (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (n : AzNat) :
    ∀ d ∈ (n.limbDigits b).reverse, d.toNat < b.toNat
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_reverse, List.mem_reverse] at hd
  have : d.toNat ∈ (n.limbDigits b).toList.map UInt64.toNat := List.mem_map_of_mem hd
  rw [AzNat.limbDigits_eq b hb] at this
  exact Nat.digits_lt_base hb this

name: Azurite.AzRat.digits_rev_head_ne_zero
statement:
lemma digits_rev_head_ne_zero (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (n : AzNat) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (h : 0 < (n.limbDigits b).reverse.size) : ((n.limbDigits b).reverse)[0]'h ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hnN : n.toNat ≠ 0 := fun hz => hn (AzNat.toNat_injective (by rw [hz]; rfl))
  have hlen : (n.limbDigits b).toList.length = (n.limbDigits b).size := Array.length_toList
  have hpos : 0 < (n.limbDigits b).toList.length := by
    rw [hlen]; rwa [Array.size_reverse] at h
  have hne : (n.limbDigits b).toList ≠ [] := List.ne_nil_of_length_pos hpos
  
  have hget : ((n.limbDigits b).reverse)[0]'h = (n.limbDigits b).toList.getLast hne := by
    rw [Array.getElem_reverse, List.getLast_eq_getElem, ← Array.getElem_toList]
    congr 1
  rw [hget]
  intro h0
  have hlast := Nat.getLast_digit_ne_zero b.toNat hnN
  have hne' : (n.limbDigits b).toList.map UInt64.toNat ≠ [] := by simpa using hne
  have hne'' : Nat.digits b.toNat n.toNat ≠ [] := by
    rw [← AzNat.limbDigits_eq b hb n]; exact hne'
  have hcongr := List.getLast_congr hne' hne'' (AzNat.limbDigits_eq b hb n)
  rw [← hcongr, List.getLast_map, h0] at hlast
  exact hlast rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.toSciNumber_wellFormed
statement:
theorem toSciNumber_wellFormed (q : AzRat) (o : SciOptions) (x : SciNumber)
    (hx : q.toSciNumber o = some x) :
    x.base = o.base ∧ (∀ d ∈ x.digits, d.toNat < o.base.toNat) ∧
      (∀ h : 0 < x.digits.size, x.digits[0]'h ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv : o.valid = true
  swap
  · have hv' : o.valid = false := by simpa using hv
    unfold toSciNumber at hx
    rw [hv'] at hx
    simp at hx
  obtain ⟨hb2, _⟩ := valid_base hv
  unfold toSciNumber at hx
  rw [hv] at hx
  simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hx
  
  have zero_case : ∀ (neg : Bool) (sc : Int),
      x = ⟨neg, o.base, #[], sc⟩ → x.base = o.base ∧ (∀ d ∈ x.digits, d.toNat < o.base.toNat) ∧
        (∀ h : 0 < x.digits.size, x.digits[0]'h ≠ 0) := by
    rintro neg sc rfl
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro d hd; simp at hd
    · intro h; simp at h
  have digits_case : ∀ (r : AzInt) (sc : Int), r.abs ≠ 0 →
      x = ⟨!r.sign, o.base, (r.abs.limbDigits o.base).reverse, sc⟩ →
      x.base = o.base ∧ (∀ d ∈ x.digits, d.toNat < o.base.toNat) ∧
        (∀ h : 0 < x.digits.size, x.digits[0]'h ≠ 0) := by
    rintro r sc hr rfl
    exact ⟨rfl, digits_rev_lt_base o.base hb2 r.abs, digits_rev_head_ne_zero o.base hb2 r.abs hr⟩
  have pop_case : ∀ (r : AzInt) (sc : Int) (p : ℕ), r.abs ≠ 0 →
      (r.abs.limbDigits o.base).reverse.size = p + 1 →
      x = ⟨!r.sign, o.base, (r.abs.limbDigits o.base).reverse.pop, sc⟩ →
      x.base = o.base ∧ (∀ d ∈ x.digits, d.toNat < o.base.toNat) ∧
        (∀ h : 0 < x.digits.size, x.digits[0]'h ≠ 0) := by
    rintro r sc p hr hsz rfl
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro d hd
      apply digits_rev_lt_base o.base hb2 r.abs d
      rw [Array.mem_def, Array.toList_pop] at hd
      rw [Array.mem_def]
      exact List.mem_of_mem_dropLast hd
    · intro h
      rw [Array.getElem_pop]
      exact digits_rev_head_ne_zero o.base hb2 r.abs hr _
  by_cases h0 : q.num = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left h0] at hx
    exact zero_case _ _ (Option.some.inj hx).symm
  · rw [ite_eq_right h0] at hx
    rcases hsz : sizeScale o.base q o.size (floorLogBaseAbs o.base q) with _ | ⟨scale, prec⟩
    · rw [hsz] at hx; simp at hx
    · rw [hsz] at hx
      simp only [] at hx
      by_cases hn : (scaledRound q o.base scale o.mode).1.abs = 0
      · rw [ite_eq_left hn] at hx
        exact zero_case _ _ (Option.some.inj hx).symm
      · rw [ite_eq_right hn] at hx
        revert hx
        rcases hsize : o.size with _ | p | s <;> intro hx <;> (try simp only [] at hx)
        · exact digits_case _ _ hn (Option.some.inj hx).symm
        · by_cases hp : ((scaledRound q o.base scale o.mode).1.abs.limbDigits o.base).reverse.size
              = p + 1
          · rw [ite_eq_left hp] at hx
            exact pop_case _ _ p hn hp (Option.some.inj hx).symm
          · rw [ite_eq_right hp] at hx
            exact digits_case _ _ hn (Option.some.inj hx).symm
        · exact digits_case _ _ hn (Option.some.inj hx).symm

name: Azurite.AzRat.abs_toRat_eq
statement:
lemma abs_toRat_eq (q : AzRat) :
    |(toRat q : ℝ)| = (q.num.toNat : ℝ) / (q.den.toNat : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hnum : (toRat q).num = if q.sign then (q.num.toNat : ℤ) else -(q.num.toNat : ℤ) := rfl
  have hden : (toRat q).den = q.den.toNat := rfl
  rw [Rat.cast_def, abs_div, hnum, hden]
  congr 1
  · cases q.sign <;> push_cast <;> simp
  · exact abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)

name: Azurite.AzRat.den_toNat_pos
statement: lemma den_toNat_pos (q : AzRat) : 0 < q.den.toNat
proof:
:=
  Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => q.den_nz (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm)))

name: Azurite.AzRat.num_toNat_pos
statement: lemma num_toNat_pos (q : AzRat) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) : 0 < q.num.toNat
proof:
:=
  Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => hq (AzNat.toNat_injective (h.trans AzNat.toNat_zero.symm)))

name: Azurite.AzRat.abs_toRat_pos
statement: lemma abs_toRat_pos (q : AzRat) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) : 0 < |(toRat q : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_toRat_eq]
  have h1 := num_toNat_pos q hq
  have h2 := den_toNat_pos q
  positivity

name: Azurite.AzRat.compare_natCast
statement:
private lemma compare_natCast (x y : ℕ) :
    compare (x : ℝ) (y : ℝ) = compare x y
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy x y with h | h | h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr (Nat.cast_lt.mpr h)]
  · subst h; rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr rfl]
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr (Nat.cast_lt.mpr h)]

name: Azurite.AzRat.compare_div_div
statement:
private lemma compare_div_div (a b c d : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (hd : 0 < d) :
    compare (a / b) (c / d) = compare (a * d) (c * b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (a / b) (c / d) with h | h | h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h, compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr ((div_lt_div_iff₀ hb hd).mp h)]
  · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h, compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr ((div_eq_div_iff hb.ne' hd.ne').mp h)]
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h, compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr ((div_lt_div_iff₀ hd hb).mp h)]

name: Azurite.AzRat.cmpPowAbs_eq
statement:
lemma cmpPowAbs_eq (b : UInt64) (hb : 0 < b.toNat) (e : ℤ) (q : AzRat) :
    cmpPowAbs b e q = compare ((b.toNat : ℝ) ^ e) |(toRat q : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < q.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast den_toNat_pos q
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hb
  rw [abs_toRat_eq]
  cases e with
  | ofNat n =>
    simp only [cmpPowAbs]
    rw [AzNat.compare_eq_compare_toNat, AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_pow, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
    rw [show ((b.toNat : ℝ) ^ (Int.ofNat n : ℤ)) = ((b.toNat ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ) / 1 from by
      rw [div_one, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast, Nat.cast_pow]]
    rw [compare_div_div _ _ _ _ one_pos hD, mul_one, ← Nat.cast_mul, compare_natCast,
      Nat.mul_comm]
  | negSucc n =>
    simp only [cmpPowAbs]
    rw [AzNat.compare_eq_compare_toNat, AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_pow, AzNat.toNat_ofNat]
    rw [zpow_negSucc, inv_eq_one_div,
      compare_div_div _ _ _ _ (pow_pos hbR _) hD, one_mul, ← Nat.cast_pow, ← Nat.cast_mul,
      compare_natCast]

name: Azurite.AzRat.floorLogSearch_eq
statement:
lemma floorLogSearch_eq (b : UInt64) (hb : 1 < b.toNat) (q : AzRat) (hq : q.num ≠ 0)
    (lo hi : ℤ) (hlo : (b.toNat : ℝ) ^ lo ≤ |(toRat q : ℝ)|)
    (hhi : |(toRat q : ℝ)| < (b.toNat : ℝ) ^ hi) :
    floorLogSearch b q lo hi = Int.log b.toNat |(toRat q : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := abs_toRat_pos q hq
  have hbR : (1 : ℝ) < b.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hb
  induction h_sub : (hi - lo).toNat using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing lo hi with
  | _ n ih =>
  rw [floorLogSearch]
  split_ifs with h
  · dsimp only
    set mid := (lo + hi) / 2 with hmid_def
    have hmid1 : lo < mid := by omega
    have hmid2 : mid < hi := by omega
    rw [cmpPowAbs_eq b (by omega) mid q]
    rcases lt_trichotomy ((b.toNat : ℝ) ^ mid) |(toRat q : ℝ)| with hlt | heq | hgt
    · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr hlt]
      exact ih _ (by omega) mid hi hlt.le hhi rfl
    · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr heq]
      exact ih _ (by omega) mid hi heq.le hhi rfl
    · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr hgt]
      exact ih _ (by omega) lo mid hlo hgt rfl
  · have hlohi : lo < hi := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      have : (b.toNat : ℝ) ^ hi ≤ (b.toNat : ℝ) ^ lo := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ hbR.le hcon
      linarith
    have hhi' : hi = lo + 1 := by omega
    rw [hhi'] at hhi
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log hb hpos).mp hlo
    · have := (Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt hb hpos).mp hhi
      omega

name: Azurite.AzRat.int_log_pow_two
statement:
private lemma int_log_pow_two (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    Int.log (2 ^ k) x = Int.log 2 x / (k : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 1 < 2 ^ k := Nat.one_lt_two_pow (by omega)
  set L := Int.log 2 x with hL
  have hkZ : (0 : ℤ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hdiv := Int.emod_def L k
  have hr0 := Int.emod_nonneg L hkZ.ne'
  have hrk := Int.emod_lt_of_pos L hkZ
  set d := L / (k : ℤ) with hd
  set r := L % (k : ℤ) with hr
  have hcast : ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (k : ℤ) := by push_cast; rw [zpow_natCast]
  have h2 : (1 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  apply le_antisymm
  · 
    have hx_lt : x < (2 : ℝ) ^ (L + 1) := by
      exact_mod_cast Int.lt_zpow_succ_log_self (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) < 2) x
    have hle : L + 1 ≤ (k : ℤ) * (d + 1) := by nlinarith
    have : x < ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (d + 1) := by
      rw [hcast, ← zpow_mul]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx_lt (zpow_le_zpow_right₀ h2.le hle)
    have := (Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt hb hx).mp this
    omega
  · 
    have hx_ge : (2 : ℝ) ^ L ≤ x := by
      exact_mod_cast Int.zpow_log_le_self (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) < 2) hx
    have hle : (k : ℤ) * d ≤ L := by nlinarith
    have : ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ d ≤ x := by
      rw [hcast, ← zpow_mul]
      exact le_trans (zpow_le_zpow_right₀ h2.le hle) hx_ge
    exact (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log hb hx).mp this

name: Azurite.AzRat.floorLogBase2Abs_eq_log
statement:
lemma floorLogBase2Abs_eq_log (q : AzRat) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) :
    floorLogBase2Abs q = Int.log 2 |(toRat q : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  rw [floorLogBase2Abs_eq q hq, ← Real.floor_logb_natCast (b := 2) (abs_toRat_pos q hq).le]
  norm_num

name: Azurite.AzRat.floorLogBaseAbs_eq
statement:
theorem floorLogBaseAbs_eq (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (q : AzRat) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) :
    floorLogBaseAbs b q = Int.log b.toNat |(toRat q : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := abs_toRat_pos q hq
  have hb1 : 1 < b.toNat := hb
  have hbR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ b.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have h2 : (1 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  unfold floorLogBaseAbs
  simp only [hq, ↓reduceIte]
  rw [floorLogBase2Abs_eq_log q hq]
  set L := Int.log 2 |(toRat q : ℝ)| with hL
  split_ifs with hpow
  · 
    set k := b.toNat.log2 with hk
    have hk0 : 0 < k := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with h0 | h0
      · rw [h0] at hpow; simp at hpow; omega
      · exact h0
    rw [← hpow]
    exact (int_log_pow_two k hk0 _ hpos).symm
  · apply floorLogSearch_eq b hb1 q hq
    · 
      have hL_le : (2 : ℝ) ^ L ≤ |(toRat q : ℝ)| := by
        have h := Int.zpow_log_le_self (R := ℝ) (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) < 2) hpos
        rw [Nat.cast_ofNat] at h
        exact h
      rcases le_or_gt L 0 with hL0 | hL0
      · rw [min_eq_left hL0]
        refine le_trans ?_ hL_le
        
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, L = -(m : ℤ) := ⟨(-L).toNat, by omega⟩
        rw [hm, zpow_neg, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]
        exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hbR m)
      · rw [min_eq_right hL0.le, zpow_zero]
        exact le_trans (one_le_zpow₀ h2.le hL0.le) hL_le
    · 
      have hL_lt : |(toRat q : ℝ)| < (2 : ℝ) ^ (L + 1) := by
        have h := Int.lt_zpow_succ_log_self (R := ℝ) (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) < 2) |(toRat q : ℝ)|
        rw [Nat.cast_ofNat] at h
        exact h
      rcases le_or_gt 0 (L + 1) with hL1 | hL1
      · rw [max_eq_left hL1]
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, L + 1 = (m : ℤ) := ⟨(L + 1).toNat, by omega⟩
        rw [hm] at hL_lt ⊢
        rw [zpow_natCast] at hL_lt ⊢
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hL_lt (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hbR m)
      · rw [max_eq_right hL1.le, zpow_zero]
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, L + 1 = -(m : ℤ) ∧ 0 < m :=
          ⟨(-(L + 1)).toNat, by omega, by omega⟩
        rw [hm.1, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast] at hL_lt
        exact lt_trans hL_lt (inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (one_lt_pow₀ (by norm_num) hm.2.ne'))

name: Azurite.AzRat.floorLogBaseAbs_eq_floor_logb
statement:
theorem floorLogBaseAbs_eq_floor_logb (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (q : AzRat)
    (hq : q.num ≠ 0) :
    floorLogBaseAbs b q = ⌊logb (b.toNat : ℝ) |(toRat q : ℝ)|⌋
proof:
:= by
  rw [floorLogBaseAbs_eq b hb q hq, Real.floor_logb_natCast (abs_toRat_pos q hq).le]

name: Azurite.AzRat.ceilingLogBaseAbs_eq
statement:
theorem ceilingLogBaseAbs_eq (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (q : AzRat) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) :
    ceilingLogBaseAbs b q = Int.clog b.toNat |(toRat q : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  unfold ceilingLogBaseAbs
  rw [ite_eq_right hq]
  simp only []
  have hpos := abs_toRat_pos q hq
  have hb1 : 1 < b.toNat := hb
  rw [floorLogBaseAbs_eq b hb q hq, cmpPowAbs_eq b (by omega)]
  set e := Int.log b.toNat |(toRat q : ℝ)| with he
  have hlo : (b.toNat : ℝ) ^ e ≤ |(toRat q : ℝ)| := Int.zpow_log_le_self hb1 hpos
  have hhi : |(toRat q : ℝ)| < (b.toNat : ℝ) ^ (e + 1) := Int.lt_zpow_succ_log_self hb1 _
  rcases hc : compare ((b.toNat : ℝ) ^ e) |(toRat q : ℝ)| with _ | _ | _
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt] at hc
    simp only [beq_iff_eq, reduceCtorEq, ↓reduceIte]
    symm
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (Int.le_zpow_iff_clog_le hb1 hpos).mp hhi.le
    · exact (Int.zpow_lt_iff_lt_clog hb1 hpos).mp hc
  · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq] at hc
    simp only [beq_self_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [← hc, Int.clog_zpow hb1]
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt] at hc
    exact absurd hlo (not_le.mpr hc)

name: Azurite.AzRat.checkedLogBaseAbs_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem checkedLogBaseAbs_eq_some_iff (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (q : AzRat) (e : ℤ) :
    checkedLogBaseAbs b q = some e ↔ |(toRat q : ℝ)| = (b.toNat : ℝ) ^ e
proof:
:= by
  unfold checkedLogBaseAbs
  have hb1 : 1 < b.toNat := hb
  by_cases hq : q.num = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left hq, abs_toRat_eq,
      show (q.num.toNat : ℝ) = 0 by rw [hq, AzNat.toNat_zero, Nat.cast_zero], zero_div]
    constructor
    · intro h; cases h
    · intro h; exact absurd h.symm (zpow_pos (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < b.toNat)) _).ne'
  · rw [ite_eq_right hq]
    simp only []
    have hpos := abs_toRat_pos q hq
    rw [floorLogBaseAbs_eq b hb q hq, cmpPowAbs_eq b (by omega)]
    constructor
    · intro h
      split_ifs at h with hc
      · simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
        rw [beq_iff_eq, compare_eq_iff_eq] at hc
        rw [← h, hc]
    · intro h
      have hlog : Int.log b.toNat |(toRat q : ℝ)| = e := by rw [h, Int.log_zpow hb1]
      rw [hlog, ite_eq_left (by rw [beq_iff_eq, compare_eq_iff_eq, h])]

name: Azurite.AzRat.checkedLogBaseAbs_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem checkedLogBaseAbs_eq_none_iff (b : UInt64) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (q : AzRat) :
    checkedLogBaseAbs b q = none ↔ ∀ e : ℤ, |(toRat q : ℝ)| ≠ (b.toNat : ℝ) ^ e
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h e he
    have := (checkedLogBaseAbs_eq_some_iff b hb q e).mpr he
    rw [h] at this
    cases this
  · intro h
    rcases hc : checkedLogBaseAbs b q with _ | e
    · rfl
    · exact absurd ((checkedLogBaseAbs_eq_some_iff b hb q e).mp hc) (h e)

name: Azurite.AzRat.toRat_eq_div_of_pos
statement:
theorem toRat_eq_div_of_pos (b : AzRat) (hb : 0 < (toRat b : ℝ)) :
    (toRat b : ℝ) = (b.num.toNat : ℝ) / b.den.toNat ∧ b.sign = true ∧ 0 < b.num.toNat
proof:
:= by
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < b.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast den_toNat_pos b
  have hcast := toRat_cast_eq b
  have hs : b.sign = true := by
    by_contra hs
    rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hs
    rw [hcast, hs] at hb
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast] at hb
    have : -(b.num.toNat : ℝ) / b.den.toNat ≤ 0 :=
      div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) hD.le
    linarith
  rw [hcast, hs] at hb ⊢
  simp only [↓reduceIte, Int.cast_natCast] at hb ⊢
  refine ⟨by simp, by simp, ?_⟩
  have : (0 : ℝ) < b.num.toNat := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have := div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg h hD.le
    linarith
  exact_mod_cast this

name: Azurite.AzRat.cmpPowRatAbs_eq
statement:
lemma cmpPowRatAbs_eq (b q : AzRat) (hb : 0 < (toRat b : ℝ)) (e : ℤ) :
    cmpPowRatAbs b e q = compare ((toRat b : ℝ) ^ e) |(toRat q : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hbv, -, hN⟩ := toRat_eq_div_of_pos b hb
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < q.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast den_toNat_pos q
  have hDb : (0 : ℝ) < b.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast den_toNat_pos b
  have hNb : (0 : ℝ) < b.num.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hN
  rw [abs_toRat_eq, hbv]
  cases e with
  | ofNat n =>
    simp only [cmpPowRatAbs]
    rw [AzNat.compare_eq_compare_toNat, AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_pow,
      AzNat.toNat_pow, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast, div_pow,
      compare_div_div _ _ _ _ (pow_pos hDb n) hD, ← Nat.cast_pow, ← Nat.cast_pow,
      ← Nat.cast_mul, ← Nat.cast_mul, compare_natCast, Nat.mul_comm q.num.toNat]
  | negSucc n =>
    simp only [cmpPowRatAbs]
    rw [AzNat.compare_eq_compare_toNat, AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_mul, AzNat.toNat_pow,
      AzNat.toNat_pow, zpow_negSucc, div_pow, inv_div,
      compare_div_div _ _ _ _ (pow_pos hNb _) hD, ← Nat.cast_pow, ← Nat.cast_pow,
      ← Nat.cast_mul, ← Nat.cast_mul, compare_natCast, Nat.mul_comm q.num.toNat]

name: Azurite.AzRat.logb_zpow'
statement: theorem logb_zpow' {b : ℝ} (hb0 : 0 < b) (hb1 : b ≠ 1) (z : ℤ) : Real.logb b (b ^ z) = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.rpow_intCast, Real.logb_rpow hb0 hb1]

name: Azurite.AzRat.floor_logb_eq
statement:
theorem floor_logb_eq {b x : ℝ} (hb : 1 < b) (hx : 0 < x) (z : ℤ)
    (hlo : b ^ z ≤ x) (hhi : x < b ^ (z + 1)) : ⌊Real.logb b x⌋ = z
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by linarith
  rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]
  constructor
  · rw [← logb_zpow' hb0 hb.ne' z]
    exact (Real.logb_le_logb hb (zpow_pos hb0 _) hx).mpr hlo
  · rw [show ((z : ℝ) + 1) = ((z + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring, ← logb_zpow' hb0 hb.ne' (z + 1)]
    exact (Real.logb_lt_logb_iff hb hx (zpow_pos hb0 _)).mpr hhi

name: Azurite.AzRat.ceil_logb_eq
statement:
theorem ceil_logb_eq {b x : ℝ} (hb : 1 < b) (hx : 0 < x) (z : ℤ)
    (hlo : b ^ (z - 1) < x) (hhi : x ≤ b ^ z) : ⌈Real.logb b x⌉ = z
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by linarith
  rw [Int.ceil_eq_iff]
  constructor
  · rw [show ((z : ℝ) - 1) = ((z - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring, ← logb_zpow' hb0 hb.ne' (z - 1)]
    exact (Real.logb_lt_logb_iff hb (zpow_pos hb0 _) hx).mpr hlo
  · rw [← logb_zpow' hb0 hb.ne' z]
    exact (Real.logb_le_logb hb hx (zpow_pos hb0 _)).mpr hhi

name: Azurite.AzRat.floorLogSearchRat_eq
statement:
lemma floorLogSearchRat_eq (b q : AzRat) (hb : 1 < (toRat b : ℝ)) (hq : q.num ≠ 0)
    (lo hi : ℤ) (hlo : (toRat b : ℝ) ^ lo ≤ |(toRat q : ℝ)|)
    (hhi : |(toRat q : ℝ)| < (toRat b : ℝ) ^ hi) :
    floorLogSearchRat b q lo hi = ⌊Real.logb (toRat b) |(toRat q : ℝ)|⌋
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := abs_toRat_pos q hq
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < toRat b := by linarith
  induction h_sub : (hi - lo).toNat using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing lo hi with
  | _ n ih =>
  rw [floorLogSearchRat]
  split_ifs with h
  · dsimp only
    set mid := (lo + hi) / 2 with hmid_def
    have hmid1 : lo < mid := by omega
    have hmid2 : mid < hi := by omega
    rw [cmpPowRatAbs_eq b q hb0 mid]
    rcases lt_trichotomy ((toRat b : ℝ) ^ mid) |(toRat q : ℝ)| with hlt | heq | hgt
    · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr hlt]
      exact ih _ (by omega) mid hi hlt.le hhi rfl
    · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr heq]
      exact ih _ (by omega) mid hi heq.le hhi rfl
    · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr hgt]
      exact ih _ (by omega) lo mid hlo hgt rfl
  · have hlohi : lo < hi := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      have : (toRat b : ℝ) ^ hi ≤ (toRat b : ℝ) ^ lo := zpow_le_zpow_right₀ hb.le hcon
      linarith
    have hhi' : hi = lo + 1 := by omega
    rw [hhi'] at hhi
    exact (floor_logb_eq hb hpos lo hlo hhi).symm

name: Azurite.AzRat.bracketHi_spec
statement:
theorem bracketHi_spec (b q : AzRat) :
    ∀ (fuel hi : ℕ), cmpPowRatAbs b (bracketHi b q hi fuel) q = .gt ∨
      bracketHi b q hi fuel = hi * 2 ^ fuel
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro hi; right; simp [bracketHi]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro hi
    simp only [bracketHi]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact Or.inl (beq_iff_eq.mp h)
    · rcases ih (2 * hi) with h1 | h1
      · exact Or.inl h1
      · right; rw [h1]; ring

name: Azurite.AzRat.bracketLo_spec
statement:
theorem bracketLo_spec (b q : AzRat) :
    ∀ (fuel lo : ℕ), cmpPowRatAbs b (-(bracketLo b q lo fuel : ℤ)) q ≠ .gt ∨
      bracketLo b q lo fuel = lo * 2 ^ fuel
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro lo; right; simp [bracketLo]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro lo
    simp only [bracketLo]
    split_ifs with h
    · rcases ih (2 * lo) with h1 | h1
      · exact Or.inl h1
      · right; rw [h1]; ring
    · exact Or.inl (fun h' => h (beq_iff_eq.mpr h'))

name: Azurite.AzRat.lt_pow_two_pow
statement:
theorem lt_pow_two_pow (b : AzRat) (hb : 1 < (toRat b : ℝ)) (m F : ℕ)
    (hF : b.den.size + m.size ≤ F) : (m : ℝ) < (toRat b : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ F : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hbv, -, hN⟩ := toRat_eq_div_of_pos b (by linarith)
  have hDpos : 0 < b.den.toNat := den_toNat_pos b
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < b.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hDpos
  have hND : b.den.toNat < b.num.toNat := by
    rw [hbv, one_lt_div hD] at hb
    exact_mod_cast hb
  
  have hb1 : (1 : ℝ) / b.den.toNat ≤ (toRat b : ℝ) - 1 := by
    rw [hbv, div_sub_one hD.ne', div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hD]
    have : (b.den.toNat : ℝ) + 1 ≤ b.num.toNat := by exact_mod_cast hND
    linarith
  
  have hDm : b.den.toNat * m < 2 ^ F := by
    have h1 : b.den.toNat < 2 ^ b.den.size := by rw [← AzNat.size_toNat]; exact Nat.lt_size_self _
    have h2 : m < 2 ^ m.size := Nat.lt_size_self _
    calc b.den.toNat * m < (b.den.toNat + 1) * (m + 1) := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ 2 ^ b.den.size * 2 ^ m.size := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
      _ = 2 ^ (b.den.size + m.size) := by rw [pow_add]
      _ ≤ 2 ^ F := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hF
  have hDmR : (m : ℝ) ≤ (2 ^ F : ℕ) / b.den.toNat := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hD]
    have : ((b.den.toNat * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((2 ^ F : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hDm.le
    push_cast at this ⊢
    linarith
  have hbern := one_add_mul_sub_le_pow (show (-1 : ℝ) ≤ toRat b by linarith) (2 ^ F)
  have h2F : (0 : ℝ) < (2 ^ F : ℕ) := by positivity
  calc (m : ℝ) ≤ (2 ^ F : ℕ) / b.den.toNat := hDmR
    _ = (2 ^ F : ℕ) * (1 / b.den.toNat) := by ring
    _ ≤ (2 ^ F : ℕ) * ((toRat b : ℝ) - 1) := by gcongr
    _ < 1 + (2 ^ F : ℕ) * ((toRat b : ℝ) - 1) := by linarith
    _ ≤ (toRat b : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ F : ℕ) := hbern

name: Azurite.AzRat.one_lt_toRat_iff
statement:
theorem one_lt_toRat_iff (b : AzRat) (hb : 0 < (toRat b : ℝ)) :
    1 < (toRat b : ℝ) ↔ b.den < b.num
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hbv, -, -⟩ := toRat_eq_div_of_pos b hb
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < b.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast den_toNat_pos b
  rw [hbv, one_lt_div hD, AzNat.lt_iff_toNat_lt]
  exact Nat.cast_lt

name: Azurite.AzRat.abs_toRat_le_num
statement: theorem abs_toRat_le_num (q : AzRat) : |(toRat q : ℝ)| ≤ q.num.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_toRat_eq]
  exact div_le_self (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast den_toNat_pos q)

name: Azurite.AzRat.inv_abs_toRat_le_den
statement:
theorem inv_abs_toRat_le_den (q : AzRat) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) :
    |(toRat q : ℝ)|⁻¹ ≤ q.den.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_toRat_eq, inv_div]
  exact div_le_self (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast num_toNat_pos q hq)

name: Azurite.AzRat.floorLogBaseRatAbsCore_eq
statement:
theorem floorLogBaseRatAbsCore_eq (b q : AzRat) (hb : 1 < (toRat b : ℝ)) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) :
    floorLogBaseRatAbsCore b q = ⌊Real.logb (toRat b) |(toRat q : ℝ)|⌋
proof:
:= by
  unfold floorLogBaseRatAbsCore
  simp only []
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < toRat b := by linarith
  have hpos := abs_toRat_pos q hq
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < q.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast den_toNat_pos q
  split_ifs with hbr hge
  · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, bne_iff_ne, ne_eq, beq_iff_eq] at hbr
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hbr
    rw [cmpPowRatAbs_eq b q hb0] at h1 h2
    apply floorLogSearchRat_eq b q hb hq
    · exact le_of_not_gt (fun h => h1 (compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h))
    · exact compare_gt_iff_gt.mp h2
  · 
    apply floorLogSearchRat_eq b q hb hq
    · rw [zpow_zero, abs_toRat_eq, le_div_iff₀ hD, one_mul]
      rw [AzNat.le_iff_toNat_le] at hge
      exact_mod_cast hge
    · rcases bracketHi_spec b q (bracketFuel b q) 1 with h | h
      · rw [cmpPowRatAbs_eq b q hb0] at h
        exact compare_gt_iff_gt.mp h
      · rw [h, one_mul, zpow_natCast]
        calc |(toRat q : ℝ)| ≤ q.num.toNat := abs_toRat_le_num q
          _ < (toRat b : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ bracketFuel b q : ℕ) :=
            lt_pow_two_pow b hb _ _ (by unfold bracketFuel; rw [AzNat.size_toNat]; omega)
  · 
    apply floorLogSearchRat_eq b q hb hq
    · rcases bracketLo_spec b q (bracketFuel b q) 1 with h | h
      · rw [cmpPowRatAbs_eq b q hb0] at h
        exact le_of_not_gt (fun hh => h (compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr hh))
      · rw [h, one_mul, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, inv_le_comm₀ (pow_pos hb0 _) hpos]
        exact (calc |(toRat q : ℝ)|⁻¹ ≤ q.den.toNat := inv_abs_toRat_le_den q hq
          _ < (toRat b : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ bracketFuel b q : ℕ) :=
            lt_pow_two_pow b hb _ _ (by unfold bracketFuel; rw [AzNat.size_toNat]; omega)).le
    · rw [zpow_zero, abs_toRat_eq, div_lt_one hD]
      rw [AzNat.le_iff_toNat_le] at hge
      push Not at hge
      exact_mod_cast hge

name: Azurite.AzRat.zpow_floor_logb_bounds
statement:
theorem zpow_floor_logb_bounds {b x : ℝ} (hb : 1 < b) (hx : 0 < x) :
    b ^ ⌊Real.logb b x⌋ ≤ x ∧ x < b ^ (⌊Real.logb b x⌋ + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by linarith
  constructor
  · rw [← Real.logb_le_logb hb (zpow_pos hb0 _) hx, logb_zpow' hb0 hb.ne']
    exact Int.floor_le _
  · rw [← Real.logb_lt_logb_iff hb hx (zpow_pos hb0 _), logb_zpow' hb0 hb.ne']
    push_cast
    exact Int.lt_floor_add_one _

name: Azurite.AzRat.ceilingLogBaseRatAbsCore_eq
statement:
theorem ceilingLogBaseRatAbsCore_eq (b q : AzRat) (hb : 1 < (toRat b : ℝ)) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) :
    ceilingLogBaseRatAbsCore b q = ⌈Real.logb (toRat b) |(toRat q : ℝ)|⌉
proof:
:= by
  unfold ceilingLogBaseRatAbsCore
  simp only []
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < toRat b := by linarith
  have hpos := abs_toRat_pos q hq
  rw [floorLogBaseRatAbsCore_eq b q hb hq, cmpPowRatAbs_eq b q hb0]
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := zpow_floor_logb_bounds hb hpos
  set e := ⌊Real.logb (toRat b) |(toRat q : ℝ)|⌋ with he
  rcases hc : compare ((toRat b : ℝ) ^ e) |(toRat q : ℝ)| with _ | _ | _
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt] at hc
    simp only [beq_iff_eq, reduceCtorEq, ↓reduceIte]
    symm
    apply ceil_logb_eq hb hpos
    · rw [add_sub_cancel_right]; exact hc
    · exact hhi.le
  · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq] at hc
    simp only [beq_self_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [← hc, logb_zpow' hb0 hb.ne', Int.ceil_intCast]
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt] at hc
    exact absurd hlo (not_le.mpr hc)

name: Azurite.AzRat.cmpPowRatAbs_floor_eq_iff
statement:
theorem cmpPowRatAbs_floor_eq_iff (b q : AzRat) (hb : 1 < (toRat b : ℝ)) (hq : q.num ≠ 0)
    (e : ℤ) :
    (cmpPowRatAbs b (floorLogBaseRatAbsCore b q) q = .eq ∧ floorLogBaseRatAbsCore b q = e) ↔
      |(toRat q : ℝ)| = (toRat b : ℝ) ^ e
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < toRat b := by linarith
  rw [floorLogBaseRatAbsCore_eq b q hb hq, cmpPowRatAbs_eq b q hb0, compare_eq_iff_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    rw [← h2, h1]
  · intro h
    have : ⌊Real.logb (toRat b) |(toRat q : ℝ)|⌋ = e := by
      rw [h, logb_zpow' hb0 hb.ne', Int.floor_intCast]
    exact ⟨by rw [this, h], this⟩

name: Azurite.AzRat.isLogBase_eq_true
statement:
theorem isLogBase_eq_true (b : AzRat) (hb0 : 0 < (toRat b : ℝ)) (hb1 : (toRat b : ℝ) ≠ 1) :
    isLogBase b = true
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hbv, hs, hN⟩ := toRat_eq_div_of_pos b hb0
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < b.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast den_toNat_pos b
  unfold isLogBase
  rw [hs, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, bne_iff_ne, bne_iff_ne]
  refine ⟨fun h => by rw [h, AzNat.toNat_zero] at hN; omega, fun h => hb1 ?_⟩
  rw [hbv, h, div_self hD.ne']

name: Azurite.AzRat.lt_one_toRat_inv
statement:
theorem lt_one_toRat_inv (b : AzRat) (hb0 : 0 < (toRat b : ℝ)) (hb1 : (toRat b : ℝ) ≠ 1)
    (hlt : ¬ b.den < b.num) : 1 < (toRat b⁻¹ : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toRat_inv, Rat.cast_inv, one_lt_inv₀ hb0]
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp (fun h => hlt ((one_lt_toRat_iff b hb0).mp h))) hb1

name: Azurite.AzRat.floorLogBaseRatAbs_eq
statement:
theorem floorLogBaseRatAbs_eq (b q : AzRat) (hb0 : 0 < (toRat b : ℝ))
    (hb1 : (toRat b : ℝ) ≠ 1) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) :
    floorLogBaseRatAbs b q = some ⌊Real.logb (toRat b) |(toRat q : ℝ)|⌋
proof:
:= by
  unfold floorLogBaseRatAbs
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨hq, not_not.mpr (isLogBase_eq_true b hb0 hb1)⟩)]
  split_ifs with hlt
  · rw [floorLogBaseRatAbsCore_eq b q ((one_lt_toRat_iff b hb0).mpr hlt) hq]
  · rw [ceilingLogBaseRatAbsCore_eq b⁻¹ q (lt_one_toRat_inv b hb0 hb1 hlt) hq, toRat_inv,
      Rat.cast_inv, Real.logb_inv_base, Int.ceil_neg, neg_neg]

name: Azurite.AzRat.ceilingLogBaseRatAbs_eq
statement:
theorem ceilingLogBaseRatAbs_eq (b q : AzRat) (hb0 : 0 < (toRat b : ℝ))
    (hb1 : (toRat b : ℝ) ≠ 1) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) :
    ceilingLogBaseRatAbs b q = some ⌈Real.logb (toRat b) |(toRat q : ℝ)|⌉
proof:
:= by
  unfold ceilingLogBaseRatAbs
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨hq, not_not.mpr (isLogBase_eq_true b hb0 hb1)⟩)]
  split_ifs with hlt
  · rw [ceilingLogBaseRatAbsCore_eq b q ((one_lt_toRat_iff b hb0).mpr hlt) hq]
  · rw [floorLogBaseRatAbsCore_eq b⁻¹ q (lt_one_toRat_inv b hb0 hb1 hlt) hq, toRat_inv,
      Rat.cast_inv, Real.logb_inv_base, Int.floor_neg, neg_neg]

name: Azurite.AzRat.checkedLogBaseRatAbs_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem checkedLogBaseRatAbs_eq_some_iff (b q : AzRat) (hb0 : 0 < (toRat b : ℝ))
    (hb1 : (toRat b : ℝ) ≠ 1) (e : ℤ) :
    checkedLogBaseRatAbs b q = some e ↔ |(toRat q : ℝ)| = (toRat b : ℝ) ^ e
proof:
:= by
  unfold checkedLogBaseRatAbs
  by_cases hq : q.num = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left (Or.inl hq), abs_toRat_eq,
      show (q.num.toNat : ℝ) = 0 by rw [hq, AzNat.toNat_zero, Nat.cast_zero], zero_div]
    constructor
    · intro h; cases h
    · intro h; exact absurd h.symm (zpow_pos hb0 _).ne'
  · rw [ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨hq, not_not.mpr (isLogBase_eq_true b hb0 hb1)⟩)]
    simp only []
    split_ifs with hlt hc hc
    · rw [Option.some.injEq,
        ← cmpPowRatAbs_floor_eq_iff b q ((one_lt_toRat_iff b hb0).mpr hlt) hq e]
      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨beq_iff_eq.mp hc, h⟩, fun h => h.2⟩
    · rw [← cmpPowRatAbs_floor_eq_iff b q ((one_lt_toRat_iff b hb0).mpr hlt) hq e]
      exact ⟨fun h => h.elim, fun h => absurd (beq_iff_eq.mpr h.1) hc⟩
    · have key := cmpPowRatAbs_floor_eq_iff b⁻¹ q (lt_one_toRat_inv b hb0 hb1 hlt) hq (-e)
      rw [toRat_inv, Rat.cast_inv, inv_zpow, zpow_neg, inv_inv] at key
      rw [Option.some.injEq, ← key]
      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨beq_iff_eq.mp hc, by omega⟩, fun h => by omega⟩
    · have key := cmpPowRatAbs_floor_eq_iff b⁻¹ q (lt_one_toRat_inv b hb0 hb1 hlt) hq (-e)
      rw [toRat_inv, Rat.cast_inv, inv_zpow, zpow_neg, inv_inv] at key
      rw [← key]
      exact ⟨fun h => h.elim, fun h => absurd (beq_iff_eq.mpr h.1) hc⟩

name: Azurite.AzRat.checkedLogBaseRatAbs_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem checkedLogBaseRatAbs_eq_none_iff (b q : AzRat) (hb0 : 0 < (toRat b : ℝ))
    (hb1 : (toRat b : ℝ) ≠ 1) :
    checkedLogBaseRatAbs b q = none ↔ ∀ e : ℤ, |(toRat q : ℝ)| ≠ (toRat b : ℝ) ^ e
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h e he
    have := (checkedLogBaseRatAbs_eq_some_iff b q hb0 hb1 e).mpr he
    rw [h] at this
    cases this
  · intro h
    rcases hc : checkedLogBaseRatAbs b q with _ | e
    · rfl
    · exact absurd ((checkedLogBaseRatAbs_eq_some_iff b q hb0 hb1 e).mp hc) (h e)

name: Azurite.AzRat.two_pow_zpow
statement: theorem two_pow_zpow (k : ℕ) (x : ℤ) : ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ x = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℤ) * x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]

name: Azurite.AzRat.int_log_two_pow
statement:
theorem int_log_two_pow (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    Int.log (2 ^ k) r = Int.log 2 r / k
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 1 < 2 ^ k := Nat.one_lt_two_pow hk.ne'
  set e := Int.log 2 r with he
  have hkZ : (0 : ℤ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hdiv : (k : ℤ) * (e / k) + e % k = e := by
    rw [mul_comm]; exact (add_comm _ _).trans (Int.emod_add_ediv_mul e k)
  have hr0 := Int.emod_nonneg e hkZ.ne'
  have hr1 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos e hkZ
  apply le_antisymm
  · have : r < ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (e / k + 1) := by
      rw [two_pow_zpow]
      calc r < (2 : ℝ) ^ (e + 1) := by
            simpa using Int.lt_zpow_succ_log_self (b := 2) (by norm_num) r
        _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℤ) * (e / k + 1)) :=
            zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by rw [mul_add, mul_one]; linarith)
    have := (Int.lt_zpow_iff_log_lt hb hr).mp this
    omega
  · apply (Int.zpow_le_iff_le_log hb hr).mp
    rw [two_pow_zpow]
    calc (2 : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℤ) * (e / k)) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ e :=
          zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      _ ≤ r := by simpa using Int.zpow_log_le_self (b := 2) (by norm_num) hr

name: Azurite.AzRat.int_clog_two_pow
statement:
theorem int_clog_two_pow (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    Int.clog (2 ^ k) r = -((-Int.clog 2 r) / k)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 1 < 2 ^ k := Nat.one_lt_two_pow hk.ne'
  set c := Int.clog 2 r with hc
  have hkZ : (0 : ℤ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hdiv : (k : ℤ) * (-c / k) + -c % k = -c := by
    rw [mul_comm]; exact (add_comm _ _).trans (Int.emod_add_ediv_mul (-c) k)
  have hr0 := Int.emod_nonneg (-c) hkZ.ne'
  have hr1 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos (-c) hkZ
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (Int.le_zpow_iff_clog_le hb hr).mp
    rw [two_pow_zpow]
    calc r ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ c := by simpa using Int.self_le_zpow_clog (b := 2) (by norm_num) r
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℤ) * -(-c / k)) :=
          zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by rw [mul_neg]; linarith)
  · have : ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-(-c / k) - 1) < r := by
      rw [two_pow_zpow]
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℤ) * (-(-c / k) - 1)) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (c - 1) :=
            zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by rw [mul_sub, mul_neg, mul_one]; linarith)
        _ < r := by simpa using Int.zpow_pred_clog_lt_self (b := 2) (by norm_num) hr
    have := (Int.zpow_lt_iff_lt_clog hb hr).mp this
    omega

name: Azurite.AzRat.floorLogBasePowerOf2Abs_eq
statement:
theorem floorLogBasePowerOf2Abs_eq (q : AzRat) (k : ℕ) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) (hk : 0 < k) :
    floorLogBasePowerOf2Abs q k = some (Int.log (2 ^ k) |(toRat q : ℝ)|)
proof:
:= by
  unfold floorLogBasePowerOf2Abs
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨hq, hk.ne'⟩), floorLogBase2Abs_eq_log q hq,
    int_log_two_pow k hk _ (abs_toRat_pos q hq)]

name: Azurite.AzRat.ceilingLogBase2Abs_eq_clog
statement:
theorem ceilingLogBase2Abs_eq_clog (q : AzRat) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) :
    ceilingLogBase2Abs q = Int.clog 2 |(toRat q : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  rw [ceilingLogBase2Abs_eq q hq, ← Real.ceil_logb_natCast (b := 2) (abs_toRat_pos q hq).le]
  norm_num

name: Azurite.AzRat.ceilingLogBasePowerOf2Abs_eq
statement:
theorem ceilingLogBasePowerOf2Abs_eq (q : AzRat) (k : ℕ) (hq : q.num ≠ 0) (hk : 0 < k) :
    ceilingLogBasePowerOf2Abs q k = some (Int.clog (2 ^ k) |(toRat q : ℝ)|)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ceilingLogBasePowerOf2Abs
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨hq, hk.ne'⟩), ceilingLogBase2Abs_eq_clog q hq,
    int_clog_two_pow k hk _ (abs_toRat_pos q hq)]

name: Azurite.AzRat.abs_toRat_eq_zpow_iff
statement:
theorem abs_toRat_eq_zpow_iff (q : AzRat) (j : ℤ) :
    |(toRat q : ℝ)| = (2 : ℝ) ^ j ↔
      q.num.toNat.isPowerOfTwo ∧ q.den.toNat.isPowerOfTwo ∧
        (q.num.size : ℤ) - q.den.size = j
proof:
:= by
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < q.den.toNat := by exact_mod_cast den_toNat_pos q
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime q.num.toNat q.den.toNat := (AzNat.coprime_iff _ _).mp q.reduced
  rw [abs_toRat_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases le_or_gt 0 j with hj | hj
    · have hnum : q.num.toNat = q.den.toNat * 2 ^ j.toNat := by
        have : (q.num.toNat : ℝ) = q.den.toNat * 2 ^ j.toNat := by
          rw [div_eq_iff hD.ne'] at h
          rw [h, ← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hj]
          ring
        exact_mod_cast this
      have hden1 : q.den.toNat = 1 := Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes hcop ⟨_, hnum⟩ (dvd_refl _)
      rw [hden1, one_mul] at hnum
      refine ⟨⟨j.toNat, hnum⟩, ⟨0, by rw [hden1, pow_zero]⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, ← AzNat.size_toNat, hnum, hden1, Nat.size_pow, Nat.size_one]
      omega
    · have hden' : q.den.toNat = q.num.toNat * 2 ^ (-j).toNat := by
        have : (q.den.toNat : ℝ) = q.num.toNat * 2 ^ (-j).toNat := by
          rw [div_eq_iff hD.ne'] at h
          rw [← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega), h, mul_comm ((2 : ℝ) ^ j),
            mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ (two_ne_zero : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0), add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero,
            mul_one]
        exact_mod_cast this
      have hnum1 : q.num.toNat = 1 :=
        Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes hcop.symm ⟨_, hden'⟩ (dvd_refl _)
      rw [hnum1, one_mul] at hden'
      refine ⟨⟨0, by rw [hnum1, pow_zero]⟩, ⟨(-j).toNat, hden'⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, ← AzNat.size_toNat, hnum1, hden', Nat.size_pow, Nat.size_one]
      omega
  · rintro ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩, hj⟩
    rw [← AzNat.size_toNat, ← AzNat.size_toNat, ha, hb, Nat.size_pow, Nat.size_pow] at hj
    rw [ha, hb, ← hj]
    push_cast
    rw [show ((a : ℤ) + 1 - ((b : ℤ) + 1)) = (a : ℤ) - b by ring, zpow_sub₀ (by norm_num),
      zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]

name: Azurite.AzRat.checkedLogBasePowerOf2Abs_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem checkedLogBasePowerOf2Abs_eq_some_iff (q : AzRat) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (e : ℤ) :
    checkedLogBasePowerOf2Abs q k = some e ↔ |(toRat q : ℝ)| = ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ e
proof:
:= by
  unfold checkedLogBasePowerOf2Abs
  rw [two_pow_zpow]
  have hkZ : (0 : ℤ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  by_cases hq : q.num = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left (Or.inl hq), abs_toRat_eq,
      show (q.num.toNat : ℝ) = 0 by rw [hq, AzNat.toNat_zero, Nat.cast_zero], zero_div]
    constructor
    · intro h; cases h
    · intro h; exact absurd h.symm (zpow_pos (by norm_num) _).ne'
  · rw [abs_toRat_eq_zpow_iff q]
    by_cases hp : (q.num.isPowerOfTwo && q.den.isPowerOfTwo) = true
    · rw [ite_eq_right (by push Not; exact ⟨hq, hk.ne', hp⟩)]
      simp only []
      rw [Bool.and_eq_true, AzNat.isPowerOfTwo_iff, AzNat.isPowerOfTwo_iff] at hp
      constructor
      · intro h
        split_ifs at h with hm
        · simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
          refine ⟨hp.1, hp.2, ?_⟩
          rw [← h]
          have := Int.emod_add_ediv_mul ((q.num.size : ℤ) - q.den.size) k
          rw [hm, zero_add] at this
          rw [mul_comm]
          exact this.symm
      · rintro ⟨-, -, hj⟩
        rw [hj, Int.mul_emod_right, ite_eq_left rfl, Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ hkZ.ne']
    · rw [ite_eq_left (Or.inr (Or.inr hp))]
      rw [Bool.and_eq_true, AzNat.isPowerOfTwo_iff, AzNat.isPowerOfTwo_iff] at hp
      constructor
      · intro h; cases h
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2, -⟩; exact absurd ⟨h1, h2⟩ hp

name: Azurite.AzRat.checkedLogBasePowerOf2Abs_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem checkedLogBasePowerOf2Abs_eq_none_iff (q : AzRat) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    checkedLogBasePowerOf2Abs q k = none ↔
      ∀ e : ℤ, |(toRat q : ℝ)| ≠ ((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ e
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h e he
    have := (checkedLogBasePowerOf2Abs_eq_some_iff q k hk e).mpr he
    rw [h] at this
    cases this
  · intro h
    rcases hc : checkedLogBasePowerOf2Abs q k with _ | e
    · rfl
    · exact absurd ((checkedLogBasePowerOf2Abs_eq_some_iff q k hk e).mp hc) (h e)

name: Azurite.AzRat.mul4_lt_of_le
statement:
theorem mul4_lt_of_le {a₁ a₂ a₃ a₄ b₁ b₂ b₃ b₄ : ℕ} (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂)
    (ha₃ : 0 < a₃) (ha₄ : 0 < a₄) (h₁ : a₁ ≤ b₁) (h₂ : a₂ ≤ b₂) (h₃ : a₃ ≤ b₃) (h₄ : a₄ ≤ b₄)
    (hs : a₁ < b₁ ∨ a₂ < b₂ ∨ a₃ < b₃ ∨ a₄ < b₄) :
    a₁ * a₂ * a₃ * a₄ < b₁ * b₂ * b₃ * b₄
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ {c₁ c₂ c₃ c₄ : ℕ}, c₁ ≤ b₁ → c₂ ≤ b₂ → c₃ ≤ b₃ → c₄ ≤ b₄ →
      c₁ * c₂ * c₃ * c₄ ≤ b₁ * b₂ * b₃ * b₄ := fun g₁ g₂ g₃ g₄ =>
    Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul g₁ g₂) g₃) g₄
  rcases hs with h | h | h | h
  · calc a₁ * a₂ * a₃ * a₄ < b₁ * a₂ * a₃ * a₄ :=
          Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
            (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h ha₂) ha₃) ha₄
      _ ≤ b₁ * b₂ * b₃ * b₄ := hle le_rfl h₂ h₃ h₄
  · calc a₁ * a₂ * a₃ * a₄ < a₁ * b₂ * a₃ * a₄ :=
          Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
            (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h ha₁) ha₃) ha₄
      _ ≤ b₁ * b₂ * b₃ * b₄ := hle h₁ le_rfl h₃ h₄
  · calc a₁ * a₂ * a₃ * a₄ < a₁ * a₂ * b₃ * a₄ :=
          Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h (Nat.mul_pos ha₁ ha₂)) ha₄
      _ ≤ b₁ * b₂ * b₃ * b₄ := hle h₁ h₂ le_rfl h₄
  · calc a₁ * a₂ * a₃ * a₄ < a₁ * a₂ * a₃ * b₄ :=
          Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos ha₁ ha₂) ha₃)
      _ ≤ b₁ * b₂ * b₃ * b₄ := hle h₁ h₂ h₃ le_rfl

name: Azurite.AzRat.screen4_spec
statement:
theorem screen4_spec {a₁ a₂ a₃ a₄ b₁ b₂ b₃ b₄ : ℕ} (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂) (ha₃ : 0 < a₃)
    (ha₄ : 0 < a₄) (hb₁ : 0 < b₁) (hb₂ : 0 < b₂) (hb₃ : 0 < b₃) (hb₄ : 0 < b₄) {o : Ordering}
    (h : screen4 (Ord.compare a₁ b₁) (Ord.compare a₂ b₂) (Ord.compare a₃ b₃) (Ord.compare a₄ b₄)
      = some o) :
    Ord.compare (a₁ * a₂ * a₃ * a₄) (b₁ * b₂ * b₃ * b₄) = o
proof:
:= by
  unfold screen4 at h
  split_ifs at h with hle hall hge
  · obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, e₃, e₄⟩ := hall
    rw [compare_Nat_eq_iff] at e₁ e₂ e₃ e₄
    rw [Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [← h, e₁, e₂, e₃, e₄, compare_Nat_eq_iff]
  · obtain ⟨l₁, l₂, l₃, l₄⟩ := hle
    rw [Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [← h, compare_Nat_lt_iff]
    have h₁ : a₁ ≤ b₁ := not_lt.mp (fun hlt => l₁ ((compare_Nat_gt_iff _ _).mpr hlt))
    have h₂ : a₂ ≤ b₂ := not_lt.mp (fun hlt => l₂ ((compare_Nat_gt_iff _ _).mpr hlt))
    have h₃ : a₃ ≤ b₃ := not_lt.mp (fun hlt => l₃ ((compare_Nat_gt_iff _ _).mpr hlt))
    have h₄ : a₄ ≤ b₄ := not_lt.mp (fun hlt => l₄ ((compare_Nat_gt_iff _ _).mpr hlt))
    apply mul4_lt_of_le ha₁ ha₂ ha₃ ha₄ h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
    by_contra hns
    push Not at hns
    apply hall
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [compare_Nat_eq_iff] <;> omega
  · obtain ⟨g₁, g₂, g₃, g₄⟩ := hge
    rw [Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [← h, compare_Nat_gt_iff]
    have h₁ : b₁ ≤ a₁ := not_lt.mp (fun hlt => g₁ ((compare_Nat_lt_iff _ _).mpr hlt))
    have h₂ : b₂ ≤ a₂ := not_lt.mp (fun hlt => g₂ ((compare_Nat_lt_iff _ _).mpr hlt))
    have h₃ : b₃ ≤ a₃ := not_lt.mp (fun hlt => g₃ ((compare_Nat_lt_iff _ _).mpr hlt))
    have h₄ : b₄ ≤ a₄ := not_lt.mp (fun hlt => g₄ ((compare_Nat_lt_iff _ _).mpr hlt))
    apply mul4_lt_of_le hb₁ hb₂ hb₃ hb₄ h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
    by_contra hns
    push Not at hns
    apply hle
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro hg <;> rw [compare_Nat_gt_iff] at hg <;> omega
