name: Azurite.AzNat.mulAdd2Limbs.go_size
statement:
theorem mulAdd2Limbs.go_size (a : Array UInt64) (offA lenA offAcc : Nat) (b₀ b₁ : UInt64)
    (acc : Array UInt64) (k : Nat) (c₀ c₁ : UInt64)
    (hA : offA + lenA ≤ a.size) (hAcc : offAcc + lenA ≤ acc.size) :
    (mulAdd2Limbs.go a offA lenA offAcc b₀ b₁ acc k c₀ c₁ hA hAcc).1.size = acc.size
proof:
:= by
  induction h_sub : lenA - k generalizing acc k c₀ c₁ with
  | zero =>
    have h_ge : lenA ≤ k := by omega
    rw [mulAdd2Limbs.go]; simp [Nat.not_lt.mpr h_ge]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h_lt : k < lenA := by omega
    rw [mulAdd2Limbs.go]
    simp only [h_lt, ↓reduceDIte]
    rw [ih _ _ _ _ _ (by omega), Array.size_set]

name: Azurite.AzNat.mulAdd2Limbs_size
statement:
theorem mulAdd2Limbs_size (a : Array UInt64) (offA lenA offAcc : Nat) (b₀ b₁ : UInt64)
    (acc : Array UInt64)
    (hA : offA + lenA ≤ a.size) (hAcc : offAcc + lenA ≤ acc.size) :
    (mulAdd2Limbs a offA lenA offAcc b₀ b₁ acc hA hAcc).1.size = acc.size
proof:
:=
  mulAdd2Limbs.go_size a offA lenA offAcc b₀ b₁ acc 0 0 0 hA hAcc

name: Azurite.AzNat.schoolbookMulLimbs.go_size
statement:
theorem schoolbookMulLimbs.go_size (a : Array UInt64) (loA lenA : Nat) (b : Array UInt64)
    (loB lenB : Nat) (acc : Array UInt64) (j : Nat)
    (hA : loA + lenA ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + lenB ≤ b.size)
    (hAcc : lenA + lenB ≤ acc.size) :
    (schoolbookMulLimbs.go a loA lenA b loB lenB acc j hA hB hAcc).size = acc.size
proof:
:= by
  induction h_sub : lenB - j generalizing acc j with
  | zero =>
    have h_ge : lenB ≤ j := by omega
    rw [schoolbookMulLimbs.go]; simp [Nat.not_lt.mpr h_ge]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h_lt : j < lenB := by omega
    have h_new : lenB - (j + 1) = n := by omega
    rw [schoolbookMulLimbs.go]
    simp only [h_lt, ↓reduceDIte]
    rw [ih _ _ _ h_new, Array.size_set, mulAddLimbs_size]

name: Azurite.AzNat.schoolbookMulLimbs.go2_size
statement:
theorem schoolbookMulLimbs.go2_size (a : Array UInt64) (loA lenA : Nat) (b : Array UInt64)
    (loB lenB : Nat) (acc : Array UInt64) (j : Nat)
    (hA : loA + lenA ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + lenB ≤ b.size)
    (hAcc : lenA + lenB ≤ acc.size) :
    (schoolbookMulLimbs.go2 a loA lenA b loB lenB acc j hA hB hAcc).size = acc.size
proof:
:= by
  induction h_sub : lenB - j using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing acc j with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [schoolbookMulLimbs.go2]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [ih (lenB - (j + 2)) (by omega) _ _ _ rfl, Array.size_set, Array.size_set,
        mulAdd2Limbs_size]
    · exact schoolbookMulLimbs.go_size _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Azurite.AzNat.schoolbookMulLimbs_size
statement:
theorem schoolbookMulLimbs_size (a b : Array UInt64) (loA lenA loB lenB : Nat)
    (hA : loA + lenA ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + lenB ≤ b.size) :
    (schoolbookMulLimbs a b loA lenA loB lenB hA hB).size = lenA + lenB
proof:
:= by
  unfold schoolbookMulLimbs
  rw [schoolbookMulLimbs.go2_size, Array.size_replicate]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toomCook4MulLimbs_size
statement:
theorem toomCook4MulLimbs_size (toom4Threshold toom3Threshold karaThreshold : Nat)
    (a b : Array UInt64) (loA loB len : Nat)
    (hA : loA + len ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + len ≤ b.size) :
    (toomCook4MulLimbs toom4Threshold toom3Threshold karaThreshold a b loA loB len hA hB).size
      = 2 * len
proof:
:=
  (toomCook4MulLimbsRec toom4Threshold toom3Threshold karaThreshold a b loA loB len hA hB).2

name: Azurite.AzNat.ssTransform_size
statement:
theorem ssTransform_size (k w N : Nat) [NeZero N] (eθ : Nat) (A : AzNat) :
    (ssTransform k w N eθ A).size = 2 ^ (k + 1)
proof: := forwardFFT_size _ _ _ _

name: Azurite.AzNat.ssProductsCached_size
statement:
theorem ssProductsCached_size (k N : Nat) [NeZero N] (eθ : Nat) (mulFn : AzNat → AzNat → AzNat)
    (fa : Array (AzFermat N)) (hfa : fa.size = 2 ^ (k + 1)) (b : Array (AzFermat N))
    (hb : b.size = 2 ^ (k + 1)) :
    (ssProductsCached k N eθ mulFn fa hfa b hb).size = 2 ^ (k + 1)
proof: := Array.size_ofFn

name: Azurite.AzNat.ssProductsCached_forwardFFT
statement:
theorem ssProductsCached_forwardFFT (k N : Nat) [NeZero N] (eθ : Nat)
    (mulFn : AzNat → AzNat → AzNat) (a b : Array (AzFermat N)) (ha : a.size = 2 ^ (k + 1))
    (hb : b.size = 2 ^ (k + 1)) :
    ssProductsCached k N eθ mulFn (forwardFFT (2 * eθ) (k + 1) a ha) (forwardFFT_size _ _ _ _) b hb
      = ssProducts k N eθ mulFn a b ha hb
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.ssFinishF_val
statement:
theorem ssFinishF_val (k w N : Nat) [NeZero N] (hw0 : 0 < w) (eθ : Nat) (c : Array (AzFermat N))
    (hc : c.size = 2 ^ (k + 1)) :
    (ssFinishF k w N hw0 eθ c hc).val = ssFinish k w N hw0 eθ c hc
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.fftMulModCachedF_ssTransform
statement:
theorem fftMulModCachedF_ssTransform (k w N : Nat) [NeZero N] (hw0 : 0 < w)
    (hN : 2 * (64 * w) + (k + 1) ≤ N) (hK : 2 ^ (k + 1) ∣ N) (mulFn : AzNat → AzNat → AzNat)
    (A B : AzNat) :
    (fftMulModCachedF k w N hw0 hN hK mulFn (ssTransform k w N (N / 2 ^ (k + 1)) A)
        (ssTransform_size _ _ _ _ _) B).val
      = fftMulModWith k w N hw0 hN hK mulFn A B
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.SSPlan.N_pos
statement: theorem N_pos (p : SSPlan) : 0 < p.N
proof:
:= by
  have := ssFermatExponent_ge p.k p.w
  unfold N; omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.SSPlan.bits_pos
statement: theorem bits_pos (p : SSPlan) : 0 < p.bits
proof:
:= by
  unfold bits; have := p.hw0; positivity

name: Azurite.AzNat.SSPlan.transform_size
statement: theorem transform_size (p : SSPlan) (A : AzNat) : (p.transform A).size = 2 ^ (p.k + 1)
proof:
:=
  ssTransform_size _ _ _ _ _

name: Azurite.AzNat.SSPlan.mulModF'_val
statement:
theorem mulModF'_val (p : SSPlan) (mulFn : AzNat → AzNat → AzNat) (A B : AzNat) :
    (p.mulModF' mulFn A B).val
      = fftMulModWith p.k p.w p.N p.hw0 (ssFermatExponent_ge p.k p.w)
          (two_pow_dvd_ssFermatExponent p.k p.w) mulFn A B
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.truncatePad_size
statement:
theorem truncatePad_size (a : Array UInt64) (n : Nat) :
    (truncatePad a n).size = n
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncatePad
  rw [Array.size_append, Array.size_replicate, Array.size_extract]
  omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.diffM1_size
statement:
theorem diffM1_size (a : Array UInt64) (lo k m : Nat) :
    (diffM1 a lo k m).1.size = k + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold diffM1
  by_cases h : ofLimbs (a.extract lo (lo + k)) + ofLimbs (a.extract (lo + 2 * k) (lo + 2 * k + m))
              < ofLimbs (a.extract (lo + k) (lo + k + k))
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]; exact truncatePad_size _ _
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]; exact truncatePad_size _ _

name: Azurite.AzNat.diffM1_size_ge
statement:
theorem diffM1_size_ge (a : Array UInt64) (lo k m : Nat) :
    0 + (k + 1) ≤ (diffM1 a lo k m).1.size
proof:
:= by
  rw [diffM1_size]; omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.toomCook3MulLimbs_size
statement:
theorem toomCook3MulLimbs_size (toomThreshold karaThreshold : Nat) (a b : Array UInt64)
    (loA loB len : Nat)
    (hA : loA + len ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + len ≤ b.size) :
    (toomCook3MulLimbs toomThreshold karaThreshold a b loA loB len hA hB).size = 2 * len
proof:
:=
  (toomCook3MulLimbsRec toomThreshold karaThreshold a b loA loB len hA hB).2

name: Azurite.AzNat.floor_nat_div_nat
statement:
private lemma floor_nat_div_nat (v n : ℕ) :
    ⌊(v : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)⌋₊ = v / n
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((n : ℝ)) = (((n : ℕ)) : ℝ) := rfl
  rw [h, Nat.floor_div_natCast, Nat.floor_natCast]

name: Azurite.AzNat.ceil_nat_div_nat_of_dvd
statement:
private lemma ceil_nat_div_nat_of_dvd (v n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (h : n ∣ v) :
    ⌈(v : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)⌉₊ = v / n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  have hn_real_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have heq : (v : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) := by
    rw [hq]; push_cast; field_simp
  rw [heq, Nat.ceil_natCast, hq, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left q hn]

name: Azurite.AzNat.ceil_nat_div_nat_of_not_dvd
statement:
private lemma ceil_nat_div_nat_of_not_dvd (v n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (h : ¬ n ∣ v) :
    ⌈(v : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)⌉₊ = v / n + 1
proof:
:= by
  set q := v / n
  set r := v % n
  have hr_pos : 0 < r := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with h0 | h0
    · exact absurd (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h0) h
    · exact h0
  have hr_lt : r < n := Nat.mod_lt _ hn
  have hsum : q * n + r = v := Nat.div_add_mod' v n
  have hn_real_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have h_value : (v : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) + (r : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : (v : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) + (r : ℝ) := by
      have h2 : ((q * n + r : ℕ) : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) + (r : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [← h2, hsum]
    rw [h1]; field_simp
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · apply Nat.ceil_le.mpr
    rw [h_value]
    have h_rn_le_one : (r : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one hn_real_pos]; exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt hr_lt
    push_cast; linarith
  · apply Nat.lt_ceil.mpr
    rw [h_value]
    have h_rn_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (r : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) := by
      apply div_pos
      · exact_mod_cast hr_pos
      · exact hn_real_pos
    linarith

name: Azurite.AzNat.divRound_fst
statement:
theorem divRound_fst (x y : AzNat) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    (x.divRound y mode).1 =
      if (x.divMod y).2.limbs.size = 0 then (x.divMod y).1
      else
        match mode with
        | .Floor | .Down => (x.divMod y).1
        | .Ceiling | .Up => (x.divMod y).1.addUInt64 1
        | .Nearest =>
          match cmpDouble y (x.divMod y).2 with
          | .lt => (x.divMod y).1.addUInt64 1
          | .gt => (x.divMod y).1
          | .eq =>
            if (x.divMod y).1.isOdd then (x.divMod y).1.addUInt64 1
            else (x.divMod y).1
proof:
:= by
  unfold divRound
  cases mode <;> simp only [] <;> split_ifs <;>
    first | rfl | (cases cmpDouble y (x.divMod y).2 <;> rfl)

name: Azurite.AzNat.divRound_snd
statement:
theorem divRound_snd (x y : AzNat) (mode : RoundingMode) :
    (x.divRound y mode).2 =
      if (x.divMod y).2.limbs.size = 0 then .eq
      else
        match mode with
        | .Floor | .Down => .lt
        | .Ceiling | .Up => .gt
        | .Nearest =>
          match cmpDouble y (x.divMod y).2 with
          | .lt => .gt
          | .gt => .lt
          | .eq => if (x.divMod y).1.isOdd then .gt else .lt
proof:
:= by
  unfold divRound
  cases mode <;> simp only [] <;> split_ifs <;>
    first | rfl | (cases cmpDouble y (x.divMod y).2 <;> rfl)

name: Azurite.AzNat.compare_Nat_eq_of_eq
statement: private lemma compare_Nat_eq_of_eq (a : ℕ) : Ord.compare a a = .eq
proof:
:= by
  show compareOfLessAndEq _ _ = _
  simp [compareOfLessAndEq]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_divRound
statement:
theorem toNat_divRound (x y : AzNat) (mode : RoundingMode) (hy : 0 < y.toNat) :
    (((x.divRound y mode).1).toNat : EReal) =
      (round natBotSet mode ((x.toNat : ℝ) / (y.toNat : ℝ))).val
proof:
:= by
  set xn := x.toNat with hxn
  set yn := y.toNat with hyn
  set q := xn / yn with hq_def
  set r := xn % yn with hr_def
  have hr_lt : r < yn := Nat.mod_lt _ hy
  have hsum : q * yn + r = xn := Nat.div_add_mod' xn yn
  set t : ℝ := (xn : ℝ) / (yn : ℝ) with ht_def
  have hyn_real_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (yn : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hy
  have ht_nonneg : 0 ≤ t := by
    apply div_nonneg
    · exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le _
    · exact le_of_lt hyn_real_pos
  have ht_decomp : t = (q : ℝ) + (r : ℝ) / (yn : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : (xn : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) * (yn : ℝ) + (r : ℝ) := by
      have h2 : ((q * yn + r : ℕ) : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) * (yn : ℝ) + (r : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [← h2, hsum]
    rw [ht_def, h1]; field_simp
  have hfloor_t : ⌊t⌋₊ = q := floor_nat_div_nat xn yn
  set F := roundFloor natBotSet t with hF_def
  have hF_val : F.val = ((q : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [hF_def, roundFloor_natBotSet_nonneg t ht_nonneg, hfloor_t]
  have hF_nat : natBotToNat F = q := natBotToNat_eq_of_nat_val q F hF_val
  have hquot_toNat : (x.divMod y).1.toNat = q := by
    rw [← div_eq_divMod_fst]; show (x / y).toNat = q; rw [toNat_div]
  rw [divRound_fst]
  by_cases hr0 : r = 0
  · 
    have hr_aznat_zero : (x.divMod y).2.toNat = 0 := by
      rw [← mod_eq_divMod_snd]; show (x % y).toNat = 0; rw [toNat_mod]; exact hr0
    have hr_size_zero : (x.divMod y).2.limbs.size = 0 := (toNat_eq_zero_iff _).mp hr_aznat_zero
    rw [ite_eq_left hr_size_zero]
    show ((x.divMod y).1.toNat : EReal) = (round natBotSet mode t).val
    rw [hquot_toNat]
    have ht_eq_q : t = (q : ℝ) := by rw [ht_decomp, hr0]; push_cast; simp
    have hC_val : (roundCeiling natBotSet t).val = ((q : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      rw [roundCeiling_natBotSet, ht_eq_q, Nat.ceil_natCast]
    have hC_nat : natBotToNat (roundCeiling natBotSet t) = q :=
      natBotToNat_eq_of_nat_val q _ hC_val
    cases mode with
    | Floor =>
      show ((q : ℕ) : EReal) = F.val
      rw [hF_val]; push_cast; rfl
    | Ceiling =>
      show ((q : ℕ) : EReal) = (roundCeiling natBotSet t).val
      rw [hC_val]; push_cast; rfl
    | Down =>
      show ((q : ℕ) : EReal) =
        (if 0 ≤ t then roundFloor natBotSet t else roundCeiling natBotSet t).val
      rw [ite_eq_left ht_nonneg, ← hF_def, hF_val]; push_cast; rfl
    | Up =>
      show ((q : ℕ) : EReal) =
        (if 0 ≤ t then roundCeiling natBotSet t else roundFloor natBotSet t).val
      rw [ite_eq_left ht_nonneg, hC_val]; push_cast; rfl
    | Nearest =>
      show ((q : ℕ) : EReal) =
        (match Ord.compare ((t : EReal) - F.val) ((roundCeiling natBotSet t).val - (t : EReal)) with
         | .lt => F
         | .gt => roundCeiling natBotSet t
         | .eq => RoundingTarget.tiebreak F (roundCeiling natBotSet t)).val
      have hdF_eq_dC : (t : EReal) - F.val = (roundCeiling natBotSet t).val - (t : EReal) := by
        rw [hF_val, hC_val,
            show ((t : ℝ) : EReal) = (((q : ℕ) : ℝ) : EReal) from by rw [ht_eq_q]]
      rw [show Ord.compare ((t : EReal) - F.val)
              ((roundCeiling natBotSet t).val - (t : EReal)) = .eq from
            compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr hdF_eq_dC]
      show ((q : ℕ) : EReal) = (natBotTiebreak F (roundCeiling natBotSet t)).val
      unfold natBotTiebreak
      rw [hF_nat, hC_nat]
      split_ifs <;> rw [hF_val] <;> push_cast <;> rfl
  · 
    have hr_aznat_ne : (x.divMod y).2.toNat ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← mod_eq_divMod_snd]; show (x % y).toNat ≠ 0; rw [toNat_mod]; exact hr0
    have hr_size_ne : ¬ ((x.divMod y).2.limbs.size = 0) := by
      intro h; apply hr_aznat_ne; exact (toNat_eq_zero_iff _).mpr h
    rw [ite_eq_right hr_size_ne]
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hr0
    have h_not_dvd : ¬ yn ∣ xn := fun hdvd => hr0 (Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hdvd)
    set C := roundCeiling natBotSet t with hC_def
    have hC_val : C.val = (((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      rw [hC_def, roundCeiling_natBotSet, ceil_nat_div_nat_of_not_dvd xn yn hy h_not_dvd]
    have hC_nat : natBotToNat C = q + 1 := natBotToNat_eq_of_nat_val (q + 1) C hC_val
    have hquot_succ_toNat : ((x.divMod y).1.addUInt64 1).toNat = q + 1 := by
      rw [toNat_addUInt64, hquot_toNat]; rfl
    have h_real_F : t - ((q : ℕ) : ℝ) = (r : ℝ) / (yn : ℝ) := by
      rw [ht_decomp]; ring
    have hdF_real_eq : (t : EReal) - F.val = (((r : ℝ) / (yn : ℝ)) : EReal) := by
      rw [hF_val, ← EReal.coe_sub, h_real_F]
    have hyn_r_le : r ≤ yn := le_of_lt hr_lt
    have h_real_C : ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - t = ((yn - r : ℕ) : ℝ) / (yn : ℝ) := by
      rw [ht_decomp, Nat.cast_sub hyn_r_le]
      have hyn_ne : (yn : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hyn_real_pos
      push_cast
      field_simp
      ring
    have hdC_real_eq : C.val - (t : EReal) = ((((yn - r : ℕ) : ℝ) / (yn : ℝ)) : EReal) := by
      rw [hC_val, ← EReal.coe_sub, h_real_C]
    have hdF_lt_dC_iff_real :
        (t : EReal) - F.val < C.val - (t : EReal) ↔ 2 * r < yn := by
      rw [hdF_real_eq, hdC_real_eq, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]
      have hyn_ne : (yn : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hyn_real_pos
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hyn_real_pos hyn_real_pos]
      push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hyn_r_le]
      constructor
      · intro h
        have h2 : (r : ℝ) < (yn : ℝ) - (r : ℝ) := by
          have h3 : (r : ℝ) * (yn : ℝ) < ((yn : ℝ) - (r : ℝ)) * (yn : ℝ) := by linarith
          exact (mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_right hyn_real_pos).mp h3
        have : (2 : ℝ) * r < yn := by linarith
        exact_mod_cast this
      · intro h
        have h2 : (2 : ℝ) * r < yn := by exact_mod_cast h
        have h3 : (r : ℝ) < (yn : ℝ) - (r : ℝ) := by linarith
        nlinarith
    have hdC_lt_dF_iff_real :
        C.val - (t : EReal) < (t : EReal) - F.val ↔ yn < 2 * r := by
      rw [hdF_real_eq, hdC_real_eq, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]
      have hyn_ne : (yn : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hyn_real_pos
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hyn_real_pos hyn_real_pos]
      push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hyn_r_le]
      constructor
      · intro h
        have h2 : ((yn : ℝ) - (r : ℝ)) < (r : ℝ) := by
          have h3 : ((yn : ℝ) - (r : ℝ)) * (yn : ℝ) < (r : ℝ) * (yn : ℝ) := by linarith
          exact (mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_right hyn_real_pos).mp h3
        have : (yn : ℝ) < 2 * (r : ℝ) := by linarith
        exact_mod_cast this
      · intro h
        have h2 : (yn : ℝ) < 2 * (r : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
        have h3 : ((yn : ℝ) - (r : ℝ)) < (r : ℝ) := by linarith
        nlinarith
    cases mode with
    | Floor =>
      show ((x.divMod y).1.toNat : EReal) = F.val
      rw [hquot_toNat, hF_val]; push_cast; rfl
    | Down =>
      show ((x.divMod y).1.toNat : EReal) =
        (if 0 ≤ t then F else C).val
      rw [ite_eq_left ht_nonneg, hquot_toNat, hF_val]; push_cast; rfl
    | Ceiling =>
      show (((x.divMod y).1.addUInt64 1).toNat : EReal) = C.val
      rw [hquot_succ_toNat, hC_val]; push_cast; rfl
    | Up =>
      show (((x.divMod y).1.addUInt64 1).toNat : EReal) =
        (if 0 ≤ t then C else F).val
      rw [ite_eq_left ht_nonneg, hquot_succ_toNat, hC_val]; push_cast; rfl
    | Nearest =>
      have hrem_toNat : (x.divMod y).2.toNat = r := by
        rw [← mod_eq_divMod_snd]; show (x % y).toNat = r; rw [toNat_mod]
      have hcmp : cmpDouble y (x.divMod y).2 = Ord.compare yn (2 * r) := by
        rw [cmpDouble_eq_compare_toNat, hrem_toNat]
      show ((match cmpDouble y (x.divMod y).2 with
             | .lt => (x.divMod y).1.addUInt64 1
             | .gt => (x.divMod y).1
             | .eq =>
               if (x.divMod y).1.isOdd then (x.divMod y).1.addUInt64 1
               else (x.divMod y).1).toNat : EReal) =
        (match Ord.compare ((t : EReal) - F.val) (C.val - (t : EReal)) with
         | .lt => F
         | .gt => C
         | .eq => RoundingTarget.tiebreak F C).val
      rw [hcmp]
      rcases lt_trichotomy yn (2 * r) with h_gt | h_eq | h_lt
      · 
        rw [compare_Nat_eq_of_lt _ _ h_gt, hquot_succ_toNat]
        have hdC_lt : C.val - (t : EReal) < (t : EReal) - F.val :=
          hdC_lt_dF_iff_real.mpr h_gt
        rw [show Ord.compare ((t : EReal) - F.val) (C.val - (t : EReal)) = .gt from
              compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr hdC_lt]
        rw [hC_val]; push_cast; rfl
      · 
        rw [h_eq, compare_Nat_eq_of_eq]
        have hdF_eq_dC : (t : EReal) - F.val = C.val - (t : EReal) := by
          rw [hdF_real_eq, hdC_real_eq]
          congr 1
          push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hyn_r_le]
          have hyn_ne : (yn : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hyn_real_pos
          field_simp
          have h_real : (yn : ℝ) = 2 * (r : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h_eq
          linarith
        rw [show Ord.compare ((t : EReal) - F.val) (C.val - (t : EReal)) = .eq from
              compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr hdF_eq_dC]
        show ((if (x.divMod y).1.isOdd then (x.divMod y).1.addUInt64 1
               else (x.divMod y).1).toNat : EReal) = (natBotTiebreak F C).val
        unfold natBotTiebreak
        rw [hF_nat, hC_nat]
        by_cases hq_par : q % 2 = 1
        · 
          have hq_isOdd : (x.divMod y).1.isOdd = true := by
            rw [isOdd_iff, hquot_toNat]; exact ⟨q / 2, by omega⟩
          rw [ite_eq_left hq_isOdd, hquot_succ_toNat]
          have hq_odd : Odd q := ⟨q / 2, by omega⟩
          have hq_not_even : ¬ Even q := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hq_odd
          have hq1_even : Even (q + 1) := Odd.add_one hq_odd
          rw [ite_eq_right hq_not_even, ite_eq_left hq1_even, hC_val]; push_cast; rfl
        · 
          have hq_mod : q % 2 = 0 := by omega
          have hq_even : Even q := (Nat.even_iff).mpr hq_mod
          have hq_isOdd_false : (x.divMod y).1.isOdd = false := by
            cases h : (x.divMod y).1.isOdd
            · rfl
            · exfalso
              rw [isOdd_iff, hquot_toNat] at h
              rcases h with ⟨k, hk⟩; omega
          rw [hq_isOdd_false]
          simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false]
          rw [hquot_toNat, ite_eq_left hq_even, hF_val]; push_cast; rfl
      · 
        rw [compare_Nat_eq_of_gt _ _ h_lt, hquot_toNat]
        have hdF_lt : (t : EReal) - F.val < C.val - (t : EReal) :=
          hdF_lt_dC_iff_real.mpr h_lt
        rw [show Ord.compare ((t : EReal) - F.val) (C.val - (t : EReal)) = .lt from
              compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr hdF_lt]
        rw [hF_val]; push_cast; rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.compare_nat_mul_div_eq_compare_real_div
statement:
private lemma compare_nat_mul_div_eq_compare_real_div (n m yn : ℕ) (hyn : 0 < yn) :
    Ord.compare (n * yn) m = Ord.compare ((n : ℝ)) ((m : ℝ) / (yn : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (yn : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hyn
  rcases lt_trichotomy (n * yn) m with h | h | h
  · rw [compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr h]
    refine (compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr ?_).symm
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ h2]; exact_mod_cast h
  · rw [compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr h]
    refine (compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr ?_).symm
    rw [eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt h2)]; exact_mod_cast h
  · rw [compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr h]
    refine (compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr ?_).symm
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ h2]; exact_mod_cast h

name: Azurite.AzNat.snd_divRound
statement:
theorem snd_divRound (x y : AzNat) (mode : RoundingMode) (hy : 0 < y.toNat) :
    (x.divRound y mode).2 =
      Ord.compare (((x.divRound y mode).1.toNat : ℕ) : ℝ)
        ((x.toNat : ℝ) / (y.toNat : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← compare_nat_mul_div_eq_compare_real_div _ _ y.toNat hy,
      divRound_snd, divRound_fst]
  have hquot_toNat : (x.divMod y).1.toNat = x.toNat / y.toNat := by
    rw [← div_eq_divMod_fst]
    show (x / y).toNat = x.toNat / y.toNat; rw [toNat_div]
  have hrem_toNat : (x.divMod y).2.toNat = x.toNat % y.toNat := by
    rw [← mod_eq_divMod_snd]; show (x % y).toNat = x.toNat % y.toNat; rw [toNat_mod]
  by_cases hr_size : (x.divMod y).2.limbs.size = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left hr_size, ite_eq_left hr_size]
    have hr_aznat_zero : (x.divMod y).2.toNat = 0 := (toNat_eq_zero_iff _).mpr hr_size
    have hr0 : x.toNat % y.toNat = 0 := by rw [← hrem_toNat]; exact hr_aznat_zero
    rw [hquot_toNat]
    have heq : x.toNat / y.toNat * y.toNat = x.toNat := by
      have := Nat.div_add_mod' x.toNat y.toNat; omega
    rw [heq]
    show Ordering.eq = compareOfLessAndEq x.toNat x.toNat
    simp [compareOfLessAndEq]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hr_size, ite_eq_right hr_size]
    have hr_aznat_ne : (x.divMod y).2.toNat ≠ 0 := fun h => hr_size ((toNat_eq_zero_iff _).mp h)
    have hr0 : x.toNat % y.toNat ≠ 0 := by rw [← hrem_toNat]; exact hr_aznat_ne
    have hsum : x.toNat / y.toNat * y.toNat + x.toNat % y.toNat = x.toNat :=
      Nat.div_add_mod' x.toNat y.toNat
    have h_q_lt : x.toNat / y.toNat * y.toNat < x.toNat := by
      have : 0 < x.toNat % y.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hr0; omega
    have h_q1_gt : x.toNat < (x.toNat / y.toNat + 1) * y.toNat := by
      have hr_lt : x.toNat % y.toNat < y.toNat := Nat.mod_lt _ hy
      have h1 : (x.toNat / y.toNat + 1) * y.toNat =
        x.toNat / y.toNat * y.toNat + y.toNat := by ring
      omega
    have h_compare_q : Ord.compare ((x.divMod y).1.toNat * y.toNat) x.toNat = Ordering.lt := by
      rw [hquot_toNat]
      show compareOfLessAndEq _ _ = Ordering.lt
      simp [compareOfLessAndEq, h_q_lt]
    have h_compare_q1 : Ord.compare (((x.divMod y).1.addUInt64 1).toNat * y.toNat) x.toNat
        = Ordering.gt := by
      rw [toNat_addUInt64, hquot_toNat,
          show ((1 : UInt64).toNat = 1) from rfl]
      show compareOfLessAndEq _ _ = Ordering.gt
      have hnot_lt : ¬ ((x.toNat / y.toNat + 1) * y.toNat < x.toNat) :=
        Nat.not_lt.mpr (Nat.le_of_lt h_q1_gt)
      have hne : (x.toNat / y.toNat + 1) * y.toNat ≠ x.toNat := Nat.ne_of_gt h_q1_gt
      simp [compareOfLessAndEq, hnot_lt, hne]
    cases mode with
    | Floor => simp only []; exact h_compare_q.symm
    | Down => simp only []; exact h_compare_q.symm
    | Ceiling => simp only []; exact h_compare_q1.symm
    | Up => simp only []; exact h_compare_q1.symm
    | Nearest =>
      simp only []
      cases hcmp : cmpDouble y (x.divMod y).2 with
      | lt => exact h_compare_q1.symm
      | gt => exact h_compare_q.symm
      | eq =>
        split_ifs
        · exact h_compare_q1.symm
        · exact h_compare_q.symm

name: Nat.ell_one
statement: @[simp] theorem ell_one : ell 1 = 0
proof: := by simp [ell]

name: Nat.ell_prime_pow_mul
statement:
theorem ell_prime_pow_mul {p M k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hM : M ≠ 0) (hpM : ¬ p ∣ M)
    (hk : k ≠ 0) : ell (p ^ k * M) = p ^ k + ell M
proof:
:= by
  have hpk : p ^ k ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero k hp.ne_zero
  have hnot : p ∉ M.primeFactors := fun h => hpM (mem_primeFactors.mp h).2.1
  have hfac : (p ^ k * M).factorization = Finsupp.single p k + M.factorization := by
    rw [factorization_mul hpk hM, hp.factorization_pow]
  unfold ell
  rw [primeFactors_mul hpk hM, primeFactors_prime_pow hk hp, Finset.singleton_union,
    Finset.sum_insert hnot, hfac]
  congr 1
  · rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same, factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd hpM,
      add_zero]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro q hq
    have hqp : q ≠ p := fun h => hnot (h ▸ hq)
    rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hqp, zero_add]

name: Nat.le_ell_of_mem_primeFactors
statement: theorem le_ell_of_mem_primeFactors {M p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ M.primeFactors) : p ≤ ell M
proof:
:= by
  have hpp := (mem_primeFactors.mp hp).1
  have hM := (mem_primeFactors.mp hp).2.2
  have hpos : M.factorization p ≠ 0 :=
    (hpp.factorization_pos_of_dvd hM (mem_primeFactors.mp hp).2.1).ne'
  calc p ≤ p ^ M.factorization p := le_self_pow hpos p
    _ ≤ ell M :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun q => q ^ M.factorization q) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hp

name: Nat.le_two_pow_ell
statement: theorem le_two_pow_ell {M : ℕ} (hM : M ≠ 0) : M ≤ 2 ^ ell M
proof:
:= by
  have hself : ∏ p ∈ M.primeFactors, p ^ M.factorization p = M := by
    have := prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hM
    rwa [Finsupp.prod, support_factorization] at this
  calc M = ∏ p ∈ M.primeFactors, p ^ M.factorization p := hself.symm
    _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ M.primeFactors, 2 ^ (p ^ M.factorization p) :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => Nat.lt_two_pow_self.le)
    _ = 2 ^ ell M := Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum _ _ _

name: Nat.isGreatest_landau
statement: theorem isGreatest_landau (n : ℕ) : IsGreatest {M | 0 < M ∧ ell M ≤ n} (landau n)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 0 < 1 ∧ ell 1 ≤ n := ⟨Nat.one_pos, by simp⟩
  refine ⟨Nat.findGreatest_spec (P := fun M => 0 < M ∧ ell M ≤ n) Nat.one_le_two_pow h1, ?_⟩
  intro M ⟨hM0, hM⟩
  exact Nat.le_findGreatest ((le_two_pow_ell hM0.ne').trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right two_pos hM))
    ⟨hM0, hM⟩

name: Azurite.AzNat.le_foldl_max
statement: theorem le_foldl_max {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] (l : List α) (a : α) : a ≤ l.foldl max a
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | cons x xs ih => exact (le_max_left a x).trans (ih _)

name: Azurite.AzNat.le_foldl_max_of_mem
statement:
theorem le_foldl_max_of_mem {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] (l : List α) (a : α) {x : α}
    (hx : x ∈ l) : x ≤ l.foldl max a
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons y ys ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx
    · exact (le_max_right a x).trans (le_foldl_max _ _)
    · exact ih _ hx

name: Azurite.AzNat.foldl_max_eq_or_mem
statement:
theorem foldl_max_eq_or_mem {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] (l : List α) (a : α) :
    l.foldl max a = a ∨ l.foldl max a ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => exact Or.inl rfl
  | cons y ys ih =>
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases ih (max a y) with h | h
    · rw [h]
      rcases max_choice a y with h' | h'
      · exact Or.inl h'
      · right
        rw [h']
        exact List.mem_cons_self ..
    · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)

name: Azurite.AzNat.landauInv_init
statement: theorem landauInv_init (n : ℕ) : LandauInv [] (Array.replicate n 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  rw [Array.getElem_replicate, toNat_one]
  refine ⟨⟨Nat.one_pos, fun q hq => by simp at hq, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
  intro M ⟨hM0, hsm, _⟩
  have : M.primeFactors = ∅ := Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun q hq => by
    have := hsm q hq; simp at this
  rcases Nat.primeFactors_eq_empty.mp this with h | h
  · omega
  · omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.size_landauStep
statement: theorem size_landauStep (g : Array AzNat) (p : ℕ) : (landauStep g p).size = g.size
proof:
:= by
  simp [landauStep]

name: Azurite.AzNat.mem_landauCandidates
statement:
theorem mem_landauCandidates (g : Array AzNat) {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 < p) {m k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0)
    (hpk : p ^ k ≤ m) (hm : m < g.size) :
    ofNat (p ^ k) * g[m - p ^ k]'(by omega) ∈ landauCandidates g p m
proof:
:= by
  unfold landauCandidates
  rw [List.mem_map]
  refine ⟨k - 1, List.mem_range.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; rw [h] at hpk; exact absurd hpk (not_le.mpr (pow_pos (by omega) k))
    have := Nat.le_log_of_pow_le hp hpk
    omega
  · rw [show k - 1 + 1 = k by omega]
    congr 1
    rw [Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega), Option.getD_some]

name: Azurite.AzNat.of_mem_landauCandidates
statement:
theorem of_mem_landauCandidates (g : Array AzNat) (p : ℕ) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : m < g.size) {c : AzNat} (hc : c ∈ landauCandidates g p m) :
    ∃ k, k ≠ 0 ∧ p ^ k ≤ m ∧ ∃ (h : m - p ^ k < g.size),
      c.toNat = p ^ k * (g[m - p ^ k]'h).toNat
proof:
:= by
  unfold landauCandidates at hc
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hc
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h, Nat.log_zero_right] at hi; simp at hi
  have hpk : p ^ (i + 1) ≤ m := Nat.pow_le_of_le_log hm0 (List.mem_range.mp hi)
  refine ⟨i + 1, Nat.succ_ne_zero i, hpk, by omega, ?_⟩
  rw [toNat_mul, toNat_ofNat, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega),
    Option.getD_some]

name: Azurite.AzNat.not_dvd_of_smooth
statement:
theorem not_dvd_of_smooth {ps : List ℕ} {p M : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hM : M ≠ 0)
    (hps : p ∉ ps) (hsm : Smooth ps M) : ¬ p ∣ M
proof:
:= fun h =>
  hps (hsm p (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hp, h, hM⟩))

name: Azurite.AzNat.landauInv_step
statement:
theorem landauInv_step {ps ps' : List ℕ} {g : Array AzNat} {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hps : p ∉ ps) (hps' : ∀ q, q ∈ ps' ↔ q ∈ ps ∨ q = p) (hinv : LandauInv ps g) :
    LandauInv ps' (landauStep g p)
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  rw [size_landauStep] at hm
  have hget : (landauStep g p)[m]'(by rw [size_landauStep]; exact hm)
      = (landauCandidates g p m).foldl max g[m] := by
    simp [landauStep]
  rw [hget]
  set c := (landauCandidates g p m).foldl max g[m] with hc
  have hp1 : 1 < p := hp.one_lt
  have hsm_mono : ∀ M, Smooth ps M → Smooth ps' M := fun M h q hq => (hps' q).mpr (Or.inl (h q hq))
  constructor
  · 
    rcases foldl_max_eq_or_mem (landauCandidates g p m) g[m] with h | h
    · rw [← hc] at h
      rw [h]
      obtain ⟨⟨h0, hsm, hell⟩, _⟩ := hinv m hm
      exact ⟨h0, hsm_mono _ hsm, hell⟩
    · rw [← hc] at h
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hpk, hlt, hval⟩ := of_mem_landauCandidates g p hm h
      obtain ⟨⟨h0, hsm, hell⟩, _⟩ := hinv (m - p ^ k) hlt
      set M' := (g[m - p ^ k]'hlt).toNat
      have hpM' : ¬ p ∣ M' := not_dvd_of_smooth hp h0.ne' hps hsm
      refine ⟨hval ▸ Nat.mul_pos (pow_pos hp.pos k) h0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro q hq
        rw [hval, Nat.primeFactors_mul (pow_ne_zero k hp.ne_zero) h0.ne',
          Nat.primeFactors_prime_pow hk hp, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] at hq
        rcases hq with rfl | hq
        · exact (hps' q).mpr (Or.inr rfl)
        · exact hsm_mono _ hsm q hq
      · rw [hval, Nat.ell_prime_pow_mul hp h0.ne' hpM' hk]
        omega
  · 
    intro M ⟨hM0, hsm, hell⟩
    have hM : M ≠ 0 := hM0.ne'
    set k := M.factorization p with hk
    set M' := M / p ^ k with hM'
    have hsplit : p ^ k * M' = M := Nat.ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self M p
    have hM'0 : M' ≠ 0 := (Nat.ordCompl_pos p hM).ne'
    have hpM' : ¬ p ∣ M' := Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl hp hM
    have hsm' : Smooth ps M' := by
      intro q hq
      have hqM : q ∈ M.primeFactors := Nat.primeFactors_mono (Nat.ordCompl_dvd M p) hM hq
      rcases (hps' q).mp (hsm q hqM) with h | rfl
      · exact h
      · exact absurd (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hq).2.1 hpM'
    by_cases hk0 : k = 0
    · 
      have hMM' : M = M' := by rw [← hsplit, hk0, pow_zero, one_mul]
      obtain ⟨_, hub⟩ := hinv m hm
      have := hub ⟨hM0, hMM' ▸ hsm', hell⟩
      exact this.trans ((le_iff_toNat_le _ _).mp (le_foldl_max _ _))
    · 
      have hellM : ell M = p ^ k + ell M' := by
        rw [← hsplit, Nat.ell_prime_pow_mul hp hM'0 hpM' hk0]
      have hpk : p ^ k ≤ m := by omega
      obtain ⟨_, hub⟩ := hinv (m - p ^ k) (by omega)
      have hle : M' ≤ (g[m - p ^ k]'(by omega)).toNat :=
        hub ⟨Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hM'0, hsm', by omega⟩
      have hcand := le_foldl_max_of_mem (landauCandidates g p m) g[m]
        (mem_landauCandidates g hp1 hk0 hpk hm)
      rw [le_iff_toNat_le, toNat_mul, toNat_ofNat] at hcand
      calc M = p ^ k * M' := hsplit.symm
        _ ≤ p ^ k * (g[m - p ^ k]'(by omega)).toNat := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hle
        _ ≤ c.toNat := hcand

name: Azurite.AzNat.size_foldl_landauStep
statement:
theorem size_foldl_landauStep (ps : List ℕ) (g : Array AzNat) :
    (ps.foldl landauStep g).size = g.size
proof:
:= by
  induction ps generalizing g with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p ps ih => rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, size_landauStep]

name: Azurite.AzNat.landauInv_foldl
statement:
theorem landauInv_foldl : ∀ (ps done : List ℕ) (g : Array AzNat), (done ++ ps).Nodup →
    (∀ p ∈ ps, p.Prime) → LandauInv done g → LandauInv (done ++ ps) (ps.foldl landauStep g)
  | [], done, g, _, _, hinv => by simpa using hinv
  | p :: ps, done, g, hnd, hpr, hinv => by
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    have hnd' : (done ++ [p] ++ ps).Nodup
proof:
:= by simpa [List.append_assoc] using hnd
    have hnot : p ∉ done := by
      intro h
      have := List.nodup_append.mp hnd
      exact this.2.2 p h p (List.mem_cons_self ..) rfl
    have hstep := landauInv_step (hpr p (List.mem_cons_self ..)) hnot
      (ps' := done ++ [p]) (fun q => by simp) hinv
    have := landauInv_foldl ps (done ++ [p]) _ hnd' (fun q hq => hpr q (List.mem_cons_of_mem p hq))
      hstep
    simpa [List.append_assoc] using this

name: Azurite.AzNat.length_landauFunctionPrefix
statement: theorem length_landauFunctionPrefix (n : ℕ) : (landauFunctionPrefix n).length = n
proof:
:= by
  unfold landauFunctionPrefix
  rw [Array.length_toList, size_foldl_landauStep, Array.size_replicate]

name: Azurite.AzNat.landauFunctionPrefix_spec
statement:
theorem landauFunctionPrefix_spec (n : ℕ) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < (landauFunctionPrefix n).length) :
    IsGreatest {M | 0 < M ∧ ell M ≤ i} ((landauFunctionPrefix n)[i]).toNat
proof:
:= by
  have hlen := length_landauFunctionPrefix n
  set ps := (primesUpTo n).toList with hps
  have hnd : ([] ++ ps).Nodup := by
    rw [List.nil_append]; exact (primesUpTo_sorted n).imp ne_of_lt
  have hpr : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Prime := fun p hp =>
    (mem_primesUpTo.mp (Array.mem_toList_iff.mp hp)).1
  have hinv := landauInv_foldl ps [] (Array.replicate n 1) hnd hpr (landauInv_init n)
  rw [List.nil_append] at hinv
  have hi' : i < (ps.foldl landauStep (Array.replicate n 1)).size := by
    rw [size_foldl_landauStep, Array.size_replicate]; omega
  have hget : (landauFunctionPrefix n)[i] = (ps.foldl landauStep (Array.replicate n 1))[i] := by
    unfold landauFunctionPrefix
    rw [Array.getElem_toList]
  have key : IsGreatest {M | 0 < M ∧ ell M ≤ i}
      ((ps.foldl landauStep (Array.replicate n 1))[i]'hi').toNat := by
    obtain ⟨⟨h0, _, hell⟩, hub⟩ := hinv i hi'
    refine ⟨⟨h0, hell⟩, ?_⟩
    intro M ⟨hM0, hM⟩
    apply hub
    refine ⟨hM0, ?_, hM⟩
    intro q hq
    have hq' := Nat.le_ell_of_mem_primeFactors hq
    exact Array.mem_toList_iff.mpr
      (mem_primesUpTo.mpr ⟨(Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hq).1, by omega⟩)
  exact (congrArg (fun x : AzNat => IsGreatest {M | 0 < M ∧ ell M ≤ i} x.toNat) hget).mpr key

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_landauFunctionPrefix
statement:
theorem toNat_landauFunctionPrefix (n : ℕ) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < (landauFunctionPrefix n).length) :
    ((landauFunctionPrefix n)[i]).toNat = Nat.landau i
proof:

  (landauFunctionPrefix_spec n i hi).unique (Nat.isGreatest_landau i)

name: Azurite.AzNat.aprclOrNaive_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem aprclOrNaive_eq_true_iff (n : AzNat) :
    aprclOrNaive n = true ↔ Nat.Prime n.toNat
proof:
:= by
  unfold aprclOrNaive
  rcases h : APRCL.aprclTestSel n with _ | b
  · exact isPrimeNaive_eq_true_iff n
  · cases b
    · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
      exact APRCL.aprclTestSel_false h
    · simp only [true_iff]
      exact APRCL.aprclTestSel_true h

name: Azurite.AzNat.isPrime_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem isPrime_eq_true_iff (n : AzNat) :
    isPrime n = true ↔ Nat.Prime n.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPrime]
  by_cases hsize : n.size ≤ 32
  · rw [ite_eq_left hsize, isPrimeNaive_eq_true_iff]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hsize, Bool.and_eq_true, aprclOrNaive_eq_true_iff]
    constructor
    · exact fun h => h.2
    · exact fun hp => ⟨millerRabin_eq_true_of_prime hp 0 0, hp⟩

name: Azurite.AzNat.isPrime_ofNat_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem isPrime_ofNat_eq_true_iff (k : Nat) :
    isPrime (ofNat k) = true ↔ Nat.Prime k
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPrime_eq_true_iff, toNat_ofNat]

statement: theorem toNat_gcd (a b : AzNat) : (gcd a b).toNat = Nat.gcd a.toNat b.toNat
proof:
:= by
  unfold gcd
  split_ifs
  · exact toNat_gcdBinary a b
  · exact toNat_gcdHalfBinary a b

name: Azurite.AzNat.coprime_iff
statement:
theorem coprime_iff (a b : AzNat) :
    AzNat.coprime a b = true ↔ Nat.Coprime a.toNat b.toNat
proof:
:= by
  show (if a.isEven && b.isEven then false else AzNat.gcd a b == 1) = true
    ↔ Nat.gcd a.toNat b.toNat = 1
  by_cases h_both_even : (a.isEven && b.isEven) = true
  · rw [ite_eq_left h_both_even]
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    have ha_even : a.isEven = true := by
      have := h_both_even; simp [Bool.and_eq_true] at this; exact this.1
    have hb_even : b.isEven = true := by
      have := h_both_even; simp [Bool.and_eq_true] at this; exact this.2
    rw [isEven_iff] at ha_even hb_even
    obtain ⟨ka, hka⟩ := ha_even
    obtain ⟨kb, hkb⟩ := hb_even
    intro h_gcd
    have h2g : 2 ∣ Nat.gcd a.toNat b.toNat :=
      Nat.dvd_gcd ⟨ka, by omega⟩ ⟨kb, by omega⟩
    omega
  · rw [ite_eq_right (Bool.not_eq_true _ ▸ h_both_even)]
    rw [beq_iff_eq]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [← toNat_gcd a b, h]; rfl
    · intro h
      apply toNat_injective
      rw [toNat_gcd, h]; rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_certProduct
statement:
theorem toNat_certProduct : ∀ l : List (AzNat × ℕ),
    (certProduct l).toNat = (l.map (fun qe => qe.1.toNat ^ qe.2)).prod
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons qe rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨q, e⟩ := qe
    rw [certProduct, toNat_mul, toNat_pow, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, ih]

name: Azurite.AzNat.checkPrattLink_sound
proof:
:= by
  rw [checkPrattLink] at h
  by_cases h1 : 1 < p.toNat
  case neg => rw [dite_eq_right h1] at h; exact Bool.noConfusion h
  rw [dite_eq_left h1] at h
  have : NeZero p.toNat := ⟨by omega⟩
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, List.all_eq_true,
    Bool.or_eq_true] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨hprod, hfac⟩, hferm, hord⟩ := h
  
  have hM1 : (p - 1).toNat = p.toNat - 1 := by rw [toNat_sub, toNat_one]
  have hprod' : (factors.map (fun qe => qe.1.toNat ^ qe.2)).prod
      = p.toNat - 1 := by
    rw [← toNat_certProduct, hprod, hM1]
  
  refine lucas_primality p.toNat ((a.toNat : ZMod p.toNat)) ?_ ?_
  · 
    have := congrArg AzZMod.toZMod hferm
    rwa [AzZMod.toZMod_powAzNat, AzZMod.toZMod_ofAzNat, AzZMod.toZMod_one,
      hM1] at this
  · 
    intro q hq hqdvd
    
    rw [← hprod'] at hqdvd
    have hqdvd' := (Prime.dvd_prod_iff hq.prime).mp hqdvd
    obtain ⟨x, hxmem, hqx⟩ := hqdvd'
    obtain ⟨qe, hqe, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hxmem
    have hqbase : q ∣ qe.1.toNat := hq.dvd_of_dvd_pow hqx
    have hbaseprime : Nat.Prime qe.1.toNat := by
      rcases hfac qe hqe with hmem | hsmall
      · exact hcert _ hmem
      · exact (isPrime_eq_true_iff _).mp hsmall
    have hqeq : q = qe.1.toNat :=
      (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq hbaseprime).mp hqbase
    
    intro hone
    apply hord qe hqe
    apply AzZMod.toZMod_injective
    rw [AzZMod.toZMod_powAzNat, AzZMod.toZMod_ofAzNat, AzZMod.toZMod_one,
      toNat_div, hM1, ← hqeq]
    exact hone

name: Azurite.AzNat.checkPrattChain_sound
statement:
theorem checkPrattChain_sound :
    ∀ (links : List PrattLink) (certified : List AzNat),
      (∀ c ∈ certified, Nat.Prime c.toNat) →
      checkPrattChain certified links = true →
      ∀ l ∈ links, Nat.Prime (l.1).toNat
proof:
:= by
  intro links
  induction links with
  | nil => intro certified _ _ l hl; exact absurd hl (List.not_mem_nil)
  | cons link rest ih =>
    intro certified hcert h l hl
    obtain ⟨p, a, factors⟩ := link
    rw [checkPrattChain, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    have hp : Nat.Prime p.toNat := checkPrattLink_sound hcert h.1
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hl with rfl | hl
    · exact hp
    · refine ih (p :: certified) ?_ h.2 l hl
      intro c hc
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hc with rfl | hc
      · exact hp
      · exact hcert c hc

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_garnerStep
statement:
theorem toNat_garnerStep (mᵢ μ c nᵢ x : AzNat) :
    (garnerStep mᵢ μ c nᵢ x).toNat
      = CP.garnerStep mᵢ.toNat μ.toNat c.toNat nᵢ.toNat x.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [garnerStep, CP.garnerStep, toNat_add, toNat_mul, toNat_mod,
    toNat_mul, toNat_add, toNat_mod, toNat_sub, toNat_mod]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_garnerLoop
statement:
theorem toNat_garnerLoop (μ : AzNat) (ms : List AzNat) :
    ∀ (x : AzNat) (ns : List AzNat), (∀ m ∈ ms, 0 < m.toNat) →
    (∀ m ∈ ms, Nat.Coprime μ.toNat m.toNat) →
    (ms.map toNat).Pairwise Nat.Coprime →
    (garnerLoop x (garnerPrecomp μ ms) ns).toNat
      = CP.garnerLoop x.toNat (CP.garnerPrecomp μ.toNat (ms.map toNat))
          (ns.map toNat)
proof:
:= by
  induction ms generalizing μ with
  | nil =>
    intro x ns _ _ _
    cases ns <;> rfl
  | cons mᵢ ms ih =>
    intro x ns hpos hcoμ hco
    match ns with
    | [] => rfl
    | nᵢ :: ns =>
      have hmᵢ : 0 < mᵢ.toNat := hpos mᵢ (by simp)
      have hc : Nat.Coprime μ.toNat mᵢ.toNat := hcoμ mᵢ (by simp)
      have hhead : (garnerStep mᵢ μ (invMod μ mᵢ) nᵢ x).toNat
          = CP.garnerStep mᵢ.toNat μ.toNat (CP.invMod μ.toNat mᵢ.toNat)
              nᵢ.toNat x.toNat := by
        rw [toNat_garnerStep, toNat_invMod hc hmᵢ]
      have hpair := List.pairwise_cons.mp hco
      have htail := ih (μ * mᵢ) (garnerStep mᵢ μ (invMod μ mᵢ) nᵢ x) ns
        (fun m hm => hpos m (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm))
        (fun m hm => by
          rw [toNat_mul]
          exact (Nat.Coprime.mul_right
            (hcoμ m (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm)).symm
            (hpair.1 m.toNat (List.mem_map_of_mem hm)).symm).symm)
        hpair.2
      show (garnerLoop (garnerStep mᵢ μ (invMod μ mᵢ) nᵢ x)
          (garnerPrecomp (μ * mᵢ) ms) ns).toNat = _
      rw [htail, hhead, toNat_mul]
      rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_garner
statement:
theorem toNat_garner (ms ns : List AzNat)
    (hpos : ∀ m ∈ ms, 0 < m.toNat)
    (hco : (ms.map toNat).Pairwise Nat.Coprime) :
    (garner ms ns).toNat = CP.garner (ms.map toNat) (ns.map toNat)
proof:
:= by
  match ms, ns with
  | [], _ => cases ns <;> rfl
  | m₀ :: ms', [] => rfl
  | m₀ :: ms', n₀ :: ns' =>
    have hpair := List.pairwise_cons.mp hco
    have hprod : ((m₀ :: ms').prod).toNat = ((m₀ :: ms').map toNat).prod := by
      have h := map_list_prod toNatRingHom (m₀ :: ms')
      rwa [show ⇑toNatRingHom = toNat from funext fun _ => rfl] at h
    show (garnerLoop (n₀ % m₀) (garnerPrecomp m₀ ms') ns'
        % (m₀ :: ms').prod).toNat = _
    rw [toNat_mod, hprod,
      toNat_garnerLoop m₀ ms' (n₀ % m₀) ns'
        (fun m hm => hpos m (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm))
        (fun m hm => hpair.1 m.toNat (List.mem_map_of_mem hm))
        hpair.2,
      toNat_mod]
    rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.garner_lt
statement:
theorem garner_lt (ms ns : List AzNat)
    (hpos : ∀ m ∈ ms, 0 < m.toNat)
    (hco : (ms.map toNat).Pairwise Nat.Coprime) :
    (garner ms ns).toNat < (ms.map toNat).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [toNat_garner ms ns hpos hco]
  exact CP.garner_lt _ _ (by simpa using hpos)

name: Azurite.AzNat.garner_modEq
statement:
theorem garner_modEq (ms ns : List AzNat)
    (hpos : ∀ m ∈ ms, 0 < m.toNat)
    (hco : (ms.map toNat).Pairwise Nat.Coprime) :
    ∀ p ∈ ms.zip ns, (garner ms ns).toNat ≡ p.2.toNat [MOD p.1.toNat]
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [toNat_garner ms ns hpos hco]
  have hmem : (p.1.toNat, p.2.toNat) ∈ (ms.map toNat).zip (ns.map toNat) := by
    rw [List.zip_map]
    exact List.mem_map_of_mem hp
  exact CP.garner_modEq _ _ (by simpa using hpos) hco _ hmem

name: Azurite.AzNat.eq_garner_of_modEq
statement:
theorem eq_garner_of_modEq (ms ns : List AzNat)
    (hpos : ∀ m ∈ ms, 0 < m.toNat)
    (hco : (ms.map toNat).Pairwise Nat.Coprime)
    (hlen : ms.length ≤ ns.length) {x : ℕ}
    (hlt : x < (ms.map toNat).prod)
    (hx : ∀ p ∈ ms.zip ns, x ≡ p.2.toNat [MOD p.1.toNat]) :
    x = (garner ms ns).toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [toNat_garner ms ns hpos hco]
  refine CP.eq_garner_of_modEq _ _ (by simpa using hpos) hco
    (by simpa using hlen) hlt ?_
  intro q hq
  rw [List.zip_map, List.mem_map] at hq
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hq
  exact hx p hp

name: Azurite.AzNat.subfactorialSplit_spec
statement:
theorem subfactorialSplit_spec : ∀ (fuel a b : ℕ), b - a ≤ fuel →
    (subfactorialSplit fuel a b).1.toNat = ∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico (a + 1) (b + 1), k ∧
    (subfactorialSplit fuel a b).2.toInt
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico (a + 1) (b + 1),
          (-1 : ℤ) ^ k * ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ico (k + 1) (b + 1), (j : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro a b hab
    rw [subfactorialSplit, Finset.Ico_eq_empty_of_le (by omega)]
    exact ⟨toNat_one, AzInt.toInt_zero⟩
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro a b hab
    rw [subfactorialSplit]
    dsimp only
    by_cases hle : b ≤ a
    · rw [ite_eq_left hle, Finset.Ico_eq_empty_of_le (by omega)]
      exact ⟨toNat_one, AzInt.toInt_zero⟩
    rw [ite_eq_right hle]
    by_cases heq : b = a + 1
    · rw [ite_eq_left heq]
      subst heq
      rw [Nat.Ico_succ_singleton, Finset.prod_singleton, Finset.sum_singleton, Finset.Ico_self,
        Finset.prod_empty, mul_one]
      refine ⟨toNat_ofNat _, ?_⟩
      show (if (a + 1) % 2 = 0 then (1 : AzInt) else -1).toInt = _
      split_ifs with hpar
      · rw [AzInt.toInt_one, (Nat.even_iff.mpr hpar).neg_one_pow]
      · rw [AzInt.toInt_neg, AzInt.toInt_one, (Nat.odd_iff.mpr (by omega)).neg_one_pow]
    rw [ite_eq_right heq]
    dsimp only
    have hm1 : a + 1 ≤ (a + b) / 2 + 1 := by omega
    have hm2 : (a + b) / 2 + 1 ≤ b + 1 := by omega
    obtain ⟨hl1, hl2⟩ := ih a ((a + b) / 2) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨hr1, hr2⟩ := ih ((a + b) / 2) b (by omega)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [toNat_mul, hl1, hr1, Finset.prod_Ico_consecutive _ hm1 hm2]
    · rw [AzInt.toInt_add, AzInt.toInt_mul, AzNat.toInt_toAzInt, hl2, hr2, hr1, Finset.sum_mul,
        ← Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive _ hm1 hm2]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
      rw [mul_assoc, Nat.cast_prod, Finset.prod_Ico_consecutive _ (by omega : k + 1 ≤ _) hm2]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_subfactorial
statement: theorem toNat_subfactorial (n : ℕ) : (subfactorial n).toNat = numDerangements n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := subfactorialSplit_spec n 0 n (by omega)
  unfold subfactorial
  dsimp only
  rw [AzInt.toNat_natAbs, AzInt.toInt_add, AzNat.toInt_toAzInt, h1, h2]
  have hsum := numDerangements_sum n
  have hasc : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ k * (((k + 1).ascFactorial (n - k) : ℕ) : ℤ)
        = (-1 : ℤ) ^ k * ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ico (k + 1) (n + 1), (j : ℤ) := by
    intro k hk
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk
    rw [Nat.ascFactorial_eq_prod_range, Finset.prod_Ico_eq_prod_range,
      show n + 1 - (k + 1) = n - k by omega]
    push_cast
    rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hasc, Finset.range_eq_Ico, Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot (by omega)]
    at hsum
  simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, zero_add] at hsum
  have hP : ((∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico (0 + 1) (n + 1), k : ℕ) : ℤ)
      = ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ico (0 + 1) (n + 1), (j : ℤ) := by push_cast; rfl
  rw [hP, zero_add, ← hsum, Int.natAbs_natCast]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_subfactorial_card
statement:
theorem toNat_subfactorial_card (n : ℕ) :
    (subfactorial n).toNat = Fintype.card (derangements (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [toNat_subfactorial, card_derangements_fin_eq_numDerangements]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNatLimbsList_dropLast_of_getLast?_zero
statement:
private lemma toNatLimbsList_dropLast_of_getLast?_zero (l : List UInt64)
    (h : l.getLast? = some 0) : toNatLimbsList l.dropLast = toNatLimbsList l
proof:
:= by
  have h_ne : l ≠ [] := by
    intro heq; rw [heq] at h; simp at h
  have h_last : l.getLast h_ne = 0 := by
    rw [List.getLast?_eq_some_getLast h_ne] at h
    exact Option.some.inj h
  have h_split : l.dropLast ++ [l.getLast h_ne] = l :=
    List.dropLast_append_getLast h_ne
  have h_app := toNatLimbsList_append l.dropLast [l.getLast h_ne]
  rw [h_split, h_last] at h_app
  rw [h_app]
  simp [toNatLimbsList]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNatLimbsList_trimTrailingZeros
statement:
theorem toNatLimbsList_trimTrailingZeros (a : Array UInt64) :
    toNatLimbsList (trimTrailingZeros a).toList = toNatLimbsList a.toList
proof:
:= by
  rw [trimTrailingZeros]
  by_cases h : a.size = 0
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte]
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte]
    have h_idx : a.size - 1 < a.size :=
      Nat.sub_lt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h) Nat.zero_lt_one
    by_cases h_last : a[a.size - 1] = 0
    · rw [ite_eq_left h_last]
      rw [toNatLimbsList_trimTrailingZeros a.pop]
      rw [Array.toList_pop]
      apply toNatLimbsList_dropLast_of_getLast?_zero
      rw [Array.getLast?_toList, Array.back?_eq_getElem?,
          Array.getElem?_eq_getElem h_idx, h_last]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h_last]
  termination_by a.size
  decreasing_by simp [Array.size_pop]; omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_ofLimbs
statement:
theorem toNat_ofLimbs (a : Array UInt64) :
    (ofLimbs a).toNat = toNatLimbsList a.toList
proof:
:= by
  show toNatLimbsList (trimTrailingZeros a).toList = _
  exact toNatLimbsList_trimTrailingZeros a

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNatLimbsList_drop
statement:
theorem toNatLimbsList_drop (l : List UInt64) (k : Nat) :
    toNatLimbsList (l.drop k) = toNatLimbsList l / 2 ^ (64 * k)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k ≤ l.length
  · have h_take_len : (l.take k).length = k := by rw [List.length_take]; omega
    have h_app := toNatLimbsList_append (l.take k) (l.drop k)
    rw [List.take_append_drop, h_take_len] at h_app
    have h_take_lt : toNatLimbsList (l.take k) < 2 ^ (64 * k) := by
      have := toNatLimbsList_lt_pow (l.take k)
      rw [h_take_len] at this
      exact this
    rw [h_app, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ (Nat.two_pow_pos (64 * k)),
        Nat.div_eq_of_lt h_take_lt, Nat.zero_add]
  · have hkl : l.length ≤ k := by omega
    rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le hkl]
    have h_lt : toNatLimbsList l < 2 ^ (64 * k) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (toNatLimbsList_lt_pow l)
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega))
    rw [Nat.div_eq_of_lt h_lt]
    rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNatLimbsList_extract_size
statement:
theorem toNatLimbsList_extract_size (a : Array UInt64) (k : Nat) :
    toNatLimbsList (a.extract k a.size).toList = toNatLimbsList a.toList / 2 ^ (64 * k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Array.toList_extract, List.extract_eq_take_drop]
  have h_len : a.toList.length = a.size := rfl
  rw [List.take_of_length_le (by rw [List.length_drop, h_len])]
  rw [toNatLimbsList_drop]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_shiftRightMul64
statement:
theorem toNat_shiftRightMul64 (a : AzNat) (k : Nat) :
    (shiftRightMul64 a k).toNat = a.toNat / 2 ^ (64 * k)
proof:
:= by
  show toNatLimbsList (shiftRightMul64 a k).limbs.toList = _
  show toNatLimbsList (ofLimbs (a.limbs.extract k a.limbs.size)).limbs.toList = _
  show toNatLimbsList (trimTrailingZeros (a.limbs.extract k a.limbs.size)).toList = _
  rw [toNatLimbsList_trimTrailingZeros]
  exact toNatLimbsList_extract_size a.limbs k

name: Azurite.AzNat.limb_shift_right_step
statement:
private lemma limb_shift_right_step (x carry : UInt64) (sh : Nat)
    (hsh_lb : 1 ≤ sh) (hsh_ub : sh ≤ 63)
    (hcarry : 2 ^ (64 - sh) ∣ carry.toNat) :
    (x <<< UInt64.ofNat (64 - sh)).toNat
        + ((x >>> UInt64.ofNat sh) ||| carry).toNat * 2 ^ 64
      = x.toNat * 2 ^ (64 - sh) + carry.toNat * 2 ^ 64
    ∧ 2 ^ (64 - sh) ∣ (x <<< UInt64.ofNat (64 - sh)).toNat
proof:
:= by
  have hsh'_lb : 1 ≤ 64 - sh := by omega
  have hsh'_ub : 64 - sh ≤ 63 := by omega
  have h_zero_lt : (0 : UInt64).toNat < 2 ^ (64 - sh) := Nat.two_pow_pos _
  
  obtain ⟨h_eq0, h_shr_lt⟩ := limb_shift_step x 0 (64 - sh) hsh'_lb hsh'_ub h_zero_lt
  have h_sh_eq : 64 - (64 - sh) = sh := by omega
  rw [h_sh_eq] at h_eq0 h_shr_lt
  have h_or_zero : ((x <<< UInt64.ofNat (64 - sh)) ||| 0).toNat
                    = (x <<< UInt64.ofNat (64 - sh)).toNat := by
    rw [UInt64.toNat_or]
    show _ ||| 0 = _
    exact Nat.or_zero _
  rw [h_or_zero, show (0 : UInt64).toNat = 0 from rfl, Nat.add_zero] at h_eq0
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hcarry
  
  have h_shr_lt' : (x >>> UInt64.ofNat sh).toNat < 2 ^ (64 - sh) := h_shr_lt
  have h_or_add : ((x >>> UInt64.ofNat sh) ||| carry).toNat
                  = (x >>> UInt64.ofNat sh).toNat + carry.toNat := by
    rw [UInt64.toNat_or]
    apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
    intro j
    rw [Nat.testBit_or, hq]
    rw [show (x >>> UInt64.ofNat sh).toNat + 2 ^ (64 - sh) * q
          = 2 ^ (64 - sh) * q + (x >>> UInt64.ofNat sh).toNat from Nat.add_comm _ _]
    rw [Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul_add _ h_shr_lt', Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul]
    by_cases hj : j < 64 - sh
    · simp [hj, show ¬(j ≥ 64 - sh) from by omega]
    · have h_shr_bit : (x >>> UInt64.ofNat sh).toNat.testBit j = false :=
        Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow
          (lt_of_lt_of_le h_shr_lt' (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)))
      rw [h_shr_bit]
      simp [hj, show j ≥ 64 - sh from by omega]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [h_or_add]
    have h_algebra : (x <<< UInt64.ofNat (64 - sh)).toNat
            + ((x >>> UInt64.ofNat sh).toNat + (2 ^ (64 - sh) * q)) * 2 ^ 64
          = ((x <<< UInt64.ofNat (64 - sh)).toNat
              + (x >>> UInt64.ofNat sh).toNat * 2 ^ 64) + (2 ^ (64 - sh) * q) * 2 ^ 64 := by
      ring
    rw [hq, h_algebra, h_eq0]
  · 
    have h_ofNat' : (UInt64.ofNat (64 - sh)).toNat = 64 - sh := by
      show (64 - sh) % 2 ^ 64 = 64 - sh
      exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
    have h_sub_mod : (64 - sh) % 64 = 64 - sh := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
    rw [UInt64.toNat_shiftLeft, h_ofNat', h_sub_mod, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
    have h_pow64 : (2 : Nat) ^ 64 = 2 ^ sh * 2 ^ (64 - sh) := by
      rw [← Nat.pow_add]; congr 1; omega
    refine ⟨x.toNat % 2 ^ sh, ?_⟩
    rw [h_pow64, Nat.mul_mod_mul_right, Nat.mul_comm]

name: Azurite.AzNat.shiftLimbsRightAux_preserves_ge
statement:
private lemma shiftLimbsRightAux_preserves_ge (lo sh : Nat)
    (a : Array UInt64) (i : Nat) (carry : UInt64) (h_i : i ≤ a.size)
    (j : Nat) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    ∀ (hj_new : j < (shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a i carry h_i).1.size)
      (hj_old : j < a.size),
      (shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a i carry h_i).1[j]'hj_new = a[j]'hj_old
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing a carry with
  | _ i ih =>
    intro hj_new hj_old
    unfold shiftLimbsRightAux
    by_cases hlt : lo < i
    · simp only [hlt, dite_eq_left]
      have h_dec : i - 1 < i := Nat.sub_lt (by omega) Nat.zero_lt_one
      have hij' : i - 1 ≤ j := by omega
      have h_ne : j ≠ i - 1 := by omega
      have h_inner := ih (i - 1) h_dec
                        (a.set (i - 1) ((a[i - 1] >>> UInt64.ofNat sh) ||| carry))
                        (a[i - 1] <<< UInt64.ofNat (64 - sh))
                        (by rw [Array.size_set]; omega) hij'
      have hj_set : j < (a.set (i - 1) ((a[i - 1] >>> UInt64.ofNat sh) ||| carry)).size := by
        rw [Array.size_set]; exact hj_old
      rw [h_inner _ hj_set]
      exact Array.getElem_set_ne _ _ h_ne.symm
    · simp [hlt]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNatLimbsList_take_succ_last
statement:
private lemma toNatLimbsList_take_succ_last (a : Array UInt64) (lo i : Nat)
    (h : i - 1 < a.size) (hlo : lo + 1 ≤ i) :
    toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop lo).take (i - lo))
      = toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop lo).take ((i - 1) - lo))
        + a[i - 1].toNat * 2 ^ (64 * ((i - 1) - lo))
proof:
:= by
  have h_len : a.toList.length = a.size := rfl
  
  have h_len_sub : i - lo = ((i - 1) - lo) + 1 := by omega
  
  have h_drop_len : (a.toList.drop lo).length = a.size - lo := by
    rw [List.length_drop, h_len]
  have h_take_lt : (i - 1) - lo < (a.toList.drop lo).length := by
    rw [h_drop_len]; omega
  have h_idx_lt : lo + ((i - 1) - lo) < a.toList.length := by
    rw [h_len]; omega
  rw [h_len_sub]
  
  rw [List.take_add_one]
  have h_get :
      (a.toList.drop lo)[(i - 1) - lo]?
        = some (a[i - 1]) := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem h_take_lt]
    rw [List.getElem_drop]
    show some (a.toList[lo + ((i - 1) - lo)]'_) = some a[i - 1]
    congr 1
    rw [Array.getElem_toList (h := by omega)]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [h_get, Option.toList]
  
  rw [toNatLimbsList_append]
  have h_take_len : ((a.toList.drop lo).take ((i - 1) - lo)).length = (i - 1) - lo := by
    rw [List.length_take, h_drop_len]; omega
  rw [h_take_len]
  have h_single : toNatLimbsList [a[i - 1]] = a[i - 1].toNat := by
    unfold toNatLimbsList; simp
  rw [h_single]
  ring

name: Azurite.AzNat.shiftLimbsRightAux_correct
statement:
private lemma shiftLimbsRightAux_correct (lo sh : Nat)
    (hsh_lb : 1 ≤ sh) (hsh_ub : sh ≤ 63)
    (a : Array UInt64) (i : Nat) (carry : UInt64) (h_i : i ≤ a.size)
    (hlo : lo ≤ i) (hcarry : 2 ^ (64 - sh) ∣ carry.toNat) :
    toNatLimbsList (((shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a i carry h_i).1.toList.drop lo).take (i - lo))
        * 2 ^ 64 + (shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a i carry h_i).2.toNat
      = toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop lo).take (i - lo)) * 2 ^ (64 - sh)
        + carry.toNat * 2 ^ (64 * (i - lo))
proof:
:= by
  induction i_sub_lo : i - lo generalizing a i carry with
  | zero =>
    have h_le : i ≤ lo := by omega
    have h_i_eq : i = lo := Nat.le_antisymm h_le hlo
    have h_eq : shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a i carry h_i = (a, carry) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [shiftLimbsRightAux]
      simp [h_i_eq]
    rw [h_eq]
    simp [toNatLimbsList]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h_lt : lo < i := by omega
    have h_im1_lt : i - 1 < a.size := by
      have : i - 1 < i := Nat.sub_lt (by omega) Nat.zero_lt_one
      omega
    set x := a[i - 1] with hx_def
    set newCarry := x <<< UInt64.ofNat (64 - sh) with hnc_def
    set newVal := (x >>> UInt64.ofNat sh) ||| carry with hnv_def
    set a' := a.set (i - 1) newVal with ha'_def
    have h_size' : i - 1 ≤ a'.size := by rw [ha'_def, Array.size_set]; omega
    have h_eq : shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a i carry h_i
                = shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a' (i - 1) newCarry h_size' := by
      conv_lhs => rw [shiftLimbsRightAux]
      simp [h_lt, hx_def, hnc_def, hnv_def, ha'_def]
    
    obtain ⟨h_limb_eq, h_newCarry_dvd⟩ :=
      limb_shift_right_step x carry sh hsh_lb hsh_ub hcarry
    
    have h_rec : (i - 1) - lo = n := by omega
    have hlo' : lo ≤ i - 1 := by omega
    have h_ih := ih a' (i - 1) newCarry h_size' hlo' h_newCarry_dvd h_rec
    rw [h_eq]
    
    
    have h_res_size :
        (shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a' (i - 1) newCarry h_size').1.size = a'.size :=
      shiftLimbsRightAux_size lo sh a' (i - 1) newCarry h_size'
    have h_res_size_eq :
        (shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a' (i - 1) newCarry h_size').1.size = a.size := by
      rw [h_res_size, ha'_def, Array.size_set]
    
    
    have h_res_i_size :
        i - 1 < (shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a' (i - 1) newCarry h_size').1.size := by
      rw [h_res_size_eq]; exact h_im1_lt
    have h_idx_a' : i - 1 < a'.size := by rw [ha'_def, Array.size_set]; exact h_im1_lt
    have h_a'_i : a'[i - 1]'h_idx_a' = newVal := by
      show (a.set (i - 1) newVal h_im1_lt)[i - 1]'_ = newVal
      exact Array.getElem_set_self ..
    have h_prev :=
      shiftLimbsRightAux_preserves_ge lo sh a' (i - 1) newCarry h_size'
        (i - 1) (Nat.le_refl _) h_res_i_size h_idx_a'
    have h_res_i :
        (shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a' (i - 1) newCarry h_size').1[i - 1]'h_res_i_size
          = newVal := h_prev.trans h_a'_i
    
    rw [show (n + 1) = i - lo from i_sub_lo.symm]
    rw [toNatLimbsList_take_succ_last
          (shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a' (i - 1) newCarry h_size').1 lo i h_res_i_size
          (by omega)]
    rw [toNatLimbsList_take_succ_last a lo i h_im1_lt (by omega)]
    
    rw [h_res_i]
    
    have h_drop_take_a' :
        (a'.toList.drop lo).take ((i - 1) - lo)
          = (a.toList.drop lo).take ((i - 1) - lo) := by
      rw [ha'_def, Array.toList_set, List.drop_set]
      rw [ite_eq_right (by omega : ¬ i - 1 < lo)]
      rw [List.take_set]
      rw [List.set_eq_of_length_le (by
        rw [List.length_take, List.length_drop]
        have : a.toList.length = a.size := rfl
        omega)]
    
    have h_pow : (2 : Nat) ^ (64 * (i - lo))
                = 2 ^ (64 * ((i - 1) - lo)) * 2 ^ 64 := by
      rw [← Nat.pow_add]; congr 1; omega
    rw [h_pow]
    
    set P := toNatLimbsList
      (((shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a' (i - 1) newCarry h_size').1.toList.drop lo).take ((i - 1) - lo))
      with hP_def
    set Q := toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop lo).take ((i - 1) - lo)) with hQ_def
    set R := (shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a' (i - 1) newCarry h_size').2.toNat with hR_def
    have h_ih' : P * 2 ^ 64 + R
                = Q * 2 ^ (64 - sh) + newCarry.toNat * 2 ^ (64 * ((i - 1) - lo)) := by
      have h := ih a' (i - 1) newCarry h_size' hlo' h_newCarry_dvd h_rec
      rw [← h_rec] at h
      rw [h_drop_take_a'] at h
      exact h
    
    have h_lhs :
        (Q + x.toNat * 2 ^ (64 * ((i - 1) - lo))) * 2 ^ (64 - sh)
          + carry.toNat * (2 ^ (64 * ((i - 1) - lo)) * 2 ^ 64)
        = Q * 2 ^ (64 - sh)
            + (x.toNat * 2 ^ (64 - sh) + carry.toNat * 2 ^ 64)
              * 2 ^ (64 * ((i - 1) - lo)) := by ring
    rw [h_lhs, ← h_limb_eq]
    have h_rhs :
        (P + newVal.toNat * 2 ^ (64 * ((i - 1) - lo))) * 2 ^ 64 + R
        = (P * 2 ^ 64 + R) + newVal.toNat * 2 ^ 64 * 2 ^ (64 * ((i - 1) - lo)) := by ring
    rw [h_rhs, h_ih']
    ring

name: Azurite.AzNat.shiftLimbsRightAux_preserves_lt
statement:
private lemma shiftLimbsRightAux_preserves_lt (lo sh : Nat)
    (a : Array UInt64) (i : Nat) (carry : UInt64) (h_i : i ≤ a.size)
    (j : Nat) (hj : j < lo) :
    ∀ (hj_new : j < (shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a i carry h_i).1.size)
      (hj_old : j < a.size),
      (shiftLimbsRightAux lo sh a i carry h_i).1[j]'hj_new = a[j]'hj_old
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing a carry with
  | _ i ih =>
    intro hj_new hj_old
    unfold shiftLimbsRightAux
    by_cases hlt : lo < i
    · simp only [hlt, dite_eq_left]
      have h_dec : i - 1 < i := Nat.sub_lt (by omega) Nat.zero_lt_one
      have h_ne : j ≠ i - 1 := by omega
      have h_inner := ih (i - 1) h_dec
                        (a.set (i - 1) ((a[i - 1] >>> UInt64.ofNat sh) ||| carry))
                        (a[i - 1] <<< UInt64.ofNat (64 - sh))
                        (by rw [Array.size_set]; omega)
      have hj_set : j < (a.set (i - 1) ((a[i - 1] >>> UInt64.ofNat sh) ||| carry)).size := by
        rw [Array.size_set]; exact hj_old
      rw [h_inner _ hj_set]
      exact Array.getElem_set_ne _ _ h_ne.symm
    · simp [hlt]

name: Azurite.AzNat.shiftLimbsRight_toNat
statement:
theorem shiftLimbsRight_toNat (a : Array UInt64) (lo hi sh : Nat)
    (hlo : lo ≤ hi) (hhi : hi ≤ a.size)
    (hsh_lb : 1 ≤ sh) (hsh_ub : sh ≤ 63) :
    let (a', carry)
proof:
:= shiftLimbsRight a lo hi sh hlo hhi hsh_lb hsh_ub
    toNatLimbsList ((a'.toList.drop lo).take (hi - lo)) * 2 ^ 64
        + carry.toNat
      = toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop lo).take (hi - lo)) * 2 ^ (64 - sh) := by
  have hcarry : 2 ^ (64 - sh) ∣ (0 : UInt64).toNat := by
    show 2 ^ (64 - sh) ∣ 0
    exact dvd_zero _
  have h := shiftLimbsRightAux_correct lo sh hsh_lb hsh_ub a hi 0 hhi hlo hcarry
  simp at h
  exact h

name: Azurite.AzNat.shiftLimbsRight_toList_take
statement:
theorem shiftLimbsRight_toList_take (a : Array UInt64) (lo hi sh : Nat)
    (hlo : lo ≤ hi) (hhi : hi ≤ a.size)
    (hsh_lb : 1 ≤ sh) (hsh_ub : sh ≤ 63) :
    (shiftLimbsRight a lo hi sh hlo hhi hsh_lb hsh_ub).1.toList.take lo
      = a.toList.take lo
proof:
:= by
  have h_size := shiftLimbsRight_size a lo hi sh hlo hhi hsh_lb hsh_ub
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · rw [List.length_take, List.length_take]
    show min lo (shiftLimbsRight _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _).1.size = min lo a.size
    rw [h_size]
  · intro j hj_new _
    rw [List.length_take] at hj_new
    have hj : j < lo := by
      have : j < min lo _ := hj_new
      omega
    have h_j_a : j < a.size := by
      have : j < lo := hj
      omega
    have h_j_res : j < (shiftLimbsRight a lo hi sh hlo hhi hsh_lb hsh_ub).1.size := by
      rw [h_size]; exact h_j_a
    rw [List.getElem_take, List.getElem_take]
    rw [show a.toList[j]'(by exact h_j_a) = a[j]'h_j_a from (Array.getElem_toList _).symm]
    rw [show (shiftLimbsRight a lo hi sh hlo hhi hsh_lb hsh_ub).1.toList[j]'(by exact h_j_res)
          = (shiftLimbsRight a lo hi sh hlo hhi hsh_lb hsh_ub).1[j]'h_j_res from
            (Array.getElem_toList _).symm]
    exact shiftLimbsRightAux_preserves_lt lo sh a hi 0 hhi j hj _ _

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_shiftRightGeneralLimbs
statement:
theorem toNat_shiftRightGeneralLimbs (a : AzNat) (sh : Nat)
    (hsm : ¬ sh % 64 = 0) :
    (shiftRightGeneralLimbs a sh hsm).toNat = a.toNat / 2 ^ sh
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftRightGeneralLimbs
  have hsh_lb : 1 ≤ sh % 64 := by omega
  have hsh_ub : sh % 64 ≤ 63 := by
    have : sh % 64 < 64 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
    omega
  by_cases h : sh / 64 ≥ a.limbs.size
  · rw [dite_eq_left h]
    have h_a_lt : a.toNat < 2 ^ sh := by
      have h1 : a.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * a.limbs.size) := by
        have := toNatLimbsList_lt_pow a.limbs.toList
        have h_len : a.limbs.toList.length = a.limbs.size := rfl
        rw [h_len] at this
        exact this
      have h2 : 64 * a.limbs.size ≤ sh := by
        have h_sh_eq : sh = 64 * (sh / 64) + sh % 64 := (Nat.div_add_mod sh 64).symm
        omega
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) h2)
    show (0 : AzNat).toNat = a.toNat / 2 ^ sh
    rw [Nat.div_eq_of_lt h_a_lt]
    rfl
  · rw [dite_eq_right h]
    
    set bigShift := sh / 64 with hbs
    set smallShift := sh % 64 with hss
    set shifted := (shiftLimbsRight a.limbs bigShift a.limbs.size smallShift
      (by omega) (Nat.le_refl _) hsh_lb hsh_ub).1 with hsh_def
    set carryOut := (shiftLimbsRight a.limbs bigShift a.limbs.size smallShift
      (by omega) (Nat.le_refl _) hsh_lb hsh_ub).2 with hco_def
    have h_size : shifted.size = a.limbs.size := by
      rw [hsh_def]
      exact shiftLimbsRight_size a.limbs bigShift a.limbs.size smallShift
        (by omega) (Nat.le_refl _) hsh_lb hsh_ub
    
    have h_inv : toNatLimbsList ((shifted.toList.drop bigShift).take (a.limbs.size - bigShift)) * 2 ^ 64
               + carryOut.toNat
             = toNatLimbsList ((a.limbs.toList.drop bigShift).take (a.limbs.size - bigShift)) * 2 ^ (64 - smallShift) := by
      have := shiftLimbsRight_toNat a.limbs bigShift a.limbs.size smallShift
        (by omega) (Nat.le_refl _) hsh_lb hsh_ub
      simp only at this
      exact this
    
    have h_drop_shifted_len : shifted.toList.length - bigShift = a.limbs.size - bigShift := by
      have : shifted.toList.length = shifted.size := rfl
      rw [this, h_size]
    have h_take_shifted : (shifted.toList.drop bigShift).take (a.limbs.size - bigShift)
                        = shifted.toList.drop bigShift := by
      apply List.take_of_length_le
      rw [List.length_drop, h_drop_shifted_len]
    have h_take_a : (a.limbs.toList.drop bigShift).take (a.limbs.size - bigShift)
                  = a.limbs.toList.drop bigShift := by
      apply List.take_of_length_le
      rw [List.length_drop]
      have : a.limbs.toList.length = a.limbs.size := rfl
      rw [this]
    rw [h_take_shifted, h_take_a] at h_inv
    set shifted_low := toNatLimbsList (shifted.toList.drop bigShift) with hsl_def
    set high := toNatLimbsList (a.limbs.toList.drop bigShift) with hh_def
    
    change toNatLimbsList (trimTrailingZeros (shifted.extract bigShift shifted.size)).toList
            = a.toNat / 2 ^ sh
    rw [toNatLimbsList_trimTrailingZeros]
    rw [toNatLimbsList_extract_size]
    
    
    have h_prefix_shifted : shifted.toList.take bigShift = a.limbs.toList.take bigShift := by
      rw [hsh_def]
      exact shiftLimbsRight_toList_take a.limbs bigShift a.limbs.size smallShift
        (by omega) (Nat.le_refl _) hsh_lb hsh_ub
    have h_shifted_split :
        toNatLimbsList shifted.toList = toNatLimbsList (a.limbs.toList.take bigShift)
                                       + shifted_low * 2 ^ (64 * bigShift) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop bigShift shifted.toList]
      rw [toNatLimbsList_append, h_prefix_shifted]
      have h_take_len : (a.limbs.toList.take bigShift).length = bigShift := by
        rw [List.length_take]
        have : a.limbs.toList.length = a.limbs.size := rfl
        rw [this]; omega
      rw [h_take_len, Nat.add_comm]
    have h_take_lt : toNatLimbsList (a.limbs.toList.take bigShift) < 2 ^ (64 * bigShift) := by
      have := toNatLimbsList_lt_pow (a.limbs.toList.take bigShift)
      have h_take_len : (a.limbs.toList.take bigShift).length = bigShift := by
        rw [List.length_take]
        have : a.limbs.toList.length = a.limbs.size := rfl
        rw [this]; omega
      rw [h_take_len] at this
      exact this
    rw [h_shifted_split, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ (Nat.two_pow_pos _),
        Nat.div_eq_of_lt h_take_lt, Nat.zero_add]
    
    
    have h_a_split :
        a.toNat = toNatLimbsList (a.limbs.toList.take bigShift) + high * 2 ^ (64 * bigShift) := by
      show toNatLimbsList a.limbs.toList = _
      conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop bigShift a.limbs.toList]
      rw [toNatLimbsList_append]
      have h_take_len : (a.limbs.toList.take bigShift).length = bigShift := by
        rw [List.length_take]
        have : a.limbs.toList.length = a.limbs.size := rfl
        rw [this]; omega
      rw [h_take_len, Nat.add_comm]
    
    have h_sh_eq : sh = 64 * bigShift + smallShift := (Nat.div_add_mod sh 64).symm
    have h_pow_sh : (2 : Nat) ^ sh = 2 ^ (64 * bigShift) * 2 ^ smallShift := by
      rw [h_sh_eq, Nat.pow_add]
    rw [h_pow_sh, ← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]
    
    rw [h_a_split, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ (Nat.two_pow_pos _),
        Nat.div_eq_of_lt h_take_lt, Nat.zero_add]
    
    
    
    have h_carry_lt : carryOut.toNat < 2 ^ 64 := UInt64.toNat_lt _
    have h_lhs_div : (shifted_low * 2 ^ 64 + carryOut.toNat) / 2 ^ 64 = shifted_low := by
      rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ (Nat.two_pow_pos _),
          Nat.div_eq_of_lt h_carry_lt, Nat.zero_add]
    have h_pow_split : (2 : Nat) ^ 64 = 2 ^ smallShift * 2 ^ (64 - smallShift) := by
      rw [← Nat.pow_add]; congr 1; omega
    have h_rhs_div : high * 2 ^ (64 - smallShift) / 2 ^ 64 = high / 2 ^ smallShift := by
      rw [h_pow_split, Nat.mul_div_mul_right _ _ (Nat.two_pow_pos _)]
    calc shifted_low
        = (shifted_low * 2 ^ 64 + carryOut.toNat) / 2 ^ 64 := h_lhs_div.symm
      _ = high * 2 ^ (64 - smallShift) / 2 ^ 64 := by rw [h_inv]
      _ = high / 2 ^ smallShift := h_rhs_div

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_shiftRight
statement:
theorem toNat_shiftRight (a : AzNat) (sh : Nat) :
    (shiftRight a sh).toNat = a.toNat / 2 ^ sh
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftRight
  by_cases hz : a.limbs.size = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left hz]
    have h_nil : a.limbs.toList = [] := by
      have : a.limbs.toList.length = 0 := hz
      simp_all
    have h_toNat_zero : a.toNat = 0 := by
      show toNatLimbsList a.limbs.toList = 0
      rw [h_nil]; rfl
    rw [h_toNat_zero]; simp
  · rw [ite_eq_right hz]
    by_cases hsm : sh % 64 = 0
    · rw [dite_eq_left hsm, toNat_shiftRightMul64]
      congr 1
      conv_rhs => rw [show sh = 64 * (sh / 64) + sh % 64 from (Nat.div_add_mod sh 64).symm]
      rw [hsm, Nat.add_zero]
    · rw [dite_eq_right hsm]
      exact toNat_shiftRightGeneralLimbs a sh hsm

name: Azurite.AzNat.hShiftRight_eq
statement: @[simp] lemma hShiftRight_eq (a : AzNat) (sh : Nat) : a >>> sh = shiftRight a sh
proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_hShiftRight
statement:
theorem toNat_hShiftRight (a : AzNat) (sh : Nat) :
    (a >>> sh).toNat = a.toNat >>> sh
proof:
:= by
  rw [hShiftRight_eq, toNat_shiftRight, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]

name: Azurite.AzNat.ofNat_shiftRight
statement: theorem ofNat_shiftRight (n sh : Nat) : ofNat (n >>> sh) = ofNat n >>> sh
proof:
:= by
  apply toNat_injective
  rw [toNat_hShiftRight, toNat_ofNat, toNat_ofNat]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_two
statement: private theorem toNat_two : ((2 : UInt64).toAzNat).toNat = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [UInt64.toNat_toAzNat]; decide

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_three
statement: private theorem toNat_three : ((3 : UInt64).toAzNat).toNat = 3
