            have h_r_plus_s_ge_k : r + (q * 64 - i * k) ≥ k := by
              have h_succ : (i + 1) * k = i * k + k := by ring
              omega
            have h_digit_high : (digits[i]'h_i_in).toNat.testBit (q * 64 - i * k + r) = false := by
              apply Nat.testBit_eq_false_of_lt
              calc (digits[i]'h_i_in).toNat < 2 ^ k := h_digit_lt
                _ ≤ 2 ^ (q * 64 - i * k + r) :=
                    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
            rw [h_digit_high]
            have h_dec_succ : decide ((q * 64 + r) / k < iLo + (0 + 1)) = false := by
              have : ¬ (q * 64 + r) / k < iLo + (0 + 1) := by
                rw [h_i_eq_iLo] at h_b_ge
                omega
              simp [this]
            rw [h_dec_succ, Bool.false_and]
    · 
      simp only [h_i_in, ↓reduceDIte]
      rw [h_prev_bit]
      by_cases h_b_div_lt : (q * 64 + r) / k < iLo + n
      · have h_dec_n : decide ((q * 64 + r) / k < iLo + n) = true := by simp [h_b_div_lt]
        have h_dec_succ : decide ((q * 64 + r) / k < iLo + (n + 1)) = true := by
          have : (q * 64 + r) / k < iLo + (n + 1) := by omega
          simp [this]
        rw [h_dec_n, h_dec_succ]
      · push Not at h_b_div_lt
        by_cases h_b_eq : (q * 64 + r) / k = i
        · have h_list : digits.toList.length ≤ (q * 64 + r) / k := by
            rw [Array.length_toList, h_b_eq]
            push Not at h_i_in
            exact h_i_in
          rw [List.getElem?_eq_none h_list]
          simp [Nat.zero_testBit]
        · have h_dec_n : decide ((q * 64 + r) / k < iLo + n) = false := by
            have : ¬ (q * 64 + r) / k < iLo + n := by omega
            simp [this]
          have h_dec_succ : decide ((q * 64 + r) / k < iLo + (n + 1)) = false := by
            have : ¬ (q * 64 + r) / k < iLo + (n + 1) := by omega
            simp [this]
          rw [h_dec_n, h_dec_succ]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_ofLimbDigitsPow2_of_not_div_64
statement:
private theorem toNat_ofLimbDigitsPow2_of_not_div_64 (k : Nat) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hk_lt : k < 64)
    (hk_not_div : ¬ (1 ≤ k ∧ k < 64 ∧ 64 % k = 0)) (digits : Array UInt64)
    (hd : ∀ x ∈ digits.toList.map UInt64.toNat, x < 2 ^ k) :
    (AzNat.ofLimbDigitsPow2 k digits).toNat =
      Nat.ofDigits (2 ^ k : Nat) (digits.toList.map UInt64.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
  intro b
  rw [testBit_ofDigits_pow2 k hk _ hd b, getElem?_map_toNat_getD]
  unfold AzNat.ofLimbDigitsPow2
  have h64 : ¬ k = 64 := by omega
  have h_lt_64 : 1 ≤ k ∧ k < 64 := ⟨hk, hk_lt⟩
  rw [ite_eq_right h64, dite_eq_right hk_not_div, dite_eq_left h_lt_64]
  rw [testBit_toNat_ofLimbs]
  set totalBits := digits.size * k with h_totalBits_def
  set numLimbs := (totalBits + 63) / 64 with h_numLimbs_def
  have h_b_mod_lt : b % 64 < 64 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  
  set bGlobal := b / 64 * 64 + b % 64 with h_bGlobal_def
  have h_bGlobal_eq : bGlobal = b := by
    rw [h_bGlobal_def]; omega
  by_cases h_q_lt : b / 64 < numLimbs
  · 
    set f_outer : Fin numLimbs → UInt64 := fun q =>
      let qBits := q.val * 64
      let iLo := qBits / k
      let iHi := (qBits + 63) / k
      (Array.range (iHi + 1 - iLo)).foldl (init := (0 : UInt64)) fun acc j =>
        let i := iLo + j
        if h : i < digits.size then
          let d := digits[i]'h
          if i * k ≥ qBits then
            acc ||| (d <<< UInt64.ofNat (i * k - qBits))
          else
            acc ||| (d >>> UInt64.ofNat (qBits - i * k))
        else acc with h_f_outer_def
    have h_get : ((Array.ofFn (n := numLimbs) f_outer).toList[b / 64]?).getD 0 =
        f_outer ⟨b / 64, h_q_lt⟩ := by
      rw [Array.toList_ofFn]
      have h_lt : b / 64 < (List.ofFn f_outer).length := by
        rw [List.length_ofFn]; exact h_q_lt
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem h_lt, List.getElem_ofFn]
      rfl
    rw [h_get]
    show ((Array.range (((b / 64) * 64 + 63) / k + 1 - (b / 64) * 64 / k)).foldl
            (init := (0 : UInt64)) (fun acc j =>
              let i := (b / 64) * 64 / k + j
              if h : i < digits.size then
                let d := digits[i]'h
                if i * k ≥ (b / 64) * 64 then
                  acc ||| (d <<< UInt64.ofNat (i * k - (b / 64) * 64))
                else
                  acc ||| (d >>> UInt64.ofNat ((b / 64) * 64 - i * k))
              else acc)).toNat.testBit (b % 64) = _
    rw [← Array.foldl_toList, Array.toList_range]
    have h_n_bound :
        (b / 64) * 64 / k + (((b / 64) * 64 + 63) / k + 1 - (b / 64) * 64 / k) ≤
          ((b / 64) * 64 + 63) / k + 1 := by
      have h_le : (b / 64) * 64 / k ≤ ((b / 64) * 64 + 63) / k :=
        Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega)
      omega
    rw [testBit_foldl_cross_limb k hk hk_lt digits hd (b / 64) _ (b % 64) h_b_mod_lt h_n_bound]
    
    
    
    have h_dec : decide
        (((b / 64) * 64 + b % 64) / k <
         (b / 64) * 64 / k + (((b / 64) * 64 + 63) / k + 1 - (b / 64) * 64 / k)) = true := by
      have h_le : ((b / 64) * 64 + b % 64) / k ≤ ((b / 64) * 64 + 63) / k :=
        Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega)
      have h_iLo_le_iHi : (b / 64) * 64 / k ≤ ((b / 64) * 64 + 63) / k :=
        Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega)
      have : ((b / 64) * 64 + b % 64) / k <
             (b / 64) * 64 / k + (((b / 64) * 64 + 63) / k + 1 - (b / 64) * 64 / k) := by omega
      simp [this]
    rw [h_dec, Bool.true_and]
    
    
    have h_b_eq : (b / 64) * 64 + b % 64 = b := by omega
    rw [h_b_eq]
  · 
    push Not at h_q_lt
    set f_oob : Fin numLimbs → UInt64 := fun q =>
      let qBits := q.val * 64
      let iLo := qBits / k
      let iHi := (qBits + 63) / k
      (Array.range (iHi + 1 - iLo)).foldl (init := (0 : UInt64)) fun acc j =>
        let i := iLo + j
        if h : i < digits.size then
          let d := digits[i]'h
          if i * k ≥ qBits then
            acc ||| (d <<< UInt64.ofNat (i * k - qBits))
          else
            acc ||| (d >>> UInt64.ofNat (qBits - i * k))
        else acc with h_f_oob_def
    have h_len_oob : (Array.ofFn (n := numLimbs) f_oob).toList.length ≤ b / 64 := by
      rw [Array.toList_ofFn, List.length_ofFn]
      exact h_q_lt
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_none h_len_oob]
    
    have h_digits_oob : digits.toList.length ≤ b / k := by
      rw [Array.length_toList]
      
      have h_b_ge : b ≥ numLimbs * 64 := by
        have h_b_decomp : b = (b / 64) * 64 + b % 64 := by omega
        have h_q_64_ge : (b / 64) * 64 ≥ numLimbs * 64 :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right 64 h_q_lt
        omega
      
      have h_numLimbs_ge_div : numLimbs * 64 ≥ digits.size * k := by
        rw [h_numLimbs_def, h_totalBits_def]
        have h_dm := Nat.div_add_mod (digits.size * k + 63) 64
        have h_mod_lt : (digits.size * k + 63) % 64 < 64 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
        have h_eq : 64 * ((digits.size * k + 63) / 64) + (digits.size * k + 63) % 64
                    = digits.size * k + 63 := h_dm
        rw [Nat.mul_comm]
        omega
      have h_b_ge_div : b ≥ digits.size * k := by omega
      have h_bk_ge : b / k ≥ (digits.size * k) / k := Nat.div_le_div_right h_b_ge_div
      have h_dk : (digits.size * k) / k = digits.size := by
        rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel _ hk]
      omega
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_none h_digits_oob]
    simp [Nat.zero_testBit]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_ofLimbDigitsPow2
statement:
theorem toNat_ofLimbDigitsPow2 (k : Nat) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hk64 : k ≤ 64)
    (digits : Array UInt64) (hd : ∀ x ∈ digits.toList.map UInt64.toNat, x < 2 ^ k) :
    (AzNat.ofLimbDigitsPow2 k digits).toNat =
      Nat.ofDigits (2 ^ k : Nat) (digits.toList.map UInt64.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h_64 : k = 64
  · subst h_64
    exact toNat_ofLimbDigitsPow2_of_64 digits
  · have hk_lt : k < 64 := by omega
    by_cases h_div : 1 ≤ k ∧ k < 64 ∧ 64 % k = 0
    · exact toNat_ofLimbDigitsPow2_of_div_64 k h_div.1 h_div.2.1 h_div.2.2 digits hd
    · exact toNat_ofLimbDigitsPow2_of_not_div_64 k hk hk_lt h_div digits hd

name: Azurite.AzNat.ofLimbDigitsPow2_limbDigitsPow2
statement:
theorem ofLimbDigitsPow2_limbDigitsPow2 (k : Nat) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hk64 : k ≤ 64)
    (n : AzNat) :
    AzNat.ofLimbDigitsPow2 k (n.limbDigitsPow2 k) = n
proof:
:= by
  apply toNat_injective
  have h_2k : 1 < 2 ^ k := by
    have : (1 : Nat) = 2 ^ 0 := by simp
    rw [this]
    exact Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
  have h_digits_lt : ∀ x ∈ (n.limbDigitsPow2 k).toList.map UInt64.toNat, x < 2 ^ k := by
    intro x hx
    rw [limbDigitsPow2_eq k hk hk64 n] at hx
    exact Nat.digits_lt_base h_2k hx
  rw [toNat_ofLimbDigitsPow2 k hk hk64 (n.limbDigitsPow2 k) h_digits_lt]
  rw [limbDigitsPow2_eq k hk hk64 n]
  rw [Nat.ofDigits_digits]

name: Azurite.AzNat.odd_div_pow_padicValNat_two
statement:
theorem odd_div_pow_padicValNat_two {a : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (a / 2 ^ padicValNat 2 a) % 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (Nat.Prime 2) := ⟨Nat.prime_two⟩
  set t := padicValNat 2 a with ht
  have hdvd : 2 ^ t ∣ a := pow_padicValNat_dvd
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hdvd
  have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ t := Nat.pow_pos (by norm_num)
  have hdiv : a / 2 ^ t = c := by rw [hc, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hpos]
  rw [hdiv]
  by_contra h
  have h2 : 2 ∣ c := by omega
  apply pow_succ_padicValNat_not_dvd (p := 2) ha
  show 2 ^ (t + 1) ∣ a
  rw [pow_succ, hc]
  exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left _ h2

name: Azurite.AzNat.chi8_pow
statement:
theorem chi8_pow (n t : ℕ) (hn : n % 2 = 1) :
    (ZMod.χ₈ (n : ZMod 8)) ^ t
      = if t % 2 = 0 then 1 else if n % 8 = 1 ∨ n % 8 = 7 then (1 : ℤ) else -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ZMod.χ₈_nat_eq_if_mod_eight, ite_eq_right (by omega)]
  by_cases h8 : n % 8 = 1 ∨ n % 8 = 7
  · rw [ite_eq_left h8, one_pow]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  · rw [ite_eq_right h8]
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd t with ht | ht
    · rw [ht.neg_one_pow, ite_eq_left (Nat.even_iff.mp ht)]
    · rw [ht.neg_one_pow, ite_eq_right (by rw [Nat.odd_iff.mp ht]; omega)]

name: Azurite.AzNat.jacobiNat_eq
statement: theorem jacobiNat_eq (a n : ℕ) (hn : n % 2 = 1) : jacobiNat a n = jacobiSym a n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing a with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [jacobiNat]
    by_cases hn1 : n ≤ 1
    · rw [ite_eq_left hn1]
      have : n = 1 := by omega
      subst this
      exact (jacobiSym.one_right _).symm
    · rw [ite_eq_right hn1]
      have hn1' : 1 < n := by omega
      have hmod : jacobiSym (a : ℤ) n = jacobiSym ((a % n : ℕ) : ℤ) n := by
        rw [jacobiSym.mod_left]
        push_cast
        rfl
      by_cases h0 : a % n = 0
      · rw [ite_eq_left h0, hmod, h0, Nat.cast_zero, jacobiSym.zero_left hn1']
      · rw [ite_eq_right h0]
        have : Fact (Nat.Prime 2) := ⟨Nat.prime_two⟩
        set a₁ := a % n with ha₁
        set t := padicValNat 2 a₁ with ht
        set a' := a₁ / 2 ^ t with ha'
        have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ t := Nat.pow_pos (by norm_num)
        have hsplit : a₁ = 2 ^ t * a' := by
          rw [ha', Nat.mul_div_cancel' pow_padicValNat_dvd]
        have hodd : a' % 2 = 1 := odd_div_pow_padicValNat_two h0
        have ha'lt : a' < n := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.div_le_self _ _) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
        
        have hfac : jacobiSym (a : ℤ) n
            = (ZMod.χ₈ (n : ZMod 8)) ^ t * jacobiSym (a' : ℤ) n := by
          rw [hmod, hsplit, Nat.cast_mul, jacobiSym.mul_left, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat,
            jacobiSym.pow_left, jacobiSym.at_two (Nat.odd_iff.mpr hn)]
        rw [hfac, chi8_pow n t hn]
        by_cases h1 : a' = 1
        · rw [ite_eq_left h1, h1, Nat.cast_one, jacobiSym.one_left, mul_one]
        · rw [ite_eq_right h1]
          have hrec := jacobiSym.quadratic_reciprocity_if hodd hn
          have hih : jacobiNat (n % a') a' = jacobiSym ((n % a' : ℕ) : ℤ) a' :=
            ih a' ha'lt (n % a') hodd
          have hmod' : jacobiSym (n : ℤ) a' = jacobiSym ((n % a' : ℕ) : ℤ) a' := by
            rw [jacobiSym.mod_left]
            push_cast
            rfl
          rw [hih, ← hmod', ← hrec]
          split_ifs <;> ring

name: Azurite.AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat
statement: private theorem eq_zero_iff_toNat (x : AzNat) : x = 0 ↔ x.toNat = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => h ▸ rfl, fun h => toNat_injective (by rw [h]; rfl)⟩

name: Azurite.AzNat.eq_one_iff_toNat
statement: private theorem eq_one_iff_toNat (x : AzNat) : x = 1 ↔ x.toNat = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => h ▸ rfl, fun h => toNat_injective (by rw [h]; rfl)⟩

name: Azurite.AzNat.modPow2_eq_ofNat_iff
statement:
private theorem modPow2_eq_ofNat_iff (x : AzNat) (k c : ℕ) :
    x.modPow2 k = ofNat c ↔ x.toNat % 2 ^ k = c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := congrArg toNat h
    rwa [toNat_modPow2, toNat_ofNat] at this
  · intro h
    exact toNat_injective (by rw [toNat_modPow2, toNat_ofNat, h])

name: Azurite.AzNat.jacobi_loop_eq
statement:
theorem jacobi_loop_eq (a n : AzNat) :
    ∀ fuel : ℕ, n.toNat ≤ fuel → jacobi.loop a n fuel = jacobiNat a.toNat n.toNat
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel generalizing a n with
  | zero =>
    intro hf
    have h0 : n.toNat = 0 := by omega
    rw [jacobi.loop, jacobiNat]
    dsimp only
    rw [ite_eq_left (show n.toNat ≤ 1 by omega)]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro hf
    rw [jacobi.loop, jacobiNat]
    dsimp only
    by_cases hn1 : n ≤ 1
    · have hn1n : n.toNat ≤ 1 := (le_iff_toNat_le n 1).mp hn1
      rw [ite_eq_left hn1, ite_eq_left hn1n]
    · have hn1' : ¬ n.toNat ≤ 1 := fun h => hn1 ((le_iff_toNat_le n 1).mpr h)
      rw [ite_eq_right hn1, ite_eq_right hn1']
      by_cases h0 : a % n = 0
      · have h0' : a.toNat % n.toNat = 0 := by
          have := (eq_zero_iff_toNat _).mp h0
          rwa [toNat_mod] at this
        rw [ite_eq_left h0, ite_eq_left h0']
      · have h0' : ¬ a.toNat % n.toNat = 0 := fun h =>
          h0 ((eq_zero_iff_toNat _).mpr (by rw [toNat_mod]; exact h))
        rw [ite_eq_right h0, ite_eq_right h0']
        rw [trailingZeros_eq_padicValNat _ h0, toNat_mod]
        dsimp only
        have hsh : ((a % n) >>> padicValNat 2 (a.toNat % n.toNat)).toNat
            = a.toNat % n.toNat / 2 ^ padicValNat 2 (a.toNat % n.toNat) := by
          rw [toNat_hShiftRight, toNat_mod, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
        have hs : (if padicValNat 2 (a.toNat % n.toNat) % 2 = 0 then (1 : ℤ)
              else if n.modPow2 3 = ofNat 1 ∨ n.modPow2 3 = ofNat 7 then 1 else -1)
            = (if padicValNat 2 (a.toNat % n.toNat) % 2 = 0 then 1
              else if n.toNat % 8 = 1 ∨ n.toNat % 8 = 7 then 1 else -1) := by
          simp only [modPow2_eq_ofNat_iff, show (2 : ℕ) ^ 3 = 8 by norm_num]
        rw [hs]
        by_cases h1 : (a % n) >>> padicValNat 2 (a.toNat % n.toNat) = 1
        · have h1' := (eq_one_iff_toNat _).mp h1
          rw [hsh] at h1'
          rw [ite_eq_left h1, ite_eq_left h1']
        · have h1' : ¬ a.toNat % n.toNat / 2 ^ padicValNat 2 (a.toNat % n.toNat) = 1 :=
            fun h => h1 ((eq_one_iff_toNat _).mpr (by rw [hsh]; exact h))
          rw [ite_eq_right h1, ite_eq_right h1']
          have hcond : (((a % n) >>> padicValNat 2 (a.toNat % n.toNat)).modPow2 2 = ofNat 3
                ∧ n.modPow2 2 = ofNat 3)
              ↔ (a.toNat % n.toNat / 2 ^ padicValNat 2 (a.toNat % n.toNat) % 4 = 3
                ∧ n.toNat % 4 = 3) := by
            rw [modPow2_eq_ofNat_iff, modPow2_eq_ofNat_iff, hsh,
              show (2 : ℕ) ^ 2 = 4 by norm_num]
          have hrec := ih (n % ((a % n) >>> padicValNat 2 (a.toNat % n.toNat)))
            ((a % n) >>> padicValNat 2 (a.toNat % n.toNat)) (by
              rw [hsh]
              have h2 : a.toNat % n.toNat / 2 ^ padicValNat 2 (a.toNat % n.toNat)
                  ≤ a.toNat % n.toNat := Nat.div_le_self _ _
              have h3 : a.toNat % n.toNat < n.toNat := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
              omega)
          rw [hrec, toNat_mod, hsh]
          simp only [hcond]

name: Azurite.AzNat.jacobi_eq
statement:
theorem jacobi_eq (a n : AzNat) (hn : n.toNat % 2 = 1) :
    jacobi a n = jacobiSym a.toNat n.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacobi, jacobi_loop_eq a n _ ?_, jacobiNat_eq _ _ hn]
  rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, one_mul, ← size_toNat]
  exact (Nat.lt_size_self _).le

name: Azurite.AzNat.SqrtCore.AM_GM
statement:
private theorem AM_GM : {a b : Nat} → (4 * a * b ≤ (a + b) * (a + b))
  | 0, _ => by rw [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_mul]; exact Nat.zero_le _
  | _, 0 => by rw [Nat.mul_zero]; exact Nat.zero_le _
  | a + 1, b + 1 => by
    simpa only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, show (4 : Nat) = 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 from rfl, Nat.one_mul,
      Nat.mul_one, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_le_add_iff_left]
      using Nat.add_le_add_right (@AM_GM a b) 4

name: Azurite.AzNat.SqrtCore.iter_sq_le
statement: theorem iter_sq_le (n guess : Nat) : Nat.sqrt.iter n guess * Nat.sqrt.iter n guess ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold Nat.sqrt.iter
  let next := (guess + n / guess) / 2
  if h : next < guess then
    simpa only [next, dite_eq_left h] using iter_sq_le n next
  else
    apply Nat.mul_le_of_le_div
    simp only
    split <;> omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.SqrtCore.lt_iter_succ_sq
statement:
theorem lt_iter_succ_sq (n guess : Nat) (hn : n < (guess + 1) * (guess + 1)) :
    n < (Nat.sqrt.iter n guess + 1) * (Nat.sqrt.iter n guess + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Nat.sqrt.iter
  let m := (guess + n / guess) / 2
  dsimp
  split <;> rename_i h
  · suffices n < (m + 1) * (m + 1) by
      simpa only [dite_eq_left h] using lt_iter_succ_sq n m this
    refine Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left ?_ (a := 4 * (guess * guess))
    apply Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt AM_GM
    rw [show (4 : Nat) = 2 * 2 from rfl]
    rw [Nat.mul_mul_mul_comm 2, Nat.mul_mul_mul_comm (2 * guess)]
    refine Nat.mul_self_lt_mul_self (?_ : _ < _ * ((_ / 2) + 1))
    rw [← Nat.add_div_right _ (by decide), Nat.mul_comm 2, Nat.mul_assoc,
      show guess + n / guess + 2 = (guess + n / guess + 1) + 1 from rfl]
    have aux_theorem {a : Nat} : a ≤ 2 * ((a + 1) / 2) := by omega
    refine Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ aux_theorem)
    rw [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.mul_add]
    exact Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.lt_mul_div_succ _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le m) h)) _
  · exact hn

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_newton_step
statement:
private theorem toNat_newton_step (m s : AzNat) :
    ((s + m / s) >>> 1).toNat = (s.toNat + m.toNat / s.toNat) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [toNat_hShiftRight, toNat_add, toNat_div, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow, pow_one]

name: Azurite.AzNat.ge_iff_toNat_ge
statement: private theorem ge_iff_toNat_ge (a b : AzNat) : a ≥ b ↔ a.toNat ≥ b.toNat
proof:
:= by
  show compare b a ≠ Ordering.gt ↔ b.toNat ≤ a.toNat
  rw [compare_eq_compare_toNat]
  exact Nat.compare_ne_gt

name: Azurite.AzNat.eq_zero_iff_toNat_zero
statement: private theorem eq_zero_iff_toNat_zero (s : AzNat) : s = 0 ↔ s.toNat = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => h ▸ rfl, fun h => ?_⟩
  apply toNat_injective
  rw [h]; rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.initialGuess_pos
statement:
private theorem initialGuess_pos (m : AzNat) :
    0 < (basecaseSqrtRem.initialGuess m).toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [toNat_initialGuess]
  exact Nat.two_pow_pos _

name: Azurite.AzNat.m_lt_initialGuess_sq
proof:
:= by
  rw [toNat_initialGuess, ← Nat.pow_add]
  have h_m_lt : m.toNat < 2 ^ m.toNat.size := Nat.lt_size_self _
  have h_size_eq : m.toNat.size = m.size := size_toNat m
  rw [h_size_eq] at h_m_lt
  have h_double : m.size ≤ (m.size + 1) / 2 + (m.size + 1) / 2 := by omega
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_m_lt (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) h_double)

name: Azurite.AzNat.m_lt_initialGuess_succ_sq
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le (m_lt_initialGuess_sq m)
  apply Nat.mul_le_mul <;> exact Nat.le_succ _

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_loop_eq_iter
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro s hfuel
    have hs_zero : s.toNat = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hfuel
    rw [basecaseSqrtRem.loop, hs_zero, Nat.sqrt.iter.eq_1]
    simp
  | succ fuel' ih =>
    intro s hfuel
    rw [basecaseSqrtRem.loop]
    by_cases hs0 : s = 0
    · rw [ite_eq_left hs0]
      rw [(eq_zero_iff_toNat_zero s).mp hs0, Nat.sqrt.iter.eq_1]
      simp
    · rw [ite_eq_right hs0]
      have hs_pos : 0 < s.toNat := by
        have : s.toNat ≠ 0 := fun h => hs0 ((eq_zero_iff_toNat_zero s).mpr h)
        omega
      have hu_toNat : ((s + m / s) >>> 1).toNat = (s.toNat + m.toNat / s.toNat) / 2 :=
        toNat_newton_step m s
      by_cases huge : (s + m / s) >>> 1 ≥ s
      · rw [ite_eq_left huge, Nat.sqrt.iter.eq_1]
        have h_ge_nat : (s.toNat + m.toNat / s.toNat) / 2 ≥ s.toNat := by
          rw [← hu_toNat]; exact (ge_iff_toNat_ge _ _).mp huge
        have h_nlt : ¬ (s.toNat + m.toNat / s.toNat) / 2 < s.toNat := by omega
        rw [dite_eq_right h_nlt]
      · rw [ite_eq_right huge]
        rw [Nat.sqrt.iter.eq_1]
        have h_nge_nat : ¬ (s.toNat + m.toNat / s.toNat) / 2 ≥ s.toNat := by
          rw [← hu_toNat]; exact mt (ge_iff_toNat_ge _ _).mpr huge
        have h_lt_nat : (s.toNat + m.toNat / s.toNat) / 2 < s.toNat := by omega
        rw [dite_eq_left h_lt_nat]
        have h_rec : (basecaseSqrtRem.loop m ((s + m / s) >>> 1) fuel').toNat
                   = Nat.sqrt.iter m.toNat ((s + m / s) >>> 1).toNat :=
          ih _ (by rw [hu_toNat]; omega)
        rw [h_rec, hu_toNat]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_zero_of_size_zero
statement:
private theorem toNat_zero_of_size_zero (m : AzNat) (hm : m.limbs.size = 0) :
    m.toNat = 0
proof:
:= by
  show toNatLimbsList _ = 0
  rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hm]; rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_basecaseSqrt
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNat_basecaseSqrt (m : AzNat) :
    (basecaseSqrt m).toNat = Nat.sqrt m.toNat
proof:
:= by
  unfold basecaseSqrt
  by_cases hm0 : m.limbs.size = 0
  · rw [ite_eq_left hm0, toNat_zero_of_size_zero m hm0]; rfl
  · rw [ite_eq_right hm0]
    by_cases hm1 : m.limbs.size = 1
    · 
      rw [dite_eq_left hm1]
      show (Azurite.UInt64.sqrt _).toAzNat.toNat = _
      rw [_root_.UInt64.toNat_toAzNat, Azurite.UInt64.toNat_sqrt]
      rw [toNat_of_size_one m hm1]
    · 
      rw [dite_eq_right hm1]
      set u₀ := basecaseSqrtRem.initialGuess m
      set fuel := (1 : Nat) <<< ((m.size + 1) / 2) + 1
      show (basecaseSqrtRem.loop m u₀ fuel).toNat = _
      have h_fuel : u₀.toNat ≤ fuel := by
        show u₀.toNat ≤ (1 : Nat) <<< ((m.size + 1) / 2) + 1
        rw [toNat_initialGuess, Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.one_mul]
        omega
      rw [toNat_loop_eq_iter m fuel u₀ h_fuel]
      have h_sq_le : Nat.sqrt.iter m.toNat u₀.toNat *
                     Nat.sqrt.iter m.toNat u₀.toNat ≤ m.toNat :=
        SqrtCore.iter_sq_le _ _
      have h_succ_sq : m.toNat < (Nat.sqrt.iter m.toNat u₀.toNat + 1) *
                                 (Nat.sqrt.iter m.toNat u₀.toNat + 1) :=
        SqrtCore.lt_iter_succ_sq m.toNat u₀.toNat (m_lt_initialGuess_succ_sq m)
      exact Nat.eq_sqrt.mpr ⟨h_sq_le, h_succ_sq⟩

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_basecaseSqrtRem_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNat_basecaseSqrtRem_fst (m : AzNat) :
    (basecaseSqrtRem m).1.toNat = Nat.sqrt m.toNat
proof: := toNat_basecaseSqrt m

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_basecaseSqrtRem_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNat_basecaseSqrtRem_snd (m : AzNat) :
    (basecaseSqrtRem m).2.toNat = m.toNat - Nat.sqrt m.toNat * Nat.sqrt m.toNat
proof:
:= by
  show (m - (basecaseSqrt m).square).toNat = _
  rw [toNat_sub, toNat_square, Nat.pow_two, toNat_basecaseSqrt]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_ofLimbs_extract
statement:
private theorem toNat_ofLimbs_extract (a : Array UInt64) (lo len : Nat) :
    (ofLimbs (a.extract lo (lo + len))).toNat = sliceVal a lo len
proof:
:= by
  rw [toNat_ofLimbs, Array.toList_extract, List.extract_eq_take_drop]
  show toNatLimbsList ((a.toList.drop lo).take (lo + len - lo)) = _
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]

name: Azurite.AzNat.sliceVal_one
statement:
private theorem sliceVal_one (a : Array UInt64) (lo : Nat) (h : lo < a.size) :
    sliceVal a lo 1 = (a[lo]'h).toNat
proof:
:= by
  unfold sliceVal
  have h_take : (a.toList.drop lo).take 1 = [a.toList[lo]'(by rw [Array.length_toList]; omega)] := by
    rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (by rw [Array.length_toList]; omega)]
    simp
  rw [h_take, Array.getElem_toList]
  simp [toNatLimbsList]

name: Azurite.AzNat.sliceVal_lower_bound_succ
statement:
private theorem sliceVal_lower_bound_succ (a : Array UInt64) (lo m : Nat)
    (hbound : lo + m + 1 ≤ a.size)
    (h_top : (a[lo + m]'(by omega)) ≠ 0) :
    2 ^ (64 * m) ≤ sliceVal a lo (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sliceVal_split a lo (m + 1) m (by omega) hbound]
  rw [show m + 1 - m = 1 from by omega]
  rw [sliceVal_one a (lo + m) (by omega)]
  have h_top_pos : 1 ≤ (a[lo + m]'(by omega)).toNat := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (a[lo + m]'(by omega)).toNat with hz | hp
    · exfalso; apply h_top
      exact _root_.UInt64.eq_of_toNat_eq (by rw [hz]; rfl)
    · exact hp
  have h_mul : 2 ^ (64 * m) ≤ (a[lo + m]'(by omega)).toNat * 2 ^ (64 * m) := by
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ (64 * m)) h_top_pos
    linarith
  omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.mca_1_12_eq
statement:
private theorem mca_1_12_eq (T R' Q U S' A₁ A₀ B : Nat)
    (h_top : T = S' * S' + R')
    (h_divmod : R' * B + A₁ = Q * (2 * S') + U) :
    T * B * B + A₁ * B + A₀ + Q * Q
      = (S' * B + Q) * (S' * B + Q) + (U * B + A₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hstep :
      (S' * S' + R') * B * B + A₁ * B + A₀ + Q * Q
        = S' * S' * B * B + (R' * B + A₁) * B + A₀ + Q * Q := by ring
  rw [h_top, hstep, h_divmod]; ring

name: Azurite.AzNat.mca_1_12_bound_no_adjust
proof:
:= by
  have h_le : U + 1 ≤ 2 * S' := h_U_lt
  have h_mul : (U + 1) * B ≤ 2 * S' * B := Nat.mul_le_mul_right B h_le
  have h1 : U * B + B ≤ 2 * S' * B := by
    calc U * B + B = (U + 1) * B := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * S' * B := h_mul
  have h2 : U * B + A₀ < 2 * S' * B := by
    calc U * B + A₀ < U * B + B := by omega
      _ ≤ 2 * S' * B := h1
  have h3 : 2 * S' * B + 2 * Q = 2 * (S' * B + Q) := by ring
  omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.mca_1_12_Q_le_B
statement:
private theorem mca_1_12_Q_le_B (S' R' Q U A₁ B : Nat)
    (h_S'_ge_B : S' ≥ B)
    (h_R'_le : R' ≤ 2 * S') (h_A₁_lt : A₁ < B)
    (h_divmod : R' * B + A₁ = Q * (2 * S') + U) :
    Q ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 : Q * (2 * S') ≤ R' * B + A₁ := by omega
  have h2 : R' * B ≤ 2 * S' * B := Nat.mul_le_mul_right B h_R'_le
  have h3 : Q * (2 * S') ≤ 2 * S' * B + (B - 1) := by omega
  
  have h4 : (B + 1) * (2 * S') = 2 * S' * B + 2 * S' := by ring
  have h5 : Q * (2 * S') < (B + 1) * (2 * S') := by
    rw [h4]
    have h_2S'_ge : 2 * S' ≥ 2 * B := by omega
    omega
  exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h5)

name: Azurite.AzNat.SliceTopNonzero_recurse
statement:
private theorem SliceTopNonzero_recurse (a : Array UInt64) (lo len ℓ : Nat)
    (h2ℓ : 2 * ℓ < len) (hbound : lo + len ≤ a.size)
    (h_inv : SliceTopNonzero a lo len) :
    SliceTopNonzero a (lo + 2 * ℓ) (len - 2 * ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold SliceTopNonzero at h_inv ⊢
  set P := (a.toList.drop lo).take len with hP_def
  have h_len_a : a.toList.length = a.size := Array.length_toList
  have hP_len : P.length = len := by
    rw [hP_def, List.length_take, List.length_drop, h_len_a]; omega
  have hP_ne : P ≠ [] := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg List.length h
    rw [hP_len] at this; simp at this; omega
  
  have h_eq : (a.toList.drop (lo + 2 * ℓ)).take (len - 2 * ℓ) = P.drop (2 * ℓ) := by
    rw [hP_def, List.drop_take, List.drop_drop]
  rw [h_eq]
  
  have h_drop_ne : P.drop (2 * ℓ) ≠ [] := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg List.length h
    rw [List.length_drop, hP_len] at this
    simp at this; omega
  have h_eq_last : (P.drop (2 * ℓ)).getLast h_drop_ne = P.getLast hP_ne :=
    List.getLast_drop h_drop_ne
  rw [List.getLast?_eq_some_getLast h_drop_ne, List.getLast?_eq_some_getLast hP_ne] at *
  rw [h_eq_last]
  exact h_inv

name: Azurite.AzNat.spec_aux_basecase
statement:
private theorem spec_aux_basecase (a : Array UInt64) (lo len : Nat)
    (_h : lo + len ≤ a.size) :
    Spec_aux a lo len
      (basecaseSqrtRem (ofLimbs (a.extract lo (lo + len)))).1
      (basecaseSqrtRem (ofLimbs (a.extract lo (lo + len)))).2
proof:
:= by
  set m := ofLimbs (a.extract lo (lo + len))
  set s := (basecaseSqrtRem m).1
  set r := (basecaseSqrtRem m).2
  have h_s_eq : s.toNat = Nat.sqrt m.toNat := toNat_basecaseSqrtRem_fst m
  have h_r_eq : r.toNat = m.toNat - Nat.sqrt m.toNat * Nat.sqrt m.toNat :=
    toNat_basecaseSqrtRem_snd m
  have h_m_val : m.toNat = sliceVal a lo len := toNat_ofLimbs_extract a lo len
  have h_sq_le : Nat.sqrt m.toNat * Nat.sqrt m.toNat ≤ m.toNat := Nat.sqrt_le _
  have h_lt_succ : m.toNat < (Nat.sqrt m.toNat + 1) * (Nat.sqrt m.toNat + 1) :=
    Nat.lt_succ_sqrt _
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [h_s_eq, h_r_eq, ← h_m_val]
    omega
  · 
    rw [h_s_eq, h_r_eq]
    
    have h_expand : (Nat.sqrt m.toNat + 1) * (Nat.sqrt m.toNat + 1)
                  = Nat.sqrt m.toNat * Nat.sqrt m.toNat + 2 * Nat.sqrt m.toNat + 1 := by ring
    omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.mca_1_12_bound_adjust
statement:
private theorem mca_1_12_bound_adjust (S' Q U A₀ B : Nat)
    (h_S'_ge_B : S' ≥ B)
    (h_Q_le_B : Q ≤ B)
    (h_case : U * B + A₀ < Q * Q) :
    Q * Q + 1 ≤ 2 * (S' * B + Q) + (U * B + A₀)
proof:
:= by
  have h_Q_pos : 1 ≤ Q := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos Q with h | h
    · simp [h] at h_case
    · exact h
  have h_QQ : Q * Q ≤ B * B := Nat.mul_le_mul h_Q_le_B h_Q_le_B
  have h_S'B : B * B ≤ S' * B := Nat.mul_le_mul_right B h_S'_ge_B
  have h_QQ_le : Q * Q ≤ S' * B := Nat.le_trans h_QQ h_S'B
  have h_expand : 2 * (S' * B + Q) + (U * B + A₀)
                = S' * B + (S' * B + 2 * Q + U * B + A₀) := by ring
  omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.mca_1_12_case1_eq
statement:
private theorem mca_1_12_case1_eq (S Q U A₀ T B A₁ : Nat)
    (h_mca : T * (B * B) + A₁ * B + A₀ + Q * Q = S * S + (U * B + A₀))
    (h_case : Q * Q ≤ U * B + A₀) :
    S * S + (U * B + A₀ - Q * Q) = T * (B * B) + A₁ * B + A₀
proof:
:= by
  omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.mca_1_12_case2_eq
statement:
private theorem mca_1_12_case2_eq (S Q U A₀ T B A₁ : Nat)
    (h_s_pos : 1 ≤ S)
    (h_mca : T * (B * B) + A₁ * B + A₀ + Q * Q = S * S + (U * B + A₀))
    (h_case : U * B + A₀ < Q * Q)
    (h_bnd : Q * Q + 1 ≤ 2 * S + (U * B + A₀)) :
    (S - 1) * (S - 1) + (2 * S - 1 - (Q * Q - (U * B + A₀)))
      = T * (B * B) + A₁ * B + A₀
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_sub_eq : (S - 1) * (S - 1) + 2 * S = S * S + 1 := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, S = k + 1 := ⟨S - 1, by omega⟩
    subst hk
    have : k + 1 - 1 = k := by omega
    rw [this]; ring
  omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.mca_1_12_case2_bound
statement:
private theorem mca_1_12_case2_bound (S Q U A₀ B : Nat)
    (h_s_pos : 1 ≤ S)
    (h_case : U * B + A₀ < Q * Q) :
    (2 * S - 1 - (Q * Q - (U * B + A₀))) ≤ 2 * (S - 1)
proof:
:= by
  omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.sqrtRem_aux_correct
statement:
private theorem sqrtRem_aux_correct (a : Array UInt64) :
    ∀ (len : Nat) (lo : Nat) (h : lo + len ≤ a.size),
    SliceTopNonzero a lo len →
    Spec_aux a lo len (sqrtRem.aux a lo len h).1 (sqrtRem.aux a lo len h).2
proof:
:= by
  intro len
  induction len using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ len ih =>
    intro lo h h_inv
    rw [sqrtRem.aux]
    by_cases hℓ : (len - 1) / 4 = 0
    · 
      simp only [hℓ, ↓reduceIte]
      exact spec_aux_basecase a lo len h
    · 
      simp only [hℓ, ↓reduceIte]
      set ℓ := (len - 1) / 4 with hℓ_def
      have hℓ_pos : 1 ≤ ℓ := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos ℓ with h0 | hp
        · exact absurd h0 hℓ
        · exact hp
      have h_2ℓ_lt : 2 * ℓ < len := by omega
      have h_new_bound : (lo + 2 * ℓ) + (len - 2 * ℓ) ≤ a.size := by omega
      have h_new_inv : SliceTopNonzero a (lo + 2 * ℓ) (len - 2 * ℓ) :=
        SliceTopNonzero_recurse a lo len ℓ h_2ℓ_lt h h_inv
      have ih_top := ih (len - 2 * ℓ) (by omega) (lo + 2 * ℓ) h_new_bound h_new_inv
      
      set bℓ : Nat := 64 * ℓ with hbℓ_def
      set B : Nat := 2 ^ bℓ with hB_def
      set sr' := sqrtRem.aux a (lo + 2 * ℓ) (len - 2 * ℓ) h_new_bound
      set s' := sr'.1 with hs'_def
      set r' := sr'.2 with hr'_def
      obtain ⟨ih_eq, ih_bnd⟩ := ih_top
      
      
      
      set T : Nat := sliceVal a (lo + 2 * ℓ) (len - 2 * ℓ) with hT_def
      have h_top_eq : T = s'.toNat * s'.toNat + r'.toNat := ih_eq.symm
      
      
      
      
      have h_top_lower : 2 ^ (64 * (len - 2 * ℓ - 1)) ≤ T := by
        rw [hT_def]
        have h_len_eq : len - 2 * ℓ = (len - 2 * ℓ - 1) + 1 := by omega
        rw [h_len_eq]
        refine sliceVal_lower_bound_succ a (lo + 2 * ℓ) (len - 2 * ℓ - 1) (by omega) ?_
        · 
          
          
          unfold SliceTopNonzero at h_inv
          
          intro h_zero
          apply h_inv
          have h_idx : (lo + 2 * ℓ) + (len - 2 * ℓ - 1) = lo + len - 1 := by omega
          
          have h_p_len : ((a.toList.drop lo).take len).length = len := by
            rw [List.length_take, List.length_drop, Array.length_toList]; omega
          have h_p_ne : ((a.toList.drop lo).take len) ≠ [] := by
            intro h
            have := congrArg List.length h
            rw [h_p_len] at this; simp at this; omega
          rw [List.getLast?_eq_some_getLast h_p_ne]
          congr 1
          
          
          
          have h_last_idx : ((a.toList.drop lo).take len).length - 1 = len - 1 := by
            rw [h_p_len]
          have h_last : ((a.toList.drop lo).take len).getLast h_p_ne
                      = ((a.toList.drop lo).take len)[len - 1]'(by rw [h_p_len]; omega) := by
            rw [List.getLast_eq_getElem]
            congr 1
          rw [h_last]
          rw [List.getElem_take, List.getElem_drop, Array.getElem_toList]
          show (a[lo + (len - 1)]'(by omega)) = 0
          have h_idx_eq : lo + (len - 1) = lo + 2 * ℓ + (len - 2 * ℓ - 1) := by omega
          rw [getElem_congr rfl h_idx_eq (by omega)]
          exact h_zero
      
      have h_s'_ge_B : s'.toNat ≥ B := by
        have h_T_lt : T < (s'.toNat + 1) * (s'.toNat + 1) := by
          rw [h_top_eq]
          have h_sq : (s'.toNat + 1) * (s'.toNat + 1)
                    = s'.toNat * s'.toNat + 2 * s'.toNat + 1 := by ring
          omega
        have h_pow_le : 2 ^ (128 * ℓ) ≤ 2 ^ (64 * (len - 2 * ℓ - 1)) := by
          apply Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide)
          have hℓ_bound : 4 * ℓ + 1 ≤ len := by
            have : ℓ ≤ (len - 1) / 4 := by omega
            omega
          omega
        have h_B_sq : B * B = 2 ^ (128 * ℓ) := by
          rw [hB_def, hbℓ_def, ← Nat.pow_add]
          congr 1; ring
        have h_T_ge_Bsq : T ≥ B * B := by
          rw [h_B_sq]; exact Nat.le_trans h_pow_le h_top_lower
        have h_sq_gt : (s'.toNat + 1) * (s'.toNat + 1) > B * B := by omega
        have h_s'_gt : s'.toNat + 1 > B := by
          by_contra hc
          push Not at hc
          exact absurd (Nat.mul_le_mul hc hc) (by omega)
        omega
      
      set a₀ := ofLimbs (a.extract lo (lo + ℓ))
      set a₁ := ofLimbs (a.extract (lo + ℓ) (lo + 2 * ℓ))
      set dividend := (r' <<< bℓ) + a₁
      set divisor := s' <<< 1
      set qu := dividend.divMod divisor
      set q := qu.1 with hq_def
      set u := qu.2 with hu_def
      set s := (s' <<< bℓ) + q
      set lhs := (u <<< bℓ) + a₀
      set rhs := q.square
      
      have h_a₀_eq : a₀.toNat = sliceVal a lo ℓ := by
        show (ofLimbs (a.extract lo (lo + ℓ))).toNat = _
        exact toNat_ofLimbs_extract a lo ℓ
      have h_a₁_eq : a₁.toNat = sliceVal a (lo + ℓ) ℓ := by
        show (ofLimbs (a.extract (lo + ℓ) (lo + 2 * ℓ))).toNat = _
        rw [show lo + 2 * ℓ = (lo + ℓ) + ℓ from by ring]
        exact toNat_ofLimbs_extract a (lo + ℓ) ℓ
      have h_dividend_eq : dividend.toNat = r'.toNat * B + a₁.toNat := by
        show ((r' <<< bℓ) + a₁).toNat = _
        rw [toNat_add, toNat_hShiftLeft, Nat.shiftLeft_eq, hB_def]
      have h_divisor_eq : divisor.toNat = 2 * s'.toNat := by
        show (s' <<< 1).toNat = _
        rw [toNat_hShiftLeft, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]; ring
      
      have h_s'_pos : 1 ≤ s'.toNat := by
        have h_B_ge_2 : 2 ≤ B := by
          rw [hB_def, hbℓ_def]
          calc 2 = 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
            _ ≤ 2 ^ (64 * ℓ) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
        omega
      have h_divisor_pos : 0 < divisor.toNat := by rw [h_divisor_eq]; omega
      
      have h_qu_spec := divMod_toNat dividend divisor
      have h_div_eq : q.toNat * divisor.toNat + u.toNat = dividend.toNat := h_qu_spec.1
      have h_u_lt : u.toNat < divisor.toNat := h_qu_spec.2 (by omega)
      have h_mca_divmod : r'.toNat * B + a₁.toNat = q.toNat * (2 * s'.toNat) + u.toNat := by
        rw [← h_dividend_eq, ← h_div_eq, h_divisor_eq]
      have h_u_lt' : u.toNat < 2 * s'.toNat := by rw [← h_divisor_eq]; exact h_u_lt
      
      have h_Q_le_B : q.toNat ≤ B := by
        have h_A₁_lt : a₁.toNat < B := by
          rw [h_a₁_eq, hB_def, hbℓ_def]
          rw [show 64 * ℓ = 64 * ℓ from rfl]
          
          unfold sliceVal
          have := toNatLimbsList_lt_pow ((a.toList.drop (lo + ℓ)).take ℓ)
          have h_len : ((a.toList.drop (lo + ℓ)).take ℓ).length ≤ ℓ := by
            rw [List.length_take]; omega
          have h_pow_le : 2 ^ (64 * ((a.toList.drop (lo + ℓ)).take ℓ).length)
                       ≤ 2 ^ (64 * ℓ) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
          omega
        exact mca_1_12_Q_le_B s'.toNat r'.toNat q.toNat u.toNat a₁.toNat B
                h_s'_ge_B ih_bnd h_A₁_lt h_mca_divmod
      
      have h_s_eq : s.toNat = s'.toNat * B + q.toNat := by
        show ((s' <<< bℓ) + q).toNat = _
        rw [toNat_add, toNat_hShiftLeft, Nat.shiftLeft_eq, hB_def]
      have h_lhs_eq : lhs.toNat = u.toNat * B + a₀.toNat := by
        show ((u <<< bℓ) + a₀).toNat = _
        rw [toNat_add, toNat_hShiftLeft, Nat.shiftLeft_eq, hB_def]
      have h_rhs_eq : rhs.toNat = q.toNat * q.toNat := by
        show q.square.toNat = _
        rw [toNat_square, Nat.pow_two]
      
      have h_A₀_lt : a₀.toNat < B := by
        rw [h_a₀_eq, hB_def, hbℓ_def]
        unfold sliceVal
        have := toNatLimbsList_lt_pow ((a.toList.drop lo).take ℓ)
        have h_len : ((a.toList.drop lo).take ℓ).length ≤ ℓ := by
          rw [List.length_take]; omega
        have h_pow_le : 2 ^ (64 * ((a.toList.drop lo).take ℓ).length)
                     ≤ 2 ^ (64 * ℓ) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
        omega
      
      have h_B : B = 2 ^ (64 * ℓ) := by rw [hB_def, hbℓ_def]
      have h_BB : B * B = 2 ^ (64 * (2 * ℓ)) := by
        rw [hB_def, hbℓ_def, ← Nat.pow_add]; congr 1; ring
      have h_sliceVal_eq : sliceVal a lo len
                        = T * (B * B) + a₁.toNat * B + a₀.toNat := by
        rw [sliceVal_split a lo len (2 * ℓ) (by omega) h]
        rw [sliceVal_split a lo (2 * ℓ) ℓ (by omega) (by omega)]
        rw [show 2 * ℓ - ℓ = ℓ from by omega]
        rw [← h_a₀_eq, ← h_a₁_eq, ← hT_def, ← h_B, ← h_BB]
        ring
      
      have h_mca_eq : T * (B * B) + a₁.toNat * B + a₀.toNat + q.toNat * q.toNat
                    = s.toNat * s.toNat + (u.toNat * B + a₀.toNat) := by
        have key := mca_1_12_eq T r'.toNat q.toNat u.toNat s'.toNat a₁.toNat a₀.toNat B
                      h_top_eq h_mca_divmod
        rw [h_s_eq]
        have h_assoc : T * B * B = T * (B * B) := by ring
        omega
      
      have h_s_pos : 1 ≤ s.toNat := by
        rw [h_s_eq]
        have hB1 : 1 ≤ B := by rw [hB_def]; exact Nat.one_le_two_pow
        have : 1 ≤ s'.toNat * B := Nat.mul_le_mul h_s'_pos hB1
        omega
      
      by_cases h_case : lhs ≥ rhs
      · 
        simp only [h_case, ↓reduceIte]
        have h_case_toNat : rhs.toNat ≤ lhs.toNat := (ge_iff_toNat_ge lhs rhs).mp h_case
        rw [h_lhs_eq, h_rhs_eq] at h_case_toNat
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · 
          show s.toNat * s.toNat + (lhs - rhs).toNat = sliceVal a lo len
          rw [toNat_sub, h_sliceVal_eq, h_lhs_eq, h_rhs_eq]
          exact mca_1_12_case1_eq s.toNat q.toNat u.toNat a₀.toNat T B a₁.toNat
                  h_mca_eq h_case_toNat
        · 
          show (lhs - rhs).toNat ≤ 2 * s.toNat
          rw [toNat_sub, h_lhs_eq, h_rhs_eq, h_s_eq]
          have h_bnd := mca_1_12_bound_no_adjust s'.toNat q.toNat u.toNat a₀.toNat B
                          h_u_lt' h_A₀_lt
          omega
      · 
        simp only [h_case, ↓reduceIte]
        have h_case_toNat : lhs.toNat < rhs.toNat := by
          have hnle : ¬ (rhs.toNat ≤ lhs.toNat) := fun h =>
            h_case ((ge_iff_toNat_ge lhs rhs).mpr h)
          omega
        rw [h_lhs_eq, h_rhs_eq] at h_case_toNat
        
        have h_2s_eq : (s <<< 1).toNat = 2 * s.toNat := by
          rw [toNat_hShiftLeft, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]; ring
        have h_s_minus_eq : (s - 1).toNat = s.toNat - 1 := by
          rw [toNat_sub]; rfl
        have h_inner_eq : ((s <<< 1) - 1 - (rhs - lhs)).toNat
                        = 2 * s.toNat - 1 - (q.toNat * q.toNat - (u.toNat * B + a₀.toNat)) := by
          rw [toNat_sub, toNat_sub, toNat_sub]
          rw [h_2s_eq, h_rhs_eq, h_lhs_eq]
          rfl
        
        have h_bnd_adj := mca_1_12_bound_adjust s'.toNat q.toNat u.toNat a₀.toNat B
                            h_s'_ge_B h_Q_le_B h_case_toNat
        have h_bnd : q.toNat * q.toNat + 1 ≤ 2 * s.toNat + (u.toNat * B + a₀.toNat) := by
          rw [h_s_eq]; exact h_bnd_adj
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · 
          show (s - 1).toNat * (s - 1).toNat
              + ((s <<< 1) - 1 - (rhs - lhs)).toNat = sliceVal a lo len
          rw [h_s_minus_eq, h_inner_eq, h_sliceVal_eq]
          exact mca_1_12_case2_eq s.toNat q.toNat u.toNat a₀.toNat T B a₁.toNat
                  h_s_pos h_mca_eq h_case_toNat h_bnd
        · 
          show ((s <<< 1) - 1 - (rhs - lhs)).toNat ≤ 2 * (s - 1).toNat
          rw [h_inner_eq, h_s_minus_eq]
          exact mca_1_12_case2_bound s.toNat q.toNat u.toNat a₀.toNat B h_s_pos h_case_toNat

name: Azurite.AzNat.sliceVal_full
statement:
private theorem sliceVal_full (m : AzNat) :
    sliceVal m.limbs 0 m.limbs.size = m.toNat
proof:
:= by
  unfold sliceVal
  show toNatLimbsList ((m.limbs.toList.drop 0).take m.limbs.size) = m.toNat
  rw [List.drop_zero]
  rw [List.take_of_length_le (by rw [Array.length_toList])]
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.sliceTopNonzero_full
statement:
private theorem sliceTopNonzero_full (m : AzNat) :
    SliceTopNonzero m.limbs 0 m.limbs.size
proof:
:= by
  unfold SliceTopNonzero
  show ((m.limbs.toList.drop 0).take m.limbs.size).getLast? ≠ some 0
  rw [List.drop_zero, List.take_of_length_le (by rw [Array.length_toList])]
  rw [Array.getLast?_toList]
  exact m.last_ne_zero

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_sqrtRem_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNat_sqrtRem_fst (m : AzNat) :
    (sqrtRem m).1.toNat = Nat.sqrt m.toNat
proof:
:= by
  have h_spec := sqrtRem_aux_correct m.limbs m.limbs.size 0 (by omega)
                   (sliceTopNonzero_full m)
  obtain ⟨h_eq, h_bnd⟩ := h_spec
  rw [sliceVal_full] at h_eq
  
  set s := (sqrtRem.aux m.limbs 0 m.limbs.size _).1 with hs_def
  set r := (sqrtRem.aux m.limbs 0 m.limbs.size _).2 with hr_def
  have h_sq_le : s.toNat * s.toNat ≤ m.toNat := by omega
  have h_lt_succ : m.toNat < (s.toNat + 1) * (s.toNat + 1) := by
    have h_expand : (s.toNat + 1) * (s.toNat + 1)
                  = s.toNat * s.toNat + 2 * s.toNat + 1 := by ring
    omega
  show s.toNat = _
  exact Nat.eq_sqrt.mpr ⟨h_sq_le, h_lt_succ⟩

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_sqrt
statement: @[simp] theorem toNat_sqrt (m : AzNat) : (sqrt m).toNat = Nat.sqrt m.toNat
proof:
:=
  toNat_sqrtRem_fst m

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_sqrtRem_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNat_sqrtRem_snd (m : AzNat) :
    (sqrtRem m).2.toNat = m.toNat - Nat.sqrt m.toNat * Nat.sqrt m.toNat
proof:
:= by
  have h_spec := sqrtRem_aux_correct m.limbs m.limbs.size 0 (by omega)
                   (sliceTopNonzero_full m)
  obtain ⟨h_eq, _⟩ := h_spec
  rw [sliceVal_full] at h_eq
  have h_s := toNat_sqrtRem_fst m
  show (sqrtRem.aux m.limbs 0 m.limbs.size _).2.toNat = _
  rw [show (sqrtRem.aux m.limbs 0 m.limbs.size _).1.toNat = Nat.sqrt m.toNat from h_s] at h_eq
  omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_clearBit
statement:
theorem toNat_clearBit (n : AzNat) (i : Nat) :
    (n.clearBit i).toNat = Nat.ldiff n.toNat (2 ^ i)
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
  intro j
  rw [Nat.testBit_ldiff, Nat.testBit_two_pow]
  conv_rhs => rw [testBit_toNat_limbs]
  have hr_lt : j % 64 < 64 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have hj_decomp : j = (j % 64) + 64 * (j / 64) := by omega
  have h_size_eq : n.limbs.toList.length = n.limbs.size := rfl
  by_cases h_in_range : i / 64 < n.limbs.size
  · 
    simp only [clearBit, dite_eq_left h_in_range]
    rw [toNat_ofLimbs, Array.toList_set]
    conv_lhs => rw [hj_decomp]
    rw [testBit_toNatLimbsList_aux _ _ hr_lt]
    simp only [List.length_set]
    by_cases hq : j / 64 < n.limbs.toList.length
    · rw [dite_eq_left hq, dite_eq_left hq, List.getElem_set]
      by_cases hqi : i / 64 = j / 64
      · rw [ite_eq_left hqi, UInt64.testBit_toNat_clearBit]
        have h_limb_eq : n.limbs[i / 64]'h_in_range = n.limbs.toList[j / 64]'hq := by
          rw [← Array.getElem_toList]; congr 1
        rw [h_limb_eq, decide_mod_eq_of_div_eq hqi]
      · rw [ite_eq_right hqi]
        have h_ij : i ≠ j := fun h => hqi (by rw [h])
        rw [decide_eq_false h_ij, Bool.not_false, Bool.and_true]
    · rw [dite_eq_right hq, dite_eq_right hq]
      have h_ij : i ≠ j := by
        intro h
        apply hq
        rw [← h, h_size_eq]
        exact h_in_range
      rw [decide_eq_false h_ij, Bool.not_false, Bool.and_true]
  · 
    simp only [clearBit, dite_eq_right h_in_range]
    push Not at h_in_range
    conv_lhs => rw [hj_decomp]
    show Nat.testBit (toNatLimbsList _) _ = _
    rw [testBit_toNatLimbsList_aux _ _ hr_lt]
    by_cases hq : j / 64 < n.limbs.toList.length
    · rw [dite_eq_left hq]
      have h_ij : i ≠ j := by
        intro h
        rw [← h, h_size_eq] at hq
        omega
      rw [decide_eq_false h_ij, Bool.not_false, Bool.and_true]
    · rw [dite_eq_right hq, Bool.false_and]

name: Azurite.AzNat.clearBit_ofNat
statement: theorem clearBit_ofNat (n i : Nat) : clearBit (ofNat n) i = ofNat (Nat.ldiff n (2 ^ i))
proof:
:= by
  apply toNat_injective
  rw [toNat_clearBit, toNat_ofNat, toNat_ofNat]

name: Azurite.AzNat.floorLogSearch_eq
statement:
theorem floorLogSearch_eq (b n : AzNat) : ∀ (lo hi : ℕ), lo < hi → b.toNat ^ lo ≤ n.toNat →
    n.toNat < b.toNat ^ hi → floorLogSearch b n lo hi = Nat.log b.toNat n.toNat
  | lo, hi, hlt, hlo, hhi => by
    unfold floorLogSearch
    simp only []
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact floorLogSearch_eq b n _ hi (by omega)
        (by rwa [le_iff_toNat_le, toNat_pow] at h2) hhi
    · exact floorLogSearch_eq b n lo _ (by omega) hlo
        (by rw [le_iff_toNat_le, toNat_pow] at h2; push Not at h2; exact h2)
    · have : hi = lo + 1
proof:
:= by omega
      subst this
      exact (Nat.log_eq_of_pow_le_of_lt_pow hlo hhi).symm
  termination_by lo hi => hi - lo

name: Azurite.AzNat.two_le_toNat_of_size
statement: theorem two_le_toNat_of_size (b : AzNat) (h : ¬ b.size ≤ 1) : 2 ≤ b.toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [← size_toNat] at h
  by_contra hlt
  exact h (Nat.size_le.mpr (by omega))

name: Azurite.AzNat.floorLogBase_eq
statement:
theorem floorLogBase_eq (b n : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    floorLogBase b n = some (Nat.log b.toNat n.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  unfold floorLogBase
  have hb' : ¬ b.size ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← size_toNat]
    intro h
    have := Nat.size_le.mp h
    omega
  rw [ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨hb', hn⟩)]
  simp only []
  split_ifs with hbr
  · obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := hbr
    rw [le_iff_toNat_le, toNat_pow] at hlo
    rw [lt_iff_toNat_lt, toNat_pow] at hhi
    rw [floorLogSearch_eq b n _ _ (by omega) hlo hhi]
  · have hpos : 0 < n.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero' hn)
    have hs : 0 < n.size := by rw [← size_toNat]; exact Nat.size_pos.mpr hpos
    rw [floorLogSearch_eq b n 0 n.size hs (by rw [pow_zero]; exact hpos)]
    calc n.toNat < 2 ^ n.toNat.size := Nat.lt_size_self _
      _ = 2 ^ n.size := by rw [size_toNat]
      _ ≤ b.toNat ^ n.size := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hb _

name: Azurite.AzNat.floorLogBase_zero_right
statement: @[simp] theorem floorLogBase_zero_right (b : AzNat) : floorLogBase b 0 = none
proof:
:= by
  unfold floorLogBase
  rw [ite_eq_left (Or.inr rfl)]

name: Azurite.AzNat.floorLogBase_of_le_one
statement: theorem floorLogBase_of_le_one (b n : AzNat) (hb : b.toNat ≤ 1) : floorLogBase b n = none
proof:
:= by
  unfold floorLogBase
  rw [ite_eq_left (Or.inl (by rw [← size_toNat]; exact Nat.size_le.mpr (by omega)))]

name: Azurite.AzNat.ceilingLogBase_eq
statement:
theorem ceilingLogBase_eq (b n : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ceilingLogBase b n = some (Nat.clog b.toNat n.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ceilingLogBase
  rw [floorLogBase_eq b n hb hn, Option.map_some]
  congr 1
  set e := Nat.log b.toNat n.toNat with he
  have hpos : 0 < n.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (toNat_ne_zero_of_ne_zero' hn)
  have hlo : b.toNat ^ e ≤ n.toNat := Nat.pow_log_le_self _ hpos.ne'
  have hhi : n.toNat < b.toNat ^ (e + 1) := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by omega) _
  split_ifs with hex
  · have := congrArg toNat hex
    rw [toNat_pow] at this
    rw [← this, Nat.clog_pow _ _ (by omega)]
  · have hne : b.toNat ^ e ≠ n.toNat := fun h => hex (toNat_injective (by rw [toNat_pow, h]))
    symm
    apply Nat.le_antisymm
    · exact Nat.clog_le_of_le_pow hhi.le
    · by_contra hlt
      push Not at hlt
      have hle : n.toNat ≤ b.toNat ^ e := (Nat.clog_le_iff_le_pow (by omega)).mp (by omega)
      exact hne (Nat.le_antisymm hlo hle)

name: Azurite.AzNat.checkedLogBase_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem checkedLogBase_eq_some_iff (b n : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hn : n ≠ 0) (e : ℕ) :
    checkedLogBase b n = some e ↔ n.toNat = b.toNat ^ e
proof:
:= by
  unfold checkedLogBase
  rw [floorLogBase_eq b n hb hn, Option.bind_some]
  constructor
  · intro h
    split_ifs at h with hex
    · simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
      have := congrArg toNat hex
      rw [toNat_pow, h] at this
      exact this.symm
  · intro h
    have hlog : Nat.log b.toNat n.toNat = e := by rw [h, Nat.log_pow (by omega)]
    rw [hlog, ite_eq_left (toNat_injective (by rw [toNat_pow, h]))]

name: Azurite.AzNat.checkedLogBase_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem checkedLogBase_eq_none_iff (b n : AzNat) (hb : 2 ≤ b.toNat) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    checkedLogBase b n = none ↔ ∀ e : ℕ, n.toNat ≠ b.toNat ^ e
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h e he
    have := (checkedLogBase_eq_some_iff b n hb hn e).mpr he
    rw [h] at this
    cases this
  · intro h
    rcases hc : checkedLogBase b n with _ | e
    · rfl
    · exact absurd ((checkedLogBase_eq_some_iff b n hb hn e).mp hc) (h e)

name: Azurite.AzNat.compare_Nat_lt_iff
statement: theorem compare_Nat_lt_iff (x y : ℕ) : Ord.compare x y = .lt ↔ x < y
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy x y with h | h | h
  · simp [compare_Nat_eq_of_lt _ _ h, h]
  · subst h; simp
  · simp [compare_Nat_eq_of_gt _ _ h, not_lt.mpr h.le]

name: Azurite.AzNat.compare_Nat_eq_iff
statement: theorem compare_Nat_eq_iff (x y : ℕ) : Ord.compare x y = .eq ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy x y with h | h | h
  · simp [compare_Nat_eq_of_lt _ _ h, h.ne]
  · subst h; simp
  · simp [compare_Nat_eq_of_gt _ _ h, h.ne']

name: Azurite.AzNat.compare_Nat_gt_iff
statement: theorem compare_Nat_gt_iff (x y : ℕ) : Ord.compare x y = .gt ↔ y < x
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy x y with h | h | h
  · simp [compare_Nat_eq_of_lt _ _ h, not_lt.mpr h.le]
  · subst h; simp
  · simp [compare_Nat_eq_of_gt _ _ h, h]

name: Azurite.AzNat.two_pow_size_sub_one_le
statement: theorem two_pow_size_sub_one_le {x : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) : 2 ^ (x.size - 1) ≤ x
proof:
:=
  Nat.lt_size.mp (by have := Nat.size_pos.mpr hx; omega)

name: Azurite.AzNat.compare_mul_of_pairs
proof:
:= by
  rcases h : Ord.compare x z with _ | _ | _
  · rw [h] at hxz
    replace hxz := hxz.symm
    rw [compare_Nat_lt_iff] at h hxz ⊢
    exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le h hxz.le hw
  · rw [h] at hxz
    replace hxz := hxz.symm
    rw [compare_Nat_eq_iff] at h hxz ⊢
    rw [h, hxz]
  · rw [h] at hxz
    replace hxz := hxz.symm
    rw [compare_Nat_gt_iff] at h hxz ⊢
    exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le h hxz.le (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) hxz)

name: Azurite.AzNat.compare_mul_left
statement:
private theorem compare_mul_left {z y w : ℕ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    Ord.compare (z * y) (z * w) = Ord.compare y w
proof:
:= by
  rcases h : Ord.compare y w with _ | _ | _
  · rw [compare_Nat_lt_iff] at h ⊢; exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h hz
  · rw [compare_Nat_eq_iff] at h ⊢; rw [h]
  · rw [compare_Nat_gt_iff] at h ⊢; exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h hz

name: Azurite.AzNat.compare_mul_right
statement:
private theorem compare_mul_right {y x z : ℕ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    Ord.compare (x * y) (z * y) = Ord.compare x z
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm x, mul_comm z, compare_mul_left hy]

name: Azurite.AzNat.mul_lt_mul_of_size
statement:
private theorem mul_lt_mul_of_size {x y z w : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y)
    (h : z.size + w.size + 2 ≤ x.size + y.size) : z * w < x * y
proof:
:= by
  have hxs := Nat.size_pos.mpr hx
  have hys := Nat.size_pos.mpr hy
  calc z * w < 2 ^ z.size * 2 ^ w.size :=
        Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_size_self z) (Nat.lt_size_self w).le
          (Nat.two_pow_pos _)
    _ = 2 ^ (z.size + w.size) := (pow_add _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (x.size - 1 + (y.size - 1)) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    _ = 2 ^ (x.size - 1) * 2 ^ (y.size - 1) := pow_add _ _ _
    _ ≤ x * y := Nat.mul_le_mul (two_pow_size_sub_one_le hx) (two_pow_size_sub_one_le hy)

name: Azurite.AzNat.compareProducts_eq
statement:
theorem compareProducts_eq (a b c d : AzNat) :
    compareProducts a b c d = Ord.compare (a.toNat * b.toNat) (c.toNat * d.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  unfold compareProducts
  simp only [eq_zero_iff_toNat, compare_eq_compare_toNat, ← size_toNat, toNat_mul, beq_iff_eq]
  set x := a.toNat
  set y := b.toNat
  set z := c.toNat
  set w := d.toNat
  split_ifs with hab hcd hcd' hs hs2 hp hp2 hp3 hq hq2 hq3
  · 
    symm; rw [compare_Nat_eq_iff]
    rcases hab with h | h <;> rcases hcd with h' | h' <;> simp [h, h']
  · symm; rw [compare_Nat_lt_iff]
    have : x * y = 0 := by rcases hab with h | h <;> simp [h]
    rw [this]
    rw [not_or] at hcd
    exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hcd.1) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hcd.2)
  · symm; rw [compare_Nat_gt_iff]
    have : z * w = 0 := by rcases hcd' with h | h <;> simp [h]
    rw [this]
    rw [not_or] at hab
    exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hab.1) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hab.2)
  all_goals rw [not_or] at hab hcd'
  all_goals have hx : 0 < x := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hab.1
  all_goals have hy : 0 < y := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hab.2
  all_goals have hz : 0 < z := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hcd'.1
  all_goals have hw : 0 < w := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hcd'.2
  · symm; rw [compare_Nat_gt_iff]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_size hx hy hs
  · symm; rw [compare_Nat_lt_iff]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_size hz hw hs2
  · exact (compare_mul_of_pairs hw hp).symm
  · rw [compare_Nat_eq_iff] at hp2
    rw [hp2, compare_mul_left hz]
  · rw [compare_Nat_eq_iff] at hp3
    rw [hp3, compare_mul_right hw]
  · rw [mul_comm z w]
    exact (compare_mul_of_pairs hz hq).symm
  · rw [compare_Nat_eq_iff] at hq2
    rw [hq2, mul_comm z w, compare_mul_left hw]
  · rw [compare_Nat_eq_iff] at hq3
    rw [hq3, mul_comm z w, compare_mul_right hz]

name: Azurite.AzNat.karatsubaSquareLimbs_size

name: Azurite.AzNat.propagateCarry_size
statement:
theorem propagateCarry_size (acc : Array UInt64) (pos : Nat) (carry : Bool) :
    (propagateCarry acc pos carry).size = acc.size
proof:
:= by
  induction h_sub : acc.size - pos generalizing acc pos carry with
  | zero =>
    have h_ge : acc.size ≤ pos := by omega
    cases carry with
    | false => rw [propagateCarry]
    | true =>
      rw [propagateCarry]; simp [Nat.not_lt.mpr h_ge]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases carry with
    | false => rw [propagateCarry]
    | true =>
      rw [propagateCarry]
      have h_lt : pos < acc.size := by omega
      simp only [h_lt, ↓reduceDIte]
      rw [ih]
      · rw [Array.size_set]
      · rw [Array.size_set]; omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.doubleLimbs.go_size
statement:
theorem doubleLimbs.go_size (acc : Array UInt64) (k : Nat) (carry : Bool) :
    (doubleLimbs.go acc k carry).size = acc.size
proof:
:= by
  induction h_sub : acc.size - k generalizing acc k carry with
  | zero =>
    have h_ge : acc.size ≤ k := by omega
    rw [doubleLimbs.go]; simp [Nat.not_lt.mpr h_ge]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h_lt : k < acc.size := by omega
    rw [doubleLimbs.go]
    simp only [h_lt, ↓reduceDIte]
    rw [ih]
    · rw [Array.size_set]
    · rw [Array.size_set]; omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.doubleLimbs_size
statement:

name: Azurite.AzNat.addDiagonalLimbs.go_size
statement:
theorem addDiagonalLimbs.go_size (a : Array UInt64) (lo len : Nat)
    (acc : Array UInt64) (i : Nat)
    (hA : lo + len ≤ a.size) (hAcc : 2 * len ≤ acc.size) :
    (addDiagonalLimbs.go a lo len acc i hA hAcc).size = acc.size
proof:
:= by
  induction h_sub : len - i generalizing acc i with
  | zero =>
    have h_ge : len ≤ i := by omega
    rw [addDiagonalLimbs.go]; simp [Nat.not_lt.mpr h_ge]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h_lt : i < len := by omega
    have h_sub' : len - (i + 1) = n := by omega
    rw [addDiagonalLimbs.go]
    simp only [h_lt, ↓reduceDIte]
    rw [ih _ _ _ h_sub']
    rw [propagateCarry_size, Array.size_set, Array.size_set]

name: Azurite.AzNat.schoolbookSquareLimbs.offDiag.go_size
statement:
theorem schoolbookSquareLimbs.offDiag.go_size (a : Array UInt64) (lo len : Nat)
    (acc : Array UInt64) (i : Nat)
    (hA : lo + len ≤ a.size) (hAcc : 2 * len ≤ acc.size) :
    (schoolbookSquareLimbs.offDiag.go a lo len acc i hA hAcc).size = acc.size
proof:
:= by
  induction h_sub : len - i generalizing acc i with
  | zero =>
    have h_ge : len ≤ i := by omega
    rw [schoolbookSquareLimbs.offDiag.go]
    have h_neg : ¬ i + 1 < len := by omega
    simp [h_neg]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [schoolbookSquareLimbs.offDiag.go]
    by_cases h_lt : i + 1 < len
    · have h_sub' : len - (i + 1) = n := by omega
      simp only [h_lt, ↓reduceDIte]
      rw [ih _ _ _ h_sub']
      rw [Array.size_set, mulAddLimbs_size]
    · simp [h_lt]

name: Azurite.AzNat.schoolbookSquareLimbs.offDiag.go2_size
statement:
theorem schoolbookSquareLimbs.offDiag.go2_size (a : Array UInt64) (lo len : Nat)
    (acc : Array UInt64) (i : Nat)

    (schoolbookSquareLimbs.offDiag.go2 a lo len acc i hA hAcc).size = acc.size
proof:

  induction h_sub : len - i using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing acc i with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [schoolbookSquareLimbs.offDiag.go2]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [ih (len - (i + 2)) (by omega) _ _ _ rfl, Array.size_set, Array.size_set,
        mulAdd2Limbs.go_size, Array.size_set]
    · exact schoolbookSquareLimbs.offDiag.go_size _ _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Azurite.AzNat.divModWith_toNat
statement:
theorem divModWith_toNat (threshold : Nat) (U V : AzNat) :
    (divModWith threshold U V).1.toNat * V.toNat + (divModWith threshold U V).2.toNat = U.toNat
    ∧ (V.toNat ≠ 0 → (divModWith threshold U V).2.toNat < V.toNat)
proof:
:= by
  unfold divModWith
  split_ifs with h
  · exact divModNewton_toNat reciprocalBaseThreshold newtonFFTThreshold shortProductBase (by decide)
      (by decide) U V
  · exact divModClassic_toNat threshold U V

name: Azurite.AzNat.useNewtonDiv_of_size_zero

name: Azurite.AzNat.divMod_toNat
statement:
theorem divMod_toNat (U V : AzNat) :
    (divMod U V).1.toNat * V.toNat + (divMod U V).2.toNat = U.toNat
    ∧ (V.toNat ≠ 0 → (divMod U V).2.toNat < V.toNat)
proof:
:=
  divModWith_toNat divDispatchThreshold U V

name: Azurite.AzNat.divModWith_eq_divMod
statement:
theorem divModWith_eq_divMod (threshold : Nat) (U V : AzNat) :
    divModWith threshold U V = divMod U V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := divModWith_toNat threshold U V
  obtain ⟨h1', h2'⟩ := divMod_toNat U V
  by_cases hV : V.toNat = 0
  · have h_size : V.limbs.size = 0 := (toNat_eq_zero_iff V).mp hV
    unfold divMod
    rw [divModWith_of_size_zero _ _ _ h_size, divModWith_of_size_zero _ _ _ h_size]
  · have hpos : 0 < V.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hV
    have hdiv : ∀ Q R : AzNat, Q.toNat * V.toNat + R.toNat = U.toNat → R.toNat < V.toNat →
        Q.toNat = U.toNat / V.toNat ∧ R.toNat = U.toNat % V.toNat := by
      intro Q R h hlt
      have h_eq : U.toNat = R.toNat + Q.toNat * V.toNat := by omega
      constructor
      · rw [h_eq, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ hpos, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hlt, Nat.zero_add]
      · rw [h_eq, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt]
    obtain ⟨hq1, hr1⟩ := hdiv _ _ h1 (h2 hV)
    obtain ⟨hq2, hr2⟩ := hdiv _ _ h1' (h2' hV)
    exact Prod.ext (toNat_injective (hq1.trans hq2.symm)) (toNat_injective (hr1.trans hr2.symm))

name: Azurite.AzNat.divMod_of_toNat_zero
statement:
private lemma divMod_of_toNat_zero (U V : AzNat) (hV : V.toNat = 0) :
    divMod U V = (0, U)
proof:
:= by
  have h_size : V.limbs.size = 0 := (toNat_eq_zero_iff V).mp hV
  unfold divMod
  exact divModWith_of_size_zero _ _ _ h_size

theorem divWith_eq_divModWith_fst (threshold : Nat) (U V : AzNat) :

name: Azurite.AzNat.mod_eq_divMod_snd

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_div
statement: @[simp] theorem toNat_div (U V : AzNat) : (U / V).toNat = U.toNat / V.toNat
proof:
:= by
  show (div U V).toNat = _
  rw [div_eq_divMod_fst]
  by_cases hV : V.toNat = 0
  · rw [divMod_of_toNat_zero U V hV, hV, Nat.div_zero, toNat_zero]
  · obtain ⟨h_id, h_lt⟩ := divMod_toNat U V
    have h_lt' := h_lt hV
    have h_pos : 0 < V.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hV
    have h_eq : U.toNat
        = (divMod U V).2.toNat + (divMod U V).1.toNat * V.toNat := by omega
    rw [h_eq, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ h_pos, Nat.div_eq_of_lt h_lt', Nat.zero_add]

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_mod
statement: @[simp] theorem toNat_mod (U V : AzNat) : (U % V).toNat = U.toNat % V.toNat
proof:
:= by
  show (mod U V).toNat = _
  rw [mod_eq_divMod_snd]
  by_cases hV : V.toNat = 0
  · rw [divMod_of_toNat_zero U V hV, hV, Nat.mod_zero]
  · obtain ⟨h_id, h_lt⟩ := divMod_toNat U V
    have h_lt' := h_lt hV
    have h_pos : 0 < V.toNat := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hV
    have h_eq : U.toNat
        = (divMod U V).2.toNat + (divMod U V).1.toNat * V.toNat := by omega
    rw [h_eq, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h_lt']

name: Azurite.AzNat.ofNat_div
statement: theorem ofNat_div (m n : Nat) : ofNat (m / n) = ofNat m / ofNat n
