proof: := rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.toomCook4_assemble_toNat
statement:
theorem toomCook4_assemble_toNat (k : Nat) (a0 a1 a2 a3 b0 b1 b2 b3 : AzNat)
    (v0 v1 vm1 v2 vm2 vh vinf : AzInt)
    (hv0 : v0.toInt = (hornerInt64 0 [a0.toAzInt, a1.toAzInt, a2.toAzInt, a3.toAzInt]).toInt
      * (hornerInt64 0 [b0.toAzInt, b1.toAzInt, b2.toAzInt, b3.toAzInt]).toInt)
    (hv1 : v1.toInt = (hornerInt64 1 [a0.toAzInt, a1.toAzInt, a2.toAzInt, a3.toAzInt]).toInt
      * (hornerInt64 1 [b0.toAzInt, b1.toAzInt, b2.toAzInt, b3.toAzInt]).toInt)
    (hvm1 : vm1.toInt = (hornerInt64 (-1) [a0.toAzInt, a1.toAzInt, a2.toAzInt, a3.toAzInt]).toInt
      * (hornerInt64 (-1) [b0.toAzInt, b1.toAzInt, b2.toAzInt, b3.toAzInt]).toInt)
    (hv2 : v2.toInt = (hornerInt64 2 [a0.toAzInt, a1.toAzInt, a2.toAzInt, a3.toAzInt]).toInt
      * (hornerInt64 2 [b0.toAzInt, b1.toAzInt, b2.toAzInt, b3.toAzInt]).toInt)
    (hvm2 : vm2.toInt = (hornerInt64 (-2) [a0.toAzInt, a1.toAzInt, a2.toAzInt, a3.toAzInt]).toInt
      * (hornerInt64 (-2) [b0.toAzInt, b1.toAzInt, b2.toAzInt, b3.toAzInt]).toInt)
    (hvh : vh.toInt = (hornerInt64 2 [a3.toAzInt, a2.toAzInt, a1.toAzInt, a0.toAzInt]).toInt
      * (hornerInt64 2 [b3.toAzInt, b2.toAzInt, b1.toAzInt, b0.toAzInt]).toInt)
    (hvinf : vinf.toInt = (hornerInt64 0 [a3.toAzInt, a2.toAzInt, a1.toAzInt, a0.toAzInt]).toInt
      * (hornerInt64 0 [b3.toAzInt, b2.toAzInt, b1.toAzInt, b0.toAzInt]).toInt) :
    (assemble k ((toomCook4Interpolate v0 v1 vm1 v2 vm2 vh vinf).map AzInt.abs)).toNat
      = polyEvalNat (2 ^ (64 * k)) [a0.toNat, a1.toNat, a2.toNat, a3.toNat]
        * polyEvalNat (2 ^ (64 * k)) [b0.toNat, b1.toNat, b2.toNat, b3.toNat]
proof:
:= by
  
  have hev : ∀ (c : Int64) (x0 x1 x2 x3 : AzNat),
      (hornerInt64 c [x0.toAzInt, x1.toAzInt, x2.toAzInt, x3.toAzInt]).toInt
        = (((x3.toNat : Int) * c.toInt + (x2.toNat : Int)) * c.toInt + (x1.toNat : Int)) * c.toInt
          + (x0.toNat : Int) := by
    intro c x0 x1 x2 x3
    simp only [toInt_hornerInt64, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, polyEvalInt_cons, polyEvalInt_nil,
      Azurite.AzNat.toInt_toAzInt, zero_mul, zero_add]
  rw [hev, hev] at hv0 hv1 hvm1 hv2 hvm2 hvh hvinf
  
  have hinterp := toomCook4Interpolate_toInt v0 v1 vm1 v2 vm2 vh vinf
    ((a0.toNat : Int) * (b0.toNat : Int)) ((a0.toNat : Int) * (b1.toNat : Int) + (a1.toNat : Int) * (b0.toNat : Int)) ((a0.toNat : Int) * (b2.toNat : Int) + (a1.toNat : Int) * (b1.toNat : Int) + (a2.toNat : Int) * (b0.toNat : Int)) ((a0.toNat : Int) * (b3.toNat : Int) + (a1.toNat : Int) * (b2.toNat : Int) + (a2.toNat : Int) * (b1.toNat : Int) + (a3.toNat : Int) * (b0.toNat : Int)) ((a1.toNat : Int) * (b3.toNat : Int) + (a2.toNat : Int) * (b2.toNat : Int) + (a3.toNat : Int) * (b1.toNat : Int)) ((a2.toNat : Int) * (b3.toNat : Int) + (a3.toNat : Int) * (b2.toNat : Int)) ((a3.toNat : Int) * (b3.toNat : Int))
    (by rw [hv0, int64_toInt_zero]; ring)
    (by rw [hv1, int64_toInt_one]; ring)
    (by rw [hvm1, int64_toInt_neg_one]; ring)
    (by rw [hv2, int64_toInt_two]; ring)
    (by rw [hvm2, int64_toInt_neg_two]; ring)
    (by rw [hvh, int64_toInt_two]; ring)
    (by rw [hvinf, int64_toInt_zero]; ring)
  obtain ⟨e0, e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6, hcs⟩ : ∃ e0 e1 e2 e3 e4 e5 e6 : AzInt,
      toomCook4Interpolate v0 v1 vm1 v2 vm2 vh vinf = [e0, e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6] :=
    ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, rfl⟩
  rw [hcs] at hinterp ⊢
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.cons.injEq, and_true] at hinterp
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := hinterp
  
  have hE0 : (e0.abs.toNat : Int) = (a0.toNat : Int) * (b0.toNat : Int) := by
    rw [← AzInt.natAbs_toInt, h0, Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  have hE1 : (e1.abs.toNat : Int) = (a0.toNat : Int) * (b1.toNat : Int) + (a1.toNat : Int) * (b0.toNat : Int) := by
    rw [← AzInt.natAbs_toInt, h1, Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  have hE2 : (e2.abs.toNat : Int) = (a0.toNat : Int) * (b2.toNat : Int) + (a1.toNat : Int) * (b1.toNat : Int) + (a2.toNat : Int) * (b0.toNat : Int) := by
    rw [← AzInt.natAbs_toInt, h2, Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  have hE3 : (e3.abs.toNat : Int) = (a0.toNat : Int) * (b3.toNat : Int) + (a1.toNat : Int) * (b2.toNat : Int) + (a2.toNat : Int) * (b1.toNat : Int) + (a3.toNat : Int) * (b0.toNat : Int) := by
    rw [← AzInt.natAbs_toInt, h3, Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  have hE4 : (e4.abs.toNat : Int) = (a1.toNat : Int) * (b3.toNat : Int) + (a2.toNat : Int) * (b2.toNat : Int) + (a3.toNat : Int) * (b1.toNat : Int) := by
    rw [← AzInt.natAbs_toInt, h4, Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  have hE5 : (e5.abs.toNat : Int) = (a2.toNat : Int) * (b3.toNat : Int) + (a3.toNat : Int) * (b2.toNat : Int) := by
    rw [← AzInt.natAbs_toInt, h5, Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  have hE6 : (e6.abs.toNat : Int) = (a3.toNat : Int) * (b3.toNat : Int) := by
    rw [← AzInt.natAbs_toInt, h6, Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  
  rw [toNat_assemble]
  apply Int.natCast_inj.mp
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, polyEvalInt_natCast, polyEvalInt_natCast, polyEvalInt_natCast]
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, polyEvalInt_cons, polyEvalInt_nil]
  rw [hE0, hE1, hE2, hE3, hE4, hE5, hE6]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Azurite.AzNat.toomCook4_eval_abs_lt
statement:
theorem toomCook4_eval_abs_lt (k : Nat) (x0 x1 x2 x3 : AzNat)
    (h0 : x0.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * k)) (h1 : x1.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * k))
    (h2 : x2.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * k)) (h3 : x3.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * k))
    (c : Int64) (hc : c.toInt.natAbs ≤ 2) :
    (hornerInt64 c [x0.toAzInt, x1.toAzInt, x2.toAzInt, x3.toAzInt]).abs.toNat
      < 2 ^ (64 * (k + 1))
proof:
:=
  hornerInt64_four_abs_lt k c hc _ _ _ _ h0 h1 h2 h3

name: Azurite.AzNat.toomCook4_core_toNat
statement:
theorem toomCook4_core_toNat (k : Nat)
    (mulK1 : (x y : Array UInt64) → 0 + (k + 1) ≤ x.size → 0 + (k + 1) ≤ y.size → Array UInt64)
    (hmul : ∀ x y hx hy,
      toNatLimbsList (mulK1 x y hx hy).toList = sliceVal x 0 (k + 1) * sliceVal y 0 (k + 1))
    (a0 a1 a2 a3 b0 b1 b2 b3 : AzNat)
    (ha0 : a0.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * k)) (ha1 : a1.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * k))
    (ha2 : a2.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * k)) (ha3 : a3.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * k))
    (hb0 : b0.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * k)) (hb1 : b1.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * k))
    (hb2 : b2.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * k)) (hb3 : b3.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * k)) :
    let bsA
proof:
:= [a0.toAzInt, a1.toAzInt, a2.toAzInt, a3.toAzInt]
    let bsB := [b0.toAzInt, b1.toAzInt, b2.toAzInt, b3.toAzInt]
    let v0 := signedMulWith (k + 1) mulK1 (hornerInt64 0 bsA) (hornerInt64 0 bsB)
    let v1 := signedMulWith (k + 1) mulK1 (hornerInt64 1 bsA) (hornerInt64 1 bsB)
    let vm1 := signedMulWith (k + 1) mulK1 (hornerInt64 (-1) bsA) (hornerInt64 (-1) bsB)
    let v2 := signedMulWith (k + 1) mulK1 (hornerInt64 2 bsA) (hornerInt64 2 bsB)
    let vm2 := signedMulWith (k + 1) mulK1 (hornerInt64 (-2) bsA) (hornerInt64 (-2) bsB)
    let vh := signedMulWith (k + 1) mulK1 (hornerInt64 2 bsA.reverse) (hornerInt64 2 bsB.reverse)
    let vinf := signedMulWith (k + 1) mulK1 (hornerInt64 0 bsA.reverse) (hornerInt64 0 bsB.reverse)
    (assemble k ((toomCook4Interpolate v0 v1 vm1 v2 vm2 vh vinf).map AzInt.abs)).toNat
      = polyEvalNat (2 ^ (64 * k)) [a0.toNat, a1.toNat, a2.toNat, a3.toNat]
        * polyEvalNat (2 ^ (64 * k)) [b0.toNat, b1.toNat, b2.toNat, b3.toNat] := by
  intro bsA bsB v0 v1 vm1 v2 vm2 vh vinf
  have hA : ∀ (c : Int64), c.toInt.natAbs ≤ 2 →
      (hornerInt64 c [a0.toAzInt, a1.toAzInt, a2.toAzInt, a3.toAzInt]).abs.toNat
        < 2 ^ (64 * (k + 1)) :=
    fun c hc => toomCook4_eval_abs_lt k _ _ _ _ ha0 ha1 ha2 ha3 c hc
  have hB : ∀ (c : Int64), c.toInt.natAbs ≤ 2 →
      (hornerInt64 c [b0.toAzInt, b1.toAzInt, b2.toAzInt, b3.toAzInt]).abs.toNat
        < 2 ^ (64 * (k + 1)) :=
    fun c hc => toomCook4_eval_abs_lt k _ _ _ _ hb0 hb1 hb2 hb3 c hc
  have hA' : ∀ (c : Int64), c.toInt.natAbs ≤ 2 →
      (hornerInt64 c [a3.toAzInt, a2.toAzInt, a1.toAzInt, a0.toAzInt]).abs.toNat
        < 2 ^ (64 * (k + 1)) :=
    fun c hc => toomCook4_eval_abs_lt k _ _ _ _ ha3 ha2 ha1 ha0 c hc
  have hB' : ∀ (c : Int64), c.toInt.natAbs ≤ 2 →
      (hornerInt64 c [b3.toAzInt, b2.toAzInt, b1.toAzInt, b0.toAzInt]).abs.toNat
        < 2 ^ (64 * (k + 1)) :=
    fun c hc => toomCook4_eval_abs_lt k _ _ _ _ hb3 hb2 hb1 hb0 c hc
  have hrevA : bsA.reverse = [a3.toAzInt, a2.toAzInt, a1.toAzInt, a0.toAzInt] := rfl
  have hrevB : bsB.reverse = [b3.toAzInt, b2.toAzInt, b1.toAzInt, b0.toAzInt] := rfl
  have hv0 : v0.toInt = (hornerInt64 0 bsA).toInt * (hornerInt64 0 bsB).toInt :=
    toInt_signedMulWith _ _ hmul _ _ (hA 0 int64_natAbs_le_two_zero) (hB 0 int64_natAbs_le_two_zero)
  have hv1 : v1.toInt = (hornerInt64 1 bsA).toInt * (hornerInt64 1 bsB).toInt :=
    toInt_signedMulWith _ _ hmul _ _ (hA 1 int64_natAbs_le_two_one) (hB 1 int64_natAbs_le_two_one)
  have hvm1 : vm1.toInt = (hornerInt64 (-1) bsA).toInt * (hornerInt64 (-1) bsB).toInt :=
    toInt_signedMulWith _ _ hmul _ _ (hA (-1) int64_natAbs_le_two_neg_one)
      (hB (-1) int64_natAbs_le_two_neg_one)
  have hv2 : v2.toInt = (hornerInt64 2 bsA).toInt * (hornerInt64 2 bsB).toInt :=
    toInt_signedMulWith _ _ hmul _ _ (hA 2 int64_natAbs_le_two_two) (hB 2 int64_natAbs_le_two_two)
  have hvm2 : vm2.toInt = (hornerInt64 (-2) bsA).toInt * (hornerInt64 (-2) bsB).toInt :=
    toInt_signedMulWith _ _ hmul _ _ (hA (-2) int64_natAbs_le_two_neg_two)
      (hB (-2) int64_natAbs_le_two_neg_two)
  have hvh : vh.toInt = (hornerInt64 2 bsA.reverse).toInt * (hornerInt64 2 bsB.reverse).toInt := by
    rw [hrevA, hrevB] at *
    exact toInt_signedMulWith _ _ hmul _ _ (hA' 2 int64_natAbs_le_two_two)
      (hB' 2 int64_natAbs_le_two_two)
  have hvinf : vinf.toInt
      = (hornerInt64 0 bsA.reverse).toInt * (hornerInt64 0 bsB.reverse).toInt := by
    rw [hrevA, hrevB] at *
    exact toInt_signedMulWith _ _ hmul _ _ (hA' 0 int64_natAbs_le_two_zero)
      (hB' 0 int64_natAbs_le_two_zero)
  rw [hrevA, hrevB] at hvh hvinf
  exact toomCook4_assemble_toNat k a0 a1 a2 a3 b0 b1 b2 b3 v0 v1 vm1 v2 vm2 vh vinf
    hv0 hv1 hvm1 hv2 hvm2 hvh hvinf

name: Azurite.AzNat.polyEvalNat_blocks_four
statement:
theorem polyEvalNat_blocks_four (a : Array UInt64) (lo len k : Nat) (hr : len ≤ 4 * k)
    (hA : lo + len ≤ a.size) :
    polyEvalNat (2 ^ (64 * k)) [(block a lo len k 0).toNat, (block a lo len k 1).toNat,
      (block a lo len k 2).toNat, (block a lo len k 3).toNat] = sliceVal a lo len
proof:
:= by
  apply Int.natCast_inj.mp
  rw [polyEvalInt_natCast, sliceVal_eq_polyEval_blocks a lo len k 4 (by omega) hA, blocks_four]
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, Azurite.AzNat.toInt_toAzInt]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: Azurite.AzNat.toomCook4MulLimbsRec_toNat
statement:
theorem toomCook4MulLimbsRec_toNat (toom4Threshold toom3Threshold karaThreshold : Nat) :
    ∀ (len : Nat) (a b : Array UInt64) (loA loB : Nat)
      (hA : loA + len ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + len ≤ b.size),
    toNatLimbsList (toomCook4MulLimbsRec toom4Threshold toom3Threshold karaThreshold
        a b loA loB len hA hB).val.toList
      = sliceVal a loA len * sliceVal b loB len
proof:
:= by
  intro len
  induction len using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ len ih =>
    intro a b loA loB hA hB
    unfold toomCook4MulLimbsRec
    by_cases h_base : len < toom4Threshold ∨ len < 4
    · simp only [h_base, ↓reduceDIte]
      exact toomCook3MulLimbs_toNat toom3Threshold karaThreshold a b loA loB len hA hB
    · simp only [h_base, ↓reduceDIte]
      have hk1_lt : (len + 3) / 4 + 1 < len := by omega
      have hlen_le : len ≤ 4 * ((len + 3) / 4) := by omega
      
      have hmul : ∀ (x y : Array UInt64) (hx : 0 + ((len + 3) / 4 + 1) ≤ x.size)
          (hy : 0 + ((len + 3) / 4 + 1) ≤ y.size),
          toNatLimbsList (toomCook4MulLimbsRec toom4Threshold toom3Threshold karaThreshold
              x y 0 0 ((len + 3) / 4 + 1) hx hy).1.toList
            = sliceVal x 0 ((len + 3) / 4 + 1) * sliceVal y 0 ((len + 3) / 4 + 1) :=
        fun x y hx hy => ih _ hk1_lt x y 0 0 hx hy
      have hcore := toomCook4_core_toNat ((len + 3) / 4)
        (fun x y hx hy => (toomCook4MulLimbsRec toom4Threshold toom3Threshold karaThreshold
          x y 0 0 ((len + 3) / 4 + 1) hx hy).1) hmul
        (block a loA len _ 0) (block a loA len _ 1) (block a loA len _ 2) (block a loA len _ 3)
        (block b loB len _ 0) (block b loB len _ 1) (block b loB len _ 2) (block b loB len _ 3)
        (toNat_block_lt _ _ _ _ _) (toNat_block_lt _ _ _ _ _) (toNat_block_lt _ _ _ _ _)
        (toNat_block_lt _ _ _ _ _) (toNat_block_lt _ _ _ _ _) (toNat_block_lt _ _ _ _ _)
        (toNat_block_lt _ _ _ _ _) (toNat_block_lt _ _ _ _ _)
      rw [polyEvalNat_blocks_four a loA len _ hlen_le hA,
        polyEvalNat_blocks_four b loB len _ hlen_le hB] at hcore
      rw [blocks_four, blocks_four, truncatePad_toNat]
      · exact hcore
      · change AzNat.toNat _ < _
        rw [hcore, show 64 * (2 * len) = 64 * len + 64 * len by ring, pow_add]
        exact Nat.mul_lt_mul'' (sliceVal_lt_pow _ _ _) (sliceVal_lt_pow _ _ _)

name: Azurite.AzNat.toomCook4MulLimbs_toNat
statement:
theorem toomCook4MulLimbs_toNat (toom4Threshold toom3Threshold karaThreshold : Nat)
    (a b : Array UInt64) (loA loB len : Nat)
    (hA : loA + len ≤ a.size) (hB : loB + len ≤ b.size) :
    toNatLimbsList (toomCook4MulLimbs toom4Threshold toom3Threshold karaThreshold
        a b loA loB len hA hB).toList
      = sliceVal a loA len * sliceVal b loB len
proof:
:=
  toomCook4MulLimbsRec_toNat toom4Threshold toom3Threshold karaThreshold len a b loA loB hA hB

name: Azurite.AzNat.toNat_mulToomCook4
statement:
theorem toNat_mulToomCook4 (toom4Threshold toom3Threshold karaThreshold : Nat) (a b : AzNat) :
    (mulToomCook4 toom4Threshold toom3Threshold karaThreshold a b).toNat = a.toNat * b.toNat
proof:
:= by
  unfold mulToomCook4
  rw [toNat_ofLimbs, toomCook4MulLimbs_toNat, sliceVal_self _ _ (truncatePad_size _ _),
    sliceVal_self _ _ (truncatePad_size _ _), truncatePad_toNat, truncatePad_toNat]
  · rfl
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (toNat_lt_pow b) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num)
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_max_right _ _)))
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (toNat_lt_pow a) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num)
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.le_max_left _ _)))

name: Azurite.AzNat.mulLow_step_mod
statement:
theorem mulLow_step_mod {b n l k A B C2 C3 : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hlk : l ≤ k) (hn : n = k + l)
    (hC2 : C2 % b ^ l = A / b ^ k * (B % b ^ l) % b ^ l)
    (hC3 : C3 % b ^ l = A % b ^ l * (B / b ^ k) % b ^ l) :
    (A % b ^ k * (B % b ^ k) % b ^ n + (C2 + C3) * b ^ k) % b ^ n = A * B % b ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hK0 : 0 < b ^ k := pow_pos hb k
  have hL0 : 0 < b ^ l := pow_pos hb l
  have hN : b ^ n = b ^ k * b ^ l := by rw [hn, pow_add]
  have hLK : b ^ l ∣ b ^ k := pow_dvd_pow b hlk
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hLK
  
  have hA := Nat.div_add_mod A (b ^ k)
  have hB := Nat.div_add_mod B (b ^ k)
  have hAB : A * B = b ^ k * (A / b ^ k) * (b ^ k * (B / b ^ k))
      + b ^ k * (A / b ^ k * (B % b ^ k) + A % b ^ k * (B / b ^ k)) + A % b ^ k * (B % b ^ k) := by
    calc A * B = (b ^ k * (A / b ^ k) + A % b ^ k) * (b ^ k * (B / b ^ k) + B % b ^ k) := by
          rw [hA, hB]
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hsq : b ^ n ∣ b ^ k * (A / b ^ k) * (b ^ k * (B / b ^ k)) := by
    have h1 : b ^ n ∣ b ^ k * b ^ k := by rw [hN]; exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left _ ⟨m, hm⟩
    exact h1.trans ⟨A / b ^ k * (B / b ^ k), by ring⟩
  
  have hBK : B % b ^ k % b ^ l = B % b ^ l := Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd B ⟨m, hm⟩
  have hAK : A % b ^ k % b ^ l = A % b ^ l := Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd A ⟨m, hm⟩
  have h2 : A / b ^ k * (B % b ^ k) ≡ C2 [MOD b ^ l] := by
    have : A / b ^ k * (B % b ^ k) ≡ A / b ^ k * (B % b ^ l) [MOD b ^ l] :=
      Nat.ModEq.mul_left _ (by unfold Nat.ModEq; rw [hBK]; exact Nat.mod_mod _ _ |>.symm ▸ rfl)
    exact this.trans (by unfold Nat.ModEq at *; rw [hC2])
  have h3 : A % b ^ k * (B / b ^ k) ≡ C3 [MOD b ^ l] := by
    have : A % b ^ k * (B / b ^ k) ≡ A % b ^ l * (B / b ^ k) [MOD b ^ l] :=
      Nat.ModEq.mul_right _ (by unfold Nat.ModEq; rw [hAK]; exact Nat.mod_mod _ _ |>.symm ▸ rfl)
    exact this.trans (by unfold Nat.ModEq at *; rw [hC3])
  have hcross : b ^ k * (A / b ^ k * (B % b ^ k) + A % b ^ k * (B / b ^ k))
      ≡ (C2 + C3) * b ^ k [MOD b ^ n] := by
    rw [hN, mul_comm (C2 + C3)]
    exact Nat.ModEq.mul_left' _ (h2.add h3)
  have hfull : A * B ≡ A % b ^ k * (B % b ^ k) + (C2 + C3) * b ^ k [MOD b ^ n] := by
    rw [hAB]
    have h0 : b ^ k * (A / b ^ k) * (b ^ k * (B / b ^ k)) ≡ 0 [MOD b ^ n] :=
      (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).mpr hsq
    have := (h0.add hcross).add (Nat.ModEq.refl (A % b ^ k * (B % b ^ k)))
    rw [zero_add] at this
    exact this.trans (by rw [add_comm])
  unfold Nat.ModEq at hfull
  rw [hfull, Nat.mod_add_mod]

name: Azurite.AzNat.mulLowFuel_toNat
statement:
theorem mulLowFuel_toNat (n₀ : Nat) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (A B : AzNat) (n : Nat),
      (mulLowFuel n₀ fuel A B n).toNat = A.toNat * B.toNat % 2 ^ (64 * n)
  | 0, A, B, n => by simp only [mulLowFuel]; rw [toNat_modPow2, toNat_mul]
  | fuel + 1, A, B, n => by
    by_cases hn : n ≤ n₀
    · simp only [mulLowFuel, hn, ↓reduceIte]; rw [toNat_modPow2, toNat_mul]
    · simp only [mulLowFuel, hn, ↓reduceIte]
      set l
proof:
:= shortSplit n with hl
      set k := n - l with hk
      have hl10 := shortSplit_le n
      have hlk : l ≤ k := by omega
      have hnkl : n = k + l := by omega
      have h2 := mulLowFuel_toNat n₀ fuel (A >>> (64 * k)) (B.modPow2 (64 * l)) l
      have h3 := mulLowFuel_toNat n₀ fuel (A.modPow2 (64 * l)) (B >>> (64 * k)) l
      rw [toNat_shr_pow, toNat_modPow2] at h2 h3
      rw [toNat_modPow2, toNat_add, toNat_shl_pow, toNat_modPow2, toNat_mul, toNat_modPow2,
        toNat_modPow2, toNat_add]
      simp only [two_pow_64_mul] at h2 h3 ⊢
      exact mulLow_step_mod (b := 2 ^ 64) (by norm_num) hlk hnkl
        (by rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by rw [h2]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (pow_pos (by norm_num) _)), h2])
        (by rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by rw [h3]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (pow_pos (by norm_num) _)), h3])

name: Azurite.AzNat.mulLow_toNat
statement:
theorem mulLow_toNat (n₀ : Nat) (A B : AzNat) (n : Nat) :
    (mulLow n₀ A B n).toNat = A.toNat * B.toNat % 2 ^ (64 * n)
proof:
:=
  mulLowFuel_toNat n₀ n A B n

name: Azurite.AzNat.mulHigh_step_bounds
statement:
theorem mulHigh_step_bounds {b n l k A B C1 C2 C3 : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hl1 : 1 ≤ l)
    (hln : 10 * l ≤ 3 * n) (hk : k = n - l)
    (hC1 : C1 = A / b ^ l * (B / b ^ l) / b ^ (k - l))
    (hC2 : C2 * b ^ l ≤ A % b ^ l * (B / b ^ k))
    (hC2' : A % b ^ l * (B / b ^ k) < (C2 + 3 * (l - 1) + 1) * b ^ l)
    (hC3 : C3 * b ^ l ≤ A / b ^ k * (B % b ^ l))
    (hC3' : A / b ^ k * (B % b ^ l) < (C3 + 3 * (l - 1) + 1) * b ^ l) :
    (C1 + C2 + C3) * b ^ n ≤ A * B ∧ A * B < (C1 + C2 + C3 + 3 * (n - 1) + 1) * b ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hn4 : 4 ≤ n := by omega
  have hlk : l ≤ k := by omega
  set L := b ^ l with hL
  set K := b ^ k with hK
  set M := b ^ (k - l) with hM
  set N := b ^ n with hN
  have hL0 : 0 < L := pow_pos hb l
  have hK0 : 0 < K := pow_pos hb k
  have hM0 : 0 < M := pow_pos hb _
  have hKML : K = M * L := by rw [hK, hM, hL, ← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  have hNLK : N = L * K := by rw [hN, hL, hK, ← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  have hNMLL : N = M * L * L := by rw [hNLK, hKML]; ring
  have hLLN : L * L ≤ N := by
    rw [hN, hL, ← pow_add]; exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right hb (by omega)
  set Ah := A / L with hAh
  set Al := A % L with hAl
  set Bh := B / L with hBh
  set Bl := B % L with hBl
  set Ak := A / K with hAk
  set Bk := B / K with hBk
  have hAeq : A = L * Ah + Al := (Nat.div_add_mod A L).symm
  have hBeq : B = L * Bh + Bl := (Nat.div_add_mod B L).symm
  have hAl_lt : Al < L := Nat.mod_lt _ hL0
  have hBl_lt : Bl < L := Nat.mod_lt _ hL0
  have hAk_eq : Ak = Ah / M := by rw [hAk, hAh, Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, hKML, mul_comm]
  have hBk_eq : Bk = Bh / M := by rw [hBk, hBh, Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, hKML, mul_comm]
  have hAh_eq : Ah = M * Ak + Ah % M := by rw [hAk_eq]; exact (Nat.div_add_mod Ah M).symm
  have hBh_eq : Bh = M * Bk + Bh % M := by rw [hBk_eq]; exact (Nat.div_add_mod Bh M).symm
  have hAm_lt : Ah % M < M := Nat.mod_lt _ hM0
  have hBm_lt : Bh % M < M := Nat.mod_lt _ hM0
  have hAB : A * B = Ah * Bh * (L * L) + Ah * Bl * L + Al * Bh * L + Al * Bl := by
    rw [hAeq, hBeq]; ring
  
  have hC1a : C1 * M ≤ Ah * Bh := by rw [hC1]; exact Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
  have hC1b : Ah * Bh < M * (C1 + 1) := by rw [hC1]; exact Nat.lt_mul_div_succ _ hM0
  constructor
  · 
    have e1 : C1 * N ≤ Ah * Bh * (L * L) := by
      calc C1 * N = C1 * M * (L * L) := by rw [hNMLL]; ring
        _ ≤ Ah * Bh * (L * L) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hC1a
    have e2 : C2 * N ≤ Al * Bh * L := by
      calc C2 * N = C2 * L * K := by rw [hNLK]; ring
        _ ≤ Al * Bk * K := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hC2
        _ = Al * (M * Bk) * L := by rw [hKML]; ring
        _ ≤ Al * Bh * L := by
            have : M * Bk ≤ Bh := by rw [hBh_eq]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
            exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ this)
    have e3 : C3 * N ≤ Ah * Bl * L := by
      calc C3 * N = C3 * L * K := by rw [hNLK]; ring
        _ ≤ Ak * Bl * K := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hC3
        _ = (M * Ak) * Bl * L := by rw [hKML]; ring
        _ ≤ Ah * Bl * L := by
            have : M * Ak ≤ Ah := by rw [hAh_eq]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
            exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ this)
    have : (C1 + C2 + C3) * N = C1 * N + C2 * N + C3 * N := by ring
    rw [this, hAB]
    omega
  · 
    have u1 : Ah * Bh * (L * L) < (C1 + 1) * N := by
      calc Ah * Bh * (L * L) < M * (C1 + 1) * (L * L) := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hC1b (by positivity)
        _ = (C1 + 1) * N := by rw [hNMLL]; ring
    have u2 : Al * Bh * L < (C2 + 3 * (l - 1) + 1) * N + N := by
      have hsplit : Al * Bh * L = Al * Bk * K + Al * (Bh % M) * L := by
        calc Al * Bh * L = Al * (M * Bk + Bh % M) * L := by rw [← hBh_eq]
          _ = Al * Bk * K + Al * (Bh % M) * L := by rw [hKML]; ring
      have ha : Al * Bk * K < (C2 + 3 * (l - 1) + 1) * N := by
        calc Al * Bk * K < (C2 + 3 * (l - 1) + 1) * L * K := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hC2' hK0
          _ = (C2 + 3 * (l - 1) + 1) * N := by rw [hNLK]; ring
      have hb' : Al * (Bh % M) * L < N := by
        calc Al * (Bh % M) * L < L * M * L := by
              apply Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right _ hL0
              exact Nat.mul_lt_mul'' hAl_lt hBm_lt
          _ = N := by rw [hNMLL]; ring
      omega
    have u3 : Ah * Bl * L < (C3 + 3 * (l - 1) + 1) * N + N := by
      have hsplit : Ah * Bl * L = Ak * Bl * K + (Ah % M) * Bl * L := by
        calc Ah * Bl * L = (M * Ak + Ah % M) * Bl * L := by rw [← hAh_eq]
          _ = Ak * Bl * K + (Ah % M) * Bl * L := by rw [hKML]; ring
      have ha : Ak * Bl * K < (C3 + 3 * (l - 1) + 1) * N := by
        calc Ak * Bl * K < (C3 + 3 * (l - 1) + 1) * L * K := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hC3' hK0
          _ = (C3 + 3 * (l - 1) + 1) * N := by rw [hNLK]; ring
      have hb' : (Ah % M) * Bl * L < N := by
        calc (Ah % M) * Bl * L < M * L * L := by
              apply Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right _ hL0
              exact Nat.mul_lt_mul'' hAm_lt hBl_lt
          _ = N := hNMLL.symm
      omega
    have u4 : Al * Bl < N := lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.mul_lt_mul'' hAl_lt hBl_lt) hLLN
    have hsum : (C1 + 1) * N + ((C2 + 3 * (l - 1) + 1) * N + N) + ((C3 + 3 * (l - 1) + 1) * N + N)
        + N = (C1 + C2 + C3 + 6 * l) * N := by
      have : 6 * (l - 1) + 6 = 6 * l := by omega
      calc _ = (C1 + C2 + C3 + (6 * (l - 1) + 6)) * N := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [this]
    have hfin : (C1 + C2 + C3 + 6 * l) * N ≤ (C1 + C2 + C3 + 3 * (n - 1) + 1) * N :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
    rw [hAB]
    omega

name: Azurite.AzNat.mulHighFuel_spec
statement:
theorem mulHighFuel_spec (n₀ : Nat) (hn₀ : 3 ≤ n₀) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (A B : AzNat) (n : Nat), n ≤ fuel + n₀ →
      A.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * n) → B.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * n) →
      (mulHighFuel n₀ fuel A B n).toNat * 2 ^ (64 * n) ≤ A.toNat * B.toNat ∧
        A.toNat * B.toNat < ((mulHighFuel n₀ fuel A B n).toNat + 3 * (n - 1) + 1) * 2 ^ (64 * n)
  | 0, A, B, n, _, _, _ => by
    simp only [mulHighFuel]
    rw [toNat_shr_pow, toNat_mul]
    have hb0 : 0 < (2 : ℕ) ^ (64 * n)
proof:
:= Nat.two_pow_pos _
    refine ⟨Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _, ?_⟩
    have := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ (A.toNat * B.toNat) hb0
    calc A.toNat * B.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * n) * (A.toNat * B.toNat / 2 ^ (64 * n) + 1) := this
      _ ≤ (A.toNat * B.toNat / 2 ^ (64 * n) + 3 * (n - 1) + 1) * 2 ^ (64 * n) := by
          rw [mul_comm]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
  | fuel + 1, A, B, n, hnf, hA, hB => by
    by_cases hn : n ≤ n₀
    · simp only [mulHighFuel, hn, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [toNat_shr_pow, toNat_mul]
      have hb0 : 0 < (2 : ℕ) ^ (64 * n) := Nat.two_pow_pos _
      refine ⟨Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _, ?_⟩
      have := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ (A.toNat * B.toNat) hb0
      calc A.toNat * B.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * n) * (A.toNat * B.toNat / 2 ^ (64 * n) + 1) := this
        _ ≤ (A.toNat * B.toNat / 2 ^ (64 * n) + 3 * (n - 1) + 1) * 2 ^ (64 * n) := by
            rw [mul_comm]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
    · simp only [mulHighFuel, hn, ↓reduceIte]
      set l := shortSplit n with hl
      set k := n - l with hk
      have hl10 := shortSplit_le n
      have hl1 : 1 ≤ l := shortSplit_pos (by omega)
      have hL0 : 0 < (2 : ℕ) ^ (64 * l) := Nat.two_pow_pos _
      have hK0 : 0 < (2 : ℕ) ^ (64 * k) := Nat.two_pow_pos _
      have hnkl : (2 : ℕ) ^ (64 * n) = 2 ^ (64 * k) * 2 ^ (64 * l) := by
        rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
      have hBk : (B >>> (64 * k)).toNat < 2 ^ (64 * l) := by
        rw [toNat_shr_pow, Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hK0, mul_comm, ← hnkl]; exact hB
      have hAk : (A >>> (64 * k)).toNat < 2 ^ (64 * l) := by
        rw [toNat_shr_pow, Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hK0, mul_comm, ← hnkl]; exact hA
      have hAl : (A.modPow2 (64 * l)).toNat < 2 ^ (64 * l) := by
        rw [toNat_modPow2]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ hL0
      have hBl : (B.modPow2 (64 * l)).toNat < 2 ^ (64 * l) := by
        rw [toNat_modPow2]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ hL0
      obtain ⟨h2, h2'⟩ := mulHighFuel_spec n₀ hn₀ fuel (A.modPow2 (64 * l)) (B >>> (64 * k)) l
        (by omega) hAl hBk
      obtain ⟨h3, h3'⟩ := mulHighFuel_spec n₀ hn₀ fuel (A >>> (64 * k)) (B.modPow2 (64 * l)) l
        (by omega) hAk hBl
      rw [toNat_modPow2, toNat_shr_pow] at h2 h2' h3 h3'
      rw [toNat_add, toNat_add, toNat_shr_pow, toNat_mul, toNat_shr_pow, toNat_shr_pow]
      simp only [two_pow_64_mul] at h2 h2' h3 h3' hA hB ⊢
      exact mulHigh_step_bounds (b := 2 ^ 64) (by norm_num) hl1 hl10 hk rfl h2 h2' h3 h3'

name: Azurite.AzNat.mulHigh_spec
statement:
theorem mulHigh_spec (n₀ : Nat) (hn₀ : 3 ≤ n₀) (A B : AzNat) (n : Nat)
    (hA : A.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * n)) (hB : B.toNat < 2 ^ (64 * n)) :
    (mulHigh n₀ A B n).toNat * 2 ^ (64 * n) ≤ A.toNat * B.toNat ∧
      A.toNat * B.toNat < ((mulHigh n₀ A B n).toNat + 3 * (n - 1) + 1) * 2 ^ (64 * n)
proof:
:=
  mulHighFuel_spec n₀ hn₀ n A B n (by omega) hA hB

name: Azurite.AzNat.SSPlan.ofLimbs_bits
statement: theorem ofLimbs_bits (L : Nat) : 64 * L ≤ (ofLimbs L).bits
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofLimbs bits
  have := ssParams_le L
  dsimp only
  calc 64 * L ≤ 64 * ((ssParams L).2 * 2 ^ ((ssParams L).1 + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ this
    _ = 64 * (ssParams L).2 * 2 ^ ((ssParams L).1 + 1) := by ring

name: Azurite.AzNat.SSPlan.mulModF_transform_toNat
statement:
theorem mulModF_transform_toNat (p : SSPlan) (mulFn : AzNat → AzNat → AzNat)
    (hmul : ∀ x y : AzNat, (mulFn x y).toNat = x.toNat * y.toNat) (A B : AzNat)
    (hA : A.toNat < 2 ^ p.bits) (hB : B.toNat < 2 ^ p.bits) :
    (p.mulModF mulFn (p.transform A) (p.transform_size A) B).val.toNat
      = (A.toNat * B.toNat) % (2 ^ p.bits + 1)
proof:
:=
  fftMulModWith_toNat p.k p.w p.N p.hw0 (ssFermatExponent_ge p.k p.w)
    (two_pow_dvd_ssFermatExponent p.k p.w) mulFn hmul A B hA hB

name: Azurite.AzNat.SSPlan.mulModF'_toNat
statement:
theorem mulModF'_toNat (p : SSPlan) (mulFn : AzNat → AzNat → AzNat)
    (hmul : ∀ x y : AzNat, (mulFn x y).toNat = x.toNat * y.toNat) (A B : AzNat)
    (hA : A.toNat < 2 ^ p.bits) (hB : B.toNat < 2 ^ p.bits) :
    (p.mulModF' mulFn A B).val.toNat = (A.toNat * B.toNat) % (2 ^ p.bits + 1)
proof:
:=
  p.mulModF_transform_toNat mulFn hmul A B hA hB

name: Azurite.AzNat.sliceToNat_lt_pow
statement:
